name: Shanti Parva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRitodakAste suhRRidAM sarveShAM pANDunandanAH |
viduro dhRRitarAShTrashcha sarvAshcha bharatastriyaH
shlokas.2:
tatra te sumahAtmAno nyavasankurunandanAH |
shauchaM nivartayiShyanto mAsamekaM bahiH purAt
shlokas.3:
kRRitodakaM tu rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
abhijagmurmahAtmAnaH siddhA brahmarShisattamAH
shlokas.4:
dvaipAyano nAradashcha devalashcha mahAnRRiShiH |
devasthAnashcha kaNvashcha teShAM shiShyAshcha sattamAH
shlokas.5:
anye cha vedavidvA.nsaH kRRitapraj~nA dvijAtayaH |
gRRihasthAH snAtakAH sarve dadRRishuH kurusattamam
shlokas.6:
abhigamya mahAtmAnaH pUjitAshcha yathAvidhi |
AsaneShu mahArheShu vivishuste maharShayaH
shlokas.7:
pratigRRihya tataH pUjAM tatkAlasadRRishIM tadA |
paryupAsanyathAnyAyaM parivArya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.8:
puNye bhAgIrathItIre shokavyAkulachetasam |
AshvAsayanto rAjAnaM viprAH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
nAradastvabravItkAle dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
vichArya munibhiH sArdhaM tatkAlasadRRishaM vachaH
shlokas.10:
bhavato bAhuvIryeNa prasAdAnmAdhavasya cha |
jiteyamavaniH kRRitsnA dharmeNa cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.11:
diShTyA muktAH stha sa~NgrAmAdasmAllokabhaya~NkarAt |
kShatradharmaratashchApi kachchinmodasi pANDava
shlokas.12:
kachchichcha nihatAmitraH prINAsi suhRRido nRRipa |
kachchichChriyamimAM prApya na tvAM shokaH prabAdhate
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vijiteyaM mahI kRRitsnA kRRiShNabAhubalAshrayAt |
brAhmaNAnAM prasAdena bhImArjunabalena cha
shlokas.14:
idaM tu me mahadduHkhaM vartate hRRidi nityadA |
kRRitvA j~nAtikShayamimaM mahAntaM lobhakAritam
shlokas.15:
saubhadraM draupadeyA.nshcha ghAtayitvA priyAnsutAn |
jayo.ayamajayAkAro bhagavanpratibhAti me
shlokas.16:
kiM nu vakShyati vArShNeyI vadhUrme madhusUdanam |
dvArakAvAsinI kRRiShNamitaH pratigataM harim
shlokas.17:
draupadI hataputreyaM kRRipaNA hatabAndhavA |
asmatpriyahite yuktA bhUyaH pIDayatIva mAm
shlokas.18:
idamanyachcha bhagavanyattvAM vakShyAmi nArada |
mantrasa.nvaraNenAsmi kuntyA duHkhena yojitaH
shlokas.19:
yo.asau nAgAyutabalo loke.apratiratho raNe |
siMhakhelagatirdhImAnghRRiNI dAnto yatavrataH
shlokas.20:
Ashrayo dhArtarAShTrANAM mAnI tIkShNaparAkramaH |
amarShI nityasa.nrambhI kSheptAsmAkaM raNe raNe
shlokas.21:
shIghrAstrashchitrayodhI cha kRRitI chAdbhutavikramaH |
gUDhotpannaH sutaH kuntyA bhrAtAsmAkaM cha sodaraH
shlokas.22:
toyakarmaNi yaM kuntI kathayAmAsa sUryajam |
putraM sarvaguNopetamavakIrNaM jale purA
shlokas.23:
yaM sUtaputraM loko.ayaM rAdheyaM chApyamanyata |
sa jyeShThaputraH kuntyA vai bhrAtAsmAkaM cha mAtRRijaH
shlokas.24:
ajAnatA mayA sa~Nkhye rAjyalubdhena ghAtitaH |
tanme dahati gAtrANi tUlarAshimivAnalaH
shlokas.25:
na hi taM veda pArtho.api bhrAtaraM shvetavAhanaH |
nAhaM na bhImo na yamau sa tvasmAnveda suvrataH
shlokas.26:
gatA kila pRRithA tasya sakAshamiti naH shrutam |
asmAkaM shamakAmA vai tvaM cha putro mametyatha
shlokas.27:
pRRithAyA na kRRitaH kAmastena chApi mahAtmanA |
atipashchAdidaM mAtaryavochaditi naH shrutam
shlokas.28:
na hi shakShyAmyahaM tyaktuM nRRipaM duryodhanaM raNe |
anAryaM cha nRRisha.nsaM cha kRRitaghnaM cha hi me bhavet
shlokas.29:
yudhiShThireNa sandhiM cha yadi kuryAM mate tava |
bhIto raNe shvetavAhAditi mAM ma.nsyate janaH
shlokas.30:
so.ahaM nirjitya samare vijayaM sahakeshavam |
sandhAsye dharmaputreNa pashchAditi cha so.abravIt
shlokas.31:
tamavochatkila pRRithA punaH pRRithulavakShasam |
chaturNAmabhayaM dehi kAmaM yudhyasva phalgunam
shlokas.32:
so.abravInmAtaraM dhImAnvepamAnaH kRRitA~njaliH |
prAptAnviShahyA.nshchaturo na haniShyAmi te sutAn
shlokas.33:
pa~nchaiva hi sutA mAtarbhaviShyanti hi te dhruvam |
sakarNA vA hate pArthe sArjunA vA hate mayi
shlokas.34:
taM putragRRiddhinI bhUyo mAtA putramathAbravIt |
bhrAtR^INAM svasti kurvIthA yeShAM svasti chikIrShasi
shlokas.35:
tamevamuktvA tu pRRithA visRRijyopayayau gRRihAn |
so.arjunena hato vIro bhrAtA bhrAtrA sahodaraH
shlokas.36:
na chaiva vivRRito mantraH pRRithAyAstasya vA mune |
atha shUro maheShvAsaH pArthenAsau nipAtitaH
shlokas.37:
ahaM tvaj~nAsiShaM pashchAtsvasodaryaM dvijottama |
pUrvajaM bhrAtaraM karNaM pRRithAyA vachanAtprabho
shlokas.38:
tena me dUyate.atIva hRRidayaM bhrAtRRighAtinaH |
karNArjunasahAyo.ahaM jayeyamapi vAsavam
shlokas.39:
sabhAyAM klishyamAnasya dhArtarAShTrairdurAtmabhiH |
sahasotpatitaH krodhaH karNaM dRRiShTvA prashAmyati
shlokas.40:
yadA hyasya giro rUkShAH shRRiNomi kaTukodayAH |
sabhAyAM gadato dyUte duryodhanahitaiShiNaH
shlokas.41:
tadA nashyati me krodhaH pAdau tasya nirIkShya ha |
kuntyA hi sadRRishau pAdau karNasyeti matirmama
shlokas.42:
sAdRRishyahetumanvichChanpRRithAyAstava chaiva ha |
kAraNaM nAdhigachChAmi katha~nchidapi chintayan
shlokas.43:
kathaM nu tasya sa~NgrAme pRRithivI chakramagrasat |
kathaM cha shapto bhrAtA me tattvaM vaktumihArhasi
shlokas.44:
shrotumichChAmi bhagava.nstvattaH sarvaM yathAtatham |
bhavAnhi sarvavidvidvA.Nlloke veda kRRitAkRRitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa evamuktastu munirnArado vadatAM varaH |
kathayAmAsa tatsarvaM yathA shaptaH sa sUtajaH
shlokas.2:
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
na karNArjunayoH ki~nchidaviShahyaM bhavedraNe
shlokas.3:
guhyametattu devAnAM kathayiShyAmi te nRRipa |
tannibodha mahArAja yathA vRRittamidaM purA
shlokas.4:
kShatraM svargaM kathaM gachChechChastrapUtamiti prabho |
sa~NgharShajananastasmAtkanyAgarbho vinirmitaH
shlokas.5:
sa bAlastejasA yuktaH sUtaputratvamAgataH |
chakArA~NgirasAM shreShThe dhanurvedaM gurau tava
shlokas.6:
sa balaM bhImasenasya phalgunasya cha lAghavam |
buddhiM cha tava rAjendra yamayorvinayaM tathA
shlokas.7:
sakhyaM cha vAsudevena bAlye gANDivadhanvanaH |
prajAnAmanurAgaM cha chintayAno vyadahyata
shlokas.8:
sa sakhyamagamadbAlye rAj~nA duryodhanena vai |
yuShmAbhirnityasa.ndviShTo daivAchchApi svabhAvataH
shlokas.9:
vidyAdhikamathAlakShya dhanurvede dhana~njayam |
droNaM rahasyupAgamya karNo vachanamabravIt
shlokas.10:
brahmAstraM vettumichChAmi sarahasyanivartanam |
arjunena samo yuddhe bhaveyamiti me matiH
shlokas.11:
samaH putreShu cha snehaH shiShyeShu cha tava dhruvam |
tvatprasAdAnna mAM brUyurakRRitAstraM vichakShaNAH
shlokas.12:
droNastathoktaH karNena sApekShaH phalgunaM prati |
daurAtmyaM chApi karNasya viditvA tamuvAcha ha
shlokas.13:
brahmAstraM brAhmaNo vidyAdyathAvachcharitavrataH |
kShatriyo vA tapasvI yo nAnyo vidyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.14:
ityukto.a~NgirasAM shreShThamAmantrya pratipUjya cha |
jagAma sahasA rAmaM mahendraM parvataM prati
shlokas.15:
sa tu rAmamupAgamya shirasAbhipraNamya cha |
brAhmaNo bhArgavo.asmIti gauraveNAbhyagachChata
shlokas.16:
rAmastaM pratijagrAha pRRiShTvA gotrAdi sarvashaH |
uShyatAM svAgataM cheti prItimA.nshchAbhavadbhRRisham
shlokas.17:
tatra karNasya vasato mahendre parvatottame |
gandharvai rAkShasairyakShairdevaishchAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.18:
sa tatreShvastramakarodbhRRigushreShThAdyathAvidhi |
priyashchAbhavadatyarthaM devagandharvarakShasAm
shlokas.19:
sa kadAchitsamudrAnte vicharannAshramAntike |
ekaH khaDgadhanuShpANiH parichakrAma sUtajaH
shlokas.20:
so.agnihotraprasaktasya kasyachidbrahmavAdinaH |
jaghAnAj~nAnataH pArtha homadhenuM yadRRichChayA
shlokas.21:
tadaj~nAnakRRitaM matvA brAhmaNAya nyavedayat |
karNaH prasAdaya.nshchainamidamityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.22:
abuddhipUrvaM bhagavandhenureShA hatA tava |
mayA tatra prasAdaM me kuruShveti punaH punaH
shlokas.23:
taM sa vipro.abravItkruddho vAchA nirbhartsayanniva |
durAchAra vadhArhastvaM phalaM prApnuhi durmate
shlokas.24:
yena vispardhase nityaM yadarthaM ghaTase.anisham |
yudhyatastena te pApa bhUmishchakraM grasiShyati
shlokas.25:
tatashchakre mahIgraste mUrdhAnaM te vichetasaH |
pAtayiShyati vikramya shatrurgachCha narAdhama
shlokas.26:
yatheyaM gaurhatA mUDha pramattena tvayA mama |
pramattasyaivamevAnyaH shiraste pAtayiShyati
shlokas.27:
tataH prasAdayAmAsa punastaM dvijasattamam |
gobhirdhanaishcha ratnaishcha sa chainaM punarabravIt
shlokas.28:
nedaM madvyAhRRitaM kuryAtsarvaloko.api vai mRRiShA |
gachCha vA tiShTha vA yadvA kAryaM te tatsamAchara
shlokas.29:
ityukto brAhmaNenAtha karNo dainyAdadhomukhaH |
rAmamabhyAgamadbhItastadeva manasA smaran

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
karNasya bAhuvIryeNa prashrayeNa damena cha |
tutoSha bhRRigushArdUlo gurushushrUShayA tathA
shlokas.2:
tasmai sa vidhivatkRRitsnaM brahmAstraM sanivartanam |
provAchAkhilamavyagraM tapasvI sutapasvine
shlokas.3:
viditAstrastataH karNo ramamANo.a.ashrame bhRRigoH |
chakAra vai dhanurvede yatnamadbhutavikramaH
shlokas.4:
tataH kadAchidrAmastu charannAshramamantikAt |
karNena sahito dhImAnupavAsena karshitaH
shlokas.5:
suShvApa jAmadagnyo vai visrambhotpannasauhRRidaH |
karNasyotsa~Nga AdhAya shiraH klAntamanA guruH
shlokas.6:
atha kRRimiH shleShmamayo mA.nsashoNitabhojanaH |
dAruNo dAruNasparshaH karNasyAbhyAshamAgamat
shlokas.7:
sa tasyorumathAsAdya bibheda rudhirAshanaH |
na chainamashakatkSheptuM hantuM vApi gurorbhayAt
shlokas.8:
sa.ndashyamAno.api tathA kRRimiNA tena bhArata |
guruprabodhasha~NkI cha tamupaikShata sUtajaH
shlokas.9:
karNastu vedanAM dhairyAdasahyAM vinigRRihya tAm |
akampannavyatha.nshchaiva dhArayAmAsa bhArgavam
shlokas.10:
yadA tu rudhireNA~Nge parispRRiShTo bhRRigUdvahaH |
tadAbudhyata tejasvI santaptashchedamabravIt
shlokas.11:
aho.asmyashuchitAM prAptaH kimidaM kriyate tvayA |
kathayasva bhayaM tyaktvA yAthAtathyamidaM mama
shlokas.12:
tasya karNastadAchaShTa kRRimiNA paribhakShaNam |
dadarsha rAmastaM chApi kRRimiM sUkarasaMnibham
shlokas.13:
aShTapAdaM tIkShNadaMShTraM sUchIbhiriva sa.nvRRitam |
romabhiH saMniruddhA~NgamalarkaM nAma nAmataH
shlokas.14:
sa dRRiShTamAtro rAmeNa kRRimiH prANAnavAsRRijat |
tasminnevAsRRiksa~Nklinne tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.15:
tato.antarikShe dadRRishe vishvarUpaH karAlavAn |
rAkShaso lohitagrIvaH kRRiShNA~Ngo meghavAhanaH
shlokas.16:
sa rAmaM prA~njalirbhUtvA babhAShe pUrNamAnasaH |
svasti te bhRRigushArdUla gamiShyAmi yathAgatam
shlokas.17:
mokShito narakAdasmi bhavatA munisattama |
bhadraM cha te.astu nandishcha priyaM me bhavatA kRRitam
shlokas.18:
tamuvAcha mahAbAhurjAmadagnyaH pratApavAn |
kastvaM kasmAchcha narakaM pratipanno bravIhi tat
shlokas.19:
so.abravIdahamAsaM prAggRRitso nAma mahAsuraH |
purA devayuge tAta bhRRigostulyavayA iva
shlokas.20:
so.ahaM bhRRigoH sudayitAM bhAryAmapaharaM balAt |
maharSherabhishApena kRRimibhUto.apataM bhuvi
shlokas.21:
abravIttu sa mAM krodhAttava pUrvapitAmahaH |
mUtrashleShmAshanaH pApa nirayaM pratipatsyase
shlokas.22:
shApasyAnto bhavedbrahmannityevaM tamathAbruvam |
bhavitA bhArgave rAma iti mAmabravIdbhRRiguH
shlokas.23:
so.ahametAM gatiM prApto yathA nakushalaM tathA |
tvayA sAdho samAgamya vimuktaH pApayonitaH
shlokas.24:
evamuktvA namaskRRitya yayau rAmaM mahAsuraH |
rAmaH karNaM tu sakrodhamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.25:
atiduHkhamidaM mUDha na jAtu brAhmaNaH sahet |
kShatriyasyaiva te dhairyaM kAmayA satyamuchyatAm
shlokas.26:
tamuvAcha tataH karNaH shApabhItaH prasAdayan |
brahmakShatrAntare sUtaM jAtaM mAM viddhi bhArgava
shlokas.27:
rAdheyaH karNa iti mAM pravadanti janA bhuvi |
prasAdaM kuru me brahmannastralubdhasya bhArgava
shlokas.28:
pitA gururna sa.ndeho vedavidyApradaH prabhuH |
ato bhArgava ityuktaM mayA gotraM tavAntike
shlokas.29:
tamuvAcha bhRRigushreShThaH saroShaH prahasanniva |
bhUmau nipatitaM dInaM vepamAnaM kRRitA~njalim
shlokas.30:
yasmAnmithyopacharito astralobhAdiha tvayA |
tasmAdetaddhi te mUDha brahmAstraM pratibhAsyati
shlokas.31:
anyatra vadhakAlAtte sadRRishena sameyuShaH |
abrAhmaNe na hi brahma dhruvaM tiShThetkadAchana
shlokas.32:
gachChedAnIM na te sthAnamanRRitasyeha vidyate |
na tvayA sadRRisho yuddhe bhavitA kShatriyo bhuvi
shlokas.33:
evamuktastu rAmeNa nyAyenopajagAma saH |
duryodhanamupAgamya kRRitAstro.asmIti chAbravIt

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
karNastu samavApyaitadastraM bhArgavanandanAt |
duryodhanena sahito mumude bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
tataH kadAchidrAjAnaH samAjagmuH svaya.nvare |
kali~NgaviShaye rAjanrAj~nashchitrA~Ngadasya cha
shlokas.3:
shrImadrAjapuraM nAma nagaraM tatra bhArata |
rAjAnaH shatashastatra kanyArthaM samupAgaman
shlokas.4:
shrutvA duryodhanastatra sametAnsarvapArthivAn |
rathena kA~nchanA~Ngena karNena sahito yayau
shlokas.5:
tataH svaya.nvare tasminsampravRRitte mahotsave |
samApeturnRRipatayaH kanyArthe nRRipasattama
shlokas.6:
shishupAlo jarAsandho bhIShmako vakra eva cha |
kapotaromA nIlashcha rukmI cha dRRiDhavikramaH
shlokas.7:
sRRigAlashcha mahArAja strIrAjyAdhipatishcha yaH |
ashokaH shatadhanvA cha bhojo vIrashcha nAmataH
shlokas.8:
ete chAnye cha bahavo dakShiNAM dishamAshritAH |
mlechChAchAryAshcha rAjAnaH prAchyodIchyAshcha bhArata
shlokas.9:
kA~nchanA~NgadinaH sarve baddhajAmbUnadasrajaH |
sarve bhAsvaradehAshcha vyAghrA iva madotkaTAH
shlokas.10:
tataH samupaviShTeShu teShu rAjasu bhArata |
vivesha ra~NgaM sA kanyA dhAtrIvarShadharAnvitA
shlokas.11:
tataH sa.nshrAvyamANeShu rAj~nAM nAmasu bhArata |
atyakrAmaddhArtarAShTraM sA kanyA varavarNinI
shlokas.12:
duryodhanastu kauravyo nAmarShayata la~Nghanam |
pratyaShedhachcha tAM kanyAmasatkRRitya narAdhipAn
shlokas.13:
sa vIryamadamattatvAdbhIShmadroNAvupAshritaH |
rathamAropya tAM kanyAmAjuhAva narAdhipAn
shlokas.14:
tamanvayAdrathI khaDgI bhaddhagodhA~NgulitravAn |
karNaH shastrabhRRitAM shreShThaH pRRiShThataH puruSharShabha
shlokas.15:
tato vimardaH sumahAnrAj~nAmAsIdyudhiShThira |
saMnahyatAM tanutrANi rathAnyojayatAmapi
shlokas.16:
te.abhyadhAvanta sa~NkruddhAH karNaduryodhanAvubhau |
sharavarShANi mu~nchanto meghAH parvatayoriva
shlokas.17:
karNasteShAmApatatAmekaikena kShureNa ha |
dhanUMShi sasharAvApAnyapAtayata bhUtale
shlokas.18:
tato vidhanuShaH kA.nshchitkA.nshchidudyatakArmukAn |
kA.nshchidudvahato bANAnrathashaktigadAstathA
shlokas.19:
lAghavAdAkulIkRRitya karNaH praharatAM varaH |
hatasUtA.nshcha bhUyiShThAnavajigye narAdhipAn
shlokas.20:
te svayaM tvarayanto.ashvAnyAhi yAhIti vAdinaH |
vyapeyuste raNaM hitvA rAjAno bhagnamAnasAH
shlokas.21:
duryodhanastu karNena pAlyamAno.abhyayAttadA |
hRRiShTaH kanyAmupAdAya nagaraM nAgasAhvayam

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
AviShkRRitabalaM karNaM j~nAtvA rAjA tu mAgadhaH |
AhvayaddvairathenAjau jarAsandho mahIpatiH
shlokas.2:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM divyAstraviduShordvayoH |
yudhi nAnApraharaNairanyonyamabhivarShatoH
shlokas.3:
kShINabANau vidhanuShau bhagnakhaDgau mahIM gatau |
bAhubhiH samasajjetAmubhAvapi balAnvitau
shlokas.4:
bAhukaNTakayuddhena tasya karNo.atha yudhyataH |
bibheda sandhiM dehasya jarayA shleShitasya ha
shlokas.5:
sa vikAraM sharIrasya dRRiShTvA nRRipatirAtmanaH |
prIto.asmItyabravItkarNaM vairamutsRRijya bhArata
shlokas.6:
prItyA dadau sa karNAya mAlinIM nagarImatha |
a~NgeShu narashArdUla sa rAjAsItsapatnajit
shlokas.7:
pAlayAmAsa champAM tu karNaH parabalArdanaH |
duryodhanasyAnumate tavApi viditaM tathA
shlokas.8:
evaM shastrapratApena prathitaH so.abhavatkShitau |
tvaddhitArthaM surendreNa bhikShito varmakuNDale
shlokas.9:
sa divye sahaje prAdAtkuNDale paramArchite |
sahajaM kavachaM chaiva mohito devamAyayA
shlokas.10:
vimuktaH kuNDalAbhyAM cha sahajena cha varmaNA |
nihato vijayenAjau vAsudevasya pashyataH
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNasyAbhishApena rAmasya cha mahAtmanaH |
kuntyAshcha varadAnena mAyayA cha shatakratoH
shlokas.12:
bhIShmAvamAnAtsa~NkhyAyAM rathAnAmardhakIrtanAt |
shalyAttejovadhAchchApi vAsudevanayena cha
shlokas.13:
rudrasya devarAjasya yamasya varuNasya cha |
kuberadroNayoshchaiva kRRipasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
astrANi divyAnyAdAya yudhi gANDIvadhanvanA |
hato vaikartanaH karNo divAkarasamadyutiH
shlokas.15:
evaM shaptastava bhrAtA bahubhishchApi va~nchitaH |
na shochyaH sa naravyAghro yuddhe hi nidhanaM gataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA devarShirvirarAma sa nAradaH |
yudhiShThirastu rAjarShirdadhyau shokapariplutaH
shlokas.2:
taM dInamanasaM vIramadhovadanamAturam |
niHshvasantaM yathA nAgaM paryashrunayanaM tathA
shlokas.3:
kuntI shokaparItA~NgI duHkhopahatachetanA |
abravInmadhurAbhAShA kAle vachanamarthavat
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho nainaM shochitumarhasi |
jahi shokaM mahAprAj~na shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.5:
yatitaH sa mayA pUrvaM bhrAtryaM j~nApayituM tava |
bhAskareNa cha devena pitrA dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.6:
yadvAchyaM hitakAmena suhRRidA bhUtimichChatA |
tathA divAkareNoktaH svapnAnte mama chAgrataH
shlokas.7:
na chainamashakadbhAnurahaM vA snehakAraNaiH |
purA pratyanunetuM vA netuM vApyekatAM tvayA
shlokas.8:
tataH kAlaparItaH sa vairasyoddhukShaNe rataH |
pratIpakArI yuShmAkamiti chopekShito mayA
shlokas.9:
ityukto dharmarAjastu mAtrA bAShpAkulekShaNaH |
uvAcha vAkyaM dharmAtmA shokavyAkulachetanaH
shlokas.10:
bhavatyA gUDhamantratvAtpIDito.asmItyuvAcha tAm |
shashApa cha mahAtejAH sarvalokeShu cha striyaH
na guhyaM dhArayiShyantItyatiduHkhasamanvitaH
shlokas.11:
sa rAjA putrapautrANAM sambandhisuhRRidAM tathA |
smarannudvignahRRidayo babhUvAsvasthachetanaH
shlokas.12:
tataH shokaparItAtmA sadhUma iva pAvakaH |
nirvedamakaroddhImAnrAjA santApapIDitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirastu dharmAtmA shokavyAkulachetanaH |
shushocha duHkhasantaptaH smRRitvA karNaM mahAratham
shlokas.2:
AviShTo duHkhashokAbhyAM niHshvasa.nshcha punaH punaH |
dRRiShTvArjunamuvAchedaM vachanaM shokakarshitaH
shlokas.3:
yadbhaikShamAchariShyAma vRRiShNyandhakapure vayam |
j~nAtInniShpuruShAnkRRitvA nemAM prApsyAma durgatim
shlokas.4:
amitrA naH samRRiddhArthA vRRittArthAH kuravaH kila |
AtmAnamAtmanA hatvA kiM dharmaphalamApnumaH
shlokas.5:
dhigastu kShAtramAchAraM dhigastu balamaurasam |
dhigastvamarShaM yenemAmApadaM gamitA vayam
shlokas.6:
sAdhu kShamA damaH shauchamavairodhyamamatsaraH |
ahi.nsA satyavachanaM nityAni vanachAriNAm
shlokas.7:
vayaM tu lobhAnmohAchcha stambhaM mAnaM cha sa.nshritAH |
imAmavasthAmApannA rAjyaleshabubhukShayA
shlokas.8:
trailokyasyApi rAjyena nAsmAnkashchitpraharShayet |
bAndhavAnnihatAndRRiShTvA pRRithivyAmAmiShaiShiNaH
shlokas.9:
te vayaM pRRithivIhetoravadhyAnpRRithivIsamAn |
samparityajya jIvAmo hInArthA hatabAndhavAH
shlokas.10:
AmiShe gRRidhyamAnAnAmashunAM naH shunAmiva |
AmiShaM chaiva no naShTamAmiShasya cha bhojinaH
shlokas.11:
na pRRithivyA sakalayA na suvarNasya rAshibhiH |
na gavAshvena sarveNa te tyAjyA ya ime hatAH
shlokas.12:
sa.nyuktAH kAmamanyubhyAM krodhAmarShasamanvitAH |
mRRityuyAnaM samAruhya gatA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.13:
bahu kalyANamichChanta Ihante pitaraH sutAn |
tapasA brahmacharyeNa vandanena titikShayA
shlokas.14:
upavAsaistathejyAbhirvratakautukama~NgalaiH |
labhante mAtaro garbhA.nstAnmAsAndasha bibhrati
shlokas.15:
yadi svasti prajAyante jAtA jIvanti vA yadi |
sambhAvitA jAtabalAste dadyuryadi naH sukham
iha chAmutra chaiveti kRRipaNAH phalahetukAH
shlokas.16:
tAsAmayaM samArambho nivRRittaH kevalo.aphalaH |
yadAsAM nihatAH putrA yuvAno mRRiShTakuNDalAH
shlokas.17:
abhuktvA pArthivAnbhogAnRRiNAnyanavadAya cha |
pitRRibhyo devatAbhyashcha gatA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.18:
yadaiShAma~Nga pitarau jAtau kAmamayAviva |
sa~njAtabalarUpeShu tadaiva nihatA nRRipAH
shlokas.19:
sa.nyuktAH kAmamanyubhyAM krodhaharShAsama~njasAH |
na te janmaphalaM ki~nchidbhoktAro jAtu karhichit
shlokas.20:
pA~nchAlAnAM kurUNAM cha hatA eva hi ye.ahatAH |
te vayaM tvadhamA.NllokAnprapadyema svakarmabhiH
shlokas.21:
vayamevAsya lokasya vinAshe kAraNaM smRRitAH |
dhRRitarAShTrasya putreNa nikRRityA pratyapatsmahi
shlokas.22:
sadaiva nikRRitipraj~no dveShTA mAyopajIvanaH |
mithyAvRRittaH sa satatamasmAsvanapakAriShu
shlokas.23:
a.nshakAmA vayaM te cha na chAsmAbhirna tairjitam |
na tairbhukteyamavanirna nAryo gItavAditam
shlokas.24:
nAmAtyasamitau kathyaM na cha shrutavatAM shrutam |
na ratnAni parArdhyAni na bhUrna draviNAgamaH
shlokas.25:
RRiddhimasmAsu tAM dRRiShTvA vivarNo hariNaH kRRishaH |
dhRRitarAShTrasya nRRipateH saubalena niveditaH
shlokas.26:
taM pitA putragRRiddhitvAdanumene.anaye sthitam |
anavekShyaiva pitaraM gA~NgeyaM viduraM tathA
asa.nshayaM dhRRitarAShTro yathaivAhaM tathA gataH
shlokas.27:
aniyamyAshuchiM lubdhaM putraM kAmavashAnugam |
patito yashaso dIptAdghAtayitvA sahodarAn
shlokas.28:
imau vRRiddhau cha shokAgnau prakShipya sa suyodhanaH |
asmatpradveShasa.nyuktaH pApabuddhiH sadaiva hi
shlokas.29:
ko hi bandhuH kulInaH sa.nstathA brUyAtsuhRRijjane |
yathAsAvuktavAnkShudro yuyutsurvRRiShNisaMnidhau
shlokas.30:
Atmano hi vayaM doShAdvinaShTAH shAshvatIH samAH |
pradahanto dishaH sarvAstejasA bhAskarA iva
shlokas.31:
so.asmAkaM vairapuruSho durmantripragrahaM gataH |
duryodhanakRRite hyetatkulaM no vinipAtitam
avadhyAnAM vadhaM kRRitvA loke prAptAH sma vAchyatAm
shlokas.32:
kulasyAsyAntakaraNaM durmatiM pApakAriNam |
rAjA rAShTreshvaraM kRRitvA dhRRitarAShTro.adya shochati
shlokas.33:
hatAH shUrAH kRRitaM pApaM viShayaH svo vinAshitaH |
hatvA no vigato manyuH shoko mAM rundhayatyayam
shlokas.34:
dhana~njaya kRRitaM pApaM kalyANenopahanyate |
tyAgavA.nshcha punaH pApaM nAlaM kartumiti shrutiH
shlokas.35:
tyAgavA~njanmamaraNe nApnotIti shrutiryadA |
prAptavartmA kRRitamatirbrahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.36:
sa dhana~njaya nirdva.ndvo munirj~nAnasamanvitaH |
vanamAmantrya vaH sarvAngamiShyAmi parantapa
shlokas.37:
na hi kRRitsnatamo dharmaH shakyaH prAptumiti shrutiH |
parigrahavatA tanme pratyakShamarisUdana
shlokas.38:
mayA nisRRiShTaM pApaM hi parigrahamabhIpsatA |
janmakShayanimittaM cha shakyaM prAptumiti shrutiH
shlokas.39:
sa parigrahamutsRRijya kRRitsnaM rAjyaM tathaiva cha |
gamiShyAmi vinirmukto vishoko vijvarastathA
shlokas.40:
prashAdhi tvamimAmurvIM kShemAM nihatakaNTakAm |
na mamArtho.asti rAjyena na bhogairvA kurUttama
shlokas.41:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vyupAramattataH pArthaH kanIyAnpratyabhAShata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athArjuna uvAchedamadhikShipta ivAkShamI |
abhinItataraM vAkyaM dRRiDhavAdaparAkramaH
shlokas.2:
darshayannaindrirAtmAnamugramugraparAkramaH |
smayamAno mahAtejAH sRRikkiNI sa.nlihanmuhuH
shlokas.3:
aho duHkhamaho kRRichChramaho vaiklavyamuttamam |
yatkRRitvAmAnuShaM karma tyajethAH shriyamuttamAm
shlokas.4:
shatrUnhatvA mahIM labdhvA svadharmeNopapAditAm |
hatAmitraH kathaM sarvaM tyajethA buddhilAghavAt
shlokas.5:
klIbasya hi kuto rAjyaM dIrghasUtrasya vA punaH |
kimarthaM cha mahIpAlAnavadhIH krodhamUrChitaH
shlokas.6:
yo hyAjijIviShedbhaikShyaM karmaNA naiva kenachit |
samArambhAnbubhUSheta hatasvastiraki~nchanaH
sarvalokeShu vikhyAto na putrapashusaMhitaH
shlokas.7:
kApAlIM nRRipa pApiShThAM vRRittimAsthAya jIvataH |
santyajya rAjyamRRiddhaM te loko.ayaM kiM vadiShyati
shlokas.8:
sarvArambhAnsamutsRRijya hatasvastiraki~nchanaH |
kasmAdAsha.nsase bhaikShyaM chartuM prAkRRitavatprabho
shlokas.9:
asminrAjakule jAto jitvA kRRitsnAM vasundharAm |
dharmArthAvakhilau hitvA vanaM mauDhyAtpratiShThase
shlokas.10:
yadImAni havIMShIha vimathiShyantyasAdhavaH |
bhavatA viprahINAni prAptaM tvAmeva kilbiSham
shlokas.11:
Aki~nchanyamanAshAsyamiti vai nahuSho.abravIt |
kRRityA nRRisha.nsA hyadhane dhigastvadhanatAmiha
shlokas.12:
ashvastanamRRiShINAM hi vidyate veda tadbhavAn |
yaM tvimaM dharmamityAhurdhanAdeSha pravartate
shlokas.13:
dharmaM saMharate tasya dhanaM harati yasya yaH |
hriyamANe dhane rAjanvayaM kasya kShamemahi
shlokas.14:
abhishastavatprapashyanti daridraM pArshvataH sthitam |
dAridryaM pAtakaM loke kastachCha.nsitumarhati
shlokas.15:
patitaH shochyate rAjannirdhanashchApi shochyate |
visheShaM nAdhigachChAmi patitasyAdhanasya cha
shlokas.16:
arthebhyo hi vivRRiddhebhyaH sambhRRitebhyastatastataH |
kriyAH sarvAH pravartante parvatebhya ivApagAH
shlokas.17:
ardhAddharmashcha kAmashcha svargashchaiva narAdhipa |
prANayAtrA hi lokasya vinArthaM na prasidhyati
shlokas.18:
arthena hi vihInasya puruShasyAlpamedhasaH |
vyuchChidyante kriyAH sarvA grIShme kusarito yathA
shlokas.19:
yasyArthAstasya mitrANi yasyArthAstasya bAndhavAH |
yasyArthAH sa pumA.Nlloke yasyArthAH sa cha paNDitaH
shlokas.20:
adhanenArthakAmena nArthaH shakyo vivitsatA |
arthairarthA nibadhyante gajairiva mahAgajAH
shlokas.21:
dharmaH kAmashcha svargashcha harShaH krodhaH shrutaM damaH |
arthAdetAni sarvANi pravartante narAdhipa
shlokas.22:
dhanAtkulaM prabhavati dhanAddharmaH pravartate |
nAdhanasyAstyayaM loko na paraH puruShottama
shlokas.23:
nAdhano dharmakRRityAni yathAvadanutiShThati |
dhanAddhi dharmaH sravati shailAdgirinadI yathA
shlokas.24:
yaH kRRishAshvaH kRRishagavaH kRRishabhRRityaH kRRishAtithiH |
sa vai rAjankRRisho nAma na sharIrakRRishaH kRRishaH
shlokas.25:
avekShasva yathAnyAyaM pashya devAsuraM yathA |
rAjankimanyajj~nAtInAM vadhAdRRidhyanti devatAH
shlokas.26:
na cheddhartavyamanyasya kathaM taddharmamArabhet |
etAvAneva vedeShu nishchayaH kavibhiH kRRitaH
shlokas.27:
adhyetavyA trayI vidyA bhavitavyaM vipashchitA |
sarvathA dhanamAhAryaM yaShTavyaM chApi yatnataH
shlokas.28:
drohAddevairavAptAni divi sthAnAni sarvashaH |
iti devA vyavasitA vedavAdAshcha shAshvatAH
shlokas.29:
adhIyante tapasyanti yajante yAjayanti cha |
kRRitsnaM tadeva cha shreyo yadapyAdadate.anyataH
shlokas.30:
na pashyAmo.anapahRRitaM dhanaM ki~nchitkvachidvayam |
evameva hi rAjAno jayanti pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.31:
jitvA mamatvaM bruvate putrA iva piturdhane |
rAjarShayo jitasvargA dharmo hyeShAM nigadyate
shlokas.32:
yathaiva pUrNAdudadheH syandantyApo disho dasha |
evaM rAjakulAdvittaM pRRithivIM pratitiShThati
shlokas.33:
AsIdiyaM dilIpasya nRRigasya nahuShasya cha |
ambarIShasya mAndhAtuH pRRithivI sA tvayi sthitA
shlokas.34:
sa tvAM dravyamayo yaj~naH samprAptaH sarvadakShiNaH |
taM chenna yajase rAjanprAptastvaM devakilbiSham
shlokas.35:
yeShAM rAjAshvamedhena yajate dakShiNAvatA |
upetya tasyAvabhRRithaM pUtAH sarve bhavanti te
shlokas.36:
vishvarUpo mahAdevaH sarvamedhe mahAmakhe |
juhAva sarvabhUtAni tathaivAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.37:
shAshvato.ayaM bhUtipatho nAsyAntamanushushruma |
mahAndAsharathaH panthA mA rAjankApathaM gamaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
muhUrtaM tAvadekAgro manaHshrotre.antarAtmani |
dhArayitvApi te shrutvA rochatAM vachanaM mama
shlokas.2:
sArthagamyamahaM mArgaM na jAtu tvatkRRite punaH |
gachCheyaM tadgamiShyAmi hitvA grAmyasukhAnyuta
shlokas.3:
kShemyashchaikAkinA gamyaH panthAH ko.astIti pRRichCha mAm |
atha vA nechChasi praShTumapRRichChannapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.4:
hitvA grAmyasukhAchAraM tapyamAno mahattapaH |
araNye phalamUlAshI chariShyAmi mRRigaiH saha
shlokas.5:
juhvAno.agniM yathAkAlamubhau kAlAvupaspRRishan |
kRRishaH parimitAhArashcharmachIrajaTAdharaH
shlokas.6:
shItavAtAtapasahaH kShutpipAsAshramakShamaH |
tapasA vidhidRRiShTena sharIramupashoShayan
shlokas.7:
manaHkarNasukhA nityaM shRRiNvannuchchAvachA giraH |
muditAnAmaraNyeShu vasatAM mRRigapakShiNAm
shlokas.8:
AjighranpeshalAngandhAnphullAnAM vRRikShavIrudhAm |
nAnArUpAnvane pashyanramaNIyAnvanaukasaH
shlokas.9:
vAnaprasthajanasyApi darshanaM kulavAsinaH |
nApriyANyAchariShyAmi kiM punargrAmavAsinAm
shlokas.10:
ekAntashIlI vimRRishanpakvApakvena vartayan |
pitR^IndevA.nshcha vanyena vAgbhiradbhishcha tarpayan
shlokas.11:
evamAraNyashAstrANAmugramugrataraM vidhim |
sevamAnaH pratIkShiShye dehasyAsya samApanam
shlokas.12:
atha vaiko.ahamekAhamekaikasminvanaspatau |
charanbhaikShyaM munirmuNDaH kShapayiShye kalevaram
shlokas.13:
pA.nsubhiH samavachChannaH shUnyAgArapratishrayaH |
vRRikShamUlaniketo vA tyaktasarvapriyApriyaH
shlokas.14:
na shochanna prahRRiShya.nshcha tulyanindAtmasa.nstutiH |
nirAshIrnirmamo bhUtvA nirdva.ndvo niShparigrahaH
shlokas.15:
AtmArAmaH prasannAtmA jaDAndhabadhirAkRRitiH |
akurvANaH paraiH kA~nchitsa.nvidaM jAtu kenachit
shlokas.16:
ja~NgamAja~NgamAnsarvAnnavihi.nsa.nshchaturvidhAn |
prajAH sarvAH svadharmasthAH samaH prANabhRRitaH prati
shlokas.17:
na chApyavahasanka~nchinna kurvanbhrukuTIM kvachit |
prasannavadano nityaM sarvendriyasusa.nyataH
shlokas.18:
apRRichChankasyachinmArgaM vrajanyenaiva kenachit |
na deshaM na dishaM kA~nchidgantumichChanvisheShataH
shlokas.19:
gamane nirapekShashcha pashchAdanavalokayan |
RRijuH praNihito gachCha.nstrasasthAvaravarjakaH
shlokas.20:
svabhAvastu prayAtyagre prabhavantyashanAnyapi |
dva.ndvAni cha viruddhAni tAni sarvANyachintayan
shlokas.21:
alpaM vAsvAdu vA bhojyaM pUrvAlAbhena jAtu chit |
anyeShvapi chara.NllAbhamalAbhe sapta pUrayan
shlokas.22:
vidhUme nyastamusale vya~NgAre bhuktavajjane |
atItapAtrasa~nchAre kAle vigatabhikShuke
shlokas.23:
ekakAlaM charanbhaikShyaM gRRihe dve chaiva pa~ncha cha |
spRRihApAshAnvimuchyAhaM chariShyAmi mahImimAm
shlokas.24:
na jijIviShuvatki~nchinna mumUrShuvadAcharan |
jIvitaM maraNaM chaiva nAbhinandanna cha dviShan
shlokas.25:
vAsyaikaM takShato bAhuM chandanenaikamukShataH |
nAkalyANaM na kalyANaM chintayannubhayostayoH
shlokas.26:
yAH kAshchijjIvatA shakyAH kartumabhyudayakriyAH |
sarvAstAH samabhityajya nimeShAdivyavasthitaH
shlokas.27:
teShu nityamasaktashcha tyaktasarvendriyakriyaH |
suparityaktasa~NkalpaH sunirNiktAtmakalmaShaH
shlokas.28:
vimuktaH sarvasa~Ngebhyo vyatItaH sarvavAgurAH |
na vashe kasyachittiShThansadharmA mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.29:
vItarAgashcharannevaM tuShTiM prApsyAmi shAshvatIm |
tRRiShNayA hi mahatpApamaj~nAnAdasmi kAritaH
shlokas.30:
kushalAkushalAnyeke kRRitvA karmANi mAnavAH |
kAryakAraNasa.nshliShTaM svajanaM nAma bibhrati
shlokas.31:
AyuSho.ante prahAyedaM kShINaprAyaM kalevaram |
pratigRRihNAti tatpApaM kartuH karmaphalaM hi tat
shlokas.32:
evaM sa.nsArachakre.asminvyAviddhe rathachakravat |
sameti bhUtagrAmo.ayaM bhUtagrAmeNa kAryavAn
shlokas.33:
janmamRRityujarAvyAdhivedanAbhirupadrutam |
asAramimamasvantaM sa.nsAraM tyajataH sukham
shlokas.34:
divaH patatsu deveShu sthAnebhyashcha maharShiShu |
ko hi nAma bhavenArthI bhavetkAraNatattvavit
shlokas.35:
kRRitvA hi vividhaM karma tattadvividhalakShaNam |
pArthivairnRRipatiH svalpaiH kAraNaireva badhyate
shlokas.36:
tasmAtpraj~nAmRRitamidaM chirAnmAM pratyupasthitam |
tatprApya prArthaye sthAnamavyayaM shAshvataM dhruvam
shlokas.37:
etayA satataM vRRittyA charannevamprakArayA |
dehaM sa.nsthApayiShyAmi nirbhayaM mArgamAsthitaH

shlokas.1:
bhIma uvAcha||
shrotriyasyeva te rAjanmandakasyAvipashchitaH |
anuvAkahatAbuddhirnaiShA tattvArthadarshinI
shlokas.2:
Alasye kRRitachittasya rAjadharmAnasUyataH |
vinAshe dhArtarAShTrANAM kiM phalaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
kShamAnukampA kAruNyamAnRRisha.nsyaM na vidyate |
kShAtramAcharato mArgamapi bandhostvadantare
shlokas.4:
yadImAM bhavato buddhiM vidyAma vayamIdRRishIm |
shastraM naiva grahIShyAmo na vadhiShyAma ka~nchana
shlokas.5:
bhaikShyamevAchariShyAma sharIrasyA vimokShaNAt |
na chedaM dAruNaM yuddhamabhaviShyanmahIkShitAm
shlokas.6:
prANasyAnnamidaM sarvamiti vai kavayo viduH |
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva sarvaM prANasya bhojanam
shlokas.7:
AdadAnasya chedrAjyaM ye kechitparipanthinaH |
hantavyAsta iti prAj~nAH kShatradharmavido viduH
shlokas.8:
te sadoShA hatAsmAbhI rAjyasya paripanthinaH |
tAnhatvA bhu~NkShva dharmeNa yudhiShThira mahImimAm
shlokas.9:
yathA hi puruShaH khAtvA kUpamaprApya chodakam |
pa~Nkadigdho nivarteta karmedaM nastathopamam
shlokas.10:
yathAruhya mahAvRRikShamapahRRitya tato madhu |
aprAshya nidhanaM gachChetkarmedaM nastathopamam
shlokas.11:
yathA mahAntamadhvAnamAshayA puruShaH patan |
sa nirAsho nivarteta karmedaM nastathopamam
shlokas.12:
yathA shatrUnghAtayitvA puruShaH kurusattama |
AtmAnaM ghAtayetpashchAtkarmedaM nastathAvidham
shlokas.13:
yathAnnaM kShudhito labdhvA na bhu~njIta yadRRichChayA |
kAmI cha kAminIM labdhvA karmedaM nastathAvidham
shlokas.14:
vayamevAtra garhyA hi ye vayaM mandachetasaH |
tvAM rAjannanugachChAmo jyeShTho.ayamiti bhArata
shlokas.15:
vayaM hi bAhubalinaH kRRitavidyA manasvinaH |
klIbasya vAkye tiShThAmo yathaivAshaktayastathA
shlokas.16:
agatInkAgatInasmAnnaShTArthAnarthasiddhaye |
kathaM vai nAnupashyeyurjanAH pashyanti yAdRRisham
shlokas.17:
ApatkAle hi saMnyAsaH kartavya iti shiShyate |
jarayAbhiparItena shatrubhirvya.nsitena cha
shlokas.18:
tasmAdiha kRRitapraj~nAstyAgaM na parichakShate |
dharmavyatikramaM chedaM manyante sUkShmadarshinaH
shlokas.19:
kathaM tasmAtsamutpannastanniShThastadupAshrayaH |
tadeva nindannAsIta shraddhA vAnyatra gRRihyate
shlokas.20:
shriyA vihInairadhanairnAstikaiH sampravartitam |
vedavAdasya vij~nAnaM satyAbhAsamivAnRRitam
shlokas.21:
shakyaM tu mauNDyamAsthAya bibhratAtmAnamAtmanA |
dharmachChadma samAsthAya AsituM na tu jIvitum
shlokas.22:
shakyaM punararaNyeShu sukhamekena jIvitum |
abibhratA putrapautrAndevarShInatithInpitR^In
shlokas.23:
neme mRRigAH svargajito na varAhA na pakShiNaH |
athaitena prakAreNa puNyamAhurna tA~njanAH
shlokas.24:
yadi saMnyAsataH siddhiM rAjankashchidavApnuyAt |
parvatAshcha drumAshchaiva kShipraM siddhimavApnuyuH
shlokas.25:
ete hi nityasaMnyAsA dRRishyante nirupadravAH |
aparigrahavantashcha satataM chAtmachAriNaH
shlokas.26:
atha chedAtmabhAgyeShu nAnyeShAM siddhimashnute |
tasmAtkarmaiva kartavyaM nAsti siddhirakarmaNaH
shlokas.27:
audakAH sRRiShTayashchaiva jantavaH siddhimApnuyuH |
yeShAmAtmaiva bhartavyo nAnyaH kashchana vidyate
shlokas.28:
avekShasva yathA svaiH svaiH karmabhirvyApRRitaM jagat |
tasmAtkarmaiva kartavyaM nAsti siddhirakarmaNaH

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
tApasaiH saha sa.nvAdaM shakrasya bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
kechidgRRihAnparityajya vanamabhyagamandvijAH |
ajAtashmashravo mandAH kule jAtAH pravavrajuH
shlokas.3:
dharmo.ayamiti manvAnA brahmacharye vyavasthitAH |
tyaktvA gRRihAnpitR^I.nshchaiva tAnindro.anvakRRipAyata
shlokas.4:
tAnAbabhAShe bhagavAnpakShI bhUtvA hiraNmayaH |
suduShkaraM manuShyaishcha yatkRRitaM vighasAshibhiH
shlokas.5:
puNyaM cha bata karmaiShAM prashastaM chaiva jIvitam |
sa.nsiddhAste gatiM mukhyAM prAptA dharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.6:
RRiShaya UchuH||
aho batAyaM shakunirvighasAshAnprasha.nsati |
asmAnnUnamayaM shAsti vayaM cha vighasAshinaH
shlokas.7:
shakuniruvAcha||
nAhaM yuShmAnprasha.nsAmi pa~NkadigdhAnrajasvalAn |
uchChiShTabhojino mandAnanye vai vighasAshinaH
shlokas.8:
RRiShaya UchuH||
idaM shreyaH paramiti vayamevAbhyupAsmahe |
shakune brUhi yachChreyo bhRRishaM vai shraddadhAma te
shlokas.9:
shakuniruvAcha||
yadi mAM nAbhisha~NkadhvaM vibhajyAtmAnamAtmanA |
tato.ahaM vaH pravakShyAmi yAthAtathyaM hitaM vachaH
shlokas.10:
RRiShaya UchuH||
shRRiNumaste vachastAta panthAno viditAstava |
niyoge chaiva dharmAtmansthAtumichChAma shAdhi naH
shlokas.11:
shakuniruvAcha||
chatuShpadAM gauH pravarA lohAnAM kA~nchanaM varam |
shabdAnAM pravaro mantro brAhmaNo dvipadAM varaH
shlokas.12:
mantro.ayaM jAtakarmAdi brAhmaNasya vidhIyate |
jIvato yo yathAkAlaM shmashAnanidhanAditi
shlokas.13:
karmANi vaidikAnyasya svargyaH panthAstvanuttamaH |
atha sarvANi karmANi mantrasiddhAni chakShate
shlokas.14:
AmnAyadRRiDhavAdIni tathA siddhiriheShyate |
mAsArdhamAsA RRitava AdityashashitArakam
shlokas.15:
Ihante sarvabhUtAni tadRRitaM karmasa~NginAm |
siddhikShetramidaM puNyamayamevAshramo mahAn
shlokas.16:
atha ye karma nindanto manuShyAH kApathaM gatAH |
mUDhAnAmarthahInAnAM teShAmenastu vidyate
shlokas.17:
devava.nshAnpitRRiva.nshAnbrahmava.nshA.nshcha shAshvatAn |
santyajya mUDhA vartante tato yAntyashrutIpatham
shlokas.18:
etadvo.astu tapo yuktaM dadAnItyRRiShichoditam |
tasmAttadadhyavasatastapasvi tapa uchyate
shlokas.19:
devava.nshAnpitRRiva.nshAnbrahmava.nshA.nshcha shAshvatAn |
sa.nvibhajya guroshcharyAM tadvai duShkaramuchyate
shlokas.20:
devA vai duShkaraM kRRitvA vibhUtiM paramAM gatAH |
tasmAdgArhasthyamudvoDhuM duShkaraM prabravImi vaH
shlokas.21:
tapaH shreShThaM prajAnAM hi mUlametanna sa.nshayaH |
kuTumbavidhinAnena yasminsarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.22:
etadvidustapo viprA dva.ndvAtItA vimatsarAH |
tasmAdvanaM madhyamaM cha lokeShu tapa uchyate
shlokas.23:
durAdharShaM padaM chaiva gachChanti vighasAshinaH |
sAyamprAtarvibhajyAnnaM svakuTumbe yathAvidhi
shlokas.24:
dattvAtithibhyo devebhyaH pitRRibhyaH svajanasya cha |
avashiShTAni ye.ashnanti tAnAhurvighasAshinaH
shlokas.25:
tasmAtsvadharmamAsthAya suvratAH satyavAdinaH |
lokasya guravo bhUtvA te bhavantyanupaskRRitAH
shlokas.26:
tridivaM prApya shakrasya svargaloke vimatsarAH |
vasanti shAshvatIrvarShA janA duShkarakAriNaH
shlokas.27:
tataste tadvachaH shrutvA tasya dharmArthasaMhitam |
utsRRijya nAstikagatiM gArhasthyaM dharmamAshritAH
shlokas.28:
tasmAttvamapi durdharSha dhairyamAlambya shAshvatam |
prashAdhi pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM hatAmitrAM narottama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
arjunasya vachaH shrutvA nakulo vAkyamabravIt |
rAjAnamabhisamprekShya sarvadharmabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.2:
anurudhya mahAprAj~no bhrAtushchittamari.ndamaH |
vyUDhorasko mahAbAhustAmrAsyo mitabhAShitA
shlokas.3:
vishAkhayUpe devAnAM sarveShAmagnayashchitAH |
tasmAdviddhi mahArAja devAnkarmapathi sthitAn
shlokas.4:
anAstikAnAstikAnAM prANadAH pitarashcha ye |
te.api karmaiva kurvanti vidhiM pashyasva pArthiva
vedavAdApaviddhA.nstu tAnviddhi bhRRishanAstikAn
shlokas.5:
na hi vedoktamutsRRijya vipraH sarveShu karmasu |
devayAnena nAkasya pRRiShThamApnoti bhArata
shlokas.6:
atyAshramAnayaM sarvAnityAhurvedanishchayAH |
brAhmaNAH shrutisampannAstAnnibodha janAdhipa
shlokas.7:
vittAni dharmalabdhAni kratumukhyeShvavAsRRijan |
kRRitAtmasu mahArAja sa vai tyAgI smRRito naraH
shlokas.8:
anavekShya sukhAdAnaM tathaivordhvaM pratiShThitaH |
AtmatyAgI mahArAja sa tyAgI tAmasaH prabho
shlokas.9:
aniketaH paripatanvRRikShamUlAshrayo muniH |
apAchakaH sadA yogI sa tyAgI pArtha bhikShukaH
shlokas.10:
krodhaharShAvanAdRRitya paishunyaM cha vishAM pate |
vipro vedAnadhIte yaH sa tyAgI gurupUjakaH
shlokas.11:
AshramA.nstulayA sarvAndhRRitAnAhurmanIShiNaH |
ekataste trayo rAjangRRihasthAshrama ekataH
shlokas.12:
samIkShate tu yo.arthaM vai kAmaM svargaM cha bhArata |
ayaM panthA maharShINAmiyaM lokavidAM gatiH
shlokas.13:
iti yaH kurute bhAvaM sa tyAgI bharatarShabha |
na yaH parityajya gRRihAnvanameti vimUDhavat
shlokas.14:
yadA kAmAnsamIkSheta dharmavaita.nsiko.anRRijuH |
athainaM mRRityupAshena kaNThe badhnAti mRRityurAT
shlokas.15:
abhimAnakRRitaM karma naitatphalavaduchyate |
tyAgayuktaM mahArAja sarvameva mahAphalam
shlokas.16:
shamo damastapo dAnaM satyaM shauchamathArjavam |
yaj~no dhRRitishcha dharmashcha nityamArSho vidhiH smRRitaH
shlokas.17:
pitRRidevAtithikRRite samArambho.atra shasyate |
atraiva hi mahArAja trivargaH kevalaM phalam
shlokas.18:
etasminvartamAnasya vidhau vipraniShevite |
tyAginaH prasRRitasyeha nochChittirvidyate kvachit
shlokas.19:
asRRijaddhi prajA rAjanprajApatirakalmaShaH |
mAM yakShyantIti shAntAtmA yaj~nairvividhadakShiNaiH
shlokas.20:
vIrudhashchaiva vRRikShA.nshcha yaj~nArthaM cha tathauShadhIH |
pashU.nshchaiva tathA medhyAnyaj~nArthAni havIMShi cha
shlokas.21:
gRRihasthAshramiNastachcha yaj~nakarma virodhakam |
tasmAdgArhasthyameveha duShkaraM durlabhaM tathA
shlokas.22:
tatsamprApya gRRihasthA ye pashudhAnyasamanvitAH |
na yajante mahArAja shAshvataM teShu kilbiSham
shlokas.23:
svAdhyAyayaj~nA RRiShayo j~nAnayaj~nAstathApare |
athApare mahAyaj~nAnmanasaiva vitanvate
shlokas.24:
evaM dAnasamAdhAnaM mArgamAtiShThato nRRipa |
dvijAterbrahmabhUtasya spRRihayanti divaukasaH
shlokas.25:
sa ratnAni vichitrANi sambhRRitAni tatastataH |
makheShvanabhisantyajya nAstikyamabhijalpasi
kuTumbamAsthite tyAgaM na pashyAmi narAdhipa
shlokas.26:
rAjasUyAshvamedheShu sarvamedheShu vA punaH |
ya chAnye kratavastAta brAhmaNairabhipUjitAH
tairyajasva mahArAja shakro devapatiryathA
shlokas.27:
rAj~naH pramAdadoSheNa dasyubhiH parimuShyatAm |
asharaNyaH prajAnAM yaH sa rAjA kaliruchyate
shlokas.28:
ashvAngAshchaiva dAsIshcha kareNUshcha svala~NkRRitAH |
grAmA~njanapadA.nshchaiva kShetrANi cha gRRihANi cha
shlokas.29:
apradAya dvijAtibhyo mAtsaryAviShTachetasaH |
vayaM te rAjakalayo bhaviShyAmo vishAM pate
shlokas.30:
adAtAro.asharaNyAshcha rAjakilbiShabhAginaH |
duHkhAnAmeva bhoktAro na sukhAnAM kadAchana
shlokas.31:
aniShTvA cha mahAyaj~nairakRRitvA cha pitRRisvadhAm |
tIrtheShvanabhisantyajya pravrajiShyasi chedatha
shlokas.32:
ChinnAbhramiva gantAsi vilayaM mAruteritam |
lokayorubhayorbhraShTo hyantarAle vyavasthitaH
shlokas.33:
antarbahishcha yatki~nchinmanovyAsa~NgakArakam |
parityajya bhavettyAgI na yo hitvA pratiShThate
shlokas.34:
etasminvartamAnasya vidhau vipraniShevite |
brAhmaNasya mahArAja nochChittirvidyate kvachit
shlokas.35:
nihatya shatrU.nstarasA samRRiddhA;nshakro yathA daityabalAni sa~Nkhye |
kaH pArtha shochennirataH svadharme; pUrvaiH smRRite pArthiva shiShTajuShTe
shlokas.36:
kShAtreNa dharmeNa parAkrameNa; jitvA mahIM mantravidbhyaH pradAya |
nAkasya pRRiShThe.asi narendra gantA; na shochitavyaM bhavatAdya pArtha

shlokas.1:
sahadeva uvAcha||
na bAhyaM dravyamutsRRijya siddhirbhavati bhArata |
shArIraM dravyamutsRRijya siddhirbhavati vA na vA
shlokas.2:
bAhyadravyavimuktasya shArIreShu cha gRRidhyataH |
yo dharmo yatsukhaM vA syAddviShatAM tattathAstu naH
shlokas.3:
shArIraM dravyamutsRRijya pRRithivImanushAsataH |
yo dharmo yatsukhaM vA syAtsuhRRidAM tattathAstu naH
shlokas.4:
dvyakSharastu bhavenmRRityustryakSharaM brahma shAshvatam |
mameti cha bhavenmRRityurna mameti cha shAshvatam
shlokas.5:
brahmamRRityU cha tau rAjannAtmanyeva samAshritau |
adRRishyamAnau bhUtAni yodhayetAmasa.nshayam
shlokas.6:
avinAsho.asya sattvasya niyato yadi bhArata |
bhittvA sharIraM bhUtAnAM na hi.nsA pratipatsyate
shlokas.7:
athApi cha sahotpattiH sattvasya pralayastathA |
naShTe sharIre naShTaM syAdvRRithA cha syAtkriyApathaH
shlokas.8:
tasmAdekAntamutsRRijya pUrvaiH pUrvataraishcha yaH |
panthA niShevitaH sadbhiH sa niShevyo vijAnatA
shlokas.9:
labdhvApi pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM sahasthAvaraja~NgamAm |
na bhu~Nkte yo nRRipaH samya~NniShphalaM tasya jIvitam
shlokas.10:
atha vA vasato rAjanvane vanyena jIvataH |
dravyeShu yasya mamatA mRRityorAsye sa vartate
shlokas.11:
bAhyAbhyantarabhUtAnAM svabhAvaM pashya bhArata |
ye tu pashyanti tadbhAvaM muchyante mahato bhayAt
shlokas.12:
bhavAnpitA bhavAnmAtA bhavAnbhrAtA bhavAnguruH |
duHkhapralApAnArtasya tasmAnme kShantumarhasi
shlokas.13:
tathyaM vA yadi vAtathyaM yanmayaitatprabhAShitam |
tadviddhi pRRithivIpAla bhaktyA bharatasattama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
avyAharati kaunteye dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
bhrAtR^INAM bruvatAM tA.nstAnvividhAnvedanishchayAn
shlokas.2:
mahAbhijanasampannA shrImatyAyatalochanA |
abhyabhAShata rAjendraM draupadI yoShitAM varA
shlokas.3:
AsInamRRiShabhaM rAj~nAM bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritam |
siMhashArdUlasadRRishairvAraNairiva yUthapam
shlokas.4:
abhimAnavatI nityaM visheSheNa yudhiShThire |
lAlitA satataM rAj~nA dharmaj~nA dharmadarshinI
shlokas.5:
Amantrya vipulashroNI sAmnA paramavalgunA |
bhartAramabhisamprekShya tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
ime te bhrAtaraH pArtha shuShyanta stokakA iva |
vAvAshyamAnAstiShThanti na chainAnabhinandase
shlokas.7:
nandayaitAnmahArAja mattAniva mahAdvipAn |
upapannena vAkyena satataM duHkhabhAginaH
shlokas.8:
kathaM dvaitavane rAjanpUrvamuktvA tathA vachaH |
bhrAtR^InetAnsma sahitA~nshItavAtAtapArditAn
shlokas.9:
vayaM duryodhanaM hatvA mRRidhe bhokShyAma medinIm |
sampUrNAM sarvakAmAnAmAhave vijayaiShiNaH
shlokas.10:
virathA.nshcha rathAnkRRitvA nihatya cha mahAgajAn |
sa.nstIrya cha rathairbhUmiM sasAdibhirari.ndamAH
shlokas.11:
yajatAM vividhairyaj~naiH samRRiddhairAptadakShiNaiH |
vanavAsakRRitaM duHkhaM bhaviShyati sukhAya naH
shlokas.12:
ityetAnevamuktvA tvaM svayaM dharmabhRRitAM vara |
kathamadya punarvIra viniha.nsi manA.nsyuta
shlokas.13:
na klIbo vasudhAM bhu~Nkte na klIbo dhanamashnute |
na klIbasya gRRihe putrA matsyAH pa~Nka ivAsate
shlokas.14:
nAdaNDaH kShatriyo bhAti nAdaNDo bhUtimashnute |
nAdaNDasya prajA rAj~naH sukhamedhanti bhArata
shlokas.15:
mitratA sarvabhUteShu dAnamadhyayanaM tapaH |
brAhmaNasyaiSha dharmaH syAnna rAj~no rAjasattama
shlokas.16:
asatAM pratiShedhashcha satAM cha paripAlanam |
eSha rAj~nAM paro dharmaH samare chApalAyanam
shlokas.17:
yasminkShamA cha krodhashcha dAnAdAne bhayAbhaye |
nigrahAnugrahau chobhau sa vai dharmaviduchyate
shlokas.18:
na shrutena na dAnena na sAntvena na chejyayA |
tvayeyaM pRRithivI labdhA notkochena tathApyuta
shlokas.19:
yattadbalamamitrANAM tathA vIrasamudyatam |
hastyashvarathasampannaM tribhira~Ngairmahattaram
shlokas.20:
rakShitaM droNakarNAbhyAmashvatthAmnA kRRipeNa cha |
tattvayA nihataM vIra tasmAdbhu~NkShva vasundharAm
shlokas.21:
jambUdvIpo mahArAja nAnAjanapadAyutaH |
tvayA puruShashArdUla daNDena mRRiditaH prabho
shlokas.22:
jambUdvIpena sadRRishaH krau~nchadvIpo narAdhipa |
apareNa mahAmerordaNDena mRRiditastvayA
shlokas.23:
krau~nchadvIpena sadRRishaH shAkadvIpo narAdhipa |
pUrveNa tu mahAmerordaNDena mRRiditastvayA
shlokas.24:
uttareNa mahAmeroH shAkadvIpena saMmitaH |
bhadrAshvaH puruShavyAghra daNDena mRRiditastvayA
shlokas.25:
dvIpAshcha sAntaradvIpA nAnAjanapadAlayAH |
vigAhya sAgaraM vIra daNDena mRRiditAstvayA
shlokas.26:
etAnyapratimAni tvaM kRRitvA karmANi bhArata |
na prIyase mahArAja pUjyamAno dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.27:
sa tvaM bhrAtR^InimAndRRiShTvA pratinandasva bhArata |
RRiShabhAniva saMmattAngajendrAnUrjitAniva
shlokas.28:
amarapratimAH sarve shatrusAhAH parantapAH |
eko.api hi sukhAyaiShAM kShamaH syAditi me matiH
shlokas.29:
kiM punaH puruShavyAghrAH patayo me nararShabhAH |
samastAnIndriyANIva sharIrasya vicheShTane
shlokas.30:
anRRitaM mAbravIchChvashrUH sarvaj~nA sarvadarshinI |
yudhiShThirastvAM pA~nchAli sukhe dhAsyatyanuttame
shlokas.31:
hatvA rAjasahasrANi bahUnyAshuparAkramaH |
tadvyarthaM samprapashyAmi mohAttava janAdhipa
shlokas.32:
yeShAmunmattako jyeShThaH sarve tasyopachAriNaH |
tavonmAdena rAjendra sonmAdAH sarvapANDavAH
shlokas.33:
yadi hi syuranunmattA bhrAtaraste janAdhipa |
baddhvA tvAM nAstikaiH sArdhaM prashAseyurvasundharAm
shlokas.34:
kurute mUDhamevaM hi yaH shreyo nAdhigachChati |
dhUpaira~njanayogaishcha nasyakarmabhireva cha
bheShajaiH sa chikitsyaH syAdya unmArgeNa gachChati
shlokas.35:
sAhaM sarvAdhamA loke strINAM bharatasattama |
tathA vinikRRitAmitrairyAhamichChAmi jIvitum
shlokas.36:
eteShAM yatamAnAnAmutpadyante tu sampadaH |
tvaM tu sarvAM mahIM labdhvA kuruShe svayamApadam
shlokas.37:
yathAstAM saMmatau rAj~nAM pRRithivyAM rAjasattamau |
mAndhAtA chAmbarIShashcha tathA rAjanvirAjase
shlokas.38:
prashAdhi pRRithivIM devIM prajA dharmeNa pAlayan |
saparvatavanadvIpAM mA rAjanvimanA bhava
shlokas.39:
yajasva vividhairyaj~nairjuhvannagnInprayachCha cha |
purANi bhogAnvAsA.nsi dvijAtibhyo nRRipottama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yAj~nasenyA vachaH shrutvA punarevArjuno.abravIt |
anumAnya mahAbAhuM jyeShThaM bhrAtaramIshvaram
shlokas.2:
daNDaH shAsti prajAH sarvA daNDa evAbhirakShati |
daNDaH supteShu jAgarti daNDaM dharmaM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.3:
dharmaM sa.nrakShate daNDastathaivArthaM narAdhipa |
kAmaM sa.nrakShate daNDastrivargo daNDa uchyate
shlokas.4:
daNDena rakShyate dhAnyaM dhanaM daNDena rakShyate |
etadvidvannupAdatsva svabhAvaM pashya laukikam
shlokas.5:
rAjadaNDabhayAdeke pApAH pApaM na kurvate |
yamadaNDabhayAdeke paralokabhayAdapi
shlokas.6:
parasparabhayAdeke pApAH pApaM na kurvate |
evaM sA.nsiddhike loke sarvaM daNDe pratiShThitam
shlokas.7:
daNDasyaiva bhayAdeke na khAdanti parasparam |
andhe tamasi majjeyuryadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.8:
yasmAdadAntAndamayatyashiShTAndaNDayatyapi |
damanAddaNDanAchchaiva tasmAddaNDaM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.9:
vAchi daNDo brAhmaNAnAM kShatriyANAM bhujArpaNam |
dAnadaNDaH smRRito vaishyo nirdaNDaH shUdra uchyate
shlokas.10:
asaMmohAya martyAnAmarthasa.nrakShaNAya cha |
maryAdA sthApitA loke daNDasa~nj~nA vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
yatra shyAmo lohitAkSho daNDashcharati sUnRRitaH |
prajAstatra na muhyanti netA chetsAdhu pashyati
shlokas.12:
brahmachArI gRRihasthashcha vAnaprastho.atha bhikShukaH |
daNDasyaiva bhayAdete manuShyA vartmani sthitAH
shlokas.13:
nAbhIto yajate rAjannAbhIto dAtumichChati |
nAbhItaH puruShaH kashchitsamaye sthAtumichChati
shlokas.14:
nAchChittvA paramarmANi nAkRRitvA karma dAruNam |
nAhatvA matsyaghAtIva prApnoti mahatIM shriyam
shlokas.15:
nAghnataH kIrtirastIha na vittaM na punaH prajAH |
indro vRRitravadhenaiva mahendraH samapadyata
shlokas.16:
ya eva devA hantArastA.Nlloko.archayate bhRRisham |
hantA rudrastathA skandaH shakro.agnirvaruNo yamaH
shlokas.17:
hantA kAlastathA vAyurmRRityurvaishravaNo raviH |
vasavo marutaH sAdhyA vishvedevAshcha bhArata
shlokas.18:
etAndevAnnamasyanti pratApapraNatA janAH |
na brahmANaM na dhAtAraM na pUShANaM katha~nchana
shlokas.19:
madhyasthAnsarvabhUteShu dAntA~nshamaparAyaNAn |
yajante mAnavAH kechitprashAntAH sarvakarmasu
shlokas.20:
na hi pashyAmi jIvantaM loke ka~nchidahi.nsayA |
sattvaiH sattvAni jIvanti durbalairbalavattarAH
shlokas.21:
nakulo mUShakAnatti biDAlo nakulaM tathA |
biDAlamatti shvA rAja~nshvAnaM vyAlamRRigastathA
shlokas.22:
tAnatti puruShaH sarvAnpashya dharmo yathAgataH |
prANasyAnnamidaM sarvaM ja~NgamaM sthAvaraM cha yat
shlokas.23:
vidhAnaM devavihitaM tatra vidvAnna muhyati |
yathA sRRiShTo.asi rAjendra tathA bhavitumarhasi
shlokas.24:
vinItakrodhaharShA hi mandA vanamupAshritAH |
vinA vadhaM na kurvanti tApasAH prANayApanam
shlokas.25:
udake bahavaH prANAH pRRithivyAM cha phaleShu cha |
na cha kashchinna tAnhanti kimanyatprANayApanAt
shlokas.26:
sUkShmayonIni bhUtAni tarkagamyAni kAnichit |
pakShmaNo.api nipAtena yeShAM syAtskandhaparyayaH
shlokas.27:
grAmAnniShkramya munayo vigatakrodhamatsarAH |
vane kuTumbadharmANo dRRishyante parimohitAH
shlokas.28:
bhUmiM bhittvauShadhIshChittvA vRRikShAdInaNDajAnpashUn |
manuShyAstanvate yaj~nA.nste svargaM prApnuvanti cha
shlokas.29:
daNDanItyAM praNItAyAM sarve sidhyantyupakramAH |
kaunteya sarvabhUtAnAM tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.30:
daNDashchenna bhavelloke vyanashiShyannimAH prajAH |
shUle matsyAnivApakShyandurbalAnbalavattarAH
shlokas.31:
satyaM chedaM brahmaNA pUrvamuktaM; daNDaH prajA rakShati sAdhu nItaH |
pashyAgnayashcha pratishAmyantyabhItAH; santarjitA daNDabhayAjjvalanti
shlokas.32:
andhaM tama ivedaM syAnna praj~nAyeta ki~nchana |
daNDashchenna bhavelloke vibhajansAdhvasAdhunI
shlokas.33:
ye.api sambhinnamaryAdA nAstikA vedanindakAH |
te.api bhogAya kalpante daNDenopanipIDitAH
shlokas.34:
sarvo daNDajito loko durlabho hi shuchirnaraH |
daNDasya hi bhayAdbhIto bhogAyeha prakalpate
shlokas.35:
chAturvarNyApramohAya sunItanayanAya cha |
daNDo vidhAtrA vihito dharmArthAvabhirakShitum
shlokas.36:
yadi daNDAnna bibhyeyurvayA.nsi shvApadAni cha |
adyuH pashUnmanuShyA.nshcha yaj~nArthAni havIMShi cha
shlokas.37:
na brahmachAryadhIyIta kalyANI gaurna duhyate |
na kanyodvahanaM gachChedyadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.38:
vishvalopaH pravarteta bhidyeransarvasetavaH |
mamatvaM na prajAnIyuryadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.39:
na sa.nvatsarasatrANi tiShTheyurakutobhayAH |
vidhivaddakShiNAvanti yadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.40:
chareyurnAshrame dharmaM yathoktaM vidhimAshritAH |
na vidyAM prApnuyAtkashchidyadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.41:
na choShTrA na balIvardA nAshvAshvataragardabhAH |
yuktA vaheyuryAnAni yadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.42:
na preShyA vachanaM kuryurna bAlo jAtu karhichit |
tiShThetpitRRimate dharme yadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.43:
daNDe sthitAH prajAH sarvA bhayaM daNDaM vidurbudhAH |
daNDe svargo manuShyANAM loko.ayaM cha pratiShThitaH
shlokas.44:
na tatra kUTaM pApaM vA va~nchanA vApi dRRiShyate |
yatra daNDaH suvihitashcharatyarivinAshanaH
shlokas.45:
haviH shvA prapibeddhRRiShTo daNDashchennodyato bhavet |
haretkAkaH puroDAshaM yadi daNDo na pAlayet
shlokas.46:
yadidaM dharmato rAjyaM vihitaM yadyadharmataH |
kAryastatra na shoko vai bhu~NkShva bhogAnyajasva cha
shlokas.47:
sukhena dharmaM shrImantashcharanti shuchivAsasaH |
sa.nvasantaH priyairdArairbhu~njAnAshchAnnamuttamam
shlokas.48:
arthe sarve samArambhAH samAyattA na sa.nshayaH |
sa cha daNDe samAyattaH pashya daNDasya gauravam
shlokas.49:
lokayAtrArthameveha dharmapravachanaM kRRitam |
ahi.nsA sAdhuhi.nseti shreyAndharmaparigrahaH
shlokas.50:
nAtyantaguNavAnkashchinna chApyatyantanirguNaH |
ubhayaM sarvakAryeShu dRRishyate sAdhvasAdhu cha
shlokas.51:
pashUnAM vRRiShaNaM ChittvA tato bhindanti nastakAn |
kRRiShanti bahavo bhArAnbadhnanti damayanti cha
shlokas.52:
evaM paryAkule loke vipathe jarjarIkRRite |
taistairnyAyairmahArAja purANaM dharmamAchara
shlokas.53:
yaja dehi prajA rakSha dharmaM samanupAlaya |
amitrA~njahi kaunteya mitrANi paripAlaya
shlokas.54:
mA cha te nighnataH shatrUnmanyurbhavatu bhArata |
na tatra kilbiShaM ki~nchitkarturbhavati bhArata
shlokas.55:
AtatAyI hi yo hanyAdAtatAyinamAgatam |
na tena bhrUNahA sa syAnmanyustaM manyumRRichChati
shlokas.56:
avadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAmantarAtmA na sa.nshayaH |
avadhye chAtmani kathaM vadhyo bhavati kenachit
shlokas.57:
yathA hi puruShaH shAlAM punaH sampravishennavAm |
evaM jIvaH sharIrANi tAni tAni prapadyate
shlokas.58:
dehAnpurANAnutsRRijya navAnsampratipadyate |
evaM mRRityumukhaM prAhurye janAstattvadarshinaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
arjunasya vachaH shrutvA bhImaseno.atyamarShaNaH |
dhairyamAsthAya tejasvI jyeShThaM bhrAtaramabravIt
shlokas.2:
rAjanviditadharmo.asi na te.astyaviditaM bhuvi |
upashikShAma te vRRittaM sadaiva na cha shaknumaH
shlokas.3:
na vakShyAmi na vakShyAmItyevaM me manasi sthitam |
atiduHkhAttu vakShyAmi tannibodha janAdhipa
shlokas.4:
bhavatastu pramohena sarvaM sa.nshayitaM kRRitam |
viklavatvaM cha naH prAptamabalatvaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.5:
kathaM hi rAjA lokasya sarvashAstravishAradaH |
mohamApadyate dainyAdyathA kupuruShastathA
shlokas.6:
Agatishcha gatishchaiva lokasya viditA tava |
AyatyAM cha tadAtve cha na te.astyaviditaM prabho
shlokas.7:
evaM gate mahArAja rAjyaM prati janAdhipa |
hetumatra pravakShyAmi tadihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.8:
dvividho jAyate vyAdhiH shArIro mAnasastathA |
parasparaM tayorjanma nirdva.ndvaM nopalabhyate
shlokas.9:
shArIrAjjAyate vyAdhirmAnaso nAtra sa.nshayaH |
mAnasAjjAyate vyAdhiH shArIra iti nishchayaH
shlokas.10:
shArIramAnase duHkhe yo.atIte anushochati |
duHkhena labhate duHkhaM dvAvanarthau prapadyate
shlokas.11:
shItoShNe chaiva vAyushcha trayaH shArIrajA guNAH |
teShAM guNAnAM sAmyaM cha tadAhuH svasthalakShaNam
shlokas.12:
teShAmanyatamotseke vidhAnamupadiShyate |
uShNena bAdhyate shItaM shItenoShNaM prabAdhyate
shlokas.13:
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva mAnasAH syustrayo guNAH |
harSheNa bAdhyate shoko harShaH shokena bAdhyate
shlokas.14:
kashchitsukhe vartamAno duHkhasya smartumichChati |
kashchidduHkhe vartamAnaH sukhasya smartumichChati
shlokas.15:
sa tvaM na duHkhI duHkhasya na sukhI cha sukhasya cha |
na duHkhI sukhajAtasya na sukhI duHkhajasya vA
shlokas.16:
smartumarhasi kauravya diShTaM tu balavattaram |
atha vA te svabhAvo.ayaM yena pArthiva kRRiShyase
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA sabhAgatAM kRRiShNAmekavastrAM rajasvalAm |
miShatAM pANDuputrANAM na tasya smartumarhasi
shlokas.18:
pravrAjanaM cha nagarAdajinaishcha nivAsanam |
mahAraNyanivAsashcha na tasya smartumarhasi
shlokas.19:
jaTAsurAtparikleshaM chitrasenena chAhavam |
saindhavAchcha parikleshaM kathaM vismRRitavAnasi
punaraj~nAtacharyAyAM kIchakena padA vadham
shlokas.20:
yachcha te droNabhIShmAbhyAM yuddhamAsIdari.ndama |
manasaikena te yuddhamidaM ghoramupasthitam
shlokas.21:
yatra nAsti sharaiH kAryaM na mitrairna cha bandhubhiH |
Atmanaikena yoddhavyaM tatte yuddhamupasthitam
shlokas.22:
tasminnanirjite yuddhe prANAnyadi ha mokShyase |
anyaM dehaM samAsthAya punastenaiva yotsyase
shlokas.23:
tasmAdadyaiva gantavyaM yuddhasya bharatarShabha |
etajjitvA mahArAja kRRitakRRityo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.24:
etAM buddhiM vinishchitya bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim |
pitRRipaitAmahe vRRitte shAdhi rAjyaM yathochitam
shlokas.25:
diShTyA duryodhanaH pApo nihataH sAnugo yudhi |
draupadyAH keshapakShasya diShTyA tvaM padavIM gataH
shlokas.26:
yajasva vAjimedhena vidhivaddakShiNAvatA |
vayaM te ki~NkarAH pArtha vAsudevashcha vIryavAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asantoShaH pramAdashcha mado rAgo.aprashAntatA |
balaM moho.abhimAnashcha udvegashchApi sarvashaH
shlokas.2:
ebhiH pApmabhirAviShTo rAjyaM tvamabhikA~NkShasi |
nirAmiSho vinirmuktaH prashAntaH susukhI bhava
shlokas.3:
ya imAmakhilAM bhUmiM shiShyAdeko mahIpatiH |
tasyApyudaramevaikaM kimidaM tvaM prasha.nsasi
shlokas.4:
nAhnA pUrayituM shakyA na mAsena nararShabha |
apUryAM pUrayannichChAmAyuShApi na shaknuyAt
shlokas.5:
yatheddhaH prajvalatyagnirasamiddhaH prashAmyati |
alpAhAratayA tvagniM shamayaudaryamutthitam
jayodaraM pRRithivyA te shreyo nirjitayA jitam
shlokas.6:
mAnuShAnkAmabhogA.nstvamaishvaryaM cha prasha.nsasi |
abhogino.abalAshchaiva yAnti sthAnamanuttamam
shlokas.7:
yogakShemau cha rAShTrasya dharmAdharmau tvayi sthitau |
muchyasva mahato bhArAttyAgamevAbhisa.nshraya
shlokas.8:
ekodarakRRite vyAghraH karoti vighasaM bahu |
tamanye.apyupajIvanti mandavega~ncharA mRRigAH
shlokas.9:
viShayAnpratisaMhRRitya saMnyAsaM kurute yatiH |
na cha tuShyanti rAjAnaH pashya buddhyantaraM yathA
shlokas.10:
patrAhArairashmakuTTairdantolUkhalikaistathA |
abbhakShairvAyubhakShaishcha tairayaM narako jitaH
shlokas.11:
yashchemAM vasudhAM kRRitsnAM prashAsedakhilAM nRRipaH |
tulyAshmakA~nchano yashcha sa kRRitArtho na pArthivaH
shlokas.12:
sa~NkalpeShu nirArambho nirAsho nirmamo bhava |
vishokaM sthAnamAtiShTha iha chAmutra chAvyayam
shlokas.13:
nirAmiShA na shochanti shochasi tvaM kimAmiSham |
parityajyAmiShaM sarvaM mRRiShAvAdAtpramokShyase
shlokas.14:
panthAnau pitRRiyAnashcha devayAnashcha vishrutau |
IjAnAH pitRRiyAnena devayAnena mokShiNaH
shlokas.15:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa svAdhyAyena cha pAvitAH |
vimuchya dehAnvai bhAnti mRRityoraviShayaM gatAH
shlokas.16:
AmiShaM bandhanaM loke karmehoktaM tathAmiSham |
tAbhyAM vimuktaH pAshAbhyAM padamApnoti tatparam
shlokas.17:
api gAthAmimAM gItAM janakena vadantyuta |
nirdva.ndvena vimuktena mokShaM samanupashyatA
shlokas.18:
anantaM bata me vittaM yasya me nAsti ki~nchana |
mithilAyAM pradIptAyAM na me dahyati ki~nchana
shlokas.19:
praj~nAprAsAdamAruhya nashochyA~nshochato janAn |
jagatIsthAnivAdristho mandabuddhInavekShate
shlokas.20:
dRRishyaM pashyati yaH pashyansa chakShuShmAnsa buddhimAn |
aj~nAtAnAM cha vij~nAnAtsambodhAdbuddhiruchyate
shlokas.21:
yastu vAchaM vijAnAti bahumAnamiyAtsa vai |
brahmabhAvaprasUtAnAM vaidyAnAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.22:
yadA bhUtapRRithagbhAvamekasthamanupashyati |
tata eva cha vistAraM brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.23:
te janAstAM gatiM yAnti nAvidvA.nso.alpachetasaH |
nAbuddhayo nAtapasaH sarvaM buddhau pratiShThitam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tUShNImbhUtaM tu rAjAnaM punarevArjuno.abravIt |
santaptaH shokaduHkhAbhyAM rAj~no vAkShalyapIDitaH
shlokas.2:
kathayanti purAvRRittamitihAsamimaM janAH |
videharAj~naH sa.nvAdaM bhAryayA saha bhArata
shlokas.3:
utsRRijya rAjyaM bhaikShArthaM kRRitabuddhiM janeshvaram |
videharAjaM mahiShI duHkhitA pratyabhAShata
shlokas.4:
dhanAnyapatyaM mitrANi ratnAni vividhAni cha |
panthAnaM pAvanaM hitvA janako mauNDyamAsthitaH
shlokas.5:
taM dadarsha priyA bhAryA bhaikShyavRRittimaki~nchanam |
dhAnAmuShTimupAsInaM nirIhaM gatamatsaram
shlokas.6:
tamuvAcha samAgamya bhartAramakutobhayam |
kruddhA manasvinI bhAryA vivikte hetumadvachaH
shlokas.7:
kathamutsRRijya rAjyaM svaM dhanadhAnyasamAchitam |
kApAlIM vRRittimAsthAya dhAnAmuShTirvane.acharaH
shlokas.8:
pratij~nA te.anyathA rAjanvicheShTA chAnyathA tava |
yadrAjyaM mahadutsRRijya svalpe tuShyasi pArthiva
shlokas.9:
naitenAtithayo rAjandevarShipitarastathA |
shakyamadya tvayA bhartuM moghaste.ayaM parishramaH
shlokas.10:
devatAtithibhishchaiva pitRRibhishchaiva pArthiva |
sarvairetaiH parityaktaH parivrajasi niShkriyaH
shlokas.11:
yastvaM traividyavRRiddhAnAM brAhmaNAnAM sahasrashaH |
bhartA bhUtvA cha lokasya so.adyAnyairbhRRitimichChasi
shlokas.12:
shriyaM hitvA pradIptAM tvaM shvavatsamprati vIkShyase |
aputrA jananI te.adya kausalyA chApatistvayA
shlokas.13:
ashItirdharmakAmAstvAM kShatriyAH paryupAsate |
tvadAshAmabhikA~NkShantyaH kRRipaNAH phalahetukAH
shlokas.14:
tAshcha tvaM viphalAH kurvankA.NllokAnnu gamiShyasi |
rAjansa.nshayite mokShe paratantreShu dehiShu
shlokas.15:
naiva te.asti paro loko nAparaH pApakarmaNaH |
dharmyAndArAnparityajya yastvamichChasi jIvitum
shlokas.16:
srajo gandhAnala~NkArAnvAsA.nsi vividhAni cha |
kimarthamabhisantyajya parivrajasi niShkriyaH
shlokas.17:
nipAnaM sarvabhUtAnAM bhUtvA tvaM pAvanaM mahat |
ADhyo vanaspatirbhUtvA so.adyAnyAnparyupAsase
shlokas.18:
khAdanti hastinaM nyAse kravyAdA bahavo.apyuta |
bahavaH kRRimayashchaiva kiM punastvAmanarthakam
shlokas.19:
ya imAM kuNDikAM bhindyAttriviShTabdhaM cha te haret |
vAsashchApaharettasminkathaM te mAnasaM bhavet
shlokas.20:
yastvayaM sarvamutsRRijya dhAnAmuShTiparigrahaH |
yadAnena samaM sarvaM kimidaM mama dIyate
dhAnAmuShTirihArthashchetpratij~nA te vinashyati
shlokas.21:
kA vAhaM tava ko me tvaM ko.adya te mayyanugrahaH |
prashAdhi pRRithivIM rAjanyatra te.anugraho bhavet
prAsAdaM shayanaM yAnaM vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.22:
shriyA nirAshairadhanaistyaktamitrairaki~nchanaiH |
saukhikaiH sambhRRitAnarthAnyaH santyajasi kiM nu tat
shlokas.23:
yo.atyantaM pratigRRihNIyAdyashcha dadyAtsadaiva hi |
tayostvamantaraM viddhi shreyA.nstAbhyAM ka uchyate
shlokas.24:
sadaiva yAchamAneShu satsu dambhavivarjiShu |
eteShu dakShiNA dattA dAvAgnAviva durhutam
shlokas.25:
jAtavedA yathA rAjannAdagdhvaivopashAmyati |
sadaiva yAchamAno vai tathA shAmyati na dvijaH
shlokas.26:
satAM cha vedA annaM cha loke.asminprakRRitirdhruvA |
na cheddAtA bhaveddAtA kutaH syurmokShakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.27:
annAdgRRihasthA loke.asminbhikShavastata eva cha |
annAtprANaH prabhavati annadaH prANado bhavet
shlokas.28:
gRRihasthebhyo.abhinirvRRittA gRRihasthAneva sa.nshritAH |
prabhavaM cha pratiShThAM cha dAntA nindanta Asate
shlokas.29:
tyAgAnna bhikShukaM vidyAnna mauNDyAnna cha yAchanAt |
RRijustu yo.arthaM tyajati taM sukhaM viddhi bhikShukam
shlokas.30:
asaktaH saktavadgachChanniHsa~Ngo muktabandhanaH |
samaH shatrau cha mitre cha sa vai mukto mahIpate
shlokas.31:
parivrajanti dAnArthaM muNDAH kAShAyavAsasaH |
sitA bahuvidhaiH pAshaiH sa~nchinvanto vRRithAmiSham
shlokas.32:
trayIM cha nAma vArtAM cha tyaktvA putrA.nstyajanti ye |
triviShTabdhaM cha vAsashcha pratigRRihNantyabuddhayaH
shlokas.33:
aniShkaShAye kAShAyamIhArthamiti viddhi tat |
dharmadhvajAnAM muNDAnAM vRRittyarthamiti me matiH
shlokas.34:
kAShAyairajinaishchIrairnagnAnmuNDA~njaTAdharAn |
bibhratsAdhUnmahArAja jaya lokA~njitendriyaH
shlokas.35:
agnyAdheyAni gurvarthAnkratUnsapashudakShiNAn |
dadAtyaharahaH pUrvaM ko nu dharmatarastataH
shlokas.36:
tattvaj~no janako rAjA loke.asminniti gIyate |
so.apyAsInmohasampanno mA mohavashamanvagAH
shlokas.37:
evaM dharmamanukrAntaM sadA dAnaparairnaraiH |
AnRRisha.nsyaguNopetaiH kAmakrodhavivarjitAH
shlokas.38:
pAlayantaH prajAshchaiva dAnamuttamamAsthitAH |
iShTA.NllokAnavApsyAmo brahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vedAhaM tAta shAstrANi aparANi parANi cha |
ubhayaM vedavachanaM kuru karma tyajeti cha
shlokas.2:
AkulAni cha shAstrANi hetubhishchitritAni cha |
nishchayashchaiva yanmAtro vedAhaM taM yathAvidhi
shlokas.3:
tvaM tu kevalamastraj~no vIravratamanuShThitaH |
shAstrArthaM tattvato gantuM na samarthaH katha~nchana
shlokas.4:
shAstrArthasUkShmadarshI yo dharmanishchayakovidaH |
tenApyevaM na vAchyo.ahaM yadi dharmaM prapashyasi
shlokas.5:
bhrAtRRisauhRRidamAsthAya yaduktaM vachanaM tvayA |
nyAyyaM yuktaM cha kaunteya prIto.ahaM tena te.arjuna
shlokas.6:
yuddhadharmeShu sarveShu kriyANAM naipuNeShu cha |
na tvayA sadRRishaH kashchittriShu lokeShu vidyate
shlokas.7:
dharmasUkShmaM tu yadvAkyaM tatra duShprataraM tvayA |
dhana~njaya na me buddhimabhisha~Nkitumarhasi
shlokas.8:
yuddhashAstravideva tvaM na vRRiddhAH sevitAstvayA |
samAsavistaravidAM na teShAM vetsi nishchayam
shlokas.9:
tapastyAgo vidhiriti nishchayastAta dhImatAm |
paraM paraM jyAya eShAM saiShA naiHshreyasI gatiH
shlokas.10:
na tvetanmanyase pArtha na jyAyo.asti dhanAditi |
atra te vartayiShyAmi yathA naitatpradhAnataH
shlokas.11:
tapaHsvAdhyAyashIlA hi dRRishyante dhArmikA janAH |
RRiShayastapasA yuktA yeShAM lokAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.12:
ajAtashmashravo dhIrAstathAnye vanavAsinaH |
anantA adhanA eva svAdhyAyena divaM gatAH
shlokas.13:
uttareNa tu panthAnamAryA viShayanigrahAt |
abuddhijaM tamastyaktvA lokA.nstyAgavatAM gatAH
shlokas.14:
dakShiNena tu panthAnaM yaM bhAsvantaM prapashyasi |
ete kriyAvatAM lokA ye shmashAnAni bhejire
shlokas.15:
anirdeshyA gatiH sA tu yAM prapashyanti mokShiNaH |
tasmAttyAgaH pradhAneShTaH sa tu duHkhaH praveditum
shlokas.16:
anusRRitya tu shAstrANi kavayaH samavasthitAH |
apIha syAdapIha syAtsArAsAradidRRikShayA
shlokas.17:
vedavAdAnatikramya shAstrANyAraNyakAni cha |
vipATya kadalIskandhaM sAraM dadRRishire na te
shlokas.18:
athaikAntavyudAsena sharIre pa~nchabhautike |
ichChAdveShasamAyuktamAtmAnaM prAhuri~NgitaiH
shlokas.19:
agrAhyashchakShuShA so.api anirdeshyaM cha tadgirA |
karmahetupuraskAraM bhUteShu parivartate
shlokas.20:
kalyANagocharaM kRRitvA manastRRiShNAM nigRRihya cha |
karmasantatimutsRRijya syAnnirAlambanaH sukhI
shlokas.21:
asminnevaM sUkShmagamye mArge sadbhirniShevite |
kathamarthamanarthADhyamarjuna tvaM prasha.nsasi
shlokas.22:
pUrvashAstravido hyevaM janAH pashyanti bhArata |
kriyAsu niratA nityaM dAne yaj~ne cha karmaNi
shlokas.23:
bhavanti sudurAvartA hetumanto.api paNDitAH |
dRRiDhapUrvashrutA mUDhA naitadastIti vAdinaH
shlokas.24:
amRRitasyAvamantAro vaktAro janasa.nsadi |
charanti vasudhAM kRRitsnAM vAvadUkA bahushrutAH
shlokas.25:
yAnvayaM nAbhijAnImaH kastA~nj~nAtumihArhati |
evaM prAj~nAnsatashchApi mahataH shAstravittamAn
shlokas.26:
tapasA mahadApnoti buddhyA vai vindate mahat |
tyAgena sukhamApnoti sadA kaunteya dharmavit

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminvAkyAntare vaktA devasthAno mahAtapAH |
abhinItataraM vAkyamityuvAcha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.2:
yadvachaH phalgunenoktaM na jyAyo.asti dhanAditi |
atra te vartayiShyAmi tadekAgramanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
ajAtashatro dharmeNa kRRitsnA te vasudhA jitA |
tAM jitvA na vRRithA rAja.nstvaM parityaktumarhasi
shlokas.4:
chatuShpadI hi niHshreNI karmaNyeShA pratiShThitA |
tAM krameNa mahAbAho yathAvajjaya pArthiva
shlokas.5:
tasmAtpArtha mahAyaj~nairyajasva bahudakShiNaiH |
svAdhyAyayaj~nA RRiShayo j~nAnayaj~nAstathApare
shlokas.6:
karmaniShThA.nstu budhyethAstaponiShThA.nshcha bhArata |
vaikhAnasAnAM rAjendra vachanaM shrUyate yathA
shlokas.7:
Ihate dhanahetoryastasyAnIhA garIyasI |
bhUyAndoShaH pravardheta yastaM dhanamapAshrayet
shlokas.8:
kRRichChrAchcha dravyasaMhAraM kurvanti dhanakAraNAt |
dhanena tRRiShito.abuddhyA bhrUNahatyAM na budhyate
shlokas.9:
anarhate yaddadAti na dadAti yadarhate |
anarhArhAparij~nAnAddAnadharmo.api duShkaraH
shlokas.10:
yaj~nAya sRRiShTAni dhanAni dhAtrA; yaShTAdiShTaH puruSho rakShitA cha |
tasmAtsarvaM yaj~na evopayojyaM; dhanaM tato.anantara eva kAmaH
shlokas.11:
yaj~nairindro vividhairannavadbhi;rdevAnsarvAnabhyayAnmahaujAH |
tenendratvaM prApya vibhrAjate.asau; tasmAdyaj~ne sarvamevopayojyam
shlokas.12:
mahAdevaH sarvamedhe mahAtmA; hutvAtmAnaM devadevo vibhUtaH |
vishvA.NllokAnvyApya viShTabhya kIrtyA; virochate dyutimAnkRRittivAsAH
shlokas.13:
AvikShitaH pArthivo vai maruttaH; svRRiddhyA martyo yo.ajayaddevarAjam |
yaj~ne yasya shrIH svayaM saMniviShTA; yasminbhANDaM kA~nchanaM sarvamAsIt
shlokas.14:
harishchandraH pArthivendraH shrutaste; yaj~nairiShTvA puNyakRRidvItashokaH |
RRiddhyA shakraM yo.ajayanmAnuShaH saM;stasmAdyaj~ne sarvamevopayojyam

shlokas.1:
devasthAna uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
indreNa samaye pRRiShTo yaduvAcha bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.2:
santoSho vai svargatamaH santoShaH paramaM sukham |
tuShTerna ki~nchitparataH susamyakparitiShThati
shlokas.3:
yadA saMharate kAmAnkUrmo.a~NgAnIva sarvashaH |
tadAtmajyotirAtmaiva svAtmanaiva prasIdati
shlokas.4:
na bibheti yadA chAyaM yadA chAsmAnna bibhyati |
kAmadveShau cha jayati tadAtmAnaM prapashyati
shlokas.5:
yadAsau sarvabhUtAnAM na krudhyati na duShyati |
karmaNA manasA vAchA brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.6:
evaM kaunteya bhUtAni taM taM dharmaM tathA tathA |
tadA tadA prapashyanti tasmAdbudhyasva bhArata
shlokas.7:
anye shamaM prasha.nsanti vyAyAmamapare tathA |
naikaM na chAparaM kechidubhayaM cha tathApare
shlokas.8:
yaj~nameke prasha.nsanti saMnyAsamapare janAH |
dAnameke prasha.nsanti kechideva pratigraham
kechitsarvaM parityajya tUShNIM dhyAyanta Asate
shlokas.9:
rAjyameke prasha.nsanti sarveShAM paripAlanam |
hatvA bhittvA cha ChittvA cha kechidekAntashIlinaH
shlokas.10:
etatsarvaM samAlokya budhAnAmeSha nishchayaH |
adroheNaiva bhUtAnAM yo dharmaH sa satAM mataH
shlokas.11:
adrohaH satyavachanaM sa.nvibhAgo dhRRitiH kShamA |
prajanaH sveShu dAreShu mArdavaM hrIrachApalam
shlokas.12:
dhanaM dharmapradhAneShTaM manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt |
tasmAdevaM prayatnena kaunteya paripAlaya
shlokas.13:
yo hi rAjye sthitaH shashvadvashI tulyapriyApriyaH |
kShatriyo yaj~nashiShTAshI rAjashAstrArthatattvavit
shlokas.14:
asAdhunigraharataH sAdhUnAM pragrahe rataH |
dharme vartmani sa.nsthApya prajA varteta dharmavit
shlokas.15:
putrasa~NkrAmitashrIstu vane vanyena vartayan |
vidhinA shrAmaNenaiva kuryAtkAlamatandritaH
shlokas.16:
ya evaM vartate rAjA rAjadharmavinishchitaH |
tasyAyaM cha parashchaiva lokaH syAtsaphalo nRRipa
nirvANaM tu suduShpAraM bahuvighnaM cha me matam
shlokas.17:
evaM dharmamanukrAntAH satyadAnatapaHparAH |
AnRRisha.nsyaguNairyuktAH kAmakrodhavivarjitAH
shlokas.18:
prajAnAM pAlane yuktA damamuttamamAsthitAH |
gobrAhmaNArthaM yuddhena samprAptA gatimuttamAm
shlokas.19:
evaM rudrAH savasavastathAdityAH parantapa |
sAdhyA rAjarShisa~NghAshcha dharmametaM samAshritAH
apramattAstataH svargaM prAptAH puNyaiH svakarmabhiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminvAkyAntare vAkyaM punarevArjuno.abravIt |
viShaNNamanasaM jyeShThamidaM bhrAtaramIshvaram
shlokas.2:
kShatradharmeNa dharmaj~na prApya rAjyamanuttamam |
jitvA chArInnarashreShTha tapyate kiM bhavAnbhRRisham
shlokas.3:
kShatriyANAM mahArAja sa~NgrAme nidhanaM smRRitam |
vishiShTaM bahubhiryaj~naiH kShatradharmamanusmara
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNAnAM tapastyAgaH pretyadharmavidhiH smRRitaH |
kShatriyANAM cha vihitaM sa~NgrAme nidhanaM vibho
shlokas.5:
kShatradharmo mahAraudraH shastranitya iti smRRitaH |
vadhashcha bharatashreShTha kAle shastreNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.6:
brAhmaNasyApi chedrAjankShatradharmeNa tiShThataH |
prashastaM jIvitaM loke kShatraM hi brahmasa.nsthitam
shlokas.7:
na tyAgo na punaryAch~nA na tapo manujeshvara |
kShatriyasya vidhIyante na parasvopajIvanam
shlokas.8:
sa bhavAnsarvadharmaj~naH sarvAtmA bharatarShabha |
rAjA manIShI nipuNo loke dRRiShTaparAvaraH
shlokas.9:
tyaktvA santApajaM shokaM da.nshito bhava karmaNi |
kShatriyasya visheSheNa hRRidayaM vajrasaMhatam
shlokas.10:
jitvArInkShatradharmeNa prApya rAjyamakaNTakam |
vijitAtmA manuShyendra yaj~nadAnaparo bhava
shlokas.11:
indro vai brahmaNaH putraH karmaNA kShatriyo.abhavat |
j~nAtInAM pApavRRittInAM jaghAna navatIrnava
shlokas.12:
tachchAsya karma pUjyaM hi prashasyaM cha vishAM pate |
tena chendratvamApede devAnAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.13:
sa tvaM yaj~nairmahArAja yajasva bahudakShiNaiH |
yathaivendro manuShyendra chirAya vigatajvaraH
shlokas.14:
mA tvameva~Ngate ki~nchitkShatriyarShabha shochithAH |
gatAste kShatradharmeNa shastrapUtAH parAM gatim
shlokas.15:
bhavitavyaM tathA tachcha yadvRRittaM bharatarShabha |
diShTaM hi rAjashArdUla na shakyamativartitum

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu kaunteyo guDAkeshena bhArata |
novAcha ki~nchitkauravyastato dvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.2:
bIbhatsorvachanaM samyaksatyametadyudhiShThira |
shAstradRRiShTaH paro dharmaH smRRito gArhasthya AshramaH
shlokas.3:
svadharmaM chara dharmaj~na yathAshAstraM yathAvidhi |
na hi gArhasthyamutsRRijya tavAraNyaM vidhIyate
shlokas.4:
gRRihasthaM hi sadA devAH pitara RRiShayastathA |
bhRRityAshchaivopajIvanti tAnbhajasva mahIpate
shlokas.5:
vayA.nsi pashavashchaiva bhUtAni cha mahIpate |
gRRihasthaireva dhAryante tasmAjjyeShThAshramo gRRihI
shlokas.6:
so.ayaM chaturNAmeteShAmAshramANAM durAcharaH |
taM charAvimanAH pArtha dushcharaM durbalendriyaiH
shlokas.7:
vedaj~nAnaM cha te kRRitsnaM tapashcha charitaM mahat |
pitRRipaitAmahe rAjye dhuramudvoDhumarhasi
shlokas.8:
tapo yaj~nastathA vidyA bhaikShamindriyanigrahaH |
dhyAnamekAntashIlatvaM tuShTirdAnaM cha shaktitaH
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNAnAM mahArAja cheShTAH sa.nsiddhikArikAH |
kShatriyANAM cha vakShyAmi tavApi viditaM punaH
shlokas.10:
yaj~no vidyA samutthAnamasantoShaH shriyaM prati |
daNDadhAraNamatyugraM prajAnAM paripAlanam
shlokas.11:
vedaj~nAnaM tathA kRRitsnaM tapaH sucharitaM tathA |
draviNopArjanaM bhUri pAtreShu pratipAdanam
shlokas.12:
etAni rAj~nAM karmANi sukRRitAni vishAM pate |
imaM lokamamuM lokaM sAdhayantIti naH shrutam
shlokas.13:
teShAM jyAyastu kaunteya daNDadhAraNamuchyate |
balaM hi kShatriye nityaM bale daNDaH samAhitaH
shlokas.14:
etAshcheShTAH kShatriyANAM rAjansa.nsiddhikArikAH |
api gAthAmimAM chApi bRRihaspatirabhAShata
shlokas.15:
bhUmiretau nigirati sarpo bilashayAniva |
rAjAnaM chAviroddhAraM brAhmaNaM chApravAsinam
shlokas.16:
sudyumnashchApi rAjarShiH shrUyate daNDadhAraNAt |
prAptavAnparamAM siddhiM dakShaH prAchetaso yathA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhagavankarmaNA kena sudyumno vasudhAdhipaH |
sa.nsiddhiM paramAM prAptaH shrotumichChAmi taM nRRipam
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sha~Nkhashcha likhitashchAstAM bhrAtarau sa.nyatavratau
shlokas.3:
tayorAvasathAvAstAM ramaNIyau pRRithakpRRithak |
nityapuShpaphalairvRRikShairupetau bAhudAmanu
shlokas.4:
tataH kadAchillikhitaH sha~NkhasyAshramamAgamat |
yadRRichChayApi sha~Nkho.atha niShkrAnto.abhavadAshramAt
shlokas.5:
so.abhigamyAshramaM bhrAtuH sha~Nkhasya likhitastadA |
phalAni shAtayAmAsa samyakpariNatAnyuta
shlokas.6:
tAnyupAdAya visrabdho bhakShayAmAsa sa dvijaH |
tasmi.nshcha bhakShayatyeva sha~Nkho.apyAshramamAgamat
shlokas.7:
bhakShayantaM tu taM dRRiShTvA sha~Nkho bhrAtaramabravIt |
kutaH phalAnyavAptAni hetunA kena khAdasi
shlokas.8:
so.abravIdbhrAtaraM jyeShThamupaspRRishyAbhivAdya cha |
ita eva gRRihItAni mayeti prahasanniva
shlokas.9:
tamabravIttadA sha~NkhastIvrakopasamanvitaH |
steyaM tvayA kRRitamidaM phalAnyAdadatA svayam
gachCha rAjAnamAsAdya svakarma prathayasva vai
shlokas.10:
adattAdAnamevedaM kRRitaM pArthivasattama |
stenaM mAM tvaM viditvA cha svadharmamanupAlaya
shIghraM dhAraya chaurasya mama daNDaM narAdhipa
shlokas.11:
ityuktastasya vachanAtsudyumnaM vasudhAdhipam |
abhyagachChanmahAbAho likhitaH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.12:
sudyumnastvantapAlebhyaH shrutvA likhitamAgatam |
abhyagachChatsahAmAtyaH padbhyAmeva nareshvaraH
shlokas.13:
tamabravItsamAgatya sa rAjA brahmavittamam |
kimAgamanamAchakShva bhagavankRRitameva tat
shlokas.14:
evamuktaH sa viprarShiH sudyumnamidamabravIt |
pratishrauShi kariShyeti shrutvA tatkartumarhasi
shlokas.15:
anisRRiShTAni guruNA phalAni puruSharShabha |
bhakShitAni mayA rAja.nstatra mAM shAdhi mAchiram
shlokas.16:
sudyumna uvAcha||
pramANaM chenmato rAjA bhavato daNDadhAraNe |
anuj~nAyAmapi tathA hetuH syAdbrAhmaNarShabha
shlokas.17:
sa bhavAnabhyanuj~nAtaH shuchikarmA mahAvrataH |
brUhi kAmAnato.anyA.nstvaM kariShyAmi hi te vachaH
shlokas.18:
vyAsa uvAcha||
ChandyamAno.api brahmarShiH pArthivena mahAtmanA |
nAnyaM vai varayAmAsa tasmAddaNDAdRRite varam
shlokas.19:
tataH sa pRRithivIpAlo likhitasya mahAtmanaH |
karau prachChedayAmAsa dhRRitadaNDo jagAma saH
shlokas.20:
sa gatvA bhrAtaraM sha~NkhamArtarUpo.abravIdidam |
dhRRitadaNDasya durbhuddherbhagavankShantumarhasi
shlokas.21:
sha~Nkha uvAcha||
na kupye tava dharmaj~na na cha dUShayase mama |
dharmastu te vyatikrAntastataste niShkRRitiH kRRitA
shlokas.22:
sa gatvA bAhudAM shIghraM tarpayasva yathAvidhi |
devAnpitR^InRRiShI.nshchaiva mA chAdharme manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.23:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sha~Nkhasya likhitastadA |
avagAhyApagAM puNyAmudakArthaM prachakrame
shlokas.24:
prAdurAstAM tatastasya karau jalajasaMnibhau |
tataH sa vismito bhrAturdarshayAmAsa tau karau
shlokas.25:
tatastamabravIchCha~NkhastapasedaM kRRitaM mayA |
mA cha te.atra visha~NkA bhUddaivameva vidhIyate
shlokas.26:
likhita uvAcha||
kiM nu nAhaM tvayA pUtaH pUrvameva mahAdyute |
yasya te tapaso vIryamIdRRishaM dvijasattama
shlokas.27:
sha~Nkha uvAcha||
evametanmayA kAryaM nAhaM daNDadharastava |
sa cha pUto narapatistvaM chApi pitRRibhiH saha
shlokas.28:
vyAsa uvAcha||
sa rAjA pANDavashreShTha shreShTho vai tena karmaNA |
prAptavAnparamAM siddhiM dakShaH prAchetaso yathA
shlokas.29:
eSha dharmaH kShatriyANAM prajAnAM paripAlanam |
utpathe.asminmahArAja mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.30:
bhrAturasya hitaM vAkyaM shRRiNu dharmaj~nasattama |
daNDa eva hi rAjendra kShatradharmo na muNDanam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
punareva maharShistaM kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
ajAtashatruM kaunteyamidaM vachanamarthavat
shlokas.2:
araNye vasatAM tAta bhrAtR^INAM te tapasvinAm |
manorathA mahArAja ye tatrAsanyudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
tAnime bharatashreShTha prApnuvantu mahArathAH |
prashAdhi pRRithivIM pArtha yayAtiriva nAhuShaH
shlokas.4:
araNye duHkhavasatiranubhUtA tapasvibhiH |
duHkhasyAnte naravyAghrAH sukhaM tvanubhavantvime
shlokas.5:
dharmamarthaM cha kAmaM cha bhrAtRRibhiH saha bhArata |
anubhUya tataH pashchAtprasthAtAsi vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
atithInAM cha pitR^INAM devatAnAM cha bhArata |
AnRRiNyaM gachCha kaunteya tataH svargaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.7:
sarvamedhAshvamedhAbhyAM yajasva kurunandana |
tataH pashchAnmahArAja gamiShyasi parAM gatim
shlokas.8:
bhrAtR^I.nshcha sarvAnkratubhiH sa.nyojya bahudakShiNaiH |
samprAptaH kIrtimatulAM pANDaveya bhaviShyasi
shlokas.9:
vidma te puruShavyAghra vachanaM kurunandana |
shRRiNu machcha yathA kurvandharmAnna chyavate nRRipaH
shlokas.10:
AdadAnasya cha dhanaM nigrahaM cha yudhiShThira |
samAnaM dharmakushalAH sthApayanti nareshvara
shlokas.11:
deshakAlapratIkShe yo dasyordarshayate nRRipaH |
shAstrajAM buddhimAsthAya nainasA sa hi yujyate
shlokas.12:
AdAya baliShaDbhAgaM yo rAShTraM nAbhirakShati |
pratigRRihNAti tatpApaM chaturthA.nshena pArthivaH
shlokas.13:
nibodha cha yathAtiShThandharmAnna chyavate nRRipaH |
nigrahAddharmashAstrANAmanurudhyannapetabhIH
kAmakrodhAvanAdRRitya piteva samadarshanaH
shlokas.14:
daivenopahate rAjA karmakAle mahAdyute |
pramAdayati tatkarma na tatrAhuratikramam
shlokas.15:
tarasA buddhipUrvaM vA nigrAhyA eva shatravaH |
pApaiH saha na sa.ndadhyAdrAShTraM paNyaM na kArayet
shlokas.16:
shUrAshchAryAshcha satkAryA vidvA.nsashcha yudhiShThira |
gomato dhaninashchaiva paripAlyA visheShataH
shlokas.17:
vyavahAreShu dharmyeShu niyojyAshcha bahushrutAH |
guNayukte.api naikasminvishvasyAchcha vichakShaNaH
shlokas.18:
arakShitA durvinIto mAnI stabdho.abhyasUyakaH |
enasA yujyate rAjA durdAnta iti chochyate
shlokas.19:
ye.arakShyamANA hIyante daivenopahate nRRipe |
taskaraishchApi hanyante sarvaM tadrAjakilbiSham
shlokas.20:
sumantrite sunIte cha vidhivachchopapAdite |
pauruShe karmaNi kRRite nAstyadharmo yudhiShThira
shlokas.21:
vipadyante samArambhAH sidhyantyapi cha daivataH |
kRRite puruShakAre tu nainaH spRRishati pArthivam
shlokas.22:
atra te rAjashArdUla vartayiShye kathAmimAm |
yadvRRittaM pUrvarAjarSherhayagrIvasya pArthiva
shlokas.23:
shatrUnhatvA hatasyAjau shUrasyAkliShTakarmaNaH |
asahAyasya dhIrasya nirjitasya yudhiShThira
shlokas.24:
yatkarma vai nigrahe shAtravANAM; yogashchAgryaH pAlane mAnavAnAm |
kRRitvA karma prApya kIrtiM suyuddhe; vAjigrIvo modate devaloke
shlokas.25:
santyaktAtmA samareShvAtatAyI; shastraishChinno dasyubhirardyamAnaH |
ashvagrIvaH karmashIlo mahAtmA; sa.nsiddhAtmA modate devaloke
shlokas.26:
dhanuryUpo rashanA jyA sharaH sru;ksruvaH khaDgo rudhiraM yatra chAjyam |
ratho vedI kAmago yuddhamagni;shchAturhotraM chaturo vAjimukhyAH
shlokas.27:
hutvA tasminyaj~navahnAvathArI;npApAnmukto rAjasiMhastarasvI |
prANAnhutvA chAvabhRRithe raNe sa; vAjigrIvo modate devaloke
shlokas.28:
rAShTraM rakShanbuddhipUrvaM nayena; santyaktAtmA yaj~nashIlo mahAtmA |
sarvA.NllokAnvyApya kIrtyA manasvI; vAjigrIvo modate devaloke
shlokas.29:
daivIM siddhiM mAnuShIM daNDanItiM; yoganyAyaiH pAlayitvA mahIM cha |
tasmAdrAjA dharmashIlo mahAtmA; hayagrIvo modate svargaloke
shlokas.30:
vidvA.nstyAgI shraddadhAnaH kRRitaj~na;styaktvA lokaM mAnuShaM karma kRRitvA |
medhAvinAM viduShAM saMmatAnAM; tanutyajAM lokamAkramya rAjA
shlokas.31:
samyagvedAnprApya shAstrANyadhItya; samyagrAShTraM pAlayitvA mahAtmA |
chAturvarNyaM sthApayitvA svadharme; vAjigrIvo modate devaloke
shlokas.32:
jitvA sa~NgrAmAnpAlayitvA prajAshcha; somaM pItvA tarpayitvA dvijAgryAn |
yuktyA daNDaM dhArayitvA prajAnAM; yuddhe kShINo modate devaloke
shlokas.33:
vRRittaM yasya shlAghanIyaM manuShyAH; santo vidvA.nsashchArhayantyarhaNIyAH |
svargaM jitvA vIralokA.nshcha gatvA; siddhiM prAptaH puNyakIrtirmahAtmA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dvaipAyanavachaH shrutvA kupite cha dhana~njaye |
vyAsamAmantrya kaunteyaH pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
na pArthivamidaM rAjyaM na cha bhogAH pRRithagvidhAH |
prINayanti mano me.adya shoko mAM nardayatyayam
shlokas.3:
shrutvA cha vIrahInAnAmaputrANAM cha yoShitAm |
