paridevayamAnAnAM shAntiM nopalabhe mune
shlokas.4:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM vyAso yogavidAM varaH |
yudhiShThiraM mahAprAj~naM dharmaj~no vedapAragaH
shlokas.5:
na karmaNA labhyate chintayA vA; nApyasya dAtA puruShasya kashchit |
paryAyayogAdvihitaM vidhAtrA; kAlena sarvaM labhate manuShyaH
shlokas.6:
na buddhishAstrAdhyayanena shakyaM; prAptuM visheShairmanujairakAle |
mUrkho.api prApnoti kadAchidarthA;nkAlo hi kAryaM prati nirvisheShaH
shlokas.7:
nAbhUtikAle cha phalaM dadAti; shilpaM na mantrAshcha tathauShadhAni |
tAnyeva kAlena samAhitAni; sidhyanti chedhyanti cha bhUtikAle
shlokas.8:
kAlena shIghrAH pravivAnti vAtAH; kAlena vRRiShTirjaladAnupaiti |
kAlena padmotpalavajjalaM cha; kAlena puShyanti nagA vaneShu
shlokas.9:
kAlena kRRiShNAshcha sitAshcha rAtryaH; kAlena chandraH paripUrNabimbaH |
nAkAlataH puShpaphalaM nagAnAM; nAkAlavegAH sarito vahanti
shlokas.10:
nAkAlamattAH khagapannagAshcha; mRRigadvipAH shailamahAgrahAshcha |
nAkAlataH strIShu bhavanti garbhA; nAyAntyakAle shishiroShNavarShAH
shlokas.11:
nAkAlato mriyate jAyate vA; nAkAlato vyAharate cha bAlaH |
nAkAlato yauvanamabhyupaiti; nAkAlato rohati bIjamuptam
shlokas.12:
nAkAlato bhAnurupaiti yogaM; nAkAlato.astaM girimabhyupaiti |
nAkAlato vardhate hIyate cha; chandraH samudrashcha mahormimAlI
shlokas.13:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gItaM rAj~nA senajitA duHkhArtena yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
sarvAnevaiSha paryAyo martyAnspRRishati dustaraH |
kAlena paripakvA hi mriyante sarvamAnavAH
shlokas.15:
ghnanti chAnyAnnarA rAja.nstAnapyanye narAstathA |
sa~nj~naiShA laukikI rAjanna hinasti na hanyate
shlokas.16:
hantIti manyate kashchinna hantItyapi chApare |
svabhAvatastu niyatau bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayau
shlokas.17:
naShTe dhane vA dAre vA putre pitari vA mRRite |
aho kaShTamiti dhyAya~nshokasyApachitiM charet
shlokas.18:
sa kiM shochasi mUDhaH sa~nshochyaH kimanushochasi |
pashya duHkheShu duHkhAni bhayeShu cha bhayAnyapi
shlokas.19:
AtmApi chAyaM na mama sarvApi pRRithivI mama |
yathA mama tathAnyeShAmiti pashyanna muhyati
shlokas.20:
shokasthAnasahasrANi harShasthAnashatAni cha |
divase divase mUDhamAvishanti na paNDitam
shlokas.21:
evametAni kAlena priyadveShyANi bhAgashaH |
jIveShu parivartante duHkhAni cha sukhAni cha
shlokas.22:
duHkhamevAsti na sukhaM tasmAttadupalabhyate |
tRRiShNArtiprabhavaM duHkhaM duHkhArtiprabhavaM sukham
shlokas.23:
sukhasyAnantaraM duHkhaM duHkhasyAnantaraM sukham |
na nityaM labhate duHkhaM na nityaM labhate sukham
shlokas.24:
sukhamante hi duHkhAnAM duHkhamante sukhasya cha |
tasmAdetaddvayaM jahyAdya ichChechChAshvataM sukham
shlokas.25:
yannimittaM bhavechChokastApo vA duHkhamUrChitaH |
AyAso vApi yanmUlastadekA~Ngamapi tyajet
shlokas.26:
sukhaM vA yadi vA duHkhaM priyaM vA yadi vApriyam |
prAptaM prAptamupAsIta hRRidayenAparAjitaH
shlokas.27:
IShadapya~Nga dArANAM putrANAM vA charApriyam |
tato j~nAsyasi kaH kasya kena vA kathameva vA
shlokas.28:
ye cha mUDhatamA loke ye cha buddheH paraM gatAH |
ta eva sukhamedhante madhyaH kleshena yujyate
shlokas.29:
ityabravInmahAprAj~no yudhiShThira sa senajit |
parAvaraj~no lokasya dharmavitsukhaduHkhavit
shlokas.30:
sukhI parasya yo duHkhe na jAtu sa sukhI bhavet |
duHkhAnAM hi kShayo nAsti jAyate hyaparAtparam
shlokas.31:
sukhaM cha duHkhaM cha bhavAbhavau cha; lAbhAlAbhau maraNaM jIvitaM cha |
paryAyashaH sarvamiha spRRishanti; tasmAddhIro naiva hRRiShyenna kupyet
shlokas.32:
dIkShAM yaj~ne pAlanaM yuddhamAhu;ryogaM rAShTre daNDanItyA cha samyak |
vittatyAgaM dakShiNAnAM cha yaj~ne; samyagj~nAnaM pAvanAnIti vidyAt
shlokas.33:
rakShanrAShTraM buddhipUrvaM nayena; santyaktAtmA yaj~nashIlo mahAtmA |
sarvA.NllokAndharmamUrtyA chara.nshchA;pyUrdhvaM dehAnmodate devaloke
shlokas.34:
jitvA sa~NgrAmAnpAlayitvA cha rAShTraM; somaM pItvA vardhayitvA prajAshcha |
yuktyA daNDaM dhArayitvA prajAnAM; yuddhe kShINo modate devaloke
shlokas.35:
samyagvedAnprApya shAstrANyadhItya; samyagrAShTraM pAlayitvA cha rAjA |
chAturvarNyaM sthApayitvA svadharme; pUtAtmA vai modate devaloke
shlokas.36:
yasya vRRittaM namasyanti svargasthasyApi mAnavAH |
paurajAnapadAmAtyAH sa rAjA rAjasattamaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
abhimanyau hate bAle draupadyAstanayeShu cha |
dhRRiShTadyumne virATe cha drupade cha mahIpatau
shlokas.2:
vasuSheNe cha dharmaj~ne dhRRiShTaketau cha pArthive |
tathAnyeShu narendreShu nAnAdeshyeShu sa.nyuge
shlokas.3:
na vimu~nchati mAM shoko j~nAtighAtinamAturam |
rAjyakAmukamatyugraM svava.nshochChedakArakam
shlokas.4:
yasyA~Nke krIDamAnena mayA vai parivartitam |
sa mayA rAjyalubdhena gA~Ngeyo vinipAtitaH
shlokas.5:
yadA hyenaM vighUrNantamapashyaM pArthasAyakaiH |
kampamAnaM yathA vajraiH prekShamANaM shikhaNDinam
shlokas.6:
jIrNaM siMhamiva prA.nshuM narasiMhaM pitAmaham |
kIryamANaM sharaistIkShNairdRRiShTvA me vyathitaM manaH
shlokas.7:
prA~NmukhaM sIdamAnaM cha rathAdapachyutaM sharaiH |
ghUrNamAnaM yathA shailaM tadA me kashmalo.abhavat
shlokas.8:
yaH sa bANadhanuShpANiryodhayAmAsa bhArgavam |
bahUnyahAni kauravyaH kurukShetre mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.9:
sametaM pArthivaM kShatraM vArANasyAM nadIsutaH |
kanyArthamAhvayadvIro rathenaikena sa.nyuge
shlokas.10:
yena chogrAyudho rAjA chakravartI durAsadaH |
dagdhaH shastrapratApena sa mayA yudhi ghAtitaH
shlokas.11:
svayaM mRRityuM rakShamANaH pA~nchAlyaM yaH shikhaNDinam |
na bANaiH pAtayAmAsa so.arjunena nipAtitaH
shlokas.12:
yadainaM patitaM bhUmAvapashyaM rudhirokShitam |
tadaivAvishadatyugro jvaro me munisattama
yena sa.nvardhitA bAlA yena sma parirakShitAH
shlokas.13:
sa mayA rAjyalubdhena pApena gurughAtinA |
alpakAlasya rAjyasya kRRite mUDhena ghAtitaH
shlokas.14:
AchAryashcha maheShvAsaH sarvapArthivapUjitaH |
abhigamya raNe mithyA pApenoktaH sutaM prati
shlokas.15:
tanme dahati gAtrANi yanmAM gururabhAShata |
satyavAkyo hi rAja.nstvaM yadi jIvati me sutaH
satyaM mA marshayanvipro mayi tatparipRRiShTavAn
shlokas.16:
ku~njaraM chAntaraM kRRitvA mithyopacharitaM mayA |
subhRRishaM rAjyalubdhena pApena gurughAtinA
shlokas.17:
satyaka~nchukamAsthAya mayokto gururAhave |
ashvatthAmA hata iti ku~njare vinipAtite
kAnnu lokAngamiShyAmi kRRitvA tatkarma dAruNam
shlokas.18:
aghAtayaM cha yatkarNaM samareShvapalAyinam |
jyeShThaM bhrAtaramatyugraM ko mattaH pApakRRittamaH
shlokas.19:
abhimanyuM cha yadbAlaM jAtaM siMhamivAdriShu |
prAveshayamahaM lubdho vAhinIM droNapAlitAm
shlokas.20:
tadAprabhRRiti bIbhatsuM na shaknomi nirIkShitum |
kRRiShNaM cha puNDarIkAkShaM kilbiShI bhrUNahA yathA
shlokas.21:
draupadIM chApyaduHkhArhAM pa~nchaputravinAkRRitAm |
shochAmi pRRithivIM hInAM pa~nchabhiH parvatairiva
shlokas.22:
so.ahamAgaskaraH pApaH pRRithivInAshakArakaH |
AsIna evamevedaM shoShayiShye kalevaram
shlokas.23:
prAyopaviShTaM jAnIdhvamadya mAM gurughAtinam |
jAtiShvanyAsvapi yathA na bhaveyaM kulAntakRRit
shlokas.24:
na bhokShye na cha pAnIyamupayokShye katha~nchana |
shoShayiShye priyAnprANAnihastho.ahaM tapodhana
shlokas.25:
yatheShTaM gamyatAM kAmamanujAne prasAdya vaH |
sarve mAmanujAnIta tyakShyAmIdaM kalevaram
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tameva.nvAdinaM pArthaM bandhushokena vihvalam |
maivamityabravIdvyAso nigRRihya munisattamaH
shlokas.27:
ativelaM mahArAja na shokaM kartumarhasi |
punaruktaM pravakShyAmi diShTametaditi prabho
shlokas.28:
sa.nyogA viprayogAshcha jAtAnAM prANinAM dhruvam |
budbudA iva toyeShu bhavanti na bhavanti cha
shlokas.29:
sarve kShayAntA nichayAH patanAntAH samuchChrayAH |
sa.nyogA viprayogAntA maraNAntaM hi jIvitam
shlokas.30:
sukhaM duHkhAntamAlasyaM dAkShyaM duHkhaM sukhodayam |
bhUtiH shrIrhrIrdhRRitiH siddhirnAdakShe nivasantyuta
shlokas.31:
nAlaM sukhAya suhRRido nAlaM duHkhAya durhRRidaH |
na cha praj~nAlamarthebhyo na sukhebhyo.apyalaM dhanam
shlokas.32:
yathA sRRiShTo.asi kaunteya dhAtrA karmasu tatkuru |
ata eva hi siddhiste neshastvamAtmanA nRRipa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
j~nAtishokAbhitaptasya prANAnabhyutsisRRikShataH |
jyeShThasya pANDuputrasya vyAsaH shokamapAnudat
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
ashmagItaM naravyAghra tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
ashmAnaM brAhmaNaM prAj~naM vaideho janako nRRipaH |
sa.nshayaM paripaprachCha duHkhashokapariplutaH
shlokas.4:
janaka uvAcha||
Agame yadi vApAye j~nAtInAM draviNasya cha |
nareNa pratipattavyaM kalyANaM kathamichChatA
shlokas.5:
ashmovAcha||
utpannamimamAtmAnaM narasyAnantaraM tataH |
tAni tAnyabhivartante duHkhAni cha sukhAni cha
shlokas.6:
teShAmanyatarApattau yadyadevopasevate |
tattaddhi chetanAmasya haratyabhramivAnilaH
shlokas.7:
abhijAto.asmi siddho.asmi nAsmi kevalamAnuShaH |
ityevaM hetubhistasya tribhishchittaM prasichyati
shlokas.8:
sa prasiktamanA bhogAnvisRRijya pitRRisa~nchitAn |
parikShINaH parasvAnAmAdAnaM sAdhu manyate
shlokas.9:
tamatikrAntamaryAdamAdadAnamasAmpratam |
pratiShedhanti rAjAno lubdhA mRRigamiveShubhiH
shlokas.10:
ye cha vi.nshativarShA vA tri.nshadvarShAshcha mAnavAH |
pareNa te varShashatAnna bhaviShyanti pArthiva
shlokas.11:
teShAM paramaduHkhAnAM buddhyA bheShajamAdishet |
sarvaprANabhRRitAM vRRittaM prekShamANastatastataH
shlokas.12:
mAnasAnAM punaryonirduHkhAnAM chittavibhramaH |
aniShTopanipAto vA tRRitIyaM nopapadyate
shlokas.13:
evametAni duHkhAni tAni tAnIha mAnavam |
vividhAnyupavartante tathA sA.nsparshakAni cha
shlokas.14:
jarAmRRityU ha bhUtAni khAditArau vRRikAviva |
balinAM durbalAnAM cha hrasvAnAM mahatAmapi
shlokas.15:
na kashchijjAtvatikrAmejjarAmRRityU ha mAnavaH |
api sAgaraparyantAM vijityemAM vasundharAm
shlokas.16:
sukhaM vA yadi vA duHkhaM bhUtAnAM paryupasthitam |
prAptavyamavashaiH sarvaM parihAro na vidyate
shlokas.17:
pUrve vayasi madhye vApyuttame vA narAdhipa |
avarjanIyAste.arthA vai kA~NkShitAshcha tato.anyathA
shlokas.18:
supriyairviprayogashcha samprayogastathApriyaiH |
arthAnarthau sukhaM duHkhaM vidhAnamanuvartate
shlokas.19:
prAdurbhAvashcha bhUtAnAM dehanyAsastathaiva cha |
prAptivyAyAmayogashcha sarvametatpratiShThitam
shlokas.20:
gandhavarNarasasparshA nivartante svabhAvataH |
tathaiva sukhaduHkhAni vidhAnamanuvartate
shlokas.21:
AsanaM shayanaM yAnamutthAnaM pAnabhojanam |
niyataM sarvabhUtAnAM kAlenaiva bhavantyuta
shlokas.22:
vaidyAshchApyAturAH santi balavantaH sudurbalAH |
strImantashcha tathA ShaNDhA vichitraH kAlaparyayaH
shlokas.23:
kule janma tathA vIryamArogyaM dhairyameva cha |
saubhAgyamupabhogashcha bhavitavyena labhyate
shlokas.24:
santi putrAH subahavo daridrANAmanichChatAm |
bahUnAmichChatAM nAsti samRRiddhAnAM vicheShTatAm
shlokas.25:
vyAdhiragnirjalaM shastraM bubhukShA shvApadaM viSham |
rajjvA cha maraNaM jantoruchchAchcha patanaM tathA
shlokas.26:
niryANaM yasya yaddiShTaM tena gachChati hetunA |
dRRishyate nAbhyatikrAmannatikrAnto na vA punaH
shlokas.27:
dRRishyate hi yuvaiveha vinashyanvasumAnnaraH |
daridrashcha parikliShTaH shatavarSho janAdhipa
shlokas.28:
aki~nchanAshcha dRRishyante puruShAshchirajIvinaH |
samRRiddhe cha kule jAtA vinashyanti pata~Ngavat
shlokas.29:
prAyeNa shrImatAM loke bhoktuM shaktirna vidyate |
kAShThAnyapi hi jIryante daridrANAM narAdhipa
shlokas.30:
ahametatkaromIti manyate kAlachoditaH |
yadyadiShTamasantoShAddurAtmA pApamAcharan
shlokas.31:
striyo.akShA mRRigayA pAnaM prasa~NgAnninditA budhaiH |
dRRishyante chApi bahavaH samprasaktA bahushrutAH
shlokas.32:
iti kAlena sarvArthAnIpsitAnIpsitAni cha |
spRRishanti sarvabhUtAni nimittaM nopalabhyate
shlokas.33:
vAyumAkAshamagniM cha chandrAdityAvahaHkShape |
jyotIMShi saritaH shailAnkaH karoti bibharti vA
shlokas.34:
shItamuShNaM tathA varShaM kAlena parivartate |
evameva manuShyANAM sukhaduHkhe nararShabha
shlokas.35:
nauShadhAni na shAstrANi na homA na punarjapAH |
trAyante mRRityunopetaM jarayA vApi mAnavam
shlokas.36:
yathA kAShThaM cha kAShThaM cha sameyAtAM mahodadhau |
sametya cha vyatIyAtAM tadvadbhUtasamAgamaH
shlokas.37:
ye chApi puruShaiH strIbhirgItavAdyairupasthitAH |
ye chAnAthAH parAnnAdAH kAlasteShu samakriyaH
shlokas.38:
mAtRRipitRRisahasrANi putradArashatAni cha |
sa.nsAreShvanubhUtAni kasya te kasya vA vayam
shlokas.39:
naivAsya kashchidbhavitA nAyaM bhavati kasyachit |
pathi sa~NgatamevedaM dArabandhusuhRRidgaNaiH
shlokas.40:
kvAsaM kvAsmi gamiShyAmi ko nvahaM kimihAsthitaH |
kasmAtkamanushocheyamityevaM sthApayenmanaH
anitye priyasa.nvAse sa.nsAre chakravadgatau
shlokas.41:
na dRRiShTapUrvaM pratyakShaM paralokaM vidurbudhAH |
AgamA.nstvanatikramya shraddhAtavyaM bubhUShatA
shlokas.42:
kurvIta pitRRidaivatyaM dharmANi cha samAcharet |
yajechcha vidvAnvidhivattrivargaM chApyanuvrajet
shlokas.43:
saMnimajjajjagadidaM gambhIre kAlasAgare |
jarAmRRityumahAgrAhe na kashchidavabudhyate
shlokas.44:
AyurvedamadhIyAnAH kevalaM saparigraham |
dRRishyante bahavo vaidyA vyAdhibhiH samabhiplutAH
shlokas.45:
te pibantaH kaShAyA.nshcha sarpIMShi vividhAni cha |
na mRRityumativartante velAmiva mahodadhiH
shlokas.46:
rasAyanavidashchaiva suprayuktarasAyanAH |
dRRishyante jarayA bhagnA nagA nAgairivottamaiH
shlokas.47:
tathaiva tapasopetAH svAdhyAyAbhyasane ratAH |
dAtAro yaj~nashIlAshcha na taranti jarAntakau
shlokas.48:
na hyahAni nivartante na mAsA na punaH samAH |
jAtAnAM sarvabhUtAnAM na pakShA na punaH kShapAH
shlokas.49:
so.ayaM vipulamadhvAnaM kAlena dhruvamadhruvaH |
naro.avashaH samabhyeti sarvabhUtaniShevitam
shlokas.50:
deho vA jIvato.abhyeti jIvo vAbhyeti dehataH |
pathi sa~NgatamevedaM dArairanyaishcha bandhubhiH
shlokas.51:
nAyamatyantasa.nvAso labhyate jAtu kenachit |
api svena sharIreNa kimutAnyena kenachit
shlokas.52:
kva nu te.adya pitA rAjankva nu te.adya pitAmahaH |
na tvaM pashyasi tAnadya na tvAM pashyanti te.api cha
shlokas.53:
na hyeva puruSho draShTA svargasya narakasya vA |
Agamastu satAM chakShurnRRipate tamihAchara
shlokas.54:
charitabrahmacharyo hi prajAyeta yajeta cha |
pitRRidevamaharShINAmAnRRiNyAyAnasUyakaH
shlokas.55:
sa yaj~nashIlaH prajane niviShTaH; prAgbrahmachArI pravibhaktapakShaH |
ArAdhayansvargamimaM cha lokaM; paraM cha muktvA hRRidayavyalIkam
shlokas.56:
samyagghi dharmaM charato nRRipasya; dravyANi chApyAharato yathAvat |
pravRRittachakrasya yasho.abhivardhate; sarveShu lokeShu charAchareShu
shlokas.57:
vyAsa uvAcha||
ityevamAj~nAya videharAjo; vAkyaM samagraM paripUrNahetuH |
ashmAnamAmantrya vishuddhabuddhi;ryayau gRRihaM svaM prati shAntashokaH
shlokas.58:
tathA tvamapyachyuta mu~ncha shoka;muttiShTha shakropama harShamehi |
kShAtreNa dharmeNa mahI jitA te; tAM bhu~NkShva kuntIsuta mA viShAdIH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
avyAharati kaunteye dharmaputre yudhiShThire |
guDAkesho hRRiShIkeshamabhyabhAShata pANDavaH
shlokas.2:
j~nAtishokAbhisantapto dharmarAjaH parantapaH |
eSha shokArNave magnastamAshvAsaya mAdhava
shlokas.3:
sarve sma te sa.nshayitAH punareva janArdana |
asya shokaM mahAbAho praNAshayitumarhasi
shlokas.4:
evamuktastu govindo vijayena mahAtmanA |
paryavartata rAjAnaM puNDarIkekShaNo.achyutaH
shlokas.5:
anatikramaNIyo hi dharmarAjasya keshavaH |
bAlyAtprabhRRiti govindaH prItyA chAbhyadhiko.arjunAt
shlokas.6:
sampragRRihya mahAbAhurbhujaM chandanabhUShitam |
shailastambhopamaM shauriruvAchAbhivinodayan
shlokas.7:
shushubhe vadanaM tasya sudaMShTraM chArulochanam |
vyAkoshamiva vispaShTaM padmaM sUryavibodhitam
shlokas.8:
mA kRRithAH puruShavyAghra shokaM tvaM gAtrashoShaNam |
na hi te sulabhA bhUyo ye hatAsminraNAjire
shlokas.9:
svapnalabdhA yathA lAbhA vitathAH pratibodhane |
evaM te kShatriyA rAjanye vyatItA mahAraNe
shlokas.10:
sarve hyabhimukhAH shUrA vigatA raNashobhinaH |
naiShAM kashchitpRRiShThato vA palAyanvApi pAtitaH
shlokas.11:
sarve tyaktvAtmanaH prANAnyuddhvA vIrA mahAhave |
shastrapUtA divaM prAptA na tA~nshochitumarhasi
shlokas.12:
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sRRi~njayaM putrashokArtaM yathAyaM prAha nAradaH
shlokas.13:
sukhaduHkhairahaM tvaM cha prajAH sarvAshcha sRRi~njaya |
avimuktaM chariShyAmastatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.14:
mahAbhAgyaM paraM rAj~nAM kIrtyamAnaM mayA shRRiNu |
gachChAvadhAnaM nRRipate tato duHkhaM prahAsyasi
shlokas.15:
mRRitAnmahAnubhAvA.nstvaM shrutvaiva tu mahIpatIn |
shrutvApanaya santApaM shRRiNu vistarashashcha me
shlokas.16:
AvikShitaM maruttaM me mRRitaM sRRi~njaya shushruhi |
yasya sendrAH savaruNA bRRihaspatipurogamAH
devA vishvasRRijo rAj~no yaj~namIyurmahAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
yaH spardhAmanayachChakraM devarAjaM shatakratum |
shakrapriyaiShI yaM vidvAnpratyAchaShTa bRRihaspatiH
sa.nvarto yAjayAmAsa yaM pIDArthaM bRRihaspateH
shlokas.18:
yasminprashAsati satAM nRRipatau nRRipasattama |
akRRiShTapachyA pRRithivI vibabhau chaityamAlinI
shlokas.19:
AvikShitasya vai satre vishve devAH sabhAsadaH |
marutaH pariveShTAraH sAdhyAshchAsanmahAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
marudgaNA maruttasya yatsomamapibanta te |
devAnmanuShyAngandharvAnatyarichyanta dakShiNAH
shlokas.21:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.22:
suhotraM chedvaitithinaM mRRitaM sRRi~njaya shushruma |
yasmai hiraNyaM vavRRiShe magahvAnparivatsaram
shlokas.23:
satyanAmA vasumatI yaM prApyAsIjjanAdhipa |
hiraNyamavahannadyastasmi~njanapadeshvare
shlokas.24:
kUrmAnkarkaTakAnnakrAnmakarA~nshi.nshukAnapi |
nadIShvapAtayadrAjanmaghavA lokapUjitaH
shlokas.25:
hairaNyAnpatitAndRRiShTvA matsyAnmakarakachChapAn |
sahasrasho.atha shatashastato.asmayata vaitithiH
shlokas.26:
taddhiraNyamaparyantamAvRRittaM kurujA~Ngale |
IjAno vitate yaj~ne brAhmaNebhyaH samAhitaH
shlokas.27:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
adakShiNamayajvAnaM shvaitya sa.nshAmya mA shuchaH
shlokas.28:
a~NgaM bRRihadrathaM chaiva mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yaH sahasraM sahasrANAM shvetAnashvAnavAsRRijat
shlokas.29:
sahasraM cha sahasrANAM kanyA hemavibhUShitAH |
IjAno vitate yaj~ne dakShiNAmatyakAlayat
shlokas.30:
shataM shatasahasrANAM vRRiShANAM hemamAlinAm |
gavAM sahasrAnucharaM dakShiNAmatyakAlayat
shlokas.31:
a~Ngasya yajamAnasya tadA viShNupade girau |
amAdyadindraH somena dakShiNAbhirdvijAtayaH
shlokas.32:
yasya yaj~neShu rAjendra shatasa~NkhyeShu vai punaH |
devAnmanuShyAngandharvAnatyarichyanta dakShiNAH
shlokas.33:
na jAto janitA chAnyaH pumAnyastatpradAsyati |
yada~NgaH pradadau vittaM somasa.nsthAsu saptasu
shlokas.34:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.35:
shibimaushInaraM chaiva mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
ya imAM pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM charmavatsamaveShTayat
shlokas.36:
mahatA rathaghoSheNa pRRithivImanunAdayan |
ekachChatrAM mahIM chakre jaitreNaikarathena yaH
shlokas.37:
yAvadadya gavAshvaM syAdAraNyaiH pashubhiH saha |
tAvatIH pradadau gAH sa shibiraushInaro.adhvare
shlokas.38:
nodyantAraM dhuraM tasya ka~nchinmene prajApatiH |
na bhUtaM na bhaviShyantaM sarvarAjasu bhArata
anyatraushInarAchChaibyAdrAjarSherindravikramAt
shlokas.39:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
adakShiNamayajvAnaM taM vai sa.nshAmya mA shuchaH
shlokas.40:
bharataM chaiva dauHShantiM mRRitaM sRRi~njaya shushruma |
shAkuntaliM maheShvAsaM bhUridraviNatejasam
shlokas.41:
yo baddhvA tri.nshato hyashvAndevebhyo yamunAmanu |
sarasvatIM vi.nshatiM cha ga~NgAmanu chaturdasha
shlokas.42:
ashvamedhasahasreNa rAjasUyashatena cha |
iShTavAnsa mahAtejA dauHShantirbharataH purA
shlokas.43:
bharatasya mahatkarma sarvarAjasu pArthivAH |
khaM martyA iva bAhubhyAM nAnugantumashaknuvan
shlokas.44:
paraM sahasrAdyo baddhvA hayAnvedIM vichitya cha |
sahasraM yatra padmAnAM kaNvAya bharato dadau
shlokas.45:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.46:
rAmaM dAsharathiM chaiva mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yo.anvakampata vai nityaM prajAH putrAnivaurasAn
shlokas.47:
vidhavA yasya viShaye nAnAthAH kAshchanAbhavan |
sarvasyAsItpitRRisamo rAmo rAjyaM yadAnvashAt
shlokas.48:
kAlavarShAshcha parjanyAH sasyAni rasavanti cha |
nityaM subhikShamevAsIdrAme rAjyaM prashAsati
shlokas.49:
prANino nApsu majjanti nAnarthe pAvako.adahat |
na vyAlajaM bhayaM chAsIdrAme rAjyaM prashAsati
shlokas.50:
AsanvarShasahasrANi tathA putrasahasrikAH |
arogAH sarvasiddhArthAH prajA rAme prashAsati
shlokas.51:
nAnyonyena vivAdo.abhUtstrINAmapi kuto nRRiNAm |
dharmanityAH prajAshchAsanrAme rAjyaM prashAsati
shlokas.52:
nityapuShpaphalAshchaiva pAdapA nirupadravAH |
sarvA droNadughA gAvo rAme rAjyaM prashAsati
shlokas.53:
sa chaturdasha varShANi vane proShya mahAtapAH |
dashAshvamedhA~njArUthyAnAjahAra nirargalAn
shlokas.54:
shyAmo yuvA lohitAkSho mattavAraNavikramaH |
dasha varShasahasrANi rAmo rAjyamakArayat
shlokas.55:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.56:
bhagIrathaM cha rAjAnaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yasyendro vitate yaj~ne somaM pItvA madotkaTaH
shlokas.57:
asurANAM sahasrANi bahUni surasattamaH |
ajayadbAhuvIryeNa bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH
shlokas.58:
yaH sahasraM sahasrANAM kanyA hemavibhUShitAH |
IjAno vitate yaj~ne dakShiNAmatyakAlayat
shlokas.59:
sarvA rathagatAH kanyA rathAH sarve chaturyujaH |
rathe rathe shataM nAgAH padmino hemamAlinaH
shlokas.60:
sahasramashvA ekaikaM hastinaM pRRiShThato.anvayuH |
gavAM sahasramashve.ashve sahasraM gavyajAvikam
shlokas.61:
upahvare nivasato yasyA~Nke niShasAda ha |
ga~NgA bhAgIrathI tasmAdurvashI hyabhavatpurA
shlokas.62:
bhUridakShiNamikShvAkuM yajamAnaM bhagIratham |
trilokapathagA ga~NgA duhitRRitvamupeyuShI
shlokas.63:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.64:
dilIpaM chaivailavilaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yasya karmANi bhUrINi kathayanti dvijAtayaH
shlokas.65:
imAM vai vasusampannAM vasudhAM vasudhAdhipaH |
dadau tasminmahAyaj~ne brAhmaNebhyaH samAhitaH
shlokas.66:
tasyeha yajamAnasya yaj~ne yaj~ne purohitaH |
sahasraM vAraNAnhaimAndakShiNAmatyakAlayat
shlokas.67:
yasya yaj~ne mahAnAsIdyUpaH shrImAnhiraNmayaH |
taM devAH karma kurvANAH shakrajyeShThA upAshrayan
shlokas.68:
chaShAlo yasya sauvarNastasminyUpe hiraNmaye |
nanRRiturdevagandharvAH ShaTsahasrANi saptadhA
shlokas.69:
avAdayattatra vINAM madhye vishvAvasuH svayam |
sarvabhUtAnyamanyanta mama vAdayatItyayam
shlokas.70:
etadrAj~no dilIpasya rAjAno nAnuchakrire |
yatstriyo hemasampannAH pathi mattAH sma sherate
shlokas.71:
rAjAnamugradhanvAnaM dilIpaM satyavAdinam |
ye.apashyansumahAtmAnaM te.api svargajito narAH
shlokas.72:
trayaH shabdA na jIryante dilIpasya niveshane |
svAdhyAyaghoSho jyAghoSho dIyatAmiti chaiva hi
shlokas.73:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.74:
mAndhAtAraM yauvanAshvaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yaM devA maruto garbhaM pituH pArshvAdapAharan
shlokas.75:
sa.nvRRiddho yuvanAshvasya jaThare yo mahAtmanaH |
pRRiShadAjyodbhavaH shrImA.nstrilokavijayI nRRipaH
shlokas.76:
yaM dRRiShTvA piturutsa~Nge shayAnaM devarUpiNam |
anyonyamabruvandevAH kamayaM dhAsyatIti vai
shlokas.77:
mAmeva dhAsyatItyevamindro abhyavapadyata |
mAndhAteti tatastasya nAma chakre shatakratuH
shlokas.78:
tatastu payaso dhArAM puShTihetormahAtmanaH |
tasyAsye yauvanAshvasya pANirindrasya chAsravat
shlokas.79:
taM pibanpANimindrasya samAmahnA vyavardhata |
sa AsIddvAdashasamo dvAdashAhena pArthiva
shlokas.80:
tamiyaM pRRithivI sarvA ekAhnA samapadyata |
dharmAtmAnaM mahAtmAnaM shUramindrasamaM yudhi
shlokas.81:
ya A~NgAraM hi nRRipatiM maruttamasitaM gayam |
a~NgaM bRRihadrathaM chaiva mAndhAtA samare.ajayat
shlokas.82:
yauvanAshvo yadA~NgAraM samare samayodhayat |
visphArairdhanuSho devA dyaurabhedIti menire
shlokas.83:
yataH sUrya udeti sma yatra cha pratitiShThati |
sarvaM tadyauvanAshvasya mAndhAtuH kShetramuchyate
shlokas.86:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.87:
yayAtiM nAhuShaM chaiva mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
ya imAM pRRithivIM sarvAM vijitya sahasAgarAm
shlokas.89:
iShTvA kratusahasreNa vAjimedhashatena cha |
tarpayAmAsa devendraM tribhiH kA~nchanaparvataiH
shlokas.90:
vyUDhe devAsure yuddhe hatvA daiteyadAnavAn |
vyabhajatpRRithivIM kRRitsnAM yayAtirnahuShAtmajaH
shlokas.91:
anteShu putrAnnikShipya yadudruhyupurogamAn |
pUruM rAjye.abhiShichya sve sadAraH prasthito vanam
shlokas.92:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.93:
ambarIShaM cha nAbhAgaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yaM prajA vavrire puNyaM goptAraM nRRipasattama
shlokas.94:
yaH sahasraM sahasrANAM rAj~nAmayuta yAjinAm |
IjAno vitate yaj~ne brAhmaNebhyaH samAhitaH
shlokas.95:
naitatpUrve janAshchakrurna kariShyanti chApare |
ityambarIShaM nAbhAgamanvamodanta dakShiNAH
shlokas.97:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.98:
shashabinduM chaitrarathaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yasya bhAryAsahasrANAM shatamAsInmahAtmanaH
shlokas.99:
sahasraM tu sahasrANAM yasyAsa~nshAshabindavaH |
hiraNyakavachAH sarve sarve chottamadhanvinaH
shlokas.100:
shataM kanyA rAjaputramekaikaM pRRiShThato.anvayuH |
kanyAM kanyAM shataM nAgA nAgaM nAgaM shataM rathAH
shlokas.101:
rathaM rathaM shataM chAshvA deshajA hemamAlinaH |
ashvamashvaM shataM gAvo gAM gAM tadvadajAvikam
shlokas.103:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.104:
gayamAmUrtarayasaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yaH sa varShashataM rAjA hutashiShTAshano.abhavat
shlokas.105:
yasmai vahnirvarAnprAdAttato vavre varAngayaH |
dadato me.akShayA chAstu dharme shraddhA cha vardhatAm
shlokas.106:
mano me ramatAM satye tvatprasAdAddhutAshana |
lebhe cha kAmA.nstAnsarvAnpAvakAditi naH shrutam
shlokas.107:
darshena paurNamAsena chAturmAsyaiH punaH punaH |
ayajatsa mahAtejAH sahasraM parivatsarAn
shlokas.108:
shataM gavAM sahasrANi shatamashvashatAni cha |
utthAyotthAya vai prAdAtsahasraM parivatsarAn
shlokas.109:
tarpayAmAsa somena devAnvittairdvijAnapi |
pitR^InsvadhAbhiH kAmaishcha striyaH svAH puruSharShabha
shlokas.110:
sauvarNAM pRRithivIM kRRitvA dashavyAmAM dvirAyatAm |
dakShiNAmadadadrAjA vAjimedhamahAmakhe
shlokas.111:
yAvatyaH sikatA rAjanga~NgAyAH puruSharShabha |
tAvatIreva gAH prAdAdAmUrtarayaso gayaH
shlokas.112:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.113:
rantidevaM cha sA~NkRRityaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
samyagArAdhya yaH shakraM varaM lebhe mahAyashAH
shlokas.114:
annaM cha no bahu bhavedatithI.nshcha labhemahi |
shraddhA cha no mA vyagamanmA cha yAchiShma ka~nchana
shlokas.115:
upAtiShThanta pashavaH svayaM taM sa.nshitavratam |
grAmyAraNyA mahAtmAnaM rantidevaM yashasvinam
shlokas.116:
mahAnadI charmarAsherutkledAtsusruve yataH |
tatashcharmaNvatItyevaM vikhyAtA sA mahAnadI
shlokas.117:
brAhmaNebhyo dadau niShkAnsadasi pratate nRRipaH |
tubhyaM tubhyaM niShkamiti yatrAkroshanti vai dvijAH
sahasraM tubhyamityuktvA brAhmaNAnsma prapadyate
shlokas.118:
anvAhAryopakaraNaM dravyopakaraNaM cha yat |
ghaTAH sthAlyaH kaTAhAshcha pAtryashcha piTharA api
na tatki~nchidasauvarNaM rantidevasya dhImataH
shlokas.119:
sA~NkRRite rantidevasya yAM rAtrimavasadgRRihe |
Alabhyanta shataM gAvaH sahasrANi cha vi.nshatiH
shlokas.120:
tatra sma sUdAH kroshanti sumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAH |
sUpabhUyiShThamashnIdhvaM nAdya mA.nsaM yathA purA
shlokas.121:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.122:
sagaraM cha mahAtmAnaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
aikShvAkaM puruShavyAghramatimAnuShavikramam
shlokas.123:
ShaShTiH putrasahasrANi yaM yAntaM pRRiShThato.anvayuH |
nakShatrarAjaM varShAnte vyabhre jyotirgaNA iva
shlokas.124:
ekachChatrA mahI yasya praNatA hyabhavatpurA |
yo.ashvamedhasahasreNa tarpayAmAsa devatAH
shlokas.125:
yaH prAdAtkA~nchanastambhaM prAsAdaM sarvakA~nchanam |
pUrNaM padmadalAkShINAM strINAM shayanasa~Nkulam
shlokas.126:
dvijAtibhyo.anurUpebhyaH kAmAnuchchAvachA.nstathA |
yasyAdeshena tadvittaM vyabhajanta dvijAtayaH
shlokas.127:
khAnayAmAsa yaH kopAtpRRithivIM sAgarA~NkitAm |
yasya nAmnA samudrashcha sAgaratvamupAgataH
shlokas.128:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.129:
rAjAnaM cha pRRithuM vainyaM mRRitaM shushruma sRRi~njaya |
yamabhyaShi~nchansambhUya mahAraNye maharShayaH
shlokas.130:
prathayiShyati vai lokAnpRRithurityeva shabditaH |
kShatAchcha nastrAyatIti sa tasmAtkShatriyaH smRRitaH
shlokas.131:
pRRithuM vainyaM prajA dRRiShTvA raktAH smeti yadabruvan |
tato rAjeti nAmAsya anurAgAdajAyata
shlokas.132:
akRRiShTapachyA pRRithivI puTake puTake madhu |
sarvA droNadughA gAvo vainyasyAsanprashAsataH
shlokas.133:
arogAH sarvasiddhArthA manuShyA akutobhayAH |
yathAbhikAmamavasankShetreShu cha gRRiheShu cha
shlokas.134:
ApaH sa.nstambhire yasya samudrasya yiyAsataH |
saritashchAnudIryanta dhvajasa~Ngashcha nAbhavat
shlokas.136:
sa chenmamAra sRRi~njaya chaturbhadratarastvayA |
putrAtpuNyatarashchaiva mA putramanutapyathAH
shlokas.137:
kiM vai tUShNIM dhyAyasi sRRi~njaya tvaM; na me rAjanvAchamimAM shRRiNoShi |
na chenmoghaM vipralaptaM mayedaM; pathyaM mumUrShoriva samyaguktam
shlokas.138:
sRRi~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNomi te nArada vAchametAM; vichitrArthAM srajamiva puNyagandhAm |
rAjarShINAM puNyakRRitAM mahAtmanAM; kIrtyA yuktAM shokanirNAshanArtham
shlokas.139:
na te moghaM vipralaptaM maharShe; dRRiShTvaiva tvAM nAradAhaM vishokaH |
shushrUShe te vachanaM brahmavAdi;nna te tRRipyAmyamRRitasyeva pAnAt
shlokas.140:
amoghadarshinmama chetprasAdaM; sutAghadagdhasya vibho prakuryAH |
mRRitasya sa~njIvanamadya me syA;ttava prasAdAtsutasa~Ngamashcha
shlokas.141:
nArada uvAcha||
yaste putro dayito.ayaM viyAtaH; svarNaShThIvI yamadAtparvataste |
punaste taM putramahaM dadAmi; hiraNyanAbhaM varShasahasriNaM cha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sa kathaM kA~nchanaShThIvI sRRi~njayasya suto.abhavat |
parvatena kimarthaM cha dattaH kena mamAra cha
shlokas.2:
yadA varShasahasrAyustadA bhavati mAnavaH |
kathamaprAptakaumAraH sRRi~njayasya suto mRRitaH
shlokas.3:
utAho nAmamAtraM vai suvarNaShThIvino.abhavat |
tathyaM vA kA~nchanaShThIvItyetadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.4:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
atra te kathayiShyAmi yathA vRRittaM janeshvara |
nAradaH parvatashchaiva prAgRRiShI lokapUjitau
shlokas.5:
mAtulo bhAgineyashcha devalokAdihAgatau |
vihartukAmau samprItyA mAnuShyeShu purA prabhU
shlokas.6:
haviHpavitrabhojyena deva bhojyena chaiva ha |
nArado mAtulashchaiva bhAgineyashcha parvataH
shlokas.7:
tAvubhau tapasopetAvavanItalachAriNau |
bhu~njAnau mAnuShAnbhogAnyathAvatparyadhAvatAm
shlokas.8:
prItimantau mudA yuktau samayaM tatra chakratuH |
yo bhaveddhRRidi sa~NkalpaH shubho vA yadi vAshubhaH
anyonyasya sa Akhyeyo mRRiShA shApo.anyathA bhavet
shlokas.9:
tau tatheti pratij~nAya maharShI lokapUjitau |
sRRi~njayaM shvaityamabhyetya rAjAnamidamUchatuH
shlokas.10:
AvAM bhavati vatsyAvaH ka~nchitkAlaM hitAya te |
yathAvatpRRithivIpAla AvayoH praguNIbhava
tatheti kRRitvA tau rAjA satkRRityopachachAra ha
shlokas.11:
tataH kadAchittau rAjA mahAtmAnau tathAgatau |
abravItparamaprItaH suteyaM varavarNinI
shlokas.12:
ekaiva mama kanyaiShA yuvAM parichariShyati |
darshanIyAnavadyA~NgI shIlavRRittasamanvitA
sukumArI kumArI cha padmaki~njalkasaMnibhA
shlokas.13:
paramaM saumya ityuktastAbhyAM rAjA shashAsa tAm |
kanye viprAvupachara devavatpitRRivachcha ha
shlokas.14:
sA tu kanyA tathetyuktvA pitaraM dharmachAriNI |
yathAnideshaM rAj~nastau satkRRityopachachAra ha
shlokas.15:
tasyAstathopachAreNa rUpeNApratimena cha |
nAradaM hRRichChayastUrNaM sahasaivAnvapadyata
shlokas.16:
vavRRidhe cha tatastasya hRRidi kAmo mahAtmanaH |
yathA shuklasya pakShasya pravRRittAvuDurATChanaiH
shlokas.17:
na cha taM bhAgineyAya parvatAya mahAtmane |
shasha.nsa manmathaM tIvraM vrIDamAnaH sa dharmavit
shlokas.18:
tapasA che~NgitenAtha parvato.atha bubodha tat |
kAmArtaM nAradaM kruddhaH shashApainaM tato bhRRisham
shlokas.19:
kRRitvA samayamavyagro bhavAnvai sahito mayA |
yo bhaveddhRRidi sa~NkalpaH shubho vA yadi vAshubhaH
shlokas.20:
anyonyasya sa Akhyeya iti tadvai mRRiShA kRRitam |
bhavatA vachanaM brahma.nstasmAdetadvadAmyaham
shlokas.21:
na hi kAmaM pravartantaM bhavAnAchaShTa me purA |
sukumAryAM kumAryAM te tasmAdeSha shapAmyaham
shlokas.22:
brahmavAdI gururyasmAttapasvI brAhmaNashcha san |
akArShIH samayabhra.nshamAvAbhyAM yaH kRRito mithaH
shlokas.23:
shapsye tasmAtsusa~Nkruddho bhavantaM taM nibodha me |
sukumArI cha te bhAryA bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.24:
vAnaraM chaiva kanyA tvAM vivAhAtprabhRRiti prabho |
sa.ndrakShyanti narAshchAnye svarUpeNa vinAkRRitam
shlokas.25:
sa tadvAkyaM tu vij~nAya nAradaH parvatAttadA |
ashapattamapi krodhAdbhAgineyaM sa mAtulaH
shlokas.26:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa satyena cha damena cha |
yukto.api dharmanityashcha na svargavAsamApsyasi
shlokas.27:
tau tu shaptvA bhRRishaM kruddhau parasparamamarShaNau |
pratijagmaturanyonyaM kruddhAviva gajottamau
shlokas.28:
parvataH pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM vichachAra mahAmuniH |
pUjyamAno yathAnyAyaM tejasA svena bhArata
shlokas.29:
atha tAmalabhatkanyAM nAradaH sRRi~njayAtmajAm |
dharmeNa dharmapravaraH sukumArImaninditAm
shlokas.30:
sA tu kanyA yathAshApaM nAradaM taM dadarsha ha |
pANigrahaNamantrANAM prayogAdeva vAnaram
shlokas.31:
sukumArI cha devarShiM vAnarapratimAnanam |
naivAvamanyata tadA prItimatyeva chAbhavat
shlokas.32:
upatasthe cha bhartAraM na chAnyaM manasApyagAt |
devaM muniM vA yakShaM vA patitve pativatsalA
shlokas.33:
tataH kadAchidbhagavAnparvato.anusasAra ha |
vanaM virahitaM ki~nchittatrApashyatsa nAradam
shlokas.34:
tato.abhivAdya provAcha nAradaM parvatastadA |
bhavAnprasAdaM kurutAM svargAdeshAya me prabho
shlokas.35:
tamuvAcha tato dRRiShTvA parvataM nAradastadA |
kRRitA~njalimupAsInaM dInaM dInataraH svayam
shlokas.36:
tvayAhaM prathamaM shapto vAnarastvaM bhaviShyasi |
ityuktena mayA pashchAchChaptastvamapi matsarAt
adyaprabhRRiti vai vAsaM svarge nAvApsyasIti ha
shlokas.37:
tava naitaddhi sadRRishaM putrasthAne hi me bhavAn |
nivartayetAM tau shApamanyo.anyena tadA munI
shlokas.38:
shrIsamRRiddhaM tadA dRRiShTvA nAradaM devarUpiNam |
sukumArI pradudrAva parapatyabhisha~NkayA
shlokas.39:
tAM parvatastato dRRiShTvA pradravantImaninditAm |
abravIttava bhartaiSha nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.40:
RRiShiH paramadharmAtmA nArado bhagavAnprabhuH |
tavaivAbhedyahRRidayo mA te bhUdatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.41:
sAnunItA bahuvidhaM parvatena mahAtmanA |
shApadoShaM cha taM bhartuH shrutvA svAM prakRRitiM gatA
parvato.atha yayau svargaM nArado.atha yayau gRRihAn
shlokas.42:
pratyakShakarmA sarvasya nArado.ayaM mahAnRRiShiH |
eSha vakShyati vai pRRiShTo yathA vRRittaM narottama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAjA pANDusuto nAradaM pratyabhAShata |
bhagava~nshrotumichChAmi suvarNaShThIvisambhavam
shlokas.2:
evamuktaH sa cha munirdharmarAjena nAradaH |
AchachakShe yathA vRRittaM suvarNaShThIvinaM prati
shlokas.3:
evametanmahArAja yathAyaM keshavo.abravIt |
kAryasyAsya tu yachCheShaM tatte vakShyAmi pRRichChataH
shlokas.4:
ahaM cha parvatashchaiva svasrIyo me mahAmuniH |
vastukAmAvabhigatau sRRi~njayaM jayatAM varam
shlokas.5:
tatra sampUjitau tena vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
sarvakAmaiH suvihitau nivasAvo.asya veshmani
shlokas.6:
vyatikrAntAsu varShAsu samaye gamanasya cha |
parvato mAmuvAchedaM kAle vachanamarthavat
shlokas.7:
AvAmasya narendrasya gRRihe paramapUjitau |
uShitau samaye brahma.nshchintyatAmatra sAmpratam
shlokas.8:
tato.ahamabruvaM rAjanparvataM shubhadarshanam |
sarvametattvayi vibho bhAgineyopapadyate
shlokas.9:
vareNa ChandyatAM rAjA labhatAM yadyadichChati |
AvayostapasA siddhiM prApnotu yadi manyase
shlokas.10:
tata AhUya rAjAnaM sRRi~njayaM shubhadarshanam |
parvato.anumataM vAkyamuvAcha munipu~NgavaH
shlokas.11:
prItau svo nRRipa satkAraistava hyArjavasambhRRitaiH |
AvAbhyAmabhyanuj~nAto varaM nRRivara chintaya
shlokas.12:
devAnAmavihi.nsAyAM yadbhavenmAnuShakShamam |
tadgRRihANa mahArAja pUjArho nau mato bhavAn
shlokas.13:
sRRi~njaya uvAcha||
prItau bhavantau yadi me kRRitametAvatA mama |
eSha eva paro lAbho nirvRRitto me mahAphalaH
shlokas.14:
nArada uvAcha||
tameva.nvAdinaM bhUyaH parvataH pratyabhAShata |
vRRiNIShva rAjansa~Nkalpo yaste hRRidi chiraM sthitaH
shlokas.15:
sRRi~njaya uvAcha||
abhIpsAmi sutaM vIraM vIryavantaM dRRiDhavratam |
AyuShmantaM mahAbhAgaM devarAjasamadyutim
shlokas.16:
parvata uvAcha||
bhaviShyatyeSha te kAmo na tvAyuShmAnbhaviShyati |
devarAjAbhibhUtyarthaM sa~Nkalpo hyeSha te hRRidi
shlokas.17:
suvarNaShThIvanAchchaiva svarNaShThIvI bhaviShyati |
rakShyashcha devarAjAtsa devarAjasamadyutiH
shlokas.18:
nArada uvAcha||
tachChrutvA sRRi~njayo vAkyaM parvatasya mahAtmanaH |
prasAdayAmAsa tadA naitadevaM bhavediti
shlokas.19:
AyuShmAnme bhavetputro bhavatastapasA mune |
na cha taM parvataH ki~nchiduvAchendravyapekShayA
shlokas.20:
tamahaM nRRipatiM dInamabruvaM punareva tu |
smartavyo.ahaM mahArAja darshayiShyAmi te smRRitaH
shlokas.21:
ahaM te dayitaM putraM pretarAjavashaM gatam |
punardAsyAmi tadrUpaM mA shuchaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.22:
evamuktvA tu nRRipatiM prayAtau svo yathepsitam |
sRRi~njayashcha yathAkAmaM pravivesha svamandiram
shlokas.23:
sRRi~njayasyAtha rAjarSheH kasmi.nshchitkAlaparyaye |
jaj~ne putro mahAvIryastejasA prajvalanniva
shlokas.24:
vavRRidhe sa yathAkAlaM sarasIva mahotpalam |
babhUva kA~nchanaShThIvI yathArthaM nAma tasya tat
shlokas.25:
tadadbhutatamaM loke paprathe kurusattama |
bubudhe tachcha devendro varadAnaM mahAtmanoH
shlokas.26:
tatastvabhibhavAdbhIto bRRihaspatimate sthitaH |
kumArasyAntaraprekShI babhUva balavRRitrahA
shlokas.27:
chodayAmAsa vajraM sa divyAstraM mUrtisa.nsthitam |
vyAghro bhUtvA jahImaM tvaM rAjaputramiti prabho
shlokas.28:
vivRRiddhaH kila vIryeNa mAmeSho.abhibhaviShyati |
sRRi~njayasya suto vajra yathainaM parvato dadau
shlokas.29:
evamuktastu shakreNa vajraH parapura~njayaH |
kumArasyAntaraprekShI nityamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.30:
sRRi~njayo.api sutaM prApya devarAjasamadyutim |
hRRiShTaH sAntaHpuro rAjA vananityo.abhavattadA
shlokas.31:
tato bhAgIrathItIre kadAchidvananirjhare |
dhAtrIdvitIyo bAlaH sa krIDArthaM paryadhAvata
shlokas.32:
pa~nchavarShakadeshIyo bAlo nAgendravikramaH |
sahasotpatitaM vyAghramAsasAda mahAbalaH
shlokas.33:
tena chaiva viniShpiShTo vepamAno nRRipAtmajaH |
vyasuH papAta medinyAM tato dhAtrI vichukrushe
shlokas.34:
hatvA tu rAjaputraM sa tatraivAntaradhIyata |
shArdUlo devarAjasya mAyayAntarhitastadA
shlokas.35:
dhAtryAstu ninadaM shrutvA rudatyAH paramArtavat |
abhyadhAvata taM deshaM svayameva mahIpatiH
shlokas.36:
sa dadarsha gatAsuM taM shayAnaM pItashoNitam |
kumAraM vigatAnandaM nishAkaramiva chyutam
shlokas.37:
sa tamutsa~NgamAropya paripIDitavakShasam |
putraM rudhirasa.nsiktaM paryadevayadAturaH
shlokas.38:
tatastA mAtarastasya rudantyaH shokakarshitAH |
abhyadhAvanta taM deshaM yatra rAjA sa sRRi~njayaH
shlokas.39:
tataH sa rAjA sasmAra mAmantargatamAnasaH |
tachchAhaM chintitaM j~nAtvA gatavA.nstasya darshanam
shlokas.40:
sa mayaitAni vAkyAni shrAvitaH shokalAlasaH |
yAni te yaduvIreNa kathitAni mahIpate
shlokas.41:
sa~njIvitashchApi mayA vAsavAnumate tadA |
bhavitavyaM tathA tachcha na tachChakyamato.anyathA
shlokas.42:
ata UrdhvaM kumAraH sa svarNaShThIvI mahAyashAH |
chittaM prasAdayAmAsa piturmAtushcha vIryavAn
shlokas.43:
kArayAmAsa rAjyaM sa pitari svargate vibhuH |
varShANAmekashatavatsahasraM bhImavikramaH
shlokas.44:
tata iShTvA mahAyaj~nairbahubhirbhUridakShiNaiH |
tarpayAmAsa devA.nshcha pitR^I.nshchaiva mahAdyutiH
shlokas.45:
utpAdya cha bahUnputrAnkulasantAnakAriNaH |
kAlena mahatA rAjankAladharmamupeyivAn
shlokas.46:
sa tvaM rAjendra sa~njAtaM shokametannivartaya |
yathA tvAM keshavaH prAha vyAsashcha sumahAtapAH
shlokas.47:
pitRRipaitAmahaM rAjyamAsthAya duramudvaha |
iShTvA puNyairmahAyaj~nairiShTA.NllokAnavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tUShNImbhUtaM tu rAjAnaM shochamAnaM yudhiShThiram |
tapasvI dharmatattvaj~naH kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt
shlokas.2:
prajAnAM pAlanaM dharmo rAj~nAM rAjIvalochana |
dharmaH pramANaM lokasya nityaM dharmAnuvartanam
shlokas.3:
anutiShThasva vai rAjanpitRRipaitAmahaM padam |
brAhmaNeShu cha yo dharmaH sa nityo vedanishchitaH
shlokas.4:
tatpramANaM pramANAnAM shAshvataM bharatarShabha |
tasya dharmasya kRRitsnasya kShatriyaH parirakShitA
shlokas.5:
tathA yaH pratihantyasya shAsanaM viShaye naraH |
sa bAhubhyAM vinigrAhyo lokayAtrAvighAtakaH
shlokas.6:
pramANamapramANaM yaH kuryAnmohavashaM gataH |
bhRRityo vA yadi vA putrastapasvI vApi kashchana
pApAnsarvairupAyaistAnniyachChedghAtayeta vA
shlokas.7:
ato.anyathA vartamAno rAjA prApnoti kilbiSham |
dharmaM vinashyamAnaM hi yo na rakShetsa dharmahA
shlokas.8:
te tvayA dharmahantAro nihatAH sapadAnugAH |
svadharme vartamAnastvaM kiM nu shochasi pANDava
rAjA hi hanyAddadyAchcha prajA rakShechcha dharmataH
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na te.abhisha~Nke vachanaM yadbravIShi tapodhana |
aparokSho hi te dharmaH sarvadharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.10:
mayA hyavadhyA bahavo ghAtitA rAjyakAraNAt |
tAnyakAryANi me brahmandahanti cha tapanti cha
shlokas.11:
vyAsa uvAcha||
Ishvaro vA bhavetkartA puruSho vApi bhArata |
haTho vA vartate loke karmajaM vA phalaM smRRitam
shlokas.12:
IshvareNa niyuktA hi sAdhvasAdhu cha pArthiva |
kurvanti puruShAH karma phalamIshvaragAmi tat
shlokas.13:
yathA hi puruShashChindyAdvRRikShaM parashunA vane |
Chettureva bhavetpApaM parashorna katha~nchana
shlokas.14:
atha vA tadupAdAnAtprApnuyuH karmaNaH phalam |
daNDashastrakRRitaM pApaM puruShe tanna vidyate
shlokas.15:
na chaitadiShTaM kaunteya yadanyena phalaM kRRitam |
prApnuyAditi tasmAchcha Ishvare tanniveshaya
shlokas.16:
atha vA puruShaH kartA karmaNoH shubhapApayoH |
na paraM vidyate tasmAdevamanyachChubhaM kuru
shlokas.17:
na hi kashchitkvachidrAjandiShTAtpratinivartate |
daNDashastrakRRitaM pApaM puruShe tanna vidyate
shlokas.18:
yadi vA manyase rAjanhaThe lokaM pratiShThitam |
evamapyashubhaM karma na bhUtaM na bhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
athAbhipattirlokasya kartavyA shubhapApayoH |
abhipannatamaM loke rAj~nAmudyatadaNDanam
shlokas.20:
athApi loke karmANi samAvartanta bhArata |
shubhAshubhaphalaM cheme prApnuvantIti me matiH
shlokas.21:
evaM satyaM shubhAdeshaM karmaNastatphalaM dhruvam |
tyaja tadrAjashArdUla maivaM shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.22:
svadharme vartamAnasya sApavAde.api bhArata |
evamAtmaparityAgastava rAjanna shobhanaH
shlokas.23:
vihitAnIha kaunteya prAyashchittAni karmiNAm |
sharIravA.nstAni kuryAdasharIraH parAbhavet
shlokas.24:
tadrAja~njIvamAnastvaM prAyashchittaM chariShyasi |
prAyashchittamakRRitvA tu pretya taptAsi bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
hatAH putrAshcha pautrAshcha bhrAtaraH pitarastathA |
shvashurA guravashchaiva mAtulAH sapitAmahAH
shlokas.2:
kShatriyAshcha mahAtmAnaH sambandhisuhRRidastathA |
vayasyA j~nAtayashchaiva bhrAtarashcha pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bahavashcha manuShyendrA nAnAdeshasamAgatAH |
ghAtitA rAjyalubdhena mayaikena pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
tA.nstAdRRishAnahaM hatvA dharmanityAnmahIkShitaH |
asakRRitsomapAnvIrAnkiM prApsyAmi tapodhana
shlokas.5:
dahyAmyanishamadyAhaM chintayAnaH punaH punaH |
hInAM pArthivasiMhaistaiH shrImadbhiH pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.6:
dRRiShTvA j~nAtivadhaM ghoraM hatA.nshcha shatashaH parAn |
koTishashcha narAnanyAnparitapye pitAmaha
shlokas.7:
kA nu tAsAM varastrINAmavasthAdya bhaviShyati |
vihInAnAM svatanayaiH patibhirbhrAtRRibhistathA
shlokas.8:
asmAnantakarAnghorAnpANDavAnvRRiShNisaMhitAn |
AkroshantyaH kRRishA dInA nipatantyashcha bhUtale
shlokas.9:
apashyantyaH pitR^InbhrAtR^InpatInputrA.nshcha yoShitaH |
tyaktvA prANAnpriyAnsarvA gamiShyanti yamakShayam
shlokas.10:
vatsalatvAddvijashreShTha tatra me nAsti sa.nshayaH |
vyaktaM saukShmyAchcha dharmasya prApsyAmaH strIvadhaM vayam
shlokas.11:
te vayaM suhRRido hatvA kRRitvA pApamanantakam |
narake nipatiShyAmo hyadhaHshirasa eva cha
shlokas.12:
sharIrANi vimokShyAmastapasogreNa sattama |
AshramA.nshcha visheShA.nstvaM mamAchakShva pitAmaha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirasya tadvAkyaM shrutvA dvaipAyanastadA |
samIkShya nipuNaM buddhyA RRiShiH provAcha pANDavam
shlokas.2:
mA viShAdaM kRRithA rAjankShatradharmamanusmara |
svadharmeNa hatA hyete kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha
shlokas.3:
kA~NkShamANAH shriyaM kRRitsnAM pRRithivyAM cha mahadyashaH |
kRRitAntavidhisa.nyuktAH kAlena nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.4:
na tvaM hantA na bhImo.api nArjuno na yamAvapi |
kAlaH paryAyadharmeNa prANAnAdatta dehinAm
shlokas.5:
na yasya mAtApitarau nAnugrAhyo.asti kashchana |
karmasAkShI prajAnAM yastena kAlena saMhRRitAH
shlokas.6:
hetumAtramidaM tasya kAlasya puruSharShabha |
yaddhanti bhUtairbhUtAni tadasmai rUpamaishvaram
shlokas.7:
karmamUrtyAtmakaM viddhi sAkShiNaM shubhapApayoH |
sukhaduHkhaguNodarkaM kAlaM kAlaphalapradam
shlokas.8:
teShAmapi mahAbAho karmANi parichintaya |
vinAshahetukAritve yaiste kAlavashaM gatAH
shlokas.9:
Atmanashcha vijAnIhi niyamavratashIlatAm |
yadA tvamIdRRishaM karma vidhinAkramya kAritaH
shlokas.10:
tvaShTreva vihitaM yantraM yathA sthApayiturvashe |
karmaNA kAlayuktena tathedaM bhrAmyate jagat
shlokas.11:
puruShasya hi dRRiShTvemAmutpattimanimittataH |
yadRRichChayA vinAshaM cha shokaharShAvanarthakau
shlokas.12:
vyalIkaM chApi yattvatra chittavaita.nsikaM tava |
tadarthamiShyate rAjanprAyashchittaM tadAchara
shlokas.13:
idaM cha shrUyate pArtha yuddhe devAsure purA |
asurA bhrAtaro jyeShThA devAshchApi yavIyasaH
shlokas.14:
teShAmapi shrInimittaM mahAnAsItsamuchChrayaH |
yuddhaM varShasahasrANi dvAtri.nshadabhavatkila
shlokas.15:
ekArNavAM mahIM kRRitvA rudhireNa pariplutAm |
jaghnurdaityA.nstadA devAstridivaM chaiva lebhire
shlokas.16:
tathaiva pRRithivIM labdhvA brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
sa.nshritA dAnavAnAM vai sAhyArthe darpamohitAH
shlokas.17:
shAlAvRRikA iti khyAtAstriShu lokeShu bhArata |
aShTAshItisahasrANi te chApi vibudhairhatAH
shlokas.18:
dharmavyuchChittimichChanto ye.adharmasya pravartakAH |
hantavyAste durAtmAno devairdaityA ivolbaNAH
shlokas.19:
ekaM hatvA yadi kule shiShTAnAM syAdanAmayam |
kulaM hatvAtha rAShTraM vA na tadvRRittopaghAtakam
shlokas.20:
adharmarUpo dharmo hi kashchidasti narAdhipa |
dharmashchAdharmarUpo.asti tachcha j~neyaM vipashchitA
shlokas.21:
tasmAtsa.nstambhayAtmAnaM shrutavAnasi pANDava |
devaiH pUrvagataM mArgamanuyAto.asi bhArata
shlokas.22:
na hIdRRishA gamiShyanti narakaM pANDavarShabha |
bhrAtR^InAshvAsayaitA.nstvaM suhRRidashcha parantapa
shlokas.23:
yo hi pApasamArambhe kArye tadbhAvabhAvitaH |
kurvannapi tathaiva syAtkRRitvA cha nirapatrapaH
shlokas.24:
tasmi.nstatkaluShaM sarvaM samAptamiti shabditam |
prAyashchittaM na tasyAsti hrAso vA pApakarmaNaH
shlokas.25:
tvaM tu shuklAbhijAtIyaH paradoSheNa kAritaH |
anichChamAnaH karmedaM kRRitvA cha paritapyase
shlokas.26:
ashvamedho mahAyaj~naH prAyashchittamudAhRRitam |
tamAhara mahArAja vipApmaivaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.27:
marudbhiH saha jitvArInmaghavAnpAkashAsanaH |
ekaikaM kratumAhRRitya shatakRRitvaH shatakratuH
shlokas.28:
pUtapApmA jitasvargo lokAnprApya sukhodayAn |
marudgaNavRRitaH shakraH shushubhe bhAsayandishaH
shlokas.29:
svargaloke mahIyantamapsarobhiH shachIpatim |
RRiShayaH paryupAsante devAshcha vibudheshvaram
shlokas.30:
so.ayaM tvamiha sa~NkrAnto vikrameNa vasundharAm |
nirjitAshcha mahIpAlA vikrameNa tvayAnagha
shlokas.31:
teShAM purANi rAShTrANi gatvA rAjansuhRRidvRRitaH |
bhrAtR^InputrA.nshcha pautrA.nshcha sve sve rAjye.abhiShechaya
shlokas.32:
bAlAnapi cha garbhasthAnsAntvAni samudAcharan |
ra~njayanprakRRitIH sarvAH paripAhi vasundharAm
shlokas.33:
kumAro nAsti yeShAM cha kanyAstatrAbhiShechaya |
kAmAshayo hi strIvargaH shokamevaM prahAsyati
shlokas.34:
evamAshvAsanaM kRRitvA sarvarAShTreShu bhArata |
yajasva vAjimedhena yathendro vijayI purA
shlokas.35:
ashochyAste mahAtmAnaH kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabha |
svakarmabhirgatA nAshaM kRRitAntabalamohitAH
shlokas.36:
avAptaH kShatradharmaste rAjyaM prAptamakalmaSham |
charasva dharmaM kaunteya shreyAnyaH pretya bhAvikaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAni kRRitveha karmANi prAyashchittIyate naraH |
kiM kRRitvA chaiva muchyeta tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
akurvanvihitaM karma pratiShiddhAni chAcharan |
prAyashchittIyate hyevaM naro mithyA cha vartayan
shlokas.3:
sUryeNAbhyudito yashcha brahmachArI bhavatyuta |
tathA sUryAbhinirmuktaH kunakhI shyAvadannapi
shlokas.4:
parivittiH parivettA brahmojjho yashcha kutsakaH |
didhiShUpatistathA yaH syAdagredidhiShureva cha
shlokas.5:
avakIrNI bhavedyashcha dvijAtivadhakastathA |
atIrthe brahmaNastyAgI tIrthe chApratipAdakaH
shlokas.6:
grAmayAjI cha kaunteya rAj~nashcha parivikrayI |
shUdrastrIvadhako yashcha pUrvaH pUrvastu garhitaH
shlokas.7:
vRRithApashusamAlambhI vanadAhasya kArakaH |
anRRitenopachartA cha pratiroddhA gurostathA
shlokas.8:
yashchAgnInapavidhyeta tathaiva brahmavikrayI |
etAnyenA.nsi sarvANi vyutkrAntasamayashcha yaH
shlokas.9:
akAryANyapi vakShyAmi yAni tAni nibodha me |
lokavedaviruddhAni tAnyekAgramanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.10:
svadharmasya parityAgaH paradharmasya cha kriyA |
ayAjyayAjanaM chaiva tathAbhakShyasya bhakShaNam
shlokas.11:
sharaNAgatasantyAgo bhRRityasyAbharaNaM tathA |
rasAnAM vikrayashchApi tiryagyonivadhastathA
shlokas.12:
AdhAnAdIni karmANi shaktimAnna karoti yaH |
aprayachCha.nshcha sarvANi nityaM deyAni bhArata
shlokas.13:
dakShiNAnAmadAnaM cha brAhmaNasvAbhimarshanam |
sarvANyetAnyakAryANi prAhurdharmavido janAH
shlokas.14:
pitrA vibhajate putro yashcha syAdgurutalpagaH |
aprajAyannadharmeNa bhavatyAdharmiko janaH
shlokas.15:
uktAnyetAni karmANi vistareNetareNa cha |
yAni kurvannakurva.nshcha prAyashchittIyate janaH
shlokas.16:
etAnyeva tu karmANi kriyamANAni mAnavAn |
yeShu yeShu nimitteShu na limpantyatha tachChRRiNu
shlokas.17:
pragRRihya shastramAyAntamapi vedAntagaM raNe |
jighA.nsantaM nihatyAjau na tena brahmahA bhavet
shlokas.18:
api chApyatra kaunteya mantro vedeShu paThyate |
vedapramANavihitaM taM dharmaM prabravImi te
shlokas.19:
apetaM brAhmaNaM vRRittAdyo hanyAdAtatAyinam |
na tena brahmahA sa syAnmanyustaM manyumRRichChati
shlokas.20:
prANAtyaye tathAj~nAnAdAcharanmadirAmapi |
achodito dharmaparaH punaH sa.nskAramarhati
shlokas.21:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM kaunteyAbhakShyabhakShaNam |
prAyashchittavidhAnena sarvametena shudhyati
shlokas.22:
gurutalpaM hi gurvarthe na dUShayati mAnavam |
uddAlakaH shvetaketuM janayAmAsa shiShyataH
shlokas.23:
steyaM kurva.nstu gurvarthamApatsu na nibadhyate |
bahushaH kAmakAreNa na chedyaH sampravartate
shlokas.24:
anyatra brAhmaNasvebhya AdadAno na duShyati |
svayamaprAshitA yashcha na sa pApena lipyate
shlokas.25:
prANatrANe.anRRitaM vAchyamAtmano vA parasya vA |
gurvarthe strIShu chaiva syAdvivAhakaraNeShu cha
shlokas.26:
nAvartate vrataM svapne shukramokShe katha~nchana |
AjyahomaH samiddhe.agnau prAyashchittaM vidhIyate
shlokas.27:
pArivittyaM cha patite nAsti pravrajite tathA |
bhikShite pAradAryaM cha na taddharmasya dUShakam
shlokas.28:
vRRithApashusamAlambhaM naiva kuryAnna kArayet |
anugrahaH pashUNAM hi sa.nskAro vidhichoditaH
shlokas.29:
anarhe brAhmaNe dattamaj~nAnAttanna dUShakam |
sakAraNaM tathA tIrthe.atIrthe vA pratipAdanam
shlokas.30:
striyastathApachAriNyo niShkRRitiH syAdadUShikA |
api sA pUyate tena na tu bhartA praduShyate
shlokas.31:
tattvaM j~nAtvA tu somasya vikrayaH syAdadUShakaH |
asamarthasya bhRRityasya visargaH syAdadoShavAn
vanadAho gavAmarthe kriyamANo na dUShakaH
shlokas.32:
uktAnyetAni karmANi yAni kurvanna duShyati |
prAyashchittAni vakShyAmi vistareNaiva bhArata

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tapasA karmabhishchaiva pradAnena cha bhArata |
punAti pApaM puruShaH pUtashchenna pravartate
shlokas.2:
ekakAlaM tu bhu~njAnashcharanbhaikShaM svakarmakRRit |
kapAlapANiH khaTvA~NgI brahmachArI sadotthitaH
shlokas.3:
anasUyuradhaHshAyI karma loke prakAshayan |
pUrNairdvAdashabhirvarShairbrahmahA vipramuchyate
shlokas.4:
ShaDbhirvarShaiH kRRichChrabhojI brahmahA pUyate naraH |
mAse mAse samashna.nstu tribhirvarShaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.5:
sa.nvatsareNa mAsAshI pUyate nAtra sa.nshayaH |
tathaivoparamanrAjansvalpenApi pramuchyate
shlokas.6:
kratunA chAshvamedhena pUyate nAtra sa.nshayaH |
ya chAsyAvabhRRithe snAnti kechideva.nvidhA narAH
shlokas.7:
te sarve pUtapApmAno bhavantIti parA shrutiH |
brAhmaNArthe hato yuddhe muchyate brahmahatyayA
shlokas.8:
gavAM shatasahasraM tu pAtrebhyaH pratipAdayan |
brahmahA vipramuchyeta sarvapApebhya eva cha
shlokas.9:
kapilAnAM sahasrANi yo dadyAtpa~nchavi.nshatim |
dogdhrINAM sa cha pApebhyaH sarvebhyo vipramuchyate
shlokas.10:
gosahasraM savatsAnAM dogdhrINAM prANasa.nshaye |
sAdhubhyo vai daridrebhyo dattvA muchyeta kilbiShAt
shlokas.11:
shataM tai yastu kAmbojAnbrAhmaNebhyaH prayachChati |
niyatebhyo mahIpAla sa cha pApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.12:
manorathaM tu yo dadyAdekasmA api bhArata |
na kIrtayeta dattvA yaH sa cha pApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.13:
surApAnaM sakRRitpItvA yo.agnivarNAM pibeddvijaH |
sa pAvayatyathAtmAnamiha loke paratra cha
shlokas.14:
meruprapAtaM prapata~njvalanaM vA samAvishan |
mahAprasthAnamAtiShThanmuchyate sarvakilbiShaiH
shlokas.15:
bRRihaspatisaveneShTvA surApo brAhmaNaH punaH |
samitiM brAhmaNairgachChediti vai brAhmaNI shrutiH
shlokas.16:
bhUmipradAnaM kuryAdyaH surAM pItvA vimatsaraH |
punarna cha pibedrAjansa.nskRRitaH shudhyate naraH
shlokas.17:
gurutalpI shilAM taptAmAyasImadhisa.nvishet |
pANAvAdhAya vA shephaM pravrajedUrdhvadarshanaH
shlokas.18:
sharIrasya vimokSheNa muchyate karmaNo.ashubhAt |
karmabhyo vipramuchyante yattAH sa.nvatsaraM striyaH
shlokas.19:
mahAvrataM charedyastu dadyAtsarvasvameva tu |
gurvarthe vA hato yuddhe sa muchyetkarmaNo.ashubhAt
shlokas.20:
anRRitenopachartA cha pratiroddhA gurostathA |
upahRRitya priyaM tasmai tasmAtpApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.21:
avakIrNinimittaM tu brahmahatyAvrataM charet |
kharacharmavAsAH ShaNmAsaM tathA muchyeta kilbiShAt
shlokas.22:
paradArApahArI cha parasyApaharanvasu |
sa.nvatsaraM vratI bhUtvA tathA muchyeta kilbiShAt
shlokas.23:
steyaM tu yasyApaharettasmai dadyAtsamaM vasu |
vividhenAbhyupAyena tena muchyeta kilbiShAt
shlokas.24:
kRRichChrAddvAdasharAtreNa svabhyastena dashAvaram |
parivettA bhavetpUtaH parivittishcha bhArata
shlokas.25:
niveshyaM tu bhavettena sadA tArayitA pitR^In |
na tu striyA bhaveddoSho na tu sA tena lipyate
shlokas.26:
bhajane hyRRitunA shuddhaM chAturmAsyaM vidhIyate |
striyastena vishudhyanti iti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.27:
striyastvAsha~NkitAH pApairnopagamyA hi jAnatA |
rajasA tA vishudhyante bhasmanA bhAjanaM yathA
shlokas.28:
chatuShpAtsakalo dharmo brAhmaNAnAM vidhIyate |
pAdAvakRRiShTo rAjanye tathA dharmo vidhIyate
shlokas.29:
tathA vaishye cha shUdre cha pAdaH pAdo vidhIyate |
vidyAdeva.nvidhenaiShAM gurulAghavanishchayam
shlokas.30:
tiryagyonivadhaM kRRitvA drumA.nshChittvetarAnbahUn |
trirAtraM vAyubhakShaH syAtkarma cha prathayennaraH
shlokas.31:
agamyAgamane rAjanprAyashchittaM vidhIyate |
ArdravastreNa ShaNmAsaM vihAryaM bhasmashAyinA
shlokas.32:
eSha eva tu sarveShAmakAryANAM vidhirbhavet |
brAhmaNoktena vidhinA dRRiShTAntAgamahetubhiH
shlokas.33:
sAvitrImapyadhIyAnaH shuchau deshe mitAshanaH |
ahi.nsro.amandako.ajalpanmuchyate sarvakilbiShaiH
shlokas.34:
ahaHsu satataM tiShThedabhyAkAshaM nishi svapet |
trirahnastrirnishAyAshcha savAsA jalamAvishet
shlokas.35:
strIshUdrapatitA.nshchApi nAbhibhAShedvratAnvitaH |
pApAnyaj~nAnataH kRRitvA muchyedeva.nvrato dvijaH
shlokas.36:
shubhAshubhaphalaM pretya labhate bhUtasAkShikaH |
atirichyettayoryattu tatkartA labhate phalam
shlokas.37:
tasmAddAnena tapasA karmaNA cha shubhaM phalam |
vardhayedashubhaM kRRitvA yathA syAdatirekavAn
shlokas.38:
kuryAchChubhAni karmANi nimitte pApakarmaNAm |
dadyAnnityaM cha vittAni tathA muchyeta kilbiShAt
shlokas.39:
anurUpaM hi pApasya prAyashchittamudAhRRitam |
mahApAtakavarjaM tu prAyashchittaM vidhIyate
shlokas.40:
bhakShyAbhakShyeShu sarveShu vAchyAvAchye tathaiva cha |
aj~nAnaj~nAnayo rAjanvihitAnyanujAnate
shlokas.41:
jAnatA tu kRRitaM pApaM guru sarvaM bhavatyuta |
aj~nAnAtskhalite doShe prAyashchittaM vidhIyate
shlokas.42:
shakyate vidhinA pApaM yathoktena vyapohitum |
Astike shraddadhAne tu vidhireSha vidhIyate
shlokas.43:
nAstikAshraddadhAneShu puruSheShu kadAchana |
dambhadoShapradhAneShu vidhireSha na dRRishyate
shlokas.44:
shiShTAchArashcha shiShTashcha dharmo dharmabhRRitAM vara |
sevitavyo naravyAghra pretya cheha sukhArthinA
shlokas.45:
sa rAjanmokShyase pApAttena pUrveNa hetunA |
trANArthaM vA vadhenaiShAmatha vA nRRipakarmaNA
shlokas.46:
atha vA te ghRRiNA kAchitprAyashchittaM chariShyasi |
mA tvevAnAryajuShTena karmaNA nidhanaM gamaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamukto bhagavatA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
chintayitvA muhUrtaM tu pratyuvAcha tapodhanam
shlokas.2:
kiM bhakShyaM kimabhakShyaM cha kiM cha deyaM prashasyate |
kiM cha pAtramapAtraM vA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
siddhAnAM chaiva sa.nvAdaM manoshchaiva prajApateH
shlokas.4:
siddhAstapovrataparAH samAgamya purA vibhum |
dharmaM paprachChurAsInamAdikAle prajApatim
shlokas.5:
kathamannaM kathaM dAnaM kathamadhyayanaM tapaH |
kAryAkAryaM cha naH sarvaM sha.nsa vai tvaM prajApate
shlokas.6:
tairevamukto bhagavAnmanuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt |
shushrUShadhvaM yathAvRRittaM dharmaM vyAsasamAsataH
shlokas.7:
adattasyAnupAdAnaM dAnamadhyayanaM tapaH |
ahi.nsA satyamakrodhaH kShamejyA dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.8:
ya eva dharmaH so.adharmo.adeshe.akAle pratiShThitaH |
AdAnamanRRitaM hi.nsA dharmo vyAvasthikaH smRRitaH
shlokas.9:
dvividhau chApyubhAvetau dharmAdharmau vijAnatAm |
apravRRittiH pravRRittishcha dvaividhyaM lokavedayoH
shlokas.10:
apravRRitteramartyatvaM martyatvaM karmaNaH phalam |
ashubhasyAshubhaM vidyAchChubhasya shubhameva cha
shlokas.11:
etayoshchobhayoH syAtAM shubhAshubhatayA tathA |
daivaM cha daivayuktaM cha prANashcha pralayashcha ha
shlokas.12:
aprekShApUrvakaraNAdashubhAnAM shubhaM phalam |
UrdhvaM bhavati sa.ndehAdiha dRRiShTArthameva vA
aprekShApUrvakaraNAtprAyashchittaM vidhIyate
shlokas.13:
krodhamohakRRite chaiva dRRiShTAntAgamahetubhiH |
sharIrANAmupaklesho manasashcha priyApriye
tadauShadhaishcha mantraishcha prAyashchittaishcha shAmyati
shlokas.14:
jAtishreNyadhivAsAnAM kuladharmA.nshcha sarvataH |
varjayenna hi taM dharmaM yeShAM dharmo na vidyate
shlokas.15:
dasha vA vedashAstraj~nAstrayo vA dharmapAThakAH |
yadbrUyuH kArya utpanne sa dharmo dharmasa.nshaye
shlokas.16:
aruNA mRRittikA chaiva tathA chaiva pipIlakAH |
shleShmAtakastathA viprairabhakShyaM viShameva cha
shlokas.17:
abhakShyA brAhmaNairmatsyAH shakalairye vivarjitAH |
chatuShpAtkachChapAdanyo maNDUkA jalajAshcha ye
shlokas.18:
bhAsA ha.nsAH suparNAshcha chakravAkA bakAH plavAH |
ka~Nko madgushcha gRRidhrAshcha kAkolUkaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.19:
kravyAdAH pakShiNaH sarve chatuShpAdAshcha daMShTriNaH |
yeShAM chobhayato dantAshchaturdaMShTrAshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.20:
eDakAshvakharoShTrINAM sUtikAnAM gavAmapi |
mAnuShINAM mRRigINAM cha na pibedbrAhmaNaH payaH
shlokas.21:
pretAnnaM sUtikAnnaM cha yachcha ki~nchidanirdasham |
abhojyaM chApyapeyaM cha dhenvA dugdhamanirdasham
shlokas.22:
takShNashcharmAvakartushcha pu.nshchalyA rajakasya cha |
chikitsakasya yachchAnnamabhojyaM rakShiNastathA
shlokas.23:
gaNagrAmAbhishastAnAM ra~NgastrIjIvinashcha ye |
parivittinapuMShAM cha bandidyUtavidAM tathA
shlokas.24:
vAryamANAhRRitaM chAnnaM shuktaM paryuShitaM cha yat |
surAnugatamuchChiShTamabhojyaM sheShitaM cha yat
shlokas.25:
piShTamA.nsekShushAkAnAM vikArAH payasastathA |
saktudhAnAkarambhAshcha nopabhojyAshchirasthitAH
shlokas.26:
pAyasaM kRRisaraM mA.nsamapUpAshcha vRRithA kRRitAH |
abhojyAshchApyabhakShyAshcha brAhmaNairgRRihamedhibhiH
shlokas.27:
devAnpitR^InmanuShyA.nshcha munIngRRihyAshcha devatAH |
pUjayitvA tataH pashchAdgRRihastho bhoktumarhati
shlokas.28:
yathA pravrajito bhikShurgRRihasthaH svagRRihe vaset |
eva.nvRRittaH priyairdAraiH sa.nvasandharmamApnuyAt
shlokas.29:
na dadyAdyashase dAnaM na bhayAnnopakAriNe |
na nRRittagItashIleShu hAsakeShu cha dhArmikaH
shlokas.30:
na matte naiva chonmatte na stene na chikitsake |
na vAgghIne vivarNe vA nA~NgahIne na vAmane
shlokas.31:
na durjane dauShkule vA vratairvA yo na sa.nskRRitaH |
ashrotriye mRRitaM dAnaM brAhmaNe.abrahmavAdini
shlokas.32:
asamyakchaiva yaddattamasamyakcha pratigrahaH |
ubhayoH syAdanarthAya dAturAdAtureva cha
shlokas.33:
yathA khadiramAlambya shilAM vApyarNavaM taran |
majjate majjate tadvaddAtA yashcha pratIchChakaH
shlokas.34:
kAShThairArdrairyathA vahnirupastIrNo na dIpyate |
tapaHsvAdhyAyachAritrairevaM hInaH pratigrahI
shlokas.35:
kapAle yadvadApaH syuH shvadRRitau vA yathA payaH |
AshrayasthAnadoSheNa vRRittahIne tathA shrutam
shlokas.36:
nirmantro nirvrato yaH syAdashAstraj~no.anasUyakaH |
anukroshAtpradAtavyaM dIneShvevaM nareShvapi
shlokas.37:
na vai deyamanukroshAddInAyApyapakAriNe |
AptAcharitamityeva dharma ityeva vA punaH
shlokas.38:
niShkAraNaM sma taddattaM brAhmaNe dharmavarjite |
bhavedapAtradoSheNa na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.39:
yathA dArumayo hastI yathA charmamayo mRRigaH |
brAhmaNashchAnadhIyAnastrayaste nAmadhArakAH
shlokas.40:
yathA ShaNDho.aphalaH strIShu yathA gaurgavi chAphalA |
shakunirvApyapakShaH syAnnirmantro brAhmaNastathA
shlokas.41:
grAmadhAnyaM yathA shUnyaM yathA kUpashcha nirjalaH |
yathA hutamanagnau cha tathaiva syAnnirAkRRitau
shlokas.42:
devatAnAM pitR^INAM cha havyakavyavinAshanaH |
shatrurarthaharo mUrkho na lokAnprAptumarhati
shlokas.43:
etatte kathitaM sarvaM yathA vRRittaM yudhiShThira |
samAsena mahaddhyetachChrotavyaM bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrotumichChAmi bhagavanvistareNa mahAmune |
rAjadharmAndvijashreShTha chAturvarNyasya chAkhilAn
shlokas.2:
Apatsu cha yathA nItirvidhAtavyA mahIkShitA |
dharmyamAlambya panthAnaM vijayeyaM kathaM mahIm
shlokas.3:
prAyashchittakathA hyeShA bhakShyAbhakShyavivardhitA |
kautUhalAnupravaNA harShaM janayatIva me
shlokas.4:
dharmacharyA cha rAjyaM cha nityameva virudhyate |
yena muhyati me chetashchintayAnasya nityashaH
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tamuvAcha mahAtejA vyAso vedavidAM varaH |
nAradaM samabhiprekShya sarvaM jAnanpurAtanam
shlokas.6:
shrotumichChasi cheddharmAnakhilena yudhiShThira |
praihi bhIShmaM mahAbAho vRRiddhaM kurupitAmaham
shlokas.7:
sa te sarvarahasyeShu sa.nshayAnmanasi sthitAn |
ChettA bhAgIrathIputraH sarvaj~naH sarvadharmavit
shlokas.8:
janayAmAsa yaM devI divyA tripathagA nadI |
sAkShAddadarsha yo devAnsarvA~nshakrapurogamAn
shlokas.9:
bRRihaspatipurogA.nshcha devarShInasakRRitprabhuH |
toShayitvopachAreNa rAjanItimadhItavAn
shlokas.10:
ushanA veda yachChAstraM devAsuragururdvijaH |
tachcha sarvaM savaiyAkhyaM prAptavAnkurusattamaH
shlokas.11:
bhArgavAchchyavanAchchApi vedAna~NgopabRRiMhitAn |
pratipede mahAbuddhirvasiShThAchcha yatavratAt
shlokas.12:
pitAmahasutaM jyeShThaM kumAraM dIptatejasam |
adhyAtmagatitattvaj~namupAshikShata yaH purA
shlokas.13:
mArkaNDeyamukhAtkRRitsnaM yatidharmamavAptavAn |
rAmAdastrANi shakrAchcha prAptavAnbharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
mRRityurAtmechChayA yasya jAtasya manujeShvapi |
tathAnapatyasya sataH puNyalokA divi shrutAH
shlokas.15:
yasya brahmarShayaH puNyA nityamAsansabhAsadaH |
yasya nAviditaM ki~nchijj~nAnaj~neyeShu vidyate
shlokas.16:
sa te vakShyati dharmaj~naH sUkShmadharmArthatattvavit |
tamabhyehi purA prANAnsa vimu~nchati dharmavit
shlokas.17:
evamuktastu kaunteyo dIrghapraj~no mahAdyutiH |
uvAcha vadatAM shreShThaM vyAsaM satyavatIsutam
shlokas.18:
vaishasaM sumahatkRRitvA j~nAtInAM lomaharShaNam |
AgaskRRitsarvalokasya pRRithivInAshakArakaH
shlokas.19:
ghAtayitvA tamevAjau ChalenAjihmayodhinam |
upasampraShTumarhAmi tamahaM kena hetunA
shlokas.20:
tatastaM nRRipatishreShThaM chAturvarNyahitepsayA |
punarAha mahAbAhuryadushreShTho mahAdyutiH
shlokas.21:
nedAnImatinirbandhaM shoke kartumihArhasi |
yadAha bhagavAnvyAsastatkuruShva nRRipottama
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNAstvAM mahAbAho bhrAtarashcha mahaujasaH |
parjanyamiva gharmArtA Asha.nsAnA upAsate
shlokas.23:
hatashiShTAshcha rAjAnaH kRRitsnaM chaiva samAgatam |
chAturvarNyaM mahArAja rAShTraM te kurujA~Ngalam
shlokas.24:
priyArthamapi chaiteShAM brAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm |
niyogAdasya cha gurorvyAsasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.25:
suhRRidAM chAsmadAdInAM draupadyAshcha parantapa |
kuru priyamamitraghna lokasya cha hitaM kuru
shlokas.26:
evamuktastu kRRiShNena rAjA rAjIvalochanaH |
hitArthaM sarvalokasya samuttasthau mahAtapAH
shlokas.27:
so.anunIto naravyAghro viShTarashravasA svayam |
dvaipAyanena cha tathA devasthAnena jiShNunA
shlokas.28:
etaishchAnyaishcha bahubhiranunIto yudhiShThiraH |
vyajahAnmAnasaM duHkhaM santApaM cha mahAmanAH
shlokas.29:
shrutavAkyaH shrutanidhiH shrutashravyavishAradaH |
vyavasya manasaH shAntimagachChatpANDunandanaH
shlokas.30:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA nakShatrairiva chandramAH |
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya svapuraM pravivesha ha
shlokas.31:
pravivikShuH sa dharmaj~naH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
archayAmAsa devA.nshcha brAhmaNA.nshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.32:
tato rathaM navaM shubhraM kambalAjinasa.nvRRitam |
yuktaM ShoDashabhirgobhiH pANDuraiH shubhalakShaNaiH
shlokas.33:
mantrairabhyarchitaH puNyaiH stUyamAno maharShibhiH |
Aruroha yathA devaH somo.amRRitamayaM ratham
shlokas.34:
jagrAha rashmInkaunteyo bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
arjunaH pANDuraM ChatraM dhArayAmAsa bhAnumat
shlokas.35:
dhriyamANaM tu tachChatraM pANDuraM tasya mUrdhani |
shushubhe tArakArAjasitamabhramivAmbare
shlokas.36:
chAmaravyajane chAsya vIrau jagRRihatustadA |
chandrarashmiprabhe shubhre mAdrIputrAvala~NkRRite
shlokas.37:
te pa~ncha rathamAsthAya bhrAtaraH samala~NkRRitAH |
bhUtAnIva samastAni rAjandadRRishire tadA
shlokas.38:
AsthAya tu rathaM shubhraM yuktamashvairmahAjavaiH |
anvayAtpRRiShThato rAjanyuyutsuH pANDavAgrajam
shlokas.39:
rathaM hemamayaM shubhraM sainyasugrIvayojitam |
saha sAtyakinA kRRiShNaH samAsthAyAnvayAtkurUn
shlokas.40:
narayAnena tu jyeShThaH pitA pArthasya bhArata |
agrato dharmarAjasya gAndhArIsahito yayau
shlokas.41:
kurustriyashcha tAH sarvAH kuntI kRRiShNA cha draupadI |
yAnairuchchAvachairjagmurvidureNa puraskRRitAH
shlokas.42:
tato rathAshcha bahulA nAgAshcha samala~NkRRitAH |
pAdAtAshcha hayAshchaiva pRRiShThataH samanuvrajan
shlokas.43:
tato vaitAlikaiH sUtairmAgadhaishcha subhAShitaiH |
stUyamAno yayau rAjA nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.44:
tatprayANaM mahAbAhorbabhUvApratimaM bhuvi |
AkulAkulamutsRRiShTaM hRRiShTapuShTajanAnvitam
shlokas.45:
abhiyAne tu pArthasya narairnagaravAsibhiH |
nagaraM rAjamArgashcha yathAvatsamala~NkRRitam
shlokas.46:
pANDureNa cha mAlyena patAkAbhishcha vedibhiH |
sa.nvRRito rAjamArgashcha dhUpanaishcha sudhUpitaH
shlokas.47:
atha chUrNaishcha gandhAnAM nAnApuShpaiH priya~NgubhiH |
mAlyadAmabhirAsaktai rAjaveshmAbhisa.nvRRitam
shlokas.48:
kumbhAshcha nagaradvAri vAripUrNA dRRiDhA navAH |
kanyAH sumanasashChAgAH sthApitAstatra tatra ha
shlokas.49:
tathA svala~NkRRitadvAraM nagaraM pANDunandanaH |
stUyamAnaH shubhairvAkyaiH pravivesha suhRRidvRRitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
praveshane tu pArthAnAM janasya puravAsinaH |
didRRikShUNAM sahasrANi samAjagmurbahUnyatha
shlokas.2:
sa rAjamArgaH shushubhe samala~NkRRitachatvaraH |
yathA chandrodaye rAjanvardhamAno mahodadhiH
shlokas.3:
gRRihANi rAjamArge tu ratnavanti bRRihanti cha |
prAkampanteva bhAreNa strINAM pUrNAni bhArata
shlokas.4:
tAH shanairiva savrIDaM prashasha.nsuryudhiShThiram |
bhImasenArjunau chaiva mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.5:
dhanyA tvamasi pA~nchAli yA tvaM puruShasattamAn |
upatiShThasi kalyANi maharShIniva gautamI
shlokas.6:
tava karmANyamoghAni vratacharyA cha bhAmini |
iti kRRiShNAM mahArAja prashasha.nsustadA striyaH
shlokas.7:
prasha.nsAvachanaistAsAM mithaHshabdaishcha bhArata |
prItijaishcha tadA shabdaiH puramAsItsamAkulam
shlokas.8:
tamatItya yathAyuktaM rAjamArgaM yudhiShThiraH |
ala~NkRRitaM shobhamAnamupAyAdrAjaveshma ha
shlokas.9:
tataH prakRRitayaH sarvAH paurajAnapadAstathA |
UchuH kathAH karNasukhAH samupetya tatastataH
shlokas.10:
diShTyA jayasi rAjendra shatrU~nshatrunisUdana |
diShTyA rAjyaM punaH prAptaM dharmeNa cha balena cha
shlokas.11:
bhava nastvaM mahArAja rAjeha sharadAM shatam |
prajAH pAlaya dharmeNa yathendrastridivaM nRRipa
shlokas.12:
evaM rAjakuladvAri ma~NgalairabhipUjitaH |
AshIrvAdAndvijairuktAnpratigRRihya samantataH
shlokas.13:
pravishya bhavanaM rAjA devarAjagRRihopamam |
shrutvA vijayasa.nyuktaM rathAtpashchAdavAtarat
shlokas.14:
pravishyAbhyantaraM shrImAndaivatAnyabhigamya cha |
pUjayAmAsa ratnaishcha gandhairmAlyaishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.15:
nishchakrAma tataH shrImAnpunareva mahAyashAH |
dadarsha brAhmaNA.nshchaiva so.abhirUpAnupasthitAn
shlokas.16:
sa sa.nvRRitastadA viprairAshIrvAdavivakShubhiH |
shushubhe vimalashchandrastArAgaNavRRito yathA
shlokas.17:
tAnsa sampUjayAmAsa kaunteyo vidhivaddvijAn |
dhaumyaM guruM puraskRRitya jyeShThaM pitarameva cha
shlokas.18:
sumanomodakai ratnairhiraNyena cha bhUriNA |
gobhirvastraishcha rAjendra vividhaishcha kimichChakaiH
shlokas.19:
tataH puNyAhaghoSho.abhUddivaM stabdhveva bhArata |
suhRRidAM harShajananaH puNyaH shrutisukhAvahaH
shlokas.20:
ha.nsavanneduShAM rAjandvijAnAM tatra bhAratI |
shushruve vedaviduShAM puShkalArthapadAkSharA
shlokas.21:
tato dundubhinirghoShaH sha~NkhAnAM cha manoramaH |
jayaM pravadatAM tatra svanaH prAdurabhUnnRRipa
shlokas.22:
niHshabde cha sthite tatra tato viprajane punaH |
rAjAnaM brAhmaNachChadmA chArvAko rAkShaso.abravIt
shlokas.23:
tatra duryodhanasakhA bhikShurUpeNa sa.nvRRitaH |
sA~NkhyaH shikhI tridaNDI cha dhRRiShTo vigatasAdhvasaH
shlokas.24:
vRRitaH sarvaistadA viprairAshIrvAdavivakShubhiH |
para.nsahasrai rAjendra taponiyamasa.nsthitaiH
shlokas.25:
sa duShTaH pApamAsha.nsanpANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
anAmantryaiva tAnviprA.nstamuvAcha mahIpatim
shlokas.26:
ime prAhurdvijAH sarve samAropya vacho mayi |
dhigbhavantaM kunRRipatiM j~nAtighAtinamastu vai
shlokas.27:
kiM te rAjyena kaunteya kRRitvemaM j~nAtisa~NkShayam |
ghAtayitvA gurU.nshchaiva mRRitaM shreyo na jIvitam
shlokas.28:
iti te vai dvijAH shrutvA tasya ghorasya rakShasaH |
vivyathushchukrushushchaiva tasya vAkyapradharShitAH
shlokas.29:
tataste brAhmaNAH sarve sa cha rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
vrIDitAH paramodvignAstUShNImAsanvishAM pate
shlokas.30:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
prasIdantu bhavanto me praNatasyAbhiyAchataH |
pratyApannaM vyasaninaM na mAM dhikkartumarhatha
shlokas.31:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAjanbrAhmaNAste sarva eva vishAM pate |
Uchurnaitadvacho.asmAkaM shrIrastu tava pArthiva
shlokas.32:
jaj~nushchaiva mahAtmAnastatastaM j~nAnachakShuShA |
brAhmaNA vedavidvA.nsastapobhirvimalIkRRitAH
shlokas.33:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
eSha duryodhanasakhA chArvAko nAma rAkShasaH |
parivrAjakarUpeNa hitaM tasya chikIrShati
shlokas.34:
na vayaM brUma dharmAtmanvyetu te bhayamIdRRisham |
upatiShThatu kalyANaM bhavantaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.35:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste brAhmaNAH sarve hu~NkAraiH krodhamUrChitAH |
nirbhartsayantaH shuchayo nijaghnuH pAparAkShasam
shlokas.36:
sa papAta vinirdagdhastejasA brahmavAdinAm |
mahendrAshaninirdagdhaH pAdapo.a~NkuravAniva
shlokas.37:
pUjitAshcha yayurviprA rAjAnamabhinandya tam |
rAjA cha harShamApede pANDavaH sasuhRRijjanaH
shlokas.38:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
brAhmaNAstAta loke.asminnarchanIyAH sadA mama |
ete bhUmicharA devA vAgviShAH suprasAdakAH
shlokas.39:
purA kRRitayuge tAta chArvAko nAma rAkShasaH |
tapastepe mahAbAho badaryAM bahuvatsaram
shlokas.40:
ChandyamAno vareNAtha brahmaNA sa punaH punaH |
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo varayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.41:
dvijAvamAnAdanyatra prAdAdvaramanuttamam |
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyastatastasmai jagatprabhuH
shlokas.42:
sa tu labdhavaraH pApo devAnamitavikramaH |
rAkShasastApayAmAsa tIvrakarmA mahAbalaH
shlokas.43:
tato devAH sametyAtha brahmANamidamabruvan |
vadhAya rakShasastasya balaviprakRRitAstadA
shlokas.44:
tAnuvAchAvyayo devo vihitaM tatra vai mayA |
yathAsya bhavitA mRRityurachireNaiva bhArata
shlokas.45:
rAjA duryodhano nAma sakhAsya bhavitA nRRipa |
tasya snehAvabaddho.asau brAhmaNAnavama.nsyate
shlokas.46:
tatrainaM ruShitA viprA viprakArapradharShitAH |
dhakShyanti vAgbalAH pApaM tato nAshaM gamiShyati
shlokas.47:
sa eSha nihataH shete brahmadaNDena rAkShasaH |
chArvAko nRRipatishreShTha mA shucho bharatarShabha
shlokas.48:
hatAste kShatradharmeNa j~nAtayastava pArthiva |
svargatAshcha mahAtmAno vIrAH kShatriyapu~NgavAH
shlokas.49:
sa tvamAtiShTha kalyANaM mA te bhUdglAnirachyuta |
shatrU~njahi prajA rakSha dvijA.nshcha pratipAlaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kuntIsuto rAjA gatamanyurgatajvaraH |
kA~nchane prA~Nmukho hRRiShTo nyaShIdatparamAsane
shlokas.2:
tamevAbhimukhau pIThe sevyAstaraNasa.nvRRite |
sAtyakirvAsudevashcha niShIdaturari.ndamau
shlokas.3:
madhye kRRitvA tu rAjAnaM bhImasenArjunAvubhau |
niShIdaturmahAtmAnau shlakShNayormaNipIThayoH
shlokas.4:
dAnte shayyAsane shubhre jAmbUnadavibhUShite |
pRRithApi sahadevena sahAste nakulena cha
shlokas.5:
sudharmA viduro dhaumyo dhRRitarAShTrashcha kauravaH |
niShedurjvalanAkAreShvAsaneShu pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.6:
yuyutsuH sa~njayashchaiva gAndhArI cha yashasvinI |
dhRRitarAShTro yato rAjA tataH sarva upAvishan
shlokas.7:
tatropaviShTo dharmAtmA shvetAH sumanaso.aspRRishat |
svastikAnakShatAnbhUmiM suvarNaM rajataM maNIn
shlokas.8:
tataH prakRRitayaH sarvAH puraskRRitya purohitam |
dadRRishurdharmarAjAnamAdAya bahu ma~Ngalam
shlokas.9:
pRRithivIM cha suvarNaM cha ratnAni vividhAni cha |
AbhiShechanikaM bhANDaM sarvasambhArasambhRRitam
shlokas.10:
kA~nchanaudumbarAstatra rAjatAH pRRithivImayAH |
pUrNakumbhAH sumanaso lAjA barhIMShi gorasAH
shlokas.11:
shamIpalAshapuMnAgAH samidho madhusarpiShI |
sruva audumbaraH sha~NkhAstathA hemavibhUShitAH
shlokas.12:
dAshArheNAbhyanuj~nAtastatra dhaumyaH purohitaH |
prAgudakpravaNAM vedIM lakShaNenopalipya ha
shlokas.13:
vyAghracharmottare shlakShNe sarvatobhadra Asane |
dRRiDhapAdapratiShThAne hutAshanasamatviShi
shlokas.14:
upaveshya mahAtmAnaM kRRiShNAM cha drupadAtmajAm |
juhAva pAvakaM dhImAnvidhimantrapuraskRRitam
shlokas.15:
abhyaShi~nchatpatiM pRRithvyAH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
dhRRitarAShTrashcha rAjarShiH sarvAH prakRRitayastathA
shlokas.16:
tato.anuvAdayAmAsuH paNavAnakadundubhIH |
dharmarAjo.api tatsarvaM pratijagrAha dharmataH
shlokas.17:
pUjayAmAsa tA.nshchApi vidhivadbhUridakShiNaH |
tato niShkasahasreNa brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchayat
vedAdhyayanasampannA~nshIlavRRittasamanvitAn
shlokas.18:
te prItA brAhmaNA rAjansvastyUchurjayameva cha |
ha.nsA iva cha nardantaH prashasha.nsuryudhiShThiram
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho diShTyA jayasi pANDava |
diShTyA svadharmaM prApto.asi vikrameNa mahAdyute
shlokas.20:
diShTyA gANDIvadhanvA cha bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
tvaM chApi kushalI rAjanmAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.21:
muktA vIrakShayAdasmAtsa~NgrAmAnnihatadviShaH |
kShipramuttarakAlAni kuru kAryANi pANDava
shlokas.22:
tataH pratyarchitaH sadbhirdharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
pratipede mahadrAjyaM suhRRidbhiH saha bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prakRRitInAM tu tadvAkyaM deshakAlopasaMhitam |
shrutvA yudhiShThiro rAjAthottaraM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
dhanyAH pANDusutA loke yeShAM brAhmaNapu~NgavAH |
tathyAnvApyatha vAtathyAnguNAnAhuH samAgatAH
shlokas.3:
anugrAhyA vayaM nUnaM bhavatAmiti me matiH |
yatraivaM guNasampannAnasmAnbrUtha vimatsarAH
shlokas.4:
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAjaH pitA no daivataM param |
sAshane.asya priye chaiva stheyaM matpriyakA~NkShibhiH
shlokas.5:
etadarthaM hi jIvAmi kRRitvA j~nAtivadhaM mahat |
asya shushrUShaNaM kAryaM mayA nityamatandriNA
shlokas.6:
yadi chAhamanugrAhyo bhavatAM suhRRidAM tataH |
dhRRitarAShTre yathApUrvaM vRRittiM vartitumarhatha
shlokas.7:
eSha nAtho hi jagato bhavatAM cha mayA saha |
asyaiva pRRithivI kRRitsnA pANDavAH sarva eva cha
etanmanasi kartavyaM bhavadbhirvachanaM mama
shlokas.8:
anugamya cha rAjAnaM yatheShTaM gamyatAmiti |
paurajAnapadAnsarvAnvisRRijya kurunandanaH
yauvarAjyena kauravyo bhImasenamayojayat
shlokas.9:
mantre cha nishchaye chaiva ShADguNyasya cha chintane |
viduraM buddhisampannaM prItimAnvai samAdishat
shlokas.10:
kRRitAkRRitaparij~nAne tathAyavyayachintane |
sa~njayaM yojayAmAsa RRiddhamRRiddhairguNairyutam
shlokas.11:
balasya parimANe cha bhaktavetanayostathA |
nakulaM vyAdishadrAjA karmiNAmanvavekShaNe
shlokas.12:
parachakroparodhe cha dRRiptAnAM chAvamardane |
yudhiShThiro mahArAjaH phalgunaM vyAdidesha ha
shlokas.13:
dvijAnAM vedakAryeShu kAryeShvanyeShu chaiva hi |
dhaumyaM purodhasAM shreShThaM vyAdidesha parantapaH
shlokas.14:
sahadevaM samIpasthaM nityameva samAdishat |
tena gopyo hi nRRipatiH sarvAvastho vishAM pate
shlokas.15:
yAnyAnamanyadyogyA.nshcha yeShu yeShviha karmasu |
tA.nstA.nsteShveva yuyuje prIyamANo mahIpatiH
shlokas.16:
viduraM sa~njayaM chaiva yuyutsuM cha mahAmatim |
abravItparavIraghno dharmAtmA dharmavatsalaH
shlokas.17:
utthAyotthAya yatkAryamasya rAj~naH piturmama |
sarvaM bhavadbhiH kartavyamapramattairyathAtatham
shlokas.18:
paurajAnapadAnAM cha yAni kAryANi nityashaH |
rAjAnaM samanuj~nApya tAni kAryANi dharmataH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA j~nAtInAM ye hatA mRRidhe |
shrAddhAni kArayAmAsa teShAM pRRithagudAradhIH
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTro dadau rAjA putrANAmaurdhvadehikam |
sarvakAmaguNopetamannaM gAshcha dhanAni cha
ratnAni cha vichitrANi mahArhANi mahAyashAH
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThirastu karNasya droNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnAbhimanyubhyAM haiDimbasya cha rakShasaH
shlokas.4:
virATaprabhRRitInAM cha suhRRidAmupakAriNAm |
drupadadraupadeyAnAM draupadyA sahito dadau
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNAnAM sahasrANi pRRithagekaikamuddishan |
dhanaishcha vastrai ratnaishcha gobhishcha samatarpayat
shlokas.6:
ye chAnye pRRithivIpAlA yeShAM nAsti suhRRijjanaH |
uddishyoddishya teShAM cha chakre rAjaurdhvadaihikam
shlokas.7:
sabhAH prapAshcha vividhAstaDAgAni cha pANDavaH |
suhRRidAM kArayAmAsa sarveShAmaurdhvadaihikam
shlokas.8:
sa teShAmanRRiNo bhUtvA gatvA lokeShvavAchyatAm |
kRRitakRRityo.abhavadrAjA prajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTraM yathApUrvaM gAndhArIM viduraM tathA |
sarvA.nshcha kauravAmAtyAnbhRRityA.nshcha samapUjayat
shlokas.10:
yAshcha tatra striyaH kAshchiddhatavIrA hatAtmajAH |
sarvAstAH kauravo rAjA sampUjyApAlayadghRRiNI
shlokas.11:
dInAndhakRRipaNAnAM cha gRRihAchChAdanabhojanaiH |
AnRRisha.nsyaparo rAjA chakArAnugrahaM prabhuH
shlokas.12:
sa vijitya mahIM kRRitsnAmAnRRiNyaM prApya vairiShu |
niHsapatnaH sukhI rAjA vijahAra yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
abhiShikto mahAprAj~no rAjyaM prApya yudhiShThiraH |
dAshArhaM puNDarIkAkShamuvAcha prA~njaliH shuchiH
shlokas.2:
tava kRRiShNa prasAdena nayena cha balena cha |
buddhyA cha yadushArdUla tathA vikramaNena cha
shlokas.3:
punaH prAptamidaM rAjyaM pitRRipaitAmahaM mayA |
namaste puNDarIkAkSha punaH punarari.ndama
shlokas.4:
tvAmekamAhuH puruShaM tvAmAhuH sAtvatAM patim |
nAmabhistvAM bahuvidhaiH stuvanti paramarShayaH
shlokas.5:
vishvakarmannamaste.astu vishvAtmanvishvasambhava |
viShNo jiShNo hare kRRiShNa vaikuNTha puruShottama
shlokas.6:
adityAH saptarAtraM tu purANe garbhatAM gataH |
pRRishnigarbhastvamevaikastriyugaM tvAM vadantyapi
shlokas.7:
shuchishravA hRRiShIkesho ghRRitArchirha.nsa uchyase |
trichakShuH shambhurekastvaM vibhurdAmodaro.api cha
shlokas.8:
varAho.agnirbRRihadbhAnurvRRiShaNastArkShyalakShaNaH |
anIkasAhaH puruShaH shipiviShTa urukramaH
shlokas.9:
vAchiShTha ugraH senAnIH satyo vAjasanirguhaH |
achyutashchyAvano.arINAM sa~NkRRitirvikRRitirvRRiShaH
shlokas.10:
kRRitavartmA tvamevAdrirvRRiShagarbho vRRiShAkapiH |
sindhukShidUrmistrikakuttridhAmA trivRRidachyutaH
shlokas.11:
samrADvirATsvarATchaiva surarADdharmado bhavaH |
vibhurbhUrabhibhUH kRRiShNaH kRRiShNavartmA tvameva cha
shlokas.12:
sviShTakRRidbhiShagAvartaH kapilastvaM cha vAmanaH |
yaj~no dhruvaH pata~Ngashcha jayatsenastvamuchyase
shlokas.13:
shikhaNDI nahuSho babhrurdivaspRRiktvaM punarvasuH |
subabhrurukSho rukmastvaM suSheNo dundubhistathA
shlokas.14:
gabhastinemiH shrIpadmaM puShkaraM puShpadhAraNaH |
RRibhurvibhuH sarvasUkShmastvaM sAvitraM cha paThyase
shlokas.15:
ambhonidhistvaM brahmA tvaM pavitraM dhAma dhanva cha |
hiraNyagarbhaM tvAmAhuH svadhA svAhA cha keshava
shlokas.16:
yonistvamasya pralayashcha kRRiShNa; tvamevedaM sRRijasi vishvamagre |
vishvaM chedaM tvadvashe vishvayone; namo.astu te shAr~NgachakrAsipANe
shlokas.17:
evaM stuto dharmarAjena kRRiShNaH; sabhAmadhye prItimAnpuShkarAkShaH |
tamabhyanandadbhArataM puShkalAbhi;rvAgbhirjyeShThaM pANDavaM yAdavAgryaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato visarjayAmAsa sarvAH prakRRitayo nRRipaH |
vivishushchAbhyanuj~nAtA yathAsvAni gRRihANi cha
shlokas.2:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA bhImaM bhImaparAkramam |
sAntvayannabravIddhImAnarjunaM yamajau tathA
shlokas.3:
shatrubhirvividhaiH shastraiH kRRittadehA mahAraNe |
shrAntA bhavantaH subhRRishaM tApitAH shokamanyubhiH
shlokas.4:
araNye duHkhavasatIrmatkRRite puruShottamAH |
