bhavadbhiranubhUtAshcha yathA kupuruShaistathA
shlokas.5:
yathAsukhaM yathAjoShaM jayo.ayamanubhUyatAm |
vishrAntA.Nllabdhavij~nAnA~nshvaH sametAsmi vaH punaH
shlokas.6:
tato duryodhanagRRihaM prAsAdairupashobhitam |
bahuratnasamAkIrNaM dAsIdAsasamAkulam
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAtaM bhrAtrA dattaM vRRikodaraH |
pratipede mahAbAhurmandaraM maghavAniva
shlokas.8:
yathA duryodhanagRRihaM tathA duHshAsanasya cha |
prAsAdamAlAsa.nyuktaM hematoraNabhUShitam
shlokas.9:
dAsIdAsasusampUrNaM prabhUtadhanadhAnyavat |
pratipede mahAbAhurarjuno rAjashAsanAt
shlokas.10:
durmarShaNasya bhavanaM duHshAsanagRRihAdvaram |
kuberabhavanaprakhyaM maNihemavibhUShitam
shlokas.11:
nakulAya varArhAya karshitAya mahAvane |
dadau prIto mahArAja dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
durmukhasya cha veshmAgryaM shrImatkanakabhUShitam |
pUrNaM padmadalAkShINAM strINAM shayanasa~Nkulam
shlokas.13:
pradadau sahadevAya satataM priyakAriNe |
mumude tachcha labdhvA sa kailAsaM dhanado yathA
shlokas.14:
yuyutsurvidurashchaiva sa~njayashcha mahAdyutiH |
sudharmA chaiva dhaumyashcha yathAsvaM jagmurAlayAn
shlokas.15:
saha sAtyakinA shaurirarjunasya niveshanam |
vivesha puruShavyAghro vyAghro giriguhAmiva
shlokas.16:
tatra bhakShAnnapAnaiste samupetAH sukhoShitAH |
sukhaprabuddhA rAjAnamupatasthuryudhiShThiram

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
prApya rAjyaM mahAtejA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
yadanyadakarodvipra tanme vaktumihArhasi
shlokas.2:
bhagavAnvA hRRiShIkeshastrailokyasya paro guruH |
RRiShe yadakarodvIrastachcha vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjendra tattvena kIrtyamAnaM mayAnagha |
vAsudevaM puraskRRitya yadakurvata pANDavAH
shlokas.4:
prApya rAjyaM mahAtejA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
chAturvarNyaM yathAyogaM sve sve dharme nyaveshayat
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNAnAM sahasraM cha snAtakAnAM mahAtmanAm |
sahasraniShkamekaikaM vAchayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.6:
tathAnujIvino bhRRityAnsa.nshritAnatithInapi |
kAmaiH santarpayAmAsa kRRipaNA.nstarkakAnapi
shlokas.7:
purohitAya dhaumyAya prAdAdayutashaH sa gAH |
dhanaM suvarNaM rajataM vAsA.nsi vividhAni cha
shlokas.8:
kRRipAya cha mahArAja guruvRRittimavartata |
vidurAya cha dharmAtmA pUjAM chakre yatavrataH
shlokas.9:
bhakShAnnapAnairvividhairvAsobhiH shayanAsanaiH |
sarvAnsantoShayAmAsa sa.nshritAndadatAM varaH
shlokas.10:
labdhaprashamanaM kRRitvA sa rAjA rAjasattama |
yuyutsordhArtarAShTrasya pUjAM chakre mahAyashAH
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTrAya tadrAjyaM gAndhAryai vidurAya cha |
nivedya svasthavadrAjannAste rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
tathA sarvaM sa nagaraM prasAdya janamejaya |
vAsudevaM mahAtmAnamabhyagachChatkRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.13:
tato mahati parya~Nke maNikA~nchanabhUShite |
dadarsha kRRiShNamAsInaM nIlaM merAvivAmbudam
shlokas.14:
jAjvalyamAnaM vapuShA divyAbharaNabhUShitam |
pItakausheyasa.nvItaM hemnIvopahitaM maNim
shlokas.15:
kaustubhena uraHsthena maNinAbhivirAjitam |
udyatevodayaM shailaM sUryeNAptakirITinam
naupamyaM vidyate yasya triShu lokeShu ki~nchana
shlokas.16:
so.abhigamya mahAtmAnaM viShNuM puruShavigraham |
uvAcha madhurAbhAShaH smitapUrvamidaM tadA
shlokas.17:
sukhena te nishA kachchidvyuShTA buddhimatAM vara |
kachchijj~nAnAni sarvANi prasannAni tavAchyuta
shlokas.18:
tava hyAshritya tAM devIM buddhiM buddhimatAM vara |
vayaM rAjyamanuprAptAH pRRithivI cha vashe sthitA
shlokas.19:
bhavatprasAdAdbhagava.nstrilokagativikrama |
jayaH prApto yashashchAgryaM na cha dharmAchchyutA vayam
shlokas.20:
taM tathA bhAShamANaM tu dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
novAcha bhagavAnki~nchiddhyAnamevAnvapadyata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimidaM paramAshcharyaM dhyAyasyamitavikrama |
kachchillokatrayasyAsya svasti lokaparAyaNa
shlokas.2:
chaturthaM dhyAnamArgaM tvamAlambya puruShottama |
apakrAnto yato deva tena me vismitaM manaH
shlokas.3:
nigRRihIto hi vAyuste pa~nchakarmA sharIragaH |
indriyANi cha sarvANi manasi sthApitAni te
shlokas.4:
indriyANi manashchaiva buddhau sa.nveshitAni te |
sarvashchaiva gaNo deva kShetraj~ne te niveshitaH
shlokas.5:
ne~Nganti tava romANi sthirA buddhistathA manaH |
sthANukuDyashilAbhUto nirIhashchAsi mAdhava
shlokas.6:
yathA dIpo nivAtastho niri~Ngo jvalate.achyuta |
tathAsi bhagavandeva nishchalo dRRiDhanishchayaH
shlokas.7:
yadi shrotumihArhAmi na rahasyaM cha te yadi |
Chindhi me sa.nshayaM deva prapannAyAbhiyAchate
shlokas.8:
tvaM hi kartA vikartA cha tvaM kSharaM chAkSharaM cha hi |
anAdinidhanashchAdyastvameva puruShottama
shlokas.9:
tvatprapannAya bhaktAya shirasA praNatAya cha |
dhyAnasyAsya yathAtattvaM brUhi dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH svagochare nyasya mano buddhIndriyANi cha |
smitapUrvamuvAchedaM bhagavAnvAsavAnujaH
shlokas.11:
sharatalpagato bhIShmaH shAmyanniva hutAshanaH |
mAM dhyAti puruShavyAghrastato me tadgataM manaH
shlokas.12:
yasya jyAtalanirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
na saheddevarAjo.api tamasmi manasA gataH
shlokas.13:
yenAbhidrutya tarasA samastaM rAjamaNDalam |
UDhAstisraH purA kanyAstamasmi manasA gataH
shlokas.14:
trayovi.nshatirAtraM yo yodhayAmAsa bhArgavam |
na cha rAmeNa nistIrNastamasmi manasA gataH
shlokas.15:
yaM ga~NgA garbhavidhinA dhArayAmAsa pArthivam |
vasiShThashiShyaM taM tAta manasAsmi gato nRRipa
shlokas.16:
divyAstrANi mahAtejA yo dhArayati buddhimAn |
sA~NgA.nshcha chaturo vedA.nstamasmi manasA gataH
shlokas.17:
rAmasya dayitaM shiShyaM jAmadagnyasya pANDava |
AdhAraM sarvavidyAnAM tamasmi manasA gataH
shlokas.18:
ekIkRRityendriyagrAmaM manaH sa.nyamya medhayA |
sharaNaM mAmupAgachChattato me tadgataM manaH
shlokas.19:
sa hi bhUtaM cha bhavyaM cha bhavachcha puruSharShabha |
vetti dharmabhRRitAM shreShThastato me tadgataM manaH
shlokas.20:
tasminhi puruShavyAghre karmabhiH svairdivaM gate |
bhaviShyati mahI pArtha naShTachandreva sharvarI
shlokas.21:
tadyudhiShThira gA~NgeyaM bhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam |
abhigamyopasa~NgRRihya pRRichCha yatte manogatam
shlokas.22:
chAturvedyaM chAturhotraM chAturAshramyameva cha |
chAturvarNyasya dharmaM cha pRRichChainaM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.23:
tasminnastamite bhIShme kauravANAM dhurandhare |
j~nAnAnyalpIbhaviShyanti tasmAttvAM chodayAmyaham
shlokas.24:
tachChrutvA vAsudevasya tathyaM vachanamuttamam |
sAshrukaNThaH sa dharmaj~no janArdanamuvAcha ha
shlokas.25:
yadbhavAnAha bhIShmasya prabhAvaM prati mAdhava |
tathA tannAtra sa.ndeho vidyate mama mAnada
shlokas.26:
mahAbhAgyaM hi bhIShmasya prabhAvashcha mahAtmanaH |
shrutaM mayA kathayatAM brAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.27:
bhavA.nshcha kartA lokAnAM yadbravItyarisUdana |
tathA tadanabhidhyeyaM vAkyaM yAdavanandana
shlokas.28:
yatastvanugrahakRRitA buddhiste mayi mAdhava |
tvAmagrataH puraskRRitya bhIShmaM pashyAmahe vayam
shlokas.29:
AvRRitte bhagavatyarke sa hi lokAngamiShyati |
tvaddarshanaM mahAbAho tasmAdarhati kauravaH
shlokas.30:
tava hyAdyasya devasya kSharasyaivAkSharasya cha |
darshanaM tasya lAbhaH syAttvaM hi brahmamayo nidhiH
shlokas.31:
shrutvaitaddharmarAjasya vachanaM madhusUdanaH |
pArshvasthaM sAtyakiM prAha ratho me yujyatAmiti
shlokas.32:
sAtyakistUpaniShkramya keshavasya samIpataH |
dArukaM prAha kRRiShNasya yujyatAM ratha ityuta
shlokas.33:
sa sAtyakerAshu vacho nishamya; rathottamaM kA~nchanabhUShitA~Ngam |
masAragalvarkamayairvibha~Ngai;rvibhUShitaM hemapinaddhachakram
shlokas.34:
divAkarA.nshuprabhamAshugAminaM; vichitranAnAmaNiratnabhUShitam |
navoditaM sUryamiva pratApinaM; vichitratArkShyadhvajinaM patAkinam
shlokas.35:
sugrIvasainyapramukhairvarAshvai;rmanojavaiH kA~nchanabhUShitA~NgaiH |
suyuktamAvedayadachyutAya; kRRitA~njalirdAruko rAjasiMha

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
sharatalpe shayAnastu bharatAnAM pitAmahaH |
kathamutsRRiShTavAndehaM kaM cha yogamadhArayat
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAja~nshuchirbhUtvA samAhitaH |
bhIShmasya kurushArdUla dehotsargaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
nivRRittamAtre tvayana uttare vai divAkare |
samAveshayadAtmAnamAtmanyeva samAhitaH
shlokas.4:
vikIrNA.nshurivAdityo bhIShmaH sharashataishchitaH |
shishye paramayA lakShmyA vRRito brAhmaNasattamaiH
shlokas.5:
vyAsena vedashravasA nAradena surarShiNA |
devasthAnena vAtsyena tathAshmakasumantunA
shlokas.6:
etaishchAnyairmunigaNairmahAbhAgairmahAtmabhiH |
shraddhAdamapuraskArairvRRitashchandra iva grahaiH
shlokas.7:
bhIShmastu puruShavyAghraH karmaNA manasA girA |
sharatalpagataH kRRiShNaM pradadhyau prA~njaliH sthitaH
shlokas.8:
svareNa puShTanAdena tuShTAva madhusUdanam |
yogeshvaraM padmanAbhaM viShNuM jiShNuM jagatpatim
shlokas.9:
kRRitA~njaliH shuchirbhUtvA vAgvidAM pravaraH prabhum |
bhIShmaH paramadharmAtmA vAsudevamathAstuvat
shlokas.10:
ArirAdhayiShuH kRRiShNaM vAchaM jigamiShAmi yAm |
tayA vyAsasamAsinyA prIyatAM puruShottamaH
shlokas.11:
shuchiH shuchiShadaM ha.nsaM tatparaH parameShThinam |
yuktvA sarvAtmanAtmAnaM taM prapadye prajApatim
shlokas.12:
yasminvishvAni bhUtAni tiShThanti cha vishanti cha |
guNabhUtAni bhUteshe sUtre maNigaNA iva
shlokas.13:
yasminnitye tate tantau dRRiDhe sragiva tiShThati |
sadasadgrathitaM vishvaM vishvA~Nge vishvakarmaNi
shlokas.14:
hariM sahasrashirasaM sahasracharaNekShaNam |
prAhurnArAyaNaM devaM yaM vishvasya parAyaNam
shlokas.15:
aNIyasAmaNIyA.nsaM sthaviShThaM cha sthavIyasAm |
garIyasAM gariShThaM cha shreShThaM cha shreyasAmapi
shlokas.16:
yaM vAkeShvanuvAkeShu niShatsUpaniShatsu cha |
gRRiNanti satyakarmANaM satyaM satyeShu sAmasu
shlokas.17:
chaturbhishchaturAtmAnaM sattvasthaM sAtvatAM patim |
yaM divyairdevamarchanti guhyaiH paramanAmabhiH
shlokas.18:
yaM devaM devakI devI vasudevAdajIjanat |
bhaumasya brahmaNo guptyai dIptamagnimivAraNiH
shlokas.19:
yamananyo vyapetAshIrAtmAnaM vItakalmaSham |
iShTvAnantyAya govindaM pashyatyAtmanyavasthitam
shlokas.20:
purANe puruShaH prokto brahmA prokto yugAdiShu |
kShaye sa~NkarShaNaH proktastamupAsyamupAsmahe
shlokas.21:
ativAyvindrakarmANamatisUryAgnitejasam |
atibuddhIndriyAtmAnaM taM prapadye prajApatim
shlokas.22:
yaM vai vishvasya kartAraM jagatastasthuShAM patim |
vadanti jagato.adhyakShamakSharaM paramaM padam
shlokas.23:
hiraNyavarNaM yaM garbhamaditirdaityanAshanam |
ekaM dvAdashadhA jaj~ne tasmai sUryAtmane namaH
shlokas.24:
shukle devAnpitR^InkRRiShNe tarpayatyamRRitena yaH |
yashcha rAjA dvijAtInAM tasmai somAtmane namaH
shlokas.25:
mahatastamasaH pAre puruShaM jvalanadyutim |
yaM j~nAtvA mRRityumatyeti tasmai j~neyAtmane namaH
shlokas.26:
yaM bRRihantaM bRRihatyukthe yamagnau yaM mahAdhvare |
yaM viprasa~NghA gAyanti tasmai vedAtmane namaH
shlokas.27:
RRigyajuHsAmadhAmAnaM dashArdhahavirAkRRitim |
yaM saptatantuM tanvanti tasmai yaj~nAtmane namaH
shlokas.28:
yaH suparNo yajurnAma ChandogAtrastrivRRichChirAH |
rathantarabRRihatyakShastasmai stotrAtmane namaH
shlokas.29:
yaH sahasrasave satre jaj~ne vishvasRRijAmRRiShiH |
hiraNyavarNaH shakunistasmai ha.nsAtmane namaH
shlokas.30:
padA~NgaM sandhiparvANaM svaravya~njanalakShaNam |
yamAhurakSharaM nityaM tasmai vAgAtmane namaH
shlokas.31:
yashchinoti satAM setumRRitenAmRRitayoninA |
dharmArthavyavahArA~Ngaistasmai satyAtmane namaH
shlokas.32:
yaM pRRithagdharmacharaNAH pRRithagdharmaphalaiShiNaH |
pRRithagdharmaiH samarchanti tasmai dharmAtmane namaH
shlokas.33:
yaM taM vyaktasthamavyaktaM vichinvanti maharShayaH |
kShetre kShetraj~namAsInaM tasmai kShetrAtmane namaH
shlokas.34:
yaM dRRigAtmAnamAtmasthaM vRRitaM ShoDashabhirguNaiH |
prAhuH saptadashaM sA~NkhyAstasmai sA~NkhyAtmane namaH
shlokas.35:
yaM vinidrA jitashvAsAH sattvasthAH sa.nyatendriyAH |
jyotiH pashyanti yu~njAnAstasmai yogAtmane namaH
shlokas.36:
apuNyapuNyoparame yaM punarbhavanirbhayAH |
shAntAH saMnyAsino yAnti tasmai mokShAtmane namaH
shlokas.37:
yo.asau yugasahasrAnte pradIptArchirvibhAvasuH |
sambhakShayati bhUtAni tasmai ghorAtmane namaH
shlokas.38:
sambhakShya sarvabhUtAni kRRitvA chaikArNavaM jagat |
bAlaH svapiti yashchaikastasmai mAyAtmane namaH
shlokas.39:
sahasrashirase tasmai puruShAyAmitAtmane |
chatuHsamudraparyAyayoganidrAtmane namaH
shlokas.40:
ajasya nAbhAvadhyekaM yasminvishvaM pratiShThitam |
puShkaraM puShkarAkShasya tasmai padmAtmane namaH
shlokas.41:
yasya kesheShu jImUtA nadyaH sarvA~NgasandhiShu |
kukShau samudrAshchatvArastasmai toyAtmane namaH
shlokas.42:
yugeShvAvartate yoM.ashairdinartvanayahAyanaiH |
sargapralayayoH kartA tasmai kAlAtmane namaH
shlokas.43:
brahma vaktraM bhujau kShatraM kRRitsnamUrUdaraM vishaH |
pAdau yasyAshritAH shUdrAstasmai varNAtmane namaH
shlokas.44:
yasyAgnirAsyaM dyaurmUrdhA khaM nAbhishcharaNau kShitiH |
sUryashchakShurdishaH shrotre tasmai lokAtmane namaH
shlokas.45:
viShaye vartamAnAnAM yaM taM vaisheShikairguNaiH |
prAhurviShayagoptAraM tasmai goptrAtmane namaH
shlokas.46:
annapAnendhanamayo rasaprANavivardhanaH |
yo dhArayati bhUtAni tasmai prANAtmane namaH
shlokas.47:
paraH kAlAtparo yaj~nAtparaH sadasatoshcha yaH |
anAdirAdirvishvasya tasmai vishvAtmane namaH
shlokas.48:
yo mohayati bhUtAni sneharAgAnubandhanaiH |
sargasya rakShaNArthAya tasmai mohAtmane namaH
shlokas.49:
Atmaj~nAnamidaM j~nAnaM j~nAtvA pa~nchasvavasthitam |
yaM j~nAnino.adhigachChanti tasmai j~nAnAtmane namaH
shlokas.50:
aprameyasharIrAya sarvato.anantachakShuShe |
apAraparimeyAya tasmai chintyAtmane namaH
shlokas.51:
jaTine daNDine nityaM lambodarasharIriNe |
kamaNDaluniSha~NgAya tasmai brahmAtmane namaH
shlokas.52:
shUline tridasheshAya tryambakAya mahAtmane |
bhasmadigdhordhvali~NgAya tasmai rudrAtmane namaH
shlokas.53:
pa~nchabhUtAtmabhUtAya bhUtAdinidhanAtmane |
akrodhadrohamohAya tasmai shAntAtmane namaH
shlokas.54:
yasminsarvaM yataH sarvaM yaH sarvaM sarvatashcha yaH |
yashcha sarvamayo nityaM tasmai sarvAtmane namaH
shlokas.55:
vishvakarmannamaste.astu vishvAtmanvishvasambhava |
apavargo.asi bhUtAnAM pa~nchAnAM parataH sthitaH
shlokas.56:
namaste triShu lokeShu namaste paratastriShu |
namaste dikShu sarvAsu tvaM hi sarvaparAyaNam
shlokas.57:
namaste bhagavanviShNo lokAnAM prabhavApyaya |
tvaM hi kartA hRRiShIkesha saMhartA chAparAjitaH
shlokas.58:
tena pashyAmi te divyAnbhAvAnhi triShu vartmasu |
tachcha pashyAmi tattvena yatte rUpaM sanAtanam
shlokas.59:
divaM te shirasA vyAptaM padbhyAM devI vasundharA |
vikrameNa trayo lokAH puruSho.asi sanAtanaH
shlokas.60:
atasIpuShpasa~NkAshaM pItavAsasamachyutam |
ye namasyanti govindaM na teShAM vidyate bhayam
shlokas.61:
yathA viShNumayaM satyaM yathA viShNumayaM haviH |
yathA viShNumayaM sarvaM pApmA me nashyatAM tathA
shlokas.62:
tvAM prapannAya bhaktAya gatimiShTAM jigIShave |
yachChreyaH puNDarIkAkSha taddhyAyasva surottama
shlokas.63:
iti vidyAtapoyonirayonirviShNurIDitaH |
vAgyaj~nenArchito devaH prIyatAM me janArdanaH
shlokas.64:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM bhIShmastadgatamAnasaH |
nama ityeva kRRiShNAya praNAmamakarottadA
shlokas.65:
abhigamya tu yogena bhaktiM bhIShmasya mAdhavaH |
traikAlyadarshanaM j~nAnaM divyaM dAtuM yayau hariH
shlokas.66:
tasminnuparate shabde tataste brahmavAdinaH |
bhIShmaM vAgbhirbAShpakaNThAstamAnarchurmahAmatim
shlokas.67:
te stuvantashcha viprAgryAH keshavaM puruShottamam |
bhIShmaM cha shanakaiH sarve prashasha.nsuH punaH punaH
shlokas.68:
viditvA bhaktiyogaM tu bhIShmasya puruShottamaH |
sahasotthAya saMhRRiShTo yAnamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.69:
keshavaH sAtyakishchaiva rathenaikena jagmatuH |
apareNa mahAtmAnau yudhiShThiradhana~njayau
shlokas.70:
bhImaseno yamau chobhau rathamekaM samAsthitau |
kRRipo yuyutsuH sUtashcha sa~njayashchAparaM ratham
shlokas.71:
te rathairnagarAkAraiH prayAtAH puruSharShabhAH |
nemighoSheNa mahatA kampayanto vasundharAm
shlokas.72:
tato giraH puruShavarastavAnvitA; dvijeritAH pathi sumanAH sa shushruve |
kRRitA~njaliM praNatamathAparaM janaM; sa keshihA muditamanAbhyanandata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa cha hRRiShIkeshaH sa cha rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
kRRipAdayashcha te sarve chatvAraH pANDavAshcha ha
shlokas.2:
rathaiste nagarAkAraiH patAkAdhvajashobhitaiH |
yayurAshu kurukShetraM vAjibhiH shIghragAmibhiH
shlokas.3:
te.avatIrya kurukShetraM keshamajjAsthisa~Nkulam |
dehanyAsaH kRRito yatra kShatriyaistairmahAtmabhiH
shlokas.4:
gajAshvadehAsthichayaiH parvatairiva sa~nchitam |
narashIrShakapAlaishcha sha~Nkhairiva samAchitam
shlokas.5:
chitAsahasrairnichitaM varmashastrasamAkulam |
ApAnabhUmiM kAlasya tadA bhuktojjhitAmiva
shlokas.6:
bhUtasa~NghAnucharitaM rakShogaNaniShevitam |
pashyantaste kurukShetraM yayurAshu mahArathAH
shlokas.7:
gachChanneva mahAbAhuH sarvayAdavanandanaH |
yudhiShThirAya provAcha jAmadagnyasya vikramam
shlokas.8:
amI rAmahradAH pa~ncha dRRishyante pArtha dUrataH |
yeShu santarpayAmAsa pUrvAnkShatriyashoNitaiH
shlokas.9:
triHsaptakRRitvo vasudhAM kRRitvA niHkShatriyAM prabhuH |
ihedAnIM tato rAmaH karmaNo virarAma ha
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivI kRRitA niHkShatriyA tadA |
rAmeNeti yadAttha tvamatra me sa.nshayo mahAn
shlokas.11:
kShatrabIjaM yadA dagdhaM rAmeNa yadupu~Ngava |
kathaM bhUyaH samutpattiH kShatrasyAmitavikrama
shlokas.12:
mahAtmanA bhagavatA rAmeNa yadupu~Ngava |
kathamutsAditaM kShatraM kathaM vRRiddhiM punargatam
shlokas.13:
mahAbhAratayuddhe hi koTishaH kShatriyA hatAH |
tathAbhUchcha mahI kIrNA kShatriyairvadatAM vara
shlokas.14:
evaM me Chindhi vArShNeya sa.nshayaM tArkShyaketana |
Agamo hi paraH kRRiShNa tvatto no vAsavAnuja
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vrajanneva gadAgrajaH prabhuH; shasha.nsa tasmai nikhilena tattvataH |
yudhiShThirAyApratimaujase tadA; yathAbhavatkShatriyasa~NkulA mahI

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
shRRiNu kaunteya rAmasya mayA yAvatparishrutam |
maharShINAM kathayatAM kAraNaM tasya janma cha
shlokas.2:
yathA cha jAmadagnyena koTishaH kShatriyA hatAH |
udbhUtA rAjava.nsheShu ye bhUyo bhArate hatAH
shlokas.3:
jahnorajahnustanayo ballavastasya chAtmajaH |
kushiko nAma dharmaj~nastasya putro mahIpatiH
shlokas.4:
ugraM tapaH samAtiShThatsahasrAkShasamo bhuvi |
putraM labheyamajitaM trilokeshvaramityuta
shlokas.5:
tamugratapasaM dRRiShTvA sahasrAkShaH pura.ndaraH |
samarthaH putrajanane svayamevaitya bhArata
shlokas.6:
putratvamagamadrAja.nstasya lokeshvareshvaraH |
gAdhirnAmAbhavatputraH kaushikaH pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.7:
tasya kanyAbhavadrAjannAmnA satyavatI prabho |
tAM gAdhiH kaviputrAya sorchIkAya dadau prabhuH
shlokas.8:
tataH prItastu kaunteya bhArgavaH kurunandana |
putrArthe shrapayAmAsa charuM gAdhestathaiva cha
shlokas.9:
AhUya chAha tAM bhAryAmRRichIko bhArgavastadA |
upayojyashcharurayaM tvayA mAtrApyayaM tava
shlokas.10:
tasyA janiShyate putro dIptimAnkShatriyarShabhaH |
ajayyaH kShatriyairloke kShatriyarShabhasUdanaH
shlokas.11:
tavApi putraM kalyANi dhRRitimantaM taponvitam |
shamAtmakaM dvijashreShThaM charureSha vidhAsyati
shlokas.12:
ityevamuktvA tAM bhAryAmRRichIko bhRRigunandanaH |
tapasyabhirato dhImA~njagAmAraNyameva ha
shlokas.13:
etasminneva kAle tu tIrthayAtrAparo nRRipaH |
gAdhiH sadAraH samprApta RRichIkasyAshramaM prati
shlokas.14:
charudvayaM gRRihItvA tu rAjansatyavatI tadA |
bharturvAkyAdathAvyagrA mAtre hRRiShTA nyavedayat
shlokas.15:
mAtA tu tasyAH kaunteya duhitre svaM charuM dadau |
tasyAshcharumathAj~nAtamAtmasa.nsthaM chakAra ha
shlokas.16:
atha satyavatI garbhaM kShatriyAntakaraM tadA |
dhArayAmAsa dIptena vapuShA ghoradarshanam
shlokas.17:
tAmRRichIkastadA dRRiShTvA dhyAnayogena vai tataH |
abravIdrAjashArdUla svAM bhAryAM varavarNinIm
shlokas.18:
mAtrAsi vya.nsitA bhadre charuvyatyAsahetunA |
janiShyate hi te putraH krUrakarmA mahAbalaH
shlokas.19:
janiShyate hi te bhrAtA brahmabhUtastapodhanaH |
vishvaM hi brahma tapasA mayA tatra samarpitam
shlokas.20:
saivamuktA mahAbhAgA bhartrA satyavatI tadA |
papAta shirasA tasmai vepantI chAbravIdidam
shlokas.21:
nArho.asi bhagavannadya vaktumeva.nvidhaM vachaH |
brAhmaNApasadaM putraM prApsyasIti mahAmune
shlokas.22:
RRichIka uvAcha||
naiSha sa~NkalpitaH kAmo mayA bhadre tathA tvayi |
ugrakarmA bhavetputrashcharurmAtA cha kAraNam
shlokas.23:
satyavatyuvAcha||
ichCha.NllokAnapi mune sRRijethAH kiM punarmama |
shamAtmakamRRijuM putraM labheyaM japatAM vara
shlokas.24:
RRichIka uvAcha||
noktapUrvaM mayA bhadre svaireShvapyanRRitaM vachaH |
kimutAgniM samAdhAya mantravachcharusAdhane
shlokas.25:
satyavatyuvAcha||
kAmamevaM bhavetpautro mameha tava chaiva ha |
shamAtmakamRRijuM putraM labheyaM japatAM vara
shlokas.26:
RRichIka uvAcha||
putre nAsti visheSho me pautre vA varavarNini |
yathA tvayoktaM tu vachastathA bhadre bhaviShyati
shlokas.27:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tataH satyavatI putraM janayAmAsa bhArgavam |
tapasyabhirataM shAntaM jamadagniM shamAtmakam
shlokas.28:
vishvAmitraM cha dAyAdaM gAdhiH kushikanandanaH |
prApa brahmarShisamitaM vishvena brahmaNA yutam
shlokas.29:
ArchIko janayAmAsa jamadagniH sudAruNam |
sarvavidyAntagaM shreShThaM dhanurvede cha pAragam
rAmaM kShatriyahantAraM pradIptamiva pAvakam
shlokas.30:
etasminneva kAle tu kRRitavIryAtmajo balI |
arjuno nAma tejasvI kShatriyo haihayAnvayaH
shlokas.31:
dadAha pRRithivIM sarvAM saptadvIpAM sapattanAm |
svabAhvastrabalenAjau dharmeNa parameNa cha
shlokas.32:
tRRiShitena sa kauravya bhikShitashchitrabhAnunA |
sahasrabAhurvikrAntaH prAdAdbhikShAmathAgnaye
shlokas.33:
grAmAnpurANi ghoShA.nshcha pattanAni cha vIryavAn |
jajvAla tasya bANaistu chitrabhAnurdidhakShayA
shlokas.34:
sa tasya puruShendrasya prabhAvena mahAtapAH |
dadAha kArtavIryasya shailAnatha vanAni cha
shlokas.35:
sa shUnyamAshramAraNyaM varuNasyAtmajasya tat |
dadAha pavaneneddhashchitrabhAnuH sahaihayaH
shlokas.36:
ApavastaM tato roShAchChashApArjunamachyuta |
dagdhe.a.ashrame mahArAja kArtavIryeNa vIryavAn
shlokas.37:
tvayA na varjitaM mohAdyasmAdvanamidaM mama |
dagdhaM tasmAdraNe rAmo bAhU.nste Chetsyate.arjuna
shlokas.38:
arjunastu mahArAja balI nityaM shamAtmakaH |
brahmaNyashcha sharaNyashcha dAtA shUrashcha bhArata
shlokas.39:
tasya putrAH subalinaH shApenAsanpiturvadhe |
nimittamavaliptA vai nRRisha.nsAshchaiva nityadA
shlokas.40:
jamadagnidhenvAste vatsamAninyurbharatarShabha |
aj~nAtaM kArtavIryasya haihayendrasya dhImataH
shlokas.41:
tato.arjunasya bAhU.nstu ChittvA vai pauruShAnvitaH |
taM ruvantaM tato vatsaM jAmadagnyaH svamAshramam
pratyAnayata rAjendra teShAmantaHpurAtprabhuH
shlokas.42:
arjunasya sutAste tu sambhUyAbuddhayastadA |
gatvAshramamasambuddhaM jamadagnermahAtmanaH
shlokas.43:
apAtayanta bhallAgraiH shiraH kAyAnnarAdhipa |
samitkushArthaM rAmasya nirgatasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.44:
tataH pitRRivadhAmarShAdrAmaH paramamanyumAn |
niHkShatriyAM pratishrutya mahIM shastramagRRihNata
shlokas.45:
tataH sa bhRRigushArdUlaH kArtavIryasya vIryavAn |
vikramya nijaghAnAshu putrAnpautrA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.46:
sa haihayasahasrANi hatvA paramamanyumAn |
chakAra bhArgavo rAjanmahIM shoNitakardamAm
shlokas.47:
sa tathA sumahAtejAH kRRitvA niHkShatriyAM mahIm |
kRRipayA parayAviShTo vanameva jagAma ha
shlokas.48:
tato varShasahasreShu samatIteShu keShuchit |
kShobhaM samprAptavA.nstIvraM prakRRityA kopanaH prabhuH
shlokas.49:
vishvAmitrasya pautrastu raibhyaputro mahAtapAH |
parAvasurmahArAja kShiptvAha janasa.nsadi
shlokas.50:
ye te yayAtipatane yaj~ne santaH samAgatAH |
pratardanaprabhRRitayo rAma kiM kShatriyA na te
shlokas.51:
mithyApratij~no rAma tvaM katthase janasa.nsadi |
bhayAtkShatriyavIrANAM parvataM samupAshritaH
shlokas.52:
sa punaH kShatriyashataiH pRRithivImanusantatAm |
parAvasostadA shrutvA shastraM jagrAha bhArgavaH
shlokas.53:
tato ye kShatriyA rAja~nshatashastena jIvitAH |
te vivRRiddhA mahAvIryAH pRRithivIpatayo.abhavan
shlokas.54:
sa punastA~njaghAnAshu bAlAnapi narAdhipa |
garbhasthaistu mahI vyAptA punarevAbhavattadA
shlokas.55:
jAtaM jAtaM sa garbhaM tu punareva jaghAna ha |
arakSha.nshcha sutAnkA.nshchittadA kShatriyayoShitaH
shlokas.56:
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivIM kRRitvA niHkShatriyAM prabhuH |
dakShiNAmashvamedhAnte kashyapAyAdadattataH
shlokas.57:
kShatriyANAM tu sheShArthaM kareNoddishya kashyapaH |
srukpragrahavatA rAja~nshrImAnvAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.58:
gachCha pAraM samudrasya dakShiNasya mahAmune |
na te madviShaye rAma vastavyamiha karhichit
shlokas.59:
tataH shUrpArakaM deshaM sAgarastasya nirmame |
santrAsAjjAmadagnyasya so.aparAntaM mahItalam
shlokas.60:
kashyapastu mahArAja pratigRRihya mahImimAm |
kRRitvA brAhmaNasa.nsthAM vai pravivesha mahAvanam
shlokas.61:
tataH shUdrAshcha vaishyAshcha yathAsvairaprachAriNaH |
avartanta dvijAgryANAM dAreShu bharatarShabha
shlokas.62:
arAjake jIvaloke durbalA balavattaraiH |
bAdhyante na cha vitteShu prabhutvamiha kasyachit
shlokas.63:
tataH kAlena pRRithivI pravivesha rasAtalam |
arakShyamANA vidhivatkShatriyairdharmarakShibhiH
shlokas.64:
UruNA dhArayAmAsa kashyapaH pRRithivIM tataH |
nimajjantIM tadA rAja.nstenorvIti mahI smRRitA
shlokas.65:
rakShiNashcha samuddishya prAyAchatpRRithivI tadA |
prasAdya kashyapaM devI kShatriyAnbAhushAlinaH
shlokas.66:
santi brahmanmayA guptA nRRiShu kShatriyapu~NgavAH |
haihayAnAM kule jAtAste sa.nrakShantu mAM mune
shlokas.67:
asti pauravadAyAdo viDUrathasutaH prabho |
RRikShaiH sa.nvardhito vipra RRikShavatyeva parvate
shlokas.68:
tathAnukampamAnena yajvanAthAmitaujasA |
parAshareNa dAyAdaH saudAsasyAbhirakShitaH
shlokas.69:
sarvakarmANi kurute tasyarSheH shUdravaddhi saH |
sarvakarmetyabhikhyAtaH sa mAM rakShatu pArthivaH
shlokas.70:
shibeH putro mahAtejA gopatirnAma nAmataH |
vane sa.nrakShito gobhiH so.abhirakShatu mAM mune
shlokas.71:
pratardanasya putrastu vatso nAma mahAyashAH |
vatsaiH sa.nvardhito goShThe sa mAM rakShatu pArthivaH
shlokas.72:
dadhivAhanapautrastu putro divirathasya ha |
a~NgaH sa gautamenApi ga~NgAkUle.abhirakShitaH
shlokas.73:
bRRihadratho mahAbAhurbhuvi bhUtipuraskRRitaH |
golA~NgUlairmahAbhAgo gRRidhrakUTe.abhirakShitaH
shlokas.74:
maruttasyAnvavAye tu kShatriyAsturvasostrayaH |
marutpatisamA vIrye samudreNAbhirakShitAH
shlokas.75:
ete kShatriyadAyAdAstatra tatra parishrutAH |
samya~NmAmabhirakShantu tataH sthAsyAmi nishchalA
shlokas.76:
eteShAM pitarashchaiva tathaiva cha pitAmahAH |
madarthaM nihatA yuddhe rAmeNAkliShTakarmaNA
shlokas.77:
teShAmapachitishchaiva mayA kAryA na sa.nshayaH |
na hyahaM kAmaye nityamavikrAntena rakShaNam
shlokas.78:
tataH pRRithivyA nirdiShTA.nstAnsamAnIya kashyapaH |
abhyaShi~nchanmahIpAlAnkShatriyAnvIryasaMmatAn
shlokas.79:
teShAM putrAshcha pautrAshcha yeShAM va.nshAH pratiShThitAH |
evametatpurA vRRittaM yanmAM pRRichChasi pANDava
shlokas.80:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bruvanneva yadupravIro; yudhiShThiraM dharmabhRRitAM variShTham |
rathena tenAshu yayau yathArko; vishanprabhAbhirbhagavA.nstrilokam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAmasya tatkarma shrutvA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
vismayaM paramaM gatvA pratyuvAcha janArdanam
shlokas.2:
aho rAmasya vArShNeya shakrasyeva mahAtmanaH |
vikramo yena vasudhA krodhAnniHkShatriyA kRRitA
shlokas.3:
gobhiH samudreNa tathA golA~NgUlarkShavAnaraiH |
guptA rAmabhayodvignAH kShatriyANAM kulodvahAH
shlokas.4:
aho dhanyo hi loko.ayaM sabhAgyAshcha narA bhuvi |
yatra karmedRRishaM dharmyaM dvijena kRRitamachyuta
shlokas.5:
tathA yAntau tadA tAta tAvachyutayudhiShThirau |
jagmaturyatra gA~NgeyaH sharatalpagataH prabhuH
shlokas.6:
tataste dadRRishurbhIShmaM sharaprastarashAyinam |
svarashmijAlasa.nvItaM sAya.nsUryamivAnalam
shlokas.7:
upAsyamAnaM munibhirdevairiva shatakratum |
deshe paramadharmiShThe nadImoghavatImanu
shlokas.8:
dUrAdeva tamAlokya kRRiShNo rAjA cha dharmarAT |
chatvAraH pANDavAshchaiva te cha shAradvatAdayaH
shlokas.9:
avaskandyAtha vAhebhyaH sa.nyamya prachalaM manaH |
ekIkRRityendriyagrAmamupatasthurmahAmunIn
shlokas.10:
abhivAdya cha govindaH sAtyakiste cha kauravAH |
vyAsAdI.nstAnRRiShInpashchAdgA~Ngeyamupatasthire
shlokas.11:
tapovRRiddhiM tataH pRRiShTvA gA~NgeyaM yadukauravAH |
parivArya tataH sarve niSheduH puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.12:
tato nishamya gA~NgeyaM shAmyamAnamivAnalam |
ki~nchiddInamanA bhIShmamiti hovAcha keshavaH
shlokas.13:
kachchijj~nAnAni te rAjanprasannAni yathA purA |
kachchidavyAkulA chaiva buddhiste vadatAM vara
shlokas.14:
sharAbhighAtaduHkhAtte kachchidgAtraM na dUyate |
mAnasAdapi duHkhAddhi shArIraM balavattaram
shlokas.15:
varadAnAtpituH kAmaM ChandamRRityurasi prabho |
shantanordharmashIlasya na tvetachChamakAraNam
shlokas.16:
susUkShmo.apIha dehe vai shalyo janayate rujam |
kiM punaH sharasa~NghAtaishchitasya tava bhArata
shlokas.17:
kAmaM naitattavAkhyeyaM prANinAM prabhavApyayau |
bhavAnhyupadishechChreyo devAnAmapi bhArata
shlokas.18:
yaddhi bhUtaM bhaviShyachcha bhavachcha puruSharShabha |
sarvaM tajj~nAnavRRiddhasya tava pANAvivAhitam
shlokas.19:
sa.nsArashchaiva bhUtAnAM dharmasya cha phalodayaH |
viditaste mahAprAj~na tvaM hi brahmamayo nidhiH
shlokas.20:
tvAM hi rAjye sthitaM sphIte samagrA~NgamarogiNam |
strIsahasraiH parivRRitaM pashyAmIhordhvaretasam
shlokas.21:
RRite shAntanavAdbhIShmAttriShu lokeShu pArthiva |
satyasandhAnmahAvIryAchChUrAddharmaikatatparAt
shlokas.22:
mRRityumAvArya tarasA sharaprastarashAyinaH |
nisargaprabhavaM ki~nchinna cha tAtAnushushruma
shlokas.23:
satye tapasi dAne cha yaj~nAdhikaraNe tathA |
dhanurvede cha vede cha nityaM chaivAnvavekShaNe
shlokas.24:
anRRisha.nsaM shuchiM dAntaM sarvabhUtahite ratam |
mahArathaM tvatsadRRishaM na ka~nchidanushushruma
shlokas.25:
tvaM hi devAnsagandharvAnsasurAsurarAkShasAn |
shakta ekarathenaiva vijetuM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
tvaM hi bhIShma mahAbAho vasUnAM vAsavopamaH |
nityaM vipraiH samAkhyAto navamo.anavamo guNaiH
shlokas.27:
ahaM hi tvAbhijAnAmi yastvaM puruShasattama |
tridasheShvapi vikhyAtaH svashaktyA sumahAbalaH
shlokas.28:
manuShyeShu manuShyendra na dRRiShTo na cha me shrutaH |
bhavato yo guNaistulyaH pRRithivyAM puruShaH kvachit
shlokas.29:
tvaM hi sarvairguNai rAjandevAnapyatirichyase |
tapasA hi bhavA~nshaktaH sraShTuM lokA.nshcharAcharAn
shlokas.30:
tadasya tapyamAnasya j~nAtInAM sa~NkShayeNa vai |
jyeShThasya pANDuputrasya shokaM bhIShma vyapAnuda
shlokas.31:
ye hi dharmAH samAkhyAtAshchAturvarNyasya bhArata |
chAturAshramyasa.nsRRiShTAste sarve viditAstava
shlokas.32:
chAturvedye cha ye proktAshchAturhotre cha bhArata |
sA~Nkhye yoge cha niyatA ye cha dharmAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.33:
chAturvarNyena yashchaiko dharmo na sma virudhyate |
sevyamAnaH sa chaivAdyo gA~Ngeya viditastava
shlokas.34:
itihAsapurANaM cha kArtsnyena viditaM tava |
dharmashAstraM cha sakalaM nityaM manasi te sthitam
shlokas.35:
ye cha kechana loke.asminnarthAH sa.nshayakArakAH |
teShAM ChettA nAsti loke tvadanyaH puruSharShabha
shlokas.36:
sa pANDaveyasya manaHsamutthitaM; narendra shokaM vyapakarSha medhayA |
bhavadvidhA hyuttamabuddhivistarA; vimuhyamAnasya janasya shAntaye

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tu vachanaM bhIShmo vAsudevasya dhImataH |
ki~nchidunnAmya vadanaM prA~njalirvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.2:
namaste bhagavanviShNo lokAnAM nidhanodbhava |
tvaM hi kartA hRRiShIkesha saMhartA chAparAjitaH
shlokas.3:
vishvakarmannamaste.astu vishvAtmanvishvasambhava |
apavargo.asi bhUtAnAM pa~nchAnAM parataH sthitaH
shlokas.4:
namaste triShu lokeShu namaste paratastriShu |
yogeshvara namaste.astu tvaM hi sarvaparAyaNam
shlokas.5:
matsa.nshritaM yadAttha tvaM vachaH puruShasattama |
tena pashyAmi te divyAnbhAvAnhi triShu vartmasu
shlokas.6:
tachcha pashyAmi tattvena yatte rUpaM sanAtanam |
sapta mArgA niruddhAste vAyoramitatejasaH
shlokas.7:
divaM te shirasA vyAptaM padbhyAM devI vasundharA |
disho bhujau ravishchakShurvIrye shakraH pratiShThitaH
shlokas.8:
atasIpuShpasa~NkAshaM pItavAsasamachyutam |
vapurhyanumimImaste meghasyeva savidyutaH
shlokas.9:
tvatprapannAya bhaktAya gatimiShTAM jigIShave |
yachChreyaH puNDarIkAkSha taddhyAyasva surottama
shlokas.10:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
yataH khalu parA bhaktirmayi te puruSharShabha |
tato vapurmayA divyaM tava rAjanpradarshitam
shlokas.11:
na hyabhaktAya rAjendra bhaktAyAnRRijave na cha |
darshayAmyahamAtmAnaM na chAdAntAya bhArata
shlokas.12:
bhavA.nstu mama bhaktashcha nityaM chArjavamAsthitaH |
dame tapasi satye cha dAne cha nirataH shuchiH
shlokas.13:
arhastvaM bhIShma mAM draShTuM tapasA svena pArthiva |
tava hyupasthitA lokA yebhyo nAvartate punaH
shlokas.14:
pa~nchAshataM ShaTcha kurupravIra; sheShaM dinAnAM tava jIvitasya |
tataH shubhaiH karmaphalodayaistvaM; sameShyase bhIShma vimuchya deham
shlokas.15:
ete hi devA vasavo vimAnA;nyAsthAya sarve jvalitAgnikalpAH |
antarhitAstvAM pratipAlayanti; kAShThAM prapadyantamudakpata~Ngam
shlokas.16:
vyAvRRittamAtre bhagavatyudIchIM; sUrye dishaM kAlavashAtprapanne |
gantAsi lokAnpuruShapravIra; nAvartate yAnupalabhya vidvAn
shlokas.17:
amuM cha lokaM tvayi bhIShma yAte; j~nAnAni na~NkShyantyakhilena vIra |
ataH sma sarve tvayi saMnikarShaM; samAgatA dharmavivechanAya
shlokas.18:
tajj~nAtishokopahatashrutAya; satyAbhisandhAya yudhiShThirAya |
prabrUhi dharmArthasamAdhiyukta;marthyaM vacho.asyApanudAsya shokam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kRRiShNasya tadvAkyaM dharmArthasahitaM hitam |
shrutvA shAntanavo bhIShmaH pratyuvAcha kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.2:
lokanAtha mahAbAho shiva nArAyaNAchyuta |
tava vAkyamabhishrutya harSheNAsmi pariplutaH
shlokas.3:
kiM chAhamabhidhAsyAmi vAkpate tava saMnidhau |
yadA vAchogataM sarvaM tava vAchi samAhitam
shlokas.4:
yaddhi ki~nchitkRRitaM loke kartavyaM kriyate cha yat |
tvattastanniHsRRitaM deva lokA buddhimayA hi te
shlokas.5:
kathayeddevalokaM yo devarAjasamIpataH |
dharmakAmArthashAstrANAM so.arthAnbrUyAttavAgrataH
shlokas.6:
sharAbhighAtAdvyathitaM mano me madhusUdana |
gAtrANi chAvasIdanti na cha buddhiH prasIdati
shlokas.7:
na cha me pratibhA kAchidasti ki~nchitprabhAShitum |
pIDyamAnasya govinda viShAnalasamaiH sharaiH
shlokas.8:
balaM medhAH prajarati prANAH santvarayanti cha |
marmANi paritapyante bhrAntaM chetastathaiva cha
shlokas.9:
daurbalyAtsajjate vA~Nme sa kathaM vaktumutsahe |
sAdhu me tvaM prasIdasva dAshArhakulanandana
shlokas.10:
tatkShamasva mahAbAho na brUyAM ki~nchidachyuta |
tvatsaMnidhau cha sIdeta vAchaspatirapi bruvan
shlokas.11:
na dishaH samprajAnAmi nAkAshaM na cha medinIm |
kevalaM tava vIryeNa tiShThAmi madhusUdana
shlokas.12:
svayameva prabho tasmAddharmarAjasya yaddhitam |
tadbravIhyAshu sarveShAmAgamAnAM tvamAgamaH
shlokas.13:
kathaM tvayi sthite loke shAshvate lokakartari |
prabrUyAnmadvidhaH kashchidgurau shiShya iva sthite
shlokas.14:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
upapannamidaM vAkyaM kauravANAM dhurandhare |
mahAvIrye mahAsattve sthite sarvArthadarshini
shlokas.15:
yachcha mAmAttha gA~Ngeya bANaghAtarujaM prati |
gRRihANAtra varaM bhIShma matprasAdakRRitaM vibho
shlokas.16:
na te glAnirna te mUrChA na dAho na cha te rujA |
prabhaviShyanti gA~Ngeya kShutpipAse na chApyuta
shlokas.17:
j~nAnAni cha samagrANi pratibhAsyanti te.anagha |
na cha te kvachidAsaktirbuddheH prAdurbhaviShyati
shlokas.18:
sattvasthaM cha mano nityaM tava bhIShma bhaviShyati |
rajastamobhyAM rahitaM ghanairmukta ivoDurAT
shlokas.19:
yadyachcha dharmasa.nyuktamarthayuktamathApi vA |
chintayiShyasi tatrAgryA buddhistava bhaviShyati
shlokas.20:
imaM cha rAjashArdUla bhUtagrAmaM chaturvidham |
chakShurdivyaM samAshritya drakShyasyamitavikrama
shlokas.21:
chaturvidhaM prajAjAlaM sa.nyukto j~nAnachakShuShA |
bhIShma drakShyasi tattvena jale mIna ivAmale
shlokas.22:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste vyAsasahitAH sarva eva maharShayaH |
RRigyajuHsAmasa.nyuktairvachobhiH kRRiShNamarchayan
shlokas.23:
tataH sarvArtavaM divyaM puShpavarShaM nabhastalAt |
papAta yatra vArShNeyaH sagA~NgeyaH sapANDavaH
shlokas.24:
vAditrANi cha divyAni jagushchApsarasAM gaNAH |
na chAhitamaniShTaM vA ki~nchittatra vyadRRishyata
shlokas.25:
vavau shivaH sukho vAyuH sarvagandhavahaH shuchiH |
shAntAyAM dishi shAntAshcha prAvadanmRRigapakShiNaH
shlokas.26:
tato muhUrtAdbhagavAnsahasrA.nshurdivAkaraH |
dahanvanamivaikAnte pratIchyAM pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.27:
tato maharShayaH sarve samutthAya janArdanam |
bhIShmamAmantrayAM chakrU rAjAnaM cha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.28:
tataH praNAmamakarotkeshavaH pANDavastathA |
sAtyakiH sa~njayashchaiva sa cha shAradvataH kRRipaH
shlokas.29:
tataste dharmaniratAH samyaktairabhipUjitAH |
shvaH sameShyAma ityuktvA yatheShTaM tvaritA yayuH
shlokas.30:
tathaivAmantrya gA~NgeyaM keshavaste cha pANDavAH |
pradakShiNamupAvRRitya rathAnAruruhuH shubhAn
shlokas.31:
tato rathaiH kA~nchanadantakUbarai;rmahIdharAbhaiH samadaishcha dantibhiH |
hayaiH suparNairiva chAshugAmibhiH; padAtibhishchAttasharAsanAdibhiH
shlokas.32:
yayau rathAnAM purato hi sA chamU;stathaiva pashchAdatimAtrasAriNI |
purashcha pashchAchcha yathA mahAnadI; purarkShavantaM girimetya narmadA
shlokas.33:
tataH purastAdbhagavAnnishAkaraH; samutthitastAmabhiharShaya.nshchamUm |
divAkarApItarasAstathauShadhIH; punaH svakenaiva guNena yojayan
shlokas.34:
tataH puraM surapurasaMnibhadyuti; pravishya te yaduvRRiShapANDavAstadA |
yathochitAnbhavanavarAnsamAvisha;~nshramAnvitA mRRigapatayo guhA iva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH pravishya bhavanaM prasupto madhusUdanaH |
yAmamAtrAvasheShAyAM yAminyAM pratyabudhyata
shlokas.2:
sa dhyAnapathamAshritya sarvaj~nAnAni mAdhavaH |
avalokya tataH pashchAddadhyau brahma sanAtanam
shlokas.3:
tataH shrutipurANaj~nAH shikShitA raktakaNThinaH |
astuvanvishvakarmANaM vAsudevaM prajApatim
shlokas.4:
paThanti pANisvanikAstathA gAyanti gAyanAH |
sha~NkhAnakamRRida~NgA.nshcha pravAdyanta sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
vINApaNavaveNUnAM svanashchAtimanoramaH |
prahAsa iva vistIrNaH shushruve tasya veshmanaH
shlokas.6:
tathA yudhiShThirasyApi rAj~no ma~NgalasaMhitAH |
uchcherurmadhurA vAcho gItavAditrasaMhitAH
shlokas.7:
tata utthAya dAshArhaH snAtaH prA~njalirachyutaH |
japtvA guhyaM mahAbAhuragnInAshritya tasthivAn
shlokas.8:
tataH sahasraM viprANAM chaturvedavidAM tathA |
gavAM sahasreNaikaikaM vAchayAmAsa mAdhavaH
shlokas.9:
ma~NgalAlambhanaM kRRitvA AtmAnamavalokya cha |
Adarshe vimale kRRiShNastataH sAtyakimabravIt
shlokas.10:
gachCha shaineya jAnIhi gatvA rAjaniveshanam |
api sajjo mahAtejA bhIShmaM draShTuM yuthiShThiraH
shlokas.11:
tataH kRRiShNasya vachanAtsAtyakistvarito yayau |
upagamya cha rAjAnaM yudhiShThiramuvAcha ha
shlokas.12:
yukto rathavaro rAjanvAsudevasya dhImataH |
samIpamApageyasya prayAsyati janArdanaH
shlokas.13:
bhavatpratIkShaH kRRiShNo.asau dharmarAja mahAdyute |
yadatrAnantaraM kRRityaM tadbhavAnkartumarhati
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yujyatAM me rathavaraH phalgunApratimadyute |
na sainikaishcha yAtavyaM yAsyAmo vayameva hi
shlokas.15:
na cha pIDayitavyo me bhIShmo dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
ataH puraHsarAshchApi nivartantu dhana~njaya
shlokas.16:
adyaprabhRRiti gA~NgeyaH paraM guhyaM pravakShyati |
tato nechChAmi kaunteya pRRithagjanasamAgamam
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tadvAkyamAkarNya tathA kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
yuktaM rathavaraM tasmA AchachakShe nararShabha
shlokas.18:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA yamau bhImArjunAvapi |
bhUtAnIva samastAni yayuH kRRiShNaniveshanam
shlokas.19:
AgachChatsvatha kRRiShNo.api pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
shaineyasahito dhImAnrathamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.20:
rathasthAH sa.nvidaM kRRitvA sukhAM pRRiShTvA cha sharvarIm |
meghaghoShai rathavaraiH prayayuste mahArathAH
shlokas.21:
meghapuShpaM balAhaM cha sainyaM sugrIvameva cha |
dArukashchodayAmAsa vAsudevasya vAjinaH
shlokas.22:
te hayA vAsudevasya dArukeNa prachoditAH |
gAM khurAgraistathA rAja.NllikhantaH prayayustadA
shlokas.23:
te grasanta ivAkAshaM vegavanto mahAbalAH |
kShetraM dharmasya kRRitsnasya kurukShetramavAtaran
shlokas.24:
tato yayuryatra bhIShmaH sharatalpagataH prabhuH |
Aste brahmarShibhiH sArdhaM brahmA devagaNairyathA
shlokas.25:
tato.avatIrya govindo rathAtsa cha yudhiShThiraH |
bhImo gANDIvadhanvA cha yamau sAtyakireva cha
RRiShInabhyarchayAmAsuH karAnudyamya dakShiNAn
shlokas.26:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA nakShatrairiva chandramAH |
abhyAjagAma gA~NgeyaM brahmANamiva vAsavaH
shlokas.27:
sharatalpe shayAnaM tamAdityaM patitaM yathA |
dadarsha sa mahAbAhurbhayAdAgatasAdhvasaH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
dharmAtmani mahAsattve satyasandhe jitAtmani |
devavrate mahAbhAge sharatalpagate.achyute
shlokas.2:
shayAne vIrashayane bhIShme shantanunandane |
gA~Ngeye puruShavyAghre pANDavaiH paryupasthite
shlokas.3:
kAH kathAH samavartanta tasminvIrasamAgame |
hateShu sarvasainyeShu tanme sha.nsa mahAmune
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sharatalpagate bhIShme kauravANAM dhurandhare |
AjagmurRRiShayaH siddhA nAradapramukhA nRRipa
shlokas.5:
hatashiShTAshcha rAjAno yudhiShThirapurogamAH |
dhRRitarAShTrashcha kRRiShNashcha bhImArjunayamAstathA
shlokas.6:
te.abhigamya mahAtmAno bharatAnAM pitAmaham |
anvashochanta gA~NgeyamAdityaM patitaM yathA
shlokas.7:
muhUrtamiva cha dhyAtvA nArado devadarshanaH |
uvAcha pANDavAnsarvAnhatashiShTA.nshcha pArthivAn
shlokas.8:
prAptakAlaM cha AchakShe bhIShmo.ayamanuyujyatAm |
astameti hi gA~Ngeyo bhAnumAniva bhArata
shlokas.9:
ayaM prANAnutsisRRikShustaM sarve.abhyetya pRRichChata |
kRRitsnAnhi vividhAndharmA.nshchAturvarNyasya vettyayam
shlokas.10:
eSha vRRiddhaH purA lokAnsamprApnoti tanutyajAm |
taM shIghramanuyu~njadhvaM sa.nshayAnmanasi sthitAn
shlokas.11:
evamuktA nAradena bhIShmamIyurnarAdhipAH |
praShTuM chAshaknuvantaste vIkShAM chakruH parasparam
shlokas.12:
athovAcha hRRiShIkeshaM pANDuputro yudhiShThiraH |
nAnyastvaddevakIputra shaktaH praShTuM pitAmaham
shlokas.13:
pravyAhAraya durdharSha tvamagre madhusUdana |
tvaM hi nastAta sarveShAM sarvadharmaviduttamaH
shlokas.14:
evamuktaH pANDavena bhagavAnkeshavastadA |
abhigamya durAdharShaM pravyAhArayadachyutaH
shlokas.15:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
kachchitsukhena rajanI vyuShTA te rAjasattama |
vispaShTalakShaNA buddhiH kachchichchopasthitA tava
shlokas.16:
kachchijj~nAnAni sarvANi pratibhAnti cha te.anagha |
na glAyate cha hRRidayaM na cha te vyAkulaM manaH
shlokas.17:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dAho mohaH shramashchaiva klamo glAnistathA rujA |
tava prasAdAdgovinda sadyo vyapagatAnagha
shlokas.18:
yachcha bhUtaM bhaviShyachcha bhavachcha paramadyute |
tatsarvamanupashyAmi pANau phalamivAhitam
shlokas.19:
vedoktAshchaiva ye dharmA vedAntanihitAshcha ye |
tAnsarvAnsamprapashyAmi varadAnAttavAchyuta
shlokas.20:
shiShTaishcha dharmo yaH proktaH sa cha me hRRidi vartate |
deshajAtikulAnAM cha dharmaj~no.asmi janArdana
shlokas.21:
chaturShvAshramadharmeShu yo.arthaH sa cha hRRidi sthitaH |
rAjadharmA.nshcha sakalAnavagachChAmi keshava
shlokas.22:
yatra yatra cha vaktavyaM tadvakShyAmi janArdana |
tava prasAdAddhi shubhA mano me buddhirAvishat
shlokas.23:
yuveva chAsmi sa.nvRRittastvadanudhyAnabRRiMhitaH |
vaktuM shreyaH samartho.asmi tvatprasAdAjjanArdana
shlokas.24:
svayaM kimarthaM tu bhavA~nshreyo na prAha pANDavam |
kiM te vivakShitaM chAtra tadAshu vada mAdhava
shlokas.25:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
yashasaH shreyasashchaiva mUlaM mAM viddhi kaurava |
mattaH sarve.abhinirvRRittA bhAvAH sadasadAtmakAH
shlokas.26:
shItA.nshushchandra ityukte ko loke vismayiShyati |
tathaiva yashasA pUrNe mayi ko vismayiShyati
shlokas.27:
AdheyaM tu mayA bhUyo yashastava mahAdyute |
tato me vipulA buddhistvayi bhIShma samAhitA
shlokas.28:
yAvaddhi pRRithivIpAla pRRithivI sthAsyate dhruvA |
tAvattavAkShayA kIrtirlokAnanu chariShyati
shlokas.29:
yachcha tvaM vakShyase bhIShma pANDavAyAnupRRichChate |
vedapravAdA iva te sthAsyanti vasudhAtale
shlokas.30:
yashchaitena pramANena yokShyatyAtmAnamAtmanA |
sa phalaM sarvapuNyAnAM pretya chAnubhaviShyati
shlokas.31:
etasmAtkAraNAdbhIShma matirdivyA mayA hi te |
dattA yasho vipratheta kathaM bhUyastaveti ha
shlokas.32:
yAvaddhi prathate loke puruShasya yasho bhuvi |
tAvattasyAkShayaM sthAnaM bhavatIti vinishchitam
shlokas.33:
rAjAno hatashiShTAstvAM rAjannabhita Asate |
dharmAnanuyuyukShantastebhyaH prabrUhi bhArata
shlokas.34:
bhavAnhi vayasA vRRiddhaH shrutAchArasamanvitaH |
kushalo rAjadharmANAM pUrveShAmaparAshcha ye
shlokas.35:
janmaprabhRRiti te kashchidvRRijinaM na dadarsha ha |
j~nAtAramanudharmANAM tvAM viduH sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.36:
tebhyaH piteva putrebhyo rAjanbrUhi paraM nayam |
RRiShayashcha hi devAshcha tvayA nityamupAsitAH
shlokas.37:
tasmAdvaktavyameveha tvayA pashyAmyasheShataH |
dharmA~nshushrUShamANebhyaH pRRiShTena cha satA punaH
shlokas.38:
vaktavyaM viduShA cheti dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH |
apratibruvataH kaShTo doSho hi bhavati prabho
shlokas.39:
tasmAtputraishcha pautraishcha dharmAnpRRiShTaH sanAtanAn |
vidvA~njij~nAsamAnaistvaM prabrUhi bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
athAbravInmahAtejA vAkyaM kauravanandanaH |
hanta dharmAnpravakShyAmi dRRiDhe vA~NmanasI mama
tava prasAdAdgovinda bhUtAtmA hyasi shAshvataH
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThirastu mAM rAjA dharmAnsamanupRRichChatu |
evaM prIto bhaviShyAmi dharmAnvakShyAmi chAnagha
shlokas.3:
yasminrAjarShabhe jAte dharmAtmani mahAtmani |
ahRRiShyannRRiShayaH sarve sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.4:
sarveShAM dIptayashasAM kurUNAM dharmachAriNAm |
yasya nAsti samaH kashchitsa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.5:
dhRRitirdamo brahmacharyaM kShamA dharmashcha nityadA |
yasminnojashcha tejashcha sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.6:
satyaM dAnaM tapaH shauchaM shAntirdAkShyamasambhramaH |
yasminnetAni sarvANi sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.7:
yo na kAmAnna sa.nrambhAnna bhayAnnArthakAraNAt |
kuryAdadharmaM dharmAtmA sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.8:
sambandhino.atithInbhRRityAnsa.nshritopAshritA.nshcha yaH |
saMmAnayati satkRRitya sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.9:
satyanityaH kShamAnityo j~nAnanityo.atithipriyaH |
yo dadAti satAM nityaM sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.10:
ijyAdhyayananityashcha dharme cha nirataH sadA |
shAntaH shrutarahasyashcha sa mAM pRRichChatu pANDavaH
shlokas.11:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
lajjayA parayopeto dharmAtmA sa yudhiShThiraH |
abhishApabhayAdbhIto bhavantaM nopasarpati
shlokas.12:
lokasya kadanaM kRRitvA lokanAtho vishAM pate |
abhishApabhayAdbhIto bhavantaM nopasarpati
shlokas.13:
pUjyAnmAnyA.nshcha bhaktA.nshcha gurUnsambandhibAndhavAn |
arghyArhAniShubhirhatvA bhavantaM nopasarpati
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNAnAM yathA dharmo dAnamadhyayanaM tapaH |
kShatriyANAM tathA kRRiShNa samare dehapAtanam
shlokas.15:
pitR^InpitAmahAnputrAngurUnsambandhibAndhavAn |
mithyApravRRittAnyaH sa~Nkhye nihanyAddharma eva saH
shlokas.16:
samayatyAgino lubdhAngurUnapi cha keshava |
nihanti samare pApAnkShatriyo yaH sa dharmavit
shlokas.17:
AhUtena raNe nityaM yoddhavyaM kShatrabandhunA |
dharmyaM svargyaM cha lokyaM cha yuddhaM hi manurabravIt
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu bhIShmeNa dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vinItavadupAgamya tasthau sa.ndarshane.agrataH
shlokas.19:
athAsya pAdau jagrAha bhIShmashchAbhinananda tam |
mUrdhni chainamupAghrAya niShIdetyabravIttadA
shlokas.20:
tamuvAchAtha gA~Ngeya RRiShabhaH sarvadhanvinAm |
pRRichCha mAM tAta visrabdhaM mA bhaistvaM kurusattama

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
praNipatya hRRiShIkeshamabhivAdya pitAmaham |
anumAnya gurUnsarvAnparyapRRichChadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
rAjyaM vai paramo dharma iti dharmavido viduH |
mahAntametaM bhAraM cha manye tadbrUhi pArthiva
shlokas.3:
rAjadharmAnvisheSheNa kathayasva pitAmaha |
sarvasya jIvalokasya rAjadharmAH parAyaNam
shlokas.4:
trivargo.atra samAsakto rAjadharmeShu kaurava |
mokShadharmashcha vispaShTaH sakalo.atra samAhitaH
shlokas.5:
yathA hi rashmayo.ashvasya dviradasyA~Nkusho yathA |
narendradharmo lokasya tathA pragrahaNaM smRRitam
shlokas.6:
atra vai sampramUDhe tu dharme rAjarShisevite |
lokasya sa.nsthA na bhavetsarvaM cha vyAkulaM bhavet
shlokas.7:
udayanhi yathA sUryo nAshayatyAsuraM tamaH |
rAjadharmAstathAlokyAmAkShipantyashubhAM gatim
shlokas.8:
tadagre rAjadharmANAmarthatattvaM pitAmaha |
prabrUhi bharatashreShTha tvaM hi buddhimatAM varaH
shlokas.9:
Agamashcha parastvattaH sarveShAM naH parantapa |
bhavantaM hi paraM buddhau vAsudevo.abhimanyate
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
namo dharmAya mahate namaH kRRiShNAya vedhase |
brAhmaNebhyo namaskRRitya dharmAnvakShyAmi shAshvatAn
shlokas.11:
shRRiNu kArtsnyena mattastvaM rAjadharmAnyudhiShThira |
niruchyamAnAnniyato yachchAnyadabhivA~nChasi
shlokas.12:
AdAveva kurushreShTha rAj~nA ra~njanakAmyayA |
devatAnAM dvijAnAM cha vartitavyaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.13:
daivatAnyarchayitvA hi brAhmaNA.nshcha kurUdvaha |
AnRRiNyaM yAti dharmasya lokena cha sa mAnyate
shlokas.14:
utthAne cha sadA putra prayatethA yudhiShThira |
na hyutthAnamRRite daivaM rAj~nAmarthaprasiddhaye
shlokas.15:
sAdhAraNaM dvayaM hyetaddaivamutthAnameva cha |
pauruShaM hi paraM manye daivaM nishchityamuchyate
shlokas.16:
vipanne cha samArambhe santApaM mA sma vai kRRithAH |
ghaTate vinayastAta rAj~nAmeSha nayaH paraH
shlokas.17:
na hi satyAdRRite ki~nchidrAj~nAM vai siddhikAraNam |
satye hi rAjA nirataH pretya cheha cha nandati
shlokas.18:
RRiShINAmapi rAjendra satyameva paraM dhanam |
tathA rAj~naH paraM satyAnnAnyadvishvAsakAraNam
shlokas.19:
guNavA~nshIlavAndAnto mRRidurdharmyo jitendriyaH |
sudarshaH sthUlalakShyashcha na bhrashyeta sadA shriyaH
shlokas.20:
ArjavaM sarvakAryeShu shrayethAH kurunandana |
punarnayavichAreNa trayIsa.nvaraNena cha
shlokas.21:
mRRidurhi rAjA satataM la~Nghyo bhavati sarvashaH |
tIkShNAchchodvijate lokastasmAdubhayamAchara
shlokas.22:
adaNDyAshchaiva te nityaM viprAH syurdadatAM vara |
bhUtametatparaM loke brAhmaNA nAma bhArata
shlokas.23:
manunA chApi rAjendra gItau shlokau mahAtmanA |
dharmeShu sveShu kauravya hRRidi tau kartumarhasi
shlokas.24:
adbhyo.agnirbrahmataH kShatramashmano lohamutthitam |
teShAM sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yoniShu shAmyati
shlokas.25:
ayo hanti yadAshmAnamagnishchApo.abhipadyate |
brahma cha kShatriyo dveShTi tadA sIdanti te trayaH
shlokas.26:
etajj~nAtvA mahArAja namasyA eva te dvijAH |
bhaumaM brahma dvijashreShThA dhArayanti shamAnvitAH
shlokas.27:
evaM chaiva naravyAghra lokatantravighAtakAH |
nigrAhyA eva satataM bAhubhyAM ye syurIdRRishAH
shlokas.28:
shlokau choshanasA gItau purA tAta maharShiNA |
tau nibodha mahAprAj~na tvamekAgramanA nRRipa
shlokas.29:
udyamya shastramAyAntamapi vedAntagaM raNe |
nigRRihNIyAtsvadharmeNa dharmApekShI nareshvaraH
shlokas.30:
vinashyamAnaM dharmaM hi yo rakShati sa dharmavit |
na tena bhrUNahA sa syAnmanyustaM manumRRichChati
shlokas.31:
evaM chaiva narashreShTha rakShyA eva dvijAtayaH |
svaparAddhAnapi hi tAnviShayAnte samutsRRijet
shlokas.32:
abhishastamapi hyeShAM kRRipAyIta vishAM pate |
brahmaghne gurutalpe cha bhrUNahatye tathaiva cha
shlokas.33:
rAjadviShTe cha viprasya viShayAnte visarjanam |
vidhIyate na shArIraM bhayameShAM kadAchana
shlokas.34:
dayitAshcha narAste syurnityaM puruShasattama |
na koshaH paramo hyanyo rAj~nAM puruShasa~nchayAt
shlokas.35:
durgeShu cha mahArAja ShaTsu ye shAstranishchitAH |
sarveShu teShu manyante naradurgaM sudustaram
shlokas.36:
tasmAnnityaM dayA kAryA chAturvarNye vipashchitA |
dharmAtmA satyavAkchaiva rAjA ra~njayati prajAH
shlokas.37:
na cha kShAntena te bhAvyaM nityaM puruShasattama |
adharmyo hi mRRidU rAjA kShamAvAniva ku~njaraH
shlokas.38:
bArhaspatye cha shAstre vai shlokA viniyatAH purA |
asminnarthe mahArAja tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.39:
kShamamANaM nRRipaM nityaM nIchaH paribhavejjanaH |
hastiyantA gajasyeva shira evArurukShati
shlokas.40:
tasmAnnaiva mRRidurnityaM tIkShNo vApi bhavennRRipaH |
vasante.arka iva shrImAnna shIto na cha gharmadaH
shlokas.41:
pratyakSheNAnumAnena tathaupamyopadeshataH |
parIkShyAste mahArAja sve pare chaiva sarvadA
shlokas.42:
vyasanAni cha sarvANi tyajethA bhUridakShiNa |
na chaiva na prayu~njIta sa~NgaM tu parivarjayet
shlokas.43:
nityaM hi vyasanI loke paribhUto bhavatyuta |
udvejayati lokaM chApyatidveShI mahIpatiH
shlokas.44:
bhavitavyaM sadA rAj~nA garbhiNIsahadharmiNA |
kAraNaM cha mahArAja shRRiNu yenedamiShyate
shlokas.45:
yathA hi garbhiNI hitvA svaM priyaM manaso.anugam |
garbhasya hitamAdhatte tathA rAj~nApyasa.nshayam
shlokas.46:
vartitavyaM kurushreShTha nityaM dharmAnuvartinA |
svaM priyaM samabhityajya yadyallokahitaM bhavet
shlokas.47:
na santyAjyaM cha te dhairyaM kadAchidapi pANDava |
dhIrasya spaShTadaNDasya na hyAj~nA pratihanyate
shlokas.48:
parihAsashcha bhRRityaiste na nityaM vadatAM vara |
kartavyo rAjashArdUla doShamatra hi me shRRiNu
shlokas.49:
avamanyanti bhartAraM saMharShAdupajIvinaH |
sve sthAne na cha tiShThanti la~Nghayanti hi tadvachaH
shlokas.50:
preShyamANA vikalpante guhyaM chApyanuyu~njate |
ayAchyaM chaiva yAchante.abhojyAnyAhArayanti cha
shlokas.51:
krudhyanti paridIpyanti bhUmimadhyAsate.asya cha |
utkochairva~nchanAbhishcha kAryANyanuvihanti cha
shlokas.52:
jarjaraM chAsya viShayaM kurvanti pratirUpakaiH |
strIrakShibhishcha sajjante tulyaveShA bhavanti cha
shlokas.53:
vAtaM cha ShThIvanaM chaiva kurvate chAsya saMnidhau |
nirlajjA narashArdUla vyAharanti cha tadvachaH
shlokas.54:
hayaM vA dantinaM vApi rathaM nRRipatisaMmatam |
adhirohantyanAdRRitya harShule pArthive mRRidau
shlokas.55:
idaM te duShkaraM rAjannidaM te durvicheShTitam |
ityevaM suhRRido nAma bruvanti pariShadgatAH
shlokas.56:
kruddhe chAsminhasantyeva na cha hRRiShyanti pUjitAH |
sa~NgharShashIlAshcha sadA bhavantyanyonyakAraNAt
shlokas.57:
visra.nsayanti mantraM cha vivRRiNvanti cha duShkRRitam |
lIlayA chaiva kurvanti sAvaj~nAstasya shAsanam
ala~NkaraNabhojyaM cha tathA snAnAnulepanam
shlokas.58:
helamAnA naravyAghra svasthAstasyopashRRiNvate |
nindanti svAnadhIkArAnsantyajanti cha bhArata
shlokas.59:
na vRRittyA parituShyanti rAjadeyaM haranti cha |
krIDituM tena chechChanti sasUtreNeva pakShiNA
asmatpraNeyo rAjeti loke chaiva vadantyuta
shlokas.60:
ete chaivApare chaiva doShAH prAdurbhavantyuta |
nRRipatau mArdavopete harShule cha yudhiShThira

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nityodyuktena vai rAj~nA bhavitavyaM yudhiShThira |
prashAmyate cha rAjA hi nArIvodyamavarjitaH
shlokas.2:
bhagavAnushanA chAha shlokamatra vishAM pate |
tamihaikamanA rAjangadatastvaM nibodha me
shlokas.3:
dvAvetau grasate bhUmiH sarpo bilashayAniva |
rAjAnaM chAviroddhAraM brAhmaNaM chApravAsinam
shlokas.4:
tadetannarashArdUla hRRidi tvaM kartumarhasi |
sandheyAnapi sandhatsva virodhyA.nshcha virodhaya
shlokas.5:
saptA~Nge yashcha te rAjye vaiparItyaM samAcharet |
gururvA yadi vA mitraM pratihantavya eva saH
shlokas.6:
maruttena hi rAj~nAyaM gItaH shlokaH purAtanaH |
rAjyAdhikAre rAjendra bRRihaspatimataH purA
shlokas.7:
gurorapyavaliptasya kAryAkAryamajAnataH |
utpathapratipannasya parityAgo vidhIyate
shlokas.8:
bAhoH putreNa rAj~nA cha sagareNeha dhImatA |
asama~njAH suto jyeShThastyaktaH paurahitaiShiNA
shlokas.9:
asama~njAH sarayvAM prAkpaurANAM bAlakAnnRRipa |
nyamajjayadataH pitrA nirbhartsya sa vivAsitaH
shlokas.10:
RRiShiNoddAlakenApi shvetaketurmahAtapAH |
mithyA viprAnupacharansantyakto dayitaH sutaH
shlokas.11:
lokara~njanamevAtra rAj~nAM dharmaH sanAtanaH |
satyasya rakShaNaM chaiva vyavahArasya chArjavam
shlokas.12:
na hi.nsyAtparavittAni deyaM kAle cha dApayet |
vikrAntaH satyavAkkShAnto nRRipo na chalate pathaH
shlokas.13:
guptamantro jitakrodho shAstrArthagatanishchayaH |
dharme chArthe cha kAme cha mokShe cha satataM rataH
shlokas.14:
trayyA sa.nvRRitarandhrashcha rAjA bhavitumarhati |
vRRijinasya narendrANAM nAnyatsa.nvaraNAtparam
shlokas.15:
chAturvarNyasya dharmAshcha rakShitavyA mahIkShitA |
dharmasa~NkararakShA hi rAj~nAM dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.16:
na vishvasechcha nRRipatirna chAtyarthaM na vishvaset |
ShADguNyaguNadoShA.nshcha nityaM buddhyAvalokayet
shlokas.17:
dviTChidradarshI nRRipatirnityameva prashasyate |
trivargaviditArthashcha yuktachAropadhishcha yaH
shlokas.18:
koshasyopArjanaratiryamavaishravaNopamaH |
vettA cha dashavargasya sthAnavRRiddhikShayAtmanaH
shlokas.19:
abhRRitAnAM bhavedbhartA bhRRitAnAM chAnvavekShakaH |
nRRipatiH sumukhashcha syAtsmitapUrvAbhibhAShitA
shlokas.20:
upAsitA cha vRRiddhAnAM jitatandrIralolupaH |
satAM vRRitte sthitamatiH santo hyAchAradarshinaH
shlokas.21:
na chAdadIta vittAni satAM hastAtkadAchana |
asadbhyastu samAdadyAtsadbhyaH sampratipAdayet
shlokas.22:
svayaM prahartAdAtA cha vashyAtmA vashyasAdhanaH |
kAle dAtA cha bhoktA cha shuddhAchArastathaiva cha
shlokas.23:
shUrAnbhaktAnasaMhAryAnkule jAtAnarogiNaH |
shiShTA~nshiShTAbhisambandhAnmAnino nAvamAninaH
shlokas.24:
vidyAvido lokavidaH paralokAnvavekShakAn |
dharmeShu niratAnsAdhUnachalAnachalAniva
shlokas.25:
sahAyAnsatataM kuryAdrAjA bhUtipuraskRRitaH |
taistulyashcha bhavedbhogaishChatramAtrAj~nayAdhikaH
shlokas.26:
pratyakShA cha parokShA cha vRRittishchAsya bhavetsadA |
evaM kRRitvA narendro hi na khedamiha vindati
shlokas.27:
sarvAtisha~NkI nRRipatiryashcha sarvaharo bhavet |
sa kShipramanRRijurlubdhaH svajanenaiva bAdhyate
shlokas.28:
shuchistu pRRithivIpAlo lokachittagrahe rataH |
na patatyaribhirgrastaH patitashchAvatiShThate
shlokas.29:
akrodhano.athAvyasanI mRRidudaNDo jitendriyaH |
rAjA bhavati bhUtAnAM vishvAsyo himavAniva
shlokas.30:
prAj~no nyAyaguNopetaH pararandhreShu tatparaH |
sudarshaH sarvavarNAnAM nayApanayavittathA
shlokas.31:
kShiprakArI jitakrodhaH suprasAdo mahAmanAH |
arogaprakRRitiryuktaH kriyAvAnavikatthanaH
shlokas.32:
ArabdhAnyeva kAryANi na paryavasitAni cha |
yasya rAj~naH pradRRishyante sa rAjA rAjasattamaH
shlokas.33:
putrA iva piturgehe viShaye yasya mAnavAH |
nirbhayA vichariShyanti sa rAjA rAjasattamaH
shlokas.34:
agUDhavibhavA yasya paurA rAShTranivAsinaH |
nayApanayavettAraH sa rAjA rAjasattamaH
shlokas.35:
svakarmaniratA yasya janA viShayavAsinaH |
asa~NghAtaratA dAntAH pAlyamAnA yathAvidhi
shlokas.36:
vashyA neyA vinItAshcha na cha sa~NgharShashIlinaH |
viShaye dAnaruchayo narA yasya sa pArthivaH
shlokas.37:
na yasya kUTakapaTaM na mAyA na cha matsaraH |
viShaye bhUmipAlasya tasya dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.38:
yaH satkaroti j~nAnAni neyaH paurahite rataH |
satAM dharmAnugastyAgI sa rAjA rAjyamarhati
shlokas.39:
yasya chArashcha mantrashcha nityaM chaiva kRRitAkRRite |
na j~nAyate hi ripubhiH sa rAjA rAjyamarhati
shlokas.40:
shlokashchAyaM purA gIto bhArgaveNa mahAtmanA |
AkhyAte rAmacharite nRRipatiM prati bhArata
shlokas.41:
rAjAnaM prathamaM vindettato bhAryAM tato dhanam |
rAjanyasati lokasya kuto bhAryA kuto dhanam
shlokas.42:
tadrAjanrAjasiMhAnAM nAnyo dharmaH sanAtanaH |
RRite rakShAM suvispaShTAM rakShA lokasya dhAraNam
shlokas.43:
prAchetasena manunA shlokau chemAvudAhRRitau |
rAjadharmeShu rAjendra tAvihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.44:
ShaDetAnpuruSho jahyAdbhinnAM nAvamivArNave |
apravaktAramAchAryamanadhIyAnamRRitvijam
shlokas.45:
arakShitAraM rAjAnaM bhAryAM chApriyavAdinIm |
grAmakAmaM cha gopAlaM vanakAmaM cha nApitam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etatte rAjadharmANAM navanItaM yudhiShThira |
bRRihaspatirhi bhagavAnnAnyaM dharmaM prasha.nsati
shlokas.2:
vishAlAkShashcha bhagavAnkAvyashchaiva mahAtapAH |
sahasrAkSho mahendrashcha tathA prAchetaso manuH
shlokas.3:
bharadvAjashcha bhagavA.nstathA gaurashirA muniH |
rAjashAstrapraNetAro brahmaNyA brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.4:
rakShAmeva prasha.nsanti dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM vara |
rAj~nAM rAjIvatAmrAkSha sAdhanaM chAtra vai shRRiNu
shlokas.5:
chArashcha praNidhishchaiva kAle dAnamamatsaraH |
yuktyAdAnaM na chAdAnamayogena yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
satAM sa~NgrahaNaM shauryaM dAkShyaM satyaM prajAhitam |
anArjavairArjavaishcha shatrupakShasya bhedanam
shlokas.7:
sAdhUnAmaparityAgaH kulInAnAM cha dhAraNam |
nichayashcha nicheyAnAM sevA buddhimatAmapi
shlokas.8:
balAnAM harShaNaM nityaM prajAnAmanvavekShaNam |
kAryeShvakhedaH koshasya tathaiva cha vivardhanam
shlokas.9:
puraguptiravishvAsaH paurasa~NghAtabhedanam |
ketanAnAM cha jIrNAnAmavekShA chaiva sIdatAm
shlokas.10:
dvividhasya cha daNDasya prayogaH kAlachoditaH |
arimadhyasthamitrANAM yathAvachchAnvavekShaNam
shlokas.11:
upajApashcha bhRRityAnAmAtmanaH paradarshanAt |
avishvAsaH svayaM chaiva parasyAshvAsanaM tathA
shlokas.12:
nItidharmAnusaraNaM nityamutthAnameva cha |
ripUNAmanavaj~nAnaM nityaM chAnAryavarjanam
shlokas.13:
utthAnaM hi narendrANAM bRRihaspatirabhAShata |
rAjadharmasya yanmUlaM shlokA.nshchAtra nibodha me
shlokas.14:
utthAnenAmRRitaM labdhamutthAnenAsurA hatAH |
utthAnena mahendreNa shraiShThyaM prAptaM divIha cha
shlokas.15:
utthAnadhIraH puruSho vAgdhIrAnadhitiShThati |
utthAnadhIraM vAgdhIrA ramayanta upAsate
shlokas.16:
utthAnahIno rAjA hi buddhimAnapi nityashaH |
dharShaNIyo ripUNAM syAdbhuja~Nga iva nirviShaH
shlokas.17:
na cha shatruravaj~neyo durbalo.api balIyasA |
alpo.api hi dahatyagnirviShamalpaM hinasti cha
shlokas.18:
ekAshvenApi sambhUtaH shatrurdurgasamAshritaH |
taM taM tApayate deshamapi rAj~naH samRRiddhinaH
shlokas.19:
rAj~no rahasyaM yadvAkyaM jayArthaM lokasa~NgrahaH |
hRRidi yachchAsya jihmaM syAtkAraNArthaM cha yadbhavet
shlokas.20:
yachchAsya kAryaM vRRijinamArjavenaiva dhAryate |
dambhanArthAya lokasya dharmiShThAmAcharetkriyAm
shlokas.21:
rAjyaM hi sumahattantraM durdhAryamakRRitAtmabhiH |
na shakyaM mRRidunA voDhumAghAtasthAnamuttamam
shlokas.22:
rAjyaM sarvAmiShaM nityamArjaveneha dhAryate |
tasmAnmishreNa satataM vartitavyaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.23:
yadyapyasya vipattiH syAdrakShamANasya vai prajAH |
so.apyasya vipulo dharma eva.nvRRittA hi bhUmipAH
shlokas.24:
eSha te rAjadharmANAM leshaH samanuvarNitaH |
bhUyaste yatra sa.ndehastadbrUhi vadatAM vara
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato vyAsashcha bhagavAndevasthAno.ashmanA saha |
vAsudevaH kRRipashchaiva sAtyakiH sa~njayastathA
shlokas.26:
sAdhu sAdhviti saMhRRiShTAH puShyamANairivAnanaiH |
astuva.nste naravyAghraM bhIShmaM dharmabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.27:
tato dInamanA bhIShmamuvAcha kurusattamaH |
netrAbhyAmashrupUrNAbhyAM pAdau tasya shanaiH spRRishan
shlokas.28:
shva idAnIM svasa.ndehaM prakShyAmi tvaM pitAmaha |
upaiti savitApyastaM rasamApIya pArthivam
shlokas.29:
tato dvijAtInabhivAdya keshavaH; kRRipashcha te chaiva yudhiShThirAdayaH |
pradakShiNIkRRitya mahAnadIsutaM; tato rathAnAruruhurmudA yutAH
shlokas.30:
dRRiShadvatIM chApyavagAhya suvratAH; kRRitodakAryAH kRRitajapyama~NgalAH |
upAsya sandhyAM vidhivatparantapA;stataH puraM te vivishurgajAhvayam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH kAlyaM samutthAya kRRitapaurvAhNikakriyAH |
yayuste nagarAkArai rathaiH pANDavayAdavAH
shlokas.2:
prapadya cha kurukShetraM bhIShmamAsAdya chAnagham |
sukhAM cha rajanIM pRRiShTvA gA~NgeyaM rathinAM varam
shlokas.3:
vyAsAdInabhivAdyarShInsarvaistaishchAbhinanditAH |
niShedurabhito bhIShmaM parivArya samantataH
shlokas.4:
tato rAjA mahAtejA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
abravItprA~njalirbhIShmaM pratipUjyAbhivAdya cha
shlokas.5:
ya eSha rAjA-rAjeti shabdashcharati bhArata |
kathameSha samutpannastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.6:
tulyapANishirogrIvastulyabuddhIndriyAtmakaH |
tulyaduHkhasukhAtmA cha tulyapRRiShThabhujodaraH
shlokas.7:
tulyashukrAsthimajjashcha tulyamA.nsAsRRigeva cha |
niHshvAsochChvAsatulyashcha tulyaprANasharIravAn
shlokas.8:
samAnajanmamaraNaH samaH sarvaguNairnRRiNAm |
vishiShTabuddhI~nshUrA.nshcha kathameko.adhitiShThati
shlokas.9:
kathameko mahIM kRRitsnAM vIrashUrAryasa~NkulAm |
rakShatyapi cha loko.asya prasAdamabhivA~nChati
shlokas.10:
ekasya cha prasAdena kRRitsno lokaH prasIdati |
vyAkulenAkulaH sarvo bhavatIti vinishchayaH
shlokas.11:
etadichChAmyahaM sarvaM tattvena bharatarShabha |
shrotuM tanme yathAtattvaM prabrUhi vadatAM vara
shlokas.12:
naitatkAraNamalpaM hi bhaviShyati vishAM pate |
yadekasmi~njagatsarvaM devavadyAti saMnatim
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
niyatastvaM narashreShTha shRRiNu sarvamasheShataH |
yathA rAjyaM samutpannamAdau kRRitayuge.abhavat
shlokas.14:
naiva rAjyaM na rAjAsInna daNDo na cha dANDikaH |
dharmeNaiva prajAH sarvA rakShanti cha parasparam
shlokas.15:
pAlayAnAstathAnyonyaM narA dharmeNa bhArata |
khedaM paramamAjagmustatastAnmoha Avishat
shlokas.16:
te mohavashamApannA mAnavA manujarShabha |
pratipattivimohAchcha dharmasteShAmanInashat
shlokas.17:
naShTAyAM pratipattau tu mohavashyA narAstadA |
lobhasya vashamApannAH sarve bhAratasattama
shlokas.18:
aprAptasyAbhimarshaM tu kurvanto manujAstataH |
kAmo nAmAparastatra samapadyata vai prabho
shlokas.19:
tA.nstu kAmavashaM prAptAnrAgo nAma samaspRRishat |
raktAshcha nAbhyajAnanta kAryAkAryaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.20:
agamyAgamanaM chaiva vAchyAvAchyaM tathaiva cha |
bhakShyAbhakShyaM cha rAjendra doShAdoShaM cha nAtyajan
shlokas.21:
viplute naraloke.asmi.nstato brahma nanAsha ha |
nAshAchcha brahmaNo rAjandharmo nAshamathAgamat
shlokas.22:
naShTe brahmaNi dharme cha devAstrAsamathAgaman |
te trastA narashArdUla brahmANaM sharaNaM yayuH
shlokas.23:
prapadya bhagavantaM te devA lokapitAmaham |
UchuH prA~njalayaH sarve duHkhashokabhayArditAH
shlokas.24:
bhagavannaralokasthaM naShTaM brahma sanAtanam |
lobhamohAdibhirbhAvaistato no bhayamAvishat
shlokas.25:
brahmaNashcha praNAshena dharmo.apyanashadIshvara |
tataH sma samatAM yAtA martyaistribhuvaneshvara
shlokas.26:
adho hi varShamasmAkaM martyAstUrdhvapravarShiNaH |
kriyAvyuparamAtteShAM tato.agachChAma sa.nshayam
shlokas.27:
atra niHshreyasaM yannastaddhyAyasva pitAmaha |
tvatprabhAvasamuttho.asau prabhAvo no vinashyati
shlokas.28:
tAnuvAcha surAnsarvAnsvayambhUrbhagavA.nstataH |
shreyo.ahaM chintayiShyAmi vyetu vo bhIH surarShabhAH
shlokas.29:
tato.adhyAyasahasrANAM shataM chakre svabuddhijam |
yatra dharmastathaivArthaH kAmashchaivAnuvarNitaH
shlokas.30:
trivarga iti vikhyAto gaNa eSha svayambhuvA |
chaturtho mokSha ityeva pRRithagarthaH pRRithaggaNaH
shlokas.31:
mokShasyApi trivargo.anyaH proktaH sattvaM rajastamaH |
sthAnaM vRRiddhiH kShayashchaiva trivargashchaiva daNDajaH
shlokas.32:
AtmA deshashcha kAlashchApyupAyAH kRRityameva cha |
sahAyAH kAraNaM chaiva ShaDvargo nItijaH smRRitaH
shlokas.33:
trayI chAnvIkShikI chaiva vArtA cha bharatarShabha |
daNDanItishcha vipulA vidyAstatra nidarshitAH
shlokas.34:
amAtyarakShApraNidhI rAjaputrasya rakShaNam |
chArashcha vividhopAyaH praNidhishcha pRRithagvidhaH
shlokas.35:
sAma chopapradAnaM cha bhedo daNDashcha pANDava |
upekShA pa~nchamI chAtra kArtsnyena samudAhRRitA
shlokas.36:
mantrashcha varNitaH kRRitsnastathA bhedArtha eva cha |
vibhra.nshashchaiva mantrasya siddhyasiddhyoshcha yatphalam
shlokas.37:
sandhishcha vividhAbhikhyo hIno madhyastathottamaH |
bhayasatkAravittAkhyaH kArtsnyena parivarNitaH
shlokas.38:
yAtrAkAlAshcha chatvArastrivargasya cha vistaraH |
vijayo dharmayuktashcha tathArthavijayashcha ha
shlokas.39:
Asurashchaiva vijayastathA kArtsnyena varNitaH |
lakShaNaM pa~nchavargasya trividhaM chAtra varNitam
shlokas.40:
prakAshashchAprakAshashcha daNDo.atha parishabditaH |
prakAsho.aShTavidhastatra guhyastu bahuvistaraH
shlokas.41:
rathA nAgA hayAshchaiva pAdAtAshchaiva pANDava |
viShTirnAvashcharAshchaiva deshikAH pathi chAShTakam
shlokas.42:
a~NgAnyetAni kauravya prakAshAni balasya tu |
ja~NgamAja~NgamAshchoktAshchUrNayogA viShAdayaH
shlokas.43:
sparshe chAbhyavahArye chApyupA.nshurvividhaH smRRitaH |
arirmitramudAsIna ityete.apyanuvarNitAH
shlokas.44:
kRRitsnA mArgaguNAshchaiva tathA bhUmiguNAshcha ha |
AtmarakShaNamAshvAsaH spashAnAM chAnvavekShaNam
shlokas.45:
kalpanA vividhAshchApi nRRinAgarathavAjinAm |
vyUhAshcha vividhAbhikhyA vichitraM yuddhakaushalam
shlokas.46:
utpAtAshcha nipAtAshcha suyuddhaM supalAyanam |
shastrANAM pAyanaj~nAnaM tathaiva bharatarShabha
shlokas.47:
balavyasanamuktaM cha tathaiva balaharShaNam |
pIDanAskandakAlashcha bhayakAlashcha pANDava
shlokas.48:
tathA khAtavidhAnaM cha yogasa~nchAra eva cha |
chaurATavyabalaishchograiH pararAShTrasya pIDanam
shlokas.49:
agnidairgaradaishchaiva pratirUpakachArakaiH |
shreNimukhyopajApena vIrudhashChedanena cha
shlokas.50:
dUShaNena cha nAgAnAmAsha~NkAjananena cha |
Arodhanena bhaktasya pathashchopArjanena cha
shlokas.51:
saptA~Ngasya cha rAjyasya hrAsavRRiddhisama~njasam |
dUtasAmarthyayogashcha rAShTrasya cha vivardhanam
shlokas.52:
arimadhyasthamitrANAM samyakchoktaM prapa~nchanam |
avamardaH pratIghAtastathaiva cha balIyasAm
shlokas.53:
vyavahAraH susUkShmashcha tathA kaNTakashodhanam |
shamo vyAyAmayogashcha yogo dravyasya sa~nchayaH
shlokas.54:
abhRRitAnAM cha bharaNaM bhRRitAnAM chAnvavekShaNam |
arthakAle pradAnaM cha vyasaneShvaprasa~NgitA
shlokas.55:
tathA rAjaguNAshchaiva senApatiguNAshcha ye |
kAraNasya cha kartushcha guNadoShAstathaiva cha
shlokas.56:
duShTe~NgitaM cha vividhaM vRRittishchaivAnujIvinAm |
sha~NkitatvaM cha sarvasya pramAdasya cha varjanam
shlokas.57:
alabdhalipsA labdhasya tathaiva cha vivardhanam |
pradAnaM cha vivRRiddhasya pAtrebhyo vidhivattathA
shlokas.58:
visargo.arthasya dharmArthamarthArthaM kAmahetunA |
chaturtho vyasanAghAte tathaivAtrAnuvarNitaH
shlokas.59:
krodhajAni tathogrANi kAmajAni tathaiva cha |
dashoktAni kurushreShTha vyasanAnyatra chaiva ha
shlokas.60:
mRRigayAkShAstathA pAnaM striyashcha bharatarShabha |
kAmajAnyAhurAchAryAH proktAnIha svayambhuvA
shlokas.61:
vAkpAruShyaM tathogratvaM daNDapAruShyameva cha |
Atmano nigrahastyAgo.athArthadUShaNameva cha
shlokas.62:
yantrANi vividhAnyeva kriyAsteShAM cha varNitAH |
avamardaH pratIghAtaH ketanAnAM cha bha~njanam
shlokas.63:
chaityadrumANAmAmardo rodhaHkarmAntanAshanam |
apaskaro.atha gamanaM tathopAsyA cha varNitA
shlokas.64:
paNavAnakasha~NkhAnAM bherINAM cha yudhAM vara |
upArjanaM cha dravyANAM paramarma cha tAni ShaT
shlokas.65:
labdhasya cha prashamanaM satAM chaiva hi pUjanam |
vidvadbhirekIbhAvashcha prAtarhomavidhij~natA
shlokas.66:
ma~NgalAlambhanaM chaiva sharIrasya pratikriyA |
AhArayojanaM chaiva nityamAstikyameva cha
shlokas.67:
ekena cha yathottheyaM satyatvaM madhurA giraH |
utsavAnAM samAjAnAM kriyAH ketanajAstathA
shlokas.68:
pratyakShA cha parokShA cha sarvAdhikaraNeShu cha |
vRRittirbharatashArdUla nityaM chaivAnvavekShaNam
shlokas.69:
adaNDyatvaM cha viprANAM yuktyA daNDanipAtanam |
anujIvisvajAtibhyo guNeShu parirakShaNam
shlokas.70:
rakShaNaM chaiva paurANAM svarAShTrasya vivardhanam |
maNDalasthA cha yA chintA rAjandvAdasharAjikA
shlokas.71:
dvAsaptatimatishchaiva proktA yA cha svayambhuvA |
deshajAtikulAnAM cha dharmAH samanuvarNitAH
shlokas.72:
dharmashchArthashcha kAmashcha mokShashchAtrAnuvarNitaH |
upAyashchArthalipsA cha vividhA bhUridakShiNAH
shlokas.73:
mUlakarmakriyA chAtra mAyA yogashcha varNitaH |
dUShaNaM srotasAmatra varNitaM cha sthirAmbhasAm
shlokas.74:
yairyairupAyairlokashcha na chaledAryavartmanaH |
tatsarvaM rAjashArdUla nItishAstre.anuvarNitam
shlokas.75:
etatkRRitvA shubhaM shAstraM tataH sa bhagavAnprabhuH |
devAnuvAcha saMhRRiShTaH sarvA~nshakrapurogamAn
shlokas.76:
upakArAya lokasya trivargasthApanAya cha |
navanItaM sarasvatyA buddhireShA prabhAvitA
shlokas.77:
daNDena sahitA hyeShA lokarakShaNakArikA |
nigrahAnugraharatA lokAnanu chariShyati
shlokas.78:
daNDena nIyate cheyaM daNDaM nayati chApyuta |
daNDanItiriti proktA trI.NllokAnanuvartate
shlokas.79:
ShADguNyaguNasAraiShA sthAsyatyagre mahAtmasu |
mahattvAttasya daNDasya nItirvispaShTalakShaNA
shlokas.80:
nayachArashcha vipulo yena sarvamidaM tatam |
Agamashcha purANAnAM maharShINAM cha sambhavaH
shlokas.81:
tIrthava.nshashcha va.nshashcha nakShatrANAM yudhiShThira |
sakalaM chAturAshramyaM chAturhotraM tathaiva cha
shlokas.82:
chAturvarNyaM tathaivAtra chAturvedyaM cha varNitam |
itihAsopavedAshcha nyAyaH kRRitsnashcha varNitaH
shlokas.83:
tapo j~nAnamahi.nsA cha satyAsatye nayaH paraH |
vRRiddhopasevA dAnaM cha shauchamutthAnameva cha
shlokas.84:
sarvabhUtAnukampA cha sarvamatropavarNitam |
bhuvi vAchogataM yachcha tachcha sarvaM samarpitam
shlokas.85:
tasminpaitAmahe shAstre pANDavaitadasa.nshayam |
dharmArthakAmamokShAshcha sakalA hyatra shabditAH
shlokas.86:
tatastAM bhagavAnnItiM pUrvaM jagrAha sha~NkaraH |
bahurUpo vishAlAkShaH shivaH sthANurumApatiH
shlokas.87:
yugAnAmAyuSho hrAsaM vij~nAya bhagavA~nshivaH |
sa~nchikShepa tataH shAstraM mahArthaM brahmaNA kRRitam
shlokas.88:
vaishAlAkShamiti proktaM tadindraH pratyapadyata |
dashAdhyAyasahasrANi subrahmaNyo mahAtapAH
shlokas.89:
bhagavAnapi tachChAstraM sa~nchikShepa pura.ndaraH |
sahasraiH pa~nchabhistAta yaduktaM bAhudantakam
shlokas.90:
adhyAyAnAM sahasraistu tribhireva bRRihaspatiH |
sa~nchikShepeshvaro buddhyA bArhaspatyaM taduchyate
shlokas.91:
adhyAyAnAM sahasreNa kAvyaH sa~NkShepamabravIt |
tachChAstramamitapraj~no yogAchAryo mahAtapAH
shlokas.92:
evaM lokAnurodhena shAstrametanmaharShibhiH |
sa~NkShiptamAyurvij~nAya martyAnAM hrAsi pANDava
shlokas.93:
atha devAH samAgamya viShNumUchuH prajApatim |
eko yo.arhati martyebhyaH shraiShThyaM taM vai samAdisha
shlokas.94:
tataH sa~nchintya bhagavAndevo nArAyaNaH prabhuH |
taijasaM vai virajasaM so.asRRijanmAnasaM sutam
shlokas.95:
virajAstu mahAbhAga vibhutvaM bhuvi naichChata |
nyAsAyaivAbhavadbuddhiH praNItA tasya pANDava
shlokas.96:
kIrtimA.nstasya putro.abhUtso.api pa~nchAtigo.abhavat |
kardamastasya cha sutaH so.apyatapyanmahattapaH
shlokas.97:
prajApateH kardamasya ana~Ngo nAma vai sutaH |
prajAnAM rakShitA sAdhurdaNDanItivishAradaH
shlokas.99:
mRRityostu duhitA rAjansunIthA nAma mAnasI |
prakhyAtA triShu lokeShu yA sA venamajIjanat
shlokas.100:
taM prajAsu vidharmANaM rAgadveShavashAnugam |
mantrapUtaiH kushairjaghnurRRiShayo brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.101:
mamanthurdakShiNaM chorumRRiShayastasya mantrataH |
tato.asya vikRRito jaj~ne hrasvA~NgaH puruSho bhuvi
shlokas.103:
tasmAnniShAdAH sambhUtAH krUrAH shailavanAshrayAH |
ye chAnye vindhyanilayA mlechChAH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.104:
bhUyo.asya dakShiNaM pANiM mamanthuste maharShayaH |
tataH puruSha utpanno rUpeNendra ivAparaH
shlokas.105:
kavachI baddhanistri.nshaH sasharaH sasharAsanaH |
vedavedA~Ngavichchaiva dhanurvede cha pAragaH
shlokas.106:
taM daNDanItiH sakalA shritA rAjannarottamam |
tataH sa prA~njalirvainyo maharShI.nstAnuvAcha ha
shlokas.107:
susUkShmA me samutpannA buddhirdharmArthadarshinI |
anayA kiM mayA kAryaM tanme tattvena sha.nsata
shlokas.108:
yanmAM bhavanto vakShyanti kAryamarthasamanvitam |
tadahaM vai kariShyAmi nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.109:
tamUchuratha devAste te chaiva paramarShayaH |
niyato yatra dharmo vai tamasha~NkaH samAchara
shlokas.110:
priyApriye parityajya samaH sarveShu jantuShu |
kAmakrodhau cha lobhaM cha mAnaM chotsRRijya dUrataH
shlokas.111:
yashcha dharmAtpravichalelloke kashchana mAnavaH |
nigrAhyaste sa bAhubhyAM shashvaddharmamavekShataH
shlokas.112:
pratij~nAM chAdhirohasva manasA karmaNA girA |
pAlayiShyAmyahaM bhaumaM brahma ityeva chAsakRRit
shlokas.113:
yashchAtra dharmanItyukto daNDanItivyapAshrayaH |
tamasha~NkaH kariShyAmi svavasho na kadAchana
shlokas.114:
adaNDyA me dvijAshcheti pratijAnIShva chAbhibho |
lokaM cha sa~NkarAtkRRitsnAttrAtAsmIti parantapa
shlokas.115:
vainyastatastAnuvAcha devAnRRiShipurogamAn |
brAhmaNA me sahAyAshchedevamastu surarShabhAH
shlokas.116:
evamastviti vainyastu tairukto brahmavAdibhiH |
purodhAshchAbhavattasya shukro brahmamayo nidhiH
shlokas.117:
mantriNo vAlakhilyAstu sArasvatyo gaNo hyabhUt |
maharShirbhagavAngargastasya sA.nvatsaro.abhavat
shlokas.118:
AtmanAShTama ityeva shrutireShA parA nRRiShu |
utpannau bandinau chAsya tatpUrvau sUtamAgadhau
shlokas.119:
samatAM vasudhAyAshcha sa samyagupapAdayat |
vaiShamyaM hi paraM bhUmerAsIditi ha naH shrutam
shlokas.120:
sa viShNunA cha devena shakreNa vibudhaiH saha |
RRiShibhishcha prajApAlye brahmaNA chAbhiShechitaH
shlokas.121:
taM sAkShAtpRRithivI bheje ratnAnyAdAya pANDava |
sAgaraH saritAM bhartA himavA.nshchAchalottamaH
shlokas.122:
shakrashcha dhanamakShayyaM prAdAttasya yudhiShThira |
rukmaM chApi mahAmeruH svayaM kanakaparvataH
shlokas.123:
yakSharAkShasabhartA cha bhagavAnnaravAhanaH |
dharme chArthe cha kAme cha samarthaM pradadau dhanam
shlokas.124:
hayA rathAshcha nAgAshcha koTishaH puruShAstathA |
prAdurbabhUvurvainyasya chintanAdeva pANDava
na jarA na cha durbhikShaM nAdhayo vyAdhayastathA
shlokas.125:
sarIsRRipebhyaH stenebhyo na chAnyonyAtkadAchana |
bhayamutpadyate tatra tasya rAj~no.abhirakShaNAt
shlokas.126:
teneyaM pRRithivI dugdhA sasyAni dasha sapta cha |
yakSharAkShasanAgaishchApIpsitaM yasya yasya yat
shlokas.127:
tena dharmottarashchAyaM kRRito loko mahAtmanA |
ra~njitAshcha prajAH sarvAstena rAjeti shabdyate
shlokas.128:
brAhmaNAnAM kShatatrANAttataH kShatriya uchyate |
prathitA dhanatashcheyaM pRRithivI sAdhubhiH smRRitA
shlokas.129:
sthApanaM chAkarodviShNuH svayameva sanAtanaH |
nAtivartiShyate kashchidrAja.nstvAmiti pArthiva
shlokas.130:
tapasA bhagavAnviShNurAvivesha cha bhUmipam |
devavannaradevAnAM namate yajjagannRRipa
shlokas.131:
daNDanItyA cha satataM rakShitaM taM nareshvara |
nAdharShayattataH kashchichchAranityAchcha darshanAt
shlokas.132:
AtmanA karaNaishchaiva samasyeha mahIkShitaH |
ko heturyadvashe tiShThelloko daivAdRRite guNAt
shlokas.133:
viShNorlalATAtkamalaM sauvarNamabhavattadA |
shrIH sambhUtA yato devI patnI dharmasya dhImataH
shlokas.134:
shriyaH sakAshAdarthashcha jAto dharmeNa pANDava |
atha dharmastathaivArthaH shrIshcha rAjye pratiShThitA
shlokas.135:
sukRRitasya kShayAchchaiva svarlokAdetya medinIm |
pArthivo jAyate tAta daNDanItivashAnugaH
shlokas.136:
mahattvena cha sa.nyukto vaiShNavena naro bhuvi |
buddhyA bhavati sa.nyukto mAhAtmyaM chAdhigachChati
shlokas.137:
sthApanAmatha devAnAM na kashchidativartate |
tiShThatyekasya cha vashe taM chedanuvidhIyate
shlokas.138:
shubhaM hi karma rAjendra shubhatvAyopakalpate |
tulyasyaikasya yasyAyaM loko vachasi tiShThati
shlokas.139:
yo hyasya mukhamadrAkShItsomya so.asya vashAnugaH |
subhagaM chArthavantaM cha rUpavantaM cha pashyati
shlokas.140:
tato jagati rAjendra satataM shabditaM budhaiH |
devAshcha naradevAshcha tulyA iti vishAM pate
shlokas.141:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM mahattvaM prati rAjasu |
kArtsnyena bharatashreShTha kimanyadiha vartatAm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH punaH sa gA~NgeyamabhivAdya pitAmaham |
prA~njalirniyato bhUtvA paryapRRichChadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
ke dharmAH sarvavarNAnAM chAturvarNyasya ke pRRithak |
chaturNAmAshramANAM cha rAjadharmAshcha ke matAH
shlokas.3:
kena svidvardhate rAShTraM rAjA kena vivardhate |
kena paurAshcha bhRRityAshcha vardhante bharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
koshaM daNDaM cha durgaM cha sahAyAnmantriNastathA |
RRitvikpurohitAchAryAnkIdRRishAnvarjayennRRipaH
shlokas.5:
keShu vishvasitavyaM syAdrAj~nAM kasyA~nchidApadi |
kuto vAtmA dRRiDho rakShyastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
namo dharmAya mahate namaH kRRiShNAya vedhase |
brAhmaNebhyo namaskRRitvA dharmAnvakShyAmi shAshvatAn
shlokas.7:
akrodhaH satyavachanaM sa.nvibhAgaH kShamA tathA |
prajanaH sveShu dAreShu shauchamadroha eva cha
shlokas.8:
ArjavaM bhRRityabharaNaM navaite sArvavarNikAH |
brAhmaNasya tu yo dharmastaM te vakShyAmi kevalam
shlokas.9:
damameva mahArAja dharmamAhuH purAtanam |
svAdhyAyo.adhyApanaM chaiva tatra karma samApyate
shlokas.10:
taM chedvittamupAgachChedvartamAnaM svakarmaNi |
akurvANaM vikarmANi shAntaM praj~nAnatarpitam
shlokas.11:
kurvItApatyasantAnamatho dadyAdyajeta cha |
sa.nvibhajya hi bhoktavyaM dhanaM sadbhiritIShyate
shlokas.12:
pariniShThitakAryastu svAdhyAyenaiva brAhmaNaH |
kuryAdanyanna vA kuryAnmaitro brAhmaNa uchyate
shlokas.13:
kShatriyasyApi yo dharmastaM te vakShyAmi bhArata |
dadyAdrAjA na yAcheta yajeta na tu yAjayet
shlokas.14:
nAdhyApayedadhIyIta prajAshcha paripAlayet |
nityodyukto dasyuvadhe raNe kuryAtparAkramam
shlokas.15:
ye cha kratubhirIjAnAH shrutavantashcha bhUmipAH |
ya evAhavajetArasta eShAM lokajittamAH
shlokas.16:
avikShatena dehena samarAdyo nivartate |
kShatriyo nAsya tatkarma prasha.nsanti purAvidaH
shlokas.17:
vadhaM hi kShatrabandhUnAM dharmamAhuH pradhAnataH |
nAsya kRRityatamaM ki~nchidanyaddasyunibarhaNAt
shlokas.18:
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~no yogaH kShemo vidhIyate |
tasmAdrAj~nA visheSheNa yoddhavyaM dharmamIpsatA
shlokas.19:
sveShu dharmeShvavasthApya prajAH sarvA mahIpatiH |
dharmeNa sarvakRRityAni samaniShThAni kArayet
shlokas.20:
pariniShThitakAryaH syAnnRRipatiH paripAlanAt |
kuryAdanyanna vA kuryAdaindro rAjanya uchyate
shlokas.21:
vaishyasyApIha yo dharmastaM te vakShyAmi bhArata |
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~naH shauchena dhanasa~nchayaH
shlokas.22:
pitRRivatpAlayedvaishyo yuktaH sarvapashUniha |
vikarma tadbhavedanyatkarma yadyatsamAcharet
rakShayA sa hi teShAM vai mahatsukhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.23:
prajApatirhi vaishyAya sRRiShTvA paridade pashUn |
brAhmaNAya cha rAj~ne cha sarvAH paridade prajAH
shlokas.24:
tasya vRRittiM pravakShyAmi yachcha tasyopajIvanam |
ShaNNAmekAM pibeddhenuM shatAchcha mithunaM haret
shlokas.25:
laye cha saptamo bhAgastathA shRRi~Nge kalA khure |
sasyasya sarvabIjAnAmeShA sA.nvatsarI bhRRitiH
shlokas.26:
na cha vaishyasya kAmaH syAnna rakSheyaM pashUniti |
vaishye chechChati nAnyena rakShitavyAH katha~nchana
shlokas.27:
shUdrasyApi hi yo dharmastaM te vakShyAmi bhArata |
prajApatirhi varNAnAM dAsaM shUdramakalpayat
shlokas.28:
tasmAchChUdrasya varNAnAM paricharyA vidhIyate |
teShAM shushrUShaNAchchaiva mahatsukhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.29:
shUdra etAnparicharettrInvarNAnanasUyakaH |
sa~nchayA.nshcha na kurvIta jAtu shUdraH katha~nchana
shlokas.30:
pApIyAnhi dhanaM labdhvA vashe kuryAdgarIyasaH |
rAj~nA vA samanuj~nAtaH kAmaM kurvIta dhArmikaH
shlokas.31:
tasya vRRittiM pravakShyAmi yachcha tasyopajIvanam |
avashyabharaNIyo hi varNAnAM shUdra uchyate
shlokas.32:
ChatraM veShTanamaushIramupAnadvyajanAni cha |
yAtayAmAni deyAni shUdrAya parichAriNe
shlokas.33:
adhAryANi vishIrNAni vasanAni dvijAtibhiH |
shUdrAyaiva vidheyAni tasya dharmadhanaM hi tat
shlokas.34:
yashcha kashchiddvijAtInAM shUdraH shushrUShurAvrajet |
