kalpyAM tasya tu tenAhurvRRittiM dharmavido janAH
deyaH piNDo.anapetAya bhartavyau vRRiddhadurbalau
shlokas.35:
shUdreNa cha na hAtavyo bhartA kasyA~nchidApadi |
atirekeNa bhartavyo bhartA dravyaparikShaye
na hi svamasti shUdrasya bhartRRihAryadhano hyasau
shlokas.36:
uktastrayANAM varNAnAM yaj~nastrayyaiva bhArata |
svAhAkAranamaskArau mantraH shUdre vidhIyate
shlokas.37:
tAbhyAM shUdraH pAkayaj~nairyajeta vratavAnsvayam |
pUrNapAtramayImAhuH pAkayaj~nasya dakShiNAm
shlokas.38:
shUdraH paijavano nAma sahasrANAM shataM dadau |
aindrAgnena vidhAnena dakShiNAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.39:
ato hi sarvavarNAnAM shraddhAyaj~no vidhIyate |
daivataM hi mahachChraddhA pavitraM yajatAM cha yat
shlokas.40:
daivataM paramaM viprAH svena svena parasparam |
ayajanniha satraiste taistaiH kAmaiH sanAtanaiH
shlokas.41:
sa.nsRRiShTA brAhmaNaireva triShu varNeShu sRRiShTayaH |
devAnAmapi ye devA yadbrUyuste paraM hi tat
tasmAdvarNaiH sarvayaj~nAH sa.nsRRijyante na kAmyayA
shlokas.42:
RRigyajuHsAmavitpUjyo nityaM syAddevavaddvijaH |
anRRigyajurasAmA tu prAjApatya upadravaH
shlokas.43:
yaj~no manIShayA tAta sarvavarNeShu bhArata |
nAsya yaj~nahano devA Ihante netare janAH
tasmAtsarveShu varNeShu shraddhAyaj~no vidhIyate
shlokas.44:
svaM daivataM brAhmaNAH svena nityaM; parAnvarNAnayajannevamAsIt |
ArochitA naH sumahAnsa dharmaH; sRRiShTo brahmaNA triShu varNeShu dRRiShTaH
shlokas.45:
tasmAdvarNA RRijavo jAtidharmAH; sa.nsRRijyante tasya vipAka eShaH |
ekaM sAma yajurekamRRigekA; viprashchaiko.anishchayasteShu dRRiShTaH
shlokas.46:
atra gAthA yaj~nagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
vaikhAnasAnAM rAjendra munInAM yaShTumichChatAm
shlokas.47:
udite.anudite vApi shraddadhAno jitendriyaH |
vahniM juhoti dharmeNa shraddhA vai kAraNaM mahat
shlokas.48:
yatskannamasya tatpUrvaM yadaskannaM taduttaram |
bahUni yaj~narUpANi nAnAkarmaphalAni cha
shlokas.49:
tAni yaH sa.nvijAnAti j~nAnanishchayanishchitaH |
dvijAtiH shraddhayopetaH sa yaShTuM puruSho.arhati
shlokas.50:
steno vA yadi vA pApo yadi vA pApakRRittamaH |
yaShTumichChati yaj~naM yaH sAdhumeva vadanti tam
shlokas.51:
RRiShayastaM prasha.nsanti sAdhu chaitadasa.nshayam |
sarvathA sarvavarNairhi yaShTavyamiti nishchayaH
na hi yaj~nasamaM ki~nchittriShu lokeShu vidyate
shlokas.52:
tasmAdyaShTavyamityAhuH puruSheNAnasUyatA |
shraddhApavitramAshritya yathAshakti prayachChatA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AshramANAM mahAbAho shRRiNu satyaparAkrama |
chaturNAmiha varNAnAM karmANi cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
vAnaprasthaM bhaikShacharyAM gArhasthyaM cha mahAshramam |
brahmacharyAshramaM prAhushchaturthaM brAhmaNairvRRitam
shlokas.3:
jaTAkaraNasa.nskAraM dvijAtitvamavApya cha |
AdhAnAdIni karmANi prApya vedamadhItya cha
shlokas.4:
sadAro vApyadAro vA AtmavAnsa.nyatendriyaH |
vAnaprasthAshramaM gachChetkRRitakRRityo gRRihAshramAt
shlokas.5:
tatrAraNyakashAstrANi samadhItya sa dharmavit |
UrdhvaretAH prajAyitvA gachChatyakSharasAtmatAm
shlokas.6:
etAnyeva nimittAni munInAmUrdhvaretasAm |
kartavyAnIha vipreNa rAjannAdau vipashchitA
shlokas.7:
charitabrahmacharyasya brAhmaNasya vishAM pate |
bhaikShacharyAsvadhIkAraH prashasta iha mokShiNaH
shlokas.8:
yatrAstamitashAyI syAnniragniraniketanaH |
yathopalabdhajIvI syAnmunirdAnto jitendriyaH
shlokas.9:
nirAshIH syAtsarvasamo nirbhogo nirvikAravAn |
vipraH kShemAshramaM prApto gachChatyakSharasAtmatAm
shlokas.10:
adhItya vedAnkRRitasarvakRRityaH; santAnamutpAdya sukhAni bhuktvA |
samAhitaH prachareddushcharaM taM; gArhasthyadharmaM munidharmadRRiShTam
shlokas.11:
svadAratuShTa RRitukAlagAmI; niyogasevI nashaTho najihmaH |
mitAshano devaparaH kRRitaj~naH; satyo mRRidushchAnRRisha.nsaH kShamAvAn
shlokas.12:
dAnto vidheyo havyakavye.apramatto; annasya dAtA satataM dvijebhyaH |
amatsarI sarvali~NgipradAtA; vaitAnanityashcha gRRihAshramI syAt
shlokas.13:
athAtra nArAyaNagItamAhu;rmaharShayastAta mahAnubhAvAH |
mahArthamatyarthatapaHprayuktaM; taduchyamAnaM hi mayA nibodha
shlokas.14:
satyArjavaM chAtithipUjanaM cha; dharmastathArthashcha ratishcha dAre |
niShevitavyAni sukhAni loke; hyasminpare chaiva mataM mamaitat
shlokas.15:
bharaNaM putradArANAM vedAnAM pAraNaM tathA |
satAM tamAshramaM shreShThaM vadanti paramarShayaH
shlokas.16:
evaM hi yo brAhmaNo yaj~nashIlo; gArhasthyamadhyAvasate yathAvat |
gRRihasthavRRittiM pravishodhya samya;ksvarge viShuddhaM phalamApnute saH
shlokas.17:
tasya dehaparityAgAdiShTAH kAmAkShayA matAH |
AnantyAyopatiShThanti sarvatokShishiromukhAH
shlokas.18:
khAdanneko japannekaH sarpanneko yudhiShThira |
ekasminneva AchArye shushrUShurmalapa~NkavAn
shlokas.19:
brahmachArI vratI nityaM nityaM dIkShAparo vashI |
avichArya tathA vedaM kRRityaM kurvanvasetsadA
shlokas.20:
shushrUShAM satataM kurvanguroH sampraNameta cha |
ShaTkarmasvanivRRittashcha napravRRittashcha sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
na charatyadhikAreNa sevitaM dviShato na cha |
eSho.a.ashramapadastAta brahmachAriNa iShyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shivAnsukhAnmahodarkAnahi.nsrA.NllokasaMmatAn |
brUhi dharmAnsukhopAyAnmadvidhAnAM sukhAvahAn
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNasyeha chatvAra AshramA vihitAH prabho |
varNAstAnanuvartante trayo bharatasattama
shlokas.3:
uktAni karmANi bahUni rAja;nsvargyANi rAjanyaparAyaNAni |
nemAni dRRiShTAntavidhau smRRitAni; kShAtre hi sarvaM vihitaM yathAvat
shlokas.4:
kShAtrANi vaishyAni cha sevamAnaH; shaudrANi karmANi cha brAhmaNaH san |
asmi.Nlloke nindito mandachetAH; pare cha loke nirayaM prayAti
shlokas.5:
yA sa~nj~nA vihitA loke dAse shuni vRRike pashau |
vikarmaNi sthite vipre tAM sa~nj~nAM kuru pANDava
shlokas.6:
ShaTkarmasampravRRittasya AshrameShu chaturShvapi |
sarvadharmopapannasya sambhUtasya kRRitAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
brAhmaNasya vishuddhasya tapasyabhiratasya cha |
nirAshiSho vadAnyasya lokA hyakSharasa~nj~nitAH
shlokas.8:
yo yasminkurute karma yAdRRishaM yena yatra cha |
tAdRRishaM tAdRRishenaiva sa guNaM pratipadyate
shlokas.9:
vRRiddhyA kRRiShivaNiktvena jIvasa~njIvanena cha |
vettumarhasi rAjendra svAdhyAyagaNitaM mahat
shlokas.10:
kAlasa~nchoditaH kAlaH kAlaparyAyanishchitaH |
uttamAdhamamadhyAni karmANi kurute.avashaH
shlokas.11:
antavanti pradAnAni purA shreyaskarANi cha |
svakarmanirato loko hyakSharaH sarvatomukhaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jyAkarShaNaM shatrunibarhaNaM cha; kRRiShirvaNijyA pashupAlanaM cha |
shushrUShaNaM chApi tathArthaheto;rakAryametatparamaM dvijasya
shlokas.2:
sevyaM tu brahmaShaTkarma gRRihasthena manIShiNA |
kRRitakRRityasya chAraNye vAso viprasya shasyate
shlokas.3:
rAjapraiShyaM kRRiShidhanaM jIvanaM cha vaNijyayA |
kauTilyaM kaulaTeyaM cha kusIdaM cha vivarjayet
shlokas.4:
shUdro rAjanbhavati brahmabandhu;rdushchAritryo yashcha dharmAdapetaH |
vRRiShalIpatiH pishuno nartakashcha; grAmapraiShyo yashcha bhavedvikarmA
shlokas.5:
japanvedAnajapa.nshchApi rAja;nsamaH shUdrairdAsavachchApi bhojyaH |
ete sarve shUdrasamA bhavanti; rAjannetAnvarjayeddevakRRitye
shlokas.6:
nirmaryAde chAshane krUravRRittau; hi.nsAtmake tyaktadharmasvavRRitte |
havyaM kavyaM yAni chAnyAni rAja;ndeyAnyadeyAni bhavanti tasmin
shlokas.7:
tasmAddharmo vihito brAhmaNasya; damaH shauchaM chArjavaM chApi rAjan |
tathA viprasyAshramAH sarva eva; purA rAjanbrahmaNA vai nisRRiShTAH
shlokas.8:
yaH syAddAntaH somapa AryashIlaH; sAnukroshaH sarvasaho nirAshIH |
RRijurmRRiduranRRisha.nsaH kShamAvA;nsa vai vipro netaraH pApakarmA
shlokas.9:
shUdraM vaishyaM rAjaputraM cha rAja.N;llokAH sarve sa.nshritA dharmakAmAH |
tasmAdvarNA~njAtidharmeShu saktA;nmatvA viShNurnechChati pANDuputra
shlokas.10:
loke chedaM sarvalokasya na syA;chchAturvarNyaM vedavAdAshcha na syuH |
sarvAshchejyAH sarvalokakriyAshcha; sadyaH sarve chAshramasthA na vai syuH
shlokas.11:
yashcha trayANAM varNAnAmichChedAshramasevanam |
kartumAshramadRRiShTA.nshcha dharmA.nstA~nshRRiNu pANDava
shlokas.12:
shushrUShAkRRitakRRityasya kRRitasantAnakarmaNaH |
abhyanuj~nApya rAjAnaM shUdrasya jagatIpate
shlokas.13:
alpAntaragatasyApi dashadharmagatasya vA |
AshramA vihitAH sarve varjayitvA nirAshiSham
shlokas.14:
bhaikShacharyAM na tu prAhustasya taddharmachAriNaH |
tathA vaishyasya rAjendra rAjaputrasya chaiva hi
shlokas.15:
kRRitakRRityo vayotIto rAj~naH kRRitaparishramaH |
vaishyo gachChedanuj~nAto nRRipeNAshramamaNDalam
shlokas.16:
vedAnadhItya dharmeNa rAjashAstrANi chAnagha |
santAnAdIni karmANi kRRitvA somaM niShevya cha
shlokas.17:
pAlayitvA prajAH sarvA dharmeNa vadatAM vara |
rAjasUyAshvamedhAdInmakhAnanyA.nstathaiva cha
shlokas.18:
samAnIya yathApAThaM viprebhyo dattadakShiNaH |
sa~NgrAme vijayaM prApya tathAlpaM yadi vA bahu
shlokas.19:
sthApayitvA prajApAlaM putraM rAjye cha pANDava |
anyagotraM prashastaM vA kShatriyaM kShatriyarShabha
shlokas.20:
archayitvA pitR^InsamyakpitRRiyaj~nairyathAvidhi |
devAnyaj~nairRRiShInvedairarchitvA chaiva yatnataH
shlokas.21:
antakAle cha samprApte ya ichChedAshramAntaram |
AnupUrvyAshramAnrAjangatvA siddhimavApnuyAt
shlokas.22:
rAjarShitvena rAjendra bhaikShacharyAdhvasevayA |
apetagRRihadharmo.api charejjIvitakAmyayA
shlokas.23:
na chaitannaiShThikaM karma trayANAM bharatarShabha |
chaturNAM rAjashArdUla prAhurAshramavAsinAm
shlokas.24:
bahvAyattaM kShatriyairmAnavAnAM; lokashreShThaM dharmamAsevamAnaiH |
sarve dharmAH sopadharmAstrayANAM; rAj~no dharmAditi vedAchChRRiNomi
shlokas.25:
yathA rAjanhastipade padAni; sa.nlIyante sarvasattvodbhavAni |
evaM dharmAnrAjadharmeShu sarvA;nsarvAvasthaM sampralInAnnibodha
shlokas.26:
alpAshrayAnalpaphalAnvadanti; dharmAnanyAndharmavido manuShyAH |
mahAshrayaM bahukalyANarUpaM; kShAtraM dharmaM netaraM prAhurAryAH
shlokas.27:
sarve dharmA rAjadharmapradhAnAH; sarve dharmAH pAlyamAnA bhavanti |
sarvatyAgo rAjadharmeShu rAjaM;styAge chAhurdharmamagryaM purANam
shlokas.28:
majjettrayI daNDanItau hatAyAM; sarve dharmA na bhaveyurviruddhAH |
sarve dharmAshchAshramANAM gatAH syuH; kShAtre tyakte rAjadharme purANe
shlokas.29:
sarve tyAgA rAjadharmeShu dRRiShTAH; sarvA dIkShA rAjadharmeShu choktAH |
sarve yogA rAjadharmeShu choktAH; sarve lokA rAjadharmAnpraviShTAH
shlokas.30:
yathA jIvAH prakRRitau vadhyamAnA; dharmAshritAnAmupapIDanAya |
evaM dharmA rAjadharmairviyuktAH; sarvAvasthaM nAdriyante svadharmam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chAturAshramyadharmAshcha jAtidharmAshcha pANDava |
lokapAlottarAshchaiva kShAtre dharme vyavasthitAH
shlokas.2:
sarvANyetAni dharmANi kShAtre bharatasattama |
nirAshiSho jIvaloke kShAtre dharme vyavasthitAH
shlokas.3:
apratyakShaM bahudvAraM dharmamAshramavAsinAm |
prarUpayanti tadbhAvamAgamaireva shAshvatam
shlokas.4:
apare vachanaiH puNyairvAdino lokanishchayam |
anishchayaj~nA dharmANAmadRRiShTAnte pare ratAH
shlokas.5:
pratyakShasukhabhUyiShThamAtmasAkShikamachChalam |
sarvalokahitaM dharmaM kShatriyeShu pratiShThitam
shlokas.6:
dharmAshramavyavasinAM brAhmaNAnAM yudhiShThira |
yathA trayANAM varNAnAM sa~NkhyAtopashrutiH purA
rAjadharmeShvanupamA lokyA sucharitairiha
shlokas.7:
udAhRRitaM te rAjendra yathA viShNuM mahaujasam |
sarvabhUteshvaraM devaM prabhuM nArAyaNaM purA
jagmuH subahavaH shUrA rAjAno daNDanItaye
shlokas.8:
ekaikamAtmanaH karma tulayitvAshrame purA |
rAjAnaH paryupAtiShThandRRiShTAntavachane sthitAH
shlokas.9:
sAdhyA devA vasavashchAshvinau cha; rudrAshcha vishve marutAM gaNAshcha |
sRRiShTAH purA Adidevena devA; kShAtre dharme vartayante cha siddhAH
shlokas.10:
atra te vartayiShyAmi dharmamarthavinishchayam |
nirmaryAde vartamAne dAnavaikAyane kRRite
babhUva rAjA rAjendra mAndhAtA nAma vIryavAn
shlokas.11:
purA vasumatIpAlo yaj~naM chakre didRRikShayA |
anAdimadhyanidhanaM devaM nArAyaNaM prati
shlokas.12:
sa rAjA rAjashArdUla mAndhAtA parameShThinaH |
jagrAha shirasA pAdau yaj~ne viShNormahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
darshayAmAsa taM viShNU rUpamAsthAya vAsavam |
sa pArthivairvRRitaH sadbhirarchayAmAsa taM prabhum
shlokas.14:
tasya pArthivasa~Nghasya tasya chaiva mahAtmanaH |
sa.nvAdo.ayaM mahAnAsIdviShNuM prati mahAdyute
shlokas.15:
indra uvAcha||
kimiShyate dharmabhRRitAM variShTha; yaddraShTukAmo.asi tamaprameyam |
anantamAyAmitasattvavIryaM; nArAyaNaM hyAdidevaM purANam
shlokas.16:
nAsau devo vishvarUpo mayApi; shakyo draShTuM brahmaNA vApi sAkShAt |
ye.anye kAmAstava rAjanhRRidisthA; dAsyAmi tA.nstvaM hi martyeShu rAjA
shlokas.17:
satye sthito dharmaparo jitendriyaH; shUro dRRiDhaM prItirataH surANAm |
buddhyA bhaktyA chottamashraddhayA cha; tataste.ahaM dadmi varaM yatheShTam
shlokas.18:
mAndhAtovAcha||
asa.nshayaM bhagavannAdidevaM; drakShyAmyahaM shirasAhaM prasAdya |
tyaktvA bhogAndharmakAmo hyaraNya;michChe gantuM satpathaM lokajuShTam
shlokas.19:
kShAtrAddharmAdvipulAdaprameyA;llokAH prAptAH sthApitaM svaM yashashcha |
dharmo yo.asAvAdidevAtpravRRitto; lokajyeShThastaM na jAnAmi kartum
shlokas.20:
indra uvAcha||
asainiko.adharmaparashcharethAH; parAM gatiM lapsyase chApramattaH |
kShAtro dharmo hyAdidevAtpravRRittaH; pashchAdanye sheShabhUtAshcha dharmAH
shlokas.21:
sheShAH sRRiShTA hyantavanto hyanantAH; suprasthAnAH kShatradharmAvishiShTAH |
asmindharme sarvadharmAH praviShTA;stasmAddharmaM shreShThamimaM vadanti
shlokas.22:
karmaNA vai purA devA RRiShayashchAmitaujasaH |
trAtAH sarve pramathyArInkShatradharmeNa viShNunA
shlokas.23:
yadi hyasau bhagavAnnAhaniShya;dripUnsarvAnvasumAnaprameyaH |
na brAhmaNA na cha lokAdikartA; na saddharmA nAdidharmA bhaveyuH
shlokas.24:
imAmurvIM na jayedvikrameNa; devashreShTho.asau purA chedameyaH |
chAturvarNyaM chAturAshramyadharmAH; sarve na syurbrahmaNo vai vinAshAt
shlokas.25:
dRRiShTA dharmAH shatadhA shAshvatena; kShAtreNa dharmeNa punaH pravRRittAH |
yuge yuge hyAdidharmAH pravRRittA; lokajyeShThaM kShatradharmaM vadanti
shlokas.26:
AtmatyAgaH sarvabhUtAnukampA; lokaj~nAnaM mokShaNaM pAlanaM cha |
viShaNNAnAM mokShaNaM pIDitAnAM; kShAtre dharme vidyate pArthivAnAm
shlokas.27:
nirmaryAdAH kAmamanyupravRRittA; bhItA rAj~no nAdhigachChanti pApam |
shiShTAshchAnye sarvadharmopapannAH; sAdhvAchArAH sAdhu dharmaM charanti
shlokas.28:
putravatparipAlyAni li~NgadharmeNa pArthivaiH |
loke bhUtAni sarvANi vicharanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.29:
sarvadharmaparaM kShatraM lokajyeShThaM sanAtanam |
shashvadakSharaparyantamakSharaM sarvatomukham

shlokas.1:
indra uvAcha||
eva.nvIryaH sarvadharmopapannaH; kShAtraH shreShThaH sarvadharmeShu dharmaH |
pAlyo yuShmAbhirlokasiMhairudArai;rviparyaye syAdabhAvaH prajAnAm
shlokas.2:
bhuvaH sa.nskAraM rAjasa.nskArayoga;mabhaikShacharyAM pAlanaM cha prajAnAm |
vidyAdrAjA sarvabhUtAnukampAM; dehatyAgaM chAhave dharmamagryam
shlokas.3:
tyAgaM shreShThaM munayo vai vadanti; sarvashreShTho yaH sharIraM tyajeta |
nityaM tyaktaM rAjadharmeShu sarvaM; pratyakShaM te bhUmipAlAH sadaite
shlokas.4:
bahushrutyA gurushushrUShayA vA; parasya vA saMhananAdvadanti |
nityaM dharmaM kShatriyo brahmachArI; charedeko hyAshramaM dharmakAmaH
shlokas.5:
sAmAnyArthe vyavahAre pravRRitte; priyApriye varjayanneva yatnAt |
chAturvarNyasthApanAtpAlanAchcha; taistairyogairniyamairaurasaishcha
shlokas.6:
sarvodyogairAshramaM dharmamAhuH; kShAtraM jyeShThaM sarvadharmopapannam |
svaM svaM dharmaM ye na charanti varNA;stA.nstAndharmAnayathAvadvadanti
shlokas.7:
nirmaryAde nityamarthe vinaShTA;nAhustAnvai pashubhUtAnmanuShyAn |
yathA nItiM gamayatyarthalobhA;chChreyA.nstasmAdAshramaH kShatradharmaH
shlokas.8:
traividyAnAM yA gatirbrAhmaNAnAM; yashchaivokto.athAshramo brAhmaNAnAm |
etatkarma brAhmaNasyAhuragrya;manyatkurva~nshUdravachChastravadhyaH
shlokas.9:
chAturAshramyadharmAshcha vedadharmAshcha pArthiva |
brAhmaNenAnugantavyA nAnyo vidyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.10:
anyathA vartamAnasya na sA vRRittiH prakalpyate |
karmaNA vyajyate dharmo yathaiva shvA tathaiva saH
shlokas.11:
yo vikarmasthito vipro na sa sanmAnamarhati |
karmasvanupayu~njAnamavishvAsyaM hi taM viduH
shlokas.12:
ete dharmAH sarvavarNAshcha vIrai;rutkraShTavyAH kShatriyaireSha dharmaH |
tasmAjjyeShThA rAjadharmA na chAnye; vIryajyeShThA vIradharmA matA me
shlokas.13:
mAndhAtovAcha||
yavanAH kirAtA gAndhArAshchInAH shabarabarbarAH |
shakAstuShArAH kahvAshcha pahlavAshchAndhramadrakAH
shlokas.14:
oDrAH pulindA ramaThAH kAchA mlechChAshcha sarvashaH |
brahmakShatraprasUtAshcha vaishyAH shUdrAshcha mAnavAH
shlokas.15:
kathaM dharmaM chareyuste sarve viShayavAsinaH |
madvidhaishcha kathaM sthApyAH sarve te dasyujIvinaH
shlokas.16:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM bhagava.nstadbravIhi me |
tvaM bandhubhUto hyasmAkaM kShatriyANAM sureshvara
shlokas.17:
indra uvAcha||
mAtApitrorhi kartavyA shushrUShA sarvadasyubhiH |
AchAryagurushushrUShA tathaivAshramavAsinAm
shlokas.18:
bhUmipAlAnAM cha shushrUShA kartavyA sarvadasyubhiH |
vedadharmakriyAshchaiva teShAM dharmo vidhIyate
shlokas.19:
pitRRiyaj~nAstathA kUpAH prapAshcha shayanAni cha |
dAnAni cha yathAkAlaM dvijeShu dadyureva te
shlokas.20:
ahi.nsA satyamakrodho vRRittidAyAnupAlanam |
bharaNaM putradArANAM shauchamadroha eva cha
shlokas.21:
dakShiNA sarvayaj~nAnAM dAtavyA bhUtimichChatA |
pAkayaj~nA mahArhAshcha kartavyAH sarvadasyubhiH
shlokas.22:
etAnyevamprakArANi vihitAni purAnagha |
sarvalokasya karmANi kartavyAnIha pArthiva
shlokas.23:
mAndhAtovAcha||
dRRishyante mAnavA loke sarvavarNeShu dasyavaH |
li~NgAntare vartamAnA AshrameShu chaturShvapi
shlokas.24:
indra uvAcha||
vinaShTAyAM daNDanItau rAjadharme nirAkRRite |
sampramuhyanti bhUtAni rAjadaurAtmyato nRRipa
shlokas.25:
asa~NkhyAtA bhaviShyanti bhikShavo li~NginastathA |
AshramANAM vikalpAshcha nivRRitte.asminkRRite yuge
shlokas.26:
ashRRiNvAnAH purANAnAM dharmANAM pravarA gatIH |
utpathaM pratipatsyante kAmamanyusamIritAH
shlokas.27:
yadA nivartyate pApo daNDanItyA mahAtmabhiH |
tadA dharmo na chalate sadbhUtaH shAshvataH paraH
shlokas.28:
paralokaguruM chaiva rAjAnaM yo.avamanyate |
na tasya dattaM na hutaM na shrAddhaM phalati kvachit
shlokas.29:
mAnuShANAmadhipatiM devabhUtaM sanAtanam |
devAshcha bahu manyante dharmakAmaM nareshvaram
shlokas.30:
prajApatirhi bhagavAnyaH sarvamasRRijajjagat |
sa pravRRittinivRRittyarthaM dharmANAM kShatramichChati
shlokas.31:
pravRRittasya hi dharmasya buddhyA yaH smarate gatim |
sa me mAnyashcha pUjyashcha tatra kShatraM pratiShThitam
shlokas.32:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa bhagavAnmarudgaNavRRitaH prabhuH |
jagAma bhavanaM viShNurakSharaM paramaM padam
shlokas.33:
evaM pravartite dharme purA sucharite.anagha |
kaH kShatramavamanyeta chetanAvAnbahushrutaH
shlokas.34:
anyAyena pravRRittAni nivRRittAni tathaiva cha |
antarA vilayaM yAnti yathA pathi vichakShuShaH
shlokas.35:
Adau pravartite chakre tathaivAdiparAyaNe |
vartasva puruShavyAghra sa.nvijAnAmi te.anagha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutA me kathitAH pUrvaishchatvAro mAnavAshramAH |
vyAkhyAnameShAmAchakShva pRRichChato me pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
viditAH sarva eveha dharmAstava yudhiShThira |
yathA mama mahAbAho viditAH sAdhusaMmatAH
shlokas.3:
yattu li~NgAntaragataM pRRichChase mAM yudhiShThira |
dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha tannibodha narAdhipa
shlokas.4:
sarvANyetAni kaunteya vidyante manujarShabha |
sAdhvAchArapravRRittAnAM chAturAshramyakarmaNAm
shlokas.5:
akAmadveShayuktasya daNDanItyA yudhiShThira |
samekShiNashcha bhUteShu bhaikShAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.6:
vettyAdAnavisargaM yo nigrahAnugrahau tathA |
yathoktavRRittervIrasya kShemAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.7:
j~nAtisambandhimitrANi vyApannAni yudhiShThira |
samabhyuddharamANasya dIkShAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.8:
AhnikaM bhUtayaj~nA.nshcha pitRRiyaj~nA.nshcha mAnuShAn |
kurvataH pArtha vipulAnvanyAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.9:
pAlanAtsarvabhUtAnAM svarAShTraparipAlanAt |
dIkShA bahuvidhA rAj~no vanyAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.10:
vedAdhyayananityatvaM kShamAthAchAryapUjanam |
tathopAdhyAyashushrUShA brahmAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.11:
ajihmamashaThaM mArgaM sevamAnasya bhArata |
sarvadA sarvabhUteShu brahmAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.12:
vAnaprastheShu vipreShu traividyeShu cha bhArata |
prayachChato.arthAnvipulAnvanyAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.13:
sarvabhUteShvanukroshaM kurvatastasya bhArata |
AnRRisha.nsyapravRRittasya sarvAvasthaM padaM bhavet
shlokas.14:
bAlavRRiddheShu kauravya sarvAvasthaM yudhiShThira |
anukroshaM vidadhataH sarvAvasthaM padaM bhavet
shlokas.15:
balAtkRRiteShu bhUteShu paritrANaM kurUdvaha |
sharaNAgateShu kauravya kurvangArhasthyamAvaset
shlokas.16:
charAcharANAM bhUtAnAM rakShAmapi cha sarvashaH |
yathArhapUjAM cha sadA kurvangArhasthyamAvaset
shlokas.17:
jyeShThAnujyeShThapatnInAM bhrAtR^INAM putranaptRRiNAm |
nigrahAnugrahau pArtha gArhasthyamiti tattapaH
shlokas.18:
sAdhUnAmarchanIyAnAM prajAsu viditAtmanAm |
pAlanaM puruShavyAghra gRRihAshramapadaM bhavet
shlokas.19:
AshramasthAni sarvANi yastu veshmani bhArata |
AdadIteha bhojyena tadgArhasthyaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.20:
yaH sthitaH puruSho dharme dhAtrA sRRiShTe yathArthavat |
AshramANAM sa sarveShAM phalaM prApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.21:
yasminna nashyanti guNAH kaunteya puruShe sadA |
AshramasthaM tamapyAhurnarashreShThaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.22:
sthAnamAnaM vayomAnaM kulamAnaM tathaiva cha |
kurvanvasati sarveShu hyAshrameShu yudhiShThira
shlokas.23:
deshadharmA.nshcha kaunteya kuladharmA.nstathaiva cha |
pAlayanpuruShavyAghra rAjA sarvAshramI bhavet
shlokas.24:
kAle vibhUtiM bhUtAnAmupahArA.nstathaiva cha |
arhayanpuruShavyAghra sAdhUnAmAshrame vaset
shlokas.25:
dashadharmagatashchApi yo dharmaM pratyavekShate |
sarvalokasya kaunteya rAjA bhavati so.a.ashramI
shlokas.26:
ye dharmakushalA loke dharmaM kurvanti sAdhavaH |
pAlitA yasya viShaye pAdoM.ashastasya bhUpateH
shlokas.27:
dharmArAmAndharmaparAnye na rakShanti mAnavAn |
pArthivAH puruShavyAghra teShAM pApaM haranti te
shlokas.28:
ye cha rakShAsahAyAH syuH pArthivAnAM yudhiShThira |
te chaivA.nshaharAH sarve dharme parakRRite.anagha
shlokas.29:
sarvAshramapade hyAhurgArhasthyaM dIptanirNayam |
pAvanaM puruShavyAghra yaM vayaM paryupAsmahe
shlokas.30:
Atmopamastu bhUteShu yo vai bhavati mAnavaH |
nyastadaNDo jitakrodhaH sa pretya labhate sukham
shlokas.31:
dharmotthitA sattvavIryA dharmasetuvaTAkarA |
tyAgavAtAdhvagA shIghrA naustvA santArayiShyati
shlokas.32:
yadA nivRRittaH sarvasmAtkAmo yo.asya hRRidi sthitaH |
tadA bhavati sattvasthastato brahma samashnute
shlokas.33:
suprasannastu bhAvena yogena cha narAdhipa |
dharmaM puruShashArdUla prApsyase pAlane rataH
shlokas.34:
vedAdhyayanashIlAnAM viprANAM sAdhukarmaNAm |
pAlane yatnamAtiShTha sarvalokasya chAnagha
shlokas.35:
vane charati yo dharmamAshrameShu cha bhArata |
rakShayA tachChataguNaM dharmaM prApnoti pArthivaH
shlokas.36:
eSha te vividho dharmaH pANDavashreShTha kIrtitaH |
anutiShTha tvamenaM vai pUrvairdRRiShTaM sanAtanam
shlokas.37:
chAturAshramyamekAgraH chAturvarNyaM cha pANDava |
dharmaM puruShashArdUla prApsyase pAlane rataH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
chAturAshramya ukto.atra chAturvarNyastathaiva cha |
rAShTrasya yatkRRityatamaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAShTrasyaitatkRRityatamaM rAj~na evAbhiShechanam |
anindramabalaM rAShTraM dasyavo.abhibhavanti cha
shlokas.3:
arAjakeShu rAShTreShu dharmo na vyavatiShThate |
parasparaM cha khAdanti sarvathA dhigarAjakam
shlokas.4:
indramenaM pravRRiNute yadrAjAnamiti shrutiH |
yathaivendrastathA rAjA sampUjyo bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.5:
nArAjakeShu rAShTreShu vastavyamiti vaidikam |
nArAjakeShu rAShTreShu havyamagnirvahatyapi
shlokas.6:
atha chedabhivarteta rAjyArthI balavattaraH |
arAjakAni rAShTrANi hatarAjAni vA punaH
shlokas.7:
pratyudgamyAbhipUjyaH syAdetadatra sumantritam |
na hi pApAtpApataramasti ki~nchidarAjakAt
shlokas.8:
sa chetsamanupashyeta samagraM kushalaM bhavet |
balavAnhi prakupitaH kuryAnniHsheShatAmapi
shlokas.9:
bhUyA.nsaM labhate kleshaM yA gaurbhavati durduhA |
suduhA yA tu bhavati naiva tAM kleshayantyuta
shlokas.10:
yadataptaM praNamati na tatsantApayantyuta |
yachcha svayaM nataM dAru na tatsaMnAmayantyapi
shlokas.11:
etayopamayA dhIraH saMnameta balIyase |
indrAya sa praNamate namate yo balIyase
shlokas.12:
tasmAdrAjaiva kartavyaH satataM bhUtimichChatA |
na dhanArtho na dArArthasteShAM yeShAmarAjakam
shlokas.13:
prIyate hi haranpApaH paravittamarAjake |
yadAsya uddharantyanye tadA rAjAnamichChati
shlokas.14:
pApA api tadA kShemaM na labhante kadAchana |
ekasya hi dvau harato dvayoshcha bahavo.apare
shlokas.15:
adAsaH kriyate dAso hriyante cha balAtstriyaH |
etasmAtkAraNAddevAH prajApAlAnprachakrire
shlokas.16:
rAjA chenna bhavelloke pRRithivyAM daNDadhArakaH |
shUle matsyAnivApakShyandurbalAnbalavattarAH
shlokas.17:
arAjakAH prajAH pUrvaM vineshuriti naH shrutam |
parasparaM bhakShayanto matsyA iva jale kRRishAn
shlokas.18:
tAH sametya tatashchakruH samayAniti naH shrutam |
vAkkrUro daNDapuruSho yashcha syAtpAradArikaH
yashcha na svamathAdadyAttyAjyA nastAdRRishA iti
shlokas.19:
vishvAsanArthaM varNAnAM sarveShAmavisheShataH |
tAstathA samayaM kRRitvA samaye nAvatasthire
shlokas.20:
sahitAstAstadA jagmurasukhArtAH pitAmaham |
anIshvarA vinashyAmo bhagavannIshvaraM disha
shlokas.21:
yaM pUjayema sambhUya yashcha naH paripAlayet |
tAbhyo manuM vyAdidesha manurnAbhinananda tAH
shlokas.22:
manuruvAcha||
bibhemi karmaNaH krUrAdrAjyaM hi bhRRishaduShkaram |
visheShato manuShyeShu mithyAvRRittiShu nityadA
shlokas.23:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tamabruvanprajA mA bhaiH karmaNaino gamiShyati |
pashUnAmadhipa~nchAshaddhiraNyasya tathaiva cha
dhAnyasya dashamaM bhAgaM dAsyAmaH koshavardhanam
shlokas.24:
mukhyena shastrapatreNa ye manuShyAH pradhAnataH |
bhavantaM te.anuyAsyanti mahendramiva devatAH
shlokas.25:
sa tvaM jAtabalo rAjanduShpradharShaH pratApavAn |
sukhe dhAsyasi naH sarvAnkubera iva nairRRitAn
shlokas.26:
yaM cha dharmaM chariShyanti prajA rAj~nA surakShitAH |
chaturthaM tasya dharmasya tvatsa.nsthaM no bhaviShyati
shlokas.27:
tena dharmeNa mahatA sukhalabdhena bhAvitaH |
pAhyasmAnsarvato rAjandevAniva shatakratuH
shlokas.28:
vijayAyAshu niryAhi pratapanrashmimAniva |
mAnaM vidhama shatrUNAM dharmo jayatu naH sadA
shlokas.29:
sa niryayau mahAtejA balena mahatA vRRitaH |
mahAbhijanasampannastejasA prajvalanniva
shlokas.30:
tasya tAM mahimAM dRRiShTvA mahendrasyeva devatAH |
apatatrasire sarve svadharme cha dadhurmanaH
shlokas.31:
tato mahIM pariyayau parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn |
shamayansarvataH pApAnsvakarmasu cha yojayan
shlokas.32:
evaM ye bhUtimichCheyuH pRRithivyAM mAnavAH kvachit |
kuryU rAjAnamevAgre prajAnugrahakAraNAt
shlokas.33:
namasyeyushcha taM bhaktyA shiShyA iva guruM sadA |
devA iva sahasrAkShaM prajA rAjAnamantike
shlokas.34:
satkRRitaM svajaneneha paro.api bahu manyate |
svajanena tvavaj~nAtaM pare paribhavantyuta
shlokas.35:
rAj~naH paraiH paribhavaH sarveShAmasukhAvahaH |
tasmAchChatraM cha patraM cha vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.36:
bhojanAnyatha pAnAni rAj~ne dadyurgRRihANi cha |
AsanAni cha shayyAshcha sarvopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.37:
guptAtmA syAddurAdharShaH smitapUrvAbhibhAShitA |
AbhAShitashcha madhuraM pratibhASheta mAnavAn
shlokas.38:
kRRitaj~no dRRiDhabhaktiH syAtsa.nvibhAgI jitendriyaH |
IkShitaH prativIkSheta mRRidu charju cha valgu cha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimAhurdaivataM viprA rAjAnaM bharatarShabha |
manuShyANAmadhipatiM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bRRihaspatiM vasumanA yathA paprachCha bhArata
shlokas.3:
rAjA vasumanA nAma kausalyo dhImatAM varaH |
maharShiM paripaprachCha kRRitapraj~no bRRihaspatim
shlokas.4:
sarvaM vainayikaM kRRitvA vinayaj~no bRRihaspateH |
dakShiNAnantaro bhUtvA praNamya vidhipUrvakam
shlokas.5:
vidhiM paprachCha rAjyasya sarvabhUtahite rataH |
prajAnAM hitamanvichChandharmamUlaM vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
kena bhUtAni vardhante kShayaM gachChanti kena cha |
kamarchanto mahAprAj~na sukhamatyantamApnuyuH
shlokas.7:
iti pRRiShTo mahArAj~nA kausalyenAmitaujasA |
rAjasatkAramavyagraH shasha.nsAsmai bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.8:
rAjamUlo mahArAja dharmo lokasya lakShyate |
prajA rAjabhayAdeva na khAdanti parasparam
shlokas.9:
rAjA hyevAkhilaM lokaM samudIrNaM samutsukam |
prasAdayati dharmeNa prasAdya cha virAjate
shlokas.10:
yathA hyanudaye rAjanbhUtAni shashisUryayoH |
andhe tamasi majjeyurapashyantaH parasparam
shlokas.11:
yathA hyanudake matsyA nirAkrande viha~NgamAH |
vihareyuryathAkAmamabhisRRitya punaH punaH
shlokas.12:
vimathyAtikramera.nshcha viShahyApi parasparam |
abhAvamachireNaiva gachCheyurnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
evameva vinA rAj~nA vinashyeyurimAH prajAH |
andhe tamasi majjeyuragopAH pashavo yathA
shlokas.14:
hareyurbalavanto hi durbalAnAM parigrahAn |
hanyurvyAyachChamAnA.nshcha yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.15:
yAnaM vastramala~NkArAnratnAni vividhAni cha |
hareyuH sahasA pApA yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.16:
mamedamiti loke.asminna bhavetsamparigrahaH |
vishvalopaH pravarteta yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.17:
mAtaraM pitaraM vRRiddhamAchAryamatithiM gurum |
klishnIyurapi hi.nsyurvA yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.18:
patedbahuvidhaM shastraM bahudhA dharmachAriShu |
adharmaH pragRRihItaH syAdyadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.19:
vadhabandhapariklesho nityamarthavatAM bhavet |
mamatvaM cha na vindeyuryadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.20:
antashchAkAshameva syAlloko.ayaM dasyusAdbhavet |
patechcha narakaM ghoraM yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.21:
na yonipoSho varteta na kRRiShirna vaNikpathaH |
majjeddharmastrayI na syAdyadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.22:
na yaj~nAH sampravarteranvidhivatsvAptadakShiNAH |
na vivAhAH samAjA vA yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.23:
na vRRiShAH sampravarteranna mathyera.nshcha gargarAH |
ghoShAH praNAshaM gachCheyuryadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.24:
trastamudvignahRRidayaM hAhAbhUtamachetanam |
kShaNena vinashetsarvaM yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.25:
na sa.nvatsarasatrANi tiShTheyurakutobhayAH |
vidhivaddakShiNAvanti yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.26:
brAhmaNAshchaturo vedAnnAdhIyera.nstapasvinaH |
vidyAsnAtAstapaHsnAtA yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.27:
hasto hastaM sa muShNIyAdbhidyeransarvasetavaH |
bhayArtaM vidravetsarvaM yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.28:
na labheddharmasa.nshleShaM hataviprahato janaH |
kartA svechChendriyo gachChedyadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.29:
anayAH sampravarteranbhavedvai varNasa~NkaraH |
durbhikShamAvishedrAShTraM yadi rAjA na pAlayet
shlokas.30:
vivRRitya hi yathAkAmaM gRRihadvArANi sherate |
manuShyA rakShitA rAj~nA samantAdakutobhayAH
shlokas.31:
nAkruShTaM sahate kashchitkuto hastasya la~Nghanam |
yadi rAjA manuShyeShu trAtA bhavati dhArmikaH
shlokas.32:
striyashchApuruShA mArgaM sarvAla~NkArabhUShitAH |
nirbhayAH pratipadyante yadA rakShati bhUmipaH
shlokas.33:
dharmameva prapadyante na hi.nsanti parasparam |
anugRRihNanti chAnyonyaM yadA rakShati bhUmipaH
shlokas.34:
yajante cha trayo varNA mahAyaj~naiH pRRithagvidhaiH |
yuktAshchAdhIyate shAstraM yadA rakShati bhUmipaH
shlokas.35:
vArtAmUlo hyayaM lokastrayyA vai dhAryate sadA |
tatsarvaM vartate samyagyadA rakShati bhUmipaH
shlokas.36:
yadA rAjA dhuraM shreShThAmAdAya vahati prajAH |
mahatA balayogena tadA lokaH prasIdati
shlokas.37:
yasyAbhAve cha bhUtAnAmabhAvaH syAtsamantataH |
bhAve cha bhAvo nityaH syAtkastaM na pratipUjayet
shlokas.38:
tasya yo vahate bhAraM sarvalokasukhAvaham |
tiShThetpriyahite rAj~na ubhau lokau hi yo jayet
shlokas.39:
yastasya puruShaH pApaM manasApyanuchintayet |
asa.nshayamiha kliShTaH pretyApi narakaM patet
shlokas.40:
na hi jAtvavamantavyo manuShya iti bhUmipaH |
mahatI devatA hyeShA nararUpeNa tiShThati
shlokas.41:
kurute pa~ncha rUpANi kAlayuktAni yaH sadA |
bhavatyagnistathAdityo mRRityurvaishravaNo yamaH
shlokas.42:
yadA hyAsIdataH pApAndahatyugreNa tejasA |
mithyopacharito rAjA tadA bhavati pAvakaH
shlokas.43:
yadA pashyati chAreNa sarvabhUtAni bhUmipaH |
kShemaM cha kRRitvA vrajati tadA bhavati bhAskaraH
shlokas.44:
ashuchI.nshcha yadA kruddhaH kShiNoti shatasho narAn |
saputrapautrAnsAmAtyA.nstadA bhavati so.antakaH
shlokas.45:
yadA tvadhArmikAnsarvA.nstIkShNairdaNDairniyachChati |
dhArmikA.nshchAnugRRihNAti bhavatyatha yamastadA
shlokas.46:
yadA tu dhanadhArAbhistarpayatyupakAriNaH |
AchChinatti cha ratnAni vividhAnyapakAriNAm
shlokas.47:
shriyaM dadAti kasmaichitkasmAchchidapakarShati |
tadA vaishravaNo rAja.Nlloke bhavati bhUmipaH
shlokas.48:
nAsyApavAde sthAtavyaM dakSheNAkliShTakarmaNA |
dharmyamAkA~NkShatA lAbhamIshvarasyAnasUyatA
shlokas.49:
na hi rAj~naH pratIpAni kurvansukhamavApnuyAt |
putro bhrAtA vayasyo vA yadyapyAtmasamo bhavet
shlokas.50:
kuryAtkRRiShNagatiH sheShaM jvalito.anilasArathiH |
na tu rAj~nAbhipannasya sheShaM kvachana vidyate
shlokas.51:
tasya sarvANi rakShyANi dUrataH parivarjayet |
mRRityoriva jugupseta rAjasvaharaNAnnaraH
shlokas.52:
nashyedabhimRRishansadyo mRRigaH kUTamiva spRRishan |
Atmasvamiva sa.nrakShedrAjasvamiha buddhimAn
shlokas.53:
mahAntaM narakaM ghoramapratiShThamachetasaH |
patanti chirarAtrAya rAjavittApahAriNaH
shlokas.54:
rAjA bhojo virATsamrATkShatriyo bhUpatirnRRipaH |
ya evaM stUyate shabdaiH kastaM nArchitumichChati
shlokas.55:
tasmAdbubhUShurniyato jitAtmA sa.nyatendriyaH |
medhAvI smRRitimAndakShaH sa.nshrayeta mahIpatim
shlokas.56:
kRRitaj~naM prAj~namakShudraM dRRiDhabhaktiM jitendriyam |
dharmanityaM sthitaM sthityAM mantriNaM pUjayennRRipaH
shlokas.57:
dRRiDhabhaktiM kRRitapraj~naM dharmaj~naM sa.nyatendriyam |
shUramakShudrakarmANaM niShiddhajanamAshrayet
shlokas.58:
rAjA pragalbhaM puruShaM karoti; rAjA kRRishaM bRRiMhayate manuShyam |
rAjAbhipannasya kutaH sukhAni; rAjAbhyupetaM sukhinaM karoti
shlokas.59:
rAjA prajAnAM hRRidayaM garIyo; gatiH pratiShThA sukhamuttamaM cha |
yamAshritA lokamimaM paraM cha; jayanti samyakpuruShA narendram
shlokas.60:
narAdhipashchApyanushiShya medinIM; damena satyena cha sauhRRidena |
mahadbhiriShTvA kratubhirmahAyashA;striviShTape sthAnamupaiti satkRRitam
shlokas.61:
sa evamukto guruNA kausalyo rAjasattamaH |
prayatnAtkRRitavAnvIraH prajAnAM paripAlanam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pArthivena visheSheNa kiM kAryamavashiShyate |
kathaM rakShyo janapadaH kathaM rakShyAshcha shatravaH
shlokas.2:
kathaM chAraM prayu~njIta varNAnvishvAsayetkatham |
kathaM bhRRityAnkathaM dArAnkathaM putrA.nshcha bhArata
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAjavRRittaM mahArAja shRRiNuShvAvahito.akhilam |
yatkAryaM pArthivenAdau pArthivaprakRRitena vA
shlokas.4:
AtmA jeyaH sadA rAj~nA tato jeyAshcha shatravaH |
ajitAtmA narapatirvijayeta kathaM ripUn
shlokas.5:
etAvAnAtmavijayaH pa~nchavargavinigrahaH |
jitendriyo narapatirbAdhituM shaknuyAdarIn
shlokas.6:
nyaseta gulmAndurgeShu sandhau cha kurunandana |
nagaropavane chaiva purodyAneShu chaiva ha
shlokas.7:
sa.nsthAneShu cha sarveShu pureShu nagarasya cha |
madhye cha narashArdUla tathA rAjaniveshane
shlokas.8:
praNidhI.nshcha tataH kuryAjjaDAndhabadhirAkRRitIn |
pu.nsaH parIkShitAnprAj~nAnkShutpipAsAtapakShamAn
shlokas.9:
amAtyeShu cha sarveShu mitreShu trividheShu cha |
putreShu cha mahArAja praNidadhyAtsamAhitaH
shlokas.10:
pure janapade chaiva tathA sAmantarAjasu |
yathA na vidyuranyonyaM praNidheyAstathA hi te
shlokas.11:
chArA.nshcha vidyAtprahitAnpareNa bharatarShabha |
ApaNeShu vihAreShu samavAyeShu bhikShuShu
shlokas.12:
ArAmeShu tathodyAne paNDitAnAM samAgame |
vesheShu chatvare chaiva sabhAsvAvasatheShu cha
shlokas.13:
evaM vihanyAchchAreNa parachAraM vichakShaNaH |
chAreNa vihataM sarvaM hataM bhavati pANDava
shlokas.14:
yadA tu hInaM nRRipatirvidyAdAtmAnamAtmanA |
amAtyaiH saha saMmantrya kuryAtsandhiM balIyasA
shlokas.15:
aj~nAyamAno hInatve kuryAtsandhiM pareNa vai |
lipsurvA ka~nchidevArthaM tvaramANo vichakShaNaH
shlokas.16:
guNavanto mahotsAhA dharmaj~nAH sAdhavashcha ye |
sa.ndadhIta nRRipastaishcha rAShTraM dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.17:
uchChidyamAnamAtmAnaM j~nAtvA rAjA mahAmatiH |
pUrvApakAriNo hanyAllokadviShTA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.18:
yo nopakartuM shaknoti nApakartuM mahIpatiH |
ashakyarUpashchoddhartumupekShyastAdRRisho bhavet
shlokas.19:
yAtrAM yAyAdavij~nAtamanAkrandamanantaram |
vyAsaktaM cha pramattaM cha durbalaM cha vichakShaNaH
shlokas.20:
yAtrAmAj~nApayedvIraH kalyapuShTabalaH sukhI |
pUrvaM kRRitvA vidhAnaM cha yAtrAyAM nagare tathA
shlokas.21:
na cha vashyo bhavedasya nRRipo yadyapi vIryavAn |
hInashcha balavIryAbhyAM karshaya.nstaM parAvaset
shlokas.22:
rAShTraM cha pIDayettasya shastrAgniviShamUrChanaiH |
amAtyavallabhAnAM cha vivAdA.nstasya kArayet
varjanIyaM sadA yuddhaM rAjyakAmena dhImatA
shlokas.23:
upAyaistribhirAdAnamarthasyAha bRRihaspatiH |
sAntvenAnupradAnena bhedena cha narAdhipa
yamarthaM shaknuyAtprAptuM tena tuShyeddhi paNDitaH
shlokas.24:
AdadIta baliM chaiva prajAbhyaH kurunandana |
ShaDbhAgamamitapraj~nastAsAmevAbhiguptaye
shlokas.25:
dashadharmagatebhyo yadvasu bahvalpameva cha |
tannAdadIta sahasA paurANAM rakShaNAya vai
shlokas.26:
yathA putrAstathA paurA draShTavyAste na sa.nshayaH |
bhaktishchaiShAM prakartavyA vyavahAre pradarshite
shlokas.27:
sutaM cha sthApayedrAjA prAj~naM sarvArthadarshinam |
vyavahAreShu satataM tatra rAjyaM vyavasthitam
shlokas.28:
Akare lavaNe shulke tare nAgavane tathA |
nyasedamAtyAnnRRipatiH svAptAnvA puruShAnhitAn
shlokas.29:
samyagdaNDadharo nityaM rAjA dharmamavApnuyAt |
nRRipasya satataM daNDaH samyagdharme prashasyate
shlokas.30:
vedavedA~NgavitprAj~naH sutapasvI nRRipo bhavet |
dAnashIlashcha satataM yaj~nashIlashcha bhArata
shlokas.31:
ete guNAH samastAH syurnRRipasya satataM sthirAH |
kriyAlope tu nRRipateH kutaH svargaH kuto yashaH
shlokas.32:
yadA tu pIDito rAjA bhavedrAj~nA balIyasA |
tridhA tvAkrandya mitrANi vidhAnamupakalpayet
shlokas.33:
ghoShAnnyaseta mArgeShu grAmAnutthApayedapi |
praveshayechcha tAnsarvA~nshAkhAnagarakeShvapi
shlokas.34:
ye guptAshchaiva durgAshcha deshAsteShu praveshayet |
dhanino balamukhyA.nshcha sAntvayitvA punaH punaH
shlokas.35:
sasyAbhihAraM kuryAchcha svayameva narAdhipaH |
asambhave praveshasya dAhayedagninA bhRRisham
shlokas.36:
kShetrastheShu cha sasyeShu shatrorupajapennarAn |
vinAshayedvA sarvasvaM balenAtha svakena vai
shlokas.37:
nadIShu mArgeShu sadA sa~NkramAnavasAdayet |
jalaM nisrAvayetsarvamanisrAvyaM cha dUShayet
shlokas.38:
tadAtvenAyatIbhishcha vivadanbhUmyanantaram |
pratIghAtaH parasyAjau mitrakAle.apyupasthite
shlokas.39:
durgANAM chAbhito rAjA mUlachChedaM prakArayet |
sarveShAM kShudravRRikShANAM chaityavRRikShAnvivarjayet
shlokas.40:
pravRRiddhAnAM cha vRRikShANAM shAkhAH prachChedayettathA |
chaityAnAM sarvathA varjyamapi patrasya pAtanam
shlokas.41:
prakaNThIH kArayetsamyagAkAshajananIstathA |
ApUrayechcha parikhAH sthANunakrajhaShAkulAH
shlokas.42:
kaDa~NgadvArakANi syuruchChvAsArthe purasya ha |
teShAM cha dvAravadguptiH kAryA sarvAtmanA bhavet
shlokas.43:
dvAreShu cha gurUNyeva yantrANi sthApayetsadA |
AropayechChataghnIshcha svAdhInAni cha kArayet
shlokas.44:
kAShThAni chAbhihAryANi tathA kUpA.nshcha khAnayet |
sa.nshodhayettathA kUpAnkRRitAnpUrvaM payorthibhiH
shlokas.45:
tRRiNachChannAni veshmAni pa~NkenApi pralepayet |
nirharechcha tRRiNaM mAse chaitre vahnibhayAtpuraH
shlokas.46:
naktameva cha bhaktAni pAchayeta narAdhipaH |
na divAgnirjvaledgehe varjayitvAgnihotrikam
shlokas.47:
karmArAriShTashAlAsu jvaledagniH samAhitaH |
gRRihANi cha pravishyAtha vidheyaH syAddhutAshanaH
shlokas.48:
mahAdaNDashcha tasya syAdyasyAgnirvai divA bhavet |
praghoShayedathaivaM cha rakShaNArthaM purasya vai
shlokas.49:
bhikShukA.nshchAkrikA.nshchaiva kShIbonmattAnkushIlavAn |
bAhyAnkuryAnnarashreShTha doShAya syurhi te.anyathA
shlokas.50:
chatvareShu cha tIrtheShu sabhAsvAvasatheShu cha |
yathArhavarNaM praNidhiM kuryAtsarvatra pArthivaH
shlokas.51:
vishAlAnrAjamArgA.nshcha kArayeta narAdhipaH |
prapAshcha vipaNIshchaiva yathoddeshaM samAdishet
shlokas.52:
bhANDAgArAyudhAgArAndhAnyAgArA.nshcha sarvashaH |
ashvAgArAngajAgArAnbalAdhikaraNAni cha
shlokas.53:
parikhAshchaiva kauravya pratolIH sa~NkaTAni cha |
na jAtu kashchitpashyettu guhyametadyudhiShThira
shlokas.54:
atha saMnichayaM kuryAdrAjA parabalArditaH |
tailaM madhu ghRRitaM sasyamauShadhAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.55:
a~NgArakushamu~njAnAM palAshasharaparNinAm |
yavasendhanadigdhAnAM kArayeta cha sa~nchayAn
shlokas.56:
AyudhAnAM cha sarveShAM shaktyRRiShTiprAsavarmaNAm |
sa~nchayAnevamAdInAM kArayeta narAdhipaH
shlokas.57:
auShadhAni cha sarvANi mUlAni cha phalAni cha |
chaturvidhA.nshcha vaidyAnvai sa~NgRRihNIyAdvisheShataH
shlokas.58:
naTAshcha nartakAshchaiva mallA mAyAvinastathA |
shobhayeyuH puravaraM modayeyushcha sarvashaH
shlokas.59:
yataH sha~NkA bhavechchApi bhRRityato vApi mantritaH |
paurebhyo nRRipatervApi svAdhInAnkArayeta tAn
shlokas.60:
kRRite karmaNi rAjendra pUjayeddhanasa~nchayaiH |
mAnena cha yathArheNa sAntvena vividhena cha
shlokas.61:
nirvedayitvA tu paraM hatvA vA kurunandana |
gatAnRRiNyo bhavedrAjA yathA shAstreShu darshitam
shlokas.62:
rAj~nA saptaiva rakShyANi tAni chApi nibodha me |
AtmAmAtyashcha koshashcha daNDo mitrANi chaiva hi
shlokas.63:
tathA janapadashchaiva puraM cha kurunandana |
etatsaptAtmakaM rAjyaM paripAlyaM prayatnataH
shlokas.64:
ShADguNyaM cha trivargaM cha trivargamaparaM tathA |
yo vetti puruShavyAghra sa bhunakti mahImimAm
shlokas.65:
ShADguNyamiti yatproktaM tannibodha yudhiShThira |
sandhAyAsanamityeva yAtrAsandhAnameva cha
shlokas.66:
vigRRihyAsanamityeva yAtrAM samparigRRihya cha |
dvaidhIbhAvastathAnyeShAM sa.nshrayo.atha parasya cha
shlokas.67:
trivargashchApi yaH proktastamihaikamanAH shRRiNu |
kShayaH sthAnaM cha vRRiddhishcha trivargamaparaM tathA
shlokas.68:
dharmashchArthashcha kAmashcha sevitavyo.atha kAlataH |
dharmeNa hi mahIpAlashchiraM pAlayate mahIm
shlokas.69:
asminnarthe cha yau shlokau gItAva~NgirasA svayam |
yAdavIputra bhadraM te shrotumarhasi tAvapi
shlokas.70:
kRRitvA sarvANi kAryANi samyaksampAlya medinIm |
pAlayitvA tathA paurAnparatra sukhamedhate
shlokas.71:
kiM tasya tapasA rAj~naH kiM cha tasyAdhvarairapi |
apAlitAH prajA yasya sarvA dharmavinAkRRitAH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
daNDanItishcha rAjA cha samastau tAvubhAvapi |
kasya kiM kurvataH siddhyai tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mahAbhAgyaM daNDanItyAH siddhaiH shabdaiH sahetukaiH |
shRRiNu me sha.nsato rAjanyathAvadiha bhArata
shlokas.3:
daNDanItiH svadharmebhyashchAturvarNyaM niyachChati |
prayuktA svAminA samyagadharmebhyashcha yachChati
shlokas.4:
chAturvarNye svadharmasthe maryAdAnAmasa~Nkare |
daNDanItikRRite kSheme prajAnAmakutobhaye
shlokas.5:
some prayatnaM kurvanti trayo varNA yathAvidhi |
tasmAddevamanuShyANAM sukhaM viddhi samAhitam
shlokas.6:
kAlo vA kAraNaM rAj~no rAjA vA kAlakAraNam |
iti te sa.nshayo mA bhUdrAjA kAlasya kAraNam
shlokas.7:
daNDanItyA yadA rAjA samyakkArtsnyena vartate |
tadA kRRitayugaM nAma kAlaH shreShThaH pravartate
shlokas.8:
bhavetkRRitayuge dharmo nAdharmo vidyate kvachit |
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM nAdharme ramate manaH
shlokas.9:
yogakShemAH pravartante prajAnAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
vaidikAni cha karmANi bhavantyaviguNAnyuta
shlokas.10:
RRitavashcha sukhAH sarve bhavantyuta nirAmayAH |
prasIdanti narANAM cha svaravarNamanA.nsi cha
shlokas.11:
vyAdhayo na bhavantyatra nAlpAyurdRRishyate naraH |
vidhavA na bhavantyatra nRRisha.nso nAbhijAyate
shlokas.12:
akRRiShTapachyA pRRithivI bhavantyoShadhayastathA |
tvakpatraphalamUlAni vIryavanti bhavanti cha
shlokas.13:
nAdharmo vidyate tatra dharma eva tu kevalaH |
iti kArtayugAnetAnguNAnviddhi yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
daNDanItyA yadA rAjA trIna.nshAnanuvartate |
chaturthama.nshamutsRRijya tadA tretA pravartate
shlokas.15:
ashubhasya chaturthA.nshastrIna.nshAnanuvartate |
kRRiShTapachyaiva pRRithivI bhavantyoShadhayastathA
shlokas.16:
ardhaM tyaktvA yadA rAjA nItyardhamanuvartate |
tatastu dvAparaM nAma sa kAlaH sampravartate
shlokas.17:
ashubhasya tadA ardhaM dvAva.nshAvanuvartate |
kRRiShTapachyaiva pRRithivI bhavatyalpaphalA tathA
shlokas.18:
daNDanItiM parityajya yadA kArtsnyena bhUmipaH |
prajAH klishnAtyayogena pravishyati tadA kaliH
shlokas.19:
kalAvadharmo bhUyiShThaM dharmo bhavati tu kvachit |
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM svadharmAchchyavate manaH
shlokas.20:
shUdrA bhaikSheNa jIvanti brAhmaNAH paricharyayA |
yogakShemasya nAshashcha vartate varNasa~NkaraH
shlokas.21:
vaidikAni cha karmANi bhavanti viguNAnyuta |
RRitavo nasukhAH sarve bhavantyAmayinastathA
shlokas.22:
hrasanti cha manuShyANAM svaravarNamanA.nsyuta |
vyAdhayashcha bhavantyatra mriyante chAgatAyuShaH
shlokas.23:
vidhavAshcha bhavantyatra nRRisha.nsA jAyate prajA |
kvachidvarShati parjanyaH kvachitsasyaM prarohati
shlokas.24:
rasAH sarve kShayaM yAnti yadA nechChati bhUmipaH |
prajAH sa.nrakShituM samyagdaNDanItisamAhitaH
shlokas.25:
rAjA kRRitayugasraShTA tretAyA dvAparasya cha |
yugasya cha chaturthasya rAjA bhavati kAraNam
shlokas.26:
kRRitasya karaNAdrAjA svargamatyantamashnute |
tretAyAH karaNAdrAjA svargaM nAtyantamashnute
shlokas.27:
pravartanAddvAparasya yathAbhAgamupAshnute |
kaleH pravartanAdrAjA pApamatyantamashnute
shlokas.28:
tato vasati duShkarmA narake shAshvatIH samAH |
prajAnAM kalmaShe magno.akIrtiM pApaM cha vindati
shlokas.29:
daNDanItiM puraskRRitya vijAnankShatriyaH sadA |
anavAptaM cha lipseta labdhaM cha paripAlayet
shlokas.30:
lokasya sImantakarI maryAdA lokabhAvanI |
samya~NnItA daNDanItiryathA mAtA yathA pitA
shlokas.31:
yasyAM bhavanti bhUtAni tadviddhi bharatarShabha |
eSha eva paro dharmo yadrAjA daNDanItimAn
shlokas.32:
tasmAtkauravya dharmeNa prajAH pAlaya nItimAn |
eva.nvRRittaH prajA rakShansvargaM jetAsi durjayam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kena vRRittena vRRittaj~na vartamAno mahIpatiH |
sukhenArthAnsukhodarkAniha cha pretya chApnuyAt
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
iyaM guNAnAM ShaTtri.nshatShaTtri.nshadguNasa.nyutA |
yAnguNA.nstu guNopetaH kurvanguNamavApnuyAt
shlokas.3:
chareddharmAnakaTuko mu~nchetsnehaM na nAstikaH |
anRRisha.nsashcharedarthaM charetkAmamanuddhataH
shlokas.4:
priyaM brUyAdakRRipaNaH shUraH syAdavikatthanaH |
dAtA nApAtravarShI syAtpragalbhaH syAdaniShThuraH
shlokas.5:
sa.ndadhIta na chAnAryairvigRRihNIyAnna bandhubhiH |
nAnAptaiH kArayechchAraM kuryAtkAryamapIDayA
shlokas.6:
arthAnbrUyAnna chAsatsu guNAnbrUyAnna chAtmanaH |
AdadyAnna cha sAdhubhyo nAsatpuruShamAshrayet
shlokas.7:
nAparIkShya nayeddaNDaM na cha mantraM prakAshayet |
visRRijenna cha lubdhebhyo vishvasennApakAriShu
shlokas.8:
anIrShurguptadAraH syAchchokShaH syAdaghRRiNI nRRipaH |
striyaM seveta nAtyarthaM mRRiShTaM bhu~njIta nAhitam
shlokas.9:
astabdhaH pUjayenmAnyAngurUnsevedamAyayA |
archeddevAnna dambhena shriyamichChedakutsitAm
shlokas.10:
seveta praNayaM hitvA dakShaH syAnna tvakAlavit |
sAntvayenna cha bhogArthamanugRRihNanna chAkShipet
shlokas.11:
praharenna tvavij~nAya hatvA shatrUnna sheShayet |
krodhaM kuryAnna chAkasmAnmRRiduH syAnnApakAriShu
shlokas.12:
evaM charasva rAjyastho yadi shreya ihechChasi |
ato.anyathA narapatirbhayamRRichChatyanuttamam
shlokas.13:
iti sarvAnguNAnetAnyathoktAnyo.anuvartate |
anubhUyeha bhadrANi pretya svarge mahIyate
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
idaM vachaH shAntanavasya shushruvA;nyudhiShThiraH pANDavamukhyasa.nvRRitaH |
tadA vavande cha pitAmahaM nRRipo; yathoktametachcha chakAra buddhimAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM rAjA prajA rakShannAdhibandhena yujyate |
dharme cha nAparAdhnoti tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
samAsenaiva te tAta dharmAnvakShyAmi nishchitAn |
vistareNa hi dharmANAM na jAtvantamavApnuyAt
shlokas.3:
dharmaniShThA~nshrutavato vedavratasamAhitAn |
architAnvAsayethAstvaM gRRihe guNavato dvijAn
shlokas.4:
pratyutthAyopasa~NgRRihya charaNAvabhivAdya cha |
atha sarvANi kurvIthAH kAryANi sapurohitaH
shlokas.5:
dharmakAryANi nirvartya ma~NgalAni prayujya cha |
brAhmaNAnvAchayethAstvamarthasiddhijayAshiShaH
shlokas.6:
Arjavena cha sampanno dhRRityA buddhyA cha bhArata |
arthArthaM parigRRihNIyAtkAmakrodhau cha varjayet
shlokas.7:
kAmakrodhau puraskRRitya yo.arthaM rAjAnutiShThati |
na sa dharmaM na chApyarthaM parigRRihNAti bAlishaH
shlokas.8:
mA sma lubdhA.nshcha mUrkhA.nshcha kAme chArtheShu yUyujaH |
alubdhAnbuddhisampannAnsarvakarmasu yojayet
shlokas.9:
mUrkho hyadhikRRito.artheShu kAryANAmavishAradaH |
prajAH klishnAtyayogena kAmadveShasamanvitaH
shlokas.10:
baliShaShThena shulkena daNDenAthAparAdhinAm |
shAstranItena lipsethA vetanena dhanAgamam
shlokas.11:
dApayitvA karaM dharmyaM rAShTraM nityaM yathAvidhi |
asheShAnkalpayedrAjA yogakShemAnatandritaH
shlokas.12:
gopAyitAraM dAtAraM dharmanityamatandritam |
akAmadveShasa.nyuktamanurajyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.13:
mA smAdharmeNa lAbhena lipsethAstvaM dhanAgamam |
dharmArthAvadhruvau tasya yo.apashAstraparo bhavet
shlokas.14:
apashAstraparo rAjA sa~nchayAnnAdhigachChati |
asthAne chAsya tadvittaM sarvameva vinashyati
shlokas.15:
arthamUlo.apahi.nsAM cha kurute svayamAtmanaH |
karairashAstradRRiShTairhi mohAtsampIDayanprajAH
shlokas.16:
UdhashChindyAddhi yo dhenvAH kShIrArthI na labhetpayaH |
evaM rAShTramayogena pIDitaM na vivardhate
shlokas.17:
yo hi dogdhrImupAste tu sa nityaM labhate payaH |
evaM rAShTramupAyena bhu~njAno labhate phalam
shlokas.18:
atha rAShTramupAyena bhujyamAnaM surakShitam |
janayatyatulAM nityaM koshavRRiddhiM yudhiShThira
shlokas.19:
dogdhi dhAnyaM hiraNyaM cha prajA rAj~ni surakShitA |
nityaM svebhyaH parebhyashcha tRRiptA mAtA yathA payaH
shlokas.20:
mAlAkAropamo rAjanbhava mA~NgArikopamaH |
tathA yuktashchiraM rAShTraM bhoktuM shakyasi pAlayan
shlokas.21:
parachakrAbhiyAnena yadi te syAddhanakShayaH |
atha sAmnaiva lipsethA dhanamabrAhmaNeShu yat
shlokas.22:
mA sma te brAhmaNaM dRRiShTvA dhanasthaM prachalenmanaH |
antyAyAmapyavasthAyAM kimu sphItasya bhArata
shlokas.23:
dhanAni tebhyo dadyAstvaM yathAshakti yathArhataH |
sAntvayanparirakSha.nshcha svargamApsyasi durjayam
shlokas.24:
evaM dharmeNa vRRittena prajAstvaM paripAlayan |
svantaM puNyaM yashovantaM prApsyase kurunandana
shlokas.25:
dharmeNa vyavahAreNa prajAH pAlaya pANDava |
yudhiShThira tathA yukto nAdhibandhena yokShyase
shlokas.26:
eSha eva paro dharmo yadrAjA rakShate prajAH |
bhUtAnAM hi yathA dharme rakShaNaM cha parA dayA
shlokas.27:
tasmAdevaM paraM dharmaM manyante dharmakovidAH |
yadrAjA rakShaNe yukto bhUteShu kurute dayAm
shlokas.28:
yadahnA kurute pApamarakShanbhayataH prajAH |
rAjA varShasahasreNa tasyAntamadhigachChati
shlokas.29:
yadahnA kurute puNyaM prajA dharmeNa pAlayan |
dasha varShasahasrANi tasya bhu~Nkte phalaM divi
shlokas.30:
sviShTiH svadhItiH sutapA lokA~njayati yAvataH |
kShaNena tAnavApnoti prajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.31:
evaM dharmaM prayatnena kaunteya paripAlayan |
iha puNyaphalaM labdhvA nAdhibandhena yokShyase
shlokas.32:
svargaloke cha mahatIM shriyaM prApsyasi pANDava |
asambhavashcha dharmANAmIdRRishAnAmarAjasu
tasmAdrAjaiva nAnyo.asti yo mahatphalamApnuyAt
shlokas.33:
sa rAjyamRRiddhimatprApya dharmeNa paripAlayan |
indraM tarpaya somena kAmaishcha suhRRido janAn

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ya eva tu sato rakShedasatashcha nibarhayet |
sa eva rAj~nA kartavyo rAjanrAjapurohitaH
shlokas.2:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
purUravasa ailasya sa.nvAdaM mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.3:
aila uvAcha||
kutaH svidbrAhmaNo jAto varNAshchApi kutastrayaH |
kasmAchcha bhavati shreyAnetadvAyo vichakShva me
shlokas.4:
vAyuruvAcha||
brahmaNo mukhataH sRRiShTo brAhmaNo rAjasattama |
bAhubhyAM kShatriyaH sRRiShTa UrubhyAM vaishya uchyate
shlokas.5:
varNAnAM paricharyArthaM trayANAM puruSharShabha |
varNashchaturthaH pashchAttu padbhyAM shUdro vinirmitaH
shlokas.6:
brAhmaNo jAtamAtrastu pRRithivImanvajAyata |
IshvaraH sarvabhUtAnAM dharmakoshasya guptaye
shlokas.7:
tataH pRRithivyA goptAraM kShatriyaM daNDadhAriNam |
dvitIyaM varNamakarotprajAnAmanuguptaye
shlokas.8:
vaishyastu dhanadhAnyena trInvarNAnbibhRRiyAdimAn |
shUdro hyenAnparicharediti brahmAnushAsanam
shlokas.9:
aila uvAcha||
dvijasya kShatrabandhorvA kasyeyaM pRRithivI bhavet |
dharmataH saha vittena samyagvAyo prachakShva me
shlokas.10:
vAyuruvAcha||
viprasya sarvamevaitadyatki~nchijjagatIgatam |
jyeShThenAbhijaneneha taddharmakushalA viduH
shlokas.11:
svameva brAhmaNo bhu~Nkte svaM vaste svaM dadAti cha |
gururhi sarvavarNAnAM jyeShThaH shreShThashcha vai dvijaH
shlokas.12:
patyabhAve yathA strI hi devaraM kurute patim |
AnantaryAttathA kShatraM pRRithivI kurute patim
shlokas.13:
eSha te prathamaH kalpa Apadyanyo bhavedataH |
yadi svarge paraM sthAnaM dharmataH parimArgasi
shlokas.14:
yaH kashchidvijayedbhUmiM brAhmaNAya nivedayet |
shrutavRRittopapannAya dharmaj~nAya tapasvine
shlokas.15:
svadharmaparitRRiptAya yo na vittaparo bhavet |
yo rAjAnaM nayedbuddhyA sarvataH paripUrNayA
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNo hi kule jAtaH kRRitapraj~no vinItavAk |
shreyo nayati rAjAnaM bruva.nshchitrAM sarasvatIm
shlokas.17:
rAjA charati yaM dharmaM brAhmaNena nidarshitam |
shushrUShuranaha.nvAdI kShatradharmavrate sthitaH
shlokas.18:
tAvatA sa kRRitapraj~nashchiraM yashasi tiShThati |
tasya dharmasya sarvasya bhAgI rAjapurohitaH
shlokas.19:
evameva prajAH sarvA rAjAnamabhisa.nshritAH |
samyagvRRittAH svadharmasthA na kutashchidbhayAnvitAH
shlokas.20:
rAShTre charanti yaM dharmaM rAj~nA sAdhvabhirakShitAH |
chaturthaM tasya dharmasya rAjA bhAgaM sa vindati
shlokas.21:
devA manuShyAH pitaro gandharvoragarAkShasAH |
yaj~namevopajIvanti nAsti cheShTamarAjake
shlokas.22:
ito dattena jIvanti devatAH pitarastathA |
rAjanyevAsya dharmasya yogakShemaH pratiShThitaH
shlokas.23:
ChAyAyAmapsu vAyau cha sukhamuShNe.adhigachChati |
agnau vAsasi sUrye cha sukhaM shIte.adhigachChati
shlokas.24:
shabde sparshe rase rUpe gandhe cha ramate manaH |
teShu bhogeShu sarveShu nabhIto labhate sukham
shlokas.25:
abhayasyaiva yo dAtA tasyaiva sumahatphalam |
na hi prANasamaM dAnaM triShu lokeShu vidyate
shlokas.26:
indro rAjA yamo rAjA dharmo rAjA tathaiva cha |
rAjA bibharti rUpANi rAj~nA sarvamidaM dhRRitam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAj~nA purohitaH kAryo bhavedvidvAnbahushrutaH |
ubhau samIkShya dharmArthAvaprameyAvanantaram
shlokas.2:
dharmAtmA dharmavidyeShAM rAj~nAM rAjanpurohitaH |
rAjA chaivaM guNo yeShAM kushalaM teShu sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
ubhau prajA vardhayato devAnpUrvAnparAnpitR^In |
yau sameyAsthitau dharme shraddheyau sutapasvinau
shlokas.4:
parasparasya suhRRidau saMmatau samachetasau |
brahmakShatrasya saMmAnAtprajAH sukhamavApnuyuH
shlokas.5:
vimAnanAttayoreva prajA nashyeyureva ha |
brahmakShatraM hi sarveShAM dharmANAM mUlamuchyate
shlokas.6:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
ailakashyapasa.nvAdaM taM nibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
aila uvAcha||
yadA hi brahma prajahAti kShatraM; kShatraM yadA vA prajahAti brahma |
anvagbalaM katame.asminbhajante; tathAbalyaM katame.asminviyanti
shlokas.8:
kashyapa uvAcha||
vyRRiddhaM rAShTraM bhavati kShatriyasya; brahma kShatraM yatra virudhyate ha |
anvagbalaM dasyavastadbhajante;.abalyaM tathA tatra viyanti santaH
shlokas.9:
naiShAmukShA vardhate nota usrA; na gargaro mathyate no yajante |
naiShAM putrA vedamadhIyate cha; yadA brahma kShatriyAH santyajanti
shlokas.10:
naiShAmukShA vardhate jAtu gehe; nAdhIyate saprajA no yajante |
apadhvastA dasyubhUtA bhavanti; ye brAhmaNAH kShatriyAnsantyajanti
shlokas.11:
etau hi nityasa.nyuktAvitaretaradhAraNe |
kShatraM hi brahmaNo yoniryoniH kShatrasya cha dvijAH
shlokas.12:
ubhAvetau nityamabhiprapannau; samprApaturmahatIM shrIpratiShThAm |
tayoH sandhirbhidyate chetpurANa;stataH sarvaM bhavati hi sampramUDham
shlokas.13:
nAtra plavaM labhate pAragAmI; mahAgAdhe nauriva sampraNunnA |
chAturvarNyaM bhavati cha sampramUDhaM; tataH prajAH kShayasa.nsthA bhavanti
shlokas.14:
brahmavRRikSho rakShyamANo madhu hema cha varShati |
arakShyamANaH satatamashru pApaM cha varShati
shlokas.15:
abrahmachArI charaNAdapeto; yadA brahmA brahmaNi trANamichChet |
Ashcharyasho varShati tatra deva;statrAbhIkShNaM duHsahAshchAvishanti
shlokas.16:
striyaM hatvA brAhmaNaM vApi pApaH; sabhAyAM yatra labhate.anuvAdam |
rAj~naH sakAshe na bibheti chApi; tato bhayaM jAyate kShatriyasya
shlokas.17:
pApaiH pApe kriyamANe.ativelaM; tato rudro jAyate deva eShaH |
pApaiH pApAH sa~njanayanti rudraM; tataH sarvAnsAdhvasAdhUnhinasti
shlokas.18:
aila uvAcha||
kuto rudraH kIdRRisho vApi rudraH; sattvaiH sattvaM dRRishyate vadhyamAnam |
etadvidvankashyapa me prachakShva; yato rudro jAyate deva eShaH
shlokas.19:
kashyapa uvAcha||
AtmA rudro hRRidaye mAnavAnAM; svaM svaM dehaM paradehaM cha hanti |
vAtotpAtaiH sadRRishaM rudramAhu;rdAvairjImUtaiH sadRRishaM rUpamasya
shlokas.20:
aila uvAcha||
na vai vAtaM parivRRinoti kashchi;nna jImUto varShati naiva dAvaH |
tathAyukto dRRishyate mAnaveShu; kAmadveShAdbadhyate muchyate cha
shlokas.21:
kashyapa uvAcha||
yathaikagehe jAtavedAH pradIptaH; kRRitsnaM grAmaM pradahetsa tvarAvAn |
vimohanaM kurute deva eSha; tataH sarvaM spRRishyate puNyapApaiH
shlokas.22:
aila uvAcha||
yadi daNDaH spRRishate puNyabhAjaM; pApaiH pApe kriyamANe.avisheShAt |
kasya hetoH sukRRitaM nAma kuryA;dduShkRRitaM vA kasya hetorna kuryAt
shlokas.23:
kashyapa uvAcha||
asantyAgAtpApakRRitAmapApAM;stulyo daNDaH spRRishate mishrabhAvAt |
shuShkeNArdraM dahyate mishrabhAvA;nna mishraH syAtpApakRRidbhiH katha~nchit
shlokas.24:
aila uvAcha||
sAdhvasAdhUndhArayatIha bhUmiH; sAdhvasAdhU.nstApayatIha sUryaH |
sAdhvasAdhUnvAtayatIha vAyu;rApastathA sAdhvasAdhUnvahanti
shlokas.25:
kashyapa uvAcha||
evamasminvartate loka eva; nAmutraivaM vartate rAjaputra |
pretyaitayorantaravAnvisheSho; yo vai puNyaM charate yashcha pApam
shlokas.26:
puNyasya loko madhumAnghRRitArchi;rhiraNyajyotiramRRitasya nAbhiH |
tatra pretya modate brahmachArI; na tatra mRRityurna jarA nota duHkham
shlokas.27:
pApasya loko nirayo.aprakAsho; nityaM duHkhaH shokabhUyiShTha eva |
tatrAtmAnaM shochate pApakarmA; bahvIH samAH prapatannapratiShThaH
shlokas.28:
mitho bhedAdbrAhmaNakShatriyANAM; prajA duHkhaM duHsahaM chAvishanti |
evaM j~nAtvA kArya eveha vidvA;npurohito naikavidyo nRRipeNa
shlokas.29:
taM chaivAnvabhiShichyeta tathA dharmo vidhIyate |
agryo hi brAhmaNaH proktaH sarvasyaiveha dharmataH
shlokas.30:
pUrvaM hi brAhmaNAH sRRiShTA iti dharmavido viduH |
jyeShThenAbhijanenAsya prAptaM sarvaM yaduttaram
shlokas.31:
tasmAnmAnyashcha pUjyashcha brAhmaNaH prasRRitAgrabhuk |
sarvaM shreShThaM variShThaM cha nivedyaM tasya dharmataH
shlokas.32:
avashyametatkartavyaM rAj~nA balavatApi hi |
brahma vardhayati kShatraM kShatrato brahma vardhate

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yogakShemo hi rAShTrasya rAjanyAyatta uchyate |
yogakShemashcha rAj~no.api samAyattaH purohite
shlokas.2:
yatAdRRiShTaM bhayaM brahma prajAnAM shamayatyuta |
dRRiShTaM cha rAjA bAhubhyAM tadrAShTraM sukhamedhate
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
muchukundasya sa.nvAdaM rAj~no vaishravaNasya cha
shlokas.4:
muchukundo vijityemAM pRRithivIM pRRithivIpatiH |
jij~nAsamAnaH svabalamabhyayAdalakAdhipam
shlokas.5:
tato vaishravaNo rAjA rakShA.nsi samavAsRRijat |
te balAnyavamRRidnantaH prAchara.nstasya nairRRitAH
shlokas.6:
sa hanyamAne sainye sve muchukundo narAdhipaH |
garhayAmAsa vidvA.nsaM purohitamari.ndamaH
shlokas.7:
tata ugraM tapastaptvA vasiShTho brahmavittamaH |
rakShA.nsyapAvadhIttatra panthAnaM chApyavindata
shlokas.8:
tato vaishravaNo rAjA muchukundamadarshayat |
vadhyamAneShu sainyeShu vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.9:
tvatto hi balinaH pUrve rAjAnaH sapurohitAH |
na chaivaM samavarta.nste yathA tvamiha vartase
shlokas.10:
te khalvapi kRRitAstrAshcha balavantashcha bhUmipAH |
Agamya paryupAsante mAmIshaM sukhaduHkhayoH
shlokas.11:
yadyasti bAhuvIryaM te taddarshayitumarhasi |
kiM brAhmaNabalena tvamatimAtraM pravartase
shlokas.12:
muchukundastataH kruddhaH pratyuvAcha dhaneshvaram |
nyAyapUrvamasa.nrabdhamasambhrAntamidaM vachaH
shlokas.13:
brahmakShatramidaM sRRiShTamekayoni svayambhuvA |
pRRithagbalavidhAnaM cha tallokaM parirakShati
shlokas.14:
tapomantrabalaM nityaM brAhmaNeShu pratiShThitam |
astrabAhubalaM nityaM kShatriyeShu pratiShThitam
shlokas.15:
tAbhyAM sambhUya kartavyaM prajAnAM paripAlanam |
tathA cha mAM pravartantaM garhayasyalakAdhipa
shlokas.16:
tato.abravIdvaishravaNo rAjAnaM sapurohitam |
nAhaM rAjyamanirdiShTaM kasmaichidvidadhAmyuta
shlokas.17:
nAchChinde chApi nirdiShTamiti jAnIhi pArthiva |
prashAdhi pRRithivIM vIra maddattAmakhilAmimAm
shlokas.18:
muchukunda uvAcha||
nAhaM rAjyaM bhavaddattaM bhoktumichChAmi pArthiva |
bAhuvIryArjitaM rAjyamashnIyAmiti kAmaye
shlokas.19:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato vaishravaNo rAjA vismayaM paramaM yayau |
kShatradharme sthitaM dRRiShTvA muchukundamasambhramam
shlokas.20:
tato rAjA muchukundaH so.anvashAsadvasundharAm |
bAhuvIryArjitAM samyakkShatradharmamanuvrataH
shlokas.21:
evaM yo brahmavidrAjA brahmapUrvaM pravartate |
jayatyavijitAmurvIM yashashcha mahadashnute
shlokas.22:
nityodako brAhmaNaH syAnnityashastrashcha kShatriyaH |
tayorhi sarvamAyattaM yatki~nchijjagatIgatam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yayA vRRittyA mahIpAlo vivardhayati mAnavAn |
puNyA.nshcha lokA~njayati tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dAnashIlo bhavedrAjA yaj~nashIlashcha bhArata |
upavAsatapaHshIlaH prajAnAM pAlane rataH
shlokas.3:
sarvAshchaiva prajA nityaM rAjA dharmeNa pAlayet |
utthAnenApramAdena pUjayechchaiva dhArmikAn
shlokas.4:
rAj~nA hi pUjito dharmastataH sarvatra pUjyate |
yadyadAcharate rAjA tatprajAnAM hi rochate
shlokas.5:
nityamudyatadaNDashcha bhavenmRRityurivAriShu |
nihanyAtsarvato dasyUnna kAmAtkasyachitkShamet
shlokas.6:
yaM hi dharmaM charantIha prajA rAj~nA surakShitAH |
chaturthaM tasya dharmasya rAjA bhArata vindati
shlokas.7:
yadadhIte yadyajate yaddadAti yadarchati |
rAjA chaturthabhAktasya prajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.8:
yadrAShTre.akushalaM ki~nchidrAj~no.arakShayataH prajAH |
chaturthaM tasya pApasya rAjA bhArata vindati
shlokas.9:
apyAhuH sarvameveti bhUyo.ardhamiti nishchayaH |
karmaNaH pRRithivIpAla nRRisha.nso.anRRitavAgapi
tAdRRishAtkilbiShAdrAjA shRRiNu yena pramuchyate
shlokas.10:
pratyAhartumashakyaM syAddhanaM chorairhRRitaM yadi |
svakoshAttatpradeyaM syAdashaktenopajIvatA
shlokas.11:
sarvavarNaiH sadA rakShyaM brahmasvaM brAhmaNAstathA |
na stheyaM viShaye teShu yo.apakuryAddvijAtiShu
shlokas.12:
brahmasve rakShyamANe hi sarvaM bhavati rakShitam |
teShAM prasAde nirvRRitte kRRitakRRityo bhavennRRipaH
shlokas.13:
parjanyamiva bhUtAni mahAdrumamiva dvijAH |
narAstamupajIvanti nRRipaM sarvArthasAdhakam
shlokas.14:
na hi kAmAtmanA rAj~nA satataM shaThabuddhinA |
nRRisha.nsenAtilubdhena shakyAH pAlayituM prajAH
shlokas.15:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nAhaM rAjyasukhAnveShI rAjyamichChAmyapi kShaNam |
dharmArthaM rochaye rAjyaM dharmashchAtra na vidyate
shlokas.16:
tadalaM mama rAjyena yatra dharmo na vidyate |
vanameva gamiShyAmi tasmAddharmachikIrShayA
shlokas.17:
tatra medhyeShvaraNyeShu nyastadaNDo jitendriyaH |
dharmamArAdhayiShyAmi munirmUlaphalAshanaH
shlokas.18:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vedAhaM tava yA buddhirAnRRisha.nsyaguNaiva sA |
na cha shuddhAnRRisha.nsyena shakyaM mahadupAsitum
shlokas.19:
api tu tvA mRRiduM dAntamatyAryamatidhArmikam |
klIbaM dharmaghRRiNAyuktaM na loko bahu manyate
shlokas.20:
rAjadharmAnavekShasva pitRRipaitAmahochitAn |
naitadrAj~nAmatho vRRittaM yathA tvaM sthAtumichChasi
shlokas.21:
na hi vaiklavyasa.nsRRiShTamAnRRisha.nsyamihAsthitaH |
prajApAlanasambhUtaM prAptA dharmaphalaM hyasi
shlokas.22:
na hyetAmAshiShaM pANDurna cha kuntyanvayAchata |
na chaitAM prAj~natAM tAta yayA charasi medhayA
shlokas.23:
shauryaM balaM cha sattvaM cha pitA tava sadAbravIt |
mAhAtmyaM balamaudAryaM tava kuntyanvayAchata
shlokas.24:
nityaM svAhA svadhA nityamubhe mAnuShadaivate |
putreShvAshAsate nityaM pitaro daivatAni cha
shlokas.25:
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~naH prajAnAM paripAlanam |
dharmametamadharmaM vA janmanaivAbhyajAyithAH
shlokas.26:
kAle dhuri niyuktAnAM vahatAM bhAra Ahite |
sIdatAmapi kaunteya na kIrtiravasIdati
shlokas.27:
samantato viniyato vahatyaskhalito hi yaH |
nirdoShakarmavachanAtsiddhiH karmaNa eva sA
shlokas.28:
naikAntavinipAtena vichachAreha kashchana |
dharmI gRRihI vA rAjA vA brahmachAryatha vA punaH
shlokas.29:
alpaM tu sAdhubhUyiShThaM yatkarmodArameva tat |
kRRitamevAkRRitAchChreyo na pApIyo.astyakarmaNaH
shlokas.30:
yadA kulIno dharmaj~naH prApnotyaishvaryamuttamam |
yogakShemastadA rAjankushalAyaiva kalpate
shlokas.31:
dAnenAnyaM balenAnyamanyaM sUnRRitayA girA |
sarvataH parigRRihNIyAdrAjyaM prApyeha dhArmikaH
shlokas.32:
yaM hi vaidyAH kule jAtA avRRittibhayapIDitAH |
prApya tRRiptAH pratiShThanti dharmaH ko.abhyadhikastataH
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM nvataH paramaM svargyaM kA nvataH prItiruttamA |
kiM nvataH paramaishvaryaM brUhi me yadi manyase
shlokas.34:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yasminpratiShThitAH samyakkShemaM vindanti tatkShaNam |
sa svargajittamo.asmAkaM satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.35:
tvameva prItimA.nstasmAtkurUNAM kurusattama |
bhava rAjA jaya svargaM sato rakShAsato jahi
shlokas.36:
anu tvA tAta jIvantu suhRRidaH sAdhubhiH saha |
parjanyamiva bhUtAni svAdudrumamivANDajAH
shlokas.37:
dhRRiShTaM shUraM prahartAramanRRisha.nsaM jitendriyam |
vatsalaM sa.nvibhaktAramanu jIvantu tvAM janAH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
svakarmaNyapare yuktAstathaivAnye vikarmaNi |
teShAM visheShamAchakShva brAhmaNAnAM pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vidyAlakShaNasampannAH sarvatrAmnAyadarshinaH |
ete brahmasamA rAjanbrAhmaNAH parikIrtitAH
shlokas.3:
RRitvigAchAryasampannAH sveShu karmasvavasthitAH |
ete devasamA rAjanbrAhmaNAnAM bhavantyuta
shlokas.4:
RRitvikpurohito mantrI dUto.athArthAnushAsakaH |
ete kShatrasamA rAjanbrAhmaNAnAM bhavantyuta
shlokas.5:
ashvArohA gajArohA rathino.atha padAtayaH |
ete vaishyasamA rAjanbrAhmaNAnAM bhavantyuta
shlokas.6:
janmakarmavihInA ye kadaryA brahmabandhavaH |
ete shUdrasamA rAjanbrAhmaNAnAM bhavantyuta
shlokas.7:
ashrotriyAH sarva eva sarve chAnAhitAgnayaH |
tAnsarvAndhArmiko rAjA baliM viShTiM cha kArayet
shlokas.8:
AhvAyakA devalakA nakShatragrAmayAjakAH |
ete brAhmaNachaNDAlA mahApathikapa~nchamAH
shlokas.9:
etebhyo balimAdadyAddhInakosho mahIpatiH |
RRite brahmasamebhyashcha devakalpebhya eva cha
shlokas.10:
abrAhmaNAnAM vittasya svAmI rAjeti vaidikam |
brAhmaNAnAM cha ye kechidvikarmasthA bhavantyuta
shlokas.11:
vikarmasthAstu nopekShyA jAtu rAj~nA katha~nchana |
niyamyAH sa.nvibhajyAshcha dharmAnugrahakAmyayA
shlokas.12:
yasya sma viShaye rAj~naH steno bhavati vai dvijaH |
rAj~na evAparAdhaM taM manyante tadvido janAH
shlokas.13:
avRRittyA yo bhavetsteno vedavitsnAtakastathA |
rAjansa rAj~nA bhartavya iti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.14:
sa chenno parivarteta kRRitavRRittiH parantapa |
tato nirvAsanIyaH syAttasmAddeshAtsabAndhavaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
keShAM rAjA prabhavati vittasya bharatarShabha |
kayA cha vRRittyA varteta tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
abrAhmaNAnAM vittasya svAmI rAjeti vaidikam |
brAhmaNAnAM cha ye kechidvikarmasthA bhavantyuta
shlokas.3:
vikarmasthAshcha nopekShyA viprA rAj~nA katha~nchana |
iti rAj~nAM purAvRRittamabhijalpanti sAdhavaH
shlokas.4:
yasya sma viShaye rAj~naH steno bhavati vai dvijaH |
rAj~na evAparAdhaM taM manyante kilbiShaM nRRipa
shlokas.5:
abhishastamivAtmAnaM manyante tena karmaNA |
tasmAdrAjarShayaH sarve brAhmaNAnanvapAlayan
shlokas.6:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gItaM kekayarAjena hriyamANena rakShasA
shlokas.7:
kekayAnAmadhipatiM rakSho jagrAha dAruNam |
svAdhyAyenAnvitaM rAjannaraNye sa.nshitavratam
shlokas.8:
rAjovAcha||
na me steno janapade na kadaryo na madyapaH |
nAnAhitAgnirnAyajvA mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.9:
na cha me brAhmaNo.avidvAnnAvratI nApyasomapaH |
nAnAhitAgnirviShaye mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.10:
nAnAptadakShiNairyaj~nairyajante viShaye mama |
adhIte nAvratI kashchinmAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.11:
adhIyate.adhyApayanti yajante yAjayanti cha |
dadati pratigRRihNanti ShaTsu karmasvavasthitAH
shlokas.12:
pUjitAH sa.nvibhaktAshcha mRRidavaH satyavAdinaH |
brAhmaNA me svakarmasthA mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.13:
na yAchante prayachChanti satyadharmavishAradAH |
nAdhyApayantyadhIyante yajante na cha yAjakAH
shlokas.14:
brAhmaNAnparirakShanti sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH |
kShatriyA me svakarmasthA mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.15:
kRRiShigorakShavANijyamupajIvantyamAyayA |
apramattAH kriyAvantaH suvratAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.16:
sa.nvibhAgaM damaM shauchaM sauhRRidaM cha vyapAshritAH |
mama vaishyAH svakarmasthA mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.17:
trInvarNAnanutiShThanti yathAvadanasUyakAH |
mama shUdrAH svakarmasthA mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.18:
kRRipaNAnAthavRRiddhAnAM durbalAturayoShitAm |
sa.nvibhaktAsmi sarveShAM mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.19:
kuladeshAdidharmANAM prathitAnAM yathAvidhi |
avyuchChettAsmi sarveShAM mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.20:
tapasvino me viShaye pUjitAH paripAlitAH |
sa.nvibhaktAshcha satkRRitya mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.21:
nAsa.nvibhajya bhoktAsmi na vishAmi parastriyam |
svatantro jAtu na krIDe mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.22:
nAbrahmachArI bhikShAvAnbhikShurvAbrahmachArikaH |
anRRitvijaM hutaM nAsti mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.23:
nAvajAnAmyahaM vRRiddhAnna vaidyAnna tapasvinaH |
rAShTre svapati jAgarmi mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.24:
vedAdhyayanasampannastapasvI sarvadharmavit |
svAmI sarvasya rAjyasya shrImAnmama purohitaH
shlokas.25:
dAnena divyAnabhivA~nChAmi lokA;nsatyenAtho brAhmaNAnAM cha guptyA |
shushrUShayA chApi gurUnupaimi; na me bhayaM vidyate rAkShasebhyaH
shlokas.26:
na me rAShTre vidhavA brahmabandhu;rna brAhmaNaH kRRipaNo nota choraH |
na pArajAyI na cha pApakarmA; na me bhayaM vidyate rAkShasebhyaH
shlokas.27:
na me shastrairanirbhinnama~Nge dvya~Ngulamantaram |
dharmArthaM yudhyamAnasya mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.28:
gobrAhmaNe cha yaj~ne cha nityaM svastyayanaM mama |
AshAsate janA rAShTre mAmakAntaramAvishaH
shlokas.29:
rAkShasa uvAcha||
yasmAtsarvAsvavasthAsu dharmamevAnvavekShase |
tasmAtprApnuhi kaikeya gRRihAnsvasti vrajAmyaham
shlokas.30:
yeShAM gobrAhmaNA rakShyAH prajA rakShyAshcha kekaya |
na rakShobhyo bhayaM teShAM kuta eva tu mAnuShAt
shlokas.31:
yeShAM purogamA viprA yeShAM brahmabalaM balam |
priyAtithyAstathA dArAste vai svargajito narAH
shlokas.32:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tasmAddvijAtInrakSheta te hi rakShanti rakShitAH |
AshIreShAM bhavedrAj~nAM rAShTraM samyakpravardhate
shlokas.33:
tasmAdrAj~nA visheSheNa vikarmasthA dvijAtayaH |
niyamyAH sa.nvibhajyAshcha prajAnugrahakAraNAt
shlokas.34:
ya evaM vartate rAjA paurajAnapadeShviha |
anubhUyeha bhadrANi prApnotIndrasalokatAm

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vyAkhyAtA kShatradharmeNa vRRittirApatsu bhArata |
katha~nchidvaishyadharmeNa jIvedvA brAhmaNo na vA
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ashaktaH kShatradharmeNa vaishyadharmeNa vartayet |
kRRiShigorakShamAsthAya vyasane vRRittisa~NkShaye
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAni paNyAni vikrINansvargalokAnna hIyate |
brAhmaNo vaishyadharmeNa vartayanbharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
surA lavaNamityeva tilAnkesariNaH pashUn |
RRiShabhAnmadhu mA.nsaM cha kRRitAnnaM cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
sarvAsvavasthAsvetAni brAhmaNaH parivarjayet |
eteShAM vikrayAttAta brAhmaNo narakaM vrajet
shlokas.6:
ajo.agnirvaruNo meShaH sUryo.ashvaH pRRithivI virAT |
dhenuryaj~nashcha somashcha na vikreyAH katha~nchana
shlokas.7:
pakvenAmasya nimayaM na prasha.nsanti sAdhavaH |
nimayetpakvamAmena bhojanArthAya bhArata
shlokas.8:
vayaM siddhamashiShyAmo bhavAnsAdhayatAmidam |
evaM samIkShya nimayannAdharmo.asti kadAchana
shlokas.9:
atra te vartayiShyAmi yathA dharmaH purAtanaH |
vyavahArapravRRittAnAM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.10:
bhavate.ahaM dadAnIdaM bhavAnetatprayachChatu |
ruchite vartate dharmo na balAtsampravartate
shlokas.11:
ityevaM sampravartanta vyavahArAH purAtanAH |
RRiShINAmitareShAM cha sAdhu chedamasa.nshayam
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atha tAta yadA sarvAH shastramAdadate prajAH |
vyutkrAmanti svadharmebhyaH kShatrasya kShIyate balam
shlokas.13:
rAjA trAtA na loke syAtkiM tadA syAtparAyaNam |
etanme sa.nshayaM brUhi vistareNa pitAmaha
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dAnena tapasA yaj~nairadroheNa damena cha |
brAhmaNapramukhA varNAH kShemamichCheyurAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
teShAM ye vedabalinasta utthAya samantataH |
rAj~no balaM vardhayeyurmahendrasyeva devatAH
shlokas.16:
rAj~no hi kShIyamANasya brahmaivAhuH parAyaNam |
tasmAdbrahmabalenaiva samuttheyaM vijAnatA
shlokas.17:
yadA tu vijayI rAjA kShemaM rAShTre.abhisa.ndadhet |
tadA varNA yathAdharmamAvisheyuH svakarmasu
shlokas.18:
unmaryAde pravRRitte tu dasyubhiH sa~Nkare kRRite |
sarve varNA na duShyeyuH shastravanto yudhiShThira
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atha chetsarvataH kShatraM praduShyedbrAhmaNAnprati |
kastasya brAhmaNastrAtA ko dharmaH kiM parAyaNam
shlokas.20:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tapasA brahmacharyeNa shastreNa cha balena cha |
amAyayA mAyayA cha niyantavyaM tadA bhavet
shlokas.21:
kShatrasyAbhipravRRiddhasya brAhmaNeShu visheShataH |
brahmaiva saMniyantRRi syAtkShatraM hi brahmasambhavam
shlokas.22:
adbhyo.agnirbrahmataH kShatramashmano lohamutthitam |
teShAM sarvatragaM tejaH svAsu yoniShu shAmyati
shlokas.23:
yadA Chinattyayo.ashmAnamagnishchApo.abhipadyate |
kShatraM cha brAhmaNaM dveShTi tadA shAmyanti te trayaH
shlokas.24:
tasmAdbrahmaNi shAmyanti kShatriyANAM yudhiShThira |
samudIrNAnyajeyAni tejA.nsi cha balAni cha
shlokas.25:
brahmavIrye mRRidUbhUte kShatravIrye cha durbale |
duShTeShu sarvavarNeShu brAhmaNAnprati sarvashaH
shlokas.26:
ye tatra yuddhaM kurvanti tyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH |
brAhmaNAnparirakShanto dharmamAtmAnameva cha
shlokas.27:
manasvino manyumantaH puNyalokA bhavanti te |
brAhmaNArthaM hi sarveShAM shastragrahaNamiShyate
shlokas.28:
ati sviShTasvadhItAnAM lokAnati tapasvinAm |
anAshakAgnyorvishatAM shUrA yAnti parAM gatim
evamevAtmanastyAgAnnAnyaM dharmaM vidurjanAH
shlokas.29:
tebhyo namashcha bhadraM cha ye sharIrANi juhvati |
brahmadviSho niyachChantasteShAM no.astu salokatA
brahmalokajitaH svargyAnvIrA.nstAnmanurabravIt
shlokas.30:
yathAshvamedhAvabhRRithe snAtAH pUtA bhavantyuta |
duShkRRitaH sukRRitashchaiva tathA shastrahatA raNe
shlokas.31:
bhavatyadharmo dharmo hi dharmAdharmAvubhAvapi |
kAraNAddeshakAlasya deshakAlaH sa tAdRRishaH
shlokas.32:
maitrAH krUrANi kurvanto jayanti svargamuttamam |
dharmyAH pApAni kurvanto gachChanti paramAM gatim
shlokas.33:
brAhmaNastriShu kAleShu shastraM gRRihNanna duShyati |
AtmatrANe varNadoShe durgasya niyameShu cha
shlokas.34:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
abhyutthite dasyubale kShatrArthe varNasa~Nkare |
sampramUDheShu varNeShu yadyanyo.abhibhavedbalI
shlokas.35:
brAhmaNo yadi vA vaishyaH shUdro vA rAjasattama |
dasyubhyo.atha prajA rakSheddaNDaM dharmeNa dhArayan
shlokas.36:
kAryaM kuryAnna vA kuryAtsa.nvAryo vA bhavenna vA |
na sma shastraM grahItavyamanyatra kShatrabandhutaH
shlokas.37:
bhIShma uvAcha||
apAre yo bhavetpAramaplave yaH plavo bhavet |
shUdro vA yadi vApyanyaH sarvathA mAnamarhati
shlokas.38:
yamAshritya narA rAjanvartayeyuryathAsukham |
anAthAH pAlyamAnA vai dasyubhiH paripIDitAH
shlokas.39:
tameva pUjayera.nste prItyA svamiva bAndhavam |
mahaddhyabhIkShNaM kauravya kartA sanmAnamarhati
shlokas.40:
kimukShNAvahatA kRRityaM kiM dhenvA chApyadugdhayA |
vandhyayA bhAryayA ko.arthaH ko.artho rAj~nApyarakShatA
shlokas.41:
yathA dArumayo hastI yathA charmamayo mRRigaH |
yathA hyanetraH shakaTaH pathi kShetraM yathoSharam
shlokas.42:
evaM brahmAnadhIyAnaM rAjA yashcha na rakShitA |
na varShati cha yo meghaH sarva ete nirarthakAH
shlokas.43:
nityaM yastu sato rakShedasatashcha nibarhayet |
sa eva rAjA kartavyastena sarvamidaM dhRRitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kvasamutthAH katha.nshIlA RRitvijaH syuH pitAmaha |
katha.nvidhAshcha rAjendra tadbrUhi vadatAM vara
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
pratikarma purAchAra RRitvijAM sma vidhIyate |
Adau ChandA.nsi vij~nAya dvijAnAM shrutameva cha
shlokas.3:
ye tvekaratayo nityaM dhIrA nApriyavAdinaH |
parasparasya suhRRidaH saMmatAH samadarshinaH
shlokas.4:
yeShvAnRRisha.nsyaM satyaM chApyahi.nsA tapa Arjavam |
adroho nAbhimAnashcha hrIstitikShA damaH shamaH
shlokas.5:
hrImAnsatyadhRRitirdAnto bhUtAnAmavihi.nsakaH |
akAmadveShasa.nyuktastribhiH shuklaiH samanvitaH
shlokas.6:
ahi.nsako j~nAnatRRiptaH sa brahmAsanamarhati |
ete mahartvijastAta sarve mAnyA yathAtatham
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM vedavachanaM dakShiNAsu vidhIyate |
idaM deyamidaM deyaM na kvachidvyavatiShThate
shlokas.8:
nedaM prati dhanaM shAstramApaddharmamashAstrataH |
Aj~nA shAstrasya ghoreyaM na shaktiM samavekShate
shlokas.9:
shraddhAmArabhya yaShTavyamityeShA vaidikI shrutiH |
mithyopetasya yaj~nasya kimu shraddhA kariShyati
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na vedAnAM paribhavAnna shAThyena na mAyayA |
kashchinmahadavApnoti mA te bhUdbuddhirIdRRishI
shlokas.11:
yaj~nA~NgaM dakShiNAstAta vedAnAM paribRRiMhaNam |
na mantrA dakShiNAhInAstArayanti katha~nchana
shlokas.12:
shaktistu pUrNapAtreNa saMmitAnavamA bhavet |
avashyaM tAta yaShTavyaM tribhirvarNairyathAvidhi
shlokas.13:
somo rAjA brAhmaNAnAmityeShA vaidikI shrutiH |
taM cha vikretumichChanti na vRRithA vRRittiriShyate
tena krItena dharmeNa tato yaj~naH pratAyate
shlokas.14:
ityevaM dharmataH khyAtamRRiShibhirdharmavAdibhiH |
pumAnyaj~nashcha somashcha nyAyavRRitto yathA bhavet
anyAyavRRittaH puruSho na parasya na chAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
sharIraM yaj~napAtrANi ityeShA shrUyate shrutiH |
tAni samyakpraNItAni brAhmaNAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.16:
tapo yaj~nAdapi shreShThamityeShA paramA shrutiH |
tatte tapaH pravakShyAmi vidva.nstadapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.17:
ahi.nsA satyavachanamAnRRisha.nsyaM damo ghRRiNA |
etattapo vidurdhIrA na sharIrasya shoShaNam
shlokas.18:
aprAmANyaM cha vedAnAM shAstrANAM chAtila~Nghanam |
avyavasthA cha sarvatra tadvai nAshanamAtmanaH
shlokas.19:
nibodha dashahotR^INAM vidhAnaM pArtha yAdRRisham |
chittiH srukchittamAjyaM cha pavitraM j~nAnamuttamam
shlokas.20:
sarvaM jihmaM mRRityupadamArjavaM brahmaNaH padam |
etAvA~nj~nAnaviShayaH kiM pralApaH kariShyati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadapyalpataraM karma tadapyekena duShkaram |
puruSheNAsahAyena kimu rAjyaM pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
ki.nshIlaH ki.nsamAchAro rAj~no.arthasachivo bhavet |
kIdRRishe vishvasedrAjA kIdRRishe nApi vishvaset
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chaturvidhAni mitrANi rAj~nAM rAjanbhavantyuta |
sahArtho bhajamAnashcha sahajaH kRRitrimastathA
shlokas.4:
dharmAtmA pa~nchamaM mitraM sa tu naikasya na dvayoH |
yato dharmastato vA syAnmadhyastho vA tato bhavet
shlokas.5:
yastasyArtho na rocheta na taM tasya prakAshayet |
dharmAdharmeNa rAjAnashcharanti vijigIShavaH
shlokas.6:
chaturNAM madhyamau shreShThau nityaM sha~Nkyau tathAparau |
sarve nityaM sha~NkitavyAH pratyakShaM kAryamAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
na hi rAj~nA pramAdo vai kartavyo mitrarakShaNe |
pramAdinaM hi rAjAnaM lokAH paribhavantyuta
shlokas.8:
asAdhuH sAdhutAmeti sAdhurbhavati dAruNaH |
arishcha mitraM bhavati mitraM chApi praduShyati
shlokas.9:
anityachittaH puruShastasminko jAtu vishvaset |
tasmAtpradhAnaM yatkAryaM pratyakShaM tatsamAcharet
shlokas.10:
ekAntena hi vishvAsaH kRRitsno dharmArthanAshakaH |
avishvAsashcha sarvatra mRRityunA na vishiShyate
shlokas.11:
akAlamRRityurvishvAso vishvasanhi vipadyate |
yasminkaroti vishvAsamichChatastasya jIvati
shlokas.12:
tasmAdvishvasitavyaM cha sha~NkitavyaM cha keShuchit |
eShA nItigatistAta lakShmIshchaiva sanAtanI
shlokas.13:
yaM manyeta mamAbhAvAdimamarthAgamaH spRRishet |
nityaM tasmAchCha~NkitavyamamitraM taM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.14:
yasya kShetrAdapyudakaM kShetramanyasya gachChati |
na tatrAnichChatastasya bhidyeransarvasetavaH
shlokas.15:
tathaivAtyudakAdbhItastasya bhedanamichChati |
yameva.nlakShaNaM vidyAttamamitraM vinirdishet
shlokas.16:
yaH samRRiddhyA na tuShyeta kShaye dInataro bhavet |
etaduttamamitrasya nimittamabhichakShate
shlokas.17:
yaM manyeta mamAbhAvAdasyAbhAvo bhavediti |
tasminkurvIta vishvAsaM yathA pitari vai tathA
shlokas.18:
taM shaktyA vardhamAnashcha sarvataH paribRRiMhayet |
nityaM kShatAdvArayati yo dharmeShvapi karmasu
shlokas.19:
kShatAdbhItaM vijAnIyAduttamaM mitralakShaNam |
ye tasya kShatamichChanti te tasya ripavaH smRRitAH
shlokas.20:
vyasanAnnityabhIto.asau samRRiddhyAmeva tRRipyate |
yatsyAdeva.nvidhaM mitraM tadAtmasamamuchyate
shlokas.21:
rUpavarNasvaropetastitikShuranasUyakaH |
kulInaH shIlasampannaH sa te syAtpratyanantaraH
shlokas.22:
medhAvI smRRitimAndakShaH prakRRityA chAnRRisha.nsavAn |
yo mAnito.amAnito vA na sa.ndUShyetkadAchana
shlokas.23:
RRitvigvA yadi vAchAryaH sakhA vAtyantasa.nstutaH |
gRRihe vasedamAtyaste yaH syAtparamapUjitaH
shlokas.24:
sa te vidyAtparaM mantraM prakRRitiM chArthadharmayoH |
vishvAsaste bhavettatra yathA pitari vai tathA
shlokas.25:
naiva dvau na trayaH kAryA na mRRiShyeranparasparam |
ekArthAdeva bhUtAnAM bhedo bhavati sarvadA
shlokas.26:
kIrtipradhAno yashcha syAdyashcha syAtsamaye sthitaH |
samarthAnyashcha na dveShTi samarthAnkurute cha yaH
shlokas.27:
yo na kAmAdbhayAllobhAtkrodhAdvA dharmamutsRRijet |
dakShaH paryAptavachanaH sa te syAtpratyanantaraH
shlokas.28:
shUrashchAryashcha vidvA.nshcha pratipattivishAradaH |
kulInaH shIlasampannastitikShuranasUyakaH
shlokas.29:
ete hyamAtyAH kartavyAH sarvakarmasvavasthitAH |
pUjitAH sa.nvibhaktAshcha susahAyAH svanuShThitAH
shlokas.30:
kRRitsnamete vinikShiptAH pratirUpeShu karmasu |
yuktA mahatsu kAryeShu shreyA.nsyutpAdayanti cha
shlokas.31:
ete karmANi kurvanti spardhamAnA mithaH sadA |
anutiShThanti chaivArthAnAchakShANAH parasparam
shlokas.32:
j~nAtibhyashchaiva bibhyethA mRRityoriva yataH sadA |
uparAjeva rAjardhiM j~nAtirna sahate sadA
shlokas.33:
