RRijormRRidorvadAnyasya hrImataH satyavAdinaH |
nAnyo j~nAtermahAbAho vinAshamabhinandati
shlokas.34:
aj~nAtitA nAtisukhA nAvaj~neyAstvataH param |
aj~nAtimantaM puruShaM pare paribhavantyuta
shlokas.35:
nikRRitasya narairanyairj~nAtireva parAyaNam |
nAnyairnikAraM sahate j~nAterj~nAtiH kadAchana
shlokas.36:
AtmAnameva jAnAti nikRRitaM bAndhavairapi |
teShu santi guNAshchaiva nairguNyaM teShu lakShyate
shlokas.37:
nAj~nAtiranugRRihNAti nAj~nAtirdigdhamasyati |
ubhayaM j~nAtilokeShu dRRishyate sAdhvasAdhu cha
shlokas.38:
tAnmAnayetpUjayechcha nityaM vAchA cha karmaNA |
kuryAchcha priyametebhyo nApriyaM ki~nchidAcharet
shlokas.39:
vishvastavadavishvastasteShu varteta sarvadA |
na hi doSho guNo veti nispRRiktasteShu dRRishyate
shlokas.40:
tasyaivaM vartamAnasya puruShasyApramAdinaH |
amitrAH samprasIdanti tathA mitrIbhavantyapi
shlokas.41:
ya evaM vartate nityaM j~nAtisambandhimaNDale |
mitreShvamitreShvaishvarye chiraM yashasi tiShThati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evamagrAhyake tasmi~nj~nAtisambandhimaNDale |
mitreShvamitreShvapi cha kathaM bhAvo vibhAvyate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vAsudevasya sa.nvAdaM surarShernAradasya cha
shlokas.3:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
nAsuhRRitparamaM mantraM nAradArhati veditum |
apaNDito vApi suhRRitpaNDito vApi nAtmavAn
shlokas.4:
sa te sauhRRidamAsthAya ki~nchidvakShyAmi nArada |
kRRitsnAM cha buddhiM samprekShya sampRRichChe tridiva~Ngama
shlokas.5:
dAsyamaishvaryavAdena j~nAtInAM vai karomyaham |
ardhabhoktAsmi bhogAnAM vAgduruktAni cha kShame
shlokas.6:
araNImagnikAmo vA mathnAti hRRidayaM mama |
vAchA duruktaM devarShe tanme dahati nityadA
shlokas.7:
balaM sa~NkarShaNe nityaM saukumAryaM punargade |
rUpeNa mattaH pradyumnaH so.asahAyo.asmi nArada
shlokas.8:
anye hi sumahAbhAgA balavanto durAsadAH |
nityotthAnena sampannA nAradAndhakavRRiShNayaH
shlokas.9:
yasya na syurna vai sa syAdyasya syuH kRRichChrameva tat |
dvAbhyAM nivArito nityaM vRRiNomyekataraM na cha
shlokas.10:
syAtAM yasyAhukAkrUrau kiM nu duHkhataraM tataH |
yasya vApi na tau syAtAM kiM nu duHkhataraM tataH
shlokas.11:
so.ahaM kitavamAteva dvayorapi mahAmune |
ekasya jayamAsha.nse dvitIyasyAparAjayam
shlokas.12:
mamaivaM klishyamAnasya nAradobhayataH sadA |
vaktumarhasi yachChreyo j~nAtInAmAtmanastathA
shlokas.13:
nArada uvAcha||
Apado dvividhAH kRRiShNa bAhyAshchAbhyantarAshcha ha |
prAdurbhavanti vArShNeya svakRRitA yadi vAnyataH
shlokas.14:
seyamAbhyantarA tubhyamApatkRRichChrA svakarmajA |
akrUrabhojaprabhavAH sarve hyete tadanvayAH
shlokas.15:
arthahetorhi kAmAdvAdvArA bIbhatsayApi vA |
AtmanA prAptamaishvaryamanyatra pratipAditam
shlokas.16:
kRRitamUlamidAnIM tajjAtashabdaM sahAyavat |
na shakyaM punarAdAtuM vAntamannamiva tvayA
shlokas.17:
babhrUgrasenayo rAjyaM nAptuM shakyaM katha~nchana |
j~nAtibhedabhayAtkRRiShNa tvayA chApi visheShataH
shlokas.18:
tachchetsidhyetprayatnena kRRitvA karma suduShkaram |
mahAkShayavyayaM vA syAdvinAsho vA punarbhavet
shlokas.19:
anAyasena shastreNa mRRidunA hRRidayachChidA |
jihvAmuddhara sarveShAM parimRRijyAnumRRijya cha
shlokas.20:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
anAyasaM mune shastraM mRRidu vidyAmahaM katham |
yenaiShAmuddhare jihvAM parimRRijyAnumRRijya cha
shlokas.21:
nArada uvAcha||
shaktyAnnadAnaM satataM titikShA dama Arjavam |
yathArhapratipUjA cha shastrametadanAyasam
shlokas.22:
j~nAtInAM vaktukAmAnAM kaTUni cha laghUni cha |
girA tvaM hRRidayaM vAchaM shamayasva manA.nsi cha
shlokas.23:
nAmahApuruShaH kashchinnAnAtmA nAsahAyavAn |
mahatIM dhuramAdatte tAmudyamyorasA vaha
shlokas.24:
sarva eva guruM bhAramanaDvAnvahate same |
durge pratIkaH sugavo bhAraM vahati durvaham
shlokas.25:
bhedAdvinAshaH sa~NghAnAM sa~Nghamukhyo.asi keshava |
yathA tvAM prApya notsIdedayaM sa~NghastathA kuru
shlokas.26:
nAnyatra buddhikShAntibhyAM nAnyatrendriyanigrahAt |
nAnyatra dhanasantyAgAdgaNaH prAj~ne.avatiShThate
shlokas.27:
dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM svapakShodbhAvanaM shubham |
j~nAtInAmavinAshaH syAdyathA kRRiShNa tathA kuru
shlokas.28:
AyatyAM cha tadAtve cha na te.astyaviditaM prabho |
ShADguNyasya vidhAnena yAtrAyAnavidhau tathA
shlokas.29:
mAdhavAH kukurA bhojAH sarve chAndhakavRRiShNayaH |
tvayyAsaktA mahAbAho lokA lokeshvarAshcha ye
shlokas.30:
upAsate hi tvadbuddhimRRiShayashchApi mAdhava |
tvaM guruH sarvabhUtAnAM jAnIShe tvaM gatAgatam
tvAmAsAdya yadushreShThamedhante j~nAtinaH sukham

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
eShA prathamato vRRittirdvitIyAM shRRiNu bhArata |
yaH kashchijjanayedarthaM rAj~nA rakShyaH sa mAnavaH
shlokas.2:
hriyamANamamAtyena bhRRito vA yadi vAbhRRitaH |
yo rAjakoshaM nashyantamAchakShIta yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
shrotavyaM tasya cha raho rakShyashchAmAtyato bhavet |
amAtyA hyupahantAraM bhUyiShThaM ghnanti bhArata
shlokas.4:
rAjakoshasya goptAraM rAjakoshavilopakAH |
sametya sarve bAdhante sa vinashyatyarakShitaH
shlokas.5:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIyaH kausalyaM yaduvAcha ha
shlokas.6:
kosalAnAmAdhipatyaM samprApte kShemadarshini |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIya AjagAmeti naH shrutam
shlokas.7:
sa kAkaM pa~njare baddhvA viShayaM kShemadarshinaH |
pUrvaM paryacharadyuktaH pravRRittyarthI punaH punaH
shlokas.8:
adhIye vAyasIM vidyAM sha.nsanti mama vAyasAH |
anAgatamatItaM cha yachcha samprati vartate
shlokas.9:
iti rAShTre paripatanbahushaH puruShaiH saha |
sarveShAM rAjayuktAnAM duShkRRitaM paripRRiShTavAn
shlokas.10:
sa buddhvA tasya rAShTrasya vyavasAyaM hi sarvashaH |
rAjayuktApachArA.nshcha sarvAnbuddhvA tatastataH
shlokas.11:
tameva kAkamAdAya rAjAnaM draShTumAgamat |
sarvaj~no.asmIti vachanaM bruvANaH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.12:
sa sma kausalyamAgamya rAjAmAtyamala~NkRRitam |
prAha kAkasya vachanAdamutredaM tvayA kRRitam
shlokas.13:
asau chAsau cha jAnIte rAjakoshastvayA hRRitaH |
evamAkhyAti kAko.ayaM tachChIghramanugamyatAm
shlokas.14:
tathAnyAnapi sa prAha rAjakoshaharAnsadA |
na chAsya vachanaM ki~nchidakRRitaM shrUyate kvachit
shlokas.15:
tena viprakRRitAH sarve rAjayuktAH kurUdvaha |
tamatikramya suptasya nishi kAkamapothayan
shlokas.16:
vAyasaM tu vinirbhinnaM dRRiShTvA bANena pa~njare |
pUrvAhNe brAhmaNo vAkyaM kShemadarshinamabravIt
shlokas.17:
rAja.nstvAmabhayaM yAche prabhuM prANadhaneshvaram |
anuj~nAtastvayA brUyAM vachanaM tvatpuro hitam
shlokas.18:
mitrArthamabhisantapto bhaktyA sarvAtmanA gataH |
ayaM tavArthaM harate yo brUyAdakShamAnvitaH
shlokas.19:
sambubodhayiShurmitraM sadashvamiva sArathiH |
atimanyuprasakto hi prasajya hitakAraNam
shlokas.20:
tathAvidhasya suhRRidaH kShantavyaM sa.nvijAnatA |
aishvaryamichChatA nityaM puruSheNa bubhUShatA
shlokas.21:
taM rAjA pratyuvAchedaM yanmA ki~nchidbhavAnvadet |
kasmAdahaM na kShameyamAkA~NkShannAtmano hitam
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNa pratijAnIhi prabrUhi yadi chechChasi |
kariShyAmi hi te vAkyaM yadyanmAM vipra vakShyasi
shlokas.23:
muniruvAcha||
j~nAtvA nayAnapAyA.nshcha bhRRityataste bhayAni cha |
bhaktyA vRRittiM samAkhyAtuM bhavato.antikamAgamam
shlokas.24:
prAgevoktashcha doSho.ayamAchAryairnRRipasevinAm |
agatIkagatirhyeShA yA rAj~nA saha jIvikA
shlokas.25:
AshIviShaishcha tasyAhuH sa~NgataM yasya rAjabhiH |
bahumitrAshcha rAjAno bahvamitrAstathaiva cha
shlokas.26:
tebhyaH sarvebhya evAhurbhayaM rAjopasevinAm |
athaiShAmekato rAjanmuhUrtAdeva bhIrbhavet
shlokas.27:
naikAntenApramAdo hi kartuM shakyo mahIpatau |
na tu pramAdaH kartavyaH katha~nchidbhUtimichChatA
shlokas.28:
pramAdAddhi skhaledrAjA skhalite nAsti jIvitam |
agniM dIptamivAsIdedrAjAnamupashikShitaH
shlokas.29:
AshIviShamiva kruddhaM prabhuM prANadhaneshvaram |
yatnenopacharennityaM nAhamasmIti mAnavaH
shlokas.30:
durvyAhRRitAchCha~NkamAno duShkRRitAdduradhiShThitAt |
durAsitAddurvrajitAdi~NgitAda~NgacheShTitAt
shlokas.31:
devateva hi sarvArthAnkuryAdrAjA prasAditaH |
vaishvAnara iva kruddhaH samUlamapi nirdahet
iti rAjanmayaH prAha vartate cha tathaiva tat
shlokas.32:
atha bhUyA.nsamevArthaM kariShyAmi punaH punaH |
dadAtyasmadvidho.amAtyo buddhisAhAyyamApadi
shlokas.33:
vAyasashchaiva me rAjannantakAyAbhisaMhitaH |
na cha me.atra bhavAngarhyo na cha yeShAM bhavAnpriyaH
hitAhitA.nstu budhyethA mA parokShamatirbhava
shlokas.34:
ye tvAdAnaparA eva vasanti bhavato gRRihe |
abhUtikAmA bhUtAnAM tAdRRishairme.abhisaMhitam
shlokas.35:
ye vA bhavadvinAshena rAjyamichChantyanantaram |
antarairabhisandhAya rAjansidhyanti nAnyathA
shlokas.36:
teShAmahaM bhayAdrAjangamiShyAmyanyamAshramam |
tairhi me sandhito bANaH kAke nipatitaH prabho
shlokas.37:
ChadmanA mama kAkashcha gamito yamasAdanam |
dRRiShTaM hyetanmayA rAja.nstapodIrgheNa chakShuShA
shlokas.38:
bahunakrajhaShagrAhAM timi~NgilagaNAyutAm |
kAkena baDishenemAmatArShaM tvAmahaM nadIm
shlokas.39:
sthANvashmakaNTakavatIM vyAghrasiMhagajAkulAm |
durAsadAM duShpraveshAM guhAM haimavatImiva
shlokas.40:
agninA tAmasaM durgaM naubhirApyaM cha gamyate |
rAjadurgAvataraNe nopAyaM paNDitA viduH
shlokas.41:
gahanaM bhavato rAjyamandhakAratamovRRitam |
neha vishvasituM shakyaM bhavatApi kuto mayA
shlokas.42:
ato nAyaM shubho vAsastulye sadasatI iha |
vadho hyevAtra sukRRite duShkRRite na cha sa.nshayaH
shlokas.43:
nyAyato duShkRRite ghAtaH sukRRite syAtkathaM vadhaH |
neha yuktaM chiraM sthAtuM javenAto vrajedbudhaH
shlokas.44:
sItA nAma nadI rAjanplavo yasyAM nimajjati |
tathopamAmimAM manye vAgurAM sarvaghAtinIm
shlokas.45:
madhuprapAto hi bhavAnbhojanaM viShasa.nyutam |
asatAmiva te bhAvo vartate na satAmiva
AshIviShaiH parivRRitaH kUpastvamiva pArthiva
shlokas.46:
durgatIrthA bRRihatkUlA karIrIvetrasa.nyutA |
nadI madhurapAnIyA yathA rAja.nstathA bhavAn
shvagRRidhragomAyuyuto rAjaha.nsasamo hyasi
shlokas.47:
yathAshritya mahAvRRikShaM kakShaH sa.nvardhate mahAn |
tatastaM sa.nvRRiNotyeva tamatItya cha vardhate
shlokas.48:
tenaivopendhano nUnaM dAvo dahati dAruNaH |
tathopamA hyamAtyAste rAja.nstAnparishodhaya
shlokas.49:
bhavataiva kRRitA rAjanbhavatA paripAlitAH |
bhavantaM paryavaj~nAya jighA.nsanti bhavatpriyam
shlokas.50:
uShitaM sha~NkamAnena pramAdaM parirakShatA |
antaHsarpa ivAgAre vIrapatnyA ivAlaye
shIlaM jij~nAsamAnena rAj~nashcha sahajIvinA
shlokas.51:
kachchijjitendriyo rAjA kachchidabhyantarA jitAH |
kachchideShAM priyo rAjA kachchidrAj~naH priyAH prajAH
shlokas.52:
jij~nAsuriha samprAptastavAhaM rAjasattama |
tasya me rochase rAjankShudhitasyeva bhojanam
shlokas.53:
amAtyA me na rochante vitRRiShNasya yathodakam |
bhavato.arthakRRidityeva mayi doSho hi taiH kRRitaH
vidyate kAraNaM nAnyaditi me nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.54:
na hi teShAmahaM drugdhastatteShAM doShavadgatam |
arerhi durhatAdbheyaM bhagnapRRiShThAdivoragAt
shlokas.55:
rAjovAcha||
bhUyasA paribarheNa satkAreNa cha bhUyasA |
pUjito brAhmaNashreShTha bhUyo vasa gRRihe mama
shlokas.56:
ye tvAM brAhmaNa nechChanti na te vatsyanti me gRRihe |
bhavataiva hi tajj~neyaM yadidAnImanantaram
shlokas.57:
yathA syAdduShkRRito daNDo yathA cha sukRRitaM kRRitam |
tathA samIkShya bhagava~nshreyase viniyu~NkShva mAm
shlokas.58:
muniruvAcha||
adarshayannimaM doShamekaikaM durbalaM kuru |
tataH kAraNamAj~nAya puruShaM puruShaM jahi
shlokas.59:
ekadoShA hi bahavo mRRidnIyurapi kaNTakAn |
mantrabhedabhayAdrAja.nstasmAdetadbravImi te
shlokas.60:
vayaM tu brAhmaNA nAma mRRidudaNDAH kRRipAlavaH |
svasti chechChAmi bhavataH pareShAM cha yathAtmanaH
shlokas.61:
rAjannAtmAnamAchakShe sambandhI bhavato hyaham |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIya ityevamabhisa~nj~nitaH
shlokas.62:
pituH sakhA cha bhavataH saMmataH satyasa~NgaraH |
vyApanne bhavato rAjye rAjanpitari sa.nsthite
shlokas.63:
sarvakAmAnparityajya tapastaptaM tadA mayA |
snehAttvAM prabravImyetanmA bhUyo vibhramediti
shlokas.64:
ubhe dRRiShTvA duHkhasukhe rAjyaM prApya yadRRichChayA |
rAjyenAmAtyasa.nsthena kathaM rAjanpramAdyasi
shlokas.65:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato rAjakule nAndI sa~njaj~ne bhUyasI punaH |
purohitakule chaiva samprApte brAhmaNarShabhe
shlokas.66:
ekachChatrAM mahIM kRRitvA kausalyAya yashasvine |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIya Ije kratubhiruttamaiH
shlokas.67:
hitaM tadvachanaM shrutvA kausalyo.anvashiShanmahIm |
tathA cha kRRitavAnrAjA yathoktaM tena bhArata

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hrIniShedhAH sadA santaH satyArjavasamanvitAH |
shaktAH kathayituM samyakte tava syuH sabhAsadaH
shlokas.2:
atyADhyA.nshchAtishUrA.nshcha brAhmaNA.nshcha bahushrutAn |
susantuShTA.nshcha kaunteya mahotsAhA.nshcha karmasu
shlokas.3:
etAnsahAyA.NllipsethAH sarvAsvApatsu bhArata |
kulInaH pUjito nityaM na hi shaktiM nigUhati
shlokas.4:
prasannaM hyaprasannaM vA pIDitaM hRRitameva vA |
Avartayati bhUyiShThaM tadeko hyanupAlitaH
shlokas.5:
kulInA deshajAH prAj~nA rUpavanto bahushrutAH |
pragalbhAshchAnuraktAshcha te tava syuH parichChadAH
shlokas.6:
dauShkuleyAshcha lubdhAshcha nRRisha.nsA nirapatrapAH |
te tvAM tAta niSheveyuryAvadArdrakapANayaH
shlokas.7:
arthamAnArghyasatkArairbhogairuchchAvachaiH priyAn |
yAnarthabhAjo manyethAste te syuH sukhabhAginaH
shlokas.8:
abhinnavRRittA vidvA.nsaH sadvRRittAshcharitavratAH |
na tvAM nityArthino jahyurakShudrAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.9:
anAryA ye na jAnanti samayaM mandachetasaH |
tebhyaH pratijugupsethA jAnIyAH samayachyutAn
shlokas.10:
naikamichChedgaNaM hitvA syAchchedanyataragrahaH |
yastveko bahubhiH shreyAnkAmaM tena gaNaM tyajet
shlokas.11:
shreyaso lakShaNaM hyetadvikramo yasya dRRishyate |
kIrtipradhAno yashcha syAtsamaye yashcha tiShThati
shlokas.12:
samarthAnpUjayedyashcha nAspardhyaiH spardhate cha yaH |
na cha kAmAdbhayAtkrodhAllobhAdvA dharmamutsRRijet
shlokas.13:
amAnI satyavAkShakto jitAtmA mAnyamAnitA |
sa te mantrasahAyaH syAtsarvAvasthaM parIkShitaH
shlokas.14:
kulInaH satyasampannastitikShurdakSha AtmavAn |
shUraH kRRitaj~naH satyashcha shreyasaH pArtha lakShaNam
shlokas.15:
tasyaivaM vartamAnasya puruShasya vijAnataH |
amitrAH samprasIdanti tato mitrIbhavantyapi
shlokas.16:
ata UrdhvamamAtyAnAM parIkSheta guNAguNAn |
sa.nyatAtmA kRRitapraj~no bhUtikAmashcha bhUmipaH
shlokas.17:
sambaddhAH puruShairAptairabhijAtaiH svadeshajaiH |
ahAryairavyabhIchAraiH sarvataH suparIkShitaiH
shlokas.18:
yodhAH srauvAstathA maulAstathaivAnye.apyavaskRRitAH |
kartavyA bhUtikAmena puruSheNa bubhUShatA
shlokas.19:
yeShAM vainayikI buddhiH prakRRitA chaiva shobhanA |
tejo dhairyaM kShamA shauchamanurAga sthitirdhRRitiH
shlokas.20:
parIkShitaguNAnnityaM prauDhabhAvAndhurandharAn |
pa~nchopadhAvyatItA.nshcha kuryAdrAjArthakAriNaH
shlokas.21:
paryAptavachanAnvIrAnpratipattivishAradAn |
kulInAnsatyasampannAni~Ngitaj~nAnaniShThurAn
shlokas.22:
deshakAlavidhAnaj~nAnbhartRRikAryahitaiShiNaH |
nityamartheShu sarveShu rAjA kurvIta mantriNaH
shlokas.23:
hInatejA hyasaMhRRiShTo naiva jAtu vyavasyati |
avashyaM janayatyeva sarvakarmasu sa.nshayAn
shlokas.24:
evamalpashruto mantrI kalyANAbhijano.apyuta |
dharmArthakAmayukto.api nAlaM mantraM parIkShitum
shlokas.25:
tathaivAnabhijAto.api kAmamastu bahushrutaH |
anAyaka ivAchakShurmuhyatyUhyeShu karmasu
shlokas.26:
yo vA hyasthirasa~Nkalpo buddhimAnAgatAgamaH |
upAyaj~no.api nAlaM sa karma yApayituM chiram
shlokas.27:
kevalAtpunarAchArAtkarmaNo nopapadyate |
parimarsho visheShANAmashrutasyeha durmateH
shlokas.28:
mantriNyananurakte tu vishvAso na hi vidyate |
tasmAdananuraktAya naiva mantraM prakAshayet
shlokas.29:
vyathayeddhi sa rAjAnaM mantribhiH sahito.anRRijuH |
mArutopahatachChidraiH pravishyAgniriva drumam
shlokas.30:
sa~NkrudhyatyekadA svAmI sthAnAchchaivApakarShati |
vAchA kShipati sa.nrabdhastataH pashchAtprasIdati
shlokas.31:
tAni tAnyanuraktena shakyAnyanutitikShitum |
mantriNAM cha bhavetkrodho visphUrjitamivAshaneH
shlokas.32:
yastu saMharate tAni bhartuH priyachikIrShayA |
samAnasukhaduHkhaM taM pRRichChedartheShu mAnavam
shlokas.33:
anRRijustvanurakto.api sampannashchetarairguNaiH |
rAj~naH praj~nAnayukto.api na mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.34:
yo.amitraiH saha sambaddho na paurAnbahu manyate |
sa suhRRittAdRRisho rAj~no na mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.35:
avidvAnashuchiH stabdhaH shatrusevI vikatthanaH |
sa suhRRitkrodhano lubdho na mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.36:
AgantushchAnurakto.api kAmamastu bahushrutaH |
satkRRitaH sa.nvibhakto vA na mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.37:
yastvalpenApi kAryeNa sakRRidAkShArito bhavet |
punaranyairguNairyukto na mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.38:
kRRitapraj~nashcha medhAvI budho jAnapadaH shuchiH |
sarvakarmasu yaH shuddhaH sa mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.39:
j~nAnavij~nAnasampannaH prakRRitij~naH parAtmanoH |
suhRRidAtmasamo rAj~naH sa mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.40:
satyavAkShIlasampanno gambhIraH satrapo mRRiduH |
pitRRipaitAmaho yaH syAtsa mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.41:
santuShTaH saMmataH satyaH shauTIro dveShyapApakaH |
mantravitkAlavichChUraH sa mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.42:
sarvalokaM samaM shaktaH sAntvena kurute vashe |
tasmai mantraH prayoktavyo daNDamAdhitsatA nRRipa
shlokas.43:
paurajAnapadA yasminvishvAsaM dharmato gatAH |
yoddhA nayavipashchichcha sa mantraM shrotumarhati
shlokas.44:
tasmAtsarvairguNairetairupapannAH supUjitAH |
mantriNaH prakRRitij~nAH syustryavarA mahadIpsavaH
shlokas.45:
svAsu prakRRitiShu ChidraM lakShayeranparasya cha |
mantriNo mantramUlaM hi rAj~no rAShTraM vivardhate
shlokas.46:
nAsya ChidraM paraH pashyechChidreShu paramanviyAt |
gUhetkUrma ivA~NgAni rakShedvivaramAtmanaH
shlokas.47:
mantragrAhA hi rAjyasya mantriNo ye manIShiNaH |
mantrasaMhanano rAjA mantrA~NgAnItaro janaH
shlokas.48:
rAjyaM praNidhimUlaM hi mantrasAraM prachakShate |
svAminaM tvanuvartanti vRRittyarthamiha mantriNaH
shlokas.49:
sa vinIya madakrodhau mAnamIrShyAM cha nirvRRitaH |
nityaM pa~nchopadhAtItairmantrayetsaha mantribhiH
shlokas.50:
teShAM trayANAM vividhaM vimarshaM; budhyeta chittaM viniveshya tatra |
svanishchayaM taM paranishchayaM cha; nivedayeduttaramantrakAle
shlokas.51:
dharmArthakAmaj~namupetya pRRichChe;dyukto guruM brAhmaNamuttamArtham |
niShThA kRRitA tena yadA saha syA;ttaM tatra mArgaM praNayedasaktam
shlokas.52:
evaM sadA mantrayitavyamAhu;rye mantratattvArthavinishchayaj~nAH |
tasmAttvamevaM praNayeH sadaiva; mantraM prajAsa~NgrahaNe samartham
shlokas.53:
na vAmanAH kubjakRRishA na kha~njA; nAndhA jaDAH strI na napu.nsakaM cha |
na chAtra tirya~Nna puro na pashchA;nnordhvaM na chAdhaH prachareta kashchit
shlokas.54:
Aruhya vAtAyanameva shUnyaM; sthalaM prakAshaM kushakAshahInam |
vAga~NgadoShAnparihRRitya mantraM; saMmantrayetkAryamahInakAlam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bRRihaspateshcha sa.nvAdaM shakrasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
shakra uvAcha||
kiM svidekapadaM brahmanpuruShaH samyagAcharan |
pramANaM sarvabhUtAnAM yashashchaivApnuyAnmahat
shlokas.3:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
sAntvamekapadaM shakra puruShaH samyagAcharan |
pramANaM sarvabhUtAnAM yashashchaivApnuyAnmahat
shlokas.4:
etadekapadaM shakra sarvalokasukhAvaham |
AcharansarvabhUteShu priyo bhavati sarvadA
shlokas.5:
yo hi nAbhAShate ki~nchitsatataM bhrukuTImukhaH |
dveShyo bhavati bhUtAnAM sa sAntvamiha nAcharan
shlokas.6:
yastu pUrvamabhiprekShya pUrvamevAbhibhAShate |
smitapUrvAbhibhAShI cha tasya lokaH prasIdati
shlokas.7:
dAnameva hi sarvatra sAntvenAnabhijalpitam |
na prINayati bhUtAni nirvya~njanamivAshanam
shlokas.8:
adAtA hyapi bhUtAnAM madhurAmIrayangiram |
sarvalokamimaM shakra sAntvena kurute vashe
shlokas.9:
tasmAtsAntvaM prakartavyaM daNDamAdhitsatAmiha |
phalaM cha janayatyevaM na chAsyodvijate janaH
shlokas.10:
sukRRitasya hi sAntvasya shlakShNasya madhurasya cha |
samyagAsevyamAnasya tulyaM jAtu na vidyate
shlokas.11:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH kRRitavAnsarvaM tathA shakraH purodhasA |
tathA tvamapi kaunteya samyagetatsamAchara

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM svidiha rAjendra pAlayanpArthivaH prajAH |
prati dharmaM visheSheNa kIrtimApnoti shAshvatIm
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vyavahAreNa shuddhena prajApAlanatatparaH |
prApya dharmaM cha kIrtiM cha lokAvApnotyubhau shuchiH
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kIdRRishaM vyavahAraM tu kaishcha vyavaharennRRipaH |
etatpRRiShTo mahAprAj~na yathAvadvaktumarhasi
shlokas.4:
ye chaite pUrvakathitA guNAste puruShaM prati |
naikasminpuruShe hyete vidyanta iti me matiH
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evametanmahAprAj~na yathA vadasi buddhimAn |
durlabhaH puruShaH kashchidebhirguNaguNairyutaH
shlokas.6:
kiM tu sa~NkShepataH shIlaM prayatne neha durlabham |
vakShyAmi tu yathAmAtyAnyAdRRishA.nshcha kariShyasi
shlokas.7:
chaturo brAhmaNAnvaidyAnpragalbhAnsAttvikA~nshuchIn |
trI.nshcha shUdrAnvinItA.nshcha shuchInkarmaNi pUrvake
shlokas.8:
aShTAbhishcha guNairyuktaM sUtaM paurANikaM charet |
pa~nchAshadvarShavayasaM pragalbhamanasUyakam
shlokas.9:
matismRRitisamAyuktaM vinItaM samadarshanam |
kArye vivadamAnAnAM shaktamartheShvalolupam
shlokas.10:
vivarjitAnAM vyasanaiH sughoraiH saptabhirbhRRisham |
aShTAnAM mantriNAM madhye mantraM rAjopadhArayet
shlokas.11:
tataH sampreShayedrAShTre rAShTrAyAtha cha darshayet |
anena vyavahAreNa draShTavyAste prajAH sadA
shlokas.12:
na chApi gUDhaM kAryaM te grAhyaM kAryopaghAtakam |
kArye khalu vipanne tvAM so.adharmastA.nshcha pIDayet
shlokas.13:
vidravechchaiva rAShTraM te shyenAtpakShigaNA iva |
parisravechcha satataM naurvishIrNeva sAgare
shlokas.14:
prajAH pAlayato.asamyagadharmeNeha bhUpateH |
hArdaM bhayaM sambhavati svargashchAsya virudhyate
shlokas.15:
atha yo.adharmataH pAti rAjAmAtyo.atha vAtmajaH |
dharmAsane niyuktaH sandharmamUlaM nararShabha
shlokas.16:
kAryeShvadhikRRitAH samyagakurvanto nRRipAnugAH |
AtmAnaM purataH kRRitvA yAntyadhaH sahapArthivAH
shlokas.17:
balAtkRRitAnAM balibhiH kRRipaNaM bahu jalpatAm |
nAtho vai bhUmipo nityamanAthAnAM nRRiNAM bhavet
shlokas.18:
tataH sAkShibalaM sAdhu dvaidhe vAdakRRitaM bhavet |
asAkShikamanAthaM vA parIkShyaM tadvisheShataH
shlokas.19:
aparAdhAnurUpaM cha daNDaM pApeShu pAtayet |
udvejayeddhanairRRiddhAndaridrAnvadhabandhanaiH
shlokas.20:
vinayairapi durvRRittAnprahArairapi pArthivaH |
sAntvenopapradAnena shiShTA.nshcha paripAlayet
shlokas.21:
rAj~no vadhaM chikIrShedyastasya chitro vadho bhavet |
AjIvakasya stenasya varNasa~Nkarakasya cha
shlokas.22:
samyakpraNayato daNDaM bhUmipasya vishAM pate |
yuktasya vA nAstyadharmo dharma eveha shAshvataH
shlokas.23:
kAmakAreNa daNDaM tu yaH kuryAdavichakShaNaH |
sa ihAkIrtisa.nyukto mRRito narakamApnuyAt
shlokas.24:
na parasya shravAdeva pareShAM daNDamarpayet |
AgamAnugamaM kRRitvA badhnIyAnmokShayeta vA
shlokas.25:
na tu hanyAnnRRipo jAtu dUtaM kasyA~nchidApadi |
dUtasya hantA nirayamAvishetsachivaiH saha
shlokas.26:
yathoktavAdinaM dUtaM kShatradharmarato nRRipaH |
yo hanyAtpitarastasya bhrUNahatyAmavApnuyuH
shlokas.27:
kulInaH shIlasampanno vAgmI dakShaH priya.nvadaH |
yathoktavAdI smRRitimAndUtaH syAtsaptabhirguNaiH
shlokas.28:
etaireva guNairyuktaH pratIhAro.asya rakShitA |
shirorakShashcha bhavati guNairetaiH samanvitaH
shlokas.29:
dharmArthashAstratattvaj~naH sandhivigrahako bhavet |
matimAndhRRitimAndhImAnrahasyavinigUhitA
shlokas.30:
kulInaH satyasampannaH shakto.amAtyaH prasha.nsitaH |
etaireva guNairyuktastathA senApatirbhavet
shlokas.31:
vyUhayantrAyudhIyAnAM tattvaj~no vikramAnvitaH |
varShashItoShNavAtAnAM sahiShNuH pararandhravit
shlokas.32:
vishvAsayetparA.nshchaiva vishvasenna tu kasyachit |
putreShvapi hi rAjendra vishvAso na prashasyate
shlokas.33:
etachChAstrArthatattvaM tu tavAkhyAtaM mayAnagha |
avishvAso narendrANAM guhyaM paramamuchyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
katha.nvidhaM puraM rAjA svayamAvastumarhati |
kRRitaM vA kArayitvA vA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yatra kaunteya vastavyaM saputrabhrAtRRibandhunA |
nyAyyaM tatra paripraShTuM guptiM vRRittiM cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
tasmAtte vartayiShyAmi durgakarma visheShataH |
shrutvA tathA vidhAtavyamanuShTheyaM cha yatnataH
shlokas.4:
ShaDvidhaM durgamAsthAya purANyatha niveshayet |
sarvasampatpradhAnaM yadbAhulyaM vApi sambhavet
shlokas.5:
dhanvadurgaM mahIdurgaM giridurgaM tathaiva cha |
manuShyadurgamabdurgaM vanadurgaM cha tAni ShaT
shlokas.6:
yatpuraM durgasampannaM dhAnyAyudhasamanvitam |
dRRiDhaprAkAraparikhaM hastyashvarathasa~Nkulam
shlokas.7:
vidvA.nsaH shilpino yatra nichayAshcha susa~nchitAH |
dhArmikashcha jano yatra dAkShyamuttamamAsthitaH
shlokas.8:
UrjasvinaranAgAshvaM chatvarApaNashobhitam |
prasiddhavyavahAraM cha prashAntamakutobhayam
shlokas.9:
suprabhaM sAnunAdaM cha suprashastaniveshanam |
shUrADhyajanasampannaM brahmaghoShAnunAditam
shlokas.10:
samAjotsavasampannaM sadApUjitadaivatam |
vashyAmAtyabalo rAjA tatpuraM svayamAvaset
shlokas.11:
tatra koshaM balaM mitraM vyavahAraM cha vardhayet |
pure janapade chaiva sarvadoShAnnivartayet
shlokas.12:
bhANDAgArAyudhAgAraM prayatnenAbhivardhayet |
nichayAnvardhayetsarvA.nstathA yantragadAgadAn
shlokas.13:
kAShThalohatuShA~NgAradArushRRi~NgAsthivaiNavAn |
majjAsnehavasAkShaudramauShadhagrAmameva cha
shlokas.14:
shaNaM sarjarasaM dhAnyamAyudhAni sharA.nstathA |
charma snAyu tathA vetraM mu~njabalbajadhanvanAn
shlokas.15:
AshayAshchodapAnAshcha prabhUtasalilA varAH |
niroddhavyAH sadA rAj~nA kShIriNashcha mahIruhAH
shlokas.16:
satkRRitAshcha prayatnena AchAryartvikpurohitAH |
maheShvAsAH sthapatayaH sA.nvatsarachikitsakAH
shlokas.17:
prAj~nA medhAvino dAntA dakShAH shUrA bahushrutAH |
kulInAH sattvasampannA yuktAH sarveShu karmasu
shlokas.18:
pUjayeddhArmikAnrAjA nigRRihNIyAdadhArmikAn |
niyu~njyAchcha prayatnena sarvavarNAnsvakarmasu
shlokas.19:
bAhyamAbhyantaraM chaiva paurajAnapadaM janam |
chAraiH suviditaM kRRitvA tataH karma prayojayet
shlokas.20:
chArAnmantraM cha koshaM cha mantraM chaiva visheShataH |
anutiShThetsvayaM rAjA sarvaM hyatra pratiShThitam
shlokas.21:
udAsInArimitrANAM sarvameva chikIrShitam |
pure janapade chaiva j~nAtavyaM chArachakShuShA
shlokas.22:
tatastathA vidhAtavyaM sarvamevApramAdataH |
bhaktAnpujayatA nityaM dviShatashcha nigRRihNatA
shlokas.23:
yaShTavyaM kratubhirnityaM dAtavyaM chApyapIDayA |
prajAnAM rakShaNaM kAryaM na kAryaM karma garhitam
shlokas.24:
kRRipaNAnAthavRRiddhAnAM vidhavAnAM cha yoShitAm |
yogakShemaM cha vRRittiM cha nityameva prakalpayet
shlokas.25:
AshrameShu yathAkAlaM chelabhAjanabhojanam |
sadaivopaharedrAjA satkRRityAnavamanya cha
shlokas.26:
AtmAnaM sarvakAryANi tApase rAjyameva cha |
nivedayetprayatnena tiShThetprahvashcha sarvadA
shlokas.27:
sarvArthatyAginaM rAjA kule jAtaM bahushrutam |
pUjayettAdRRishaM dRRiShTvA shayanAsanabhojanaiH
shlokas.28:
tasminkurvIta vishvAsaM rAjA kasyA~nchidApadi |
tApaseShu hi vishvAsamapi kurvanti dasyavaH
shlokas.29:
tasminnidhInAdadhIta praj~nAM paryAdadIta cha |
na chApyabhIkShNaM seveta bhRRishaM vA pratipUjayet
shlokas.30:
anyaH kAryaH svarAShTreShu pararAShTreShu chAparaH |
aTavIShvaparaH kAryaH sAmantanagareShu cha
shlokas.31:
teShu satkArasa.nskArAnsa.nvibhAgA.nshcha kArayet |
pararAShTrATavIstheShu yathA svaviShaye tathA
shlokas.32:
te kasyA~nchidavasthAyAM sharaNaM sharaNArthine |
rAj~ne dadyuryathAkAmaM tApasAH sa.nshitavratAH
shlokas.33:
eSha te lakShaNoddeshaH sa~NkShepeNa prakIrtitaH |
yAdRRishaM nagaraM rAjA svayamAvastumarhati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rAShTraguptiM cha me rAjanrAShTrasyaiva cha sa~Ngraham |
samyagjij~nAsamAnAya prabrUhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAShTraguptiM cha te samyagrAShTrasyaiva cha sa~Ngraham |
hanta sarvaM pravakShyAmi tattvamekamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
grAmasyAdhipatiH kAryo dashagrAmyastathAparaH |
dviguNAyAH shatasyaivaM sahasrasya cha kArayet
shlokas.4:
grAme yAngrAmadoShA.nshcha grAmikaH paripAlayet |
tAnbrUyAddashapAyAsau sa tu vi.nshatipAya vai
shlokas.5:
so.api vi.nshatyadhipatirvRRittaM jAnapade jane |
grAmANAM shatapAlAya sarvameva nivedayet
shlokas.6:
yAni grAmINabhojyAni grAmikastAnyupAshnuyAt |
dashapastena bhartavyastenApi dviguNAdhipaH
shlokas.7:
grAmaM grAmashatAdhyakSho bhoktumarhati satkRRitaH |
mahAntaM bharatashreShTha susphItajanasa~Nkulam
tatra hyanekamAyattaM rAj~no bhavati bhArata
shlokas.8:
shAkhAnagaramarhastu sahasrapatiruttamam |
dhAnyahairaNyabhogena bhoktuM rAShTriya udyataH
shlokas.9:
tathA yadgrAmakRRityaM syAdgrAmikRRityaM cha te svayam |
dharmaj~naH sachivaH kashchittatprapashyedatandritaH
shlokas.10:
nagare nagare cha syAdekaH sarvArthachintakaH |
uchchaiHsthAne ghorarUpo nakShatrANAmiva grahaH
bhavetsa tAnparikrAmetsarvAneva sadA svayam
shlokas.11:
vikrayaM krayamadhvAnaM bhaktaM cha saparivyayam |
yogakShemaM cha samprekShya vaNijaH kArayetkarAn
shlokas.12:
utpattiM dAnavRRittiM cha shilpaM samprekShya chAsakRRit |
shilpapratikarAneva shilpinaH prati kArayet
shlokas.13:
uchchAvachakarA nyAyyAH pUrvarAj~nAM yudhiShThira |
yathA yathA na hIyera.nstathA kuryAnmahIpatiH
shlokas.14:
phalaM karma cha samprekShya tataH sarvaM prakalpayet |
phalaM karma cha nirhetu na kashchitsampravartayet
shlokas.15:
yathA rAjA cha kartA cha syAtAM karmaNi bhAginau |
samavekShya tathA rAj~nA praNeyAH satataM karAH
shlokas.16:
nochChindyAdAtmano mUlaM pareShAM vApi tRRiShNayA |
IhAdvArANi sa.nrudhya rAjA samprItidarshanaH
shlokas.17:
pradviShanti parikhyAtaM rAjAnamatikhAdinam |
pradviShTasya kutaH shreyaH sampriyo labhate priyam
shlokas.18:
vatsaupamyena dogdhavyaM rAShTramakShINabuddhinA |
bhRRito vatso jAtabalaH pIDAM sahati bhArata
shlokas.19:
na karma kurute vatso bhRRishaM dugdho yudhiShThira |
rAShTramapyatidugdhaM hi na karma kurute mahat
shlokas.20:
yo rAShTramanugRRihNAti parigRRihya svayaM nRRipaH |
sa~njAtamupajIvansa labhate sumahatphalam
shlokas.21:
ApadarthaM hi nichayAnrAjAna iha chinvate |
rAShTraM cha koshabhUtaM syAtkosho veshmagatastathA
shlokas.22:
paurajAnapadAnsarvAnsa.nshritopAshritA.nstathA |
yathAshaktyanukampeta sarvAnabhyantarAnapi
shlokas.23:
bAhyaM janaM bhedayitvA bhoktavyo madhyamaH sukham |
evaM na samprakupyante janAH sukhitaduHkhitAH
shlokas.24:
prAgeva tu karAdAnamanubhAShya punaH punaH |
saMnipatya svaviShaye bhayaM rAShTre pradarshayet
shlokas.25:
iyamApatsamutpannA parachakrabhayaM mahat |
api nAntAya kalpeta veNoriva phalAgamaH
shlokas.26:
arayo me samutthAya bahubhirdasyubhiH saha |
idamAtmavadhAyaiva rAShTramichChanti bAdhitum
shlokas.27:
asyAmApadi ghorAyAM samprApte dAruNe bhaye |
paritrANAya bhavatAM prArthayiShye dhanAni vaH
shlokas.28:
pratidAsye cha bhavatAM sarvaM chAhaM bhayakShaye |
nArayaH pratidAsyanti yaddhareyurbalAditaH
shlokas.29:
kalatramAditaH kRRitvA nashyetsvaM svayameva hi |
api chetputradArArthamarthasa~nchaya iShyate
shlokas.30:
nandAmi vaH prabhAvena putrANAmiva chodaye |
yathAshaktyanugRRihNAmi rAShTrasyApIDayA cha vaH
shlokas.31:
Apatsveva cha voDhavyaM bhavadbhiH sadgavairiva |
na vaH priyataraM kAryaM dhanaM kasyA~nchidApadi
shlokas.32:
iti vAchA madhurayA shlakShNayA sopachArayA |
svarashmInabhyavasRRijedyugamAdAya kAlavit
shlokas.33:
prachAraM bhRRityabharaNaM vyayaM gogrAmato bhayam |
yogakShemaM cha samprekShya gominaH kArayetkarAn
shlokas.34:
upekShitA hi nashyeyurgomino.araNyavAsinaH |
tasmAtteShu visheSheNa mRRidupUrvaM samAcharet
shlokas.35:
sAntvanaM rakShaNaM dAnamavasthA chApyabhIkShNashaH |
gominAM pArtha kartavyaM sa.nvibhAgAH priyANi cha
shlokas.36:
ajasramupayoktavyaM phalaM gomiShu sarvataH |
prabhAvayati rAShTraM cha vyavahAraM kRRiShiM tathA
shlokas.37:
tasmAdgomiShu yatnena prItiM kuryAdvichakShaNaH |
dayAvAnapramattashcha karAnsampraNayanmRRidUn
shlokas.38:
sarvatra kShemacharaNaM sulabhaM tAta gomibhiH |
na hyataH sadRRishaM ki~nchiddhanamasti yudhiShThira

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadA rAjA samartho.api koshArthI syAnmahAmate |
kathaM pravarteta tadA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yathAdeshaM yathAkAlamapi chaiva yathAbalam |
anushiShyAtprajA rAjA dharmArthI taddhite rataH
shlokas.3:
yathA tAsAM cha manyeta shreya Atmana eva cha |
tathA dharmyANi sarvANi rAjA rAShTre pravartayet
shlokas.4:
madhudohaM duhedrAShTraM bhramarAnna vipAtayet |
vatsApekShI duhechchaiva stanA.nshcha na vikuTTayet
shlokas.5:
jalaukAvatpibedrAShTraM mRRidunaiva narAdhipa |
vyAghrIva cha haretputramadaShTvA mA patediti
shlokas.6:
alpenAlpena deyena vardhamAnaM pradApayet |
tato bhUyastato bhUyaH kAmaM vRRiddhiM samAcharet
shlokas.7:
damayanniva damyAnAM shashvadbhAraM pravardhayet |
mRRidupUrvaM prayatnena pAshAnabhyavahArayet
shlokas.8:
sakRRitpAshAvakIrNAste na bhaviShyanti durdamAH |
uchitenaiva bhoktavyAste bhaviShyanti yatnataH
shlokas.9:
tasmAtsarvasamArambho durlabhaH puruShavrajaH |
yathAmukhyAnsAntvayitvA bhoktavya itaro janaH
shlokas.10:
tatastAnbhedayitvAtha parasparavivakShitAn |
bhu~njIta sAntvayitvaiva yathAsukhamayatnataH
shlokas.11:
na chAsthAne na chAkAle karAnebhyo.anupAtayet |
AnupUrvyeNa sAntvena yathAkAlaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.12:
upAyAnprabravImyetAnna me mAyA vivakShitA |
anupAyena damayanprakopayati vAjinaH
shlokas.13:
pAnAgArANi veshAshcha veshaprApaNikAstathA |
kushIlavAH sakitavA ye chAnye kechidIdRRishAH
shlokas.14:
niyamyAH sarva evaite ye rAShTrasyopaghAtakAH |
ete rAShTre hi tiShThanto bAdhante bhadrikAH prajAH
shlokas.15:
na kenachidyAchitavyaH kashchitki~nchidanApadi |
iti vyavasthA bhUtAnAM purastAnmanunA kRRitA
shlokas.16:
sarve tathA na jIveyurna kuryuH karma chediha |
sarva eva trayo lokA na bhaveyurasa.nshayam
shlokas.17:
prabhurniyamane rAjA ya etAnna niyachChati |
bhu~Nkte sa tasya pApasya chaturbhAgamiti shrutiH
tathA kRRitasya dharmasya chaturbhAgamupAshnute
shlokas.18:
sthAnAnyetAni sa~Ngamya prasa~Nge bhUtinAshanaH |
kAmaprasaktaH puruShaH kimakAryaM vivarjayet
shlokas.19:
Apadyeva tu yAcheranyeShAM nAsti parigrahaH |
dAtavyaM dharmatastebhyastvanukroshAddayArthinA
shlokas.20:
mA te rAShTre yAchanakA mA te bhUyushcha dasyavaH |
iShTAdAtAra evaite naite bhUtasya bhAvakAH
shlokas.21:
ye bhUtAnyanugRRihNanti vardhayanti cha ye prajAH |
te te rAShTre pravartantAM mA bhUtAnAmabhAvakAH
shlokas.22:
daNDyAste cha mahArAja dhanAdAnaprayojanAH |
prayogaM kArayeyustAnyathA balikarA.nstathA
shlokas.23:
kRRiShigorakShyavANijyaM yachchAnyatki~nchidIdRRisham |
puruShaiH kArayetkarma bahubhiH saha karmibhiH
shlokas.24:
narashchetkRRiShigorakShyaM vANijyaM chApyanuShThitaH |
sa.nshayaM labhate ki~nchittena rAjA vigarhyate
shlokas.25:
dhaninaH pUjayennityaM yAnAchChAdanabhojanaiH |
vaktavyAshchAnugRRihNIdhvaM pUjAH saha mayeti ha
shlokas.26:
a~NgametanmahadrAj~nAM dhanino nAma bhArata |
kakudaM sarvabhUtAnAM dhanastho nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.27:
prAj~naH shUro dhanasthashcha svAmI dhArmika eva cha |
tapasvI satyavAdI cha buddhimA.nshchAbhirakShati
shlokas.28:
tasmAdeteShu sarveShu prItimAnbhava pArthiva |
satyamArjavamakrodhamAnRRisha.nsyaM cha pAlaya
shlokas.29:
evaM daNDaM cha koshaM cha mitraM bhUmiM cha lapsyase |
satyArjavaparo rAjanmitrakoshasamanvitaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vanaspatInbhakShyaphalAnna ChindyurviShaye tava |
brAhmaNAnAM mUlaphalaM dharmyamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNebhyo.atiriktaM cha bhu~njIrannitare janAH |
na brAhmaNoparodhena haredanyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.3:
viprashchettyAgamAtiShThedAkhyAyAvRRittikarshitaH |
parikalpyAsya vRRittiH syAtsadArasya narAdhipa
shlokas.4:
sa chennopanivarteta vAchyo brAhmaNasa.nsadi |
kasminnidAnIM maryAdAmayaM lokaH kariShyati
shlokas.5:
asa.nshayaM nivarteta na chedvakShyatyataH param |
pUrvaM parokShaM kartavyametatkaunteya shAsanam
shlokas.6:
AhuretajjanA brahmanna chaitachChraddadhAmyaham |
nimantryashcha bhavedbhogairavRRittyA chettadAcharet
shlokas.7:
kRRiShigorakShyavANijyaM lokAnAmiha jIvanam |
UrdhvaM chaiva trayI vidyA sA bhUtAnbhAvayatyuta
shlokas.8:
tasyAM prayatamAnAyAM ye syustatparipanthinaH |
dasyavastadvadhAyeha brahmA kShatramathAsRRijat
shlokas.9:
shatrU~njahi prajA rakSha yajasva kratubhirnRRipa |
yudhyasva samare vIro bhUtvA kauravanandana
shlokas.10:
sa.nrakShyAnpAlayedrAjA yaH sa rAjAryakRRittamaH |
ye kechittAnna rakShanti tairartho nAsti kashchana
shlokas.11:
sadaiva rAj~nA boddhavyaM sarvalokAdyudhiShThira |
tasmAddhetorhi bhu~njIta manuShyAneva mAnavaH
shlokas.12:
antarebhyaH parAnrakShanparebhyaH punarantarAn |
parAnparebhyaH svAnsvebhyaH sarvAnpAlaya nityadA
shlokas.13:
AtmAnaM sarvato rakShanrAjA rakSheta medinIm |
AtmamUlamidaM sarvamAhurhi viduSho janAH
shlokas.14:
kiM ChidraM ko.anuSha~Ngo me kiM vAstyavinipAtitam |
kuto mAmAsraveddoSha iti nityaM vichintayet
shlokas.15:
guptaishchArairanumataiH pRRithivImanuchArayet |
sunItaM yadi me vRRittaM prasha.nsanti na vA punaH
kachchidrochejjanapade kachchidrAShTre cha me yashaH
shlokas.16:
dharmaj~nAnAM dhRRitimatAM sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinAm |
rAShTraM cha ye.anujIvanti ye cha rAj~no.anujIvinaH
shlokas.17:
amAtyAnAM cha sarveShAM madhyasthAnAM cha sarvashaH |
ye cha tvAbhiprasha.nseyurnindeyuratha vA punaH
sarvAnsupariNItA.nstAnkArayeta yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
ekAntena hi sarveShAM na shakyaM tAta rochitum |
mitrAmitramatho madhyaM sarvabhUteShu bhArata
shlokas.19:
tulyabAhubalAnAM cha guNairapi niShevinAm |
kathaM syAdadhikaH kashchitsa tu bhu~njIta mAnavAn
shlokas.20:
ye charA hyacharAnadyuradaMShTrAndaMShTriNastathA |
AshIviShA iva kruddhA bhujagA bhujagAniva
shlokas.21:
etebhyashchApramattaH syAtsadA yatto yudhiShThira |
bhAruNDasadRRishA hyete nipatanti pramAdyataH
shlokas.22:
kachchitte vaNijo rAShTre nodvijante karArditAH |
krINanto bahu vAlpena kAntArakRRitanishramAH
shlokas.23:
kachchitkRRiShikarA rAShTraM na jahatyatipIDitAH |
ye vahanti dhuraM rAj~nAM sambharantItarAnapi
shlokas.24:
ito dattena jIvanti devAH pitRRigaNAstathA |
manuShyoragarakShA.nsi vayA.nsi pashavastathA
shlokas.25:
eShA te rAShTravRRittishcha rAShTraguptishcha bhArata |
etamevArthamAshritya bhUyo vakShyAmi pANDava

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yAna~NgirAH kShatradharmAnutathyo brahmavittamaH |
mAndhAtre yauvanAshvAya prItimAnabhyabhAShata
shlokas.2:
sa yathAnushashAsainamutathyo brahmavittamaH |
tatte sarvaM pravakShyAmi nikhilena yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
utathya uvAcha||
dharmAya rAjA bhavati na kAmakaraNAya tu |
mAndhAtarevaM jAnIhi rAjA lokasya rakShitA
shlokas.4:
rAjA charati vai dharmaM devatvAyaiva gachChati |
na cheddharmaM sa charati narakAyaiva gachChati
shlokas.5:
dharme tiShThanti bhUtAni dharmo rAjani tiShThati |
taM rAjA sAdhu yaH shAsti sa rAjA pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.6:
rAjA paramadharmAtmA lakShmIvAnpApa uchyate |
devAshcha garhAM gachChanti dharmo nAstIti chochyate
shlokas.7:
adharme vartamAnAnAmarthasiddhiH pradRRishyate |
tadeva ma~NgalaM sarvaM lokaH samanuvartate
shlokas.8:
uchChidyate dharmavRRittamadharmo vartate mahAn |
bhayamAhurdivArAtraM yadA pApo na vAryate
shlokas.9:
na vedAnanuvartanti vratavanto dvijAtayaH |
na yaj~nA.nstanvate viprA yadA pApo na vAryate
shlokas.10:
vadhyAnAmiva sarveShAM mano bhavati vihvalam |
manuShyANAM mahArAja yadA pApo na vAryate
shlokas.11:
ubhau lokAvabhiprekShya rAjAnamRRiShayaH svayam |
asRRijansumahadbhUtamayaM dharmo bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
yasmindharmo virAjeta taM rAjAnaM prachakShate |
yasminvilIyate dharmastaM devA vRRiShalaM viduH
shlokas.13:
vRRiSho hi bhagavAndharmo yastasya kurute hyalam |
vRRiShalaM taM vidurdevAstasmAddharmaM na lopayet
shlokas.14:
dharme vardhati vardhanti sarvabhUtAni sarvadA |
tasminhrasati hIyante tasmAddharmaM pravardhayet
shlokas.15:
dhanAtsravati dharmo hi dhAraNAdveti nishchayaH |
akAryANAM manuShyendra sa sImAntakaraH smRRitaH
shlokas.16:
prabhavArthaM hi bhUtAnAM dharmaH sRRiShTaH svayambhuvA |
tasmAtpravardhayeddharmaM prajAnugrahakAraNAt
shlokas.17:
tasmAddhi rAjashArdUla dharmaH shreShTha iti smRRitaH |
sa rAjA yaH prajAH shAsti sAdhukRRitpuruSharShabhaH
shlokas.18:
kAmakrodhAvanAdRRitya dharmamevAnupAlayet |
dharmaH shreyaskaratamo rAj~nAM bharatasattama
shlokas.19:
dharmasya brAhmaNA yonistasmAttAnpUjayetsadA |
brAhmaNAnAM cha mAndhAtaH kAmAnkuryAdamatsarI
shlokas.20:
teShAM hyakAmakaraNAdrAj~naH sa~njAyate bhayam |
mitrANi cha na vardhante tathAmitrIbhavantyapi
shlokas.21:
brAhmaNAnvai tadAsUyAdyadA vairochano baliH |
athAsmAchChrIrapAkrAmadyAsminnAsItpratApinI
shlokas.22:
tatastasmAdapakramya sAgachChatpAkashAsanam |
atha so.anvatapatpashchAchChriyaM dRRiShTvA pura.ndare
shlokas.23:
etatphalamasUyAyA abhimAnasya chAbhibho |
tasmAdbudhyasva mAndhAtarmA tvA jahyAtpratApinI
shlokas.24:
darpo nAma shriyaH putro jaj~ne.adharmAditi shrutiH |
tena devAsurA rAjannItAH subahusho vasham
shlokas.25:
rAjarShayashcha bahavastasmAdbudhyasva pArthiva |
rAjA bhavati taM jitvA dAsastena parAjitaH
shlokas.26:
sa yathA darpasahitamadharmaM nAnusevase |
tathA vartasva mAndhAtashchiraM chetsthAtumichChasi
shlokas.27:
mattAtpramattAtpogaNDAdunmattAchcha visheShataH |
tadabhyAsAdupAvartAdahitAnAM cha sevanAt
shlokas.28:
nigRRihItAdamAtyAchcha strIbhyashchaiva visheShataH |
parvatAdviShamAddurgAddhastino.ashvAtsarIsRRipAt
shlokas.29:
etebhyo nityayattaH syAnnakta~ncharyAM cha varjayet |
atyAyaM chAtimAnaM cha dambhaM krodhaM cha varjayet
shlokas.30:
avij~nAtAsu cha strIShu klIbAsu svairiNIShu cha |
parabhAryAsu kanyAsu nAcharenmaithunaM nRRipaH
shlokas.31:
kuleShu pAparakShA.nsi jAyante varNasa~NkarAt |
apumA.nso.a~NgahInAshcha sthUlajihvA vichetasaH
shlokas.32:
ete chAnye cha jAyante yadA rAjA pramAdyati |
tasmAdrAj~nA visheSheNa vartitavyaM prajAhite
shlokas.33:
kShatriyasya pramattasya doShaH sa~njAyate mahAn |
adharmAH sampravartante prajAsa~NkarakArakAH
shlokas.34:
ashIte vidyate shItaM shIte shItaM na vidyate |
avRRiShTirativRRiShTishcha vyAdhishchAvishati prajAH
shlokas.35:
nakShatrANyupatiShThanti grahA ghorAstathApare |
utpAtAshchAtra dRRishyante bahavo rAjanAshanAH
shlokas.36:
arakShitAtmA yo rAjA prajAshchApi na rakShati |
prajAshcha tasya kShIyante tAshcha so.anu vinashyati
shlokas.37:
dvAvAdadAte hyekasya dvayoshcha bahavo.apare |
kumAryaH sampralupyante tadAhurnRRipadUShaNam
shlokas.38:
mamaitaditi naikasya manuShyeShvavatiShThate |
tyaktvA dharmaM yadA rAjA pramAdamanutiShThati

shlokas.1:
utathya uvAcha||
kAlavarShI cha parjanyo dharmachArI cha pArthivaH |
sampadyadaiShA bhavati sA bibharti sukhaM prajAH
shlokas.2:
yo na jAnAti nirhantuM vastrANAM rajako malam |
raktAni vA shodhayituM yathA nAsti tathaiva saH
shlokas.3:
evameva dvijendrANAM kShatriyANAM vishAmapi |
shUdrAshchaturNAM varNAnAM nAnAkarmasvavasthitAH
shlokas.4:
karma shUdre kRRiShirvaishye daNDanItishcha rAjani |
brahmacharyaM tapo mantrAH satyaM chApi dvijAtiShu
shlokas.5:
teShAM yaH kShatriyo veda vastrANAmiva shodhanam |
shIladoShAnvinirhantuM sa pitA sa prajApatiH
shlokas.6:
kRRitaM tretA dvAparashcha kalishcha bharatarShabha |
rAjavRRittAni sarvANi rAjaiva yugamuchyate
shlokas.7:
chAturvarNyaM tathA vedAshchAturAshramyameva cha |
sarvaM pramuhyate hyetadyadA rAjA pramAdyati
shlokas.8:
rAjaiva kartA bhUtAnAM rAjaiva cha vinAshakaH |
dharmAtmA yaH sa kartA syAdadharmAtmA vinAshakaH
shlokas.9:
rAj~no bhAryAshcha putrAshcha bAndhavAH suhRRidastathA |
sametya sarve shochanti yadA rAjA pramAdyati
shlokas.10:
hastino.ashvAshcha gAvashchApyuShTrAshvataragardabhAH |
adharmavRRitte nRRipatau sarve sIdanti pArthiva
shlokas.11:
durbalArthaM balaM sRRiShTaM dhAtrA mAndhAtaruchyate |
abalaM tanmahadbhUtaM yasminsarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.12:
yachcha bhUtaM sa bhajate bhUtA ye cha tadanvayAH |
adharmasthe hi nRRipatau sarve sIdanti pArthiva
shlokas.13:
durbalasya hi yachchakShurmunerAshIviShasya cha |
aviShahyatamaM manye mA sma durbalamAsadaH
shlokas.14:
durbalA.nstAta budhyethA nityamevAvimAnitAn |
mA tvAM durbalachakShUMShi pradaheyuH sabAndhavam
shlokas.15:
na hi durbaladagdhasya kule ki~nchitprarohati |
AmUlaM nirdahatyeva mA sma durbalamAsadaH
shlokas.16:
abalaM vai balAchChreyo yachchAtibalavadbalam |
balasyAbaladagdhasya na ki~nchidavashiShyate
shlokas.17:
vimAnito hatotkruShTastrAtAraM chenna vindati |
amAnuShakRRitastatra daNDo hanti narAdhipam
shlokas.18:
mA sma tAta bale stheyA bAdhiShThA mApi durbalam |
mA tvA durbalachakShUMShi dhakShyantyagnirivAshrayam
shlokas.19:
yAni mithyAbhishastAnAM patantyashrUNi rodatAm |
tAni putrAnpashUnghnanti teShAM mithyAbhishAsatAm
shlokas.20:
yadi nAtmani putreShu na chetpautreShu naptRRiShu |
na hi pApaM kRRitaM karma sadyaH phalati gauriva
shlokas.21:
yatrAbalo vadhyamAnastrAtAraM nAdhigachChati |
mahAndaivakRRitastatra daNDaH patati dAruNaH
shlokas.22:
yuktA yadA jAnapadA bhikShante brAhmaNA iva |
abhIkShNaM bhikShudoSheNa rAjAnaM ghnanti tAdRRishAH
shlokas.23:
rAj~no yadA janapade bahavo rAjapUruShAH |
anayenopavartante tadrAj~naH kilbiShaM mahat
shlokas.24:
yadA yuktA nayantyarthAnkAmAdarthavashena vA |
kRRipaNaM yAchamAnAnAM tadrAj~no vaishasaM mahat
shlokas.25:
mahAvRRikSho jAyate vardhate cha; taM chaiva bhUtAni samAshrayanti |
yadA vRRikShashChidyate dahyate vA; tadAshrayA aniketA bhavanti
shlokas.26:
yadA rAShTre dharmamagryaM charanti; sa.nskAraM vA rAjaguNaM bruvANAH |
tairevAdharmashcharito dharmamohA;ttUrNaM jahyAtsukRRitaM duShkRRitaM cha
shlokas.27:
yatra pApA j~nAyamAnAshcharanti; satAM kalirvindati tatra rAj~naH |
yadA rAjA shAsti narAnnashiShyA;nna tadrAjyaM vardhate bhUmipAla
shlokas.28:
yashchAmAtyaM mAnayitvA yathArhaM; mantre cha yuddhe cha nRRipo niyu~njyAt |
pravardhate tasya rAShTraM nRRipasya; bhu~Nkte mahIM chApyakhilAM chirAya
shlokas.29:
atrApi sukRRitaM karma vAchaM chaiva subhAShitAm |
samIkShya pUjayanrAjA dharmaM prApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.30:
sa.nvibhajya yadA bhu~Nkte na chAnyAnavamanyate |
nihanti balinaM dRRiptaM sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.31:
trAyate hi yadA sarvaM vAchA kAyena karmaNA |
putrasyApi na mRRiShyechcha sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.32:
yadA shAraNikAnrAjA putravatparirakShati |
bhinatti na cha maryAdAM sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.33:
yadAptadakShiNairyaj~nairyajate shraddhayAnvitaH |
kAmadveShAvanAdRRitya sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.34:
kRRipaNAnAthavRRiddhAnAM yadAshru vyapamArShTi vai |
harShaM sa~njanayannR^INAM sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.35:
vivardhayati mitrANi tathArI.nshchApakarShati |
sampUjayati sAdhU.nshcha sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.36:
satyaM pAlayati prAptyA nityaM bhUmiM prayachChati |
pUjayatyatithInbhRRityAnsa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.37:
nigrahAnugrahau chobhau yatra syAtAM pratiShThitau |
asmi.Nlloke pare chaiva rAjA tatprApnute phalam
shlokas.38:
yamo rAjA dhArmikANAM mAndhAtaH parameshvaraH |
sa.nyachChanbhavati prANAnnasa.nyachCha.nstu pApakaH
shlokas.39:
RRitvikpurohitAchAryAnsatkRRityAnavamanya cha |
yadA samyakpragRRihNAti sa rAj~no dharma uchyate
shlokas.40:
yamo yachChati bhUtAni sarvANyevAvisheShataH |
tasya rAj~nAnukartavyaM yantavyA vidhivatprajAH
shlokas.41:
sahasrAkSheNa rAjA hi sarva evopamIyate |
sa pashyati hi yaM dharmaM sa dharmaH puruSharShabha
shlokas.42:
apramAdena shikShethAH kShamAM buddhiM dhRRitiM matim |
bhUtAnAM sattvajij~nAsAM sAdhvasAdhu cha sarvadA
shlokas.43:
sa~NgrahaH sarvabhUtAnAM dAnaM cha madhurA cha vAk |
paurajAnapadAshchaiva goptavyAH svA yathA prajAH
shlokas.44:
na jAtvadakSho nRRipatiH prajAH shaknoti rakShitum |
bhAro hi sumahA.nstAta rAjyaM nAma suduShkaram
shlokas.45:
taddaNDavinnRRipaH prAj~naH shUraH shaknoti rakShitum |
na hi shakyamadaNDena klIbenAbuddhinApi vA
shlokas.46:
abhirUpaiH kule jAtairdakShairbhaktairbahushrutaiH |
sarvA buddhIH parIkShethAstApasAshramiNAmapi
shlokas.47:
tatastvaM sarvabhUtAnAM dharmaM vetsyasi vai param |
svadeshe paradeshe vA na te dharmo vinashyati
shlokas.48:
dharmashchArthashcha kAmashcha dharma evottaro bhavet |
asmi.Nlloke pare chaiva dharmavitsukhamedhate
shlokas.49:
tyajanti dArAnprANA.nshcha manuShyAH pratipUjitAH |
sa~Ngrahashchaiva bhUtAnAM dAnaM cha madhurA cha vAk
shlokas.50:
apramAdashcha shauchaM cha tAta bhUtikaraM mahat |
etebhyashchaiva mAndhAtaH satataM mA pramAdithAH
shlokas.51:
apramatto bhavedrAjA ChidradarshI parAtmanoH |
nAsya ChidraM paraH pashyechChidreShu paramanviyAt
shlokas.52:
etadvRRittaM vAsavasya yamasya varuNasya cha |
rAjarShINAM cha sarveShAM tattvamapyanupAlaya
shlokas.53:
tatkuruShva mahArAja vRRittaM rAjarShisevitam |
AtiShTha divyaM panthAnamahnAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.54:
dharmavRRittaM hi rAjAnaM pretya cheha cha bhArata |
devarShipitRRigandharvAH kIrtayantyamitaujasaH
shlokas.55:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa evamukto mAndhAtA tenotathyena bhArata |
kRRitavAnavisha~NkastadekaH prApa cha medinIm
shlokas.56:
bhavAnapi tathA samya~NmAndhAteva mahIpatiH |
dharmaM kRRitvA mahIM rakShansvarge sthAnamavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM dharme sthAtumichChanrAjA varteta dhArmikaH |
pRRichChAmi tvA kurushreShTha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gItaM dRRiShTArthatattvena vAmadevena dhImatA
shlokas.3:
rAjA vasumanA nAma kausalyo balavA~nshuchiH |
maharShiM paripaprachCha vAmadevaM yashasvinam
shlokas.4:
dharmArthasahitaM vAkyaM bhagavannanushAdhi mAm |
yena vRRittena vai tiShThanna chyaveyaM svadharmataH
shlokas.5:
tamabravIdvAmadevastapasvI japatAM varaH |
hemavarNamupAsInaM yayAtimiva nAhuSham
shlokas.6:
dharmamevAnuvartasva na dharmAdvidyate param |
dharme sthitA hi rAjAno jayanti pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.7:
arthasiddheH paraM dharmaM manyate yo mahIpatiH |
RRitAM cha kurute buddhiM sa dharmeNa virochate
shlokas.8:
adharmadarshI yo rAjA balAdeva pravartate |
kShipramevApayAto.asmAdubhau prathamamadhyamau
shlokas.9:
asatpApiShThasachivo vadhyo lokasya dharmahA |
sahaiva parivAreNa kShipramevAvasIdati
shlokas.10:
arthAnAmananuShThAtA kAmachArI vikatthanaH |
api sarvAM mahIM labdhvA kShiprameva vinashyati
shlokas.11:
athAdadAnaH kalyANamanasUyurjitendriyaH |
vardhate matimAnrAjA srotobhiriva sAgaraH
shlokas.12:
na pUrNo.asmIti manyeta dharmataH kAmato.arthataH |
buddhito mitratashchApi satataM vasudhAdhipaH
shlokas.13:
eteShveva hi sarveShu lokayAtrA pratiShThitA |
etAni shRRiNva.Nllabhate yashaH kIrtiM shriyaH prajAH
shlokas.14:
evaM yo dharmasa.nrambhI dharmArthaparichintakaH |
arthAnsamIkShyArabhate sa dhruvaM mahadashnute
shlokas.15:
adAtA hyanatisneho daNDenAvartayanprajAH |
sAhasaprakRRitI rAjA kShiprameva vinashyati
shlokas.16:
atha pApaM kRRitaM buddhyA na cha pashyatyabuddhimAn |
akIrtyApi samAyukto mRRito narakamashnute
shlokas.17:
atha mAnayiturdAtuH shuklasya rasavedinaH |
vyasanaM svamivotpannaM vijighA.nsanti mAnavAH
shlokas.18:
yasya nAsti gururdharme na chAnyAnanupRRichChati |
sukhatantro.arthalAbheShu na chiraM mahadashnute
shlokas.19:
gurupradhAno dharmeShu svayamarthAnvavekShitA |
dharmapradhAno lokeShu suchiraM mahadashnute

shlokas.1:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
yatrAdharmaM praNayate durbale balavattaraH |
tAM vRRittimupajIvanti ye bhavanti tadanvayAH
shlokas.2:
rAjAnamanuvartante taM pApAbhipravartakam |
avinItamanuShyaM tatkShipraM rAShTraM vinashyati
shlokas.3:
yadvRRittimupajIvanti prakRRitisthasya mAnavAH |
tadeva viShamasthasya svajano.api na mRRiShyate
shlokas.4:
sAhasaprakRRitiryatra kurute ki~nchidulbaNam |
ashAstralakShaNo rAjA kShiprameva vinashyati
shlokas.5:
yo.atyantAcharitAM vRRittiM kShatriyo nAnuvartate |
jitAnAmajitAnAM cha kShatradharmAdapaiti saH
shlokas.6:
dviShantaM kRRitakarmANaM gRRihItvA nRRipatI raNe |
yo na mAnayate dveShAtkShatradharmAdapaiti saH
shlokas.7:
shaktaH syAtsumukho rAjA kuryAtkAruNyamApadi |
priyo bhavati bhUtAnAM na cha vibhrashyate shriyaH
shlokas.8:
apriyaM yasya kurvIta bhUyastasya priyaM charet |
nachireNa priyaH sa syAdyo.apriyaH priyamAcharet
shlokas.9:
mRRiShAvAdaM pariharetkuryAtpriyamayAchitaH |
na cha kAmAnna sa.nrambhAnna dveShAddharmamutsRRijet
shlokas.10:
nApatrapeta prashneShu nAbhibhavyAM giraM sRRijet |
na tvareta na chAsUyettathA sa~NgRRihyate paraH
shlokas.11:
priye nAtibhRRishaM hRRiShyedapriye na cha sa~njvaret |
na muhyedarthakRRichChreShu prajAhitamanusmaran
shlokas.12:
yaH priyaM kurute nityaM guNato vasudhAdhipaH |
tasya karmANi sidhyanti na cha santyajyate shriyA
shlokas.13:
nivRRittaM pratikUlebhyo vartamAnamanupriye |
bhaktaM bhajeta nRRipatistadvai vRRittaM satAmiha
shlokas.14:
aprakIrNendriyaM prAj~namatyantAnugataM shuchim |
shaktaM chaivAnuraktaM cha yu~njyAnmahati karmaNi
shlokas.15:
evameva guNairyukto yo na rajyati bhUmipam |
bharturartheShvasUyantaM na taM yu~njIta karmaNi
shlokas.16:
mUDhamaindriyakaM lubdhamanAryacharitaM shaTham |
anatItopadhaM hi.nsraM durbuddhimabahushrutam
shlokas.17:
tyaktopAttaM madyarataM dyUtastrImRRigayAparam |
kArye mahati yo yu~njyAddhIyate sa nRRipaH shriyaH
shlokas.18:
rakShitAtmA tu yo rAjA rakShyAnyashchAnurakShati |
prajAshcha tasya vardhante dhruvaM cha mahadashnute
shlokas.19:
ye kechidbhUmipatayastAnsarvAnanvavekShayet |
suhRRidbhiranabhikhyAtaistena rAjA na riShyate
shlokas.20:
apakRRitya balasthasya dUrastho.asmIti nAshvaset |
shyenAnucharitairhyete nipatanti pramAdyataH
shlokas.21:
dRRiDhamUlastvaduShTAtmA viditvA balamAtmanaH |
abalAnabhiyu~njIta na tu ye balavattarAH
shlokas.22:
vikrameNa mahIM labdhvA prajA dharmeNa pAlayan |
Ahave nidhanaM kuryAdrAjA dharmaparAyaNaH
shlokas.23:
maraNAntamidaM sarvaM neha ki~nchidanAmayam |
tasmAddharme sthito rAjA prajA dharmeNa pAlayet
shlokas.24:
rakShAdhikaraNaM yuddhaM tathA dharmAnushAsanam |
mantrachintyaM sukhaM kAle pa~nchabhirvardhate mahI
shlokas.25:
etAni yasya guptAni sa rAjA rAjasattama |
satataM vartamAno.atra rAjA bhu~Nkte mahImimAm
shlokas.26:
naitAnyekena shakyAni sAtatyenAnvavekShitum |
eteShvAptAnpratiShThApya rAjA bhu~Nkte mahIM chiram
shlokas.27:
dAtAraM sa.nvibhaktAraM mArdavopagataM shuchim |
asantyaktamanuShyaM cha taM janAH kurvate priyam
shlokas.28:
yastu niHshreyasaM j~nAtvA j~nAnaM tatpratipadyate |
Atmano matamutsRRijya taM loko.anuvidhIyate
shlokas.29:
yo.arthakAmasya vachanaM prAtikUlyAnna mRRiShyate |
shRRiNoti pratikUlAni vimanA nachirAdiva
shlokas.30:
agrAmyacharitAM buddhimatyantaM yo na budhyate |
jitAnAmajitAnAM cha kShatradharmAdapaiti saH
shlokas.31:
mukhyAnamAtyAnyo hitvA nihInAnkurute priyAn |
sa vai vyasanamAsAdya gAdhamArto na vindati
shlokas.32:
yaH kalyANaguNA~nj~nAtIndveShAnnaivAbhimanyate |
adRRiDhAtmA dRRiDhakrodho nAsyArtho ramate.antike
shlokas.33:
atha yo guNasampannAnhRRidayasyApriyAnapi |
priyeNa kurute vashyA.nshchiraM yashasi tiShThati
shlokas.34:
nAkAle praNayedarthAnnApriye jAtu sa~njvaret |
priye nAtibhRRishaM hRRiShyedyujyetArogyakarmaNi
shlokas.35:
ke mAnuraktA rAjAnaH ke bhayAtsamupAshritAH |
madhyasthadoShAH ke chaiShAmiti nityaM vichintayet
shlokas.36:
na jAtu balavAnbhUtvA durbale vishvasetkvachit |
bhAruNDasadRRishA hyete nipatanti pramAdyataH
shlokas.37:
api sarvairguNairyuktaM bhartAraM priyavAdinam |
abhidruhyati pApAtmA tasmAddhi vibhiShejjanAt
shlokas.38:
etAM rAjopaniShadaM yayAtiH smAha nAhuShaH |
manuShyavijaye yukto hanti shatrUnanuttamAn

shlokas.1:
vAmadeva uvAcha||
ayuddhenaiva vijayaM vardhayedvasudhAdhipaH |
jaghanyamAhurvijayaM yo yuddhena narAdhipa
shlokas.2:
na chApyalabdhaM lipseta mUle nAtidRRiDhe sati |
na hi durbalamUlasya rAj~no lAbho vidhIyate
shlokas.3:
yasya sphIto janapadaH sampannaH priyarAjakaH |
santuShTapuShTasachivo dRRiDhamUlaH sa pArthivaH
shlokas.4:
yasya yodhAH susantuShTAH sAntvitAH sUpadhAsthitAH |
alpenApi sa daNDena mahIM jayati bhUmipaH
shlokas.5:
paurajAnapadA yasya svanuraktAH supUjitAH |
sadhanA dhAnyavantashcha dRRiDhamUlaH sa pArthivaH
shlokas.6:
prabhAvakAlAvadhikau yadA manyeta chAtmanaH |
tadA lipseta medhAvI parabhUmiM dhanAnyuta
shlokas.7:
bhogeShvadayamAnasya bhUteShu cha dayAvataH |
vardhate tvaramANasya viShayo rakShitAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
takShatyAtmAnamevaiSha vanaM parashunA yathA |
yaH samyagvartamAneShu sveShu mithyA pravartate
shlokas.9:
na vai dviShantaH kShIyante rAj~no nityamapi ghnataH |
krodhaM niyantuM yo veda tasya dveShTA na vidyate
shlokas.10:
yadAryajanavidviShTaM karma tannAcharedbudhaH |
yatkalyANamabhidhyAyettatrAtmAnaM niyojayet
shlokas.11:
nainamanye.avajAnanti nAtmanA paritapyate |
kRRityasheSheNa yo rAjA sukhAnyanububhUShati
shlokas.12:
ida.nvRRittaM manuShyeShu vartate yo mahIpatiH |
ubhau lokau vinirjitya vijaye sampratiShThate
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityukto vAmadevena sarvaM tatkRRitavAnnRRipaH |
tathA kurva.nstvamapyetau lokau jetA na sa.nshayaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atha yo vijigISheta kShatriyaH kShatriyaM yudhi |
kastasya dharmyo vijaya etatpRRiShTo bravIhi me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sasahAyo.asahAyo vA rAShTramAgamya bhUmipaH |
brUyAdahaM vo rAjeti rakShiShyAmi cha vaH sadA
shlokas.3:
mama dharmyaM baliM datta kiM vA mAM pratipatsyatha |
te chettamAgataM tatra vRRiNuyuH kushalaM bhavet
shlokas.4:
te chedakShatriyAH santo virudhyeyuH katha~nchana |
sarvopAyairniyantavyA vikarmasthA narAdhipa
shlokas.5:
ashaktaM kShatriyaM matvA shastraM gRRihNAtyathAparaH |
trANAyApyasamarthaM taM manyamAnamatIva cha
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atha yaH kShatriyo rAjA kShatriyaM pratyupAvrajet |
kathaM sa pratiyoddhavyastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAsaMnaddho nAkavacho yoddhavyaH kShatriyo raNe |
eka ekena vAchyashcha visRRijasva kShipAmi cha
shlokas.8:
sa chetsaMnaddha AgachChetsaMnaddhavyaM tato bhavet |
sa chetsasainya AgachChetsasainyastamathAhvayet
shlokas.9:
sa chennikRRityA yudhyeta nikRRityA taM prayodhayet |
atha cheddharmato yudhyeddharmeNaiva nivArayet
shlokas.10:
nAshvena rathinaM yAyAdudiyAdrathinaM rathI |
vyasane na prahartavyaM na bhItAya jitAya cha
shlokas.11:
neShurlipto na karNI syAdasatAmetadAyudham |
jayArthameva yoddhavyaM na krudhyedajighA.nsataH
shlokas.12:
sAdhUnAM tu mithobhedAtsAdhushchedvyasanI bhavet |
savraNo nAbhihantavyo nAnapatyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.13:
bhagnashastro vipannAshvashChinnajyo hatavAhanaH |
chikitsyaH syAtsvaviShaye prApyo vA svagRRihAnbhavet
nirvraNo.api cha moktavya eSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.14:
tasmAddharmeNa yoddhavyaM manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt |
satsu nityaM satAM dharmastamAsthAya na nAshayet
shlokas.15:
yo vai jayatyadharmeNa kShatriyo vardhamAnakaH |
AtmAnamAtmanA hanti pApo nikRRitijIvanaH
shlokas.16:
karma chaitadasAdhUnAmasAdhuM sAdhunA jayet |
dharmeNa nidhanaM shreyo na jayaH pApakarmaNA
shlokas.17:
nAdharmashcharito rAjansadyaH phalati gauriva |
mUlAnyasya prashAkhAshcha dahansamanugachChati
shlokas.18:
pApena karmaNA vittaM labdhvA pApaH prahRRiShyati |
sa vardhamAnaH steyena pApaH pApe prasajjati
shlokas.19:
na dharmo.astIti manvAnaH shuchInavahasanniva |
ashraddadhAnabhAvAchcha vinAshamupagachChati
shlokas.20:
sa baddho vAruNaiH pAshairamartya iva manyate |
mahAdRRitirivAdhmAtaH svakRRitena vivardhate
shlokas.21:
tataH samUlo hriyate nadIkUlAdiva drumaH |
athainamabhinindanti bhinnaM kumbhamivAshmani
tasmAddharmeNa vijayaM kAmaM lipseta bhUmipaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAdharmeNa mahIM jetuM lipseta jagatIpatiH |
adharmavijayaM labdhvA ko.anumanyeta bhUmipaH
shlokas.2:
adharmayukto vijayo hyadhruvo.asvargya eva cha |
sAdayatyeSha rAjAnaM mahIM cha bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
vishIrNakavachaM chaiva tavAsmIti cha vAdinam |
kRRitA~njaliM nyastashastraM gRRihItvA na vihi.nsayet
shlokas.4:
balenAvajito yashcha na taM yudhyeta bhUmipaH |
sa.nvatsaraM vipraNayettasmAjjAtaH punarbhavet
shlokas.5:
nArvAksa.nvatsarAtkanyA spraShTavyA vikramAhRRitA |
evameva dhanaM sarvaM yachchAnyatsahasAhRRitam
shlokas.6:
na tu vandhyaM dhanaM tiShThetpibeyurbrAhmaNAH payaH |
yu~njIranvApyanaDuhaH kShantavyaM vA tadA bhavet
shlokas.7:
rAj~nA rAjaiva yoddhavyastathA dharmo vidhIyate |
nAnyo rAjAnamabhyasedarAjanyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.8:
anIkayoH saMhatayoryadIyAdbrAhmaNo.antarA |
shAntimichChannubhayato na yoddhavyaM tadA bhavet
maryAdAM shAshvatIM bhindyAdbrAhmaNaM yo.abhila~Nghayet
shlokas.9:
atha chella~NghayedenAM maryAdAM kShatriyabruvaH |
aprashasyastadUrdhvaM syAdanAdeyashcha sa.nsadi
shlokas.10:
yA tu dharmavilopena maryAdAbhedanena cha |
tAM vRRittiM nAnuvarteta vijigIShurmahIpatiH
dharmalabdhAddhi vijayAtko lAbho.abhyadhiko bhavet
shlokas.11:
sahasA nAmya bhUtAni kShiprameva prasAdayet |
sAntvena bhogadAnena sa rAj~nAM paramo nayaH
shlokas.12:
bhujyamAnA hyayogena svarAShTrAdabhitApitAH |
amitrAnparyupAsIranvyasanaughapratIkShiNaH
shlokas.13:
amitropagrahaM chAsya te kuryuH kShipramApadi |
sa.nduShTAH sarvato rAjanrAjavyasanakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.14:
nAmitro vinikartavyo nAtichChedyaH katha~nchana |
jIvitaM hyapyatichChinnaH santyajatyekadA naraH
shlokas.15:
alpenApi hi sa.nyuktastuShyatyevAparAdhikaH |
shuddhaM jIvitamevApi tAdRRisho bahu manyate
shlokas.16:
yasya sphIto janapadaH sampannaH priyarAjakaH |
santuShTabhRRityasachivo dRRiDhamUlaH sa pArthivaH
shlokas.17:
RRitvikpurohitAchAryA ye chAnye shrutasaMmatAH |
pUjArhAH pUjitA yasya sa vai lokajiduchyate
shlokas.18:
etenaiva cha vRRittena mahIM prApa surottamaH |
anveva chaindraM vijayaM vyajigIShanta pArthivAH
shlokas.19:
bhUmivarjaM puraM rAjA jitvA rAjAnamAhave |
amRRitAshchauShadhIH shashvadAjahAra pratardanaH
shlokas.20:
agnihotrANyagnisheShaM havirbhAjanameva cha |
AjahAra divodAsastato viprakRRito.abhavat
shlokas.21:
sarAjakAni rAShTrANi nAbhAgo dakShiNAM dadau |
anyatra shrotriyasvAchcha tApasasvAchcha bhArata
shlokas.22:
uchchAvachAni vRRittAni dharmaj~nAnAM yudhiShThira |
AsanrAj~nAM purANAnAM sarvaM tanmama rochate
shlokas.23:
sarvavidyAtirekAdvA jayamichChenmahIpatiH |
na mAyayA na dambhena ya ichChedbhUtimAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kShatradharmAnna pApIyAndharmo.asti bharatarShabha |
abhiyAne cha yuddhe cha rAjA hanti mahAjanam
shlokas.2:
atha sma karmaNA yena lokA~njayati pArthivaH |
vidva~njij~nAsamAnAya prabrUhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nigraheNa cha pApAnAM sAdhUnAM pragraheNa cha |
yaj~nairdAnaishcha rAjAno bhavanti shuchayo.amalAH
shlokas.4:
uparundhanti rAjAno bhUtAni vijayArthinaH |
ta eva vijayaM prApya vardhayanti punaH prajAH
shlokas.5:
apavidhyanti pApAni dAnayaj~natapobalaiH |
anugraheNa bhUtAnAM puNyameShAM pravardhate
shlokas.6:
yathaiva kShetranirdAtA nirdanvai kShetramekadA |
hinasti kakShaM dhAnyaM cha na cha dhAnyaM vinashyati
shlokas.7:
evaM shastrANi mu~nchanto ghnanti vadhyAnathaikadA |
tasyaiShA niShkRRitiH kRRitsnA bhUtAnAM bhAvanaM punaH
shlokas.8:
yo bhUtAni dhanajyAnAdvadhAtkleshAchcha rakShati |
dasyubhyaH prANadAnAtsa dhanadaH sukhado virAT
shlokas.9:
sa sarvayaj~nairIjAno rAjAthAbhayadakShiNaiH |
anubhUyeha bhadrANi prApnotIndrasalokatAm
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNArthe samutpanne yo.abhiniHsRRitya yudhyate |
AtmAnaM yUpamuchChritya sa yaj~no.anantadakShiNaH
shlokas.11:
abhIto vikira~nshatrUnpratigRRihNa~nsharA.nstathA |
na tasmAttridashAH shreyo bhuvi pashyanti ki~nchana
shlokas.12:
tasya yAvanti shastrANi tvachaM bhindanti sa.nyuge |
tAvataH so.ashnute lokAnsarvakAmaduho.akShayAn
shlokas.13:
na tasya rudhiraM gAtrAdAvedhebhyaH pravartate |
sa ha tenaiva raktena sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.14:
yAni duHkhAni sahate vraNAnAmabhitApane |
na tato.asti tapo bhUya iti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.15:
pRRiShThato bhIravaH sa~Nkhye vartante.adhamapUruShAH |
shUrAchCharaNamichChantaH parjanyAdiva jIvanam
shlokas.16:
yadi shUrastathA kSheme pratirakShettathA bhaye |
pratirUpaM janAH kuryurna cha tadvartate tathA
shlokas.17:
yadi te kRRitamAj~nAya namaskuryuH sadaiva tam |
yuktaM nyAyyaM cha kuryuste na cha tadvartate tathA
shlokas.18:
puruShANAM samAnAnAM dRRishyate mahadantaram |
sa~NgrAme.anIkavelAyAmutkruShTe.abhipatatsu cha
shlokas.19:
patatyabhimukhaH shUraH parAnbhIruH palAyate |
AsthAyAsvargyamadhvAnaM sahAyAnviShame tyajan
shlokas.20:
mA sma tA.nstAdRRishA.nstAta janiShThAH puruShAdhamAn |
ye sahAyAnraNe hitvA svastimanto gRRihAnyayuH
shlokas.21:
asvasti tebhyaH kurvanti devA indrapurogamAH |
tyAgena yaH sahAyAnAM svAnprANA.nstrAtumichChati
shlokas.22:
taM hanyuH kAShThaloShTairvA daheyurvA kaTAgninA |
pashuvanmArayeyurvA kShatriyA ye syurIdRRishAH
shlokas.23:
adharmaH kShatriyasyaiSha yachChayyAmaraNaM bhavet |
visRRija~nshleShmapittAni kRRipaNaM paridevayan
shlokas.24:
avikShatena dehena pralayaM yo.adhigachChati |
kShatriyo nAsya tatkarma prasha.nsanti purAvidaH
shlokas.25:
na gRRihe maraNaM tAta kShatriyANAM prashasyate |
shauTIrANAmashauTIramadharmyaM kRRipaNaM cha tat
shlokas.26:
idaM duHkhamaho kaShTaM pApIya iti niShTanan |
pratidhvastamukhaH pUtiramAtyAnbahu shochayan
shlokas.27:
arogANAM spRRihayate muhurmRRityumapIchChati |
vIro dRRipto.abhimAnI cha nedRRishaM mRRityumarhati
shlokas.28:
raNeShu kadanaM kRRitvA j~nAtibhiH parivAritaH |
tIkShNaiH shastraiH suvikliShTaH kShatriyo mRRityumarhati
shlokas.29:
shUro hi satyamanyubhyAmAviShTo yudhyate bhRRisham |
kRRityamAnAni gAtrANi parairnaivAvabudhyate
shlokas.30:
sa sa~Nkhye nidhanaM prApya prashastaM lokapUjitam |
svadharmaM vipulaM prApya shakrasyaiti salokatAm
shlokas.31:
sarvo yodhaH paraM tyaktumAviShTastyaktajIvitaH |
prApnotIndrasya sAlokyaM shUraH pRRiShThamadarshayan

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ke lokA yudhyamAnAnAM shUrANAmanivartinAm |
bhavanti nidhanaM prApya tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
ambarIShasya sa.nvAdamindrasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
ambarISho hi nAbhAgaH svargaM gatvA sudurlabham |
dadarsha suralokasthaM shakreNa sachivaM saha
shlokas.4:
sarvatejomayaM divyaM vimAnavaramAsthitam |
uparyupari gachChantaM svaM vai senApatiM prabhum
shlokas.5:
sa dRRiShTvopari gachChantaM senApatimudAradhIH |
RRiddhiM dRRiShTvA sudevasya vismitaH prAha vAsavam
shlokas.6:
sAgarAntAM mahIM kRRitsnAmanushiShya yathAvidhi |
chAturvarNye yathAshAstraM pravRRitto dharmakAmyayA
shlokas.7:
brahmacharyeNa ghoreNa AchAryakulasevayA |
vedAnadhItya dharmeNa rAjashAstraM cha kevalam
shlokas.8:
atithInannapAnena pitR^I.nshcha svadhayA tathA |
RRiShInsvAdhyAyadIkShAbhirdevAnyaj~nairanuttamaiH
shlokas.9:
kShatradharme sthito bhUtvA yathAshAstraM yathAvidhi |
udIkShamANaH pRRitanAM jayAmi yudhi vAsava
shlokas.10:
devarAja sudevo.ayaM mama senApatiH purA |
AsIdyodhaH prashAntAtmA so.ayaM kasmAdatIva mAm
shlokas.11:
nAnena kratubhirmukhyairiShTaM naiva dvijAtayaH |
tarpitA vidhivachChakra so.ayaM kasmAdatIva mAm
shlokas.12:
indra uvAcha||
etasya vitatastAta sudevasya babhUva ha |
sa~NgrAmayaj~naH sumahAnyashchAnyo yudhyate naraH
shlokas.13:
saMnaddho dIkShitaH sarvo yodhaH prApya chamUmukham |
yuddhayaj~nAdhikArastho bhavatIti vinishchayaH
shlokas.14:
ambarISha uvAcha||
kAni yaj~ne havIMShyatra kimAjyaM kA cha dakShiNA |
RRitvijashchAtra ke proktAstanme brUhi shatakrato
shlokas.15:
indra uvAcha||
RRitvijaH ku~njarAstatra vAjino.adhvaryavastathA |
havIMShi paramA.nsAni rudhiraM tvAjyameva cha
shlokas.16:
sRRigAlagRRidhrakAkolAH sadasyAstatra satriNaH |
AjyasheShaM pibantyete haviH prAshnanti chAdhvare
shlokas.17:
prAsatomarasa~NghAtAH khaDgashaktiparashvadhAH |
jvalanto nishitAH pItAH sruchastasyAtha satriNaH
shlokas.18:
chApavegAyatastIkShNaH parakAyAvadAraNaH |
RRijuH sunishitaH pItaH sAyako.asya sruvo mahAn
shlokas.19:
dvIpicharmAvanaddhashcha nAgadantakRRitatsaruH |
hastihastagataH khaDgaH sphyo bhavettasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.20:
jvalitairnishitaiH pItaiH prAsashaktiparashvadhaiH |
shaikyAyasamayaistIkShNairabhighAto bhavedvasu
shlokas.21:
AvegAdyattu rudhiraM sa~NgrAme syandate bhuvi |
sAsya pUrNAhutirhotre samRRiddhA sarvakAmadhuk
shlokas.22:
Chindhi bhindhIti yasyaitachChrUyate vAhinImukhe |
sAmAni sAmagAstasya gAyanti yamasAdane
shlokas.23:
havirdhAnaM tu tasyAhuH pareShAM vAhinImukham |
ku~njarANAM hayAnAM cha varmiNAM cha samuchchayaH
agniH shyenachito nAma tasya yaj~ne vidhIyate
shlokas.24:
uttiShThati kabandho.atra sahasre nihate tu yaH |
sa yUpastasya shUrasya khAdiro.aShTAshriruchyate
shlokas.25:
iDopahUtaM kroshanti ku~njarA a~NkusheritAH |
vyAghuShTatalanAdena vaShaTkAreNa pArthiva
udgAtA tatra sa~NgrAme trisAmA dundubhiH smRRitaH
shlokas.26:
brahmasve hriyamANe yaH priyAM yuddhe tanuM tyajet |
AtmAnaM yUpamuchChritya sa yaj~no.anantadakShiNaH
shlokas.27:
bharturarthe tu yaH shUro vikramedvAhinImukhe |
bhayAnna cha nivarteta tasya lokA yathA mama
shlokas.28:
nIlachandrAkRRitaiH khaDgairbAhubhiH parighopamaiH |
yasya vedirupastIrNA tasya lokA yathA mama
shlokas.29:
yastu nAvekShate ka~nchitsahAyaM vijaye sthitaH |
vigAhya vAhinImadhyaM tasya lokA yathA mama
shlokas.30:
yasya tomarasa~NghATA bherImaNDUkakachChapA |
vIrAsthisharkarA durgA mA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.31:
asicharmaplavA sindhuH keshashaivalashAdvalA |
ashvanAgarathaishchaiva sambhinnaiH kRRitasa~NkramA
shlokas.32:
patAkAdhvajavAnIrA hatavAhanavAhinI |
shoNitodA susampUrNA dustarA pAragairnaraiH
shlokas.33:
hatanAgamahAnakrA paralokavahAshivA |
RRiShTikhaDgadhvajAnUkA gRRidhraka~NkavaDaplavA
shlokas.34:
puruShAdAnucharitA bhIrUNAM kashmalAvahA |
nadI yodhamahAyaj~ne tadasyAvabhRRithaM smRRitam
shlokas.35:
vedI yasya tvamitrANAM shirobhiravakIryate |
ashvaskandhairgajaskandhaistasya lokA yathA mama
shlokas.36:
patnIshAlA kRRitA yasya pareShAM vAhinImukham |
havirdhAnaM svavAhinyastadasyAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.37:
sadashchAntarayodhAgnirAgnIdhrashchottarAM disham |
shatrusenAkalatrasya sarvalokAnadUrataH
shlokas.38:
yadA tUbhayato vyUho bhavatyAkAshamagrataH |
sAsya vedI tathA yaj~ne nityaM vedAstrayo.agnayaH
shlokas.39:
yastu yodhaH parAvRRittaH santrasto hanyate paraiH |
apratiShThaM sa narakaM yAti nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.40:
yasya shoNitavegena nadI syAtsamabhiplutA |
keshamA.nsAsthisa~NkIrNA sa gachChetparamAM gatim
shlokas.41:
yastu senApatiM hatvA tadyAnamadhirohati |
sa viShNuvikramakrAmI bRRihaspatisamaH kratuH
shlokas.42:
nAyakaM vA pramANaM vA yo vA syAttatra pUjitaH |
jIvagrAhaM nigRRihNAti tasya lokA yathA mama
shlokas.43:
Ahave nihataM shUraM na shocheta kadAchana |
ashochyo hi hataH shUraH svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.44:
na hyannaM nodakaM tasya na snAnaM nApyashauchakam |
hatasya kartumichChanti tasya lokA~nshRRiNuShva me
shlokas.45:
varApsaraHsahasrANi shUramAyodhane hatam |
tvaramANA hi dhAvanti mama bhartA bhavediti
shlokas.46:
etattapashcha puNyaM cha dharmashchaiva sanAtanaH |
chatvArashchAshramAstasya yo yuddhe na palAyate
shlokas.47:
vRRiddhaM balaM na hantavyaM naiva strI na cha vai dvijaH |
tRRiNapUrNamukhashchaiva tavAsmIti cha yo vadet
shlokas.48:
ahaM vRRitraM balaM pAkaM shatamAyaM virochanam |
durAvAryaM cha namuchiM naikamAyaM cha shambaram
shlokas.49:
viprachittiM cha daiteyaM danoH putrA.nshcha sarvashaH |
prahrAdaM cha nihatyAjau tato devAdhipo.abhavam
shlokas.50:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityetachChakravachanaM nishamya pratigRRihya cha |
yodhAnAmAtmanaH siddhimambarISho.abhipannavAn

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
pratardano maithilashcha sa~NgrAmaM yatra chakratuH
shlokas.2:
yaj~nopavItI sa~NgrAme janako maithilo yathA |
yodhAnuddharShayAmAsa tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
janako maithilo rAjA mahAtmA sarvatattvavit |
yodhAnsvAndarshayAmAsa svargaM narakameva cha
shlokas.4:
abhItAnAmime lokA bhAsvanto hanta pashyata |
pUrNA gandharvakanyAbhiH sarvakAmaduho.akShayAH
shlokas.5:
ime palAyamAnAnAM narakAH pratyupasthitAH |
akIrtiH shAshvatI chaiva patitavyamanantaram
shlokas.6:
tAndRRiShTvArInvijayato bhUtvA santyAgabuddhayaH |
narakasyApratiShThasya mA bhUta vashavartinaH
shlokas.7:
tyAgamUlaM hi shUrANAM svargadvAramanuttamam |
ityuktAste nRRipatinA yodhAH parapura~njaya
shlokas.8:
vyajayanta raNe shatrUnharShayanto janeshvaram |
tasmAdAtmavatA nityaM sthAtavyaM raNamUrdhani
shlokas.9:
gajAnAM rathino madhye rathAnAmanu sAdinaH |
sAdinAmantarA sthApyaM pAdAtamiha da.nshitam
shlokas.10:
ya evaM vyUhate rAjA sa nityaM jayate dviShaH |
tasmAdevaM vidhAtavyaM nityameva yudhiShThira
shlokas.11:
sarve sukRRitamichChantaH suyuddhenAtimanyavaH |
kShobhayeyuranIkAni sAgaraM makarA iva
shlokas.12:
harShayeyurviShaNNA.nshcha vyavasthApya parasparam |
jitAM cha bhUmiM rakSheta bhagnAnnAtyanusArayet
shlokas.13:
punarAvartamAnAnAM nirAshAnAM cha jIvite |
na vegaH susaho rAja.nstasmAnnAtyanusArayet
shlokas.14:
na hi prahartumichChanti shUrAH prAdravatAM bhayAt |
tasmAtpalAyamAnAnAM kuryAnnAtyanusAraNam
shlokas.15:
charANAmacharA hyannamadaMShTrA daMShTriNAmapi |
apANayaH pANimatAmannaM shUrasya kAtarAH
shlokas.16:
samAnapRRiShThodarapANipAdAH; pashchAchChUraM bhIravo.anuvrajanti |
ato bhayArtAH praNipatya bhUyaH; kRRitvA~njalInupatiShThanti shUrAn
shlokas.17:
shUrabAhuShu loko.ayaM lambate putravatsadA |
tasmAtsarvAsvavasthAsu shUraH saMmAnamarhati
shlokas.18:
na hi shauryAtparaM ki~nchittriShu lokeShu vidyate |
shUraH sarvaM pAlayati sarvaM shUre pratiShThitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yathA jayArthinaH senAM nayanti bharatarShabha |
IShaddharmaM prapIDyApi tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
satyena hi sthitA dharmA upapattyA tathApare |
sAdhvAchAratayA kechittathaivaupayikA api
upAyadharmAnvakShyAmi siddhArthAnarthadharmayoH
shlokas.3:
nirmaryAdA dasyavastu bhavanti paripanthinaH |
teShAM prativighAtArthaM pravakShyAmyatha naigamam
kAryANAM samprasiddhyarthaM tAnupAyAnnibodha me
shlokas.4:
ubhe praj~ne veditavye RRijvI vakrA cha bhArata |
jAnanvakrAM na seveta pratibAdheta chAgatAm
shlokas.5:
amitrA eva rAjAnaM bhedenopacharantyuta |
tAM rAjA nikRRitiM jAnanyathAmitrAnprabAdhate
shlokas.6:
gajAnAM pArshvacharmANi govRRiShAjagarANi cha |
shalyaka~NkaTalohAni tanutrANi matAni cha
shlokas.7:
shitapItAni shastrANi saMnAhAH pItalohitAH |
nAnAra~njanaraktAH syuH patAkAH ketavashcha te
shlokas.8:
RRiShTayastomarAH khaDgA nishitAshcha parashvadhAH |
phalakAnyatha charmANi pratikalpyAnyanekashaH
abhinItAni shastrANi yodhAshcha kRRitanishramAH
shlokas.9:
chaitryAM vA mArgashIrShyAM vA senAyogaH prashasyate |
pakvasasyA hi pRRithivI bhavatyambumatI tathA
shlokas.10:
naivAtishIto nAtyuShNaH kAlo bhavati bhArata |
tasmAttadA yojayeta pareShAM vyasaneShu vA
eteShu yogAH senAyAH prashastAH parabAdhane
shlokas.11:
jalavA.nstRRiNavAnmArgaH samo gamyaH prashasyate |
chArairhi vihitAbhyAsaH kushalairvanagocharaiH
shlokas.12:
navyAraNyairna shakyeta gantuM mRRigagaNairiva |
tasmAtsarvAsu senAsu yojayanti jayArthinaH
shlokas.13:
AvAsastoyavAndurgaH paryAkAshaH prashasyate |
pareShAmupasarpANAM pratiShedhastathA bhavet
shlokas.14:
AkAshaM tu vanAbhyAshe manyante guNavattaram |
bahubhirguNajAtaistu ye yuddhakushalA janAH
shlokas.15:
upanyAso.apasarpANAM padAtInAM cha gUhanam |
atha shatrupratIghAtamApadarthaM parAyaNam
shlokas.16:
saptarShInpRRiShThataH kRRitvA yudhyerannachalA iva |
anena vidhinA rAja~njigIShetApi durjayAn
shlokas.17:
yato vAyuryataH sUryo yataH shukrastato jayaH |
pUrvaM pUrvaM jyAya eShAM saMnipAte yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
akardamAmanudakAmamaryAdAmaloShTakAm |
ashvabhUmiM prasha.nsanti ye yuddhakushalA janAH
shlokas.19:
samA nirudakAkAshA rathabhUmiH prashasyate |
nIchadrumA mahAkakShA sodakA hastiyodhinAm
shlokas.20:
bahudurgA mahAvRRikShA vetraveNubhirAstRRitA |
padAtInAM kShamA bhUmiH parvatopavanAni cha
shlokas.21:
padAtibahulA senA dRRiDhA bhavati bhArata |
rathAshvabahulA senA sudineShu prashasyate
shlokas.22:
padAtinAgabahulA prAvRRiTkAle prashasyate |
guNAnetAnprasa~NkhyAya deshakAlau prayojayet
shlokas.23:
evaM sa~nchintya yo yAti tithinakShatrapUjitaH |
vijayaM labhate nityaM senAM samyakprayojayan
shlokas.24:
prasuptA.nstRRiShitA~nshrAntAnprakIrNAnnAbhighAtayet |
mokShe prayANe chalane pAnabhojanakAlayoH
shlokas.25:
atikShiptAnvyatikShiptAnvihatAnpratanUkRRitAn |
suvisrambhAnkRRitArambhAnupanyAsapratApitAn
bahishcharAnupanyAsAnkRRitvA veshmAnusAriNaH
shlokas.26:
pAramparyAgate dvAre ye kechidanuvartinaH |
paricharyAvaroddhAro ye cha kechana valginaH
shlokas.27:
anIkaM ye prabhindanti bhinnaM ye sthagayanti cha |
samAnAshanapAnAste kAryA dviguNavetanAH
shlokas.28:
dashAdhipatayaH kAryAH shatAdhipatayastathA |
teShAM sahasrAdhipatiM kuryAchChUramatandritam
shlokas.29:
yathAmukhyaM saMnipAtya vaktavyAH sma shapAmahe |
yathA jayArthaM sa~NgrAme na jahyAma parasparam
shlokas.30:
ihaiva te nivartantAM ye naH kechana bhIravaH |
na ghAtayeyuH pradaraM kurvANAstumule sati
shlokas.31:
AtmAnaM cha svapakShaM cha palAyanhanti sa.nyuge |
dravyanAsho vadho.akIrtirayashashcha palAyane
shlokas.32:
amanoj~nAsukhA vAchaH puruShasya palAyataH |
pratispandauShThadantasya nyastasarvAyudhasya cha
shlokas.33:
hitvA palAyamAnasya sahAyAnprANasa.nshaye |
amitrairanubaddhasya dviShatAmastu nastathA
shlokas.34:
manuShyApasadA hyete ye bhavanti parA~NmukhAH |
rAshivardhanamAtrAste naiva te pretya no iha
shlokas.35:
amitrA hRRiShTamanasaH pratyudyAnti palAyinam |
jayinaM suhRRidastAta vandanairma~Ngalena cha
shlokas.36:
yasya sma vyasane rAjannanumodanti shatravaH |
tadasahyataraM duHkhamahaM manye vadhAdapi
shlokas.37:
shriyaM jAnIta dharmasya mUlaM sarvasukhasya cha |
sA bhIrUNAM parAnyAti shUrastAmadhigachChati
shlokas.38:
te vayaM svargamichChantaH sa~NgrAme tyaktajIvitAH |
jayanto vadhyamAnA vA prAptumarhAma sadgatim
shlokas.39:
evaM sa.nshaptashapathAH samabhityaktajIvitAH |
amitravAhinIM vIrAH sampragAhantyabhIravaH
shlokas.40:
agrataH puruShAnIkamasicharmavatAM bhavet |
pRRiShThataH shakaTAnIkaM kalatraM madhyatastathA
shlokas.41:
pareShAM pratighAtArthaM padAtInAM cha gUhanam |
api hyasminpare gRRiddhA bhaveyurye purogamAH
shlokas.42:
ye purastAdabhimatAH sattvavanto manasvinaH |
te pUrvamabhivartera.nstAnanvagitare janAH
shlokas.43:
api choddharShaNaM kAryaM bhIrUNAmapi yatnataH |
skandhadarshanamAtraM tu tiShTheyurvA samIpataH
shlokas.44:
saMhatAnyodhayedalpAnkAmaM vistArayedbahUn |
sUchImukhamanIkaM syAdalpAnAM bahubhiH saha
shlokas.45:
samprayuddhe prahRRiShTe vA satyaM vA yadi vAnRRitam |
pragRRihya bAhUnkrosheta bhagnA bhagnAH parA iti
shlokas.46:
AgataM no mitrabalaM praharadhvamabhItavat |
shabdavanto.anudhAveyuH kurvanto bhairavaM ravam
shlokas.47:
kShveDAH kilakilAH sha~NkhAH krakachA goviShANikAn |
bherImRRida~NgapaNavAnnAdayeyushcha ku~njarAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ki.nshIlAH ki.nsamutthAnAH katha.nrUpAshcha bhArata |
ki.nsaMnAhAH katha.nshastrA janAH syuH sa.nyuge nRRipa
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yathAcharitamevAtra shastrapatraM vidhIyate |
AchArAdeva puruShastathA karmasu vartate
shlokas.3:
gAndhArAH sindhusauvIrA nakharaprAsayodhinaH |
AbhIravaH subalinastadbalaM sarvapAragam
shlokas.4:
sarvashastreShu kushalAH sattvavanto hyushInarAH |
prAchyA mAta~NgayuddheShu kushalAH shaThayodhinaH
shlokas.5:
tathA yavanakAmbojA mathurAmabhitashcha ye |
ete niyuddhakushalA dAkShiNAtyAsicharmiNaH
shlokas.6:
sarvatra shUrA jAyante mahAsattvA mahAbalAH |
prAya eSha samuddiShTo lakShaNAni tu me shRRiNu
shlokas.7:
siMhashArdUlavA~NnetrAH siMhashArdUlagAminaH |
pArAvatakuli~NgAkShAH sarve shUrAH pramAthinaH
shlokas.8:
mRRigasvarA dvIpinetrA RRiShabhAkShAstathApare |
pravAdinaH suchaNDAshcha krodhinaH kiMnarIsvanAH
shlokas.9:
meghasvanAH kruddhamukhAH kechitkarabhanisvanAH |
jihmanAsAnuja~NghAshcha dUragA dUrapAtinaH
shlokas.10:
biDAlakubjAstanavastanukeshAstanutvachaH |
shUrAshchapalachittAshcha te bhavanti durAsadAH
shlokas.11:
godhAnimIlitAH kechinmRRiduprakRRitayo.api cha |
tura~NgagatinirghoShAste narAH pArayiShNavaH
shlokas.12:
susaMhatAH pratanavo vyUDhoraskAH susa.nsthitAH |
pravAditena nRRityanti hRRiShyanti kalaheShu cha
shlokas.13:
gambhIrAkShA niHsRRitAkShAH pi~NgalA bhrukuTImukhAH |
nakulAkShAstathA chaiva sarve shUrAstanutyajaH
shlokas.14:
jihmAkShAH pralalATAshcha nirmA.nsahanavo.api cha |
vakrabAhva~NgulIsaktAH kRRishA dhamanisantatAH
shlokas.15:
pravishantyativegena samparAye.abhyupasthite |
vAraNA iva saMmattAste bhavanti durAsadAH
shlokas.16:
dIptasphuTitakeshAntAH sthUlapArshvahanUmukhAH |
unnatA.nsAH pRRithugrIvA vikaTAH sthUlapiNDikAH
shlokas.17:
udvRRittAshchaiva sugrIvA vinatA vihagA iva |
piNDashIrShAhivaktrAshcha vRRiShada.nshamukhA iva
shlokas.18:
ugrasvanA manyumanto yuddheShvArAvasAriNaH |
adharmaj~nAvaliptAshcha ghorA raudrapradarshinaH
shlokas.19:
tyaktAtmAnaH sarva ete antyajA hyanivartinaH |
puraskAryAH sadA sainye hanyante ghnanti chApi te
shlokas.20:
adhArmikA bhinnavRRittAH sAdhvevaiShAM parAbhavaH |
evameva prakupyanti rAj~no.apyete hyabhIkShNashaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
jaitryA vA kAni rUpANi bhavanti puruSharShabha |
pRRitanAyAH prashastAni tAnIhechChAmi veditum
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jaitryA vA yAni rUpANi bhavanti puruSharShabha |
pRRitanAyAH prashastAni tAni vakShyAmi sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
daivaM pUrvaM vikurute mAnuShe kAlachodite |
tadvidvA.nso.anupashyanti j~nAnadIrgheNa chakShuShA
shlokas.4:
prAyashchittavidhiM chAtra japahomA.nshcha tadvidaH |
ma~NgalAni cha kurvantaH shamayantyahitAnyapi
shlokas.5:
udIrNamanaso yodhA vAhanAni cha bhArata |
yasyAM bhavanti senAyAM dhruvaM tasyAM jayaM vadet
shlokas.6:
anvenAM vAyavo vAnti tathaivendradhanUMShi cha |
anuplavante meghAshcha tathAdityasya rashmayaH
shlokas.7:
gomAyavashchAnulomA vaDA gRRidhrAshcha sarvashaH |
AchareyuryadA senAM tadA siddhiranuttamA
shlokas.8:
prasannabhAH pAvaka UrdhvarashmiH; pradakShiNAvartashikho vidhUmaH |
puNyA gandhAshchAhutInAM pravAnti; jayasyaitadbhAvino rUpamAhuH
shlokas.9:
gambhIrashabdAshcha mahAsvanAshcha; sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha nadanti yatra |
yuyutsavashchApratIpA bhavanti; jayasyaitadbhAvino rUpamAhuH
shlokas.10:
iShTA mRRigAH pRRiShThato vAmatashcha; samprasthitAnAM cha gamiShyatAM cha |
jighA.nsatAM dakShiNAH siddhimAhu;rye tvagrataste pratiShedhayanti
shlokas.11:
ma~NgalyashabdAH shakunA vadanti; ha.nsAH krau~nchAH shatapatrAshcha chAShAH |
hRRiShTA yodhAH sattvavanto bhavanti; jayasyaitadbhAvino rUpamAhuH
shlokas.12:
shastraiH patraiH kavachaiH ketubhishcha; subhAnubhirmukhavarNaishcha yUnAm |
bhrAjiShmatI duShpratiprekShaNIyA; yeShAM chamUste.abhibhavanti shatrUn
shlokas.13:
shushrUShavashchAnabhimAninashcha; parasparaM sauhRRidamAsthitAshcha |
yeShAM yodhAH shauchamanuShThitAshcha; jayasyaitadbhAvino rUpamAhuH
shlokas.14:
