shabdAH sparshAstathA gandhA vicharanti manaHpriyAH |
dhairyaM chAvishate yodhAnvijayasya mukhaM tu tat
shlokas.15:
iShTo vAmaH praviShTasya dakShiNaH pravivikShataH |
pashchAtsa.nsAdhayatyarthaM purastAtpratiShedhati
shlokas.16:
sambhRRitya mahatIM senAM chatura~NgAM yudhiShThira |
sAmnaivAvartane pUrvaM prayatethAstatho yudhi
shlokas.17:
jaghanya eSha vijayo yadyuddhaM nAma bhArata |
yAdRRichChiko yudhi jayo daivo veti vichAraNam
shlokas.18:
apAmiva mahAvegastrastA mRRigagaNA iva |
durnivAryatamA chaiva prabhagnA mahatI chamUH
shlokas.19:
bhagnA ityeva bhajyante vidvA.nso.api nakAraNam |
udArasArA mahatI rurusa~NghopamA chamUH
shlokas.20:
parasparaj~nAH saMhRRiShTAstyaktaprANAH sunishchitAH |
api pa~nchAshatiH shUrA mRRidnanti paravAhinIm
shlokas.21:
atha vA pa~ncha ShaTsapta sahitAH kRRitanishchayAH |
kulInAH pUjitAH samyagvijayantIha shAtravAn
shlokas.22:
saMnipAto na gantavyaH shakye sati katha~nchana |
sAntvabhedapradAnAnAM yuddhamuttaramuchyate
shlokas.23:
sa.nsarpaNAddhi senAyA bhayaM bhIrUnprabAdhate |
vajrAdiva prajvalitAdiyaM kva nu patiShyati
shlokas.24:
abhiprayAtAM samitiM j~nAtvA ye pratiyAntyatha |
teShAM spandanti gAtrANi yodhAnAM viShayasya cha
shlokas.25:
viShayo vyathate rAjansarvaH sasthANuja~NgamaH |
shastrapratApataptAnAM majjA sIdati dehinAm
shlokas.26:
teShAM sAntvaM krUramishraM praNetavyaM punaH punaH |
sampIDyamAnA hi pare yogamAyAnti sarvashaH
shlokas.27:
antarANAM cha bhedArthaM chArAnabhyavachArayet |
yashcha tasmAtparo rAjA tena sandhiH prashasyate
shlokas.28:
na hi tasyAnyathA pIDA shakyA kartuM tathAvidhA |
yathA sArdhamamitreNa sarvataH pratibAdhanam
shlokas.29:
kShamA vai sAdhumAyA hi na hi sAdhvakShamA sadA |
kShamAyAshchAkShamAyAshcha viddhi pArtha prayojanam
shlokas.30:
vijitya kShamamANasya yasho rAj~no.abhivardhate |
mahAparAdhA hyapyasminvishvasanti hi shatravaH
shlokas.31:
manyate karshayitvA tu kShamA sAdhviti shambaraH |
asantaptaM tu yaddAru pratyeti prakRRitiM punaH
shlokas.32:
naitatprasha.nsantyAchAryA na cha sAdhu nidarshanam |
akleshenAvinAshena niyantavyAH svaputravat
shlokas.33:
dveShyo bhavati bhUtAnAmugro rAjA yudhiShThira |
mRRidumapyavamanyante tasmAdubhayabhAgbhavet
shlokas.34:
prahariShyanpriyaM brUyAtpraharannapi bhArata |
prahRRitya cha kRRipAyeta shochanniva rudanniva
shlokas.35:
na me priyaM yatsa hataH samprAhaivaM puro vachaH |
na chakartha cha me vAkyamuchyamAnaH punaH punaH
shlokas.36:
aho jIvitamAkA~NkShe nedRRisho vadhamarhati |
sudurlabhAH supuruShAH sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH
shlokas.37:
kRRitaM mamApriyaM tena yenAyaM nihato mRRidhe |
iti vAchA vadanhantR^InpUjayeta rahogataH
shlokas.38:
hantR^INAM chAhatAnAM cha yatkuryuraparAdhinaH |
kroshedbAhuM pragRRihyApi chikIrSha~njanasa~Ngraham
shlokas.39:
evaM sarvAsvavasthAsu sAntvapUrvaM samAcharan |
priyo bhavati bhUtAnAM dharmaj~no vItabhIrnRRipaH
shlokas.40:
vishvAsaM chAtra gachChanti sarvabhUtAni bhArata |
vishvastaH shakyate bhoktuM yathAkAmamupasthitaH
shlokas.41:
tasmAdvishvAsayedrAjA sarvabhUtAnyamAyayA |
sarvataH parirakShechcha yo mahIM bhoktumichChati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM mRRidau kathaM tIkShNe mahApakShe cha pArthiva |
arau varteta nRRipatistanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bRRihaspateshcha sa.nvAdamindrasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
bRRihaspatiM devapatirabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
upasa~Ngamya paprachCha vAsavaH paravIrahA
shlokas.4:
ahiteShu kathaM brahmanvartayeyamatandritaH |
asamuchChidya chaivenAnniyachCheyamupAyataH
shlokas.5:
senayorvyatiSha~NgeNa jayaH sAdhAraNo bhavet |
kiM kurvANaM na mAM jahyAjjvalitA shrIH pratApinI
shlokas.6:
tato dharmArthakAmAnAM kushalaH pratibhAnavAn |
rAjadharmavidhAnaj~naH pratyuvAcha pura.ndaram
shlokas.7:
na jAtu kalahenechChenniyantumapakAriNaH |
bAlasa.nsevitaM hyetadyadamarSho yadakShamA
na shatrurvivRRitaH kAryo vadhamasyAbhikA~NkShatA
shlokas.8:
krodhaM balamamarShaM cha niyamyAtmajamAtmani |
amitramupaseveta vishvastavadavishvasan
shlokas.9:
priyameva vadennityaM nApriyaM ki~nchidAcharet |
viramechChuShkavairebhyaH kaNThAyAsaM cha varjayet
shlokas.10:
yathA vaita.nsiko yukto dvijAnAM sadRRishasvanaH |
tAndvijAnkurute vashyA.nstathA yukto mahIpatiH
vashaM chopanayechChatrUnnihanyAchcha pura.ndara
shlokas.11:
na nityaM paribhUyArInsukhaM svapiti vAsava |
jAgartyeva cha duShTAtmA sa~Nkare.agnirivotthitaH
shlokas.12:
na saMnipAtaH kartavyaH sAmAnye vijaye sati |
vishvAsyaivopasaMnyAsyo vashe kRRitvA ripuH prabho
shlokas.13:
sampradhArya sahAmAtyairmantravidbhirmahAtmabhiH |
upekShamANo.avaj~nAte hRRidayenAparAjitaH
shlokas.14:
athAsya praharetkAle ki~nchidvichalite pade |
daNDaM cha dUShayedasya puruShairAptakAribhiH
shlokas.15:
AdimadhyAvasAnaj~naH prachChannaM cha vichArayet |
balAni dUShayedasya jAna.nshchaiva pramANataH
shlokas.16:
bhedenopapradAnena sa.nsRRijannauShadhaistathA |
na tveva chelasa.nsargaM rachayedaribhiH saha
shlokas.17:
dIrghakAlamapi kShAntvA vihanyAdeva shAtravAn |
kAlAkA~NkShI yAmayechcha yathA visrambhamApnuyuH
shlokas.18:
na sadyo.arInvinirhanyAddRRiShTasya vijayo.ajvaraH |
na yaH shalyaM ghaTTayati navaM cha kurute vraNam
shlokas.19:
prApte cha praharetkAle na sa sa.nvartate punaH |
hantukAmasya devendra puruShasya ripuM prati
shlokas.20:
yaH kAlo hi vyatikrAmetpuruShaM kAlakA~NkShiNam |
durlabhaH sa punaH kAlaH kAladharmachikIrShuNA
shlokas.21:
aurjasthyaM vijayedevaM sa~NgRRihNansAdhusaMmatAn |
kAlena sAdhayennityaM nAprApte.abhinipIDayet
shlokas.22:
vihAya kAmaM krodhaM cha tathAha~NkArameva cha |
yukto vivaramanvichChedahitAnAM pura.ndara
shlokas.23:
mArdavaM daNDa AlasyaM pramAdashcha surottama |
mAyAshcha vividhAH shakra sAdhayantyavichakShaNam
shlokas.24:
nihatyaitAni chatvAri mAyAM pratividhAya cha |
tataH shaknoti shatrUNAM prahartumavichArayan
shlokas.25:
yadaivaikena shakyeta guhyaM kartuM tadAcharet |
yachChanti sachivA guhyaM mitho vidrAvayantyapi
shlokas.26:
ashakyamiti kRRitvA vA tato.anyaiH sa.nvidaM charet |
brahmadaNDamadRRiShTeShu dRRiShTeShu chatura~NgiNIm
shlokas.27:
bhedaM cha prathamaM yu~njyAttUShNI.ndaNDaM tathaiva cha |
kAle prayojayedrAjA tasmi.nstasmi.nstadA tadA
shlokas.28:
praNipAtaM cha gachCheta kAle shatrorbalIyasaH |
yukto.asya vadhamanvichChedapramattaH pramAdyataH
shlokas.29:
praNipAtena dAnena vAchA madhurayA bruvan |
amitramupaseveta na tu jAtu visha~Nkayet
shlokas.30:
sthAnAni sha~NkitAnAM cha nityameva vivarjayet |
na cha teShvAshvaseddrugdhvA jAgratIha nirAkRRitAH
shlokas.31:
na hyato duShkaraM karma ki~nchidasti surottama |
yathA vividhavRRittAnAmaishvaryamamarAdhipa
shlokas.32:
tathA vividhashIlAnAmapi sambhava uchyate |
yateta yogamAsthAya mitrAmitrAnavArayan
shlokas.33:
mRRidumapyavamanyante tIkShNAdudvijate janaH |
mAtIkShNo mAmRRidurbhUstvaM tIkShNo bhava mRRidurbhava
shlokas.34:
yathA vapre vegavati sarvataHsamplutodake |
nityaM vivaraNAdbAdhastathA rAjyaM pramAdyataH
shlokas.35:
na banUnabhiyu~njIta yaugapadyena shAtravAn |
sAmnA dAnena bhedena daNDena cha pura.ndara
shlokas.36:
ekaikameShAM niShpiMSha~nshiShTeShu nipuNaM charet |
na cha shakto.api medhAvI sarvAnevArabhennRRipaH
shlokas.37:
yadA syAnmahatI senA hayanAgarathAkulA |
padAtiyantrabahulA svanuraktA ShaDa~NginI
shlokas.38:
yadA bahuvidhAM vRRiddhiM manyate pratilomataH |
tadA vivRRitya prahareddasyUnAmavichArayan
shlokas.39:
na sAma daNDopaniShatprashasyate; na mArdavaM shatruShu yAtrikaM sadA |
na sasyaghAto na cha sa~NkarakriyA; na chApi bhUyaH prakRRitervichAraNA
shlokas.40:
mAyAvibhedAnupasarjanAni; pApaM tathaiva spashasamprayogAt |
AptairmanuShyairupachArayeta; pureShu rAShTreShu cha samprayuktaH
shlokas.41:
purANi chaiShAmanusRRitya bhUmipAH; pureShu bhogAnnikhilAnihAjayan |
pureShu nItiM vihitAM yathAvidhi; prayojayanto balavRRitrasUdana
shlokas.42:
pradAya gUDhAni vasUni nAma; prachChidya bhogAnavadhAya cha svAn |
duShTAH svadoShairiti kIrtayitvA; pureShu rAShTreShu cha yojayanti
shlokas.43:
tathaiva chAnyai ratishAstravedibhiH; svala~NkRRitaiH shAstravidhAnadRRiShTibhiH |
sushikShitairbhAShyakathAvishAradaiH; pareShu kRRityAnupadhArayasva
shlokas.44:
indra uvAcha||
kAni li~NgAni duShTasya bhavanti dvijasattama |
kathaM duShTaM vijAnIyAdetatpRRiShTo bravIhi me
shlokas.45:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
parokShamaguNAnAha sadguNAnabhyasUyati |
parairvA kIrtyamAneShu tUShNImAste parA~NmukhaH
shlokas.46:
tUShNImbhAve.api hi j~nAnaM na chedbhavati kAraNam |
vishvAsamoShThasa.nda.nshaM shirasashcha prakampanam
shlokas.47:
karotyabhIkShNaM sa.nsRRiShTamasa.nsRRiShTashcha bhAShate |
adRRiShTito vikurute dRRiShTvA vA nAbhibhAShate
shlokas.48:
pRRithagetya samashnAti nedamadya yathAvidhi |
Asane shayane yAne bhAvA lakShyA visheShataH
shlokas.49:
ArtirArte priye prItiretAvanmitralakShaNam |
viparItaM tu boddhavyamarilakShaNameva tat
shlokas.50:
etAnyevaM yathoktAni budhyethAstridashAdhipa |
puruShANAM praduShTAnAM svabhAvo balavattaraH
shlokas.51:
iti duShTasya vij~nAnamuktaM te surasattama |
nishAmya shAstratattvArthaM yathAvadamareshvara
shlokas.52:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa tadvachaH shatrunibarhaNe rata;stathA chakArAvitathaM bRRihaspateH |
chachAra kAle vijayAya chArihA; vashaM cha shatrUnanayatpura.ndaraH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhArmiko.arthAnasamprApya rAjAmAtyaiH prabAdhitaH |
chyutaH koshAchcha daNDAchcha sukhamichChankathaM charet
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrAyaM kShemadarshIyamitihAso.anugIyate |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
kShemadarshaM nRRipasutaM yatra kShINabalaM purA |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIya AjagAmeti naH shrutam
taM paprachChopasa~NgRRihya kRRichChrAmApadamAsthitaH
shlokas.4:
artheShu bhAgI puruSha IhamAnaH punaH punaH |
alabdhvA madvidho rAjyaM brahmankiM kartumarhati
shlokas.5:
anyatra maraNAtsteyAdanyatra parasa.nshrayAt |
kShudrAdanyatra chAchArAttanmamAchakShva sattama
shlokas.6:
vyAdhinA chAbhipannasya mAnasenetareNa vA |
bahushrutaH kRRitapraj~nastvadvidhaH sharaNaM bhavet
shlokas.7:
nirvidya hi naraH kAmAnniyamya sukhamedhate |
tyaktvA prItiM cha shokaM cha labdhvAprItimayaM vasu
shlokas.8:
sukhamarthAshrayaM yeShAmanushochAmi tAnaham |
mama hyarthAH subahavo naShTAH svapna ivAgatAH
shlokas.9:
duShkaraM bata kurvanti mahato.arthA.nstyajanti ye |
vayaM tvenAnparityaktumasato.api na shaknumaH
shlokas.10:
imAmavasthAM samprAptaM dInamArtaM shriyashchyutam |
yadanyatsukhamastIha tadbrahmannanushAdhi mAm
shlokas.11:
kausalyenaivamuktastu rAjaputreNa dhImatA |
muniH kAlakavRRikShIyaH pratyuvAcha mahAdyutiH
shlokas.12:
purastAdeva te buddhiriyaM kAryA vijAnataH |
anityaM sarvamevedamahaM cha mama chAsti yat
shlokas.13:
yatki~nchinmanyase.astIti sarvaM nAstIti viddhi tat |
evaM na vyathate prAj~naH kRRichChrAmapyApadaM gataH
shlokas.14:
yaddhi bhUtaM bhaviShyachcha dhruvaM tanna bhaviShyati |
evaM viditavedyastvamadharmebhyaH pramokShyase
shlokas.15:
yachcha pUrve samAhAre yachcha pUrvatare pare |
sarvaM tannAsti tachchaiva tajj~nAtvA ko.anusa~njvaret
shlokas.16:
bhUtvA cha na bhavatyetadabhUtvA cha bhavatyapi |
shoke na hyasti sAmarthyaM shokaM kuryAtkathaM naraH
shlokas.17:
kva nu te.adya pitA rAjankva nu te.adya pitAmahaH |
na tvaM pashyasi tAnadya na tvA pashyanti te.api cha
shlokas.18:
Atmano.adhruvatAM pashya.nstA.nstvaM kimanushochasi |
buddhyA chaivAnubudhyasva dhruvaM hi na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.19:
ahaM cha tvaM cha nRRipate shatravaH suhRRidashcha te |
avashyaM na bhaviShyAmaH sarvaM cha na bhaviShyati
shlokas.20:
ye tu vi.nshativarShA vai tri.nshadvarShAshcha mAnavAH |
arvAgeva hi te sarve mariShyanti sharachChatAt
shlokas.21:
api chenmahato vittAdvipramuchyeta pUruShaH |
naitanmameti tanmatvA kurvIta priyamAtmanaH
shlokas.22:
anAgataM yanna mameti vidyA;datikrAntaM yanna mameti vidyAt |
diShTaM balIya iti manyamAnA;ste paNDitAstatsatAM sthAnamAhuH
shlokas.23:
anADhyAshchApi jIvanti rAjyaM chApyanushAsate |
buddhipauruShasampannAstvayA tulyAdhikA janAH
shlokas.24:
na cha tvamiva shochanti tasmAttvamapi mA shuchaH |
kiM nu tvaM tairna vai shreyA.nstulyo vA buddhipauruShaiH
shlokas.25:
rAjaputra uvAcha||
yAdRRichChikaM mamAsIttadrAjyamityeva chintaye |
hriyate sarvamevedaM kAlena mahatA dvija
shlokas.26:
tasyaivaM hriyamANasya srotaseva tapodhana |
phalametatprapashyAmi yathAlabdhena vartaye
shlokas.27:
muniruvAcha||
anAgatamatItaM cha yathA tathyavinishchayAt |
nAnushochasi kausalya sarvArtheShu tathA bhava
shlokas.28:
avApyAnkAmayasvArthAnnAnavApyAnkadAchana |
pratyutpannAnanubhavanmA shuchastvamanAgatAn
shlokas.29:
yathA labdhopapannArthastathA kausalya ra.nsyase |
kachchichChuddhasvabhAvena shriyA hIno na shochasi
shlokas.30:
purastAdbhUtapUrvatvAddhInabhAgyo hi durmatiH |
dhAtAraM garhate nityaM labdhArthA.nshcha na mRRiShyate
shlokas.31:
anarhAnapi chaivAnyAnmanyate shrImato janAn |
etasmAtkAraNAdetadduHkhaM bhUyo.anuvartate
shlokas.32:
IrShyAtichChedasampannA rAjanpuruShamAninaH |
kachchittvaM na tathA prAj~na matsarI kosalAdhipa
shlokas.33:
sahasva shriyamanyeShAM yadyapi tvayi nAsti sA |
anyatrApi satIM lakShmIM kushalA bhu~njate janAH
abhiviShyandate shrIrhi satyapi dviShato janAt
shlokas.34:
shriyaM cha putrapautraM cha manuShyA dharmachAriNaH |
tyAgadharmavido vIrAH svayameva tyajantyuta
shlokas.35:
bahu sa~NkasukaM dRRiShTvA vivitsAsAdhanena cha |
tathAnye santyajantyenaM matvA paramadurlabham
shlokas.36:
tvaM punaH prAj~narUpaH sankRRipaNaM paritapyase |
akAmyAnkAmayAno.arthAnparAchInAnupadrutAn
shlokas.37:
tAM buddhimupajij~nAsustvamevainAnparityaja |
anarthA.nshchArtharUpeNa arthA.nshchAnartharUpataH
shlokas.38:
arthAyaiva hi keShA~nchiddhananAsho bhavatyuta |
anantyaM taM sukhaM matvA shriyamanyaH parIkShate
shlokas.39:
ramamANaH shriyA kashchinnAnyachChreyo.abhimanyate |
tathA tasyehamAnasya samArambho vinashyati
shlokas.40:
kRRichChrAllabdhamabhipretaM yadA kausalya nashyati |
tadA nirvidyate so.arthAtparibhagnakramo naraH
shlokas.41:
dharmameke.abhipadyante kalyANAbhijanA narAH |
paratra sukhamichChanto nirvidyeyushcha laukikAt
shlokas.42:
jIvitaM santyajantyeke dhanalobhaparA narAH |
na jIvitArthaM manyante puruShA hi dhanAdRRite
shlokas.43:
pashya teShAM kRRipaNatAM pashya teShAmabuddhitAm |
adhruve jIvite mohAdarthatRRiShNAmupAshritAH
shlokas.44:
sa~nchaye cha vinAshAnte maraNAnte cha jIvite |
sa.nyoge viprayogAnte ko nu vipraNayenmanaH
shlokas.45:
dhanaM vA puruShaM rAjanpuruSho vA punardhanam |
avashyaM prajahAtyetattadvidvAnko.anusa~njvaret
shlokas.46:
anyeShAmapi nashyanti suhRRidashcha dhanAni cha |
pashya buddhyA manuShyANAM rAjannApadamAtmanaH
niyachCha yachCha sa.nyachCha indriyANi mano giram
shlokas.47:
pratiShiddhAnavApyeShu durlabheShvahiteShu cha |
pratikRRiShTeShu bhAveShu vyatikRRiShTeShvasambhave
praj~nAnatRRipto vikrAntastvadvidho nAnushochati
shlokas.48:
alpamichChannachapalo mRRidurdAntaH susa.nshitaH |
brahmacharyopapannashcha tvadvidho naiva muhyati
shlokas.49:
na tveva jAlmIM kApAlIM vRRittimeShitumarhasi |
nRRisha.nsavRRittiM pApiShThAM duHkhAM kApuruShochitAm
shlokas.50:
api mUlaphalAjIvo ramasvaiko mahAvane |
vAgyataH sa~NgRRihItAtmA sarvabhUtadayAnvitaH
shlokas.51:
sadRRishaM paNDitasyaitadIShAdantena dantinA |
yadeko ramate.araNye yachchApyalpena tuShyati
shlokas.52:
mahAhradaH sa~NkShubhita Atmanaiva prasIdati |
etadeva~NgatasyAhaM sukhaM pashyAmi kevalam
shlokas.53:
asambhave shriyo rAjanhInasya sachivAdibhiH |
daive pratiniviShTe cha kiM shreyo manyate bhavAn

shlokas.1:
muniruvAcha||
atha chetpauruShaM ki~nchitkShatriyAtmani pashyasi |
bravImi hanta te nItiM rAjyasya pratipattaye
shlokas.2:
tAM chechChakShyasyanuShThAtuM karma chaiva kariShyasi |
shRRiNu sarvamasheSheNa yattvAM vakShyAmi tattvataH
shlokas.3:
AchariShyasi chetkarma mahato.arthAnavApsyasi |
rAjyaM rAjyasya mantraM vA mahatIM vA punaH shriyam
yadyetadrochate rAjanpunarbrUhi bravImi te
shlokas.4:
rAjaputra uvAcha||
bravItu bhagavAnnItimupapanno.asmyahaM prabho |
amoghamidamadyAstu tvayA saha samAgatam
shlokas.5:
muniruvAcha||
hitvA stambhaM cha mAnaM cha krodhaharShau bhayaM tathA |
pratyamitraM niShevasva praNipatya kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.6:
tamuttamena shauchena karmaNA chAbhirAdhaya |
dAtumarhati te vRRittiM vaidehaH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.7:
pramANaM sarvabhUteShu pragrahaM cha gamiShyasi |
tataH sahAyAnsotsAhA.Nllapsyase.avyasanA~nshuchIn
shlokas.8:
vartamAnaH svashAstre vai sa.nyatAtmA jitendriyaH |
abhyuddharati chAtmAnaM prasAdayati cha prajAH
shlokas.9:
tenaiva tvaM dhRRitimatA shrImatA chAbhisatkRRitaH |
pramANaM sarvabhUteShu gatvA pragrahaNaM mahat
shlokas.10:
tataH suhRRidbalaM labdhvA mantrayitvA sumantritam |
antarairbhedayitvArInbilvaM bilvena shAtaya
parairvA sa.nvidaM kRRitvA balamapyasya ghAtaya
shlokas.11:
alabhyA ye shubhA bhAvAH striyashchAchChAdanAni cha |
shayyAsanAni yAnAni mahArhANi gRRihANi cha
shlokas.12:
pakShiNo mRRigajAtAni rasA gandhAH phalAni cha |
teShveva sajjayethAstvaM yathA nashyetsvayaM paraH
shlokas.13:
yadyeva pratiSheddhavyo yadyupekShaNamarhati |
na jAtu vivRRitaH kAryaH shatrurvinayamichChatA
shlokas.14:
vasasva paramAmitraviShaye prAj~nasaMmate |
bhajasva shvetakAkIyairmitrAdhamamanarthakaiH
shlokas.15:
ArambhA.nshchAsya mahato duShkarA.nstvaM prayojaya |
nadIbandhavirodhA.nshcha balavadbhirvirudhyatAm
shlokas.16:
udyAnAni mahArhANi shayanAnyAsanAni cha |
pratibhogasukhenaiva koshamasya virechaya
shlokas.17:
yaj~nadAnaprasha.nsAsmai brAhmaNeShvanuvarNyatAm |
te tvatpriyaM kariShyanti taM cheShyanti vRRikA iva
shlokas.18:
asa.nshayaM puNyashIlaH prApnoti paramAM gatim |
triviShTape puNyatamaM sthAnaM prApnoti pArthivaH
koshakShaye tvamitrANAM vashaM kausalya gachChati
shlokas.19:
ubhayatra prasaktasya dharme chAdharma eva cha |
balArthamUlaM vyuchChidyettena nandanti shatravaH
shlokas.20:
nindyAsya mAnuShaM karma daivamasyopavarNaya |
asa.nshayaM daivaparaH kShiprameva vinashyati
shlokas.21:
yAjayainaM vishvajitA sarvasvena viyujyatAm |
tato gachChatvasiddhArthaH pIDyamAno mahAjanam
shlokas.22:
tyAgadharmavidaM muNDaM ka~nchidasyopavarNaya |
api tyAgaM bubhUSheta kachchidgachChedanAmayam
shlokas.23:
siddhenauShadhayogena sarvashatruvinAshinA |
nAgAnashvAnmanuShyA.nshcha kRRitakairupaghAtaya
shlokas.24:
ete chAnye cha bahavo dambhayogAH sunishchitAH |
shakyA viShahatA kartuM naklIbena nRRipAtmaja

shlokas.1:
rAjaputra uvAcha||
na nikRRityA na dambhena brahmannichChAmi jIvitum |
nAdharmayuktAnichCheyamarthAnsumahato.apyaham
shlokas.2:
purastAdeva bhagavanmayaitadapavarjitam |
yena mAM nAbhisha~Nketa yadvA kRRitsnaM hitaM bhavet
shlokas.3:
AnRRisha.nsyena dharmeNa loke hyasmi~njijIviShuH |
nAhametadalaM kartuM naitanmayyupapadyate
shlokas.4:
muniruvAcha||
upapannastvametena yathA kShatriya bhAShase |
prakRRityA hyupapanno.asi buddhyA chAdbhutadarshana
shlokas.5:
ubhayoreva vAmarthe yatiShye tava tasya cha |
sa.nshleShaM vA kariShyAmi shAshvataM hyanapAyinam
shlokas.6:
tvAdRRishaM hi kule jAtamanRRisha.nsaM bahushrutam |
amAtyaM ko na kurvIta rAjyapraNayakovidam
shlokas.7:
yastvaM pravrajito rAjyAdvyasanaM chottamaM gataH |
AnRRisha.nsyena vRRittena kShatriyechChasi jIvitum
shlokas.8:
AgantA madgRRihaM tAta vaidehaH satyasa~NgaraH |
yathAhaM taM niyokShyAmi tatkariShyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.9:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tata AhUya vaidehaM munirvachanamabravIt |
ayaM rAjakule jAto viditAbhyantaro mama
shlokas.10:
Adarsha iva shuddhAtmA shAradashchandramA iva |
nAsminpashyAmi vRRijinaM sarvato me parIkShitaH
shlokas.11:
tena te sandhirevAstu vishvasAsminyathA mayi |
na rAjyamanamAtyena shakyaM shAstumamitrahan
shlokas.12:
amAtyaH shUra eva syAdbuddhisampanna eva cha |
tAbhyAM chaiva bhayaM rAj~naH pashya rAjyasya yojanam
dharmAtmanAM kvachilloke nAnyAsti gatirIdRRishI
shlokas.13:
kRRitAtmA rAjaputro.ayaM satAM mArgamanuShThitaH |
susa~NgRRihItastvevaiSha tvayA dharmapurogamaH
sa.nsevyamAnaH shatrU.nste gRRihNIyAnmahato gaNAn
shlokas.14:
yadyayaM pratiyudhyettvAM svakarma kShatriyasya tat |
jigIShamANastvAM yuddhe pitRRipaitAmahe pade
shlokas.15:
tvaM chApi pratiyudhyethA vijigIShuvrate sthitaH |
ayuddhvaiva niyogAnme vashe vaideha te sthitaH
shlokas.16:
sa tvaM dharmamavekShasva tyaktvAdharmamasAmpratam |
na hi kAmAnna cha drohAtsvadharmaM hAtumarhasi
shlokas.17:
naiva nityaM jayastAta naiva nityaM parAjayaH |
tasmAdbhojayitavyashcha bhoktavyashcha paro janaH
shlokas.18:
Atmanyeva hi sa.ndRRishyAvubhau jayaparAjayau |
niHsheShakAriNAM tAta niHsheShakaraNAdbhayam
shlokas.19:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM vachanaM brAhmaNarShabham |
abhipUjyAbhisatkRRitya pUjArhamanumAnya cha
shlokas.20:
yathA brUyAnmahAprAj~no yathA brUyAdbahushrutaH |
shreyaskAmo yathA brUyAdubhayoryatkShamaM bhavet
shlokas.21:
tathA vachanamukto.asmi kariShyAmi cha tattathA |
etaddhi paramaM shreyo na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.22:
tataH kaushalyamAhUya vaideho vAkyamabravIt |
dharmato nItitashchaiva balena cha jito mayA
shlokas.23:
so.ahaM tvayA tvAtmaguNairjitaH pArthivasattama |
AtmAnamanavaj~nAya jitavadvartatAM bhavAn
shlokas.24:
nAvamanye cha te buddhiM nAvamanye cha pauruSham |
nAvamanye jayAmIti jitavadvartatAM bhavAn
shlokas.25:
yathAvatpUjito rAjangRRihaM gantAsi me gRRihAt |
tataH sampUjya tau vipraM vishvastau jagmaturgRRihAn
shlokas.26:
vaidehastvatha kausalyaM praveshya gRRihama~njasA |
pAdyArghyamadhuparkaistaM pUjArhaM pratyapUjayat
shlokas.27:
dadau duhitaraM chAsmai ratnAni vividhAni cha |
eSha rAj~nAM paro dharmaH sahyau jayaparAjayau

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
brAhmaNakShatriyavishAM shUdrANAM cha parantapa |
dharmo vRRittaM cha vRRittishcha vRRittyupAyaphalAni cha
shlokas.2:
rAj~nAM vRRittaM cha koshashcha koshasa~njananaM mahat |
amAtyaguNavRRiddhishcha prakRRitInAM cha vardhanam
shlokas.3:
ShADguNyaguNakalpashcha senAnItistathaiva cha |
duShTasya cha parij~nAnamaduShTasya cha lakShaNam
shlokas.4:
samahInAdhikAnAM cha yathAvallakShaNochchayaH |
madhyamasya cha tuShTyarthaM yathA stheyaM vivardhatA
shlokas.5:
kShINasa~NgrahavRRittishcha yathAvatsamprakIrtitA |
laghunAdesharUpeNa granthayogena bhArata
shlokas.6:
vijigIShostathAvRRittamuktaM chaiva tathaiva te |
gaNAnAM vRRittimichChAmi shrotuM matimatAM vara
shlokas.7:
yathA gaNAH pravardhante na bhidyante cha bhArata |
arInhi vijigIShante suhRRidaH prApnuvanti cha
shlokas.8:
bhedamUlo vinAsho hi gaNAnAmupalabhyate |
mantrasa.nvaraNaM duHkhaM bahUnAmiti me matiH
shlokas.9:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM nikhilena parantapa |
yathA cha te na bhidyera.nstachcha me brUhi pArthiva
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
gaNAnAM cha kulAnAM cha rAj~nAM cha bharatarShabha |
vairasa.ndIpanAvetau lobhAmarShau janAdhipa
shlokas.11:
lobhameko hi vRRiNute tato.amarShamanantaram |
tau kShayavyayasa.nyuktAvanyonyajanitAshrayau
shlokas.12:
chAramantrabalAdAnaiH sAmadAnavibhedanaiH |
kShayavyayabhayopAyaiH karshayantItaretaram
shlokas.13:
tatra dAnena bhidyante gaNAH sa~NghAtavRRittayaH |
bhinnA vimanasaH sarve gachChantyarivashaM bhayAt
shlokas.14:
bhedAdgaNA vinashyanti bhinnAH sUpajapAH paraiH |
tasmAtsa~NghAtayogeShu prayaterangaNAH sadA
shlokas.15:
arthA hyevAdhigamyante sa~NghAtabalapauruShAt |
bAhyAshcha maitrIM kurvanti teShu sa~NghAtavRRittiShu
shlokas.16:
j~nAnavRRiddhAnprasha.nsantaH shushrUShantaH parasparam |
vinivRRittAbhisandhAnAH sukhamedhanti sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
dharmiShThAnvyavahArA.nshcha sthApayantashcha shAstrataH |
yathAvatsampravartanto vivardhante gaNottamAH
shlokas.18:
putrAnbhrAtR^InnigRRihNanto vinaye cha sadA ratAH |
vinItA.nshcha pragRRihNanto vivardhante gaNottamAH
shlokas.19:
chAramantravidhAneShu koshasaMnichayeShu cha |
nityayuktA mahAbAho vardhante sarvato gaNAH
shlokas.20:
prAj~nA~nshUrAnmaheShvAsAnkarmasu sthirapauruShAn |
mAnayantaH sadA yuktA vivardhante gaNA nRRipa
shlokas.21:
dravyavantashcha shUrAshcha shastraj~nAH shAstrapAragAH |
kRRichChrAsvApatsu saMmUDhAngaNAnuttArayanti te
shlokas.22:
krodho bhedo bhayo daNDaH karshanaM nigraho vadhaH |
nayantyarivashaM sadyo gaNAnbharatasattama
shlokas.23:
tasmAnmAnayitavyAste gaNamukhyAH pradhAnataH |
lokayAtrA samAyattA bhUyasI teShu pArthiva
shlokas.24:
mantraguptiH pradhAneShu chArashchAmitrakarshana |
na gaNAH kRRitsnasho mantraM shrotumarhanti bhArata
shlokas.25:
gaNamukhyaistu sambhUya kAryaM gaNahitaM mithaH |
pRRithaggaNasya bhinnasya vimatasya tato.anyathA
arthAH pratyavasIdanti tathAnarthA bhavanti cha
shlokas.26:
teShAmanyonyabhinnAnAM svashaktimanutiShThatAm |
nigrahaH paNDitaiH kAryaH kShiprameva pradhAnataH
shlokas.27:
kuleShu kalahA jAtAH kulavRRiddhairupekShitAH |
gotrasya rAjankurvanti gaNasambhedakArikAm
shlokas.28:
AbhyantaraM bhayaM rakShyaM surakShyaM bAhyato bhayam |
abhyantarAdbhayaM jAtaM sadyo mUlaM nikRRintati
shlokas.29:
akasmAtkrodhalobhAdvA mohAdvApi svabhAvajAt |
anyonyaM nAbhibhAShante tatparAbhavalakShaNam
shlokas.30:
jAtyA cha sadRRishAH sarve kulena sadRRishAstathA |
na tu shauryeNa buddhyA vA rUpadravyeNa vA punaH
shlokas.31:
bhedAchchaiva pramAdAchcha nAmyante ripubhirgaNAH |
tasmAtsa~NghAtamevAhurgaNAnAM sharaNaM mahat

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mahAnayaM dharmapatho bahushAkhashcha bhArata |
kiM svideveha dharmANAmanuShTheyatamaM matam
shlokas.2:
kiM kAryaM sarvadharmANAM garIyo bhavato matam |
yathAyaM puruSho dharmamiha cha pretya chApnuyAt
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mAtApitrorgurUNAM cha pUjA bahumatA mama |
atra yukto naro lokAnyashashcha mahadashnute
shlokas.4:
yadete hyabhijAnIyuH karma tAta supUjitAH |
dharmyaM dharmaviruddhaM vA tatkartavyaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
na tairanabhyanuj~nAto dharmamanyaM prakalpayet |
yamete.abhyanujAnIyuH sa dharma iti nishchayaH
shlokas.6:
eta eva trayo lokA eta evAshramAstrayaH |
eta eva trayo vedA eta eva trayo.agnayaH
shlokas.7:
pitA hyagnirgArhapatyo mAtAgnirdakShiNaH smRRitaH |
gururAhavanIyastu sAgnitretA garIyasI
shlokas.8:
triShvapramAdyanneteShu trI.NllokAnavajeShyasi |
pitRRivRRittyA tvimaM lokaM mAtRRivRRittyA tathAparam
brahmalokaM gurorvRRittyA nityameva chariShyasi
shlokas.9:
samyageteShu vartasva triShu lokeShu bhArata |
yashaH prApsyasi bhadraM te dharmaM cha sumahAphalam
shlokas.10:
naitAnatishayejjAtu nAtyashnIyAnna dUShayet |
nityaM paricharechchaiva tadvai sukRRitamuttamam
kIrtiM puNyaM yasho lokAnprApsyase cha janAdhipa
shlokas.11:
sarve tasyAdRRitA lokA yasyaite traya AdRRitAH |
anAdRRitAstu yasyaite sarvAstasyAphalAH kriyAH
shlokas.12:
naivAyaM na paro lokastasya chaiva parantapa |
amAnitA nityameva yasyaite guravastrayaH
shlokas.13:
na chAsminna pare loke yashastasya prakAshate |
na chAnyadapi kalyANaM pAratraM samudAhRRitam
shlokas.14:
tebhya eva tu tatsarvaM kRRityayA visRRijAmyaham |
tadAsInme shataguNaM sahasraguNameva cha
tasmAnme samprakAshante trayo lokA yudhiShThira
shlokas.15:
dashaiva tu sadAchAryaH shrotriyAnatirichyate |
dashAchAryAnupAdhyAya upAdhyAyAnpitA dasha
shlokas.16:
pitR^Indasha tu mAtaikA sarvAM vA pRRithivImapi |
gurutvenAbhibhavati nAsti mAtRRisamo guruH
gururgarIyAnpitRRito mAtRRitashcheti me matiH
shlokas.17:
ubhau hi mAtApitarau janmani vyupayujyataH |
sharIrametau sRRijataH pitA mAtA cha bhArata
AchAryashiShTA yA jAtiH sA divyA sAjarAmarA
shlokas.18:
avadhyA hi sadA mAtA pitA chApyapakAriNau |
na sa.nduShyati tatkRRitvA na cha te dUShayanti tam
dharmAya yatamAnAnAM vidurdevAH saharShibhiH
shlokas.19:
ya AvRRiNotyavitathena karNA;vRRitaM bruvannamRRitaM samprayachChan |
taM vai manye pitaraM mAtaraM cha; tasmai na druhyetkRRitamasya jAnan
shlokas.20:
vidyAM shrutvA ye guruM nAdriyante; pratyAsannaM manasA karmaNA vA |
yathaiva te gurubhirbhAvanIyA;stathA teShAM guravo.apyarchanIyAH
shlokas.21:
tasmAtpUjayitavyAshcha sa.nvibhajyAshcha yatnataH |
guravo.archayitavyAshcha purANaM dharmamichChatA
shlokas.22:
yena prItAshcha pitarastena prItaH pitAmahaH |
prINAti mAtaraM yena pRRithivI tena pUjitA
shlokas.23:
yena prINAtyupAdhyAyaM tena syAdbrahma pUjitam |
mAtRRitaH pitRRitashchaiva tasmAtpUjyatamo guruH
RRiShayashcha hi devAshcha prIyante pitRRibhiH saha
shlokas.24:
na kenachana vRRittena hyavaj~neyo gururbhavet |
na cha mAtA na cha pitA tAdRRisho yAdRRisho guruH
shlokas.25:
na te.avamAnamarhanti na cha te dUShayanti tam |
gurUNAmeva satkAraM vidurdevAH saharShibhiH
shlokas.26:
upAdhyAyaM pitaraM mAtaraM cha; ye.abhidruhyanti manasA karmaNA vA |
teShAM pApaM bhrUNahatyAvishiShTaM; tasmAnnAnyaH pApakRRidasti loke
shlokas.27:
mitradruhaH kRRitaghnasya strIghnasya pishunasya cha |
chaturNAM vayameteShAM niShkRRitiM nAnushushrumaH
shlokas.28:
etatsarvamatideshena sRRiShTaM; yatkartavyaM puruSheNeha loke |
etachChreyo nAnyadasmAdvishiShTaM; sarvAndharmAnanusRRityaitaduktam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM dharme sthAtumichChannaro varteta bhArata |
vidva~njij~nAsamAnAya prabrUhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
satyaM chaivAnRRitaM chobhe lokAnAvRRitya tiShThataH |
tayoH kimAcharedrAjanpuruSho dharmanishchitaH
shlokas.3:
kiM svitsatyaM kimanRRitaM kiM sviddharmyaM sanAtanam |
kasminkAle vadetsatyaM kasminkAle.anRRitaM vadet
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
satyasya vachanaM sAdhu na satyAdvidyate param |
yadbhUloke sudurj~nAtaM tatte vakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.5:
bhavetsatyaM na vaktavyaM vaktavyamanRRitaM bhavet |
yatrAnRRitaM bhavetsatyaM satyaM vApyanRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.6:
tAdRRishe muhyate bAlo yatra satyamaniShThitam |
satyAnRRite vinishchitya tato bhavati dharmavit
shlokas.7:
apyanAryo.akRRitapraj~naH puruSho.api sudAruNaH |
sumahatprApnuyAtpuNyaM balAko.andhavadhAdiva
shlokas.8:
kimAshcharyaM cha yanmUDho dharmakAmo.apyadharmavit |
sumahatprApnuyAtpApaM ga~NgAyAmiva kaushikaH
shlokas.9:
tAdRRisho.ayamanuprashno yatra dharmaH sudurvachaH |
duShkaraH pratisa~NkhyAtuM tarkeNAtra vyavasyati
shlokas.10:
prabhAvArthAya bhUtAnAM dharmapravachanaM kRRitam |
yatsyAdahi.nsAsa.nyuktaM sa dharma iti nishchayaH
shlokas.11:
dhAraNAddharma ityAhurdharmeNa vidhRRitAH prajAH |
yatsyAddhAraNasa.nyuktaM sa dharma iti nishchayaH
shlokas.12:
shrutidharma iti hyeke netyAhurapare janAH |
na tu tatpratyasUyAmo na hi sarvaM vidhIyate
shlokas.13:
ye.anyAyena jihIrShanto dhanamichChanti karhichit |
tebhyastanna tadAkhyeyaM sa dharma iti nishchayaH
shlokas.14:
akUjanena chenmokSho nAtra kUjetkatha~nchana |
avashyaM kUjitavyaM vA sha~NkeranvApyakUjanAt
shlokas.15:
shreyastatrAnRRitaM vaktuM satyAditi vichAritam |
yaH pApaiH saha sambandhAnmuchyate shapathAditi
shlokas.16:
na cha tebhyo dhanaM deyaM shakye sati katha~nchana |
pApebhyo hi dhanaM dattaM dAtAramapi pIDayet
shlokas.17:
svasharIroparodhena varamAdAtumichChataH |
satyasampratipattyarthaM ye brUyuH sAkShiNaH kvachit
anuktvA tatra tadvAchyaM sarve te.anRRitavAdinaH
shlokas.18:
prANAtyaye vivAhe cha vaktavyamanRRitaM bhavet |
arthasya rakShaNArthAya pareShAM dharmakAraNAt
pareShAM dharmamAkA~NkShannIchaH syAddharmabhikShukaH
shlokas.19:
pratishrutya tu dAtavyaM shvaHkAryastu balAtkRRitaH |
yaH kashchiddharmasamayAtprachyuto.adharmamAsthitaH
shlokas.20:
shaThaH svadharmamutsRRijya tamichChedupajIvitum |
sarvopAyairnihantavyaH pApo nikRRitijIvanaH
shlokas.21:
dhanamityeva pApAnAM sarveShAmiha nishchayaH |
ye.aviShahyA hyasambhojyA nikRRityA patanaM gatAH
shlokas.22:
chyutA devamanuShyebhyo yathA pretAstathaiva te |
dhanAdAnAdduHkhataraM jIvitAdviprayojanam
shlokas.23:
ayaM vo rochatAM dharma iti vAchyaH prayatnataH |
na kashchidasti pApAnAM dharma ityeSha nishchayaH
shlokas.24:
tathAgataM cha yo hanyAnnAsau pApena lipyate |
svakarmaNA hataM hanti hata eva sa hanyate
teShu yaH samayaM kashchitkurvIta hatabuddhiShu
shlokas.25:
yathA kAkashcha gRRidhrashcha tathaivopadhijIvinaH |
UrdhvaM dehavimokShAnte bhavantyetAsu yoniShu
shlokas.26:
yasminyathA vartate yo manuShya;stasmi.nstathA vartitavyaM sa dharmaH |
mAyAchAro mAyayA vartitavyaH; sAdhvAchAraH sAdhunA pratyudeyaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
klishyamAneShu bhUteShu taistairbhAvaistatastataH |
durgANyatitaredyena tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AshrameShu yathokteShu yathoktaM ye dvijAtayaH |
vartante sa.nyatAtmAno durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.3:
ye dambhAnna japanti sma yeShAM vRRittishcha sa.nvRRitA |
viShayA.nshcha nigRRihNanti durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.4:
vAsayantyatithInnityaM nityaM ye chAnasUyakAH |
nityaM svAdhyAyashIlAshcha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.5:
mAtApitroshcha ye vRRittiM vartante dharmakovidAH |
varjayanti divAsvapnaM durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.6:
sveShu dAreShu vartante nyAyavRRitteShvRRitAvRRitau |
agnihotraparAH santo durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.7:
ye na lobhAnnayantyarthAnrAjAno rajasAvRRitAH |
viShayAnparirakShanto durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.8:
AhaveShu cha ye shUrAstyaktvA maraNajaM bhayam |
dharmeNa jayamichChanto durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.9:
ye pApAni na kurvanti karmaNA manasA girA |
nikShiptadaNDA bhUteShu durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.10:
ye vadantIha satyAni prANatyAge.apyupasthite |
pramANabhUtA bhUtAnAM durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.11:
anadhyAyeShu ye viprAH svAdhyAyaM naiva kurvate |
taponityAH sutapaso durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.12:
karmANyakuhakArthAni yeShAM vAchashcha sUnRRitAH |
yeShAmarthAshcha sAdhvarthA durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.13:
ye tapashcha tapasyanti kaumArabrahmachAriNaH |
vidyAvedavratasnAtA durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.14:
ye cha sa.nshAntarajasaH sa.nshAntatamasashcha ye |
satye sthitA mahAtmAno durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.15:
yeShAM na kashchittrasati trasanti na cha kasyachit |
yeShAmAtmasamo loko durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.16:
parashriyA na tapyante ye santaH puruSharShabhAH |
grAmyAdannAnnivRRittAshcha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.17:
sarvAndevAnnamasyanti sarvAndharmA.nshcha shRRiNvate |
ye shraddadhAnA dAntAshcha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.18:
ye na mAnitamichChanti mAnayanti cha ye param |
mAnyamAnA na manyante durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.19:
ye shrAddhAni cha kurvanti tithyAM tithyAM prajArthinaH |
suvishuddhena manasA durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.20:
ye krodhaM naiva kurvanti kruddhAnsa.nshamayanti cha |
na cha kupyanti bhRRityebhyo durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.21:
madhu mA.nsaM cha ye nityaM varjayantIha mAnavAH |
janmaprabhRRiti madyaM cha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.22:
yAtrArthaM bhojanaM yeShAM santAnArthaM cha maithunam |
vAksatyavachanArthAya durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.23:
IshvaraM sarvabhUtAnAM jagataH prabhavApyayam |
bhaktA nArAyaNaM ye cha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.24:
ya eSha raktapadmAkShaH pItavAsA mahAbhujaH |
suhRRidbhrAtA cha mitraM cha sambandhI cha tavAchyutaH
shlokas.25:
ya imAnsakalA.NllokA.nshcharmavatpariveShTayet |
ichChanprabhurachintyAtmA govindaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.26:
sthitaH priyahite jiShNoH sa eSha puruSharShabha |
rAja.nstava cha durdharSho vaikuNThaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.27:
ya enaM sa.nshrayantIha bhaktyA nArAyaNaM harim |
te tarantIha durgANi na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.28:
durgAtitaraNaM ye cha paThanti shrAvayanti cha |
pAThayanti cha viprebhyo durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.29:
iti kRRityasamuddeshaH kIrtitaste mayAnagha |
santaredyena durgANi paratreha cha mAnavaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asaumyAH saumyarUpeNa saumyAshchAsaumyadarshinaH |
IdRRishAnpuruShA.nstAta kathaM vidyAmahe vayam
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vyAghragomAyusa.nvAdaM taM nibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
purikAyAM puri purA shrImatyAM pauriko nRRipaH |
parahi.nsAruchiH krUro babhUva puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.4:
sa tvAyuShi parikShINe jagAmAnIpsitAM gatim |
gomAyutvaM cha samprApto dUShitaH pUrvakarmaNA
shlokas.5:
sa.nsmRRitya pUrvajAtiM sa nirvedaM paramaM gataH |
na bhakShayati mA.nsAni parairupahRRitAnyapi
shlokas.6:
ahi.nsraH sarvabhUteShu satyavAksudRRiDhavrataH |
chakAra cha yathAkAmamAhAraM patitaiH phalaiH
shlokas.7:
shmashAne tasya chAvAso gomAyoH saMmato.abhavat |
janmabhUmyanurodhAchcha nAnyadvAsamarochayat
shlokas.8:
tasya shauchamamRRiShyantaH sarve te sahajAtayaH |
chAlayanti sma tAM buddhiM vachanaiH prashrayottaraiH
shlokas.9:
vasanpitRRivane raudre shauchaM lapsitumichChasi |
iyaM vipratipattiste yadA tvaM pishitAshanaH
shlokas.10:
tatsamo vA bhavAsmAbhirbhakShyAndAsyAmahe vayam |
bhu~NkShva shauchaM parityajya yaddhi bhuktaM tadasti te
shlokas.11:
iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA pratyuvAcha samAhitaH |
madhuraiH prashritairvAkyairhetumadbhiraniShThuraiH
shlokas.12:
apramANaM prasUtirme shIlataH kriyate kulam |
prArthayiShye tu tatkarma yena vistIryate yashaH
shlokas.13:
shmashAne yadi vAso me samAdhirme nishAmyatAm |
AtmA phalati karmANi nAshramo dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.14:
Ashrame yo dvijaM hanyAdgAM vA dadyAdanAshrame |
kiM nu tatpAtakaM na syAttadvA dattaM vRRithA bhavet
shlokas.15:
bhavantaH sarvalobhena kevalaM bhakShaNe ratAH |
anubandhe tu ye doShAstAnna pashyanti mohitAH
shlokas.16:
apratyayakRRitAM garhyAmarthApanayadUShitAm |
iha chAmutra chAniShTAM tasmAdvRRittiM na rochaye
shlokas.17:
taM shuchiM paNDitaM matvA shArdUlaH khyAtavikramaH |
kRRitvAtmasadRRishAM pUjAM sAchivye.avardhayatsvayam
shlokas.18:
saumya vij~nAtarUpastvaM gachCha yAtrAM mayA saha |
vriyantAmIpsitA bhogAH parihAryAshcha puShkalAH
shlokas.19:
tIkShNA vayamiti khyAtA bhavato j~nApayAmahe |
mRRidupUrvaM ghAtinaste shreyashchAdhigamiShyati
shlokas.20:
atha sampUjya tadvAkyaM mRRigendrasya mahAtmanaH |
gomAyuH prashritaM vAkyaM babhAShe ki~nchidAnataH
shlokas.21:
sadRRishaM mRRigarAjaitattava vAkyaM madantare |
yatsahAyAnmRRigayase dharmArthakushalA~nshuchIn
shlokas.22:
na shakyamanamAtyena mahattvamanushAsitum |
duShTAmAtyena vA vIra sharIraparipanthinA
shlokas.23:
sahAyAnanuraktA.nstu yatetAnupasaMhitAn |
parasparamasa~NghuShTAnvijigIShUnalolupAn
shlokas.24:
tAnatItopadhAnprAj~nAnhite yuktAnmanasvinaH |
pUjayethA mahAbhAgAnyathAchAryAnyathA pitR^In
shlokas.25:
na tvevaM mama santoShAdrochate.anyanmRRigAdhipa |
na kAmaye sukhAnbhogAnaishvaryaM vA tvadAshrayam
shlokas.26:
na yokShyati hi me shIlaM tava bhRRityaiH purAtanaiH |
te tvAM vibhedayiShyanti duHkhashIlA madantare
shlokas.27:
sa.nshrayaH shlAghanIyastvamanyeShAmapi bhAsvatAm |
kRRitAtmA sumahAbhAgaH pApakeShvapyadAruNaH
shlokas.28:
dIrghadarshI mahotsAhaH sthUlalakShyo mahAbalaH |
kRRitI chAmoghakartAsi bhAvyaishcha samala~NkRRitaH
shlokas.29:
kiM tu svenAsmi santuShTo duHkhA vRRittiranuShThitA |
sevAyAshchApi nAbhij~naH svachChandena vanecharaH
shlokas.30:
rAjopakroshadoShAshcha sarve sa.nshrayavAsinAm |
vanacharyA cha niHsa~NgA nirbhayA niravagrahA
shlokas.31:
nRRipeNAhUyamAnasya yattiShThati bhayaM hRRidi |
na tattiShThati tuShTAnAM vane mUlaphalAshinAm
shlokas.32:
pAnIyaM vA nirAyAsaM svAdvannaM vA bhayottaram |
vichArya khalu pashyAmi tatsukhaM yatra nirvRRitiH
shlokas.33:
aparAdhairna tAvanto bhRRityAH shiShTA narAdhipaiH |
upaghAtairyathA bhRRityA dUShitA nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.34:
yadi tvetanmayA kAryaM mRRigendro yadi manyate |
samayaM kRRitamichChAmi vartitavyaM yathA mayi
shlokas.35:
madIyA mAnanIyAste shrotavyaM cha hitaM vachaH |
kalpitA yA cha te vRRittiH sA bhavettava susthirA
shlokas.36:
na mantrayeyamanyaiste sachivaiH saha karhichit |
nItimantaH parIpsanto vRRithA brUyuH pare mayi
shlokas.37:
eka ekena sa~Ngamya raho brUyAM hitaM tava |
na cha te j~nAtikAryeShu praShTavyo.ahaM hitAhite
shlokas.38:
mayA saMmantrya pashchAchcha na hi.nsyAH sachivAstvayA |
madIyAnAM cha kupito mA tvaM daNDaM nipAtayeH
shlokas.39:
evamastviti tenAsau mRRigendreNAbhipUjitaH |
prAptavAnmatisAchivyaM gomAyurvyAghrayonitaH
shlokas.40:
taM tathA satkRRitaM dRRiShTvA yujyamAnaM cha karmaNi |
prAdviShankRRitasa~NghAtAH pUrvabhRRityA muhurmuhuH
shlokas.41:
mitrabuddhyA cha gomAyuM sAntvayitvA praveshya cha |
doSheShu samatAM netumaichChannashubhabuddhayaH
shlokas.42:
anyathA hyuchitAH pUrvaM paradravyApahAriNaH |
ashaktAH ki~nchidAdAtuM dravyaM gomAyuyantritAH
shlokas.43:
vyutthAnaM chAtra kA~NkShadbhiH kathAbhiH pravilobhyate |
dhanena mahatA chaiva buddhirasya vilobhyate
shlokas.44:
na chApi sa mahAprAj~nastasmAddhairyAchchachAla ha |
athAsya samayaM kRRitvA vinAshAya sthitAH pare
shlokas.45:
IpsitaM cha mRRigendrasya mA.nsaM yattatra sa.nskRRitam |
apanIya svayaM taddhi tairnyastaM tasya veshmani
shlokas.46:
yadarthaM chApyapahRRitaM yena yachchaiva mantritam |
tasya tadviditaM sarvaM kAraNArthaM cha marShitam
shlokas.47:
samayo.ayaM kRRitastena sAchivyamupagachChatA |
nopaghAtastvayA grAhyo rAjanmaitrImihechChatA
shlokas.48:
bhojane chopahartavye tanmA.nsaM na sma dRRishyate |
mRRigarAjena chAj~naptaM mRRigyatAM chora ityuta
shlokas.49:
kRRitakaishchApi tanmA.nsaM mRRigendrAyopavarNitam |
sachivenopanItaM te viduShA prAj~namAninA
shlokas.50:
saroShastvatha shArdUlaH shrutvA gomAyuchApalam |
babhUvAmarShito rAjA vadhaM chAsyAbhyarochayat
shlokas.51:
ChidraM tu tasya taddRRiShTvA prochuste pUrvamantriNaH |
sarveShAmeva so.asmAkaM vRRittibha~NgeShu vartate
shlokas.52:
idaM chAsyedRRishaM karma vAllabhyena tu rakShyate |
shrutashcha svAminA pUrvaM yAdRRisho naiSha tAdRRishaH
shlokas.53:
vA~NmAtreNaiva dharmiShThaH svabhAvena tu dAruNaH |
dharmachChadmA hyayaM pApo vRRithAchAraparigrahaH
kAryArthaM bhojanArtheShu vrateShu kRRitavA~nshramam
shlokas.54:
mA.nsApanayanaM j~nAtvA vyAghrasteShAM tu tadvachaH |
Aj~nApayAmAsa tadA gomAyurvadhyatAmiti
shlokas.55:
shArdUlavachanaM shrutvA shArdUlajananI tataH |
mRRigarAjaM hitairvAkyaiH sambodhayitumAgamat
shlokas.56:
putra naitattvayA grAhyaM kapaTArambhasa.nvRRitam |
karmasa~NgharShajairdoShairduShyatyashuchibhiH shuchiH
shlokas.57:
nochChritaM sahate kashchitprakriyA vairakArikA |
shucherapi hi yuktasya doSha eva nipAtyate
shlokas.58:
lubdhAnAM shuchayo dveShyAH kAtarANAM tarasvinaH |
mUrkhANAM paNDitA dveShyA daridrANAM mahAdhanAH
adhArmikANAM dharmiShThA virUpANAM surUpakAH
shlokas.59:
bahavaH paNDitA lubdhAH sarve mAyopajIvinaH |
kuryurdoShamadoShasya bRRihaspatimaterapi
shlokas.60:
shUnyAttachcha gRRihAnmA.nsaM yadadyApahRRitaM tava |
nechChate dIyamAnaM cha sAdhu tAvadvimRRishyatAm
shlokas.61:
asatyAH satyasa~NkAshAH satyAshchAsatyadarshinaH |
dRRishyante vividhA bhAvAsteShu yuktaM parIkShaNam
shlokas.62:
talavaddRRishyate vyoma khadyoto havyavADiva |
na chaivAsti talaM vyomni na khadyote hutAshanaH
shlokas.63:
tasmAtpratyakShadRRiShTo.api yuktamarthaH parIkShitum |
parIkShya j~nApayanhyarthAnna pashchAtparitapyate
shlokas.64:
na duShkaramidaM putra yatprabhurghAtayetparam |
shlAghanIyA cha varyA cha loke prabhavatAM kShamA
shlokas.65:
sthApito.ayaM putra tvayA sAmanteShvadhi vishrutaH |
duHkhenAsAdyate pAtraM dhAryatAmeSha te suhRRit
shlokas.66:
dUShitaM paradoShairhi gRRihNIte yo.anyathA shuchim |
svayaM sa.ndUShitAmAtyaH kShiprameva vinashyati
shlokas.67:
tasmAdathArisa~NghAtAdgomAyoH kashchidAgataH |
dharmAtmA tena chAkhyAtaM yathaitatkapaTaM kRRitam
shlokas.68:
tato vij~nAtachAritraH satkRRitya sa vimokShitaH |
pariShvaktashcha sasnehaM mRRigendreNa punaH punaH
shlokas.69:
anuj~nApya mRRigendraM tu gomAyurnItishAstravit |
tenAmarSheNa santaptaH prAyamAsitumaichChata
shlokas.70:
shArdUlastatra gomAyuM snehAtprasrutalochanaH |
avArayatsa dharmiShThaM pUjayA pratipUjayan
shlokas.71:
taM sa gomAyurAlokya snehAdAgatasambhramam |
babhAShe praNato vAkyaM bAShpagadgadayA girA
shlokas.72:
pUjito.ahaM tvayA pUrvaM pashchAchchaiva vimAnitaH |
pareShAmAspadaM nIto vastuM nArhAmyahaM tvayi
shlokas.73:
svasantuShTAshchyutAH sthAnAnmAnAtpratyavaropitAH |
svayaM chopahRRitA bhRRityA ye chApyupahRRitAH paraiH
shlokas.74:
parikShINAshcha lubdhAshcha krUrAH kArAbhitApitAH |
hRRitasvA mAnino ye cha tyaktopAttA mahepsavaH
shlokas.75:
santApitAshcha ye kechidvyasanaughapratIkShiNaH |
antarhitAH sopahitAH sarve te parasAdhanAH
shlokas.76:
avamAnena yuktasya sthApitasya cha me punaH |
kathaM yAsyasi vishvAsamahameShyAmi vA punaH
shlokas.77:
samartha iti sa~NgRRihya sthApayitvA parIkShya cha |
kRRitaM cha samayaM bhittvA tvayAhamavamAnitaH
shlokas.78:
prathamaM yaH samAkhyAtaH shIlavAniti sa.nsadi |
na vAchyaM tasya vaiguNyaM pratij~nAM parirakShatA
shlokas.79:
evaM chAvamatasyeha vishvAsaM kiM prayAsyasi |
tvayi chaiva hyavishvAse mamodvego bhaviShyati
shlokas.80:
sha~NkitastvamahaM bhItaH pare ChidrAnudarshinaH |
asnigdhAshchaiva dustoShAH karma chaitadbahuchChalam
shlokas.81:
duHkhena shleShyate bhinnaM shliShTaM duHkhena bhidyate |
bhinnashliShTA tu yA prItirna sA snehena vartate
shlokas.82:
kashchideva hi bhItastu dRRishyate na parAtmanoH |
kAryApekShA hi vartante bhAvAH snigdhAstu durlabhAH
shlokas.83:
suduHkhaM puruShaj~nAnaM chittaM hyeShAM chalAchalam |
samartho vApyashakto vA shateShveko.adhigamyate
shlokas.84:
akasmAtprakriyA nR^INAmakasmAchchApakarShaNam |
shubhAshubhe mahattvaM cha prakartuM buddhilAghavAt
shlokas.85:
evaM bahuvidhaM sAntvamuktvA dharmArthahetumat |
prasAdayitvA rAjAnaM gomAyurvanamabhyagAt
shlokas.86:
agRRihyAnunayaM tasya mRRigendrasya sa buddhimAn |
gomAyuH prAyamAsInastyaktvA dehaM divaM yayau

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM pArthivena kartavyaM kiM cha kRRitvA sukhI bhavet |
tanmamAchakShva tattvena sarvaM dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta te.ahaM pravakShyAmi shRRiNu kAryaikanishchayam |
yathA rAj~neha kartavyaM yachcha kRRitvA sukhI bhavet
shlokas.3:
na tvevaM vartitavyaM sma yathedamanushushrumaH |
uShTrasya sumahadvRRittaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.4:
jAtismaro mahAnuShTraH prAjApatyayugodbhavaH |
tapaH sumahadAtiShThadaraNye sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.5:
tapasastasya chAnte vai prItimAnabhavatprabhuH |
vareNa ChandayAmAsa tatashchainaM pitAmahaH
shlokas.6:
uShTra uvAcha||
bhagava.nstvatprasAdAnme dIrghA grIvA bhavediyam |
yojanAnAM shataM sAgraM yA gachChechcharituM vibho
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamastviti choktaH sa varadena mahAtmanA |
pratilabhya varaM shreShThaM yayAvuShTraH svakaM vanam
shlokas.8:
sa chakAra tadAlasyaM varadAnAtsa durmatiH |
na chaichChachcharituM gantuM durAtmA kAlamohitaH
shlokas.9:
sa kadAchitprasAryaivaM tAM grIvAM shatayojanAm |
chachArAshrAntahRRidayo vAtashchAgAttato mahAn
shlokas.10:
sa guhAyAM shirogrIvaM nidhAya pashurAtmanaH |
AstAtha varShamabhyAgAtsumahatplAvayajjagat
shlokas.11:
atha shItaparItA~Ngo jambukaH kShuchChramAnvitaH |
sadArastAM guhAmAshu pravivesha jalArditaH
shlokas.12:
sa dRRiShTvA mA.nsajIvI tu subhRRishaM kShuchChramAnvitaH |
abhakShayattato grIvAmuShTrasya bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
yadA tvabudhyatAtmAnaM bhakShyamANaM sa vai pashuH |
tadA sa~Nkochane yatnamakarodbhRRishaduHkhitaH
shlokas.14:
yAvadUrdhvamadhashchaiva grIvAM sa~NkShipate pashuH |
tAvattena sadAreNa jambukena sa bhakShitaH
shlokas.15:
sa hatvA bhakShayitvA cha jambukoShTraM tatastadA |
vigate vAtavarShe cha nishchakrAma guhAmukhAt
shlokas.16:
evaM durbuddhinA prAptamuShTreNa nidhanaM tadA |
Alasyasya kramAtpashya mahaddoShamupAgatam
shlokas.17:
tvamapyetaM vidhiM tyaktvA yogena niyatendriyaH |
vartasva buddhimUlaM hi vijayaM manurabravIt
shlokas.18:
buddhishreShThAni karmANi bAhumadhyAni bhArata |
tAni ja~NghAjaghanyAni bhArapratyavarANi cha
shlokas.19:
rAjyaM tiShThati dakShasya sa~NgRRihItendriyasya cha |
guptamantrashrutavataH susahAyasya chAnagha
shlokas.20:
parIkShyakAriNo.arthAshcha tiShThantIha yudhiShThira |
sahAyayuktena mahI kRRitsnA shakyA prashAsitum
shlokas.21:
idaM hi sadbhiH kathitaM vidhij~naiH; purA mahendrapratimaprabhAva |
mayApi choktaM tava shAstradRRiShTyA; tvamatra yuktaH pracharasva rAjan

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rAjA rAjyamanuprApya durbalo bharatarShabha |
amitrasyAtivRRiddhasya kathaM tiShThedasAdhanaH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
saritAM chaiva sa.nvAdaM sAgarasya cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
surArinilayaH shashvatsAgaraH saritAM patiH |
paprachCha saritaH sarvAH sa.nshayaM jAtamAtmanaH
shlokas.4:
samUlashAkhAnpashyAmi nihatA.nshChAyino drumAn |
yuShmAbhiriha pUrNAbhiranyA.nstatra na vetasam
shlokas.5:
akAyashchAlpasArashcha vetasaH kUlajashcha vaH |
avaj~nAya nashakyo vA ki~nchidvA tena vaH kRRitam
shlokas.6:
tadahaM shrotumichChAmi sarvAsAmeva vo matam |
yathA kUlAni chemAni bhittvA nAnIyate vasham
shlokas.7:
tataH prAha nadI ga~NgA vAkyamuttaramarthavat |
hetumadgrAhakaM chaiva sAgaraM saritAM patim
shlokas.8:
tiShThantyete yathAsthAnaM nagA hyekaniketanAH |
tatastyajanti tatsthAnaM prAtilomyAdachetasaH
shlokas.9:
vetaso vegamAyAntaM dRRiShTvA namati netaraH |
sa cha vege.abhyatikrAnte sthAnamAsAdya tiShThati
shlokas.10:
kAlaj~naH samayaj~nashcha sadA vashyashcha nodrumaH |
anulomastathAstabdhastena nAbhyeti vetasaH
shlokas.11:
mArutodakavegena ye namantyunnamanti cha |
oShadhyaH pAdapA gulmA na te yAnti parAbhavam
shlokas.12:
yo hi shatrorvivRRiddhasya prabhorvadhavinAshane |
pUrvaM na sahate vegaM kShiprameva sa nashyati
shlokas.13:
sArAsAraM balaM vIryamAtmano dviShatashcha yaH |
jAnanvicharati prAj~no na sa yAti parAbhavam
shlokas.14:
evameva yadA vidvAnmanyetAtibalaM ripum |
sa.nshrayedvaitasIM vRRittimevaM praj~nAnalakShaNam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vidvAnmUrkhapragalbhena mRRidustIkShNena bhArata |
AkrushyamAnaH sadasi kathaM kuryAdari.ndama
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shrUyatAM pRRithivIpAla yathaiSho.artho.anugIyate |
sadA suchetAH sahate narasyehAlpachetasaH
shlokas.3:
aruShyankrushyamAnasya sukRRitaM nAma vindati |
duShkRRitaM chAtmano marShI ruShyatyevApamArShTi vai
shlokas.4:
TiTTibhaM tamupekSheta vAshamAnamivAturam |
lokavidveShamApanno niShphalaM pratipadyate
shlokas.5:
iti sa shlAghate nityaM tena pApena karmaNA |
idamukto mayA kashchitsaMmato janasa.nsadi
sa tatra vrIDitaH shuShko mRRitakalpo.avatiShThati
shlokas.6:
shlAghannashlAghanIyena karmaNA nirapatrapaH |
upekShitavyo dAntena tAdRRishaH puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.7:
yadyadbrUyAdalpamatistattadasya sahetsadA |
prAkRRito hi prasha.nsanvA nindanvA kiM kariShyati
vane kAka ivAbuddhirvAshamAno nirarthakam
shlokas.8:
yadi vAgbhiH prayogaH syAtprayoge pApakarmaNaH |
vAgevArtho bhavettasya na hyevArtho jighA.nsataH
shlokas.9:
niShekaM viparItaM sa AchaShTe vRRittacheShTayA |
mayUra iva kaupInaM nRRityansa.ndarshayanniva
shlokas.10:
yasyAvAchyaM na loke.asti nAkAryaM vApi ki~nchana |
vAchaM tena na sa.ndadhyAchChuchiH sa~NkliShTakarmaNA
shlokas.11:
pratyakShaM guNavAdI yaH parokShaM tu vinindakaH |
sa mAnavaH shvavalloke naShTalokaparAyaNaH
shlokas.12:
tAdRRigjanashatasyApi yaddadAti juhoti cha |
parokSheNApavAdena tannAshayati sa kShaNAt
shlokas.13:
tasmAtprAj~no naraH sadyastAdRRishaM pApachetasam |
varjayetsAdhubhirvarjyaM sArameyAmiShaM yathA
shlokas.14:
parivAdaM bruvANo hi durAtmA vai mahAtmane |
prakAshayati doShAnsvAnsarpaH phaNamivochChritam
shlokas.15:
taM svakarmANi kurvANaM pratikartuM ya ichChati |
bhasmakUTa ivAbuddhiH kharo rajasi majjati
shlokas.16:
manuShyashAlAvRRikamaprashAntaM; janApavAde satataM niviShTam |
mAta~NgamunmattamivonnadantaM; tyajeta taM shvAnamivAtiraudram
shlokas.17:
adhIrajuShTe pathi vartamAnaM; damAdapetaM vinayAchcha pApam |
arivrataM nityamabhUtikAmaM; dhigastu taM pApamatiM manuShyam
shlokas.18:
pratyuchyamAnastu hi bhUya ebhi;rnishAmya mA bhUstvamathArtarUpaH |
uchchasya nIchena hi samprayogaM; vigarhayanti sthirabuddhayo ye
shlokas.19:
kruddho dashArdhena hi tADayedvA; sa pA.nsubhirvApakirettuShairvA |
vivRRitya dantA.nshcha vibhIShayedvA; siddhaM hi mUrkhe kupite nRRisha.nse
shlokas.20:
vigarhaNAM paramadurAtmanA kRRitAM; saheta yaH sa.nsadi durjanAnnaraH |
paThedidaM chApi nidarshanaM sadA; na vA~NmayaM sa labhati ki~nchidapriyam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na sa.nshayo me mahAnayam |
sa chChettavyastvayA rAjanbhavAnkulakaro hi naH
shlokas.2:
puruShANAmayaM tAta durvRRittAnAM durAtmanAm |
kathito vAkyasa~nchArastato vij~nApayAmi te
shlokas.3:
yaddhitaM rAjyatantrasya kulasya cha sukhodayam |
AyatyAM cha tadAtve cha kShemavRRiddhikaraM cha yat
shlokas.4:
putrapautrAbhirAmaM cha rAShTravRRiddhikaraM cha yat |
annapAne sharIre cha hitaM yattadbravIhi me
shlokas.5:
abhiShikto hi yo rAjA rAjyastho mitrasa.nvRRitaH |
asuhRRitsamupeto vA sa kathaM ra~njayetprajAH
shlokas.6:
yo hyasatpragraharatiH sneharAgabalAtkRRitaH |
indriyANAmanIshatvAdasajjanabubhUShakaH
shlokas.7:
tasya bhRRityA viguNatAM yAnti sarve kulodgatAH |
na cha bhRRityaphalairarthaiH sa rAjA samprayujyate
shlokas.8:
etAnme sa.nshayasthasya rAjadharmAnsudurlabhAn |
bRRihaspatisamo buddhyA bhavA~nsha.nsitumarhati
shlokas.9:
sha.nsitA puruShavyAghra tvaM naH kulahite rataH |
kShattA chaiva paTupraj~no yo naH sha.nsati sarvadA
shlokas.10:
tvattaH kulahitaM vAkyaM shrutvA rAjyahitodayam |
amRRitasyAvyayasyeva tRRiptaH svapsyAmyahaM sukham
shlokas.11:
kIdRRiShAH saMnikarShasthA bhRRityAH syurvA guNAnvitAH |
kIdRRishaiH ki~NkulInairvA saha yAtrA vidhIyate
shlokas.12:
na hyeko bhRRityarahito rAjA bhavati rakShitA |
rAjyaM chedaM janaH sarvastatkulIno.abhisha.nsati
shlokas.13:
na hi prashAstuM rAjyaM hi shakyamekena bhArata |
asahAyavatA tAta naivArthAH kechidapyuta
labdhuM labdhvA chApi sadA rakShituM bharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yasya bhRRityajanaH sarvo j~nAnavij~nAnakovidaH |
hitaiShI kulajaH snigdhaH sa rAjyaphalamashnute
shlokas.15:
mantriNo yasya kulajA asaMhAryAH sahoShitAH |
nRRipatermatidAH santi sambandhaj~nAnakovidAH
shlokas.16:
anAgatavidhAtAraH kAlaj~nAnavishAradAH |
atikrAntamashochantaH sa rAjyaphalamashnute
shlokas.17:
samaduHkhasukhA yasya sahAyAH satyakAriNaH |
arthachintAparA yasya sa rAjyaphalamashnute
shlokas.18:
yasya nArto janapadaH saMnikarShagataH sadA |
akShudraH satpathAlambI sa rAjyaphalabhAgbhavet
shlokas.19:
koshAkShapaTalaM yasya koshavRRiddhikarairjanaiH |
AptaistuShTaishcha satataM dhAryate sa nRRipottamaH
shlokas.20:
koShThAgAramasaMhAryairAptaiH sa~nchayatatparaiH |
pAtrabhUtairalubdhaishcha pAlyamAnaM guNIbhavet
shlokas.21:
vyavahArashcha nagare yasya karmaphalodayaH |
dRRishyate sha~NkhalikhitaH sa dharmaphalabhAgbhavet
shlokas.22:
sa~NgRRihItamanuShyashcha yo rAjA rAjadharmavit |
ShaDvargaM pratigRRihNansa dharmAtphalamupAshnute

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nidarshanakaraM loke sajjanAcharitaM sadA
shlokas.2:
asyaivArthasya sadRRishaM yachChrutaM me tapovane |
jAmadagnyasya rAmasya yaduktamRRiShisattamaiH
shlokas.3:
vane mahati kasmi.nshchidamanuShyaniShevite |
RRiShirmUlaphalAhAro niyato niyatendriyaH
shlokas.4:
dIkShAdamaparaH shAntaH svAdhyAyaparamaH shuchiH |
upavAsavishuddhAtmA satataM satpathe sthitaH
shlokas.5:
tasya sa.ndRRishya sadbhAvamupaviShTasya dhImataH |
sarvasattvAH samIpasthA bhavanti vanachAriNaH
shlokas.6:
siMhavyAghrAH sasharabhA mattAshchaiva mahAgajAH |
dvIpinaH khaDgabhallUkA ye chAnye bhImadarshanAH
shlokas.7:
te sukhaprashnadAH sarve bhavanti kShatajAshanAH |
tasyarSheH shiShyavachchaiva nyagbhUtAH priyakAriNaH
shlokas.8:
dattvA cha te sukhaprashnaM sarve yAnti yathAgatam |
grAmyastvekaH pashustatra nAjahAchChvA mahAmunim
shlokas.9:
bhakto.anuraktaH satatamupavAsakRRisho.abalaH |
phalamUlotkarAhAraH shAntaH shiShTAkRRitiryathA
shlokas.10:
tasyarSherupaviShTasya pAdamUle mahAmuneH |
manuShyavadgato bhAvaH snehabaddho.abhavadbhRRisham
shlokas.11:
tato.abhyayAnmahAvIryo dvIpI kShatajabhojanaH |
shvArthamatyantasa.nduShTaH krUraH kAla ivAntakaH
shlokas.12:
lelihyamAnastRRiShitaH puchChAsphoTanatatparaH |
vyAditAsyaH kShudhAbhagnaH prArthayAnastadAmiSham
shlokas.13:
taM dRRiShTvA krUramAyAntaM jIvitArthI narAdhipa |
provAcha shvA muniM tatra yattachChRRiNu mahAmate
shlokas.14:
shvashatrurbhagavannatra dvIpI mAM hantumichChati |
tvatprasAdAdbhayaM na syAttasmAnmama mahAmune
shlokas.15:
muniruvAcha||
na bhayaM dvIpinaH kAryaM mRRityutaste katha~nchana |
eSha shvarUparahito dvIpI bhavasi putraka
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH shvA dvIpitAM nIto jAmbUnadanibhAkRRitiH |
chitrA~Ngo visphuranhRRiShTo vane vasati nirbhayaH
shlokas.17:
tato.abhyayAnmahAraudro vyAditAsyaH kShudhAnvitaH |
dvIpinaM lelihadvaktro vyAghro rudhiralAlasaH
shlokas.18:
vyAghraM dRRiShTvA kShudhAbhagnaM daMShTriNaM vanagocharam |
dvIpI jIvitarakShArthamRRiShiM sharaNameyivAn
shlokas.19:
tataH sa.nvAsajaM snehamRRiShiNA kurvatA sadA |
sa dvIpI vyAghratAM nIto ripubhirbalavattaraH
tato dRRiShTvA sa shArdUlo nAbhyaha.nstaM vishAM pate
shlokas.20:
sa tu shvA vyAghratAM prApya balavAnpishitAshanaH |
na mUlaphalabhogeShu spRRihAmapyakarottadA
shlokas.21:
yathA mRRigapatirnityaM prakA~NkShati vanaukasaH |
tathaiva sa mahArAja vyAghraH samabhavattadA
shlokas.22:
vyAghrastUTajamUlasthastRRiptaH supto hatairmRRigaiH |
nAgashchAgAttamuddeshaM matto megha ivotthitaH
shlokas.23:
prabhinnakaraTaH prA.nshuH padmI vitatamastakaH |
suviShANo mahAkAyo meghagambhIranisvanaH
shlokas.24:
taM dRRiShTvA ku~njaraM mattamAyAntaM madagarvitam |
vyAghro hastibhayAttrastastamRRiShiM sharaNaM yayau
shlokas.25:
tato.anayatku~njaratAM taM vyAghramRRiShisattamaH |
mahAmeghopamaM dRRiShTvA taM sa bhIto.abhavadgajaH
shlokas.26:
tataH kamalaShaNDAni shallakIgahanAni cha |
vyacharatsa mudA yuktaH padmareNuvibhUShitaH
shlokas.27:
kadAchidramamANasya hastinaH sumukhaM tadA |
RRiShestasyoTajasthasya kAlo.agachChannishAnisham
shlokas.28:
athAjagAma taM deshaM kesarI kesarAruNaH |
girikandarajo bhImaH siMho nAgakulAntakaH
shlokas.29:
taM dRRiShTvA siMhamAyAntaM nAgaH siMhabhayAkulaH |
RRiShiM sharaNamApede vepamAno bhayAturaH
shlokas.30:
tataH sa siMhatAM nIto nAgendro muninA tadA |
vanyaM nAgaNayatsiMhaM tulyajAtisamanvayAt
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTvA cha so.anashatsiMho vanyo bhIsannavAgbalaH |
sa chAshrame.avasatsiMhastasminneva vane sukhI
shlokas.32:
na tvanye kShudrapashavastapovananivAsinaH |
vyadRRishyanta bhayatrastA jIvitAkA~NkShiNaH sadA
shlokas.33:
kadAchitkAlayogena sarvaprANivihi.nsakaH |
balavAnkShatajAhAro nAnAsattvabhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.34:
aShTapAdUrdhvacharaNaH sharabho vanagocharaH |
taM siMhaM hantumAgachChanmunestasya niveshanam
shlokas.35:
taM muniH sharabhaM chakre balotkaTamari.ndama |
tataH sa sharabho vanyo muneH sharabhamagrataH
dRRiShTvA balinamatyugraM drutaM samprAdravadbhayAt
shlokas.36:
sa evaM sharabhasthAne nyasto vai muninA tadA |
muneH pArshvagato nityaM shArabhyaM sukhamAptavAn
shlokas.37:
tataH sharabhasantrastAH sarve mRRigagaNA vanAt |
dishaH samprAdravanrAjanbhayAjjIvitakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.38:
sharabho.apyatisa.nduShTo nityaM prANivadhe rataH |
phalamUlAshanaM shAntaM naichChatsa pishitAshanaH
shlokas.39:
tato rudhiratarSheNa balinA sharabho.anvitaH |
iyeSha taM muniM hantumakRRitaj~naH shvayonijaH
shlokas.40:
tatastena tapaHshaktyA vidito j~nAnachakShuShA |
vij~nAya cha mahAprAj~no muniH shvAnaM tamuktavAn
shlokas.41:
shvA tvaM dvIpitvamApanno dvIpI vyAghratvamAgataH |
vyAghro nAgo madapaTurnAgaH siMhatvamAptavAn
shlokas.42:
siMho.atibalasa.nyukto bhUyaH sharabhatAM gataH |
mayA snehaparItena na vimRRiShTaH kulAnvayaH
shlokas.43:
yasmAdevamapApaM mAM pApa hi.nsitumichChasi |
tasmAtsvayonimApannaH shvaiva tvaM hi bhaviShyasi
shlokas.44:
tato munijanadveShAdduShTAtmA shvAkRRito.abudhaH |
RRiShiNA sharabhaH shaptaH svaM rUpaM punarAptavAn

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa shvA prakRRitimApannaH paraM dainyamupAgamat |
RRiShiNA hu~NkRRitaH pApastapovanabahiShkRRitaH
shlokas.2:
evaM rAj~nA matimatA viditvA shIlashauchatAm |
ArjavaM prakRRitiM sattvaM kulaM vRRittaM shrutaM damam
shlokas.3:
anukroshaM balaM vIryaM bhAvaM samprashamaM kShamAm |
bhRRityA ye yatra yogyAH syustatra sthApyAH sushikShitAH
shlokas.4:
nAparIkShya mahIpAlaH prakartuM bhRRityamarhati |
akulInanarAkIrNo na rAjA sukhamedhate
shlokas.5:
kulajaH prakRRito rAj~nA tatkulInatayA sadA |
na pApe kurute buddhiM nindyamAno.apyanAgasi
shlokas.6:
akulInastu puruShaH prakRRitaH sAdhusa~NkShayAt |
durlabhaishvaryatAM prApto ninditaH shatrutAM vrajet
shlokas.7:
kulInaM shikShitaM prAj~naM j~nAnavij~nAnakovidam |
sarvashAstrArthatattvaj~naM sahiShNuM deshajaM tathA
shlokas.8:
kRRitaj~naM balavantaM cha kShAntaM dAntaM jitendriyam |
alubdhaM labdhasantuShTaM svAmimitrabubhUShakam
shlokas.9:
sachivaM deshakAlaj~naM sarvasa~NgrahaNe ratam |
satkRRitaM yuktamanasaM hitaiShiNamatandritam
shlokas.10:
yuktAchAraM svaviShaye sandhivigrahakovidam |
rAj~nastrivargavettAraM paurajAnapadapriyam
shlokas.11:
khAtakavyUhatattvaj~naM balaharShaNakovidam |
i~NgitAkAratattvaj~naM yAtrAyAnavishAradam
shlokas.12:
hastishikShAsu tattvaj~namaha~NkAravivarjitam |
pragalbhaM dakShiNaM dAntaM balinaM yuktakAriNam
shlokas.13:
chokShaM chokShajanAkIrNaM suveShaM sukhadarshanam |
nAyakaM nItikushalaM guNaShaShTyA samanvitam
shlokas.14:
astabdhaM prashritaM shaktaM mRRiduvAdinameva cha |
dhIraM shlakShNaM maharddhiM cha deshakAlopapAdakam
shlokas.15:
sachivaM yaH prakurute na chainamavamanyate |
tasya vistIryate rAjyaM jyotsnA grahapateriva
shlokas.16:
etaireva guNairyukto rAjA shAstravishAradaH |
eShTavyo dharmaparamaH prajApAlanatatparaH
shlokas.17:
dhIro marShI shuchiH shIghraH kAle puruShakAravit |
shushrUShuH shrutavA~nshrotA UhApohavishAradaH
shlokas.18:
medhAvI dhAraNAyukto yathAnyAyopapAdakaH |
dAntaH sadA priyAbhAShI kShamAvA.nshcha viparyaye
shlokas.19:
dAnAchChede svaya~NkArI sudvAraH sukhadarshanaH |
Artahastaprado nityamAptaMmanyo naye rataH
shlokas.20:
nAha.nvAdI na nirdva.ndvo na yatki~nchanakArakaH |
kRRite karmaNyamoghAnAM kartA bhRRityajanapriyaH
shlokas.21:
sa~NgRRihItajano.astabdhaH prasannavadanaH sadA |
dAtA bhRRityajanAvekShI na krodhI sumahAmanAH
shlokas.22:
yuktadaNDo na nirdaNDo dharmakAryAnushAsakaH |
chAranetraH parAvekShI dharmArthakushalaH sadA
shlokas.23:
rAjA guNashatAkIrNa eShTavyastAdRRisho bhavet |
yodhAshchaiva manuShyendra sarvairguNaguNairvRRitAH
shlokas.24:
anveShTavyAH supuruShAH sahAyA rAjyadhAraNAH |
na vimAnayitavyAshcha rAj~nA vRRiddhimabhIpsatA
shlokas.25:
yodhAH samarashauTIrAH kRRitaj~nAH shastrakovidAH |
dharmashAstrasamAyuktAH padAtijanasa.nyutAH
shlokas.26:
arthamAnavivRRiddhAshcha rathacharyAvishAradAH |
iShvastrakushalA yasya tasyeyaM nRRipatermahI
shlokas.27:
sarvasa~NgrahaNe yukto nRRipo bhavati yaH sadA |
utthAnashIlo mitrADhyaH sa rAjA rAjasattamaH
shlokas.28:
shakyA ashvasahasreNa vIrAroheNa bhArata |
sa~NgRRihItamanuShyeNa kRRitsnA jetuM vasundharA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM shunAsamAnbhRRityAnsvasthAne yo narAdhipaH |
niyojayati kRRityeShu sa rAjyaphalamashnute
shlokas.2:
na shvA svasthAnamutkramya pramANamabhi satkRRitaH |
AropyaH shvA svakAtsthAnAdutkramyAnyatprapadyate
shlokas.3:
svajAtikulasampannAH sveShu karmasvavasthitAH |
prakartavyA budhA bhRRityA nAsthAne prakriyA kShamA
shlokas.4:
anurUpANi karmANi bhRRityebhyo yaH prayachChati |
sa bhRRityaguNasampannaM rAjA phalamupAshnute
shlokas.5:
sharabhaH sharabhasthAne siMhaH siMha ivorjitaH |
vyAghro vyAghra iva sthApyo dvIpI dvIpI yathA tathA
shlokas.6:
karmasvihAnurUpeShu nyasyA bhRRityA yathAvidhi |
pratilomaM na bhRRityAste sthApyAH karmaphalaiShiNA
shlokas.7:
yaH pramANamatikramya pratilomaM narAdhipaH |
bhRRityAnsthApayate.abuddhirna sa ra~njayate prajAH
shlokas.8:
na bAlishA na cha kShudrA na chApratimitendriyAH |
nAkulInA narAH pArshve sthApyA rAj~nA hitaiShiNA
shlokas.9:
sAdhavaH kushalAH shUrA j~nAnavanto.anasUyakAH |
akShudrAH shuchayo dakShA narAH syuH pAripArshvakAH
shlokas.10:
nyagbhUtAstatparAH kShAntAshchaukShAH prakRRitijAH shubhAH |
sve sve sthAne.aparikruShTAste syU rAj~no bahishcharAH
shlokas.11:
siMhasya satataM pArshve siMha eva jano bhavet |
asiMhaH siMhasahitaH siMhavallabhate phalam
shlokas.12:
yastu siMhaH shvabhiH kIrNaH siMhakarmaphale rataH |
na sa siMhaphalaM bhoktuM shaktaH shvabhirupAsitaH
shlokas.13:
evametairmanuShyendra shUraiH prAj~nairbahushrutaiH |
kulInaiH saha shakyeta kRRitsnAM jetuM vasundharAm
shlokas.14:
nAvaidyo nAnRRijuH pArshve nAvidyo nAmahAdhanaH |
sa~NgrAhyo vasudhApAlairbhRRityo bhRRityavatAM vara
shlokas.15:
bANavadvisRRitA yAnti svAmikAryaparA janAH |
ye bhRRityAH pArthivahitAsteShAM sAntvaM prayojayet
shlokas.16:
koshashcha satataM rakShyo yatnamAsthAya rAjabhiH |
koshamUlA hi rAjAnaH koshamUlakaro bhava
shlokas.17:
koShThAgAraM cha te nityaM sphItaM dhAnyaiH susa~nchitam |
sadAstu satsu saMnyastaM dhanadhAnyaparo bhava
shlokas.18:
nityayuktAshcha te bhRRityA bhavantu raNakovidAH |
vAjinAM cha prayogeShu vaishAradyamiheShyate
shlokas.19:
j~nAtibandhujanAvekShI mitrasambandhisa.nvRRitaH |
paurakAryahitAnveShI bhava kauravanandana
shlokas.20:
eShA te naiShThikI buddhiH praj~nA chAbhihitA mayA |
shvA te nidarshanaM tAta kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
rAjavRRittAnyanekAni tvayA proktAni bhArata |
pUrvaiH pUrvaniyuktAni rAjadharmArthavedibhiH
shlokas.2:
tadeva vistareNoktaM pUrvairdRRiShTaM satAM matam |
praNayaM rAjadharmANAM prabrUhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rakShaNaM sarvabhUtAnAmiti kShatre paraM matam |
tadyathA rakShaNaM kuryAttathA shRRiNu mahIpate
shlokas.4:
yathA barhANi chitrANi bibharti bhujagAshanaH |
tathA bahuvidhaM rAjA rUpaM kurvIta dharmavit
shlokas.5:
taikShNyaM jihmatvamAdAntyaM satyamArjavameva cha |
madhyasthaH sattvamAtiShTha.nstathA vai sukhamRRichChati
shlokas.6:
yasminnarthe hitaM yatsyAttadvarNaM rUpamAvishet |
bahurUpasya rAj~no hi sUkShmo.apyartho na sIdati
shlokas.7:
nityaM rakShitamantraH syAdyathA mUkaH sharachChikhI |
shlakShNAkSharatanuH shrImAnbhavechChAstravishAradaH
shlokas.8:
ApaddvAreShu yattaH syAjjalaprasravaNeShviva |
shailavarShodakAnIva dvijAnsiddhAnsamAshrayet
shlokas.9:
arthakAmaH shikhAM rAjA kuryAddharmadhvajopamAm |
nityamudyatadaNDaH syAdAcharechchApramAdataH
loke chAyavyayau dRRiShTvA vRRikShAdvRRikShamivAplavan
shlokas.10:
mRRijAvAnsyAtsvayUthyeShu bhAvAni charaNaiH kShipet |
jAtapakShaH parispandedrakShedvaikalyamAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
doShAnvivRRiNuyAchChatroH parapakShAnvidhUnayet |
kAnaneShviva puShpANi barhIvArthAnsamAcharet
shlokas.12:
uchChritAnAshrayetsphItAnnarendrAnachalopamAn |
shrayechChAyAmavij~nAtAM guptaM sharaNamAshrayet
shlokas.13:
prAvRRiShIvAsitagrIvo majjeta nishi nirjane |
mAyUreNa guNenaiva strIbhishchAlakShitashcharet
na jahyAchcha tanutrANaM rakShedAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.14:
chArabhUmiShvabhigamAnpAshA.nshcha parivarjayet |
pIDayechchApi tAM bhUmiM praNashyedgahane punaH
shlokas.15:
hanyAtkruddhAnativiShAnye jihmagatayo.ahitAn |
nAshrayedbAlabarhANi sannivAsAni vAsayet
shlokas.16:
sadA barhinibhaH kAmaM prasaktikRRitamAcharet |
sarvatashchAdadetpraj~nAM pata~NgAngahaneShviva
evaM mayUravadrAjA svarAShTraM paripAlayet
shlokas.17:
AtmavRRiddhikarIM nItiM vidadhIta vichakShaNaH |
Atmasa.nyamanaM buddhyA parabuddhyAvatAraNam
buddhyA chAtmaguNaprAptiretachChAstranidarshanam
shlokas.18:
paraM chAshvAsayetsAmnA svashaktiM chopalakShayet |
AtmanaH parimarshena buddhiM buddhyA vichArayet
sAntvayogamatiH prAj~naH kAryAkAryavichArakaH
shlokas.19:
nigUDhabuddhirdhIraH syAdvaktavye vakShyate tathA |
saMnikRRiShTAM kathAM prAj~no yadi buddhyA bRRihaspatiH
svabhAvameShyate taptaM kRRiShNAyasamivodake
shlokas.20:
anuyu~njIta kRRityAni sarvANyeva mahIpatiH |
AgamairupadiShTAni svasya chaiva parasya cha
shlokas.21:
kShudraM krUraM tathA prAj~naM shUraM chArthavishAradam |
svakarmaNi niyu~njIta ye chAnye vachanAdhikAH
shlokas.22:
apyadRRiShTvA niyuktAni anurUpeShu karmasu |
sarvA.nstAnanuvarteta svarA.nstantrIrivAyatA
shlokas.23:
dharmANAmavirodhena sarveShAM priyamAcharet |
mamAyamiti rAjA yaH sa parvata ivAchalaH
shlokas.24:
vyavasAyaM samAdhAya sUryo rashmimivAyatAm |
dharmamevAbhirakSheta kRRitvA tulye priyApriye
shlokas.25:
kulaprakRRitideshAnAM dharmaj~nAnmRRidubhAShiNaH |
madhye vayasi nirdoShAnhite yuktA~njitendriyAn
shlokas.26:
alubdhA~nshikShitAndAntAndharmeShu pariniShThitAn |
sthApayetsarvakAryeShu rAjA dharmArtharakShiNaH
shlokas.27:
etenaiva prakAreNa kRRityAnAmAgatiM gatim |
yuktaH samanutiShTheta tuShTashchArairupaskRRitaH
shlokas.28:
amoghakrodhaharShasya svayaM kRRityAnvavekShiNaH |
Atmapratyayakoshasya vasudhaiva vasundharA
shlokas.29:
vyaktashchAnugraho yasya yathArthashchApi nigrahaH |
guptAtmA guptarAShTrashcha sa rAjA rAjadharmavit
shlokas.30:
nityaM rAShTramavekSheta gobhiH sUrya ivotpatan |
chArA.nshcha nacharAnvidyAttathA buddhyA na sa~njvaret
shlokas.31:
kAlaprAptamupAdadyAnnArthaM rAjA prasUchayet |
ahanyahani sa.nduhyAnmahIM gAmiva buddhimAn
shlokas.32:
yathA krameNa puShpebhyashchinoti madhu ShaTpadaH |
tathA dravyamupAdAya rAjA kurvIta sa~nchayam
shlokas.33:
yaddhi guptAvashiShTaM syAttaddhitaM dharmakAmayoH |
sa~nchayAnuvisargI syAdrAjA shAstravidAtmavAn
shlokas.34:
nAlpamarthaM paribhavennAvamanyeta shAtravAn |
buddhyAvabudhyedAtmAnaM na chAbuddhiShu vishvaset
shlokas.35:
dhRRitirdAkShyaM sa.nyamo buddhiragryA; dhairyaM shauryaM deshakAlo.apramAdaH |
svalpasya vA mahato vApi vRRiddhau; dhanasyaitAnyaShTa samindhanAni
shlokas.36:
agnistoko vardhate hyAjyasikto; bIjaM chaikaM bahusAhasrameti |
kShayodayau vipulau saMnishAmya; tasmAdalpaM nAvamanyeta vidvAn
shlokas.37:
bAlo.abAlaH sthaviro vA ripuryaH; sadA pramattaM puruShaM nihanyAt |
kAlenAnyastasya mUlaM hareta; kAlaj~nAtA pArthivAnAM variShThaH
shlokas.38:
haretkIrtiM dharmamasyoparundhyA;darthe dIrghaM vIryamasyopahanyAt |
ripurdveShTA durbalo vA balI vA; tasmAchChatrau naiva heDedyatAtmA
shlokas.39:
kShayaM shatroH sa~nchayaM pAlanaM chA;pyubhau chArthau sahitau dharmakAmau |
atashchAnyanmatimAnsa.ndadhIta; tasmAdrAjA buddhimantaM shrayeta
shlokas.40:
buddhirdIptA balavantaM hinasti; balaM buddhyA vardhate pAlyamAnam |
shatrurbuddhyA sIdate vardhamAno; buddheH pashchAtkarma yattatprashastam
shlokas.41:
sarvAnkAmAnkAmayAno hi dhIraH; sattvenAlpenAplute hInadehaH |
yathAtmAnaM prArthayate.arthamAnaiH; shreyaHpAtraM pUrayate hyanalpam
shlokas.42:
tasmAdrAjA pragRRihItaH pareShu; mUlaM lakShmyAH sarvato.abhyAdadIta |
dIrghaM kAlamapi sampIDyamAno; vidyutsampAtamiva mAnorjitaH syAt
shlokas.43:
vidyA tapo vA vipulaM dhanaM vA; sarvametadvyavasAyena shakyam |
brahma yattaM nivasati dehavatsu; tasmAdvidyAdvyavasAyaM prabhUtam
shlokas.44:
yatrAsate matimanto manasvinaH; shakro viShNuryatra sarasvatI cha |
vasanti bhUtAni cha yatra nityaM; tasmAdvidvAnnAvamanyeta deham
shlokas.45:
lubdhaM hanyAtsampradAnena nityaM; lubdhastRRiptiM paravittasya naiti |
sarvo lubdhaH karmaguNopabhoge; yo.arthairhIno dharmakAmau jahAti
shlokas.46:
dhanaM bhojyaM putradAraM samRRiddhiM; sarvo lubdhaH prArthayate pareShAm |
lubdhe doShAH sambhavantIha sarve; tasmAdrAjA na pragRRihNIta lubdhAn
shlokas.47:
sa.ndarshane satpuruShaM jaghanyamapi chodayet |
ArambhAndviShatAM prAj~naH sarvAnarthA.nstu sUdayet
shlokas.48:
dharmAnviteShu vij~nAto mantrI guptashcha pANDava |
Apto rAjankulInashcha paryApto rAjyasa~Ngrahe
shlokas.49:
vidhipravRRittAnnaradevadharmA;nuktAnsamAsena nibodha buddhyA |
imAnvidadhyAdvyanusRRitya yo vai; rAjA mahIM pAlayituM sa shaktaH
shlokas.50:
anItijaM yadyavidhAnajaM sukhaM; haThapraNItaM vividhaM pradRRishyate |
na vidyate tasya gatirmahIpate;rna vidyate rAShTrajamuttamaM sukham
shlokas.51:
dhanairvishiShTAnmatishIlapUjitA;nguNopapannAnyudhi dRRiShTavikramAn |
guNeShu dRRiShTAnachirAdihAtmavA;nsato.abhisandhAya nihanti shAtravAn
shlokas.52:
pashyedupAyAnvividhaiH kriyApathai;rna chAnupAyena matiM niveshayet |
shriyaM vishiShTAM vipulaM yasho dhanaM; na doShadarshI puruShaH samashnute
shlokas.53:
prItipravRRittau vinivartane tathA; suhRRitsu vij~nAya nivRRitya chobhayoH |
yadeva mitraM gurubhAramAvahe;ttadeva susnigdhamudAharedbudhaH
shlokas.54:
etAnmayoktA.nstava rAjadharmA;nnRRiNAM cha guptau matimAdadhatsva |
avApsyase puNyaphalaM sukhena; sarvo hi lokottamadharmamUlaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayaM pitAmahenokto rAjadharmaH sanAtanaH |
Ishvarashcha mahAdaNDo daNDe sarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.2:
devatAnAmRRiShINAM cha pitR^INAM cha mahAtmanAm |
yakSharakShaHpishAchAnAM martyAnAM cha visheShataH
shlokas.3:
sarveShAM prANinAM loke tiryakShvapi nivAsinAm |
sarvavyApI mahAtejA daNDaH shreyAniti prabho
shlokas.4:
ityetaduktaM bhavatA sarvaM daNDyaM charAcharam |
dRRishyate lokamAsaktaM sasurAsuramAnuSham
shlokas.5:
etadichChAmyahaM j~nAtuM tattvena bharatarShabha |
ko daNDaH kIdRRisho daNDaH ki.nrUpaH kimparAyaNaH
shlokas.6:
kimAtmakaH kathambhUtaH katimUrtiH kathamprabhuH |
jAgarti sa kathaM daNDaH prajAsvavahitAtmakaH
shlokas.7:
kashcha pUrvAparamidaM jAgarti paripAlayan |
kashcha vij~nAyate pUrvaM ko.aparo daNDasa~nj~nitaH
ki.nsa.nsthashcha bhaveddaNDaH kA chAsya gatiriShyate
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu kauravya yo daNDo vyavahAryo yathA cha saH |
yasminhi sarvamAyattaM sa daNDa iha kevalaH
shlokas.9:
dharmasyAkhyA mahArAja vyavahAra itIShyate |
tasya lopaH kathaM na syAllokeShvavahitAtmanaH
ityarthaM vyavahArasya vyavahAratvamiShyate
shlokas.10:
api chaitatpurA rAjanmanunA proktamAditaH |
supraNItena daNDena priyApriyasamAtmanA
prajA rakShati yaH samyagdharma eva sa kevalaH
shlokas.11:
athoktametadvachanaM prAgeva manunA purA |
janma choktaM vasiShThena brahmaNo vachanaM mahat
shlokas.12:
prAgidaM vachanaM proktamataH prAgvachanaM viduH |
vyavahArasya chAkhyAnAdvyavahAra ihochyate
shlokas.13:
daNDAttrivargaH satataM supraNItAtpravartate |
daivaM hi paramo daNDo rUpato.agnirivochChikhaH
shlokas.14:
nIlotpaladalashyAmashchaturdaMShTrashchaturbhujaH |
aShTapAnnaikanayanaH sha~NkukarNordhvaromavAn
shlokas.15:
jaTI dvijihvastAmrAsyo mRRigarAjatanuchChadaH |
etadrUpaM bibhartyugraM daNDo nityaM durAvaraH
shlokas.16:
asirgadA dhanuH shaktistrishUlaM mudgaraH sharaH |
musalaM parashushchakraM prAso daNDarShTitomarAH
shlokas.17:
sarvapraharaNIyAni santi yAnIha kAnichit |
daNDa eva hi sarvAtmA loke charati mUrtimAn
shlokas.18:
bhinda.nshChindanrujankRRintandArayanpATaya.nstathA |
ghAtayannabhidhAva.nshcha daNDa eva charatyuta
shlokas.19:
asirvishasano dharmastIkShNavartmA durAsadaH |
shrIgarbho vijayaH shAstA vyavahAraH prajAgaraH
shlokas.20:
shAstraM brAhmaNamantrashcha shAstA prAgvachanaM gataH |
dharmapAlo.akSharo devaH satyago nityago grahaH
shlokas.21:
asa~Ngo rudratanayo manujyeShThaH shiva~NkaraH |
nAmAnyetAni daNDasya kIrtitAni yudhiShThira
shlokas.22:
daNDo hi bhagavAnviShNuryaj~no nArAyaNaH prabhuH |
shashvadrUpaM mahadbibhranmahApuruSha uchyate
shlokas.23:
yathoktA brahmakanyeti lakShmIrnItiH sarasvatI |
daNDanItirjagaddhAtrI daNDo hi bahuvigrahaH
shlokas.24:
arthAnarthau sukhaM duHkhaM dharmAdharmau balAbale |
daurbhAgyaM bhAgadheyaM cha puNyApuNye guNAguNau
shlokas.25:
kAmAkAmAvRRiturmAsaH sharvarI divasaH kShaNaH |
aprasAdaH prasAdashcha harShaH krodhaH shamo damaH
shlokas.26:
daivaM puruShakArashcha mokShAmokShau bhayAbhaye |
hi.nsAhi.nse tapo yaj~naH sa.nyamo.atha viShAviSham
shlokas.27:
antashchAdishcha madhyaM cha kRRityAnAM cha prapa~nchanam |
madaH pramAdo darpashcha dambho dhairyaM nayAnayau
shlokas.28:
ashaktiH shaktirityeva mAnastambhau vyayAvyayau |
vinayashcha visargashcha kAlAkAlau cha bhArata
shlokas.29:
anRRitaM j~nAj~natA satyaM shraddhAshraddhe tathaiva cha |
klIbatA vyavasAyashcha lAbhAlAbhau jayAjayau
shlokas.30:
tIkShNatA mRRidutA mRRityurAgamAnAgamau tathA |
virAddhishchaiva rAddhishcha kAryAkArye balAbale
shlokas.31:
asUyA chAnasUyA cha dharmAdharmau tathaiva cha |
apatrapAnapatrape hrIshcha sampadvipachcha ha
shlokas.32:
tejaH karmaNi pANDityaM vAkShaktistattvabuddhitA |
evaM daNDasya kauravya loke.asminbahurUpatA
shlokas.33:
na syAdyadIha daNDo vai pramatheyuH parasparam |
bhayAddaNDasya chAnyonyaM ghnanti naiva yudhiShThira
shlokas.34:
daNDena rakShyamANA hi rAjannaharahaH prajAH |
rAjAnaM vardhayantIha tasmAddaNDaH parAyaNam
shlokas.35:
vyavasthApayati kShipramimaM lokaM nareshvara |
satye vyavasthito dharmo brAhmaNeShvavatiShThate
shlokas.36:
dharmayuktA dvijAH shreShThA vedayuktA bhavanti cha |
babhUva yaj~no vedebhyo yaj~naH prINAti devatAH
shlokas.37:
prItAshcha devatA nityamindre paridadatyuta |
annaM dadAti shakrashchApyanugRRihNannimAH prajAH
shlokas.38:
prANAshcha sarvabhUtAnAM nityamanne pratiShThitAH |
tasmAtprajAH pratiShThante daNDo jAgarti tAsu cha
shlokas.39:
evamprayojanashchaiva daNDaH kShatriyatAM gataH |
rakShanprajAH prajAgarti nityaM suvihito.akSharaH
shlokas.40:
IshvaraH puruShaH prANaH sattvaM vittaM prajApatiH |
bhUtAtmA jIva ityeva nAmabhiH prochyate.aShTabhiH
shlokas.41:
adadaddaNDa evAsmai dhruvamaishvaryameva cha |
bale nayashcha sa.nyuktaH sadA pa~nchavidhAtmakaH
shlokas.42:
kulabAhudhanAmAtyAH praj~nA choktA balAni cha |
AhAryaM chAShTakairdravyairbalamanyadyudhiShThira
shlokas.43:
hastino.ashvA rathAH pattirnAvo viShTistathaiva cha |
daishikAshchArakAshchaiva tadaShTA~NgaM balaM smRRitam
shlokas.44:
aShTA~Ngasya tu yuktasya hastino hastiyAyinaH |
ashvArohAH padAtAshcha mantriNo rasadAshcha ye
shlokas.45:
bhikShukAH prADvivAkAshcha mauhUrtA daivachintakAH |
kosho mitrANi dhAnyaM cha sarvopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.46:
saptaprakRRiti chAShTA~NgaM sharIramiha yadviduH |
rAjyasya daNDa evA~NgaM daNDaH prabhava eva cha
shlokas.47:
IshvareNa prayatnena dhAraNe kShatriyasya hi |
daNDo dattaH samAnAtmA daNDo hIdaM sanAtanam
rAj~nAM pUjyatamo nAnyo yathAdharmapradarshanaH
shlokas.48:
brahmaNA lokarakShArthaM svadharmasthApanAya cha |
bhartRRipratyaya utpanno vyavahArastathAparaH
tasmAdyaH sahito dRRiShTo bhartRRipratyayalakShaNaH
shlokas.49:
vyavahArastu vedAtmA vedapratyaya uchyate |
maulashcha narashArdUla shAstroktashcha tathAparaH
shlokas.50:
ukto yashchApi daNDo.asau bhartRRipratyayalakShaNaH |
j~neyo na sa narendrastho daNDapratyaya eva cha
shlokas.51:
daNDapratyayadRRiShTo.api vyavahArAtmakaH smRRitaH |
vyavahAraH smRRito yashcha sa vedaviShayAtmakaH
shlokas.52:
yashcha vedaprasUtAtmA sa dharmo guNadarshakaH |
dharmapratyaya utpanno yathAdharmaH kRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.53:
vyavahAraH prajAgoptA brahmadiShTo yudhiShThira |
trIndhArayati lokAnvai satyAtmA bhUtivardhanaH
shlokas.54:
yashcha daNDaH sa dRRiShTo no vyavahAraH sanAtanaH |
vyavahArashcha yo dRRiShTaH sa dharma iti naH shrutaH
yashcha vedaH sa vai dharmo yashcha dharmaH sa satpathaH
shlokas.55:
brahmA prajApatiH pUrvaM babhUvAtha pitAmahaH |
lokAnAM sa hi sarveShAM sasurAsurarakShasAm
samanuShyoragavatAM kartA chaiva sa bhUtakRRit
shlokas.56:
tato no vyavahAro.ayaM bhartRRipratyayalakShaNaH |
tasmAdidamavochAma vyavahAranidarshanam
shlokas.57:
mAtA pitA cha bhrAtA cha bhAryA chAtha purohitaH |
nAdaNDyo vidyate rAj~nAM yaH svadharme na tiShThati

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
a~NgeShu rAjA dyutimAnvasuhoma iti shrutaH
shlokas.2:
sa rAjA dharmanityaH sansaha patnyA mahAtapAH |
mu~njapRRiShThaM jagAmAtha devarShigaNapUjitam
shlokas.3:
tatra shRRi~Nge himavato merau kanakaparvate |
yatra mu~njavaTe rAmo jaTAharaNamAdishat
shlokas.4:
tadAprabhRRiti rAjendra RRiShibhiH sa.nshitavrataiH |
mu~njapRRiShTha iti proktaH sa desho rudrasevitaH
shlokas.5:
sa tatra bahubhiryuktaH sadA shrutimayairguNaiH |
brAhmaNAnAmanumato devarShisadRRisho.abhavat
shlokas.6:
taM kadAchidadInAtmA sakhA shakrasya mAnitaH |
abhyAgachChanmahIpAlo mAndhAtA shatrukarshanaH
shlokas.7:
so.abhisRRitya tu mAndhAtA vasuhomaM narAdhipam |
dRRiShTvA prakRRiShTaM tapasA vinayenAbhyatiShThata
shlokas.8:
vasuhomo.api rAj~no vai gAmarghyaM cha nyavedayat |
aShTA~Ngasya cha rAjyasya paprachCha kushalaM tadA
shlokas.9:
sadbhirAcharitaM pUrvaM yathAvadanuyAyinam |
apRRichChadvasuhomastaM rAjankiM karavANi te
shlokas.10:
so.abravItparamaprIto mAndhAtA rAjasattamam |
vasuhomaM mahAprAj~namAsInaM kurunandana
shlokas.11:
bRRihaspatermataM rAjannadhItaM sakalaM tvayA |
tathaivaushanasaM shAstraM vij~nAtaM te narAdhipa
shlokas.12:
tadahaM shrotumichChAmi daNDa utpadyate katham |
kiM vApi pUrvaM jAgarti kiM vA paramamuchyate
shlokas.13:
kathaM kShatriyasa.nsthashcha daNDaH sampratyavasthitaH |
brUhi me sumahAprAj~na dadAmyAchAryavetanam
shlokas.14:
vasuhoma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathA daNDaH sambhUto lokasa~NgrahaH |
prajAvinayarakShArthaM dharmasyAtmA sanAtanaH
shlokas.15:
brahmA yiyakShurbhagavAnsarvalokapitAmahaH |
RRitvijaM nAtmanA tulyaM dadarsheti hi naH shrutam
shlokas.16:
sa garbhaM shirasA devo varShapUgAnadhArayat |
pUrNe varShasahasre tu sa garbhaH kShuvato.apatat
shlokas.17:
sa kShupo nAma sambhUtaH prajApatirari.ndama |
RRitvigAsIttadA rAjanyaj~ne tasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
tasminpravRRitte satre tu brahmaNaH pArthivarShabha |
hRRiShTarUpaprachAratvAddaNDaH so.antarhito.abhavat
shlokas.19:
tasminnantarhite chAtha prajAnAM sa~Nkaro.abhavat |
naiva kAryaM na chAkAryaM bhojyAbhojyaM na vidyate
shlokas.20:
peyApeyaM kutaH siddhirhi.nsanti cha parasparam |
gamyAgamyaM tadA nAsItparasvaM svaM cha vai samam
shlokas.21:
parasparaM vilumpante sArameyA ivAmiSham |
abalaM balino jaghnurnirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.22:
tataH pitAmaho viShNuM bhagavantaM sanAtanam |
sampUjya varadaM devaM mahAdevamathAbravIt
shlokas.23:
atra sAdhvanukampAM vai kartumarhasi kevalam |
sa~Nkaro na bhavedatra yathA vai tadvidhIyatAm
shlokas.24:
tataH sa bhagavAndhyAtvA chiraM shUlajaTAdharaH |
AtmAnamAtmanA daNDamasRRijaddevasattamaH
shlokas.25:
tasmAchcha dharmacharaNAM nItiM devIM sarasvatIm |
asRRijaddaNDanItiH sA triShu lokeShu vishrutA
shlokas.26:
bhUyaH sa bhagavAndhyAtvA chiraM shUlavarAyudhaH |
tasya tasya nikAyasya chakAraikaikamIsharam
shlokas.27:
devAnAmIshvaraM chakre devaM dashashatekShaNam |
yamaM vaivasvataM chApi pitR^INAmakarotpatim
shlokas.28:
dhanAnAM rakShasAM chApi kuberamapi cheshvaram |
parvatAnAM patiM meruM saritAM cha mahodadhim
shlokas.29:
apAM rAjye surANAM cha vidadhe varuNaM prabhum |
mRRityuM prANeshvaramatho tejasAM cha hutAshanam
shlokas.30:
rudrANAmapi cheshAnaM goptAraM vidadhe prabhuH |
mahAtmAnaM mahAdevaM vishAlAkShaM sanAtanam
shlokas.31:
vasiShThamIshaM viprANAM vasUnAM jAtavedasam |
tejasAM bhAskaraM chakre nakShatrANAM nishAkaram
shlokas.32:
vIrudhAma.nshumantaM cha bhUtAnAM cha prabhuM varam |
