kumAraM dvAdashabhujaM skandaM rAjAnamAdishat
shlokas.33:
kAlaM sarveshamakarotsaMhAravinayAtmakam |
mRRityoshchaturvibhAgasya duHkhasya cha sukhasya cha
shlokas.34:
IshvaraH sarvadehastu rAjarAjo dhanAdhipaH |
sarveShAmeva rudrANAM shUlapANiriti shrutiH
shlokas.35:
tamekaM brahmaNaH putramanujAtaM kShupaM dadau |
prajAnAmadhipaM shreShThaM sarvadharmabhRRitAmapi
shlokas.36:
mahAdevastatastasminvRRitte yaj~ne yathAvidhi |
daNDaM dharmasya goptAraM viShNave satkRRitaM dadau
shlokas.37:
viShNura~Ngirase prAdAda~NgirA munisattamaH |
prAdAdindramarIchibhyAM marIchirbhRRigave dadau
shlokas.38:
bhRRigurdadAvRRiShibhyastu taM daNDaM dharmasaMhitam |
RRiShayo lokapAlebhyo lokapAlAH kShupAya cha
shlokas.39:
kShupastu manave prAdAdAdityatanayAya cha |
putrebhyaH shrAddhadevastu sUkShmadharmArthakAraNAt
taM dadau sUryaputrastu manurvai rakShaNAtmakam
shlokas.40:
vibhajya daNDaH kartavyo dharmeNa na yadRRichChayA |
durvAchA nigraho bandho hiraNyaM bAhyataHkriyA
shlokas.41:
vya~NgatvaM cha sharIrasya vadho vA nAlpakAraNAt |
sharIrapIDAstAstAstu dehatyAgo vivAsanam
shlokas.42:
AnupUrvyA cha daNDo.asau prajA jAgarti pAlayan |
indro jAgarti bhagavAnindrAdagnirvibhAvasuH
shlokas.43:
agnerjAgarti varuNo varuNAchcha prajApatiH |
prajApatestato dharmo jAgarti vinayAtmakaH
shlokas.44:
dharmAchcha brahmaNaH putro vyavasAyaH sanAtanaH |
vyavasAyAttatastejo jAgarti paripAlayan
shlokas.45:
oShadhyastejasastasmAdoShadhibhyashcha parvatAH |
parvatebhyashcha jAgarti raso rasaguNAttathA
shlokas.46:
jAgarti nirRRitirdevI jyotIMShi nirRRiterapi |
vedAH pratiShThA jyotirbhyastato hayashirAH prabhuH
shlokas.47:
brahmA pitAmahastasmAjjAgarti prabhuravyayaH |
pitAmahAnmahAdevo jAgarti bhagavA~nshivaH
shlokas.48:
vishvedevAH shivAchchApi vishvebhyashcha tatharShayaH |
RRiShibhyo bhagavAnsomaH somAddevAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.49:
devebhyo brAhmaNA loke jAgratItyupadhAraya |
brAhmaNebhyashcha rAjanyA lokAnrakShanti dharmataH
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva kShatriyebhyaH sanAtanam
shlokas.50:
prajA jAgrati loke.asmindaNDo jAgarti tAsu cha |
sarvasa~NkShepako daNDaH pitAmahasamaH prabhuH
shlokas.51:
jAgarti kAlaH pUrvaM cha madhye chAnte cha bhArata |
IshvaraH sarvalokasya mahAdevaH prajApatiH
shlokas.52:
devadevaH shivaH sharvo jAgarti satataM prabhuH |
kapardI sha~Nkaro rudro bhavaH sthANurumApatiH
shlokas.53:
ityeSha daNDo vikhyAta Adau madhye tathAvare |
bhUmipAlo yathAnyAyaM vartetAnena dharmavit
shlokas.54:
bhIShma uvAcha||
itIdaM vasuhomasya shRRiNuyAdyo mataM naraH |
shrutvA cha samyagvarteta sa kAmAnApnuyAnnRRipaH
shlokas.55:
iti te sarvamAkhyAtaM yo daNDo manujarShabha |
niyantA sarvalokasya dharmAkrAntasya bhArata

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tAta dharmArthakAmAnAM shrotumichChAmi nishchayam |
lokayAtrA hi kArtsnyena triShveteShu pratiShThitA
shlokas.2:
dharmArthakAmAH kiMmUlAstrayANAM prabhavashcha kaH |
anyonyaM chAnuShajjante vartante cha pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yadA te syuH sumanaso lokasa.nsthArthanishchaye |
kAlaprabhavasa.nsthAsu sajjante cha trayastadA
shlokas.4:
dharmamUlastu deho.arthaH kAmo.arthaphalamuchyate |
sa~NkalpamUlAste sarve sa~Nkalpo viShayAtmakaH
shlokas.5:
viShayAshchaiva kArtsnyena sarva AhArasiddhaye |
mUlametattrivargasya nivRRittirmokSha uchyate
shlokas.6:
dharmaH sharIrasa~NguptirdharmArthaM chArtha iShyate |
kAmo ratiphalashchAtra sarve chaite rajasvalAH
shlokas.7:
saMnikRRiShTA.nshcharedenAnna chainAnmanasA tyajet |
vimuktastamasA sarvAndharmAdInkAmanaiShThikAn
shlokas.8:
shreShThabuddhistrivargasya yadayaM prApnuyAtkShaNAt |
buddhyA budhyedihArthe na tadahnA tu nikRRiShTayA
shlokas.9:
apadhyAnamalo dharmo malo.arthasya nigUhanam |
sampramodamalaH kAmo bhUyaH svaguNavartitaH
shlokas.10:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
kAmandasya cha sa.nvAdama~NgAriShThasya chobhayoH
shlokas.11:
kAmandamRRiShimAsInamabhivAdya narAdhipaH |
a~NgAriShTho.atha paprachCha kRRitvA samayaparyayam
shlokas.12:
yaH pApaM kurute rAjA kAmamohabalAtkRRitaH |
pratyAsannasya tasyarShe kiM syAtpApapraNAshanam
shlokas.13:
adharmo dharma iti ha yo.aj~nAnAdAcharediha |
taM chApi prathitaM loke kathaM rAjA nivartayet
shlokas.14:
kAmanda uvAcha||
yo dharmArthau samutsRRijya kAmamevAnuvartate |
sa dharmArthaparityAgAtpraj~nAnAshamihArChati
shlokas.15:
praj~nApraNAshako mohastathA dharmArthanAshakaH |
tasmAnnAstikatA chaiva durAchArashcha jAyate
shlokas.16:
durAchArAnyadA rAjA praduShTAnna niyachChati |
tasmAdudvijate lokaH sarpAdveshmagatAdiva
shlokas.17:
taM prajA nAnuvartante brAhmaNA na cha sAdhavaH |
tataH sa~NkShayamApnoti tathA vadhyatvameti cha
shlokas.18:
apadhvastastvavamato duHkhaM jIvati jIvitam |
jIvechcha yadapadhvastastachChuddhaM maraNaM bhavet
shlokas.19:
atraitadAhurAchAryAH pApasya cha nibarhaNam |
sevitavyA trayI vidyA satkAro brAhmaNeShu cha
shlokas.20:
mahAmanA bhaveddharme vivahechcha mahAkule |
brAhmaNA.nshchApi seveta kShamAyuktAnmanasvinaH
shlokas.21:
japedudakashIlaH syAtsumukho nAnyadAsthitaH |
dharmAnvitAnsampravishedbahiH kRRitvaiva duShkRRitIn
shlokas.22:
prasAdayenmadhuraya vAchApyatha cha karmaNA |
ityasmIti vadennityaM pareShAM kIrtayanguNAn
shlokas.23:
apApo hyevamAchAraH kShipraM bahumato bhavet |
pApAnyapi cha kRRichChrANi shamayennAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.24:
guravo.api paraM dharmaM yadbrUyustattathA kuru |
gurUNAM hi prasAdAddhi shreyaH paramavApsyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ime janA narashreShTha prasha.nsanti sadA bhuvi |
dharmasya shIlamevAdau tato me sa.nshayo mahAn
shlokas.2:
yadi tachChakyamasmAbhirj~nAtuM dharmabhRRitAM vara |
shrotumichChAmi tatsarvaM yathaitadupalabhyate
shlokas.3:
kathaM nu prApyate shIlaM shrotumichChAmi bhArata |
ki.nlakShaNaM cha tatproktaM brUhi me vadatAM vara
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
purA duryodhaneneha dhRRitarAShTrAya mAnada |
AkhyAtaM tapyamAnena shriyaM dRRiShTvA tathAgatAm
shlokas.5:
indraprasthe mahArAja tava sabhrAtRRikasya ha |
sabhAyAM chAvahasanaM tatsarvaM shRRiNu bhArata
shlokas.6:
bhavatastAM sabhAM dRRiShTvA samRRiddhiM chApyanuttamAm |
duryodhanastadAsInaH sarvaM pitre nyavedayat
shlokas.7:
shrutvA cha dhRRitarAShTro.api duryodhanavachastadA |
abravItkarNasahitaM duryodhanamidaM vachaH
shlokas.8:
kimarthaM tapyase putra shrotumichChAmi tattvataH |
shrutvA tvAmanuneShyAmi yadi samyagbhaviShyasi
shlokas.9:
yathA tvaM mahadaishvaryaM prAptaH parapura~njaya |
ki~NkarA bhrAtaraH sarve mitrAH sambandhinastathA
shlokas.10:
AchChAdayasi prAvArAnashnAsi pishitodanam |
AjAneyA vahanti tvAM kasmAchChochasi putraka
shlokas.11:
duryodhana uvAcha||
dasha tAni sahasrANi snAtakAnAM mahAtmanAm |
bhu~njate rukmapAtrIShu yudhiShThiraniveshane
shlokas.12:
dRRiShTvA cha tAM sabhAM divyAM divyapuShpaphalAnvitAm |
ashvA.nstittirakalmAShAnratnAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA tAM pANDaveyAnAmRRiddhimindropamAM shubhAm |
amitrANAM sumahatImanushochAmi mAnada
shlokas.14:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yadIchChasi shriyaM tAta yAdRRishIM tAM yudhiShThire |
vishiShTAM vA naravyAghra shIlavAnbhava putraka
shlokas.15:
shIlena hi trayo lokAH shakyA jetuM na sa.nshayaH |
na hi ki~nchidasAdhyaM vai loke shIlavatAM bhavet
shlokas.16:
ekarAtreNa mAndhAtA tryaheNa janamejayaH |
saptarAtreNa nAbhAgaH pRRithivIM pratipedivAn
shlokas.17:
ete hi pArthivAH sarve shIlavanto damAnvitAH |
atasteShAM guNakrItA vasudhA svayamAgamat
shlokas.18:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradena purA proktaM shIlamAshritya bhArata
shlokas.19:
prahrAdena hRRitaM rAjyaM mahendrasya mahAtmanaH |
shIlamAshritya daityena trailokyaM cha vashIkRRitam
shlokas.20:
tato bRRihaspatiM shakraH prA~njaliH samupasthitaH |
uvAcha cha mahAprAj~naH shreya ichChAmi veditum
shlokas.21:
tato bRRihaspatistasmai j~nAnaM naiHshreyasaM param |
kathayAmAsa bhagavAndevendrAya kurUdvaha
shlokas.22:
etAvachChreya ityeva bRRihaspatirabhAShata |
indrastu bhUyaH paprachCha kva visheSho bhavediti
shlokas.23:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
visheSho.asti mahA.nstAta bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH |
tatrAgamaya bhadraM te bhUya eva pura.ndara
shlokas.24:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
Atmanastu tataH shreyo bhArgavAtsumahAyashAH |
j~nAnamAgamayatprItyA punaH sa paramadyutiH
shlokas.25:
tenApi samanuj~nAto bhArgaveNa mahAtmanA |
shreyo.astIti punarbhUyaH shukramAha shatakratuH
shlokas.26:
bhArgavastvAha dharmaj~naH prahrAdasya mahAtmanaH |
j~nAnamasti visheSheNa tato hRRiShTashcha so.abhavat
shlokas.27:
sa tato brAhmaNo bhUtvA prahrAdaM pAkashAsanaH |
sRRitvA provAcha medhAvI shreya ichChAmi veditum
shlokas.28:
prahrAdastvabravIdvipraM kShaNo nAsti dvijarShabha |
trailokyarAjye saktasya tato nopadishAmi te
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNastvabravIdvAkyaM kasminkAle kShaNo bhavet |
tatopadiShTamichChAmi yadyatkAryAntaraM bhavet
shlokas.30:
tataH prIto.abhavadrAjA prahrAdo brahmavAdine |
tathetyuktvA shubhe kAle j~nAnatattvaM dadau tadA
shlokas.31:
brAhmaNo.api yathAnyAyaM guruvRRittimanuttamAm |
chakAra sarvabhAvena yadvatsa manasechChati
shlokas.32:
pRRiShTashcha tena bahushaH prAptaM kathamari.ndama |
trailokyarAjyaM dharmaj~na kAraNaM tadbravIhi me
shlokas.33:
prahrAda uvAcha||
nAsUyAmi dvijashreShTha rAjAsmIti kadAchana |
kavyAni vadatAM tAta sa.nyachChAmi vahAmi cha
shlokas.34:
te visrabdhAH prabhAShante sa.nyachChanti cha mAM sadA |
te mA kavyapade saktaM shushrUShumanasUyakam
shlokas.35:
dharmAtmAnaM jitakrodhaM sa.nyataM sa.nyatendriyam |
samAchinvanti shAstAraH kShaudraM madhviva makShikAH
shlokas.36:
so.ahaM vAgagrapiShTAnAM rasAnAmavalehitA |
svajAtyAnadhitiShThAmi nakShatrANIva chandramAH
shlokas.37:
etatpRRithivyAmamRRitametachchakShuranuttamam |
yadbrAhmaNamukhe kavyametachChrutvA pravartate
shlokas.38:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
etAvachChreya ityAha prahrAdo brahmavAdinam |
shushrUShitastena tadA daityendro vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.39:
yathAvadguruvRRittyA te prIto.asmi dvijasattama |
varaM vRRiNIShva bhadraM te pradAtAsmi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.40:
kRRitamityeva daityendramuvAcha sa cha vai dvijaH |
prahrAdastvabravItprIto gRRihyatAM vara ityuta
shlokas.41:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
yadi rAjanprasannastvaM mama chechChasi cheddhitam |
bhavataH shIlamichChAmi prAptumeSha varo mama
shlokas.42:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tataH prItashcha daityendro bhayaM chAsyAbhavanmahat |
vare pradiShTe vipreNa nAlpatejAyamityuta
shlokas.43:
evamastviti taM prAha prahrAdo vismitastadA |
upAkRRitya tu viprAya varaM duHkhAnvito.abhavat
shlokas.44:
datte vare gate vipre chintAsInmahatI tataH |
prahrAdasya mahArAja nishchayaM na cha jagmivAn
shlokas.45:
tasya chintayatastAta ChAyAbhUtaM mahAdyute |
tejo vigrahavattAta sharIramajahAttadA
shlokas.46:
tamapRRichChanmahAkAyaM prahrAdaH ko bhavAniti |
pratyAha nanu shIlo.asmi tyakto gachChAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.47:
tasmindvijavare rAjanvatsyAmyahamaninditam |
yo.asau shiShyatvamAgamya tvayi nityaM samAhitaH
ityuktvAntarhitaM tadvai shakraM chAnvavishatprabho
shlokas.48:
tasmi.nstejasi yAte tu tAdRRigrUpastato.aparaH |
sharIrAnniHsRRitastasya ko bhavAniti chAbravIt
shlokas.49:
dharmaM prahrAda mAM viddhi yatrAsau dvijasattamaH |
tatra yAsyAmi daityendra yataH shIlaM tato hyaham
shlokas.50:
tato.aparo mahArAja prajvalanniva tejasA |
sharIrAnniHsRRitastasya prahrAdasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.51:
ko bhavAniti pRRiShTashcha tamAha sa mahAdyutiH |
satyamasmyasurendrAgrya yAsye.ahaM dharmamanviha
shlokas.52:
tasminnanugate dharmaM puruShe puruSho.aparaH |
nishchakrAma tatastasmAtpRRiShTashchAha mahAtmanA
vRRittaM prahrAda mAM viddhi yataH satyaM tato hyaham
shlokas.53:
tasmingate mahAshvetaH sharIrAttasya niryayau |
pRRiShTashchAha balaM viddhi yato vRRittamahaM tataH
ityuktvA cha yayau tatra yato vRRittaM narAdhipa
shlokas.54:
tataH prabhAmayI devI sharIrAttasya niryayau |
tAmapRRichChatsa daityendraH sA shrIrityevamabravIt
shlokas.55:
uShitAsmi sukhaM vIra tvayi satyaparAkrame |
tvayA tyaktA gamiShyAmi balaM yatra tato hyaham
shlokas.56:
tato bhayaM prAdurAsItprahrAdasya mahAtmanaH |
apRRichChata cha tAM bhUyaH kva yAsi kamalAlaye
shlokas.57:
tvaM hi satyavratA devI lokasya parameshvarI |
kashchAsau brAhmaNashreShThastattvamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.58:
shrIruvAcha||
sa shakro brahmachArI cha yastvayA chopashikShitaH |
trailokye te yadaishvaryaM tattenApahRRitaM prabho
shlokas.59:
shIlena hi tvayA lokAH sarve dharmaj~na nirjitAH |
tadvij~nAya mahendreNa tava shIlaM hRRitaM prabho
shlokas.60:
dharmaH satyaM tathA vRRittaM balaM chaiva tathA hyaham |
shIlamUlA mahAprAj~na sadA nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.61:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA gatA tu shrIste cha sarve yudhiShThira |
duryodhanastu pitaraM bhUya evAbravIdidam
shlokas.62:
shIlasya tattvamichChAmi vettuM kauravanandana |
prApyate cha yathA shIlaM tamupAyaM vadasva me
shlokas.63:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sopAyaM pUrvamuddiShTaM prahrAdena mahAtmanA |
sa~NkShepatastu shIlasya shRRiNu prAptiM narAdhipa
shlokas.64:
adrohaH sarvabhUteShu karmaNA manasA girA |
anugrahashcha dAnaM cha shIlametatprashasyate
shlokas.65:
yadanyeShAM hitaM na syAdAtmanaH karma pauruSham |
apatrapeta vA yena na tatkuryAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.66:
tattu karma tathA kuryAdyena shlAgheta sa.nsadi |
etachChIlaM samAsena kathitaM kurusattama
shlokas.67:
yadyapyashIlA nRRipate prApnuvanti kvachichChriyam |
na bhu~njate chiraM tAta samUlAshcha patanti te
shlokas.68:
etadviditvA tattvena shIlavAnbhava putraka |
yadIchChasi shriyaM tAta suvishiShTAM yudhiShThirAt
shlokas.69:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etatkathitavAnputre dhRRitarAShTro narAdhipa |
etatkuruShva kaunteya tataH prApsyasi tatphalam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shIlaM pradhAnaM puruShe kathitaM te pitAmaha |
kathamAshA samutpannA yA cha sA tadvadasva me
shlokas.2:
sa.nshayo me mahAneSha samutpannaH pitAmaha |
ChettA cha tasya nAnyo.asti tvattaH parapura~njaya
shlokas.3:
pitAmahAshA mahatI mamAsIddhi suyodhane |
prApte yuddhe tu yadyuktaM tatkartAyamiti prabho
shlokas.4:
sarvasyAshA sumahatI puruShasyopajAyate |
tasyAM vihanyamAnAyAM duHkho mRRityurasa.nshayam
shlokas.5:
so.ahaM hatAsho durbuddhiH kRRitastena durAtmanA |
dhArtarAShTreNa rAjendra pashya mandAtmatAM mama
shlokas.6:
AshAM mahattarAM manye parvatAdapi sadrumAt |
AkAshAdapi vA rAjannaprameyaiva vA punaH
shlokas.7:
eShA chaiva kurushreShTha durvichintyA sudurlabhA |
durlabhatvAchcha pashyAmi kimanyaddurlabhaM tataH
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi yudhiShThira nibodha tat |
itihAsaM sumitrasya nirvRRittamRRiShabhasya cha
shlokas.9:
sumitro nAma rAjarShirhaihayo mRRigayAM gataH |
sasAra sa mRRigaM viddhvA bANena nataparvaNA
shlokas.10:
sa mRRigo bANamAdAya yayAvamitavikramaH |
sa cha rAjA balI tUrNaM sasAra mRRigamantikAt
shlokas.11:
tato nimnaM sthalaM chaiva sa mRRigo.adravadAshugaH |
muhUrtameva rAjendra samena sa pathAgamat
shlokas.12:
tataH sa rAjA tAruNyAdaurasena balena cha |
sasAra bANAsanabhRRitsakhaDgo ha.nsavattadA
shlokas.13:
tIrtvA nadAnnadIshchaiva palvalAni vanAni cha |
atikramyAbhyatikramya sasAraiva vane charan
shlokas.14:
sa tu kAmAnmRRigo rAjannAsAdyAsAdya taM nRRipam |
punarabhyeti javano javena mahatA tataH
shlokas.15:
sa tasya bANairbahubhiH samabhyasto vanecharaH |
prakrIDanniva rAjendra punarabhyeti chAntikam
shlokas.16:
punashcha javamAsthAya javano mRRigayUthapaH |
atItyAtItya rAjendra punarabhyeti chAntikam
shlokas.17:
tasya marmachChidaM ghoraM sumitro.amitrakarshanaH |
samAdAya sharashreShThaM kArmukAnniravAsRRijat
shlokas.18:
tato gavyUtimAtreNa mRRigayUthapayUthapaH |
tasya bANapathaM tyaktvA tasthivAnprahasanniva
shlokas.19:
tasminnipatite bANe bhUmau prajvalite tataH |
pravivesha mahAraNyaM mRRigo rAjApyathAdravat
shlokas.20:
pravishya tu mahAraNyaM tApasAnAmathAshramam |
AsasAda tato rAjA shrAntashchopAvishatpunaH
shlokas.21:
taM kArmukadharaM dRRiShTvA shramArtaM kShudhitaM tadA |
sametya RRiShayastasminpUjAM chakruryathAvidhi
shlokas.22:
RRiShayo rAjashArdUlamapRRichChansvaM prayojanam |
kena bhadramukhArthena samprApto.asi tapovanam
shlokas.23:
padAtirbaddhanistri.nsho dhanvI bANI nareshvara |
etadichChAma vij~nAtuM kutaH prApto.asi mAnada
kasminkule hi jAtastvaM kiMnAmAsi bravIhi naH
shlokas.24:
tataH sa rAjA sarvebhyo dvijebhyaH puruSharShabha |
Achakhyau tadyathAnyAyaM paricharyAM cha bhArata
shlokas.25:
haihayAnAM kule jAtaH sumitro mitranandanaH |
charAmi mRRigayUthAni nighnanbANaiH sahasrashaH
balena mahatA guptaH sAmAtyaH sAvarodhanaH
shlokas.26:
mRRigastu viddho bANena mayA sarati shalyavAn |
taM dravantamanu prApto vanametadyadRRichChayA
bhavatsakAshe naShTashrIrhatAshaH shramakarshitaH
shlokas.27:
kiM nu duHkhamato.anyadvai yadahaM shramakarshitaH |
bhavatAmAshramaM prApto hatAsho naShTalakShaNaH
shlokas.28:
na rAjalakShaNatyAgo na purasya tapodhanAH |
duHkhaM karoti tattIvraM yathAshA vihatA mama
shlokas.29:
himavAnvA mahAshailaH samudro vA mahodadhiH |
mahattvAnnAnvapadyetAM rodasyorantaraM yathA
AshAyAstapasi shreShThAstathA nAntamahaM gataH
shlokas.30:
bhavatAM viditaM sarvaM sarvaj~nA hi tapodhanAH |
bhavantaH sumahAbhAgAstasmAtprakShyAmi sa.nshayam
shlokas.31:
AshAvAnpuruSho yaH syAdantarikShamathApi vA |
kiM nu jyAyastaraM loke mahattvAtpratibhAti vaH
etadichChAmi tattvena shrotuM kimiha durlabham
shlokas.32:
yadi guhyaM taponityA na vo brUteha mAchiram |
na hi guhyamataH shrotumichChAmi dvijapu~NgavAH
shlokas.33:
bhavattapovighAto vA yena syAdvirame tataH |
yadi vAsti kathAyogo yo.ayaM prashno mayeritaH
shlokas.34:
etatkAraNasAmagryaM shrotumichChAmi tattvataH |
bhavanto hi taponityA brUyuretatsamAhitAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatasteShAM samastAnAmRRiShINAmRRiShisattamaH |
RRiShabho nAma viprarShiH smayanniva tato.abravIt
shlokas.2:
purAhaM rAjashArdUla tIrthAnyanucharanprabho |
samAsAditavAndivyaM naranArAyaNAshramam
shlokas.3:
yatra sA badarI ramyA hrado vaihAyasastathA |
yatra chAshvashirA rAjanvedAnpaThati shAshvatAn
shlokas.4:
tasminsarasi kRRitvAhaM vidhivattarpaNaM purA |
pitR^INAM devatAnAM cha tato.a.ashramamiyAM tadA
shlokas.5:
remAte yatra tau nityaM naranArAyaNAvRRiShI |
adUrAdAshramaM ka~nchidvAsArthamagamaM tataH
shlokas.6:
tatashchIrAjinadharaM kRRishamuchchamatIva cha |
adrAkShamRRiShimAyAntaM tanuM nAma taponidhim
shlokas.7:
anyairnarairmahAbAho vapuShAShTaguNAnvitam |
kRRishatA chApi rAjarShe na dRRiShTA tAdRRishI kvachit
shlokas.8:
sharIramapi rAjendra tasya kAniShThikAsamam |
grIvA bAhU tathA pAdau keshAshchAdbhutadarshanAH
shlokas.9:
shiraH kAyAnurUpaM cha karNau netre tathaiva cha |
tasya vAkchaiva cheShTA cha sAmAnye rAjasattama
shlokas.10:
dRRiShTvAhaM taM kRRishaM vipraM bhItaH paramadurmanAH |
pAdau tasyAbhivAdyAtha sthitaH prA~njaliragrataH
shlokas.11:
nivedya nAma gotraM cha pitaraM cha nararShabha |
pradiShTe chAsane tena shanairahamupAvisham
shlokas.12:
tataH sa kathayAmAsa kathA dharmArthasaMhitAH |
RRiShimadhye mahArAja tatra dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.13:
tasmi.nstu kathayatyeva rAjA rAjIvalochanaH |
upAyAjjavanairashvaiH sabalaH sAvarodhanaH
shlokas.14:
smaranputramaraNye vai naShTaM paramadurmanAH |
bhUridyumnapitA dhImAnraghushreShTho mahAyashAH
shlokas.15:
iha drakShyAmi taM putraM drakShyAmIheti pArthivaH |
evamAshAkRRito rAja.nshcharanvanamidaM purA
shlokas.16:
durlabhaH sa mayA draShTuM nUnaM paramadhArmikaH |
ekaH putro mahAraNye naShTa ityasakRRittadA
shlokas.17:
durlabhaH sa mayA draShTumAshA cha mahatI mama |
tayA parItagAtro.ahaM mumUrShurnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
etachChrutvA sa bhagavA.nstanurmunivarottamaH |
avAkShirA dhyAnaparo muhUrtamiva tasthivAn
shlokas.19:
tamanudhyAntamAlakShya rAjA paramadurmanAH |
uvAcha vAkyaM dInAtmA mandaM mandamivAsakRRit
shlokas.20:
durlabhaM kiM nu viprarShe AshAyAshchaiva kiM bhavet |
bravItu bhagavAnetadyadi guhyaM na tanmayi
shlokas.21:
maharShirbhagavA.nstena pUrvamAsIdvimAnitaH |
bAlishAM buddhimAsthAya mandabhAgyatayAtmanaH
shlokas.22:
arthayankalashaM rAjankA~nchanaM valkalAni cha |
nirviNNaH sa tu viprarShirnirAshaH samapadyata
shlokas.23:
evamuktvAbhivAdyAtha tamRRiShiM lokapUjitam |
shrAnto nyaShIdaddharmAtmA yathA tvaM narasattama
shlokas.24:
arghyaM tataH samAnIya pAdyaM chaiva mahAnRRiShiH |
AraNyakena vidhinA rAj~ne sarvaM nyavedayat
shlokas.25:
tataste munayaH sarve parivArya nararShabham |
upAvishanpuraskRRitya saptarShaya iva dhruvam
shlokas.26:
apRRichCha.nshchaiva te tatra rAjAnamaparAjitam |
prayojanamidaM sarvamAshramasya praveshanam
shlokas.27:
rAjovAcha||
vIradyumna iti khyAto rAjAhaM dikShu vishrutaH |
bhUridyumnaM sutaM naShTamanveShTuM vanamAgataH
shlokas.28:
ekaputraH sa viprAgrya bAla eva cha so.anagha |
na dRRishyate vane chAsmi.nstamanveShTuM charAmyaham
shlokas.29:
RRiShabha uvAcha||
evamukte tu vachane rAj~nA muniradhomukhaH |
tUShNImevAbhavattatra na cha pratyuktavAnnRRipam
shlokas.30:
sa hi tena purA vipro rAj~nA nAtyarthamAnitaH |
AshAkRRishaM cha rAjendra tapo dIrghaM samAsthitaH
shlokas.31:
pratigrahamahaM rAj~nAM na kariShye katha~nchana |
anyeShAM chaiva varNAnAmiti kRRitvA dhiyaM tadA
shlokas.32:
AshA hi puruShaM bAlaM lAlApayati tasthuShI |
tAmahaM vyapaneShyAmi iti kRRitvA vyavasthitaH
shlokas.33:
rAjovAcha||
AshAyAH kiM kRRishatvaM cha kiM cheha bhuvi durlabham |
bravItu bhagavAnetattvaM hi dharmArthadarshivAn
shlokas.34:
RRiShabha uvAcha||
tataH sa.nsmRRitya tatsarvaM smArayiShyannivAbravIt |
rAjAnaM bhagavAnviprastataH kRRishatanustanuH
shlokas.35:
kRRishatve na samaM rAjannAshAyA vidyate nRRipa |
tasyA vai durlabhatvAttu prArthitAH pArthivA mayA
shlokas.36:
rAjovAcha||
kRRishAkRRishe mayA brahmangRRihIte vachanAttava |
durlabhatvaM cha tasyaiva vedavAkyamiva dvija
shlokas.37:
sa.nshayastu mahAprAj~na sa~njAto hRRidaye mama |
tanme sattama tattvena vaktumarhasi pRRichChataH
shlokas.38:
tvattaH kRRishataraM kiM nu bravItu bhagavAnidam |
yadi guhyaM na te vipra loke.asminkiM nu durlabham
shlokas.39:
kRRishatanuruvAcha||
durlabho.apyatha vA nAsti yo.arthI dhRRitimivApnuyAt |
sudurlabhatarastAta yo.arthinaM nAvamanyate
shlokas.40:
sa.nshrutya nopakriyate paraM shaktyA yathArhataH |
saktA yA sarvabhUteShu sAshA kRRishatarI mayA
shlokas.41:
ekaputraH pitA putre naShTe vA proShite tathA |
pravRRittiM yo na jAnAti sAshA kRRishatarI mayA
shlokas.42:
prasave chaiva nArINAM vRRiddhAnAM putrakAritA |
tathA narendra dhaninAmAshA kRRishatarI mayA
shlokas.43:
RRiShabha uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tato rAjansa rAjA sAvarodhanaH |
sa.nspRRishya pAdau shirasA nipapAta dvijarShabhe
shlokas.44:
rAjovAcha||
prasAdaye tvA bhagavanputreNechChAmi sa~Ngatim |
vRRiNIShva cha varaM vipra yamichChasi yathAvidhi
shlokas.45:
RRiShabha uvAcha||
abravIchcha hi taM vAkyaM rAjA rAjIvalochanaH |
satyametadyathA vipra tvayoktaM nAstyato mRRiShA
shlokas.46:
tataH prahasya bhagavA.nstanurdharmabhRRitAM varaH |
putramasyAnayatkShipraM tapasA cha shrutena cha
shlokas.47:
taM samAnAyya putraM tu tadopAlabhya pArthivam |
AtmAnaM darshayAmAsa dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.48:
sa.ndarshayitvA chAtmAnaM divyamadbhutadarshanam |
vipApmA vigatakrodhashchachAra vanamantikAt
shlokas.49:
etaddRRiShTaM mayA rAja.nstatashcha vachanaM shrutam |
AshAmapanayasvAshu tataH kRRishatarImimAm
shlokas.50:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa tatrokto mahArAja RRiShabheNa mahAtmanA |
sumitro.apanayatkShipramAshAM kRRishatarIM tadA
shlokas.51:
evaM tvamapi kaunteya shrutvA vANImimAM mama |
sthiro bhava yathA rAjanhimavAnachalottamaH
shlokas.52:
tvaM hi draShTA cha shrotA cha kRRichChreShvarthakRRiteShviha |
shrutvA mama mahArAja na santaptumihArhasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
nAmRRitasyeva paryAptirmamAsti bruvati tvayi |
tasmAtkathaya bhUyastvaM dharmameva pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gautamasya cha sa.nvAdaM yamasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
pAriyAtragiriM prApya gautamasyAshramo mahAn |
uvAsa gautamo yatra kAlaM tadapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.4:
ShaShTiM varShasahasrANi so.atapyadgautamastapaH |
tamugratapasaM yuktaM tapasA bhAvitaM munim
shlokas.5:
upayAto naravyAghra lokapAlo yamastadA |
tamapashyatsutapasamRRiShiM vai gautamaM munim
shlokas.6:
sa taM viditvA brahmarShiryamamAgatamojasA |
prA~njaliH prayato bhUtvA upasRRiptastapodhanaH
shlokas.7:
taM dharmarAjo dRRiShTvaiva namaskRRitya nararShabham |
nyamantrayata dharmeNa kriyatAM kimiti bruvan
shlokas.8:
gautama uvAcha||
mAtApitRRibhyAmAnRRiNyaM kiM kRRitvA samavApnuyAt |
kathaM cha lokAnashnAti puruSho durlabhA~nshubhAn
shlokas.9:
yama uvAcha||
tapaHshauchavatA nityaM satyadharmaratena cha |
mAtApitroraharahaH pUjanaM kAryama~njasA
shlokas.10:
ashvamedhaishcha yaShTavyaM bahubhiH svAptadakShiNaiH |
tena lokAnupAshnAti puruSho.adbhutadarshanAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mitraiH prahIyamANasya bahvamitrasya kA gatiH |
rAj~naH sa~NkShINakoshasya balahInasya bhArata
shlokas.2:
duShTAmAtyasahAyasya srutamantrasya sarvataH |
rAjyAtprachyavamAnasya gatimanyAmapashyataH
shlokas.3:
parachakrAbhiyAtasya durbalasya balIyasA |
asa.nvihitarAShTrasya deshakAlAvajAnataH
shlokas.4:
aprApyaM cha bhavetsAntvaM bhedo vApyatipIDanAt |
jIvitaM chArthahetorvA tatra kiM sukRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
guhyaM mA dharmamaprAkShIratIva bharatarShabha |
apRRiShTo notsahe vaktuM dharmamenaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
dharmo hyaNIyAnvachanAdbuddheshcha bharatarShabha |
shrutvopAsya sadAchAraiH sAdhurbhavati sa kvachit
shlokas.7:
karmaNA buddhipUrveNa bhavatyADhyo na vA punaH |
tAdRRisho.ayamanuprashnaH sa vyavasyastvayA dhiyA
shlokas.8:
upAyaM dharmabahulaM yAtrArthaM shRRiNu bhArata |
nAhametAdRRishaM dharmaM bubhUShe dharmakAraNAt
duHkhAdAna ihADhyeShu syAttu pashchAtkShamo mataH
shlokas.9:
anugamya gatInAM cha sarvAsAmeva nishchayam |
yathA yathA hi puruSho nityaM shAstramavekShate
tathA tathA vijAnAti vij~nAnaM chAsya rochate
shlokas.10:
avij~nAnAdayogashcha puruShasyopajAyate |
avij~nAnAdayogo hi yogo bhUtikaraH punaH
shlokas.11:
asha~NkamAno vachanamanasUyuridaM shRRiNu |
rAj~naH koshakShayAdeva jAyate balasa~NkShayaH
shlokas.12:
koshaM sa~njanayedrAjA nirjalebhyo yathA jalam |
kAlaM prApyAnugRRihNIyAdeSha dharmo.atra sAmpratam
shlokas.13:
upAyadharmaM prApyainaM pUrvairAcharitaM janaiH |
anyo dharmaH samarthAnAmApatsvanyashcha bhArata
shlokas.14:
prAkkoshaH prochyate dharmo buddhirdharmAdgarIyasI |
dharmaM prApya nyAyavRRittimabalIyAnna vindati
shlokas.15:
yasmAddhanasyopapattirekAntena na vidyate |
tasmAdApadyadharmo.api shrUyate dharmalakShaNaH
shlokas.16:
adharmo jAyate yasminniti vai kavayo viduH |
anantaraH kShatriyasya iti vai vichikitsase
shlokas.17:
yathAsya dharmo na glAyenneyAchChatruvashaM yathA |
tatkartavyamihetyAhurnAtmAnamavasAdayet
shlokas.18:
sannAtmA naiva dharmasya na parasya na chAtmanaH |
sarvopAyairujjihIrShedAtmAnamiti nishchayaH
shlokas.19:
tatra dharmavidAM tAta nishchayo dharmanaipuNe |
udyamo jIvanaM kShatre bAhuvIryAditi shrutiH
shlokas.20:
kShatriyo vRRittisa.nrodhe kasya nAdAtumarhati |
anyatra tApasasvAchcha brAhmaNasvAchcha bhArata
shlokas.21:
yathA vai brAhmaNaH sIdannayAjyamapi yAjayet |
abhojyAnnAni chAshnIyAttathedaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.22:
pIDitasya kimadvAramutpatho nidhRRitasya vA |
advArataH pradravati yadA bhavati pIDitaH
shlokas.23:
tasya koshabalajyAnyA sarvalokaparAbhavaH |
bhaikShacharyA na vihitA na cha viTshUdrajIvikA
shlokas.24:
svadharmAnantarA vRRittiryAnyAnanupajIvataH |
vahataH prathamaM kalpamanukalpena jIvanam
shlokas.25:
Apadgatena dharmANAmanyAyenopajIvanam |
api hyetadbrAhmaNeShu dRRiShTaM vRRittiparikShaye
shlokas.26:
kShatriye sa.nshayaH kaH syAdityetannishchitaM sadA |
AdadIta vishiShTebhyo nAvasIdetkatha~nchana
shlokas.27:
hantAraM rakShitAraM cha prajAnAM kShatriyaM viduH |
tasmAtsa.nrakShatA kAryamAdAnaM kShatrabandhunA
shlokas.28:
anyatra rAjanhi.nsAyA vRRittirnehAsti kasyachit |
apyaraNyasamutthasya ekasya charato muneH
shlokas.29:
na sha~NkhalikhitAM vRRittiM shakyamAsthAya jIvitum |
visheShataH kurushreShTha prajApAlanamIpsatA
shlokas.30:
parasparAbhisa.nrakShA rAj~nA rAShTreNa chApadi |
nityameveha kartavyA eSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.31:
rAjA rAShTraM yathApatsu dravyaughaiH parirakShati |
rAShTreNa rAjA vyasane parirakShyastathA bhavet
shlokas.32:
koshaM daNDaM balaM mitraM yadanyadapi sa~nchitam |
na kurvItAntaraM rAShTre rAjA parigate kShudhA
shlokas.33:
bIjaM bhaktena sampAdyamiti dharmavido viduH |
atraitachChambarasyAhurmahAmAyasya darshanam
shlokas.34:
dhiktasya jIvitaM rAj~no rAShTre yasyAvasIdati |
avRRittyAntyamanuShyo.api yo vai veda shibervachaH
shlokas.35:
rAj~naH koshabalaM mUlaM koshamUlaM punarbalam |
tanmUlaM sarvadharmANAM dharmamUlAH punaH prajAH
shlokas.36:
nAnyAnapIDayitveha koshaH shakyaH kuto balam |
tadarthaM pIDayitvA cha doShaM na prAptumarhati
shlokas.37:
akAryamapi yaj~nArthaM kriyate yaj~nakarmasu |
etasmAtkAraNAdrAjA na doShaM prAptumarhati
shlokas.38:
arthArthamanyadbhavati viparItamathAparam |
anarthArthamathApyanyattatsarvaM hyarthalakShaNam
evaM buddhyA samprapashyenmedhAvI kAryanishchayam
shlokas.39:
yaj~nArthamanyadbhavati yaj~ne nArthastathAparaH |
yaj~nasyArthArthamevAnyattatsarvaM yaj~nasAdhanam
shlokas.40:
upamAmatra vakShyAmi dharmatattvaprakAshinIm |
yUpaM Chindanti yaj~nArthaM tatra ye paripanthinaH
shlokas.41:
drumAH kechana sAmantA dhruvaM Chindanti tAnapi |
te chApi nipatanto.anyAnnighnanti cha vanaspatIn
shlokas.42:
evaM koshasya mahato ye narAH paripanthinaH |
tAnahatvA na pashyAmi siddhimatra parantapa
shlokas.43:
dhanena jayate lokAvubhau paramimaM tathA |
satyaM cha dharmavachanaM yathA nAstyadhanastathA
shlokas.44:
sarvopAyairAdadIta dhanaM yaj~naprayojanam |
na tulyadoShaH syAdevaM kAryAkAryeShu bhArata
shlokas.45:
naitau sambhavato rAjankatha~nchidapi bhArata |
na hyaraNyeShu pashyAmi dhanavRRiddhAnahaM kvachit
shlokas.46:
yadidaM dRRishyate vittaM pRRithivyAmiha ki~nchana |
mamedaM syAnmamedaM syAdityayaM kA~NkShate janaH
shlokas.47:
na cha rAjyasamo dharmaH kashchidasti parantapa |
dharmaM sha.nsanti te rAj~nAmApadarthamito.anyathA
shlokas.48:
dAnena karmaNA chAnye tapasAnye tapasvinaH |
buddhyA dAkShyeNa chApyanye chinvanti dhanasa~nchayAn
shlokas.49:
adhanaM durbalaM prAhurdhanena balavAnbhavet |
sarvaM dhanavataH prApyaM sarvaM tarati koshavAn
koshAddharmashcha kAmashcha paro lokastathApyayam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kShINasya dIrghasUtrasya sAnukroshasya bandhuShu |
viraktapaurarAShTrasya nirdravyanichayasya cha
shlokas.2:
parisha~Nkitamukhyasya srutamantrasya bhArata |
asambhAvitamitrasya bhinnAmAtyasya sarvashaH
shlokas.3:
parachakrAbhiyAtasya durbalasya balIyasA |
Apannachetaso brUhi kiM kAryamavashiShyate
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
bAhyashchedvijigIShuH syAddharmArthakushalaH shuchiH |
javena sandhiM kurvIta pUrvAnpUrvAnvimokShayan
shlokas.5:
adharmavijigIShushchedbalavAnpApanishchayaH |
AtmanaH saMnirodhena sandhiM tenAbhiyojayet
shlokas.6:
apAsya rAjadhAnIM vA taredanyena vApadam |
tadbhAvabhAve dravyANi jIvanpunarupArjayet
shlokas.7:
yAstu syuH kevalatyAgAchChakyAstaritumApadaH |
kastatrAdhikamAtmAnaM santyajedarthadharmavit
shlokas.8:
avarodhAjjugupseta kA sapatnadhane dayA |
na tvevAtmA pradAtavyaH shakye sati katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
Abhyantare prakupite bAhye chopanipIDite |
kShINe koshe srute mantre kiM kAryamavashiShyate
shlokas.10:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kShipraM vA sandhikAmaH syAtkShipraM vA tIkShNavikramaH |
padApanayanaM kShiprametAvatsAmparAyikam
shlokas.11:
anuraktena puShTena hRRiShTena jagatIpate |
alpenApi hi sainyena mahIM jayati pArthivaH
shlokas.12:
hato vA divamArohedvijayI kShitimAvaset |
yuddhe tu santyajanprANA~nshakrasyaiti salokatAm
shlokas.13:
sarvalokAgamaM kRRitvA mRRidutvaM gantumeva cha |
vishvAsAdvinayaM kuryAdvyavasyedvApyupAnahau
shlokas.14:
apakramitumichChedvA yathAkAmaM tu sAntvayet |
vili~NgamitvA mitreNa tataH svayamupakramet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
hIne paramake dharme sarvalokAtila~Nghini |
sarvasmindasyusAdbhUte pRRithivyAmupajIvane
shlokas.2:
kenAsminbrAhmaNo jIvejjaghanye kAla Agate |
asantyajanputrapautrAnanukroshAtpitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vij~nAnabalamAsthAya jIvitavyaM tathAgate |
sarvaM sAdhvarthamevedamasAdhvarthaM na ki~nchana
shlokas.4:
asAdhubhyo nirAdAya sAdhubhyo yaH prayachChati |
AtmAnaM sa~NkramaM kRRitvA kRRitsnadharmavideva saH
shlokas.5:
suroSheNAtmano rAjanrAjye sthitimakopayan |
adattamapyAdadIta dAturvittaM mameti vA
shlokas.6:
vij~nAnabalapUto yo vartate ninditeShvapi |
vRRittavij~nAnavAndhIraH kastaM kiM vaktumarhati
shlokas.7:
yeShAM balakRRitA vRRittirnaiShAmanyAbhirochate |
tejasAbhipravardhante balavanto yudhiShThira
shlokas.8:
yadeva prakRRitaM shAstramavisheSheNa vindati |
tadeva madhyAH sevante medhAvI chApyathottaram
shlokas.9:
RRitvikpurohitAchAryAnsatkRRitairabhipUjitAn |
na brAhmaNAnyAtayeta doShAnprApnoti yAtayan
shlokas.10:
etatpramANaM lokasya chakShuretatsanAtanam |
tatpramANo.avagAheta tena tatsAdhvasAdhu vA
shlokas.11:
bahUni grAmavAstavyA roShAdbrUyuH parasparam |
na teShAM vachanAdrAjA satkuryAdyAtayeta vA
shlokas.12:
na vAchyaH parivAdo vai na shrotavyaH katha~nchana |
karNAveva pidhAtavyau prastheyaM vA tato.anyataH
shlokas.13:
na vai satAM vRRittametatparivAdo na paishunam |
guNAnAmeva vaktAraH santaH satsu yudhiShThira
shlokas.14:
yathA samadhurau damyau sudAntau sAdhuvAhinau |
dhuramudyamya vahatastathA varteta vai nRRipaH
yathA yathAsya vahataH sahAyAH syustathApare
shlokas.15:
AchArameva manyante garIyo dharmalakShaNam |
apare naivamichChanti ye sha~NkhalikhitapriyAH
mArdavAdatha lobhAdvA te brUyurvAkyamIdRRisham
shlokas.16:
ArShamapyatra pashyanti vikarmasthasya yApanam |
na chArShAtsadRRishaM ki~nchitpramANaM vidyate kvachit
shlokas.17:
devA api vikarmasthaM yAtayanti narAdhamam |
vyAjena vindanvittaM hi dharmAttu parihIyate
shlokas.18:
sarvataH satkRRitaH sadbhirbhUtiprabhavakAraNaiH |
hRRidayenAbhyanuj~nAto yo dharmastaM vyavasyati
shlokas.19:
yashchaturguNasampannaM dharmaM veda sa dharmavit |
aheriva hi dharmasya padaM duHkhaM gaveShitum
shlokas.20:
yathA mRRigasya viddhasya mRRigavyAdhaH padaM nayet |
kakShe rudhirapAtena tathA dharmapadaM nayet
shlokas.21:
evaM sadbhirvinItena pathA gantavyamachyuta |
rAjarShINAM vRRittametadavagachCha yudhiShThira

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
svarAShTrAtpararAShTrAchcha koshaM sa~njanayennRRipaH |
koshAddhi dharmaH kaunteya rAjyamUlaH pravartate
shlokas.2:
tasmAtsa~njanayetkoshaM saMhRRitya paripAlayet |
paripAlyAnugRRihNIyAdeSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.3:
na koshaH shuddhashauchena na nRRisha.nsena jAyate |
padaM madhyamamAsthAya koshasa~NgrahaNaM charet
shlokas.4:
abalasya kutaH kosho hyakoshasya kuto balam |
abalasya kuto rAjyamarAj~naH shrIH kuto bhavet
shlokas.5:
uchchairvRRitteH shriyo hAniryathaiva maraNaM tathA |
tasmAtkoshaM balaM mitrANyatha rAjA vivardhayet
shlokas.6:
hInakoshaM hi rAjAnamavajAnanti mAnavAH |
na chAsyAlpena tuShyanti kAryamabhyutsahanti cha
shlokas.7:
shriyo hi kAraNAdrAjA satkriyAM labhate parAm |
sAsya gUhati pApAni vAso guhyamiva striyAH
shlokas.8:
RRiddhimasyAnuvartante purA viprakRRitA janAH |
shAlAvRRikA ivAjasraM jighA.nsUniva vindati
IdRRishasya kuto rAj~naH sukhaM bharatasattama
shlokas.9:
udyachChedeva na glAyedudyamo hyeva pauruSham |
apyaparvaNi bhajyeta na nameteha kasyachit
shlokas.10:
apyaraNyaM samAshritya chareddasyugaNaiH saha |
na tvevoddhRRitamaryAdairdasyubhiH sahitashcharet
dasyUnAM sulabhA senA raudrakarmasu bhArata
shlokas.11:
ekAntena hyamaryAdAtsarvo.apyudvijate janaH |
dasyavo.apyupasha~Nkante niranukroshakAriNaH
shlokas.12:
sthApayedeva maryAdAM janachittaprasAdinIm |
alpApyatheha maryAdA loke bhavati pUjitA
shlokas.13:
nAyaM loko.asti na para iti vyavasito janaH |
nAlaM gantuM cha vishvAsaM nAstike bhayasha~Nkini
shlokas.14:
yathA sadbhiH parAdAnamahi.nsA dasyubhistathA |
anurajyanti bhUtAni samaryAdeShu dasyuShu
shlokas.15:
ayudhyamAnasya vadho dArAmarshaH kRRitaghnatA |
brahmavittasya chAdAnaM niHsheShakaraNaM tathA
striyA moShaH paristhAnaM dasyuShvetadvigarhitam
shlokas.16:
sa eSha eva bhavati dasyuretAni varjayan |
abhisa.ndadhate ye na vinAshAyAsya bhArata
nasheShamevopAlabhya na kurvantIti nishchayaH
shlokas.17:
tasmAtsasheShaM kartavyaM svAdhInamapi dasyubhiH |
na balastho.ahamasmIti nRRisha.nsAni samAcharet
shlokas.18:
sasheShakAriNastAta sheShaM pashyanti sarvataH |
niHsheShakAriNo nityamasheShakaraNAdbhayam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra karmAntavachanaM kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
pratyakShAveva dharmArthau kShatriyasya vijAnataH
tatra na vyavadhAtavyaM parokShA dharmayApanA
shlokas.2:
adharmo dharma ityetadyathA vRRikapadaM tathA |
dharmAdharmaphale jAtu na dadarsheha kashchana
shlokas.3:
bubhUShedbalavAneva sarvaM balavato vashe |
shriyaM balamamAtyA.nshcha balavAniha vindati
shlokas.4:
yo hyanADhyaH sa patitastaduchChiShTaM yadalpakam |
bahvapathyaM balavati na ki~nchittrAyate bhayAt
shlokas.5:
ubhau satyAdhikArau tau trAyete mahato bhayAt |
ati dharmAdbalaM manye balAddharmaH pravartate
shlokas.6:
bale pratiShThito dharmo dharaNyAmiva ja~NgamaH |
dhUmo vAyoriva vashaM balaM dharmo.anuvartate
shlokas.7:
anIshvare balaM dharmo drumaM vallIva sa.nshritA |
vashyo balavatAM dharmaH sukhaM bhogavatAmiva
nAstyasAdhyaM balavatAM sarvaM balavatAM shuchi
shlokas.8:
durAchAraH kShINabalaH parimANaM niyachChati |
atha tasmAdudvijate sarvo loko vRRikAdiva
shlokas.9:
apadhvasto hyavamato duHkhaM jIvati jIvitam |
jIvitaM yadavakShiptaM yathaiva maraNaM tathA
shlokas.10:
yadenamAhuH pApena chAritreNa vinikShatam |
sa bhRRishaM tapyate.anena vAkShalyena parikShataH
shlokas.11:
atraitadAhurAchAryAH pApasya parimokShaNe |
trayIM vidyAM niSheveta tathopAsIta sa dvijAn
shlokas.12:
prasAdayenmadhurayA vAchApyatha cha karmaNA |
mahAmanAshchaiva bhavedvivahechcha mahAkule
shlokas.13:
ityasmIti vadedevaM pareShAM kIrtayanguNAn |
japedudakashIlaH syAtpeshalo nAtijalpanaH
shlokas.14:
brahmakShatraM sampravishedbahu kRRitvA suduShkaram |
uchyamAno.api lokena bahu tattadachintayan
shlokas.15:
apApo hyevamAchAraH kShipraM bahumato bhavet |
sukhaM vittaM cha bhu~njIta vRRittenaitena gopayet
loke cha labhate pUjAM paratra cha mahatphalam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yathA dasyuH samaryAdaH pretyabhAve na nashyati
shlokas.2:
prahartA matimA~nshUraH shrutavAnanRRisha.nsavAn |
rakShannakShayiNaM dharmaM brahmaNyo gurupUjakaH
shlokas.3:
niShAdyAM kShatriyAjjAtaH kShatradharmAnupAlakaH |
kApavyo nAma naiShAdirdasyutvAtsiddhimAptavAn
shlokas.4:
araNye sAyapUrvAhNe mRRigayUthaprakopitA |
vidhij~no mRRigajAtInAM nipAnAnAM cha kovidaH
shlokas.5:
sarvakAnanadeshaj~naH pAriyAtracharaH sadA |
dharmaj~naH sarvabhUtAnAmamogheShurdRRiDhAyudhaH
shlokas.6:
apyanekashatAH senA eka eva jigAya saH |
sa vRRiddhAvandhapitarau mahAraNye.abhyapUjayat
shlokas.7:
madhumA.nsairmUlaphalairannairuchchAvachairapi |
satkRRitya bhojayAmAsa samyakparichachAra cha
shlokas.8:
AraNyakAnpravrajitAnbrAhmaNAnparipAlayan |
api tebhyo mRRigAnhatvA ninAya cha mahAvane
shlokas.9:
ye sma na pratigRRihNanti dasyubhojanasha~NkayA |
teShAmAsajya geheShu kAlya eva sa gachChati
shlokas.10:
taM bahUni sahasrANi grAmaNitve.abhivavrire |
nirmaryAdAni dasyUnAM niranukroshakAriNAm
shlokas.11:
dasyava UchuH||
muhUrtadeshakAlaj~na prAj~na shIladRRiDhAyudha |
grAmaNIrbhava no mukhyaH sarveShAmeva saMmataH
shlokas.12:
yathA yathA vakShyasi naH kariShyAmastathA tathA |
pAlayAsmAnyathAnyAyaM yathA mAtA yathA pitA
shlokas.13:
kApavya uvAcha||
mA vadhIstvaM striyaM bhIruM mA shishuM mA tapasvinam |
nAyudhyamAno hantavyo na cha grAhyA balAtstriyaH
shlokas.14:
sarvathA strI na hantavyA sarvasattveShu yudhyatA |
nityaM gobrAhmaNe svasti yoddhavyaM cha tadarthataH
shlokas.15:
sasyaM cha nApahantavyaM sIravighnaM cha mA kRRithAH |
pUjyante yatra devAshcha pitaro.atithayastathA
shlokas.16:
sarvabhUteShvapi cha vai brAhmaNo mokShamarhati |
kAryA chApachitisteShAM sarvasvenApi yA bhavet
shlokas.17:
yasya hyete sampraruShTA mantrayanti parAbhavam |
na tasya triShu lokeShu trAtA bhavati kashchana
shlokas.18:
yo brAhmaNAnparibhavedvinAshaM vApi rochayet |
sUryodaya ivAvashyaM dhruvaM tasya parAbhavaH
shlokas.19:
ihaiva phalamAsInaH pratyAkA~NkShati shaktitaH |
ye ye no na pradAsyanti tA.nstAnsenAbhiyAsyati
shlokas.20:
shiShTyarthaM vihito daNDo na vadhArthaM vinishchayaH |
ye cha shiShTAnprabAdhante dharmasteShAM vadhaH smRRitaH
shlokas.21:
ye hi rAShTroparodhena vRRittiM kurvanti kechana |
tadeva te.anu mIyante kuNapaM kRRimayo yathA
shlokas.22:
ye punardharmashAstreNa varteranniha dasyavaH |
api te dasyavo bhUtvA kShipraM siddhimavApnuyuH
shlokas.23:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatsarvamupachakruste kApavyasyAnushAsanam |
vRRittiM cha lebhire sarve pApebhyashchApyupAraman
shlokas.24:
kApavyaH karmaNA tena mahatIM siddhimAptavAn |
sAdhUnAmAcharankShemaM dasyUnpApAnnivartayan
shlokas.25:
idaM kApavyacharitaM yo nityamanukIrtayet |
nAraNyebhyaH sa bhUtebhyo bhayamArChetkadAchana
shlokas.26:
bhayaM tasya na martyebhyo nAmartyebhyaH katha~nchana |
na sato nAsato rAjansa hyaraNyeShu gopatiH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra gAthA brahmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
yena mArgeNa rAjAnaH koshaM sa~njanayanti cha
shlokas.2:
na dhanaM yaj~nashIlAnAM hAryaM devasvameva tat |
dasyUnAM niShkriyANAM cha kShatriyo hartumarhati
shlokas.3:
imAH prajAH kShatriyANAM rakShyAshchAdyAshcha bhArata |
dhanaM hi kShatriyasyeha dvitIyasya na vidyate
shlokas.4:
tadasya syAdbalArthaM vA dhanaM yaj~nArthameva vA |
abhogyA hyoShadhIshChittvA bhogyA eva pachantyuta
shlokas.5:
yo vai na devAnna pitR^Inna martyAnhaviShArchati |
AnantikAM tAM dhanitAmAhurvedavido janAH
shlokas.6:
harettaddraviNaM rAjandhArmikaH pRRithivIpatiH |
na hi tatprINayellokAnna koshaM tadvidhaM nRRipaH
shlokas.7:
asAdhubhyo nirAdAya sAdhubhyo yaH prayachChati |
AtmAnaM sa~NkramaM kRRitvA manye dharmavideva saH
shlokas.8:
audbhijjA jantavaH kechidyuktavAcho yathA tathA |
aniShTataH sambhavanti tathAyaj~naH pratAyate
shlokas.9:
yathaiva da.nshamashakaM yathA chANDapipIlikam |
saiva vRRittirayaj~neShu tathA dharmo vidhIyate
shlokas.10:
yathA hyakasmAdbhavati bhUmau pA.nsutRRiNolapam |
tathaiveha bhaveddharmaH sUkShmaH sUkShmataro.api cha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atraiva chedamavyagraH shRRiNvAkhyAnamanuttamam |
dIrghasUtraM samAshritya kAryAkAryavinishchaye
shlokas.2:
nAtigAdhe jalasthAye suhRRidaH shakulAstrayaH |
prabhUtamatsye kaunteya babhUvuH sahachAriNaH
shlokas.3:
atraikaH prAptakAlaj~no dIrghadarshI tathAparaH |
dIrghasUtrashcha tatraikastrayANAM jalachAriNAm
shlokas.4:
kadAchittajjalasthAyaM matsyabandhAH samantataH |
niHsrAvayAmAsuratho nimneShu vividhairmukhaiH
shlokas.5:
prakShIyamANaM taM buddhvA jalasthAyaM bhayAgame |
abravIddIrghadarshI tu tAvubhau suhRRidau tadA
shlokas.6:
iyamApatsamutpannA sarveShAM salilaukasAm |
shIghramanyatra gachChAmaH panthA yAvanna duShyati
shlokas.7:
anAgatamanarthaM hi sunayairyaH prabAdhate |
na sa sa.nshayamApnoti rochatAM vAM vrajAmahe
shlokas.8:
dIrghasUtrastu yastatra so.abravItsamyaguchyate |
na tu kAryA tvarA yAvaditi me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.9:
atha sampratipattij~naH prAbravIddIrghadarshinam |
prApte kAle na me ki~nchinnyAyataH parihAsyate
shlokas.10:
evamukto nirAkrAmaddIrghadarshI mahAmatiH |
jagAma srotasaikena gambhIrasalilAshayam
shlokas.11:
tataH prasrutatoyaM taM samIkShya salilAshayam |
babandhurvividhairyogairmatsyAnmatsyopajIvinaH
shlokas.12:
viloDyamAne tasmi.nstu srutatoye jalAshaye |
agachChadgrahaNaM tatra dIrghasUtraH sahAparaiH
shlokas.13:
uddAnaM kriyamANaM cha matsyAnAM vIkShya rajjubhiH |
pravishyAntaramanyeShAmagrasatpratipattimAn
shlokas.14:
grastameva taduddAnaM gRRihItvAsta tathaiva saH |
sarvAneva tu tA.nstatra te vidurgrathitA iti
shlokas.15:
tataH prakShAlyamAneShu matsyeShu vimale jale |
tyaktvA rajjuM vimukto.abhUchChIghraM sampratipattimAn
shlokas.16:
dIrghasUtrastu mandAtmA hInabuddhirachetanaH |
maraNaM prAptavAnmUDho yathaivopahatendriyaH
shlokas.17:
evaM prAptatamaM kAlaM yo mohAnnAvabudhyate |
sa vinashyati vai kShipraM dIrghasUtro yathA jhaShaH
shlokas.18:
Adau na kurute shreyaH kushalo.asmIti yaH pumAn |
sa sa.nshayamavApnoti yathA sampratipattimAn
shlokas.19:
anAgatavidhAnaM tu yo naraH kurute kShamam |
shreyaH prApnoti so.atyarthaM dIrghadarshI yathA hyasau
shlokas.20:
kalAH kAShThA muhUrtAshcha dinA nADyaH kShaNA lavAH |
pakShA mAsAshcha RRitavastulyAH sa.nvatsarANi cha
shlokas.21:
pRRithivI desha ityuktaH kAlaH sa cha na dRRishyate |
abhipretArthasiddhyarthaM nyAyato yachcha tattathA
shlokas.22:
etau dharmArthashAstreShu mokShashAstreShu charShibhiH |
pradhAnAviti nirdiShTau kAmeshAbhimatau nRRiNAm
shlokas.23:
parIkShyakArI yuktastu samyaksamupapAdayet |
deshakAlAvabhipretau tAbhyAM phalamavApnuyAt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sarvatra buddhiH kathitA shreShThA te bharatarShabha |
anAgatA tathotpannA dIrghasUtrA vinAshinI
shlokas.2:
tadichChAmi parAM buddhiM shrotuM bharatasattama |
yathA rAjanna muhyeta shatrubhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.3:
dharmArthakushala prAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
pRRichChAmi tvA kurushreShTha tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.4:
shatrubhirbahubhirgrasto yathA varteta pArthivaH |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM sarvameva yathAvidhi
shlokas.5:
viShamasthaM hi rAjAnaM shatravaH paripanthinaH |
bahavo.apyekamuddhartuM yatante pUrvatApitAH
shlokas.6:
sarvataH prArthyamAnena durbalena mahAbalaiH |
ekenaivAsahAyena shakyaM sthAtuM kathaM bhavet
shlokas.7:
kathaM mitramariM chaiva vindeta bharatarShabha |
cheShTitavyaM kathaM chAtra shatrormitrasya chAntare
shlokas.8:
praj~nAtalakShaNe rAjannamitre mitratAM gate |
kathaM nu puruShaH kuryAtkiM vA kRRitvA sukhI bhavet
shlokas.9:
vigrahaM kena vA kuryAtsandhiM vA kena yojayet |
kathaM vA shatrumadhyastho vartetAbalavAniti
shlokas.10:
etadvai sarvakRRityAnAM paraM kRRityaM parantapa |
naitasya kashchidvaktAsti shrotA chApi sudurlabhaH
shlokas.11:
RRite shAntanavAdbhIShmAtsatyasandhAjjitendriyAt |
tadanviShya mahAbAho sarvametadvadasva me
shlokas.12:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tvadyukto.ayamanuprashno yudhiShThira guNodayaH |
shRRiNu me putra kArtsnyena guhyamApatsu bhArata
shlokas.13:
amitro mitratAM yAti mitraM chApi praduShyati |
sAmarthyayogAtkAryANAM tadgatyA hi sadA gatiH
shlokas.14:
tasmAdvishvasitavyaM cha vigrahaM cha samAcharet |
deshaM kAlaM cha vij~nAya kAryAkAryavinishchaye
shlokas.15:
sandhAtavyaM budhairnityaM vyavasyaM cha hitArthibhiH |
amitrairapi sandheyaM prANA rakShyAshcha bhArata
shlokas.16:
yo hyamitrairnaro nityaM na sa.ndadhyAdapaNDitaH |
na so.arthamApnuyAtki~nchitphalAnyapi cha bhArata
shlokas.17:
yastvamitreNa sandhatte mitreNa cha virudhyate |
arthayuktiM samAlokya sumahadvindate phalam
shlokas.18:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
mArjArasya cha sa.nvAdaM nyagrodhe mUShakasya cha
shlokas.19:
vane mahati kasmi.nshchinnyagrodhaH sumahAnabhUt |
latAjAlaparichChanno nAnAdvijagaNAyutaH
shlokas.20:
skandhavAnmeghasa~NkAshaH shItachChAyo manoramaH |
vairantyamabhito jAtastarurvyAlamRRigAkulaH
shlokas.21:
tasya mUlaM samAshritya kRRitvA shatamukhaM bilam |
vasati sma mahAprAj~naH palito nAma mUShakaH
shlokas.22:
shAkhAshcha tasya sa.nshritya vasati sma sukhaM puraH |
lomasho nAma mArjAraH pakShisattvAvasAdakaH
shlokas.23:
tatra chAgatya chaNDAlo vairantyakRRitaketanaH |
ayojayattamunmAthaM nityamastaM gate ravau
shlokas.24:
tatra snAyumayAnpAshAnyathAvatsaMnidhAya saH |
gRRihaM gatvA sukhaM shete prabhAtAmeti sharvarIm
shlokas.25:
tatra sma nityaM badhyante naktaM bahuvidhA mRRigAH |
kadAchittatra mArjArastvapramatto.apyabadhyata
shlokas.26:
tasminbaddhe mahAprAj~naH shatrau nityAtatAyini |
taM kAlaM palito j~nAtvA vichachAra sunirbhayaH
shlokas.27:
tenAnucharatA tasminvane vishvastachAriNA |
bhakShaM vicharamANena nachirAddRRiShTamAmiSham
shlokas.28:
sa tamunmAthamAruhya tadAmiShamabhakShayat |
tasyopari sapatnasya baddhasya manasA hasan
shlokas.29:
AmiShe tu prasaktaH sa kadAchidavalokayan |
apashyadaparaM ghoramAtmanaH shatrumAgatam
shlokas.30:
sharaprasUnasa~NkAshaM mahIvivarashAyinam |
nakulaM harikaM nAma chapalaM tAmralochanam
shlokas.31:
tena mUShakagandhena tvaramANamupAgatam |
bhakShArthaM lelihadvaktraM bhUmAvUrdhvamukhaM sthitam
shlokas.32:
shAkhAgatamariM chAnyadapashyatkoTarAlayam |
ulUkaM chandrakaM nAma tIkShNatuNDaM kShapAcharam
shlokas.33:
gatasya viShayaM tasya nakulolUkayostadA |
athAsyAsIdiyaM chintA tatprApya sumahadbhayam
shlokas.34:
ApadyasyAM sukaShTAyAM maraNe samupasthite |
samantAdbhaya utpanne kathaM kAryaM hitaiShiNA
shlokas.35:
sa tathA sarvato ruddhaH sarvatra samadarshanaH |
abhavadbhayasantaptashchakre chemAM parAM gatim
shlokas.36:
ApadvinAshabhUyiShThA shataikIyaM cha jIvitam |
samantasa.nshayA cheyamasmAnApadupasthitA
shlokas.37:
gataM hi sahasA bhUmiM nakulo mAM samApnuyAt |
ulUkashcheha tiShThantaM mArjAraH pAshasa~NkShayAt
shlokas.38:
na tvevAsmadvidhaH prAj~naH saMmohaM gantumarhati |
kariShye jIvite yatnaM yAvaduchChvAsanigraham
shlokas.39:
na hi buddhyAnvitAH prAj~nA nItishAstravishAradAH |
sambhramantyApadaM prApya mahato.arthAnavApya cha
shlokas.40:
na tvanyAmiha mArjArAdgatiM pashyAmi sAmpratam |
viShamastho hyayaM jantuH kRRityaM chAsya mahanmayA
shlokas.41:
jIvitArthI kathaM tvadya prArthitaH shatrubhistribhiH |
tasmAdimamahaM shatruM mArjAraM sa.nshrayAmi vai
shlokas.42:
kShatravidyAM samAshritya hitamasyopadhAraye |
yenemaM shatrusa~NghAtaM matipUrveNa va~nchaye
shlokas.43:
ayamatyantashatrurme vaiShamyaM paramaM gataH |
mUDho grAhayituM svArthaM sa~NgatyA yadi shakyate
shlokas.44:
kadAchidvyasanaM prApya sandhiM kuryAnmayA saha |
balinA saMniviShTasya shatrorapi parigrahaH
kArya ityAhurAchAryA viShame jIvitArthinA
shlokas.45:
shreyAnhi paNDitaH shatrurna cha mitramapaNDitam |
mama hyamitre mArjAre jIvitaM sampratiShThitam
shlokas.46:
hantainaM sampravakShyAmi hetumAtmAbhirakShaNe |
apIdAnImayaM shatruH sa~NgatyA paNDito bhavet
shlokas.47:
tato.arthagatitattvaj~naH sandhivigrahakAlavit |
sAntvapUrvamidaM vAkyaM mArjAraM mUShako.abravIt
shlokas.48:
sauhRRidenAbhibhAShe tvA kachchinmArjAra jIvasi |
jIvitaM hi tavechChAmi shreyaH sAdhAraNaM hi nau
shlokas.49:
na te saumya viShattavyaM jIviShyasi yathA purA |
ahaM tvAmuddhariShyAmi prANA~njahyAM hi te kRRite
shlokas.50:
asti kashchidupAyo.atra puShkalaH pratibhAti mAm |
yena shakyastvayA mokShaH prAptuM shreyo yathA mayA
shlokas.51:
mayA hyupAyo dRRiShTo.ayaM vichArya matimAtmanaH |
AtmArthaM cha tvadarthaM cha shreyaH sAdhAraNaM hi nau
shlokas.52:
idaM hi nakulolUkaM pApabuddhyabhitaH sthitam |
na dharShayati mArjAra tena me svasti sAmpratam
shlokas.53:
kUja.nshchapalanetro.ayaM kaushiko mAM nirIkShate |
nagashAkhAgrahastiShTha.nstasyAhaM bhRRishamudvije
shlokas.54:
satAM sAptapadaM sakhyaM savAso me.asi paNDitaH |
sA.nvAsyakaM kariShyAmi nAsti te mRRityuto bhayam
shlokas.55:
na hi shaknoShi mArjAra pAshaM ChettuM vinA mayA |
ahaM ChetsyAmi te pAshaM yadi mAM tvaM na hi.nsasi
shlokas.56:
tvamAshrito nagasyAgraM mUlaM tvahamupAshritaH |
chiroShitAvihAvAM vai vRRikShe.asminviditaM hi te
shlokas.57:
yasminnAshvasate kashchidyashcha nAshvasate kvachit |
na tau dhIrAH prasha.nsanti nityamudvignachetasau
shlokas.58:
tasmAdvivardhatAM prItiH satyA sa~Ngatirastu nau |
kAlAtItamapArthaM hi na prasha.nsanti paNDitAH
shlokas.59:
arthayuktimimAM tAvadyathAbhUtAM nishAmaya |
tava jIvitamichChAmi tvaM mamechChasi jIvitam
shlokas.60:
kashchittarati kAShThena sugambhIrAM mahAnadIm |
sa tArayati tatkAShThaM sa cha kAShThena tAryate
shlokas.61:
IdRRisho nau samAyogo bhaviShyati sunistaraH |
ahaM tvAM tArayiShyAmi tvaM cha mAM tArayiShyasi
shlokas.62:
evamuktvA tu palitastadarthamubhayorhitam |
hetumadgrahaNIyaM cha kAlAkA~NkShI vyapaikShata
shlokas.63:
atha suvyAhRRitaM tasya shrutvA shatrurvichakShaNaH |
hetumadgrahaNIyArthaM mArjAro vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.64:
buddhimAnvAkyasampannastadvAkyamanuvarNayan |
tAmavasthAmavekShyAntyAM sAmnaiva pratyapUjayat
shlokas.65:
tatastIkShNAgradashano vaiDUryamaNilochanaH |
mUShakaM mandamudvIkShya mArjAro lomasho.abravIt
shlokas.66:
nandAmi saumya bhadraM te yo mAM jIvantamichChasi |
shreyashcha yadi jAnIShe kriyatAM mA vichAraya
shlokas.67:
ahaM hi dRRiDhamApannastvamApannataro mayA |
dvayorApannayoH sandhiH kriyatAM mA vichAraya
shlokas.68:
vidhatsva prAptakAlaM yatkAryaM sidhyatu chAvayoH |
mayi kRRichChrAdvinirmukte na vina~NkShyati te kRRitam
shlokas.69:
nyastamAno.asmi bhakto.asmi shiShyastvaddhitakRRittathA |
nideshavashavartI cha bhavantaM sharaNaM gataH
shlokas.70:
ityevamuktaH palito mArjAraM vashamAgatam |
vAkyaM hitamuvAchedamabhinItArthamarthavat
shlokas.71:
udAraM yadbhavAnAha naitachchitraM bhavadvidhe |
vidito yastu mArgo me hitArthaM shRRiNu taM mama
shlokas.72:
ahaM tvAnupravekShyAmi nakulAnme mahadbhayam |
trAyasva mAM mA vadhIshcha shakto.asmi tava mokShaNe
shlokas.73:
ulUkAchchaiva mAM rakSha kShudraH prArthayate hi mAm |
ahaM ChetsyAmi te pAshAnsakhe satyena te shape
shlokas.74:
tadvachaH sa~NgataM shrutvA lomasho yuktamarthavat |
harShAdudvIkShya palitaM svAgatenAbhyapUjayat
shlokas.75:
sa taM sampUjya palitaM mArjAraH sauhRRide sthitaH |
suvichintyAbravIddhIraH prItastvarita eva hi
shlokas.76:
kShipramAgachCha bhadraM te tvaM me prANasamaH sakhA |
tava prAj~na prasAdAddhi kShipraM prApsyAmi jIvitam
shlokas.77:
yadyadeva~NgatenAdya shakyaM kartuM mayA tava |
tadAj~nApaya kartAhaM sandhirevAstu nau sakhe
shlokas.78:
asmAtte sa.nshayAnmuktaH samitragaNabAndhavaH |
sarvakAryANi kartAhaM priyANi cha hitAni cha
shlokas.79:
muktashcha vyasanAdasmAtsaumyAhamapi nAma te |
prItimutpAdayeyaM cha pratikartuM cha shaknuyAm
shlokas.80:
grAhayitvA tu taM svArthaM mArjAraM mUShakastadA |
pravivesha suvisrabdhaH samyagarthA.nshchachAra ha
shlokas.81:
evamAshvAsito vidvAnmArjAreNa sa mUShakaH |
mArjArorasi visrabdhaH suShvApa pitRRimAtRRivat
shlokas.82:
lInaM tu tasya gAtreShu mArjArasyAtha mUShakam |
tau dRRiShTvA nakulolUkau nirAshau jagmaturgRRihAn
shlokas.83:
lInastu tasya gAtreShu palito deshakAlavit |
chichCheda pAshAnnRRipate kAlAkA~NkShI shanaiH shanaiH
shlokas.84:
atha bandhaparikliShTo mArjAro vIkShya mUShakam |
ChindantaM vai tadA pAshAnatvarantaM tvarAnvitaH
shlokas.85:
tamatvarantaM palitaM pAshAnAM Chedane tadA |
sa~nchodayitumArebhe mArjAro mUShakaM tadA
shlokas.86:
kiM saumya nAbhitvarase kiM kRRitArtho.avamanyase |
Chindhi pAshAnamitraghna purA shvapacha eti saH
shlokas.87:
ityuktastvaratA tena matimAnpalito.abravIt |
mArjAramakRRitapraj~naM vashyamAtmahitaM vachaH
shlokas.88:
tUShNIM bhava na te saumya tvarA kAryA na sambhramaH |
vayamevAtra kAlaj~nA na kAlaH parihAsyate
shlokas.89:
akAle kRRityamArabdhaM kartuM nArthAya kalpate |
tadeva kAla ArabdhaM mahate.arthAya kalpate
shlokas.90:
akAlavipramuktAnme tvatta eva bhayaM bhavet |
tasmAtkAlaM pratIkShasva kimiti tvarase sakhe
shlokas.91:
yAvatpashyAmi chaNDAlamAyAntaM shastrapANinam |
tatashChetsyAmi te pAshaM prApte sAdhAraNe bhaye
shlokas.92:
tasminkAle pramuktastvaM tarumevAdhirohasi |
na hi te jIvitAdanyatki~nchitkRRityaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.93:
tato bhavatyatikrAnte traste bhIte cha lomasha |
ahaM bilaM pravekShyAmi bhavA~nshAkhAM gamiShyati
shlokas.94:
evamuktastu mArjAro mUShakeNAtmano hitam |
vachanaM vAkyatattvaj~no jIvitArthI mahAmatiH
shlokas.95:
athAtmakRRityatvaritaH samyakprashrayamAcharan |
uvAcha lomasho vAkyaM mUShakaM chirakAriNam
shlokas.96:
na hyevaM mitrakAryANi prItyA kurvanti sAdhavaH |
yathA tvaM mokShitaH kRRichChrAttvaramANena vai mayA
shlokas.97:
tathaiva tvaramANena tvayA kAryaM hitaM mama |
yatnaM kuru mahAprAj~na yathA svastyAvayorbhavet
shlokas.98:
atha vA pUrvavairaM tvaM smarankAlaM vikarShasi |
pashya duShkRRitakarmatvaM vyaktamAyuHkShayo mama
shlokas.99:
yachcha ki~nchinmayAj~nAnAtpurastAdvipriyaM kRRitam |
na tanmanasi kartavyaM kShamaye tvAM prasIda me
shlokas.100:
tameva.nvAdinaM prAj~naH shAstravidbuddhisaMmataH |
uvAchedaM vachaH shreShThaM mArjAraM mUShakastadA
shlokas.101:
shrutaM me tava mArjAra svamarthaM parigRRihNataH |
mamApi tvaM vijAnIhi svamarthaM parigRRihNataH
shlokas.102:
yanmitraM bhItavatsAdhyaM yanmitraM bhayasaMhitam |
surakShitaM tataH kAryaM pANiH sarpamukhAdiva
shlokas.103:
kRRitvA balavatA sandhimAtmAnaM yo na rakShati |
apathyamiva tadbhuktaM tasyAnarthAya kalpate
shlokas.104:
na kashchitkasyachinmitraM na kashchitkasyachitsuhRRit |
arthairarthA nibadhyante gajairvanagajA iva
shlokas.105:
na hi kashchitkRRite kArye kartAraM samavekShate |
tasmAtsarvANi kAryANi sAvasheShANi kArayet
shlokas.106:
tasminkAle.api cha bhavAndivAkIrtibhayAnvitaH |
mama na grahaNe shaktaH palAyanaparAyaNaH
shlokas.107:
ChinnaM tu tantubAhulyaM tantureko.avasheShitaH |
ChetsyAmyahaM tadapyAshu nirvRRito bhava lomasha
shlokas.108:
tayoH sa.nvadatorevaM tathaivApannayordvayoH |
kShayaM jagAma sA rAtrirlomashaM chAvishadbhayam
shlokas.109:
tataH prabhAtasamaye vikRRitaH kRRiShNapi~NgalaH |
sthUlasphigvikacho rUkShaH shvachakraparivAritaH
shlokas.110:
sha~NkukarNo mahAvaktraH palito ghoradarshanaH |
parigho nAma chaNDAlaH shastrapANiradRRishyata
shlokas.111:
taM dRRiShTvA yamadUtAbhaM mArjArastrastachetanaH |
uvAcha palitaM bhItaH kimidAnIM kariShyasi
shlokas.112:
atha chApi susantrastau taM dRRiShTvA ghoradarshanam |
kShaNena nakulolUkau nairAshyaM jagmatustadA
shlokas.113:
balinau matimantau cha sa~NghAtaM chApyupAgatau |
ashakyau sunayAttasmAtsampradharShayituM balAt
shlokas.114:
kAryArthaM kRRitasandhI tau dRRiShTvA mArjAramUShakau |
ulUkanakulau tUrNaM jagmatuH svaM svamAlayam
shlokas.115:
tatashchichCheda taM tantuM mArjArasya sa mUShakaH |
vipramukto.atha mArjArastamevAbhyapataddrumam
shlokas.116:
sa cha tasmAdbhayAnmukto mukto ghoreNa shatruNA |
bilaM vivesha palitaH shAkhAM bheje cha lomashaH
shlokas.117:
unmAthamapyathAdAya chaNDAlo vIkShya sarvashaH |
vihatAshaH kShaNenAtha tasmAddeshAdapAkramat
jagAma cha svabhavanaM chaNDAlo bharatarShabha
shlokas.118:
tatastasmAdbhayAnmukto durlabhaM prApya jIvitam |
bilasthaM pAdapAgrasthaH palitaM lomasho.abravIt
shlokas.119:
akRRitvA sa.nvidaM kA~nchitsahasAhamupaplutaH |
kRRitaj~naM kRRitakalyANaM kachchinmAM nAbhisha~Nkase
shlokas.120:
gatvA cha mama vishvAsaM dattvA cha mama jIvitam |
mitropabhogasamaye kiM tvaM naivopasarpasi
shlokas.121:
kRRitvA hi pUrvaM mitrANi yaH pashchAnnAnutiShThati |
na sa mitrANi labhate kRRichChrAsvApatsu durmatiH
shlokas.122:
tatkRRito.ahaM tvayA mitraM sAmarthyAdAtmanaH sakhe |
sa mAM mitratvamApannamupabhoktuM tvamarhasi
shlokas.123:
yAni me santi mitrANi ye cha me santi bAndhavAH |
sarve tvAM pUjayiShyanti shiShyA gurumiva priyam
shlokas.124:
ahaM cha pUjayiShye tvAM samitragaNabAndhavam |
jIvitasya pradAtAraM kRRitaj~naH ko na pUjayet
shlokas.125:
Ishvaro me bhavAnastu sharIrasya gRRihasya cha |
arthAnAM chaiva sarveShAmanushAstA cha me bhava
shlokas.126:
amAtyo me bhava prAj~na piteva hi prashAdhi mAm |
na te.asti bhayamasmatto jIvitenAtmanaH shape
shlokas.127:
buddhyA tvamushanAH sAkShAdbale tvadhikRRitA vayam |
tvanmantrabalayukto hi vindeta jayameva ha
shlokas.128:
evamuktaH paraM sAntvaM mArjAreNa sa mUShakaH |
uvAcha paramArthaj~naH shlakShNamAtmahitaM vachaH
shlokas.129:
yadbhavAnAha tatsarvaM mayA te lomasha shrutam |
mamApi tAvadbruvataH shRRiNu yatpratibhAti mAm
shlokas.130:
veditavyAni mitrANi boddhavyAshchApi shatravaH |
etatsusUkShmaM loke.asmindRRishyate prAj~nasaMmatam
shlokas.131:
shatrurUpAshcha suhRRido mitrarUpAshcha shatravaH |
sAntvitAste na budhyante rAgalobhavashaM gatAH
shlokas.132:
nAsti jAtyA ripurnAma mitraM nAma na vidyate |
sAmarthyayogAjjAyante mitrANi ripavastathA
shlokas.133:
yo yasmi~njIvati svArthaM pashyettAvatsa jIvati |
sa tasya tAvanmitraM syAdyAvanna syAdviparyayaH
shlokas.134:
nAsti maitrI sthirA nAma na cha dhruvamasauhRRidam |
arthayuktyA hi jAyante mitrANi ripavastathA
shlokas.135:
mitraM cha shatrutAmeti kasmi.nshchitkAlaparyaye |
shatrushcha mitratAmeti svArtho hi balavattaraH
shlokas.136:
yo vishvasati mitreShu na chAshvasati shatruShu |
arthayuktimavij~nAya chalitaM tasya jIvitam
shlokas.137:
arthayuktimavij~nAya yaH shubhe kurute matim |
mitre vA yadi vA shatrau tasyApi chalitA matiH
shlokas.138:
na vishvasedavishvaste vishvaste.api na vishvaset |
vishvAsAdbhayamutpannaM mUlAnyapi nikRRintati
shlokas.139:
arthayuktyA hi dRRishyante pitA mAtA sutAstathA |
mAtulA bhAgineyAshcha tathA sambandhibAndhavAH
shlokas.140:
putraM hi mAtApitaru tyajataH patitaM priyam |
loko rakShati chAtmAnaM pashya svArthasya sAratAm
shlokas.141:
taM manye nikRRitipraj~naM yo mokShaM pratyanantaram |
kRRityaM mRRigayase kartuM sukhopAyamasa.nshayam
shlokas.142:
asminnilaya eva tvaM nyagrodhAdavatAritaH |
pUrvaM niviShTamunmAthaM chapalatvAnna buddhavAn
shlokas.143:
Atmanashchapalo nAsti kuto.anyeShAM bhaviShyati |
tasmAtsarvANi kAryANi chapalo hantyasa.nshayam
shlokas.144:
bravIti madhuraM ka~nchitpriyo me ha bhavAniti |
tanmithyAkaraNaM sarvaM vistareNApi me shRRiNu
shlokas.145:
kAraNAtpriyatAmeti dveShyo bhavati kAraNAt |
arthArthI jIvaloko.ayaM na kashchitkasyachitpriyaH
shlokas.146:
sakhyaM sodarayorbhrAtrordampatyorvA parasparam |
kasyachinnAbhijAnAmi prItiM niShkAraNAmiha
shlokas.147:
yadyapi bhrAtaraH kruddhA bhAryA vA kAraNAntare |
svabhAvataste prIyante netaraH prIyate janaH
shlokas.148:
priyo bhavati dAnena priyavAdena chAparaH |
mantrahomajapairanyaH kAryArthaM prIyate janaH
shlokas.149:
utpanne kAraNe prItirnAsti nau kAraNAntare |
pradhvaste kAraNasthAne sA prItirvinivartate
shlokas.150:
kiM nu tatkAraNaM manye yenAhaM bhavataH priyaH |
anyatrAbhyavahArArthAttatrApi cha budhA vayam
shlokas.151:
kAlo hetuM vikurute svArthastamanuvartate |
svArthaM prAj~no.abhijAnAti prAj~naM loko.anuvartate
shlokas.152:
na tvIdRRishaM tvayA vAchyaM viduShi svArthapaNDite |
akAle.aviShamasthasya svArthaheturayaM tava
shlokas.153:
tasmAnnAhaM chale svArthAtsusthitaH sandhivigrahe |
abhrANAmiva rUpANi vikurvanti kShaNe kShaNe
shlokas.154:
adyaiva hi ripurbhUtvA punaradyaiva sauhRRidam |
punashcha ripuradyaiva yuktInAM pashya chApalam
shlokas.155:
AsIttAvattu maitrI nau yAvaddheturabhUtpurA |
sA gatA saha tenaiva kAlayuktena hetunA
shlokas.156:
tvaM hi me.atyantataH shatruH sAmarthyAnmitratAM gataH |
tatkRRityamabhinirvRRittaM prakRRitiH shatrutAM gatA
shlokas.157:
so.ahamevaM praNItAni j~nAtvA shAstrANi tattvataH |
pravisheyaM kathaM pAshaM tvatkRRitaM tadvadasva me
shlokas.158:
tvadvIryeNa vimukto.ahaM madvIryeNa tathA bhavAn |
anyonyAnugrahe vRRitte nAsti bhUyaH samAgamaH
shlokas.159:
tvaM hi saumya kRRitArtho.adya nirvRRittArthAstathA vayam |
na te.astyanyanmayA kRRityaM ki~nchidanyatra bhakShaNAt
shlokas.160:
ahamannaM bhavAnbhoktA durbalo.ahaM bhavAnbalI |
nAvayorvidyate sandhirniyukte viShame bale
shlokas.161:
saMmanye.ahaM tava praj~nAM yanmokShAtpratyanantaram |
bhakShyaM mRRigayase nUnaM sukhopAyamasa.nshayam
shlokas.162:
bhakShyArthameva baddhastvaM sa muktaH prasRRitaH kShudhA |
shAstraj~namabhisandhAya nUnaM bhakShayitAdya mAm
shlokas.163:
jAnAmi kShudhitaM hi tvAmAhArasamayashcha te |
sa tvaM mAmabhisandhAya bhakShyaM mRRigayase punaH
shlokas.164:
yachchApi putradAraM svaM tatsaMnisRRijase mayi |
shushrUShAM nAma me kartuM sakhe mama na tatkShamam
shlokas.165:
tvayA mAM sahitaM dRRiShTvA priyA bhAryA sutAshcha ye |
kasmAnmAM te na khAdeyurhRRiShTAH praNayinastvayi
shlokas.166:
nAhaM tvayA sameShyAmi vRRitto hetuH samAgame |
shivaM dhyAyasva me.atrasthaH sukRRitaM smaryate yadi
shlokas.167:
shatrorannAdyabhUtaH sankliShTasya kShudhitasya cha |
bhakShyaM mRRigayamANasya kaH prAj~no viShayaM vrajet
shlokas.168:
svasti te.astu gamiShyAmi dUrAdapi tavodvije |
nAhaM tvayA sameShyAmi nirvRRito bhava lomasha
shlokas.169:
balavatsaMnikarSho hi na kadAchitprashasyate |
prashAntAdapi me prAj~na bhetavyaM balinaH sadA
shlokas.170:
yadi tvarthena me kAryaM brUhi kiM karavANi te |
kAmaM sarvaM pradAsyAmi na tvAtmAnaM kadAchana
shlokas.171:
AtmArthe santatistyAjyA rAjyaM ratnaM dhanaM tathA |
api sarvasvamutsRRijya rakShedAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.172:
aishvaryadhanaratnAnAM pratyamitre.api tiShThatAm |
dRRiShTA hi punarAvRRittirjIvatAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.173:
na tvAtmanaH sampradAnaM dhanaratnavadiShyate |
AtmA tu sarvato rakShyo dArairapi dhanairapi
shlokas.174:
AtmarakShitatantrANAM suparIkShitakAriNAm |
Apado nopapadyante puruShANAM svadoShajAH
shlokas.175:
shatrUnsamyagvijAnanti durbalA ye balIyasaH |
teShAM na chAlyate buddhirAtmArthaM kRRitanishchayA
shlokas.176:
ityabhivyaktamevAsau palitenAvabhartsitaH |
mArjAro vrIDito bhUtvA mUShakaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.177:
saMmanye.ahaM tava praj~nAM yastvaM mama hite rataH |
uktavAnarthatattvena mayA sambhinnadarshanaH
shlokas.178:
na tu mAmanyathA sAdho tvaM vij~nAtumihArhasi |
prANapradAnajaM tvatto mama sauhRRidamAgatam
shlokas.179:
dharmaj~no.asmi guNaj~no.asmi kRRitaj~no.asmi visheShataH |
mitreShu vatsalashchAsmi tvadvidheShu visheShataH
shlokas.180:
tanmAmeva~Ngate sAdho na yAvayitumarhasi |
tvayA hi yAvyamAno.ahaM prANA~njahyAM sabAndhavaH
shlokas.181:
dhikShabdo hi budhairdRRiShTo madvidheShu manasviShu |
maraNaM dharmatattvaj~na na mAM sha~Nkitumarhasi
shlokas.182:
iti sa.nstUyamAno hi mArjAreNa sa mUShakaH |
manasA bhAvagambhIraM mArjAraM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.183:
sAdhurbhavA~nshrutArtho.asmi prIyate na cha vishvase |
sa.nstavairvA dhanaughairvA nAhaM shakyaH punastvayA
shlokas.184:
na hyamitravashaM yAnti prAj~nA niShkAraNaM sakhe |
asminnarthe cha gAthe dve nibodhoshanasA kRRite
shlokas.185:
shatrusAdhAraNe kRRitye kRRitvA sandhiM balIyasA |
samAhitashcharedyuktyA kRRitArthashcha na vishvaset
shlokas.186:
tasmAtsarvAsvavasthAsu rakShejjIvitamAtmanaH |
dravyANi santatishchaiva sarvaM bhavati jIvataH
shlokas.187:
sa~NkShepo nItishAstrANAmavishvAsaH paro mataH |
nRRiShu tasmAdavishvAsaH puShkalaM hitamAtmanaH
shlokas.188:
vadhyante na hyavishvastAH shatrubhirdurbalA api |
vishvastAstvAshu vadhyante balavanto.api durbalaiH
shlokas.189:
tvadvidhebhyo mayA hyAtmA rakShyo mArjAra sarvadA |
rakSha tvamapi chAtmAnaM chaNDAlAjjAtikilbiShAt
shlokas.190:
sa tasya bruvatastvevaM santrAsAjjAtasAdhvasaH |
svabilaM hi javenAshu mArjAraH prayayau tataH
shlokas.191:
tataH shAstrArthatattvaj~no buddhisAmarthyamAtmanaH |
vishrAvya palitaH prAj~no bilamanyajjagAma ha
shlokas.192:
evaM praj~nAvatA buddhyA durbalena mahAbalAH |
ekena bahavo.amitrAH palitenAbhisandhitAH
shlokas.193:
ariNApi samarthena sandhiM kurvIta paNDitaH |
mUShakashcha biDAlashcha muktAvanyonyasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.194:
ityeSha kShatradharmasya mayA mArgo.anudarshitaH |
vistareNa mahIpAla sa~NkShepeNa punaH shRRiNu
shlokas.195:
anyonyakRRitavairau tu chakratuH prItimuttamAm |
anyonyamabhisandhAtumabhUchchaiva tayormatiH
shlokas.196:
tatra prAj~no.abhisandhatte samyagbuddhibalAshrayAt |
abhisandhIyate prAj~naH pramAdAdapi chAbudhaiH
shlokas.197:
tasmAdabhItavadbhIto vishvastavadavishvasan |
na hyapramattashchalati chalito vA vinashyati
shlokas.198:
kAlena ripuNA sandhiH kAle mitreNa vigrahaH |
kArya ityeva tattvaj~nAH prAhurnityaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.199:
evaM matvA mahArAja shAstrArthamabhigamya cha |
abhiyukto.apramattashcha prAgbhayAdbhItavachcharet
shlokas.200:
bhItavatsa.nvidhiH kAryaH pratisandhistathaiva cha |
bhayAdutpadyate buddhirapramattAbhiyogajA
shlokas.201:
na bhayaM vidyate rAjanbhItasyAnAgate bhaye |
abhItasya tu visrambhAtsumahajjAyate bhayam
shlokas.202:
na bhIruriti chAtyantaM mantro.adeyaH katha~nchana |
avij~nAnAddhi vij~nAte gachChedAspadadarshiShu
shlokas.203:
tasmAdabhItavadbhIto vishvastavadavishvasan |
kAryANAM gurutAM buddhvA nAnRRitaM ki~nchidAcharet
shlokas.204:
evametanmayA proktamitihAsaM yudhiShThira |
shrutvA tvaM suhRRidAM madhye yathAvatsamupAchara
shlokas.205:
upalabhya matiM chAgryAmarimitrAntaraM tathA |
sandhivigrahakAlaM cha mokShopAyaM tathApadi
shlokas.206:
shatrusAdhAraNe kRRitye kRRitvA sandhiM balIyasA |
samAgamaM charedyuktyA kRRitArtho na cha vishvaset
shlokas.207:
aviruddhAM trivargeNa nItimetAM yudhiShThira |
abhyuttiShTha shrutAdasmAdbhUyastvaM ra~njayanprajAH
shlokas.208:
brAhmaNaishchApi te sArdhaM yAtrA bhavatu pANDava |
brAhmaNA hi paraM shreyo divi cheha cha bhArata
shlokas.209:
ete dharmasya vettAraH kRRitaj~nAH satataM prabho |
pUjitAH shubhakarmANaH pUrvajityA narAdhipa
shlokas.210:
rAjyaM shreyaH paraM rAjanyashaH kIrtiM cha lapsyase |
kulasya santatiM chaiva yathAnyAyaM yathAkramam
shlokas.211:
dvayorimaM bhArata sandhivigrahaM; subhAShitaM buddhivisheShakAritam |
tathAnvavekShya kShitipena sarvadA; niShevitavyaM nRRipa shatrumaNDale

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ukto mantro mahAbAho na vishvAso.asti shatruShu |
kathaM hi rAjA varteta yadi sarvatra nAshvaset
shlokas.2:
vishvAsAddhi paraM rAj~no rAjannutpadyate bhayam |
kathaM vai nAshvasanrAjA shatrU~njayati pArthiva
shlokas.3:
etanme sa.nshayaM Chindhi mano me sampramuhyati |
avishvAsakathAmetAmupashrutya pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu kaunteya yo vRRitto brahmadattaniveshane |
pUjanyA saha sa.nvAdo brahmadattasya pArthiva
shlokas.5:
kAmpilye brahmadattasya antaHpuranivAsinI |
pUjanI nAma shakunI dIrghakAlaM sahoShitA
shlokas.6:
rutaj~nA sarvabhUtAnAM yathA vai jIvajIvakaH |
sarvaj~nA sarvadharmaj~nA tiryagyonigatApi sA
shlokas.7:
abhiprajAtA sA tatra putramekaM suvarchasam |
samakAlaM cha rAj~no.api devyAH putro vyajAyata
shlokas.8:
samudratIraM gatvA sA tvAjahAra phaladvayam |
puShTyarthaM cha svaputrasya rAjaputrasya chaiva ha
shlokas.9:
phalamekaM sutAyAdAdrAjaputrAya chAparam |
amRRitAsvAdasadRRishaM balatejovivardhanam
tatrAgachChatparAM vRRiddhiM rAjaputraH phalAshanAt
shlokas.10:
dhAtryA hastagatashchApi tenAkrIData pakShiNA |
shUnye tu tamupAdAya pakShiNaM samajAtakam
hatvA tataH sa rAjendra dhAtryA hastamupAgamat
shlokas.11:
atha sA shakunI rAjannAgamatphalahArikA |
apashyannihataM putraM tena bAlena bhUtale
shlokas.12:
bAShpapUrNamukhI dInA dRRiShTvA sA tu hataM sutam |
pUjanI duHkhasantaptA rudatI vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.13:
kShatriye sa~NgataM nAsti na prItirna cha sauhRRidam |
kAraNe sambhajantIha kRRitArthAH santyajanti cha
shlokas.14:
kShatriyeShu na vishvAsaH kAryaH sarvopaghAtiShu |
apakRRityApi satataM sAntvayanti nirarthakam
shlokas.15:
ahamasya karomyadya sadRRishIM vairayAtanAm |
kRRitaghnasya nRRisha.nsasya bhRRishaM vishvAsaghAtinaH
shlokas.16:
sahasa~njAtavRRiddhasya tathaiva sahabhojinaH |
sharaNAgatasya cha vadhastrividhaM hyasya kilbiSham
shlokas.17:
ityuktvA charaNAbhyAM tu netre nRRipasutasya sA |
bhittvA svasthA tata idaM pUjanI vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.18:
ichChayaiva kRRitaM pApaM sadya evopasarpati |
kRRitapratikriyaM teShAM na nashyati shubhAshubham
shlokas.19:
pApaM karma kRRitaM ki~nchinna tasminyadi vidyate |
nipAtyate.asya putreShu na chetpautreShu naptRRiShu
shlokas.20:
brahmadatta uvAcha||
asti vai kRRitamasmAbhirasti pratikRRitaM tvayA |
ubhayaM tatsamIbhUtaM vasa pUjani mA gamaH
shlokas.21:
pUjanyuvAcha||
sakRRitkRRitAparAdhasya tatraiva parilambataH |
na tadbudhAH prasha.nsanti shreyastatrApasarpaNam
shlokas.22:
sAntve prayukte nRRipate kRRitavaire na vishvaset |
kShipraM prabadhyate mUDho na hi vairaM prashAmyati
shlokas.23:
anyonyaM kRRitavairANAM putrapautraM nigachChati |
putrapautre vinaShTe tu paralokaM nigachChati
shlokas.24:
sarveShAM kRRitavairANAmavishvAsaH sukhAvahaH |
ekAntato na vishvAsaH kAryo vishvAsaghAtakaH
shlokas.25:
na vishvasedavishvaste vishvaste.api na vishvaset |
kAmaM vishvAsayedanyAnpareShAM tu na vishvaset
shlokas.26:
mAtA pitA bAndhavAnAM variShThau; bhAryA jarA bIjamAtraM tu putraH |
bhrAtA shatruH klinnapANirvayasya; AtmA hyekaH sukhaduHkhasya vettA
shlokas.27:
anyonyakRRitavairANAM na sandhirupapadyate |
sa cha heturatikrAnto yadarthamahamAvasam
shlokas.28:
pUjitasyArthamAnAbhyAM jantoH pUrvApakAriNaH |
cheto bhavatyavishvastaM pUrvaM trAsayate balAt
shlokas.29:
pUrvaM saMmAnanA yatra pashchAchchaiva vimAnanA |
jahyAttaM sattvavAnvAsaM saMmAnitavimAnitaH
shlokas.30:
uShitAsmi tavAgAre dIrghakAlamahi.nsitA |
tadidaM vairamutpannaM sukhamAssva vrajAmyaham
shlokas.31:
brahmadatta uvAcha||
yatkRRite pratikuryAdvai na sa tatrAparAdhnuyAt |
anRRiNastena bhavati vasa pUjani mA gamaH
shlokas.32:
pUjanyuvAcha||
na kRRitasya na kartushcha sakhyaM sandhIyate punaH |
hRRidayaM tatra jAnAti kartushchaiva kRRitasya cha
shlokas.33:
brahmadatta uvAcha||
kRRitasya chaiva kartushcha sakhyaM sandhIyate punaH |
vairasyopashamo dRRiShTaH pApaM nopAshnute punaH
shlokas.34:
pUjanyuvAcha||
nAsti vairamupakrAntaM sAntvito.asmIti nAshvaset |
vishvAsAdbadhyate bAlastasmAchChreyo hyadarshanam
shlokas.35:
tarasA ye na shakyante shastraiH sunishitairapi |
sAmnA te vinigRRihyante gajA iva kareNubhiH
shlokas.36:
brahmadatta uvAcha||
sa.nvAsAjjAyate sneho jIvitAntakareShvapi |
anyonyasya cha vishvAsaH shvapachena shuno yathA
shlokas.37:
anyonyakRRitavairANAM sa.nvAsAnmRRidutAM gatam |
naiva tiShThati tadvairaM puShkarasthamivodakam
shlokas.38:
pUjanyuvAcha||
vairaM pa~nchasamutthAnaM tachcha budhyanti paNDitAH |
strIkRRitaM vAstujaM vAgjaM sasapatnAparAdhajam
shlokas.39:
tatra dAtA nihantavyaH kShatriyeNa visheShataH |
prakAshaM vAprakAshaM vA buddhvA deshabalAdikam
shlokas.40:
kRRitavaire na vishvAsaH kAryastviha suhRRidyapi |
ChannaM santiShThate vairaM gUDho.agniriva dAruShu
shlokas.41:
na vittena na pAruShyairna sAntvena na cha shrutaiH |
vairAgniH shAmyate rAjannaurvAgniriva sAgare
shlokas.42:
na hi vairAgnirudbhUtaH karma vApyaparAdhajam |
shAmyatyadagdhvA nRRipate vinA hyekatarakShayAt
shlokas.43:
satkRRitasyArthamAnAbhyAM syAttu pUrvApakAriNaH |
naiva shAntirna vishvAsaH karma trAsayate balAt
shlokas.44:
naivApakAre kasmi.nshchidahaM tvayi tathA bhavAn |
vishvAsAduShitA pUrvaM nedAnIM vishvasAmyaham
shlokas.45:
brahmadatta uvAcha||
kAlena kriyate kAryaM tathaiva vividhAH kriyAH |
kAlenaiva pravartante kaH kasyehAparAdhyati
shlokas.46:
tulyaM chobhe pravartete maraNaM janma chaiva ha |
kAryate chaiva kAlena tannimittaM hi jIvati
shlokas.47:
badhyante yugapatkechidekaikasya na chApare |
kAlo dahati bhUtAni samprApyAgnirivendhanam
shlokas.48:
nAhaM pramANaM naiva tvamanyonyakaraNe shubhe |
kAlo nityamupAdhatte sukhaM duHkhaM cha dehinAm
shlokas.49:
evaM vaseha sasnehA yathAkAlamahi.nsitA |
yatkRRitaM tachcha me kShAntaM tvaM chaiva kShama pUjani
shlokas.50:
pUjanyuvAcha||
yadi kAlaH pramANaM te na vairaM kasyachidbhavet |
kasmAttvapachitiM yAnti bAndhavA bAndhave hate
shlokas.51:
kasmAddevAsurAH pUrvamanyonyamabhijaghnire |
yadi kAlena niryANaM sukhaduHkhe bhavAbhavau
shlokas.52:
bhiShajo bheShajaM kartuM kasmAdichChanti rogiNe |
yadi kAlena pachyante bheShajaiH kiM prayojanam
shlokas.53:
pralApaH kriyate kasmAtsumahA~nshokamUrChitaiH |
yadi kAlaH pramANaM te kasmAddharmo.asti kartRRiShu
shlokas.54:
tava putro mamApatyaM hatavAnhi.nsito mayA |
anantaraM tvayA chAhaM bandhanIyA mahIpate
shlokas.55:
ahaM hi putrashokena kRRitapApA tavAtmaje |
tathA tvayA prahartavyaM mayi tattvaM cha me shRRiNu
shlokas.56:
bhakShArthaM krIDanArthaM vA narA vA~nChanti pakShiNaH |
tRRitIyo nAsti sa.nyogo vadhabandhAdRRite kShamaH
shlokas.57:
vadhabandhabhayAdeke mokShatantramupAgatAH |
maraNotpAtajaM duHkhamAhurdharmavido janAH
shlokas.58:
sarvasya dayitAH prANAH sarvasya dayitAH sutAH |
duHkhAdudvijate sarvaH sarvasya sukhamIpsitam
shlokas.59:
duHkhaM jarA brahmadatta duHkhamarthaviparyayaH |
duHkhaM chAniShTasa.nvAso duHkhamiShTaviyogajam
shlokas.60:
vairabandhakRRitaM duHkhaM hi.nsAjaM strIkRRitaM tathA |
duHkhaM sukhena satataM janAdviparivartate
shlokas.61:
na duHkhaM paraduHkhe vai kechidAhurabuddhayaH |
yo duHkhaM nAbhijAnAti sa jalpati mahAjane
shlokas.62:
yastu shochati duHkhArtaH sa kathaM vaktumutsahet |
rasaj~naH sarvaduHkhasya yathAtmani tathA pare
shlokas.63:
yatkRRitaM te mayA rAja.nstvayA cha mama yatkRRitam |
na tadvarShashataiH shakyaM vyapohitumari.ndama
shlokas.64:
AvayoH kRRitamanyonyaM tatra sandhirna vidyate |
smRRitvA smRRitvA hi te putraM navaM vairaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.65:
vairamantikamAsajya yaH prItiM kartumichChati |
mRRinmayasyeva bhagnasya tasya sandhirna vidyate
shlokas.66:
nishchitashchArthashAstraj~nairavishvAsaH sukhodayaH |
ushanAshchAtha gAthe dve prahrAdAyAbravItpurA
shlokas.67:
ye vairiNaH shraddadhate satye satyetare.api vA |
te shraddadhAnA vadhyante madhu shuShkatRRiNairyathA
shlokas.68:
na hi vairANi shAmyanti kuleShvA dashamAdyugAt |
AkhyAtArashcha vidyante kule chedvidyate pumAn
shlokas.69:
upaguhya hi vairANi sAntvayanti narAdhipAH |
athainaM pratipiMShanti pUrNaM ghaTamivAshmani
shlokas.70:
sadA na vishvasedrAjanpApaM kRRitveha kasyachit |
apakRRitya pareShAM hi vishvAsAdduHkhamashnute
shlokas.71:
brahmadatta uvAcha||
nAvishvAsAchchinvate.arthAnnehante chApi ki~nchana |
bhayAdekatarAnnityaM mRRitakalpA bhavanti cha
shlokas.72:
pUjanyuvAcha||
yasyeha vraNinau pAdau padbhyAM cha parisarpati |
kShaNyete tasya tau pAdau suguptamabhidhAvataH
shlokas.73:
netrAbhyAM sarujAbhyAM yaH prativAtamudIkShate |
tasya vAyurujAtyarthaM netrayorbhavati dhruvam
shlokas.74:
duShTaM panthAnamAshritya yo mohAdabhipadyate |
Atmano balamaj~nAtvA tadantaM tasya jIvitam
shlokas.75:
yastu varShamavij~nAya kShetraM kRRiShati mAnavaH |
hInaM puruShakAreNa sasyaM naivApnute punaH
shlokas.76:
yashcha tiktaM kaShAyaM vApyAsvAdavidhuraM hitam |
AhAraM kurute nityaM so.amRRitatvAya kalpate
shlokas.77:
pathyaM bhuktvA naro lobhAdyo.anyadashnAti bhojanam |
pariNAmamavij~nAya tadantaM tasya jIvitam
shlokas.78:
daivaM puruShakArashcha sthitAvanyonyasa.nshrayAt |
udAttAnAM karma tantraM daivaM klIbA upAsate
shlokas.79:
karma chAtmahitaM kAryaM tIkShNaM vA yadi vA mRRidu |
grasyate.akarmashIlastu sadAnarthairaki~nchanaH
shlokas.80:
tasmAtsa.nshayite.apyarthe kArya eva parAkramaH |
sarvasvamapi santyajya kAryamAtmahitaM naraiH
shlokas.81:
vidyA shauryaM cha dAkShyaM cha balaM dhairyaM cha pa~nchamam |
mitrANi sahajAnyAhurvartayantIha yairbudhAH
shlokas.82:
niveshanaM cha kupyaM cha kShetraM bhAryA suhRRijjanaH |
etAnyupachitAnyAhuH sarvatra labhate pumAn
shlokas.83:
sarvatra ramate prAj~naH sarvatra cha virochate |
na vibhIShayate ka~nchidbhIShito na bibheti cha
shlokas.84:
nityaM buddhimato hyarthaH svalpako.api vivardhate |
dAkShyeNa kurute karma sa.nyamAtpratitiShThati
shlokas.85:
gRRihasnehAvabaddhAnAM narANAmalpamedhasAm |
kustrI khAdati mA.nsAni mAghamA segavAmiva
shlokas.86:
gRRihaM kShetrANi mitrANi svadesha iti chApare |
ityevamavasIdanti narA buddhiviparyaye
shlokas.88:
tasmAdanyatra yAsyAmi vastuM nAhamihotsahe |
kRRitametadanAhAryaM tava putreNa pArthiva
shlokas.89:
kubhAryAM cha kuputraM cha kurAjAnaM kusauhRRidam |
kusambandhaM kudeshaM cha dUrataH parivarjayet
shlokas.90:
kumitre nAsti vishvAsaH kubhAryAyAM kuto ratiH |
kurAjye nirvRRitirnAsti kudeshe na prajIvyate
shlokas.91:
kumitre sa~NgataM nAsti nityamasthirasauhRRide |
avamAnaH kusambandhe bhavatyarthaviparyaye
shlokas.92:
sA bhAryA yA priyaM brUte sa putro yatra nirvRRitiH |
tanmitraM yatra vishvAsaH sa desho yatra jIvyate
shlokas.93:
yatra nAsti balAtkAraH sa rAjA tIvrashAsanaH |
na chaiva hyabhisambandho daridraM yo bubhUShati
shlokas.94:
bhAryA desho.atha mitrANi putrasambandhibAndhavAH |
etatsarvaM guNavati dharmanetre mahIpatau
shlokas.95:
adharmaj~nasya vilayaM prajA gachChantyanigrahAt |
rAjA mUlaM trivargasya apramatto.anupAlayan
shlokas.96:
baliShaDbhAgamuddhRRitya baliM tamupayojayet |
na rakShati prajAH samyagyaH sa pArthivataskaraH
shlokas.97:
dattvAbhayaM yaH svayameva rAjA; na tatpramANaM kurute yathAvat |
sa sarvalokAdupalabhya pApa;madharmabuddhirnirayaM prayAti
shlokas.98:
dattvAbhayaM yaH sma rAjA pramANaM kurute sadA |
sa sarvasukhakRRijj~neyaH prajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.99:
pitA mAtA gururgoptA vahnirvaishravaNo yamaH |
sapta rAj~no guNAnetAnmanurAha prajApatiH
shlokas.100:
pitA hi rAjA rAShTrasya prajAnAM yo.anukampakaH |
tasminmithyApraNIte hi tiryaggachChati mAnavaH
shlokas.102:
iShTeShu visRRijatyarthAnkubera iva kAmadaH |
gururdharmopadeshena goptA cha paripAlanAt
shlokas.103:
yastu ra~njayate rAjA paurajAnapadAnguNaiH |
na tasya bhrashyate rAjyaM guNadharmAnupAlanAt
shlokas.104:
svayaM samupajAnanhi paurajAnapadakriyAH |
sa sukhaM modate bhUpa iha loke paratra cha
shlokas.105:
nityodvignAH prajA yasya karabhAraprapIDitAH |
anarthairvipralupyante sa gachChati parAbhavam
shlokas.106:
prajA yasya vivardhante sarasIva mahotpalam |
sa sarvayaj~naphalabhAgrAjA loke mahIyate
shlokas.107:
balinA vigraho rAjanna katha~nchitprashasyate |
balinA vigRRihItasya kuto rAjyaM kutaH sukham
shlokas.108:
bhIShma uvAcha||
saivamuktvA shakunikA brahmadattaM narAdhipam |
rAjAnaM samanuj~nApya jagAmAthepsitAM disham
shlokas.109:
etatte brahmadattasya pUjanyA saha bhAShitam |
mayoktaM bharatashreShTha kimanyachChrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yugakShayAtparikShINe dharme loke cha bhArata |
dasyubhiH pIDyamAne cha kathaM stheyaM pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi nItimApatsu bhArata |
utsRRijyApi ghRRiNAM kAle yathA varteta bhUmipaH
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bharadvAjasya sa.nvAdaM rAj~naH shatruntapasya cha
shlokas.4:
rAjA shatruntapo nAma sauvIrANAM mahArathaH |
kaNi~Nkamupasa~Ngamya paprachChArthavinishchayam
shlokas.5:
alabdhasya kathaM lipsA labdhaM kena vivardhate |
vardhitaM pAlayetkena pAlitaM praNayetkatham
shlokas.6:
tasmai vinishchayArthaM sa paripRRiShTArthanishchayaH |
uvAcha brAhmaNo vAkyamidaM hetumaduttaram
shlokas.7:
nityamudyatadaNDaH syAnnityaM vivRRitapauruShaH |
achChidrashChidradarshI cha pareShAM vivarAnugaH
shlokas.8:
nityamudyatadaNDasya bhRRishamudvijate janaH |
tasmAtsarvANi bhUtAni daNDenaiva prarodhayet
shlokas.9:
