evameva prasha.nsanti paNDitAstattvadarshinaH |
tasmAchchatuShTaye tasminpradhAno daNDa uchyate
shlokas.10:
ChinnamUle hyadhiShThAne sarve tajjIvino hatAH |
kathaM hi shAkhAstiShTheyushChinnamUle vanaspatau
shlokas.11:
mUlamevAditashChindyAtparapakShasya paNDitaH |
tataH sahAyAnpakShaM cha sarvamevAnusArayet
shlokas.12:
sumantritaM suvikrAntaM suyuddhaM supalAyitam |
ApadAM padakAleShu kurvIta na vichArayet
shlokas.13:
vA~NmAtreNa vinItaH syAddhRRidayena yathA kShuraH |
shlakShNapUrvAbhibhAShI cha kAmakrodhau vivarjayet
shlokas.14:
sapatnasahite kArye kRRitvA sandhiM na vishvaset |
apakrAmettataH kShipraM kRRitakAryo vichakShaNaH
shlokas.15:
shatruM cha mitrarUpeNa sAntvenaivAbhisAntvayet |
nityashashchodvijettasmAtsarpAdveshmagatAdiva
shlokas.16:
yasya buddhiM paribhavettamatItena sAntvayet |
anAgatena duShpraj~naM pratyutpannena paNDitam
shlokas.17:
a~njaliM shapathaM sAntvaM praNamya shirasA vadet |
ashruprapAtanaM chaiva kartavyaM bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.18:
vahedamitraM skandhena yAvatkAlaviparyayaH |
athainamAgate kAle bhindyAdghaTamivAshmani
shlokas.19:
muhUrtamapi rAjendra tindukAlAtavajjvalet |
na tuShAgnirivAnarchirdhUmAyeta narashchiram
shlokas.20:
nAnarthakenArthavattvaM kRRitaghnena samAcharet |
arthe tu shakyate bhoktuM kRRitakAryo.avamanyate
tasmAtsarvANi kAryANi sAvasheShANi kArayet
shlokas.21:
kokilasya varAhasya meroH shUnyasya veshmanaH |
vyADasya bhaktichitrasya yachChreShThaM tatsamAcharet
shlokas.22:
utthAyotthAya gachChechcha nityayukto riporgRRihAn |
kushalaM chApi pRRichCheta yadyapyakushalaM bhavet
shlokas.23:
nAlasAH prApnuvantyarthAnna klIbA na cha mAninaH |
na cha lokaravAdbhItA na cha shashvatpratIkShiNaH
shlokas.24:
nAsya ChidraM paro vidyAdvidyAchChidraM parasya tu |
gUhetkUrma ivA~NgAni rakShedvivaramAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
bakavachchintayedarthAnsiMhavachcha parAkramet |
vRRikavachchAvalumpeta shashavachcha viniShpatet
shlokas.26:
pAnamakShAstathA nAryo mRRigayA gItavAditam |
etAni yuktyA seveta prasa~Ngo hyatra doShavAn
shlokas.27:
kuryAttRRiNamayaM chApaM shayIta mRRigashAyikAm |
andhaH syAdandhavelAyAM bAdhiryamapi sa.nshrayet
shlokas.28:
deshaM kAlaM samAsAdya vikrameta vichakShaNaH |
deshakAlAbhyatIto hi vikramo niShphalo bhavet
shlokas.29:
kAlAkAlau sampradhArya balAbalamathAtmanaH |
parasparabalaM j~nAtvA tathAtmAnaM niyojayet
shlokas.30:
daNDenopanataM shatruM yo rAjA na niyachChati |
sa mRRityumupagUhyAste garbhamashvatarI yathA
shlokas.31:
supuShpitaH syAdaphalaH phalavAnsyAddurAruhaH |
AmaH syAtpakvasa~NkAsho na cha shIryeta kasyachit
shlokas.32:
AshAM kAlavatIM kuryAttAM cha vighnena yojayet |
vighnaM nimittato brUyAnnimittaM chApi hetutaH
shlokas.33:
bhItavatsa.nvidhAtavyaM yAvadbhayamanAgatam |
AgataM tu bhayaM dRRiShTvA prahartavyamabhItavat
shlokas.34:
na sa.nshayamanAruhya naro bhadrANi pashyati |
sa.nshayaM punarAruhya yadi jIvati pashyati
shlokas.35:
anAgataM vijAnIyAdyachChedbhayamupasthitam |
punarvRRiddhikShayAtki~nchidabhivRRittaM nishAmayet
shlokas.36:
pratyupasthitakAlasya sukhasya parivarjanam |
anAgatasukhAshA cha naiSha buddhimatAM nayaH
shlokas.37:
yo.ariNA saha sandhAya sukhaM svapiti vishvasan |
sa vRRikShAgraprasupto vA patitaH pratibudhyate
shlokas.38:
karmaNA yena teneha mRRidunA dAruNena vA |
uddhareddInamAtmAnaM samartho dharmamAcharet
shlokas.39:
ye sapatnAH sapatnAnAM sarvA.nstAnapavatsayet |
AtmanashchApi boddhavyAshchArAH praNihitAH paraiH
shlokas.40:
chAraH suvihitaH kArya Atmano.atha parasya cha |
pAShaNDA.nstApasAdI.nshcha pararAShTraM praveshayet
shlokas.41:
udyAneShu vihAreShu prapAsvAvasatheShu cha |
pAnAgAreShu vesheShu tIrtheShu cha sabhAsu cha
shlokas.42:
dharmAbhichAriNaH pApAshchArA lokasya kaNTakAH |
samAgachChanti tAnbuddhvA niyachChechChamayedapi
shlokas.43:
na vishvasedavishvaste vishvaste nApi vishvaset |
vishvastaM bhayamanveti nAparIkShya cha vishvaset
shlokas.44:
vishvAsayitvA tu paraM tattvabhUtena hetunA |
athAsya praharetkAle ki~nchidvichalite pade
shlokas.45:
asha~Nkyamapi sha~Nketa nityaM sha~Nketa sha~NkitAt |
bhayaM hi sha~NkitAjjAtaM samUlamapi kRRintati
shlokas.46:
avadhAnena maunena kAShAyeNa jaTAjinaiH |
vishvAsayitvA dveShTAramavalumpedyathA vRRikaH
shlokas.47:
putro vA yadi vA bhrAtA pitA vA yadi vA suhRRit |
arthasya vighnaM kurvANA hantavyA bhUtivardhanAH
shlokas.48:
gurorapyavaliptasya kAryAkAryamajAnataH |
utpathapratipannasya daNDo bhavati shAsanam
shlokas.49:
pratyutthAnAbhivAdAbhyAM sampradAnena kasyachit |
pratipuShkalaghAtI syAttIkShNatuNDa iva dvijaH
shlokas.50:
nAchChittvA paramarmANi nAkRRitvA karma dAruNam |
nAhatvA matsyaghAtIva prApnoti paramAM shriyam
shlokas.51:
nAsti jAtyA ripurnAma mitraM nAma na vidyate |
sAmarthyayogAjjAyante mitrANi ripavastathA
shlokas.52:
amitraM naiva mu~ncheta bruvantaM karuNAnyapi |
duHkhaM tatra na kurvIta hanyAtpUrvApakAriNam
shlokas.53:
sa~NgrahAnugrahe yatnaH sadA kAryo.anasUyatA |
nigrahashchApi yatnena kartavyo bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.54:
prahariShyanpriyaM brUyAtprahRRityApi priyottaram |
api chAsya shirashChittvA rudyAchChochedathApi vA
shlokas.55:
nimantrayeta sAntvena saMmAnena titikShayA |
AshAkAraNamityetatkartavyaM bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.56:
na shuShkavairaM kurvIta na bAhubhyAM nadIM taret |
apArthakamanAyuShyaM goviShANasya bhakShaNam
dantAshcha parighRRiShyante rasashchApi na labhyate
shlokas.57:
trivarge trividhA pIDAnubandhAstraya eva cha |
anubandhavadhau j~nAtvA pIDAM hi parivarjayet
shlokas.58:
RRiNasheSho.agnisheShashcha shatrusheShastathaiva cha |
punaH punarvivardheta svalpo.apyanivAritaH
shlokas.59:
vardhamAnamRRiNaM tiShThatparibhUtAshcha shatravaH |
AvahantyanayaM tIvraM vyAdhayashchApyupekShitAH
shlokas.60:
nAsamyakkRRitakArI syAdapramattaH sadA bhavet |
kaNTako.api hi dushChinno vikAraM kurute chiram
shlokas.61:
vadhena cha manuShyANAM mArgANAM dUShaNena cha |
AkarANAM vinAshaishcha pararAShTraM vinAshayet
shlokas.62:
gRRidhradRRiShTirbakAlInaH shvacheShTaH siMhavikramaH |
anudvignaH kAkasha~NkI bhuja~NgacharitaM charet
shlokas.63:
shreNimukhyopajApeShu vallabhAnunayeShu cha |
amAtyAnparirakSheta bhedasa~NghAtayorapi
shlokas.64:
mRRidurityavamanyante tIkShNa ityudvijanti cha |
tIkShNakAle cha tIkShNaH syAnmRRidukAle mRRidurbhavet
shlokas.65:
mRRidunA sumRRiduM hanti mRRidunA hanti dAruNam |
nAsAdhyaM mRRidunA ki~nchittasmAttIkShNataraM mRRidu
shlokas.66:
kAle mRRiduryo bhavati kAle bhavati dAruNaH |
sa sAdhayati kRRityAni shatrU.nshchaivAdhitiShThati
shlokas.67:
paNDitena viruddhaH sandUre.asmIti na vishvaset |
dIrghau buddhimato bAhU yAbhyAM hi.nsati hi.nsitaH
shlokas.68:
na tattaredyasya na pAramuttare;nna taddharedyatpunarAharetparaH |
na tatkhanedyasya na mUlamutkhane;nna taM hanyAdyasya shiro na pAtayet
shlokas.69:
itIdamuktaM vRRijinAbhisaMhitaM; na chaitadevaM puruShaH samAcharet |
paraprayuktaM tu kathaM nishAmaye;dato mayoktaM bhavato hitArthinA
shlokas.70:
yathAvaduktaM vachanaM hitaM tadA; nishamya vipreNa suvIrarAShTriyaH |
tathAkarodvAkyamadInachetanaH; shriyaM cha dIptAM bubhuje sabAndhavaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
hIne paramake dharme sarvalokAtila~Nghini |
adharme dharmatAM nIte dharme chAdharmatAM gate
shlokas.2:
maryAdAsu prabhinnAsu kShubhite dharmanishchaye |
rAjabhiH pIDite loke chorairvApi vishAM pate
shlokas.3:
sarvAshrameShu mUDheShu karmasUpahateShu cha |
kAmAnmohAchcha lobhAchcha bhayaM pashyatsu bhArata
shlokas.4:
avishvasteShu sarveShu nityabhIteShu pArthiva |
nikRRityA hanyamAneShu va~nchayatsu parasparam
shlokas.5:
sampradIpteShu desheShu brAhmaNye chAbhipIDite |
avarShati cha parjanye mitho bhede samutthite
shlokas.6:
sarvasmindasyusAdbhUte pRRithivyAmupajIvane |
kena svidbrAhmaNo jIvejjaghanye kAla Agate
shlokas.7:
atityakShuH putrapautrAnanukroshAnnarAdhipa |
kathamApatsu varteta tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.8:
kathaM cha rAjA varteta loke kaluShatAM gate |
kathamarthAchcha dharmAchcha na hIyeta parantapa
shlokas.9:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAjamUlA mahArAja yogakShemasuvRRiShTayaH |
prajAsu vyAdhayashchaiva maraNaM cha bhayAni cha
shlokas.10:
kRRitaM tretA dvAparashcha kalishcha bharatarShabha |
rAjamUlAni sarvANi mama nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
tasmi.nstvabhyAgate kAle prajAnAM doShakArake |
vij~nAnabalamAsthAya jIvitavyaM tadA bhavet
shlokas.12:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vishvAmitrasya sa.nvAdaM chaNDAlasya cha pakkaNe
shlokas.13:
tretAdvAparayoH sandhau purA daivavidhikramAt |
anAvRRiShTirabhUdghorA rAjandvAdashavArShikI
shlokas.14:
prajAnAmabhivRRiddhAnAM yugAnte paryupasthite |
tretAnirmokShasamaye dvAparapratipAdane
shlokas.15:
na vavarSha sahasrAkShaH pratilomo.abhavadguruH |
jagAma dakShiNaM mArgaM somo vyAvRRittalakShaNaH
shlokas.16:
nAvashyAyo.api rAtryante kuta evAbhrarAjayaH |
nadyaH sa~NkShiptatoyaughAH kvachidantargatAbhavan
shlokas.17:
sarA.nsi saritashchaiva kUpAH prasravaNAni cha |
hatatviTkAnyalakShyanta nisargAddaivakAritAt
shlokas.18:
upashuShkajalasthAyA vinivRRittasabhAprapA |
nivRRittayaj~nasvAdhyAyA nirvaShaTkArama~NgalA
shlokas.19:
utsannakRRiShigorakShyA nivRRittavipaNApaNA |
nivRRittapUgasamayA sampranaShTamahotsavA
shlokas.20:
asthika~NkAlasa~NkIrNA hAhAbhUtajanAkulA |
shUnyabhUyiShThanagarA dagdhagrAmaniveshanA
shlokas.21:
kvachichchoraiH kvachichChastraiH kvachidrAjabhirAturaiH |
parasparabhayAchchaiva shUnyabhUyiShThanirjanA
shlokas.22:
gatadaivatasa~NkalpA vRRiddhabAlavinAkRRitA |
gojAvimahiShairhInA parasparaharAharA
shlokas.23:
hataviprA hatArakShA pranaShTauShadhisa~nchayA |
shyAvabhUtanaraprAyA babhUva vasudhA tadA
shlokas.24:
tasminpratibhaye kAle kShINe dharme yudhiShThira |
babhramuH kShudhitA martyAH khAdantaH sma parasparam
shlokas.25:
RRiShayo niyamA.nstyaktvA parityaktAgnidaivatAH |
AshramAnsamparityajya paryadhAvannitastataH
shlokas.26:
vishvAmitro.atha bhagavAnmaharShiraniketanaH |
kShudhA parigato dhImAnsamantAtparyadhAvata
shlokas.27:
sa kadAchitparipata~nshvapachAnAM niveshanam |
hi.nsrANAM prANihantR^INAmAsasAda vane kvachit
shlokas.28:
vibhinnakalashAkIrNaM shvacharmAchChAdanAyutam |
varAhakharabhagnAsthikapAlaghaTasa~Nkulam
shlokas.29:
mRRitachelaparistIrNaM nirmAlyakRRitabhUShaNam |
sarpanirmokamAlAbhiH kRRitachihnakuTImaTham
shlokas.30:
ulUkapakShadhvajibhirdevatAyatanairvRRitam |
lohaghaNTApariShkAraM shvayUthaparivAritam
shlokas.31:
tatpravishya kShudhAviShTo gAdheH putro mahAnRRiShiH |
AhArAnveShaNe yuktaH paraM yatnaM samAsthitaH
shlokas.32:
na cha kvachidavindatsa bhikShamANo.api kaushikaH |
mA.nsamannaM mUlaphalamanyadvA tatra ki~nchana
shlokas.33:
aho kRRichChraM mayA prAptamiti nishchitya kaushikaH |
papAta bhUmau daurbalyAttasmi.nshchaNDAlapakkaNe
shlokas.34:
chintayAmAsa sa muniH kiM nu me sukRRitaM bhavet |
kathaM vRRithA na mRRityuH syAditi pArthivasattama
shlokas.35:
sa dadarsha shvamA.nsasya kutantIM vitatAM muniH |
chaNDAlasya gRRihe rAjansadyaH shastrahatasya cha
shlokas.36:
sa chintayAmAsa tadA steyaM kAryamito mayA |
na hIdAnImupAyo.anyo vidyate prANadhAraNe
shlokas.37:
Apatsu vihitaM steyaM vishiShTasamahInataH |
paraM paraM bhavetpUrvamasteyamiti nishchayaH
shlokas.38:
hInAdAdeyamAdau syAtsamAnAttadanantaram |
asambhavAdAdadIta vishiShTAdapi dhArmikAt
shlokas.39:
so.ahamantAvasAnAnAM haramANaH parigrahAt |
na steyadoShaM pashyAmi hariShyAmyetadAmiSham
shlokas.40:
etAM buddhiM samAsthAya vishvAmitro mahAmuniH |
tasmindeshe prasuShvApa patito yatra bhArata
shlokas.41:
sa vigADhAM nishAM dRRiShTvA supte chaNDAlapakkaNe |
shanairutthAya bhagavAnpravivesha kuTImaTham
shlokas.42:
sa supta eva chaNDAlaH shleShmApihitalochanaH |
paribhinnasvaro rUkSha uvAchApriyadarshanaH
shlokas.43:
kaH kutantIM ghaTTayati supte chaNDAlapakkaNe |
jAgarmi nAvasupto.asmi hato.asIti cha dAruNaH
shlokas.44:
vishvAmitro.ahamityeva sahasA tamuvAcha saH |
sahasAbhyAgatabhayaH sodvegastena karmaNA
shlokas.45:
chaNDAlastadvachaH shrutvA maharSherbhAvitAtmanaH |
shayanAdupasambhrAnta iyeShotpatituM tataH
shlokas.46:
sa visRRijyAshru netrAbhyAM bahumAnAtkRRitA~njaliH |
uvAcha kaushikaM rAtrau brahmankiM te chikIrShitam
shlokas.47:
vishvAmitrastu mAta~NgamuvAcha parisAntvayan |
kShudhito.ahaM gataprANo hariShyAmi shvajAghanIm
shlokas.48:
avasIdanti me prANAH smRRitirme nashyati kShudhA |
svadharmaM budhyamAno.api hariShyAmi shvajAghanIm
shlokas.49:
aTanbhaikShaM na vindAmi yadA yuShmAkamAlaye |
tadA buddhiH kRRitA pApe hariShyAmi shvajAghanIm
shlokas.50:
tRRiShitaH kaluShaM pAtA nAsti hrIrashanArthinaH |
kShuddharmaM dUShayatyatra hariShyAmi shvajAghanIm
shlokas.51:
agnirmukhaM purodhAshcha devAnAM shuchipAdvibhuH |
yathA sa sarvabhugbrahmA tathA mAM viddhi dharmataH
shlokas.52:
tamuvAcha sa chaNDAlo maharShe shRRiNu me vachaH |
shrutvA tathA samAtiShTha yathA dharmAnna hIyase
shlokas.53:
mRRigANAmadhamaM shvAnaM pravadanti manIShiNaH |
tasyApyadhama uddeshaH sharIrasyorujAghanI
shlokas.54:
nedaM samyagvyavasitaM maharShe karma vaikRRitam |
chaNDAlasvasya haraNamabhakShyasya visheShataH
shlokas.55:
sAdhvanyamanupashya tvamupAyaM prANadhAraNe |
na mA.nsalobhAttapaso nAshaste syAnmahAmune
shlokas.56:
jAnato.avihito mArgo na kAryo dharmasa~NkaraH |
mA sma dharmaM parityAkShIstvaM hi dharmaviduttamaH
shlokas.57:
vishvAmitrastato rAjannityukto bharatarShabha |
kShudhArtaH pratyuvAchedaM punareva mahAmuniH
shlokas.58:
nirAhArasya sumahAnmama kAlo.abhidhAvataH |
na vidyate.abhyupAyashcha kashchinme prANadhAraNe
shlokas.59:
yena tena visheSheNa karmaNA yena kenachit |
abhyujjIvetsIdamAnaH samartho dharmamAcharet
shlokas.60:
aindro dharmaH kShatriyANAM brAhmaNAnAmathAgnikaH |
brahmavahnirmama balaM bhakShyAmi samayaM kShudhA
shlokas.61:
yathA yathA vai jIveddhi tatkartavyamapIDayA |
jIvitaM maraNAchChreyo jIvandharmamavApnuyAt
shlokas.62:
so.ahaM jIvitamAkA~NkShannabhakShasyApi bhakShaNam |
vyavasye buddhipUrvaM vai tadbhavAnanumanyatAm
shlokas.63:
jIvandharmaM chariShyAmi praNotsyAmyashubhAni cha |
tapobhirvidyayA chaiva jyotIMShIva mahattamaH
shlokas.64:
shvapacha uvAcha||
naitatkhAdanprApsyase prANamanyaM; nAyurdIrghaM nAmRRitasyeva tRRiptim |
bhikShAmanyAM bhikSha mA te mano.astu; shvabhakShaNe shvA hyabhakSho dvijAnAm
shlokas.65:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
na durbhikShe sulabhaM mA.nsamanya;chChvapAka nAnnaM na cha me.asti vittam |
kShudhArtashchAhamagatirnirAshaH; shvamA.nse chAsminShaDrasAnsAdhu manye
shlokas.66:
shvapacha uvAcha||
pa~ncha pa~nchanakhA bhakShyA brahmakShatrasya vai dvija |
yadi shAstraM pramANaM te mAbhakShye mAnasaM kRRithAH
shlokas.67:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
agastyenAsuro jagdho vAtApiH kShudhitena vai |
ahamApadgataH kShubdho bhakShayiShye shvajAghanIm
shlokas.68:
shvapacha uvAcha||
bhikShAmanyAmAhareti na chaitatkartumarhasi |
na nUnaM kAryametadvai hara kAmaM shvajAghanIm
shlokas.69:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
shiShTA vai kAraNaM dharme tadvRRittamanuvartaye |
parAM medhyAshanAdetAM bhakShyAM manye shvajAghanIm
shlokas.70:
shvapacha uvAcha||
asatA yatsamAchIrNaM na sa dharmaH sanAtanaH |
nAvRRittamanukAryaM vai mA ChalenAnRRitaM kRRithAH
shlokas.71:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
na pAtakaM nAvamatamRRiShiH sankartumarhasi |
samau cha shvamRRigau manye tasmAdbhakShyA shvajAghanI
shlokas.72:
shvapacha uvAcha||
yadbrAhmaNArthe kRRitamarthitena; tenarShiNA tachcha bhakShyAdhikAram |
sa vai dharmo yatra na pApamasti; sarvairupAyairhi sa rakShitavyaH
shlokas.73:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
mitraM cha me brAhmaNashchAyamAtmA; priyashcha me pUjyatamashcha loke |
taM bhartukAmo.ahamimAM hariShye; nRRisha.nsAnAmIdRRishAnAM na bibhye
shlokas.74:
shvapacha uvAcha||
kAmaM narA jIvitaM santyajanti; na chAbhakShyaiH pratikurvanti tatra |
sarvAnkAmAnprApnuvantIha vidva;npriyasva kAmaM sahitaH kShudhA vai
shlokas.75:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
sthAne tAvatsa.nshayaH pretyabhAve; niHsa.nshayaM karmaNAM vA vinAshaH |
ahaM punarvarta ityAshayAtmA; mUlaM rakShanbhakShayiShyAmyabhakShyam
shlokas.76:
buddhyAtmake vyastamastIti tuShTo; mohAdekatvaM yathA charma chakShuH |
yadyapyenaH sa.nshayAdAcharAmi; nAhaM bhaviShyAmi yathA tvameva
shlokas.77:
shvapacha uvAcha||
patanIyamidaM duHkhamiti me vartate matiH |
duShkRRitI brAhmaNaM santaM yastvAmahamupAlabhe
shlokas.78:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
pibantyevodakaM gAvo maNDUkeShu ruvatsvapi |
na te.adhikAro dharme.asti mA bhUrAtmaprasha.nsakaH
shlokas.79:
shvapacha uvAcha||
suhRRidbhUtvAnushAsmi tvA kRRipA hi tvayi me dvija |
tadevaM shreya Adhatsva mA lobhAchChvAnamAdithAH
shlokas.80:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
suhRRinme tvaM sukhepsushchedApado mAM samuddhara |
jAne.ahaM dharmato.a.atmAnaM shvAnImutsRRija jAghanIm
shlokas.81:
shvapacha uvAcha||
naivotsahe bhavate dAtumetAM; nopekShituM hriyamANaM svamannam |
ubhau syAvaH svamalenAvaliptau; dAtAhaM cha tvaM cha vipra pratIchChan
shlokas.82:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
adyAhametadvRRijinaM karma kRRitvA; jIva.nshchariShyAmi mahApavitram |
prapUtAtmA dharmamevAbhipatsye; yadetayorguru tadvai bravIhi
shlokas.83:
shvapacha uvAcha||
Atmaiva sAkShI kila lokakRRitye; tvameva jAnAsi yadatra duShTam |
yo hyAdriyedbhakShyamiti shvamA.nsaM; manye na tasyAsti vivarjanIyam
shlokas.84:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
upAdAne khAdane vAsya doShaH; kAryo nyAyairnityamatrApavAdaH |
yasminna hi.nsA nAnRRite vAkyalesho; bhakShyakriyA tatra na tadgarIyaH
shlokas.85:
shvapacha uvAcha||
yadyeSha hetustava khAdanasya; na te vedaH kAraNaM nAnyadharmaH |
tasmAdabhakShye bhakShaNAdvA dvijendra; doShaM na pashyAmi yathedamAttha
shlokas.86:
vishvAmitra uvAcha||
na pAtakaM bhakShaNamasya dRRiShTaM; surAM pItvA patatItIha shabdaH |
anyonyakarmANi tathA tathaiva; na leshamAtreNa kRRityaM hinasti
shlokas.87:
shvapacha uvAcha||
asthAnato hInataH kutsitAdvA; taM vidvA.nsaM bAdhate sAdhuvRRittam |
sthAnaM punaryo labhate niSha~NgA;ttenApi daNDaH sahitavya eva
shlokas.88:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA nivavRRite mAta~NgaH kaushikaM tadA |
vishvAmitro jahAraiva kRRitabuddhiH shvajAghanIm
shlokas.89:
tato jagrAha pa~nchA~NgIM jIvitArthI mahAmuniH |
sadArastAmupAkRRitya vane yAto mahAmuniH
shlokas.90:
etasminneva kAle tu pravavarShAtha vAsavaH |
sa~njIvayanprajAH sarvA janayAmAsa chauShadhIH
shlokas.91:
vishvAmitro.api bhagavA.nstapasA dagdhakilbiShaH |
kAlena mahatA siddhimavApa paramAdbhutAm
shlokas.92:
evaM vidvAnadInAtmA vyasanastho jijIviShuH |
sarvopAyairupAyaj~no dInamAtmAnamuddharet
shlokas.93:
etAM buddhiM samAsthAya jIvitavyaM sadA bhavet |
jIvanpuNyamavApnoti naro bhadrANi pashyati
shlokas.94:
tasmAtkaunteya viduShA dharmAdharmavinishchaye |
buddhimAsthAya loke.asminvartitavyaM yatAtmanA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM ghoramuddiShTamashraddheyamivAnRRitam |
asti sviddasyumaryAdA yAmahaM parivarjaye
shlokas.2:
saMmuhyAmi viShIdAmi dharmo me shithilIkRRitaH |
udyamaM nAdhigachChAmi kutashchitparichintayan
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
naitachChuddhAgamAdeva tava dharmAnushAsanam |
praj~nAsamavatAro.ayaM kavibhiH sambhRRitaM madhu
shlokas.4:
bahvyaH pratividhAtavyAH praj~nA rAj~nA tatastataH |
naikashAkhena dharmeNa yAtraiShA sampravartate
shlokas.5:
buddhisa~njananaM rAj~nAM dharmamAcharatAM sadA |
jayo bhavati kauravya tadA tadviddhi me vachaH
shlokas.6:
buddhishreShThA hi rAjAno jayanti vijayaiShiNaH |
dharmaH pratividhAtavyo buddhyA rAj~nA tatastataH
shlokas.7:
naikashAkhena dharmeNa rAj~nAM dharmo vidhIyate |
durbalasya kutaH praj~nA purastAdanudAhRRitA
shlokas.8:
advaidhaj~naH pathi dvaidhe sa.nshayaM prAptumarhati |
buddhidvaidhaM veditavyaM purastAdeva bhArata
shlokas.9:
pArshvataHkaraNaM praj~nA viShUchI tvApagA iva |
janastUchchAritaM dharmaM vijAnAtyanyathAnyathA
shlokas.10:
samyagvij~nAninaH kechinmithyAvij~nAnino.apare |
tadvai yathAtathaM buddhvA j~nAnamAdadate satAm
shlokas.11:
parimuShNanti shAstrANi dharmasya paripanthinaH |
vaiShamyamarthavidyAnAM nairarthyAtkhyApayanti te
shlokas.12:
AjijIviShavo vidyAM yashaskAmAH samantataH |
te sarve narapApiShThA dharmasya paripanthinaH
shlokas.13:
apakvamatayo mandA na jAnanti yathAtatham |
sadA hyashAstrakushalAH sarvatrApariniShThitAH
shlokas.14:
parimuShNanti shAstrANi shAstradoShAnudarshinaH |
vij~nAnamatha vidyAnAM na samyagiti vartate
shlokas.15:
nindayA paravidyAnAM svAM vidyAM khyApayanti ye |
vAgastrA vAkChurImattvA dugdhavidyAphalA iva
tAnvidyAvaNijo viddhi rAkShasAniva bhArata
shlokas.16:
vyAjena kRRitsno vidito dharmaste parihAsyate |
na dharmavachanaM vAchA na buddhyA cheti naH shrutam
shlokas.17:
iti bArhaspataM j~nAnaM provAcha maghavA svayam |
na tveva vachanaM ki~nchidanimittAdihochyate
shlokas.18:
svavinItena shAstreNa vyavasyanti tathApare |
lokayAtrAmihaike tu dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.19:
samuddiShTaM satAM dharmaM svayamUhenna paNDitaH |
amarShAchChAstrasaMmohAdavij~nAnAchcha bhArata
shlokas.20:
shAstraM prAj~nasya vadataH samUhe yAtyadarshanam |
AgatAgamayA buddhyA vachanena prashasyate
shlokas.21:
aj~nAnAjj~nAnahetutvAdvachanaM sAdhu manyate |
anapAhatamevedaM nedaM shAstramapArthakam
shlokas.22:
daiteyAnushanAH prAha sa.nshayachChedane purA |
j~nAnamavyapadeshyaM hi yathA nAsti tathaiva tat
shlokas.23:
tena tvaM ChinnamUlena kaM toShayitumarhasi |
atathyavihitaM yo vA nedaM vAkyamupAshnuyAt
shlokas.24:
ugrAyaiva hi sRRiShTo.asi karmaNe na tvavekShase |
a~NgemAmanvavekShasva rAjanItiM bubhUShitum
yayA pramuchyate tvanyo yadarthaM cha pramodate
shlokas.25:
ajo.ashvaH kShatramityetatsadRRishaM brahmaNA kRRitam |
tasmAnnatIkShNabhUtAnAM yAtrA kAchitprasidhyati
shlokas.26:
yastvavadhyavadhe doShaH sa vadhyasyAvadhe smRRitaH |
eShaiva khalu maryAdA yAmayaM parivarjayet
shlokas.27:
tasmAttIkShNaH prajA rAjA svadharme sthApayeduta |
anyonyaM bhakShayanto hi prachareyurvRRikA iva
shlokas.28:
yasya dasyugaNA rAShTre dhvA~NkShA matsyA~njalAdiva |
viharanti parasvAni sa vai kShatriyapA.nsanaH
shlokas.29:
kulInAnsachivAnkRRitvA vedavidyAsamanvitAn |
prashAdhi pRRithivIM rAjanprajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.30:
vihInajamakarmANaM yaH pragRRihNAti bhUmipaH |
ubhayasyAvisheShaj~nastadvai kShatraM napu.nsakam
shlokas.31:
naivograM naiva chAnugraM dharmeNeha prashasyate |
ubhayaM na vyatikrAmedugro bhUtvA mRRidurbhava
shlokas.32:
kaShTaH kShatriyadharmo.ayaM sauhRRidaM tvayi yatsthitam |
ugre karmaNi sRRiShTo.asi tasmAdrAjyaM prashAdhi vai
shlokas.33:
ashiShTanigraho nityaM shiShTasya paripAlanam |
iti shakro.abravIddhImAnApatsu bharatarShabha
shlokas.34:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asti sviddasyumaryAdA yAmanyo nAtila~Nghayet |
pRRichChAmi tvAM satAM shreShTha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.35:
bhIShma uvAcha||
brAhmaNAneva seveta vidyAvRRiddhA.nstapasvinaH |
shrutachAritravRRittADhyAnpavitraM hyetaduttamam
shlokas.36:
yA devatAsu vRRittiste sAstu vipreShu sarvadA |
kruddhairhi vipraiH karmANi kRRitAni bahudhA nRRipa
shlokas.37:
teShAM prItyA yasho mukhyamaprItyA tu viparyayaH |
prItyA hyamRRitavadviprAH kruddhAshchaiva yathA viSham

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
sharaNaM pAlayAnasya yo dharmastaM vadasva me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mahAndharmo mahArAja sharaNAgatapAlane |
arhaH praShTuM bhavA.nshchaiva prashnaM bharatasattama
shlokas.3:
nRRigaprabhRRitayo rAjanrAjAnaH sharaNAgatAn |
paripAlya mahArAja sa.nsiddhiM paramAM gatAH
shlokas.4:
shrUyate hi kapotena shatruH sharaNamAgataH |
pUjitashcha yathAnyAyaM svaishcha mA.nsairnimantritaH
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM kapotena purA shatruH sharaNamAgataH |
svamA.nsairbhojitaH kAM cha gatiM lebhe sa bhArata
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjankathAM divyAM sarvapApapraNAshinIm |
nRRipatermuchukundasya kathitAM bhArgaveNa ha
shlokas.7:
imamarthaM purA pArtha muchukundo narAdhipaH |
bhArgavaM paripaprachCha praNato bharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
tasmai shushrUShamANAya bhArgavo.akathayatkathAm |
iyaM yathA kapotena siddhiH prAptA narAdhipa
shlokas.9:
dharmanishchayasa.nyuktAM kAmArthasahitAM kathAm |
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAjangadato me mahAbhuja
shlokas.10:
kashchitkShudrasamAchAraH pRRithivyAM kAlasaMmataH |
chachAra pRRithivIM pApo ghoraH shakunilubdhakaH
shlokas.11:
kAkola iva kRRiShNA~Ngo rUkShaH pApasamAhitaH |
yavamadhyaH kRRishagrIvo hrasvapAdo mahAhanuH
shlokas.12:
naiva tasya suhRRitkashchinna sambandhI na bAndhavaH |
sa hi taiH samparityaktastena ghoreNa karmaNA
shlokas.13:
sa vai kShArakamAdAya dvijAnhatvA vane sadA |
chakAra vikrayaM teShAM pata~NgAnAM narAdhipa
shlokas.14:
evaM tu vartamAnasya tasya vRRittiM durAtmanaH |
agamatsumahAnkAlo na chAdharmamabudhyata
shlokas.15:
tasya bhAryAsahAyasya ramamANasya shAshvatam |
daivayogavimUDhasya nAnyA vRRittirarochata
shlokas.16:
tataH kadAchittasyAtha vanasthasya samudgataH |
pAtayanniva vRRikShA.nstAnsumahAnvAtasambhramaH
shlokas.17:
meghasa~NkulamAkAshaM vidyunmaNDalamaNDitam |
sa~nChannaM sumuhUrtena nausthAneneva sAgaraH
shlokas.18:
vAridhArAsamUhaishcha samprahRRiShTaH shatakratuH |
kShaNena pUrayAmAsa salilena vasundharAm
shlokas.19:
tato dhArAkule loke sambhramannaShTachetanaH |
shItArtastadvanaM sarvamAkulenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.20:
naiva nimnaM sthalaM vApi so.avindata viha~NgahA |
pUrito hi jalaughena mArgastasya vanasya vai
shlokas.21:
pakShiNo vAtavegena hatA lInAstadAbhavan |
mRRigAH siMhA varAhAshcha sthalAnyAshritya tasthire
shlokas.22:
mahatA vAtavarSheNa trAsitAste vanaukasaH |
bhayArtAshcha kShudhArtAshcha babhramuH sahitA vane
shlokas.23:
sa tu shItahatairgAtrairjagAmaiva na tasthivAn |
so.apashyadvanaShaNDeShu meghanIlaM vanaspatim
shlokas.24:
tArADhyaM kumudAkAramAkAshaM nirmalaM cha ha |
meghairmuktaM nabho dRRiShTvA lubdhakaH shItavihvalaH
shlokas.25:
disho.avalokayAmAsa velAM chaiva durAtmavAn |
dUre grAmaniveshashcha tasmAddeshAditi prabho
kRRitabuddhirvane tasminvastuM tAM rajanIM tadA
shlokas.26:
so.a~njaliM prayataH kRRitvA vAkyamAha vanaspatim |
sharaNaM yAmi yAnyasmindaivatAnIha bhArata
shlokas.27:
sa shilAyAM shiraH kRRitvA parNAnyAstIrya bhUtale |
duHkhena mahatAviShTastataH suShvApa pakShihA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha vRRikShasya shAkhAyAM viha~NgaH sasuhRRijjanaH |
dIrghakAloShito rAja.nstatra chitratanUruhaH
shlokas.2:
tasya kAlyaM gatA bhAryA charituM nAbhyavartata |
prAptAM cha rajanIM dRRiShTvA sa pakShI paryatapyata
shlokas.3:
vAtavarShaM mahachchAsInna chAgachChati me priyA |
kiM nu tatkAraNaM yena sAdyApi na nivartate
shlokas.4:
api svasti bhavettasyAH priyAyA mama kAnane |
tayA virahitaM hIdaM shUnyamadya gRRihaM mama
shlokas.5:
yadi sA raktanetrAntA chitrA~NgI madhurasvarA |
adya nAbhyeti me kAntA na kAryaM jIvitena me
shlokas.6:
patidharmaratA sAdhvI prANebhyo.api garIyasI |
sA hi shrAntaM kShudhArtaM cha jAnIte mAM tapasvinI
shlokas.7:
anuraktA hitA chaiva snigdhA chaiva pativratA |
yasya vai tAdRRishI bhAryA dhanyaH sa manujo bhuvi
shlokas.8:
bhAryA hi paramo nAthaH puruShasyeha paThyate |
asahAyasya loke.asmi.NllokayAtrAsahAyinI
shlokas.9:
tathA rogAbhibhUtasya nityaM kRRichChragatasya cha |
nAsti bhAryAsamaM ki~nchinnarasyArtasya bheShajam
shlokas.10:
nAsti bhAryAsamo bandhurnAsti bhAryAsamA gatiH |
nAsti bhAryAsamo loke sahAyo dharmasAdhanaH
shlokas.11:
evaM vilapatastasya dvijasyArtasya tatra vai |
gRRihItA shakunaghnena bhAryA shushrAva bhAratIm
shlokas.12:
na sA strItyabhibhAShA syAdyasyA bhartA na tuShyati |
agnisAkShikamapyetadbhartA hi sharaNaM striyaH
shlokas.13:
iti sa~nchintya duHkhArtA bhartAraM duHkhitaM tadA |
kapotI lubdhakenAtha yattA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.14:
hanta vakShyAmi te shreyaH shrutvA cha kuru tattathA |
sharaNAgatasantrAtA bhava kAnta visheShataH
shlokas.15:
eSha shAkunikaH shete tava vAsaM samAshritaH |
shItArtashcha kShudhArtashcha pUjAmasmai prayojaya
shlokas.16:
yo hi kashchiddvijaM hanyAdgAM vA lokasya mAtaram |
sharaNAgataM cha yo hanyAttulyaM teShAM cha pAtakam
shlokas.17:
yAsmAkaM vihitA vRRittiH kApotI jAtidharmataH |
sA nyAyyAtmavatA nityaM tvadvidhenAbhivartitum
shlokas.18:
yastu dharmaM yathAshakti gRRihastho hyanuvartate |
sa pretya labhate lokAnakShayAniti shushruma
shlokas.19:
sa tvaM santAnavAnadya putravAnapi cha dvija |
tatsvadehe dayAM tyaktvA dharmArthau parigRRihya vai
pUjAmasmai prayu~NkShva tvaM prIyetAsya mano yathA
shlokas.20:
iti sA shakunI vAkyaM kShArakasthA tapasvinI |
atiduHkhAnvitA prochya bhartAraM samudaikShata
shlokas.21:
sa patnyA vachanaM shrutvA dharmayuktisamanvitam |
harSheNa mahatA yukto bAShpavyAkulalochanaH
shlokas.22:
taM vai shAkunikaM dRRiShTvA vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
pUjayAmAsa yatnena sa pakShI pakShijIvinam
shlokas.23:
uvAcha cha svAgataM te brUhi kiM karavANyaham |
santApashcha na kartavyaH svagRRihe vartate bhavAn
shlokas.24:
tadbravItu bhavAnkShipraM kiM karomi kimichChasi |
praNayena bravImi tvAM tvaM hi naH sharaNAgataH
shlokas.25:
sharaNAgatasya kartavyamAtithyamiha yatnataH |
pa~nchayaj~napravRRittena gRRihasthena visheShataH
shlokas.26:
pa~nchayaj~nA.nstu yo mohAnna karoti gRRihAshramI |
tasya nAyaM na cha paro loko bhavati dharmataH
shlokas.27:
tadbrUhi tvaM suvisrabdho yattvaM vAchA vadiShyasi |
tatkariShyAmyahaM sarvaM mA tvaM shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.28:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA shakunerlubdhako.abravIt |
bAdhate khalu mA shItaM himatrANaM vidhIyatAm
shlokas.29:
evamuktastataH pakShI parNAnyAstIrya bhUtale |
yathAshuShkANi yatnena jvalanArthaM drutaM yayau
shlokas.30:
sa gatvA~NgArakarmAntaM gRRihItvAgnimathAgamat |
tataH shuShkeShu parNeShu pAvakaM so.abhyadIdipat
shlokas.31:
susa.ndIptaM mahatkRRitvA tamAha sharaNAgatam |
pratApaya suvisrabdhaM svagAtrANyakutobhayaH
shlokas.32:
sa tathoktastathetyuktvA lubdho gAtrANyatApayat |
agnipratyAgataprANastataH prAha viha~Ngamam
shlokas.33:
dattamAhAramichChAmi tvayA kShudbAdhate hi mAm |
tadvachaH sa pratishrutya vAkyamAha viha~NgamaH
shlokas.34:
na me.asti vibhavo yena nAshayAmi tava kShudhAm |
utpannena hi jIvAmo vayaM nityaM vanaukasaH
shlokas.35:
sa~nchayo nAsti chAsmAkaM munInAmiva kAnane |
ityuktvA sa tadA tatra vivarNavadano.abhavat
shlokas.36:
kathaM nu khalu kartavyamiti chintAparaH sadA |
babhUva bharatashreShTha garhayanvRRittimAtmanaH
shlokas.37:
muhUrtAllabdhasa~nj~nastu sa pakShI pakShighAtakam |
uvAcha tarpayiShye tvAM muhUrtaM pratipAlaya
shlokas.38:
ityuktvA shuShkaparNaiH sa samprajvAlya hutAshanam |
harSheNa mahatA yuktaH kapotaH punarabravIt
shlokas.39:
devAnAM cha munInAM cha pitR^INAM cha mahAtmanAm |
shrutapUrvo mayA dharmo mahAnatithipUjane
shlokas.40:
kuruShvAnugrahaM me.adya satyametadbravImi te |
nishchitA khalu me buddhiratithipratipUjane
shlokas.41:
tataH satyapratij~no vai sa pakShI prahasanniva |
tamagniM triH parikramya pravivesha mahIpate
shlokas.42:
agnimadhyaM praviShTaM taM lubdho dRRiShTvAtha pakShiNam |
chintayAmAsa manasA kimidaM nu kRRitaM mayA
shlokas.43:
aho mama nRRisha.nsasya garhitasya svakarmaNA |
adharmaH sumahAnghoro bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.44:
evaM bahuvidhaM bhUri vilalApa sa lubdhakaH |
garhayansvAni karmANi dvijaM dRRiShTvA tathAgatam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastaM lubdhakaH pashyankRRipayAbhipariplutaH |
kapotamagnau patitaM vAkyaM punaruvAcha ha
shlokas.2:
kimIdRRishaM nRRisha.nsena mayA kRRitamabuddhinA |
bhaviShyati hi me nityaM pAtakaM hRRidi jIvataH
shlokas.3:
sa vinindannathAtmAnaM punaH punaruvAcha ha |
dhi~NmAmastu sudurbuddhiM sadA nikRRitinishchayam
shubhaM karma parityajya yo.ahaM shakunilubdhakaH
shlokas.4:
nRRisha.nsasya mamAdyAyaM pratyAdesho na sa.nshayaH |
dattaH svamA.nsaM dadatA kapotena mahAtmanA
shlokas.5:
so.ahaM tyakShye priyAnprANAnputradAraM visRRijya cha |
upadiShTo hi me dharmaH kapotenAtidharmiNA
shlokas.6:
adya prabhRRiti dehaM svaM sarvabhogairvivarjitam |
yathA svalpaM jalaM grIShme shoShayiShyAmyahaM tathA
shlokas.7:
kShutpipAsAtapasahaH kRRisho dhamanisantataH |
upavAsairbahuvidhaishchariShye pAralaukikam
shlokas.8:
aho dehapradAnena darshitAtithipUjanA |
tasmAddharmaM chariShyAmi dharmo hi paramA gatiH
dRRiShTo hi dharmo dharmiShThairyAdRRisho vihagottame
shlokas.9:
evamuktvA vinishchitya raudrakarmA sa lubdhakaH |
mahAprasthAnamAshritya prayayau sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.10:
tato yaShTiM shalAkAshcha kShArakaM pa~njaraM tathA |
tA.nshcha baddhA kapotAnsa sampramuchyotsasarja ha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato gate shAkunike kapotI prAha duHkhitA |
sa.nsmRRitya bhartAramatho rudatI shokamUrChitA
shlokas.2:
nAhaM te vipriyaM kAnta kadAchidapi sa.nsmare |
sarvA vai vidhavA nArI bahuputrApi khechara
shochyA bhavati bandhUnAM patihInA manasvinI
shlokas.3:
lAlitAhaM tvayA nityaM bahumAnAchcha sAntvitA |
vachanairmadhuraiH snigdhairasakRRitsumanoharaiH
shlokas.4:
kandareShu cha shailAnAM nadInAM nirjhareShu cha |
drumAgreShu cha ramyeShu ramitAhaM tvayA priya
shlokas.5:
AkAshagamane chaiva sukhitAhaM tvayA sukham |
vihRRitAsmi tvayA kAnta tanme nAdyAsti ki~nchana
shlokas.6:
mitaM dadAti hi pitA mitaM mAtA mitaM sutaH |
amitasya tu dAtAraM bhartAraM kA na pUjayet
shlokas.7:
nAsti bhartRRisamo nAtho na cha bhartRRisamaM sukham |
visRRijya dhanasarvasvaM bhartA vai sharaNaM striyAH
shlokas.8:
na kAryamiha me nAtha jIvitena tvayA vinA |
patihInApi kA nArI satI jIvitumutsahet
shlokas.9:
evaM vilapya bahudhA karuNaM sA suduHkhitA |
pativratA sampradIptaM pravivesha hutAshanam
shlokas.10:
tatashchitrAmbaradharaM bhartAraM sAnvapashyata |
vimAnasthaM sukRRitibhiH pUjyamAnaM mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.11:
chitramAlyAmbaradharaM sarvAbharaNabhUShitam |
vimAnashatakoTIbhirAvRRitaM puNyakIrtibhiH
shlokas.12:
tataH svargagataH pakShI bhAryayA saha sa~NgataH |
karmaNA pUjitastena reme tatra sa bhAryayA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vimAnasthau tu tau rAja.Nllubdhako vai dadarsha ha |
dRRiShTvA tau dampatI duHkhAdachintayata sadgatim
shlokas.2:
kIdRRisheneha tapasA gachCheyaM paramAM gatim |
iti buddhyA vinishchitya gamanAyopachakrame
shlokas.3:
mahAprasthAnamAshritya lubdhakaH pakShijIvanaH |
nishcheShTo mArutAhAro nirmamaH svargakA~NkShayA
shlokas.4:
tato.apashyatsuvistIrNaM hRRidyaM padmavibhUShitam |
nAnAdvijagaNAkIrNaM saraH shItajalaM shubham
pipAsArto.api taddRRiShTvA tRRiptaH syAnnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
upavAsakRRisho.atyarthaM sa tu pArthiva lubdhakaH |
upasarpata saMhRRiShTaH shvApadAdhyuShitaM vanam
shlokas.6:
mahAntaM nishchayaM kRRitvA lubdhakaH pravivesha ha |
pravishanneva cha vanaM nigRRihItaH sa kaNTakaiH
shlokas.7:
sa kaNTakavibhugnA~Ngo lohitArdrIkRRitachChaviH |
babhrAma tasminvijane nAnAmRRigasamAkule
shlokas.8:
tato drumANAM mahatAM pavanena vane tadA |
udatiShThata sa~NgharShAtsumahAnhavyavAhanaH
shlokas.9:
tadvanaM vRRikShasa~NkIrNaM latAviTapasa~Nkulam |
dadAha pAvakaH kruddho yugAntAgnisamaprabhaH
shlokas.10:
sajvAlaiH pavanoddhUtairvisphuli~NgaiH samanvitaH |
dadAha tadvanaM ghoraM mRRigapakShisamAkulam
shlokas.11:
tataH sa dehamokShArthaM samprahRRiShTena chetasA |
abhyadhAvata sa.nvRRiddhaM pAvakaM lubdhakastadA
shlokas.12:
tatastenAgninA dagdho lubdhako naShTakilbiShaH |
jagAma paramAM siddhiM tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.13:
tataH svargasthamAtmAnaM so.apashyadvigatajvaraH |
yakShagandharvasiddhAnAM madhye bhrAjantamindravat
shlokas.14:
evaM khalu kapotashcha kapotI cha pativratA |
lubdhakena saha svargaM gatAH puNyena karmaNA
shlokas.15:
yApi chaiva.nvidhA nArI bhartAramanuvartate |
virAjate hi sA kShipraM kapotIva divi sthitA
shlokas.16:
evametatpurA vRRittaM lubdhakasya mahAtmanaH |
kapotasya cha dharmiShThA gatiH puNyena karmaNA
shlokas.17:
yashchedaM shRRiNuyAnnityaM yashchedaM parikIrtayet |
nAshubhaM vidyate tasya manasApi pramAdyataH
shlokas.18:
yudhiShThira mahAneSha dharmo dharmabhRRitAM vara |
goghneShvapi bhavedasminniShkRRitiH pApakarmaNaH
niShkRRitirna bhavettasminyo hanyAchCharaNAgatam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
abuddhipUrvaM yaH pApaM kuryAdbharatasattama |
muchyate sa kathaM tasmAdenasastadvadasva me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te varNayiShye.ahamitihAsaM purAtanam |
indrotaH shaunako vipro yadAha janamejayam
shlokas.3:
AsIdrAjA mahAvIryaH pArikShijjanamejayaH |
abuddhipUrvaM brahmahatyA tamAgachChanmahIpatim
shlokas.4:
taM brAhmaNAH sarva eva tatyajuH sapurohitAH |
jagAma sa vanaM rAjA dahyamAno divAnisham
shlokas.5:
sa prajAbhiH parityaktashchakAra kushalaM mahat |
ativelaM tapastepe dahyamAnaH sa manyunA
shlokas.6:
tatretihAsaM vakShyAmi dharmasyAsyopabRRiMhaNam |
dahyamAnaH pApakRRityA jagAma janamejayaH
shlokas.7:
variShyamANa indrotaM shaunakaM sa.nshitavratam |
samAsAdyopajagrAha pAdayoH paripIDayan
shlokas.8:
tato bhIto mahAprAj~no jagarhe subhRRishaM tadA |
kartA pApasya mahato bhrUNahA kimihAgataH
shlokas.9:
kiM tavAsmAsu kartavyaM mA mA sprAkShIH katha~nchana |
gachCha gachCha na te sthAnaM prINAtyasmAniha dhruvam
shlokas.10:
rudhirasyeva te gandhaH shavasyeva cha darshanam |
ashivaH shivasa~NkAsho mRRito jIvannivATasi
shlokas.11:
antarmRRityurashuddhAtmA pApamevAnuchintayan |
prabudhyase prasvapiShi vartase charase sukhI
shlokas.12:
moghaM te jIvitaM rAjanparikliShTaM cha jIvasi |
pApAyeva cha sRRiShTo.asi karmaNe ha yavIyase
shlokas.13:
bahu kalyANamichChanta Ihante pitaraH sutAn |
tapasA devatejyAbhirvandanena titikShayA
shlokas.14:
pitRRiva.nshamimaM pashya tvatkRRite narakaM gatam |
nirarthAH sarva evaiShAmAshAbandhAstvadAshrayAH
shlokas.15:
yAnpUjayanto vindanti svargamAyuryashaH sukham |
teShu te satataM dveSho brAhmaNeShu nirarthakaH
shlokas.16:
imaM lokaM vimuchya tvamavA~NmUrdhA patiShyasi |
ashAshvatIH shAshvatIshcha samAH pApena karmaNA
shlokas.17:
adyamAno jantugRRidhraiH shitikaNThairayomukhaiH |
tato.api punarAvRRittaH pApayoniM gamiShyasi
shlokas.18:
yadidaM manyase rAjannAyamasti paraH kutaH |
pratismArayitArastvAM yamadUtA yamakShaye

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha taM muniM janamejayaH |
garhyaM bhavAngarhayati nindyaM nindati mA bhavAn
shlokas.2:
dhikkAryaM mA dhikkurute tasmAttvAhaM prasAdaye |
sarvaM hIdaM svakRRitaM me jvalAmyagnAvivAhitaH
shlokas.3:
svakarmANyabhisandhAya nAbhinandati me manaH |
prAptaM nUnaM mayA ghoraM bhayaM vaivasvatAdapi
shlokas.4:
tattu shalyamanirhRRitya kathaM shakShyAmi jIvitum |
sarvamanyUnvinIya tvamabhi mA vada shaunaka
shlokas.5:
mahAnasaM brAhmaNAnAM bhaviShyAmyarthavAnpunaH |
astu sheShaM kulasyAsya mA parAbhUdidaM kulam
shlokas.6:
na hi no brahmashaptAnAM sheSho bhavitumarhati |
shrutIralabhamAnAnAM sa.nvidaM vedanishchayAt
shlokas.7:
nirvidyamAnaH subhRRishaM bhUyo vakShyAmi sAmpratam |
bhUyashchaivAbhina~NkShanti nirdharmA nirjapA iva
shlokas.8:
arvAkcha pratitiShThanti pulindashabarA iva |
na hyayaj~nA amuM lokaM prApnuvanti katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
avij~nAyaiva me praj~nAM bAlasyeva supaNDitaH |
brahmanpiteva putrebhyaH prati mAM vA~nCha shaunaka
shlokas.10:
shaunaka uvAcha||
kimAshcharyaM yataH prAj~no bahu kuryAddhi sAmpratam |
iti vai paNDito bhUtvA bhUtAnAM nopatapyati
shlokas.11:
praj~nAprAsAdamAruhya ashochyaH shochate janAn |
jagatIsthAnivAdristhaH praj~nayA pratipashyati
shlokas.12:
na chopalabhate tatra na cha kAryANi pashyati |
nirviNNAtmA parokSho vA dhikkRRitaH sarvasAdhuShu
shlokas.13:
viditvobhayato vIryaM mAhAtmyaM veda Agame |
kuruShveha mahAshAntiM brahmA sharaNamastu te
shlokas.14:
tadvai pAratrikaM chAru brAhmaNAnAmakupyatAm |
atha chettapyase pApairdharmaM chedanupashyasi
shlokas.15:
janamejaya uvAcha||
anutapye cha pApena na chAdharmaM charAmyaham |
bubhUShuM bhajamAnaM cha prativA~nChAmi shaunaka
shlokas.16:
shaunaka uvAcha||
ChittvA stambhaM cha mAnaM cha prItimichChAmi te nRRipa |
sarvabhUtahite tiShTha dharmaM chaiva pratismara
shlokas.17:
na bhayAnna cha kArpaNyAnna lobhAttvAmupAhvaye |
tAM me devA giraM satyAM shRRiNvantu brAhmaNaiH saha
shlokas.18:
so.ahaM na kenachichchArthI tvAM cha dharmamupAhvaye |
kroshatAM sarvabhUtAnAmaho dhigiti kurvatAm
shlokas.19:
vakShyanti mAmadharmaj~nA vakShyantyasuhRRido janAH |
vAchastAH suhRRidaH shrutvA sa~njvariShyanti me bhRRisham
shlokas.20:
kechideva mahAprAj~nAH parij~nAsyanti kAryatAm |
jAnIhi me kRRitaM tAta brAhmaNAnprati bhArata
shlokas.21:
yathA te matkRRite kShemaM labhera.nstattathA kuru |
pratijAnIhi chAdrohaM brAhmaNAnAM narAdhipa
shlokas.22:
janamejaya uvAcha||
naiva vAchA na manasA na punarjAtu karmaNA |
drogdhAsmi brAhmaNAnvipra charaNAveva te spRRishe

shlokas.1:
shaunaka uvAcha||
tasmAtte.ahaM pravakShyAmi dharmamAvRRittachetase |
shrImAnmahAbalastuShTo yastvaM dharmamavekShase
purastAddAruNo bhUtvA suchitratarameva tat
shlokas.2:
anugRRihNanti bhUtAni svena vRRittena pArthiva |
kRRitsne nUnaM sadasatI iti loko vyavasyati
yatra tvaM tAdRRisho bhUtvA dharmamadyAnupashyasi
shlokas.3:
hitvA suruchiraM bhakShyaM bhogA.nshcha tapa AsthitaH |
ityetadapi bhUtAnAmadbhutaM janamejaya
shlokas.4:
yo durbalo bhaveddAtA kRRipaNo vA tapodhanaH |
anAshcharyaM tadityAhurnAtidUre hi vartate
shlokas.5:
etadeva hi kArpaNyaM samagramasamIkShitam |
tasmAtsamIkShayaiva syAdbhavettasmi.nstato guNaH
shlokas.6:
yaj~no dAnaM dayA vedAH satyaM cha pRRithivIpate |
pa~nchaitAni pavitrANi ShaShThaM sucharitaM tapaH
shlokas.7:
tadeva rAj~nAM paramaM pavitraM janamejaya |
tena samyaggRRihItena shreyA.nsaM dharmamApsyasi
shlokas.8:
puNyadeshAbhigamanaM pavitraM paramaM smRRitam |
api hyudAharantImA gAthA gItA yayAtinA
shlokas.9:
yo martyaH pratipadyeta AyurjIveta vA punaH |
yaj~namekAntataH kRRitvA tatsaMnyasya tapashcharet
shlokas.10:
puNyamAhuH kurukShetraM sarasvatyAM pRRithUdakam |
yatrAvagAhya pItvA vA naivaM shvomaraNaM tapet
shlokas.11:
mahAsaraH puShkarANi prabhAsottaramAnase |
kAlodaM tveva gantAsi labdhAyurjIvite punaH
shlokas.12:
sarasvatIdRRiShadvatyau sevamAno.anusa~nchareH |
svAdhyAyashIlaH sthAneShu sarveShu samupaspRRisheH
shlokas.13:
tyAgadharmaM pavitrANAM saMnyAsaM paramabravIt |
atrApyudAharantImA gAthAH satyavatA kRRitAH
shlokas.14:
yathA kumAraH satyo vai na puNyo na cha pApakRRit |
na hyasti sarvabhUteShu duHkhamasminkutaH sukham
shlokas.15:
evaM prakRRitibhUtAnAM sarvasa.nsargayAyinAm |
tyajatAM jIvitaM prAyo vivRRite puNyapAtake
shlokas.16:
yattveva rAj~no jyAyo vai kAryANAM tadvadAmi te |
balena sa.nvibhAgaishcha jaya svargaM punIShva cha
shlokas.17:
yasyaivaM balamojashcha sa dharmasya prabhurnaraH |
brAhmaNAnAM sukhArthaM tvaM paryehi pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.18:
yathaivainAnpurAkShaipsIstathaivainAnprasAdaya |
api dhikkriyamANo.api tyajyamAno.apyanekadhA
shlokas.19:
Atmano darshanaM vidvannAhantAsmIti mA krudhaH |
ghaTamAnaH svakAryeShu kuru naiHshreyasaM param
shlokas.20:
himAgnighorasadRRisho rAjA bhavati kashchana |
lA~NgalAshanikalpo vA bhavatyanyaH parantapa
shlokas.21:
na niHsheSheNa mantavyamachikitsyena vA punaH |
na jAtu nAhamasmIti prasaktavyamasAdhuShu
shlokas.22:
vikarmaNA tapyamAnaH pAdAtpApasya muchyate |
naitatkAryaM punariti dvitIyAtparimuchyate
chariShye dharmameveti tRRitIyAtparimuchyate
shlokas.23:
kalyANamanumantavyaM puruSheNa bubhUShatA |
ye sugandhIni sevante tathAgandhA bhavanti te
ye durgandhIni sevante tathAgandhA bhavanti te
shlokas.24:
tapashcharyAparaH sadyaH pApAddhi parimuchyate |
sa.nvatsaramupAsyAgnimabhishastaH pramuchyate
trINi varShANyupAsyAgniM bhrUNahA vipramuchyate
shlokas.25:
yAvataH prANino hanyAttajjAtIyAnsvabhAvataH |
pramIyamANAnunmochya bhrUNahA vipramuchyate
shlokas.26:
api vApsu nimajjeta trirjapannaghamarShaNam |
yathAshvamedhAvabhRRithastathA tanmanurabravIt
shlokas.27:
kShipraM praNudate pApaM satkAraM labhate tathA |
api chainaM prasIdanti bhUtAni jaDamUkavat
shlokas.28:
bRRihaspatiM devaguruM surAsurAH; sametya sarve nRRipate.anvayu~njan |
dharme phalaM vettha kRRite maharShe; tathetarasminnarake pApaloke
shlokas.29:
ubhe tu yasya sukRRite bhavetAM; kiM svittayostatra jayottaraM syAt |
AchakShva naH karmaphalaM maharShe; kathaM pApaM nudate puNyashIlaH
shlokas.30:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
kRRitvA pApaM pUrvamabuddhipUrvaM; puNyAni yaH kurute buddhipUrvam |
sa tatpApaM nudate puNyashIlo; vAso yathA malinaM kShArayuktyA
shlokas.31:
pApaM kRRitvA na manyeta nAhamasmIti pUruShaH |
chikIrShedeva kalyANaM shraddadhAno.anasUyakaH
shlokas.32:
ChidrANi vasanasyeva sAdhunA vivRRiNoti yaH |
yaH pApaM puruShaH kRRitvA kalyANamabhipadyate
shlokas.33:
yathAdityaH punarudya.nstamaH sarvaM vyapohati |
kalyANamAcharannevaM sarvaM pApaM vyapohati
shlokas.34:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa rAjAnamindroto janamejayam |
yAjayAmAsa vidhivadvAjimedhena shaunakaH
shlokas.35:
tataH sa rAjA vyapanItakalmaShaH; shriyA yutaH prajvalitAgnirUpayA |
vivesha rAjyaM svamamitrakarshano; divaM yathA pUrNavapurnishAkaraH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu pArtha yathAvRRittamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gRRidhrajambukasa.nvAdaM yo vRRitto vaidishe purA
shlokas.2:
duHkhitAH kechidAdAya bAlamaprAptayauvanam |
kulasarvasvabhUtaM vai rudantaH shokavihvalAH
shlokas.3:
bAlaM mRRitaM gRRihItvAtha shmashAnAbhimukhAH sthitAH |
a~NkenA~NkaM cha sa~Nkramya rurudurbhUtale tadA
shlokas.4:
teShAM ruditashabdena gRRidhro.abhyetya vacho.abravIt |
ekAtmakamimaM loke tyaktvA gachChata mAchiram
shlokas.5:
iha pu.nsAM sahasrANi strIsahasrANi chaiva hi |
samAnItAni kAlena kiM te vai jAtvabAndhavAH
shlokas.6:
sampashyata jagatsarvaM sukhaduHkhairadhiShThitam |
sa.nyogo viprayogashcha paryAyeNopalabhyate
shlokas.7:
gRRihItvA ye cha gachChanti ye.anuyAnti cha tAnmRRitAn |
te.apyAyuShaH pramANena svena gachChanti jantavaH
shlokas.8:
alaM sthitvA shmashAne.asmingRRidhragomAyusa~Nkule |
ka~NkAlabahule ghore sarvaprANibhaya~Nkare
shlokas.9:
na punarjIvitaH kashchitkAladharmamupAgataH |
priyo vA yadi vA dveShyaH prANinAM gatirIdRRishI
shlokas.10:
sarveNa khalu martavyaM martyaloke prasUyatA |
kRRitAntavihite mArge ko mRRitaM jIvayiShyati
shlokas.11:
karmAntavihite loke chAstaM gachChati bhAskare |
gamyatAM svamadhiShThAnaM sutasnehaM visRRijya vai
shlokas.12:
tato gRRidhravachaH shrutvA vikroshantastadA nRRipa |
bAndhavAste.abhyagachChanta putramutsRRijya bhUtale
shlokas.13:
vinishchityAtha cha tataH santyajantaH svamAtmajam |
nirAshA jIvite tasya mArgamAruhya dhiShThitAH
shlokas.14:
dhvA~NkShAbhrasamavarNastu bilAnniHsRRitya jambukaH |
gachChamAnAnsma tAnAha nirghRRiNAH khalu mAnavAH
shlokas.15:
Adityo.ayaM sthito mUDhAH snehaM kuruta mA bhayam |
bahurUpo muhUrtashcha jIvetApi kadAchana
shlokas.16:
yUyaM bhUmau vinikShipya putrasnehavinAkRRitAH |
shmashAne putramutsRRijya kasmAdgachChatha nirghRRiNAH
shlokas.17:
na vo.astyasminsute sneho bAle madhurabhAShiNi |
yasya bhAShitamAtreNa prasAdamupagachChatha
shlokas.18:
na pashyatha sutasnehaM yAdRRishaH pashupakShiNAm |
na yeShAM dhArayitvA tAnkashchidasti phalAgamaH
shlokas.19:
chatuShpAtpakShikITAnAM prANinAM snehasa~NginAm |
paralokagatisthAnAM muniyaj~nakriyA iva
shlokas.20:
teShAM putrAbhirAmANAmiha loke paratra cha |
na guNo dRRishyate kashchitprajAH sandhArayanti cha
shlokas.21:
apashyatAM priyAnputrAnnaiShAM shoko.anutiShThati |
na cha puShNanti sa.nvRRiddhAste mAtApitarau kvachit
shlokas.22:
mAnuShANAM kutaH sneho yeShAM shoko bhaviShyati |
imaM kulakaraM putraM kathaM tyaktvA gamiShyatha
shlokas.23:
chiraM mu~nchata bAShpaM cha chiraM snehena pashyata |
eva.nvidhAni hIShTAni dustyajAni visheShataH
shlokas.24:
kShINasyAthAbhiyuktasya shmashAnAbhimukhasya cha |
bAndhavA yatra tiShThanti tatrAnyo nAvatiShThate
shlokas.25:
sarvasya dayitAH prANAH sarvaH snehaM cha vindati |
tiryagyoniShvapi satAM snehaM pashyata yAdRRisham
shlokas.26:
tyaktvA kathaM gachChethemaM padmalolAyatAkShakam |
yathA navodvAhakRRitaM snAnamAlyavibhUShitam
shlokas.27:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jambukasya vachaH shrutvA kRRipaNaM paridevataH |
nyavartanta tadA sarve shavArthaM te sma mAnuShAH
shlokas.28:
gRRidhra uvAcha||
aho dhiksunRRisha.nsena jambukenAlpamedhasA |
kShudreNoktA hInasattvA mAnuShAH kiM nivartatha
shlokas.29:
pa~nchabhUtaparityaktaM shUnyaM kAShThatvamAgatam |
kasmAchChochatha nishcheShTamAtmAnaM kiM na shochatha
shlokas.30:
tapaH kuruta vai tIvraM muchyadhvaM yena kilbiShAt |
tapasA labhyate sarvaM vilApaH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.31:
aniShTAni cha bhAgyAni jAnIta saha mUrtibhiH |
yena gachChati loko.ayaM dattvA shokamanantakam
shlokas.32:
dhanaM gAshcha suvarNaM cha maNiratnamathApi cha |
apatyaM cha tapomUlaM tapoyogAchcha labhyate
shlokas.33:
yathAkRRitA cha bhUteShu prApyate sukhaduHkhatA |
gRRihItvA jAyate janturduHkhAni cha sukhAni cha
shlokas.34:
na karmaNA pituH putraH pitA vA putrakarmaNA |
mArgeNAnyena gachChanti tyaktvA sukRRitaduShkRRite
shlokas.35:
dharmaM charata yatnena tathAdharmAnnivartata |
vartadhvaM cha yathAkAlaM daivateShu dvijeShu cha
shlokas.36:
shokaM tyajata dainyaM cha sutasnehAnnivartata |
tyajyatAmayamAkAshe tataH shIghraM nivartata
shlokas.37:
yatkaroti shubhaM karma tathAdharmaM sudAruNam |
tatkartaiva samashnAti bAndhavAnAM kimatra hi
shlokas.38:
iha tyaktvA na tiShThanti bAndhavA bAndhavaM priyam |
snehamutsRRijya gachChanti bAShpapUrNAvilekShaNAH
shlokas.39:
prAj~no vA yadi vA mUrkhaH sadhano nirdhano.api vA |
sarvaH kAlavashaM yAti shubhAshubhasamanvitaH
shlokas.40:
kiM kariShyatha shochitvA mRRitaM kimanushochatha |
sarvasya hi prabhuH kAlo dharmataH samadarshanaH
shlokas.41:
yauvanasthA.nshcha bAlA.nshcha vRRiddhAngarbhagatAnapi |
sarvAnAvishate mRRityurevambhUtamidaM jagat
shlokas.42:
jambuka uvAcha||
aho mandIkRRitaH sneho gRRidhreNehAlpamedhasA |
putrasnehAbhibhUtAnAM yuShmAkaM shochatAM bhRRisham
shlokas.43:
samaiH samyakprayuktaishcha vachanaiH prashrayottaraiH |
yadgachChatha jalasthAyaM snehamutsRRijya dustyajam
shlokas.44:
aho putraviyogena mRRitashUnyopasevanAt |
kroshatAM vai bhRRishaM duHkhaM vivatsAnAM gavAmiva
shlokas.45:
adya shokaM vijAnAmi mAnuShANAM mahItale |
snehaM hi karuNaM dRRiShTvA mamApyashrUNyathAgaman
shlokas.46:
yatno hi satataM kAryaH kRRito daivena sidhyati |
daivaM puruShakArashcha kRRitAntenopapadyate
shlokas.47:
anirvedaH sadA kAryo nirvedAddhi kutaH sukham |
prayatnAtprApyate hyarthaH kasmAdgachChatha nirdayAH
shlokas.48:
AtmamA.nsopavRRittaM cha sharIrArdhamayIM tanum |
pitR^INAM va.nshakartAraM vane tyaktvA kva yAsyatha
shlokas.49:
atha vAstaM gate sUrye sandhyAkAla upasthite |
tato neShyatha vA putramihasthA vA bhaviShyatha
shlokas.50:
gRRidhra uvAcha||
adya varShasahasraM me sAgraM jAtasya mAnuShAH |
na cha pashyAmi jIvantaM mRRitaM strIpuMnapu.nsakam
shlokas.51:
mRRitA garbheShu jAyante mriyante jAtamAtrakAH |
vikramanto mriyante cha yauvanasthAstathApare
shlokas.52:
anityAnIha bhAgyAni chatuShpAtpakShiNAmapi |
ja~NgamAja~NgamAnAM chApyAyuragre.avatiShThate
shlokas.53:
iShTadAraviyuktAshcha putrashokAnvitAstathA |
dahyamAnAH sma shokena gRRihaM gachChanti nityadA
shlokas.54:
aniShTAnAM sahasrANi tatheShTAnAM shatAni cha |
utsRRijyeha prayAtA vai bAndhavA bhRRishaduHkhitAH
shlokas.55:
tyajyatAmeSha nistejAH shUnyaH kAShThatvamAgataH |
anyadehaviShakto hi shAvaM kAShThamupAsate
shlokas.56:
bhrAntajIvasya vai bAShpaM kasmAddhitvA na gachChatha |
nirarthako hyayaM sneho nirarthashcha parigrahaH
shlokas.57:
na chakShurbhyAM na karNAbhyAM sa.nshRRiNoti samIkShate |
tasmAdenaM samutsRRijya svagRRihAngachChatAshu vai
shlokas.58:
mokShadharmAshritairvAkyairhetumadbhiraniShThuraiH |
mayoktA gachChata kShipraM svaM svameva niveshanam
shlokas.59:
praj~nAvij~nAnayuktena buddhisa~nj~nApradAyinA |
vachanaM shrAvitA rUkShaM mAnuShAH saMnivartata
shlokas.60:
jambuka uvAcha||
imaM kanakavarNAbhaM bhUShaNaiH samala~NkRRitam |
gRRidhravAkyAtkathaM putraM tyajadhvaM pitRRipiNDadam
shlokas.61:
na snehasya virodho.asti vilAparuditasya vai |
mRRitasyAsya parityAgAttApo vai bhavitA dhruvam
shlokas.62:
shrUyate shambuke shUdre hate brAhmaNadArakaH |
jIvito dharmamAsAdya rAmAtsatyaparAkramAt
shlokas.63:
tathA shvetasya rAjarSherbAlo diShTAntamAgataH |
shvo.abhUte dharmanityena mRRitaH sa~njIvitaH punaH
shlokas.64:
tathA kashchidbhavetsiddho munirvA devatApi vA |
kRRipaNAnAmanukroshaM kuryAdvo rudatAmiha
shlokas.65:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktAH saMnyavartanta shokArtAH putravatsalAH |
a~Nke shiraH samAdhAya rurudurbahuvistaram
shlokas.66:
gRRidhra uvAcha||
ashrupAtapariklinnaH pANisparshanapIDitaH |
dharmarAjaprayogAchcha dIrghAM nidrAM praveshitaH
shlokas.67:
tapasApi hi sa.nyukto na kAle nopahanyate |
sarvasnehAvasAnaM tadidaM tatpretapattanam
shlokas.68:
bAlavRRiddhasahasrANi sadA santyajya bAndhavAH |
dinAni chaiva rAtrIshcha duHkhaM tiShThanti bhUtale
shlokas.69:
alaM nirbandhamAgamya shokasya parivAraNam |
apratyayaM kuto hyasya punaradyeha jIvitam
shlokas.70:
naiSha jambukavAkyena punaH prApsyati jIvitam |
mRRitasyotsRRiShTadehasya punardeho na vidyate
shlokas.71:
na vai mUrtipradAnena na jambukashatairapi |
shakyo jIvayituM hyeSha bAlo varShashatairapi
shlokas.72:
api rudraH kumAro vA brahmA vA viShNureva vA |
varamasmai prayachCheyustato jIvedayaM shishuH
shlokas.73:
na cha bAShpavimokSheNa na chAshvAsakRRitena vai |
na dIrgharuditeneha punarjIvo bhaviShyati
shlokas.74:
ahaM cha kroShTukashchaiva yUyaM chaivAsya bAndhavAH |
dharmAdharmau gRRihItveha sarve vartAmahe.adhvani
shlokas.75:
apriyaM paruShaM chApi paradrohaM parastriyam |
adharmamanRRitaM chaiva dUrAtprAj~no nivartayet
shlokas.76:
satyaM dharmaM shubhaM nyAyyaM prANinAM mahatIM dayAm |
ajihmatvamashAThyaM cha yatnataH parimArgata
shlokas.77:
mAtaraM pitaraM chaiva bAndhavAnsuhRRidastathA |
jIvato ye na pashyanti teShAM dharmaviparyayaH
shlokas.78:
yo na pashyati chakShurbhyAM ne~Ngate cha katha~nchana |
tasya niShThAvasAnAnte rudantaH kiM kariShyatha
shlokas.79:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktAstaM sutaM tyaktvA bhUmau shokapariplutAH |
dahyamAnAH sutasnehAtprayayurbAndhavA gRRihAn
shlokas.80:
jambuka uvAcha||
dAruNo martyaloko.ayaM sarvaprANivinAshanaH |
iShTabandhuviyogashcha tathaivAlpaM cha jIvitam
shlokas.81:
bahvalIkamasatyaM cha prativAdApriya.nvadam |
imaM prekShya punarbhAvaM duHkhashokAbhivardhanam
shlokas.82:
na me mAnuShaloko.ayaM muhUrtamapi rochate |
aho dhiggRRidhravAkyena saMnivartatha mAnuShAH
shlokas.83:
pradIptAH putrashokena yathaivAbuddhayastathA |
kathaM gachChatha sasnehAH sutasnehaM visRRijya cha
shrutvA gRRidhrasya vachanaM pApasyehAkRRitAtmanaH
shlokas.84:
sukhasyAnantaraM duHkhaM duHkhasyAnantaraM sukham |
sukhaduHkhAnvite loke nehAstyekamanantakam
shlokas.85:
imaM kShititale nyasya bAlaM rUpasamanvitam |
kulashokAkaraM mUDhAH putraM tyaktvA kva yAsyatha
shlokas.86:
rUpayauvanasampannaM dyotamAnamiva shriyA |
jIvantamenaM pashyAmi manasA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.87:
vinAshashchApyanarho.asya sukhaM prApsyatha mAnuShAH |
putrashokAgnidagdhAnAM mRRitamapyadya vaH kShamam
shlokas.88:
duHkhasambhAvanAM kRRitvA dhArayitvA svayaM sukham |
tyaktvA gamiShyatha kvAdya samutsRRijyAlpabuddhivat
shlokas.89:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tathA dharmavirodhena priyamithyAbhidhyAyinA |
shmashAnavAsinA nityaM rAtriM mRRigayatA tadA
shlokas.90:
tato madhyasthatAM nItA vachanairamRRitopamaiH |
jambukena svakAryArthaM bAndhavAstasya dhiShThitAH
shlokas.91:
gRRidhra uvAcha||
ayaM pretasamAkIrNo yakSharAkShasasevitaH |
dAruNaH kAnanoddeshaH kaushikairabhinAditaH
shlokas.92:
bhImaH sughorashcha tathA nIlameghasamaprabhaH |
asmi~nshavaM parityajya pretakAryANyupAsata
shlokas.93:
bhAnuryAvanna yAtyastaM yAvachcha vimalA dishaH |
tAvadenaM parityajya pretakAryANyupAsata
shlokas.94:
nadanti paruShaM shyenAH shivAH kroshanti dAruNAH |
mRRigendrAH pratinandanti ravirastaM cha gachChati
shlokas.95:
chitAdhUmena nIlena sa.nrajyante cha pAdapAH |
shmashAne cha nirAhArAH pratinandanti dehinaH
shlokas.96:
sarve vikrAntavIryAshcha asmindeshe sudAruNAH |
yuShmAnpradharShayiShyanti vikRRitA mA.nsabhojanAH
shlokas.97:
dUrAchchAyaM vanoddesho bhayamatra bhaviShyati |
tyajyatAM kAShThabhUto.ayaM mRRiShyatAM jAmbukaM vachaH
shlokas.98:
yadi jambukavAkyAni niShphalAnyanRRitAni cha |
shroShyatha bhraShTavij~nAnAstataH sarve vina~NkShyatha
shlokas.99:
jambuka uvAcha||
sthIyatAM neha bhetavyaM yAvattapati bhAskaraH |
tAvadasminsutasnehAdanirvedena vartata
shlokas.100:
svairaM rudata visrabdhAH svairaM snehena pashyata |
sthIyatAM yAvadAdityaH kiM vaH kravyAdabhAShitaiH
shlokas.101:
yadi gRRidhrasya vAkyAni tIvrANi rabhasAni cha |
gRRihNIta mohitAtmAnaH suto vo na bhaviShyati
shlokas.102:
bhIShma uvAcha||
gRRidhro.anastamite tvAha gate.astamiti jambukaH |
mRRitasya taM parijanamUchatustau kShudhAnvitau
shlokas.103:
svakAryadakShiNau rAjangRRidhro jambuka eva cha |
kShutpipAsAparishrAntau shAstramAlambya jalpataH
shlokas.105:
shokadainyasamAviShTA rudantastasthire tadA |
svakAryakushalAbhyAM te sambhrAmyante ha naipuNAt
shlokas.106:
tathA tayorvivadatorvij~nAnaviduShordvayoH |
bAndhavAnAM sthitAnAM cha upAtiShThata sha~NkaraH
shlokas.107:
tatastAnAha manujAnvarado.asmIti shUlabhRRit |
te pratyUchuridaM vAkyaM duHkhitAH praNatAH sthitAH
shlokas.108:
ekaputravihInAnAM sarveShAM jIvitArthinAm |
putrasya no jIvadAnAjjIvitaM dAtumarhasi
shlokas.109:
evamuktaH sa bhagavAnvAripUrNena pANinA |
jIvaM tasmai kumArAya prAdAdvarShashatAya vai
shlokas.110:
tathA gomAyugRRidhrAbhyAmadadatkShudvinAshanam |
varaM pinAkI bhagavAnsarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.111:
tataH praNamya taM devaM shreyoharShasamanvitAH |
kRRitakRRityAH sukhaM hRRiShTAH prAtiShThanta tadA vibho
shlokas.112:
anirvedena dIrgheNa nishchayena dhruveNa cha |
devadevaprasAdAchcha kShipraM phalamavApyate
shlokas.113:
pashya devasya sa.nyogaM bAndhavAnAM cha nishchayam |
kRRipaNAnAM hi rudatAM kRRitamashrupramArjanam
shlokas.114:
pashya chAlpena kAlena nishchayAnveShaNena cha |
prasAdaM sha~NkarAtprApya duHkhitAH sukhamApnuvan
shlokas.115:
te vismitAH prahRRiShTAshcha putrasa~njIvanAtpunaH |
babhUvurbharatashreShTha prasAdAchCha~Nkarasya vai
shlokas.116:
tataste tvaritA rAja~nshrutvA shokamaghodbhavam |
vivishuH putramAdAya nagaraM hRRiShTamAnasAH
eShA buddhiH samastAnAM chAturvarNye nidarshitA
shlokas.117:
dharmArthamokShasa.nyuktamitihAsamimaM shubham |
shrutvA manuShyaH satatamiha pretya cha modate

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sa.nvAdaM bharatashreShTha shalmaleH pavanasya cha
shlokas.2:
himavantaM samAsAdya mahAnAsIdvanaspatiH |
varShapUgAbhisa.nvRRiddhaH shAkhAskandhapalAshavAn
shlokas.3:
tatra sma mattA mAta~NgA dharmArtAH shramakarshitAH |
vishramanti mahAbAho tathAnyA mRRigajAtayaH
shlokas.4:
nalvamAtraparINAho ghanachChAyo vanaspatiH |
shukashArikasa~NghuShTaH phalavAnpuShpavAnapi
shlokas.5:
sArthikA vaNijashchApi tApasAshcha vanaukasaH |
vasanti vAsAnmArgasthAH suramye tarusattame
shlokas.6:
tasyA tA vipulAH shAkhA dRRiShTvA skandhA.nshcha sarvataH |
abhigamyAbravIdenaM nArado bharatarShabha
shlokas.7:
aho nu ramaNIyastvamaho chAsi manoramaH |
prIyAmahe tvayA nityaM tarupravara shalmale
shlokas.8:
sadaiva shakunAstAta mRRigAshchAdhastathA gajAH |
vasanti tava saMhRRiShTA manoharatarAstathA
shlokas.9:
tava shAkhA mahAshAkha skandhaM cha vipulaM tathA |
na vai prabhagnAnpashyAmi mArutena katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
kiM nu te mArutastAta prItimAnatha vA suhRRit |
tvAM rakShati sadA yena vane.asminpavano dhruvam
shlokas.11:
vivAnhi pavanaH sthAnAdvRRikShAnuchchAvachAnapi |
parvatAnAM cha shikharANyAchAlayati vegavAn
shlokas.12:
shoShayatyeva pAtAlaM vivAngandhavahaH shuchiH |
hradA.nshcha saritashchaiva sAgarA.nshcha tathaiva ha
shlokas.13:
tvAM sa.nrakSheta pavanaH sakhitvena na sa.nshayaH |
tasmAdbahalashAkho.asi parNavAnpuShpavAnapi
shlokas.14:
idaM cha ramaNIyaM te pratibhAti vanaspate |
yadime vihagAstAta ramante muditAstvayi
shlokas.15:
eShAM pRRithaksamastAnAM shrUyate madhuraH svaraH |
puShpasaMmodane kAle vAshatAM sumanoharam
shlokas.16:
tatheme muditA nAgAH svayUthakulashobhinaH |
gharmArtAstvAM samAsAdya sukhaM vindanti shalmale
shlokas.17:
tathaiva mRRigajAtIbhiranyAbhirupashobhase |
tathA sArthAdhivAsaishcha shobhase meruvaddruma
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNaishcha tapaHsiddhaistApasaiH shramaNairapi |
triviShTapasamaM manye tavAyatanameva ha
shlokas.19:
bandhutvAdatha vA sakhyAchChalmale nAtra sa.nshayaH |
pAlayatyeva satataM bhImaH sarvatrago.anilaH
shlokas.20:
nyagbhAvaM paramaM vAyoH shalmale tvamupAgataH |
tavAhamasmIti sadA yena rakShati mArutaH
shlokas.21:
na taM pashyAmyahaM vRRikShaM parvataM vApi taM dRRiDham |
yo na vAyubalAdbhagnaH pRRithivyAmiti me matiH
shlokas.22:
tvaM punaH kAraNairnUnaM shalmale rakShyase sadA |
vAyunA saparIvArastena tiShThasyasa.nshayam
shlokas.23:
shalmaliruvAcha||
na me vAyuH sakhA brahmanna bandhurna cha me suhRRit |
parameShThI tathA naiva yena rakShati mAnilaH
shlokas.24:
mama tejobalaM vAyorbhImamapi hi nArada |
kalAmaShTAdashIM prANairna me prApnoti mArutaH
shlokas.25:
AgachChanparamo vAyurmayA viShTambhito balAt |
rujandrumAnparvatA.nshcha yachchAnyadapi ki~nchana
shlokas.26:
sa mayA bahusho bhagnaH prabha~njanvai prabha~njanaH |
tasmAnna bibhye devarShe kruddhAdapi samIraNAt
shlokas.27:
nArada uvAcha||
shalmale viparItaM te darshanaM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
na hi vAyorbalenAsti bhUtaM tulyabalaM kvachit
shlokas.28:
indro yamo vaishravaNo varuNashcha jaleshvaraH |
na te.api tulyA marutaH kiM punastvaM vanaspate
shlokas.29:
yaddhi ki~nchidiha prANi shalmale cheShTate bhuvi |
sarvatra bhagavAnvAyushcheShTAprANakaraH prabhuH
shlokas.30:
eSha cheShTayate samyakprANinaH samyagAyataH |
asamyagAyato bhUyashcheShTate vikRRito nRRiShu
shlokas.31:
sa tvameva.nvidhaM vAyuM sarvasattvabhRRitAM varam |
na pUjayasi pUjyaM taM kimanyadbuddhilAghavAt
shlokas.32:
asArashchAsi durbuddhe kevalaM bahu bhAShase |
krodhAdibhiravachChanno mithyA vadasi shalmale
shlokas.33:
mama roShaH samutpannastvayyevaM samprabhAShati |
bravImyeSha svayaM vAyostava durbhAShitaM bahu
shlokas.34:
chandanaiH spandanaiH shAlaiH saralairdevadArubhiH |
vetasairbandhanaishchApi ye chAnye balavattarAH
shlokas.35:
taishchApi naivaM durbuddhe kShipto vAyuH kRRitAtmabhiH |
te hi jAnanti vAyoshcha balamAtmana eva cha
shlokas.36:
tasmAtte vai namasyanti shvasanaM drumasattamAH |
tvaM tu mohAnna jAnIShe vAyorbalamanantakam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu rAjendra shalmaliM brahmavittamaH |
nAradaH pavane sarvaM shalmalervAkyamabravIt
shlokas.2:
himavatpRRiShThajaH kashchichChalmaliH parivAravAn |
bRRihanmUlo bRRihachChAkhaH sa tvAM vAyo.avamanyate
shlokas.3:
bahUnyAkShepayuktAni tvAmAha vachanAni saH |
na yuktAni mayA vAyo tAni vaktuM tvayi prabho
shlokas.4:
jAnAmi tvAmahaM vAyo sarvaprANabhRRitAM varam |
variShThaM cha gariShThaM cha krodhe vaivasvataM yathA
shlokas.5:
evaM tu vachanaM shrutvA nAradasya samIraNaH |
shalmaliM tamupAgamya kruddho vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
shalmale nArade yattattvayoktaM madvigarhaNam |
ahaM vAyuH prabhAvaM te darshayAmyAtmano balam
shlokas.7:
nAhaM tvA nAbhijAnAmi viditashchAsi me druma |
pitAmahaH prajAsarge tvayi vishrAntavAnprabhuH
shlokas.8:
tasya vishramaNAdeva prasAdo yaH kRRitastava |
rakShyase tena durbuddhe nAtmavIryAddrumAdhama
shlokas.9:
yanmA tvamavajAnIShe yathAnyaM prAkRRitaM tathA |
darshayAmyeSha AtmAnaM yathA mAmavabhotsyase
shlokas.10:
evamuktastataH prAha shalmaliH prahasanniva |
pavana tvaM vane kruddho darshayAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.11:
mayi vai tyajyatAM krodhaH kiM me kruddhaH kariShyasi |
na te bibhemi pavana yadyapi tvaM svayamprabhuH
shlokas.12:
ityevamuktaH pavanaH shva ityevAbravIdvachaH |
darshayiShyAmi te tejastato rAtrirupAgamat
shlokas.13:
atha nishchitya manasA shalmalirvAtakAritam |
pashyamAnastadAtmAnamasamaM mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.14:
nArade yanmayA proktaM pavanaM prati tanmRRiShA |
asamartho hyahaM vAyorbalena balavAnhi saH
shlokas.15:
mAruto balavAnnityaM yathainaM nArado.abravIt |
ahaM hi durbalo.anyebhyo vRRikShebhyo nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.16:
kiM tu buddhyA samo nAsti mama kashchidvanaspatiH |
tadahaM buddhimAsthAya bhayaM mokShye samIraNAt
shlokas.17:
yadi tAM buddhimAsthAya chareyuH parNino vane |
ariShTAH syuH sadA kruddhAtpavanAnnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
te.atra bAlA na jAnanti yathA nainAnsamIraNaH |
samIrayeta sa~Nkruddho yathA jAnAmyahaM tathA
shlokas.19:
tato nishchitya manasA shalmaliH kShubhitastadA |
shAkhAH skandhAnprashAkhAshcha svayameva vyashAtayat
shlokas.20:
sa parityajya shAkhAshcha patrANi kusumAni cha |
prabhAte vAyumAyAntaM pratyaikShata vanaspatiH
shlokas.21:
tataH kruddhaH shvasanvAyuH pAtayanvai mahAdrumAn |
AjagAmAtha taM deshaM sthito yatra sa shalmaliH
shlokas.22:
taM hInaparNaM patitAgrashAkhaM; vishIrNapuShpaM prasamIkShya vAyuH |
uvAcha vAkyaM smayamAna enaM; mudA yutaM shalmaliM rugNashAkham
shlokas.23:
ahamapyevameva tvAM kurvANaH shalmale ruShA |
AtmanA yatkRRitaM kRRitsnaM shAkhAnAmapakarShaNam
shlokas.24:
hInapuShpAgrashAkhastvaM shIrNA~NkurapalAshavAn |
Atmadurmantriteneha madvIryavashago.abhavaH
shlokas.25:
etachChrutvA vacho vAyoH shalmalirvrIDitastadA |
atapyata vachaH smRRitvA nArado yattadAbravIt
shlokas.26:
evaM yo rAjashArdUla durbalaH sanbalIyasA |
vairamAsajjate bAlastapyate shalmaliryathA
shlokas.27:
tasmAdvairaM na kurvIta durbalo balavattaraiH |
shocheddhi vairaM kurvANo yathA vai shalmalistathA
shlokas.28:
na hi vairaM mahAtmAno vivRRiNvantyapakAriShu |
shanaiH shanairmahArAja darshayanti sma te balam
shlokas.29:
vairaM na kurvIta naro durbuddhirbuddhijIvinA |
buddhirbuddhimato yAti tUleShviva hutAshanaH
shlokas.30:
na hi buddhyA samaM ki~nchidvidyate puruShe nRRipa |
tathA balena rAjendra na samo.astIti chintayet
shlokas.31:
tasmAtkShameta bAlAya jaDAya badhirAya cha |
balAdhikAya rAjendra taddRRiShTaM tvayi shatruhan
shlokas.32:
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha sapta chaiva mahAdyute |
balena na samA rAjannarjunasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.33:
hatAstAshchaiva bhagnAshcha pANDavena yashasvinA |
charatA balamAsthAya pAkashAsaninA mRRidhe
shlokas.34:
uktAste rAjadharmAshcha ApaddharmAshcha bhArata |
vistareNa mahArAja kiM bhUyaH prabravImi te

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pApasya yadadhiShThAnaM yataH pApaM pravartate |
etadichChAmyahaM j~nAtuM tattvena bharatarShabha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
pApasya yadadhiShThAnaM tachChRRiNuShva narAdhipa |
eko lobho mahAgrAho lobhAtpApaM pravartate
shlokas.3:
ataH pApamadharmashcha tathA duHkhamanuttamam |
nikRRityA mUlametaddhi yena pApakRRito janAH
shlokas.4:
lobhAtkrodhaH prabhavati lobhAtkAmaH pravartate |
lobhAnmohashcha mAyA cha mAnastambhaH parAsutA
shlokas.5:
akShamA hrIparityAgaH shrInAsho dharmasa~NkShayaH |
abhidhyApraj~natA chaiva sarvaM lobhAtpravartate
shlokas.6:
anyAyashchAvitarkashcha vikarmasu cha yAH kriyAH |
kUTavidyAdayashchaiva rUpaishvaryamadastathA
shlokas.7:
sarvabhUteShvavishvAsaH sarvabhUteShvanArjavam |
sarvabhUteShvabhidrohaH sarvabhUteShvayuktatA
haraNaM paravittAnAM paradArAbhimarshanam
shlokas.8:
vAgvego mAnaso vego nindAvegastathaiva cha |
upasthodarayorvego mRRityuvegashcha dAruNaH
shlokas.9:
IrShyAvegashcha balavAnmithyAvegashcha dustyajaH |
rasavegashcha durvAraH shrotravegashcha duHsahaH
shlokas.10:
kutsA vikatthA mAtsaryaM pApaM duShkarakAritA |
sAhasAnAM cha sarveShAmakAryANAM kriyAstathA
shlokas.11:
jAtau bAlye.atha kaumAre yauvane chApi mAnavaH |
na santyajatyAtmakarma yanna jIryati jIryataH
shlokas.12:
yo na pUrayituM shakyo lobhaH prAptyA kurUdvaha |
nityaM gambhIratoyAbhirApagAbhirivodadhiH
na prahRRiShyati lAbhairyo yashcha kAmairna tRRipyati
shlokas.13:
yo na devairna gandharvairnAsurairna mahoragaiH |
j~nAyate nRRipa tattvena sarvairbhUtagaNaistathA
sa lobhaH saha mohena vijetavyo jitAtmanA
shlokas.14:
dambho drohashcha nindA cha paishunyaM matsarastathA |
bhavantyetAni kauravya lubdhAnAmakRRitAtmanAm
shlokas.15:
sumahAntyapi shAstrANi dhArayanti bahushrutAH |
ChettAraH sa.nshayAnAM cha klishyantIhAlpabuddhayaH
shlokas.16:
dveShakrodhaprasaktAshcha shiShTAchArabahiShkRRitAH |
antaHkShurA vA~NmadhurAH kUpAshChannAstRRiNairiva
dharmavaita.nsikAH kShudrA muShNanti dhvajino jagat
shlokas.17:
kurvate cha bahUnmArgA.nstA.nstAnhetubalAshritAH |
sarvaM mArgaM vilumpanti lobhAj~nAneShu niShThitAH
shlokas.18:
dharmasyAhriyamANasya lobhagrastairdurAtmabhiH |
yA yA vikriyate sa.nsthA tataH sAbhiprapadyate
shlokas.19:
darpaH krodho madaH svapno harShaH shoko.atimAnitA |
tata eva hi kauravya dRRishyante lubdhabuddhiShu
etAnashiShTAnbudhyasva nityaM lobhasamanvitAn
shlokas.20:
shiShTA.nstu paripRRichChethA yAnvakShyAmi shuchivratAn |
yeShu vRRittibhayaM nAsti paralokabhayaM na cha
shlokas.21:
nAmiSheShu prasa~Ngo.asti na priyeShvapriyeShu cha |
shiShTAchAraH priyo yeShu damo yeShu pratiShThitaH
shlokas.22:
sukhaM duHkhaM paraM yeShAM satyaM yeShAM parAyaNam |
dAtAro na gRRihItAro dayAvantastathaiva cha
shlokas.23:
pitRRidevAtitheyAshcha nityodyuktAstathaiva cha |
sarvopakAriNo dhIrAH sarvadharmAnupAlakAH
shlokas.24:
sarvabhUtahitAshchaiva sarvadeyAshcha bhArata |
na te chAlayituM shakyA dharmavyApArapAragAH
shlokas.25:
na teShAM bhidyate vRRittaM yatpurA sAdhubhiH kRRitam |
na trAsino na chapalA na raudrAH satpathe sthitAH
shlokas.26:
te sevyAH sAdhubhirnityaM yeShvahi.nsA pratiShThitA |
kAmakrodhavyapetA ye nirmamA niraha~NkRRitAH
suvratAH sthiramaryAdAstAnupAssva cha pRRichCha cha
shlokas.27:
na gavArthaM yashorthaM vA dharmasteShAM yudhiShThira |
avashyakArya ityeva sharIrasya kriyAstathA
shlokas.28:
na bhayaM krodhachApalyaM na shokasteShu vidyate |
na dharmadhvajinashchaiva na guhyaM ki~nchidAsthitAH
shlokas.29:
yeShvalobhastathAmoho ye cha satyArjave ratAH |
teShu kaunteya rajyethA yeShvatandrIkRRitaM manaH
shlokas.30:
ye na hRRiShyanti lAbheShu nAlAbheShu vyathanti cha |
nirmamA niraha~NkArAH sattvasthAH samadarshinaH
shlokas.31:
lAbhAlAbhau sukhaduHkhe cha tAta; priyApriye maraNaM jIvitaM cha |
samAni yeShAM sthiravikramANAM; buddhAtmanAM sattvamavasthitAnAm
shlokas.32:
sukhapriyaistAnsumahApratApA;nyatto.apramattashcha samarthayethAH |
daivAtsarve guNavanto bhavanti; shubhAshubhA vAkpralApA yathaiva

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anarthAnAmadhiShThAnamukto lobhaH pitAmaha |
aj~nAnamapi vai tAta shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
karoti pApaM yo.aj~nAnAnnAtmano vetti cha kShamam |
pradveShTi sAdhuvRRittA.nshcha sa lokasyaiti vAchyatAm
shlokas.3:
aj~nAnAnnirayaM yAti tathAj~nAnena durgatim |
aj~nAnAtkleshamApnoti tathApatsu nimajjati
shlokas.4:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
aj~nAnasya pravRRittiM cha sthAnaM vRRiddhiM kShayodayau |
mUlaM yogaM gatiM kAlaM kAraNaM hetumeva cha
shlokas.5:
shrotumichChAmi tattvena yathAvadiha pArthiva |
aj~nAnaprabhavaM hIdaM yadduHkhamupalabhyate
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAgo dveShastathA moho harShaH shoko.abhimAnitA |
kAmaH krodhashcha darpashcha tandrIrAlasyameva cha
shlokas.7:
ichChA dveShastathA tApaH paravRRiddhyupatApitA |
aj~nAnametannirdiShTaM pApAnAM chaiva yAH kriyAH
shlokas.8:
etayA yA pravRRittishcha vRRiddhyAdInyA.nshcha pRRichChasi |
vistareNa mahAbAho shRRiNu tachcha vishAM pate
shlokas.9:
ubhAvetau samaphalau samadoShau cha bhArata |
aj~nAnaM chAtilobhashchApyekaM jAnIhi pArthiva
shlokas.10:
lobhaprabhavamaj~nAnaM vRRiddhaM bhUyaH pravardhate |
sthAne sthAnaM kShaye kShaiNyamupaiti vividhAM gatim
shlokas.11:
mUlaM lobhasya mahataH kAlAtmagatireva cha |
Chinne.achChinne tathA lobhe kAraNaM kAla eva hi
shlokas.12:
tasyAj~nAnAttu lobho hi lobhAdaj~nAnameva cha |
sarve doShAstathA lobhAttasmAllobhaM vivarjayet
shlokas.13:
janako yuvanAshvashcha vRRiShAdarbhiH prasenajit |
lobhakShayAddivaM prAptAstathaivAnye janAdhipAH
shlokas.14:
pratyakShaM tu kurushreShTha tyaja lobhamihAtmanA |
tyaktvA lobhaM sukhaM loke pretya chAnuchariShyasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
svAdhyAyakRRitayatnasya brAhmaNasya pitAmaha |
dharmakAmasya dharmAtmankiM nu shreya ihochyate
shlokas.2:
bahudhAdarshane loke shreyo yadiha manyase |
asmi.Nlloke pare chaiva tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
mahAnayaM dharmapatho bahushAkhashcha bhArata |
kiM svideveha dharmANAmanuShTheyatamaM matam
shlokas.4:
dharmasya mahato rAjanbahushAkhasya tattvataH |
yanmUlaM paramaM tAta tatsarvaM brUhyatandritaH
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta te kathayiShyAmi yena shreyaH prapatsyase |
pItvAmRRitamiva prAj~no j~nAnatRRipto bhaviShyasi
shlokas.6:
dharmasya vidhayo naike te te proktA maharShibhiH |
svaM svaM vij~nAnamAshritya damasteShAM parAyaNam
shlokas.7:
damaM niHshreyasaM prAhurvRRiddhA nishchayadarshinaH |
brAhmaNasya visheSheNa damo dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.8:
nAdAntasya kriyAsiddhiryathAvadupalabhyate |
damo dAnaM tathA yaj~nAnadhItaM chAtivartate
shlokas.9:
damastejo vardhayati pavitraM cha damaH param |
vipApmA tejasA yuktaH puruSho vindate mahat
shlokas.10:
damena sadRRishaM dharmaM nAnyaM lokeShu shushruma |
damo hi paramo loke prashastaH sarvadharmiNAm
shlokas.11:
pretya chApi manuShyendra paramaM vindate sukham |
damena hi samAyukto mahAntaM dharmamashnute
shlokas.12:
sukhaM dAntaH prasvapiti sukhaM cha pratibudhyate |
sukhaM paryeti lokA.nshcha manashchAsya prasIdati
shlokas.13:
adAntaH puruShaH kleshamabhIkShNaM pratipadyate |
anarthA.nshcha bahUnanyAnprasRRijatyAtmadoShajAn
shlokas.14:
AshrameShu chaturShvAhurdamamevottamaM vratam |
tasya li~NgAni vakShyAmi yeShAM samudayo damaH
shlokas.15:
kShamA dhRRitirahi.nsA cha samatA satyamArjavam |
indriyAvajayo dAkShyaM mArdavaM hrIrachApalam
shlokas.16:
akArpaNyamasa.nrambhaH santoShaH priyavAditA |
avivitsAnasUyA chApyeShAM samudayo damaH
shlokas.17:
gurupUjA cha kauravya dayA bhUteShvapaishunam |
janavAdo.amRRiShAvAdaH stutinindAvivarjanam
shlokas.18:
kAmaH krodhashcha lobhashcha darpaH stambho vikatthanam |
moha IrShyAvamAnashchetyetaddAnto na sevate
shlokas.19:
anindito hyakAmAtmAthAlpechCho.athAnasUyakaH |
samudrakalpaH sa naro na kadAchana pUryate
shlokas.20:
ahaM tvayi mama tvaM cha mayi te teShu chApyaham |
pUrvasambandhisa.nyogAnnaitaddAnto niShevate
shlokas.21:
sarvA grAmyAstathAraNyA yAshcha loke pravRRittayaH |
nindAM chaiva prasha.nsAM cha yo nAshrayati muchyate
shlokas.22:
maitro.atha shIlasampannaH susahAyaparashcha yaH |
muktashcha vividhaiH sa~Ngaistasya pretya mahatphalam
shlokas.23:
suvRRittaH shIlasampannaH prasannAtmAtmavidbudhaH |
prApyeha loke satkAraM sugatiM pratipadyate
shlokas.24:
karma yachChubhameveha sadbhirAcharitaM cha yat |
tadeva j~nAnayuktasya munerdharmo na hIyate
shlokas.25:
niShkramya vanamAsthAya j~nAnayukto jitendriyaH |
kAlAkA~NkShI charannevaM brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.26:
abhayaM yasya bhUtebhyo bhUtAnAmabhayaM yataH |
tasya dehAdvimuktasya bhayaM nAsti kutashchana
shlokas.27:
avAchinoti karmANi na cha samprachinoti ha |
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu maitrAyaNagatishcharet
shlokas.28:
shakunInAmivAkAshe jale vAricharasya vA |
yathA gatirna dRRishyeta tathA tasya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.29:
gRRihAnutsRRijya yo rAjanmokShamevAbhipadyate |
lokAstejomayAstasya kalpante shAshvatIH samAH
shlokas.30:
saMnyasya sarvakarmANi saMnyasya vidhivattapaH |
saMnyasya vividhA vidyAH sarvaM saMnyasya chaiva ha
shlokas.31:
kAmeShu chApyanAvRRittaH prasannAtmAtmavichChuchiH |
prApyeha loke satkAraM svargaM samabhipadyate
shlokas.32:
yachcha paitAmahaM sthAnaM brahmarAshisamudbhavam |
guhAyAM pihitaM nityaM taddamenAbhipadyate
shlokas.33:
j~nAnArAmasya buddhasya sarvabhUtAvirodhinaH |
nAvRRittibhayamastIha paraloke bhayaM kutaH
shlokas.34:
eka eva dame doSho dvitIyo nopapadyate |
yadenaM kShamayA yuktamashaktaM manyate janaH
shlokas.35:
etasya tu mahAprAj~na doShasya sumahAnguNaH |
kShamAyAM vipulA lokAH sulabhA hi sahiShNunA
shlokas.36:
dAntasya kimaraNyena tathAdAntasya bhArata |
yatraiva hi vaseddAntastadaraNyaM sa AshramaH
shlokas.37:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etadbhIShmasya vachanaM shrutvA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
amRRiteneva santRRiptaH prahRRiShTaH samapadyata
shlokas.38:
punashcha paripaprachCha bhIShmaM dharmabhRRitAM varam |
tapaH prati sa chovAcha tasmai sarvaM kurUdvaha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvametattapomUlaM kavayaH parichakShate |
na hyataptatapA mUDhaH kriyAphalamavApyate
shlokas.2:
prajApatiridaM sarvaM tapasaivAsRRijatprabhuH |
tathaiva vedAnRRiShayastapasA pratipedire
shlokas.3:
tapaso hyAnupUrvyeNa phalamUlAnilAshanAH |
trI.NllokA.nstapasA siddhAH pashyanti susamAhitAH
shlokas.4:
auShadhAnyagadAdIni tisro vidyAshcha sa.nskRRitAH |
tapasaiva hi sidhyanti tapomUlaM hi sAdhanam
shlokas.5:
yaddurApaM durAmnAyaM durAdharShaM durutsaham |
sarvaM tattapasA shakyaM tapo hi duratikramam
shlokas.6:
surApo.asaMmatAdAyI bhrUNahA gurutalpagaH |
tapasaiva sutaptena naraH pApAdvimuchyate
shlokas.7:
tapaso bahurUpasya taistairdvAraiH pravartataH |
nivRRittyA vartamAnasya tapo nAnashanAtparam
shlokas.8:
ahi.nsA satyavachanaM dAnamindriyanigrahaH |
etebhyo hi mahArAja tapo nAnashanAtparam
shlokas.9:
na duShkarataraM dAnAnnAtimAtaramAshramaH |
traividyebhyaH paraM nAsti saMnyAsaH paramaM tapaH
shlokas.10:
indriyANIha rakShanti dhanadhAnyAbhiguptaye |
tasmAdarthe cha dharme cha tapo nAnashanAtparam
shlokas.11:
RRiShayaH pitaro devA manuShyA mRRigasattamAH |
yAni chAnyAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.12:
tapaHparAyaNAH sarve sidhyanti tapasA cha te |
ityevaM tapasA devA mahattvaM chApyavApnuvan
shlokas.13:
imAnIShTavibhAgAni phalAni tapasA sadA |
tapasA shakyate prAptuM devatvamapi nishchayAt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
satyaM dharme prasha.nsanti viprarShipitRRidevatAH |
satyamichChAmyahaM shrotuM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
satyaM ki.nlakShaNaM rAjankathaM vA tadavApyate |
satyaM prApya bhavetkiM cha kathaM chaiva taduchyate
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
chAturvarNyasya dharmANAM sa~Nkaro na prashasyate |
avikAritamaM satyaM sarvavarNeShu bhArata
shlokas.4:
satyaM satsu sadA dharmaH satyaM dharmaH sanAtanaH |
satyameva namasyeta satyaM hi paramA gatiH
shlokas.5:
satyaM dharmastapo yogaH satyaM brahma sanAtanam |
satyaM yaj~naH paraH proktaH satye sarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.6:
AchArAniha satyasya yathAvadanupUrvashaH |
lakShaNaM cha pravakShyAmi satyasyeha yathAkramam
shlokas.7:
prApyate hi yathA satyaM tachcha shrotuM tvamarhasi |
satyaM trayodashavidhaM sarvalokeShu bhArata
shlokas.8:
satyaM cha samatA chaiva damashchaiva na sa.nshayaH |
amAtsaryaM kShamA chaiva hrIstitikShAnasUyatA
shlokas.9:
tyAgo dhyAnamathAryatvaM dhRRitishcha satataM sthirA |
ahi.nsA chaiva rAjendra satyAkArAstrayodasha
shlokas.10:
satyaM nAmAvyayaM nityamavikAri tathaiva cha |
sarvadharmAviruddhaM cha yogenaitadavApyate
shlokas.11:
AtmanIShTe tathAniShTe ripau cha samatA tathA |
ichChAdveShakShayaM prApya kAmakrodhakShayaM tathA
shlokas.12:
damo nAnyaspRRihA nityaM dhairyaM gAmbhIryameva cha |
abhayaM krodhashamanaM j~nAnenaitadavApyate
shlokas.13:
amAtsaryaM budhAH prAhurdAnaM dharme cha sa.nyamam |
avasthitena nityaM cha satyenAmatsarI bhavet
shlokas.14:
akShamAyAH kShamAyAshcha priyANIhApriyANi cha |
kShamate sarvataH sAdhuH sAdhvApnoti cha satyavAn
shlokas.15:
kalyANaM kurute gADhaM hrImAnna shlAghate kvachit |
prashAntavA~NmanA nityaM hrIstu dharmAdavApyate
shlokas.16:
dharmArthahetoH kShamate titikShA kShAntiruchyate |
lokasa~NgrahaNArthaM tu sA tu dhairyeNa labhyate
shlokas.17:
tyAgaH snehasya yastyAgo viShayANAM tathaiva cha |
rAgadveShaprahINasya tyAgo bhavati nAnyathA
shlokas.18:
AryatA nAma bhUtAnAM yaH karoti prayatnataH |
shubhaM karma nirAkAro vItarAgatvameva cha
shlokas.19:
dhRRitirnAma sukhe duHkhe yathA nApnoti vikriyAm |
tAM bhajeta sadA prAj~no ya ichChedbhUtimAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
sarvathA kShamiNA bhAvyaM tathA satyapareNa cha |
vItaharShabhayakrodho dhRRitimApnoti paNDitaH
shlokas.21:
adrohaH sarvabhUteShu karmaNA manasA girA |
anugrahashcha dAnaM cha satAM dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.22:
ete trayodashAkArAH pRRithaksatyaikalakShaNAH |
bhajante satyameveha bRRiMhayanti cha bhArata
shlokas.23:
nAntaH shakyo guNAnAM hi vaktuM satyasya bhArata |
ataH satyaM prasha.nsanti viprAH sapitRRidevatAH
shlokas.24:
nAsti satyAtparo dharmo nAnRRitAtpAtakaM param |
sthitirhi satyaM dharmasya tasmAtsatyaM na lopayet
shlokas.25:
upaiti satyAddAnaM hi tathA yaj~nAH sadakShiNAH |
vratAgnihotraM vedAshcha ye chAnye dharmanishchayAH
shlokas.26:
ashvamedhasahasraM cha satyaM cha tulayA dhRRitam |
ashvamedhasahasrAddhi satyamevAtirichyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yataH prabhavati krodhaH kAmashcha bharatarShabha |
shokamohau vivitsA cha parAsutvaM tathA madaH
shlokas.2:
lobho mAtsaryamIrShyA cha kutsAsUyA kRRipA tathA |
etatsarvaM mahAprAj~na yAthAtathyena me vada
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
trayodashaite.atibalAH shatravaH prANinAM smRRitAH |
upAsate mahArAja samastAH puruShAniha
shlokas.4:
ete pramattaM puruShamapramattA nudanti hi |
vRRikA iva vilumpanti dRRiShTvaiva puruShetarAn
shlokas.5:
ebhyaH pravartate duHkhamebhyaH pApaM pravartate |
iti martyo vijAnIyAtsatataM bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
eteShAmudayaM sthAnaM kShayaM cha puruShottama |
hanta te vartayiShyAmi tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.7:
lobhAtkrodhaH prabhavati paradoShairudIryate |
kShamayA tiShThate rAja~nshrImA.nshcha vinivartate
shlokas.8:
sa~NkalpAjjAyate kAmaH sevyamAno vivardhate |
avadyadarshanAdvyeti tattvaj~nAnAchcha dhImatAm
shlokas.9:
viruddhAni hi shAstrANi pashyantIhAlpabuddhayaH |
vivitsA jAyate tatra tattvaj~nAnAnnivartate
shlokas.10:
prIteH shokaH prabhavati viyogAttasya dehinaH |
yadA nirarthakaM vetti tadA sadyaH praNashyati
shlokas.11:
parAsutA krodhalobhAdabhyAsAchcha pravartate |
dayayA sarvabhUtAnAM nirvedAtsA nivartate
shlokas.12:
sattvatyAgAttu mAtsaryamahitAni cha sevate |
etattu kShIyate tAta sAdhUnAmupasevanAt
shlokas.13:
kulAjj~nAnAttathaishvaryAnmado bhavati dehinAm |
ebhireva tu vij~nAtairmadaH sadyaH praNashyati
shlokas.14:
IrShyA kAmAtprabhavati sa~NgharShAchchaiva bhArata |
itareShAM tu martyAnAM praj~nayA sA praNashyati
shlokas.15:
vibhramAllokabAhyAnAM dveShyairvAkyairasa~NgataiH |
kutsA sa~njAyate rAjannupekShAbhiH prashAmyati
shlokas.16:
pratikartumashakyAya balasthAyApakAriNe |
asUyA jAyate tIvrA kAruNyAdvinivartate
shlokas.17:
kRRipaNAnsatataM dRRiShTvA tataH sa~njAyate kRRipA |
dharmaniShThAM yadA vetti tadA shAmyati sA kRRipA
shlokas.18:
etAnyeva jitAnyAhuH prashamAchcha trayodasha |
ete hi dhArtarAShTrANAM sarve doShAstrayodasha
tvayA sarvAtmanA nityaM vijitA jeShyase cha tAn

shlokas.1:
