yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AnRRisha.nsyaM vijAnAmi darshanena satAM sadA |
nRRisha.nsAnna vijAnAmi teShAM karma cha bhArata
shlokas.2:
kaNTakAnkUpamagniM cha varjayanti yathA narAH |
tathA nRRisha.nsakarmANaM varjayanti narA naram
shlokas.3:
nRRisha.nso hyadhamo nityaM pretya cheha cha bhArata |
tasmAdbravIhi kauravya tasya dharmavinishchayam
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
spRRihAsyAntarhitA chaiva viditArthA cha karmaNA |
AkroShTA krushyate chaiva bandhitA badhyate cha yaH
shlokas.5:
dattAnukIrtirviShamaH kShudro naikRRitikaH shaThaH |
asambhogI cha mAnI cha tathA sa~NgI vikatthanaH
shlokas.6:
sarvAtisha~NkI paruSho bAlishaH kRRipaNastathA |
vargaprasha.nsI satatamAshramadveShasa~NkarI
shlokas.7:
hi.nsAvihArI satatamavisheShaguNAguNaH |
bahvalIko manasvI cha lubdho.atyarthaM nRRisha.nsakRRit
shlokas.8:
dharmashIlaM guNopetaM pApa ityavagachChati |
AtmashIlAnumAnena na vishvasiti kasyachit
shlokas.9:
pareShAM yatra doShaH syAttadguhyaM samprakAshayet |
samAneShveva doSheShu vRRittyarthamupaghAtayet
shlokas.10:
tathopakAriNaM chaiva manyate va~nchitaM param |
dattvApi cha dhanaM kAle santapatyupakAriNe
shlokas.11:
bhakShyaM bhojyamatho lehyaM yachchAnyatsAdhu bhojanam |
prekShamANeShu yo.ashnIyAnnRRisha.nsa iti taM viduH
shlokas.12:
brAhmaNebhyaH pradAyAgraM yaH suhRRidbhiH sahAshnute |
sa pretya labhate svargamiha chAnantyamashnute
shlokas.13:
eSha te bharatashreShTha nRRisha.nsaH parikIrtitaH |
sadA vivarjanIyo vai puruSheNa bubhUShatA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kRRitArtho yakShyamANashcha sarvavedAntagashcha yaH |
AchAryapitRRibhAryArthaM svAdhyAyArthamathApi vA
shlokas.2:
ete vai sAdhavo dRRiShTA brAhmaNA dharmabhikShavaH |
asvebhyo deyametebhyo dAnaM vidyAvisheShataH
shlokas.3:
anyatra dakShiNA yA tu deyA bharatasattama |
anyebhyo hi bahirvedyAM nAkRRitAnnaM vidhIyate
shlokas.4:
sarvaratnAni rAjA cha yathArhaM pratipAdayet |
brAhmaNAshchaiva yaj~nAshcha sahAnnAH sahadakShiNAH
shlokas.5:
yasya traivArShikaM bhaktaM paryAptaM bhRRityavRRittaye |
adhikaM vApi vidyeta sa somaM pAtumarhati
shlokas.6:
yaj~nashchetpratividdhaH syAda~Ngenaikena yajvanaH |
brAhmaNasya visheSheNa dhArmike sati rAjani
shlokas.7:
yo vaishyaH syAdbahupashurhInakraturasomapaH |
kuTumbAttasya taddravyaM yaj~nArthaM pArthivo haret
shlokas.8:
AharedveshmataH ki~nchitkAmaM shUdrasya dravyataH |
na hi veshmani shUdrasya kashchidasti parigrahaH
shlokas.9:
yo.anAhitAgniH shatagurayajvA cha sahasraguH |
tayorapi kuTumbAbhyAmAharedavichArayan
shlokas.10:
adAtRRibhyo harennityaM vyAkhyApya nRRipatiH prabho |
tathA hyAcharato dharmo nRRipateH syAdathAkhilaH
shlokas.11:
tathaiva saptame bhakte bhaktAni ShaDanashnatA |
ashvastanavidhAnena hartavyaM hInakarmaNaH
khalAtkShetrAttathAgArAdyato vApyupapadyate
shlokas.12:
AkhyAtavyaM nRRipasyaitatpRRichChato.apRRichChato.api vA |
na tasmai dhArayeddaNDaM rAjA dharmeNa dharmavit
shlokas.13:
kShatriyasya hi bAlishyAdbrAhmaNaH klishyate kShudhA |
shrutashIle samAj~nAya vRRittimasya prakalpayet
athainaM parirakSheta pitA putramivaurasam
shlokas.14:
iShTiM vaishvAnarIM nityaM nirvapedabdaparyaye |
avikalpaH purAdharmo dharmavAdaistu kevalam
shlokas.15:
vishvaistu devaiH sAdhyaishcha brAhmaNaishcha maharShibhiH |
Apatsu maraNAdbhItairli~NgapratinidhiH kRRitaH
shlokas.16:
prabhuH prathamakalpasya yo.anukalpena vartate |
na sAmparAyikaM tasya durmatervidyate phalam
shlokas.17:
na brAhmaNAnvedayeta kashchidrAjani mAnavaH |
avIryo vedanAdvidyAtsuvIryo vIryavattaram
shlokas.18:
tasmAdrAj~nA sadA tejo duHsahaM brahmavAdinAm |
mantA shAstA vidhAtA cha brAhmaNo deva uchyate
tasminnAkushalaM brUyAnna shuktAmIrayedgiram
shlokas.19:
kShatriyo bAhuvIryeNa taratyApadamAtmanaH |
dhanena vaishyaH shUdrashcha mantrairhomaishcha vai dvijaH
shlokas.20:
na vai kanyA na yuvatirnAmantro na cha bAlishaH |
pariveShTAgnihotrasya bhavennAsa.nskRRitastathA
narake nipatantyete juhvAnAH sa cha yasya tat
shlokas.21:
prAjApatyamadattvAshvamagnyAdheyasya dakShiNAm |
anAhitAgniriti sa prochyate dharmadarshibhiH
shlokas.22:
puNyAnyanyAni kurvIta shraddadhAno jitendriyaH |
anAptadakShiNairyaj~nairna yajeta katha~nchana
shlokas.23:
prajAH pashU.nshcha svargaM cha hanti yaj~no hyadakShiNaH |
indriyANi yashaH kIrtimAyushchAsyopakRRintati
shlokas.24:
udakyA hyAsate ye cha ye cha kechidanagnayaH |
kulaM chAshrotriyaM yeShAM sarve te shUdradharmiNaH
shlokas.25:
udapAnodake grAme brAhmaNo vRRiShalIpatiH |
uShitvA dvAdasha samAH shUdrakarmeha gachChati
shlokas.26:
anAryAM shayane bibhradujjhanbibhrachcha yo dvijAm |
abrAhmaNo manyamAnastRRiNeShvAsIta pRRiShThataH
tathA sa shudhyate rAja~nshRRiNu chAtra vacho mama
shlokas.27:
yadekarAtreNa karoti pApaM; kRRiShNaM varNaM brAhmaNaH sevamAnaH |
sthAnAsanAbhyAM vicharanvratI saM;stribhirvarShaiH shamayedAtmapApam
shlokas.28:
na narmayuktaM vachanaM hinasti; na strIShu rAjanna vivAhakAle |
na gurvarthe nAtmano jIvitArthe; pa~nchAnRRitAnyAhurapAtakAni
shlokas.29:
shraddadhAnaH shubhAM vidyAM hInAdapi samAcharet |
suvarNamapi chAmedhyAdAdadIteti dhAraNA
shlokas.30:
strIratnaM duShkulAchchApi viShAdapyamRRitaM pibet |
aduShTA hi striyo ratnamApa ityeva dharmataH
shlokas.31:
gobrAhmaNahitArthaM cha varNAnAM sa~NkareShu cha |
gRRihNIyAttu dhanurvaishyaH paritrANAya chAtmanaH
shlokas.32:
surApAnaM brahmahatyA gurutalpamathApi vA |
anirdeshyAni manyante prANAntAnIti dhAraNA
shlokas.33:
suvarNaharaNaM stainyaM viprAsa~Ngashcha pAtakam |
viharanmadyapAnaM chApyagamyAgamanaM tathA
shlokas.34:
patitaiH samprayogAchcha brAhmaNairyonitastathA |
achireNa mahArAja tAdRRisho vai bhavatyuta
shlokas.35:
sa.nvatsareNa patati patitena sahAcharan |
yAjanAdhyApanAdyaunAnna tu yAnAsanAshanAt
shlokas.36:
etAni cha tato.anyAni nirdeshyAnIti dhAraNA |
nirdeshyakena vidhinA kAlenAvyasanI bhavet
shlokas.37:
annaM tirya~Nna hotavyaM pretakarmaNyapAtite |
triShu tveteShu pUrveShu na kurvIta vichAraNAm
shlokas.38:
amAtyAnvA gurUnvApi jahyAddharmeNa dhArmikaH |
prAyashchittamakurvANairnaitairarhati sa.nvidam
shlokas.39:
adharmakArI dharmeNa tapasA hanti kilbiSham |
bruvanstena iti stenaM tAvatprApnoti kilbiSham
astenaM stena ityuktvA dviguNaM pApamApnuyAt
shlokas.40:
tribhAgaM brahmahatyAyAH kanyA prApnoti duShyatI |
yastu dUShayitA tasyAH sheShaM prApnoti kilbiSham
shlokas.41:
brAhmaNAyAvagUryeha spRRiShTvA gurutaraM bhavet |
varShANAM hi shataM pApaH pratiShThAM nAdhigachChati
shlokas.42:
sahasraM tveva varShANAM nipAtya narake vaset |
tasmAnnaivAvagUryAddhi naiva jAtu nipAtayet
shlokas.43:
shoNitaM yAvataH pA.nsUnsa~NgRRihNIyAddvijakShatAt |
tAvatIH sa samA rAjannarake parivartate
shlokas.44:
bhrUNahAhavamadhye tu shudhyate shastrapAtitaH |
AtmAnaM juhuyAdvahnau samiddhe tena shudhyati
shlokas.45:
surApo vAruNImuShNAM pItvA pApAdvimuchyate |
tayA sa kAye nirdagdhe mRRityunA pretya shudhyati
lokA.nshcha labhate vipro nAnyathA labhate hi saH
shlokas.46:
gurutalpamadhiShThAya durAtmA pApachetanaH |
sUrmIM jvalantImAshliShya mRRityunA sa vishudhyati
shlokas.47:
atha vA shishnavRRiShaNAvAdAyA~njalinA svayam |
nairRRitIM dishamAsthAya nipatetsa tvajihmagaH
shlokas.48:
brAhmaNArthe.api vA prANAnsantyajettena shudhyati |
ashvamedhena vApIShTvA gomedhenApi vA punaH
agniShTomena vA samyagiha pretya cha pUyate
shlokas.49:
tathaiva dvAdasha samAH kapAlI brahmahA bhavet |
brahmachArI charedbhaikShaM svakarmodAharanmuniH
shlokas.50:
evaM vA tapasA yukto brahmahA savanI bhavet |
evaM vA garbhamaj~nAtA chAtreyIM yo.abhigachChati
dviguNA brahmahatyA vai AtreyIvyasane bhavet
shlokas.51:
surApo niyatAhAro brahmachArI kShamAcharaH |
UrdhvaM tribhyo.atha varShebhyo yajetAgniShTutA param
RRiShabhaikasahasraM gA dattvA shubhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.52:
vaishyaM hatvA tu varShe dve RRiShabhaikashatAshcha gAH |
shUdraM hatvAbdamevaikamRRiShabhaikAdashAshcha gAH
shlokas.53:
shvabarbarakharAnhatvA shaudrameva vrataM charet |
mArjArachAShamaNDUkAnkAkaM bhAsaM cha mUShakam
shlokas.54:
uktaH pashusamo dharmo rAjanprANinipAtanAt |
prAyashchittAnyathAnyAni pravakShyAmyanupUrvashaH
shlokas.55:
talpe chAnyasya chaurye cha pRRithaksa.nvatsaraM charet |
trINi shrotriyabhAryAyAM paradAre tu dve smRRite
shlokas.56:
kAle chaturthe bhu~njAno brahmachArI vratI bhavet |
sthAnAsanAbhyAM viharettrirahno.abhyuditAdapaH
evameva nirAchAnto yashchAgnInapavidhyati
shlokas.57:
tyajatyakAraNe yashcha pitaraM mAtaraM tathA |
patitaH syAtsa kauravya tathA dharmeShu nishchayaH
shlokas.58:
grAsAchChAdanamatyarthaM dadyAditi nidarshanam |
bhAryAyAM vyabhichAriNyAM niruddhAyAM visheShataH
yatpu.nsAM paradAreShu tachchainAM chArayedvratam
shlokas.59:
shreyA.nsaM shayane hitvA yA pApIyA.nsamRRichChati |
shvabhistAM khAdayedrAjA sa.nsthAne bahusa.nvRRite
shlokas.60:
pumA.nsaM bandhayetprAj~naH shayane tapta Ayase |
apyAdadhIta dArUNi tatra dahyeta pApakRRit
shlokas.61:
eSha daNDo mahArAja strINAM bhartRRivyatikrame |
sa.nvatsarAbhishastasya duShTasya dviguNo bhavet
shlokas.62:
dve tasya trINi varShANi chatvAri sahasevinaH |
kucharaH pa~ncha varShANi charedbhaikShaM munivrataH
shlokas.63:
parivittiH parivettA yayA cha parividyate |
pANigrAhashcha dharmeNa sarve te patitAH smRRitAH
shlokas.64:
chareyuH sarva evaite vIrahA yadvrataM charet |
chAndrAyaNaM charenmAsaM kRRichChraM vA pApashuddhaye
shlokas.65:
parivettA prayachCheta parivittAya tAM snuShAm |
jyeShThena tvabhyanuj~nAto yavIyAnpratyanantaram
enaso mokShamApnoti sA cha tau chaiva dharmataH
shlokas.66:
amAnuShIShu govarjamanAvRRiShTirna duShyati |
adhiShThAtAramattAraM pashUnAM puruShaM viduH
shlokas.67:
paridhAyordhvavAlaM tu pAtramAdAya mRRinmayam |
charetsapta gRRihAnbhaikShaM svakarma parikIrtayan
shlokas.68:
tatraiva labdhabhojI syAddvAdashAhAtsa shudhyati |
charetsa.nvatsaraM chApi tadvrataM yannirAkRRiti
shlokas.69:
bhavettu mAnuSheShvevaM prAyashchittamanuttamam |
dAnaM vAdAnasakteShu sarvameva prakalpayet
anAstikeShu gomAtraM prANamekaM prachakShate
shlokas.70:
shvavarAhamanuShyANAM kukkuTasya kharasya cha |
mA.nsaM mUtrapurIShaM cha prAshya sa.nskAramarhati
shlokas.71:
brAhmaNasya surApasya gandhamAghrAya somapaH |
apastryahaM pibeduShNAstryahamuShNaM payaH pibet
tryahamuShNaM ghRRitaM pItvA vAyubhakSho bhavettryaham
shlokas.72:
evametatsamuddiShTaM prAyashchittaM sanAtanam |
brAhmaNasya visheSheNa tattvaj~nAnena jAyate

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kathAntaramathAsAdya khaDgayuddhavishAradaH |
nakulaH sharatalpasthamidamAha pitAmaham
shlokas.2:
dhanuH praharaNaM shreShThamiti vAdaH pitAmaha |
matastu mama dharmaj~na khaDga eva susa.nshitaH
shlokas.3:
vishIrNe kArmuke rAjanprakShINeShu cha vAjiShu |
khaDgena shakyate yuddhe sAdhvAtmA parirakShitum
shlokas.4:
sharAsanadharA.nshchaiva gadAshaktidharA.nstathA |
ekaH khaDgadharo vIraH samarthaH pratibAdhitum
shlokas.5:
atra me sa.nshayashchaiva kautUhalamatIva cha |
kiM svitpraharaNaM shreShThaM sarvayuddheShu pArthiva
shlokas.6:
kathaM chotpAditaH khaDgaH kasyArthAya cha kena vA |
pUrvAchAryaM cha khaDgasya prabrUhi prapitAmaha
shlokas.7:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA mAdrIputrasya dhImataH |
sarvakaushalasa.nyuktaM sUkShmachitrArthavachChubham
shlokas.8:
tatastasyottaraM vAkyaM svaravarNopapAditam |
shikShAnyAyopasampannaM droNashiShyAya pRRichChate
shlokas.9:
uvAcha sarvadharmaj~no dhanurvedasya pAragaH |
sharatalpagato bhIShmo nakulAya mahAtmane
shlokas.10:
tattvaM shRRiNuShva mAdreya yadetatparipRRichChasi |
prabodhito.asmi bhavatA dhAtumAniva parvataH
shlokas.11:
salilaikArNavaM tAta purA sarvamabhUdidam |
niShprakampamanAkAshamanirdeshyamahItalam
shlokas.12:
tamaHsa.nvRRitamasparshamatigambhIradarshanam |
niHshabdaM chAprameyaM cha tatra jaj~ne pitAmahaH
shlokas.13:
so.asRRijadvAyumagniM cha bhAskaraM chApi vIryavAn |
AkAshamasRRijachchordhvamadho bhUmiM cha nairRRitim
shlokas.14:
nabhaH sachandratAraM cha nakShatrANi grahA.nstathA |
sa.nvatsarAnahorAtrAnRRitUnatha lavAnkShaNAn
shlokas.15:
tataH sharIraM lokasthaM sthApayitvA pitAmahaH |
janayAmAsa bhagavAnputrAnuttamatejasaH
shlokas.16:
marIchimRRiShimatriM cha pulastyaM pulahaM kratum |
vasiShThA~Ngirasau chobhau rudraM cha prabhumIshvaram
shlokas.17:
prAchetasastathA dakShaH kanyAH ShaShTimajIjanat |
tA vai brahmarShayaH sarvAH prajArthaM pratipedire
shlokas.18:
tAbhyo vishvAni bhUtAni devAH pitRRigaNAstathA |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva rakShA.nsi vividhAni cha
shlokas.19:
patatrimRRigamInAshcha plava~NgAshcha mahoragAH |
nAnAkRRitibalAshchAnye jalakShitivichAriNaH
shlokas.20:
audbhidAH svedajAshchaiva aNDajAshcha jarAyujAH |
jaj~ne tAta tathA sarvaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.21:
bhUtasargamimaM kRRitvA sarvalokapitAmahaH |
shAshvataM vedapaThitaM dharmaM cha yuyuje punaH
shlokas.22:
tasmindharme sthitA devAH sahAchAryapurohitAH |
AdityA vasavo rudrAH sasAdhyA marudashvinaH
shlokas.23:
bhRRigvatrya~NgirasaH siddhAH kAshyapashcha tapodhanaH |
vasiShThagautamAgastyAstathA nAradaparvatau
shlokas.24:
RRiShayo vAlakhilyAshcha prabhAsAH sikatAstathA |
ghRRitAchAH somavAyavyA vaikhAnasamarIchipAH
shlokas.25:
akRRiShTAshchaiva ha.nsAshcha RRiShayo.athAgniyonijAH |
vAnaprasthAH pRRishnayashcha sthitA brahmAnushAsane
shlokas.26:
dAnavendrAstvatikramya tatpitAmahashAsanam |
dharmasyApachayaM chakruH krodhalobhasamanvitAH
shlokas.27:
hiraNyakashipushchaiva hiraNyAkSho virochanaH |
shambaro viprachittishcha prahrAdo namuchirbaliH
shlokas.28:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH sagaNA daityadAnavAH |
dharmasetumatikramya remire.adharmanishchayAH
shlokas.29:
sarve sma tulyajAtIyA yathA devAstathA vayam |
ityevaM hetumAsthAya spardhamAnAH surarShibhiH
shlokas.30:
na priyaM nApyanukroshaM chakrurbhUteShu bhArata |
trInupAyAnatikramya daNDena rurudhuH prajAH
na jagmuH sa.nvidaM taishcha darpAdasurasattamAH
shlokas.31:
atha vai bhagavAnbrahmA brahmarShibhirupasthitaH |
tadA himavataH pRRiShThe suramye padmatArake
shlokas.32:
shatayojanavistAre maNimuktAchayAchite |
tasmingirivare putra puShpitadrumakAnane
tasthau sa vibudhashreShTho brahmA lokArthasiddhaye
shlokas.33:
tato varShasahasrAnte vitAnamakarotprabhuH |
vidhinA kalpadRRiShTena yathoktenopapAditam
shlokas.34:
RRiShibhiryaj~napaTubhiryathAvatkarmakartRRibhiH |
marudbhiH parisa.nstIrNaM dIpyamAnaishcha pAvakaiH
shlokas.35:
kA~nchanairyaj~nabhANDaishcha bhrAjiShNubhirala~NkRRitam |
vRRitaM devagaNaishchaiva prababhau yaj~namaNDalam
shlokas.36:
tathA brahmarShibhishchaiva sadasyairupashobhitam |
tatra ghoratamaM vRRittamRRiShINAM me parishrutam
shlokas.37:
chandramA vimalaM vyoma yathAbhyuditatArakam |
vidAryAgniM tathA bhUtamutthitaM shrUyate tataH
shlokas.38:
nIlotpalasavarNAbhaM tIkShNadaMShTraM kRRishodaram |
prA.nshu durdarshanaM chaivApyatitejastathaiva cha
shlokas.39:
tasminnutpatamAne cha prachachAla vasundharA |
tatrormikalilAvartashchukShubhe cha mahArNavaH
shlokas.40:
peturulkA mahotpAtAH shAkhAshcha mumuchurdrumAH |
aprasannA dishaH sarvAH pavanashchAshivo vavau
muhurmuhushcha bhUtAni prAvyathanta bhayAttathA
shlokas.41:
tataH sutumulaM dRRiShTvA tadadbhutamupasthitam |
maharShisuragandharvAnuvAchedaM pitAmahaH
shlokas.42:
mayaitachchintitaM bhUtamasirnAmaiSha vIryavAn |
rakShaNArthAya lokasya vadhAya cha suradviShAm
shlokas.43:
tatastadrUpamutsRRijya babhau nistri.nsha eva saH |
vimalastIkShNadhArashcha kAlAntaka ivodyataH
shlokas.44:
tatastaM shitikaNThAya rudrAyarShabhaketave |
brahmA dadAvasiM dIptamadharmaprativAraNam
shlokas.45:
tataH sa bhagavAnrudro brahmarShigaNasa.nstutaH |
pragRRihyAsimameyAtmA rUpamanyachchakAra ha
shlokas.46:
chaturbAhuH spRRishanmUrdhnA bhUsthito.api nabhastalam |
UrdhvadRRiShTirmahAli~Ngo mukhAjjvAlAH samutsRRijan
vikurvanbahudhA varNAnnIlapANDuralohitAn
shlokas.47:
bibhratkRRiShNAjinaM vAso hemapravaratArakam |
netraM chaikaM lalATena bhAskarapratimaM mahat
shushubhAte cha vimale dve netre kRRiShNapi~Ngale
shlokas.48:
tato devo mahAdevaH shUlapANirbhagAkShihA |
sampragRRihya tu nistri.nshaM kAlArkAnalasaMnibham
shlokas.49:
trikUTaM charma chodyamya savidyutamivAmbudam |
chachAra vividhAnmArgAnmahAbalaparAkramaH
vidhunvannasimAkAshe dAnavAntachikIrShayA
shlokas.50:
tasya nAdaM vinadato mahAhAsaM cha mu~nchataH |
babhau pratibhayaM rUpaM tadA rudrasya bhArata
shlokas.51:
tadrUpadhAriNaM rudraM raudrakarma chikIrShavaH |
nishamya dAnavAH sarve hRRiShTAH samabhidudruvuH
shlokas.52:
ashmabhishchApyavarShanta pradIptaishcha tatholmukaiH |
ghoraiH praharaNaishchAnyaiH shitadhArairayomukhaiH
shlokas.53:
tatastaddAnavAnIkaM sampraNetAramachyutam |
rudrakhaDgabaloddhUtaM prachachAla mumoha cha
shlokas.54:
chitraM shIghrataratvAchcha charantamasidhAriNam |
tamekamasurAH sarve sahasramiti menire
shlokas.55:
ChindanbhindanrujankRRintandArayanpramathannapi |
acharaddaityasa~NgheShu rudro.agniriva kakShagaH
shlokas.56:
asivegaprarugNAste ChinnabAhUruvakShasaH |
samprakRRittottamA~NgAshcha petururvyAM mahAsurAH
shlokas.57:
apare dAnavA bhagnA rudraghAtAvapIDitAH |
anyonyamabhinardanto dishaH sampratipedire
shlokas.58:
bhUmiM kechitpravivishuH parvatAnapare tathA |
apare jagmurAkAshamapare.ambhaH samAvishan
shlokas.59:
tasminmahati sa.nvRRitte samare bhRRishadAruNe |
babhau bhUmiH pratibhayA tadA rudhirakardamA
shlokas.60:
dAnavAnAM sharIraishcha mahadbhiH shoNitokShitaiH |
samAkIrNA mahAbAho shailairiva saki.nshukaiH
shlokas.61:
rudhireNa pariklinnA prababhau vasudhA tadA |
raktArdravasanA shyAmA nArIva madavihvalA
shlokas.62:
sa rudro dAnavAnhatvA kRRitvA dharmottaraM jagat |
raudraM rUpaM vihAyAshu chakre rUpaM shivaM shivaH
shlokas.63:
tato maharShayaH sarve sarve devagaNAstathA |
jayenAdbhutakalpena devadevamathArchayan
shlokas.64:
tataH sa bhagavAnrudro dAnavakShatajokShitam |
asiM dharmasya goptAraM dadau satkRRitya viShNave
shlokas.65:
viShNurmarIchaye prAdAnmarIchirbhagavA.nshcha tam |
maharShibhyo dadau khaDgamRRiShayo vAsavAya tu
shlokas.66:
mahendro lokapAlebhyo lokapAlAstu putraka |
manave sUryaputrAya daduH khaDgaM suvistaram
shlokas.67:
UchushchainaM tathaivAdyaM mAnuShANAM tvamIshvaraH |
asinA dharmagarbheNa pAlayasva prajA iti
shlokas.68:
dharmasetumatikrAntAH sUkShmasthUlArthakAraNAt |
vibhajya daNDaM rakShyAH syurdharmato na yadRRichChayA
shlokas.69:
durvAchA nigraho daNDo hiraNyabahulastathA |
vya~NganaM cha sharIrasya vadho vAnalpakAraNAt
shlokas.70:
aseretAni rUpANi durvAchAdIni nirdishet |
asereva pramANAni parimANavyatikramAt
shlokas.71:
adhisRRijyAtha putraM svaM prajAnAmadhipaM tataH |
manuH prajAnAM rakShArthaM kShupAya pradadAvasim
shlokas.72:
kShupAjjagrAha chekShvAkurikShvAkoshcha purUravAH |
Ayushcha tasmAllebhe taM nahuShashcha tato bhuvi
shlokas.73:
yayAtirnahuShAchchApi pUrustasmAchcha labdhavAn |
AmUrtarayasastasmAttato bhUmishayo nRRipaH
shlokas.74:
bharatashchApi dauHShantirlebhe bhUmishayAdasim |
tasmAchcha lebhe dharmaj~no rAjannaiDabiDastathA
shlokas.75:
tatashchaiDabiDAllebhe dhundhumAro janeshvaraH |
dhundhumArAchcha kAmbojo muchukundastato.alabhat
shlokas.76:
muchukundAnmaruttashcha maruttAdapi raivataH |
raivatAdyuvanAshvashcha yuvanAshvAttato raghuH
shlokas.77:
ikShvAkuva.nshajastasmAddhariNAshvaH pratApavAn |
hariNAshvAdasiM lebhe shunakaH shunakAdapi
shlokas.78:
ushInaro vai dharmAtmA tasmAdbhojAH sayAdavAH |
yadubhyashcha shibirlebhe shibeshchApi pratardanaH
shlokas.79:
pratardanAdaShTakashcha rushadashvo.aShTakAdapi |
rushadashvAdbharadvAjo droNastasmAtkRRipastataH
tatastvaM bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM paramAsimavAptavAn
shlokas.80:
kRRittikAshchAsya nakShatramaseragnishcha daivatam |
rohiNyo gotramasyAtha rudrashcha gururuttamaH
shlokas.81:
aseraShTau cha nAmAni rahasyAni nibodha me |
pANDaveya sadA yAni kIrtaya.Nllabhate jayam
shlokas.82:
asirvishasanaH khaDgastIkShNavartmA durAsadaH |
shrIgarbho vijayashchaiva dharmapAlastathaiva cha
shlokas.83:
agryaH praharaNAnAM cha khaDgo mAdravatIsuta |
maheshvarapraNItashcha purANe nishchayaM gataH
shlokas.84:
pRRithustUtpAdayAmAsa dhanurAdyamari.ndama |
teneyaM pRRithivI pUrvaM vainyena parirakShitA
shlokas.85:
tadetadArShaM mAdreya pramANaM kartumarhasi |
aseshcha pUjA kartavyA sadA yuddhavishAradaiH
shlokas.86:
ityeSha prathamaH kalpo vyAkhyAtaste suvistaraH |
aserutpattisa.nsargo yathAvadbharatarShabha
shlokas.87:
sarvathaitadiha shrutvA khaDgasAdhanamuttamam |
labhate puruShaH kIrtiM pretya chAnantyamashnute

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktavati bhIShme tu tUShNImbhUte yudhiShThiraH |
paprachChAvasaraM gatvA bhrAtR^Invidurapa~nchamAn
shlokas.2:
dharme chArthe cha kAme cha lokavRRittiH samAhitA |
teShAM garIyAnkatamo madhyamaH ko laghushcha kaH
shlokas.3:
kasmi.nshchAtmA niyantavyastrivargavijayAya vai |
santuShTA naiShThikaM vAkyaM yathAvadvaktumarhatha
shlokas.4:
tato.arthagatitattvaj~naH prathamaM pratibhAnavAn |
jagAda viduro vAkyaM dharmashAstramanusmaran
shlokas.5:
bAhushrutyaM tapastyAgaH shraddhA yaj~nakriyA kShamA |
bhAvashuddhirdayA satyaM sa.nyamashchAtmasampadaH
shlokas.6:
etadevAbhipadyasva mA te bhUchchalitaM manaH |
etanmUlau hi dharmArthAvetadekapadaM hitam
shlokas.7:
dharmeNaivarShayastIrNA dharme lokAH pratiShThitAH |
dharmeNa devA divigA dharme chArthaH samAhitaH
shlokas.8:
dharmo rAjanguNashreShTho madhyamo hyartha uchyate |
kAmo yavIyAniti cha pravadanti manIShiNaH
tasmAddharmapradhAnena bhavitavyaM yatAtmanA
shlokas.9:
samAptavachane tasminnarthashAstravishAradaH |
pArtho vAkyArthatattvaj~no jagau vAkyamatandritaH
shlokas.10:
karmabhUmiriyaM rAjanniha vArttA prashasyate |
kRRiShivANijyagorakShyaM shilpAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.11:
artha ityeva sarveShAM karmaNAmavyatikramaH |
na RRite.arthena vartete dharmakAmAviti shrutiH
shlokas.12:
vijayI hyarthavAndharmamArAdhayitumuttamam |
kAmaM cha charituM shakto duShprApamakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.13:
arthasyAvayavAvetau dharmakAmAviti shrutiH |
arthasiddhyA hi nirvRRittAvubhAvetau bhaviShyataH
shlokas.14:
udbhUtArthaM hi puruShaM vishiShTatarayonayaH |
brahmANamiva bhUtAni satataM paryupAsate
shlokas.15:
jaTAjinadharA dAntAH pa~NkadigdhA jitendriyAH |
muNDA nistantavashchApi vasantyarthArthinaH pRRithak
shlokas.16:
kAShAyavasanAshchAnye shmashrulA hrIsusa.nvRRitAH |
vidvA.nsashchaiva shAntAshcha muktAH sarvaparigrahaiH
shlokas.17:
arthArthinaH santi kechidapare svargakA~NkShiNaH |
kulapratyAgamAshchaike svaM svaM mArgamanuShThitAH
shlokas.18:
AstikA nAstikAshchaiva niyatAH sa.nyame pare |
apraj~nAnaM tamobhUtaM praj~nAnaM tu prakAshatA
shlokas.19:
bhRRityAnbhogairdviSho daNDairyo yojayati so.arthavAn |
etanmatimatAM shreShTha mataM mama yathAtatham
anayostu nibodha tvaM vachanaM vAkyakaNThayoH
shlokas.20:
tato dharmArthakushalau mAdrIputrAvanantaram |
nakulaH sahadevashcha vAkyaM jagadatuH param
shlokas.21:
AsInashcha shayAnashcha vicharannapi cha sthitaH |
arthayogaM dRRiDhaM kuryAdyogairuchchAvachairapi
shlokas.22:
asmi.nstu vai susa.nvRRitte durlabhe paramapriye |
iha kAmAnavApnoti pratyakShaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
yo.artho dharmeNa sa.nyukto dharmo yashchArthasa.nyutaH |
madhvivAmRRitasa.nyuktaM tasmAdetau matAviha
shlokas.24:
anarthasya na kAmo.asti tathArtho.adharmiNaH kutaH |
tasmAdudvijate loko dharmArthAdyo bahiShkRRitaH
shlokas.25:
tasmAddharmapradhAnena sAdhyo.arthaH sa.nyatAtmanA |
vishvasteShu cha bhUteShu kalpate sarva eva hi
shlokas.26:
dharmaM samAcharetpUrvaM tathArthaM dharmasa.nyutam |
tataH kAmaM charetpashchAtsiddhArthasya hi tatphalam
shlokas.27:
virematustu tadvAkyamuktvA tAvashvinoH sutau |
bhImasenastadA vAkyamidaM vaktuM prachakrame
shlokas.28:
nAkAmaH kAmayatyarthaM nAkAmo dharmamichChati |
nAkAmaH kAmayAno.asti tasmAtkAmo vishiShyate
shlokas.29:
kAmena yuktA RRiShayastapasyeva samAhitAH |
palAshaphalamUlAshA vAyubhakShAH susa.nyatAH
shlokas.30:
vedopavAdeShvapare yuktAH svAdhyAyapAragAH |
shrAddhayaj~nakriyAyAM cha tathA dAnapratigrahe
shlokas.31:
vaNijaH karShakA gopAH kAravaH shilpinastathA |
daivakarmakRRitashchaiva yuktAH kAmena karmasu
shlokas.32:
samudraM chAvishantyanye narAH kAmena sa.nyutAH |
kAmo hi vividhAkAraH sarvaM kAmena santatam
shlokas.33:
nAsti nAsInnAbhaviShyadbhUtaM kAmAtmakAtparam |
etatsAraM mahArAja dharmArthAvatra sa.nshritau
shlokas.34:
navanItaM yathA dadhnastathA kAmo.arthadharmataH |
shreyastailaM cha piNyAkAddhRRitaM shreya udashvitaH
shlokas.35:
shreyaH puShpaphalaM kAShThAtkAmo dharmArthayorvaraH |
puShpato madhviva rasaH kAmAtsa~njAyate sukham
shlokas.36:
suchAruveShAbhirala~NkRRitAbhi;rmadotkaTAbhiH priyavAdinIbhiH |
ramasva yoShAbhirupetya kAmaM; kAmo hi rAja.nstarasAbhipAtI
shlokas.37:
buddhirmamaiShA pariShatsthitasya; mA bhUdvichArastava dharmaputra |
syAtsaMhitaM sadbhiraphalgusAraM; sametya vAkyaM paramAnRRisha.nsyam
shlokas.38:
dharmArthakAmAH samameva sevyA; yastvekasevI sa naro jaghanyaH |
dvayostu dakShaM pravadanti madhyaM; sa uttamo yo niratastrivarge
shlokas.39:
prAj~naH suhRRichchandanasAralipto; vichitramAlyAbharaNairupetaH |
tato vachaH sa~NgrahavigraheNa; proktvA yavIyAnvirarAma bhImaH
shlokas.40:
tato muhUrtAdatha dharmarAjo; vAkyAni teShAmanuchintya samyak |
uvAcha vAchAvitathaM smayanvai; bahushruto dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH
shlokas.41:
niHsa.nshayaM nishchitadharmashAstrAH; sarve bhavanto viditapramANAH |
vij~nAtukAmasya mameha vAkya;muktaM yadvai naiShThikaM tachChrutaM me
iha tvavashyaM gadato mamApi; vAkyaM nibodhadhvamananyabhAvAH
shlokas.42:
yo vai na pApe nirato na puNye; nArthe na dharme manujo na kAme |
vimuktadoShaH samaloShTakA~nchanaH; sa muchyate duHkhasukhArthasiddheH
shlokas.43:
bhUtAni jAtImaraNAnvitAni; jarAvikAraishcha samanvitAni |
bhUyashcha taistaiH pratibodhitAni; mokShaM prasha.nsanti na taM cha vidmaH
shlokas.44:
snehe nabaddhasya na santi tAnI;tyevaM svayambhUrbhagavAnuvAcha |
budhAshcha nirvANaparA vadanti; tasmAnna kuryAtpriyamapriyaM cha
shlokas.45:
etatpradhAnaM na tu kAmakAro; yathA niyukto.asmi tathA charAmi |
bhUtAni sarvANi vidhirniyu~Nkte; vidhirbalIyAniti vitta sarve
shlokas.46:
na karmaNApnotyanavApyamarthaM; yadbhAvi sarvaM bhavatIti vitta |
trivargahIno.api hi vindate.arthaM; tasmAdidaM lokahitAya guhyam
shlokas.47:
tatastadagryaM vachanaM manonugaM; samastamAj~nAya tato.atihetumat |
tadA praNedushcha jaharShire cha te; kurupravIrAya cha chakrura~njalIn
shlokas.48:
suchAruvarNAkSharashabdabhUShitAM; manonugAM nirdhutavAkyakaNTakAm |
nishamya tAM pArthiva pArthabhAShitAM; giraM narendrAH prashasha.nsureva te
punashcha paprachCha saridvarAsutaM; tataH paraM dharmamahInasattvaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na kurUNAM kIrtivardhana |
prashnaM ka~nchitpravakShyAmi tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.2:
kIdRRishA mAnavAH saumyAH kaiH prItiH paramA bhavet |
AyatyAM cha tadAtve cha ke kShamAstAnvadasva me
shlokas.3:
na hi tatra dhanaM sphItaM na cha sambandhibAndhavAH |
tiShThanti yatra suhRRidastiShThantIti matirmama
shlokas.4:
durlabho hi suhRRichChrotA durlabhashcha hitaH suhRRit |
etaddharmabhRRitAM shreShTha sarvaM vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sandheyAnpuruShAnrAjannasandheyA.nshcha tattvataH |
vadato me nibodha tvaM nikhilena yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
lubdhaH krUrastyaktadharmA nikRRitaH shaTha eva cha |
kShudraH pApasamAchAraH sarvasha~NkI tathAlasaH
shlokas.7:
dIrghasUtro.anRRijuH kaShTo gurudArapradharShakaH |
vyasane yaH parityAgI durAtmA nirapatrapaH
shlokas.8:
sarvataH pApadarshI cha nAstiko vedanindakaH |
samprakIrNendriyo loke yaH kAmaniratashcharet
shlokas.9:
asatyo lokavidviShTaH samaye chAnavasthitaH |
pishuno.athAkRRitapraj~no matsarI pApanishchayaH
shlokas.10:
duHshIlo.athAkRRitAtmA cha nRRisha.nsaH kitavastathA |
mitrairarthakRRitI nityamichChatyarthaparashcha yaH
shlokas.11:
vahatashcha yathAshakti yo na tuShyati mandadhIH |
amitramiva yo bhu~Nkte sadA mitraM nararShabha
shlokas.12:
asthAnakrodhano yashcha akasmAchcha virajyate |
suhRRidashchaiva kalyANAnAshu tyajati kilbiShI
shlokas.13:
alpe.apyapakRRite mUDhastathAj~nAnAtkRRite.api cha |
kAryopasevI mitreShu mitradveShI narAdhipa
shlokas.14:
shatrurmitramukho yashcha jihmaprekShI vilobhanaH |
na rajyati cha kalyANe yastyajettAdRRishaM naram
shlokas.15:
pAnapo dveShaNaH krUro nirghRRiNaH paruShastathA |
paropatApI mitradhruktathA prANivadhe rataH
shlokas.16:
kRRitaghnashchAdhamo loke na sandheyaH katha~nchana |
ChidrAnveShI na sandheyaH sandheyAnapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.17:
kulInA vAkyasampannA j~nAnavij~nAnakovidAH |
mitraj~nAshcha kRRitaj~nAshcha sarvaj~nAH shokavarjitAH
shlokas.18:
mAdhuryaguNasampannAH satyasandhA jitendriyAH |
vyAyAmashIlAH satataM bhRRitaputrAH kulodgatAH
shlokas.19:
rUpavanto guNopetAstathAlubdhA jitashramAH |
doShairviyuktAH prathitaiste grAhyAH pArthivena ha
shlokas.20:
yathAshaktisamAchArAH santastuShyanti hi prabho |
nAsthAne krodhavantashcha na chAkasmAdvirAgiNaH
shlokas.21:
viraktAshcha na ruShyanti manasApyarthakovidAH |
AtmAnaM pIDayitvApi suhRRitkAryaparAyaNAH
na virajyanti mitrebhyo vAso raktamivAvikam
shlokas.22:
doShA.nshcha lobhamohAdInartheShu yuvatiShvatha |
na darshayanti suhRRidAM vishvastA bandhuvatsalAH
shlokas.23:
loShTakA~nchanatulyArthAH suhRRitsvashaThabuddhayaH |
ye charantyanabhImAnA nisRRiShTArthavibhUShaNAH
sa~NgRRihNantaH parijanaM svAmyarthaparamAH sadA
shlokas.24:
IdRRishaiH puruShashreShThaiH sandhiM yaH kurute nRRipaH |
tasya vistIryate rAShTraM jyotsnA grahapateriva
shlokas.25:
shAstranityA jitakrodhA balavanto raNapriyAH |
kShAntAH shIlaguNopetAH sandheyAH puruShottamAH
shlokas.26:
ye cha doShasamAyuktA narAH proktA mayAnagha |
teShAmapyadhamo rAjankRRitaghno mitraghAtakaH
tyaktavyaH sa durAchAraH sarveShAmiti nishchayaH
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vistareNArthasambandhaM shrotumichChAmi pArthiva |
mitradrohI kRRitaghnashcha yaH proktastaM cha me vada
shlokas.28:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta te vartayiShye.ahamitihAsaM purAtanam |
udIchyAM dishi yadvRRittaM mlechCheShu manujAdhipa
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNo madhyadeshIyaH kRRiShNA~Ngo brahmavarjitaH |
grAmaM prekShya janAkIrNaM prAvishadbhaikShakA~NkShayA
shlokas.30:
tatra dasyurdhanayutaH sarvavarNavisheShavit |
brahmaNyaH satyasandhashcha dAne cha nirato.abhavat
shlokas.31:
tasya kShayamupAgamya tato bhikShAmayAchata |
pratishrayaM cha vAsArthaM bhikShAM chaivAtha vArShikIm
shlokas.32:
prAdAttasmai sa viprAya vastraM cha sadRRishaM navam |
nArIM chApi vayopetAM bhartrA virahitAM tadA
shlokas.33:
etatsamprApya hRRiShTAtmA dasyoH sarvaM dvijastadA |
tasmingRRihavare rAja.nstayA reme sa gautamaH
shlokas.34:
kuTumbArtheShu dasyoH sa sAhAyyaM chApyathAkarot |
tatrAvasatso.atha varShAH samRRiddhe shabarAlaye
bANavedhye paraM yatnamakarochchaiva gautamaH
shlokas.35:
vakrA~NgA.nstu sa nityaM vai sarvato bANagochare |
jaghAna gautamo rAjanyathA dasyugaNastathA
shlokas.36:
hi.nsAparo ghRRiNAhInaH sadA prANivadhe rataH |
gautamaH saMnikarSheNa dasyubhiH samatAmiyAt
shlokas.37:
tathA tu vasatastasya dasyugrAme sukhaM tadA |
agachChanbahavo mAsA nighnataH pakShiNo bahUn
shlokas.38:
tataH kadAchidaparo dvijastaM deshamAgamat |
jaTI chIrAjinadharaH svAdhyAyaparamaH shuchiH
shlokas.39:
vinIto niyatAhAro brahmaNyo vedapAragaH |
sabrahmachArI taddeshyaH sakhA tasyaiva supriyam
taM dasyugrAmamagamadyatrAsau gautamo.abhavat
shlokas.40:
sa tu vipragRRihAnveShI shUdrAnnaparivarjakaH |
grAme dasyujanAkIrNe vyacharatsarvatodisham
shlokas.41:
tataH sa gautamagRRihaM pravivesha dvijottamaH |
gautamashchApi samprAptastAvanyonyena sa~Ngatau
shlokas.42:
vakrA~NgabhArahastaM taM dhanuShpANiM kRRitAgasam |
rudhireNAvasiktA~NgaM gRRihadvAramupAgatam
shlokas.43:
taM dRRiShTvA puruShAdAbhamapadhvastaM kShayAgatam |
abhij~nAya dvijo vrIDAmagamadvAkyamAha cha
shlokas.44:
kimidaM kuruShe mauDhyAdviprastvaM hi kulodgataH |
madhyadeshaparij~nAto dasyubhAvaM gataH katham
shlokas.45:
pUrvAnsmara dvijAgryA.nstAnprakhyAtAnvedapAragAn |
yeShAM va.nshe.abhijAtastvamIdRRishaH kulapA.nsanaH
shlokas.46:
avabudhyAtmanAtmAnaM satyaM shIlaM shrutaM damam |
anukroshaM cha sa.nsmRRitya tyaja vAsamimaM dvija
shlokas.47:
evamuktaH sa suhRRidA tadA tena hitaiShiNA |
pratyuvAcha tato rAjanvinishchitya tadArtavat
shlokas.48:
adhano.asmi dvijashreShTha na cha vedavidapyaham |
vRRittyarthamiha samprAptaM viddhi mAM dvijasattama
shlokas.49:
tvaddarshanAttu viprarShe kRRitArthaM vedmyahaM dvija |
AtmAnaM saha yAsyAvaH shvo vasAdyeha sharvarIm

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tasyAM nishAyAM vyuShTAyAM gate tasmindvijottame |
niShkramya gautamo.agachChatsamudraM prati bhArata
shlokas.2:
sAmudrakAnsa vaNijastato.apashyatsthitAnpathi |
sa tena sArthena saha prayayau sAgaraM prati
shlokas.3:
sa tu sArtho mahArAja kasmi.nshchidgirigahvare |
mattena dviradenAtha nihataH prAyasho.abhavat
shlokas.4:
sa katha~nchittatastasmAtsArthAnmukto dvijastadA |
kA.ndigbhUto jIvitArthI pradudrAvottarAM disham
shlokas.5:
sa sarvataH paribhraShTaH sArthAddeshAttathArthataH |
ekAkI vyadravattatra vane kimpuruSho yathA
shlokas.6:
sa panthAnamathAsAdya samudrAbhisaraM tadA |
AsasAda vanaM ramyaM mahatpuShpitapAdapam
shlokas.7:
sarvartukairAmravanaiH puShpitairupashobhitam |
nandanoddeshasadRRishaM yakShakiMnarasevitam
shlokas.8:
shAlatAladhavAshvatthatvachAguruvanaistathA |
chandanasya cha mukhyasya pAdapairupashobhitam
giriprastheShu ramyeShu shubheShu susugandhiShu
shlokas.9:
samantato dvijashreShThA valgu kUjanti tatra vai |
manuShyavadanAstvanye bhAruNDA iti vishrutAH
bhUli~NgashakunAshchAnye samudraM sarvato.abhavan
shlokas.10:
sa tAnyatimanoj~nAni viha~NgAbhirutAni vai |
shRRiNvansuramaNIyAni vipro.agachChata gautamaH
shlokas.11:
tato.apashyatsuramye sa suvarNasikatAchite |
deshabhAge same chitre svargoddeshasamaprabhe
shlokas.12:
shriyA juShTaM mahAvRRikShaM nyagrodhaM parimaNDalam |
shAkhAbhiranurUpAbhirbhUShitaM ChatrasaMnibham
shlokas.13:
tasya mUlaM susa.nsiktaM varachandanavAriNA |
divyapuShpAnvitaM shrImatpitAmahasadopamam
shlokas.14:
taM dRRiShTvA gautamaH prIto munikAntamanuttamam |
medhyaM suragRRihaprakhyaM puShpitaiH pAdapairvRRitam
tamAgamya mudA yuktastasyAdhastAdupAvishat
shlokas.15:
tatrAsInasya kauravya gautamasya sukhaH shivaH |
puShpANi samupaspRRishya pravavAvanilaH shuchiH
hlAdayansarvagAtrANi gautamasya tadA nRRipa
shlokas.16:
sa tu vipraH parishrAntaH spRRiShTaH puNyena vAyunA |
sukhamAsAdya suShvApa bhAskarashchAstamabhyagAt
shlokas.17:
tato.astaM bhAskare yAte sandhyAkAla upasthite |
AjagAma svabhavanaM brahmalokAtkhagottamaH
shlokas.18:
nADIja~Ngha iti khyAto dayito brahmaNaH sakhA |
bakarAjo mahAprAj~naH kashyapasyAtmasambhavaH
shlokas.19:
rAjadharmeti vikhyAto babhUvApratimo bhuvi |
devakanyAsutaH shrImAnvidvAndevapatiprabhaH
shlokas.20:
mRRiShTahATakasa~nChanno bhUShaNairarkasaMnibhaiH |
bhUShitaH sarvagAtreShu devagarbhaH shriyA jvalan
shlokas.21:
tamAgataM dvijaM dRRiShTvA vismito gautamo.abhavat |
kShutpipAsAparItAtmA hi.nsArthI chApyavaikShata
shlokas.22:
rAjadharmovAcha||
svAgataM bhavate vipra diShTyA prApto.asi me gRRiham |
astaM cha savitA yAtaH sandhyeyaM samupasthitA
shlokas.23:
mama tvaM nilayaM prAptaH priyAtithiraninditaH |
pUjito yAsyasi prAtarvidhidRRiShTena karmaNA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
giraM tAM madhurAM shrutvA gautamo vismitastadA |
kautUhalAnvito rAjanrAjadharmANamaikShata
shlokas.2:
rAjadharmovAcha||
bhoH kashyapasya putro.ahaM mAtA dAkShAyaNI cha me |
atithistvaM guNopetaH svAgataM te dvijarShabha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tasmai dattvA sa satkAraM vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
shAlapuShpamayIM divyAM bRRisIM samupakalpayat
shlokas.4:
bhagIratharathAkrAntAndeshAnga~NgAniShevitAn |
ye charanti mahAmInAstA.nshcha tasyAnvakalpayat
shlokas.5:
vahniM chApi susa.ndIptaM mInA.nshchaiva supIvarAn |
sa gautamAyAtithaye nyavedayata kAshyapaH
shlokas.6:
bhuktavantaM cha taM vipraM prItAtmAnaM mahAmanAH |
klamApanayanArthaM sa pakShAbhyAmabhyavIjayat
shlokas.7:
tato vishrAntamAsInaM gotraprashnamapRRichChata |
so.abravIdgautamo.asmIti brAhma nAnyadudAharat
shlokas.8:
tasmai parNamayaM divyaM divyapuShpAdhivAsitam |
gandhADhyaM shayanaM prAdAtsa shishye tatra vai sukham
shlokas.9:
athopaviShTaM shayane gautamaM bakarATtadA |
paprachCha kAshyapo vAgmI kimAgamanakAraNam
shlokas.10:
tato.abravIdgautamastaM daridro.ahaM mahAmate |
samudragamanAkA~NkShI dravyArthamiti bhArata
shlokas.11:
taM kAshyapo.abravItprIto notkaNThAM kartumarhasi |
kRRitakAryo dvijashreShTha sadravyo yAsyase gRRihAn
shlokas.12:
chaturvidhA hyarthagatirbRRihaspatimataM yathA |
pAramparyaM tathA daivaM karma mitramiti prabho
shlokas.13:
prAdurbhUto.asmi te mitraM suhRRittvaM cha mama tvayi |
so.ahaM tathA yatiShyAmi bhaviShyasi yathArthavAn
shlokas.14:
tataH prabhAtasamaye sukhaM pRRiShTvAbravIdidam |
gachCha saumya pathAnena kRRitakRRityo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.15:
itastriyojanaM gatvA rAkShasAdhipatirmahAn |
virUpAkSha iti khyAtaH sakhA mama mahAbalaH
shlokas.16:
taM gachCha dvijamukhya tvaM mama vAkyaprachoditaH |
kAmAnabhIpsitA.nstubhyaM dAtA nAstyatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
ityuktaH prayayau rAjangautamo vigataklamaH |
phalAnyamRRitakalpAni bhakShayansma yatheShTataH
shlokas.18:
chandanAgurumukhyAni tvakpatrANAM vanAni cha |
tasminpathi mahArAja sevamAno drutaM yayau
shlokas.19:
tato meruvrajaM nAma nagaraM shailatoraNam |
shailaprAkAravapraM cha shailayantrArgalaM tathA
shlokas.20:
viditashchAbhavattasya rAkShasendrasya dhImataH |
prahitaH suhRRidA rAjanprIyatA vai priyAtithiH
shlokas.21:
tataH sa rAkShasendraH svAnpreShyAnAha yudhiShThira |
gautamo nagaradvArAchChIghramAnIyatAmiti
shlokas.22:
tataH puravarAttasmAtpuruShAH shvetaveShTanAH |
gautametyabhibhAShantaH puradvAramupAgaman
shlokas.23:
te tamUchurmahArAja preShyA rakShaHpaterdvijam |
tvarasva tUrNamAgachCha rAjA tvAM draShTumichChati
shlokas.24:
rAkShasAdhipatirvIro virUpAkSha iti shrutaH |
sa tvAM tvarati vai draShTuM tatkShipraM sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.25:
tataH sa prAdravadvipro vismayAdvigataklamaH |
gautamo nagararddhiM tAM pashyanparamavismitaH
shlokas.26:
taireva sahito rAj~no veshma tUrNamupAdravat |
darshanaM rAkShasendrasya kA~NkShamANo dvijastadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa vidito rAj~naH pravishya gRRihamuttamam |
pUjito rAkShasendreNa niShasAdAsanottame
shlokas.2:
pRRiShTashcha gotracharaNaM svAdhyAyaM brahmachArikam |
na tatra vyAjahArAnyadgotramAtrAdRRite dvijaH
shlokas.3:
brahmavarchasahInasya svAdhyAyaviratasya cha |
gotramAtravido rAjA nivAsaM samapRRichChata
shlokas.4:
kva te nivAsaH kalyANa ki~NgotrA brAhmaNI cha te |
tattvaM brUhi na bhIH kAryA vishramasva yathAsukham
shlokas.5:
gautama uvAcha||
madhyadeshaprasUto.ahaM vAso me shabarAlaye |
shUdrA punarbhUrbhAryA me satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato rAjA vimamRRishe kathaM kAryamidaM bhavet |
kathaM vA sukRRitaM me syAditi buddhyAnvachintayat
shlokas.7:
ayaM vai jananAdvipraH suhRRittasya mahAtmanaH |
sampreShitashcha tenAyaM kAshyapena mamAntikam
shlokas.8:
tasya priyaM kariShyAmi sa hi mAmAshritaH sadA |
bhrAtA me bAndhavashchAsau sakhA cha hRRidaya~NgamaH
shlokas.9:
kArttikyAmadya bhoktAraH sahasraM me dvijottamAH |
tatrAyamapi bhoktA vai deyamasmai cha me dhanam
shlokas.10:
tataH sahasraM viprANAM viduShAM samala~NkRRitam |
snAtAnAmanusamprAptamahatakShaumavAsasAm
shlokas.11:
tAnAgatAndvijashreShThAnvirUpAkSho vishAM pate |
yathArhaM pratijagrAha vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.12:
bRRisyasteShAM tu saMnyastA rAkShasendrasya shAsanAt |
bhUmau varakuthAstIrNAH preShyairbharatasattama
shlokas.13:
tAsu te pUjitA rAj~nA niShaNNA dvijasattamAH |
vyarAjanta mahArAja nakShatrapatayo yathA
shlokas.14:
tato jAmbUnadAH pAtrIrvajrA~NkA vimalAH shubhAH |
varAnnapUrNA viprebhyaH prAdAnmadhughRRitAplutAH
shlokas.15:
tasya nityaM tathAShADhyAM mAghyAM cha bahavo dvijAH |
IpsitaM bhojanavaraM labhante satkRRitaM sadA
shlokas.16:
visheShatastu kArttikyAM dvijebhyaH samprayachChati |
sharadvyapAye ratnAni paurNamAsyAmiti shrutiH
shlokas.17:
suvarNaM rajataM chaiva maNInatha cha mauktikam |
vajrAnmahAdhanA.nshchaiva vaiDUryAjinarA~NkavAn
shlokas.18:
ratnarAshInvinikShipya dakShiNArthe sa bhArata |
tataH prAha dvijashreShThAnvirUpAkSho mahAyashAH
shlokas.19:
gRRihNIta ratnAnyetAni yathotsAhaM yatheShTataH |
yeShu yeShu cha bhANDeShu bhuktaM vo dvijasattamAH
tAnyevAdAya gachChadhvaM svaveshmAnIti bhArata
shlokas.20:
ityuktavachane tasminrAkShasendre mahAtmani |
yatheShTaM tAni ratnAni jagRRihurbrAhmaNarShabhAH
shlokas.21:
tato mahArhaiste sarve ratnairabhyarchitAH shubhaiH |
brAhmaNA mRRiShTavasanAH suprItAH sma tadAbhavan
shlokas.22:
tatastAnrAkShasendrashcha dvijAnAha punarvachaH |
nAnAdigAgatAnrAjanrAkShasAnpratiShidhya vai
shlokas.23:
adhyaikadivasaM viprA na vo.astIha bhayaM kvachit |
rAkShasebhyaH pramodadhvamiShTato yAta mAchiram
shlokas.24:
tataH pradudruvuH sarve viprasa~NghAH samantataH |
gautamo.api suvarNasya bhAramAdAya satvaraH
shlokas.25:
kRRichChrAtsamudvahanvIra nyagrodhaM samupAgamat |
nyaShIdachcha parishrAntaH klAntashcha kShudhitashcha ha
shlokas.26:
tatastamabhyagAdrAjanrAjadharmA khagottamaH |
svAgatenAbhyanandachcha gautamaM mitravatsalaH
shlokas.27:
tasya pakShAgravikShepaiH klamaM vyapanayatkhagaH |
pUjAM chApyakaroddhImAnbhojanaM chApyakalpayat
shlokas.28:
sa bhuktavAnsuvishrAnto gautamo.achintayattadA |
hATakasyAbhirUpasya bhAro.ayaM sumahAnmayA
gRRihIto lobhamohAdvai dUraM cha gamanaM mama
shlokas.29:
na chAsti pathi bhoktavyaM prANasandhAraNaM mama |
kiM kRRitvA dhArayeyaM vai prANAnityabhyachintayat
shlokas.30:
tataH sa pathi bhoktavyaM prekShamANo na ki~nchana |
kRRitaghnaH puruShavyAghra manasedamachintayat
shlokas.31:
ayaM bakapatiH pArshve mA.nsarAshiH sthito mama |
imaM hatvA gRRihItvA cha yAsye.ahaM samabhidrutam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha tatra mahArchiShmAnanalo vAtasArathiH |
tasyAvidUre rakShArthaM khagendreNa kRRito.abhavat
shlokas.2:
sa chApi pArshve suShvApa vishvasto bakarATtadA |
kRRitaghnastu sa duShTAtmA taM jighA.nsurajAgarat
shlokas.3:
tato.alAtena dIptena vishvastaM nijaghAna tam |
nihatya cha mudA yuktaH so.anubandhaM na dRRiShTavAn
shlokas.4:
sa taM vipakSharomANaM kRRitvAgnAvapachattadA |
taM gRRihItvA suvarNaM cha yayau drutataraM dvijaH
shlokas.5:
tato.anyasmingate chAhni virUpAkSho.abravItsutam |
na prekShe rAjadharmANamadya putra khagottamam
shlokas.6:
sa pUrvasandhyAM brahmANaM vandituM yAti sarvadA |
mAM chAdRRiShTvA kadAchitsa na gachChati gRRihAnkhagaH
shlokas.7:
ubhe dvirAtraM sandhye vai nAbhyagAtsa mamAlayam |
tasmAnna shudhyate bhAvo mama sa j~nAyatAM suhRRit
shlokas.8:
svAdhyAyena viyukto hi brahmavarchasavarjitaH |
taM gatastatra me sha~NkA hanyAttaM sa dvijAdhamaH
shlokas.9:
durAchArastu durbuddhiri~NgitairlakShito mayA |
niShkriyo dAruNAkAraH kRRiShNo dasyurivAdhamaH
shlokas.10:
gautamaH sa gatastatra tenodvignaM mano mama |
putra shIghramito gatvA rAjadharmaniveshanam
j~nAyatAM sa vishuddhAtmA yadi jIvati mAchiram
shlokas.11:
sa evamuktastvarito rakShobhiH sahito yayau |
nyagrodhaM tatra chApashyatka~NkAlaM rAjadharmaNaH
shlokas.12:
sa rudannagamatputro rAkShasendrasya dhImataH |
tvaramANaH paraM shaktyA gautamagrahaNAya vai
shlokas.13:
tato.avidUre jagRRihurgautamaM rAkShasAstadA |
rAjadharmasharIraM cha pakShAsthicharaNojjhitam
shlokas.14:
tamAdAyAtha rakShA.nsi drutaM meruvrajaM yayuH |
rAj~nashcha darshayAmAsuH sharIraM rAjadharmaNaH
kRRitaghnaM puruShaM taM cha gautamaM pApachetasam
shlokas.15:
ruroda rAjA taM dRRiShTvA sAmAtyaH sapurohitaH |
ArtanAdashcha sumahAnabhUttasya niveshane
shlokas.16:
sastrIkumAraM cha puraM babhUvAsvasthamAnasam |
athAbravInnRRipaH putraM pApo.ayaM vadhyatAmiti
shlokas.17:
asya mA.nsairime sarve viharantu yatheShTataH |
pApAchAraH pApakarmA pApAtmA pApanishchayaH
hantavyo.ayaM mama matirbhavadbhiriti rAkShasAH
shlokas.18:
ityuktA rAkShasendreNa rAkShasA ghoravikramAH |
naichChanta taM bhakShayituM pApakarmAyamityuta
shlokas.19:
dasyUnAM dIyatAmeSha sAdhvadya puruShAdhamaH |
ityUchustaM mahArAja rAkShasendraM nishAcharAH
shlokas.20:
shirobhishcha gatA bhUmimUchU rakShogaNAdhipam |
na dAtumarhasi tvaM no bhakShaNAyAsya kilbiSham
shlokas.21:
evamastviti tAnAha rAkShasendro nishAcharAn |
dasyUnAM dIyatAmeSha kRRitaghno.adyaiva rAkShasAH
shlokas.22:
ityukte tasya te dAsAH shUlamudgarapANayaH |
ChittvA taM khaNDashaH pApaM dasyubhyaH pradadustadA
shlokas.23:
dasyavashchApi naichChanta tamattuM pApakAriNam |
kravyAdA api rAjendra kRRitaghnaM nopabhu~njate
shlokas.24:
brahmaghne cha surApe cha chore bhagnavrate tathA |
niShkRRitirvihitA rAjankRRitaghne nAsti niShkRRitiH
shlokas.25:
mitradrohI nRRisha.nsashcha kRRitaghnashcha narAdhamaH |
kravyAdaiH kRRimibhishchAnyairna bhujyante hi tAdRRishAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatashchitAM bakapateH kArayAmAsa rAkShasaH |
ratnairgandhaishcha bahubhirvastraishcha samala~NkRRitAm
shlokas.2:
tatra prajvAlya nRRipate bakarAjaM pratApavAn |
pretakAryANi vidhivadrAkShasendrashchakAra ha
shlokas.3:
tasminkAle.atha surabhirdevI dAkShAyaNI shubhA |
upariShTAttatastasya sA babhUva payasvinI
shlokas.4:
tasyA vaktrAchchyutaH phenaH kShIramishrastadAnagha |
so.apatadvai tatastasyAM chitAyAM rAjadharmaNaH
shlokas.5:
tataH sa~njIvitastena bakarAjastadAnagha |
utpatya cha sameyAya virUpAkShaM bakAdhipaH
shlokas.6:
tato.abhyayAddevarAjo virUpAkShapuraM tadA |
prAha chedaM virUpAkShaM diShTyAyaM jIvatItyuta
shlokas.7:
shrAvayAmAsa chendrastaM virUpAkShaM purAtanam |
yathA shApaH purA datto brahmaNA rAjadharmaNaH
shlokas.8:
yadA bakapatI rAjanbrahmANaM nopasarpati |
tato roShAdidaM prAha bakendrAya pitAmahaH
shlokas.9:
yasmAnmUDho mama sado nAgato.asau bakAdhamaH |
tasmAdvadhaM sa duShTAtmA nachirAtsamavApsyati
shlokas.10:
tadAyaM tasya vachanAnnihato gautamena vai |
tenaivAmRRitasiktashcha punaH sa~njIvito bakaH
shlokas.11:
rAjadharmA tataH prAha praNipatya pura.ndaram |
yadi te.anugrahakRRitA mayi buddhiH pura.ndara
sakhAyaM me sudayitaM gautamaM jIvayetyuta
shlokas.12:
tasya vAkyaM samAj~nAya vAsavaH puruSharShabha |
sa~njIvayitvA sakhye vai prAdAttaM gautamaM tadA
shlokas.13:
sabhANDopaskaraM rAja.nstamAsAdya bakAdhipaH |
sampariShvajya suhRRidaM prItyA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.14:
atha taM pApakarmANaM rAjadharmA bakAdhipaH |
visarjayitvA sadhanaM pravivesha svamAlayam
shlokas.15:
yathochitaM cha sa bako yayau brahmasadastadA |
brahmA cha taM mahAtmAnamAtithyenAbhyapUjayat
shlokas.16:
gautamashchApi samprApya punastaM shabarAlayam |
shUdrAyAM janayAmAsa putrAnduShkRRitakAriNaH
shlokas.17:
shApashcha sumahA.nstasya dattaH suragaNaistadA |
kukShau punarbhvAM bhAryAyAM janayitvA chirAtsutAn
nirayaM prApsyati mahatkRRitaghno.ayamiti prabho
shlokas.18:
etatprAha purA sarvaM nArado mama bhArata |
sa.nsmRRitya chApi sumahadAkhyAnaM puruSharShabha
mayApi bhavate sarvaM yathAvadupavarNitam
shlokas.19:
kutaH kRRitaghnasya yashaH kutaH sthAnaM kutaH sukham |
ashraddheyaH kRRitaghno hi kRRitaghne nAsti niShkRRitiH
shlokas.20:
mitradroho na kartavyaH puruSheNa visheShataH |
mitradhru~NnirayaM ghoramanantaM pratipadyate
shlokas.21:
kRRitaj~nena sadA bhAvyaM mitrakAmena chAnagha |
mitrAtprabhavate satyaM mitrAtprabhavate balam
satkArairuttamairmitraM pUjayeta vichakShaNaH
shlokas.22:
parityAjyo budhaiH pApaH kRRitaghno nirapatrapaH |
mitradrohI kulA~NgAraH pApakarmA narAdhamaH
shlokas.23:
eSha dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha proktaH pApo mayA tava |
mitradrohI kRRitaghno vai kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tadA vAkyaM bhIShmeNoktaM mahAtmanA |
yudhiShThiraH prItamanA babhUva janamejaya

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dharmAH pitAmahenoktA rAjadharmAshritAH shubhAH |
dharmamAshramiNAM shreShThaM vaktumarhasi pArthiva
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvatra vihito dharmaH svargyaH satyaphalaM tapaH |
bahudvArasya dharmasya nehAsti viphalA kriyA
shlokas.3:
yasminyasmi.nstu vinaye yo yo yAti vinishchayam |
sa tamevAbhijAnAti nAnyaM bharatasattama
shlokas.4:
yathA yathA cha paryeti lokatantramasAravat |
tathA tathA virAgo.atra jAyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
evaM vyavasite loke bahudoShe yudhiShThira |
AtmamokShanimittaM vai yateta matimAnnaraH
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
naShTe dhane vA dAre vA putre pitari vA mRRite |
yayA buddhyA nudechChokaM tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
naShTe dhane vA dAre vA putre pitari vA mRRite |
aho duHkhamiti dhyAya~nshokasyApachitiM charet
shlokas.8:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yathA senajitaM vipraH kashchidityabravIdvachaH
shlokas.9:
putrashokAbhisantaptaM rAjAnaM shokavihvalam |
viShaNNavadanaM dRRiShTvA vipro vachanamabravIt
shlokas.10:
kiM nu khalvasi mUDhastvaM shochyaH kimanushochasi |
yadA tvAmapi shochantaH shochyA yAsyanti tAM gatim
shlokas.11:
tvaM chaivAhaM cha ye chAnye tvAM rAjanparyupAsate |
sarve tatra gamiShyAmo yata evAgatA vayam
shlokas.12:
senajiduvAcha||
kA buddhiH kiM tapo vipra kaH samAdhistapodhana |
kiM j~nAnaM kiM shrutaM vA te yatprApya na viShIdasi
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
pashya bhUtAni duHkhena vyatiShaktAni sarvashaH |
AtmApi chAyaM na mama sarvA vA pRRithivI mama
shlokas.14:
yathA mama tathAnyeShAmiti buddhyA na me vyathA |
etAM buddhimahaM prApya na prahRRiShye na cha vyathe
shlokas.15:
yathA kAShThaM cha kAShThaM cha sameyAtAM mahodadhau |
sametya cha vyapeyAtAM tadvadbhUtasamAgamaH
shlokas.16:
evaM putrAshcha pautrAshcha j~nAtayo bAndhavAstathA |
teShu sneho na kartavyo viprayogo hi tairdhruvam
shlokas.17:
adarshanAdApatitaH punashchAdarshanaM gataH |
na tvAsau veda na tvaM taM kaH sankamanushochasi
shlokas.18:
tRRiShNArtiprabhavaM duHkhaM duHkhArtiprabhavaM sukham |
sukhAtsa~njAyate duHkhamevametatpunaH punaH
sukhasyAnantaraM duHkhaM duHkhasyAnantaraM sukham
shlokas.19:
sukhAttvaM duHkhamApannaH punarApatsyase sukham |
na nityaM labhate duHkhaM na nityaM labhate sukham
shlokas.20:
nAlaM sukhAya suhRRido nAlaM duHkhAya shatravaH |
na cha praj~nAlamarthAnAM na sukhAnAmalaM dhanam
shlokas.21:
na buddhirdhanalAbhAya na jADyamasamRRiddhaye |
lokaparyAyavRRittAntaM prAj~no jAnAti netaraH
shlokas.22:
buddhimantaM cha mUDhaM cha shUraM bhIruM jaDaM kavim |
durbalaM balavantaM cha bhAginaM bhajate sukham
shlokas.23:
dhenurvatsasya gopasya svAminastaskarasya cha |
payaH pibati yastasyA dhenustasyeti nishchayaH
shlokas.24:
ye cha mUDhatamA loke ye cha buddheH paraM gatAH |
te narAH sukhamedhante klishyatyantarito janaH
shlokas.25:
antyeShu remire dhIrA na te madhyeShu remire |
antyaprAptiM sukhAmAhurduHkhamantaramantayoH
shlokas.26:
ye tu buddhisukhaM prAptA dva.ndvAtItA vimatsarAH |
tAnnaivArthA na chAnarthA vyathayanti kadAchana
shlokas.27:
atha ye buddhimaprAptA vyatikrAntAshcha mUDhatAm |
te.ativelaM prahRRiShyanti santApamupayAnti cha
shlokas.28:
nityapramuditA mUDhA divi devagaNA iva |
avalepena mahatA paridRRibdhA vichetasaH
shlokas.29:
sukhaM duHkhAntamAlasyaM duHkhaM dAkShyaM sukhodayam |
bhUtishchaiva shriyA sArdhaM dakShe vasati nAlase
shlokas.30:
sukhaM vA yadi vA duHkhaM dveShyaM vA yadi vA priyam |
prAptaM prAptamupAsIta hRRidayenAparAjitaH
shlokas.31:
shokasthAnasahasrANi harShasthAnashatAni cha |
divase divase mUDhamAvishanti na paNDitam
shlokas.32:
buddhimantaM kRRitapraj~naM shushrUShumanasUyakam |
dAntaM jitendriyaM chApi shoko na spRRishate naram
shlokas.33:
etAM buddhiM samAsthAya guptachittashcharedbudhaH |
udayAstamayaj~naM hi na shokaH spraShTumarhati
shlokas.34:
yannimittaM bhavechChokastrAso vA duHkhameva vA |
AyAso vA yatomUlastadekA~Ngamapi tyajet
shlokas.35:
yadyattyajati kAmAnAM tatsukhasyAbhipUryate |
kAmAnusArI puruShaH kAmAnanu vinashyati
shlokas.36:
yachcha kAmasukhaM loke yachcha divyaM mahatsukham |
tRRiShNAkShayasukhasyaite nArhataH ShoDashIM kalAm
shlokas.37:
pUrvadehakRRitaM karma shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
prAj~naM mUDhaM tathA shUraM bhajate yAdRRishaM kRRitam
shlokas.38:
evameva kilaitAni priyANyevApriyANi cha |
jIveShu parivartante duHkhAni cha sukhAni cha
shlokas.39:
tadevaM buddhimAsthAya sukhaM jIvedguNAnvitaH |
sarvAnkAmA~njugupseta sa~NgAnkurvIta pRRiShThataH
vRRitta eSha hRRidi prauDho mRRityureSha manomayaH
shlokas.40:
yadA saMharate kAmAnkUrmo.a~NgAnIva sarvashaH |
tadAtmajyotirAtmA cha Atmanyeva prasIdati
shlokas.41:
ki~nchideva mamatvena yadA bhavati kalpitam |
tadeva paritApArthaM sarvaM sampadyate tadA
shlokas.42:
na bibheti yadA chAyaM yadA chAsmAnna bibhyati |
yadA nechChati na dveShTi brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.43:
ubhe satyAnRRite tyaktvA shokAnandau bhayAbhaye |
priyApriye parityajya prashAntAtmA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.44:
yadA na kurute dhIraH sarvabhUteShu pApakam |
karmaNA manasA vAchA brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.45:
yA dustyajA durmatibhiryA na jIryati jIryataH |
yo.asau prANAntiko rogastAM tRRiShNAM tyajataH sukham
shlokas.46:
atra pi~NgalayA gItA gAthAH shrUyanti pArthiva |
yathA sA kRRichChrakAle.api lebhe dharmaM sanAtanam
shlokas.47:
sa~Nkete pi~NgalA veshyA kAntenAsIdvinAkRRitA |
atha kRRichChragatA shAntAM buddhimAsthApayattadA
shlokas.48:
pi~NgalovAcha||
unmattAhamanunmattaM kAntamanvavasaM chiram |
antike ramaNaM santaM nainamadhyagamaM purA
shlokas.49:
ekasthUNaM navadvAramapidhAsyAmyagArakam |
kA hi kAntamihAyAntamayaM kAnteti ma.nsyate
shlokas.50:
akAmAH kAmarUpeNa dhUrtA narakarUpiNaH |
na punarva~nchayiShyanti pratibuddhAsmi jAgRRimi
shlokas.51:
anartho.api bhavatyartho daivAtpUrvakRRitena vA |
sambuddhAhaM nirAkArA nAhamadyAjitendriyA
shlokas.52:
sukhaM nirAshaH svapiti nairAshyaM paramaM sukham |
AshAmanAshAM kRRitvA hi sukhaM svapiti pi~NgalA
shlokas.53:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etaishchAnyaishcha viprasya hetumadbhiH prabhAShitaiH |
paryavasthApito rAjA senajinmumude sukham

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atikrAmati kAle.asminsarvabhUtakShayAvahe |
kiM shreyaH pratipadyeta tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
pituH putreNa sa.nvAdaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
dvijAteH kasyachitpArtha svAdhyAyaniratasya vai |
babhUva putro medhAvI medhAvI nAma nAmataH
shlokas.4:
so.abravItpitaraM putraH svAdhyAyakaraNe ratam |
mokShadharmArthakushalo lokatattvavichakShaNaH
shlokas.5:
dhIraH kiM svittAta kuryAtprajAna;nkShipraM hyAyurbhrashyate mAnavAnAm |
pitastadAchakShva yathArthayogaM; mamAnupUrvyA yena dharmaM chareyam
shlokas.6:
pitovAcha||
vedAnadhItya brahmacharyeNa putra; putrAnichChetpAvanArthaM pitR^INAm |
agnInAdhAya vidhivachcheShTayaj~no; vanaM pravishyAtha munirbubhUShet
shlokas.7:
putra uvAcha||
evamabhyAhate loke samantAtparivArite |
amoghAsu patantIShu kiM dhIra iva bhAShase
shlokas.8:
pitovAcha||
kathamabhyAhato lokaH kena vA parivAritaH |
amoghAH kAH patantIha kiM nu bhIShayasIva mAm
shlokas.9:
putra uvAcha||
mRRityunAbhyAhato loko jarayA parivAritaH |
ahorAtrAH patantyete nanu kasmAnna budhyase
shlokas.10:
yadAhametajjAnAmi na mRRityustiShThatIti ha |
so.ahaM kathaM pratIkShiShye jAlenApihitashcharan
shlokas.11:
rAtryAM rAtryAM vyatItAyAmAyuralpataraM yadA |
gAdhodake matsya iva sukhaM vindeta kastadA
tadeva vandhyaM divasamiti vidyAdvichakShaNaH
shlokas.12:
anavApteShu kAmeShu mRRityurabhyeti mAnavam |
shaShpANIva vichinvantamanyatragatamAnasam
vRRikIvoraNamAsAdya mRRityurAdAya gachChati
shlokas.13:
adyaiva kuru yachChreyo mA tvA kAlo.atyagAdayam |
akRRiteShveva kAryeShu mRRityurvai samprakarShati
shlokas.14:
shvaHkAryamadya kurvIta pUrvAhNe chAparAhNikam |
na hi pratIkShate mRRityuH kRRitaM vAsya na vA kRRitam
ko hi jAnAti kasyAdya mRRityusenA nivekShyate
shlokas.15:
yuvaiva dharmashIlaH syAdanimittaM hi jIvitam |
kRRite dharme bhavetkIrtiriha pretya cha vai sukham
shlokas.16:
mohena hi samAviShTaH putradArArthamudyataH |
kRRitvA kAryamakAryaM vA puShTimeShAM prayachChati
shlokas.17:
taM putrapashusaMmattaM vyAsaktamanasaM naram |
suptaM vyAghraM mahaugho vA mRRityurAdAya gachChati
shlokas.18:
sa~nchinvAnakamevaikaM kAmAnAmavitRRiptakam |
vyAghraH pashumivAdAya mRRityurAdAya gachChati
shlokas.19:
idaM kRRitamidaM kAryamidamanyatkRRitAkRRitam |
evamIhAsukhAsaktaM kRRitAntaH kurute vashe
shlokas.20:
kRRitAnAM phalamaprAptaM karmaNAM phalasa~Nginam |
kShetrApaNagRRihAsaktaM mRRityurAdAya gachChati
shlokas.21:
mRRityurjarA cha vyAdhishcha duHkhaM chAnekakAraNam |
anuShaktaM yadA dehe kiM svastha iva tiShThasi
shlokas.22:
jAtamevAntako.antAya jarA chAnveti dehinam |
anuShaktA dvayenaite bhAvAH sthAvaraja~NgamAH
shlokas.23:
mRRityorvA gRRihamevaitadyA grAme vasato ratiH |
devAnAmeSha vai goShTho yadaraNyamiti shrutiH
shlokas.24:
nibandhanI rajjureShA yA grAme vasato ratiH |
ChittvainAM sukRRito yAnti nainAM Chindanti duShkRRitaH
shlokas.25:
na hi.nsayati yaH prANAnmanovAkkAyahetubhiH |
jIvitArthApanayanaiH karmabhirna sa badhyate
shlokas.26:
na mRRityusenAmAyAntIM jAtu kashchitprabAdhate |
RRite satyamasantyAjyaM satye hyamRRitamAshritam
shlokas.27:
tasmAtsatyavratAchAraH satyayogaparAyaNaH |
satyArAmaH samo dAntaH satyenaivAntakaM jayet
shlokas.28:
amRRitaM chaiva mRRityushcha dvayaM dehe pratiShThitam |
mRRityumApadyate mohAtsatyenApadyate.amRRitam
shlokas.29:
so.ahaM hyahi.nsraH satyArthI kAmakrodhabahiShkRRitaH |
samaduHkhasukhaH kShemI mRRityuM hAsyAmyamartyavat
shlokas.30:
shAntiyaj~narato dAnto brahmayaj~ne sthito muniH |
vA~NmanaHkarmayaj~nashcha bhaviShyAmyudagAyane
shlokas.31:
pashuyaj~naiH kathaM hi.nsrairmAdRRisho yaShTumarhati |
antavadbhiruta prAj~naH kShatrayaj~naiH pishAchavat
shlokas.32:
yasya vA~NmanasI syAtAM samyakpraNihite sadA |
tapastyAgashcha yogashcha sa vai sarvamavApnuyAt
shlokas.33:
nAsti vidyAsamaM chakShurnAsti vidyAsamaM balam |
nAsti rAgasamaM duHkhaM nAsti tyAgasamaM sukham
shlokas.34:
AtmanyevAtmanA jAta AtmaniShTho.aprajo.api vA |
Atmanyeva bhaviShyAmi na mAM tArayati prajA
shlokas.35:
naitAdRRishaM brAhmaNasyAsti vittaM; yathaikatA samatA satyatA cha |
shIle sthitirdaNDanidhAnamArjavaM; tatastatashchoparamaH kriyAbhyaH
shlokas.36:
kiM te dhanairbAndhavairvApi kiM te; kiM te dArairbrAhmaNa yo mariShyasi |
AtmAnamanvichCha guhAM praviShTaM; pitAmahaste kva gataH pitA cha
shlokas.37:
bhIShma uvAcha||
putrasyaitadvachaH shrutvA tathAkArShItpitA nRRipa |
tathA tvamapi vartasva satyadharmaparAyaNaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhanino vAdhanA ye cha vartayanti svatantriNaH |
sukhaduHkhAgamasteShAM kaH kathaM vA pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shamyAkena vimuktena gItaM shAntigatena ha
shlokas.3:
abravInmAM purA kashchidbrAhmaNastyAgamAsthitaH |
klishyamAnaH kudAreNa kuchailena bubhukShayA
shlokas.4:
utpannamiha loke vai janmaprabhRRiti mAnavam |
vividhAnyupavartante duHkhAni cha sukhAni cha
shlokas.5:
tayorekatare mArge yadyenamabhisaMnayet |
na sukhaM prApya saMhRRiShyenna duHkhaM prApya sa~njvaret
shlokas.6:
na vai charasi yachChreya Atmano vA yadIhase |
akAmAtmApi hi sadA dhuramudyamya chaiva hi
shlokas.7:
aki~nchanaH paripatansukhamAsvAdayiShyasi |
aki~nchanaH sukhaM shete samuttiShThati chaiva hi
shlokas.8:
Aki~nchanyaM sukhaM loke pathyaM shivamanAmayam |
anamitramatho hyetaddurlabhaM sulabhaM satAm
shlokas.9:
aki~nchanasya shuddhasya upapannasya sarvashaH |
avekShamANastrI.NllokAnna tulyamupalakShaye
shlokas.10:
Aki~nchanyaM cha rAjyaM cha tulayA samatolayam |
atyarichyata dAridryaM rAjyAdapi guNAdhikam
shlokas.11:
Aki~nchanye cha rAjye cha visheShaH sumahAnayam |
nityodvigno hi dhanavAnmRRityorAsyagato yathA
shlokas.12:
naivAsyAgnirna chAdityo na mRRityurna cha dasyavaH |
prabhavanti dhanajyAninirmuktasya nirAshiShaH
shlokas.13:
taM vai sadA kAmacharamanupastIrNashAyinam |
bAhUpadhAnaM shAmyantaM prasha.nsanti divaukasaH
shlokas.14:
dhanavAnkrodhalobhAbhyAmAviShTo naShTachetanaH |
tiryagIkShaH shuShkamukhaH pApako bhrukuTImukhaH
shlokas.15:
nirdasha.nshchAdharoShThaM cha kruddho dAruNabhAShitA |
kastamichChetparidraShTuM dAtumichChati chenmahIm
shlokas.16:
shriyA hyabhIkShNaM sa.nvAso mohayatyavichakShaNam |
sA tasya chittaM harati shAradAbhramivAnilaH
shlokas.17:
athainaM rUpamAnashcha dhanamAnashcha vindati |
abhijAto.asmi siddho.asmi nAsmi kevalamAnuShaH
ityebhiH kAraNaistasya tribhishchittaM prasichyate
shlokas.18:
sa prasiktamanA bhogAnvisRRijya pitRRisa~nchitAn |
parikShINaH parasvAnAmAdAnaM sAdhu manyate
shlokas.19:
tamatikrAntamaryAdamAdadAnaM tatastataH |
pratiShedhanti rAjAno lubdhA mRRigamiveShubhiH
shlokas.20:
evametAni duHkhAni tAni tAnIha mAnavam |
vividhAnyupavartante gAtrasa.nsparshajAni cha
shlokas.21:
teShAM paramaduHkhAnAM buddhyA bhaiShajyamAcharet |
lokadharmaM samAj~nAya dhruvANAmadhruvaiH saha
shlokas.22:
nAtyaktvA sukhamApnoti nAtyaktvA vindate param |
nAtyaktvA chAbhayaH shete tyaktvA sarvaM sukhI bhava
shlokas.23:
ityetaddhAstinapure brAhmaNenopavarNitam |
shamyAkena purA mahyaM tasmAttyAgaH paro mataH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
IhamAnaH samArambhAnyadi nAsAdayeddhanam |
dhanatRRiShNAbhibhUtashcha kiM kurvansukhamApnuyAt
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvasAmyamanAyAsaH satyavAkyaM cha bhArata |
nirvedashchAvivitsA cha yasya syAtsa sukhI naraH
shlokas.3:
etAnyeva padAnyAhuH pa~ncha vRRiddhAH prashAntaye |
eSha svargashcha dharmashcha sukhaM chAnuttamaM satAm
shlokas.4:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nirvedAnma~NkinA gItaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
IhamAno dhanaM ma~Nkirbhagnehashcha punaH punaH |
kenachiddhanasheSheNa krItavAndamyagoyugam
shlokas.6:
susambaddhau tu tau damyau damanAyAbhiniHsRRitau |
AsInamuShTraM madhyena sahasaivAbhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.7:
tayoH samprAptayoruShTraH skandhadeshamamarShaNaH |
utthAyotkShipya tau damyau prasasAra mahAjavaH
shlokas.8:
hriyamANau tu tau damyau tenoShTreNa pramAthinA |
mriyamANau cha samprekShya ma~NkistatrAbravIdidam
shlokas.9:
na chaivAvihitaM shakyaM dakSheNApIhituM dhanam |
yuktena shraddhayA samyagIhAM samanutiShThatA
shlokas.10:
kRRitasya pUrvaM chAnarthairyuktasyApyanutiShThataH |
imaM pashyata sa~NgatyA mama daivamupaplavam
shlokas.11:
udyamyodyamya me damyau viShameNeva gachChati |
utkShipya kAkatAlIyamunmAtheneva jambukaH
shlokas.12:
maNI voShTrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama |
shuddhaM hi daivamevedamato naivAsti pauruSham
shlokas.13:
yadi vApyupapadyeta pauruShaM nAma karhichit |
anviShyamANaM tadapi daivamevAvatiShThate
shlokas.14:
tasmAnnirveda eveha gantavyaH sukhamIpsatA |
sukhaM svapiti nirviNNo nirAshashchArthasAdhane
shlokas.15:
aho samyakShukenoktaM sarvataH parimuchyatA |
pratiShThatA mahAraNyaM janakasya niveshanAt
shlokas.16:
yaH kAmAnprApnuyAtsarvAnyashchainAnkevalA.nstyajet |
prApaNAtsarvakAmAnAM parityAgo vishiShyate
shlokas.17:
nAntaM sarvavivitsAnAM gatapUrvo.asti kashchana |
sharIre jIvite chaiva tRRiShNA mandasya vardhate
shlokas.18:
nivartasva vivitsAbhyaH shAmya nirvidya mAmaka |
asakRRichchAsi nikRRito na cha nirvidyase tano
shlokas.19:
yadi nAhaM vinAshyaste yadyevaM ramase mayA |
mA mAM yojaya lobhena vRRithA tvaM vittakAmuka
shlokas.20:
sa~nchitaM sa~nchitaM dravyaM naShTaM tava punaH punaH |
kadA vimokShyase mUDha dhanehAM dhanakAmuka
shlokas.21:
aho nu mama bAlishyaM yo.ahaM krIDanakastava |
kiM naiva jAtu puruShaH pareShAM preShyatAmiyAt
shlokas.22:
na pUrve nApare jAtu kAmAnAmantamApnuvan |
tyaktvA sarvasamArambhAnpratibuddho.asmi jAgRRimi
shlokas.23:
nUnaM te hRRidayaM kAma vajrasAramayaM dRRidham |
yadanarthashatAviShTaM shatadhA na vidIryate
shlokas.24:
tyajAmi kAma tvAM chaiva yachcha ki~nchitpriyaM tava |
tavAhaM sukhamanvichChannAtmanyupalabhe sukham
shlokas.25:
kAma jAnAmi te mUlaM sa~NkalpAtkila jAyase |
na tvAM sa~NkalpayiShyAmi samUlo na bhaviShyasi
shlokas.26:
IhA dhanasya na sukhA labdhvA chintA cha bhUyasI |
labdhanAsho yathA mRRityurlabdhaM bhavati vA na vA
shlokas.27:
paretya yo na labhate tato duHkhataraM nu kim |
na cha tuShyati labdhena bhUya eva cha mArgati
shlokas.28:
anutarShula evArthaH svAdu gA~Ngamivodakam |
madvilApanametattu pratibuddho.asmi santyaja
shlokas.29:
ya imaM mAmakaM dehaM bhUtagrAmaH samAshritaH |
sa yAtvito yathAkAmaM vasatAM vA yathAsukham
shlokas.30:
na yuShmAsviha me prItiH kAmalobhAnusAriShu |
tasmAdutsRRijya sarvAnvaH satyamevAshrayAmyaham
shlokas.31:
sarvabhUtAnyahaM dehe pashyanmanasi chAtmanaH |
yoge buddhiM shrute sattvaM mano brahmaNi dhArayan
shlokas.32:
vihariShyAmyanAsaktaH sukhI lokAnnirAmayaH |
yathA mA tvaM punarnaivaM duHkheShu praNidhAsyasi
shlokas.33:
tvayA hi me praNunnasya gatiranyA na vidyate |
tRRiShNAshokashramANAM hi tvaM kAma prabhavaH sadA
shlokas.34:
dhananAsho.adhikaM duHkhaM manye sarvamahattaram |
j~nAtayo hyavamanyante mitrANi cha dhanachyutam
shlokas.35:
avaj~nAnasahasraistu doShAH kaShTatarAdhane |
dhane sukhakalA yA cha sApi duHkhairvidhIyate
shlokas.36:
dhanamasyeti puruShaM purA nighnanti dasyavaH |
klishyanti vividhairdaNDairnityamudvejayanti cha
shlokas.37:
mandalolupatA duHkhamiti buddhaM chirAnmayA |
yadyadAlambase kAma tattadevAnurudhyase
shlokas.38:
atattvaj~no.asi bAlashcha dustoSho.apUraNo.analaH |
naiva tvaM vettha sulabhaM naiva tvaM vettha durlabham
shlokas.39:
pAtAlamiva duShpUro mAM duHkhairyoktumichChasi |
nAhamadya samAveShTuM shakyaH kAma punastvayA
shlokas.40:
nirvedamahamAsAdya dravyanAshAdyadRRichChayA |
nirvRRitiM paramAM prApya nAdya kAmAnvichintaye
shlokas.41:
atikleshAnsahAmIha nAhaM budhyAmyabuddhimAn |
nikRRito dhananAshena shaye sarvA~NgavijvaraH
shlokas.42:
parityajAmi kAma tvAM hitvA sarvamanogatIH |
na tvaM mayA punaH kAma nasyoteneva ra.nsyase
shlokas.43:
kShamiShye.akShamamANAnAM na hi.nsiShye cha hi.nsitaH |
dveShyamuktaH priyaM vakShyAmyanAdRRitya tadapriyam
shlokas.44:
tRRiptaH svasthendriyo nityaM yathAlabdhena vartayan |
na sakAmaM kariShyAmi tvAmahaM shatrumAtmanaH
shlokas.45:
nirvedaM nirvRRitiM tRRiptiM shAntiM satyaM damaM kShamAm |
sarvabhUtadayAM chaiva viddhi mAM sharaNAgatam
shlokas.46:
tasmAtkAmashcha lobhashcha tRRiShNA kArpaNyameva cha |
tyajantu mAM pratiShThantaM sattvastho hyasmi sAmpratam
shlokas.47:
prahAya kAmaM lobhaM cha krodhaM pAruShyameva cha |
nAdya lobhavashaM prApto duHkhaM prApsyAmyanAtmavAn
shlokas.48:
yadyattyajati kAmAnAM tatsukhasyAbhipUryate |
kAmasya vashago nityaM duHkhameva prapadyate
shlokas.49:
kAmAnvyudasya dhunute yatki~nchitpuruSho rajaH |
kAmakrodhodbhavaM duHkhamahrIraratireva cha
shlokas.50:
eSha brahmapraviShTo.ahaM grIShme shItamiva hradam |
shAmyAmi parinirvAmi sukhamAse cha kevalam
shlokas.51:
yachcha kAmasukhaM loke yachcha divyaM mahatsukham |
tRRiShNAkShayasukhasyaite nArhataH ShoDashIM kalAm
shlokas.52:
AtmanA saptamaM kAmaM hatvA shatrumivottamam |
prApyAvadhyaM brahmapuraM rAjeva syAmahaM sukhI
shlokas.53:
etAM buddhiM samAsthAya ma~NkirnirvedamAgataH |
sarvAnkAmAnparityajya prApya brahma mahatsukham
shlokas.54:
damyanAshakRRite ma~NkiramaratvaM kilAgamat |
achChinatkAmamUlaM sa tena prApa mahatsukham
shlokas.55:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gItaM videharAjena janakena prashAmyatA
shlokas.56:
anantaM bata me vittaM yasya me nAsti ki~nchana |
mithilAyAM pradIptAyAM na me dahyati ki~nchana
shlokas.57:
atraivodAharantImaM bodhyasya padasa~nchayam |
nirvedaM prati vinyastaM pratibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.58:
bodhyaM dAntamRRiShiM rAjA nahuShaH paryapRRichChata |
nirvedAchChAntimApannaM shAntaM praj~nAnatarpitam
shlokas.59:
upadeshaM mahAprAj~na shamasyopadishasva me |
kAM buddhiM samanudhyAya shAntashcharasi nirvRRitaH
shlokas.60:
bodhya uvAcha||
upadeshena vartAmi nAnushAsmIha ka~nchana |
lakShaNaM tasya vakShye.ahaM tatsvayaM pravimRRishyatAm
shlokas.61:
pi~NgalA kuraraH sarpaH sAra~NgAnveShaNaM vane |
iShukAraH kumArI cha ShaDete guravo mama

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kena vRRittena vRRittaj~na vItashokashcharenmahIm |
kiM cha kurvannaro loke prApnoti paramAM gatim
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
prahrAdasya cha sa.nvAdaM munerAjagarasya cha
shlokas.3:
charantaM brAhmaNaM ka~nchitkalyachittamanAmayam |
paprachCha rAjanprahrAdo buddhimAnprAj~nasaMmataH
shlokas.4:
svasthaH shakto mRRidurdAnto nirvivitso.anasUyakaH |
suvAgbahumato loke prAj~nashcharasi bAlavat
shlokas.5:
naiva prArthayase lAbhaM nAlAbheShvanushochasi |
nityatRRipta iva brahmanna ki~nchidavamanyase
shlokas.6:
srotasA hriyamANAsu prajAsvavimanA iva |
dharmakAmArthakAryeShu kUTastha iva lakShyase
shlokas.7:
nAnutiShThasi dharmArthau na kAme chApi vartase |
indriyArthAnanAdRRitya muktashcharasi sAkShivat
shlokas.8:
kA nu praj~nA shrutaM vA kiM vRRittirvA kA nu te mune |
kShipramAchakShva me brahma~nshreyo yadiha manyase
shlokas.9:
anuyuktaH sa medhAvI lokadharmavidhAnavit |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA prahrAdamanapArthayA
shlokas.10:
pashyanprahrAda bhUtAnAmutpattimanimittataH |
hrAsaM vRRiddhiM vinAshaM cha na prahRRiShye na cha vyathe
shlokas.11:
svabhAvAdeva sa.ndRRishya vartamAnAH pravRRittayaH |
svabhAvaniratAH sarvAH paritapye na kenachit
shlokas.12:
pashyanprahrAda sa.nyogAnviprayogaparAyaNAn |
sa~nchayA.nshcha vinAshAntAnna kvachidvidadhe manaH
shlokas.13:
antavanti cha bhUtAni guNayuktAni pashyataH |
utpattinidhanaj~nasya kiM kAryamavashiShyate
shlokas.14:
jalajAnAmapi hyantaM paryAyeNopalakShaye |
mahatAmapi kAyAnAM sUkShmANAM cha mahodadhau
shlokas.15:
ja~NgamasthAvarANAM cha bhUtAnAmasurAdhipa |
pArthivAnAmapi vyaktaM mRRityuM pashyAmi sarvashaH
shlokas.16:
antarikShacharANAM cha dAnavottama pakShiNAm |
uttiShThati yathAkAlaM mRRityurbalavatAmapi
shlokas.17:
divi sa~ncharamANAni hrasvAni cha mahAnti cha |
jyotIMShi cha yathAkAlaM patamAnAni lakShaye
shlokas.18:
iti bhUtAni sampashyannanuShaktAni mRRityunA |
sarvasAmAnyato vidvAnkRRitakRRityaH sukhaM svape
shlokas.19:
sumahAntamapi grAsaM grase labdhaM yadRRichChayA |
shaye punarabhu~njAno divasAni bahUnyapi
shlokas.20:
Asravatyapi mAmannaM punarbahuguNaM bahu |
punaralpaguNaM stokaM punarnaivopapadyate
shlokas.21:
kaNAnkadAchitkhAdAmi piNyAkamapi cha grase |
bhakShaye shAlimA.nsAni bhakShA.nshchochchAvachAnpunaH
shlokas.22:
shaye kadAchitparya~Nke bhUmAvapi punaH shaye |
prAsAde.api cha me shayyA kadAchidupapadyate
shlokas.23:
dhArayAmi cha chIrANi shANIM kShaumAjinAni cha |
mahArhANi cha vAsA.nsi dhArayAmyahamekadA
shlokas.24:
na saMnipatitaM dharmyamupabhogaM yadRRichChayA |
pratyAchakShe na chApyenamanurudhye sudurlabham
shlokas.25:
achalamanidhanaM shivaM vishokaM; shuchimatulaM viduShAM mate niviShTam |
anabhimatamasevitaM cha mUDhai;rvratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.26:
achalitamatirachyutaH svadharmA;tparimitasa.nsaraNaH parAvaraj~naH |
vigatabhayakaShAyalobhamoho; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.27:
aniyataphalabhakShyabhojyapeyaM; vidhipariNAmavibhaktadeshakAlam |
hRRidayasukhamasevitaM kadaryai;rvratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.28:
idamidamiti tRRiShNayAbhibhUtaM; janamanavAptadhanaM viShIdamAnam |
nipuNamanunishAmya tattvabuddhyA; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.29:
bahuvidhamanudRRishya chArthahetoH; kRRipaNamihAryamanAryamAshrayantam |
upashamaruchirAtmavAnprashAnto; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.30:
sukhamasukhamanarthamarthalAbhaM; ratimaratiM maraNaM cha jIvitaM cha |
vidhiniyatamavekShya tattvato.ahaM; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.31:
apagatabhayarAgamohadarpo; dhRRitimatibuddhisamanvitaH prashAntaH |
upagataphalabhogino nishAmya; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.32:
aniyatashayanAsanaH prakRRityA; damaniyamavratasatyashauchayuktaH |
apagataphalasa~nchayaH prahRRiShTo; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.33:
abhigatamasukhArthamIhanArthai;rupagatabuddhiravekShya chAtmasa.nsthaH |
tRRiShitamaniyataM mano niyantuM; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.34:
na hRRidayamanurudhyate mano vA; priyasukhadurlabhatAmanityatAM cha |
tadubhayamupalakShayannivAhaM; vratamidamAjagaraM shuchishcharAmi
shlokas.35:
bahu kathitamidaM hi buddhimadbhiH; kavibhirabhiprathayadbhirAtmakIrtim |
idamidamiti tatra tatra tatta;tsvaparamatairgahanaM pratarkayadbhiH
shlokas.36:
tadahamanunishAmya viprayAtaM; pRRithagabhipannamihAbudhairmanuShyaiH |
anavasitamanantadoShapAraM; nRRiShu viharAmi vinItaroShatRRiShNaH
shlokas.37:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ajagaracharitaM vrataM mahAtmA; ya iha naro.anucharedvinItarAgaH |
apagatabhayamanyulobhamohaH; sa khalu sukhI viharedimaM vihAram

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bAndhavAH karma vittaM vA praj~nA veha pitAmaha |
narasya kA pratiShThA syAdetatpRRiShTo vadasva me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
praj~nA pratiShThA bhUtAnAM praj~nA lAbhaH paro mataH |
praj~nA naiHshreyasI loke praj~nA svargo mataH satAm
shlokas.3:
praj~nayA prApitArtho hi baliraishvaryasa~NkShaye |
prahrAdo namuchirma~NkistasyAH kiM vidyate param
shlokas.4:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
indrakAshyapasa.nvAdaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.5:
vaishyaH kashchidRRiShiM tAta kAshyapaM sa.nshitavratam |
rathena pAtayAmAsa shrImAndRRiptastapasvinam
shlokas.6:
ArtaH sa patitaH kruddhastyaktvAtmAnamathAbravIt |
mariShyAmyadhanasyeha jIvitArtho na vidyate
shlokas.7:
tathA mumUrShumAsInamakUjantamachetasam |
indraH sRRigAlarUpeNa babhAShe kruddhamAnasam
shlokas.8:
manuShyayonimichChanti sarvabhUtAni sarvashaH |
manuShyatve cha vipratvaM sarva evAbhinandati
shlokas.9:
manuShyo brAhmaNashchAsi shrotriyashchAsi kAshyapa |
sudurlabhamavApyaitadadoShAnmartumichChasi
shlokas.10:
sarve lAbhAH sAbhimAnA iti satyA bata shrutiH |
santoShaNIyarUpo.asi lobhAdyadabhimanyase
shlokas.11:
aho siddhArthatA teShAM yeShAM santIha pANayaH |
pANimadbhyaH spRRihAsmAkaM yathA tava dhanasya vai
shlokas.12:
na pANilAbhAdadhiko lAbhaH kashchana vidyate |
apANitvAdvayaM brahmankaNTakAnnoddharAmahe
shlokas.13:
atha yeShAM punaH pANI devadattau dashA~NgulI |
uddharanti kRRimIna~NgAddashamAnAnkaShanti cha
shlokas.14:
himavarShAtapAnAM cha paritrANAni kurvate |
chelamannaM sukhaM shayyAM nivAtaM chopabhu~njate
shlokas.15:
adhiShThAya cha gAM loke bhu~njate vAhayanti cha |
upAyairbahubhishchaiva vashyAnAtmani kurvate
shlokas.16:
ye khalvajihvAH kRRipaNA alpaprANA apANayaH |
sahante tAni duHkhAni diShTyA tvaM na tathA mune
shlokas.17:
diShTyA tvaM na sRRigAlo vai na kRRimirna cha mUShakaH |
na sarpo na cha maNDUko na chAnyaH pApayonijaH
shlokas.18:
etAvatApi lAbhena toShTumarhasi kAshyapa |
kiM punaryo.asi sattvAnAM sarveShAM brAhmaNottamaH
shlokas.19:
ime mAM kRRimayo.adanti teShAmuddharaNAya me |
nAsti shaktirapANitvAtpashyAvasthAmimAM mama
shlokas.20:
akAryamiti chaivemaM nAtmAnaM santyajAmyaham |
netaH pApIyasIM yoniM pateyamaparAmiti
shlokas.21:
madhye vai pApayonInAM sArgAlI yAmahaM gataH |
pApIyasyo bahutarA ito.anyAH pApayonayaH
shlokas.22:
jAtyaivaike sukhatarAH santyanye bhRRishaduHkhitAH |
naikAntasukhameveha kvachitpashyAmi kasyachit
shlokas.23:
manuShyA hyADhyatAM prApya rAjyamichChantyanantaram |
rAjyAddevatvamichChanti devatvAdindratAmapi
shlokas.24:
bhavestvaM yadyapi tvADhyo na rAjA na cha daivatam |
devatvaM prApya chendratvaM naiva tuShyestathA sati
shlokas.25:
na tRRiptiH priyalAbhe.asti tRRiShNA nAdbhiH prashAmyati |
samprajvalati sA bhUyaH samidbhiriva pAvakaH
shlokas.26:
astyeva tvayi shoko vai harShashchAsti tathA tvayi |
sukhaduHkhe tathA chobhe tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.27:
parichChidyaiva kAmAnAM sarveShAM chaiva karmaNAm |
mUlaM rundhIndriyagrAmaM shakuntAniva pa~njare
shlokas.28:
na khalvapyarasaj~nasya kAmaH kvachana jAyate |
sa.nsparshAddarshanAdvApi shravaNAdvApi jAyate
shlokas.29:
na tvaM smarasi vAruNyA laTvAkAnAM cha pakShiNAm |
tAbhyAM chAbhyadhiko bhakShyo na kashchidvidyate kvachit
shlokas.30:
yAni chAnyAni dUreShu bhakShyabhojyAni kAshyapa |
yeShAmabhuktapUrvaM te teShAmasmRRitireva cha
shlokas.31:
aprAshanamasa.nsparshamasa.ndarshanameva cha |
puruShasyaiSha niyamo manye shreyo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.32:
pANimanto dhanairyuktA balavanto na sa.nshayaH |
manuShyA mAnuShaireva dAsatvamupapAditAH
shlokas.33:
vadhabandhaparikleshaiH klishyante cha punaH punaH |
te khalvapi ramante cha modante cha hasanti cha
shlokas.34:
apare bAhubalinaH kRRitavidyA manasvinaH |
jugupsitAM sukRRipaNAM pApAM vRRittimupAsate
shlokas.35:
utsahante cha te vRRittimanyAmapyupasevitum |
svakarmaNA tu niyataM bhavitavyaM tu tattathA
shlokas.36:
na pulkaso na chaNDAla AtmAnaM tyaktumichChati |
asantuShTaH svayA yonyA mAyAM pashyasva yAdRRishIm
shlokas.37:
dRRiShTvA kuNInpakShahatAnmanuShyAnAmayAvinaH |
susampUrNaH svayA yonyA labdhalAbho.asi kAshyapa
shlokas.38:
yadi brAhmaNa dehaste nirAta~Nko nirAmayaH |
a~NgAni cha samagrANi na cha lokeShu dhikkRRitaH
shlokas.39:
na kenachitpravAdena satyenaivApahAriNA |
dharmAyottiShTha viprarShe nAtmAnaM tyaktumarhasi
shlokas.40:
yadi brahma~nshRRiNoShyetachChraddadhAsi cha me vachaH |
vedoktasya cha dharmasya phalaM mukhyamavApsyasi
shlokas.41:
svAdhyAyamagnisa.nskAramapramatto.anupAlaya |
satyaM damaM cha dAnaM cha spardhiShThA mA cha kenachit
shlokas.42:
ye kechana svadhyayanAH prAptA yajanayAjanam |
kathaM te jAtu shocheyurdhyAyeyurvApyashobhanam
shlokas.43:
ichChantaste vihArAya sukhaM mahadavApnuyuH |
uta jAtAH sunakShatre sutIrthAH sumuhUrtajAH
shlokas.44:
nakShatreShvAsureShvanye dustIrthA durmuhUrtajAH |
sampatantyAsurIM yoniM yaj~naprasavavarjitAm
shlokas.45:
ahamAsaM paNDitako haituko vedanindakaH |
AnvIkShikIM tarkavidyAmanurakto nirarthikAm
shlokas.46:
hetuvAdAnpravaditA vaktA sa.nsatsu hetumat |
AkroShTA chAbhivaktA cha brahmayaj~neShu vai dvijAn
shlokas.47:
nAstikaH sarvasha~NkI cha mUrkhaH paNDitamAnikaH |
tasyeyaM phalanirvRRittiH sRRigAlatvaM mama dvija
shlokas.48:
api jAtu tathA tatsyAdahorAtrashatairapi |
yadahaM mAnuShIM yoniM sRRigAlaH prApnuyAM punaH
shlokas.49:
santuShTashchApramattashcha yaj~nadAnataporatiH |
j~neyaj~nAtA bhaveyaM vai varjyavarjayitA tathA
shlokas.50:
tataH sa munirutthAya kAshyapastamuvAcha ha |
aho batAsi kushalo buddhimAniti vismitaH
shlokas.51:
samavaikShata taM vipro j~nAnadIrgheNa chakShuShA |
dadarsha chainaM devAnAmindraM devaM shachIpatim
shlokas.52:
tataH sampUjayAmAsa kAshyapo harivAhanam |
anuj~nAtashcha tenAtha pravivesha svamAshramam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadyasti dattamiShTaM vA tapastaptaM tathaiva cha |
gurUNAM chApi shushrUShA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AtmanAnarthayuktena pApe nivishate manaH |
sa karma kaluShaM kRRitvA kleshe mahati dhIyate
shlokas.3:
durbhikShAdeva durbhikShaM kleshAtkleshaM bhayAdbhayam |
mRRitebhyaH pramRRitaM yAnti daridrAH pApakAriNaH
shlokas.4:
utsavAdutsavaM yAnti svargAtsvargaM sukhAtsukham |
shraddadhAnAshcha dAntAshcha dhanADhyAH shubhakAriNaH
shlokas.5:
vyAlaku~njaradurgeShu sarpachorabhayeShu cha |
hastAvApena gachChanti nAstikAH kimataH param
shlokas.6:
priyadevAtitheyAshcha vadAnyAH priyasAdhavaH |
kShemyamAtmavatAM mArgamAsthitA hastadakShiNam
shlokas.7:
pulAkA iva dhAnyeShu puttikA iva pakShiShu |
tadvidhAste manuShyeShu yeShAM dharmo na kAraNam
shlokas.8:
sushIghramapi dhAvantaM vidhAnamanudhAvati |
shete saha shayAnena yena yena yathA kRRitam
shlokas.9:
upatiShThati tiShThantaM gachChantamanugachChati |
karoti kurvataH karma ChAyevAnuvidhIyate
shlokas.10:
yena yena yathA yadyatpurA karma samAchitam |
tattadeva naro bhu~Nkte nityaM vihitamAtmanA
shlokas.11:
svakarmaphalavikShiptaM vidhAnaparirakShitam |
bhUtagrAmamimaM kAlaH samantAtparikarShati
shlokas.12:
achodyamAnAni yathA puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
svakAlaM nAtivartante tathA karma purAkRRitam
shlokas.13:
saMmAnashchAvamAnashcha lAbhAlAbhau kShayodayau |
pravRRittA vinivartante vidhAnAnte punaH punaH
shlokas.14:
AtmanA vihitaM duHkhamAtmanA vihitaM sukham |
garbhashayyAmupAdAya bhujyate paurvadehikam
shlokas.15:
bAlo yuvA cha vRRiddhashcha yatkaroti shubhAshubham |
tasyAM tasyAmavasthAyAM bhu~Nkte janmani janmani
shlokas.16:
yathA dhenusahasreShu vatso vindati mAtaram |
tathA pUrvakRRitaM karma kartAramanugachChati
shlokas.17:
samunnamagrato vastraM pashchAchChudhyati karmaNA |
upavAsaiH prataptAnAM dIrghaM sukhamanantakam
shlokas.18:
dIrghakAlena tapasA sevitena tapovane |
dharmanirdhUtapApAnAM sa.nsidhyante manorathAH
shlokas.19:
shakunInAmivAkAshe matsyAnAmiva chodake |
padaM yathA na dRRishyeta tathA j~nAnavidAM gatiH
shlokas.20:
alamanyairupAlambhaiH kIrtitaishcha vyatikramaiH |
peshalaM chAnurUpaM cha kartavyaM hitamAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kutaH sRRiShTamidaM vishvaM jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
pralaye cha kamabhyeti tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
sasAgaraH sagaganaH sashailaH sabalAhakaH |
sabhUmiH sAgnipavano loko.ayaM kena nirmitaH
shlokas.3:
kathaM sRRiShTAni bhUtAni kathaM varNavibhaktayaH |
shauchAshauchaM kathaM teShAM dharmAdharmAvatho katham
shlokas.4:
kIdRRisho jIvatAM jIvaH kva vA gachChanti ye mRRitAH |
asmAllokAdamuM lokaM sarvaM sha.nsatu no bhavAn
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bhRRiguNAbhihitaM shreShThaM bharadvAjAya pRRichChate
shlokas.6:
kailAsashikhare dRRiShTvA dIpyamAnamivaujasA |
bhRRiguM maharShimAsInaM bharadvAjo.anvapRRichChata
shlokas.7:
sasAgaraH sagaganaH sashailaH sabalAhakaH |
sabhUmiH sAgnipavano loko.ayaM kena nirmitaH
shlokas.8:
kathaM sRRiShTAni bhUtAni kathaM varNavibhaktayaH |
shauchAshauchaM kathaM teShAM dharmAdharmAvatho katham
shlokas.9:
kIdRRisho jIvatAM jIvaH kva vA gachChanti ye mRRitAH |
paralokamimaM chApi sarvaM sha.nsatu no bhavAn
shlokas.10:
evaM sa bhagavAnpRRiShTo bharadvAjena sa.nshayam |
maharShirbrahmasa~NkAshaH sarvaM tasmai tato.abravIt
shlokas.11:
mAnaso nAma vikhyAtaH shrutapUrvo maharShibhiH |
anAdinidhano devastathAbhedyo.ajarAmaraH
shlokas.12:
avyakta iti vikhyAtaH shAshvato.athAkSharo.avyayaH |
yataH sRRiShTAni bhUtAni jAyante cha mriyanti cha
shlokas.13:
so.asRRijatprathamaM devo mahAntaM nAma nAmataH |
AkAshamiti vikhyAtaM sarvabhUtadharaH prabhuH
shlokas.14:
AkAshAdabhavadvAri salilAdagnimArutau |
agnimArutasa.nyogAttataH samabhavanmahI
shlokas.15:
tatastejomayaM divyaM padmaM sRRiShTaM svayambhuvA |
tasmAtpadmAtsamabhavadbrahmA vedamayo nidhiH
shlokas.16:
aha~NkAra iti khyAtaH sarvabhUtAtmabhUtakRRit |
