brahmA vai sumahAtejA ya ete pa~ncha dhAtavaH
shlokas.17:
shailAstasyAsthisa~nj~nAstu medo mA.nsaM cha medinI |
samudrAstasya rudhiramAkAshamudaraM tathA
shlokas.18:
pavanashchaiva niHshvAsastejo.agnirnimnagAH sirAH |
agnIShomau tu chandrArkau nayane tasya vishrute
shlokas.19:
nabhashchordhvaM shirastasya kShitiH pAdau disho bhujau |
durvij~neyo hyanantatvAtsiddhairapi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.20:
sa eva bhagavAnviShNurananta iti vishrutaH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtastho durvij~neyo.akRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.21:
aha~NkArasya yaH sraShTA sarvabhUtabhavAya vai |
yataH samabhavadvishvaM pRRiShTo.ahaM yadiha tvayA
shlokas.22:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
gaganasya dishAM chaiva bhUtalasyAnilasya cha |
kAnyatra parimANAni sa.nshayaM Chindhi me.arthataH
shlokas.23:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
anantametadAkAshaM siddhachAraNasevitam |
ramyaM nAnAshrayAkIrNaM yasyAnto nAdhigamyate
shlokas.24:
UrdhvaM gateradhastAttu chandrAdityau na dRRishyataH |
tatra devAH svayaM dIptA bhAsvarAshchAgnivarchasaH
shlokas.25:
te chApyantaM na pashyanti nabhasaH prathitaujasaH |
durgamatvAdanantatvAditi me viddhi mAnada
shlokas.26:
upariShTopariShTAttu prajvaladbhiH svayamprabhaiH |
niruddhametadAkAshamaprameyaM surairapi
shlokas.27:
pRRithivyante samudrAstu samudrAnte tamaH smRRitam |
tamaso.ante jalaM prAhurjalasyAnte.agnireva cha
shlokas.28:
rasAtalAnte salilaM jalAnte pannagAdhipaH |
tadante punarAkAshamAkAshAnte punarjalam
shlokas.29:
evamantaM bhagavataH pramANaM salilasya cha |
agnimArutatoyebhyo durj~neyaM daivatairapi
shlokas.30:
agnimArutatoyAnAM varNAH kShititalasya cha |
AkAshasadRRishA hyete bhidyante tattvadarshanAt
shlokas.31:
paThanti chaiva munayaH shAstreShu vividheShu cha |
trailokye sAgare chaiva pramANaM vihitaM yathA
adRRishyAya tvagamyAya kaH pramANamudAharet
shlokas.32:
siddhAnAM devatAnAM cha yadA parimitA gatiH |
tadA gauNamanantasya nAmAnanteti vishrutam
nAmadheyAnurUpasya mAnasasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.33:
yadA tu divyaM tadrUpaM hrasate vardhate punaH |
ko.anyastadvedituM shakto yo.api syAttadvidho.aparaH
shlokas.34:
tataH puShkarataH sRRiShTaH sarvaj~no mUrtimAnprabhuH |
brahmA dharmamayaH pUrvaH prajApatiranuttamaH
shlokas.35:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
puShkarAdyadi sambhUto jyeShThaM bhavati puShkaram |
brahmANaM pUrvajaM chAha bhavAnsa.ndeha eva me
shlokas.36:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
mAnasasyeha yA mUrtirbrahmatvaM samupAgatA |
tasyAsanavidhAnArthaM pRRithivI padmamuchyate
shlokas.37:
karNikA tasya padmasya merurgaganamuchChritaH |
tasya madhye sthito lokAnsRRijate jagataH prabhuH

shlokas.1:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
prajAvisargaM vividhaM kathaM sa sRRijate prabhuH |
merumadhye sthito brahmA tadbrUhi dvijasattama
shlokas.2:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
prajAvisargaM vividhaM mAnaso manasAsRRijat |
sandhukShaNArthaM bhUtAnAM sRRiShTaM prathamato jalam
shlokas.3:
yatprANAH sarvabhUtAnAM vardhante yena cha prajAH |
parityaktAshcha nashyanti tenedaM sarvamAvRRitam
shlokas.4:
pRRithivI parvatA meghA mUrtimantashcha ye pare |
sarvaM tadvAruNaM j~neyamApastastambhire punaH
shlokas.5:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
kathaM salilamutpannaM kathaM chaivAgnimArutau |
kathaM cha medinI sRRiShTetyatra me sa.nshayo mahAn
shlokas.6:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
brahmakalpe purA brahmanbrahmarShINAM samAgame |
lokasambhavasa.ndehaH samutpanno mahAtmanAm
shlokas.7:
te.atiShThandhyAnamAlambya maunamAsthAya nishchalAH |
tyaktAhArAH pavanapA divyaM varShashataM dvijAH
shlokas.8:
teShAM dharmamayI vANI sarveShAM shrotramAgamat |
divyA sarasvatI tatra sambabhUva nabhastalAt
shlokas.9:
purA stimitaniHshabdamAkAshamachalopamam |
naShTachandrArkapavanaM prasuptamiva sambabhau
shlokas.10:
tataH salilamutpannaM tamasIvAparaM tamaH |
tasmAchcha salilotpIDAdudatiShThata mArutaH
shlokas.11:
yathA bhAjanamachChidraM niHshabdamiva lakShyate |
tachchAmbhasA pUryamANaM sashabdaM kurute.anilaH
shlokas.12:
tathA salilasa.nruddhe nabhaso.ante nirantare |
bhittvArNavatalaM vAyuH samutpatati ghoShavAn
shlokas.13:
sa eSha charate vAyurarNavotpIDasambhavaH |
AkAshasthAnamAsAdya prashAntiM nAdhigachChati
shlokas.14:
tasminvAyvambusa~NgharShe dIptatejA mahAbalaH |
prAdurbhavatyUrdhvashikhaH kRRitvA vitimiraM nabhaH
shlokas.15:
agniH pavanasa.nyuktaH khAtsamutpatate jalam |
so.agnirmArutasa.nyogAdghanatvamupapadyate
shlokas.16:
tasyAkAshe nipatitaH snehastiShThati yo.aparaH |
sa sa~NghAtatvamApanno bhUmitvamupagachChati
shlokas.17:
rasAnAM sarvagandhAnAM snehAnAM prANinAM tathA |
bhUmiryoniriha j~neyA yasyAM sarvaM prasUyate

shlokas.1:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
ete te dhAtavaH pa~ncha brahmA yAnasRRijatpurA |
AvRRitA yairime lokA mahAbhUtAbhisa~nj~nitaiH
shlokas.2:
yadAsRRijatsahasrANi bhUtAnAM sa mahAmatiH |
pa~nchAnAmeva bhUtatvaM kathaM samupapadyate
shlokas.3:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
amitAnAM mahAshabdo yAnti bhUtAni sambhavam |
tatasteShAM mahAbhUtashabdo.ayamupapadyate
shlokas.4:
cheShTA vayUH khamAkAshamUShmAgniH salilaM dravaH |
pRRithivI chAtra sa~NghAtaH sharIraM pA~nchabhautikam
shlokas.5:
ityetaiH pa~nchabhirbhUtairyuktaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
shrotraM ghrANaM rasaH sparsho dRRiShTishchendriyasa~nj~nitAH
shlokas.6:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
pa~nchabhiryadi bhUtaistu yuktAH sthAvaraja~NgamAH |
sthAvarANAM na dRRishyante sharIre pa~ncha dhAtavaH
shlokas.7:
anUShmaNAmacheShTAnAM ghanAnAM chaiva tattvataH |
vRRikShANAM nopalabhyante sharIre pa~ncha dhAtavaH
shlokas.8:
na shRRiNvanti na pashyanti na gandharasavedinaH |
na cha sparshaM vijAnanti te kathaM pA~nchabhautikAH
shlokas.9:
adravatvAdanagnitvAdabhaumatvAdavAyutaH |
AkAshasyAprameyatvAdvRRikShANAM nAsti bhautikam
shlokas.10:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
ghanAnAmapi vRRikShANAmAkAsho.asti na sa.nshayaH |
teShAM puShpaphale vyaktirnityaM samupalabhyate
shlokas.11:
UShmato glAnaparNAnAM tvakphalaM puShpameva cha |
mlAyate chaiva shIte na sparshastenAtra vidyate
shlokas.12:
vAyvagnyashaniniShpeShaiH phalapuShpaM vishIryate |
shrotreNa gRRihyate shabdastasmAchChRRiNvanti pAdapAH
shlokas.13:
vallI veShTayate vRRikShaM sarvatashchaiva gachChati |
na hyadRRiShTeshcha mArgo.asti tasmAtpashyanti pAdapAH
shlokas.14:
puNyApuNyaistathA gandhairdhUpaishcha vividhairapi |
arogAH puShpitAH santi tasmAjjighranti pAdapAH
shlokas.15:
pAdaiH salilapAnaM cha vyAdhInAmapi darshanam |
vyAdhipratikriyatvAchcha vidyate rasanaM drume
shlokas.16:
vaktreNotpalanAlena yathordhvaM jalamAdadet |
tathA pavanasa.nyuktaH pAdaiH pibati pAdapaH
shlokas.17:
grahaNAtsukhaduHkhasya Chinnasya cha virohaNAt |
jIvaM pashyAmi vRRikShANAmachaitanyaM na vidyate
shlokas.18:
tena tajjalamAdattaM jarayatyagnimArutau |
AhArapariNAmAchcha sneho vRRiddhishcha jAyate
shlokas.19:
ja~NgamAnAM cha sarveShAM sharIre pa~ncha dhAtavaH |
pratyekashaH prabhidyante yaiH sharIraM vicheShTate
shlokas.20:
tvakcha mA.nsaM tathAsthIni majjA snAyu cha pa~nchamam |
ityetadiha sa~NkhyAtaM sharIre pRRithivImayam
shlokas.21:
tejo.agnishcha tathA krodhashchakShurUShmA tathaiva cha |
agnirjarayate chApi pa~nchAgneyAH sharIriNaH
shlokas.22:
shrotraM ghrANamathAsyaM cha hRRidayaM koShThameva cha |
AkAshAtprANinAmete sharIre pa~ncha dhAtavaH
shlokas.23:
shleShmA pittamatha svedo vasA shoNitameva cha |
ityApaH pa~nchadhA dehe bhavanti prANinAM sadA
shlokas.24:
prANAtpraNIyate prANI vyAnAdvyAyachChate tathA |
gachChatyapAno.avAkchaiva samAno hRRidyavasthitaH
shlokas.25:
udAnAduchChvasiti cha pratibhedAchcha bhAShate |
ityete vAyavaH pa~ncha cheShTayantIha dehinam
shlokas.26:
bhUmergandhaguNAnvetti rasaM chAdbhyaH sharIravAn |
jyotiH pashyati chakShurbhyAM sparshaM vetti cha vAyunA
shlokas.27:
tasya gandhasya vakShyAmi vistarAbhihitAnguNAn |
iShTashchAniShTagandhashcha madhuraH kaTureva cha
shlokas.28:
nirhArI saMhataH snigdho rUkSho vishada eva cha |
evaM navavidho j~neyaH pArthivo gandhavistaraH
shlokas.29:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha rasashchApAM guNAH smRRitAH |
rasaj~nAnaM tu vakShyAmi tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.30:
raso bahuvidhaH proktaH sUribhiH prathitAtmabhiH |
madhuro lavaNastiktaH kaShAyo.amlaH kaTustathA
eSha ShaDvidhavistAro raso vArimayaH smRRitaH
shlokas.31:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha triguNaM jyotiruchyate |
jyotiH pashyati rUpANi rUpaM cha bahudhA smRRitam
shlokas.32:
hrasvo dIrghastathA sthUlashchaturasro.aNu vRRittavAn |
shuklaH kRRiShNastathA rakto nIlaH pIto.aruNastathA
evaM dvAdashavistAro jyotIrUpaguNaH smRRitaH
shlokas.33:
shabdasparshau tu vij~neyau dviguNo vAyuruchyate |
vAyavyastu guNaH sparshaH sparshashcha bahudhA smRRitaH
shlokas.34:
kaThinashchikkaNaH shlakShNaH pichChalo mRRidudAruNaH |
uShNaH shItaH sukho duHkhaH snigdho vishada eva cha
evaM dvAdashavistAro vAyavyo guNa uchyate
shlokas.35:
tatraikaguNamAkAshaM shabda ityeva tatsmRRitam |
tasya shabdasya vakShyAmi vistaraM vividhAtmakam
shlokas.36:
ShaDja RRiShabhagAndhArau madhyamaH pa~nchamastathA |
dhaivatashchApi vij~neyastathA chApi niShAdakaH
shlokas.37:
eSha saptavidhaH prokto guNa AkAshalakShaNaH |
traisvaryeNa tu sarvatra sthito.api paTahAdiShu
shlokas.38:
AkAshajaM shabdamAhurebhirvAyuguNaiH saha |
avyAhataishchetayate na vetti viShamAgataiH
shlokas.39:
ApyAyante cha te nityaM dhAtavastaistu dhAtubhiH |
Apo.agnirmArutashchaiva nityaM jAgrati dehiShu

shlokas.1:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
pArthivaM dhAtumAshritya shArIro.agniH kathaM bhavet |
avakAshavisheSheNa kathaM vartayate.anilaH
shlokas.2:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
vAyorgatimahaM brahmankIrtayiShyAmi te.anagha |
prANinAmanilo dehAnyathA cheShTayate balI
shlokas.3:
shrito mUrdhAnamagnistu sharIraM paripAlayan |
prANo mUrdhani chAgnau cha vartamAno vicheShTate
shlokas.4:
sa jantuH sarvabhUtAtmA puruShaH sa sanAtanaH |
mano buddhiraha~NkAro bhUtAni viShayAshcha saH
shlokas.5:
evaM tviha sa sarvatra prANena paripAlyate |
pRRiShThatashcha samAnena svAM svAM gatimupAshritaH
shlokas.6:
vastimUlaM gudaM chaiva pAvakaM cha samAshritaH |
vahanmUtraM purIShaM chApyapAnaH parivartate
shlokas.7:
prayatne karmaNi bale ya ekastriShu vartate |
udAna iti taM prAhuradhyAtmaviduSho janAH
shlokas.8:
sandhiShvapi cha sarveShu saMniviShTastathAnilaH |
sharIreShu manuShyANAM vyAna ityupadishyate
shlokas.9:
dhAtuShvagnistu vitataH samAnena samIritaH |
rasAndhAtU.nshcha doShA.nshcha vartayannavatiShThati
shlokas.10:
apAnaprANayormadhye prANApAnasamAhitaH |
samanvitaH svadhiShThAnaH samyakpachati pAvakaH
shlokas.11:
AsyaM hi pAyusa.nyuktamante syAdgudasa~nj~nitam |
srotastasmAtprajAyante sarvasrotA.nsi dehinAm
shlokas.12:
prANAnAM saMnipAtAchcha saMnipAtaH prajAyate |
UShmA chAgniriti j~neyo yo.annaM pachati dehinAm
shlokas.13:
agnivegavahaH prANo gudAnte pratihanyate |
sa UrdhvamAgamya punaH samutkShipati pAvakam
shlokas.14:
pakvAshayastvadho nAbherUrdhvamAmAshayaH sthitaH |
nAbhimadhye sharIrasya sarve prANAH samAhitAH
shlokas.15:
prasRRitA hRRidayAtsarve tiryagUrdhvamadhastathA |
vahantyannarasAnnADyo dasha prANaprachoditAH
shlokas.16:
eSha mArgo.atha yogAnAM yena gachChanti tatpadam |
jitaklamAsanA dhIrA mUrdhanyAtmAnamAdadhuH
shlokas.17:
evaM sarveShu vihitaH prANApAneShu dehinAm |
tasminsthito nityamagniH sthAlyAmiva samAhitaH

shlokas.1:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
yadi prANAyate vAyurvAyureva vicheShTate |
shvasityAbhAShate chaiva tasmAjjIvo nirarthakaH
shlokas.2:
yadyUShmabhAva Agneyo vahninA pachyate yadi |
agnirjarayate chaiva tasmAjjIvo nirarthakaH
shlokas.3:
jantoH pramIyamANasya jIvo naivopalabhyate |
vAyureva jahAtyenamUShmabhAvashcha nashyati
shlokas.4:
yadi vAtopamo jIvaH sa.nshleSho yadi vAyunA |
vAyumaNDalavaddRRishyo gachChetsaha marudgaNaiH
shlokas.5:
shleSho yadi cha vAtena yadi tasmAtpraNashyati |
mahArNavavimuktatvAdanyatsalilabhAjanam
shlokas.6:
kUpe vA salilaM dadyAtpradIpaM vA hutAshane |
prakShiptaM nashyati kShipraM yathA nashyatyasau tathA
shlokas.7:
pa~nchasAdhAraNe hyasmi~nsharIre jIvitaM kutaH |
yeShAmanyataratyAgAchchaturNAM nAsti sa~NgrahaH
shlokas.8:
nashyantyApo hyanAhArAdvAyuruchChvAsanigrahAt |
nashyate koShThabhedAtkhamagnirnashyatyabhojanAt
shlokas.9:
vyAdhivraNaparikleshairmedinI chaiva shIryate |
pIDite.anyatare hyeShAM sa~NghAto yAti pa~nchadhA
shlokas.10:
tasminpa~nchatvamApanne jIvaH kimanudhAvati |
kiM vedayati vA jIvaH kiM shRRiNoti bravIti vA
shlokas.11:
eShA gauH paralokasthaM tArayiShyati mAmiti |
yo dattvA mriyate jantuH sA gauH kaM tArayiShyati
shlokas.12:
gaushcha pratigrahItA cha dAtA chaiva samaM yadA |
ihaiva vilayaM yAnti kutasteShAM samAgamaH
shlokas.13:
vihagairupayuktasya shailAgrAtpatitasya vA |
agninA chopayuktasya kutaH sa~njIvanaM punaH
shlokas.14:
Chinnasya yadi vRRikShasya na mUlaM pratirohati |
bIjAnyasya pravartante mRRitaH kva punareShyati
shlokas.15:
bIjamAtraM purA sRRiShTaM yadetatparivartate |
mRRitA mRRitAH praNashyanti bIjAdbIjaM pravartate

shlokas.1:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
na praNAsho.asti jIvAnAM dattasya cha kRRitasya cha |
yAti dehAntaraM prANI sharIraM tu vishIryate
shlokas.2:
na sharIrAshrito jIvastasminnaShTe praNashyati |
yathA samitsu dagdhAsu na praNashyati pAvakaH
shlokas.3:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
agneryathA tathA tasya yadi nAsho na vidyate |
indhanasyopayogAnte sa chAgnirnopalabhyate
shlokas.4:
nashyatItyeva jAnAmi shAntamagnimanindhanam |
gatiryasya pramANaM vA sa.nsthAnaM vA na dRRishyate
shlokas.5:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
samidhAmupayogAnte sannevAgnirna dRRishyate |
AkAshAnugatatvAddhi durgrahaH sa nirAshrayaH
shlokas.6:
tathA sharIrasantyAge jIvo hyAkAshavatsthitaH |
na gRRihyate susUkShmatvAdyathA jyotirna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
prANAndhArayate hyagniH sa jIva upadhAryatAm |
vAyusandhAraNo hyagnirnashyatyuchChvAsanigrahAt
shlokas.8:
tasminnaShTe sharIrAgnau sharIraM tadachetanam |
patitaM yAti bhUmitvamayanaM tasya hi kShitiH
shlokas.9:
ja~NgamAnAM hi sarveShAM sthAvarANAM tathaiva cha |
AkAshaM pavano.abhyeti jyotistamanugachChati
tatra trayANAmekatvaM dvayaM bhUmau pratiShThitam
shlokas.10:
yatra khaM tatra pavanastatrAgniryatra mArutaH |
amUrtayaste vij~neyA Apo mUrtAstathA kShitiH
shlokas.11:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
yadyagnimArutau bhUmiH khamApashcha sharIriShu |
jIvaH ki.nlakShaNastatretyetadAchakShva me.anagha
shlokas.12:
pa~nchAtmake pa~ncharatau pa~nchavij~nAnasa.nyute |
sharIre prANinAM jIvaM j~nAtumichChAmi yAdRRisham
shlokas.13:
mA.nsashoNitasa~NghAte medaHsnAyvasthisa~nchaye |
bhidyamAne sharIre tu jIvo naivopalabhyate
shlokas.14:
yadyajIvaM sharIraM tu pa~nchabhUtasamanvitam |
shArIre mAnase duHkhe kastAM vedayate rujam
shlokas.15:
shRRiNoti kathitaM jIvaH karNAbhyAM na shRRiNoti tat |
maharShe manasi vyagre tasmAjjIvo nirarthakaH
shlokas.16:
sarvaM pashyati yaddRRishyaM manoyuktena chakShuShA |
manasi vyAkule taddhi pashyannapi na pashyati
shlokas.17:
na pashyati na cha brUte na shRRiNoti na jighrati |
na cha sparsharasau vetti nidrAvashagataH punaH
shlokas.18:
hRRiShyati krudhyati cha kaH shochatyudvijate cha kaH |
ichChati dhyAyati dveShTi vAchamIrayate cha kaH
shlokas.19:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
na pa~nchasAdhAraNamatra kiM chi;chCharIrameko vahate.antarAtmA |
sa vetti gandhA.nshcha rasA~nshrutiM cha; sparshaM cha rUpaM cha guNAshcha ye.anye
shlokas.20:
pa~nchAtmake pa~nchaguNapradarshI; sa sarvagAtrAnugato.antarAtmA |
sa vetti duHkhAni sukhAni chAtra; tadviprayogAttu na vetti dehaH
shlokas.21:
yadA na rUpaM na sparsho noShmabhAvashcha pAvake |
tadA shAnte sharIrAgnau dehaM tyaktvA sa nashyati
shlokas.22:
ammayaM sarvamevedamApo mUrtiH sharIriNAm |
tatrAtmA mAnaso brahmA sarvabhUteShu lokakRRit
shlokas.23:
AtmAnaM taM vijAnIhi sarvalokahitAtmakam |
tasminyaH sa.nshrito dehe hyabbinduriva puShkare
shlokas.24:
kShetraj~naM taM vijAnIhi nityaM lokahitAtmakam |
tamo rajashcha sattvaM cha viddhi jIvaguNAnimAn
shlokas.25:
sachetanaM jIvaguNaM vadanti; sa cheShTate cheShTayate cha sarvam |
tataH paraM kShetravidaM vadanti; prAvartayadyo bhuvanAni sapta
shlokas.26:
na jIvanAsho.asti hi dehabhede; mithyaitadAhurmRRita ityabuddhAH |
jIvastu dehAntaritaH prayAti; dashArdhataivAsya sharIrabhedaH
shlokas.27:
evaM sarveShu bhUteShu gUDhashcharati sa.nvRRitaH |
dRRishyate tvagryayA buddhyA sUkShmayA tattvadarshibhiH
shlokas.28:
taM pUrvApararAtreShu yu~njAnaH satataM budhaH |
laghvAhAro vishuddhAtmA pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.29:
chittasya hi prasAdena hitvA karma shubhAshubham |
prasannAtmAtmani sthitvA sukhamakShayamashnute
shlokas.30:
mAnaso.agniH sharIreShu jIva ityabhidhIyate |
sRRiShTiH prajApatereShA bhUtAdhyAtmavinishchaye

shlokas.1:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
asRRijadbrAhmaNAneva pUrvaM brahmA prajApatiH |
AtmatejobhinirvRRittAnbhAskarAgnisamaprabhAn
shlokas.2:
tataH satyaM cha dharmaM cha tapo brahma cha shAshvatam |
AchAraM chaiva shauchaM cha svargAya vidadhe prabhuH
shlokas.3:
devadAnavagandharvadaityAsuramahoragAH |
yakSharAkShasanAgAshcha pishAchA manujAstathA
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH shUdrAshcha dvijasattama |
ye chAnye bhUtasa~NghAnAM sa~NghAstA.nshchApi nirmame
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNAnAM sito varNaH kShatriyANAM tu lohitaH |
vaishyAnAM pItako varNaH shUdrANAmasitastathA
shlokas.6:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
chAturvarNyasya varNena yadi varNo vibhajyate |
sarveShAM khalu varNAnAM dRRishyate varNasa~NkaraH
shlokas.7:
kAmaH krodho bhayaM lobhaH shokashchintA kShudhA shramaH |
sarveShAM naH prabhavati kasmAdvarNo vibhajyate
shlokas.8:
svedamUtrapurIShANi shleShmA pittaM sashoNitam |
tanuH kSharati sarveShAM kasmAdvarNo vibhajyate
shlokas.9:
ja~NgamAnAmasa~NkhyeyAH sthAvarANAM cha jAtayaH |
teShAM vividhavarNAnAM kuto varNavinishchayaH
shlokas.10:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
na visheSho.asti varNAnAM sarvaM brAhmamidaM jagat |
brahmaNA pUrvasRRiShTaM hi karmabhirvarNatAM gatam
shlokas.11:
kAmabhogapriyAstIkShNAH krodhanAH priyasAhasAH |
tyaktasvadharmA raktA~NgAste dvijAH kShatratAM gatAH
shlokas.12:
goShu vRRittiM samAdhAya pItAH kRRiShyupajIvinaH |
svadharmaM nAnutiShThanti te dvijA vaishyatAM gatAH
shlokas.13:
hi.nsAnRRitapriyA lubdhAH sarvakarmopajIvinaH |
kRRiShNAH shauchaparibhraShTAste dvijAH shUdratAM gatAH
shlokas.14:
ityetaiH karmabhirvyastA dvijA varNAntaraM gatAH |
dharmo yaj~nakriyA chaiShAM nityaM na pratiShidhyate
shlokas.15:
varNAshchatvAra ete hi yeShAM brAhmI sarasvatI |
vihitA brahmaNA pUrvaM lobhAttvaj~nAnatAM gatAH
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNA dharmatantrasthAstapasteShAM na nashyati |
brahma dhArayatAM nityaM vratAni niyamA.nstathA
shlokas.17:
brahma chaitatpurA sRRiShTaM ye na jAnantyatadvidaH |
teShAM bahuvidhAstvanyAstatra tatra hi jAtayaH
shlokas.18:
pishAchA rAkShasAH pretA bahudhA mlechChajAtayaH |
pranaShTaj~nAnavij~nAnAH svachChandAchAracheShTitAH
shlokas.19:
prajA brAhmaNasa.nskArAH svadharmakRRitanishchayAH |
RRiShibhiH svena tapasA sRRijyante chApare paraiH
shlokas.20:
AdidevasamudbhUtA brahmamUlAkShayAvyayA |
sA sRRiShTirmAnasI nAma dharmatantraparAyaNA

shlokas.1:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
brAhmaNaH kena bhavati kShatriyo vA dvijottama |
vaishyaH shUdrashcha viprarShe tadbrUhi vadatAM vara
shlokas.2:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
jAtakarmAdibhiryastu sa.nskAraiH sa.nskRRitaH shuchiH |
vedAdhyayanasampannaH ShaTsu karmasvavasthitaH
shlokas.3:
shauchAchArasthitaH samyagvighasAshI gurupriyaH |
nityavratI satyaparaH sa vai brAhmaNa uchyate
shlokas.4:
satyaM dAnaM damo.adroha AnRRisha.nsyaM kShamA ghRRiNA |
tapashcha dRRishyate yatra sa brAhmaNa iti smRRitaH
shlokas.5:
kShatrajaM sevate karma vedAdhyayanasaMmataH |
dAnAdAnaratiryashcha sa vai kShatriya uchyate
shlokas.6:
kRRiShigorakShyavANijyaM yo vishatyanishaM shuchiH |
vedAdhyayanasampannaH sa vaishya iti sa~nj~nitaH
shlokas.7:
sarvabhakSharatirnityaM sarvakarmakaro.ashuchiH |
tyaktavedastvanAchAraH sa vai shUdra iti smRRitaH
shlokas.8:
shUdre chaitadbhavellakShyaM dvije chaitanna vidyate |
na vai shUdro bhavechChUdro brAhmaNo na cha brAhmaNaH
shlokas.9:
sarvopAyaistu lobhasya krodhasya cha vinigrahaH |
etatpavitraM j~nAtavyaM tathA chaivAtmasa.nyamaH
shlokas.10:
nityaM krodhAttapo rakShechChriyaM rakSheta matsarAt |
vidyAM mAnAvamAnAbhyAmAtmAnaM tu pramAdataH
shlokas.11:
yasya sarve samArambhA nirAshIrbandhanAstviha |
tyAge yasya hutaM sarvaM sa tyAgI sa cha buddhimAn
shlokas.12:
ahi.nsraH sarvabhUtAnAM maitrAyaNagatashcharet |
avisrambhe na gantavyaM visrambhe dhArayenmanaH
shlokas.13:
parigrahAnparityajya bhavedbuddhyA jitendriyaH |
ashokaM sthAnamAtiShThediha chAmutra chAbhayam
shlokas.14:
taponityena dAntena muninA sa.nyatAtmanA |
ajitaM jetukAmena bhAvyaM sa~NgeShvasa~NginA
shlokas.15:
indriyairgRRihyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sthitiH |
avyaktamiti vij~neyaM li~NgagrAhyamatIndriyam
shlokas.16:
manaH prANe nigRRihNIyAtprANaM brahmaNi dhArayet |
nirvANAdeva nirvANo na cha ki~nchidvichintayet
sukhaM vai brAhmaNo brahma sa vai tenAdhigachChati
shlokas.17:
shauchena satataM yuktastathAchArasamanvitaH |
sAnukroshashcha bhUteShu taddvijAtiShu lakShaNam

shlokas.1:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
satyaM brahma tapaH satyaM satyaM sRRijati cha prajAH |
satyena dhAryate lokaH svargaM satyena gachChati
shlokas.2:
anRRitaM tamaso rUpaM tamasA nIyate hyadhaH |
tamograstA na pashyanti prakAshaM tamasAvRRitam
shlokas.3:
svargaH prakAsha ityAhurnarakaM tama eva cha |
satyAnRRitAttadubhayaM prApyate jagatIcharaiH
shlokas.4:
tatra tveva.nvidhA vRRittirloke satyAnRRitA bhavet |
dharmAdharmau prakAshashcha tamo duHkhaM sukhaM tathA
shlokas.5:
tatra yatsatyaM sa dharmo yo dharmaH sa prakAsho yaH prakAshastatsukhamiti |
tatra yadanRRitaM so.adharmo yo.adharmastattamo yattamastadduHkhamiti
shlokas.6:
atrochyate
shArIrairmAnasairduHkhaiH sukhaishchApyasukhodayaiH |
lokasRRiShTiM prapashyanto na muhyanti vichakShaNAH
shlokas.7:
tatra duHkhavimokShArthaM prayateta vichakShaNaH |
sukhaM hyanityaM bhUtAnAmiha loke paratra cha
shlokas.8:
rAhugrastasya somasya yathA jyotsnA na bhAsate |
tathA tamobhibhUtAnAM bhUtAnAM bhrashyate sukham
shlokas.9:
tatkhalu dvividhaM sukhamuchyate shArIraM mAnasaM cha
iha khalvamuShmi.nshcha loke sarvArambhapravRRittayaH sukhArthA abhidhIyante |
na hyatastrivargaphalaM vishiShTataramasti
sa eSha kAmyo guNavisheSho dharmArthayorArambhastaddheturasyotpattiH
sukhaprayojanA bharadvAja uvAcha
shlokas.10:
yadetadbhavatAbhihitaM sukhAnAM paramAH striya iti tanna gRRihNImaH
na hyeShAmRRiShINAM mahati sthitAnAmaprApya eSha guNavisheSho
na chainamabhilaShanti shrUyate cha bhagavA.nstrilokakRRidbrahmA
prabhurekAkI tiShThati brahmachArI na kAmasukheShvAtmAnamavadadhAti
api cha bhagavAnvishveshvara umApatiH kAmamabhivartamAnamana~Ngatvena
shamamanayat tasmAdbrUmo na mahAtmabhirayaM pratigRRihIto na tveSha
tAvadvishiShTo guNa iti naitadbhagavataH pratyemi bhagavatA tUktaM
sukhAnAM paramAH striya iti lokapravAdo.api cha bhavati dvividhaH
phalodayaH sukRRitAtsukhamavApyate duShkRRitAdduHkhamiti atrochyatAm
bhRRiguruvAcha
shlokas.11:
anRRitAtkhalu tamaH prAdurbhUtaM tamograstA adharmamevAnuvartante
na dharmam krodhalobhamohamAnAnRRitAdibhiravachChannA
na khalvasmi.Nlloke na chAmutra sukhamApnuvanti
vividhavyAdhigaNopatApairavakIryante vadhabandharogaparikleshAdibhishcha
kShutpipAsAshramakRRitairupatApairupatapyante |
chaNDavAtAtyuShNAtishItakRRitaishcha pratibhayaiH
shArIrairduHkhairupatapyante bandhudhanavinAshaviprayogakRRitaishcha
mAnasaiH shokairabhibhUyante jarAmRRityukRRitaishchAnyairiti
shlokas.12:
yastvetaiH shArIrairmAnasairduHkhairna spRRishyate sa sukhaM veda |
na chaite doShAH svarge prAdurbhavanti tatra bhavati khalu
shlokas.13:
susukhaH pavanaH svarge gandhashcha surabhistathA |
kShutpipAsAshramo nAsti na jarA na cha pApakam
shlokas.14:
nityameva sukhaM svarge sukhaM duHkhamihobhayam |
narake duHkhamevAhuH samaM tu paramaM padam
shlokas.15:
pRRithivI sarvabhUtAnAM janitrI tadvidhAH striyaH |
pumAnprajApatistatra shukraM tejomayaM viduH
shlokas.16:
ityetallokanirmANaM brahmaNA vihitaM purA |
prajA viparivartante svaiH svaiH karmabhirAvRRitAH

shlokas.1:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
dAnasya kiM phalaM prAhurdharmasya charitasya cha |
tapasashcha sutaptasya svAdhyAyasya hutasya cha
shlokas.2:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
hutena shAmyate pApaM svAdhyAye shAntiruttamA |
dAnena bhoga ityAhustapasA sarvamApnuyAt
shlokas.3:
dAnaM tu dvividhaM prAhuH paratrArthamihaiva cha |
sadbhyo yaddIyate ki~nchittatparatropatiShThati
shlokas.4:
asatsu dIyate yattu taddAnamiha bhujyate |
yAdRRishaM dIyate dAnaM tAdRRishaM phalamApyate
shlokas.5:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
kiM kasya dharmacharaNaM kiM vA dharmasya lakShaNam |
dharmaH katividho vApi tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.6:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
svadharmacharaNe yuktA ye bhavanti manIShiNaH |
teShAM dharmaphalAvAptiryo.anyathA sa vimuhyati
shlokas.7:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
yadetachchAturAshramyaM brahmarShivihitaM purA |
teShAM sve sve ya AchArAstAnme vaktumihArhasi
shlokas.8:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
pUrvameva bhagavatA lokahitamanutiShThatA
dharmasa.nrakShaNArthamAshramAshchatvAro.abhinirdiShTAH
tatra gurukulavAsameva tAvatprathamamAshramamudAharanti
samyagatra shauchasa.nskAravinayaniyamapraNIto vinItAtmA ubhe
sandhye bhAskarAgnidaivatAnyupasthAya vihAya tandrAlasye
gurorabhivAdanavedAbhyAsashravaNapavitrIkRRitAntarAtmA
triShavaNamupaspRRishya brahmacharyAgniparicharaNagurushushrUShAnityo
bhaikShAdisarvaniveditAntarAtmA guruvachananirdeshAnuShThAnApratikUlo
guruprasAdalabdhasvAdhyAyatatparaH syAt
shlokas.9:
bhavati chAtra shlokaH guruM yastu samArAdhya dvijo vedamavApnuyAt |
tasya svargaphalAvAptiH sidhyate chAsya mAnasam
shlokas.10:
gArhasthyaM khalu dvitIyamAshramaM vadanti tasya
samudAchAralakShaNaM sarvamanuvyAkhyAsyAmaH samAvRRittAnAM
sadArANAM sahadharmacharyAphalArthinAM gRRihAshramo vidhIyate
dharmArthakAmAvAptirhyatra trivargasAdhanamavekShyAgarhitena karmaNA
dhanAnyAdAya svAdhyAyaprakarShopalabdhena brahmarShinirmitena vA
adrisAragatena vA havyaniyamAbhyAsadaivataprasAdopalabdhena
vA dhanena gRRihastho gArhasthyaM pravartayet taddhi
sarvAshramANAM mUlamudAharanti gurukulavAsinaH parivrAjakA ye
chAnye sa~NkalpitavrataniyamadharmAnuShThAyinasteShAmapyata eva
bhikShAbalisa.nvibhAgAH pravartante ||
shlokas.11:
vAnaprasthAnAM dravyopaskAra iti prAyashaH khalvete sAdhavaH
sAdhupathyadarshanAH svAdhyAyaprasa~NginastIrthAbhigamanadeshadarshanArthaM
pRRithivIM paryaTanti teShAM
pratyutthAnAbhivAdanAnasUyAvAkpradAnasaumukhyashaktyAsanashayanAbhyavahArasatkriyAshcheti
shlokas.12:
bhavati chAtra shlokaH atithiryasya bhagnAsho gRRihAtpratinivartate |
sa dattvA duShkRRitaM tasmai puNyamAdAya gachChati
shlokas.13:
api chAtra yaj~nakriyAbhirdevatAH prIyante nivApena pitaro
vedAbhyAsashravaNadhAraNena RRiShayaH apatyotpAdanena prajApatiriti
shlokas.14:
shlokau chAtra bhavataH
vatsalAH sarvabhUtAnAM vAchyAH shrotrasukhA giraH |
parivAdopaghAtau cha pAruShyaM chAtra garhitam
shlokas.15:
avaj~nAnamaha~NkAro dambhashchaiva vigarhitaH |
ahi.nsA satyamakrodhaH sarvAshramagataM tapaH
shlokas.16:
api chAtra
mAlyAbharaNavastrAbhya~NgagandhopabhoganRRittagItavAditrashrutisukha\-
nayanAbhirAmasa.ndarshanAnAM
prAptirbhakShyabhojyapeyalehyachoShyANAmabhyavahAryANAM vividhAnAmupabhogaH
svadAravihArasantoShaH kAmasukhAvAptiriti
shlokas.17:
trivargaguNanirvRRittiryasya nityaM gRRihAshrame |
sa sukhAnyanubhUyeha shiShTAnAM gatimApnuyAt
shlokas.18:
u~nChavRRittirgRRihastho yaH svadharmacharaNe rataH |
tyaktakAmasukhArambhastasya svargo na durlabhaH

shlokas.1:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
vAnaprasthAH khalu RRiShidharmamanusarantaH puNyAni
tIrthAni nadIprasravaNAni suvivikteShvaraNyeShu
mRRigamahiShavarAhasRRimaragajAkIrNeShu tapasyanto.anusa~ncharanti |
tyaktagrAmyavastrAhAropabhogA
vanyauShadhimUlaphalaparNaparimitavichitraniyatAhArAH sthAnAsanino
bhUmipAShANasikatAsharkarAvAlukAbhasmashAyinaH
kAshakushacharmavalkalasa.nvRRitA~NgAH keshashmashrunakharomadhAriNo
niyatakAlopasparshanA askannahomabalikAlAnuShThAyinaH
samitkushakusumopahArahomArjanalabdhavishrAmAH
shItoShNapavananiShTaptavibhinnasarvatvacho
vividhaniyamayogacharyAvihitadharmAnuShThAnahRRitamA.nsashoNitAstvagasthibhUtA
dhRRitiparAH sattvayogAchCharIrANyudvahanti
shlokas.2:
yastvetAM niyatashcharyAM brahmarShivihitAM charet |
sa dahedagnivaddoShA~njayellokA.nshcha durjayAn
shlokas.3:
parivrAjakAnAM punarAchArastadyathA |
vimuchyAgnidhanakalatraparibarhasa~NgAnAtmanaH snehapAshAnavadhUya parivrajanti
samaloShTAshmakA~nchanAstrivargapravRRitteShvArambheShvasaktabuddhayo.arimitrodAsIneShu
tulyavRRittayaH sthAvarajarAyujANDajasvedajodbhijjAnAM bhUtAnAM
vA~NmanaHkarmabhiranabhidrohiNo.aniketAH
parvatapulinavRRikShamUladevatAyatanAnyanucharanto vAsArthamupeyurnagaraM
grAmaM vA nagare pa~ncharAtrikA grAmaikarAtrikAH |
pravishya cha prANadhAraNamAtrArthaM dvijAtInAM
bhavanAnyasa~NkIrNakarmaNAmupatiShTheyuH pAtrapatitAyAchitabhaikShAH
kAmakrodhadarpamohalobhakArpaNyadambhaparivAdAbhimAnahi.nsAnivRRittA iti
shlokas.4:
bhavati chAtra shlokaH
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo dattvA charati yo muniH |
na tasya sarvabhUtebhyo bhayamutpadyate kvachit
shlokas.5:
kRRitvAgnihotraM svasharIrasa.nsthaM; shArIramagniM svamukhe juhoti |
yo bhaikShacharyopagatairhavirbhi;shchitAgninAM sa vyatiyAti lokAn
shlokas.6:
mokShAshramaM yaH kurute yathoktaM; shuchiH susa~NkalpitabuddhiyuktaH |
anindhanaM jyotiriva prashAntaM; sa brahmalokaM shrayate dvijAtiH
shlokas.7:
bharadvAja uvAcha||
asmAllokAtparo lokaH shrUyate nopalabhyate |
tamahaM j~nAtumichChAmi tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.8:
bhRRiguruvAcha||
uttare himavatpArshve puNye sarvaguNAnvite |
puNyaH kShemyashcha kAmyashcha sa varo loka uchyate
shlokas.9:
tatra hyapApakarmANaH shuchayo.atyantanirmalAH |
lobhamohaparityaktA mAnavA nirupadravAH
shlokas.10:
sa svargasadRRisho deshastatra hyuktAH shubhA guNAH |
kAle mRRityuH prabhavati spRRishanti vyAdhayo na cha
shlokas.11:
na lobhaH paradAreShu svadAranirato janaH |
na chAnyonyavadhastatra dravyeShu na cha vismayaH
parokShadharmo naivAsti sa.ndeho nApi jAyate
shlokas.12:
kRRitasya tu phalaM tatra pratyakShamupalabhyate |
shayyAyAnAsanopetAH prAsAdabhavanAshrayAH
sarvakAmairvRRitAH kechiddhemAbharaNabhUShitAH
shlokas.13:
prANadhAraNamAtraM tu keShA~nchidupapadyate |
shrameNa mahatA kechitkurvanti prANadhAraNam
shlokas.14:
iha dharmaparAH kechitkechinnaikRRitikA narAH |
sukhitA duHkhitAH kechinnirdhanA dhanino.apare
shlokas.15:
iha shramo bhayaM mohaH kShudhA tIvrA cha jAyate |
lobhashchArthakRRito nR^INAM yena muhyanti paNDitAH
shlokas.16:
iha chintA bahuvidhA dharmAdharmasya karmaNaH |
yastadvedobhayaM prAj~naH pApmanA na sa lipyate
shlokas.17:
sopadhaM nikRRitiH steyaM parivAdo.abhyasUyatA |
paropaghAto hi.nsA cha paishunyamanRRitaM tathA
shlokas.18:
etAnAsevate yastu tapastasya prahIyate |
yastvetAnnAcharedvidvA.nstapastasyAbhivardhate
shlokas.19:
karmabhUmiriyaM loka iha kRRitvA shubhAshubham |
shubhaiH shubhamavApnoti kRRitvAshubhamato.anyathA
shlokas.20:
iha prajApatiH pUrvaM devAH sarShigaNAstathA |
iShTveShTatapasaH pUtA brahmalokamupAshritAH
shlokas.21:
uttaraH pRRithivIbhAgaH sarvapuNyatamaH shubhaH |
ihatyAstatra jAyante ye vai puNyakRRito janAH
shlokas.22:
asatkarmANi kurvantastiryagyoniShu chApare |
kShINAyuShastathaivAnye nashyanti pRRithivItale
shlokas.23:
anyonyabhakShaNe saktA lobhamohasamanvitAH |
ihaiva parivartante na te yAntyuttarAM disham
shlokas.24:
ye gurUnupasevante niyatA brahmachAriNaH |
panthAnaM sarvalokAnAM te jAnanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.25:
ityukto.ayaM mayA dharmaH sa~NkShepAdbrahmanirmitaH |
dharmAdharmau hi lokasya yo vai vetti sa buddhimAn
shlokas.26:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityukto bhRRiguNA rAjanbharadvAjaH pratApavAn |
bhRRiguM paramadharmAtmA vismitaH pratyapUjayat
shlokas.27:
eSha te prabhavo rAja~njagataH samprakIrtitaH |
nikhilena mahAprAj~na kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AchArasya vidhiM tAta prochyamAnaM tvayAnagha |
shrotumichChAmi dharmaj~na sarvaj~no hyasi me mataH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
durAchArA durvicheShTA duShpraj~nAH priyasAhasAH |
asanto hyabhivikhyAtAH santashchAchAralakShaNAH
shlokas.3:
purIShaM yadi vA mUtraM ye na kurvanti mAnavAH |
rAjamArge gavAM madhye dhAnyamadhye cha te shubhAH
shlokas.4:
shauchamAvashyakaM kRRitvA devatAnAM cha tarpaNam |
dharmamAhurmanuShyANAmupaspRRishya nadIM taret
shlokas.5:
sUryaM sadopatiShTheta na svapyAdbhAskarodaye |
sAyaM prAtarjapansandhyAM tiShThetpUrvAM tathAparAm
shlokas.6:
pa~nchArdro bhojanaM kuryAtprA~Nmukho maunamAsthitaH |
na nindedannabhakShyA.nshcha svAdvasvAdu cha bhakShayet
shlokas.7:
nArdrapANiH samuttiShThennArdrapAdaH svapennishi |
devarShinAradaproktametadAchAralakShaNam
shlokas.8:
shuchikAmamanaDvAhaM devagoShThaM chatuShpatham |
brAhmaNaM dhArmikaM chaiva nityaM kuryAtpradakShiNam
shlokas.9:
atithInAM cha sarveShAM preShyANAM svajanasya cha |
sAmAnyaM bhojanaM bhRRityaiH puruShasya prashasyate
shlokas.10:
sAyaM prAtarmanuShyANAmashanaM devanirmitam |
nAntarA bhojanaM dRRiShTamupavAsI tathA bhavet
shlokas.11:
homakAle tathA juhvannRRitukAle tathA vrajan |
ananyastrIjanaH prAj~no brahmachArI tathA bhavet
shlokas.12:
amRRitaM brAhmaNochChiShTaM jananyA hRRidayaM kRRitam |
upAsIta janaH satyaM satyaM santa upAsate
shlokas.13:
yajuShA sa.nskRRitaM mA.nsaM nivRRitto mA.nsabhakShaNAt |
na bhakShayedvRRithAmA.nsaM pRRiShThamA.nsaM cha varjayet
shlokas.14:
svadeshe paradeshe vA atithiM nopavAsayet |
kAmyaM karmaphalaM labdhvA gurUNAmupapAdayet
shlokas.15:
gurubhya AsanaM deyaM kartavyaM chAbhivAdanam |
gurUnabhyarchya yujyante AyuShA yashasA shriyA
shlokas.16:
nekShetAdityamudyantaM na cha nagnAM parastriyam |
maithunaM samaye dharmyaM guhyaM chaiva samAcharet
shlokas.17:
tIrthAnAM hRRidayaM tIrthaM shuchInAM hRRidayaM shuchiH |
sarvamAryakRRitaM shauchaM vAlasa.nsparshanAni cha
shlokas.18:
darshane darshane nityaM sukhaprashnamudAharet |
sAyaM prAtashcha viprANAM pradiShTamabhivAdanam
shlokas.19:
devagoShThe gavAM madhye brAhmaNAnAM kriyApathe |
svAdhyAye bhojane chaiva dakShiNaM pANimuddharet
shlokas.20:
paNyAnAM shobhanaM paNyaM kRRiShINAM bAdyate kRRiShiH |
bahukAraM cha sasyAnAM vAhye vAhyaM tathA gavAm
shlokas.21:
sampannaM bhojane nityaM pAnIye tarpaNaM tathA |
sushRRitaM pAyase brUyAdyavAgvAM kRRisare tathA
shlokas.22:
shmashrukarmaNi samprApte kShute snAne.atha bhojane |
vyAdhitAnAM cha sarveShAmAyuShyamabhinandanam
shlokas.23:
pratyAdityaM na meheta na pashyedAtmanaH shakRRit |
sutastriyA cha shayanaM sahabhojyaM cha varjayet
shlokas.24:
tva~NkAraM nAmadheyaM cha jyeShThAnAM parivarjayet |
avarANAM samAnAnAmubhayeShAM na duShyati
shlokas.25:
hRRidayaM pApavRRittAnAM pApamAkhyAti vaikRRitam |
j~nAnapUrvaM vinashyanti gUhamAnA mahAjane
shlokas.26:
j~nAnapUrvaM kRRitaM pApaM ChAdayantyabahushrutAH |
nainaM manuShyAH pashyanti pashyanti tridivaukasaH
shlokas.27:
pApena hi kRRitaM pApaM pApamevAnuvartate |
dhArmikeNa kRRito dharmaH kartAramanuvartate
shlokas.28:
pApaM kRRitaM na smaratIha mUDho; vivartamAnasya tadeti kartuH |
rAhuryathA chandramupaiti chApi; tathAbudhaM pApamupaiti karma
shlokas.29:
AshayA sa~nchitaM dravyaM yatkAle neha bhujyate |
tadbudhA na prasha.nsanti maraNaM na pratIkShate
shlokas.30:
mAnasaM sarvabhUtAnAM dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH |
tasmAtsarveShu bhUteShu manasA shivamAcharet
shlokas.31:
eka eva chareddharmaM nAsti dharme sahAyatA |
kevalaM vidhimAsAdya sahAyaH kiM kariShyati
shlokas.32:
devA yonirmanuShyANAM devAnAmamRRitaM divi |
pretyabhAve sukhaM dharmAchChashvattairupabhujyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
adhyAtmaM nAma yadidaM puruShasyeha chintyate |
yadadhyAtmaM yatashchaitattanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
adhyAtmamiti mAM pArtha yadetadanupRRichChasi |
tadvyAkhyAsyAmi te tAta shreyaskarataraM sukham
shlokas.3:
yajj~nAtvA puruSho loke prItiM saukhyaM cha vindati |
phalalAbhashcha sadyaH syAtsarvabhUtahitaM cha tat
shlokas.4:
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
mahAbhUtAni bhUtAnAM sarveShAM prabhavApyayau
shlokas.5:
tataH sRRiShTAni tatraiva tAni yAnti punaH punaH |
mahAbhUtAni bhUteShu sAgarasyormayo yathA
shlokas.6:
prasArya cha yathA~NgAni kUrmaH saMharate punaH |
tadvadbhUtAni bhUtAtmA sRRiShTvA saMharate punaH
shlokas.7:
mahAbhUtAni pa~nchaiva sarvabhUteShu bhUtakRRit |
akarotteShu vaiShamyaM tattu jIvo.anu pashyati
shlokas.8:
shabdaH shrotraM tathA khAni trayamAkAshayonijam |
vAyostvaksparshacheShTAshcha vAgityetachchatuShTayam
shlokas.9:
rUpaM chakShustathA paktistrividhaM teja uchyate |
rasaH kledashcha jihvA cha trayo jalaguNAH smRRitAH
shlokas.10:
ghreyaM ghrANaM sharIraM cha te tu bhUmiguNAstrayaH |
mahAbhUtAni pa~nchaiva ShaShThaM tu mana uchyate
shlokas.11:
indriyANi manashchaiva vij~nAnAnyasya bhArata |
saptamI buddhirityAhuH kShetraj~naH punaraShTamaH
shlokas.12:
chakShurAlokanAyaiva sa.nshayaM kurute manaH |
buddhiradhyavasAyAya kShetraj~naH sAkShivatsthitaH
shlokas.13:
UrdhvaM pAdatalAbhyAM yadarvAgUrdhvaM cha pashyati |
etena sarvamevedaM viddhyabhivyAptamantaram
shlokas.14:
puruShe chendriyANIha veditavyAni kRRitsnashaH |
tamo rajashcha sattvaM cha viddhi bhAvA.nstadAshrayAn
shlokas.15:
etAM buddhvA naro buddhyA bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim |
samavekShya shanaishchaiva labhate shamamuttamam
shlokas.16:
guNAnnenIyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyANyapi |
manaHShaShThAni sarvANi buddhyabhAve kuto guNAH
shlokas.17:
iti tanmayamevaitatsarvaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
pralIyate chodbhavati tasmAnnirdishyate tathA
shlokas.18:
yena pashyati tachchakShuH shRRiNoti shrotramuchyate |
jighrati ghrANamityAhU rasaM jAnAti jihvayA
shlokas.19:
tvachA spRRishati cha sparshAnbuddhirvikriyate.asakRRit |
yena sa~NkalpayatyarthaM ki~nchidbhavati tanmanaH
shlokas.20:
adhiShThAnAni buddherhi pRRithagarthAni pa~nchadhA |
pa~nchendriyANi yAnyAhustAnyadRRishyo.adhitiShThati
shlokas.21:
puruShAdhiShThitA buddhistriShu bhAveShu vartate |
kadAchillabhate prItiM kadAchidanushochati
shlokas.22:
na sukhena na duHkhena kadAchidapi vartate |
evaM narANAM manasi triShu bhAveShvavasthitA
shlokas.23:
seyaM bhAvAtmikA bhAvA.nstrInetAnnAtivartate |
saritAM sAgaro bhartA mahAvelAmivormimAn
shlokas.24:
atibhAvagatA buddhirbhAve manasi vartate |
pravartamAnaM hi rajastadbhAvamanuvartate
shlokas.25:
indriyANi hi sarvANi pradarshayati sA sadA |
prItiH sattvaM rajaH shokastamo mohashcha te trayaH
shlokas.26:
ye ye cha bhAvA loke.asminsarveShveteShu te triShu |
iti buddhigatiH sarvA vyAkhyAtA tava bhArata
shlokas.27:
indriyANi cha sarvANi vijetavyAni dhImatA |
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva prANinAM sa.nshritAH sadA
shlokas.28:
trividhA vedanA chaiva sarvasattveShu dRRishyate |
sAttvikI rAjasI chaiva tAmasI cheti bhArata
shlokas.29:
sukhasparshaH sattvaguNo duHkhasparsho rajoguNaH |
tamoguNena sa.nyuktau bhavato.avyAvahArikau
shlokas.30:
tatra yatprItisa.nyuktaM kAye manasi vA bhavet |
vartate sAttviko bhAva ityavekSheta tattadA
shlokas.31:
atha yadduHkhasa.nyuktamatuShTikaramAtmanaH |
pravRRittaM raja ityeva tannasa.nrabhya chintayet
shlokas.32:
atha yanmohasa.nyuktamavyaktamiva yadbhavet |
apratarkyamavij~neyaM tamastadupadhArayet
shlokas.33:
praharShaH prItirAnandaH sukhaM sa.nshAntachittatA |
katha~nchidabhivartanta ityete sAttvikA guNAH
shlokas.34:
atuShTiH paritApashcha shoko lobhastathAkShamA |
li~NgAni rajasastAni dRRishyante hetvahetubhiH
shlokas.35:
abhimAnastathA mohaH pramAdaH svapnatandritA |
katha~nchidabhivartante vividhAstAmasA guNAH
shlokas.36:
dUragaM bahudhAgAmi prArthanAsa.nshayAtmakam |
manaH suniyataM yasya sa sukhI pretya cheha cha
shlokas.37:
sattvakShetraj~nayoretadantaraM pashya sUkShmayoH |
sRRijate tu guNAneka eko na sRRijate guNAn
shlokas.38:
mashakodumbarau chApi samprayuktau yathA sadA |
anyonyamanyau cha yathA samprayogastathA tayoH
shlokas.39:
pRRithagbhUtau prakRRityA tau samprayuktau cha sarvadA |
yathA matsyo jalaM chaiva samprayuktau tathaiva tau
shlokas.40:
na guNA vidurAtmAnaM sa guNAnvetti sarvashaH |
paridraShTA guNAnAM cha sa.nsraShTA manyate sadA
shlokas.41:
indriyaistu pradIpArthaM kurute buddhisaptamaiH |
nirvicheShTairajAnadbhiH paramAtmA pradIpavat
shlokas.42:
sRRijate hi guNAnsattvaM kShetraj~naH paripashyati |
samprayogastayoreSha sattvakShetraj~nayordhruvaH
shlokas.43:
Ashrayo nAsti sattvasya kShetraj~nasya cha kashchana |
sattvaM manaH sa.nsRRijati na guNAnvai kadAchana
shlokas.44:
rashmI.nsteShAM sa manasA yadA samya~NniyachChati |
tadA prakAshate.asyAtmA ghaTe dIpo jvalanniva
shlokas.45:
tyaktvA yaH prAkRRitaM karma nityamAtmaratirmuniH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtaH syAtsa gachChetparamAM gatim
shlokas.46:
yathA vAricharaH pakShI lipyamAno na lipyate |
evameva kRRitapraj~no bhUteShu parivartate
shlokas.47:
eva.nsvabhAvamevaitatsvabuddhyA viharennaraH |
ashochannaprahRRiShya.nshcha charedvigatamatsaraH
shlokas.48:
svabhAvasiddhyA sa.nsiddhAnsa nityaM sRRijate guNAn |
UrNanAbhiryathA sraShTA vij~neyAstantuvadguNAH
shlokas.49:
pradhvastA na nivartante nivRRittirnopalabhyate |
pratyakSheNa parokShaM tadanumAnena sidhyati
shlokas.50:
evameke vyavasyanti nivRRittiriti chApare |
ubhayaM sampradhAryaitadadhyavasyedyathAmati
shlokas.51:
itImaM hRRidayagranthiM buddhibhedamayaM dRRiDham |
vimuchya sukhamAsIta na shochechChinnasa.nshayaH
shlokas.52:
malinAH prApnuyuH shuddhiM yathA pUrNAM nadIM narAH |
avagAhya suvidva.nso viddhi j~nAnamidaM tathA
shlokas.53:
mahAnadIM hi pAraj~nastapyate na taranyathA |
evaM ye viduradhyAtmaM kaivalyaM j~nAnamuttamam
shlokas.54:
etAM buddhvA naraH sarvAM bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim |
avekShya cha shanairbuddhyA labhate shaM paraM tataH
shlokas.55:
trivargo yasya viditaH prAgjyotiH sa vimuchyate |
anviShya manasA yuktastattvadarshI nirutsukaH
shlokas.56:
na chAtmA shakyate draShTumindriyeShu vibhAgashaH |
tatra tatra visRRiShTeShu durjayeShvakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.57:
etadbuddhvA bhavedbuddhaH kimanyadbuddhalakShaNam |
vij~nAya taddhi manyante kRRitakRRityA manIShiNaH
shlokas.58:
na bhavati viduShAM tato bhayaM; yadaviduShAM sumahadbhayaM bhavet |
na hi gatiradhikAsti kasya chi;tsati hi guNe pravadantyatulyatAm
shlokas.59:
yatkarotyanabhisandhipUrvakaM; tachcha nirNudati yatpurA kRRitam |
nApriyaM tadubhayaM kutaH priyaM; tasya tajjanayatIha kurvataH
shlokas.60:
loka AturajanAnvirAviNa;stattadeva bahu pashya shochataH |
tatra pashya kushalAnashochato; ye vidustadubhayaM padaM sadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
hanta vakShyAmi te pArtha dhyAnayogaM chaturvidham |
yaM j~nAtvA shAshvatIM siddhiM gachChanti paramarShayaH
shlokas.2:
yathA svanuShThitaM dhyAnaM tathA kurvanti yoginaH |
maharShayo j~nAnatRRiptA nirvANagatamAnasAH
shlokas.3:
nAvartante punaH pArtha muktAH sa.nsAradoShataH |
janmadoShaparikShINAH svabhAve paryavasthitAH
shlokas.4:
nirdva.ndvA nityasattvasthA vimuktA nityamAshritAH |
asa~NgInyavivAdIni manaHshAntikarANi cha
shlokas.5:
tatra svAdhyAyasa.nshliShTamekAgraM dhArayenmanaH |
piNDIkRRityendriyagrAmamAsInaH kAShThavanmuniH
shlokas.6:
shabdaM na vindechChrotreNa sparshaM tvachA na vedayet |
rUpaM na chakShuShA vidyAjjihvayA na rasA.nstathA
shlokas.7:
ghreyANyapi cha sarvANi jahyAddhyAnena yogavit |
pa~nchavargapramAthIni nechChechchaitAni vIryavAn
shlokas.8:
tato manasi sa.nsajya pa~nchavargaM vichakShaNaH |
samAdadhyAnmano bhrAntamindriyaiH saha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.9:
visa~nchAri nirAlambaM pa~nchadvAraM chalAchalam |
pUrve dhyAnapathe dhIraH samAdadhyAnmano.antaram
shlokas.10:
indriyANi manashchaiva yadA piNDIkarotyayam |
eSha dhyAnapathaH pUrvo mayA samanuvarNitaH
shlokas.11:
tasya tatpUrvasa.nruddhaM manaHShaShThamanantaram |
sphuriShyati samudbhrAntaM vidyudambudhare yathA
shlokas.12:
jalabinduryathA lolaH parNasthaH sarvatashchalaH |
evamevAsya tachchittaM bhavati dhyAnavartmani
shlokas.13:
samAhitaM kShaNaM ki~nchiddhyAnavartmani tiShThati |
punarvAyupathaM bhrAntaM mano bhavati vAyuvat
shlokas.14:
anirvedo gataklesho gatatandrIramatsaraH |
samAdadhyAtpunashcheto dhyAnena dhyAnayogavit
shlokas.15:
vichArashcha vitarkashcha vivekashchopajAyate |
muneH samAdadhAnasya prathamaM dhyAnamAditaH
shlokas.16:
manasA klishyamAnastu samAdhAnaM cha kArayet |
na nirvedaM munirgachChetkuryAdevAtmano hitam
shlokas.17:
pA.nsubhasmakarIShANAM yathA vai rAshayashchitAH |
sahasA vAriNA siktA na yAnti paribhAvanAm
shlokas.18:
ki~nchitsnigdhaM yathA cha syAchChuShkachUrNamabhAvitam |
kramashastu shanairgachChetsarvaM tatparibhAvanam
shlokas.19:
evamevendriyagrAmaM shanaiH samparibhAvayet |
saMharetkramashashchaiva sa samyakprashamiShyati
shlokas.20:
svayameva manashchaiva pa~nchavargashcha bhArata |
pUrvaM dhyAnapathaM prApya nityayogena shAmyati
shlokas.21:
na tatpuruShakAreNa na cha daivena kenachit |
sukhameShyati tattasya yadevaM sa.nyatAtmanaH
shlokas.22:
sukhena tena sa.nyukto ra.nsyate dhyAnakarmaNi |
gachChanti yogino hyevaM nirvANaM tannirAmayam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
chAturAshramyamuktaM te rAjadharmAstathaiva cha |
nAnAshrayAshcha bahava itihAsAH pRRithagvidhAH
shlokas.2:
shrutAstvattaH kathAshchaiva dharmayuktA mahAmate |
sa.ndeho.asti tu kashchinme tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.3:
jApakAnAM phalAvAptiM shrotumichChAmi bhArata |
kiM phalaM japatAmuktaM kva vA tiShThanti jApakAH
shlokas.4:
japasya cha vidhiM kRRitsnaM vaktumarhasi me.anagha |
jApakA iti kiM chaitatsA~NkhyayogakriyAvidhiH
shlokas.5:
kiM yaj~navidhirevaiSha kimetajjapyamuchyate |
etanme sarvamAchakShva sarvaj~no hyasi me mataH
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yamasya yatpurA vRRittaM kAlasya brAhmaNasya cha
shlokas.7:
saMnyAsa eva vedAnte vartate japanaM prati |
vedavAdAbhinirvRRittA shAntirbrahmaNyavasthitau
mArgau tAvapyubhAvetau sa.nshritau na cha sa.nshritau
shlokas.8:
yathA sa.nshrUyate rAjankAraNaM chAtra vakShyate |
manaHsamAdhiratrApi tathendriyajayaH smRRitaH
shlokas.9:
satyamagniparIchAro viviktAnAM cha sevanam |
dhyAnaM tapo damaH kShAntiranasUyA mitAshanam
shlokas.10:
viShayapratisaMhAro mitajalpastathA shamaH |
eSha pravRRittako dharmo nivRRittakamatho shRRiNu
shlokas.11:
yathA nivartate karma japato brahmachAriNaH |
etatsarvamasheSheNa yathoktaM parivarjayet
trividhaM mArgamAsAdya vyaktAvyaktamanAshrayam
shlokas.12:
kushochchayaniShaNNaH sankushahastaH kushaiH shikhI |
chIraiH parivRRitastasminmadhye ChannaH kushaistathA
shlokas.13:
viShayebhyo namaskuryAdviShayAnna cha bhAvayet |
sAmyamutpAdya manaso manasyeva mano dadhat
shlokas.14:
taddhiyA dhyAyati brahma japanvai saMhitAM hitAm |
saMnyasyatyatha vA tAM vai samAdhau paryavasthitaH
shlokas.15:
dhyAnamutpAdayatyatra saMhitAbalasa.nshrayAt |
shuddhAtmA tapasA dAnto nivRRittadveShakAmavAn
shlokas.16:
arAgamoho nirdva.ndvo na shochati na sajjate |
na kartAkaraNIyAnAM na kAryANAmiti sthitiH
shlokas.17:
na chAha~NkArayogena manaH prasthApayetkvachit |
na chAtmagrahaNe yukto nAvamAnI na chAkriyaH
shlokas.18:
dhyAnakriyAparo yukto dhyAnavAndhyAnanishchayaH |
dhyAne samAdhimutpAdya tadapi tyajati kramAt
shlokas.19:
sa vai tasyAmavasthAyAM sarvatyAgakRRitaH sukhI |
nirIhastyajati prANAnbrAhmIM sa.nshrayate tanum
shlokas.20:
atha vA nechChate tatra brahmakAyaniShevaNam |
utkrAmati cha mArgastho naiva kvachana jAyate
shlokas.21:
AtmabuddhiM samAsthAya shAntIbhUto nirAmayaH |
amRRitaM virajaHshuddhamAtmAnaM pratipadyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gatInAmuttamA prAptiH kathitA jApakeShviha |
ekaivaiShA gatisteShAmuta yAntyaparAmapi
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAja~njApakAnAM gatiM vibho |
yathA gachChanti nirayamanekaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.3:
yathoktametatpUrvaM yo nAnutiShThati jApakaH |
ekadeshakriyashchAtra nirayaM sa nigachChati
shlokas.4:
avaj~nAnena kurute na tuShyati na shochati |
IdRRisho jApako yAti nirayaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.5:
aha~NkArakRRitashchaiva sarve nirayagAminaH |
parAvamAnI puruSho bhavitA nirayopagaH
shlokas.6:
abhidhyApUrvakaM japyaM kurute yashcha mohitaH |
yatrAbhidhyAM sa kurute taM vai nirayamRRichChati
shlokas.7:
athaishvaryapravRRittaH sa~njApakastatra rajyate |
sa eva nirayastasya nAsau tasmAtpramuchyate
shlokas.8:
rAgeNa jApako japyaM kurute tatra mohitaH |
yatrAsya rAgaH patati tatra tatropajAyate
shlokas.9:
durbuddhirakRRitapraj~nashchale manasi tiShThati |
chalAmeva gatiM yAti nirayaM vAdhigachChati
shlokas.10:
akRRitapraj~nako bAlo mohaM gachChati jApakaH |
sa mohAnnirayaM yAti tatra gatvAnushochati
shlokas.11:
dRRiDhagrAhI karomIti japyaM japati jApakaH |
na sampUrNo na vA yukto nirayaM so.adhigachChati
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
animittaM paraM yattadavyaktaM brahmaNi sthitam |
sadbhUto jApakaH kasmAtsa sharIramathAvishet
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
duShpraj~nAnena nirayA bahavaH samudAhRRitAH |
prashastaM jApakatvaM cha doShAshchaite tadAtmakAH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kIdRRisho jApako yAti nirayaM varNayasva me |
kautUhalaM hi me jAtaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
dharmasyA.nshaH prasUto.asi dharmiShTho.asi svabhAvataH |
dharmamUlAshrayaM vAkyaM shRRiNuShvAvahito.anagha
shlokas.3:
amUni yAni sthAnAni devAnAM paramAtmanAm |
nAnAsa.nsthAnavarNAni nAnArUpaphalAni cha
shlokas.4:
divyAni kAmachArINi vimAnAni sabhAstathA |
AkrIDA vividhA rAjanpadminyashchAmalodakAH
shlokas.5:
chaturNAM lokapAlAnAM shukrasyAtha bRRihaspateH |
marutAM vishvadevAnAM sAdhyAnAmashvinorapi
shlokas.6:
rudrAdityavasUnAM cha tathAnyeShAM divaukasAm |
ete vai nirayAstAta sthAnasya paramAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
abhayaM chAnimittaM cha na cha kleshabhayAvRRitam |
dvAbhyAM muktaM tribhirmuktamaShTAbhistribhireva cha
shlokas.8:
chaturlakShaNavarjaM tu chatuShkAraNavarjitam |
apraharShamanAnandamashokaM vigataklamam
shlokas.9:
kAlaH sampachyate tatra na kAlastatra vai prabhuH |
sa kAlasya prabhU rAjansvargasyApi tatheshvaraH
shlokas.10:
AtmakevalatAM prAptastatra gatvA na shochati |
IdRRishaM paramaM sthAnaM nirayAste cha tAdRRishAH
shlokas.11:
ete te nirayAH proktAH sarva eva yathAtatham |
tasya sthAnavarasyeha sarve nirayasa~nj~nitAH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAlamRRityuyamAnAM cha brAhmaNasya cha sattama |
vivAdo vyAhRRitaH pUrvaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
ikShvAkoH sUryaputrasya yadvRRittaM brAhmaNasya cha
shlokas.3:
kAlasya mRRityoshcha tathA yadvRRittaM tannibodha me |
yathA sa teShAM sa.nvAdo yasminsthAne.api chAbhavat
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNo jApakaH kashchiddharmavRRitto mahAyashAH |
ShaDa~NgavinmahAprAj~naH paippalAdiH sa kaushikaH
shlokas.5:
tasyAparokShaM vij~nAnaM ShaDa~NgeShu tathaiva cha |
vedeShu chaiva niShNAto himavatpAdasa.nshrayaH
shlokas.6:
so.antyaM brAhmaM tapastepe saMhitAM sa.nyato japan |
tasya varShasahasraM tu niyamena tathA gatam
shlokas.7:
sa devyA darshitaH sAkShAtprItAsmIti tadA kila |
japyamAvartaya.nstUShNIM na cha tAM ki~nchidabravIt
shlokas.8:
tasyAnukampayA devI prItA samabhavattadA |
vedamAtA tatastasya tajjapyaM samapUjayat
shlokas.9:
samAptajapyastUtthAya shirasA pAdayostathA |
papAta devyA dharmAtmA vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.10:
diShTyA devi prasannA tvaM darshanaM chAgatA mama |
yadi vApi prasannAsi japye me ramatAM manaH
shlokas.11:
sAvitryuvAcha||
kiM prArthayasi viprarShe kiM cheShTaM karavANi te |
prabrUhi japatAM shreShTha sarvaM tatte bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA devyA vipraH provAcha dharmavit |
japyaM prati mamechCheyaM vardhatviti punaH punaH
shlokas.13:
manasashcha samAdhirme vardhetAharahaH shubhe |
tattatheti tato devI madhuraM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.14:
idaM chaivAparaM prAha devI tatpriyakAmyayA |
nirayaM naiva yAtAsi yatra yAtA dvijarShabhAH
shlokas.15:
yAsyasi brahmaNaH sthAnamanimittamaninditam |
sAdhaye bhavitA chaitadyattvayAhamihArthitA
shlokas.16:
niyato japa chaikAgro dharmastvAM samupaiShyati |
kAlo mRRityuryamashchaiva samAyAsyanti te.antikam
bhavitA cha vivAdo.atra tava teShAM cha dharmataH
shlokas.17:
evamuktvA bhagavatI jagAma bhavanaM svakam |
brAhmaNo.api japannAste divyaM varShashataM tadA
shlokas.18:
samApte niyame tasminnatha viprasya dhImataH |
sAkShAtprItastadA dharmo darshayAmAsa taM dvijam
shlokas.19:
dharma uvAcha||
dvijAte pashya mAM dharmamahaM tvAM draShTumAgataH |
japyasya cha phalaM yatte samprAptaM tachcha me shRRiNu
shlokas.20:
jitA lokAstvayA sarve ye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH |
devAnAM nirayAnsAdho sarvAnutkramya yAsyasi
shlokas.21:
prANatyAgaM kuru mune gachCha lokAnyathepsitAn |
tyaktvAtmanaH sharIraM cha tato lokAnavApsyasi
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
kRRitaM lokairhi me dharma gachCha cha tvaM yathAsukham |
bahuduHkhasukhaM dehaM notsRRijeyamahaM vibho
shlokas.23:
dharma uvAcha||
avashyaM bhoH sharIraM te tyaktavyaM munipu~Ngava |
svarga ArohyatAM vipra kiM vA te rochate.anagha
shlokas.24:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
na rochaye svargavAsaM vinA dehAdahaM vibho |
gachCha dharma na me shraddhA svargaM gantuM vinAtmanA
shlokas.25:
dharma uvAcha||
alaM dehe manaH kRRitvA tyaktvA dehaM sukhI bhava |
gachCha lokAnarajaso yatra gatvA na shochasi
shlokas.26:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
rame japanmahAbhAga kRRitaM lokaiH sanAtanaiH |
sasharIreNa gantavyo mayA svargo na vA vibho
shlokas.27:
dharma uvAcha||
yadi tvaM nechChasi tyaktuM sharIraM pashya vai dvija |
eSha kAlastathA mRRityuryamashcha tvAmupAgatAH
shlokas.28:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha vaivasvataH kAlo mRRityushcha tritayaM vibho |
brAhmaNaM taM mahAbhAgamupAgamyedamabruvan
shlokas.29:
tapaso.asya sutaptasya tathA sucharitasya cha |
phalaprAptistava shreShThA yamo.ahaM tvAmupabruve
shlokas.30:
yathAvadasya japyasya phalaM prAptastvamuttamam |
kAlaste svargamAroDhuM kAlo.ahaM tvAmupAgataH
shlokas.31:
mRRityuM mA viddhi dharmaj~na rUpiNaM svayamAgatam |
kAlena choditaM vipra tvAmito netumadya vai
shlokas.32:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
svAgataM sUryaputrAya kAlAya cha mahAtmane |
mRRityave chAtha dharmAya kiM kAryaM karavANi vaH
shlokas.33:
bhIShma uvAcha||
arghyaM pAdyaM cha dattvA sa tebhyastatra samAgame |
abravItparamaprItaH svashaktyA kiM karomi vaH
shlokas.34:
tasminnevAtha kAle tu tIrthayAtrAmupAgataH |
ikShvAkuragamattatra sametA yatra te vibho
shlokas.35:
sarvAneva tu rAjarShiH sampUjyAbhipraNamya cha |
kushalaprashnamakarotsarveShAM rAjasattamaH
shlokas.36:
tasmai so.athAsanaM dattvA pAdyamarghyaM tathaiva cha |
abravIdbrAhmaNo vAkyaM kRRitvA kushalasa.nvidam
shlokas.37:
svAgataM te mahArAja brUhi yadyadihechChasi |
svashaktyA kiM karomIha tadbhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.38:
rAjovAcha||
rAjAhaM brAhmaNashcha tvaM yadi ShaTkarmasa.nsthitaH |
dadAmi vasu ki~nchitte prArthitaM tadvadasva me
shlokas.39:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
dvividhA brAhmaNA rAjandharmashcha dvividhaH smRRitaH |
pravRRittashcha nivRRittashcha nivRRitto.asmi pratigrahAt
shlokas.40:
tebhyaH prayachCha dAnAni ye pravRRittA narAdhipa |
ahaM na pratigRRihNAmi kimiShTaM kiM dadAni te
brUhi tvaM nRRipatishreShTha tapasA sAdhayAmi kim
shlokas.41:
rAjovAcha||
kShatriyo.ahaM na jAnAmi dehIti vachanaM kvachit |
prayachCha yuddhamityevaM vAdinaH smo dvijottama
shlokas.42:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
tuShyasi tvaM svadharmeNa tathA tuShTA vayaM nRRipa |
anyonyasyottaraM nAsti yadiShTaM tatsamAchara
shlokas.43:
rAjovAcha||
svashaktyAhaM dadAnIti tvayA pUrvaM prabhAShitam |
yAche tvAM dIyatAM mahyaM japyasyAsya phalaM dvija
shlokas.44:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
yuddhaM mama sadA vANI yAchatIti vikatthase |
na cha yuddhaM mayA sArdhaM kimarthaM yAchase punaH
shlokas.45:
rAjovAcha||
vAgvajrA brAhmaNAH proktAH kShatriyA bAhujIvinaH |
vAgyuddhaM tadidaM tIvraM mama vipra tvayA saha
shlokas.46:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
saivAdyApi pratij~nA me svashaktyA kiM pradIyatAm |
brUhi dAsyAmi rAjendra vibhave sati mAchiram
shlokas.47:
rAjovAcha||
yattadvarShashataM pUrNaM japyaM vai japatA tvayA |
phalaM prAptaM tatprayachCha mama ditsurbhavAnyadi
shlokas.48:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
paramaM gRRihyatAM tasya phalaM yajjapitaM mayA |
ardhaM tvamavichAreNa phalaM tasya samApnuhi
shlokas.49:
atha vA sarvameveha japyakaM mAmakaM phalam |
rAjanprApnuhi kAmaM tvaM yadi sarvamihechChasi
shlokas.50:
rAjovAcha||
kRRitaM sarveNa bhadraM te japyaM yadyAchitaM mayA |
svasti te.astu gamiShyAmi kiM cha tasya phalaM vada
shlokas.51:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
phalaprAptiM na jAnAmi dattaM yajjapitaM mayA |
ayaM dharmashcha kAlashcha yamo mRRityushcha sAkShiNaH
shlokas.52:
rAjovAcha||
aj~nAtamasya dharmasya phalaM me kiM kariShyati |
prApnotu tatphalaM vipro nAhamichChe sasa.nshayam
shlokas.53:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
nAdade.aparavaktavyaM dattaM vAchA phalaM mayA |
vAkyaM pramANaM rAjarShe mamApi tava chaiva hi
shlokas.54:
nAbhisandhirmayA japye kRRitapUrvaH katha~nchana |
japyasya rAjashArdUla kathaM j~nAsyAmyahaM phalam
shlokas.55:
dadasveti tvayA choktaM dadAmIti tathA mayA |
na vAchaM dUShayiShyAmi satyaM rakSha sthiro bhava
shlokas.56:
athaivaM vadato me.adya vachanaM na kariShyasi |
mahAnadharmo bhavitA tava rAjanmRRiShAkRRitaH
shlokas.57:
na yuktaM tu mRRiShA vANI tvayA vaktumari.ndama |
tathA mayApyabhyadhikaM mRRiShA vaktuM na shakyate
shlokas.58:
sa.nshrutaM cha mayA pUrvaM dadAnItyavichAritam |
tadgRRihNIShvAvichAreNa yadi satye sthito bhavAn
shlokas.59:
ihAgamya hi mAM rAja~njApyaM phalamayAchithAH |
tanmannisRRiShTaM gRRihNIShva bhava satye sthiro.api cha
shlokas.60:
nAyaM loko.asti na paro na cha pUrvAnsa tArayet |
kuta evAvarAnrAjanmRRiShAvAdaparAyaNaH
shlokas.61:
na yaj~nAdhyayane dAnaM niyamAstArayanti hi |
tathA satyaM pare loke yathA vai puruSharShabha
shlokas.62:
tapA.nsi yAni chIrNAni chariShyasi cha yattapaH |
samAH shataiH sahasraishcha tatsatyAnna vishiShyate
shlokas.63:
satyamekAkSharaM brahma satyamekAkSharaM tapaH |
satyamekAkSharo yaj~naH satyamekAkSharaM shrutam
shlokas.64:
satyaM vedeShu jAgarti phalaM satye paraM smRRitam |
satyAddharmo damashchaiva sarvaM satye pratiShThitam
shlokas.65:
satyaM vedAstathA~NgAni satyaM yaj~nastathA vidhiH |
vratacharyAstathA satyamo~NkAraH satyameva cha
shlokas.66:
prANinAM jananaM satyaM satyaM santatireva cha |
satyena vAyurabhyeti satyena tapate raviH
shlokas.67:
satyena chAgnirdahati svargaH satye pratiShThitaH |
satyaM yaj~nastapo vedAH stobhA mantrAH sarasvatI
shlokas.68:
tulAmAropito dharmaH satyaM chaiveti naH shrutam |
samAM kakShAM dhArayato yataH satyaM tato.adhikam
shlokas.69:
yato dharmastataH satyaM sarvaM satyena vardhate |
kimarthamanRRitaM karma kartuM rAja.nstvamichChasi
shlokas.70:
satye kuru sthiraM bhAvaM mA rAjannanRRitaM kRRithAH |
kasmAttvamanRRitaM vAkyaM dehIti kuruShe.ashubham
shlokas.71:
yadi japyaphalaM dattaM mayA neShiShyase nRRipa |
svadharmebhyaH paribhraShTo lokAnanuchariShyasi
shlokas.72:
sa.nshrutya yo na ditseta yAchitvA yashcha nechChati |
ubhAvAnRRitikAvetau na mRRiShA kartumarhasi
shlokas.73:
rAjovAcha||
yoddhavyaM rakShitavyaM cha kShatradharmaH kila dvija |
dAtAraH kShatriyAH proktA gRRihNIyAM bhavataH katham
shlokas.74:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
na ChandayAmi te rAjannApi te gRRihamAvrajam |
ihAgamya tu yAchitvA na gRRihNIShe punaH katham
shlokas.75:
dharma uvAcha||
avivAdo.astu yuvayorvittaM mAM dharmamAgatam |
dvijo dAnaphalairyukto rAjA satyaphalena cha
shlokas.76:
svarga uvAcha||
svargaM mAM viddhi rAjendra rUpiNaM svayamAgatam |
avivAdo.astu yuvayorubhau tulyaphalau yuvAm
shlokas.77:
rAjovAcha||
kRRitaM svargeNa me kAryaM gachCha svarga yathAsukham |
vipro yadIchChate dAtuM pratIchChatu cha me dhanam
shlokas.78:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
bAlye yadi syAdaj~nAnAnmayA hastaH prasAritaH |
nivRRittilakShaNaM dharmamupAse saMhitAM japan
shlokas.79:
nivRRittaM mAM chiraM rAjanvipraM lobhayase katham |
svena kAryaM kariShyAmi tvatto nechChe phalaM nRRipa
tapaHsvAdhyAyashIlo.ahaM nivRRittashcha pratigrahAt
shlokas.80:
rAjovAcha||
yadi vipra nisRRiShTaM te japyasya phalamuttamam |
AvayoryatphalaM ki~nchitsahitaM nau tadastviha
shlokas.81:
dvijAH pratigrahe yuktA dAtAro rAjava.nshajAH |
yadi dharmaH shruto vipra sahaiva phalamastu nau
shlokas.82:
mA vA bhUtsahabhojyaM nau madIyaM phalamApnuhi |
pratIchCha matkRRitaM dharmaM yadi te mayyanugrahaH
shlokas.83:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato vikRRitacheShTau dvau puruShau samupasthitau |
gRRihItvAnyonyamAveShTya kuchelAvUchaturvachaH
shlokas.84:
na me dhArayasItyeko dhArayAmIti chAparaH |
ihAsti nau vivAdo.ayamayaM rAjAnushAsakaH
shlokas.85:
satyaM bravImyahamidaM na me dhArayate bhavAn |
anRRitaM vadasIha tvamRRiNaM te dhArayAmyaham
shlokas.86:
tAvubhau bhRRishasantaptau rAjAnamidamUchatuH |
parIkShyatAM yathA syAva nAvAmiha vigarhitau
shlokas.87:
virUpa uvAcha||
dhArayAmi naravyAghra vikRRitasyeha goH phalam |
dadatashcha na gRRihNAti vikRRito me mahIpate
shlokas.88:
vikRRita uvAcha||
na me dhArayate ki~nchidvirUpo.ayaM narAdhipa |
mithyA bravItyayaM hi tvA mithyAbhAsaM narAdhipa
shlokas.89:
rAjovAcha||
virUpa kiM dhArayate bhavAnasya vadasva me |
shrutvA tathA kariShyAmItyevaM me dhIyate matiH
shlokas.90:
virUpa uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvAvahito rAjanyathaitaddhArayAmyaham |
vikRRitasyAsya rAjarShe nikhilena nararShabha
shlokas.91:
anena dharmaprAptyarthaM shubhA dattA purAnagha |
dhenurviprAya rAjarShe tapaHsvAdhyAyashIline
shlokas.92:
tasyAshchAyaM mayA rAjanphalamabhyetya yAchitaH |
vikRRitena cha me dattaM vishUddhenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.93:
tato me sukRRitaM karma kRRitamAtmavishuddhaye |
gAvau hi kapile krItvA vatsale bahudohane
shlokas.94:
te cho~nChavRRittaye rAjanmayA samapavarjite |
yathAvidhi yathAshraddhaM tadasyAhaM punaH prabho
shlokas.95:
ihAdya vai gRRihItvA tatprayachChe dviguNaM phalam |
ekasyAH puruShavyAghra kaH shuddhaH ko.atra doShavAn
shlokas.96:
evaM vivadamAnau svastvAmihAbhyAgatau nRRipa |
kuru dharmamadharmaM vA vinaye nau samAdhaya
shlokas.97:
yadi nechChati me dAnaM yathA dattamanena vai |
bhavAnatra sthiro bhUtvA mArge sthApayatu prabhuH
shlokas.98:
rAjovAcha||
dIyamAnaM na gRRihNAsi RRiNaM kasmAttvamadya vai |
yathaiva te.abhyanuj~nAtaM tathA gRRihNIShva mAchiram
shlokas.99:
vikRRita uvAcha||
dIyatAmityanenoktaM dadAnIti tathA mayA |
nAyaM me dhArayatyatra gamyatAM yatra vA~nChati
shlokas.100:
rAjovAcha||
dadato.asya na gRRihNAsi viShamaM pratibhAti me |
daNDyo hi tvaM mama mato nAstyatra khalu sa.nshayaH
shlokas.101:
vikRRita uvAcha||
mayAsya dattaM rAjarShe gRRihNIyAM tatkathaM punaH |
kAmamatrAparAdho me daNDyamAj~nApaya prabho
shlokas.102:
virUpa uvAcha||
dIyamAnaM yadi mayA neShiShyasi katha~nchana |
niya.nsyati tvA nRRipatirayaM dharmAnushAsakaH
shlokas.103:
vikRRita uvAcha||
svaM mayA yAchiteneha dattaM kathamihAdya tat |
gRRihNIyAM gachChatu bhavAnabhyanuj~nAM dadAni te
shlokas.104:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
shrutametattvayA rAjannanayoH kathitaM dvayoH |
pratij~nAtaM mayA yatte tadgRRihANAvichAritam
shlokas.105:
rAjovAcha||
prastutaM sumahatkAryamAvayorgahvaraM yathA |
jApakasya dRRiDhIkAraH kathametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.106:
yadi tAvanna gRRihNAmi brAhmaNenApavarjitam |
kathaM na lipyeyamahaM doSheNa mahatAdya vai
shlokas.107:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tau chovAcha sa rAjarShiH kRRitakAryau gamiShyathaH |
nedAnIM mAmihAsAdya rAjadharmo bhavenmRRiShA
shlokas.108:
svadharmaH paripAlyashcha rAj~nAmeSha vinishchayaH |
vipradharmashcha sugururmAmanAtmAnamAvishat
shlokas.109:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
gRRihANa dhAraye.ahaM te yAchitaM te shrutaM mayA |
na chedgrahIShyase rAja~nshapiShye tvAM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.110:
rAjovAcha||
dhigrAjadharmaM yasyAyaM kAryasyeha vinishchayaH |
ityarthaM me grahItavyaM kathaM tulyaM bhavediti
shlokas.111:
eSha pANirapUrvaM bho nikShepArthaM prasAritaH |
yanme dhArayase vipra tadidAnIM pradIyatAm
shlokas.112:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
saMhitAM japatA yAvAnmayA kashchidguNaH kRRitaH |
tatsarvaM pratigRRihNIShva yadi ki~nchidihAsti me
shlokas.113:
rAjovAcha||
jalametannipatitaM mama pANau dvijottama |
samamastu sahaivAstu pratigRRihNAtu vai bhavAn
shlokas.114:
virUpa uvAcha||
kAmakrodhau viddhi nau tvamAvAbhyAM kArito bhavAn |
sameti cha yaduktaM te samA lokAstavAsya cha
shlokas.115:
nAyaM dhArayate ki~nchijjij~nAsA tvatkRRite kRRitA |
kAlo dharmastathA mRRityuH kAmakrodhau tathA yuvAm
shlokas.116:
sarvamanyonyanikaShe nighRRiShTaM pashyatastava |
gachCha lokA~njitAnsvena karmaNA yatra vA~nChasi
shlokas.117:
bhIShma uvAcha||
jApakAnAM phalAvAptirmayA te samprakIrtitA |
gatiH sthAnaM cha lokAshcha jApakena yathA jitAH
shlokas.118:
prayAti saMhitAdhyAyI brahmANaM parameShThinam |
atha vAgniM samAyAti sUryamAvishate.api vA
shlokas.119:
sa taijasena bhAvena yadi tatrAshnute ratim |
guNA.nsteShAM samAdatte rAgeNa pratimohitaH
shlokas.120:
evaM some tathA vAyau bhUmyAkAshasharIragaH |
sarAgastatra vasati guNA.nsteShAM samAcharan
shlokas.121:
atha tatra virAgI sa gachChati tvatha sa.nshayam |
paramavyayamichChansa tamevAvishate punaH
shlokas.122:
amRRitAchchAmRRitaM prAptaH shItIbhUto nirAtmavAn |
brahmabhUtaH sa nirdva.ndvaH sukhI shAnto nirAmayaH
shlokas.124:
chaturbhirlakShaNairhInaM tathA ShaDbhiH saShoDashaiH |
puruShaM samatikramya AkAshaM pratipadyate
shlokas.125:
atha vechChati rAgAtmA sarvaM tadadhitiShThati |
yachcha prArthayate tachcha manasA pratipadyate
shlokas.126:
atha vA vIkShate lokAnsarvAnnirayasa.nsthitAn |
niHspRRihaH sarvato muktastatraiva ramate sukhI
shlokas.127:
evameShA mahArAja jApakasya gatiryathA |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimuttaraM tadA tau sma chakratustena bhAShite |
brAhmaNo vAtha vA rAjA tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
atha vA tau gatau tatra yadetatkIrtitaM tvayA |
sa.nvAdo vA tayoH ko.abhUtkiM vA tau tatra chakratuH
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tathetyevaM pratishrutya dharmaM sampUjya chAbhibho |
yamaM kAlaM cha mRRityuM cha svargaM sampUjya chArhataH
shlokas.4:
pUrvaM ye chApare tatra sametA brAhmaNarShabhAH |
sarvAnsampUjya shirasA rAjAnaM so.abravIdvachaH
shlokas.5:
phalenAnena sa.nyukto rAjarShe gachCha puNyatAm |
bhavatA chAbhyanuj~nAto japeyaM bhUya eva hi
shlokas.6:
varashcha mama pUrvaM hi devyA datto mahAbala |
shraddhA te japato nityaM bhaviteti vishAM pate
shlokas.7:
rAjovAcha||
yadyevamaphalA siddhiH shraddhA cha japituM tava |
gachCha vipra mayA sArdhaM jApakaM phalamApnuhi
shlokas.8:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
kRRitaH prayatnaH sumahAnsarveShAM saMnidhAviha |
saha tulyaphalau chAvAM gachChAvo yatra nau gatiH
shlokas.9:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vyavasAyaM tayostatra viditvA tridasheshvaraH |
saha devairupayayau lokapAlaistathaiva cha
shlokas.10:
sAdhyA vishve.atha maruto jyotIMShi sumahAnti cha |
nadyaH shailAH samudrAshcha tIrthAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.11:
tapA.nsi sa.nyogavidhirvedAH stobhAH sarasvatI |
nAradaH parvatashchaiva vishvAvasurhahA huhUH
shlokas.12:
gandharvashchitrasenashcha parivAragaNairyutaH |
nAgAH siddhAshcha munayo devadevaH prajApatiH
viShNuH sahasrashIrShashcha devo.achintyaH samAgamat
shlokas.13:
avAdyantAntarikShe cha bheryastUryANi chAbhibho |
puShpavarShANi divyAni tatra teShAM mahAtmanAm
nanRRitushchApsaraHsa~NghAstatra tatra samantataH
shlokas.14:
atha svargastathA rUpI brAhmaNaM vAkyamabravIt |
sa.nsiddhastvaM mahAbhAga tvaM cha siddhastathA nRRipa
shlokas.15:
atha tau sahitau rAjannanyonyena vidhAnataH |
viShayapratisaMhAramubhAveva prachakratuH
shlokas.16:
prANApAnau tathodAnaM samAnaM vyAnameva cha |
evaM tAnmanasi sthApya dadhatuH prANayormanaH
shlokas.17:
upasthitakRRitau tatra nAsikAgramadho bhruvau |
ku~NkuNyAM chaiva manasA shanairdhArayataH sma tau
shlokas.18:
nishcheShTAbhyAM sharIrAbhyAM sthiradRRiShTI samAhitau |
jitAsanau tathAdhAya mUrdhanyAtmAnameva cha
shlokas.19:
tAludeshamathoddAlya brAhmaNasya mahAtmanaH |
jyotirjvAlA sumahatI jagAma tridivaM tadA
shlokas.20:
hAhAkArastato dikShu sarvAsu sumahAnabhUt |
tajjyotiH stUyamAnaM sma brahmANaM prAvishattadA
shlokas.21:
tataH svAgatamityAha tattejaH sa pitAmahaH |
prAdeshamAtraM puruShaM pratyudgamya vishAM pate
shlokas.22:
bhUyashchaivAparaM prAha vachanaM madhuraM sma saH |
jApakaistulyaphalatA yogAnAM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
yogasya tAvadetebhyaH phalaM pratyakShadarshanam |
jApakAnAM vishiShTaM tu pratyutthAnaM samAdhikam
shlokas.24:
uShyatAM mayi chetyuktvAchetayatsa tataH punaH |
athAsya praviveshAsyaM brAhmaNo vigatajvaraH
shlokas.25:
rAjApyetena vidhinA bhagavantaM pitAmaham |
yathaiva dvijashArdUlastathaiva prAvishattadA
shlokas.26:
svayambhuvamatho devA abhivAdya tato.abruvan |
jApakArthamayaM yatnastadarthaM vayamAgatAH
shlokas.27:
kRRitapUjAvimau tulyaM tvayA tulyaphalAvimau |
yogajApakayordRRiShTaM phalaM sumahadadya vai
sarvA.NllokAnatItyaitau gachChetAM yatra vA~nChitam
shlokas.28:
brahmovAcha||
mahAsmRRitiM paThedyastu tathaivAnusmRRitiM shubhAm |
tAvapyetena vidhinA gachChetAM matsalokatAm
shlokas.29:
yashcha yoge bhavedbhaktaH so.api nAstyatra sa.nshayaH |
vidhinAnena dehAnte mama lokAnavApnuyAt
gamyatAM sAdhayiShyAmi yathAsthAnAni siddhaye
shlokas.30:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktvA sa tadA devastatraivAntaradhIyata |
Amantrya taM tato devA yayuH svaM svaM niveshanam
shlokas.31:
te cha sarve mahAtmAno dharmaM satkRRitya tatra vai |
pRRiShThato.anuyayU rAjansarve suprItamAnasAH
shlokas.32:
etatphalaM jApakAnAM gatishchaiva prakIrtitA |
yathAshrutaM mahArAja kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM phalaM j~nAnayogasya vedAnAM niyamasya cha |
bhUtAtmA vA kathaM j~neyastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
manoH prajApatervAdaM maharSheshcha bRRihaspateH
shlokas.3:
prajApatiM shreShThatamaM pRRithivyAM; devarShisa~Nghapravaro maharShiH |
bRRihaspatiH prashnamimaM purANaM; paprachCha shiShyo.atha guruM praNamya
shlokas.4:
yatkAraNaM mantravidhiH pravRRitto; j~nAne phalaM yatpravadanti viprAH |
yanmantrashabdairakRRitaprakAshaM; taduchyatAM me bhagavanyathAvat
shlokas.5:
yadarthashAstrAgamamantravidbhi;ryaj~nairanekairvaragopradAnaiH |
phalaM mahadbhiryadupAsyate cha; tatkiM kathaM vA bhavitA kva vA tat
shlokas.6:
mahI mahIjAH pavano.antarikShaM; jalaukasashchaiva jalaM divaM cha |
divaukasashchaiva yataH prasUtA;staduchyatAM me bhagavanpurANam
shlokas.7:
j~nAnaM yataH prArthayate naro vai; tatastadarthA bhavati pravRRittiH |
na chApyahaM veda paraM purANaM; mithyApravRRittiM cha kathaM nu kuryAm
shlokas.8:
RRiksAmasa~NghA.nshcha yajUMShi chAhaM; ChandA.nsi nakShatragatiM niruktam |
adhItya cha vyAkaraNaM sakalpaM; shikShAM cha bhUtaprakRRitiM na vedmi
shlokas.9:
sa me bhavA~nsha.nsatu sarvameta;jj~nAne phalaM karmaNi vA yadasti |
yathA cha dehAchchyavate sharIrI; punaH sharIraM cha yathAbhyupaiti
shlokas.10:
manuruvAcha||
yadyatpriyaM yasya sukhaM tadAhu;stadeva duHkhaM pravadantyaniShTam |
iShTaM cha me syAditarachcha na syA;detatkRRite karmavidhiH pravRRittaH
iShTaM tvaniShTaM cha na mAM bhajete;tyetatkRRite j~nAnavidhiH pravRRittaH
shlokas.11:
kAmAtmakAshChandasi karmayogA; ebhirvimuktaH paramashnuvIta |
nAnAvidhe karmapathe sukhArthI; naraH pravRRitto na paraM prayAti
paraM hi tatkarmapathAdapetaM; nirAshiShaM brahmaparaM hyavashyam
shlokas.12:
prajAH sRRiShTA manasA karmaNA cha; dvAvapyetau satpathau lokajuShTau |
dRRiShTvA karma shAshvataM chAntavachcha; manastyAgaH kAraNaM nAnyadasti
shlokas.13:
svenAtmanA chakShuriva praNetA; nishAtyaye tamasA sa.nvRRitAtmA |
j~nAnaM tu vij~nAnaguNena yuktaM; karmAshubhaM pashyati varjanIyam
shlokas.14:
sarpAnkushAgrANi tathodapAnaM; j~nAtvA manuShyAH parivarjayanti |
aj~nAnatastatra patanti mUDhA; j~nAne phalaM pashya yathA vishiShTam
shlokas.15:
kRRitsnastu mantro vidhivatprayukto; yaj~nA yathoktAstvatha dakShiNAshcha |
annapradAnaM manasaH samAdhiH; pa~nchAtmakaM karmaphalaM vadanti
shlokas.16:
guNAtmakaM karma vadanti vedA;stasmAnmantrA mantramUlaM hi karma |
vidhirvidheyaM manasopapattiH; phalasya bhoktA tu yathA sharIrI
shlokas.17:
shabdAshcha rUpANi rasAshcha puNyAH; sparshAshcha gandhAshcha shubhAstathaiva |
naro nasa.nsthAnagataH prabhuH syA;detatphalaM sidhyati karmaloke
shlokas.18:
yadyachCharIreNa karoti karma; sharIrayuktaH samupAshnute tat |
sharIramevAyatanaM sukhasya; duHkhasya chApyAyatanaM sharIram
shlokas.19:
vAchA tu yatkarma karoti kiM chi;dvAchaiva sarvaM samupAshnute tat |
manastu yatkarma karoti kiM chi;nmanaHstha evAyamupAshnute tat
shlokas.20:
yathAguNaM karmagaNaM phalArthI; karotyayaM karmaphale niviShTaH |
tathA tathAyaM guNasamprayuktaH; shubhAshubhaM karmaphalaM bhunakti
shlokas.21:
matsyo yathA srota ivAbhipAtI; tathA kRRitaM pUrvamupaiti karma |
shubhe tvasau tuShyati duShkRRite tu; na tuShyate vai paramaH sharIrI
shlokas.22:
yato jagatsarvamidaM prasUtaM; j~nAtvAtmavanto vyatiyAnti yattat |
yanmantrashabdairakRRitaprakAshaM; taduchyamAnaM shRRiNu me paraM yat
shlokas.23:
rasairviyuktaM vividhaishcha gandhai;rashabdamasparshamarUpavachcha |
agrAhyamavyaktamavarNamekaM; pa~nchaprakAraM sasRRije prajAnAm
shlokas.24:
na strI pumAnvApi napu.nsakaM cha; na sanna chAsatsadasachcha tanna |
pashyanti yadbrahmavido manuShyA;stadakSharaM na kSharatIti viddhi

shlokas.1:
manuruvAcha||
akSharAtkhaM tato vAyurvAyorjyotistato jalam |
jalAtprasUtA jagatI jagatyAM jAyate jagat
shlokas.2:
ime sharIrairjalameva gatvA; jalAchcha tejaH pavano.antarikSham |
khAdvai nivartanti nabhAvinaste; ye bhAvinaste paramApnuvanti
shlokas.3:
noShNaM na shItaM mRRidu nApi tIkShNaM; nAmlaM kaShAyaM madhuraM na tiktam |
na shabdavannApi cha gandhavatta;nna rUpavattatparamasvabhAvam
shlokas.4:
sparshaM tanurveda rasaM tu jihvA; ghrANaM cha gandhA~nshravaNe cha shabdAn |
rUpANi chakShurna cha tatparaM ya;dgRRihNantyanadhyAtmavido manuShyAH
shlokas.5:
nivartayitvA rasanaM rasebhyo; ghrANaM cha gandhAchChravaNe cha shabdAt |
sparshAttanuM rUpaguNAttu chakShu;stataH paraM pashyati svaM svabhAvam
shlokas.6:
yato gRRihItvA hi karoti yachcha; yasmi.nshcha tAmArabhate pravRRittim |
yasmi.nshcha yadyena cha yashcha kartA; tatkAraNaM taM samupAyamAhuH
shlokas.7:
yachchAbhibhUH sAdhakaM vyApakaM cha; yanmantravachCha.nsyate chaiva loke |
yaH sarvahetuH paramArthakArI; tatkAraNaM kAryamato yadanyat
shlokas.8:
yathA cha kashchitsukRRitairmanuShyaH; shubhAshubhaM prApnute.athAvirodhAt |
evaM sharIreShu shubhAshubheShu; svakarmajairj~nAnamidaM nibaddham
shlokas.9:
yathA pradIpaH purataH pradIptaH; prakAshamanyasya karoti dIpyan |
tatheha pa~nchendriyadIpavRRikShA; j~nAnapradIptAH paravanta eva
shlokas.10:
yathA hi rAj~no bahavo hyamAtyAH; pRRithakpramAnaM pravadanti yuktAH |
tadvachCharIreShu bhavanti pa~ncha; j~nAnaikadeshaH paramaH sa tebhyaH
shlokas.11:
yathArchiSho.agneH pavanasya vegA; marIchayo.arkasya nadIShu chApaH |
gachChanti chAyAnti cha tanyamAnA;stadvachCharIrANi sharIriNAM tu
shlokas.12:
yathA cha kashchitparashuM gRRihItvA; dhUmaM na pashyejjvalanaM cha kAShThe |
tadvachCharIrodarapANipAdaM; ChittvA na pashyanti tato yadanyat
shlokas.13:
tAnyeva kAShThAni yathA vimathya; dhUmaM cha pashyejjvalanaM cha yogAt |
tadvatsubuddhiH samamindriyatvA;dbudhaH paraM pashyati svaM svabhAvam
shlokas.14:
yathAtmano.a~NgaM patitaM pRRithivyAM; svapnAntare pashyati chAtmano.anyat |
shrotrAdiyuktaH sumanAH subuddhi;rli~NgAttathA gachChati li~Ngamanyat
shlokas.15:
utpattivRRiddhikShayasaMnipAtai;rna yujyate.asau paramaH sharIrI |
anena li~Ngena tu li~Ngamanya;dgachChatyadRRiShTaH pratisandhiyogAt
shlokas.16:
na chakShuShA pashyati rUpamAtmano; na chApi sa.nsparshamupaiti ki~nchit |
na chApi taiH sAdhayate.atha kAryaM; te taM na pashyanti sa pashyate tAn
shlokas.17:
yathA pradIpe jvalato.analasya; santApajaM rUpamupaiti ki~nchit |
na chAntaraM rUpaguNaM bibharti; tathaiva taddRRishyate rUpamasya
shlokas.18:
yathA manuShyaH parimuchya kAya;madRRishyamanyadvishate sharIram |
visRRijya bhUteShu mahatsu dehaM; tadAshrayaM chaiva bibharti rUpam
shlokas.19:
khaM vAyumagniM salilaM tathorvIM; samantato.abhyAvishate sharIrI |
nAnAshrayAH karmasu vartamAnAH; shrotrAdayaH pa~ncha guNA~nshrayante
shlokas.20:
shrotraM khato ghrANamatho pRRithivyA;stejomayaM rUpamatho vipAkaH |
jalAshrayaH sveda ukto rasashcha; vAyvAtmakaH sparshakRRito guNashcha
shlokas.21:
mahatsu bhUteShu vasanti pa~ncha; pa~nchendriyArthAshcha tathendriyeShu |
sarvANi chaitAni manonugAni; buddhiM mano.anveti manaH svabhAvam
shlokas.22:
shubhAshubhaM karma kRRitaM yadasya; tadeva pratyAdadate svadehe |
mano.anuvartanti parAvarANi; jalaukasaH srota ivAnukUlam
shlokas.23:
chalaM yathA dRRiShTipathaM paraiti; sUkShmaM mahadrUpamivAbhipAti |
svarUpamAlochayate cha rUpaM; paraM tathA buddhipathaM paraiti

shlokas.1:
manuruvAcha||
yadindriyaistUpakRRitAnpurastA;tprAptAnguNAnsa.nsmarate chirAya |
teShvindriyeShUpahateShu pashchA;tsa buddhirUpaH paramaH svabhAvaH
shlokas.2:
yathendriyArthAnyugapatsamastA;nnAvekShate kRRitsnamatulyakAlam |
yathAbalaM sa~ncharate sa vidvAM;stasmAtsa ekaH paramaH sharIrI
shlokas.3:
rajastamaH sattvamatho tRRitIyaM; gachChatyasau j~nAnaguNAnvirUpAn |
tathendriyANyAvishate sharIrI; hutAshanaM vAyurivendhanastham
shlokas.4:
na chakShuShA pashyati rUpamAtmano; na pashyati sparshamindriyendriyam |
na shrotrali~NgaM shravaNe nidarshanaM; tathAgataM pashyati tadvinashyati
shlokas.5:
shrotrAdIni na pashyanti svaM svamAtmAnamAtmanA |
sarvaj~naH sarvadarshI cha kShetraj~nastAni pashyati
shlokas.6:
yathA himavataH pArshvaM pRRiShThaM chandramaso yathA |
na dRRiShTapUrvaM manujairna cha tannAsti tAvatA
shlokas.7:
tadvadbhUteShu bhUtAtmA sUkShmo j~nAnAtmavAnasau |
adRRiShTapUrvashchakShurbhyAM na chAsau nAsti tAvatA
shlokas.8:
pashyannapi yathA lakShma jagatsome na vindati |
evamasti na vetyetanna cha tanna parAyaNam
shlokas.9:
rUpavantamarUpatvAdudayAstamaye budhAH |
dhiyA samanupashyanti tadgatAH saviturgatim
shlokas.10:
tathA buddhipradIpena dUrasthaM suvipashchitaH |
pratyAsannaM ninIShanti j~neyaM j~nAnAbhisaMhitam
shlokas.11:
na hi khalvanupAyena kashchidartho.abhisidhyati |
sUtrajAlairyathA matsyAnbadhnanti jalajIvinaH
shlokas.12:
mRRigairmRRigANAM grahaNaM pakShiNAM pakShibhiryathA |
gajAnAM cha gajairevaM j~neyaM j~nAnena gRRihyate
shlokas.13:
ahireva hyaheH pAdAnpashyatIti nidarshanam |
tadvanmUrtiShu mUrtiShThaM j~neyaM j~nAnena pashyati
shlokas.14:
notsahante yathA vettumindriyairindriyANyapi |
tathaiveha parA buddhiH paraM buddhyA na pashyati
shlokas.15:
yathA chandro hyamAvAsyAmali~NgatvAnna dRRishyate |
na cha nAsho.asya bhavati tathA viddhi sharIriNam
shlokas.16:
kShINakosho hyamAvAsyAM chandramA na prakAshate |
tadvanmUrtiviyuktaH sa~nsharIrI nopalabhyate
shlokas.17:
yathA koshAntaraM prApya chandramA bhrAjate punaH |
tadvalli~NgAntaraM prApya sharIrI bhrAjate punaH
shlokas.18:
janmavRRiddhikShayashchAsya pratyakSheNopalabhyate |
sA tu chandramaso vyaktirna tu tasya sharIriNaH
shlokas.19:
utpattivRRiddhivyayato yathA sa iti gRRihyate |
chandra eva tvamAvAsyAM tathA bhavati mUrtimAn
shlokas.20:
nAbhisarpadvimu~nchadvA shashinaM dRRishyate tamaH |
visRRija.nshchopasarpa.nshcha tadvatpashya sharIriNam
shlokas.21:
yathA chandrArkasa.nyuktaM tamastadupalabhyate |
tadvachCharIrasa.nyuktaH sharIrItyupalabhyate
shlokas.22:
yathA chandrArkanirmuktaH sa rAhurnopalabhyate |
tadvachCharIranirmuktaH sharIrI nopalabhyate
shlokas.23:
yathA chandro hyamAvAsyAM nakShatrairyujyate gataH |
tadvachCharIranirmuktaH phalairyujyati karmaNaH

shlokas.1:
manuruvAcha||
yathA vyaktamidaM shete svapne charati chetanam |
j~nAnamindriyasa.nyuktaM tadvatpretya bhavAbhavau
shlokas.2:
yathAmbhasi prasanne tu rUpaM pashyati chakShuShA |
tadvatprasannendriyavA~nj~neyaM j~nAnena pashyati
shlokas.3:
sa eva lulite tasminyathA rUpaM na pashyati |
tathendriyAkulIbhAve j~neyaM j~nAne na pashyati
shlokas.4:
abuddhiraj~nAnakRRitA abuddhyA duShyate manaH |
duShTasya manasaH pa~ncha sampraduShyanti mAnasAH
shlokas.5:
aj~nAnatRRipto viShayeShvavagADho na dRRishyate |
adRRiShTvaiva tu pUtAtmA viShayebhyo nivartate
shlokas.6:
tarShachChedo na bhavati puruShasyeha kalmaShAt |
nivartate tathA tarShaH pApamantaM gataM yathA
shlokas.7:
viShayeShu cha sa.nsargAchChAshvatasya nasa.nshrayAt |
manasA chAnyadAkA~NkShanparaM na pratipadyate
shlokas.8:
j~nAnamutpadyate pu.nsAM kShayAtpApasya karmaNaH |
athAdarshatalaprakhye pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.9:
prasRRitairindriyairduHkhI taireva niyataiH sukhI |
tasmAdindriyarUpebhyo yachChedAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.10:
indriyebhyo manaH pUrvaM buddhiH paratarA tataH |
buddheH parataraM j~nAnaM j~nAnAtparataraM param
shlokas.11:
avyaktAtprasRRitaM j~nAnaM tato buddhistato manaH |
manaH shrotrAdibhiryuktaM shabdAdInsAdhu pashyati
shlokas.12:
yastA.nstyajati shabdAdInsarvAshcha vyaktayastathA |
vimu~nchatyAkRRitigrAmA.nstAnmuktvAmRRitamashnute
shlokas.13:
udyanhi savitA yadvatsRRijate rashmimaNDalam |
sa evAstamupAgachCha.nstadevAtmani yachChati
shlokas.14:
antarAtmA tathA dehamAvishyendriyarashmibhiH |
prApyendriyaguNAnpa~ncha so.astamAvRRitya gachChati
shlokas.15:
praNItaM karmaNA mArgaM nIyamAnaH punaH punaH |
prApnotyayaM karmaphalaM pravRRiddhaM dharmamAtmavAn
shlokas.16:
viShayA vinivartante nirAhArasya dehinaH |
rasavarjaM raso.apyasya paraM dRRiShTvA nivartate
shlokas.17:
buddhiH karmaguNairhInA yadA manasi vartate |
tadA sampadyate brahma tatraiva pralayaM gatam
shlokas.18:
asparshanamashRRiNvAnamanAsvAdamadarshanam |
aghrANamavitarkaM cha sattvaM pravishate param
shlokas.19:
manasyAkRRitayo magnA manastvatigataM matim |
matistvatigatA j~nAnaM j~nAnaM tvabhigataM param
shlokas.20:
indriyairmanasaH siddhirna buddhiM budhyate manaH |
na buddhirbudhyate.avyaktaM sUkShmastvetAni pashyati

shlokas.1:
manuruvAcha||
j~nAnaM j~neyAbhinirvRRittaM viddhi j~nAnaguNaM manaH |
praj~nAkaraNasa.nyuktaM tato buddhiH pravartate
shlokas.2:
yadA karmaguNopetA buddhirmanasi vartate |
tadA praj~nAyate brahma dhyAnayogasamAdhinA
shlokas.3:
seyaM guNavatI buddhirguNeShvevAbhivartate |
avatArAbhiniHsrotaM gireH shRRi~NgAdivodakam
shlokas.4:
yadA nirguNamApnoti dhyAnaM manasi pUrvajam |
tadA praj~nAyate brahma nikaShyaM nikaShe yathA
shlokas.5:
manastvapahRRitaM buddhimindriyArthanidarshanam |
na samakShaM guNAvekShi nirguNasya nidarshanam
shlokas.6:
sarvANyetAni sa.nvArya dvArANi manasi sthitaH |
manasyekAgratAM kRRitvA tatparaM pratipadyate
shlokas.7:
yathA mahAnti bhUtAni nivartante guNakShaye |
tathendriyANyupAdAya buddhirmanasi vartate
shlokas.8:
yadA manasi sA buddhirvartate.antarachAriNI |
vyavasAyaguNopetA tadA sampadyate manaH
shlokas.9:
guNavadbhirguNopetaM yadA dhyAnaguNaM manaH |
