tadA sarvaguNAnhitvA nirguNaM pratipadyate
shlokas.10:
avyaktasyeha vij~nAne nAsti tulyaM nidarshanam |
yatra nAsti padanyAsaH kastaM viShayamApnuyAt
shlokas.11:
tapasA chAnumAnena guNairjAtyA shrutena cha |
ninIShettatparaM brahma vishuddhenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.12:
guNahIno hi taM mArgaM bahiH samanuvartate |
guNAbhAvAtprakRRityA cha nistarkyaM j~neyasaMmitam
shlokas.13:
nairguNyAdbrahma chApnoti saguNatvAnnivartate |
guNaprasAriNI buddhirhutAshana ivendhane
shlokas.14:
yathA pa~ncha vimuktAni indriyANi svakarmabhiH |
tathA tatparamaM brahma vimuktaM prakRRiteH param
shlokas.15:
evaM prakRRititaH sarve prabhavanti sharIriNaH |
nivartante nivRRittau cha sargaM naivopayAnti cha
shlokas.16:
puruShaH prakRRitirbuddhirvisheShAshchendriyANi cha |
aha~NkAro.abhimAnashcha sambhUto bhUtasa~nj~nakaH
shlokas.17:
ekasyAdyA pravRRittistu pradhAnAtsampravartate |
dvitIyA mithunavyaktimavisheShAnniyachChati
shlokas.18:
dharmAdutkRRiShyate shreyastathAshreyo.apyadharmataH |
rAgavAnprakRRitiM hyeti virakto j~nAnavAnbhavet

shlokas.1:
manuruvAcha||
yadA te pa~nchabhiH pa~ncha vimuktA manasA saha |
atha taddrakShyase brahma maNau sUtramivArpitam
shlokas.2:
tadeva cha yathA sUtraM suvarNe vartate punaH |
muktAsvatha pravAleShu mRRinmaye rAjate tathA
shlokas.3:
tadvadgoShu manuShyeShu tadvaddhastimRRigAdiShu |
tadvatkITapata~NgeShu prasaktAtmA svakarmabhiH
shlokas.4:
yena yena sharIreNa yadyatkarma karotyayam |
tena tena sharIreNa tattatphalamupAshnute
shlokas.5:
yathA hyekarasA bhUmiroShadhyAtmAnusAriNI |
tathA karmAnugA buddhirantarAtmAnudarshinI
shlokas.6:
j~nAnapUrvodbhavA lipsA lipsApUrvAbhisandhitA |
abhisandhipUrvakaM karma karmamUlaM tataH phalam
shlokas.7:
phalaM karmAtmakaM vidyAtkarma j~neyAtmakaM tathA |
j~neyaM j~nAnAtmakaM vidyAjj~nAnaM sadasadAtmakam
shlokas.8:
j~nAnAnAM cha phalAnAM cha j~neyAnAM karmaNAM tathA |
kShayAnte tatphalaM divyaM j~nAnaM j~neyapratiShThitam
shlokas.9:
mahaddhi paramaM bhUtaM yuktAH pashyanti yoginaH |
abudhAstaM na pashyanti hyAtmasthA guNabuddhayaH
shlokas.10:
pRRithivIrUpato rUpamapAmiha mahattaram |
adbhyo mahattaraM tejastejasaH pavano mahAn
shlokas.11:
pavanAchcha mahadvyoma tasmAtparataraM manaH |
manaso mahatI buddhirbuddheH kAlo mahAnsmRRitaH
shlokas.12:
kAlAtsa bhagavAnviShNuryasya sarvamidaM jagat |
nAdirna madhyaM naivAntastasya devasya vidyate
shlokas.13:
anAditvAdamadhyatvAdanantatvAchcha so.avyayaH |
atyeti sarvaduHkhAni duHkhaM hyantavaduchyate
shlokas.14:
tadbrahma paramaM proktaM taddhAma paramaM smRRitam |
tadgatvA kAlaviShayAdvimuktA mokShamAshritAH
shlokas.15:
guNaistvetaiH prakAshante nirguNatvAttataH param |
nivRRittilakShaNo dharmastathAnantyAya kalpate
shlokas.16:
RRicho yajUMShi sAmAni sharIrANi vyapAshritAH |
jihvAgreShu pravartante yatnasAdhyA vinAshinaH
shlokas.17:
na chaivamiShyate brahma sharIrAshrayasambhavam |
na yatnasAdhyaM tadbrahma nAdimadhyaM na chAntavat
shlokas.18:
RRichAmAdistathA sAmnAM yajuShAmAdiruchyate |
antashchAdimatAM dRRiShTo na chAdirbrahmaNaH smRRitaH
shlokas.19:
anAditvAdanantatvAttadanantamathAvyayam |
avyayatvAchcha nirdva.ndvaM dva.ndvAbhAvAttataH param
shlokas.20:
adRRiShTato.anupAyAchcha apyabhisandheshcha karmaNaH |
na tena martyAH pashyanti yena gachChanti tatparam
shlokas.21:
viShayeShu cha sa.nsargAchChAshvatasya cha darshanAt |
manasA chAnyadAkA~NkShanparaM na pratipadyate
shlokas.22:
guNAnyadiha pashyanti tadichChantyapare janAH |
paraM naivAbhikA~NkShanti nirguNatvAdguNArthinaH
shlokas.23:
guNairyastvavarairyuktaH kathaM vidyAdguNAnimAn |
anumAnAddhi gantavyaM guNairavayavaiH saha
shlokas.24:
sUkShmeNa manasA vidmo vAchA vaktuM na shaknumaH |
mano hi manasA grAhyaM darshanena cha darshanam
shlokas.25:
j~nAnena nirmalIkRRitya buddhiM buddhyA tathA manaH |
manasA chendriyagrAmamanantaM pratipadyate
shlokas.26:
buddhiprahINo manasAsamRRiddha;stathA nirAshIrguNatAmupaiti |
paraM tyajantIha vilobhyamAnA; hutAshanaM vAyurivendhanastham
shlokas.27:
guNAdAne viprayoge cha teShAM; manaH sadA buddhiparAvarAbhyAm |
anenaiva vidhinA sampravRRitto; guNAdAne brahmasharIrameti
shlokas.28:
avyaktAtmA puruSho.avyaktakarmA; so.avyaktatvaM gachChati hyantakAle |
tairevAyaM chendriyairvardhamAnai;rglAyadbhirvA vartate karmarUpaH
shlokas.29:
sarvairayaM chendriyaiH samprayukto; dehaH prAptaH pa~nchabhUtAshrayaH syAt |
nAsAmarthyAdgachChati karmaNeha; hInastena parameNAvyayena
shlokas.30:
pRRithvyA naraH pashyati nAntamasyA; hyantashchAsyA bhavitA cheti viddhi |
paraM nayantIha vilobhyamAnaM; yathA plavaM vAyurivArNavastham
shlokas.31:
divAkaro guNamupalabhya nirguNo; yathA bhavedvyapagatarashmimaNDalaH |
tathA hyasau muniriha nirvisheShavA;nsa nirguNaM pravishati brahma chAvyayam
shlokas.32:
anAgatiM sukRRitimatAM parAM gatiM; svayambhuvaM prabhavanidhAnamavyayam |
sanAtanaM yadamRRitamavyayaM padaM; vichArya taM shamamamRRitatvamashnute

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na puNDarIkAkShamachyutam |
kartAramakRRitaM viShNuM bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayam
shlokas.2:
nArAyaNaM hRRiShIkeshaM govindamaparAjitam |
tattvena bharatashreShTha shrotumichChAmi keshavam
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shruto.ayamartho rAmasya jAmadagnyasya jalpataH |
nAradasya cha devarSheH kRRiShNadvaipAyanasya cha
shlokas.4:
asito devalastAta vAlmIkishcha mahAtapAH |
mArkaNDeyashcha govinde kathayatyadbhutaM mahat
shlokas.5:
keshavo bharatashreShTha bhagavAnIshvaraH prabhuH |
puruShaH sarvamityeva shrUyate bahudhA vibhuH
shlokas.6:
kiM tu yAni vidurloke brAhmaNAH shAr~NgadhanvanaH |
mAhAtmyAni mahAbAho shRRiNu tAni yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
yAni chAhurmanuShyendra ye purANavido janAH |
asheSheNa hi govinde kIrtayiShyAmi tAnyaham
shlokas.8:
mahAbhUtAni bhUtAtmA mahAtmA puruShottamaH |
vAyurjyotistathA chApaH khaM gAM chaivAnvakalpayat
shlokas.9:
sa dRRiShTvA pRRithivIM chaiva sarvabhUteshvaraH prabhuH |
apsveva shayanaM chakre mahAtmA puruShottamaH
shlokas.10:
sarvatejomayastasmi~nshayAnaH shayane shubhe |
so.agrajaM sarvabhUtAnAM sa~NkarShaNamachintayat
shlokas.11:
AshrayaM sarvabhUtAnAM manaseti vishushruma |
sa dhArayati bhUtAtmA ubhe bhUtabhaviShyatI
shlokas.12:
tatastasminmahAbAho prAdurbhUte mahAtmani |
bhAskarapratimaM divyaM nAbhyAM padmamajAyata
shlokas.13:
sa tatra bhagavAndevaH puShkare bhAsayandishaH |
brahmA samabhavattAta sarvabhUtapitAmahaH
shlokas.14:
tasminnapi mahAbAho prAdurbhUte mahAtmani |
tamasaH pUrvajo jaj~ne madhurnAma mahAsuraH
shlokas.15:
tamugramugrakarmANamugrAM buddhiM samAsthitam |
brahmaNopachitiM kurva~njaghAna puruShottamaH
shlokas.16:
tasya tAta vadhAtsarve devadAnavamAnavAH |
madhusUdanamityAhurvRRiShabhaM sarvasAtvatAm
shlokas.17:
brahmA tu sasRRije putrAnmAnasAndakShasaptamAn |
marIchimatrya~Ngirasau pulastyaM pulahaM kratum
shlokas.18:
marIchiH kashyapaM tAta putraM chAsRRijadagrajam |
mAnasaM janayAmAsa taijasaM brahmasattamam
shlokas.19:
a~NguShThAdasRRijadbrahmA marIcherapi pUrvajam |
so.abhavadbharatashreShTha dakSho nAma prajApatiH
shlokas.20:
tasya pUrvamajAyanta dasha tisrashcha bhArata |
prajApaterduhitarastAsAM jyeShThAbhavadditiH
shlokas.21:
sarvadharmavisheShaj~naH puNyakIrtirmahAyashAH |
mArIchaH kashyapastAta sarvAsAmabhavatpatiH
shlokas.22:
utpAdya tu mahAbhAgastAsAmavarajA dasha |
dadau dharmAya dharmaj~no dakSha eva prajApatiH
shlokas.23:
dharmasya vasavaH putrA rudrAshchAmitatejasaH |
vishvedevAshcha sAdhyAshcha marutvantashcha bhArata
shlokas.24:
aparAstu yavIyasyastAbhyo.anyAH saptavi.nshatiH |
somastAsAM mahAbhAgaH sarvAsAmabhavatpatiH
shlokas.25:
itarAstu vyajAyanta gandharvA.nsturagAndvijAn |
gAshcha kimpuruShAnmatsyAnaudbhidA.nshcha vanaspatIn
shlokas.26:
AdityAnaditirjaj~ne devashreShThAnmahAbalAn |
teShAM viShNurvAmano.abhUdgovindashchAbhavatprabhuH
shlokas.27:
tasya vikramaNAdeva devAnAM shrIrvyavardhata |
dAnavAshcha parAbhUtA daiteyI chAsurI prajA
shlokas.28:
viprachittipradhAnA.nshcha dAnavAnasRRijaddanuH |
ditistu sarvAnasurAnmahAsattvAnvyajAyata
shlokas.29:
ahorAtraM cha kAlaM cha yathartu madhusUdanaH |
pUrvAhNaM chAparAhNaM cha sarvamevAnvakalpayat
shlokas.30:
buddyApaH so.asRRijanmeghA.nstathA sthAvaraja~NgamAn |
pRRithivIM so.asRRijadvishvAM sahitAM bhUritejasA
shlokas.31:
tataH kRRiShNo mahAbAhuH punareva yudhiShThira |
brAhmaNAnAM shataM shreShThaM mukhAdasRRijata prabhuH
shlokas.32:
bAhubhyAM kShatriyashataM vaishyAnAmUrutaH shatam |
padbhyAM shUdrashataM chaiva keshavo bharatarShabha
shlokas.33:
sa evaM chaturo varNAnsamutpAdya mahAyashAH |
adhyakShaM sarvabhUtAnAM dhAtAramakarotprabhuH
shlokas.34:
yAvadyAvadabhUchChraddhA dehaM dhArayituM nRRiNAm |
tAvattAvadajIva.nste nAsIdyamakRRitaM bhayam
shlokas.35:
na chaiShAM maithuno dharmo babhUva bharatarShabha |
sa~NkalpAdeva chaiteShAmapatyamudapadyata
shlokas.36:
tatra tretAyuge kAle sa~NkalpAjjAyate prajA |
na hyabhUnmaithuno dharmasteShAmapi janAdhipa
shlokas.37:
dvApare maithuno dharmaH prajAnAmabhavannRRipa |
tathA kaliyuge rAjandva.ndvamApedire janAH
shlokas.38:
eSha bhUtapatistAta svadhyakShashcha prakIrtitaH |
niradhyakShA.nstu kaunteya kIrtayiShyAmi tAnapi
shlokas.39:
dakShiNApathajanmAnaH sarve talavarAndhrakAH |
utsAH pulindAH shabarAshchUchupA maNDapaiH saha
shlokas.40:
uttarApathajanmAnaH kIrtayiShyAmi tAnapi |
yaunakAmbojagAndhArAH kirAtA barbaraiH saha
shlokas.41:
ete pApakRRitastAta charanti pRRithivImimAm |
shvakAkabalagRRidhrANAM sadharmANo narAdhipa
shlokas.42:
naite kRRitayuge tAta charanti pRRithivImimAm |
tretAprabhRRiti vartante te janA bharatarShabha
shlokas.43:
tatastasminmahAghore sandhyAkAle yugAntike |
rAjAnaH samasajjanta samAsAdyetaretaram
shlokas.44:
evameSha kurushreShTha prAdurbhAvo mahAtmanaH |
devadevarShirAchaShTa nAradaH sarvalokadRRik
shlokas.45:
nArado.apyatha kRRiShNasya paraM mene narAdhipa |
shAshvatatvaM mahAbAho yathAvadbharatarShabha
shlokas.46:
evameSha mahAbAhuH keshavaH satyavikramaH |
achintyaH puNDarIkAkSho naiSha kevalamAnuShaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ke pUrvamAsanpatayaH prajAnAM bharatarShabha |
ke charShayo mahAbhAgA dikShu pratyekashaH smRRitAH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shrUyatAM bharatashreShTha yanmA tvaM paripRRichChasi |
prajAnAM patayo ye sma dikShu pratyekashaH smRRitAH
shlokas.3:
ekaH svayambhUrbhagavAnAdyo brahmA sanAtanaH |
brahmaNaH sapta putrA vai mahAtmAnaH svayambhuvaH
shlokas.4:
marIchiratrya~Ngirasau pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
vasiShThashcha mahAbhAgaH sadRRishA vai svayambhuvA
shlokas.5:
sapta brahmANa ityeSha purANe nishchayo gataH |
ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi sarvAneva prajApatIn
shlokas.6:
atriva.nshasamutpanno brahmayoniH sanAtanaH |
prAchInabarhirbhagavA.nstasmAtprAchetaso dasha
shlokas.7:
dashAnAM tanayastveko dakSho nAma prajApatiH |
tasya dve nAmanI loke dakShaH ka iti chochyate
shlokas.8:
marIcheH kashyapaH putrastasya dve nAmanI shrute |
ariShTanemirityekaM kashyapetyaparaM viduH
shlokas.9:
a~NgashchaivaurasaH shrImAnrAjA bhaumashcha vIryavAn |
sahasraM yashcha divyAnAM yugAnAM paryupAsitA
shlokas.10:
aryamA chaiva bhagavAnye chAnye tanayA vibho |
ete pradeshAH kathitA bhuvanAnAM prabhAvanAH
shlokas.11:
shashabindoshcha bhAryANAM sahasrANi dashAchyuta |
ekaikasyAM sahasraM tu tanayAnAmabhUttadA
shlokas.12:
evaM shatasahasrANAM shataM tasya mahAtmanaH |
putrANAM na cha te ka~nchidichChantyanyaM prajApatim
shlokas.13:
prajAmAchakShate viprAH paurANIM shAshabindavIm |
sa vRRiShNiva.nshaprabhavo mahAnva.nshaH prajApateH
shlokas.14:
ete prajAnAM patayaH samuddiShTA yashasvinaH |
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi devA.nstribhuvaneshvarAn
shlokas.15:
bhagoM.ashashchAryamA chaiva mitro.atha varuNastathA |
savitA chaiva dhAtA cha vivasvA.nshcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.16:
pUShA tvaShTA tathaivendro dvAdasho viShNuruchyate |
ta ete dvAdashAdityAH kashyapasyAtmasambhavAH
shlokas.17:
nAsatyashchaiva dasrashcha smRRitau dvAvashvinAvapi |
mArtANDasyAtmajAvetAvaShTamasya prajApateH
shlokas.18:
tvaShTushchaivAtmajaH shrImAnvishvarUpo mahAyashAH |
ajaikapAdahirbudhnyo virUpAkSho.atha raivataH
shlokas.19:
harashcha bahurUpashcha tryambakashcha sureshvaraH |
sAvitrashcha jayantashcha pinAkI chAparAjitaH
pUrvameva mahAbhAgA vasavo.aShTau prakIrtitAH
shlokas.20:
eta eva.nvidhA devA manoreva prajApateH |
te cha pUrve surAshcheti dvividhAH pitaraH smRRitAH
shlokas.21:
shIlarUparatAstvanye tathAnye siddhasAdhyayoH |
RRibhavo marutashchaiva devAnAM choditA gaNAH
shlokas.22:
evamete samAmnAtA vishvedevAstathAshvinau |
AdityAH kShatriyAsteShAM vishastu marutastathA
shlokas.23:
ashvinau tu matau shUdrau tapasyugre samAhitau |
smRRitAstva~Ngiraso devA brAhmaNA iti nishchayaH
ityetatsarvadevAnAM chAturvarNyaM prakIrtitam
shlokas.24:
etAnvai prAtarutthAya devAnyastu prakIrtayet |
svajAdanyakRRitAchchaiva sarvapApAtpramuchyate
shlokas.25:
yavakrIto.atha raibhyashcha arvAvasuparAvasU |
aushijashchaiva kakShIvAnnalashchA~NgirasaH sutAH
shlokas.26:
RRiShermedhAtitheH putraH kaNvo barhiShadastathA |
trailokyabhAvanAstAta prAchyAM saptarShayastathA
shlokas.27:
unmucho vimuchashchaiva svastyAtreyashcha vIryavAn |
pramuchashchedhmavAhashcha bhagavA.nshcha dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.28:
mitrAvaruNayoH putrastathAgastyaH pratApavAn |
ete brahmarShayo nityamAshritA dakShiNAM disham
shlokas.29:
ruShadguH kavaSho dhaumyaH parivyAdhashcha vIryavAn |
ekatashcha dvitashchaiva tritashchaiva maharShayaH
shlokas.30:
atreH putrashcha bhagavA.nstathA sArasvataH prabhuH |
ete nava mahAtmAnaH pashchimAmAshritA disham
shlokas.31:
Atreyashcha vasiShThashcha kashyapashcha mahAnRRiShiH |
gautamaH sabharadvAjo vishvAmitro.atha kaushikaH
shlokas.32:
tathaiva putro bhagavAnRRichIkasya mahAtmanaH |
jamadagnishcha saptaite udIchIM dishamAshritAH
shlokas.33:
ete pratidishaM sarve kIrtitAstigmatejasaH |
sAkShibhUtA mahAtmAno bhuvanAnAM prabhAvanAH
shlokas.34:
evamete mahAtmAnaH sthitAH pratyekasho dishaH |
eteShAM kIrtanaM kRRitvA sarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.35:
yasyAM yasyAM dishi hyete tAM dishaM sharaNaM gataH |
muchyate sarvapApebhyaH svastimA.nshcha gRRihAnvrajet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na yudhi satyaparAkrama |
shrotumichChAmi kArtsnyena kRRiShNamavyayamIshvaram
shlokas.2:
yachchAsya tejaH sumahadyachcha karma purAtanam |
tanme sarvaM yathAtattvaM prabrUhi bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
tiryagyonigataM rUpaM kathaM dhAritavAnhariH |
kena kAryavisargeNa tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
purAhaM mRRigayAM yAto mArkaNDeyAshrame sthitaH |
tatrApashyaM munigaNAnsamAsInAnsahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
tataste madhuparkeNa pUjAM chakruratho mayi |
pratigRRihya cha tAM pUjAM pratyanandamRRiShInaham
shlokas.6:
kathaiShA kathitA tatra kashyapena maharShiNA |
manaHprahlAdinIM divyAM tAmihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.7:
purA dAnavamukhyA hi krodhalobhasamanvitAH |
balena mattAH shatasho narakAdyA mahAsurAH
shlokas.8:
tathaiva chAnye bahavo dAnavA yuddhadurmadAH |
na sahante sma devAnAM samRRiddhiM tAmanuttamAm
shlokas.9:
dAnavairardyamAnAstu devA devarShayastathA |
na sharma lebhire rAjanvishamAnAstatastataH
shlokas.10:
pRRithivIM chArtarUpAM te samapashyandivaukasaH |
dAnavairabhisa~NkIrNAM ghorarUpairmahAbalaiH
bhArArtAmapakRRiShTAM cha duHkhitAM saMnimajjatIm
shlokas.11:
athAditeyAH santrastA brahmANamidamabruvan |
kathaM shakyAmahe brahmandAnavairupamardanam
shlokas.12:
svayambhUstAnuvAchedaM nisRRiShTo.atra vidhirmayA |
te vareNAbhisaMmattA balena cha madena cha
shlokas.13:
nAvabhotsyanti saMmUDhA viShNumavyaktadarshanam |
varAharUpiNaM devamadhRRiShyamamarairapi
shlokas.14:
eSha vegena gatvA hi yatra te dAnavAdhamAH |
antarbhUmigatA ghorA nivasanti sahasrashaH
shamayiShyati shrutvA te jahRRiShuH surasattamAH
shlokas.15:
tato viShNurmahAtejA vArAhaM rUpamAshritaH |
antarbhUmiM sampravishya jagAma ditijAnprati
shlokas.16:
dRRiShTvA cha sahitAH sarve daityAH sattvamamAnuSham |
prasahya sahasA sarve santasthuH kAlamohitAH
shlokas.17:
sarve cha samabhidrutya varAhaM jagRRihuH samam |
sa~NkruddhAshcha varAhaM taM vyakarShanta samantataH
shlokas.18:
dAnavendrA mahAkAyA mahAvIryA balochChritAH |
nAshaknuva.nshcha ki~nchitte tasya kartuM tadA vibho
shlokas.19:
tato.agamanvismayaM te dAnavendrA bhayAttadA |
sa.nshayaM gatamAtmAnaM menire cha sahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
tato devAdidevaH sa yogAtmA yogasArathiH |
yogamAsthAya bhagavA.nstadA bharatasattama
shlokas.21:
vinanAda mahAnAdaM kShobhayandaityadAnavAn |
saMnAditA yena lokAH sarvAshchaiva disho dasha
shlokas.22:
tena saMnAdashabdena lokAH sa~NkShobhamAgaman |
sambhrAntAshcha dishaH sarvA devAH shakrapurogamAH
shlokas.23:
nirvicheShTaM jagachchApi babhUvAtibhRRishaM tadA |
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva tena nAdena mohitam
shlokas.24:
tataste dAnavAH sarve tena shabdena bhIShitAH |
peturgatAsavashchaiva viShNutejovimohitAH
shlokas.25:
rasAtalagatA.nshchaiva varAhastridashadviShaH |
khuraiH sa.ndArayAmAsa mA.nsamedosthisa~nchayam
shlokas.26:
nAdena tena mahatA sanAtana iti smRRitaH |
padmanAbho mahAyogI bhUtAchAryaH sa bhUtarAT
shlokas.27:
tato devagaNAH sarve pitAmahamupAbruvan |
nAdo.ayaM kIdRRisho deva nainaM vidma vayaM vibho
ko.asau hi kasya vA nAdo yena vihvalitaM jagat
shlokas.28:
etasminnantare viShNurvArAhaM rUpamAsthitaH |
udatiShThanmahAdevaH stUyamAno maharShibhiH
shlokas.29:
pitAmaha uvAcha||
nihatya dAnavapatInmahAvarShmA mahAbalaH |
eSha devo mahAyogI bhUtAtmA bhUtabhAvanaH
shlokas.30:
sarvabhUteshvaro yogI yonirAtmA tathAtmanaH |
sthirIbhavata kRRiShNo.ayaM sarvapApapraNAshanaH
shlokas.31:
kRRitvA karmAtisAdhvetadashakyamamitaprabhaH |
samAyAtaH svamAtmAnaM mahAbhAgo mahAdyutiH
padmanAbho mahAyogI bhUtAtmA bhUtabhAvanaH
shlokas.32:
na santApo na bhIH kAryA shoko vA surasattamAH |
vidhireSha prabhAvashcha kAlaH sa~NkShayakArakaH
lokAndhArayatAnena nAdo mukto mahAtmanA
shlokas.33:
sa eva hi mahAbhAgaH sarvalokanamaskRRitaH |
achyutaH puNDarIkAkShaH sarvabhUtasamudbhavaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yogaM me paramaM tAta mokShasya vada bhArata |
tamahaM tattvato j~nAtumichChAmi vadatAM vara
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sa.nvAdaM mokShasa.nyuktaM shiShyasya guruNA saha
shlokas.3:
kashchidbrAhmaNamAsInamAchAryamRRiShisattamam |
shiShyaH paramamedhAvI shreyorthI susamAhitaH
charaNAvupasa~NgRRihya sthitaH prA~njalirabravIt
shlokas.4:
upAsanAtprasanno.asi yadi vai bhagavanmama |
sa.nshayo me mahAnkashchittanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.5:
kutashchAhaM kutashcha tvaM tatsamyagbrUhi yatparam |
kathaM cha sarvabhUteShu sameShu dvijasattama
samyagvRRittA nivartante viparItAH kShayodayAH
shlokas.6:
vedeShu chApi yadvAkyaM laukikaM vyApakaM cha yat |
etadvidvanyathAtattvaM sarvaM vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.7:
gururuvAcha||
shRRiNu shiShya mahAprAj~na brahmaguhyamidaM param |
adhyAtmaM sarvabhUtAnAmAgamAnAM cha yadvasu
shlokas.8:
vAsudevaH sarvamidaM vishvasya brahmaNo mukham |
satyaM dAnamatho yaj~nastitikShA dama Arjavam
shlokas.9:
puruShaM sanAtanaM viShNuM yattadvedavido viduH |
sargapralayakartAramavyaktaM brahma shAshvatam
tadidaM brahma vArShNeyamitihAsaM shRRiNuShva me
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNo brAhmaNaiH shrAvyo rAjanyaH kShatriyaistathA |
mAhAtmyaM devadevasya viShNoramitatejasaH
arhastvamasi kalyANa vArShNeyaM shRRiNu yatparam
shlokas.11:
kAlachakramanAdyantaM bhAvAbhAvasvalakShaNam |
trailokyaM sarvabhUteShu chakravatparivartate
shlokas.12:
yattadakSharamavyaktamamRRitaM brahma shAshvatam |
vadanti puruShavyAghraM keshavaM puruSharShabham
shlokas.13:
pitR^IndevAnRRiShI.nshchaiva tathA vai yakShadAnavAn |
nAgAsuramanuShyA.nshcha sRRijate paramo.avyayaH
shlokas.14:
tathaiva vedashAstrANi lokadharmA.nshcha shAshvatAn |
pralaye prakRRitiM prApya yugAdau sRRijate prabhuH
shlokas.15:
yathartuShvRRituli~NgAni nAnArUpANi paryaye |
dRRishyante tAni tAnyeva tathA brahmAharAtriShu
shlokas.16:
atha yadyadyadA bhAvi kAlayogAdyugAdiShu |
tattadutpadyate j~nAnaM lokayAtrAvidhAnajam
shlokas.17:
yugAnte.antarhitAnvedAnsetihAsAnmaharShayaH |
lebhire tapasA pUrvamanuj~nAtAH svayambhuvA
shlokas.18:
vedavidveda bhagavAnvedA~NgAni bRRihaspatiH |
bhArgavo nItishAstraM cha jagAda jagato hitam
shlokas.19:
gAndharvaM nArado vedaM bharadvAjo dhanurgraham |
devarShicharitaM gArgyaH kRRiShNAtreyashchikitsitam
shlokas.20:
nyAyatantrANyanekAni taistairuktAni vAdibhiH |
hetvAgamasadAchArairyaduktaM tadupAsyate
shlokas.21:
anAdyaM yatparaM brahma na devA narShayo viduH |
ekastadveda bhagavAndhAtA nArAyaNaH prabhuH
shlokas.22:
nArAyaNAdRRiShigaNAstathA mukhyAH surAsurAH |
rAjarShayaH purANAshcha paramaM duHkhabheShajam
shlokas.23:
puruShAdhiShThitaM bhAvaM prakRRitiH sUyate sadA |
hetuyuktamataH sarvaM jagatsamparivartate
shlokas.24:
dIpAdanye yathA dIpAH pravartante sahasrashaH |
prakRRitiH sRRijate tadvadAnantyAnnApachIyate
shlokas.25:
avyaktakarmajA buddhiraha~NkAraM prasUyate |
AkAshaM chApyaha~NkArAdvAyurAkAshasambhavaH
shlokas.26:
vAyostejastatashchApastvadbhyo hi vasudhodgatA |
mUlaprakRRitayo.aShTau tA jagadetAsvavasthitam
shlokas.27:
j~nAnendriyANyataH pa~ncha pa~ncha karmendriyANyapi |
viShayAH pa~ncha chaikaM cha vikAre ShoDashaM manaH
shlokas.28:
shrotraM tvakchakShuShI jihvA ghrANaM pa~nchendriyANyapi |
pAdau pAyurupasthashcha hastau vAkkarmaNAmapi
shlokas.29:
shabdaH sparsho.atha rUpaM cha raso gandhastathaiva cha |
vij~neyaM vyApakaM chittaM teShu sarvagataM manaH
shlokas.30:
rasaj~nAne tu jihveyaM vyAhRRite vAktathaiva cha |
indriyairvividhairyuktaM sarvaM vyastaM manastathA
shlokas.31:
vidyAttu ShoDashaitAni daivatAni vibhAgashaH |
deheShu j~nAnakartAramupAsInamupAsate
shlokas.32:
tadvatsomaguNA jihvA gandhastu pRRithivIguNaH |
shrotraM shabdaguNaM chaiva chakShuragnerguNastathA
sparshaM vAyuguNaM vidyAtsarvabhUteShu sarvadA
shlokas.33:
manaH sattvaguNaM prAhuH sattvamavyaktajaM tathA |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasthaM tasmAdbudhyeta buddhimAn
shlokas.34:
ete bhAvA jagatsarvaM vahanti sacharAcharam |
shritA virajasaM devaM yamAhuH paramaM padam
shlokas.35:
navadvAraM puraM puNyametairbhAvaiH samanvitam |
vyApya shete mahAnAtmA tasmAtpuruSha uchyate
shlokas.36:
ajaraH so.amarashchaiva vyaktAvyaktopadeshavAn |
vyApakaH saguNaH sUkShmaH sarvabhUtaguNAshrayaH
shlokas.37:
yathA dIpaH prakAshAtmA hrasvo vA yadi vA mahAn |
j~nAnAtmAnaM tathA vidyAtpuruShaM sarvajantuShu
shlokas.38:
so.atra vedayate vedyaM sa shRRiNoti sa pashyati |
kAraNaM tasya deho.ayaM sa kartA sarvakarmaNAm
shlokas.39:
agnirdArugato yadvadbhinne dArau na dRRishyate |
tathaivAtmA sharIrastho yogenaivAtra dRRishyate
shlokas.40:
nadIShvApo yathA yuktA yathA sUrye marIchayaH |
santanvAnA yathA yAnti tathA dehAH sharIriNAm
shlokas.41:
svapnayoge yathaivAtmA pa~nchendriyasamAgataH |
dehamutsRRijya vai yAti tathaivAtropalabhyate
shlokas.42:
karmaNA vyApyate pUrvaM karmaNA chopapadyate |
karmaNA nIyate.anyatra svakRRitena balIyasA
shlokas.43:
sa tu dehAdyathA dehaM tyaktvAnyaM pratipadyate |
tathA taM sampravakShyAmi bhUtagrAmaM svakarmajam

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
chaturvidhAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
avyaktaprabhavAnyAhuravyaktanidhanAni cha
avyaktanidhanaM vidyAdavyaktAtmAtmakaM manaH
shlokas.2:
yathAshvatthakaNIkAyAmantarbhUto mahAdrumaH |
niShpanno dRRishyate vyaktamavyaktAtsambhavastathA
shlokas.3:
abhidravatyayaskAntamayo nishchetanAvubhau |
svabhAvahetujA bhAvA yadvadanyadapIdRRisham
shlokas.4:
tadvadavyaktajA bhAvAH kartuH kAraNalakShaNAH |
achetanAshchetayituH kAraNAdabhisaMhitAH
shlokas.5:
na bhUH khaM dyaurna bhUtAni narShayo na surAsurAH |
nAnyadAsIdRRite jIvamAsedurna tu saMhitam
shlokas.6:
sarvanItyA sarvagataM manohetu salakShaNam |
aj~nAnakarma nirdiShTametatkAraNalakShaNam
shlokas.7:
tatkAraNairhi sa.nyuktaM kAryasa~NgrahakArakam |
yenaitadvartate chakramanAdinidhanaM mahat
shlokas.8:
avyaktanAbhaM vyaktAraM vikAraparimaNDalam |
kShetraj~nAdhiShThitaM chakraM snigdhAkShaM vartate dhruvam
shlokas.9:
snigdhatvAttilavatsarvaM chakre.asminpIDyate jagat |
tilapIDairivAkramya bhogairaj~nAnasambhavaiH
shlokas.10:
karma tatkurute tarShAdaha~NkAraparigraham |
kAryakAraNasa.nyoge sa heturupapAditaH
shlokas.11:
nAtyeti kAraNaM kAryaM na kAryaM kAraNaM tathA |
kAryANAM tUpakaraNe kAlo bhavati hetumAn
shlokas.12:
hetuyuktAH prakRRitayo vikArAshcha parasparam |
anyonyamabhivartante puruShAdhiShThitAH sadA
shlokas.13:
sarajastAmasairbhAvaishchyuto hetubalAnvitaH |
kShetraj~namevAnuyAti pA.nsurvAterito yathA
na cha taiH spRRishyate bhAvo na te tena mahAtmanA
shlokas.14:
sarajasko.arajaskashcha sa vai vAyuryathA bhavet |
tathaitadantaraM vidyAtkShetrakShetraj~nayorbudhaH
abhyAsAtsa tathA yukto na gachChetprakRRitiM punaH
shlokas.15:
sa.ndehametamutpannamachChinadbhagavAnRRiShiH |
tathA vArtAM samIkSheta kRRitalakShaNasaMmitAm
shlokas.16:
bIjAnyagnyupadagdhAni na rohanti yathA punaH |
j~nAnadagdhaistathA kleshairnAtmA sambadhyate punaH

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
pravRRittilakShaNo dharmo yathAyamupapadyate |
teShAM vij~nAnaniShThAnAmanyattattvaM na rochate
shlokas.2:
durlabhA vedavidvA.nso vedokteShu vyavasthitAH |
prayojanamatastvatra mArgamichChanti sa.nstutam
shlokas.3:
sadbhirAcharitatvAttu vRRittametadagarhitam |
iyaM sA buddhiranyeyaM yayA yAti parAM gatim
shlokas.4:
sharIravAnupAdatte mohAtsarvaparigrahAn |
kAmakrodhAdibhirbhAvairyukto rAjasatAmasaiH
shlokas.5:
nAshuddhamAcharettasmAdabhIpsandehayApanam |
karmaNo vivaraM kurvanna lokAnApnuyAchChubhAn
shlokas.6:
lohayuktaM yathA hema vipakvaM na virAjate |
tathApakvakaShAyAkhyaM vij~nAnaM na prakAshate
shlokas.7:
yashchAdharmaM charenmohAtkAmalobhAvanu plavan |
dharmyaM panthAnamAkramya sAnubandho vinashyati
shlokas.8:
shandAdInviShayA.nstasmAdasa.nrAgAdanuplavet |
krodhaharShau viShAdashcha jAyante hi parasparam
shlokas.9:
pa~nchabhUtAtmake dehe sattvarAjasatAmase |
kamabhiShTuvate chAyaM kaM vA kroshati kiM vadet
shlokas.10:
sparsharUparasAdyeShu sa~NgaM gachChanti bAlishAH |
nAvagachChantyavij~nAnAdAtmajaM pArthivaM guNam
shlokas.11:
mRRinmayaM sharaNaM yadvanmRRidaiva parilipyate |
pArthivo.ayaM tathA deho mRRidvikArairvilipyate
shlokas.12:
madhu tailaM payaH sarpirmA.nsAni lavaNaM guDaH |
dhAnyAni phalamUlAni mRRidvikArAH sahAmbhasA
shlokas.13:
yadvatkAntAramAtiShThannautsukyaM samanuvrajet |
shramAdAhAramAdadyAdasvAdvapi hi yApanam
shlokas.14:
tadvatsa.nsArakAntAramAtiShTha~nshramatatparaH |
yAtrArthamadyAdAhAraM vyAdhito bheShajaM yathA
shlokas.15:
satyashauchArjavatyAgairyashasA vikrameNa cha |
kShAntyA dhRRityA cha buddhyA cha manasA tapasaiva cha
shlokas.16:
bhAvAnsarvAnyathAvRRittAnsa.nvaseta yathAkramam |
shAntimichChannadInAtmA sa.nyachChedindriyANi cha
shlokas.17:
sattvena rajasA chaiva tamasA chaiva mohitAH |
chakravatparivartante hyaj~nAnAjjantavo bhRRisham
shlokas.18:
tasmAtsamyakparIkSheta doShAnaj~nAnasambhavAn |
aj~nAnaprabhavaM nityamaha~NkAraM parityajet
shlokas.19:
mahAbhUtAnIndriyANi guNAH sattvaM rajastamaH |
trailokyaM seshvaraM sarvamaha~NkAre pratiShThitam
shlokas.20:
yatheha niyataM kAlo darshayatyArtavAnguNAn |
tadvadbhUteShvaha~NkAraM vidyAdbhUtapravartakam
shlokas.21:
saMmohakaM tamo vidyAtkRRiShNamaj~nAnasambhavam |
prItiduHkhanibaddhA.nshcha samastA.nstrInatho guNAn
sattvasya rajasashchaiva tamasashcha nibodha tAn
shlokas.22:
pramoho harShajaH prItirasa.ndeho dhRRitiH smRRitiH |
etAnsattvaguNAnvidyAdimAnrAjasatAmasAn
shlokas.23:
kAmakrodhau pramAdashcha lobhamohau bhayaM klamaH |
viShAdashokAvaratirmAnadarpAvanAryatA
shlokas.24:
doShANAmevamAdInAM parIkShya gurulAghavam |
vimRRishedAtmasa.nsthAnAmekaikamanusantatam
shlokas.25:
shiShya uvAcha||
ke doShA manasA tyaktAH ke buddhyA shithilIkRRitAH |
ke punaH punarAyAnti ke mohAdaphalA iva
shlokas.26:
keShAM balAbalaM buddhyA hetubhirvimRRishedbudhaH |
etatsarvaM samAchakShva yathA vidyAmahaM prabho
shlokas.27:
gururuvAcha||
doShairmUlAdavachChinnairvishuddhAtmA vimuchyate |
vinAshayati sambhUtamayasmayamayo yathA
tathAkRRitAtmA sahajairdoShairnashyati rAjasaiH
shlokas.28:
rAjasaM tAmasaM chaiva shuddhAtmAkarmasambhavam |
tatsarvaM dehinAM bIjaM sarvamAtmavataH samam
shlokas.29:
tasmAdAtmavatA varjyaM rajashcha tama eva cha |
rajastamobhyAM nirmuktaM sattvaM nirmalatAmiyAt
shlokas.30:
atha vA mantravadbrUyurmA.nsAdAnAM yajuShkRRitam |
hetuH sa evAnAdAne shuddhadharmAnupAlane
shlokas.31:
rajasA dharmayuktAni kAryANyapi samApnuyAt |
arthayuktAni chAtyarthaM kAmAnsarvA.nshcha sevate
shlokas.32:
tamasA lobhayuktAni krodhajAni cha sevate |
hi.nsAvihArAbhiratastandrInidrAsamanvitaH
shlokas.33:
sattvasthaH sAttvikAnbhAvA~nshuddhAnpashyati sa.nshritaH |
sa dehI vimalaH shrImA~nshuddho vidyAsamanvitaH

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
rajasA sAdhyate mohastamasA cha nararShabha |
krodhalobhau bhayaM darpa eteShAM sAdhanAchChuchiH
shlokas.2:
paramaM paramAtmAnaM devamakShayamavyayam |
viShNumavyaktasa.nsthAnaM vishante devasattamam
shlokas.3:
tasya mAyAvidagdhA~NgA j~nAnabhraShTA nirAshiShaH |
mAnavA j~nAnasaMmohAttataH kAmaM prayAnti vai
shlokas.4:
kAmAtkrodhamavApyAtha lobhamohau cha mAnavAH |
mAnadarpAdaha~NkAramaha~NkArAttataH kriyAH
shlokas.5:
kriyAbhiH snehasambandhaH snehAchChokamanantaram |
sukhaduHkhasamArambhAjjanmAjanmakRRitakShaNAH
shlokas.6:
janmato garbhavAsaM tu shukrashoNitasambhavam |
purIShamUtravikledashoNitaprabhavAvilam
shlokas.7:
tRRiShNAbhibhUtastairbaddhastAnevAbhipariplavan |
sa.nsAratantravAhinyastatra budhyeta yoShitaH
shlokas.8:
prakRRityA kShetrabhUtAstA narAH kShetraj~nalakShaNAH |
tasmAdetA visheSheNa naro.atIyurvipashchitaH
shlokas.9:
kRRityA hyetA ghorarUpA mohayantyavichakShaNAn |
rajasyantarhitA mUrtirindriyANAM sanAtanI
shlokas.10:
tasmAttarShAtmakAdrAgAdbIjAjjAyanti jantavaH |
svadehajAnasvasa~nj~nAnyadvada~NgAtkRRimI.nstyajet
svasa~nj~nAnasvajA.nstadvatsutasa~nj~nAnkRRimI.nstyajet
shlokas.11:
shukrato rasatashchaiva snehAjjAyanti jantavaH |
svabhAvAtkarmayogAdvA tAnupekSheta buddhimAn
shlokas.12:
rajastamasi paryastaM sattvaM tamasi sa.nsthitam |
j~nAnAdhiShThAnamaj~nAnaM buddhyaha~NkAralakShaNam
shlokas.13:
tadbIjaM dehinAmAhustadbIjaM jIvasa~nj~nitam |
karmaNA kAlayuktena sa.nsAraparivartakam
shlokas.14:
ramatyayaM yathA svapne manasA dehavAniva |
karmagarbhairguNairdehI garbhe tadupapadyate
shlokas.15:
karmaNA bIjabhUtena chodyate yadyadindriyam |
jAyate tadaha~NkArAdrAgayuktena chetasA
shlokas.16:
shabdarAgAchChrotramasya jAyate bhAvitAtmanaH |
rUparAgAttathA chakShurghrANaM gandhachikIrShayA
shlokas.17:
sparshanebhyastathA vAyuH prANApAnavyapAshrayaH |
vyAnodAnau samAnashcha pa~nchadhA dehayApanA
shlokas.18:
sa~njAtairjAyate gAtraiH karmajairbrahmaNA vRRitaH |
duHkhAdyantairduHkhamadhyairnaraH shArIramAnasaiH
shlokas.19:
duHkhaM vidyAdupAdAnAdabhimAnAchcha vardhate |
tyAgAttebhyo nirodhaH syAnnirodhaj~no vimuchyate
shlokas.20:
indriyANAM rajasyeva prabhavapralayAvubhau |
parIkShya sa~ncharedvidvAnyathAvachChAstrachakShuShA
shlokas.21:
j~nAnendriyANIndriyArthAnnopasarpantyatarShulam |
j~nAtaishcha kAraNairdehI na dehaM punararhati

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
atropAyaM pravakShyAmi yathAvachChAstrachakShuShA |
tadvij~nAnAchcharanprAj~naH prApnuyAtparamAM gatim
shlokas.2:
sarveShAmeva bhUtAnAM puruShaH shreShTha uchyate |
puruShebhyo dvijAnAhurdvijebhyo mantravAdinaH
shlokas.3:
sarvabhUtavishiShTAste sarvaj~nAH sarvadarshinaH |
brAhmaNA vedatattvaj~nAstattvArthagatinishchayAH
shlokas.4:
netrahIno yathA hyekaH kRRichChrANi labhate.adhvani |
j~nAnahInastathA loke tasmAjj~nAnavido.adhikAH
shlokas.5:
tA.nstAnupAsate dharmAndharmakAmA yathAgamam |
na tveShAmarthasAmAnyamantareNa guNAnimAn
shlokas.6:
vAgdehamanasAM shauchaM kShamA satyaM dhRRitiH smRRitiH |
sarvadharmeShu dharmaj~nA j~nApayanti guNAnimAn
shlokas.7:
yadidaM brahmaNo rUpaM brahmacharyamiti smRRitam |
paraM tatsarvabhUtebhyastena yAnti parAM gatim
shlokas.8:
li~Ngasa.nyogahInaM yachCharIrasparshavarjitam |
shrotreNa shravaNaM chaiva chakShuShA chaiva darshanam
shlokas.9:
jihvayA rasanaM yachcha tadeva parivarjitam |
buddhyA cha vyavasAyena brahmacharyamakalmaSham
shlokas.10:
samyagvRRittirbrahmalokaM prApnuyAnmadhyamaH surAn |
dvijAgryo jAyate vidvAnkanyasIM vRRittimAsthitaH
shlokas.11:
suduShkaraM brahmacharyamupAyaM tatra me shRRiNu |
sampravRRittamudIrNaM cha nigRRihNIyAddvijo manaH
shlokas.12:
yoShitAM na kathAH shrAvyA na nirIkShyA nirambarAH |
kadAchiddarshanAdAsAM durbalAnAvishedrajaH
shlokas.13:
rAgotpattau charetkRRichChramahnastriH pravishedapaH |
magnaH svapne cha manasA trirjapedaghamarShaNam
shlokas.14:
pApmAnaM nirdahedevamantarbhUtaM rajomayam |
j~nAnayuktena manasA santatena vichakShaNaH
shlokas.15:
kuNapAmedhyasa.nyuktaM yadvadachChidrabandhanam |
tadvaddehagataM vidyAdAtmAnaM dehabandhanam
shlokas.16:
vAtapittakaphAnraktaM tva~NmA.nsaM snAyumasthi cha |
majjAM chaiva sirAjAlaistarpayanti rasA nRRiNAm
shlokas.17:
dasha vidyAddhamanyo.atra pa~nchendriyaguNAvahAH |
yAbhiH sUkShmAH pratAyante dhamanyo.anyAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
evametAH sirAnadyo rasodA dehasAgaram |
tarpayanti yathAkAlamApagA iva sAgaram
shlokas.19:
madhye cha hRRidayasyaikA sirA tvatra manovahA |
shukraM sa~NkalpajaM nR^INAM sarvagAtrairvimu~nchati
shlokas.20:
sarvagAtrapratAyinyastasyA hyanugatAH sirAH |
netrayoH pratipadyante vahantyastaijasaM guNam
shlokas.21:
payasyantarhitaM sarpiryadvannirmathyate khajaiH |
shukraM nirmathyate tadvaddehasa~NkalpajaiH khajaiH
shlokas.22:
svapne.apyevaM yathAbhyeti manaHsa~NkalpajaM rajaH |
shukramasparshajaM dehAtsRRijantyasya manovahA
shlokas.23:
maharShirbhagavAnatrirveda tachChukrasambhavam |
tribIjamindradaivatyaM tasmAdindriyamuchyate
shlokas.24:
ye vai shukragatiM vidyurbhUtasa~NkarakArikAm |
virAgA dagdhadoShAste nApnuyurdehasambhavam
shlokas.25:
guNAnAM sAmyamAgamya manasaiva manovaham |
dehakarma nudanprANAnantakAle vimuchyate
shlokas.26:
bhavitA manaso j~nAnaM mana eva pratAyate |
jyotiShmadvirajo divyamatra siddhaM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.27:
tasmAttadavighAtAya karma kuryAdakalmaSham |
rajastamashcha hitveha na tiryaggatimApnuyAt
shlokas.28:
taruNAdhigataM j~nAnaM jarAdurbalatAM gatam |
paripakvabuddhiH kAlena Adatte mAnasaM balam
shlokas.29:
sudurgamiva panthAnamatItya guNabandhanam |
yadA pashyettadA doShAnatItyAmRRitamashnute

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
duranteShvindriyArtheShu saktAH sIdanti jantavaH |
ye tvasaktA mahAtmAnaste yAnti paramAM gatim
shlokas.2:
janmamRRityujarAduHkhairvyAdhibhirmanasaH klamaiH |
dRRiShTvemaM santataM lokaM ghaTenmokShAya buddhimAn
shlokas.3:
vA~NmanobhyAM sharIreNa shuchiH syAdanaha~NkRRitaH |
prashAnto j~nAnavAnbhikShurnirapekShashcharetsukham
shlokas.4:
atha vA manasaH sa~NgaM pashyedbhUtAnukampayA |
atrApyupekShAM kurvIta j~nAtvA karmaphalaM jagat
shlokas.5:
yatkRRitaM prAkShubhaM karma pApaM vA tadupAshnute |
tasmAchChubhAni karmANi kuryAdvAgbuddhikarmabhiH
shlokas.6:
ahi.nsA satyavachanaM sarvabhUteShu chArjavam |
kShamA chaivApramAdashcha yasyaite sa sukhI bhavet
shlokas.7:
yashchainaM paramaM dharmaM sarvabhUtasukhAvaham |
duHkhAnniHsaraNaM veda sa tattvaj~naH sukhI bhavet
shlokas.8:
tasmAtsamAhitaM buddhyA mano bhUteShu dhArayet |
nApadhyAyenna spRRihayennAbaddhaM chintayedasat
shlokas.9:
avAgyogaprayogeNa manoj~naM sampravartate |
vivakShatA vA sadvAkyaM dharmaM sUkShmamavekShatA
satyAM vAchamahi.nsrAM cha vadedanapavAdinIm
shlokas.10:
kalkApetAmaparuShAmanRRisha.nsAmapaishunAm |
IdRRigalpaM cha vaktavyamavikShiptena chetasA
shlokas.11:
vAkprabuddho hi sa.nrAgAdvirAgAdvyAharedyadi |
buddhyA hyanigRRihItena manasA karma tAmasam
rajobhUtairhi karaNaiH karmaNA pratipadyate
shlokas.12:
sa duHkhaM prApya loke.asminnarakAyopapadyate |
tasmAnmanovAkSharIrairAchareddhairyamAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
prakIrNameShabhAro hi yadvaddhAryeta dasyubhiH |
pratilomAM dishaM buddhvA sa.nsAramabudhAstathA
shlokas.14:
tAneva cha yathA dasyUnkShiptvA gachChechChivAM disham |
tathA rajastamaHkarmANyutsRRijya prApnuyAtsukham
shlokas.15:
niHsa.ndigdhamanIho vai muktaH sarvaparigrahaiH |
viviktachArI laghvAshI tapasvI niyatendriyaH
shlokas.16:
j~nAnadagdhaparikleshaH prayogaratirAtmavAn |
niShprachAreNa manasA paraM tadadhigachChati
shlokas.17:
dhRRitimAnAtmavAnbuddhiM nigRRihNIyAdasa.nshayam |
mano buddhyA nigRRihNIyAdviShayAnmanasAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
nigRRihItendriyasyAsya kurvANasya mano vashe |
devatAstAH prakAshante hRRiShTA yAnti tamIshvaram
shlokas.19:
tAbhiH sa.nsaktamanaso brahmavatsamprakAshate |
etaishchApagataiH sarvairbrahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.20:
atha vA na pravarteta yogatantrairupakramet |
yena tantramayaM tantraM vRRittiH syAttattadAcharet
shlokas.21:
kaNapiNyAkakulmAShashAkayAvakasaktavaH |
tathA mUlaphalaM bhaikShaM paryAyeNopayojayet
shlokas.22:
AhAraM niyataM chaiva deshe kAle cha sAttvikam |
tatparIkShyAnuvarteta yatpravRRittyanuvartakam
shlokas.23:
pravRRittaM noparundheta shanairagnimivendhayet |
j~nAnendhitaM tato j~nAnamarkavatsamprakAshate
shlokas.24:
j~nAnAdhiShThAnamaj~nAnaM trI.NllokAnadhitiShThati |
vij~nAnAnugataM j~nAnamaj~nAnAdapakRRiShyate
shlokas.25:
pRRithaktvAtsamprayogAchcha nAsUyurveda shAshvatam |
sa tayorapavargaj~no vItarAgo vimuchyate
shlokas.26:
vayotIto jarAmRRityU jitvA brahma sanAtanam |
amRRitaM tadavApnoti yattadakSharamavyayam

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
niShkalmaShaM brahmacharyamichChatA charituM sadA |
nidrA sarvAtmanA tyAjyA svapnadoShAnavekShatA
shlokas.2:
svapne hi rajasA dehI tamasA chAbhibhUyate |
dehAntaramivApannashcharatyapagatasmRRitiH
shlokas.3:
j~nAnAbhyAsAjjAgarato jij~nAsArthamanantaram |
vij~nAnAbhiniveshAttu jAgaratyanishaM sadA
shlokas.4:
atrAha ko nvayaM bhAvaH svapne viShayavAniva |
pralInairindriyairdehI vartate dehavAniva
shlokas.5:
atrochyate yathA hyetadveda yogeshvaro hariH |
tathaitadupapannArthaM varNayanti maharShayaH
shlokas.6:
indriyANAM shramAtsvapnamAhuH sarvagataM budhAH |
manasastu pralInatvAttattadAhurnidarshanam
shlokas.7:
kAryavyAsaktamanasaH sa~Nkalpo jAgrato hyapi |
yadvanmanorathaishvaryaM svapne tadvanmanogatam
shlokas.8:
sa.nsArANAmasa~NkhyAnAM kAmAtmA tadavApnuyAt |
manasyantarhitaM sarvaM veda sottamapUruShaH
shlokas.9:
guNAnAmapi yadyattatkarma jAnAtyupasthitam |
tattachCha.nsanti bhUtAni mano yadbhAvitaM yathA
shlokas.10:
tatastamupavartante guNA rAjasatAmasAH |
sAttviko vA yathAyogamAnantaryaphalodayaH
shlokas.11:
tataH pashyatyasambaddhAnvAtapittakaphottarAn |
rajastamobhavairbhAvaistadapyAhurduranvayam
shlokas.12:
prasannairindriyairyadyatsa~Nkalpayati mAnasam |
tattatsvapne.apyuparate manodRRiShTirnirIkShate
shlokas.13:
vyApakaM sarvabhUteShu vartate.apratighaM manaH |
manasyantarhitaM dvAraM dehamAsthAya mAnasam
shlokas.14:
yattatsadasadavyaktaM svapityasminnidarshanam |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasthaM tadadhyAtmaguNaM viduH
shlokas.15:
lipseta manasA yashcha sa~NkalpAdaishvaraM guNam |
AtmaprabhAvAttaM vidyAtsarvA hyAtmani devatAH
shlokas.16:
evaM hi tapasA yuktamarkavattamasaH param |
trailokyaprakRRitirdehI tapasA taM maheshvaram
shlokas.17:
tapo hyadhiShThitaM devaistapoghnamasuraistamaH |
etaddevAsurairguptaM tadAhurj~nAnalakShaNam
shlokas.18:
sattvaM rajastamashcheti devAsuraguNAnviduH |
sattvaM devaguNaM vidyAditarAvAsurau guNau
shlokas.19:
brahma tatparamaM vedyamamRRitaM jyotirakSharam |
ye vidurbhAvitAtmAnaste yAnti paramAM gatim
shlokas.20:
hetumachChakyamAkhyAtumetAvajj~nAnachakShuShA |
pratyAhAreNa vA shakyamavyaktaM brahma veditum

shlokas.1:
gururuvAcha||
na sa veda paraM dharmaM yo na veda chatuShTayam |
vyaktAvyakte cha yattattvaM samprAptaM paramarShiNA
shlokas.2:
vyaktaM mRRityumukhaM vidyAdavyaktamamRRitaM padam |
pravRRittilakShaNaM dharmamRRiShirnArAyaNo.abravIt
shlokas.3:
atraivAvasthitaM sarvaM trailokyaM sacharAcharam |
nivRRittilakShaNaM dharmamavyaktaM brahma shAshvatam
shlokas.4:
pravRRittilakShaNaM dharmaM prajApatirathAbravIt |
pravRRittiH punarAvRRittirnivRRittiH paramA gatiH
shlokas.5:
tAM gatiM paramAmeti nivRRittiparamo muniH |
j~nAnatattvaparo nityaM shubhAshubhanidarshakaH
shlokas.6:
tadevametau vij~neyAvavyaktapuruShAvubhau |
avyaktapuruShAbhyAM tu yatsyAdanyanmahattaram
shlokas.7:
taM visheShamavekSheta visheSheNa vichakShaNaH |
anAdyantAvubhAvetAvali~Ngau chApyubhAvapi
shlokas.8:
ubhau nityau sUkShmatarau mahadbhyashcha mahattarau |
sAmAnyametadubhayorevaM hyanyadvisheShaNam
shlokas.9:
prakRRityA sargadharmiNyA tathA trividhasattvayA |
viparItamato vidyAtkShetraj~nasya cha lakShaNam
shlokas.10:
prakRRiteshcha vikArANAM draShTAramaguNAnvitam |
agrAhyau puruShAvetAvali~NgatvAdasaMhitau
shlokas.11:
sa.nyogalakShaNotpattiH karmajA gRRihyate yayA |
karaNaiH karmanirvRRittaiH kartA yadyadvicheShTate
kIrtyate shabdasa~nj~nAbhiH ko.ahameSho.apyasAviti
shlokas.12:
uShNIShavAnyathA vastraistribhirbhavati sa.nvRRitaH |
sa.nvRRito.ayaM tathA dehI sattvarAjasatAmasaiH
shlokas.13:
tasmAchchatuShTayaM vedyametairhetubhirAchitam |
yathAsa~nj~no hyayaM samyagantakAle na muhyati
shlokas.14:
shriyaM divyAmabhiprepsurbrahma vA~NmanasA shuchiH |
shArIrairniyamairugraishcharenniShkalmaShaM tapaH
shlokas.15:
trailokyaM tapasA vyAptamantarbhUtena bhAsvatA |
sUryashcha chandramAshchaiva bhAsatastapasA divi
shlokas.16:
pratApastapaso j~nAnaM loke sa.nshabditaM tapaH |
rajastamoghnaM yatkarma tapasastatsvalakShaNam
shlokas.17:
brahmacharyamahi.nsA cha shArIraM tapa uchyate |
vA~NmanoniyamaH sAmyaM mAnasaM tapa uchyate
shlokas.18:
vidhij~nebhyo dvijAtibhyo grAhyamannaM vishiShyate |
AhAraniyamenAsya pApmA nashyati rAjasaH
shlokas.19:
vaimanasyaM cha viShaye yAntyasya karaNAni cha |
tasmAttanmAtramAdadyAdyAvadatra prayojanam
shlokas.20:
antakAle vayotkarShAchChanaiH kuryAdanAturaH |
evaM yuktena manasA j~nAnaM tadupapadyate
shlokas.21:
rajasA chApyayaM dehI dehavA~nshabdavachcharet |
kAryairavyAhatamatirvairAgyAtprakRRitau sthitaH
A dehAdapramAdAchcha dehAntAdvipramuchyate
shlokas.22:
hetuyuktaH sadotsargo bhUtAnAM pralayastathA |
parapratyayasarge tu niyataM nAtivartate
shlokas.23:
bhavAntaprabhavapraj~nA Asate ye viparyayam |
dhRRityA dehAndhArayanto buddhisa~NkShiptamAnasAH
sthAnebhyo dhva.nsamAnAshcha sUkShmatvAttAnupAsate
shlokas.24:
yathAgamaM cha tatsarvaM buddhyA tannaiva budhyate |
dehAntaM kashchidanvAste bhAvitAtmA nirAshrayaH
yukto dhAraNayA kashchitsattAM kechidupAsate
shlokas.25:
abhyasyanti paraM devaM vidyutsa.nshabditAkSharam |
antakAle hyupAsannAstapasA dagdhakilbiShAH
shlokas.26:
sarva ete mahAtmAno gachChanti paramAM gatim |
sUkShmaM visheShaNaM teShAmavekShechChAstrachakShuShA
shlokas.27:
dehaM tu paramaM vidyAdvimuktamaparigraham |
antarikShAdanyataraM dhAraNAsaktamAnasam
shlokas.28:
martyalokAdvimuchyante vidyAsa.nyuktamAnasAH |
brahmabhUtA virajasastato yAnti parAM gatim
shlokas.29:
kaShAyavarjitaM j~nAnaM yeShAmutpadyate.achalam |
te yAnti paramA.NllokAnvishudhyanto yathAbalam
shlokas.30:
bhagavantamajaM divyaM viShNumavyaktasa~nj~nitam |
bhAvena yAnti shuddhA ye j~nAnatRRiptA nirAshiShaH
shlokas.31:
j~nAtvAtmasthaM hariM chaiva nivartante na te.avyayAH |
prApya tatparamaM sthAnaM modante.akSharamavyayam
shlokas.32:
etAvadetadvij~nAnametadasti cha nAsti cha |
tRRiShNAbaddhaM jagatsarvaM chakravatparivartate
shlokas.33:
bisatanturyathaivAyamantaHsthaH sarvato bise |
tRRiShNAtanturanAdyantastathA dehagataH sadA
shlokas.34:
sUchyA sUtraM yathA vastre sa.nsArayati vAyakaH |
tadvatsa.nsArasUtraM hi tRRiShNAsUchyA nibadhyate
shlokas.35:
vikAraM prakRRitiM chaiva puruShaM cha sanAtanam |
yo yathAvadvijAnAti sa vitRRiShNo vimuchyate
shlokas.36:
prakAshaM bhagavAnetadRRiShirnArAyaNo.amRRitam |
bhUtAnAmanukampArthaM jagAda jagato hitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kena vRRittena vRRittaj~no janako mithilAdhipaH |
jagAma mokShaM dharmaj~no bhogAnutsRRijya mAnuShAn
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yena vRRittena vRRittaj~naH sa jagAma mahatsukham
shlokas.3:
janako janadevastu mithilAyAM janAdhipaH |
aurdhvadehikadharmANAmAsIdyukto vichintane
shlokas.4:
tasya sma shatamAchAryA vasanti satataM gRRihe |
darshayantaH pRRithagdharmAnnAnApAShaNDavAdinaH
shlokas.5:
sa teShAM pretyabhAve cha pretyajAtau vinishchaye |
AgamasthaH sa bhUyiShThamAtmatattve na tuShyati
shlokas.6:
tatra pa~nchashikho nAma kApileyo mahAmuniH |
paridhAvanmahIM kRRitsnAM jagAma mithilAmapi
shlokas.7:
sarvasaMnyAsadharmANAM tattvaj~nAnavinishchaye |
suparyavasitArthashcha nirdva.ndvo naShTasa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
RRiShINAmAhurekaM yaM kAmAdavasitaM nRRiShu |
shAshvataM sukhamatyantamanvichChansa sudurlabham
shlokas.9:
yamAhuH kapilaM sA~NkhyAH paramarShiM prajApatim |
sa manye tena rUpeNa vismApayati hi svayam
shlokas.10:
AsureH prathamaM shiShyaM yamAhushchirajIvinam |
pa~nchasrotasi yaH satramAste varShasahasrikam
shlokas.11:
taM samAsInamAgamya maNDalaM kApilaM mahat |
puruShAvasthamavyaktaM paramArthaM nibodhayat
shlokas.12:
iShTisatreNa sa.nsiddho bhUyashcha tapasA muniH |
kShetrakShetraj~nayorvyaktiM bubudhe devadarshanaH
shlokas.13:
yattadekAkSharaM brahma nAnArUpaM pradRRishyate |
AsurirmaNDale tasminpratipede tadavyayam
shlokas.14:
tasya pa~nchashikhaH shiShyo mAnuShyA payasA bhRRitaH |
brAhmaNI kapilA nAma kAchidAsItkuTumbinI
shlokas.15:
tasyAH putratvamAgamya striyAH sa pibati stanau |
tataH sa kApileyatvaM lebhe buddhiM cha naiShThikIm
shlokas.16:
etanme bhagavAnAha kApileyAya sambhavam |
tasya tatkApileyatvaM sarvavittvamanuttamam
shlokas.17:
sAmAnyaM kapilo j~nAtvA dharmaj~nAnAmanuttamam |
upetya shatamAchAryAnmohayAmAsa hetubhiH
shlokas.18:
janakastvabhisa.nraktaH kApileyAnudarshanAt |
utsRRijya shatamAchAryAnpRRiShThato.anujagAma tam
shlokas.19:
tasmai paramakalpAya praNatAya cha dharmataH |
abravItparamaM mokShaM yattatsA~NkhyaM vidhIyate
shlokas.20:
jAtinirvedamuktvA hi karmanirvedamabravIt |
karmanirvedamuktvA cha sarvanirvedamabravIt
shlokas.21:
yadarthaM karmasa.nsargaH karmaNAM cha phalodayaH |
tadanAshvAsikaM moghaM vinAshi chalamadhruvam
shlokas.22:
dRRishyamAne vinAshe cha pratyakShe lokasAkShike |
AgamAtparamastIti bruvannapi parAjitaH
shlokas.23:
anAtmA hyAtmano mRRityuH klesho mRRityurjarAmayaH |
AtmAnaM manyate mohAttadasamyakparaM matam
shlokas.24:
atha chedevamapyasti yalloke nopapadyate |
ajaro.ayamamRRityushcha rAjAsau manyate tathA
shlokas.25:
asti nAstIti chApyetattasminnasati lakShaNe |
kimadhiShThAya tadbrUyAllokayAtrAvinishchayam
shlokas.26:
pratyakShaM hyetayormUlaM kRRitAntaitihyayorapi |
pratyakSho hyAgamo.abhinnaH kRRitAnto vA na ki~nchana
shlokas.27:
yatra tatrAnumAne.asti kRRitaM bhAvayate.api vA |
anyo jIvaH sharIrasya nAstikAnAM mate smRRitaH
shlokas.28:
reto vaTakaNIkAyAM ghRRitapAkAdhivAsanam |
jAtismRRitirayaskAntaH sUryakAnto.ambubhakShaNam
shlokas.29:
pretya bhUtAtyayashchaiva devatAbhyupayAchanam |
mRRite karmanivRRittishcha pramANamiti nishchayaH
shlokas.30:
na tvete hetavaH santi ye kechinmUrtisa.nsthitAH |
amartyasya hi martyena sAmAnyaM nopapadyate
shlokas.31:
avidyAkarmacheShTAnAM kechidAhuH punarbhavam |
kAraNaM lobhamohau tu doShANAM cha niShevaNam
shlokas.32:
avidyAM kShetramAhurhi karma bIjaM tathA kRRitam |
tRRiShNAsa~njananaM sneha eSha teShAM punarbhavaH
shlokas.33:
tasminvyUDhe cha dagdhe cha chitte maraNadharmiNi |
anyo.anyAjjAyate dehastamAhuH sattvasa~NkShayam
shlokas.34:
yadA sa rUpatashchAnyo jAtitaH shrutito.arthataH |
kathamasminsa ityeva sambandhaH syAdasaMhitaH
shlokas.35:
evaM sati cha kA prItirdAnavidyAtapobalaiH |
yadanyAcharitaM karma sarvamanyaH prapadyate
shlokas.36:
yadA hyayamihaivAnyaiH prAkRRitairduHkhito bhavet |
sukhitairduHkhitairvApi dRRishyo.apyasya vinirNayaH
shlokas.37:
tathA hi musalairhanyuH sharIraM tatpunarbhavet |
pRRithagj~nAnaM yadanyachcha yenaitannopalabhyate
shlokas.38:
RRituH sa.nvatsarastithyaH shItoShNe cha priyApriye |
yathAtItAni pashyanti tAdRRishaH sattvasa~NkShayaH
shlokas.39:
jarayA hi parItasya mRRityunA vA vinAshinA |
durbalaM durbalaM pUrvaM gRRihasyeva vinashyati
shlokas.40:
indriyANi mano vAyuH shoNitaM mA.nsamasthi cha |
AnupUrvyA vinashyanti svaM dhAtumupayAnti cha
shlokas.41:
lokayAtrAvidhAnaM cha dAnadharmaphalAgamaH |
yadarthaM vedashabdAshcha vyavahArAshcha laukikAH
shlokas.42:
iti samya~Nmanasyete bahavaH santi hetavaH |
etadastIdamastIti na ki~nchitpratipadyate
shlokas.43:
teShAM vimRRishatAmevaM tattatsamabhidhAvatAm |
kvachinnivishate buddhistatra jIryati vRRikShavat
shlokas.44:
evamarthairanarthaishcha duHkhitAH sarvajantavaH |
AgamairapakRRiShyante hastipairhastino yathA
shlokas.45:
arthA.nstathAtyantasukhAvahA.nshcha; lipsanta ete bahavo vishulkAH |
mahattaraM duHkhamabhiprapannA; hitvAmiShaM mRRityuvashaM prayAnti
shlokas.46:
vinAshino hyadhruvajIvitasya; kiM bandhubhirmitraparigrahaishcha |
vihAya yo gachChati sarvameva; kShaNena gatvA na nivartate cha
shlokas.47:
bhUvyomatoyAnalavAyavo hi; sadA sharIraM paripAlayanti |
itIdamAlakShya kuto ratirbhave;dvinAshino hyasya na sharma vidyate
shlokas.48:
idamanupadhi vAkyamachChalaM; paramanirAmayamAtmasAkShikam |
narapatirabhivIkShya vismitaH; punaranuyoktumidaM prachakrame

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
janako janadevastu j~nApitaH paramarShiNA |
punarevAnupaprachCha sAmparAye bhavAbhavau
shlokas.2:
bhagavanyadidaM pretya sa~nj~nA bhavati kasyachit |
evaM sati kimaj~nAnaM j~nAnaM vA kiM kariShyati
shlokas.3:
sarvamuchChedaniShThaM syAtpashya chaitaddvijottama |
apramattaH pramatto vA kiM visheShaM kariShyati
shlokas.4:
asa.nsargo hi bhUteShu sa.nsargo vA vinAshiShu |
kasmai kriyeta kalpena nishchayaH ko.atra tattvataH
shlokas.5:
tamasA hi pratichChannaM vibhrAntamiva chAturam |
punaH prashamayanvAkyaiH kaviH pa~nchashikho.abravIt
shlokas.6:
uchChedaniShThA nehAsti bhAvaniShThA na vidyate |
ayaM hyapi samAhAraH sharIrendriyachetasAm
vartate pRRithaganyonyamapyapAshritya karmasu
shlokas.7:
dhAtavaH pa~nchashAkho.ayaM khaM vAyurjyotirambu bhUH |
te svabhAvena tiShThanti viyujyante svabhAvataH
shlokas.8:
AkAshaM vAyurUShmA cha sneho yachchApi pArthivam |
eSha pa~nchasamAhAraH sharIramiti naikadhA
j~nAnamUShmA cha vAyushcha trividhaH karmasa~NgrahaH
shlokas.9:
indriyANIndriyArthAshcha svabhAvashchetanA manaH |
prANApAnau vikArashcha dhAtavashchAtra niHsRRitAH
shlokas.10:
shravaNaM sparshanaM jihvA dRRiShTirnAsA tathaiva cha |
indriyANIti pa~nchaite chittapUrva~NgamA guNAH
shlokas.11:
tatra vij~nAnasa.nyuktA trividhA vedanA dhruvA |
sukhaduHkheti yAmAhuraduHkhetyasukheti cha
shlokas.12:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhashcha mUrtyatha |
ete hyAmaraNAtpa~ncha ShaDguNA j~nAnasiddhaye
shlokas.13:
teShu karmanisargashcha sarvatattvArthanishchayaH |
tamAhuH paramaM shukraM buddhirityavyayaM mahat
shlokas.14:
imaM guNasamAhAramAtmabhAvena pashyataH |
asamyagdarshanairduHkhamanantaM nopashAmyati
shlokas.15:
anAtmeti cha yaddRRiShTaM tenAhaM na mametyapi |
vartate kimadhiShThAnA prasaktA duHkhasantatiH
shlokas.16:
tatra samya~Nmano nAma tyAgashAstramanuttamam |
shRRiNu yattava mokShAya bhAShyamANaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.17:
tyAga eva hi sarveShAmuktAnAmapi karmaNAm |
nityaM mithyAvinItAnAM klesho duHkhAvaho mataH
shlokas.18:
dravyatyAge tu karmANi bhogatyAge vratAnyapi |
sukhatyAge tapoyogaH sarvatyAge samApanA
shlokas.19:
tasya mArgo.ayamadvaidhaH sarvatyAgasya darshitaH |
viprahANAya duHkhasya durgatirhyanyathA bhavet
shlokas.20:
pa~ncha j~nAnendriyANyuktvA manaHShaShThAni chetasi |
manaHShaShThAni vakShyAmi pa~ncha karmendriyANi tu
shlokas.21:
hastau karmendriyaM j~neyamatha pAdau gatIndriyam |
prajanAnandayoH shepho visarge pAyurindriyam
shlokas.22:
vAktu shabdavisheShArthaM gatiM pa~nchAnvitAM viduH |
evamekAdashaitAni buddhyA tvavasRRijenmanaH
shlokas.23:
karNau shabdashcha chittaM cha trayaH shravaNasa~Ngrahe |
tathA sparshe tathA rUpe tathaiva rasagandhayoH
shlokas.24:
evaM pa~nchatrikA hyete guNAstadupalabdhaye |
yena yastrividho bhAvaH paryAyAtsamupasthitaH
shlokas.25:
sAttviko rAjasashchaiva tAmasashchaiva te trayaH |
trividhA vedanA yeShu prasUtA sarvasAdhanA
shlokas.26:
praharShaH prItirAnandaH sukhaM sa.nshAntachittatA |
akutashchitkutashchidvA chittataH sAttviko guNaH
shlokas.27:
atuShTiH paritApashcha shoko lobhastathAkShamA |
li~NgAni rajasastAni dRRishyante hetvahetutaH
shlokas.28:
avivekastathA mohaH pramAdaH svapnatandritA |
katha~nchidapi vartante vividhAstAmasA guNAH
shlokas.29:
tatra yatprItisa.nyuktaM kAye manasi vA bhavet |
vartate sAttviko bhAva ityapekSheta tattathA
shlokas.30:
yattu santApasa.nyuktamaprItikaramAtmanaH |
pravRRittaM raja ityeva tatastadabhichintayet
shlokas.31:
atha yanmohasa.nyuktaM kAye manasi vA bhavet |
apratarkyamavij~neyaM tamastadupadhArayet
shlokas.32:
taddhi shrotrAshrayaM bhUtaM shabdaH shrotraM samAshritaH |
nobhayaM shabdavij~nAne vij~nAnasyetarasya vA
shlokas.33:
evaM tvakchakShuShI jihvA nAsikA chaiva pa~nchamI |
sparshe rUpe rase gandhe tAni cheto manashcha tat
shlokas.34:
svakarmayugapadbhAvo dashasveteShu tiShThati |
chittamekAdashaM viddhi buddhirdvAdashamI bhavet
shlokas.35:
teShAmayugapadbhAve uchChedo nAsti tAmasaH |
Asthito yugapadbhAve vyavahAraH sa laukikaH
shlokas.36:
indriyANyavasRRijyApi dRRiShTvA pUrvaM shrutAgamam |
chintayannAnuparyeti tribhirevAnvito guNaiH
shlokas.37:
yattamopahataM chittamAshu sa~nchAramadhruvam |
karotyuparamaM kAle tadAhustAmasaM sukham
shlokas.38:
yadyadAgamasa.nyuktaM na kRRitsnamupashAmyati |
atha tatrApyupAdatte tamo vyaktamivAnRRitam
shlokas.39:
evameSha prasa~NkhyAtaH svakarmapratyayI guNaH |
katha~nchidvartate samyakkeShA~nchidvA na vartate
shlokas.40:
evamAhuH samAhAraM kShetramadhyAtmachintakAH |
sthito manasi yo bhAvaH sa vai kShetraj~na uchyate
shlokas.41:
evaM sati ka uchChedaH shAshvato vA kathaM bhavet |
svabhAvAdvartamAneShu sarvabhUteShu hetutaH
shlokas.42:
yathArNavagatA nadyo vyaktIrjahati nAma cha |
na cha svatAM niyachChanti tAdRRishaH sattvasa~NkShayaH
shlokas.43:
evaM sati kutaH sa~nj~nA pretyabhAve punarbhavet |
pratisaMmishrite jIve gRRihyamANe cha madhyataH
shlokas.44:
imAM tu yo veda vimokShabuddhi;mAtmAnamanvichChati chApramattaH |
na lipyate karmaphalairaniShTaiH; patraM bisasyeva jalena siktam
shlokas.45:
dRRiDhaishcha pAshairbahubhirvimuktaH; prajAnimittairapi daivataishcha |
yadA hyasau sukhaduHkhe jahAti; muktastadAgryAM gatimetyali~NgaH
shrutipramANAgamama~Ngalaishcha; shete jarAmRRityubhayAdatItaH
shlokas.46:
kShINe cha puNye vigate cha pApe; tatonimitte cha phale vinaShTe |
alepamAkAshamali~Ngameva;mAsthAya pashyanti mahaddhyasaktAH
shlokas.47:
yathorNanAbhiH parivartamAna;stantukShaye tiShThati pAtyamAnaH |
tathA vimuktaH prajahAti duHkhaM; vidhva.nsate loShTa ivAdrimarchChan
shlokas.48:
yathA ruruH shRRi~Ngamatho purANaM; hitvA tvachaM vApyurago yathAvat |
vihAya gachChatyanavekShamANa;stathA vimukto vijahAti duHkham
shlokas.49:
drumaM yathA vApyudake patanta;mutsRRijya pakShI prapatatyasaktaH |
tathA hyasau sukhaduHkhe vihAya; muktaH parArdhyAM gatimetyali~NgaH
shlokas.50:
api cha bhavati maithilena gItaM; nagaramupAhitamagninAbhivIkShya |
na khalu mama tuSho.api dahyate.atra; svayamidamAha kila sma bhUmipAlaH
shlokas.51:
idamamRRitapadaM videharAjaH; svayamiha pa~nchashikhena bhAShyamANaH |
nikhilamabhisamIkShya nishchitArthaM; paramasukhI vijahAra vItashokaH
shlokas.52:
imaM hi yaH paThati vimokShanishchayaM; na hIyate satatamavekShate tathA |
upadravAnnAnubhavatyaduHkhitaH; pramuchyate kapilamivaitya maithilaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM kurvansukhamApnoti kiM kurvanduHkhamApnute |
kiM kurvannirbhayo loke siddhashcharati bhArata
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
damameva prasha.nsanti vRRiddhAH shrutisamAdhayaH |
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM brAhmaNasya visheShataH
shlokas.3:
nAdAntasya kriyAsiddhiryathAvadupalabhyate |
kriyA tapashcha vedAshcha dame sarvaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.4:
damastejo vardhayati pavitraM dama uchyate |
vipApmA nirbhayo dAntaH puruSho vindate mahat
shlokas.5:
sukhaM dAntaH prasvapiti sukhaM cha pratibudhyate |
sukhaM loke viparyeti manashchAsya prasIdati
shlokas.6:
tejo damena dhriyate na tattIkShNo.adhigachChati |
amitrA.nshcha bahUnnityaM pRRithagAtmani pashyati
shlokas.7:
kravyAdbhya iva bhUtAnAmadAntebhyaH sadA bhayam |
teShAM vipratiShedhArthaM rAjA sRRiShTaH svayambhuvA
shlokas.8:
AshrameShu cha sarveShu dama eva vishiShyate |
yachcha teShu phalaM dharme bhUyo dAnte taduchyate
shlokas.9:
teShAM li~NgAni vakShyAmi yeShAM samudayo damaH |
akArpaNyamasa.nrambhaH santoShaH shraddadhAnatA
shlokas.10:
akrodha ArjavaM nityaM nAtivAdo na mAnitA |
gurupUjAnasUyA cha dayA bhUteShvapaishunam
shlokas.11:
janavAdamRRiShAvAdastutinindAvivarjanam |
sAdhukAmashchAspRRihayannAyAti pratyayaM nRRiShu
shlokas.12:
avairakRRitsUpachAraH samo nindAprasha.nsayoH |
suvRRittaH shIlasampannaH prasannAtmAtmavAnbudhaH
prApya loke cha satkAraM svargaM vai pretya gachChati
shlokas.13:
sarvabhUtahite yukto na smayAddveShTi vai janam |
mahAhrada ivAkShobhya praj~nAtRRiptaH prasIdati
shlokas.14:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyaH sarveShAmabhayaM yataH |
namasyaH sarvabhUtAnAM dAnto bhavati j~nAnavAn
shlokas.15:
na hRRiShyati mahatyarthe vyasane cha na shochati |
sa vai parimitapraj~naH sa dAnto dvija uchyate
shlokas.16:
karmabhiH shrutasampannaH sadbhirAcharitaiH shubhaiH |
sadaiva damasa.nyuktastasya bhu~Nkte mahatphalam
shlokas.17:
anasUyA kShamA shAntiH santoShaH priyavAditA |
satyaM dAnamanAyAso naiSha mArgo durAtmanAm
shlokas.18:
kAmakrodhau vashe kRRitvA brahmachArI jitendriyaH |
vikramya ghore tapasi brAhmaNaH sa.nshitavrataH
kAlAkA~NkShI charellokAnnirapAya ivAtmavAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dvijAtayo vratopetA yadidaM bhu~njate haviH |
annaM brAhmaNakAmAya kathametatpitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
avedoktavratopetA bhu~njAnAH kAryakAriNaH |
vedokteShu cha bhu~njAnA vrataluptA yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM tapa ityAhurupavAsaM pRRithagjanAH |
etattapo mahArAja utAho kiM tapo bhavet
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mAsapakShopavAsena manyante yattapo janAH |
AtmatantropaghAtaH sa na tapastatsatAM matam
tyAgashcha sannatishchaiva shiShyate tapa uttamam
shlokas.5:
sadopavAsI cha bhavedbrahmachArI sadaiva cha |
munishcha syAtsadA vipro daivataM cha sadA bhajet
shlokas.6:
kuTumbiko dharmakAmaH sadAsvapnashcha bhArata |
amA.nsAshI sadA cha syAtpavitraM cha sadA japet
shlokas.7:
amRRitAshI sadA cha syAnna cha syAdviShabhojanaH |
vighasAshI sadA cha syAtsadA chaivAtithipriyaH
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM sadopavAsI syAdbrahmachArI kathaM bhavet |
vighasAshI kathaM cha syAtsadA chaivAtithipriyaH
shlokas.9:
bhIShma uvAcha||
antarA prAtarAshaM cha sAyamAshaM tathaiva cha |
sadopavAsI cha bhavedyo na bhu~Nkte katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
bhAryAM gachChanbrahmachArI RRitau bhavati brAhmaNaH |
RRitavAdI sadA cha syAjj~nAnanityashcha yo naraH
shlokas.11:
abhakShayanvRRithAmA.nsamamA.nsAshI bhavatyuta |
dAnanityaH pavitrashcha asvapnashcha divAsvapan
shlokas.12:
bhRRityAtithiShu yo bhu~Nkte bhuktavatsu sadA sa ha |
amRRitaM sakalaM bhu~Nkta iti viddhi yudhiShThira
shlokas.13:
abhuktavatsu nAshnAnaH satataM yastu vai dvijaH |
abhojanena tenAsya jitaH svargo bhavatyuta
shlokas.14:
devatAbhyaH pitRRibhyashcha bhRRityebhyo.atithibhiH saha |
avashiShTaM tu yo.ashnAti tamAhurvighasAshinam
shlokas.15:
teShAM lokA hyaparyantAH sadane brahmaNA saha |
upasthitAshchApsarobhiH pariyAnti divaukasaH
shlokas.16:
devatAbhishcha ye sArdhaM pitRRibhishchopabhu~njate |
ramante putrapautraishcha teShAM gatiranuttamA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadidaM karma loke.asmi~nshubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
puruShaM yojayatyeva phalayogena bhArata
shlokas.2:
kartA svittasya puruSha utAho neti sa.nshayaH |
etadichChAmi tattvena tvattaH shrotuM pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
prahrAdasya cha sa.nvAdamindrasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.4:
asaktaM dhUtapApmAnaM kule jAtaM bahushrutam |
astambhamanaha~NkAraM sattvasthaM samaye ratam
shlokas.5:
tulyanindAstutiM dAntaM shUnyAgAraniveshanam |
charAcharANAM bhUtAnAM viditaprabhavApyayam
shlokas.6:
akrudhyantamahRRiShyantamapriyeShu priyeShu cha |
kA~nchane vAtha loShTe vA ubhayoH samadarshanam
shlokas.7:
AtmaniHshreyasaj~nAne dhIraM nishchitanishchayam |
parAvaraj~naM bhUtAnAM sarvaj~naM samadarshanam
shlokas.8:
shakraH prahrAdamAsInamekAnte sa.nyatendriyam |
bubhutsamAnastatpraj~nAmabhigamyedamabravIt
shlokas.9:
yaiH kaishchitsaMmato loke guNaiH syAtpuruSho nRRiShu |
bhavatyanapagAnsarvA.nstAnguNA.NllakShayAmahe
shlokas.10:
atha te lakShyate buddhiH samA bAlajanairiha |
AtmAnaM manyamAnaH sa~nshreyaH kimiha manyase
shlokas.11:
baddhaH pAshaishchyutaH sthAnAddviShatAM vashamAgataH |
shriyA vihInaH prahrAda shochitavye na shochasi
shlokas.12:
praj~nAlAbhAttu daiteya utAho dhRRitimattayA |
prahrAda svastharUpo.asi pashyanvyasanamAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
iti sa~nchoditastena dhIro nishchitanishchayaH |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA svAM praj~nAmanuvarNayan
shlokas.14:
pravRRittiM cha nivRRittiM cha bhUtAnAM yo na budhyate |
tasya stambho bhavedbAlyAnnAsti stambho.anupashyataH
shlokas.15:
svabhAvAtsampravartante nivartante tathaiva cha |
sarve bhAvAstathAbhAvAH puruShArtho na vidyate
shlokas.16:
puruShArthasya chAbhAve nAsti kashchitsvakArakaH |
svayaM tu kurvatastasya jAtu mAno bhavediha
shlokas.17:
yastu kartAramAtmAnaM manyate sAdhvasAdhunoH |
tasya doShavatI praj~nA svamUrtyaj~neti me matiH
shlokas.18:
yadi syAtpuruShaH kartA shakrAtmashreyase dhruvam |
ArambhAstasya sidhyeranna cha jAtu parAbhavet
shlokas.19:
aniShTasya hi nirvRRittiranivRRittiH priyasya cha |
lakShyate yatamAnAnAM puruShArthastataH kutaH
shlokas.20:
aniShTasyAbhinirvRRittimiShTasa.nvRRittimeva cha |
aprayatnena pashyAmaH keShA~nchittatsvabhAvataH
shlokas.21:
pratirUpadharAH kechiddRRishyante buddhisattamAH |
virUpebhyo.alpabuddhibhyo lipsamAnA dhanAgamam
shlokas.22:
svabhAvapreritAH sarve nivishante guNA yadA |
shubhAshubhAstadA tatra tasya kiM mAnakAraNam
shlokas.23:
svabhAvAdeva tatsarvamiti me nishchitA matiH |
AtmapratiShThitA praj~nA mama nAsti tato.anyathA
shlokas.24:
karmajaM tviha manye.ahaM phalayogaM shubhAshubham |
karmaNAM viShayaM kRRitsnamahaM vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.25:
yathA vedayate kashchidodanaM vAyaso vadan |
evaM sarvANi karmANi svabhAvasyaiva lakShaNam
shlokas.26:
vikArAneva yo veda na veda prakRRitiM parAm |
tasya stambho bhavedbAlyAnnAsti stambho.anupashyataH
shlokas.27:
svabhAvabhAvino bhAvAnsarvAneveha nishchaye |
budhyamAnasya darpo vA mAno vA kiM kariShyati
shlokas.28:
veda dharmavidhiM kRRitsnaM bhUtAnAM chApyanityatAm |
tasmAchChakra na shochAmi sarvaM hyevedamantavat
shlokas.29:
nirmamo niraha~NkAro nirIho muktabandhanaH |
svastho.avyapetaH pashyAmi bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayau
shlokas.30:
kRRitapraj~nasya dAntasya vitRRiShNasya nirAshiShaH |
nAyAso vidyate shakra pashyato lokavidyayA
shlokas.31:
prakRRitau cha vikAre cha na me prItirna cha dviShe |
dveShTAraM na cha pashyAmi yo mamAdya mamAyate
shlokas.32:
nordhvaM nAvA~Nna tiryakcha na kvachichChakra kAmaye |
na vij~nAne na vij~neye nAj~nAne sharma vidyate
shlokas.33:
shakra uvAcha||
yenaiShA labhyate praj~nA yena shAntiravApyate |
prabrUhi tamupAyaM me samyakprahrAda pRRichChate
shlokas.34:
prahrAda uvAcha||
ArjavenApramAdena prasAdenAtmavattayA |
vRRiddhashushrUShayA shakra puruSho labhate mahat
shlokas.35:
svabhAvAllabhate praj~nAM shAntimeti svabhAvataH |
svabhAvAdeva tatsarvaM yatki~nchidanupashyasi
shlokas.36:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityukto daityapatinA shakro vismayamAgamat |
prItimA.nshcha tadA rAja.nstadvAkyaM pratyapUjayat
shlokas.37:
sa tadAbhyarchya daityendraM trailokyapatirIshvaraH |
asurendramupAmantrya jagAma svaM niveshanam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yayA buddhyA mahIpAlo bhraShTashrIrvicharenmahIm |
kAladaNDaviniShpiShTastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vAsavasya cha sa.nvAdaM balervairochanasya cha
shlokas.3:
pitAmahamupAgatya praNipatya kRRitA~njaliH |
sarvAnevAsurA~njitvA baliM paprachCha vAsavaH
shlokas.4:
yasya sma dadato vittaM na kadAchana hIyate |
taM baliM nAdhigachChAmi brahmannAchakShva me balim
shlokas.5:
sa eva hyastamayate sa sma vidyotate dishaH |
sa varShati sma varShANi yathAkAlamatandritaH
taM baliM nAdhigachChAmi brahmannAchakShva me balim
shlokas.6:
sa vAyurvaruNashchaiva sa raviH sa cha chandramAH |
so.agnistapati bhUtAni pRRithivI cha bhavatyuta
taM baliM nAdhigachChAmi brahmannAchakShva me balim
shlokas.7:
brahmovAcha||
naitatte sAdhu maghavanyadetadanupRRichChasi |
pRRiShTastu nAnRRitaM brUyAttasmAdvakShyAmi te balim
shlokas.8:
uShTreShu yadi vA goShu khareShvashveShu vA punaH |
variShTho bhavitA jantuH shUnyAgAre shachIpate
shlokas.9:
shakra uvAcha||
yadi sma balinA brahma~nshUnyAgAre sameyivAn |
hanyAmenaM na vA hanyAM tadbrahmannanushAdhi mAm
shlokas.10:
brahmovAcha||
mA sma shakra baliM hi.nsIrna balirvadhamarhati |
nyAyA.nstu shakra praShTavyastvayA vAsava kAmyayA
shlokas.11:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamukto bhagavatA mahendraH pRRithivIM tadA |
chachArairAvataskandhamadhiruhya shriyA vRRitaH
shlokas.12:
tato dadarsha sa baliM kharaveSheNa sa.nvRRitam |
yathAkhyAtaM bhagavatA shUnyAgArakRRitAlayam
shlokas.13:
shakra uvAcha||
kharayonimanuprAptastuShabhakSho.asi dAnava |
iyaM te yoniradhamA shochasyAho na shochasi
shlokas.14:
adRRiShTaM bata pashyAmi dviShatAM vashamAgatam |
shriyA vihInaM mitraishcha bhraShTavIryaparAkramam
shlokas.15:
yattadyAnasahasreNa j~nAtibhiH parivAritaH |
lokAnpratApayansarvAnyAsyasmAnavitarkayan
shlokas.16:
tvanmukhAshchaiva daiteyA vyatiShTha.nstava shAsane |
akRRiShTapachyA pRRithivI tavaishvarye babhUva ha
idaM cha te.adya vyasanaM shochasyAho na shochasi
shlokas.17:
yadAtiShThaH samudrasya pUrvakUle vilelihan |
j~nAtibhyo vibhajanvittaM tadAsItte manaH katham
shlokas.18:
yatte sahasrasamitA nanRRiturdevayoShitaH |
bahUni varShapUgAni vihAre dIpyataH shriyA
shlokas.19:
sarvAH puShkaramAlinyaH sarvAH kA~nchanasaprabhAH |
kathamadya tadA chaiva manaste dAnaveshvara
shlokas.20:
ChatraM tavAsItsumahatsauvarNaM maNibhUShitam |
nanRRituryatra gandharvAH ShaTsahasrANi saptadhA
shlokas.21:
yUpastavAsItsumahAnyajataH sarvakA~nchanaH |
yatrAdadaH sahasrANAmayutAni gavAM dasha
shlokas.22:
yadA tu pRRithivIM sarvAM yajamAno.anuparyayAH |
shamyAkShepeNa vidhinA tadAsItkiM nu te hRRidi
shlokas.23:
na te pashyAmi bhRRi~NgAraM na ChatraM vyajanaM na cha |
brahmadattAM cha te mAlAM na pashyAmyasurAdhipa
shlokas.24:
baliruvAcha||
na tvaM pashyasi bhRRi~NgAraM na ChatraM vyajanaM na cha |
brahmadattAM cha me mAlAM na tvaM drakShyasi vAsava
shlokas.25:
guhAyAM nihitAni tvaM mama ratnAni pRRichChasi |
yadA me bhavitA kAlastadA tvaM tAni drakShyasi
shlokas.26:
na tvetadanurUpaM te yashaso vA kulasya vA |
samRRiddhArtho.asamRRiddhArthaM yanmAM katthitumichChasi
shlokas.27:
na hi duHkheShu shochanti na prahRRiShyanti charddhiShu |
kRRitapraj~nA j~nAnatRRiptAH kShAntAH santo manIShiNaH
shlokas.28:
tvaM tu prAkRRitayA buddhyA pura.ndara vikatthase |
yadAhamiva bhAvI tvaM tadA naivaM vadiShyasi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
punareva tu taM shakraH prahasannidamabravIt |
niHshvasantaM yathA nAgaM pravyAhArAya bhArata
shlokas.2:
yattadyAnasahasreNa j~nAtibhiH parivAritaH |
lokAnpratApayansarvAnyAsyasmAnavitarkayan
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA sukRRipaNAM chemAmavasthAmAtmano bale |
j~nAtimitraparityaktaH shochasyAho na shochasi
shlokas.4:
prItiM prApyAtulAM pUrvaM lokA.nshchAtmavashe sthitAn |
vinipAtamimaM chAdya shochasyAho na shochasi
shlokas.5:
baliruvAcha||
anityamupalakShyedaM kAlaparyAyamAtmanaH |
tasmAchChakra na shochAmi sarvaM hyevedamantavat
shlokas.6:
antavanta ime dehA bhUtAnAmamarAdhipa |
tena shakra na shochAmi nAparAdhAdidaM mama
shlokas.7:
jIvitaM cha sharIraM cha pretya vai saha jAyate |
ubhe saha vivardhete ubhe saha vinashyataH
shlokas.8:
tadIdRRishamidaM bhAvamavashaH prApya kevalam |
yadyevamabhijAnAmi kA vyathA me vijAnataH
shlokas.9:
bhUtAnAM nidhanaM niShThA srotasAmiva sAgaraH |
naitatsamyagvijAnanto narA muhyanti vajrabhRRit
shlokas.10:
ye tvevaM nAbhijAnanti rajomohaparAyaNAH |
te kRRichChraM prApya sIdanti buddhiryeShAM praNashyati
shlokas.11:
buddhilAbhe hi puruShaH sarvaM nudati kilbiSham |
vipApmA labhate sattvaM sattvasthaH samprasIdati
shlokas.12:
tatastu ye nivartante jAyante vA punaH punaH |
kRRipaNAH paritapyante te.anarthaiH parichoditAH
shlokas.13:
arthasiddhimanarthaM cha jIvitaM maraNaM tathA |
sukhaduHkhaphalaM chaiva na dveShmi na cha kAmaye
shlokas.14:
hataM hanti hato hyeva yo naro hanti ka~nchana |
ubhau tau na vijAnIto yashcha hanti hatashcha yaH
shlokas.15:
hatvA jitvA cha maghavanyaH kashchitpuruShAyate |
akartA hyeva bhavati kartA tveva karoti tat
shlokas.16:
ko hi lokasya kurute vinAshaprabhavAvubhau |
kRRitaM hi tatkRRitenaiva kartA tasyApi chAparaH
shlokas.17:
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
etadyonIni bhUtAni tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.18:
mahAvidyo.alpavidyashcha balavAndurbalashcha yaH |
darshanIyo virUpashcha subhago durbhagashcha yaH
shlokas.19:
sarvaM kAlaH samAdatte gambhIraH svena tejasA |
tasminkAlavashaM prApte kA vyathA me vijAnataH
shlokas.20:
dagdhamevAnudahati hatamevAnuhanti cha |
nashyate naShTamevAgre labdhavyaM labhate naraH
shlokas.21:
nAsya dvIpaH kutaH pAraM nAvAraH sampradRRishyate |
nAntamasya prapashyAmi vidherdivyasya chintayan
shlokas.22:
yadi me pashyataH kAlo bhUtAni na vinAshayet |
syAnme harShashcha darpashcha krodhashchaiva shachIpate
shlokas.23:
tuShabhakShaM tu mAM j~nAtvA praviviktajane gRRihe |
bibhrataM gArdabhaM rUpamAdishya parigarhase
shlokas.24:
ichChannahaM vikuryAM hi rUpANi bahudhAtmanaH |
vibhIShaNAni yAnIkShya palAyethAstvameva me
shlokas.25:
kAlaH sarvaM samAdatte kAlaH sarvaM prayachChati |
kAlena vidhRRitaM sarvaM mA kRRithAH shakra pauruSham
shlokas.26:
purA sarvaM pravyathate mayi kruddhe pura.ndara |
avaimi tvasya lokasya dharmaM shakra sanAtanam
shlokas.27:
tvamapyevamapekShasva mAtmanA vismayaM gamaH |
prabhavashcha prabhAvashcha nAtmasa.nsthaH kadAchana
shlokas.28:
kaumArameva te chittaM tathaivAdya yathA purA |
samavekShasva maghavanbuddhiM vindasva naiShThikIm
shlokas.29:
devA manuShyAH pitaro gandharvoragarAkShasAH |
Asansarve mama vashe tatsarvaM vettha vAsava
shlokas.30:
namastasyai dishe.apyastu yasyAM vairochano baliH |
iti mAmabhyapadyanta buddhimAtsaryamohitAH
shlokas.31:
nAhaM tadanushochAmi nAtmabhra.nshaM shachIpate |
evaM me nishchitA buddhiH shAstustiShThAmyahaM vashe
shlokas.32:
dRRishyate hi kule jAto darshanIyaH pratApavAn |
duHkhaM jIvansahAmAtyo bhavitavyaM hi tattathA
shlokas.33:
dauShkuleyastathA mUDho durjAtaH shakra dRRishyate |
sukhaM jIvansahAmAtyo bhavitavyaM hi tattathA
shlokas.34:
kalyANI rUpasampannA durbhagA shakra dRRishyate |
alakShaNA virUpA cha subhagA shakra dRRishyate
shlokas.35:
naitadasmatkRRitaM shakra naitachChakra tvayA kRRitam |
yattvameva~Ngato vajrinyadvApyeva~NgatA vayam
shlokas.36:
na karma tava nAnyeShAM kuto mama shatakrato |
RRiddhirvApyatha vA narddhiH paryAyakRRitameva tat
shlokas.37:
pashyAmi tvA virAjantaM devarAjamavasthitam |
shrImantaM dyutimantaM cha garjantaM cha mamopari
shlokas.38:
etachchaivaM na chetkAlo mAmAkramya sthito bhavet |
pAtayeyamahaM tvAdya savajramapi muShTinA
shlokas.39:
na tu vikramakAlo.ayaM kShamAkAlo.ayamAgataH |
kAlaH sthApayate sarvaM kAlaH pachati vai tathA
shlokas.40:
mAM chedabhyAgataH kAlo dAnaveshvaramUrjitam |
garjantaM pratapantaM cha kamanyaM nAgamiShyati
shlokas.41:
dvAdashAnAM hi bhavatAmAdityAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tejA.nsyekena sarveShAM devarAja hRRitAni me
shlokas.42:
ahamevodvahAmyApo visRRijAmi cha vAsava |
tapAmi chaiva trailokyaM vidyotAmyahameva cha
shlokas.43:
sa.nrakShAmi vilumpAmi dadAmyahamathAdade |
sa.nyachChAmi niyachChAmi lokeShu prabhurIshvaraH
shlokas.44:
tadadya vinivRRittaM me prabhutvamamarAdhipa |
kAlasainyAvagADhasya sarvaM na pratibhAti me
shlokas.45:
nAhaM kartA na chaiva tvaM nAnyaH kartA shachIpate |
paryAyeNa hi bhujyante lokAH shakra yadRRichChayA
shlokas.46:
mAsArdhamAsaveshmAnamahorAtrAbhisa.nvRRitam |
RRitudvAraM varShamukhamAhurvedavido janAH
shlokas.47:
AhuH sarvamidaM chintyaM janAH kechinmanIShayA |
asyAH pa~nchaiva chintAyAH paryeShyAmi cha pa~nchadhA
shlokas.48:
ganbhIraM gahanaM brahma mahattoyArNavaM yathA |
anAdinidhanaM chAhurakSharaM parameva cha
shlokas.49:
sattveShu li~NgamAveshya nali~Ngamapi tatsvayam |
manyante dhruvamevainaM ye narAstattvadarshinaH
shlokas.50:
bhUtAnAM tu viparyAsaM manyate gatavAniti |
na hyetAvadbhavedgamyaM na yasmAtprakRRiteH paraH
shlokas.51:
gatiM hi sarvabhUtAnAmagatvA kva gamiShyasi |
yo dhAvatA na hAtavyastiShThannapi na hIyate
tamindriyANi sarvANi nAnupashyanti pa~nchadhA
shlokas.52:
AhushchainaM kechidagniM kechidAhuH prajApatim |
RRitumAsArdhamAsA.nshcha divasA.nstu kShaNA.nstathA
shlokas.53:
pUrvAhNamaparAhNaM cha madhyAhnamapi chApare |
muhUrtamapi chaivAhurekaM santamanekadhA
taM kAlamavajAnIhi yasya sarvamidaM vashe
shlokas.54:
bahUnIndrasahasrANi samatItAni vAsava |
balavIryopapannAni yathaiva tvaM shachIpate
shlokas.55:
tvAmapyatibalaM shakraM devarAjaM balotkaTam |
prApte kAle mahAvIryaH kAlaH sa.nshamayiShyati
shlokas.56:
ya idaM sarvamAdatte tasmAchChakra sthiro bhava |
mayA tvayA cha pUrvaishcha na sa shakyo.ativartitum
shlokas.57:
yAmetAM prApya jAnIShe rAjashriyamanuttamAm |
sthitA mayIti tanmithyA naiShA hyekatra tiShThati
shlokas.58:
sthitA hIndrasahasreShu tvadvishiShTatameShviyam |
mAM cha lolA parityajya tvAmagAdvibudhAdhipa
shlokas.59:
maivaM shakra punaH kArShIH shAnto bhavitumarhasi |
tvAmapyeva~NgataM tyaktvA kShipramanyaM gamiShyati

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shatakraturathApashyadbalerdIptAM mahAtmanaH |
svarUpiNIM sharIrAddhi tadA niShkrAmatIM shriyam
shlokas.2:
tAM dIptAM prabhayA dRRiShTvA bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
vismayotphullanayano baliM paprachCha vAsavaH
shlokas.3:
bale keyamapakrAntA rochamAnA shikhaNDinI |
tvattaH sthitA sakeyUrA dIpyamAnA svatejasA
shlokas.4:
baliruvAcha||
na hImAmAsurIM vedmi na daivIM na cha mAnuShIm |
tvamevainAM pRRichCha mA vA yatheShTaM kuru vAsava
shlokas.5:
shakra uvAcha||
kA tvaM balerapakrAntA rochamAnA shikhaNDinI |
ajAnato mamAchakShva nAmadheyaM shuchismite
shlokas.6:
kA tvaM tiShThasi mAyeva dIpyamAnA svatejasA |
hitvA daityeshvaraM subhru tanmamAchakShva tattvataH
shlokas.7:
shrIruvAcha||
na mA virochano veda na mA vairochano baliH |
AhurmAM duHsahetyevaM vidhitseti cha mAM viduH
shlokas.8:
bhUtirlakShmIti mAmAhuH shrIrityevaM cha vAsava |
tvaM mAM shakra na jAnIShe sarve devA na mAM viduH
shlokas.9:
shakra uvAcha||
kimidaM tvaM mama kRRite utAho balinaH kRRite |
duHsahe vijahAsyenaM chirasa.nvAsinI satI
shlokas.10:
shrIruvAcha||
na dhAtA na vidhAtA mAM vidadhAti katha~nchana |
kAlastu shakra paryAyAnmainaM shakrAvamanyathAH
shlokas.11:
shakra uvAcha||
kathaM tvayA balistyaktaH kimarthaM vA shikhaNDini |
kathaM cha mAM na jahyAstvaM tanme brUhi shuchismite
shlokas.12:
shrIruvAcha||
satye sthitAsmi dAne cha vrate tapasi chaiva hi |
parAkrame cha dharme cha parAchInastato baliH
shlokas.13:
brahmaNyo.ayaM sadA bhUtvA satyavAdI jitendriyaH |
abhyasUyadbrAhmaNAnvai uchChiShTashchAspRRishadghRRitam
shlokas.14:
yaj~nashIlaH purA bhUtvA mAmeva yajatetyayam |
provAcha lokAnmUDhAtmA kAlenopanipIDitaH
shlokas.15:
apAkRRitA tataH shakra tvayi vatsyAmi vAsava |
apramattena dhAryAsmi tapasA vikrameNa cha
shlokas.16:
shakra uvAcha||
asti devamanuShyeShu sarvabhUteShu vA pumAn |
yastvAmeko viShahituM shaknuyAtkamalAlaye
shlokas.17:
shrIruvAcha||
naiva devo na gandharvo nAsuro na cha rAkShasaH |
yo mAmeko viShahituM shaktaH kashchitpura.ndara
shlokas.18:
shakra uvAcha||
tiShThethA mayi nityaM tvaM yathA tadbrUhi me shubhe |
tatkariShyAmi te vAkyamRRitaM tvaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.19:
shrIruvAcha||
sthAsyAmi nityaM devendra yathA tvayi nibodha tat |
vidhinA vedadRRiShTena chaturdhA vibhajasva mAm
shlokas.20:
shakra uvAcha||
ahaM vai tvA nidhAsyAmi yathAshakti yathAbalam |
na tu me.atikramaH syAdvai sadA lakShmi tavAntike
shlokas.21:
bhUmireva manuShyeShu dhAraNI bhUtabhAvinI |
sA te pAdaM titikSheta samarthA hIti me matiH
shlokas.22:
shrIruvAcha||
eSha me nihitaH pAdo yo.ayaM bhUmau pratiShThitaH |
dvitIyaM shakra pAdaM me tasmAtsunihitaM kuru
shlokas.23:
shakra uvAcha||
Apa eva manuShyeShu dravantyaH parichArikAH |
tAste pAdaM titikShantAmalamApastitikShitum
shlokas.24:
shrIruvAcha||
eSha me nihitaH pAdo yo.ayamapsu pratiShThitaH |
tRRitIyaM shakra pAdaM me tasmAtsunihitaM kuru
shlokas.25:
shakra uvAcha||
yasmindevAshcha yaj~nAshcha yasminvedAH pratiShThitAH |
tRRitIyaM pAdamagniste sudhRRitaM dhArayiShyati
shlokas.26:
shrIruvAcha||
eSha me nihitaH pAdo yo.ayamagnau pratiShThitaH |
chaturthaM shakra pAdaM me tasmAtsunihitaM kuru
shlokas.27:
shakra uvAcha||
ye vai santo manuShyeShu brahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH |
te te pAdaM titikShantAmalaM santastitikShitum
shlokas.28:
shrIruvAcha||
eSha me nihitaH pAdo yo.ayaM satsu pratiShThitaH |
evaM vinihitAM shakra bhUteShu paridhatsva mAm
shlokas.29:
shakra uvAcha||
bhUtAnAmiha vai yastvA mayA vinihitAM satIm |
upahanyAtsa me dviShyAttathA shRRiNvantu me vachaH
shlokas.30:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastyaktaH shriyA rAjA daityAnAM balirabravIt |
yAvatpurastAtpratapettAvadvai dakShiNAM disham
shlokas.31:
pashchimAM tAvadevApi tathodIchIM divAkaraH |
tathA madhya.ndine sUryo astameti yadA tadA
punardevAsuraM yuddhaM bhAvi jetAsmi vastadA
shlokas.32:
sarvA.NllokAnyadAditya ekasthastApayiShyati |
tadA devAsure yuddhe jetAhaM tvAM shatakrato
shlokas.33:
shakra uvAcha||
brahmaNAsmi samAdiShTo na hantavyo bhavAniti |
tena te.ahaM bale vajraM na vimu~nchAmi mUrdhani
shlokas.34:
yatheShTaM gachCha daityendra svasti te.astu mahAsura |
Adityo nAvatapitA kadAchinmadhyataH sthitaH
shlokas.35:
sthApito hyasya samayaH pUrvameva svayambhuvA |
ajasraM pariyAtyeSha satyenAvatapanprajAH
shlokas.36:
ayanaM tasya ShaNmAsA uttaraM dakShiNaM tathA |
yena sa.nyAti lokeShu shItoShNe visRRijanraviH
shlokas.37:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktastu daityendro balirindreNa bhArata |
jagAma dakShiNAmAshAmudIchIM tu pura.ndaraH
shlokas.38:
ityetadbalinA gItamanaha~NkArasa~nj~nitam |
vAkyaM shrutvA sahasrAkShaH khamevAruruhe tadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shatakratoshcha sa.nvAdaM namucheshcha yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
shriyA vihInamAsInamakShobhyamiva sAgaram |
bhavAbhavaj~naM bhUtAnAmityuvAcha pura.ndaraH
shlokas.3:
baddhaH pAshaishchyutaH sthAnAddviShatAM vashamAgataH |
shriyA vihIno namuche shochasyAho na shochasi
shlokas.4:
namuchiruvAcha||
anavApyaM cha shokena sharIraM chopatapyate |
amitrAshcha prahRRiShyanti nAsti shoke sahAyatA
shlokas.5:
tasmAchChakra na shochAmi sarvaM hyevedamantavat |
santApAdbhrashyate rUpaM dharmashchaiva sureshvara
shlokas.6:
vinIya khalu tadduHkhamAgataM vaimanasyajam |
dhyAtavyaM manasA hRRidyaM kalyANaM sa.nvijAnatA
shlokas.7:
yathA yathA hi puruShaH kalyANe kurute manaH |
tadaivAsya prasIdanti sarvArthA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
ekaH shAstA na dvitIyo.asti shAstA; garbhe shayAnaM puruShaM shAsti shAstA |
tenAnushiShTaH pravaNAdivodakaM; yathA niyukto.asmi tathA vahAmi
shlokas.9:
bhAvAbhAvAvabhijAnangarIyo; jAnAmi shreyo na tu tatkaromi |
AshAH susharmyAH suhRRidAM sukurva;nyathA niyukto.asmi tathA vahAmi
shlokas.10:
yathA yathAsya prAptavyaM prApnotyeva tathA tathA |
bhavitavyaM yathA yachcha bhavatyeva tathA tathA
shlokas.11:
yatra yatraiva sa.nyu~Nkte dhAtA garbhaM punaH punaH |
tatra tatraiva vasati na yatra svayamichChati
shlokas.12:
bhAvo yo.ayamanuprApto bhavitavyamidaM mama |
iti yasya sadA bhAvo na sa muhyetkadAchana
shlokas.13:
paryAyairhanyamAnAnAmabhiyoktA na vidyate |
duHkhametattu yaddveShTA kartAhamiti manyate
shlokas.14:
RRiShI.nshcha devA.nshcha mahAsurA.nshcha; traividyavRRiddhA.nshcha vane munI.nshcha |
kAnnApado nopanamanti loke; parAvaraj~nAstu na sambhramanti
shlokas.15:
na paNDitaH krudhyati nApi sajjate; na chApi sa.nsIdati na prahRRiShyati |
na chArthakRRichChravyasaneShu shochati; sthitaH prakRRityA himavAnivAchalaH
shlokas.16:
yamarthasiddhiH paramA na harShaye;ttathaiva kAle vyasanaM na mohayet |
sukhaM cha duHkhaM cha tathaiva madhyamaM; niShevate yaH sa dhurandharo naraH
shlokas.17:
yAM yAmavasthAM puruSho.adhigachChe;ttasyAM rametAparitapyamAnaH |
evaM pravRRiddhaM praNudenmanojaM; santApamAyAsakaraM sharIrAt
shlokas.18:
tatsadaH sa pariShatsabhAsadaH; prApya yo na kurute sabhAbhayam |
dharmatattvamavagAhya buddhimA;nyo.abhyupaiti sa pumAndhurandharaH
shlokas.19:
prAj~nasya karmANi duranvayAni; na vai prAj~no muhyati mohakAle |
sthAnAchchyutashchenna mumoha gautama;stAvatkRRichChrAmApadaM prApya vRRiddhaH
shlokas.20:
na mantrabalavIryeNa praj~nayA pauruSheNa vA |
alabhyaM labhate martyastatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.21:
yadevamanujAtasya dhAtAro vidadhuH purA |
tadevAnubhaviShyAmi kiM me mRRityuH kariShyati
shlokas.22:
labdhavyAnyeva labhate gantavyAnyeva gachChati |
prAptavyAnyeva prApnoti duHkhAni cha sukhAni cha
shlokas.23:
etadviditvA kArtsnyena yo na muhyati mAnavaH |
kushalaH sukhaduHkheShu sa vai sarvadhaneshvaraH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
magnasya vyasane kRRichChre kiM shreyaH puruShasya hi |
bandhunAshe mahIpAla rAjyanAshe.api vA punaH
shlokas.2:
tvaM hi naH paramo vaktA loke.asminbharatarShabha |
etadbhavantaM pRRichChAmi tanme vaktumihArhasi
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
putradAraiH sukhaishchaiva viyuktasya dhanena cha |
magnasya vyasane kRRichChre dhRRitiH shreyaskarI nRRipa
shlokas.4:
dhairyeNa yuktasya sataH sharIraM na vishIryate |
ArogyAchcha sharIrasya sa punarvindate shriyam
shlokas.5:
yasya rAj~no narAstAta sAttvikIM vRRittimAsthitAH |
tasya sthairyaM cha dhairyaM cha vyavasAyashcha karmasu
shlokas.6:
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
balivAsavasa.nvAdaM punareva yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
vRRitte devAsure yuddhe daityadAnavasa~NkShaye |
viShNukrAnteShu lokeShu devarAje shatakratau
