shlokas.8:
ijyamAneShu deveShu chAturvarNye vyavasthite |
samRRidhyamAne trailokye prItiyukte svayambhuvi
shlokas.9:
rudrairvasubhirAdityairashvibhyAmapi charShibhiH |
gandharvairbhujagendraishcha siddhaishchAnyairvRRitaH prabhuH
shlokas.10:
chaturdantaM sudAntaM cha vAraNendraM shriyA vRRitam |
AruhyairAvataM shakrastrailokyamanusa.nyayau
shlokas.11:
sa kadAchitsamudrAnte kasmi.nshchidgirigahvare |
baliM vairochaniM vajrI dadarshopasasarpa cha
shlokas.12:
tamairAvatamUrdhasthaM prekShya devagaNairvRRitam |
surendramindraM daityendro na shushocha na vivyathe
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA tamavikArasthaM tiShThantaM nirbhayaM balim |
adhirUDho dvipashreShThamityuvAcha shatakratuH
shlokas.14:
daitya na vyathase shauryAdatha vA vRRiddhasevayA |
tapasA bhAvitatvAdvA sarvathaitatsuduShkaram
shlokas.15:
shatrubhirvashamAnIto hInaH sthAnAdanuttamAt |
vairochane kimAshritya shochitavye na shochasi
shlokas.16:
shraiShThyaM prApya svajAtInAM bhuktvA bhogAnanuttamAn |
hRRitasvabalarAjyastvaM brUhi kasmAnna shochasi
shlokas.17:
Ishvaro hi purA bhUtvA pitRRipaitAmahe pade |
tattvamadya hRRitaM dRRiShTvA sapatnaiH kiM na shochasi
shlokas.18:
baddhashcha vAruNaiH pAshairvajreNa cha samAhataH |
hRRitadAro hRRitadhano brUhi kasmAnna shochasi
shlokas.19:
bhraShTashrIrvibhavabhraShTo yanna shochasi duShkaram |
trailokyarAjyanAshe hi ko.anyo jIvitumutsahet
shlokas.20:
etachchAnyachcha paruShaM bruvantaM paribhUya tam |
shrutvA sukhamasambhrAnto balirvairochano.abravIt
shlokas.21:
nigRRihIte mayi bhRRishaM shakra kiM katthitena te |
vajramudyamya tiShThantaM pashyAmi tvAM pura.ndara
shlokas.22:
ashaktaH pUrvamAsIstvaM katha~nchichChaktatAM gataH |
kastvadanya imA vAchaH sukrUrA vaktumarhati
shlokas.23:
yastu shatrorvashasthasya shakto.api kurute dayAm |
hastaprAptasya vIrasya taM chaiva puruShaM viduH
shlokas.24:
anishchayo hi yuddheShu dvayorvivadamAnayoH |
ekaH prApnoti vijayamekashchaiva parAbhavam
shlokas.25:
mA cha te bhUtsvabhAvo.ayaM mayA daivatapu~Ngava |
IshvaraH sarvabhUtAnAM vikrameNa jito balAt
shlokas.26:
naitadasmatkRRitaM shakra naitachChakra tvayA kRRitam |
yattvameva~Ngato vajrinyadvApyeva~NgatA vayam
shlokas.27:
ahamAsaM yathAdya tvaM bhavitA tvaM yathA vayam |
mAvama.nsthA mayA karma duShkRRitaM kRRitamityuta
shlokas.28:
sukhaduHkhe hi puruShaH paryAyeNAdhigachChati |
paryAyeNAsi shakratvaM prAptaH shakra na karmaNA
shlokas.29:
kAlaH kAle nayati mAM tvAM cha kAlo nayatyayam |
tenAhaM tvaM yathA nAdya tvaM chApi na yathA vayam
shlokas.30:
na mAtRRipitRRishushrUShA na cha daivatapUjanam |
nAnyo guNasamAchAraH puruShasya sukhAvahaH
shlokas.31:
na vidyA na tapo dAnaM na mitrANi na bAndhavAH |
shaknuvanti paritrAtuM naraM kAlena pIDitam
shlokas.32:
nAgAminamanarthaM hi pratighAtashatairapi |
shaknuvanti prativyoDhumRRite buddhibalAnnarAH
shlokas.33:
paryAyairhanyamAnAnAM paritrAtA na vidyate |
idaM tu duHkhaM yachChakra kartAhamiti manyate
shlokas.34:
yadi kartA bhavetkartA na kriyeta kadAchana |
yasmAttu kriyate kartA tasmAtkartApyanIshvaraH
shlokas.35:
kAlena tvAhamajayaM kAlenAhaM jitastvayA |
gantA gatimatAM kAlaH kAlaH kalayati prajAH
shlokas.36:
indra prAkRRitayA buddhyA pralapannAvabudhyase |
kechittvAM bahu manyante shraiShThyaM prAptaM svakarmaNA
shlokas.37:
kathamasmadvidho nAma jAna.NllokapravRRittayaH |
kAlenAbhyAhataH shochenmuhyedvApyarthasambhrame
shlokas.38:
nityaM kAlaparItasya mama vA madvidhasya vA |
buddhirvyasanamAsAdya bhinnA nauriva sIdati
shlokas.39:
ahaM cha tvaM cha ye chAnye bhaviShyanti surAdhipAH |
te sarve shakra yAsyanti mArgamindrashatairgatam
shlokas.40:
tvAmapyevaM sudurdharShaM jvalantaM parayA shriyA |
kAle pariNate kAlaH kAlayiShyati mAmiva
shlokas.41:
bahUnIndrasahasrANi daiteyAnAM yuge yuge |
abhyatItAni kAlena kAlo hi duratikramaH
shlokas.42:
idaM tu labdhvA tvaM sthAnamAtmAnaM bahu manyase |
sarvabhUtabhavaM devaM brahmANamiva shAshvatam
shlokas.43:
na chedamachalaM sthAnamanantaM vApi kasyachit |
tvaM tu bAlishayA buddhyA mamedamiti manyase
shlokas.44:
avishvAsye vishvasiShi manyase chAdhruvaM dhruvam |
mameyamiti mohAttvaM rAjashriyamabhIpsasi
shlokas.45:
neyaM tava na chAsmAkaM na chAnyeShAM sthirA matA |
atikramya bahUnanyA.nstvayi tAvadiyaM sthitA
shlokas.46:
ka~nchitkAlamiyaM sthitvA tvayi vAsava cha~nchalA |
gaurnipAnamivotsRRijya punaranyaM gamiShyati
shlokas.47:
rAjalokA hyatikrAntA yAnna sa~NkhyAtumutsahe |
tvatto bahutarAshchAnye bhaviShyanti pura.ndara
shlokas.48:
savRRikShauShadhiratneyaM sasaritparvatAkarA |
tAnidAnIM na pashyAmi yairbhukteyaM purA mahI
shlokas.49:
pRRithurailo mayo bhaumo narakaH shambarastathA |
ashvagrIvaH pulomA cha svarbhAnuramitadhvajaH
shlokas.50:
prahrAdo namuchirdakSho viprachittirvirochanaH |
hrIniShedhaH suhotrashcha bhUrihA puShpavAnvRRiShaH
shlokas.51:
satyeShurRRiShabho rAhuH kapilAshvo virUpakaH |
bANaH kArtasvaro vahnirvishvadaMShTro.atha nairRRitaH
shlokas.52:
ritthAhutthau vIratAmrau varAhAshvo ruchiH prabhuH |
vishvajitpratishaurishcha vRRiShANDo viShkaro madhuH
shlokas.53:
hiraNyakashipushchaiva kaiTabhashchaiva dAnavaH |
daityAshcha kAlakha~njAshcha sarve te nairRRitaiH saha
shlokas.54:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH pUrve pUrvatarAshcha ye |
daityendrA dAnavendrAshcha yA.nshchAnyAnanushushruma
shlokas.55:
bahavaH pUrvadaityendrAH santyajya pRRithivIM gatAH |
kAlenAbhyAhatAH sarve kAlo hi balavattaraH
shlokas.56:
sarvaiH kratushatairiShTaM na tvamekaH shatakratuH |
sarve dharmaparAshchAsansarve satatasatriNaH
shlokas.57:
antarikShacharAH sarve sarve.abhimukhayodhinaH |
sarve saMhananopetAH sarve parighabAhavaH
shlokas.58:
sarve mAyAshatadharAH sarve te kAmachAriNaH |
sarve samaramAsAdya na shrUyante parAjitAH
shlokas.59:
sarve satyavrataparAH sarve kAmavihAriNaH |
sarve vedavrataparAH sarve chAsanbahushrutAH
shlokas.60:
sarve saMhatamaishvaryamIshvarAH pratipedire |
na chaishvaryamadasteShAM bhUtapUrvo mahAtmanAm
shlokas.61:
sarve yathArthadAtAraH sarve vigatamatsarAH |
sarve sarveShu bhUteShu yathAvatpratipedire
shlokas.62:
sarve dAkShAyaNIputrAH prAjApatyA mahAbalAH |
jvalantaH pratapantashcha kAlena pratisaMhRRitAH
shlokas.63:
tvaM chaivemAM yadA bhuktvA pRRithivIM tyakShyase punaH |
na shakShyasi tadA shakra niyantuM shokamAtmanaH
shlokas.64:
mu~nchechChAM kAmabhogeShu mu~nchemaM shrIbhavaM madam |
evaM svarAjyanAshe tvaM shokaM samprasahiShyasi
shlokas.65:
shokakAle shucho mA tvaM harShakAle cha mA hRRiShaH |
atItAnAgate hitvA pratyutpannena vartaya
shlokas.66:
mAM chedabhyAgataH kAlaH sadAyuktamatandritam |
kShamasva nachirAdindra tvAmapyupagamiShyati
shlokas.67:
trAsayanniva devendra vAgbhistakShasi mAmiha |
sa.nyate mayi nUnaM tvamAtmAnaM bahu manyase
shlokas.68:
kAlaH prathamamAyAnmAM pashchAttvAmanudhAvati |
tena garjasi devendra pUrvaM kAlahate mayi
shlokas.69:
ko hi sthAtumalaM loke kruddhasya mama sa.nyuge |
kAlastu balavAnprAptastena tiShThasi vAsava
shlokas.70:
yattadvarShasahasrAntaM pUrNaM bhavitumarhati |
yathA me sarvagAtrANi nasvasthAni hataujasaH
shlokas.71:
ahamaindrachchyutaH sthAnAttvamindraH prakRRito divi |
suchitre jIvaloke.asminnupAsyaH kAlaparyayAt
shlokas.72:
kiM hi kRRitvA tvamindro.adya kiM hi kRRitvA chyutA vayam |
kAlaH kartA vikartA cha sarvamanyadakAraNam
shlokas.73:
nAshaM vinAshamaishvaryaM sukhaduHkhe bhavAbhavau |
vidvAnprApyaivamatyarthaM na prahRRiShyenna cha vyathet
shlokas.74:
tvameva hIndra vetthAsmAnvedAhaM tvAM cha vAsava |
vikatthase mAM kiM baddhaM kAlena nirapatrapa
shlokas.75:
tvameva hi purA vettha yattadA pauruShaM mama |
samareShu cha vikrAntaM paryAptaM tannidarshanam
shlokas.76:
AdityAshchaiva rudrAshcha sAdhyAshcha vasubhiH saha |
mayA vinirjitAH sarve marutashcha shachIpate
shlokas.77:
tvameva shakra jAnAsi devAsurasamAgame |
sametA vibudhA bhagnAstarasA samare mayA
shlokas.78:
parvatAshchAsakRRitkShiptAH savanAH savanaukasaH |
saTa~NkashikharA ghorAH samare mUrdhni te mayA
shlokas.79:
kiM nu shakyaM mayA kartuM yatkAlo duratikramaH |
na hi tvAM notsahe hantuM savajramapi muShTinA
shlokas.80:
na tu vikramakAlo.ayaM kShamAkAlo.ayamAgataH |
tena tvA marShaye shakra durmarShaNatarastvayA
shlokas.81:
tvaM mA pariNate kAle parItaM kAlavahninA |
niyataM kAlapAshena baddhaM shakra vikatthase
shlokas.82:
ayaM sa puruShaH shyAmo lokasya duratikramaH |
baddhvA tiShThati mAM raudraH pashuM rashanayA yathA
shlokas.83:
lAbhAlAbhau sukhaM duHkhaM kAmakrodhau bhavAbhavau |
vadho bandhaH pramokShashcha sarvaM kAlena labhyate
shlokas.84:
nAhaM kartA na kartA tvaM kartA yastu sadA prabhuH |
so.ayaM pachati kAlo mAM vRRikShe phalamivAgatam
shlokas.85:
yAnyeva puruShaH kurvansukhaiH kAlena yujyate |
punastAnyeva kurvANo duHkhaiH kAlena yujyate
shlokas.86:
na cha kAlena kAlaj~naH spRRiShTaH shochitumarhati |
tena shakra na shochAmi nAsti shoke sahAyatA
shlokas.87:
yadA hi shochatAM shoko vyasanaM nApakarShati |
sAmarthyaM shochato nAsti nAdya shochAmyahaM tataH
shlokas.88:
evamuktaH sahasrAkSho bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
pratisaMhRRitya sa.nrambhamityuvAcha shatakratuH
shlokas.89:
savajramudyataM bAhuM dRRiShTvA pAshA.nshcha vAruNAn |
kasyeha na vyathedbuddhirmRRityorapi jighA.nsataH
shlokas.90:
sA te na vyathate buddhirachalA tattvadarshinI |
bruvanna vyathase sa tvaM vAkyaM satyaparAkrama
shlokas.91:
ho hi vishvAsamartheShu sharIre vA sharIrabhRRit |
kartumutsahate loke dRRiShTvA samprasthitaM jagat
shlokas.92:
ahamapyevamevainaM lokaM jAnAmyashAshvatam |
kAlAgnAvAhitaM ghore guhye satatage.akShare
shlokas.93:
na chAtra parihAro.asti kAlaspRRiShTasya kasyachit |
sUkShmANAM mahatAM chaiva bhUtAnAM paripachyatAm
shlokas.94:
anIshasyApramattasya bhUtAni pachataH sadA |
anivRRittasya kAlasya kShayaM prApto na muchyate
shlokas.95:
apramattaH pramatteShu kAlo jAgarti dehiShu |
prayatnenApyatikrAnto dRRiShTapUrvo na kenachit
shlokas.96:
purANaH shAshvato dharmaH sarvaprANabhRRitAM samaH |
kAlo na parihAryashcha na chAsyAsti vyatikramaH
shlokas.97:
ahorAtrA.nshcha mAsA.nshcha kShaNAnkAShThAH kalA lavAn |
sampiNDayati naH kAlo vRRiddhiM vArdhuShiko yathA
shlokas.98:
idamadya kariShyAmi shvaH kartAsmIti vAdinam |
kAlo harati samprApto nadIvega ivoDupam
shlokas.99:
idAnIM tAvadevAsau mayA dRRiShTaH kathaM mRRitaH |
iti kAlena hriyatAM pralApaH shrUyate nRRiNAm
shlokas.100:
nashyantyarthAstathA bhogAH sthAnamaishvaryameva cha |
anityamadhruvaM sarvaM vyavasAyo hi duShkaraH
uchChrAyA vinipAtAntA bhAvo.abhAvastha eva cha
shlokas.101:
sA te na vyathate buddhirachalA tattvadarshinI |
ahamAsaM purA cheti manasApi na budhyase
shlokas.102:
kAlenAkramya loke.asminpachyamAne balIyasA |
ajyeShThamakaniShThaM cha kShipyamANo na budhyase
shlokas.103:
IrShyAbhimAnalobheShu kAmakrodhabhayeShu cha |
spRRihAmohAbhimAneShu lokaH sakto vimuhyati
shlokas.104:
bhavA.nstu bhAvatattvaj~no vidvA~nj~nAnataponvitaH |
kAlaM pashyati suvyaktaM pANAvAmalakaM yathA
shlokas.105:
kAlachAritratattvaj~naH sarvashAstravishAradaH |
vairochane kRRitAtmAsi spRRihaNIyo vijAnatAm
shlokas.106:
sarvaloko hyayaM manye buddhyA parigatastvayA |
viharansarvatomukto na kvachitpariShajjase
shlokas.107:
rajashcha hi tamashcha tvA spRRishato na jitendriyam |
niShprItiM naShTasantApaM tvamAtmAnamupAsase
shlokas.108:
suhRRidaM sarvabhUtAnAM nirvairaM shAntamAnasam |
dRRiShTvA tvAM mama sa~njAtA tvayyanukroshinI matiH
shlokas.109:
nAhametAdRRishaM buddhaM hantumichChAmi bandhane |
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmo anukroshastathA tvayi
shlokas.110:
mokShyante vAruNAH pAshAstaveme kAlaparyayAt |
prajAnAmapachAreNa svasti te.astu mahAsura
shlokas.111:
yadA shvashrUM snuShA vRRiddhAM parichAreNa yokShyate |
putrashcha pitaraM mohAtpreShayiShyati karmasu
shlokas.112:
brAhmaNaiH kArayiShyanti vRRiShalAH pAdadhAvanam |
shUdrAshcha brAhmaNIM bhAryAmupayAsyanti nirbhayAH
shlokas.113:
viyoniShu cha bIjAni mokShyante puruShA yadA |
sa~NkaraM kA.nsyabhANDaishcha baliM chApi kupAtrakaiH
shlokas.114:
chAturvarNyaM yadA kRRitsnamunmaryAdaM bhaviShyati |
ekaikaste tadA pAshaH kramashaH pratimokShyate
shlokas.115:
asmattaste bhayaM nAsti samayaM pratipAlaya |
sukhI bhava nirAbAdhaH svasthachetA nirAmayaH
shlokas.116:
tamevamuktvA bhagavA~nshatakratuH; pratiprayAto gajarAjavAhanaH |
vijitya sarvAnasurAnsurAdhipo; nananda harSheNa babhUva chaikarAT
shlokas.117:
maharShayastuShTuvura~njasA cha taM; vRRiShAkapiM sarvacharAchareshvaram |
himApaho havyamudAvaha.nstvaraM;stathAmRRitaM chArpitamIshvarAya ha
shlokas.118:
dvijottamaiH sarvagatairabhiShTuto; vidIptatejA gatamanyurIshvaraH |
prashAntachetA muditaH svamAlayaM; triviShTapaM prApya mumoda vAsavaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pUrvarUpANi me rAjanpuruShasya bhaviShyataH |
parAbhaviShyatashchaiva tvaM me brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mana eva manuShyasya pUrvarUpANi sha.nsati |
bhaviShyatashcha bhadraM te tathaiva nabhaviShyataH
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shriyA shakrasya sa.nvAdaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.4:
mahatastapaso vyuShTyA pashya.Nllokau parAvarau |
sAmAnyamRRiShibhirgatvA brahmalokanivAsibhiH
shlokas.5:
brahmaivAmitadIptaujAH shAntapApmA mahAtapAH |
vichachAra yathAkAmaM triShu lokeShu nAradaH
shlokas.6:
kadAchitprAtarutthAya pispRRikShuH salilaM shuchi |
dhruvadvArabhavAM ga~NgAM jagAmAvatatAra cha
shlokas.7:
sahasranayanashchApi vajrI shambarapAkahA |
tasyA devarShijuShTAyAstIramabhyAjagAma ha
shlokas.8:
tAvAplutya yatAtmAnau kRRitajapyau samAsatuH |
nadyAH pulinamAsAdya sUkShmakA~nchanavAlukam
shlokas.9:
puNyakarmabhirAkhyAtA devarShikathitAH kathAH |
chakratustau kathAshIlau shuchisaMhRRiShTamAnasau
pUrvavRRittavyapetAni kathayantau samAhitau
shlokas.10:
atha bhAskaramudyantaM rashmijAlapuraskRRitam |
pUrNamaNDalamAlokya tAvutthAyopatasthatuH
shlokas.11:
abhitastUdayantaM tamarkamarkamivAparam |
AkAshe dadRRishe jyotirudyatArchiHsamaprabham
shlokas.12:
tayoH samIpaM samprAptaM pratyadRRishyata bhArata |
tatsuparNArkacharitamAsthitaM vaiShNavaM padam
bhAbhirapratimaM bhAti trailokyamavabhAsayat
shlokas.13:
divyAbhirUpashobhAbhirapsarobhiH puraskRRitAm |
bRRihatIma.nshumatprakhyAM bRRihadbhAnorivArchiSham
shlokas.14:
nakShatrakalpAbharaNAM tArAbhaktisamasrajam |
shriyaM dadRRishatuH padmAM sAkShAtpadmatalasthitAm
shlokas.15:
sAvaruhya vimAnAgrAda~NganAnAmanuttamA |
abhyagachChattrilokeshaM shakraM charShiM cha nAradam
shlokas.16:
nAradAnugataH sAkShAnmaghavA.nstAmupAgamat |
kRRitA~njalipuTo devIM nivedyAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.17:
chakre chAnupamAM pUjAM tasyAshchApi sa sarvavit |
devarAjaH shriyaM rAjanvAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.18:
kA tvaM kena cha kAryeNa samprAptA chAruhAsini |
kutashchAgamyate subhru gantavyaM kva cha te shubhe
shlokas.19:
shrIruvAcha||
puNyeShu triShu lokeShu sarve sthAvaraja~NgamAH |
mamAtmabhAvamichChanto yatante paramAtmanA
shlokas.20:
sAhaM vai pa~Nkaje jAtA sUryarashmivibodhite |
bhUtyarthaM sarvabhUtAnAM padmA shrIH padmamAlinI
shlokas.21:
ahaM lakShmIrahaM bhUtiH shrIshchAhaM balasUdana |
ahaM shraddhA cha medhA cha sannatirvijitiH sthitiH
shlokas.22:
ahaM dhRRitirahaM siddhirahaM tviDbhUtireva cha |
ahaM svAhA svadhA chaiva sa.nstutirniyatiH kRRitiH
shlokas.23:
rAj~nAM vijayamAnAnAM senAgreShu dhvajeShu cha |
nivAse dharmashIlAnAM viShayeShu pureShu cha
shlokas.24:
jitakAshini shUre cha sa~NgrAmeShvanivartini |
nivasAmi manuShyendre sadaiva balasUdana
shlokas.25:
dharmanitye mahAbuddhau brahmaNye satyavAdini |
prashrite dAnashIle cha sadaiva nivasAmyaham
shlokas.26:
asureShvavasaM pUrvaM satyadharmanibandhanA |
viparItA.nstu tAnbuddhvA tvayi vAsamarochayam
shlokas.27:
shakra uvAcha||
katha.nvRRitteShu daityeShu tvamavAtsIrvarAnane |
dRRiShTvA cha kimihAgAstvaM hitvA daiteyadAnavAn
shlokas.28:
shrIruvAcha||
svadharmamanutiShThatsu dhairyAdachaliteShu cha |
svargamArgAbhirAmeShu sattveShu niratA hyaham
shlokas.29:
dAnAdhyayanayaj~nejyA gurudaivatapUjanam |
viprANAmatithInAM cha teShAM nityamavartata
shlokas.30:
susaMmRRiShTagRRihAshchAsa~njitastrIkA hutAgnayaH |
gurushushrUShavo dAntA brahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.31:
shraddadhAnA jitakrodhA dAnashIlAnasUyakAH |
bhRRitaputrA bhRRitAmAtyA bhRRitadArA hyanIrShavaH
shlokas.32:
amarShaNA na chAnyonyaM spRRihayanti kadAchana |
na cha jAtUpatapyante dhIrAH parasamRRiddhibhiH
shlokas.33:
dAtAraH sa~NgRRihItAra AryAH karuNavedinaH |
mahAprasAdA RRijavo dRRiDhabhaktA jitendriyAH
shlokas.34:
santuShTabhRRityasachivAH kRRitaj~nAH priyavAdinaH |
yathArthamAnArthakarA hrIniShedhA yatavratAH
shlokas.35:
nityaM parvasu susnAtAH svanuliptAH svala~NkRRitAH |
upavAsatapaHshIlAH pratItA brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.36:
nainAnabhyudiyAtsUryo na chApyAsanpragenishAH |
rAtrau dadhi cha saktU.nshcha nityameva vyavarjayan
shlokas.37:
kAlyaM ghRRitaM chAnvavekShanprayatA brahmachAriNaH |
ma~NgalAnapi chApashyanbrAhmaNA.nshchApyapUjayan
shlokas.38:
sadA hi dadatAM dharmaH sadA chApratigRRihNatAm |
ardhaM cha rAtryAH svapatAM divA chAsvapatAM tathA
shlokas.39:
kRRipaNAnAthavRRiddhAnAM durbalAturayoShitAm |
dAyaM cha sa.nvibhAgaM cha nityamevAnumodatAm
shlokas.40:
viShaNNaM trastamudvignaM bhayArtaM vyAdhipIDitam |
hRRitasvaM vyasanArtaM cha nityamAshvAsayanti te
shlokas.41:
dharmamevAnvavartanta na hi.nsanti parasparam |
anukUlAshcha kAryeShu guruvRRiddhopasevinaH
shlokas.42:
pitRRidevAtithI.nshchaiva yathAvatte.abhyapUjayan |
avasheShANi chAshnanti nityaM satyataporatAH
shlokas.43:
naike.ashnanti susampannaM na gachChanti parastriyam |
sarvabhUteShvavartanta yathAtmani dayAM prati
shlokas.44:
naivAkAshe na pashuShu nAyonau na cha parvasu |
indriyasya visargaM te.arochayanta kadAchana
shlokas.45:
nityaM dAnaM tathA dAkShyamArjavaM chaiva nityadA |
utsAhashchAnaha~NkAraH paramaM sauhRRidaM kShamA
shlokas.46:
satyaM dAnaM tapaH shauchaM kAruNyaM vAganiShThurA |
mitreShu chAnabhidrohaH sarvaM teShvabhavatprabho
shlokas.47:
nidrA tandrIrasamprItirasUyA chAnavekShitA |
aratishcha viShAdashcha na spRRihA chAvishanta tAn
shlokas.48:
sAhameva~NguNeShveva dAnaveShvavasaM purA |
prajAsargamupAdAya naikaM yugaviparyayam
shlokas.49:
tataH kAlaviparyAse teShAM guNaviparyayAt |
apashyaM vigataM dharmaM kAmakrodhavashAtmanAm
shlokas.50:
sabhAsadAM te vRRiddhAnAM satyAH kathayatAM kathAH |
prAhasannabhyasUya.nshcha sarvavRRiddhAnguNAvarAH
shlokas.51:
yUnaH sahasamAsInAnvRRiddhAnabhigatAnsataH |
nAbhyutthAnAbhivAdAbhyAM yathApUrvamapUjayan
shlokas.52:
vartayantyeva pitari putrAH prabhavatA.a.atmanaH |
amitrabhRRityatAM prApya khyApayanto.anapatrapAH
shlokas.53:
tathA dharmAdapetena karmaNA garhitena ye |
mahataH prApnuvantyarthA.nsteShveShAmabhavatspRRihA
shlokas.54:
uchChaishchApyavadanrAtrau nIchaistatrAgnirajvalat |
putrAH pitR^InabhyavadanbhAryAshchAbhyavadanpatIn
shlokas.55:
mAtaraM pitaraM vRRiddhamAchAryamatithiM gurum |
guruvannAbhyanandanta kumArAnnAnvapAlayan
shlokas.56:
bhikShAM balimadattvA cha svayamannAni bhu~njate |
aniShTvA sa.nvibhajyAtha pitRRidevAtithIngurUn
shlokas.57:
na shauchamanurudhyanta teShAM sUdajanAstathA |
manasA karmaNA vAchA bhaktamAsIdanAvRRitam
shlokas.58:
viprakIrNAni dhAnyAni kAkamUShakabhojanam |
apAvRRitaM payo.atiShThaduchChiShTAshchAspRRishanghRRitam
shlokas.59:
kuddAlapATIpiTakaM prakIrNaM kA.nsyabhAjanam |
dravyopakaraNaM sarvaM nAnvavaikShatkuTumbinI
shlokas.60:
prAkArAgAravidhva.nsAnna sma te pratikurvate |
nAdriyante pashUnbaddhvA yavasenodakena cha
shlokas.61:
bAlAnAM prekShamANAnAM svayaM bhakShAnabhakShayan |
tathA bhRRityajanaM sarvaM paryashnanti cha dAnavAH
shlokas.62:
pAyasaM kRRisaraM mA.nsamapUpAnatha shaShkulIH |
apAchayannAtmano.arthe vRRithAmA.nsAnyabhakShayan
shlokas.63:
utsUryashAyinashchAsansarve chAsanpragenishAH |
avartankalahAshchAtra divArAtraM gRRihe gRRihe
shlokas.64:
anAryAshchAryamAsInaM paryupAsanna tatra ha |
AshramasthAnvikarmasthAH pradviShanti parasparam
sa~NkarAshchApyavartanta na cha shauchamavartata
shlokas.65:
ye cha vedavido viprA vispaShTamanRRichashcha ye |
nirantaravisheShAste bahumAnAvamAnayoH
shlokas.66:
hAvamAbharaNaM veShaM gatiM sthitimavekShitum |
asevanta bhujiShyA vai durjanAcharitaM vidhim
shlokas.67:
striyaH puruShaveSheNa pu.nsaH strIveShadhAriNaH |
krIDArativihAreShu parAM mudamavApnuvan
shlokas.68:
prabhavadbhiH purA dAyAnarhebhyaH pratipAditAn |
nAbhyavartanta nAstikyAdvartantaH sambhaveShvapi
shlokas.69:
mitreNAbhyarthitaM mitramarthe sa.nshayite kvachit |
vAlakoTyagramAtreNa svArthenAghnata tadvasu
shlokas.70:
parasvAdAnaruchayo vipaNyavyavahAriNaH |
adRRishyantAryavarNeShu shUdrAshchApi tapodhanAH
shlokas.71:
adhIyante.avratAH kechidvRRithAvratamathApare |
ashushrUShurguroH shiShyaH kashchichChiShyasakho guruH
shlokas.72:
pitA chaiva janitrI cha shrAntau vRRittotsavAviva |
aprabhutve sthitau vRRiddhAvannaM prArthayataH sutAn
shlokas.73:
tatra vedavidaH prAj~nA gAmbhIrye sAgaropamAH |
kRRiShyAdiShvabhavansaktA mUrkhAH shrAddhAnyabhu~njata
shlokas.74:
prAtaH prAtashcha suprashnaM kalpanaM preShaNakriyAH |
shiShyAnuprahitAstasminnakurvanguravashcha ha
shlokas.75:
shvashrUshvashurayoragre vadhUH preShyAnashAsata |
anvashAsachcha bhartAraM samAhUyAbhijalpatI
shlokas.76:
prayatnenApi chArakShachchittaM putrasya vai pitA |
vyabhaja.nshchApi sa.nrambhAdduHkhavAsaM tathAvasan
shlokas.77:
agnidAhena chorairvA rAjabhirvA hRRitaM dhanam |
dRRiShTvA dveShAtprAhasanta suhRRitsambhAvitA hyapi
shlokas.78:
kRRitaghnA nAstikAH pApA gurudArAbhimarshinaH |
abhakShyabhakShaNaratA nirmaryAdA hatatviShaH
shlokas.79:
teShvevamAdInAchArAnAcharatsu viparyaye |
nAhaM devendra vatsyAmi dAnaveShviti me matiH
shlokas.80:
tAM mAM svayamanuprAptAmabhinanda shachIpate |
tvayArchitAM mAM devesha purodhAsyanti devatAH
shlokas.81:
yatrAhaM tatra matkAntA madvishiShTA madarpaNAH |
sapta devyo mayAShTamyo vAsaM cheShyanti me.aShTadhA
shlokas.82:
AshA shraddhA dhRRitiH kAntirvijitiH sannatiH kShamA |
aShTamI vRRittiretAsAM purogA pAkashAsana
shlokas.83:
tAshchAhaM chAsurA.nstyaktvA yuShmadviShayamAgatA |
tridasheShu nivatsyAmo dharmaniShThAntarAtmasu
shlokas.84:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktavachanAM devImatyarthaM tau nanandatuH |
nAradashcha trilokarShirvRRitrahantA cha vAsavaH
shlokas.85:
tato.analasakho vAyuH pravavau devaveshmasu |
iShTagandhaH sukhasparshaH sarvendriyasukhAvahaH
shlokas.86:
shuchau chAbhyarchite deshe tridashAH prAyashaH sthitAH |
lakShmyA sahitamAsInaM maghavantaM didRRikShavaH
shlokas.87:
tato divaM prApya sahasralochanaH; shriyopapannaH suhRRidA surarShiNA |
rathena haryashvayujA surarShabhaH; sadaH surANAmabhisatkRRito yayau
shlokas.88:
athe~NgitaM vajradharasya nAradaH; shriyAshcha devyA manasA vichArayan |
shriyai shasha.nsAmaradRRiShTapauruShaH; shivena tatrAgamanaM maharddhimat
shlokas.89:
tato.amRRitaM dyauH pravavarSha bhAsvatI; pitAmahasyAyatane svayambhuvaH |
anAhatA dundubhayashcha nedire; tathA prasannAshcha dishashchakAshire
shlokas.90:
yathartu sasyeShu vavarSha vAsavo; na dharmamArgAdvichachAla kashchana |
anekaratnAkarabhUShaNA cha bhUH; sughoShaghoShA bhuvanaukasAM jaye
shlokas.91:
kriyAbhirAmA manujA yashasvino; babhuH shubhe puNyakRRitAM pathi sthitAH |
narAmarAH kiMnarayakSharAkShasAH; samRRiddhimantaH sukhino yashasvinaH
shlokas.92:
na jAtvakAle kusumaM kutaH phalaM; papAta vRRikShAtpavaneritAdapi |
rasapradAH kAmadughAshcha dhenavo; na dAruNA vAgvichachAra kasyachit
shlokas.93:
imAM saparyAM saha sarvakAmadaiH; shriyAshcha shakrapramukhaishcha daivataiH |
paThanti ye viprasadaH samAgame; samRRiddhakAmAH shriyamApnuvanti te
shlokas.94:
tvayA kurUNAM vara yatprachoditaM; bhavAbhavasyeha paraM nidarshanam |
tadadya sarvaM parikIrtitaM mayA; parIkShya tattvaM parigantumarhasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ki.nshIlaH ki.nsamAchAraH ki.nvidyaH kimparAyaNaH |
prApnoti brahmaNaH sthAnaM yatparaM prakRRiterdhruvam
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mokShadharmeShu niyato laghvAhAro jitendriyaH |
prApnoti brahmaNaH sthAnaM yatparaM prakRRiterdhruvam
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
jaigIShavyasya sa.nvAdamasitasya cha bhArata
shlokas.4:
jaigIShavyaM mahAprAj~naM dharmANAmAgatAgamam |
akrudhyantamahRRiShyantamasito devalo.abravIt
shlokas.5:
na prIyase vandyamAno nindyamAno na kupyasi |
kA te praj~nA kutashchaiShA kiM chaitasyAH parAyaNam
shlokas.6:
iti tenAnuyuktaH sa tamuvAcha mahAtapAH |
mahadvAkyamasa.ndigdhaM puShkalArthapadaM shuchi
shlokas.7:
yA gatiryA parA niShThA yA shAntiH puNyakarmaNAm |
tAM te.ahaM sampravakShyAmi yanmAM pRRichChasi vai dvija
shlokas.8:
nindatsu cha samo nityaM prasha.nsatsu cha devala |
nihnuvanti cha ye teShAM samayaM sukRRitaM cha ye
shlokas.9:
uktAshcha na vivakShanti vaktAramahite ratam |
pratihantuM na chechChanti hantAraM vai manIShiNaH
shlokas.10:
nAprAptamanushochanti prAptakAlAni kurvate |
na chAtItAni shochanti na chainAnpratijAnate
shlokas.11:
samprAptAnAM cha pUjyAnAM kAmAdartheShu devala |
yathopapattiM kurvanti shaktimantaH kRRitavratAH
shlokas.12:
pakvavidyA mahAprAj~nA jitakrodhA jitendriyAH |
manasA karmaNA vAchA nAparAdhyanti kasyachit
shlokas.13:
anIrShavo na chAnyonyaM vihi.nsanti kadAchana |
na cha jAtUpatapyante dhIrAH parasamRRiddhibhiH
shlokas.14:
nindAprasha.nse chAtyarthaM na vadanti parasya ye |
na cha nindAprasha.nsAbhyAM vikriyante kadAchana
shlokas.15:
sarvatashcha prashAntA ye sarvabhUtahite ratAH |
na krudhyanti na hRRiShyanti nAparAdhyanti kasyachit
vimuchya hRRidayagranthI.nshcha~Nkamyante yathAsukham
shlokas.16:
na yeShAM bAndhavAH santi ye chAnyeShAM na bAndhavAH |
amitrAshcha na santyeShAM ye chAmitrA na kasyachit
shlokas.17:
ya evaM kurvate martyAH sukhaM jIvanti sarvadA |
dharmamevAnuvartante dharmaj~nA dvijasattama
ye hyato vichyutA mArgAtte hRRiShyantyudvijanti cha
shlokas.18:
AsthitastamahaM mArgamasUyiShyAmi kaM katham |
nindyamAnaH prashasto vA hRRiShyeyaM kena hetunA
shlokas.19:
yadyadichChanti tanmArgamabhigachChanti mAnavAH |
na me nindAprasha.nsAbhyAM hrAsavRRiddhI bhaviShyataH
shlokas.20:
amRRitasyeva santRRipyedavamAnasya tattvavit |
viShasyevodvijennityaM saMmAnasya vichakShaNaH
shlokas.21:
avaj~nAtaH sukhaM shete iha chAmutra chobhayoH |
vimuktaH sarvapApebhyo yo.avamantA sa badhyate
shlokas.22:
parAM gatiM cha ye kechitprArthayanti manIShiNaH |
etadvrataM samAshritya sukhamedhanti te janAH
shlokas.23:
sarvatashcha samAhRRitya kratUnsarvA~njitendriyaH |
prApnoti brahmaNaH sthAnaM yatparaM prakRRiterdhruvam
shlokas.24:
nAsya devA na gandharvA na pishAchA na rAkShasAH |
padamanvavarohanti prAptasya paramAM gatim

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
priyaH sarvasya lokasya sarvasattvAbhinanditA |
guNaiH sarvairupetashcha ko nvasti bhuvi mAnavaH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi pRRichChato bharatarShabha |
ugrasenasya sa.nvAdaM nArade keshavasya cha
shlokas.3:
ugrasena uvAcha||
pashya sa~Nkalpate loko nAradasya prakIrtane |
manye sa guNasampanno brUhi tanmama pRRichChataH
shlokas.4:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
kukurAdhipa yAnmanye shRRiNu tAnme vivakShataH |
nAradasya guNAnsAdhUnsa~NkShepeNa narAdhipa
shlokas.5:
na chAritranimitto.asyAha~NkAro dehapAtanaH |
abhinnashrutachAritrastasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.6:
tapasvI nArado bADhaM vAchi nAsya vyatikramaH |
kAmAdvA yadi vA lobhAttasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.7:
adhyAtmavidhitattvaj~naH kShAntaH shakto jitendriyaH |
RRijushcha satyavAdI cha tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.8:
tejasA yashasA buddhyA nayena vinayena cha |
janmanA tapasA vRRiddhastasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.9:
sukhashIlaH susambhogaH subhojyaH svAdaraH shuchiH |
suvAkyashchApyanIrShyashcha tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.10:
kalyAnaM kurute bADhaM pApamasminna vidyate |
na prIyate parAnarthaistasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.11:
vedashrutibhirAkhyAnairarthAnabhijigIShate |
titikShuranavaj~nashcha tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.12:
samatvAddhi priyo nAsti nApriyashcha katha~nchana |
manonukUlavAdI cha tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.13:
bahushrutashchaitrakathaH paNDito.analaso.ashaThaH |
adIno.akrodhano.alubdhastasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.14:
nArthe na dharme kAme vA bhUtapUrvo.asya vigrahaH |
doShAshchAsya samuchChinnAstasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.15:
dRRiDhabhaktiranindyAtmA shrutavAnanRRisha.nsavAn |
vItasaMmohadoShashcha tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.16:
asaktaH sarvasa~NgeShu saktAtmeva cha lakShyate |
adIrghasa.nshayo vAgmI tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.17:
samAdhirnAsya mAnArthe nAtmAnaM stauti karhichit |
anIrShyurdRRiDhasambhAShastasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.18:
lokasya vividhaM vRRittaM prakRRiteshchApyakutsayan |
sa.nsargavidyAkushalastasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.19:
nAsUyatyAgamaM ka~nchitsvaM tapo nopajIvati |
avandhyakAlo vashyAtmA tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.20:
kRRitashramaH kRRitapraj~no na cha tRRiptaH samAdhitaH |
niyamastho.apramattashcha tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.21:
sApatrapashcha yuktashcha suneyaH shreyase paraiH |
abhettA paraguhyAnAM tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.22:
na hRRiShyatyarthalAbheShu nAlAbheShu vyathatyapi |
sthirabuddhirasaktAtmA tasmAtsarvatra pUjitaH
shlokas.23:
taM sarvaguNasampannaM dakShaM shuchimakAtaram |
kAlaj~naM cha nayaj~naM cha kaH priyaM na kariShyati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AdyantaM sarvabhUtAnAM shrotumichChAmi kaurava |
dhyAnaM karma cha kAlaM cha tathaivAyuryuge yuge
shlokas.2:
lokatattvaM cha kArtsnyena bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim |
sargashcha nidhanaM chaiva kuta etatpravartate
shlokas.3:
yadi te.anugrahe buddhirasmAsviha satAM vara |
etadbhavantaM pRRichChAmi tadbhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.4:
pUrvaM hi kathitaM shrutvA bhRRigubhAShitamuttamam |
bharadvAjasya viprarShestato me buddhiruttamA
shlokas.5:
jAtA paramadharmiShThA divyasa.nsthAnasa.nsthitA |
tato bhUyastu pRRichChAmi tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShye.ahamitihAsaM purAtanam |
jagau yadbhagavAnvyAsaH putrAya paripRRichChate
shlokas.7:
adhItya vedAnakhilAnsA~NgopaniShadastathA |
anvichChannaiShThikaM karma dharmanaipuNadarshanAt
shlokas.8:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM vyAsaM putro vaiyAsakiH shukaH |
paprachCha sa.ndehamimaM ChinnadharmArthasa.nshayam
shlokas.9:
bhUtagrAmasya kartAraM kAlaj~nAne cha nishchayam |
brAhmaNasya cha yatkRRityaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.10:
tasmai provAcha tatsarvaM pitA putrAya pRRichChate |
atItAnAgate vidvAnsarvaj~naH sarvadharmavit
shlokas.11:
anAdyantamajaM divyamajaraM dhruvamavyayam |
apratarkyamavij~neyaM brahmAgre samavartata
shlokas.12:
kAShThA nimeShA dasha pa~ncha chaiva; tri.nshattu kAShThA gaNayetkalAM tAm |
tri.nshatkalAshchApi bhavenmuhUrto; bhAgaH kalAyA dashamashcha yaH syAt
shlokas.13:
tri.nshanmuhUrtashcha bhavedahashcha; rAtrishcha sa~NkhyA munibhiH praNItA |
mAsaH smRRito rAtryahanI cha tri.nsha;tsa.nvatsaro dvAdashamAsa uktaH
sa.nvatsaraM dve ayane vadanti; sa~NkhyAvido dakShiNamuttaraM cha
shlokas.14:
ahorAtre vibhajate sUryo mAnuShalaukike |
rAtriH svapnAya bhUtAnAM cheShTAyai karmaNAmahaH
shlokas.15:
pitrye rAtryahanI mAsaH pravibhAgastayoH punaH |
kRRiShNo.ahaH karmacheShTAyAM shuklaH svapnAya sharvarI
shlokas.16:
daive rAtryahanI varShaM pravibhAgastayoH punaH |
ahastatrodagayanaM rAtriH syAddakShiNAyanam
shlokas.17:
ye te rAtryahanI pUrve kIrtite daivalaukike |
tayoH sa~NkhyAya varShAgraM brAhme vakShyAmyahaHkShape
shlokas.18:
teShAM sa.nvatsarAgrANi pravakShyAmyanupUrvashaH |
kRRite tretAyuge chaiva dvApare cha kalau tathA
shlokas.19:
chatvAryAhuH sahasrANi varShANAM tatkRRitaM yugam |
tasya tAvachChatI sandhyA sandhyA.nshashcha tathAvidhaH
shlokas.20:
itareShu sasandhyeShu sasandhyA.nsheShu cha triShu |
ekApAyena sa.nyAnti sahasrANi shatAni cha
shlokas.21:
etAni shAshvatA.NllokAndhArayanti sanAtanAn |
etadbrahmavidAM tAta viditaM brahma shAshvatam
shlokas.22:
chatuShpAtsakalo dharmaH satyaM chaiva kRRite yuge |
nAdharmeNAgamaH kashchitparastasya pravartate
shlokas.23:
itareShvAgamAddharmaH pAdashastvavaropyate |
chaurikAnRRitamAyAbhiradharmashchopachIyate
shlokas.24:
arogAH sarvasiddhArthAshchaturvarShashatAyuShaH |
kRRite tretAdiShveteShAM pAdasho hrasate vayaH
shlokas.25:
vedavAdAshchAnuyugaM hrasantIti cha naH shrutam |
AyUMShi chAshiShashchaiva vedasyaiva cha yatphalam
shlokas.26:
anye kRRitayuge dharmAstretAyAM dvApare.apare |
anye kaliyuge dharmA yathAshaktikRRitA iva
shlokas.27:
tapaH paraM kRRitayuge tretAyAM j~nAnamuttamam |
dvApare yaj~namevAhurdAnameva kalau yuge
shlokas.28:
etAM dvAdashasAhasrIM yugAkhyAM kavayo viduH |
sahasraM parivRRittaM tadbrAhmaM divasamuchyate
shlokas.29:
rAtristAvattithI brAhmI tadAdau vishvamIshvaraH |
pralaye.adhyAtmamAvishya suptvA so.ante vibudhyate
shlokas.30:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaNo viduH |
rAtriM yugasahasrAntAM te.ahorAtravido janAH
shlokas.31:
pratibuddho vikurute brahmAkShayyaM kShapAkShaye |
sRRijate cha mahadbhUtaM tasmAdvyaktAtmakaM manaH
shlokas.32:
brahma tejomayaM shukraM yasya sarvamidaM jagat |
ekasya bhUtaM bhUtasya dvayaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.33:
aharmukhe vibuddhaH sansRRijate vidyayA jagat |
agra eva mahAbhUtamAshu vyaktAtmakaM manaH
shlokas.34:
abhibhUyeha chArchiShmadvyasRRijatsapta mAnasAn |
dUragaM bahudhAgAmi prArthanAsa.nshayAtmakam
shlokas.35:
manaH sRRiShTiM vikurute chodyamAnaM sisRRikShayA |
AkAshaM jAyate tasmAttasya shabdo guNo mataH
shlokas.36:
AkAshAttu vikurvANAtsarvagandhavahaH shuchiH |
balavA~njAyate vAyustasya sparsho guNo mataH
shlokas.37:
vAyorapi vikurvANAjjyotirbhUtaM tamonudam |
rochiShNu jAyate tatra tadrUpaguNamuchyate
shlokas.38:
jyotiSho.api vikurvANAdbhavantyApo rasAtmikAH |
adbhyo gandhaguNA bhUmiH pUrvaiShA sRRiShTiruchyate
shlokas.39:
guNAH pUrvasya pUrvasya prApnuvantyuttarottaram |
teShAM yAvattithaM yadyattattattAvadguNaM smRRitam
shlokas.40:
upalabhyApsu chedgandhaM kechidbrUyuranaipuNAt |
pRRithivyAmeva taM vidyAdApo vAyuM cha sa.nshritam
shlokas.41:
ete tu sapta puruShA nAnAviryAH pRRithakpRRithak |
nAshaknuvanprajAH sraShTumasamAgamya sarvataH
shlokas.42:
te sametya mahAtmAnamanyonyamabhisa.nshritAH |
sharIrAshrayaNaM prAptAstataH puruSha uchyate
shlokas.43:
shrayaNAchCharIraM bhavati mUrtimatShoDashAtmakam |
tadAvishanti bhUtAni mahAnti saha karmaNA
shlokas.44:
sarvabhUtAni chAdAya tapasashcharaNAya cha |
AdikartA mahAbhUtaM tamevAhuH prajApatim
shlokas.45:
sa vai sRRijati bhUtAni sa eva puruShaH paraH |
ajo janayate brahmA devarShipitRRimAnavAn
shlokas.46:
lokAnnadIH samudrA.nshcha dishaH shailAnvanaspatIn |
narakiMnararakShA.nsi vayaHpashumRRigoragAn
avyayaM cha vyayaM chaiva dvayaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.47:
teShAM ye yAni karmANi prAksRRiShTyAM pratipedire |
tAnyeva pratipadyante sRRijyamAnAH punaH punaH
shlokas.48:
hi.nsrAhi.nsre mRRidukrUre dharmAdharme RRitAnRRite |
ato yanmanyate dhAtA tasmAttattasya rochate
shlokas.49:
mahAbhUteShu nAnAtvamindriyArtheShu mUrtiShu |
viniyogaM cha bhUtAnAM dhAtaiva vidadhAtyuta
shlokas.50:
kechitpuruShakAraM tu prAhuH karmavido janAH |
daivamityapare viprAH svabhAvaM bhUtachintakAH
shlokas.51:
pauruShaM karma daivaM cha phalavRRittisvabhAvataH |
traya ete.apRRithagbhUtA navivekaM tu kechana
shlokas.52:
evametachcha naivaM cha yadbhUtaM sRRijate jagat |
karmasthA viShamaM brUyuH sattvasthAH samadarshinaH
shlokas.53:
tapo niHshreyasaM jantostasya mUlaM damaH shamaH |
tena sarvAnavApnoti yAnkAmAnmanasechChati
shlokas.54:
tapasA tadavApnoti yadbhUtaM sRRijate jagat |
sa tadbhUtashcha sarveShAM bhUtAnAM bhavati prabhuH
shlokas.55:
RRiShayastapasA vedAnadhyaiShanta divAnisham |
anAdinidhanA nityA vAgutsRRiShTA svayambhuvA
shlokas.56:
RRiShINAM nAmadheyAni yAshcha vedeShu sRRiShTayaH |
sharvaryanteShu jAtAnAM tAnyevaibhyo dadAti saH
shlokas.57:
nAmabhedastapaHkarmayaj~nAkhyA lokasiddhayaH |
Atmasiddhistu vedeShu prochyate dashabhiH kramaiH
shlokas.58:
yaduktaM vedavAdeShu gahanaM vedadRRiShTibhiH |
tadanteShu yathAyuktaM kramayogena lakShyate
shlokas.59:
karmajo.ayaM pRRithagbhAvo dva.ndvayukto viyoginaH |
Atmasiddhistu vij~nAtA jahAti prAyasho balam
shlokas.60:
dve brahmaNI veditavye shabdabrahma paraM cha yat |
shabdabrahmaNi niShNAtaH paraM brahmAdhigachChati
shlokas.61:
Arambhayaj~nAH kShatrasya haviryaj~nA vishastathA |
parichArayaj~nAH shUdrAstu tapoyaj~nA dvijAtayaH
shlokas.62:
tretAyuge vidhistveShAM yaj~nAnAM na kRRite yuge |
dvApare viplavaM yAnti yaj~nAH kaliyuge tathA
shlokas.63:
apRRithagdharmiNo martyA RRiksAmAni yajUMShi cha |
kAmyAM puShTiM pRRithagdRRiShTvA tapobhistapa eva cha
shlokas.64:
tretAyAM tu samastAste prAdurAsanmahAbalAH |
sa.nyantAraH sthAvarANAM ja~NgamAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.65:
tretAyAM saMhatA hyete yaj~nA varNAstathaiva cha |
sa.nrodhAdAyuShastvete vyasyante dvApare yuge
shlokas.66:
dRRishyante nApi dRRishyante vedAH kaliyuge.akhilAH |
utsIdante sayaj~nAshcha kevalA dharmasetavaH
shlokas.67:
kRRite yuge yastu dharmo brAhmaNeShu pradRRishyate |
Atmavatsu tapovatsu shrutavatsu pratiShThitaH
shlokas.68:
adharmavratasa.nyogaM yathAdharmaM yuge yuge |
vikriyante svadharmasthA vedavAdA yathAyugam
shlokas.69:
yathA vishvAni bhUtAni vRRiShTyA bhUyA.nsi prAvRRiShi |
sRRijyante ja~NgamasthAni tathA dharmA yuge yuge
shlokas.70:
yathartuShvRRituli~NgAni nAnArUpANi paryaye |
dRRishyante tAni tAnyeva tathA brahmAharAtriShu
shlokas.71:
vihitaM kAlanAnAtvamanAdinidhanaM tathA |
kIrtitaM yatpurastAtte tatsUte chAtti cha prajAH
shlokas.72:
dadhAti prabhave sthAnaM bhUtAnAM sa.nyamo yamaH |
svabhAvenaiva vartante dva.ndvayuktAni bhUrishaH
shlokas.73:
sargaH kAlaH kriyA vedAH kartA kAryaM kriyA phalam |
proktaM te putra sarvaM vai yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.74:
pratyAhAraM tu vakShyAmi sharvaryAdau gate.ahani |
yathedaM kurute.adhyAtmaM susUkShmaM vishvamIshvaraH
shlokas.75:
divi sUryAstathA sapta dahanti shikhino.archiShA |
sarvametattadArchirbhiH pUrNaM jAjvalyate jagat

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
pRRithivyAM yAni bhUtAni ja~NgamAni dhruvANi cha |
tAnyevAgre pralIyante bhUmitvamupayAnti cha
shlokas.2:
tataH pralIne sarvasminsthAvare ja~Ngame tathA |
akAShThA nistRRiNA bhUmirdRRishyate kUrmapRRiShThavat
shlokas.3:
bhUmerapi guNaM gandhamApa Adadate yadA |
AttagandhA tadA bhUmiH pralayatvAya kalpate
shlokas.4:
ApastataH pratiShThanti Urmimatyo mahAsvanAH |
sarvamevedamApUrya tiShThanti cha charanti cha
shlokas.5:
apAmapi guNA.nstAta jyotirAdadate yadA |
ApastadA AttaguNA jyotiShyuparamanti cha
shlokas.6:
yadAdityaM sthitaM madhye gUhanti shikhino.archiShaH |
sarvamevedamarchirbhiH pUrNaM jAjvalyate nabhaH
shlokas.7:
jyotiSho.api guNaM rUpaM vAyurAdadate yadA |
prashAmyati tadA jyotirvAyurdodhUyate mahAn
shlokas.8:
tatastu mUlamAsAdya vAyuH sambhavamAtmanaH |
adhashchordhvaM cha tiryakcha dodhavIti disho dasha
shlokas.9:
vAyorapi guNaM sparshamAkAshaM grasate yadA |
prashAmyati tadA vAyuH khaM tu tiShThati nAnadat
shlokas.10:
AkAshasya guNaM shabdamabhivyaktAtmakaM manaH |
manaso vyaktamavyaktaM brAhmaH sa pratisa~ncharaH
shlokas.11:
tadAtmaguNamAvishya mano grasati chandramAH |
manasyuparate.adhyAtmA chandramasyavatiShThate
shlokas.12:
taM tu kAlena mahatA sa~NkalpaH kurute vashe |
chittaM grasati sa~Nkalpastachcha j~nAnamanuttamam
shlokas.13:
kAlo girati vij~nAnaM kAlo balamiti shrutiH |
balaM kAlo grasati tu taM vidvAnkurute vashe
shlokas.14:
AkAshasya tadA ghoShaM taM vidvAnkurute.a.atmani |
tadavyaktaM paraM brahma tachChAshvatamanuttamam
evaM sarvANi bhUtAni brahmaiva pratisa~ncharaH
shlokas.15:
yathAvatkIrtitaM samyagevametadasa.nshayam |
bodhyaM vidyAmayaM dRRiShTvA yogibhiH paramAtmabhiH
shlokas.16:
evaM vistArasa~NkShepau brahmAvyakte punaH punaH |
yugasAhasrayorAdAvahno rAtryAstathaiva cha

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
bhUtagrAme niyuktaM yattadetatkIrtitaM mayA |
brAhmaNasya tu yatkRRityaM tatte vakShyAmi pRRichChate
shlokas.2:
jAtakarmaprabhRRityasya karmaNAM dakShiNAvatAm |
kriyA syAdA samAvRRitterAchArye vedapArage
shlokas.3:
adhItya vedAnakhilAngurushushrUShaNe rataH |
gurUNAmanRRiNo bhUtvA samAvarteta yaj~navit
shlokas.4:
AchAryeNAbhyanuj~nAtashchaturNAmekamAshramam |
A vimokShAchCharIrasya so.anutiShThedyathAvidhi
shlokas.5:
prajAsargeNa dAraishcha brahmacharyeNa vA punaH |
vane gurusakAshe vA yatidharmeNa vA punaH
shlokas.6:
gRRihasthastveva sarveShAM chaturNAM mUlamuchyate |
tatra pakvakaShAyo hi dAntaH sarvatra sidhyati
shlokas.7:
prajAvA~nshrotriyo yajvA mukto divyaistribhirRRiNaiH |
athAnyAnAshramAnpashchAtpUto gachChati karmabhiH
shlokas.8:
yatpRRithivyAM puNyatamaM vidyAsthAnaM tadAvaset |
yateta tasminprAmANyaM gantuM yashasi chottame
shlokas.9:
tapasA vA sumahatA vidyAnAM pAraNena vA |
ijyayA vA pradAnairvA viprANAM vardhate yashaH
shlokas.10:
yAvadasya bhavatyasmi.Nlloke kIrtiryashaskarI |
tAvatpuNyakRRitA.NllokAnanantAnpuruSho.ashnute
shlokas.11:
adhyApayedadhIyIta yAjayeta yajeta cha |
na vRRithA pratigRRihNIyAnna cha dadyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.12:
yAjyataH shiShyato vApi kanyayA vA dhanaM mahat |
yadyAgachChedyajeddadyAnnaiko.ashnIyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.13:
gRRihamAvasato hyasya nAnyattIrthaM pratigrahAt |
devarShipitRRigurvarthaM vRRiddhAturabubhukShatAm
shlokas.14:
antarhitAbhitaptAnAM yathAshakti bubhUShatAm |
dravyANAmatishaktyApi deyameShAM kRRitAdapi
shlokas.15:
arhatAmanurUpANAM nAdeyaM hyasti ki~nchana |
uchchaiHshravasamapyashvaM prApaNIyaM satAM viduH
shlokas.16:
anunIya tathA kAvyaH satyasandho mahAvrataH |
svaiH prANairbrAhmaNaprANAnparitrAya divaM gataH
shlokas.17:
rantidevashcha sA~NkRRityo vasiShThAya mahAtmane |
apaH pradAya shItoShNA nAkapRRiShThe mahIyate
shlokas.18:
AtreyashchandradamayorarhatorvividhaM dhanam |
dattvA lokAnyayau dhImAnanantAnsa mahIpatiH
shlokas.19:
shibiraushInaro.a~NgAni sutaM cha priyamaurasam |
brAhmaNArthamupAkRRitya nAkapRRiShThamito gataH
shlokas.20:
pratardanaH kAshipatiH pradAya nayane svake |
brAhmaNAyAtulAM kIrtimiha chAmutra chAshnute
shlokas.21:
divyaM mRRiShTashalAkaM tu sauvarNaM paramarddhimat |
ChatraM devAvRRidho dattvA sarAShTro.abhyapataddivam
shlokas.22:
sA~NkRRitishcha tathAtreyaH shiShyebhyo brahma nirguNam |
upadishya mahAtejA gato lokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.23:
ambarISho gavAM dattvA brAhmaNebhyaH pratApavAn |
arbudAni dashaikaM cha sarAShTro.abhyapataddivam
shlokas.24:
sAvitrI kuNDale divye sharIraM janamejayaH |
brAhmaNArthe parityajya jagmaturlokamuttamam
shlokas.25:
sarvaratnaM vRRiShAdarbho yuvanAshvaH priyAH striyaH |
ramyamAvasathaM chaiva dattvAmuM lokamAsthitaH
shlokas.26:
nimI rAShTraM cha vaideho jAmadagnyo vasundharAm |
brAhmaNebhyo dadau chApi gayashchorvIM sapattanAm
shlokas.27:
avarShati cha parjanye sarvabhUtAni chAsakRRit |
vasiShTho jIvayAmAsa prajApatiriva prajAH
shlokas.28:
karandhamasya putrastu marutto nRRipatistathA |
kanyAma~Ngirase dattvA divamAshu jagAma ha
shlokas.29:
brahmadattashcha pA~nchAlyo rAjA buddhimatAM varaH |
nidhiM sha~NkhaM dvijAgryebhyo dattvA lokAnavAptavAn
shlokas.30:
rAjA mitrasahashchApi vasiShThAya mahAtmane |
madayantIM priyAM dattvA tayA saha divaM gataH
shlokas.31:
sahasrajichcha rAjarShiH prANAniShTAnmahAyashAH |
brAhmaNArthe parityajya gato lokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.32:
sarvakAmaishcha sampUrNaM dattvA veshma hiraNmayam |
mudgalAya gataH svargaM shatadyumno mahIpatiH
shlokas.33:
nAmnA cha dyutimAnnAma shAlvarAjaH pratApavAn |
dattvA rAjyamRRichIkAya gato lokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.34:
madirAshvashcha rAjarShirdattvA kanyAM sumadhyamAm |
hiraNyahastAya gato lokAndevairabhiShTutAn
shlokas.35:
lomapAdashcha rAjarShiH shAntAM dattvA sutAM prabhuH |
RRishyashRRi~NgAya vipulaiH sarvakAmairayujyata
shlokas.36:
dattvA shatasahasraM tu gavAM rAjA prasenajit |
savatsAnAM mahAtejA gato lokAnanuttamAn
shlokas.37:
ete chAnye cha bahavo dAnena tapasA cha ha |
mahAtmAno gatAH svargaM shiShTAtmAno jitendriyAH
shlokas.38:
teShAM pratiShThitA kIrtiryAvatsthAsyati medinI |
dAnayaj~naprajAsargairete hi divamApnuvan

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
trayIvidyAmavekSheta vedeShUktAmathA~NgataH |
RRiksAmavarNAkSharato yajuSho.atharvaNastathA
shlokas.2:
vedavAdeShu kushalA hyadhyAtmakushalAshcha ye |
sattvavanto mahAbhAgAH pashyanti prabhavApyayau
shlokas.3:
evaM dharmeNa varteta kriyAH shiShTavadAcharet |
asa.nrodhena bhUtAnAM vRRittiM lipseta vai dvijaH
shlokas.4:
sadbhya Agatavij~nAnaH shiShTaH shAstravichakShaNaH |
svadharmeNa kriyA loke kurvANaH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.5:
tiShThatyeteShu gRRihavAnShaTsu karmasu sa dvijaH |
pa~nchabhiH satataM yaj~naiH shraddadhAno yajeta cha
shlokas.6:
dhRRitimAnapramattashcha dAnto dharmavidAtmavAn |
vItaharShabhayakrodho brAhmaNo nAvasIdati
shlokas.7:
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~nastapo hrIrArjavaM damaH |
etairvardhayate tejaH pApmAnaM chApakarShati
shlokas.8:
dhUtapApmA tu medhAvI laghvAhAro jitendriyaH |
kAmakrodhau vashe kRRitvA ninIShedbrahmaNaH padam
shlokas.9:
agnI.nshcha brAhmaNA.nshchArcheddevatAH praNameta cha |
varjayedruShatIM vAchaM hi.nsAM chAdharmasaMhitAm
shlokas.10:
eShA pUrvatarA vRRittirbrAhmaNasya vidhIyate |
j~nAnAgamena karmANi kurvankarmasu sidhyati
shlokas.11:
pa~nchendriyajalAM ghorAM lobhakUlAM sudustarAm |
manyupa~NkAmanAdhRRiShyAM nadIM tarati buddhimAn
shlokas.12:
kAmamanyUddhataM yatsyAnnityamatyantamohitam |
mahatA vidhidRRiShTena balenApratighAtinA
svabhAvasrotasA vRRittamuhyate satataM jagat
shlokas.13:
kAlodakena mahatA varShAvartena santatam |
mAsormiNartuvegena pakSholapatRRiNena cha
shlokas.14:
nimeShonmeShaphenena ahorAtrajavena cha |
kAmagrAheNa ghoreNa vedayaj~naplavena cha
shlokas.15:
dharmadvIpena bhUtAnAM chArthakAmaraveNa cha |
RRitasopAnatIreNa vihi.nsAtaruvAhinA
shlokas.16:
yugahradaughamadhyena brahmaprAyabhavena cha |
dhAtrA sRRiShTAni bhUtAni kRRiShyante yamasAdanam
shlokas.17:
etatpraj~nAmayairdhIrA nistaranti manIShiNaH |
plavairaplavavanto hi kiM kariShyantyachetasaH
shlokas.18:
upapannaM hi yatprAj~no nistarennetaro janaH |
dUrato guNadoShau hi prAj~naH sarvatra pashyati
shlokas.19:
sa.nshayAtmA sa kAmAtmA chalachitto.alpachetanaH |
aprAj~no na taratyeva yo hyAste na sa gachChati
shlokas.20:
aplavo hi mahAdoShamuhyamAno.adhigachChati |
kAmagrAhagRRihItasya j~nAnamapyasya na plavaH
shlokas.21:
tasmAdunmajjanasyArthe prayateta vichakShaNaH |
etadunmajjanaM tasya yadayaM brAhmaNo bhavet
shlokas.22:
tryavadAte kule jAtastrisa.ndehastrikarmakRRit |
tasmAdunmajjanastiShThennistaretpraj~nayA yathA
shlokas.23:
sa.nskRRitasya hi dAntasya niyatasya kRRitAtmanaH |
prAj~nasyAnantarA siddhiriha loke paratra cha
shlokas.24:
vartate teShu gRRihavAnakrudhyannanasUyakaH |
pa~nchabhiH satataM yaj~nairvighasAshI yajeta cha
shlokas.25:
satAM vRRittena varteta kriyAH shiShTavadAcharet |
asa.nrodhena dharmasya vRRittiM lipsedagarhitAm
shlokas.26:
shrutivij~nAnatattvaj~naH shiShTAchAro vichakShaNaH |
svadharmeNa kriyAvA.nshcha karmaNA so.apyasa~NkaraH
shlokas.27:
kriyAvA~nshraddadhAnashcha dAtA prAj~no.anasUyakaH |
dharmAdharmavisheShaj~naH sarvaM tarati dustaram
shlokas.28:
dhRRitimAnapramattashcha dAnto dharmavidAtmavAn |
vItaharShabhayakrodho brAhmaNo nAvasIdati
shlokas.29:
eShA pUrvatarA vRRittirbrAhmaNasya vidhIyate |
j~nAnavittvena karmANi kurvansarvatra sidhyati
shlokas.30:
adharmaM dharmakAmo hi karotIhAvichakShaNaH |
dharmaM chAdharmasa~NkAshaM shochanniva karoti saH
shlokas.31:
dharmaM karomIti karotyadharma;madharmakAmashcha karoti dharmam |
ubhe bAlaH karmaNI na prajAna;nsa jAyate mriyate chApi dehI

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atha chedrochayedetaddruhyeta manasA tathA |
unmajja.nshcha nimajja.nshcha j~nAnavAnplavavAnbhavet
shlokas.2:
praj~nayA nirmitairdhIrAstArayantyabudhAnplavaiH |
nAbudhAstArayantyanyAnAtmAnaM vA katha~nchana
shlokas.3:
ChinnadoSho muniryogAnyukto yu~njIta dvAdasha |
dashakarmasukhAnarthAnupAyApAyanirbhayaH
shlokas.4:
chakShurAchAravitprAj~no manasA darshanena cha |
yachChedvA~NmanasI buddhyA ya ichChejj~nAnamuttamam
j~nAnena yachChedAtmAnaM ya ichChechChAntimAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
eteShAM chedanudraShTA puruSho.api sudAruNaH |
yadi vA sarvavedaj~no yadi vApyanRRicho.ajapaH
shlokas.6:
yadi vA dhArmiko yajvA yadi vA pApakRRittamaH |
yadi vA puruShavyAghro yadi vA klaibyadhAritA
shlokas.7:
taratyeva mahAdurgaM jarAmaraNasAgaram |
evaM hyetena yogena yu~njAno.apyekamantataH
api jij~nAsamAno hi shabdabrahmAtivartate
shlokas.8:
dharmopastho hrIvarUtha upAyApAyakUbaraH |
apAnAkShaH prANayugaH praj~nAyurjIvabandhanaH
shlokas.9:
chetanAbandhurashchArurAchAragrahanemivAn |
darshanasparshanavaho ghrANashravaNavAhanaH
shlokas.10:
praj~nAnAbhiH sarvatantrapratodo j~nAnasArathiH |
kShetraj~nAdhiShThito dhIraH shraddhAdamapuraHsaraH
shlokas.11:
tyAgavartmAnugaH kShemyaH shauchago dhyAnagocharaH |
jIvayukto ratho divyo brahmaloke virAjate
shlokas.12:
atha santvaramANasya rathametaM yuyukShataH |
akSharaM gantumanaso vidhiM vakShyAmi shIghragam
shlokas.13:
sapta yo dhAraNAH kRRitsnA vAgyataH pratipadyate |
pRRiShThataH pArshvatashchAnyA yAvatyastAH pradhAraNAH
shlokas.14:
kramashaH pArthivaM yachcha vAyavyaM khaM tathA payaH |
jyotiSho yattadaishvaryamaha~NkArasya buddhitaH
shlokas.15:
avyaktasya tathaishvaryaM kramashaH pratipadyate |
vikramAshchApi yasyaite tathA yu~Nkte sa yogataH
shlokas.16:
athAsya yogayuktasya siddhimAtmani pashyataH |
nirmathyamAnaH sUkShmatvAdrUpANImAni darshayet
shlokas.17:
shaishirastu yathA dhUmaH sUkShmaH sa.nshrayate nabhaH |
tathA dehAdvimuktasya pUrvarUpaM bhavatyuta
shlokas.18:
atha dhUmasya virame dvitIyaM rUpadarshanam |
jalarUpamivAkAshe tatraivAtmani pashyati
shlokas.19:
apAM vyatikrame chApi vahnirUpaM prakAshate |
tasminnuparate chAsya pItavastravadiShyate
UrNArUpasavarNaM cha tasya rUpaM prakAshate
shlokas.20:
atha shvetAM gatiM gatvA vAyavyaM sUkShmamapyajaH |
ashuklaM chetasaH saukShmyamavyaktaM brahmaNo.asya vai
shlokas.21:
eteShvapi hi jAteShu phalajAtAni me shRRiNu |
jAtasya pArthivaishvarye sRRiShTiriShTA vidhIyate
shlokas.22:
prajApatirivAkShobhyaH sharIrAtsRRijati prajAH |
a~Ngulya~NguShThamAtreNa hastapAdena vA tathA
shlokas.23:
pRRithivIM kampayatyeko guNo vAyoriti smRRitaH |
AkAshabhUtashchAkAshe savarNatvAtpraNashyati
shlokas.24:
varNato gRRihyate chApi kAmAtpibati chAshayAn |
na chAsya tejasA rUpaM dRRishyate shAmyate tathA
shlokas.25:
aha~NkArasya vijiteH pa~nchaite syurvashAnugAH |
ShaNNAmAtmani buddhau cha jitAyAM prabhavatyatha
shlokas.26:
nirdoShA pratibhA hyenaM kRRitsnA samabhivartate |
tathaiva vyaktamAtmAnamavyaktaM pratipadyate
shlokas.27:
yato niHsarate loko bhavati vyaktasa~nj~nakaH |
tatrAvyaktamayIM vyAkhyAM shRRiNu tvaM vistareNa me
tathA vyaktamayIM chaiva sa~NkhyAM pUrvaM nibodha me
shlokas.28:
pa~nchavi.nshatitattvAni tulyAnyubhayataH samam |
yoge sA~Nkhye.api cha tathA visheShA.nstatra me shRRiNu
shlokas.29:
proktaM tadvyaktamityeva jAyate vardhate cha yat |
jIryate mriyate chaiva chaturbhirlakShaNairyutam
shlokas.30:
viparItamato yattu tadavyaktamudAhRRitam |
dvAvAtmAnau cha vedeShu siddhAnteShvapyudAhRRitau
shlokas.31:
chaturlakShaNajaM tvanyaM chaturvargaM prachakShate |
vyaktamavyaktajaM chaiva tathA buddhamathetarat
sattvaM kShetraj~na ityetaddvayamapyanudarshitam
shlokas.32:
dvAvAtmAnau cha vedeShu viShayeShu cha rajyataH |
viShayAtpratisaMhAraH sA~NkhyAnAM siddhilakShaNam
shlokas.33:
nirmamashchAnaha~NkAro nirdva.ndvashChinnasa.nshayaH |
naiva krudhyati na dveShTi nAnRRitA bhAShate giraH
shlokas.34:
AkruShTastADitashchaiva maitreNa dhyAti nAshubham |
vAgdaNDakarmamanasAM trayANAM cha nivartakaH
shlokas.35:
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu brahmANamabhivartate |
naivechChati na chAnichCho yAtrAmAtravyavasthitaH
shlokas.36:
alolupo.avyatho dAnto na kRRitI na nirAkRRitiH |
nAsyendriyamanekAgraM nAtikShiptamanorathaH
ahi.nsraH sarvabhUtAnAmIdRRiksA~Nkhyo vimuchyate
shlokas.37:
atha yogAdvimuchyante kAraNairyairnibodha me |
yogaishvaryamatikrAnto yo.atikrAmati muchyate
shlokas.38:
ityeShA bhAvajA buddhiH kathitA te na sa.nshayaH |
evaM bhavati nirdva.ndvo brahmANaM chAdhigachChati

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atha j~nAnaplavaM dhIro gRRihItvA shAntimAsthitaH |
unmajja.nshcha nimajja.nshcha j~nAnamevAbhisa.nshrayet
shlokas.2:
shuka uvAcha||
kiM tajj~nAnamatho vidyA yayA nistarati dvayam |
pravRRittilakShaNo dharmo nivRRittiriti chaiva hi
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yastu pashyetsvabhAvena vinA bhAvamachetanaH |
puShyate cha punaH sarvAnpraj~nayA muktahetukaH
shlokas.4:
yeShAM chaikAntabhAvena svabhAvaH kAraNaM matam |
pUtvA tRRiNabusIkAM vai te labhante na ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
ye chainaM pakShamAshritya vartayantyalpachetasaH |
svabhAvaM kAraNaM j~nAtvA na shreyaH prApnuvanti te
shlokas.6:
svabhAvo hi vinAshAya mohakarmamanobhavaH |
niruktametayoretatsvabhAvaparabhAvayoH
shlokas.7:
kRRiShyAdIni hi karmANi sasyasaMharaNAni cha |
praj~nAvadbhiH prakL^iptAni yAnAsanagRRihANi cha
shlokas.8:
AkrIDAnAM gRRihANAM cha gadAnAmagadasya cha |
praj~nAvantaH pravaktAro j~nAnavadbhiranuShThitAH
shlokas.9:
praj~nA sa.nyojayatyarthaiH praj~nA shreyo.adhigachChati |
rAjAno bhu~njate rAjyaM praj~nayA tulyalakShaNAH
shlokas.10:
pArAvaryaM tu bhUtAnAM j~nAnenaivopalabhyate |
vidyayA tAta sRRiShTAnAM vidyaiva paramA gatiH
shlokas.11:
bhUtAnAM janma sarveShAM vividhAnAM chaturvidham |
jarAyvaNDamathodbhedaM svedaM chApyupalakShayet
shlokas.12:
sthAvarebhyo vishiShTAni ja~NgamAnyupalakShayet |
upapannaM hi yachcheShTA vishiShyeta visheShyayoH
shlokas.13:
AhurdvibahupAdAni ja~NgamAni dvayAni cha |
bahupAdbhyo vishiShTAni dvipAdAni bahUnyapi
shlokas.14:
dvipadAni dvayAnyAhuH pArthivAnItarANi cha |
pArthivAni vishiShTAni tAni hyannAni bhu~njate
shlokas.15:
pArthivAni dvayAnyAhurmadhyamAnyuttamAni cha |
madhyamAni vishiShTAni jAtidharmopadhAraNAt
shlokas.16:
madhyamAni dvayAnyAhurdharmaj~nAnItarANi cha |
dharmaj~nAni vishiShTAni kAryAkAryopadhAraNAt
shlokas.17:
dharmaj~nAni dvayAnyAhurvedaj~nAnItarANi cha |
vedaj~nAni vishiShTAni vedo hyeShu pratiShThitaH
shlokas.18:
vedaj~nAni dvayAnyAhuH pravaktR^INItarANi cha |
pravaktR^INi vishiShTAni sarvadharmopadhAraNAt
shlokas.19:
vij~nAyante hi yairvedAH sarvadharmakriyAphalAH |
sayaj~nAH sakhilA vedAH pravaktRRibhyo viniHsRRitAH
shlokas.20:
pravaktR^INi dvayAnyAhurAtmaj~nAnItarANi cha |
Atmaj~nAni vishiShTAni janmAjanmopadhAraNAt
shlokas.21:
dharmadvayaM hi yo veda sa sarvaH sarvadharmavid |
sa tyAgI satyasa~NkalpaH sa tu kShAntaH sa IshvaraH
shlokas.22:
dharmaj~nAnapratiShThaM hi taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH |
shabdabrahmaNi niShNAtaM pare cha kRRitanishchayam
shlokas.23:
antaHsthaM cha bahiShThaM cha ye.a.adhiyaj~nAdhidaivatam |
jAnanti tAnnamasyAmaste devAstAta te dvijAH
shlokas.24:
teShu vishvamidaM bhUtaM sAgraM cha jagadAhitam |
teShAM mAhAtmyabhAvasya sadRRishaM nAsti ki~nchana
shlokas.25:
AdiM te nidhanaM chaiva karma chAtItya sarvashaH |
chaturvidhasya bhUtasya sarvasyeshAH svayambhuvaH

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
eShA pUrvatarA vRRittirbrAhmaNasya vidhIyate |
j~nAnavAneva karmANi kurvansarvatra sidhyati
shlokas.2:
tatra chenna bhavedevaM sa.nshayaH karmanishchaye |
kiM nu karma svabhAvo.ayaM j~nAnaM karmeti vA punaH
shlokas.3:
tatra cheha vivitsA syAjj~nAnaM chetpuruShaM prati |
upapattyupalabdhibhyAM varNayiShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.4:
pauruShaM kAraNaM kechidAhuH karmasu mAnavAH |
daivameke prasha.nsanti svabhAvaM chApare janAH
shlokas.5:
pauruShaM karma daivaM cha phalavRRittisvabhAvataH |
trayametatpRRithagbhUtamavivekaM tu kechana
shlokas.6:
evametanna chApyevamubhe chApi na chApyubhe |
karmasthA viShamaM brUyuH sattvasthAH samadarshinaH
shlokas.7:
tretAyAM dvApare chaiva kalijAshcha sasa.nshayAH |
tapasvinaH prashAntAshcha sattvasthAshcha kRRite yuge
shlokas.8:
apRRithagdarshinaH sarve RRiksAmasu yajuHShu cha |
kAmadveShau pRRithagdRRiShTvA tapaH kRRita upAsate
shlokas.9:
tapodharmeNa sa.nyuktastaponityaH susa.nshitaH |
tena sarvAnavApnoti kAmAnyAnmanasechChati
shlokas.10:
tapasA tadavApnoti yadbhUtvA sRRijate jagat |
tadbhUtashcha tataH sarvo bhUtAnAM bhavati prabhuH
shlokas.11:
taduktaM vedavAdeShu gahanaM vedadarshibhiH |
vedAnteShu punarvyaktaM kramayogena lakShyate
shlokas.12:
Arambhayaj~nAH kShatrasya haviryaj~nA vishaH smRRitAH |
parichArayaj~nAH shUdrAshcha japayaj~nA dvijAtayaH
shlokas.13:
pariniShThitakAryo hi svAdhyAyena dvijo bhavet |
kuryAdanyanna vA kuryAnmaitro brAhmaNa uchyate
shlokas.14:
tretAdau sakalA vedA yaj~nA varNAshramAstathA |
sa.nrodhAdAyuShastvete vyasyante dvApare yuge
shlokas.15:
dvApare viplavaM yAnti vedAH kaliyuge tathA |
dRRishyante nApi dRRishyante kalerante punaH punaH
shlokas.16:
utsIdanti svadharmAshcha tatrAdharmeNa pIDitAH |
gavAM bhUmeshcha ye chApAmoShadhInAM cha ye rasAH
shlokas.17:
adharmAntarhitA vedA vedadharmAstathAshramAH |
vikriyante svadharmasthAH sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.18:
yathA sarvANi bhUtAni vRRiShTirbhaumAni varShati |
sRRijate sarvato.a~NgAni tathA vedA yuge yuge
shlokas.19:
visRRitaM kAlanAnAtvamanAdinidhanaM cha yat |
kIrtitaM tatpurastAnme yataH sa.nyAnti yAnti cha
shlokas.20:
dhAtedaM prabhavasthAnaM bhUtAnAM sa.nyamo yamaH |
svabhAvena pravartante dva.ndvasRRiShTAni bhUrishaH
shlokas.21:
sargaH kAlo dhRRitirvedAH kartA kAryaM kriyA phalam |
etatte kathitaM tAta yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityukto.abhiprashasyaitatparamarShestu shAsanam |
mokShadharmArthasa.nyuktamidaM praShTuM prachakrame
shlokas.2:
shuka uvAcha||
prajAvA~nshrotriyo yajvA vRRiddhaH praj~no.anasUyakaH |
anAgatamanaitihyaM kathaM brahmAdhigachChati
shlokas.3:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa sarvatyAgena medhayA |
sA~Nkhye vA yadi vA yoge etatpRRiShTo.abhidhatsva me
shlokas.4:
manasashchendriyANAM chApyaikAgryaM samavApyate |
yenopAyena puruShaistachcha vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.5:
vyAsa uvAcha||
nAnyatra vidyAtapasornAnyatrendriyanigrahAt |
nAnyatra sarvasantyAgAtsiddhiM vindati kashchana
shlokas.6:
mahAbhUtAni sarvANi pUrvasRRiShTiH svayambhuvaH |
bhUyiShThaM prANabhRRidgrAme niviShTAni sharIriShu
shlokas.7:
bhUmerdeho jalAtsAro jyotiShashchakShuShI smRRite |
prANApAnAshrayo vAyuH kheShvAkAshaM sharIriNAm
shlokas.8:
krAnte viShNurbale shakraH koShThe.agnirbhuktamarChati |
karNayoH pradishaH shrotre jihvAyAM vAksarasvatI
shlokas.9:
karNau tvakchakShuShI jihvA nAsikA chaiva pa~nchamI |
darshanAnIndriyoktAni dvArANyAhArasiddhaye
shlokas.10:
shabdaM sparshaM tathA rUpaM rasaM gandhaM cha pa~nchamam |
indriyANi pRRithaktvarthAnmanaso darshayantyuta
shlokas.11:
indriyANi mano yu~Nkte vashyAnyanteva vAjinaH |
manashchApi sadA yu~Nkte bhUtAtmA hRRidayAshritaH
shlokas.12:
indriyANAM tathaiveShAM sarveShAmIshvaraM manaH |
niyame cha visarge cha bhUtAtmA manasastathA
shlokas.13:
indriyANIndriyArthAshcha svabhAvashchetanA manaH |
prANApAnau cha jIvashcha nityaM deheShu dehinAm
shlokas.14:
Ashrayo nAsti sattvasya guNashabdo na chetanA |
sattvaM hi tejaH sRRijati na guNAnvai kadAchana
shlokas.15:
evaM saptadashaM dehe vRRitaM ShoDashabhirguNaiH |
manIShI manasA vipraH pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.16:
na hyayaM chakShuShA dRRishyo na cha sarvairapIndriyaiH |
manasA sampradIptena mahAnAtmA prakAshate
shlokas.17:
ashabdasparsharUpaM tadarasAgandhamavyayam |
asharIraM sharIre sve nirIkSheta nirindriyam
shlokas.18:
avyaktaM vyaktadeheShu martyeShvamaramAshritam |
yo.anupashyati sa pretya kalpate brahmabhUyase
shlokas.19:
vidyAbhijanasampanne brAhmaNe gavi hastini |
shuni chaiva shvapAke cha paNDitAH samadarshinaH
shlokas.20:
sa hi sarveShu bhUteShu ja~NgameShu dhruveShu cha |
vasatyeko mahAnAtmA yena sarvamidaM tatam
shlokas.21:
sarvabhUteShu chAtmAnaM sarvabhUtAni chAtmani |
yadA pashyati bhUtAtmA brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.22:
yAvAnAtmani vedAtmA tAvAnAtmA parAtmani |
ya evaM satataM veda so.amRRitatvAya kalpate
shlokas.23:
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya sarvabhUtahitasya cha |
devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padaiShiNaH
shlokas.24:
shakunInAmivAkAshe jale vAricharasya vA |
yathA gatirna dRRishyeta tathaiva sumahAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
kAlaH pachati bhUtAni sarvANyevAtmanAtmani |
yasmi.nstu pachyate kAlastaM na vedeha kashchana
shlokas.26:
na tadUrdhvaM na tiryakcha nAdho na cha tiraH punaH |
na madhye pratigRRihNIte naiva kashchitkutashchana
shlokas.27:
sarve.antaHsthA ime lokA bAhyameShAM na ki~nchana |
yaH sahasraM samAgachChedyathA bANo guNachyutaH
shlokas.28:
naivAntaM kAraNasyeyAdyadyapi syAnmanojavaH |
tasmAtsUkShmAtsUkShmataraM nAsti sthUlataraM tataH
shlokas.29:
sarvataHpANipAdAntaM sarvatokShishiromukham |
sarvataHshrutimalloke sarvamAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.30:
tadevANoraNutaraM tanmahadbhyo mahattaram |
tadantaH sarvabhUtAnAM dhruvaM tiShThanna dRRishyate
shlokas.31:
akSharaM cha kSharaM chaiva dvaidhIbhAvo.ayamAtmanaH |
kSharaH sarveShu bhUteShu divyaM hyamRRitamakSharam
shlokas.32:
navadvAraM puraM gatvA ha.nso hi niyato vashI |
IshaH sarvasya bhUtasya sthAvarasya charasya cha
shlokas.33:
hAnibha~NgavikalpAnAM navAnAM sa.nshrayeNa cha |
sharIrANAmajasyAhurha.nsatvaM pAradarshinaH
shlokas.34:
ha.nsoktaM chAkSharaM chaiva kUTasthaM yattadakSharam |
tadvidvAnakSharaM prApya jahAti prANajanmanI

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
pRRichChatastava satputra yathAvadiha tattvataH |
sA~NkhyanyAyena sa.nyuktaM yadetatkIrtitaM mayA
shlokas.2:
yogakRRityaM tu te kRRitsnaM vartayiShyAmi tachChRRiNu |
ekatvaM buddhimanasorindriyANAM cha sarvashaH
Atmano dhyAyinastAta j~nAnametadanuttamam
shlokas.3:
tadetadupashAntena dAntenAdhyAtmashIlinA |
AtmArAmeNa buddhena boddhavyaM shuchikarmaNA
shlokas.4:
yogadoShAnsamuchChidya pa~ncha yAnkavayo viduH |
kAmaM krodhaM cha lobhaM cha bhayaM svapnaM cha pa~nchamam
shlokas.5:
krodhaM shamena jayati kAmaM sa~NkalpavarjanAt |
sattvasa.nsevanAddhIro nidrAmuchChettumarhati
shlokas.6:
dhRRityA shishnodaraM rakShetpANipAdaM cha chakShuShA |
chakShuH shrotre cha manasA mano vAchaM cha karmaNA
shlokas.7:
apramAdAdbhayaM jahyAllobhaM prAj~nopasevanAt |
evametAnyogadoShA~njayennityamatandritaH
shlokas.8:
agnI.nshcha brAhmaNA.nshchArcheddevatAH praNameta cha |
varjayedruShitAM vAchaM hi.nsAyuktAM manonugAm
shlokas.9:
brahma tejomayaM shukraM yasya sarvamidaM rasaH |
ekasya bhUtaM bhUtasya dvayaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.10:
dhyAnamadhyayanaM dAnaM satyaM hrIrArjavaM kShamA |
shauchamAhArasa.nshuddhirindriyANAM cha nigrahaH
shlokas.11:
etairvivardhate tejaH pApmAnaM chApakarShati |
sidhyanti chAsya sarvArthA vij~nAnaM cha pravartate
shlokas.12:
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu labdhAlabdhena vartayan |
dhutapApmA tu tejasvI laghvAhAro jitendriyaH
kAmakrodhau vashe kRRitvA ninIShedbrahmaNaH padam
shlokas.13:
manasashchendriyANAM cha kRRitvaikAgryaM samAhitaH |
prAgrAtrApararAtreShu dhArayenmana AtmanA
shlokas.14:
jantoH pa~nchendriyasyAsya yadekaM Chidramindriyam |
tato.asya sravati praj~nA dRRiteH pAdAdivodakam
shlokas.15:
manastu pUrvamAdadyAtkumInAniva matsyahA |
tataH shrotraM tatashchakShurjihvAM ghrANaM cha yogavit
shlokas.16:
tata etAni sa.nyamya manasi sthApayedyatiH |
tathaivApohya sa~NkalpAnmano hyAtmani dhArayet
shlokas.17:
pa~ncha j~nAnena sandhAya manasi sthApayedyatiH |
yadaitAnyavatiShThante manaHShaShThAni chAtmani
prasIdanti cha sa.nsthAya tadA brahma prakAshate
shlokas.18:
vidhUma iva dIptArchirAditya iva dIptimAn |
vaidyuto.agnirivAkAshe pashyatyAtmAnamAtmanA
sarvaM cha tatra sarvatra vyApakatvAchcha dRRishyate
shlokas.19:
taM pashyanti mahAtmAno brAhmaNA ye manIShiNaH |
dhRRitimanto mahAprAj~nAH sarvabhUtahite ratAH
shlokas.20:
evaM parimitaM kAlamAcharansa.nshitavrataH |
AsIno hi rahasyeko gachChedakSharasAtmyatAm
shlokas.21:
pramoho bhrama Avarto ghrANashravaNadarshane |
adbhutAni rasasparshe shItoShNe mArutAkRRitiH
shlokas.22:
pratibhAmupasargA.nshchApyupasa~NgRRihya yogataH |
tA.nstattvavidanAdRRitya svAtmanaiva nivartayet
shlokas.23:
kuryAtparichayaM yoge traikAlyaM niyato muniH |
girishRRi~Nge tathA chaitye vRRikShAgreShu cha yojajet
shlokas.24:
saMniyamyendriyagrAmaM goShThe bhANDamanA iva |
ekAgrashchintayennityaM yogAnnodvejayenmanaH
shlokas.25:
yenopAyena shakyeta saMniyantuM chalaM manaH |
taM taM yukto niSheveta na chaiva vichalettataH
shlokas.26:
shUnyA giriguhAshchaiva devatAyatanAni cha |
shUnyAgArANi chaikAgro nivAsArthamupakramet
shlokas.27:
nAbhiShvajetparaM vAchA karmaNA manasApi vA |
upekShako yatAhAro labdhAlabdhe samo bhavet
shlokas.28:
yashchainamabhinandeta yashchainamapavAdayet |
samastayoshchApyubhayornAbhidhyAyechChubhAshubham
shlokas.29:
na prahRRiShyeta lAbheShu nAlAbheShu cha chintayet |
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu sadharmA mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.30:
evaM sarvAtmanaH sAdhoH sarvatra samadarshinaH |
ShaNmAsAnnityayuktasya shabdabrahmAtivartate
shlokas.31:
vedanArtAH prajA dRRiShTvA samaloShTAshmakA~nchanaH |
etasminnirato mArge viramenna vimohitaH
shlokas.32:
api varNAvakRRiShTastu nArI vA dharmakA~NkShiNI |
tAvapyetena mArgeNa gachChetAM paramAM gatim
shlokas.33:
ajaM purANamajaraM sanAtanaM; yadindriyairupalabhate naro.achalaH |
aNoraNIyo mahato mahattaraM; tadAtmanA pashyati yukta AtmavAn
shlokas.34:
idaM maharShervachanaM mahAtmano; yathAvaduktaM manasAnudRRishya cha |
avekShya cheyAtparameShThisAtmyatAM; prayAnti yAM bhUtagatiM manIShiNaH

shlokas.1:
shuka uvAcha||
yadidaM vedavachanaM kuru karma tyajeti cha |
kAM dishaM vidyayA yAnti kAM cha gachChanti karmaNA
shlokas.2:
etadvai shrotumichChAmi tadbhavAnprabravItu me |
etattvanyonyavairUpye vartate pratikUlataH
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM parAsharasutaH sutam |
karmavidyAmayAvetau vyAkhyAsyAmi kSharAkSharau
shlokas.4:
yAM dishaM vidyayA yAnti yAM cha gachChanti karmaNA |
shRRiNuShvaikamanAH putra gahvaraM hyetadantaram
shlokas.5:
asti dharma iti proktaM nAstItyatraiva yo vadet |
tasya pakShasya sadRRishamidaM mama bhavedatha
shlokas.6:
dvAvimAvatha panthAnau yatra vedAH pratiShThitAH |
pravRRittilakShaNo dharmo nivRRittau cha subhAShitaH
shlokas.7:
karmaNA badhyate janturvidyayA tu pramuchyate |
tasmAtkarma na kurvanti yatayaH pAradarshinaH
shlokas.8:
karmaNA jAyate pretya mUrtimAnShoDashAtmakaH |
vidyayA jAyate nityamavyayo hyavyayAtmakaH
shlokas.9:
karma tveke prasha.nsanti svalpabuddhitarA narAH |
tena te dehajAlAni ramayanta upAsate
shlokas.10:
ye tu buddhiM parAM prAptA dharmanaipuNyadarshinaH |
na te karma prasha.nsanti kUpaM nadyAM pibanniva
shlokas.11:
karmaNaH phalamApnoti sukhaduHkhe bhavAbhavau |
vidyayA tadavApnoti yatra gatvA na shochati
shlokas.12:
yatra gatvA na mriyate yatra gatvA na jAyate |
na jIryate yatra gatvA yatra gatvA na vardhate
shlokas.13:
yatra tadbrahma paramamavyaktamajaraM dhruvam |
avyAhatamanAyAsamamRRitaM chAviyogi cha
shlokas.14:
dva.ndvairyatra na bAdhyante mAnasena cha karmaNA |
samAH sarvatra maitrAshcha sarvabhUtahite ratAH
shlokas.15:
vidyAmayo.anyaH puruShastAta karmamayo.aparaH |
viddhi chandramasaM darshe sUkShmayA kalayA sthitam
shlokas.16:
tadetadRRiShiNA proktaM vistareNAnumIyate |
navajaM shashinaM dRRiShTvA vakraM tantumivAmbare
shlokas.17:
ekAdashavikArAtmA kalAsambhArasambhRRitaH |
mUrtimAniti taM viddhi tAta karmaguNAtmakam
shlokas.18:
devo yaH sa.nshritastasminnabbinduriva puShkare |
kShetraj~naM taM vijAnIyAnnityaM tyAgajitAtmakam
shlokas.19:
tamo rajashcha sattvaM cha viddhi jIvaguNAnimAn |
jIvamAtmaguNaM vidyAdAtmAnaM paramAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
sachetanaM jIvaguNaM vadanti; sa cheShTate cheShTayate cha sarvam |
tataH paraM kShetravido vadanti; prAvartayadyo bhuvanAni sapta

shlokas.1:
shuka uvAcha||
kSharAtprabhRRiti yaH sargaH saguNAnIndriyANi cha |
buddhyaishvaryAbhisargArthaM yaddhyAnaM chAtmanaH shubham
shlokas.2:
bhUya eva tu loke.asminsadvRRittiM vRRittihaitukIm |
yayA santaH pravartante tadichChAmyanuvarNitam
shlokas.3:
vede vachanamuktaM tu kuru karma tyajeti cha |
kathametadvijAnIyAM tachcha vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.4:
lokavRRittAntatattvaj~naH pUto.ahaM gurushAsanAt |
kRRitvA buddhiM viyuktAtmA tyakShyAmyAtmAnamavyathaH
shlokas.5:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yaiShA vai vihitA vRRittiH purastAdbrahmaNA svayam |
eShA pUrvataraiH sadbhirAchIrNA paramarShibhiH
shlokas.6:
brahmacharyeNa vai lokA~njayanti paramarShayaH |
Atmanashcha hRRidi shreyastvanvichCha manasAtmani
shlokas.7:
vane mUlaphalAshI cha tapyansuvipulaM tapaH |
puNyAyatanachArI cha bhUtAnAmavihi.nsakaH
shlokas.8:
vidhUme sannamusale vAnaprasthapratishraye |
kAle prApte charanbhaikShaM kalpate brahmabhUyase
shlokas.9:
niHstutirnirnamaskAraH parityajya shubhAshubhe |
araNye vicharaikAkI yena kenachidAshitaH
shlokas.10:
shuka uvAcha||
yadidaM vedavachanaM lokavAde virudhyate |
pramANe chApramANe cha viruddhe shAstratA kutaH
shlokas.11:
ityetachChrotumichChAmi bhagavAnprabravItu me |
karmaNAmavirodhena kathametatpravartate
shlokas.12:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM gandhavatyAH sutaH sutam |
RRiShistatpUjayanvAkyaM putrasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.13:
gRRihastho brahmachArI cha vAnaprastho.atha bhikShukaH |
yathoktakAriNaH sarve gachChanti paramAM gatim
shlokas.14:
eko ya AshramAnetAnanutiShThedyathAvidhi |
akAmadveShasa.nyuktaH sa paratra mahIyate
shlokas.15:
chatuShpadI hi niHshreNI brahmaNyeShA pratiShThitA |
etAmAshritya niHshreNIM brahmaloke mahIyate
shlokas.16:
AyuShastu chaturbhAgaM brahmachAryanasUyakaH |
gurau vA guruputre vA vaseddharmArthakovidaH
shlokas.17:
karmAtirekeNa guroradhyetavyaM bubhUShatA |
dakShiNo nApavAdI syAdAhUto gurumAshrayet
shlokas.18:
jaghanyashAyI pUrvaM syAdutthAyI guruveshmani |
yachcha shiShyeNa kartavyaM kAryaM dAsena vA punaH
shlokas.19:
kRRitamityeva tatsarvaM kRRitvA tiShTheta pArshvataH |
ki~NkaraH sarvakArI cha sarvakarmasu kovidaH
shlokas.20:
shuchirdakSho guNopeto brUyAdiShurivAtvaraH |
chakShuShA gurumavyagro nirIkSheta jitendriyaH
shlokas.21:
nAbhuktavati chAshnIyAdapItavati no pibet |
na tiShThati tathAsIta nAsupte prasvapeta cha
shlokas.22:
uttAnAbhyAM cha pANibhyAM pAdAvasya mRRidu spRRishet |
dakShiNaM dakShiNenaiva savyaM savyena pIDayet
shlokas.23:
abhivAdya guruM brUyAdadhIShva bhagavanniti |
idaM kariShye bhagavannidaM chApi kRRitaM mayA
shlokas.24:
iti sarvamanuj~nApya nivedya gurave dhanam |
kuryAtkRRitvA cha tatsarvamAkhyeyaM gurave punaH
shlokas.25:
yA.nstu gandhAnrasAnvApi brahmachArI na sevate |
seveta tAnsamAvRRitta iti dharmeShu nishchayaH
shlokas.26:
ye kechidvistareNoktA niyamA brahmachAriNaH |
tAnsarvAnanugRRihNIyAdbhavechchAnapago guroH
shlokas.27:
sa evaM gurave prItimupahRRitya yathAbalam |
AshrameShvAshrameShvevaM shiShyo varteta karmaNA
shlokas.28:
vedavratopavAsena chaturthe chAyuSho gate |
gurave dakShiNAM dattvA samAvartedyathAvidhi
shlokas.29:
dharmalabdhairyuto dArairagnInutpAdya dharmataH |
dvitIyamAyuSho bhAgaM gRRihamedhivratI bhavet

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
dvitIyamAyuSho bhAgaM gRRihamedhI gRRihe vaset |
dharmalabdhairyuto dArairagnInutpAdya suvrataH
shlokas.2:
gRRihasthavRRittayashchaiva chatasraH kavibhiH smRRitAH |
kusUladhAnyaH prathamaH kumbhIdhAnyastvanantaram
shlokas.3:
ashvastano.atha kApotImAshrito vRRittimAharet |
teShAM paraH paro jyAyAndharmato lokajittamaH
shlokas.4:
ShaTkarmA vartayatyekastribhiranyaH pravartate |
dvAbhyAmekashchaturthastu brahmasatre vyavasthitaH
gRRihamedhivratAnyatra mahAntIha prachakShate
shlokas.5:
nAtmArthaM pAchayedannaM na vRRithA ghAtayetpashUn |
prANI vA yadi vAprANI sa.nskAraM yajuShArhati
shlokas.6:
na divA prasvapejjAtu na pUrvApararAtrayoH |
na bhu~njItAntarAkAle nAnRRitAvAhvayetstriyam
shlokas.7:
nAsyAnashnanvasedvipro gRRihe kashchidapUjitaH |
tathAsyAtithayaH pUjyA havyakavyavahAH sadA
shlokas.8:
vedavidyAvratasnAtAH shrotriyA vedapAragAH |
svadharmajIvino dAntAH kriyAvantastapasvinaH
teShAM havyaM cha kavyaM chApyarhaNArthaM vidhIyate
shlokas.9:
na kharaiH samprayAtasya svadharmAj~nAnakasya cha |
apaviddhAgnihotrasya gurorvAlIkakAriNaH
shlokas.10:
sa.nvibhAgo.atra bhUtAnAM sarveShAmeva shiShyate |
tathaivApachamAnebhyaH pradeyaM gRRihamedhinA
shlokas.11:
vighasAshI bhavennityaM nityaM chAmRRitabhojanaH |
amRRitaM yaj~nasheShaM syAdbhojanaM haviShA samam
bhRRityasheShaM tu yo.ashnAti tamAhurvighasAshinam
shlokas.12:
svadAranirato dAnto hyanasUyurjitendriyaH |
RRitvikpurohitAchAryairmAtulAtithisa.nshritaiH
shlokas.13:
vRRiddhabAlAturairvaidyairj~nAtisambandhibAndhavaiH |
mAtApitRRibhyAM jAmIbhirbhrAtrA putreNa bhAryayA
shlokas.14:
duhitrA dAsavargeNa vivAdaM na samAcharet |
etAnvimuchya sa.nvAdAnsarvapApaiH pramuchyate
shlokas.15:
etairjitaistu jayati sarvA.NllokAnna sa.nshayaH |
AchAryo brahmalokeshaH prAjApatye pitA prabhuH
shlokas.16:
atithistvindralokesho devalokasya chartvijaH |
jAmayo.apsarasAM loke vaishvadeve tu j~nAtayaH
shlokas.17:
sambandhibAndhavA dikShu pRRithivyAM mAtRRimAtulau |
vRRiddhabAlAturakRRishAstvAkAshe prabhaviShNavaH
shlokas.18:
bhrAtA jyeShThaH samaH pitrA bhAryA putraH svakA tanuH |
ChAyA svA dAshavargastu duhitA kRRipaNaM param
shlokas.19:
tasmAdetairadhikShiptaH sahennityamasa~njvaraH |
gRRihadharmarato vidvAndharmanityo jitaklamaH
shlokas.20:
na chArthabaddhaH karmANi dharmaM vA ka~nchidAcharet |
gRRihasthavRRittayastisrastAsAM niHshreyasaM param
shlokas.21:
parasparaM tathaivAhushchAturAshramyameva tat |
ye choktA niyamAsteShAM sarvaM kAryaM bubhUShatA
shlokas.22:
kumbhIdhAnyairu~nChashilaiH kApotIM chAsthitaistathA |
yasmi.nshchaite vasantyarhAstadrAShTramabhivardhate
shlokas.23:
dasha pUrvAndasha parAnpunAti cha pitAmahAn |
gRRihasthavRRittayastvetA vartayedyo gatavyathaH
shlokas.24:
sa chakracharalokAnAM sadRRishIM prApnuyAdgatim |
yatendriyANAmatha vA gatireShA vidhIyate
shlokas.25:
svargaloko gRRihasthAnAmudAramanasAM hitaH |
svargo vimAnasa.nyukto vedadRRiShTaH supuShpitaH
shlokas.26:
svargaloke gRRihasthAnAM pratiShThA niyatAtmanAm |
brahmaNA vihitA shreNireShA yasmAtpramuchyate
dvitIyaM kramashaH prApya svargaloke mahIyate
shlokas.27:
ataH paraM paramamudAramAshramaM; tRRitIyamAhustyajatAM kalevaram |
vanaukasAM gRRihapatinAmanuttamaM; shRRiNuShvaitatkliShTasharIrakAriNAm

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
proktA gRRihasthavRRittiste vihitA yA manIShiNAm |
tadanantaramuktaM yattannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
kramashastvavadhUyainAM tRRitIyAM vRRittimuttamAm |
sa.nyogavratakhinnAnAM vAnaprasthAshramaukasAm
shlokas.3:
shrUyatAM pArtha bhadraM te sarvalokAshrayAtmanAm |
prekShApUrvaM pravRRittAnAM puNyadeshanivAsinAm
shlokas.4:
vyAsa uvAcha||
gRRihasthastu yadA pashyedvalIpalitamAtmanaH |
apatyasyaiva chApatyaM vanameva tadAshrayet
shlokas.5:
tRRitIyamAyuSho bhAgaM vAnaprasthAshrame vaset |
tAnevAgnInparicharedyajamAno divaukasaH
shlokas.6:
niyato niyatAhAraH ShaShThabhakto.apramAdavAn |
tadagnihotraM tA gAvo yaj~nA~NgAni cha sarvashaH
shlokas.7:
akRRiShTaM vai vrIhiyavaM nIvAraM vighasAni cha |
havIMShi samprayachCheta makheShvatrApi pa~nchasu
shlokas.8:
vAnaprasthAshrame.apyetAshchatasro vRRittayaH smRRitAH |
sadyaHprakShAlakAH kechitkechinmAsikasa~nchayAH
shlokas.9:
vArShikaM sa~nchayaM kechitkechiddvAdashavArShikam |
kurvantyatithipUjArthaM yaj~natantrArthasiddhaye
shlokas.10:
abhrAvakAshA varShAsu hemante jalasa.nshrayAH |
grIShme cha pa~nchatapasaH shashvachcha mitabhojanAH
shlokas.11:
bhUmau viparivartante tiShThedvA prapadairapi |
sthAnAsanairvartayanti savaneShvabhiShi~nchate
shlokas.12:
dantolUkhalinaH kechidashmakuTTAstathApare |
shuklapakShe pibantyeke yavAgUM kvathitAM sakRRit
shlokas.13:
kRRiShNapakShe pibantyeke bhu~njate cha yathAkramam |
mUlaireke phalaireke puShpaireke dRRiDhavratAH
shlokas.14:
vartayanti yathAnyAyaM vaikhAnasamataM shritAH |
etAshchAnyAshcha vividhA dIkShAsteShAM manIShiNAm
shlokas.15:
chaturthashchaupaniShado dharmaH sAdhAraNaH smRRitaH |
vAnaprastho gRRihasthashcha tato.anyaH sampravartate
shlokas.16:
asminneva yuge tAta vipraiH sarvArthadarshibhiH |
agastyaH sapta RRiShayo madhuchChando.aghamarShaNaH
shlokas.17:
sA~NkRRitiH sudivA taNDiryavAnno.atha kRRitashramaH |
ahovIryastathA kAvyastANDyo medhAtithirbudhaH
shlokas.18:
shalo vAkashcha nirvAkaH shUnyapAlaH kRRitashramaH |
evandharmasu vidvA.nsastataH svargamupAgaman
shlokas.19:
tAta pratyakShadharmANastathA yAyAvarA gaNAH |
RRiShINAmugratapasAM dharmanaipuNadarshinAm
shlokas.20:
avAchyAparimeyAshcha brAhmaNA vanamAshritAH |
vaikhAnasA vAlakhilyAH sikatAshcha tathApare
shlokas.21:
karmabhiste nirAnandA dharmanityA jitendriyAH |
gatAH pratyakShadharmANaste sarve vanamAshritAH
anakShatrA anAdhRRiShyA dRRishyante jyotiShAM gaNAH
shlokas.22:
jarayA cha paridyUno vyAdhinA cha prapIDitaH |
chaturthe chAyuShaH sheShe vAnaprasthAshramaM tyajet
sadyaskArAM nirUpyeShTiM sarvavedasadakShiNAm
shlokas.23:
AtmayAjI so.a.atmaratirAtmakrIDAtmasa.nshrayaH |
AtmanyagnInsamAropya tyaktvA sarvaparigrahAn
shlokas.24:
sadyaskrA.nshcha yajedyaj~nAniShTIshchaiveha sarvadA |
sadaiva yAjinAM yaj~nAdAtmanIjyA nivartate
shlokas.25:
trI.nshchaivAgnInyajetsamyagAtmanyevAtmamokShaNAt |
prANebhyo yajuShA pa~ncha ShaTprAshnIyAdakutsayan
shlokas.26:
keshalomanakhAnvApya vAnaprastho munistataH |
AshramAdAshramaM sadyaH pUto gachChati karmabhiH
shlokas.27:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo yo dattvA pravrajeddvijaH |
lokAstejomayAstasya pretya chAnantyamashnute
shlokas.28:
sushIlavRRitto vyapanItakalmaSho; na cheha nAmutra cha kartumIhate |
aroShamoho gatasandhivigraho; bhavedudAsInavadAtmavinnaraH
shlokas.29:
yameShu chaivAtmagateShu na vyathe;tsvashAstrasUtrAhutimantravikramaH |
bhavedyatheShTA gatirAtmayAjino; na sa.nshayo dharmapare jItendriye
shlokas.30:
tataH paraM shreShThamatIva sadguNai;radhiShThitaM trInadhivRRittamuttamam |
chaturthamuktaM paramAshramaM shRRiNu; prakIrtyamAnaM paramaM parAyaNam

shlokas.1:
shuka uvAcha||
vartamAnastathaivAtra vAnaprasthAshrame yathA |
yoktavyo.a.atmA yathA shaktyA paraM vai kA~NkShatA padam
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
prApya sa.nskArametAbhyAmAshramAbhyAM tataH param |
yatkAryaM paramArthArthaM tadihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
kaShAyaM pAchayitvA tu shreNisthAneShu cha triShu |
pravrajechcha paraM sthAnaM parivrajyAmanuttamAm
shlokas.4:
tadbhavAnevamabhyasya vartatAM shrUyatAM tathA |
eka eva charennityaM siddhyarthamasahAyavAn
shlokas.5:
ekashcharati yaH pashyanna jahAti na hIyate |
anagniraniketaH syAdgrAmamannArthamAshrayet
shlokas.6:
ashvastanavidhAnaH syAnmunirbhAvasamanvitaH |
laghvAshI niyatAhAraH sakRRidannaniShevitA
shlokas.7:
kapAlaM vRRikShamUlAni kuchelamasahAyatA |
upekShA sarvabhUtAnAmetAvadbhikShulakShaNam
shlokas.8:
yasminvAchaH pravishanti kUpe prAptAH shilA iva |
na vaktAraM punaryAnti sa kaivalyAshrame vaset
shlokas.9:
naiva pashyenna shRRiNuyAdavAchyaM jAtu kasyachit |
brAhmaNAnAM visheSheNa naiva brUyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.10:
yadbrAhmaNasya kushalaM tadeva satataM vadet |
tUShNImAsIta nindAyAM kurvanbheShajamAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
yena pUrNamivAkAshaM bhavatyekena sarvadA |
shUnyaM yena janAkIrNaM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.12:
yena kenachidAchChanno yena kenachidAshitaH |
yatrakvachanashAyI cha taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.13:
aheriva gaNAdbhItaH sauhityAnnarakAdiva |
kuNapAdiva cha strIbhyastaM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.14:
na krudhyenna prahRRiShyechcha mAnito.amAnitashcha yaH |
sarvabhUteShvabhayadastaM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.15:
nAbhinandeta maraNaM nAbhinandeta jIvitam |
kAlameva pratIkSheta nideshaM bhRRitako yathA
shlokas.16:
anabhyAhatachittaH syAdanabhyAhatavAktathA |
nirmuktaH sarvapApebhyo niramitrasya kiM bhayam
shlokas.17:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo bhUtAnAmabhayaM yataH |
tasya dehAdvimuktasya bhayaM nAsti kutashchana
shlokas.18:
yathA nAgapade.anyAni padAni padagAminAm |
sarvANyevApidhIyante padajAtAni kau~njare
shlokas.19:
evaM sarvamahi.nsAyAM dharmArthamapidhIyate |
amRRitaH sa nityaM vasati yo.ahi.nsAM pratipadyate
shlokas.20:
ahi.nsakaH samaH satyo dhRRitimAnniyatendriyaH |
sharaNyaH sarvabhUtAnAM gatimApnotyanuttamAm
shlokas.21:
evaM praj~nAnatRRiptasya nirbhayasya manIShiNaH |
na mRRityuratigo bhAvaH sa mRRityumadhigachChati
shlokas.22:
vimuktaM sarvasa~Ngebhyo munimAkAshavatsthitam |
asvamekacharaM shAntaM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.23:
jIvitaM yasya dharmArthaM dharmo.aratyarthameva cha |
ahorAtrAshcha puNyArthaM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.24:
nirAshiShamanArambhaM nirnamaskAramastutim |
akShINaM kShINakarmANaM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.25:
sarvANi bhUtAni sukhe ramante; sarvANi duHkhasya bhRRishaM trasanti |
teShAM bhayotpAdanajAtakhedaH; kuryAnna karmANi hi shraddadhAnaH
shlokas.26:
dAnaM hi bhUtAbhayadakShiNAyAH; sarvANi dAnAnyadhitiShThatIha |
tIkShNAM tanuM yaH prathamaM jahAti; so.anantamApnotyabhayaM prajAbhyaH
shlokas.27:
uttAna Asyena havirjuhoti; lokasya nAbhirjagataH pratiShThA |
tasyA~Ngama~NgAni kRRitAkRRitaM cha; vaishvAnaraH sarvameva prapede
shlokas.28:
prAdeshamAtre hRRidi nishritaM ya;ttasminprANAnAtmayAjI juhoti |
tasyAgnihotraM hutamAtmasa.nsthaM; sarveShu lokeShu sadaivateShu
shlokas.29:
daivaM tridhAtuM trivRRitaM suparNaM; ye vidyuragryaM paramArthatAM cha |
te sarvalokeShu mahIyamAnA; devAH samarthAH sukRRitaM vrajanti
shlokas.30:
vedA.nshcha vedyaM cha vidhiM cha kRRitsna;matho niruktaM paramArthatAM cha |
sarvaM sharIrAtmani yaH praveda; tasmai sma devAH spRRihayanti nityam
shlokas.31:
bhUmAvasaktaM divi chAprameyaM; hiraNmayaM yo.aNDajamaNDamadhye |
patatriNaM pakShiNamantarikShe; yo veda bhogyAtmani dIptarashmiH
shlokas.32:
AvartamAnamajaraM vivartanaM; ShaNNemikaM dvAdashAraM suparva |
yasyedamAsye pariyAti vishvaM; tatkAlachakraM nihitaM guhAyAm
shlokas.33:
yaH samprasAdaM jagataH sharIraM; sarvAnsa lokAnadhigachChatIha |
tasminhutaM tarpayatIha devAM;ste vai tRRiptAstarpayantyAsyamasya
shlokas.34:
tejomayo nityatanuH purANo; lokAnanantAnabhayAnupaiti |
bhUtAni yasmAnna trasante kadA chi;tsa bhUtebhyo na trasate kadAchit
shlokas.35:
agarhaNIyo na cha garhate.anyA;nsa vai vipraH paramAtmAnamIkShet |
vinItamoho vyapanItakalmaSho; na cheha nAmutra cha yo.arthamRRichChati
shlokas.36:
aroShamohaH samaloShTakA~nchanaH; prahINashoko gatasandhivigrahaH |
apetanindAstutirapriyApriya;shcharannudAsInavadeSha bhikShukaH

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
prakRRitestu vikArA ye kShetraj~nastaiH parishritaH |
te chainaM na prajAnanti sa tu jAnAti tAnapi
shlokas.2:
taishchaiSha kurute kAryaM manaHShaShThairihendriyaiH |
