sudAntairiva sa.nyantA dRRiDhaiH paramavAjibhiH
shlokas.3:
indriyebhyaH parA hyarthA arthebhyaH paramaM manaH |
manasastu parA buddhirbuddherAtmA mahAnparaH
shlokas.4:
mahataH paramavyaktamavyaktAtparato.amRRitam |
amRRitAnna paraM ki~nchitsA kAShThA sA parA gatiH
shlokas.5:
evaM sarveShu bhUteShu gUDho.a.atmA na prakAshate |
dRRishyate tvagryayA buddhyA sUkShmayA tattvadarshibhiH
shlokas.6:
antarAtmani sa.nlIya manaHShaShThAni medhayA |
indriyANIndriyArthA.nshcha bahu chintyamachintayan
shlokas.7:
dhyAnoparamaNaM kRRitvA vidyAsampAditaM manaH |
anIshvaraH prashAntAtma tato.arChatyamRRitaM padam
shlokas.8:
indriyANAM tu sarveShAM vashyAtmA chalitasmRRitiH |
AtmanaH sampradAnena martyo mRRityumupAshnute
shlokas.9:
hitvA tu sarvasa~NkalpAnsattve chittaM niveshayet |
sattve chittaM samAveshya tataH kAla~njaro bhavet
shlokas.10:
chittaprasAdena yatirjahAti hi shubhAshubham |
prasannAtmAtmani sthitvA sukhamAnantyamashnute
shlokas.11:
lakShaNaM tu prasAdasya yathA tRRiptaH sukhaM svapet |
nivAte vA yathA dIpo dIpyamAno na kampate
shlokas.12:
evaM pUrvApare rAtre yu~njannAtmAnamAtmanA |
sattvAhAravishuddhAtmA pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.13:
rahasyaM sarvavedAnAmanaitihyamanAgamam |
AtmapratyayikaM shAstramidaM putrAnushAsanam
shlokas.14:
dharmAkhyAneShu sarveShu satyAkhyAneShu yadvasu |
dashedamRRiksahasrANi nirmathyAmRRitamuddhRRitam
shlokas.15:
navanItaM yathA dadhnaH kAShThAdagniryathaiva cha |
tathaiva viduShAM j~nAnaM putrahetoH samuddhRRitam
snAtakAnAmidaM shAstraM vAchyaM putrAnushAsanam
shlokas.16:
tadidaM nAprashAntAya nAdAntAyAtapasvine |
nAvedaviduShe vAchyaM tathA nAnugatAya cha
shlokas.17:
nAsUyakAyAnRRijave na chAnirdiShTakAriNe |
na tarkashAstradagdhAya tathaiva pishunAya cha
shlokas.18:
shlAghate shlAghanIyAya prashAntAya tapasvine |
idaM priyAya putrAya shiShyAyAnugatAya cha
rahasyadharmaM vaktavyaM nAnyasmai tu katha~nchana
shlokas.19:
yadyapyasya mahIM dadyAdratnapUrNAmimAM naraH |
idameva tataH shreya iti manyeta tattvavit
shlokas.20:
ato guhyatarArthaM tadadhyAtmamatimAnuSham |
yattanmaharShibhirdRRiShTaM vedAnteShu cha gIyate
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
shuka uvAcha||
adhyAtmaM vistareNeha punareva vadasva me |
yadadhyAtmaM yathA chedaM bhagavannRRiShisattama
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
adhyAtmaM yadidaM tAta puruShasyeha vidyate |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi tasya vyAkhyAmimAM shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
bhUmirApastathA jyotirvAyurAkAshameva cha |
mahAbhUtAni bhUtAnAM sAgarasyormayo yathA
shlokas.4:
prasAryeha yathA~NgAni kUrmaH saMharate punaH |
tadvanmahAnti bhUtAni yavIyaHsu vikurvate
shlokas.5:
iti tanmayamevedaM sarvaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
sarge cha pralaye chaiva tasmAnnirdishyate tathA
shlokas.6:
mahAbhUtAni pa~nchaiva sarvabhUteShu bhUtakRRit |
akarottAta vaiShamyaM yasminyadanupashyati
shlokas.7:
shuka uvAcha||
akarodyachCharIreShu kathaM tadupalakShayet |
indriyANi guNAH kechitkathaM tAnupalakShayet
shlokas.8:
vyAsa uvAcha||
etatte vartayiShyAmi yathAvadiha darshanam |
shRRiNu tattvamihaikAgro yathAtattvaM yathA cha tat
shlokas.9:
shabdaH shrotraM tathA khAni trayamAkAshasambhavam |
prANashcheShTA tathA sparsha ete vAyuguNAstrayaH
shlokas.10:
rUpaM chakShurvipAkashcha tridhA jyotirvidhIyate |
raso.atha rasanaM sneho guNAstvete trayo.ambhasAm
shlokas.11:
ghreyaM ghrANaM sharIraM cha bhUmerete guNAstrayaH |
etAvAnindriyagrAmo vyAkhyAtaH pA~nchabhautikaH
shlokas.12:
vAyoH sparsho raso.adbhyashcha jyotiSho rUpamuchyate |
AkAshaprabhavaH shabdo gandho bhUmiguNaH smRRitaH
shlokas.13:
mano buddhishcha bhAvashcha traya ete.a.atmayonijAH |
na guNAnativartante guNebhyaH paramA matAH
shlokas.14:
indriyANi nare pa~ncha ShaShThaM tu mana uchyate |
saptamIM buddhimevAhuH kShetraj~naM punaraShTamam
shlokas.15:
chakShurAlochanAyaiva sa.nshayaM kurute manaH |
buddhiradhyavasAnAya sAkShI kShetraj~na uchyate
shlokas.16:
rajastamashcha sattvaM cha traya ete svayonijAH |
samAH sarveShu bhUteShu tadguNeShUpalakShayet
shlokas.17:
yathA kUrma ihA~NgAni prasArya viniyachChati |
evamevendriyagrAmaM buddhiH sRRiShTvA niyachChati
shlokas.18:
yadUrdhvaM pAdatalayoravA~NmUrdhnashcha pashyati |
etasminneva kRRitye vai vartate buddhiruttamA
shlokas.19:
guNAnnenIyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyANyapi |
manaHShaShThAni sarvANi buddhyabhAve kuto guNAH
shlokas.20:
tatra yatprItisa.nyuktaM ki~nchidAtmani lakShayet |
prashAntamiva sa.nshuddhaM sattvaM tadupadhArayet
shlokas.21:
yattu santApasa.nyuktaM kAye manasi vA bhavet |
rajaH pravartakaM tatsyAtsatataM hAri dehinAm
shlokas.22:
yattu saMmohasa.nyuktamavyaktaviShayaM bhavet |
apratarkyamavij~neyaM tamastadupadhAryatAm
shlokas.23:
praharShaH prItirAnandaH sAmyaM svasthAtmachittatA |
akasmAdyadi vA kasmAdvartate sAttviko guNaH
shlokas.24:
abhimAno mRRiShAvAdo lobho mohastathAkShamA |
li~NgAni rajasastAni vartante hetvahetutaH
shlokas.25:
tathA mohaH pramAdashcha tandrI nidrAprabodhitA |
katha~nchidabhivartante vij~neyAstAmasA guNAH

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
manaH prasRRijate bhAvaM buddhiradhyavasAyinI |
hRRidayaM priyApriye veda trividhA karmachodanA
shlokas.2:
indriyebhyaH parA hyarthA arthebhyaH paramaM manaH |
manasastu parA buddhirbuddherAtmA paro mataH
shlokas.3:
buddhirAtmA manuShyasya buddhirevAtmano.a.atmikA |
yadA vikurute bhAvaM tadA bhavati sA manaH
shlokas.4:
indriyANAM pRRithagbhAvAdbuddhirvikriyate hyaNu |
shRRiNvatI bhavati shrotraM spRRishatI sparsha uchyate
shlokas.5:
pashyantI bhavate dRRiShTI rasatI rasanaM bhavet |
jighratI bhavati ghrANaM buddhirvikriyate pRRithak
shlokas.6:
indriyANIti tAnyAhusteShvadRRishyAdhitiShThati |
tiShThatI puruShe buddhistriShu bhAveShu vartate
shlokas.7:
kadAchillabhate prItiM kadAchidapi shochate |
na sukhena na duHkhena kadAchidiha yujyate
shlokas.8:
seyaM bhAvAtmikA bhAvA.nstrInetAnativartate |
saritAM sAgaro bhartA mahAvelAmivormimAn
shlokas.9:
yadA prArthayate ki~nchittadA bhavati sA manaH |
adhiShThAnAni vai buddhyA pRRithagetAni sa.nsmaret
indriyANyeva medhyAni vijetavyAni kRRitsnashaH
shlokas.10:
sarvANyevAnupUrvyeNa yadyannAnuvidhIyate |
avibhAgagatA buddhirbhAve manasi vartate
pravartamAnaM tu rajaH sattvamapyanuvartate
shlokas.11:
ye chaiva bhAvA vartante sarva eShveva te triShu |
anvarthAH sampravartante rathanemimarA iva
shlokas.12:
pradIpArthaM naraH kuryAdindriyairbuddhisattamaiH |
nishcharadbhiryathAyogamudAsInairyadRRichChayA
shlokas.13:
eva.nsvabhAvamevedamiti vidvAnna muhyati |
ashochannaprahRRiShya.nshcha nityaM vigatamatsaraH
shlokas.14:
na hyAtmA shakyate draShTumindriyaiH kAmagocharaiH |
pravartamAnairanaye durdharairakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.15:
teShAM tu manasA rashmInyadA samya~NniyachChati |
tadA prakAshate hyAtmA ghaTe dIpa iva jvalan
sarveShAmeva bhUtAnAM tamasyapagate yathA
shlokas.16:
yathA vAricharaH pakShI na lipyati jale charan |
evameva kRRitapraj~no na doShairviShayA.nshcharan
asajjamAnaH sarveShu na katha~nchana lipyate
shlokas.17:
tyaktvA pUrvakRRitaM karma ratiryasya sadAtmani |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya guNamArgeShvasajjataH
shlokas.18:
sattvamAtmA prasavati guNAnvApi kadA cha na |
na guNA vidurAtmAnaM guNAnveda sa sarvadA
shlokas.19:
paridraShTA guNAnAM sa sraShTA chaiva yathAtatham |
sattvakShetraj~nayoretadantaraM viddhi sUkShmayoH
shlokas.20:
sRRijate tu guNAneka eko na sRRijate guNAn |
pRRithagbhUtau prakRRityA tau samprayuktau cha sarvadA
shlokas.21:
yathA matsyo.adbhiranyaH sansamprayuktau tathaiva tau |
mashakodumbarau chApi samprayuktau yathA saha
shlokas.22:
iShIkA vA yathA mu~nje pRRithakcha saha chaiva cha |
tathaiva sahitAvetAvanyonyasminpratiShThitau

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
sRRijate tu guNAnsattvaM kShetraj~nastvanutiShThati |
guNAnvikriyataH sarvAnudAsInavadIshvaraH
shlokas.2:
svabhAvayuktaM tatsarvaM yadimAnsRRijate guNAn |
UrNanAbhiryathA sUtraM sRRijate tantuvadguNAn
shlokas.3:
pradhvastA na nivartante pravRRittirnopalabhyate |
evameke vyavasyanti nivRRittiriti chApare
shlokas.4:
ubhayaM sampradhAryaitadadhyavasyedyathAmati |
anenaiva vidhAnena bhavedgarbhashayo mahAn
shlokas.5:
anAdinidhanaM nityamAsAdya vicharennaraH |
akrudhyannaprahRRiShya.nshcha nityaM vigatamatsaraH
shlokas.6:
ityevaM hRRidayagranthiM buddhichintAmayaM dRRiDham |
atItya sukhamAsIta ashocha.nshChinnasa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
tapyeyuH prachyutAH pRRithvyA yathA pUrNAM nadIM narAH |
avagADhA hyavidvA.nso viddhi lokamimaM tathA
shlokas.8:
na tu tAmyati vai vidvAnsthale charati tattvavit |
evaM yo vindate.a.atmAnaM kevalaM j~nAnamAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
evaM buddhvA naraH sarvAM bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim |
samavekShya shanaiH samyaglabhate shamamuttamam
shlokas.10:
etadvai janmasAmarthyaM brAhmaNasya visheShataH |
Atmaj~nAnaM shamashchaiva paryAptaM tatparAyaNam
shlokas.11:
etadbuddhvA bhavedbuddhaH kimanyadbuddhalakShaNam |
vij~nAyaitadvimuchyante kRRitakRRityA manIShiNaH
shlokas.12:
na bhavati viduShAM mahadbhayaM; yadaviduShAM sumahadbhayaM bhavet |
na hi gatiradhikAsti kasya chi;dbhavati hi yA viduShaH sanAtanI
shlokas.13:
lokamAturamasUyate jana;stattadeva cha nirIkShya shochate |
tatra pashya kushalAnashochato; ye vidustadubhayaM kRRitAkRRitam
shlokas.14:
yatkarotyanabhisandhipUrvakaM; tachcha nirNudati yatpurA kRRitam |
na priyaM tadubhayaM na chApriyaM; tasya tajjanayatIha kurvataH

shlokas.1:
shuka uvAcha||
yasmAddharmAtparo dharmo vidyate neha kashchana |
yo vishiShTashcha dharmebhyastaM bhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
dharmaM te sampravakShyAmi purANamRRiShisa.nstutam |
vishiShTaM sarvadharmebhyastamihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.3:
indriyANi pramAthIni buddhyA sa.nyamya yatnataH |
sarvato niShpatiShNUni pitA bAlAnivAtmajAn
shlokas.4:
manasashchendriyANAM cha hyaikAgryaM paramaM tapaH |
tajjyAyaH sarvadharmebhyaH sa dharmaH para uchyate
shlokas.5:
tAni sarvANi sandhAya manaHShaShThAni medhayA |
AtmatRRipta ivAsIta bahu chintyamachintayan
shlokas.6:
gocharebhyo nivRRittAni yadA sthAsyanti veshmani |
tadA tvamAtmanAtmAnaM paraM drakShyasi shAshvatam
shlokas.7:
sarvAtmAnaM mahAtmAnaM vidhUmamiva pAvakam |
taM pashyanti mahAtmAno brAhmaNA ye manIShiNaH
shlokas.8:
yathA puShpaphalopeto bahushAkho mahAdrumaH |
Atmano nAbhijAnIte kva me puShpaM kva me phalam
shlokas.9:
evamAtmA na jAnIte kva gamiShye kuto nvaham |
anyo hyatrAntarAtmAsti yaH sarvamanupashyati
shlokas.10:
j~nAnadIpena dIptena pashyatyAtmAnamAtmanA |
dRRiShTvA tvamAtmanAtmAnaM nirAtmA bhava sarvavit
shlokas.11:
vimuktaH sarvapApebhyo muktatvacha ivoragaH |
parAM buddhimavApyeha vipApmA vigatajvaraH
shlokas.12:
sarvataHsrotasaM ghorAM nadIM lokapravAhinIm |
pa~nchendriyagrAhavatIM manaHsa~Nkalparodhasam
shlokas.13:
lobhamohatRRiNachChannAM kAmakrodhasarIsRRipAm |
satyatIrthAnRRitakShobhAM krodhapa~NkAM saridvarAm
shlokas.14:
avyaktaprabhavAM shIghrAM dustarAmakRRitAtmabhiH |
pratarasva nadIM buddhyA kAmagrAhasamAkulAm
shlokas.15:
sa.nsArasAgaragamAM yonipAtAladustarAm |
AtmajanmodbhavAM tAta jihvAvartAM durAsadAm
shlokas.16:
yAM taranti kRRitapraj~nA dhRRitimanto manIShiNaH |
tAM tIrNaH sarvatomukto vipUtAtmAtmavichChuchiH
shlokas.17:
uttamAM buddhimAsthAya brahmabhUyaM gamiShyasi |
santIrNaH sarvasa~NkleshAnprasannAtmA vikalmaShaH
shlokas.18:
bhUmiShThAnIva bhUtAni parvatastho nishAmaya |
akrudhyannaprahRRiShya.nshcha nanRRisha.nsamatistathA
tato drakShyasi bhUtAnAM sarveShAM prabhavApyayau
shlokas.19:
evaM vai sarvadharmebhyo vishiShTaM menire budhAH |
dharmaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha munayastattvadarshinaH
shlokas.20:
Atmano.avyayino j~nAtvA idaM putrAnushAsanam |
prayatAya pravaktavyaM hitAyAnugatAya cha
shlokas.21:
Atmaj~nAnamidaM guhyaM sarvaguhyatamaM mahat |
abruvaM yadahaM tAta AtmasAkShikama~njasA
shlokas.22:
naiva strI na pumAnetannaiva chedaM napu.nsakam |
aduHkhamasukhaM brahma bhUtabhavyabhavAtmakam
shlokas.23:
naitajj~nAtvA pumAnstrI vA punarbhavamavApnuyAt |
abhavapratipattyarthametadvartma vidhIyate
shlokas.24:
yathA matAni sarvANi na chaitAni yathA tathA |
kathitAni mayA putra bhavanti na bhavanti cha
shlokas.25:
tatprItiyuktena guNAnvitena; putreNa satputraguNAnvitena |
pRRiShTo hIdaM prItimatA hitArthaM; brUyAtsutasyeha yaduktametat

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
gandhAnrasAnnAnurundhyAtsukhaM vA; nAla~NkArA.nshchApnuyAttasya tasya |
mAnaM cha kIrtiM cha yashashcha nechChe;tsa vai prachAraH pashyato brAhmaNasya
shlokas.2:
sarvAnvedAnadhIyIta shushrUShurbrahmacharyavAn |
RRicho yajUMShi sAmAni na tena na sa brAhmaNaH
shlokas.3:
j~nAtivatsarvabhUtAnAM sarvavitsarvavedavit |
nAkAmo mriyate jAtu na tena na cha brAhmaNaH
shlokas.4:
iShTIshcha vividhAH prApya kratU.nshchaivAptadakShiNAn |
naiva prApnoti brAhmaNyamabhidhyAnAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.5:
yadA chAyaM na bibheti yadA chAsmAnna bibhyati |
yadA nechChati na dveShTi brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.6:
yadA na kurute bhAvaM sarvabhUteShu pApakam |
karmaNA manasA vAchA brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.7:
kAmabandhanamevaikaM nAnyadastIha bandhanam |
kAmabandhanamukto hi brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.8:
kAmato muchyamAnastu dhUmrAbhrAdiva chandramAH |
virajAH kAlamAkA~NkShandhIro dhairyeNa vartate
shlokas.9:
ApUryamANamachalapratiShThaM; samudramApaH pravishanti yadvat |
sa kAmakAnto na tu kAmakAmaH; sa vai lokAtsvargamupaiti dehI
shlokas.10:
vedasyopaniShatsatyaM satyasyopaniShaddamaH |
damasyopaniShaddAnaM dAnasyopaniShattapaH
shlokas.11:
tapasopaniShattyAgastyAgasyopaniShatsukham |
sukhasyopaniShatsvargaH svargasyopaniShachChamaH
shlokas.12:
kledanaM shokamanasoH santApaM tRRiShNayA saha |
sattvamichChasi santoShAchChAntilakShaNamuttamam
shlokas.13:
vishoko nirmamaH shAntaH prasannAtmAtmavittamaH |
ShaDbhirlakShaNavAnetaiH samagraH punareShyati
shlokas.14:
ShaDbhiH sattvaguNopetaiH prAj~nairadhikamantribhiH |
ye viduH pretya chAtmAnamihasthA.nstA.nstathA viduH
shlokas.15:
akRRitrimamasaMhAryaM prAkRRitaM nirupaskRRitam |
adhyAtmaM sukRRitapraj~naH sukhamavyayamashnute
shlokas.16:
niShprachAraM manaH kRRitvA pratiShThApya cha sarvataH |
yAmayaM labhate tuShTiM sA na shakyamato.anyathA
shlokas.17:
yena tRRipyatyabhu~njAno yena tuShyatyavittavAn |
yenAsneho balaM dhatte yastaM veda sa vedavit
shlokas.18:
sa~Ngopya hyAtmano dvArANyapidhAya vichintayan |
yo hyAste brAhmaNaH shiShTaH sa Atmaratiruchyate
shlokas.19:
samAhitaM pare tattve kShINakAmamavasthitam |
sarvataH sukhamanveti vapushchAndramasaM yathA
shlokas.20:
savisheShANi bhUtAni guNA.nshchAbhajato muneH |
sukhenApohyate duHkhaM bhAskareNa tamo yathA
shlokas.21:
tamatikrAntakarmANamatikrAntaguNakShayam |
brAhmaNaM viShayAshliShTaM jarAmRRityU na vindataH
shlokas.22:
sa yadA sarvato muktaH samaH paryavatiShThate |
indriyANIndriyArthA.nshcha sharIrastho.ativartate
shlokas.23:
kAraNaM paramaM prApya atikrAntasya kAryatAm |
punarAvartanaM nAsti samprAptasya parAtparam

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
dva.ndvAni mokShajij~nAsurarthadharmAvanuShThitaH |
vaktrA guNavatA shiShyaH shrAvyaH pUrvamidaM mahat
shlokas.2:
AkAshaM mAruto jyotirApaH pRRithvI cha pa~nchamI |
bhAvAbhAvau cha kAlashcha sarvabhUteShu pa~nchasu
shlokas.3:
antarAtmakamAkAshaM tanmayaM shrotramindriyam |
tasya shabdaM guNaM vidyAnmUrtishAstravidhAnavit
shlokas.4:
charaNaM mArutAtmeti prANApAnau cha tanmayau |
sparshanaM chendriyaM vidyAttathA sparshaM cha tanmayam
shlokas.5:
tataH pAkaH prakAshashcha jyotishchakShushcha tanmayam |
tasya rUpaM guNaM vidyAttamo.anvavasitAtmakam
shlokas.6:
prakledaH kShudratA sneha ityApo hyupadishyate |
rasanaM chendriyaM jihvA rasashchApAM guNo mataH
shlokas.7:
sa~NghAtaH pArthivo dhAturasthidantanakhAni cha |
shmashru loma cha keshAshcha sirAH snAyu cha charma cha
shlokas.8:
indriyaM ghrANasa~nj~nAnaM nAsiketyabhidhIyate |
gandhashchaivendriyArtho.ayaM vij~neyaH pRRithivImayaH
shlokas.9:
uttareShu guNAH santi sarve sarveShu chottarAH |
pa~nchAnAM bhUtasa~NghAnAM santatiM munayo viduH
shlokas.10:
mano navamameShAM tu buddhistu dashamI smRRitA |
ekAdasho.antarAtmA cha sarvataH para uchyate
shlokas.11:
vyavasAyAtmikA buddhirmano vyAkaraNAtmakam |
karmAnumAnAdvij~neyaH sa jIvaH kShetrasa~nj~nakaH
shlokas.12:
ebhiH kAlAShTamairbhAvairyaH sarvaiH sarvamanvitam |
pashyatyakaluShaM prAj~naH sa mohaM nAnuvartate

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
sharIrAdvipramuktaM hi sUkShmabhUtaM sharIriNam |
karmabhiH paripashyanti shAstroktaiH shAstrachetasaH
shlokas.2:
yathA marIchyaH sahitAshcharanti; gachChanti tiShThanti cha dRRishyamAnAH |
dehairvimuktA vicharanti lokAM;stathaiva sattvAnyatimAnuShANi
shlokas.3:
pratirUpaM yathaivApsu tApaH sUryasya lakShyate |
sattvavA.nstu tathA sattvaM pratirUpaM prapashyati
shlokas.4:
tAni sUkShmANi sattvasthA vimuktAni sharIrataH |
svena tattvena tattvaj~nAH pashyanti niyatendriyAH
shlokas.5:
svapatAM jAgratAM chaiva sarveShAmAtmachintitam |
pradhAnadvaidhayuktAnAM jahatAM karmajaM rajaH
shlokas.6:
yathAhani tathA rAtrau yathA rAtrau tathAhani |
vashe tiShThati sattvAtmA satataM yogayoginAm
shlokas.7:
teShAM nityaM sadAnityo bhUtAtmA satataM guNaiH |
saptabhistvanvitaH sUkShmaishchariShNurajarAmaraH
shlokas.8:
manobuddhiparAbhUtaH svadehaparadehavit |
svapneShvapi bhavatyeSha vij~nAtA sukhaduHkhayoH
shlokas.9:
tatrApi labhate duHkhaM tatrApi labhate sukham |
krodhalobhau tu tatrApi kRRitvA vyasanamarChati
shlokas.10:
prINitashchApi bhavati mahato.arthAnavApya cha |
karoti puNyaM tatrApi jAgranniva cha pashyati
shlokas.11:
tamevamatitejo.nshaM bhUtAtmAnaM hRRidi sthitam |
tamorajobhyAmAviShTA nAnupashyanti mUrtiShu
shlokas.12:
shAstrayogaparA bhUtvA svamAtmAnaM parIpsavaH |
anuchChvAsAnyamUrtIni yAni vajropamAnyapi
shlokas.13:
pRRithagbhUteShu sRRiShTeShu chaturShvAshramakarmasu |
samAdhau yogamevaitachChANDilyaH shamamabravIt
shlokas.14:
viditvA sapta sUkShmANi ShaDa~NgaM cha maheshvaram |
pradhAnaviniyogasthaH paraM brahmAdhigachChati

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
hRRidi kAmadrumashchitro mohasa~nchayasambhavaH |
krodhamAnamahAskandho vivitsAparimochanaH
shlokas.2:
tasya chAj~nAnamAdhAraH pramAdaH pariShechanam |
so.abhyasUyApalAsho hi purAduShkRRitasAravAn
shlokas.3:
saMmohachintAviTapaH shokashAkho bhaya~NkaraH |
mohanIbhiH pipAsAbhirlatAbhiH pariveShTitaH
shlokas.4:
upAsate mahAvRRikShaM sulubdhAstaM phalepsavaH |
AyAsaiH sa.nyataH pAshaiH phalAni pariveShTayan
shlokas.5:
yastAnpAshAnvashe kRRitvA taM vRRikShamapakarShati |
gataH sa duHkhayorantaM yatamAnastayordvayoH
shlokas.6:
sa.nrohatyakRRitapraj~naH santApena hi pAdapam |
sa tameva tato hanti viShaM grastamivAturam
shlokas.7:
tasyAnushayamUlasya mUlamuddhriyate balAt |
tyAgApramAdAkRRitinA sAmyena paramAsinA
shlokas.8:
evaM yo veda kAmasya kevalaM parikarShaNam |
vadhaM vai kAmashAstrasya sa duHkhAnyativartate
shlokas.9:
sharIraM puramityAhuH svAminI buddhiriShyate |
tatra buddheH sharIrasthaM mano nAmArthachintakam
shlokas.10:
indriyANi janAH paurAstadarthaM tu parA kRRitiH |
tatra dvau dAruNau doShau tamo nAma rajastathA
shlokas.11:
yadarthamupajIvanti paurAH sahapureshvarAH |
advAreNa tamevArthaM dvau doShAvupajIvataH
shlokas.12:
tatra buddhirhi durdharShA manaH sAdharmyamuchyate |
paurAshchApi manastrastAsteShAmapi chalA sthitiH
shlokas.13:
yadarthaM buddhiradhyAste na so.arthaH pariShIdati |
yadarthaM pRRithagadhyAste manastatpariShIdati
shlokas.14:
pRRithagbhUtaM yadA buddhyA mano bhavati kevalam |
tatrainaM vivRRitaM shUnyaM rajaH paryavatiShThate
shlokas.15:
tanmanaH kurute sakhyaM rajasA saha sa~Ngatam |
taM chAdAya janaM pauraM rajase samprayachChati

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
bhUtAnAM guNasa~NkhyAnaM bhUyaH putra nishAmaya |
dvaipAyanamukhAdbhraShTaM shlAghayA parayAnagha
shlokas.2:
dIptAnalanibhaH prAha bhagavAndhUmravarchase |
tato.ahamapi vakShyAmi bhUyaH putra nidarshanam
shlokas.3:
bhUmeH sthairyaM pRRithutvaM cha kAThinyaM prasavAtmatA |
gandho gurutvaM shaktishcha sa~NghAtaH sthApanA dhRRitiH
shlokas.4:
apAM shaityaM rasaH kledo dravatvaM snehasaumyatA |
jihvA viShyandinI chaiva bhaumApyAsravaNaM tathA
shlokas.5:
agnerdurdharShatA tejastApaH pAkaH prakAshanam |
shauchaM rAgo laghustaikShNyaM dashamaM chordhvabhAgitA
shlokas.6:
vAyoraniyamaH sparsho vAdasthAnaM svatantratA |
balaM shaighryaM cha mohashcha cheShTA karmakRRitA bhavaH
shlokas.7:
AkAshasya guNaH shabdo vyApitvaM ChidratApi cha |
anAshrayamanAlambamavyaktamavikAritA
shlokas.8:
apratIghAtatA chaiva bhUtatvaM vikRRitAni cha |
guNAH pa~nchAshataM proktAH pa~nchabhUtAtmabhAvitAH
shlokas.9:
chalopapattirvyaktishcha visargaH kalpanA kShamA |
sadasachchAshutA chaiva manaso nava vai guNAH
shlokas.10:
iShTAniShTavikalpashcha vyavasAyaH samAdhitA |
sa.nshayaH pratipattishcha buddhau pa~ncheha ye guNAH
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM pa~nchaguNA buddhiH kathaM pa~nchendriyA guNAH |
etanme sarvamAchakShva sUkShmaj~nAnaM pitAmaha
shlokas.12:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AhuH ShaShTiM bhUtaguNAnvai; bhUtavishiShTA nityaviShaktAH |
bhUtaviShaktAshchAkSharasRRiShTAH; putra na nityaM tadiha vadanti
shlokas.13:
tatputra chintAkalitaM yadukta;manAgataM vai tava sampratIha |
bhUtArthatattvaM tadavApya sarvaM; bhUtaprabhAvAdbhava shAntabuddhiH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ya ime pRRithivIpAlAH sherate pRRithivItale |
pRRitanAmadhya ete hi gatasattvA mahAbalAH
shlokas.2:
ekaikasho bhImabalA nAgAyutabalAstathA |
ete hi nihatAH sa~Nkhye tulyatejobalairnaraiH
shlokas.3:
naiShAM pashyAmi hantAraM prANinAM sa.nyuge purA |
vikrameNopasampannAstejobalasamanvitAH
shlokas.4:
atha cheme mahAprAj~na sherate hi gatAsavaH |
mRRitA iti cha shabdo.ayaM vartatyeShu gatAsuShu
shlokas.5:
ime mRRitA nRRipatayaH prAyasho bhImavikramAH |
tatra me sa.nshayo jAtaH kutaH sa~nj~nA mRRitA iti
shlokas.6:
kasya mRRityuH kuto mRRityuH kena mRRityuriha prajAH |
haratyamarasa~NkAsha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
purA kRRitayuge tAta rAjAsIdavikampakaH |
sa shatruvashamApannaH sa~NgrAme kShINavAhanaH
shlokas.8:
tatra putro harirnAma nArAyaNasamo bale |
sa shatrubhirhataH sa~Nkhye sabalaH sapadAnugaH
shlokas.9:
sa rAjA shatruvashagaH putrashokasamanvitaH |
yadRRichChayAshAntiparo dadarsha bhuvi nAradam
shlokas.10:
sa tasmai sarvamAchaShTa yathA vRRittaM janeshvaraH |
shatrubhirgrahaNaM sa~Nkhye putrasya maraNaM tathA
shlokas.11:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA nArado.atha tapodhanaH |
AkhyAnamidamAchaShTa putrashokApahaM tadA
shlokas.12:
rAja~nshRRiNu samAkhyAnamadyedaM bahuvistaram |
yathA vRRittaM shrutaM chaiva mayApi vasudhAdhipa
shlokas.13:
prajAH sRRiShTvA mahAtejAH prajAsarge pitAmahaH |
atIva vRRiddhA bahulA nAmRRiShyata punaH prajAH
shlokas.14:
na hyantaramabhUtki~nchitkvachijjantubhirachyuta |
niruchChvAsamivonnaddhaM trailokyamabhavannRRipa
shlokas.15:
tasya chintA samutpannA saMhAraM prati bhUpate |
chintayannAdhyagachChachcha saMhAre hetukAraNam
shlokas.16:
tasya roShAnmahArAja khebhyo.agnirudatiShThata |
tena sarvA disho rAjandadAha sa pitAmahaH
shlokas.17:
tato divaM bhuvaM khaM cha jagachcha sacharAcharam |
dadAha pAvako rAjanbhagavatkopasambhavaH
shlokas.18:
tatrAdahyanta bhUtAni ja~NgamAni dhruvANi cha |
mahatA kopavegena kupite prapitAmahe
shlokas.19:
tato harijaTaH sthANurvedAdhvarapatiH shivaH |
jagAda sharaNaM devo brahmANaM paravIrahA
shlokas.20:
tasminnabhigate sthANau prajAnAM hitakAmyayA |
abravIdvarado devo jvalanniva tadA shivam
shlokas.21:
karavANyadya kaM kAmaM varArho.asi mato mama |
kartA hyasmi priyaM shambho tava yaddhRRidi vartate

shlokas.1:
sthANuruvAcha||
prajAsarganimittaM me kAryavattAmimAM prabho |
viddhi sRRiShTAstvayA hImA mA kupyAsAM pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
tava tejogninA deva prajA dahyanti sarvashaH |
tA dRRiShTvA mama kAruNyaM mA kupyAsAM jagatprabho
shlokas.3:
prajApatiruvAcha||
na kupye na cha me kAmo na bhaveranprajA iti |
lAghavArthaM dharaNyAstu tataH saMhAra iShyate
shlokas.4:
iyaM hi mAM sadA devI bhArArtA samachodayat |
saMhArArthaM mahAdeva bhAreNApsu nimajjati
shlokas.5:
yadAhaM nAdhigachChAmi buddhyA bahu vichArayan |
saMhAramAsAM vRRiddhAnAM tato mAM krodha Avishat
shlokas.6:
sthANuruvAcha||
saMhArAntaM prasIdasva mA krudhastridasheshvara |
mA prajAH sthAvaraM vaicha ja~NgamaM cha vinInashaH
shlokas.7:
palvalAni cha sarvANi sarvaM chaiva tRRiNolapam |
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva bhUtagrAmaM chaturvidham
shlokas.8:
tadetadbhasmasAdbhUtaM jagatsarvamupaplutam |
prasIda bhagavansAdho vara eSha vRRito mayA
shlokas.9:
naShTA na punareShyanti prajA hyetAH katha~nchana |
tasmAnnivartyatAmetattejaH svenaiva tejasA
shlokas.10:
upAyamanyaM sampashya prajAnAM hitakAmyayA |
yatheme jantavaH sarve nivarteranparantapa
shlokas.11:
abhAvamabhigachCheyurutsannaprajanAH prajAH |
adhidaivaniyukto.asmi tvayA lokeShviheshvara
shlokas.12:
tvadbhavaM hi jagannAtha jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
prasAdya tvAM mahAdeva yAchAmyAvRRittijAH prajAH
shlokas.13:
nArada uvAcha||
shrutvA tu vachanaM devaH sthANorniyatavA~NmanAH |
tejastatsvaM nijagrAha punarevAntarAtmanA
shlokas.14:
tato.agnimupasa~NgRRihya bhagavA.NllokapUjitaH |
pravRRittiM cha nivRRittiM cha kalpayAmAsa vai prabhuH
shlokas.15:
upasaMharatastasya tamagniM roShajaM tadA |
prAdurbabhUva vishvebhyaH khebhyo nArI mahAtmanaH
shlokas.16:
kRRiShNA raktAmbaradharA raktanetratalAntarA |
divyakuNDalasampannA divyAbharaNabhUShitA
shlokas.17:
sA viniHsRRitya vai khebhyo dakShiNAmAshritA disham |
dadRRishAte.atha tau kanyAM devau vishveshvarAvubhau
shlokas.18:
tAmAhUya tadA devo lokAnAmAdirIshvaraH |
mRRityo iti mahIpAla jahi chemAH prajA iti
shlokas.19:
tvaM hi saMhArabuddhyA me chintitA ruShitena cha |
tasmAtsaMhara sarvAstvaM prajAH sajaDapaNDitAH
shlokas.20:
avisheSheNa chaiva tvaM prajAH saMhara bhAmini |
mama tvaM hi niyogena shreyaH paramavApsyasi
shlokas.21:
evamuktA tu sA devI mRRityuH kamalamAlinI |
pradadhyau duHkhitA bAlA sAshrupAtamatIva hi
shlokas.22:
pANibhyAM chaiva jagrAha tAnyashrUNi janeshvaraH |
mAnavAnAM hitArthAya yayAche punareva cha

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
vinIya duHkhamabalA sA tvatIvAyatekShaNA |
uvAcha prA~njalirbhUtvA latevAvarjitA tadA
shlokas.2:
tvayA sRRiShTA kathaM nArI mAdRRishI vadatAM vara |
raudrakarmAbhijAyeta sarvaprANibhaya~NkarI
shlokas.3:
bibhemyahamadharmasya dharmyamAdisha karma me |
tvaM mAM bhItAmavekShasva shiveneshvara chakShuShA
shlokas.4:
bAlAnvRRiddhAnvayaHsthA.nshcha na hareyamanAgasaH |
prANinaH prANinAmIsha namaste.abhiprasIda me
shlokas.5:
priyAnputrAnvayasyA.nshcha bhrAtR^InmAtR^IH pitR^Inapi |
apadhyAsyanti yaddeva mRRitA.nsteShAM bibhemyaham
shlokas.6:
kRRipaNAshruparikledo dahenmAM shAshvatIH samAH |
tebhyo.ahaM balavadbhItA sharaNaM tvAmupAgatA
shlokas.7:
yamasya bhavane deva yAtyante pApakarmiNaH |
prasAdaye tvA varada prasAdaM kuru me prabho
shlokas.8:
etamichChAmyahaM kAmaM tvatto lokapitAmaha |
ichCheyaM tvatprasAdAchcha tapastaptuM sureshvara
shlokas.9:
pitAmaha uvAcha||
mRRityo sa~NkalpitA me tvaM prajAsaMhArahetunA |
gachCha saMhara sarvAstvaM prajA mA cha vichAraya
shlokas.10:
etadevamavashyaM hi bhavitA naitadanyathA |
kriyatAmanavadyA~Ngi yathoktaM madvacho.anaghe
shlokas.11:
nArada uvAcha||
evamuktA mahAbAho mRRityuH parapura~njaya |
na vyAjahAra tasthau cha prahvA bhagavadunmukhI
shlokas.12:
punaH punarathoktA sA gatasattveva bhAminI |
tUShNImAsIttato devo devAnAmIshvareshvaraH
shlokas.13:
prasasAda kila brahmA svayamevAtmanAtmavAn |
smayamAnashcha lokesho lokAnsarvAnavaikShata
shlokas.14:
nivRRittaroShe tasmi.nstu bhagavatyaparAjite |
sA kanyApajagAmAsya samIpAditi naH shrutam
shlokas.15:
apasRRityApratishrutya prajAsaMharaNaM tadA |
tvaramANeva rAjendra mRRityurdhenukamabhyayAt
shlokas.16:
sA tatra paramaM devI tapo.acharata dushcharam |
samA hyekapade tasthau dasha padmAni pa~ncha cha
shlokas.17:
tAM tathA kurvatIM tatra tapaH paramadushcharam |
punareva mahAtejA brahmA vachanamabravIt
shlokas.18:
kuruShva me vacho mRRityo tadanAdRRitya satvarA |
tathaivaikapade tAta punaranyAni sapta sA
shlokas.19:
tasthau padmAni ShaTchaiva pa~ncha dve chaiva mAnada |
bhUyaH padmAyutaM tAta mRRigaiH saha chachAra sA
shlokas.20:
punargatvA tato rAjanmaunamAtiShThaduttamam |
apsu varShasahasrANi sapta chaikaM cha pArthiva
shlokas.21:
tato jagAma sA kanyA kaushikIM bharatarShabha |
tatra vAyujalAhArA chachAra niyamaM punaH
shlokas.22:
tato yayau mahAbhAgA ga~NgAM meruM cha kevalam |
tasthau dArviva nishcheShTA bhUtAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.23:
tato himavato mUrdhni yatra devAH samIjire |
tatrA~NguShThena rAjendra nikharvamaparaM tataH
tasthau pitAmahaM chaiva toShayAmAsa yatnataH
shlokas.24:
tatastAmabravIttatra lokAnAM prabhavApyayaH |
kimidaM vartate putri kriyatAM tadvacho mama
shlokas.25:
tato.abravItpunarmRRityurbhagavantaM pitAmaham |
na hareyaM prajA deva punastvAhaM prasAdaye
shlokas.26:
tAmadharmabhayatrastAM punareva cha yAchatIm |
tadAbravIddevadevo nigRRihyedaM vachastataH
shlokas.27:
adharmo nAsti te mRRityo sa.nyachChemAH prajAH shubhe |
mayA hyuktaM mRRiShA bhadre bhavitA neha ki~nchana
shlokas.28:
dharmaH sanAtanashcha tvAmihaivAnupravekShyate |
ahaM cha vibudhAshchaiva tvaddhite niratAH sadA
shlokas.29:
imamanyaM cha te kAmaM dadAmi manasepsitam |
na tvA doSheNa yAsyanti vyAdhisampIDitAH prajAH
shlokas.30:
puruSheShu cha rUpeNa puruShastvaM bhaviShyasi |
strIShu strIrUpiNI chaiva tRRitIyeShu napu.nsakam
shlokas.31:
saivamuktA mahArAja kRRitA~njaliruvAcha ha |
punareva mahAtmAnaM neti deveshamavyayam
shlokas.32:
tAmabravIttadA devo mRRityo saMhara mAnavAn |
adharmaste na bhavitA tathA dhyAsyAmyahaM shubhe
shlokas.33:
yAnashrubindUnpatitAnapashyaM; ye pANibhyAM dhAritAste purastAt |
te vyAdhayo mAnavAnghorarUpAH; prApte kAle pIDayiShyanti mRRityo
shlokas.34:
sarveShAM tvaM prANinAmantakAle; kAmakrodhau sahitau yojayethAH |
evaM dharmastvAmupaiShyatyameyo; na chAdharmaM lapsyase tulyavRRittiH
shlokas.35:
evaM dharmaM pAlayiShyasyathoktaM; na chAtmAnaM majjayiShyasyadharme |
tasmAtkAmaM rochayAbhyAgataM tvaM; sa.nyojyAtho saMharasveha jantUn
shlokas.36:
sA vai tadA mRRityusa~nj~nApadeshA;chChApAdbhItA bADhamityabravIttam |
atho prANAnprANinAmantakAle; kAmakrodhau prApya nirmohya hanti
shlokas.37:
mRRityorye te vyAdhayashchAshrupAtA; manuShyANAM rujyate yaiH sharIram |
sarveShAM vai prANinAM prANanAnte; tasmAchChokaM mA kRRithA budhya buddhyA
shlokas.38:
sarve devAH prANinAM prANanAnte; gatvA vRRittAH saMnivRRittAstathaiva |
evaM sarve mAnavAH prANanAnte; gatvAvRRittA devavadrAjasiMha
shlokas.39:
vAyurbhImo bhImanAdo mahaujAH; sarveShAM cha prANinAM prANabhUtaH |
nAnAvRRittirdehinAM dehabhede; tasmAdvAyurdevadevo vishiShTaH
shlokas.40:
sarve devA martyasa~nj~nAvishiShTAH; sarve martyA devasa~nj~nAvishiShTAH |
tasmAtputraM mA shucho rAjasiMha; putraH svargaM prApya te modate ha
shlokas.41:
evaM mRRityurdevasRRiShTA prajAnAM; prApte kAle saMharantI yathAvat |
tasyAshchaiva vyAdhayaste.ashrupAtAH; prApte kAle saMharantIha jantUn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ime vai mAnavAH sarve dharmaM prati visha~NkitAH |
ko.ayaM dharmaH kuto dharmastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
dharmo nvayamihArthaH kimamutrArtho.api vA bhavet |
ubhayArtho.api vA dharmastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sadAchAraH smRRitirvedAstrividhaM dharmalakShaNam |
chaturthamarthamityAhuH kavayo dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.4:
api hyuktAni karmANi vyavasyantyuttarAvare |
lokayAtrArthameveha dharmasya niyamaH kRRitaH
ubhayatra sukhodarka iha chaiva paratra cha
shlokas.5:
alabdhvA nipuNaM dharmaM pApaH pApe prasajjati |
na cha pApakRRitaH pApAnmuchyante kechidApadi
shlokas.6:
apApavAdI bhavati yadA bhavati dharmavit |
dharmasya niShThA svAchArastamevAshritya bhotsyase
shlokas.7:
yadAdharmasamAviShTo dhanaM gRRihNAti taskaraH |
ramate nirharanstenaH paravittamarAjake
shlokas.8:
yadAsya taddharantyanye tadA rAjAnamichChati |
tadA teShAM spRRihayate ye vai tuShTAH svakairdhanaiH
shlokas.9:
abhItaH shuchirabhyeti rAjadvAramasha~NkitaH |
na hi dushcharitaM ki~nchidantarAtmani pashyati
shlokas.10:
satyasya vachanaM sAdhu na satyAdvidyate param |
satyena vidhRRitaM sarvaM sarvaM satye pratiShThitam
shlokas.11:
api pApakRRito raudrAH satyaM kRRitvA pRRithakpRRithak |
adrohamavisa.nvAdaM pravartante tadAshrayAH
te chenmitho.adhRRitiM kuryurvinashyeyurasa.nshayam
shlokas.12:
na hartavyaM paradhanamiti dharmaH sanAtanaH |
manyante balavantastaM durbalaiH sampravartitam
yadA niyatidaurbalyamathaiShAmeva rochate
shlokas.13:
na hyatyantaM balayutA bhavanti sukhino.api vA |
tasmAdanArjave buddhirna kAryA te katha~nchana
shlokas.14:
asAdhubhyo.asya na bhayaM na chorebhyo na rAjataH |
na ki~nchitkasyachitkurvannirbhayaH shuchirAvaset
shlokas.15:
sarvataH sha~Nkate steno mRRigo grAmamiveyivAn |
bahudhAcharitaM pApamanyatraivAnupashyati
shlokas.16:
muditaH shuchirabhyeti sarvato nirbhayaH sadA |
na hi dushcharitaM ki~nchidAtmano.anyeShu pashyati
shlokas.17:
dAtavyamityayaM dharma ukto bhUtahite rataiH |
taM manyante dhanayutAH kRRipaNaiH sampravartitam
shlokas.18:
yadA niyatikArpaNyamathaiShAmeva rochate |
na hyatyantaM dhanavanto bhavanti sukhino.api vA
shlokas.19:
yadanyairvihitaM nechChedAtmanaH karma pUruShaH |
na tatpareShu kurvIta jAnannapriyamAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
yo.anyasya syAdupapatiH sa kaM kiM vaktumarhati |
yadanyastasya tatkuryAnna mRRiShyediti me matiH
shlokas.21:
jIvituM yaH svayaM chechChetkathaM so.anyaM praghAtayet |
yadyadAtmana ichCheta tatparasyApi chintayet
shlokas.22:
atiriktaiH sa.nvibhajedbhogairanyAnaki~nchanAn |
etasmAtkAraNAddhAtrA kusIdaM sampravartitam
shlokas.23:
yasmi.nstu devAH samaye santiShThera.nstathA bhavet |
atha chellAbhasamaye sthitirdharme.api shobhanA
shlokas.24:
sarvaM priyAbhyupagataM dharmamAhurmanIShiNaH |
pashyaitaM lakShaNoddeshaM dharmAdharme yudhiShThira
shlokas.25:
lokasa~Ngrahasa.nyuktaM vidhAtrA vihitaM purA |
sUkShmadharmArthaniyataM satAM charitamuttamam
shlokas.26:
dharmalakShaNamAkhyAtametatte kurusattama |
tasmAdanArjave buddhirna kAryA te katha~nchana

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sUkShmaM sAdhu samAdiShTaM bhavatA dharmalakShaNam |
pratibhA tvasti me kAchittAM brUyAmanumAnataH
shlokas.2:
bhUyA.nso hRRidaye ye me prashnAste vyAhRRitAstvayA |
imamanyaM pravakShyAmi na rAjanvigrahAdiva
shlokas.3:
imAni hi prApayanti sRRijantyuttArayanti cha |
na dharmaH paripAThena shakyo bhArata veditum
shlokas.4:
anyo dharmaH samasthasya viShamasthasya chAparaH |
Apadastu kathaM shakyAH paripAThena veditum
shlokas.5:
sadAchAro mato dharmaH santastvAchAralakShaNAH |
sAdhyAsAdhyaM kathaM shakyaM sadAchAro hyalakShaNam
shlokas.6:
dRRishyate dharmarUpeNa adharmaM prAkRRitashcharan |
dharmaM chAdharmarUpeNa kashchidaprAkRRitashcharan
shlokas.7:
punarasya pramANaM hi nirdiShTaM shAstrakovidaiH |
vedavAdAshchAnuyugaM hrasantIti ha naH shrutam
shlokas.8:
anye kRRitayuge dharmAstretAyAM dvApare.apare |
anye kaliyuge dharmA yathAshaktikRRitA iva
shlokas.9:
AmnAyavachanaM satyamityayaM lokasa~NgrahaH |
AmnAyebhyaH paraM vedAH prasRRitA vishvatomukhAH
shlokas.10:
te chetsarve pramANaM vai pramANaM tanna vidyate |
pramANe chApramANe cha viruddhe shAstratA kutaH
shlokas.11:
dharmasya hriyamANasya balavadbhirdurAtmabhiH |
yA yA vikriyate sa.nsthA tataH sApi praNashyati
shlokas.12:
vidma chaivaM na vA vidma shakyaM vA vedituM na vA |
aNIyAnkShuradhArAyA garIyAnparvatAdapi
shlokas.13:
gandharvanagarAkAraH prathamaM sampradRRishyate |
anvIkShyamANaH kavibhiH punargachChatyadarshanam
shlokas.14:
nipAnAnIva gobhyAshe kShetre kulyeva bhArata |
smRRito.api shAshvato dharmo viprahINo na dRRishyate
shlokas.15:
kAmAdanye kShayAdanye kAraNairaparaistathA |
asanto hi vRRithAchAraM bhajante bahavo.apare
shlokas.16:
dharmo bhavati sa kShipraM vilInastveva sAdhuShu |
anye tAnAhurunmattAnapi chAvahasantyuta
shlokas.17:
mahAjanA hyupAvRRittA rAjadharmaM samAshritAH |
na hi sarvahitaH kashchidAchAraH sampradRRishyate
shlokas.18:
tenaivAnyaH prabhavati so.aparaM bAdhate punaH |
dRRishyate chaiva sa punastulyarUpo yadRRichChayA
shlokas.19:
yenaivAnyaH prabhavati so.aparAnapi bAdhate |
AchArANAmanaikAgryaM sarveShAmeva lakShayet
shlokas.20:
chirAbhipannaH kavibhiH pUrvaM dharma udAhRRitaH |
tenAchAreNa pUrveNa sa.nsthA bhavati shAshvatI

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
tulAdhArasya vAkyAni dharme jAjalinA saha
shlokas.2:
vane vanacharaH kashchijjAjalirnAma vai dvijaH |
sAgaroddeshamAgamya tapastepe mahAtapAH
shlokas.3:
niyato niyatAhArashchIrAjinajaTAdharaH |
malapa~Nkadharo dhImAnbahUnvarShagaNAnmuniH
shlokas.4:
sa kadAchinmahAtejA jalavAso mahIpate |
chachAra lokAnviprarShiH prekShamANo manojavaH
shlokas.5:
sa chintayAmAsa munirjalamadhye kadAchana |
viprekShya sAgarAntAM vai mahIM savanakAnanAm
shlokas.6:
na mayA sadRRisho.astIha loke sthAvaraja~Ngame |
apsu vaihAyasaM gachChenmayA yo.anyaH saheti vai
shlokas.7:
sa dRRishyamAno rakShobhirjalamadhye.avadattataH |
abruva.nshcha pishAchAstaM naivaM tvaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.8:
tulAdhAro vaNigdharmA vArANasyAM mahAyashAH |
so.apyevaM nArhate vaktuM yathA tvaM dvijasattama
shlokas.9:
ityukto jAjalirbhUtaiH pratyuvAcha mahAtapAH |
pashyeyaM tamahaM prAj~naM tulAdhAraM yashasvinam
shlokas.10:
iti bruvANaM tamRRiShiM rakShA.nsyuddhRRitya sAgarAt |
abruvangachCha panthAnamAsthAyemaM dvijottama
shlokas.11:
ityukto jAjalirbhUtairjagAma vimanAstadA |
vArANasyAM tulAdhAraM samAsAdyAbravIdvachaH
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM kRRitaM sukRRitaM karma tAta jAjalinA purA |
yena siddhiM parAM prAptastanno vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atIva tapasA yukto ghoreNa sa babhUva ha |
nadyupasparshanarataH sAyaM prAtarmahAtapAH
shlokas.14:
agnInparicharansamyaksvAdhyAyaparamo dvijaH |
vAnaprasthavidhAnaj~no jAjalirjvalitaH shriyA
shlokas.15:
satye tapasi tiShThansa na cha dharmamavaikShata |
varShAsvAkAshashAyI sa hemante jalasa.nshrayaH
shlokas.16:
vatAtapasaho grIShme na cha dharmamavindata |
duHkhashayyAshcha vividhA bhUmau cha parivartanam
shlokas.17:
tataH kadAchitsa munirvarShAsvAkAshamAsthitaH |
antarikShAjjalaM mUrdhnA pratyagRRihNAnmuhurmuhuH
shlokas.18:
atha tasya jaTAH klinnA babhUvurgrathitAH prabho |
araNyagamanAnnityaM malino malasa.nyutAH
shlokas.19:
sa kadAchinnirAhAro vAyubhakSho mahAtapAH |
tasthau kAShThavadavyagro na chachAla cha karhichit
shlokas.20:
tasya sma sthANubhUtasya nirvicheShTasya bhArata |
kuli~Ngashakunau rAjannIDaM shirasi chakratuH
shlokas.21:
sa tau dayAvAnviprarShirupapraikShata dampatI |
kurvANaM nIDakaM tatra jaTAsu tRRiNatantubhiH
shlokas.22:
yadA sa na chalatyeva sthANubhUto mahAtapAH |
tatastau parivishvastau sukhaM tatroShatustadA
shlokas.23:
atItAsvatha varShAsu sharatkAla upasthite |
prAjApatyena vidhinA vishvAsAtkAmamohitau
shlokas.24:
tatrApAtayatAM rAja~nshirasyaNDAni khecharau |
tAnyabudhyata tejasvI sa vipraH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.25:
buddhvA cha sa mahAtejA na chachAlaiva jAjaliH |
dharme dhRRitamanA nityaM nAdharmaM sa tvarochayat
shlokas.26:
ahanyahani chAgamya tatastau tasya mUrdhani |
AshvAsitau vai vasataH samprahRRiShTau tadA vibho
shlokas.27:
aNDebhyastvatha puShTebhyaH prajAyanta shakuntakAH |
vyavardhanta cha tatraiva na chAkampata jAjaliH
shlokas.28:
sa rakShamANastvaNDAni kuli~NgAnAM yatavrataH |
tathaiva tasthau dharmAtmA nirvicheShTaH samAhitaH
shlokas.29:
tatastu kAlasamaye babhUvuste.atha pakShiNaH |
bubudhe tA.nshcha sa munirjAtapakShA~nshakuntakAn
shlokas.30:
tataH kadAchittA.nstatra pashyanpakShInyatavrataH |
babhUva paramaprItastadA matimatAM varaH
shlokas.31:
tathA tAnabhisa.nvRRiddhAndRRiShTvA chApnuvatAM mudam |
shakunau nirbhayau tatra UShatushchAtmajaiH saha
shlokas.32:
jAtapakShA.nshcha so.apashyaduDDInAnpunarAgatAn |
sAyaM sAyaM dvijAnvipro na chAkampata jAjaliH
shlokas.33:
kadAchitpunarabhyetya punargachChanti santatam |
tyaktA mAtRRipitRRibhyAM te na chAkampata jAjaliH
shlokas.34:
atha te divasaM chArIM gatvA sAyaM punarnRRipa |
upAvartanta tatraiva nivAsArthaM shakuntakAH
shlokas.35:
kadAchiddivasAnpa~ncha samutpatya viha~NgamAH |
ShaShThe.ahani samAjagmurna chAkampata jAjaliH
shlokas.36:
krameNa cha punaH sarve divasAni bahUnyapi |
nopAvartanta shakunA jAtaprANAH sma te yadA
shlokas.37:
kadAchinmAsamAtreNa samutpatya viha~NgamAH |
naivAgachCha.nstato rAjanprAtiShThata sa jAjaliH
shlokas.38:
tatasteShu pralIneShu jAjalirjAtavismayaH |
siddho.asmIti matiM chakre tatastaM mAna Avishat
shlokas.39:
sa tathA nirgatAndRRiShTvA shakuntAnniyatavrataH |
sambhAvitAtmA sambhAvya bhRRishaM prItastadAbhavan
shlokas.40:
sa nadyAM samupaspRRishya tarpayitvA hutAshanam |
udayantamathAdityamabhyagachChanmahAtapAH
shlokas.41:
sambhAvya chaTakAnmUrdhni jAjalirjapatAM varaH |
AsphoTayattadAkAshe dharmaH prApto mayeti vai
shlokas.42:
athAntarikShe vAgAsIttAM sa shushrAva jAjaliH |
dharmeNa na samastvaM vai tulAdhArasya jAjale
shlokas.43:
vArANasyAM mahAprAj~nastulAdhAraH pratiShThitaH |
so.apyevaM nArhate vaktuM yathA tvaM bhAShase dvija
shlokas.44:
so.amarShavashamApannastulAdhAradidRRikShayA |
pRRithivImacharadrAjanyatrasAya~NgRRiho muniH
shlokas.45:
kAlena mahatAgachChatsa tu vArANasIM purIm |
vikrINantaM cha paNyAni tulAdhAraM dadarsha saH
shlokas.46:
so.api dRRiShTvaiva taM vipramAyAntaM bhANDajIvanaH |
samutthAya susaMhRRiShTaH svAgatenAbhyapUjayat
shlokas.47:
tulAdhAra uvAcha||
AyAnevAsi vidito mama brahmanna sa.nshayaH |
bravImi yattu vachanaM tachChRRiNuShva dvijottama
shlokas.48:
sAgarAnUpamAshritya tapastaptaM tvayA mahat |
na cha dharmasya sa~nj~nAM tvaM purA vettha katha~nchana
shlokas.49:
tataH siddhasya tapasA tava vipra shakuntakAH |
kShipraM shirasyajAyanta te cha sambhAvitAstvayA
shlokas.50:
jAtapakShA yadA te cha gatAshchArImitastataH |
manyamAnastato dharmaM chaTakaprabhavaM dvija
khe vAchaM tvamathAshrauShIrmAM prati dvijasattama
shlokas.51:
amarShavashamApannastataH prApto bhavAniha |
karavANi priyaM kiM te tadbrUhi dvijasattama

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA tena tulAdhAreNa dhImatA |
provAcha vachanaM dhImA~njAjalirjapatAM varaH
shlokas.2:
vikrINAnaH sarvarasAnsarvagandhA.nshcha vANija |
vanaspatInoShadhIshcha teShAM mUlaphalAni cha
shlokas.3:
adhyagA naiShThikIM buddhiM kutastvAmidamAgatam |
etadAchakShva me sarvaM nikhilena mahAmate
shlokas.4:
evamuktastulAdhAro brAhmaNena yashasvinA |
uvAcha dharmasUkShmANi vaishyo dharmArthatattvavit
jAjaliM kaShTatapasaM j~nAnatRRiptastadA nRRipa
shlokas.5:
vedAhaM jAjale dharmaM sarahasyaM sanAtanam |
sarvabhUtahitaM maitraM purANaM yaM janA viduH
shlokas.6:
adroheNaiva bhUtAnAmalpadroheNa vA punaH |
yA vRRittiH sa paro dharmastena jIvAmi jAjale
shlokas.7:
parichChinnaiH kAShThatRRiNairmayedaM sharaNaM kRRitam |
alaktaM padmakaM tu~NgaM gandhA.nshchochchAvachA.nstathA
shlokas.8:
rasA.nshcha tA.nstAnviprarShe madyavarjAnahaM bahUn |
krItvA vai prativikrINe parahastAdamAyayA
shlokas.9:
sarveShAM yaH suhRRinnityaM sarveShAM cha hite rataH |
karmaNA manasA vAchA sa dharmaM veda jAjale
shlokas.10:
nAhaM pareShAM karmANi prasha.nsAmi shapAmi vA |
AkAshasyeva viprarShe pashya.Nllokasya chitratAm
shlokas.11:
nAnurudhye virudhye vA na dveShmi na cha kAmaye |
samo.asmi sarvabhUteShu pashya me jAjale vratam
shlokas.12:
iShTAniShTavimuktasya prItirAgabahiShkRRitaH |
tulA me sarvabhUteShu samA tiShThati jAjale
shlokas.13:
iti mAM tvaM vijAnIhi sarvalokasya jAjale |
samaM matimatAM shreShTha samaloShTAshmakA~nchanam
shlokas.14:
yathAndhabadhironmattA uchChvAsaparamAH sadA |
devairapihitadvArAH sopamA pashyato mama
shlokas.15:
yathA vRRiddhAturakRRishA niHspRRihA viShayAnprati |
tathArthakAmabhogeShu mamApi vigatA spRRihA
shlokas.16:
yadA chAyaM na bibheti yadA chAsmAnna bibhyati |
yadA nechChati na dveShTi tadA sidhyati vai dvijaH
shlokas.17:
yadA na kurute bhAvaM sarvabhUteShu pApakam |
karmaNA manasA vAchA brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.18:
na bhUto na bhaviShyashcha na cha dharmo.asti kashchana |
yo.abhayaH sarvabhUtAnAM sa prApnotyabhayaM padam
shlokas.19:
yasmAdudvijate lokaH sarvo mRRityumukhAdiva |
vAkkrUrAddaNDapAruShyAtsa prApnoti mahadbhayam
shlokas.20:
yathAvadvartamAnAnAM vRRiddhAnAM putrapautriNAm |
anuvartAmahe vRRittamahi.nsrANAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.21:
pranaShTaH shAshvato dharmaH sadAchAreNa mohitaH |
tena vaidyastapasvI vA balavAnvA vimohyate
shlokas.22:
AchArAjjAjale prAj~naH kShipraM dharmamavApnuyAt |
evaM yaH sAdhubhirdAntashcharedadrohachetasA
shlokas.23:
nadyAM yathA cheha kAShThamuhyamAnaM yadRRichChayA |
yadRRichChayaiva kAShThena sandhiM gachCheta kenachit
shlokas.24:
tatrAparANi dArUNi sa.nsRRijyante tatastataH |
tRRiNakAShThakarIShANi kadA chinnasamIkShayA
evamevAyamAchAraH prAdurbhUto yatastataH
shlokas.25:
yasmAnnodvijate bhUtaM jAtu ki~nchitkatha~nchana |
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyaH sa prApnoti sadA mune
shlokas.26:
yasmAdudvijate vidvansarvaloko vRRikAdiva |
kroshatastIramAsAdya yathA sarve jalecharAH
shlokas.27:
sahAyavAndravyavAnyaH subhago.anyo.aparastathA |
tatastAneva kavayaH shAstreShu pravadantyuta
kIrtyarthamalpahRRillekhAH paTavaH kRRitsnanirNayAH
shlokas.28:
tapobhiryaj~nadAnaishcha vAkyaiH praj~nAshritaistathA |
prApnotyabhayadAnasya yadyatphalamihAshnute
shlokas.29:
loke yaH sarvabhUtebhyo dadAtyabhayadakShiNAm |
sa sarvayaj~nairIjAnaH prApnotyabhayadakShiNAm
na bhUtAnAmahi.nsAyA jyAyAndharmo.asti kashchana
shlokas.30:
yasmAnnodvijate bhUtaM jAtu ki~nchitkatha~nchana |
so.abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyaH samprApnoti mahAmune
shlokas.31:
yasmAdudvijate lokaH sarpAdveshmagatAdiva |
na sa dharmamavApnoti iha loke paratra cha
shlokas.32:
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya samyagbhUtAni pashyataH |
devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padaiShiNaH
shlokas.33:
dAnaM bhUtAbhayasyAhuH sarvadAnebhya uttamam |
bravImi te satyamidaM shraddadhasva cha jAjale
shlokas.34:
sa eva subhago bhUtvA punarbhavati durbhagaH |
vyApattiM karmaNAM dRRiShTvA jugupsanti janAH sadA
shlokas.35:
akAraNo hi nehAsti dharmaH sUkShmo.api jAjale |
bhUtabhavyArthameveha dharmapravachanaM kRRitam
shlokas.36:
sUkShmatvAnna sa vij~nAtuM shakyate bahunihnavaH |
upalabhyAntarA chAnyAnAchArAnavabudhyate
shlokas.37:
ye cha Chindanti vRRiShaNAnye cha bhindanti nastakAn |
vahanti mahato bhArAnbadhnanti damayanti cha
shlokas.38:
hatvA sattvAni khAdanti tAnkathaM na vigarhase |
mAnuShA mAnuShAneva dAsabhogena bu~njate
shlokas.39:
vadhabandhavirodhena kArayanti divAnisham |
AtmanA chApi jAnAsi yadduHkhaM vadhatADane
shlokas.40:
pa~nchendriyeShu bhUteShu sarvaM vasati daivatam |
AdityashchandramA vAyurbrahmA prANaH kraturyamaH
shlokas.41:
tAni jIvAni vikrIya kA mRRiteShu vichAraNA |
kA taile kA ghRRite brahmanmadhunyapsvauShadheShu vA
shlokas.42:
ada.nshamashake deshe sukhaM sa.nvardhitAnpashUn |
tA.nshcha mAtuH priyA~njAnannAkramya bahudhA narAH
bahuda.nshakushAndeshAnnayanti bahukardamAn
shlokas.43:
vAhasampIDitA dhuryAH sIdantyavidhinApare |
na manye bhrUNahatyApi vishiShTA tena karmaNA
shlokas.44:
kRRiShiM sAdhviti manyante sA cha vRRittiH sudAruNA |
bhUmiM bhUmishayA.nshchaiva hanti kAShThamayomukham
tathaivAnaDuho yuktAnsamavekShasva jAjale
shlokas.45:
aghnyA iti gavAM nAma ka enAnhantumarhati |
mahachchakArAkushalaM pRRiShadhro gAlabhanniva
shlokas.46:
RRiShayo yatayo hyetannahuShe pratyavedayan |
gAM mAtaraM chApyavadhIrvRRiShabhaM cha prajApatim
akAryaM nahuShAkArShIrlapsyAmastvatkRRite bhayam
shlokas.47:
shataM chaikaM cha rogANAM sarvabhUteShvapAtayan |
RRiShayaste mahAbhAgAH prajAsveva hi jAjale
bhrUNahaM nahuShaM tvAhurna te hoShyAmahe haviH
shlokas.48:
ityuktvA te mahAtmAnaH sarve tattvArthadarshinaH |
RRiShayo yatayaH shAntAstarasA pratyavedayan
shlokas.49:
IdRRishAnashivAnghorAnAchArAniha jAjale |
kevalAcharitatvAttu nipuNAnnAvabudhyase
shlokas.50:
kAraNAddharmamanvichChenna lokacharitaM charet |
yo hanyAdyashcha mAM stauti tatrApi shRRiNu jAjale
shlokas.51:
samau tAvapi me syAtAM na hi me staH priyApriye |
etadIdRRishakaM dharmaM prasha.nsanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.52:
upapattyA hi sampanno yatibhishchaiva sevyate |
satataM dharmashIlaishcha naipuNyenopalakShitaH

shlokas.1:
jAjaliruvAcha||
yathA pravartito dharmastulAM dhArayatA tvayA |
svargadvAraM cha vRRittiM cha bhUtAnAmavarotsyate
shlokas.2:
kRRiShyA hyannaM prabhavati tatastvamapi jIvasi |
pashubhishchauShadhIbhishcha martyA jIvanti vANija
shlokas.3:
yato yaj~naH prabhavati nAstikyamapi jalpasi |
na hi vartedayaM loko vArtAmutsRRijya kevalam
shlokas.4:
tulAdhAra uvAcha||
vakShyAmi jAjale vRRittiM nAsmi brAhmaNa nAstikaH |
na cha yaj~naM vinindAmi yaj~navittu sudurlabhaH
shlokas.5:
namo brAhmaNayaj~nAya ye cha yaj~navido janAH |
svayaj~naM brAhmaNA hitvA kShAtraM yaj~namihAsthitAH
shlokas.6:
lubdhairvittaparairbrahmannAstikaiH sampravartitam |
vedavAdAnavij~nAya satyAbhAsamivAnRRitam
shlokas.7:
idaM deyamidaM deyamiti nAntaM chikIrShati |
ataH stainyaM prabhavati vikarmANi cha jAjale
tadeva sukRRitaM havyaM yena tuShyanti devatAH
shlokas.8:
namaskAreNa haviShA svAdhyAyairauShadhaistathA |
pUjA syAddevatAnAM hi yathA shAstranidarshanam
shlokas.9:
iShTApUrtAdasAdhUnAM viShamA jAyate prajA |
lubdhebhyo jAyate lubdhaH samebhyo jAyate samaH
shlokas.10:
yajamAno yathAtmAnamRRitvijashcha tathA prajAH |
yaj~nAtprajA prabhavati nabhaso.ambha ivAmalam
shlokas.11:
agnau prAstAhutirbrahmannAdityamupatiShThati |
AdityAjjAyate vRRiShTirvRRiShTerannaM tataH prajAH
shlokas.12:
tasmAtsvanuShThitAtpUrve sarvAnkAmA.nshcha lebhire |
akRRiShTapachyA pRRithivI AshIrbhirvIrudho.abhavan
na te yaj~neShvAtmasu vA phalaM pashyanti ki~nchana
shlokas.13:
sha~NkamAnAH phalaM yaj~ne ye yajerankatha~nchana |
jAyante.asAdhavo dhUrtA lubdhA vittaprayojanAH
shlokas.14:
sa sma pApakRRitAM lokAngachChedashubhakarmaNA |
pramANamapramANena yaH kuryAdashubhaM naraH
pApAtmA so.akRRitapraj~naH sadaiveha dvijottama
shlokas.15:
kartavyamiti kartavyaM vetti yo brAhmaNobhayam |
brahmaiva vartate loke naiti kartavyatAM punaH
shlokas.16:
viguNaM cha punaH karma jyAya ityanushushruma |
sarvabhUtopaghAtashcha phalabhAve cha sa.nyamaH
shlokas.17:
satyayaj~nA damayaj~nA alubdhAshchAtmatRRiptayaH |
utpannatyAginaH sarve janA AsannamatsarAH
shlokas.18:
kShetrakShetraj~natattvaj~nAH svayaj~napariniShThitAH |
brAhmaM vedamadhIyantastoShayantyamarAnapi
shlokas.19:
akhilaM daivataM sarvaM brahma brAhmaNasa.nshritam |
tRRipyanti tRRipyato devAstRRiptAstRRiptasya jAjale
shlokas.20:
yathA sarvarasaistRRipto nAbhinandati ki~nchana |
tathA praj~nAnatRRiptasya nityaM tRRiptiH sukhodayA
shlokas.21:
dharmArAmA dharmasukhAH kRRitsnavyavasitAstathA |
asti nastattvato bhUya iti praj~nAgaveShiNaH
shlokas.22:
j~nAnavij~nAninaH kechitparaM pAraM titIrShavaH |
atIva tatsadA puNyaM puNyAbhijanasaMhitam
shlokas.23:
yatra gatvA na shochanti na chyavanti vyathanti cha |
te tu tadbrahmaNaH sthAnaM prApnuvantIha sAttvikAH
shlokas.24:
naiva te svargamichChanti na yajanti yashodhanaiH |
satAM vartmAnuvartante yathAbalamahi.nsayA
shlokas.25:
vanaspatInoShadhIshcha phalamUlaM cha te viduH |
na chaitAnRRitvijo lubdhA yAjayanti dhanArthinaH
shlokas.26:
svameva chArthaM kurvANA yaj~naM chakruH punardvijAH |
pariniShThitakarmANaH prajAnugrahakAmyayA
shlokas.27:
prApayeyuH prajAH svargaM svadharmacharaNena vai |
iti me vartate buddhiH samA sarvatra jAjale
shlokas.28:
prayu~njate yAni yaj~ne sadA prAj~nA dvijarShabha |
tena te devayAnena pathA yAnti mahAmune
shlokas.29:
AvRRittistatra chaikasya nAstyAvRRittirmanIShiNAm |
ubhau tau devayAnena gachChato jAjale pathA
shlokas.30:
svayaM chaiShAmanaDuho yujyanti cha vahanti cha |
svayamusrAshcha duhyante manaHsa~NkalpasiddhibhiH
shlokas.31:
svayaM yUpAnupAdAya yajante svAptadakShiNaiH |
yastathAbhAvitAtmA syAtsa gAmAlabdhumarhati
shlokas.32:
oShadhIbhistathA brahmanyajera.nste natAdRRishAH |
buddhityAgaM puraskRRitya tAdRRishaM prabravImi te
shlokas.33:
nirAshiShamanArambhaM nirnamaskAramastutim |
akShINaM kShINakarmANaM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.34:
nAshrAvayanna cha yajanna dadadbrAhmaNeShu cha |
grAmyAM vRRittiM lipsamAnaH kAM gatiM yAti jAjale
idaM tu daivataM kRRitvA yathA yaj~namavApnuyAt
shlokas.35:
jAjaliruvAcha||
na vai munInAM shRRiNumaH sma tattvaM; pRRichChAmi tvA vANija kaShTametat |
pUrve pUrve chAsya nAvekShamANA; nAtaH paraM tamRRiShayaH sthApayanti
shlokas.36:
asminnevAtmatIrthe na pashavaH prApnuyuH sukham |
atha svakarmaNA kena vANija prApnuyAtsukham
sha.nsa me tanmahAprAj~na bhRRishaM vai shraddadhAmi te
shlokas.37:
tulAdhAra uvAcha||
uta yaj~nA utAyaj~nA makhaM nArhanti te kvachit |
Ajyena payasA dadhnA pUrNAhutyA visheShataH
vAlaiH shRRi~NgeNa pAdena sambhavatyeva gaurmakham
shlokas.38:
patnIM chAnena vidhinA prakaroti niyojayan |
puroDAsho hi sarveShAM pashUnAM medhya uchyate
shlokas.39:
sarvA nadyaH sarasvatyaH sarve puNyAH shilochchayAH |
jAjale tIrthamAtmaiva mA sma deshAtithirbhava
shlokas.40:
etAnIdRRishakAndharmAnAcharanniha jAjale |
kAraNairdharmamanvichChanna lokAnApnute shubhAn
shlokas.41:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etAnIdRRishakAndharmA.nstulAdhAraH prasha.nsati |
upapattyA hi sampannAnnityaM sadbhirniShevitAn

shlokas.1:
tulAdhAra uvAcha||
sadbhirvA yadi vAsadbhirayaM panthAH samAshritaH |
pratyakShaM kriyatAM sAdhu tato j~nAsyasi tadyathA
shlokas.2:
ete shakuntA bahavaH samantAdvicharanti hi |
tavottamA~Nge sambhUtAH shyenAshchAnyAshcha jAtayaH
shlokas.3:
AhvayainAnmahAbrahmanvishamAnA.nstatastataH |
pashyemAnhastapAdeShu shliShTAndehe cha sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
sambhAvayanti pitaraM tvayA sambhAvitAH khagAH |
asa.nshayaM pitA cha tvaM putrAnAhvaya jAjale
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato jAjalinA tena samAhUtAH patatriNaH |
vAchamuchchArayandivyAM dharmasya vachanAtkila
shlokas.6:
ahi.nsAdikRRitaM karma iha chaiva paratra cha |
spardhA nihanti vai brahmansAhatA hanti taM naram
shlokas.7:
shraddhAvRRiddhaM vA~NmanasI na yaj~nastrAtumarhati |
atra gAthA brahmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH
shlokas.8:
shucherashraddadhAnasya shraddadhAnasya chAshucheH |
devAshchittamamanyanta sadRRishaM yaj~nakarmaNi
shlokas.9:
shrotriyasya kadaryasya vadAnyasya cha vArdhuSheH |
mImA.nsitvobhayaM devAH samamannamakalpayan
shlokas.10:
prajApatistAnuvAcha viShamaM kRRitamityuta |
shraddhApUtaM vadAnyasya hatamashraddhayetarat
bhojyamannaM vadAnyasya kadaryasya na vArdhuSheH
shlokas.11:
ashraddadhAna evaiko devAnAM nArhate haviH |
tasyaivAnnaM na bhoktavyamiti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.12:
ashraddhA paramaM pApaM shraddhA pApapramochanI |
jahAti pApaM shraddhAvAnsarpo jIrNAmiva tvacham
shlokas.13:
jyAyasI yA pavitrANAM nivRRittiH shraddhayA saha |
nivRRittashIladoSho yaH shraddhAvAnpUta eva saH
shlokas.14:
kiM tasya tapasA kAryaM kiM vRRittena kimAtmanA |
shraddhAmayo.ayaM puruSho yo yachChraddhaH sa eva saH
shlokas.15:
iti dharmaH samAkhyAtaH sadbhirdharmArthadarshibhiH |
vayaM jij~nAsamAnAstvA samprAptA dharmadarshanAt
shlokas.16:
spardhAM jahi mahAprAj~na tataH prApsyasi yatparam |
shraddhAvA~nshraddadhAnashcha dharmA.nshchaiveha vANijaH
svavartmani sthitashchaiva garIyAneSha jAjale
shlokas.17:
evaM bahumatArthaM cha tulAdhAreNa bhAShitam |
samyakchaivamupAlabdho dharmashchoktaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.18:
tasya vikhyAtavIryasya shrutvA vAkyAni sa dvijaH |
tulAdhArasya kaunteya shAntimevAnvapadyata
shlokas.19:
tato.achireNa kAlena tulAdhAraH sa eva cha |
divaM gatvA mahAprAj~nau viharetAM yathAsukham
svaM svaM sthAnamupAgamya svakarmaphalanirjitam
shlokas.20:
samAnAM shraddadhAnAnAM sa.nyatAnAM suchetasAm |
kurvatAM yaj~na ityeva na yaj~no jAtu neShyate
shlokas.21:
shraddhA vai sAttvikI devI sUryasya duhitA nRRipa |
sAvitrI prasavitrI cha jIvavishvAsinI tathA
shlokas.22:
vAgvRRiddhaM trAyate shraddhA manovRRiddhaM cha bhArata |
yathaupamyopadeshena kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
prajAnAmanukampArthaM gItaM rAj~nA vichakhnunA
shlokas.2:
ChinnasthUNaM vRRiShaM dRRiShTvA virAvaM cha gavAM bhRRisham |
gograhe yaj~navATasya prekShamANaH sa pArthivaH
shlokas.3:
svasti gobhyo.astu lokeShu tato nirvachanaM kRRitam |
hi.nsAyAM hi pravRRittAyAmAshIreShAnukalpitA
shlokas.4:
avyavasthitamaryAdairvimUDhairnAstikairnaraiH |
sa.nshayAtmabhiravyaktairhi.nsA samanukIrtitA
shlokas.5:
sarvakarmasvahi.nsA hi dharmAtmA manurabravIt |
kAmarAgAdvihi.nsanti bahirvedyAM pashUnnarAH
shlokas.6:
tasmAtpramANataH kAryo dharmaH sUkShmo vijAnatA |
ahi.nsaiva hi sarvebhyo dharmebhyo jyAyasI matA
shlokas.7:
upoShya sa.nshito bhUtvA hitvA vedakRRitAH shrutIH |
AchAra ityanAchArAH kRRipaNAH phalahetavaH
shlokas.8:
yadi yaj~nA.nshcha vRRikShA.nshcha yUpA.nshchoddishya mAnavAH |
vRRithA mA.nsAni khAdanti naiSha dharmaH prashasyate
shlokas.9:
mA.nsaM madhu surA matsyA AsavaM kRRisaraudanam |
dhUrtaiH pravartitaM hyetannaitadvedeShu kalpitam
shlokas.10:
kAmAnmohAchcha lobhAchcha laulyametatpravartitam |
viShNumevAbhijAnanti sarvayaj~neShu brAhmaNAH
pAyasaiH sumanobhishcha tasyApi yajanaM smRRitam
shlokas.11:
yaj~niyAshchaiva ye vRRikShA vedeShu parikalpitAH |
yachchApi ki~nchitkartavyamanyachchokShaiH susa.nskRRitam
mahAsattvaiH shuddhabhAvaiH sarvaM devArhameva tat
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sharIramApadashchApi vivadantyavihi.nsataH |
kathaM yAtrA sharIrasya nirArambhasya setsyati
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yathA sharIraM na glAyenneyAnmRRityuvashaM yathA |
tathA karmasu varteta samartho dharmamAcharet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM kAryaM parIkSheta shIghraM vAtha chireNa vA |
sarvathA kAryadurge.asminbhavAnnaH paramo guruH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
chirakArestu yatpUrvaM vRRittamA~Ngirase kule
shlokas.3:
chirakArika bhadraM te bhadraM te chirakArika |
chirakArI hi medhAvI nAparAdhyati karmasu
shlokas.4:
chirakArI mahAprAj~no gautamasyAbhavatsutaH |
chiraM hi sarvakAryANi samekShAvAnprapadyate
shlokas.5:
chiraM sa~nchintayannarthA.nshchiraM jAgrachchiraM svapan |
chirakAryAbhisampatteshchirakArI tathochyate
shlokas.6:
alasagrahaNaM prApto durmedhAvI tathochyate |
buddhilAghavayuktena janenAdIrghadarshinA
shlokas.7:
vyabhichAre tu kasmi.nshchidvyatikramyAparAnsutAn |
pitroktaH kupitenAtha jahImAM jananImiti
shlokas.8:
sa tatheti chireNoktvA svabhAvAchchirakArikaH |
vimRRishya chirakAritvAchchintayAmAsa vai chiram
shlokas.9:
piturAj~nAM kathaM kuryAM na hanyAM mAtaraM katham |
kathaM dharmachChale nAsminnimajjeyamasAdhuvat
shlokas.10:
piturAj~nA paro dharmaH svadharmo mAtRRirakShaNam |
asvatantraM cha putratvaM kiM nu mAM nAtra pIDayet
shlokas.11:
striyaM hatvA mAtaraM cha ko hi jAtu sukhI bhavet |
pitaraM chApyavaj~nAya kaH pratiShThAmavApnuyAt
shlokas.12:
anavaj~nA pituryuktA dhAraNaM mAtRRirakShaNam |
yuktakShamAvubhAvetau nAtivartetamAM katham
shlokas.13:
pitA hyAtmAnamAdhatte jAyAyAM jaj~niyAmiti |
shIlachAritragotrasya dhAraNArthaM kulasya cha
shlokas.14:
so.ahamAtmA svayaM pitrA putratve prakRRitaH punaH |
vij~nAnaM me kathaM na syAdbubudhe chAtmasambhavam
shlokas.15:
jAtakarmaNi yatprAha pitA yachchopakarmaNi |
paryAptaH sa dRRiDhIkAraH piturgauravanishchaye
shlokas.16:
gururagryaH paro dharmaH poShaNAdhyayanAddhitaH |
pitA yadAha dharmaH sa vedeShvapi sunishchitaH
shlokas.17:
prItimAtraM pituH putraH sarvaM putrasya vai pitA |
sharIrAdIni deyAni pitA tvekaH prayachChati
shlokas.18:
tasmAtpiturvachaH kAryaM na vichAryaM katha~nchana |
pAtakAnyapi pUyante piturvachanakAriNaH
shlokas.19:
bhoge bhAgye prasavane sarvalokanidarshane |
bhartrA chaiva samAyoge sImantonnayane tathA
shlokas.20:
pitA svargaH pitA dharmaH pitA paramakaM tapaH |
pitari prItimApanne sarvAH prIyanti devatAH
shlokas.21:
AshiShastA bhajantyenaM puruShaM prAha yAH pitA |
niShkRRitiH sarvapApAnAM pitA yadabhinandati
shlokas.22:
muchyate bandhanAtpuShpaM phalaM vRRintAtpramuchyate |
klishyannapi sutasnehaiH pitA snehaM na mu~nchati
shlokas.23:
etadvichintitaM tAvatputrasya pitRRigauravam |
pitA hyalpataraM sthAnaM chintayiShyAmi mAtaram
shlokas.24:
yo hyayaM mayi sa~NghAto martyatve pA~nchabhautikaH |
asya me jananI hetuH pAvakasya yathAraNiH
mAtA dehAraNiH pu.nsAM sarvasyArtasya nirvRRitiH
shlokas.25:
na cha shochati nApyenaM sthAviryamapakarShati |
shriyA hIno.api yo gehe ambeti pratipadyate
shlokas.26:
putrapautrasamAkIrNo jananIM yaH samAshritaH |
api varShashatasyAnte sa dvihAyanavachcharet
shlokas.27:
samarthaM vAsamarthaM vA kRRishaM vApyakRRishaM tathA |
rakShatyeva sutaM mAtA nAnyaH poShTA vidhAnataH
shlokas.28:
tadA sa vRRiddho bhavati yadA bhavati duHkhitaH |
tadA shUnyaM jagattasya yadA mAtrA viyujyate
shlokas.29:
nAsti mAtRRisamA ChAyA nAsti mAtRRisamA gatiH |
nAsti mAtRRisamaM trANaM nAsti mAtRRisamA prapA
shlokas.30:
kukShisandhAraNAddhAtrI jananAjjananI smRRitA |
a~NgAnAM vardhanAdambA vIrasUtvena vIrasUH
shlokas.31:
shishoH shushrUShaNAchChushrUrmAtA dehamanantaram |
chetanAvAnnaro hanyAdyasya nAsuShiraM shiraH
shlokas.32:
dampatyoH prANasa.nshleShe yo.abhisandhiH kRRitaH kila |
taM mAtA vA pitA veda bhUtArtho mAtari sthitaH
shlokas.33:
mAtA jAnAti yadgotraM mAtA jAnAti yasya saH |
mAturbharaNamAtreNa prItiH snehaH pituH prajAH
shlokas.34:
pANibandhaM svayaM kRRitvA sahadharmamupetya cha |
yadi yApyanti puruShAH striyo nArhanti yApyatAm
shlokas.35:
bharaNAddhi striyo bhartA pAtyAchchaiva striyAH patiH |
guNasyAsya nivRRittau tu na bhartA na patiH patiH
shlokas.36:
evaM strI nAparAdhnoti nara evAparAdhyati |
vyuchchara.nshcha mahAdoShaM nara evAparAdhyati
shlokas.37:
striyA hi paramo bhartA daivataM paramaM smRRitam |
tasyAtmanA tu sadRRishamAtmAnaM paramaM dadau
sarvakAryAparAdhyatvAnnAparAdhyanti chA~NganAH
shlokas.38:
yashchanokto hi nirdeshaH striyA maithunatRRiptaye |
tasya smArayato vyaktamadharmo nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.39:
yAvannArIM mAtaraM cha gaurave chAdhike sthitAm |
avadhyAM tu vijAnIyuH pashavo.apyavichakShaNAH
shlokas.40:
devatAnAM samAvAyamekasthaM pitaraM viduH |
martyAnAM devatAnAM cha snehAdabhyeti mAtaram
shlokas.41:
evaM vimRRishatastasya chirakAritayA bahu |
dIrghaH kAlo vyatikrAntastatastasyAgamatpitA
shlokas.42:
medhAtithirmahAprAj~no gautamastapasi sthitaH |
vimRRishya tena kAlena patnyAH sa.nsthAvyatikramam
shlokas.43:
so.abravIdduHkhasantapto bhRRishamashrUNi vartayan |
shrutadhairyaprasAdena pashchAttApamupAgataH
shlokas.44:
AshramaM mama samprAptastrilokeshaH pura.ndaraH |
atithivratamAsthAya brAhmaNaM rUpamAsthitaH
shlokas.45:
samayA sAntvito vAgbhiH svAgatenAbhipUjitaH |
arghyaM pAdyaM cha nyAyena tayAbhipratipAditaH
shlokas.46:
paravatyasmi chApyuktaH praNayiShye nayena cha |
atra chAkushale jAte striyo nAsti vyatikramaH
shlokas.47:
evaM na strI na chaivAhaM nAdhvagastridasheshvaraH |
aparAdhyati dharmasya pramAdastvaparAdhyati
shlokas.48:
IrShyAjaM vyasanaM prAhustena chaivordhvaretasaH |
IrShyayA tvahamAkShipto magno duShkRRitasAgare
shlokas.49:
hatvA sAdhvIM cha nArIM cha vyasanitvAchcha shAsitAm |
bhartavyatvena bhAryAM cha ko nu mAM tArayiShyati
shlokas.50:
antareNa mayAj~naptashchirakArI hyudAradhIH |
yadyadya chirakArI syAtsa mAM trAyeta pAtakAt
shlokas.51:
chirakArika bhadraM te bhadraM te chirakArika |
yadyadya chirakArI tvaM tato.asi chirakArikaH
shlokas.52:
trAhi mAM mAtaraM chaiva tapo yachchArjitaM mayA |
AtmAnaM pAtakebhyashcha bhavAdya chirakArikaH
shlokas.53:
sahajaM chirakAritvaM chiraprAj~natayA tava |
saphalaM tattavAdyAstu bhavAdya chirakArikaH
shlokas.54:
chiramAsha.nsito mAtrA chiraM garbheNa dhAritaH |
saphalaM chirakAritvaM kuru tvaM chirakArika
shlokas.55:
chirAyate cha santApAchchiraM svapiti vAritaH |
AvayoshchirasantApAdavekShya chirakArika
shlokas.56:
evaM sa duHkhito rAjanmaharShirgautamastadA |
chirakAriM dadarshAtha putraM sthitamathAntike
shlokas.57:
chirakArI tu pitaraM dRRiShTvA paramaduHkhitaH |
shastraM tyaktvA tato mUrdhnA prasAdAyopachakrame
shlokas.58:
gautamastu sutaM dRRiShTvA shirasA patitaM bhuvi |
patnIM chaiva nirAkArAM parAmabhyagamanmudam
shlokas.59:
na hi sA tena sambhedaM patnI nItA mahAtmanA |
vijane chAshramasthena putrashchApi samAhitaH
shlokas.60:
hanyAttvanapavAdena shastrapANau sute sthite |
vinItaM prashnayitvA cha vyavasyedAtmakarmasu
shlokas.61:
buddhishchAsItsutaM dRRiShTvA pitushcharaNayornatam |
shastragrahaNachApalyaM sa.nvRRiNoti bhayAditi
shlokas.62:
tataH pitrA chiraM stutvA chiraM chAghrAya mUrdhani |
chiraM dorbhyAM pariShvajya chiraM jIvetyudAhRRitaH
shlokas.63:
evaM sa gautamaH putraM prItiharShasamanvitaH |
abhinandya mahAprAj~na idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.64:
chirakArika bhadraM te chirakArI chiraM bhava |
chirAyamANe tvayi cha chiramasmi suduHkhitaH
shlokas.65:
gAthAshchApyabravIdvidvAngautamo munisattamaH |
chirakAriShu dhIreShu guNoddeshasamAshrayAt
shlokas.66:
chireNa mitraM badhnIyAchchireNa cha kRRitaM tyajet |
chireNa hi kRRitaM mitraM chiraM dhAraNamarhati
shlokas.67:
rAge darpe cha mAne cha drohe pApe cha karmaNi |
apriye chaiva kartavye chirakArI prashasyate
shlokas.68:
bandhUnAM suhRRidAM chaiva bhRRityAnAM strIjanasya cha |
avyakteShvaparAdheShu chirakArI prashasyate
shlokas.69:
evaM sa gautamastasya prItaH putrasya bhArata |
karmaNA tena kauravya chirakAritayA tayA
shlokas.70:
evaM sarveShu kAryeShu vimRRishya puruShastataH |
chireNa nishchayaM kRRitvA chiraM na paritapyate
shlokas.71:
chiraM dhArayate roShaM chiraM karma niyachChati |
pashchAttApakaraM karma na ki~nchidupapadyate
shlokas.72:
chiraM vRRiddhAnupAsIta chiramanvAsya pUjayet |
chiraM dharmAnniSheveta kuryAchchAnveShaNaM chiram
shlokas.73:
chiramanvAsya viduShashchiraM shiShTAnniShevya cha |
chiraM vinIya chAtmAnaM chiraM yAtyanavaj~natAm
shlokas.74:
bruvatashcha parasyApi vAkyaM dharmopasaMhitam |
chiraM pRRichChechchiraM brUyAchchiraM na paribhUyate
shlokas.75:
upAsya bahulAstasminnAshrame sumahAtapAH |
samAH svargaM gato vipraH putreNa sahitastadA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM rAjA prajA rakShenna cha ki~nchitpratApayet |
pRRichChAmi tvAM satAM shreShTha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
dyumatsenasya sa.nvAdaM rAj~nA satyavatA saha
shlokas.3:
avyAhRRitaM vyAjahAra satyavAniti naH shrutam |
vadhAya nIyamAneShu piturevAnushAsanAt
shlokas.4:
adharmatAM yAti dharmo yAtyadharmashcha dharmatAm |
vadho nAma bhaveddharmo naitadbhavitumarhati
shlokas.5:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
atha chedavadho dharmo dharmaH ko jAtu chidbhavet |
dasyavashchenna hanyeransatyavansa~Nkaro bhavet
shlokas.6:
mamedamiti nAsyaitatpravarteta kalau yuge |
lokayAtrA na chaiva syAdatha chedvettha sha.nsa naH
shlokas.7:
satyavAnuvAcha||
sarva eva trayo varNAH kAryA brAhmaNabandhanAH |
dharmapAshanibaddhAnAmalpo vyapachariShyati
shlokas.8:
yo yasteShAmapacharettamAchakShIta vai dvijaH |
ayaM me na shRRiNotIti tasminrAjA pradhArayet
shlokas.9:
tattvAbhedena yachChAstraM tatkAryaM nAnyathA vadhaH |
asamIkShyaiva karmANi nItishAstraM yathAvidhi
shlokas.10:
dasyUnhinasti vai rAjA bhUyaso vApyanAgasaH |
bhAryA mAtA pitA putro hanyate puruShe hate
pareNApakRRite rAjA tasmAtsamyakpradhArayet
shlokas.11:
asAdhushchaiva puruSho labhate shIlamekadA |
sAdhoshchApi hyasAdhubhyo jAyate.ashobhanA prajA
shlokas.12:
na mUlaghAtaH kartavyo naiSha dharmaH sanAtanaH |
api khalvavadhenaiva prAyashchittaM vidhIyate
shlokas.13:
udvejanena bandhena virUpakaraNena cha |
vadhadaNDena te kleshyA na puro.ahitasampadA
shlokas.14:
yadA purohitaM vA te paryeyuH sharaNaiShiNaH |
kariShyAmaH punarbrahmanna pApamiti vAdinaH
shlokas.15:
tadA visargamarhAH syuritIdaM nRRipashAsanam |
bibhraddaNDAjinaM muNDo brAhmaNo.arhati vAsasam
shlokas.16:
garIyA.nso garIyA.nsamaparAdhe punaH punaH |
tathA visargamarhanti na yathA prathame tathA
shlokas.17:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
yatra yatraiva shakyeransa.nyantuM samaye prajAH |
sa tAvatprochyate dharmo yAvanna pratila~Nghyate
shlokas.18:
ahanyamAneShu punaH sarvameva parAbhavet |
pUrve pUrvatare chaiva sushAsyA abhava~njanAH
shlokas.19:
mRRidavaH satyabhUyiShThA alpadrohAlpamanyavaH |
purA dhigdaNDa evAsIdvAgdaNDastadanantaram
shlokas.20:
AsIdAdAnadaNDo.api vadhadaNDo.adya vartate |
vadhenApi na shakyante niyantumapare janAH
shlokas.21:
naiva dasyurmanuShyANAM na devAnAmiti shrutiH |
na gandharvapitR^INAM cha kaH kasyeha na kashchana
shlokas.22:
padmaM shmashAnAdAdatte pishAchAchchApi daivatam |
teShu yaH samayaM kuryAdaj~neShu hatabuddhiShu
shlokas.23:
satyavAnuvAcha||
tAnna shaknoShi chetsAdhUnparitrAtumahi.nsayA |
kasyachidbhUtabhavyasya lAbhenAntaM tathA kuru
shlokas.24:
dyumatsena uvAcha||
rAjAno lokayAtrArthaM tapyante paramaM tapaH |
apatrapanti tAdRRigbhyastathAvRRittA bhavanti cha
shlokas.25:
vitrAsyamAnAH sukRRito na kAmAdghnanti duShkRRitIn |
sukRRitenaiva rAjAno bhUyiShThaM shAsate prajAH
shlokas.26:
shreyasaH shreyasImevaM vRRittiM loko.anuvartate |
sadaiva hi gurorvRRittamanuvartanti mAnavAH
shlokas.27:
AtmAnamasamAdhAya samAdhitsati yaH parAn |
viShayeShvindriyavashaM mAnavAH prahasanti tam
shlokas.28:
yo rAj~no dambhamohena ki~nchitkuryAdasAmpratam |
sarvopAyairniyamyaH sa tathA pApAnnivartate
shlokas.29:
AtmaivAdau niyantavyo duShkRRitaM saMniyachChatA |
daNDayechcha mahAdaNDairapi bandhUnanantarAn
shlokas.30:
yatra vai pApakRRitkleshyo na mahadduHkhamarChati |
vardhante tatra pApAni dharmo hrasati cha dhruvam
iti kAruNyashIlastu vidvAnvai brAhmaNo.anvashAt
shlokas.31:
iti chaivAnushiShTo.asmi pUrvaistAta pitAmahaiH |
AshvAsayadbhiH subhRRishamanukroshAttathaiva cha
shlokas.32:
etatprathamakalpena rAjA kRRitayuge.abhajat |
pAdonenApi dharmeNa gachChettretAyuge tathA
dvApare tu dvipAdena pAdena tvapare yuge
shlokas.33:
tathA kaliyuge prApte rAj~nAM dushcharitena ha |
bhavetkAlavisheSheNa kalA dharmasya ShoDashI
shlokas.34:
atha prathamakalpena satyavansa~Nkaro bhavet |
AyuH shaktiM cha kAlaM cha nirdishya tapa Adishet
shlokas.35:
satyAya hi yathA neha jahyAddharmaphalaM mahat |
bhUtAnAmanukampArthaM manuH svAyambhuvo.abravIt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
avirodhena bhUtAnAM tyAgaH ShADguNyakArakaH |
yaH syAdubhayabhAgdharmastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
gArhasthyasya cha dharmasya tyAgadharmasya chobhayoH |
adUrasamprasthitayoH kiM svichChreyaH pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ubhau dharmau mahAbhAgAvubhau paramadushcharau |
ubhau mahAphalau tAta sadbhirAcharitAvubhau
shlokas.4:
atra te vartayiShyAmi prAmANyamubhayostayoH |
shRRiNuShvaikamanAH pArtha ChinnadharmArthasa.nshayam
shlokas.5:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
kapilasya goshcha sa.nvAdaM tannibodha yudhiShThira
shlokas.6:
AmnAyamanupashyanhi purANaM shAshvataM dhruvam |
nahuShaH pUrvamAlebhe tvaShTurgAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.7:
tAM niyuktAmadInAtmA sattvasthaH samaye rataH |
j~nAnavAnniyatAhAro dadarsha kapilastadA
shlokas.8:
sa buddhimuttamAM prApto naiShThikImakutobhayAm |
smarAmi shithilaM satyaM vedA ityabravItsakRRit
shlokas.9:
tAM gAmRRiShiH syUmarashmiH pravishya yatimabravIt |
haMho vedA yadi matA dharmAH kenApare matAH
shlokas.10:
tapasvino dhRRitimataH shrutivij~nAnachakShuShaH |
sarvamArShaM hi manyante vyAhRRitaM viditAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
tasyaivaM gatatRRiShNasya vijvarasya nirAshiShaH |
kA vivakShAsti vedeShu nirArambhasya sarvashaH
shlokas.12:
kapila uvAcha||
nAhaM vedAnvinindAmi na vivakShAmi karhichit |
pRRithagAshramiNAM karmANyekArthAnIti naH shrutam
shlokas.13:
gachChatyeva parityAgI vAnaprasthashcha gachChati |
gRRihastho brahmachArI cha ubhau tAvapi gachChataH
shlokas.14:
devayAnA hi panthAnashchatvAraH shAshvatA matAH |
teShAM jyAyaHkanIyastvaM phaleShUktaM balAbalam
shlokas.15:
evaM viditvA sarvArthAnArabhediti vaidikam |
nArabhediti chAnyatra naiShThikI shrUyate shrutiH
shlokas.16:
anArambhe hyadoShaH syAdArambhe.adoSha uttamaH |
evaM sthitasya shAstrasya durvij~neyaM balAbalam
shlokas.17:
yadyatra ki~nchitpratyakShamahi.nsAyAH paraM matam |
RRite tvAgamashAstrebhyo brUhi tadyadi pashyasi
shlokas.18:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
svargakAmo yajeteti satataM shrUyate shrutiH |
phalaM prakalpya pUrvaM hi tato yaj~naH pratAyate
shlokas.19:
ajashchAshvashcha meShashcha gaushcha pakShigaNAshcha ye |
grAmyAraNyA oShadhayaH prANasyAnnamiti shrutiH
shlokas.20:
tathaivAnnaM hyaharahaH sAyaM prAtarnirupyate |
pashavashchAtha dhAnyaM cha yaj~nasyA~Ngamiti shrutiH
shlokas.21:
etAni saha yaj~nena prajApatirakalpayat |
tena prajApatirdevAnyaj~nenAyajata prabhuH
shlokas.22:
te smAnyonya~ncharAH sarve prANinaH sapta sapta cha |
yaj~neShUpAkRRitaM vishvaM prAhuruttamasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.23:
etachchaivAbhyanuj~nAtaM pUrvaiH pUrvataraistathA |
ko jAtu na vichinvIta vidvAnsvAM shaktimAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
pashavashcha manuShyAshcha drumAshchauShadhibhiH saha |
svargamevAbhikA~NkShante na cha svargastvRRite makham
shlokas.25:
oShadhyaH pashavo vRRikShA vIrudAjyaM payo dadhi |
havirbhUmirdishaH shraddhA kAlashchaitAni dvAdasha
shlokas.26:
RRicho yajUMShi sAmAni yajamAnashcha ShoDashaH |
agnirj~neyo gRRihapatiH sa saptadasha uchyate
a~NgAnyetAni yaj~nasya yaj~no mUlamiti shrutiH
shlokas.27:
Ajyena payasA dadhnA shakRRitAmikShayA tvachA |
vAlaiH shRRi~NgeNa pAdena sambhavatyeva gaurmakham
evaM pratyekashaH sarvaM yadyadasya vidhIyate
shlokas.28:
yaj~naM vahanti sambhUya sahartvigbhiH sadakShiNaiH |
saMhatyaitAni sarvANi yaj~naM nirvartayantyuta
shlokas.29:
yaj~nArthAni hi sRRiShTAni yathA vai shrUyate shrutiH |
evaM pUrve pUrvatarAH pravRRittAshchaiva mAnavAH
shlokas.30:
na hinasti hyArabhate nAbhidruhyati ki~nchana |
yaj~no yaShTavya ityeva yo yajatyaphalepsayA
shlokas.31:
yaj~nA~NgAnyapi chaitAni yathoktAni nasa.nshayaH |
vidhinA vidhiyuktAni tArayanti parasparam
shlokas.32:
AmnAyamArShaM pashyAmi yasminvedAH pratiShThitAH |
taM vidvA.nso.anupashyanti brAhmaNasyAnudarshanAt
shlokas.33:
brAhmaNaprabhavo yaj~no brAhmaNArpaNa eva cha |
anu yaj~naM jagatsarvaM yaj~nashchAnu jagatsadA
shlokas.34:
omiti brahmaNo yonirnamaH svAhA svadhA vaShaT |
yasyaitAni prayujyante yathAshakti kRRitAnyapi
shlokas.35:
na tasya triShu lokeShu paralokabhayaM viduH |
iti vedA vadantIha siddhAshcha paramarShayaH
shlokas.36:
RRicho yajUMShi sAmAni stobhAshcha vidhichoditAH |
yasminnetAni sarvANi bahireva sa vai dvijaH
shlokas.37:
agnyAdheye yadbhavati yachcha some sute dvija |
yachchetarairmahAyaj~nairveda tadbhagavAnsvataH
shlokas.38:
tasmAdbrahmanyajetaiva yAjayechchAvichArayan |
yajataH svargavidhinA pretya svargaphalaM mahat
shlokas.39:
nAyaM loko.astyayaj~nAnAM parashcheti vinishchayaH |
vedavAdavidashchaiva pramANamubhayaM tadA

shlokas.1:
kapila uvAcha||
etAvadanupashyanto yatayo yAnti mArgagAH |
naiShAM sarveShu lokeShu kashchidasti vyatikramaH
shlokas.2:
nirdva.ndvA nirnamaskArA nirAshIrbandhanA budhAH |
vimuktAH sarvapApebhyashcharanti shuchayo.amalAH
shlokas.3:
apavarge.atha santyAge buddhau cha kRRitanishchayAH |
brahmiShThA brahmabhUtAshcha brahmaNyeva kRRitAlayAH
shlokas.4:
vishokA naShTarajasasteShAM lokAH sanAtanAH |
teShAM gatiM parAM prApya gArhasthye kiM prayojanam
shlokas.5:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
yadyeShA paramA niShThA yadyeShA paramA gatiH |
gRRihasthAnavyapAshritya nAshramo.anyaH pravartate
shlokas.6:
yathA mAtaramAshritya sarve jIvanti jantavaH |
evaM gRRihasthamAshritya vartanta itare.a.ashramAH
shlokas.7:
gRRihastha eva yajate gRRihasthastapyate tapaH |
gArhasthyamasya dharmasya mUlaM yatki~nchidejate
shlokas.8:
prajanAddhyabhinirvRRittAH sarve prANabhRRito mune |
prajanaM chApyutAnyatra na katha~nchana vidyate
shlokas.9:
yAstAH syurbahiroShadhyo bahvaraNyAstathA dvija |
oShadhibhyo bahiryasmAtprANI kashchinna vidyate
kasyaiShA vAgbhavetsatyA mokSho nAsti gRRihAditi
shlokas.10:
ashraddadhAnairaprAj~naiH sUkShmadarshanavarjitaiH |
nirAshairalasaiH shrAntaistapyamAnaiH svakarmabhiH
shramasyoparamo dRRiShTaH pravrajyA nAma paNDitaiH
shlokas.11:
trailokyasyaiva heturhi maryAdA shAshvatI dhruvA |
brAhmaNo nAma bhagavA~njanmaprabhRRiti pUjyate
shlokas.12:
prAggarbhAdhAnAnmantrA hi pravartante dvijAtiShu |
avishrambheShu vartante vishrambheShvapyasa.nshayam
shlokas.13:
dAhaH punaH sa.nshrayaNe sa.nsthite pAtrabhojanam |
dAnaM gavAM pashUnAM vA piNDAnAM chApsu majjanam
shlokas.14:
archiShmanto barhiShadaH kravyAdAH pitaraH smRRitAH |
mRRitasyApyanumanyante mantrA mantrAshcha kAraNam
shlokas.15:
evaM kroshatsu vedeShu kuto mokSho.asti kasyachit |
RRiNavanto yadA martyAH pitRRidevadvijAtiShu
shlokas.16:
shriyA vihInairalasaiH paNDitairapalApitam |
vedavAdAparij~nAnaM satyAbhAsamivAnRRitam
shlokas.17:
na vai pApairhriyate kRRiShyate vA; yo brAhmaNo yajate vedashAstraiH |
UrdhvaM yaj~naH pashubhiH sArdhameti; santarpitastarpayate cha kAmaiH
shlokas.18:
na vedAnAM paribhavAnna shAThyena na mAyayA |
mahatprApnoti puruSho brahma brahmaNi vindati
shlokas.19:
kapila uvAcha||
darshaM cha paurNamAsaM cha agnihotraM cha dhImatAm |
chAturmAsyAni chaivAsa.nsteShu yaj~naH sanAtanaH
shlokas.20:
anArambhAH sudhRRitayaH shuchayo brahmasa.nshritAH |
brahmaNaiva sma te devA.nstarpayantyamRRitaiShiNaH
shlokas.21:
sarvabhUtAtmabhUtasya sarvabhUtAni pashyataH |
devApi mArge muhyanti apadasya padaiShiNaH
shlokas.22:
chaturdvAraM puruShaM chaturmukhaM; chaturdhA chainamupayAti nindA |
bAhubhyAM vAcha udarAdupasthA;tteShAM dvAraM dvArapAlo bubhUShet
shlokas.23:
nAkShairdIvyennAdadItAnyavittaM; na vAyonIyasya shRRitaM pragRRihNet |
kruddho na chaiva prahareta dhImAM;stathAsya tatpANipAdaM suguptam
shlokas.24:
nAkroshamarChenna mRRiShA vadechcha; na paishunaM janavAdaM cha kuryAt |
satyavrato mitabhASho.apramatta;stathAsya vAgdvAramatho suguptam
shlokas.25:
nAnAshanaH syAnna mahAshanaH syA;dalolupaH sAdhubhirAgataH syAt |
yAtrArthamAhAramihAdadIta; tathAsya syAjjATharI dvAraguptiH
shlokas.26:
na vIrapatnIM vihareta nArIM; na chApi nArImanRRitAvAhvayIta |
bhAryAvrataM hyAtmani dhArayIta; tathAsyopasthadvAraguptirbhaveta
shlokas.27:
dvArANi yasya sarvANi suguptAni manIShiNaH |
upasthamudaraM bAhU vAkchaturthI sa vai dvijaH
shlokas.28:
moghAnyaguptadvArasya sarvANyeva bhavantyuta |
kiM tasya tapasA kAryaM kiM yaj~nena kimAtmanA
shlokas.29:
anuttarIyavasanamanupastIrNashAyinam |
bAhUpadhAnaM shAmyantaM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.30:
dva.ndvArAmeShu sarveShu ya eko ramate muniH |
pareShAmananudhyAya.nstaM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.31:
yena sarvamidaM buddhaM prakRRitirvikRRitishcha yA |
gatij~naH sarvabhUtAnAM taM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.32:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyaH sarveShAmabhayaM yataH |
sarvabhUtAtmabhUto yastaM devA brAhmaNaM viduH
shlokas.33:
nAntareNAnujAnanti vedAnAM yatkriyAphalam |
anuj~nAya cha tatsarvamanyadrochayate.aphalam
shlokas.34:
phalavanti cha karmANi vyuShTimanti dhruvANi cha |
viguNAni cha pashyanti tathAnaikAntikAni cha
shlokas.35:
guNAshchAtra sudurj~neyA j~nAtAshchApi suduShkarAH |
anuShThitAshchAntavanta iti tvamanupashyasi
shlokas.36:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
yathA cha vedaprAmANyaM tyAgashcha saphalo yathA |
tau panthAnAvubhau vyaktau bhagava.nstadbravIhi me
shlokas.37:
kapila uvAcha||
pratyakShamiha pashyanti bhavantaH satpathe sthitAH |
pratyakShaM tu kimatrAsti yadbhavanta upAsate
shlokas.38:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
syUmarashmirahaM brahma~njij~nAsArthamihAgataH |
shreyaskAmaH pratyavochamArjavAnna vivakShayA
imaM cha sa.nshayaM ghoraM bhagavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.39:
pratyakShamiha pashyanto bhavantaH satpathe sthitAH |
kimatra pratyakShatamaM bhavanto yadupAsate
anyatra tarkashAstrebhya AgamAchcha yathAgamam
shlokas.40:
Agamo vedavAdastu tarkashAstrANi chAgamaH |
yathAgamamupAsIta Agamastatra sidhyati
siddhiH pratyakSharUpA cha dRRishyatyAgamanishchayAt
shlokas.41:
naurnAvIva nibaddhA hi srotasA sanibandhanA |
hriyamANA kathaM vipra kubuddhI.nstArayiShyati
etadbravItu bhagavAnupapanno.asmyadhIhi bhoH
shlokas.42:
naiva tyAgI na santuShTo nAshoko na nirAmayaH |
na nirvivitso nAvRRitto nApavRRitto.asti kashchana
shlokas.43:
bhavanto.api cha hRRiShyanti shochanti cha yathA vayam |
indriyArthAshcha bhavatAM samAnAH sarvajantuShu
shlokas.44:
evaM chaturNAM varNAnAmAshramANAM pravRRittiShu |
ekamAlambamAnAnAM nirNaye kiM nirAmayam
shlokas.45:
kapila uvAcha||
yadyadAcharate shAstramatha sarvapravRRittiShu |
yasya yatra hyanuShThAnaM tatra tatra nirAmayam
shlokas.46:
sarvaM pAvayate j~nAnaM yo j~nAnaM hyanuvartate |
j~nAnAdapetya yA vRRittiH sA vinAshayati prajAH
shlokas.47:
bhavanto j~nAnino nityaM sarvatashcha nirAgamAH |
aikAtmyaM nAma kashchiddhi kadAchidabhipadyate
shlokas.48:
shAstraM hyabuddhvA tattvena kechidvAdabalA janAH |
kAmadveShAbhibhUtatvAdaha~NkAravashaM gatAH
shlokas.49:
yAthAtathyamavij~nAya shAstrANAM shAstradasyavaH |
brahmastenA nirArambhA apakvamatayo.ashivAH
shlokas.50:
vaiguNyameva pashyanti na guNAnanuyu~njate |
teShAM tamaHsharIrANAM tama eva parAyaNam
shlokas.51:
yo yathAprakRRitirjantuH prakRRiteH syAdvashAnugaH |
tasya dveShashcha kAmashcha krodho dambho.anRRitaM madaH
nityamevAbhivartante guNAH prakRRitisambhavAH
shlokas.52:
etadbuddhyAnupashyantaH santyajeyuH shubhAshubham |
parAM gatimabhIpsanto yatayaH sa.nyame ratAH
shlokas.53:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
sarvametanmayA brahma~nshAstrataH parikIrtitam |
na hyavij~nAya shAtrArthaM pravartante pravRRittayaH
shlokas.54:
yaH kashchinnyAyya AchAraH sarvaM shAstramiti shrutiH |
yadanyAyyamashAstraM tadityeShA shrUyate shrutiH
shlokas.55:
na pravRRittirRRite shAstrAtkAchidastIti nishchayaH |
yadanyadvedavAdebhyastadashAstramiti shrutiH
shlokas.56:
shAstrAdapetaM pashyanti bahavo vyaktamAninaH |
shAstradoShAnna pashyanti iha chAmutra chApare
avij~nAnahatapraj~nA hInapraj~nAstamovRRitAH
shlokas.57:
shakyaM tvekena muktena kRRitakRRityena sarvashaH |
piNDamAtraM vyapAshritya charituM sarvatodisham
vedavAdaM vyapAshritya mokSho.astIti prabhAShitum
shlokas.58:
idaM tu duShkaraM karma kuTumbamabhisa.nshritam |
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~naH prajAsantAnamArjavam
shlokas.59:
yadyetadevaM kRRitvApi na vimokSho.asti kasyachit |
dhikkartAraM cha kAryaM cha shramashchAyaM nirarthakaH
shlokas.60:
nAstikyamanyathA cha syAdvedAnAM pRRiShThataHkriyA |
etasyAnantyamichChAmi bhagava~nshrotuma~njasA
shlokas.61:
tathyaM vadasva me brahmannupasanno.asmyadhIhi bhoH |
yathA te vidito mokShastathechChAmyupashikShitum

shlokas.1:
