kapila uvAcha||
vedAH pramANaM lokAnAM na vedAH pRRiShThataHkRRitAH |
dve brahmaNI veditavye shabdabrahma paraM cha yat
shabdabrahmaNi niShNAtaH paraM brahmAdhigachChati
shlokas.2:
sharIrametatkurute yadvede kurute tanum |
kRRitashuddhasharIro hi pAtraM bhavati brAhmaNaH
shlokas.3:
Anantyamanuyu~Nkte yaH karmaNA tadbravImi te |
nirAgamamanaitihyaM pratyakShaM lokasAkShikam
shlokas.4:
dharma ityeva ye yaj~nAnvitanvanti nirAshiShaH |
utpannatyAgino.alubdhAH kRRipAsUyAvivarjitAH
dhanAnAmeSha vai panthAstIrtheShu pratipAdanam
shlokas.5:
anAshritAH pApakRRityAH kadAchitkarmayonitaH |
manaHsa~Nkalpasa.nsiddhA vishuddhaj~nAnanishchayAH
shlokas.6:
akrudhyanto.anasUyanto niraha~NkAramatsarAH |
j~nAnaniShThAstrishuklAshcha sarvabhUtahite ratAH
shlokas.7:
AsangRRihasthA bhUyiShThamavyutkrAntAH svakarmasu |
rAjAnashcha tathA yuktA brAhmaNAshcha yathAvidhi
shlokas.8:
samA hyArjavasampannAH santuShTA j~nAnanishchayAH |
pratyakShadharmAH shuchayaH shraddadhAnAH parAvare
shlokas.9:
purastAdbhAvitAtmAno yathAvachcharitavratAH |
charanti dharmaM kRRichChre.api durge chaivAdhisaMhatAH
shlokas.10:
saMhatya dharmaM charatAM purAsItsukhameva tat |
teShAM nAsIdvidhAtavyaM prAyashchittaM kadAchana
shlokas.11:
satyaM hi dharmamAsthAya durAdharShatamA matAH |
na mAtrAmanurudhyante na dharmachChalamantataH
shlokas.12:
ya eva prathamaH kalpastamevAbhyAcharansaha |
asyAM sthitau sthitAnAM hi prAyashchittaM na vidyate
durbalAtmana utpannaM prAyashchittamiti shrutiH
shlokas.13:
yata eva.nvidhA viprAH purANA yaj~navAhanAH |
traividyavRRiddhAH shuchayo vRRittavanto yashasvinaH
yajanto.aharaharyaj~nairnirAshIrbandhanA budhAH
shlokas.14:
teShAM yaj~nAshcha vedAshcha karmANi cha yathAgamam |
AgamAshcha yathAkAlaM sa~NkalpAshcha yathAvratam
shlokas.15:
apetakAmakrodhAnAM prakRRityA sa.nshitAtmanAm |
RRijUnAM shamanityAnAM sthitAnAM sveShu karmasu
sarvamAnantyamevAsIditi naH shAshvatI shrutiH
shlokas.16:
teShAmadInasattvAnAM dushcharAchArakarmaNAm |
svakarmabhiH sa.nvRRitAnAM tapo ghoratvamAgatam
shlokas.17:
taM sadAchAramAshcharyaM purANaM shAshvataM dhruvam |
ashaknuvadbhishcharituM ki~nchiddharmeShu sUchitam
shlokas.18:
nirApaddharma AchArastvapramAdo.aparAbhavaH |
sarvavarNeShu yatteShu nAsItkashchidvyatikramaH
shlokas.19:
dharmamekaM chatuShpAdamAshritAste nararShabhAH |
taM santo vidhivatprApya gachChanti paramAM gatim
shlokas.20:
gRRihebhya eva niShkramya vanamanye samAshritAH |
gRRihamevAbhisa.nshritya tato.anye brahmachAriNaH
shlokas.21:
dharmametaM chatuShpAdamAshramaM brAhmaNA viduH |
AnantyaM brahmaNaH sthAnaM brAhmaNA nAma nishchayaH
shlokas.22:
ata eva.nvidhA viprAH purANA dharmachAriNaH |
ta ete divi dRRishyante jyotirbhUtA dvijAtayaH
shlokas.23:
nakShatrANIva dhiShNyeShu bahavastArakAgaNAH |
AnantyamupasamprAptAH santoShAditi vaidikam
shlokas.24:
yadyAgachChanti sa.nsAraM punaryoniShu tAdRRishAH |
na lipyante pApakRRityaiH kadAchitkarmayonitaH
shlokas.25:
evaM yukto brAhmaNaH syAdanyo brAhmaNako bhavet |
karmaiva puruShasyAha shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham
shlokas.26:
evaM pakvakaShAyANAmAnantyena shrutena cha |
sarvamAnantyamevAsIdevaM naH shAshvatI shrutiH
shlokas.27:
teShAmapetatRRiShNAnAM nirNiktAnAM shubhAtmanAm |
chaturtha aupaniShado dharmaH sAdhAraNaH smRRitaH
shlokas.28:
sa siddhaiH sAdhyate nityaM brAhmaNairniyatAtmabhiH |
santoShamUlastyAgAtmA j~nAnAdhiShThAnamuchyate
shlokas.29:
apavargagatirnityo yatidharmaH sanAtanaH |
sAdhAraNaH kevalo vA yathAbalamupAsyate
shlokas.30:
gachChato gachChataH kShemaM durbalo.atrAvasIdati |
brahmaNaH padamanvichChansa.nsArAnmuchyate shuchiH
shlokas.31:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
ye bhu~njate ye dadate yajante.adhIyate cha ye |
mAtrAbhirdharmalabdhAbhirye vA tyAgaM samAshritAH
shlokas.32:
eteShAM pretyabhAve tu katamaH svargajittamaH |
etadAchakShva me brahmanyathAtathyena pRRichChataH
shlokas.33:
kapila uvAcha||
parigrahAH shubhAH sarve guNato.abhyudayAshcha ye |
na tu tyAgasukhaM prAptA etattvamapi pashyasi
shlokas.34:
syUmarashmiruvAcha||
bhavanto j~nAnaniShThA vai gRRihasthAH karmanishchayAH |
AshramANAM cha sarveShAM niShThAyAmaikyamuchyate
shlokas.35:
ekatve cha pRRithaktve cha visheSho nAnya uchyate |
tadyathAvadyathAnyAyaM bhagavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.36:
kapila uvAcha||
sharIrapaktiH karmANi j~nAnaM tu paramA gatiH |
pakve kaShAye vamanai rasaj~nAne na tiShThati
shlokas.37:
AnRRisha.nsyaM kShamA shAntirahi.nsA satyamArjavam |
adroho nAbhimAnashcha hrIstitikShA shamastathA
shlokas.38:
panthAno brahmaNastvete etaiH prApnoti yatparam |
tadvidvAnanubudhyeta manasA karmanishchayam
shlokas.39:
yAM viprAH sarvataH shAntA vishuddhA j~nAnanishchayAH |
gatiM gachChanti santuShTAstAmAhuH paramAM gatim
shlokas.40:
vedA.nshcha veditavyaM cha viditvA cha yathAsthiti |
evaM vedavidityAhurato.anyo vAtareTakaH
shlokas.41:
sarvaM vidurvedavido vede sarvaM pratiShThitam |
vede hi niShThA sarvasya yadyadasti cha nAsti cha
shlokas.42:
eShaiva niShThA sarvasya yadyadasti cha nAsti cha |
etadantaM cha madhyaM cha sachchAsachcha vijAnataH
shlokas.43:
samastatyAga ityeva shama ityeva niShThitaH |
santoSha ityatra shubhamapavarge pratiShThitam
shlokas.44:
RRitaM satyaM viditaM veditavyaM; sarvasyAtmA ja~NgamaM sthAvaraM cha |
sarvaM sukhaM yachChivamuttamaM cha; brahmAvyaktaM prabhavashchAvyayashcha
shlokas.45:
tejaH kShamA shAntiranAmayaM shubhaM; tathAvidhaM vyoma sanAtanaM dhruvam |
etaiH shabdairgamyate buddhinetrai;stasmai namo brahmaNe brAhmaNAya

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dharmamarthaM cha kAmaM cha vedAH sha.nsanti bhArata |
kasya lAbho vishiShTo.atra tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi itihAsaM purAtanam |
kuNDadhAreNa yatprItyA bhaktAyopakRRitaM purA
shlokas.3:
adhano brAhmaNaH kashchitkAmAddharmamavaikShata |
yaj~nArthaM sa tato.arthArthI tapo.atapyata dAruNam
shlokas.4:
sa nishchayamatho kRRitvA pUjayAmAsa devatAH |
bhaktyA na chaivAdhyagachChaddhanaM sampUjya devatAH
shlokas.5:
tatashchintAM punaH prAptaH katamaddaivataM nu tat |
yanme drutaM prasIdeta mAnuShairajaDIkRRitam
shlokas.6:
atha saumyena vapuShA devAnucharamantike |
pratyapashyajjaladharaM kuNDadhAramavasthitam
shlokas.7:
dRRiShTvaiva taM mahAtmAnaM tasya bhaktirajAyata |
ayaM me dhAsyati shreyo vapuretaddhi tAdRRisham
shlokas.8:
saMnikRRiShTashcha devasya na chAnyairmAnuShairvRRitaH |
eSha me dAsyati dhanaM prabhUtaM shIghrameva cha
shlokas.9:
tato dhUpaishcha gandhaishcha mAlyairuchchAvachairapi |
balibhirvividhaishchApi pUjayAmAsa taM dvijaH
shlokas.10:
tataH svalpena kAlena tuShTo jaladharastadA |
tasyopakAre niyatAmimAM vAchamuvAcha ha
shlokas.11:
brahmaghne cha surApe cha chore bhagnavrate tathA |
niShkRRitirvihitA sadbhiH kRRitaghne nAsti niShkRRitiH
shlokas.12:
AshAyAstanayo.adharmaH krodho.asUyAsutaH smRRitaH |
putro lobho nikRRityAstu kRRitaghno nArhati prajAm
shlokas.13:
tataH sa brAhmaNaH svapne kuNDadhArasya tejasA |
apashyatsarvabhUtAni kusheShu shayitastadA
shlokas.14:
shamena tapasA chaiva bhaktyA cha nirupaskRRitaH |
shuddhAtmA brAhmaNo rAtrau nidarshanamapashyata
shlokas.15:
maNibhadraM sa tatrasthaM devatAnAM mahAdyutim |
apashyata mahAtmAnaM vyAdishantaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.16:
tatra devAH prayachChanti rAjyAni cha dhanAni cha |
shubhaiH karmabhirArabdhAH prachChidantyashubheShu cha
shlokas.17:
pashyatAmatha yakShANAM kuNDadhAro mahAdyutiH |
niShpatya patito bhUmau devAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.18:
tatastu devavachanAnmaNibhadro mahAyashAH |
uvAcha patitaM bhUmau kuNDadhAra kimiShyate
shlokas.19:
kuNDadhAra uvAcha||
yadi prasannA devA me bhakto.ayaM brAhmaNo mama |
asyAnugrahamichChAmi kRRitaM ki~nchitsukhodayam
shlokas.20:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastaM maNibhadrastu punarvachanamabravIt |
devAnAmeva vachanAtkuNDadhAraM mahAdyutim
shlokas.21:
uttiShThottiShTha bhadraM te kRRitakAryaH sukhI bhava |
yAvaddhanaM prArthayate brAhmaNo.ayaM sakhA tava
devAnAM shAsanAttAvadasa~NkhyeyaM dadAmyaham
shlokas.22:
vichArya kuNDadhArastu mAnuShyaM chalamadhruvam |
tapase matimAdhatta brAhmaNasya yashasvinaH
shlokas.23:
kuNDadhAra uvAcha||
nAhaM dhanAni yAchAmi brAhmaNAya dhanaprada |
anyamevAhamichChAmi bhaktAyAnugrahaM kRRitam
shlokas.24:
pRRithivIM ratnapUrNAM vA mahadvA dhanasa~nchayam |
bhaktAya nAhamichChAmi bhavedeSha tu dhArmikaH
shlokas.25:
dharme.asya ramatAM buddhirdharmaM chaivopajIvatu |
dharmapradhAno bhavatu mamaiSho.anugraho mataH
shlokas.26:
maNibhadra uvAcha||
yadA dharmaphalaM rAjyaM sukhAni vividhAni cha |
phalAnyevAyamashnAtu kAyakleshavivarjitaH
shlokas.27:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastadeva bahushaH kuNDadhAro mahAyashAH |
abhyAsamakaroddharme tatastuShTAsya devatAH
shlokas.28:
maNibhadra uvAcha||
prItAste devatAH sarvA dvijasyAsya tathaiva cha |
bhaviShyatyeSha dharmAtmA dharme chAdhAsyate matiH
shlokas.29:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH prIto jaladharaH kRRitakAryo yudhiShThira |
IpsitaM manaso labdhvA varamanyaiH sudurlabham
shlokas.30:
tato.apashyata chIrANi sUkShmANi dvijasattamaH |
pArshvato.abhyAgato nyastAnyatha nirvedamAgataH
shlokas.31:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ayaM na sukRRitaM vetti ko nvanyo vetsyate kRRitam |
gachChAmi vanamevAhaM varaM dharmeNa jIvitum
shlokas.32:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nirvedAddevatAnAM cha prasAdAtsa dvijottamaH |
vanaM pravishya sumahattapa ArabdhavA.nstadA
shlokas.33:
devatAtithisheSheNa phalamUlAshano dvijaH |
dharme chApi mahArAja ratirasyAbhyajAyata
shlokas.34:
tyaktvA mUlaphalaM sarvaM parNAhAro.abhavaddvijaH |
parNaM tyaktvA jalAhArastadAsIddvijasattamaH
shlokas.35:
vAyubhakShastataH pashchAdbahUnvarShagaNAnabhUt |
na chAsya kShIyate prANastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.36:
dharme cha shraddadhAnasya tapasyugre cha vartataH |
kAlena mahatA tasya divyA dRRiShTirajAyata
shlokas.37:
tasya buddhiH prAdurAsIdyadi dadyAM mahaddhanam |
tuShTaH kasmaichidevAhaM na mithyA vAgbhavenmama
shlokas.38:
tataH prahRRiShTavadano bhUya ArabdhavA.nstapaH |
bhUyashchAchintayatsiddho yatparaM so.abhyapadyata
shlokas.39:
yadi dadyAmahaM rAjyaM tuShTo vai yasya kasyachit |
sa bhavedachirAdrAjA na mithyA vAgbhavenmama
shlokas.40:
tasya sAkShAtkuNDadhAro darshayAmAsa bhArata |
brAhmaNasya tapoyogAtsauhRRidenAbhichoditaH
shlokas.41:
samAgamya sa tenAtha pUjAM chakre yathAvidhi |
brAhmaNaH kuNDadhArasya vismitashchAbhavannRRipa
shlokas.42:
tato.abravItkuNDadhAro divyaM te chakShuruttamam |
pashya rAj~nAM gatiM vipra lokA.nshchAvekSha chakShuShA
shlokas.43:
tato rAj~nAM sahasrANi magnAni niraye tadA |
dUrAdapashyadvipraH sa divyayuktena chakShuShA
shlokas.44:
kuNDadhAra uvAcha||
mAM pUjayitvA bhAvena yadi tvaM duHkhamApnuyAH |
kRRitaM mayA bhavetkiM te kashcha te.anugraho bhavet
shlokas.45:
pashya pashya cha bhUyastvaM kAmAnichChetkathaM naraH |
svargadvAraM hi sa.nruddhaM mAnuSheShu visheShataH
shlokas.46:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.apashyatsa kAmaM cha krodhaM lobhaM bhayaM madam |
nidrAM tandrIM tathAlasyamAvRRitya puruShAnsthitAn
shlokas.47:
kuNDadhAra uvAcha||
etairlokAH susa.nruddhA devAnAM mAnuShAdbhayam |
tathaiva devavachanAdvighnaM kurvanti sarvashaH
shlokas.48:
na devairananuj~nAtaH kashchidbhavati dhArmikaH |
eSha shakto.asi tapasA rAjyaM dAtuM dhanAni cha
shlokas.49:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH papAta shirasA brAhmaNastoyadhAriNe |
uvAcha chainaM dharmAtmA mahAnme.anugrahaH kRRitaH
shlokas.50:
kAmalobhAnubandhena purA te yadasUyitam |
mayA snehamavij~nAya tatra me kShantumarhasi
shlokas.51:
kShAntameva mayetyuktvA kuNDadhAro dvijarShabham |
sampariShvajya bAhubhyAM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.52:
tataH sarvAnimA.NllokAnbrAhmaNo.anuchachAra ha |
kuNDadhAraprasAdena tapasA yojitaH purA
shlokas.53:
vihAyasA cha gamanaM tathA sa~NkalpitArthatA |
dharmAchChaktyA tathA yogAdyA chaiva paramA gatiH
shlokas.54:
devatA brAhmaNAH santo yakShA mAnuShachAraNAH |
dhArmikAnpUjayantIha na dhanADhyAnna kAminaH
shlokas.55:
suprasannA hi te devA yatte dharme ratA matiH |
dhane sukhakalA kAchiddharme tu paramaM sukham

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bahUnAM yaj~natapasAmekArthAnAM pitAmaha |
dharmArthaM na sukhArthArthaM kathaM yaj~naH samAhitaH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi nAradenAnukIrtitam |
u~nChavRRitteH purAvRRittaM yaj~nArthe brAhmaNasya ha
shlokas.3:
rAShTre dharmottare shreShThe vidarbheShvabhavaddvijaH |
u~nChavRRittirRRiShiH kashchidyaj~ne yaj~naM samAdadhe
shlokas.4:
shyAmAkamashanaM tatra sUryapatnI suvarchalA |
tiktaM cha virasaM shAkaM tapasA svAdutAM gatam
shlokas.5:
upagamya vane pRRithvIM sarvabhUtavihi.nsayA |
api mUlaphalairijyo yaj~naH svargyaH parantapa
shlokas.6:
tasya bhAryA vratakRRishA shuchiH puShkarachAriNI |
yaj~napatnItvamAnItA satyenAnuvidhIyate
sA tu shApaparitrastA na svabhAvAnuvartinI
shlokas.7:
mayUrajIrNaparNAnAM vastraM tasyAshcha parNinAm |
akAmAyAH kRRitaM tatra yaj~ne hotrAnumArgataH
shlokas.8:
shukrasya punarAjAtirapadhyAnAdadharmavit |
tasminvane samIpastho mRRigo.abhUtsahachArikaH
vachobhirabravItsatyaM tvayA duShkRRitakaM kRRitam
shlokas.9:
yadi mantrA~NgahIno.ayaM yaj~no bhavati vaikRRitaH |
mAM bhoH prakShipa hotre tvaM gachCha svargamatandritaH
shlokas.10:
tatastu yaj~ne sAvitrI sAkShAttaM saMnyamantrayat |
nimantrayantI pratyuktA na hanyAM sahavAsinam
shlokas.11:
evamuktA nivRRittA sA praviShTA yaj~napAvakam |
kiM nu dushcharitaM yaj~ne didRRikShuH sA rasAtalam
shlokas.12:
sA tu baddhA~njaliM satyamayAchaddhariNaM punaH |
satyena sampariShvajya sa.ndiShTo gamyatAmiti
shlokas.13:
tataH sa hariNo gatvA padAnyaShTau nyavartata |
sAdhu hi.nsaya mAM satya hato yAsyAmi sadgatim
shlokas.14:
pashya hyapsaraso divyA mayA dattena chakShuShA |
vimAnAni vichitrANi gandharvANAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.15:
tataH suruchiraM dRRiShTvA spRRihAlagnena chakShuShA |
mRRigamAlokya hi.nsAyAM svargavAsaM samarthayat
shlokas.16:
sa tu dharmo mRRigo bhUtvA bahuvarShoShito vane |
tasya niShkRRitimAdhatta na hyasau yaj~nasa.nvidhiH
shlokas.17:
tasya tena tu bhAvena mRRigahi.nsAtmanastadA |
tapo mahatsamuchChinnaM tasmAddhi.nsA na yaj~niyA
shlokas.18:
tatastaM bhagavAndharmo yaj~naM yAjayata svayam |
samAdhAnaM cha bhAryAyA lebhe sa tapasA param
shlokas.19:
ahi.nsA sakalo dharmo hi.nsA yaj~ne.asamAhitA |
satyaM te.ahaM pravakShyAmi yo dharmaH satyavAdinAm

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM bhavati pApAtmA kathaM dharmaM karoti vA |
kena nirvedamAdatte mokShaM vA kena gachChati
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
viditAH sarvadharmAste sthityarthamanupRRichChasi |
shRRiNu mokShaM sanirvedaM pApaM dharmaM cha mUlataH
shlokas.3:
vij~nAnArthaM hi pa~nchAnAmichChA pUrvaM pravartate |
prApya tA~njAyate kAmo dveSho vA bharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
tatastadarthaM yatate karma chArabhate punaH |
iShTAnAM rUpagandhAnAmabhyAsaM cha chikIrShati
shlokas.5:
tato rAgaH prabhavati dveShashcha tadanantaram |
tato lobhaH prabhavati mohashcha tadanantaram
shlokas.6:
lobhamohAbhibhUtasya rAgadveShAnvitasya cha |
na dharme jAyate buddhirvyAjAddharmaM karoti cha
shlokas.7:
vyAjena charato dharmamarthavyAjo.api rochate |
vyAjena sidhyamAneShu dhaneShu kurunandana
shlokas.8:
tatraiva kurute buddhiM tataH pApaM chikIrShati |
suhRRidbhirvAryamANo.api paNDitaishchApi bhArata
shlokas.9:
uttaraM nyAyasambaddhaM bravIti vidhiyojitam |
adharmastrividhastasya vardhate rAgamohajaH
shlokas.10:
pApaM chintayate chaiva prabravIti karoti cha |
tasyAdharmapravRRittasya doShAnpashyanti sAdhavaH
shlokas.11:
ekashIlAshcha mitratvaM bhajante pApakarmiNaH |
sa neha sukhamApnoti kuta eva paratra vai
shlokas.12:
evaM bhavati pApAtmA dharmAtmAnaM tu me shRRiNu |
yathA kushaladharmA sa kushalaM pratipadyate
shlokas.13:
ya etAnpraj~nayA doShAnpUrvamevAnupashyati |
kushalaH sukhaduHkhAnAM sAdhU.nshchApyupasevate
shlokas.14:
tasya sAdhusamAchArAdabhyAsAchchaiva vardhate |
praj~nA dharme cha ramate dharmaM chaivopajIvati
shlokas.15:
so.atha dharmAdavApteShu dhaneShu kurute manaH |
tasyaiva si~nchate mUlaM guNAnpashyati yatra vai
shlokas.16:
dharmAtmA bhavati hyevaM mitraM cha labhate shubham |
sa mitradhanalAbhAttu pretya cheha cha nandati
shlokas.17:
shabde sparshe tathA rUpe rase gandhe cha bhArata |
prabhutvaM labhate janturdharmasyaitatphalaM viduH
shlokas.18:
sa dharmasya phalaM labdhvA na tRRipyati yudhiShThira |
atRRipyamANo nirvedamAdatte j~nAnachakShuShA
shlokas.19:
praj~nAchakShuryadA kAme doShamevAnupashyati |
virajyate tadA kAmAnna cha dharmaM vimu~nchati
shlokas.20:
sarvatyAge cha yatate dRRiShTvA lokaM kShayAtmakam |
tato mokShAya yatate nAnupAyAdupAyataH
shlokas.21:
shanairnirvedamAdatte pApaM karma jahAti cha |
dharmAtmA chaiva bhavati mokShaM cha labhate param
shlokas.22:
etatte kathitaM tAta yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
pApaM dharmaM tathA mokShaM nirvedaM chaiva bhArata
shlokas.23:
tasmAddharme pravartethAH sarvAvasthaM yudhiShThira |
dharme sthitAnAM kaunteya siddhirbhavati shAshvatI

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
mokShaH pitAmahenokta upAyAnnAnupAyataH |
tamupAyaM yathAnyAyaM shrotumichChAmi bhArata
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tvayyevaitanmahAprAj~na yuktaM nipuNadarshanam |
yadupAyena sarvArthAnnityaM mRRigayase.anagha
shlokas.3:
karaNe ghaTasya yA buddhirghaTotpattau na sAnagha |
evaM dharmAbhyupAyeShu nAnyaddharmeShu kAraNam
shlokas.4:
pUrve samudre yaH panthA na sa gachChati pashchimam |
ekaH panthA hi mokShasya tanme vistarataH shRRiNu
shlokas.5:
kShamayA krodhamuchChindyAtkAmaM sa~NkalpavarjanAt |
sattvasa.nsevanAddhIro nidrAmuchChetumarhati
shlokas.6:
apramAdAdbhayaM rakShechChvAsaM kShetraj~nashIlanAt |
ichChAM dveShaM cha kAmaM cha dhairyeNa vinivartayet
shlokas.7:
bhramaM pramohamAvartamabhyAsAdvinivartayet |
nidrAM cha pratibhAM chaiva j~nAnAbhyAsena tattvavit
shlokas.8:
upadravA.nstathA rogAnhitajIrNamitAshanAt |
lobhaM mohaM cha santoShAdviShayA.nstattvadarshanAt
shlokas.9:
anukroshAdadharmaM cha jayeddharmamupekShayA |
AyatyA cha jayedAshAmarthaM sa~NgavivarjanAt
shlokas.10:
anityatvena cha snehaM kShudhaM yogena paNDitaH |
kAruNyenAtmano mAnaM tRRiShNAM cha paritoShataH
shlokas.11:
utthAnena jayettandrIM vitarkaM nishchayAjjayet |
maunena bahubhAShyaM cha shauryeNa cha bhayaM jayet
shlokas.12:
yachChedvA~NmanasI buddhyA tAM yachChejj~nAnachakShuShA |
j~nAnamAtmA mahAnyachChettaM yachChechChAntirAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
tadetadupashAntena boddhavyaM shuchikarmaNA |
yogadoShAnsamuchChidya pa~ncha yAnkavayo viduH
shlokas.14:
kAmaM krodhaM cha lobhaM cha bhayaM svapnaM cha pa~nchamam |
parityajya niSheveta tathemAnyogasAdhanAn
shlokas.15:
dhyAnamadhyayanaM dAnaM satyaM hrIrArjavaM kShamA |
shauchamAhArataH shuddhirindriyANAM cha sa.nyamaH
shlokas.16:
etairvivardhate tejaH pApmAnamapahanti cha |
sidhyanti chAsya sa~NkalpA vij~nAnaM cha pravartate
shlokas.17:
dhUtapApaH sa tejasvI laghvAhAro jitendriyaH |
kAmakrodhau vashe kRRitvA ninIShedbrahmaNaH padam
shlokas.18:
amUDhatvamasa~NgitvaM kAmakrodhavivarjanam |
adainyamanudIrNatvamanudvego vyavasthitiH
shlokas.19:
eSha mArgo hi mokShasya prasanno vimalaH shuchiH |
tathA vAkkAyamanasAM niyamaH kAmato.anyathA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradasya cha sa.nvAdaM devalasyAsitasya cha
shlokas.2:
AsInaM devalaM vRRiddhaM buddhvA buddhimatAM varaH |
nAradaH paripaprachCha bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayam
shlokas.3:
kutaH sRRiShTamidaM vishvaM brahmansthAvaraja~Ngamam |
pralaye cha kamabhyeti tadbhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.4:
asita uvAcha||
yebhyaH sRRijati bhUtAni kAlo bhAvaprachoditaH |
mahAbhUtAni pa~ncheti tAnyAhurbhUtachintakAH
shlokas.5:
tebhyaH sRRijati bhUtAni kAla AtmaprachoditaH |
etebhyo yaH paraM brUyAdasadbrUyAdasa.nshayam
shlokas.6:
viddhi nArada pa~nchaitA~nshAshvatAnachalAndhruvAn |
mahatastejaso rAshInkAlaShaShThAnsvabhAvataH
shlokas.7:
ApashchaivAntarikShaM cha pRRithivI vAyupAvakau |
asiddhiH parametebhyo bhUtebhyo muktasa.nshayam
shlokas.8:
nopapattyA na vA yuktyA tvasadbrUyAdasa.nshayam |
vettha tAnabhinirvRRittAnShaDete yasya rAshayaH
shlokas.9:
pa~nchaiva tAni kAlashcha bhAvAbhAvau cha kevalau |
aShTau bhUtAni bhUtAnAM shAshvatAni bhavApyayau
shlokas.10:
abhAvAdbhAviteShveva tebhyashcha prabhavantyapi |
vinaShTo.api cha tAnyeva janturbhavati pa~nchadhA
shlokas.11:
tasya bhUmimayo dehaH shrotramAkAshasambhavam |
sUryashchakShurasurvAyuradbhyastu khalu shoNitam
shlokas.12:
chakShuShI nAsikAkarNau tvagjihveti cha pa~nchamI |
indriyANIndriyArthAnAM j~nAnAni kavayo viduH
shlokas.13:
darshanaM shravaNaM ghrANaM sparshanaM rasanaM tathA |
upapattyA guNAnviddhi pa~ncha pa~nchasu pa~nchadhA
shlokas.14:
rUpaM gandho rasaH sparshaH shabdashchaivAtha tadguNAH |
indriyairupalabhyante pa~nchadhA pa~ncha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.15:
rUpaM gandhaM rasaM sparshaM shabdaM chaitA.nstu tadguNAn |
indriyANi na budhyante kShetraj~nastaistu budhyate
shlokas.16:
chittamindriyasa~NghAtAtparaM tasmAtparaM manaH |
manasastu parA buddhiH kShetraj~no buddhitaH paraH
shlokas.17:
pUrvaM chetayate janturindriyairviShayAnpRRithak |
vichArya manasA pashchAdatha buddhyA vyavasyati
indriyairupalabdhArthAnsarvAnyastvadhyavasyati
shlokas.18:
chittamindriyasa~NghAtaM mano buddhiM tathAShTamIm |
aShTau j~nAnendriyANyAhuretAnyadhyAtmachintakAH
shlokas.19:
pANipAdaM cha pAyushcha mehanaM pa~nchamaM mukham |
iti sa.nshabdyamAnAni shRRiNu karmendriyANyapi
shlokas.20:
jalpanAbhyavahArArthaM mukhamindriyamuchyate |
gamanendriyaM tathA pAdau karmaNaH karaNe karau
shlokas.21:
pAyUpasthau visargArthamindriye tulyakarmaNI |
visarge cha purIShasya visarge chAbhikAmike
shlokas.22:
balaM ShaShThaM ShaDetAni vAchA samyagyathAgamam |
j~nAnacheShTendriyaguNAH sarve sa.nshabditA mayA
shlokas.23:
indriyANAM svakarmabhyaH shramAduparamo yadA |
bhavatIndriyasaMnyAsAdatha svapiti vai naraH
shlokas.24:
indriyANAM vyuparame mano.anuparataM yadi |
sevate viShayAneva tadvidyAtsvapnadarshanam
shlokas.25:
sAttvikAshchaiva ye bhAvAstathA rAjasatAmasAH |
karmayuktAnprasha.nsanti sAttvikAnitarA.nstathA
shlokas.26:
AnandaH karmaNAM siddhiH pratipattiH parA gatiH |
sAttvikasya nimittAni bhAvAnsa.nshrayate smRRitiH
shlokas.27:
jantuShvekatameShvevaM bhAvA ye vidhimAsthitAH |
bhAvayorIpsitaM nityaM pratyakShagamanaM dvayoH
shlokas.28:
indriyANi cha bhAvAshcha guNAH saptadasha smRRitAH |
teShAmaShTAdasho dehI yaH sharIre sa shAshvataH
shlokas.29:
atha vA sasharIrAste guNAH sarve sharIriNAm |
sa.nshritAstadviyoge hi sasharIrA na santi te
shlokas.30:
atha vA saMnipAto.ayaM sharIraM pA~nchabhautikam |
ekashcha dasha chAShTau cha guNAH saha sharIriNAm
UShmaNA saha vi.nsho vA sa~NghAtaH pA~nchabhautikaH
shlokas.31:
mahAnsandhArayatyetachCharIraM vAyunA saha |
tasyAsya bhAvayuktasya nimittaM dehabhedane
shlokas.32:
yathaivotpadyate ki~nchitpa~nchatvaM gachChate tathA |
puNyapApavinAshAnte puNyapApasamIritam
dehaM vishati kAlena tato.ayaM karmasambhavam
shlokas.33:
hitvA hitvA hyayaM praiti dehAddehaM kRRitAshrayaH |
kAlasa~nchoditaH kShetrI vishIrNAdvA gRRihAdgRRiham
shlokas.34:
tatra naivAnutapyante prAj~nA nishchitanishchayAH |
kRRipaNAstvanutapyante janAH sambandhimAninaH
shlokas.35:
na hyayaM kasyachitkashchinnAsya kashchana vidyate |
bhavatyeko hyayaM nityaM sharIre sukhaduHkhabhAk
shlokas.36:
naiva sa~njAyate janturna cha jAtu vipadyate |
yAti dehamayaM bhuktvA kadAchitparamAM gatim
shlokas.37:
puNyapApamayaM dehaM kShapayankarmasa~nchayAt |
kShINadehaH punardehI brahmatvamupagachChati
shlokas.38:
puNyapApakShayArthaM cha sA~NkhyaM j~nAnaM vidhIyate |
tatkShaye hyasya pashyanti brahmabhAve parAM gatim

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhrAtaraH pitaraH putrA j~nAtayaH suhRRidastathA |
arthahetorhatAH krUrairasmAbhiH pApabuddhibhiH
shlokas.2:
yeyamarthodbhavA tRRiShNA kathametAM pitAmaha |
nivartayema pApaM hi tRRiShNayA kAritA vayam
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gItaM videharAjena mANDavyAyAnupRRichChate
shlokas.4:
susukhaM bata jIvAmi yasya me nAsti ki~nchana |
mithilAyAM pradIptAyAM na me dahyati ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
arthAH khalu samRRiddhA hi bADhaM duHkhaM vijAnatAm |
asamRRiddhAstvapi sadA mohayantyavichakShaNAn
shlokas.6:
yachcha kAmasukhaM loke yachcha divyaM mahatsukham |
tRRiShNAkShayasukhasyaite nArhataH ShoDashIM kalAm
shlokas.7:
yathaiva shRRi~NgaM goH kAle vardhamAnasya vardhate |
tathaiva tRRiShNA vittena vardhamAnena vardhate
shlokas.8:
ki~nchideva mamatvena yadA bhavati kalpitam |
tadeva paritApAya nAshe sampadyate punaH
shlokas.9:
na kAmAnanurudhyeta duHkhaM kAmeShu vai ratiH |
prApyArthamupayu~njIta dharme kAmaM vivarjayet
shlokas.10:
vidvAnsarveShu bhUteShu vyAghramA.nsopamo bhavet |
kRRitakRRityo vishuddhAtmA sarvaM tyajati vai saha
shlokas.11:
ubhe satyAnRRite tyaktvA shokAnandau priyApriye |
bhayAbhaye cha santyajya samprashAnto nirAmayaH
shlokas.12:
yA dustyajA durmatibhiryA na jIryati jIryataH |
yo.asau prANAntiko rogastAM tRRiShNAM tyajataH sukham
shlokas.13:
chAritramAtmanaH pashya.nshchandrashuddhamanAmayam |
dharmAtmA labhate kIrtiM pretya cheha yathAsukham
shlokas.14:
rAj~nastadvachanaM shrutvA prItimAnabhavaddvijaH |
pUjayitvA cha tadvAkyaM mANDavyo mokShamAshritaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ki.nshIlaH ki.nsamAchAraH ki.nvidyaH kimparAyaNaH |
prApnoti brahmaNaH sthAnaM yatparaM prakRRiterdhruvam
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mokShadharmeShu nirato laghvAhAro jitendriyaH |
prApnoti paramaM sthAnaM yatparaM prakRRiterdhruvam
shlokas.3:
svagRRihAdabhiniHsRRitya lAbhAlAbhe samo muniH |
samupoDheShu kAmeShu nirapekShaH parivrajet
shlokas.4:
na chakShuShA na manasA na vAchA dUShayedapi |
na pratyakShaM parokShaM vA dUShaNaM vyAharetkvachit
shlokas.5:
na hi.nsyAtsarvabhUtAni maitrAyaNagatishcharet |
nedaM jIvitamAsAdya vairaM kurvIta kenachit
shlokas.6:
ativAdA.nstitikSheta nAbhimanyetkatha~nchana |
krodhyamAnaH priyaM brUyAdAkruShTaH kushalaM vadet
shlokas.7:
pradakShiNaM prasavyaM cha grAmamadhye na chAcharet |
bhaikShacharyAmanApanno na gachChetpUrvaketitaH
shlokas.8:
avakIrNaH suguptashcha na vAchA hyapriyaM vadet |
mRRiduH syAdapratikrUro visrabdhaH syAdaroShaNaH
shlokas.9:
vidhUme nyastamusale vya~NgAre bhuktavajjane |
atIte pAtrasa~nchAre bhikShAM lipseta vai muniH
shlokas.10:
anuyAtrikamarthasya mAtrAlAbheShvanAdRRitaH |
alAbhe na vihanyeta lAbhashchainaM na harShayet
shlokas.11:
lAbhaM sAdhAraNaM nechChenna bhu~njItAbhipUjitaH |
abhipUjitalAbhaM hi jugupsetaiva tAdRRishaH
shlokas.12:
na chAnnadoShAnnindeta na guNAnabhipUjayet |
shayyAsane vivikte cha nityamevAbhipUjayet
shlokas.13:
shUnyAgAraM vRRikShamUlamaraNyamatha vA guhAm |
aj~nAtacharyAM gatvAnyAM tato.anyatraiva sa.nvishet
shlokas.14:
anurodhavirodhAbhyAM samaH syAdachalo dhruvaH |
sukRRitaM duShkRRitaM chobhe nAnurudhyeta karmaNi
shlokas.15:
vAcho vegaM manasaH krodhavegaM; vivitsAvegamudaropasthavegam |
etAnvegAnvinayedvai tapasvI; nindA chAsya hRRidayaM nopahanyAt
shlokas.16:
madhyastha eva tiShTheta prasha.nsAnindayoH samaH |
etatpavitraM paramaM parivrAjaka Ashrame
shlokas.17:
mahAtmA suvrato dAntaH sarvatraivAnapAshritaH |
apUrvachArakaH saumyo aniketaH samAhitaH
shlokas.18:
vAnaprasthagRRihasthAbhyAM na sa.nsRRijyeta karhichit |
aj~nAtalipsAM lipseta na chainaM harSha Avishet
shlokas.19:
vijAnatAM mokSha eSha shramaH syAdavijAnatAm |
mokShayAnamidaM kRRitsnaM viduShAM hArito.abravIt
shlokas.20:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo dattvA yaH pravrajedgRRihAt |
lokAstejomayAstasya tathAnantyAya kalpate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dhanyA dhanyA iti janAH sarve.asmAnpravadantyuta |
na duHkhitataraH kashchitpumAnasmAbhirasti ha
shlokas.2:
lokasambhAvitairduHkhaM yatprAptaM kurusattama |
prApya jAtiM manuShyeShu devairapi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
kadA vayaM kariShyAmaH saMnyAsaM duHkhasa~nj~nakam |
duHkhametachCharIrANAM dhAraNaM kurusattama
shlokas.4:
vimuktAH saptadashabhirhetubhUtaishcha pa~nchabhiH |
indriyArthairguNaishchaiva aShTAbhiH prapitAmaha
shlokas.5:
na gachChanti punarbhAvaM munayaH sa.nshitavratAH |
kadA vayaM bhaviShyAmo rAjyaM hitvA parantapa
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAstyanantaM mahArAja sarvaM sa~NkhyAnagocharam |
punarbhAvo.api sa~NkhyAto nAsti ki~nchidihAchalam
shlokas.7:
na chApi gamyate rAjannaiSha doShaH prasa~NgataH |
udyogAdeva dharmaj~na kAlenaiva gamiShyatha
shlokas.8:
Isho.ayaM satataM dehI nRRipate puNyapApayoH |
tata eva samutthena tamasA rudhyate.api cha
shlokas.9:
yathA~njanamayo vAyuH punarmAnaHshilaM rajaH |
anupravishya tadvarNo dRRishyate ra~njayandishaH
shlokas.10:
tathA karmaphalairdehI ra~njitastamasAvRRitaH |
vivarNo varNamAshritya deheShu parivartate
shlokas.11:
j~nAnena hi yadA janturaj~nAnaprabhavaM tamaH |
vyapohati tadA brahma prakAsheta sanAtanam
shlokas.12:
ayatnasAdhyaM munayo vadanti; ye chApi muktAsta upAsitavyAH |
tvayA cha lokena cha sAmareNa; tasmAnna shAmyanti maharShisa~NghAH
shlokas.13:
asminnarthe purA gItaM shRRiNuShvaikamanA nRRipa |
yathA daityena vRRitreNa bhraShTaishvaryeNa cheShTitam
shlokas.14:
nirjitenAsahAyena hRRitarAjyena bhArata |
ashochatA shatrumadhye buddhimAsthAya kevalAm
shlokas.15:
bhraShTaishvaryaM purA vRRitramushanA vAkyamabravIt |
kachchitparAjitasyAdya na vyathA te.asti dAnava
shlokas.16:
vRRitra uvAcha||
satyena tapasA chaiva viditvA sa~NkShayaM hyaham |
na shochAmi na hRRiShyAmi bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim
shlokas.17:
kAlasa~nchoditA jIvA majjanti narake.avashAH |
paridRRiShTAni sarvANi divyAnyAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.18:
kShapayitvA tu taM kAlaM gaNitaM kAlachoditAH |
sAvasheSheNa kAlena sambhavanti punaH punaH
shlokas.19:
tiryagyonisahasrANi gatvA narakameva cha |
nirgachChantyavashA jIvAH kAlabandhanabandhanAH
shlokas.20:
evaM sa.nsaramANAni jIvAnyahamadRRiShTavAn |
yathA karma tathA lAbha iti shAstranidarshanam
shlokas.21:
tiryaggachChanti narakaM mAnuShyaM daivameva cha |
sukhaduHkhe priyadveShye charitvA pUrvameva cha
shlokas.22:
kRRitAntavidhisa.nyuktaM sarvalokaH prapadyate |
gataM gachChanti chAdhvAnaM sarvabhUtAni sarvadA
shlokas.23:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kAlasa~NkhyAnasa~NkhyAtaM sRRiShTisthitiparAyaNam |
taM bhAShamANaM bhagavAnushanA pratyabhAShata
bhImAnduShTapralApA.nstvaM tAta kasmAtprabhAShase
shlokas.24:
vRRitra uvAcha||
pratyakShametadbhavatastathAnyeShAM manIShiNAm |
mayA yajjayalubdhena purA taptaM mahattapaH
shlokas.25:
gandhAnAdAya bhUtAnAM rasA.nshcha vividhAnapi |
avardhaM trInsamAkramya lokAnvai svena tejasA
shlokas.26:
jvAlAmAlAparikShipto vaihAyasacharastathA |
ajeyaH sarvabhUtAnAmAsaM nityamapetabhIH
shlokas.27:
aishvaryaM tapasA prAptaM bhraShTaM tachcha svakarmabhiH |
dhRRitimAsthAya bhagavanna shochAmi tatastvaham
shlokas.28:
yuyutsatA mahendreNa purA sArdhaM mahAtmanA |
tato me bhagavAndRRiShTo harirnArAyaNaH prabhuH
shlokas.29:
vaikuNThaH puruSho viShNuH shuklo.anantaH sanAtanaH |
mu~njakesho harishmashruH sarvabhUtapitAmahaH
shlokas.30:
nUnaM tu tasya tapasaH sAvasheShaM mamAsti vai |
yadahaM praShTumichChAmi bhavantaM karmaNaH phalam
shlokas.31:
aishvaryaM vai mahadbrahmankasminvarNe pratiShThitam |
nivartate chApi punaH kathamaishvaryamuttamam
shlokas.32:
kasmAdbhUtAni jIvanti pravartante.atha vA punaH |
kiM vA phalaM paraM prApya jIvastiShThati shAshvataH
shlokas.33:
kena vA karmaNA shakyamatha j~nAnena kena vA |
brahmarShe tatphalaM prAptuM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.34:
itIdamuktaH sa munistadAnIM; pratyAha yattachChRRiNu rAjasiMha |
mayochyamAnaM puruSharShabha tva;mananyachittaH saha sodarIyaiH

shlokas.1:
ushanovAcha||
namastasmai bhagavate devAya prabhaviShNave |
yasya pRRithvItalaM tAta sAkAshaM bAhugocharam
shlokas.2:
mUrdhA yasya tvanantaM cha sthAnaM dAnavasattama |
tasyAhaM te pravakShyAmi viShNormAhAtmyamuttamam
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tayoH sa.nvadatorevamAjagAma mahAmuniH |
sanatkumAro dharmAtmA sa.nshayachChedanAya vai
shlokas.4:
sa pUjito.asurendreNa muninoshanasA tathA |
niShasAdAsane rAjanmahArhe munipu~NgavaH
shlokas.5:
tamAsInaM mahAprAj~namushanA vAkyamabravIt |
brUhyasmai dAnavendrAya viShNormAhAtmyamuttamam
shlokas.6:
sanatkumArastu tataH shrutvA prAha vacho.arthavat |
viShNormAhAtmyasa.nyuktaM dAnavendrAya dhImate
shlokas.7:
shRRiNu sarvamidaM daitya viShNormAhAtmyamuttamam |
viShNau jagatsthitaM sarvamiti viddhi parantapa
shlokas.8:
sRRijatyeSha mahAbAho bhUtagrAmaM charAcharam |
eSha chAkShipate kAle kAle visRRijate punaH
asmingachChanti vilayamasmAchcha prabhavantyuta
shlokas.9:
naiSha dAnavatA shakyastapasA naiva chejyayA |
samprAptumindriyANAM tu sa.nyamenaiva shakyate
shlokas.10:
bAhye chAbhyantare chaiva karmaNA manasi sthitaH |
nirmalIkurute buddhyA so.amutrAnantyamashnute
shlokas.11:
yathA hiraNyakartA vai rUpyamagnau vishodhayet |
bahusho.atiprayatnena mahatAtmakRRitena ha
shlokas.12:
tadvajjAtishatairjIvaH shudhyate.alpena karmaNA |
yatnena mahatA chaivApyekajAtau vishudhyate
shlokas.13:
lIlayAlpaM yathA gAtrAtpramRRijyAdAtmano rajaH |
bahu yatnena mahatA doShanirharaNaM tathA
shlokas.14:
yathA chAlpena mAlyena vAsitaM tilasarShapam |
na mu~nchati svakaM gandhaM tadvatsUkShmasya darshanam
shlokas.15:
tadeva bahubhirmAlyairvAsyamAnaM punaH punaH |
vimu~nchati svakaM gandhaM mAlyagandhe.avatiShThati
shlokas.16:
evaM jAtishatairyukto guNaireva prasa~NgiShu |
buddhyA nivartate doSho yatnenAbhyAsajena vai
shlokas.17:
karmaNA svena raktAni viraktAni cha dAnava |
yathA karmavisheShA.nshcha prApnuvanti tathA shRRiNu
shlokas.18:
yathA cha sampravartante yasmi.nstiShThanti vA vibho |
tatte.anupUrvyA vyAkhyAsye tadihaikamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.19:
anAdinidhanaH shrImAnharirnArAyaNaH prabhuH |
sa vai sRRijati bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.20:
eSha sarveShu bhUteShu kSharashchAkShara eva cha |
ekAdashavikArAtmA jagatpibati rashmibhiH
shlokas.21:
pAdau tasya mahIM viddhi mUrdhAnaM divameva cha |
bAhavastu disho daitya shrotramAkAshameva cha
shlokas.22:
tasya tejomayaH sUryo manashchandramasi sthitam |
buddhirj~nAnagatA nityaM rasastvapsu pravartate
shlokas.23:
bhruvoranantarAstasya grahA dAnavasattama |
nakShatrachakraM netrAbhyAM pAdayorbhUshcha dAnava
shlokas.24:
rajastamashcha sattvaM cha viddhi nArAyaNAtmakam |
so.a.ashramANAM mukhaM tAta karmaNastatphalaM viduH
shlokas.25:
akarmaNaH phalaM chaiva sa eva paramavyayaH |
ChandA.nsi tasya romANi akSharaM cha sarasvatI
shlokas.26:
bahvAshrayo bahumukho dharmo hRRidi samAshritaH |
sa brahmaparamo dharmastapashcha sadasachcha saH
shlokas.27:
shrutishAstragrahopetaH ShoDashartvikkratushcha saH |
pitAmahashcha viShNushcha so.ashvinau sa pura.ndaraH
shlokas.28:
mitrashcha varuNashchaiva yamo.atha dhanadastathA |
te pRRithagdarshanAstasya sa.nvidanti tathaikatAm
ekasya viddhi devasya sarvaM jagadidaM vashe
shlokas.29:
nAnAbhUtasya daityendra tasyaikatvaM vadatyayam |
jantuH pashyati j~nAnena tataH sattvaM prakAshate
shlokas.30:
saMhAravikShepasahasrakoTI;stiShThanti jIvAH pracharanti chAnye |
prajAvisargasya cha pArimANyaM; vApIsahasrANi bahUni daitya
shlokas.31:
vApyaH punaryojanavistRRitAstAH; kroshaM cha gambhIratayAvagADhAH |
AyAmataH pa~nchashatAshcha sarvAH; pratyekasho yojanataH pravRRiddhAH
shlokas.32:
vApyA jalaM kShipyati vAlakoTyA; tvahnA sakRRichchApyatha na dvitIyam |
tAsAM kShaye viddhi kRRitaM visargaM; saMhAramekaM cha tathA prajAnAm
shlokas.33:
ShaDjIvavarNAH paramaM pramANaM; kRRiShNo dhUmro nIlamathAsya madhyam |
raktaM punaH sahyataraM sukhaM tu; hAridravarNaM susukhaM cha shuklam
shlokas.34:
paraM tu shuklaM vimalaM vishokaM; gataklamaM sidhyati dAnavendra |
gatvA tu yoniprabhavAni daitya; sahasrashaH siddhimupaiti jIvaH
shlokas.35:
gatiM cha yAM darshanamAha devo; gatvA shubhaM darshanameva chAha |
gatiH punarvarNakRRitA prajAnAM; varNastathA kAlakRRito.asurendra
shlokas.36:
shataM sahasrANi chaturdasheha; parA gatirjIvaguNasya daitya |
ArohaNaM tatkRRitameva viddhi; sthAnaM tathA niHsaraNaM cha teShAm
shlokas.37:
kRRiShNasya varNasya gatirnikRRiShTA; sa majjate narake pachyamAnaH |
sthAnaM tathA durgatibhistu tasya; prajAvisargAnsubahUnvadanti
shlokas.38:
shataM sahasrANi tatashcharitvA; prApnoti varNaM haritaM tu pashchAt |
sa chaiva tasminnivasatyanIsho; yugakShaye tamasA sa.nvRRitAtmA
shlokas.39:
sa vai yadA sattvaguNena yukta;stamo vyapohanghaTate svabuddhyA |
sa lohitaM varNamupaiti nIlo; manuShyaloke parivartate cha
shlokas.40:
sa tatra saMhAravisargameva; svakarmajairbandhanaiH klishyamAnaH |
tataH sa hAridramupaiti varNaM; saMhAravikShepashate vyatIte
shlokas.41:
hAridravarNastu prajAvisargA;nsahasrashastiShThati sa~ncharanvai |
avipramukto niraye cha daitya; tataH sahasrANi dashAparANi
shlokas.42:
gatIH sahasrANi cha pa~ncha tasya; chatvAri sa.nvartakRRitAni chaiva |
vimuktamenaM nirayAchcha viddhi; sarveShu chAnyeShu cha sambhaveShu
shlokas.43:
sa devaloke viharatyabhIkShNaM; tatashchyuto mAnuShatAmupaiti |
saMhAravikShepashatAni chAShTau; martyeShu tiShThannamRRitatvameti
shlokas.44:
so.asmAdatha bhrashyati kAlayogA;tkRRiShNe tale tiShThati sarvakaShTe |
yathA tvayaM sidhyati jIvaloka;statte.abhidhAsyAmyasurapravIra
shlokas.45:
daivAni sa vyUhashatAni sapta; rakto haridro.atha tathaiva shuklaH |
sa.nshritya sandhAvati shuklameta;maShTAparAnarchyatamAnsa lokAn
shlokas.46:
aShTau cha ShaShTiM cha shatAni yAni; manoviruddhAni mahAdyutInAm |
shuklasya varNasya parA gatiryA; trINyeva ruddhAni mahAnubhAva
shlokas.47:
saMhAravikShepamaniShTamekaM; chatvAri chAnyAni vasatyanIshaH |
ShaShThasya varNasya parA gatiryA; siddhA vishiShTasya gataklamasya
shlokas.48:
saptottaraM teShu vasatyanIshaH; saMhAravikShepashataM sasheSham |
tasmAdupAvRRitya manuShyaloke; tato mahAnmAnuShatAmupaiti
shlokas.49:
tasmAdupAvRRitya tataH krameNa; so.agre sma santiShThati bhUtasargam |
sa saptakRRitvashcha paraiti lokA;nsaMhAravikShepakRRitapravAsaH
shlokas.50:
saptaiva saMhAramupaplavAni; sambhAvya santiShThati siddhaloke |
tato.avyayaM sthAnamanantameti; devasya viShNoratha brahmaNashcha
sheShasya chaivAtha narasya chaiva; devasya viShNoH paramasya chaiva
shlokas.51:
saMhArakAle paridagdhakAyA; brahmANamAyAnti sadA prajA hi |
cheShTAtmano devagaNAshcha sarve; ye brahmalokAdamarAH sma te.api
shlokas.52:
prajAvisargaM tu sasheShakAlaM; sthAnAni svAnyeva saranti jIvAH |
niHsheShANAM tatpadaM yAnti chAnte; sarvApadA ye sadRRishA manuShyAH
shlokas.53:
ye tu chyutAH siddhalokAtkrameNa; teShAM gatiM yAnti tathAnupUrvyA |
jIvAH pare tadbalaveSharUpA; vidhiM svakaM yAnti viparyayeNa
shlokas.54:
sa yAvadevAsti sasheShabhukte; prajAshcha devyau cha tathaiva shukle |
tAvattadA teShu vishuddhabhAvaH; sa.nyamya pa~nchendriyarUpametat
shlokas.55:
shuddhAM gatiM tAM paramAM paraiti; shuddhena nityaM manasA vichinvan |
tato.avyayaM sthAnamupaiti brahma; duShprApamabhyeti sa shAshvataM vai
ityetadAkhyAtamahInasattva; nArAyaNasyeha balaM mayA te
shlokas.56:
vRRitra uvAcha||
evaM gate me na viShAdo.asti kashchi;tsamyakcha pashyAmi vachastavaitat |
shrutvA cha te vAchamadInasattva; vikalmaSho.asmyadya tathA vipApmA
shlokas.57:
pravRRittametadbhagavanmaharShe; mahAdyuteshchakramanantavIryam |
viShNoranantasya sanAtanaM ta;tsthAnaM sargA yatra sarve pravRRittAH
sa vai mahAtmA puruShottamo vai; tasmi~njagatsarvamidaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.58:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA sa kaunteya vRRitraH prANAnavAsRRijat |
yojayitvA tathAtmAnaM paraM sthAnamavAptavAn
shlokas.59:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayaM sa bhagavAndevaH pitAmaha janArdanaH |
sanatkumAro vRRitrAya yattadAkhyAtavAnpurA
shlokas.60:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mUlasthAyI sa bhagavAnsvenAnantena tejasA |
tatsthaH sRRijati tAnbhAvAnnAnArUpAnmahAtapAH
shlokas.61:
turIyArdhena tasyemaM viddhi keshavamachyutam |
turIyArdhena lokA.nstrInbhAvayatyeSha buddhimAn
shlokas.62:
arvAksthitastu yaH sthAyI kalpAnte parivartate |
sa shete bhagavAnapsu yo.asAvatibalaH prabhuH
tAnvidhAtA prasannAtmA lokA.nshcharati shAshvatAn
shlokas.63:
sarvANyashUnyAni karotyanantaH; sanatkumAraH sa~ncharate cha lokAn |
sa chAniruddhaH sRRijate mahAtmA; tatsthaM jagatsarvamidaM vichitram
shlokas.64:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vRRitreNa paramArthaj~na dRRiShTA manye.a.atmano gatiH |
shubhA tasmAtsa sukhito na shochati pitAmaha
shlokas.65:
shuklaH shuklAbhijAtIyaH sAdhyo nAvartate.anagha |
tiryaggateshcha nirmukto nirayAchcha pitAmaha
shlokas.66:
hAridravarNe rakte vA vartamAnastu pArthiva |
tiryagevAnupashyeta karmabhistAmasairvRRitaH
shlokas.67:
vayaM tu bhRRishamApannA raktAH kaShTamukhe.asukhe |
kAM gatiM pratipatsyAmo nIlAM kRRiShNAdhamAmatha
shlokas.68:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shuddhAbhijanasampannAH pANDavAH sa.nshitavratAH |
vihRRitya devalokeShu punarmAnuShyameShyatha
shlokas.69:
prajAvisargaM cha sukhena kAle; pratyetya deveShu sukhAni bhuktvA |
sukhena sa.nyAsyatha siddhasa~NkhyAM; mA vo bhayaM bhUdvimalAH stha sarve

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
aho dharmiShThatA tAta vRRitrasyAmitatejasaH |
yasya vij~nAnamatulaM viShNorbhaktishcha tAdRRishI
shlokas.2:
durvij~neyamidaM tAta viShNoramitatejasaH |
kathaM vA rAjashArdUla padaM tajj~nAtavAnasau
shlokas.3:
bhavatA kathitaM hyetachChraddadhe chAhamachyuta |
bhUyastu me samutpannA buddhiravyaktadarshanAt
shlokas.4:
kathaM vinihato vRRitraH shakreNa bharatarShabha |
dharmiShTho viShNubhaktashcha tattvaj~nashcha padAnvaye
shlokas.5:
etanme sa.nshayaM brUhi pRRichChato bharatarShabha |
vRRitrastu rAjashArdUla yathA shakreNa nirjitaH
shlokas.6:
yathA chaivAbhavadyuddhaM tachchAchakShva pitAmaha |
vistareNa mahAbAho paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rathenendraH prayAto vai sArdhaM suragaNaiH purA |
dadarshAthAgrato vRRitraM viShThitaM parvatopamam
shlokas.8:
yojanAnAM shatAnyUrdhvaM pa~nchochChritamari.ndama |
shatAni vistareNAtha trINyevAbhyadhikAni tu
shlokas.9:
tatprekShya tAdRRishaM rUpaM trailokyenApi durjayam |
vRRitrasya devAH santrastA na shAntimupalebhire
shlokas.10:
shakrasya tu tadA rAjannUrustambho vyajAyata |
bhayAdvRRitrasya sahasA dRRiShTvA tadrUpamuttamam
shlokas.11:
tato nAdaH samabhavadvAditrANAM cha nisvanaH |
devAsurANAM sarveShAM tasminyuddha upasthite
shlokas.12:
atha vRRitrasya kauravya dRRiShTvA shakramupasthitam |
na sambhramo na bhIH kAchidAsthA vA samajAyata
shlokas.13:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM trailokyasya bhaya~Nkaram |
shakrasya cha surendrasya vRRitrasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
asibhiH paTTishaiH shUlaiH shaktitomaramudgaraiH |
shilAbhirvividhAbhishcha kArmukaishcha mahAsvanaiH
shlokas.15:
astraishcha vividhairdivyaiH pAvakolkAbhireva cha |
devAsuraistataH sainyaiH sarvamAsItsamAkulam
shlokas.16:
pitAmahapurogAshcha sarve devagaNAstathA |
RRiShayashcha mahAbhAgAstadyuddhaM draShTumAgaman
shlokas.17:
vimAnAgryairmahArAja siddhAshcha bharatarShabha |
gandharvAshcha vimAnAgryairapsarobhiH samAgaman
shlokas.18:
tato.antarikShamAvRRitya vRRitro dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
ashmavarSheNa devendraM parvatAtsamavAkirat
shlokas.19:
tato devagaNAH kruddhAH sarvataH shastravRRiShTibhiH |
ashmavarShamapohanta vRRitrapreritamAhave
shlokas.20:
vRRitrashcha kurushArdUla mahAmAyo mahAbalaH |
mohayAmAsa devendraM mAyAyuddhena sarvataH
shlokas.21:
tasya vRRitrArditasyAtha moha AsIchChatakratoH |
rathantareNa taM tatra vasiShThaH samabodhayat
shlokas.22:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
devashreShTho.asi devendra surArivinibarhaNa |
trailokyabalasa.nyuktaH kasmAchChakra viShIdasi
shlokas.23:
eSha brahmA cha viShNushcha shivashchaiva jagatprabhuH |
somashcha bhagavAndevaH sarve cha paramarShayaH
shlokas.24:
mA kArShIH kashmalaM shakra kashchidevetaro yathA |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA jahi shatruM sureshvara
shlokas.25:
eSha lokagurustryakShaH sarvalokanamaskRRitaH |
nirIkShate tvAM bhagavA.nstyaja mohaM sureshvara
shlokas.26:
ete brahmarShayashchaiva bRRihaspatipurogamAH |
stavena shakra divyena stuvanti tvAM jayAya vai
shlokas.27:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM sambodhyamAnasya vasiShThena mahAtmanA |
atIva vAsavasyAsIdbalamuttamatejasaH
shlokas.28:
tato buddhimupAgamya bhagavAnpAkashAsanaH |
yogena mahatA yuktastAM mAyAM vyapakarShata
shlokas.29:
tato.a~NgiraHsutaH shrImA.nste chaiva paramarShayaH |
dRRiShTvA vRRitrasya vikrAntamupagamya maheshvaram
UchurvRRitravinAshArthaM lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.30:
tato bhagavatastejo jvaro bhUtvA jagatpateH |
samAvishanmahAraudraM vRRitraM daityavaraM tadA
shlokas.31:
viShNushcha bhagavAndevaH sarvalokAbhipUjitaH |
aindraM samAvishadvajraM lokasa.nrakShaNe rataH
shlokas.32:
tato bRRihaspatirdhImAnupAgamya shatakratum |
vasiShThashcha mahAtejAH sarve cha paramarShayaH
shlokas.33:
te samAsAdya varadaM vAsavaM lokapUjitam |
UchurekAgramanaso jahi vRRitramiti prabho
shlokas.34:
maheshvara uvAcha||
eSha vRRitro mahA~nshakra balena mahatA vRRitaH |
vishvAtmA sarvagashchaiva bahumAyashcha vishrutaH
shlokas.35:
tadenamasurashreShThaM trailokyenApi durjayam |
jahi tvaM yogamAsthAya mAvama.nsthAH sureshvara
shlokas.36:
anena hi tapastaptaM balArthamamarAdhipa |
ShaShTiM varShasahasrANi brahmA chAsmai varaM dadau
shlokas.37:
mahattvaM yoginAM chaiva mahAmAyatvameva cha |
mahAbalatvaM cha tathA tejashchAgryaM sureshvara
shlokas.38:
etadvai mAmakaM tejaH samAvishati vAsava |
vRRitramenaM tvamapyevaM jahi vajreNa dAnavam
shlokas.39:
shakra uvAcha||
bhagava.nstvatprasAdena ditijaM sudurAsadam |
vajreNa nihaniShyAmi pashyataste surarShabha
shlokas.40:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AvishyamAne daitye tu jvareNAtha mahAsure |
devatAnAmRRiShINAM cha harShAnnAdo mahAnabhUt
shlokas.41:
tato dundubhayashchaiva sha~NkhAshcha sumahAsvanAH |
murajA DiNDimAshchaiva prAvAdyanta sahasrashaH
shlokas.42:
asurANAM tu sarveShAM smRRitilopo.abhavanmahAn |
praj~nAnAshashcha balavAnkShaNena samapadyata
shlokas.43:
tamAviShTamatho j~nAtvA RRiShayo devatAstathA |
stuvantaH shakramIshAnaM tathA prAchodayannapi
shlokas.44:
rathasthasya hi shakrasya yuddhakAle mahAtmanaH |
RRiShibhiH stUyamAnasya rUpamAsItsudurdRRisham

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vRRitrasya tu mahArAja jvarAviShTasya sarvashaH |
abhavanyAni li~NgAni sharIre tAni me shRRiNu
shlokas.2:
jvalitAsyo.abhavadghoro vaivarNyaM chAgamatparam |
gAtrakampashcha sumahA~nshvAsashchApyabhavanmahAn
romaharShashcha tIvro.abhUnniHshvAsashcha mahAnnRRipa
shlokas.3:
shivA chAshivasa~NkAshA tasya vaktrAtsudAruNA |
niShpapAta mahAghorA smRRitiH sA tasya bhArata
ulkAshcha jvalitAstasya dIptAH pArshve prapedire
shlokas.4:
gRRidhraka~NkavaDAshchaiva vAcho.amu~nchansudAruNAH |
vRRitrasyopari saMhRRiShTAshchakravatparibabhramuH
shlokas.5:
tatastaM rathamAsthAya devApyAyitamAhave |
vajrodyatakaraH shakrastaM daityaM pratyavaikShata
shlokas.6:
amAnuShamatho nAdaM sa mumocha mahAsuraH |
vyajRRimbhata cha rAjendra tIvrajvarasamanvitaH
athAsya jRRimbhataH shakrastato vajramavAsRRijat
shlokas.7:
sa vajraH sumahAtejAH kAlAgnisadRRishopamaH |
kShiprameva mahAkAyaM vRRitraM daityamapAtayat
shlokas.8:
tato nAdaH samabhavatpunareva samantataH |
vRRitraM vinihataM dRRiShTvA devAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
vRRitraM tu hatvA bhagavAndAnavArirmahAyashAH |
vajreNa viShNuyuktena divameva samAvishat
shlokas.10:
atha vRRitrasya kauravya sharIrAdabhiniHsRRitA |
brahmahatyA mahAghorA raudrA lokabhayAvahA
shlokas.11:
karAladashanA bhImA vikRRitA kRRiShNapi~NgalA |
prakIrNamUrdhajA chaiva ghoranetrA cha bhArata
shlokas.12:
kapAlamAlinI chaiva kRRishA cha bharatarShabha |
rudhirArdrA cha dharmaj~na chIravastranivAsinI
shlokas.13:
sAbhiniShkramya rAjendra tAdRRigrUpA bhayAvahA |
vajriNaM mRRigayAmAsa tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.14:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya vRRitrahA kurunandana |
svargAyAbhimukhaH prAyAllokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.15:
bisAnniHsaramANaM tu dRRiShTvA shakraM mahaujasam |
kaNThe jagrAha devendraM sulagnA chAbhavattadA
shlokas.16:
sa hi tasminsamutpanne brahmahatyAkRRite bhaye |
nalinyAM bisamadhyastho babhUvAbdagaNAnbahUn
shlokas.17:
anusRRitya tu yatnAtsa tayA vai brahmahatyayA |
tadA gRRihItaH kauravya nishcheShTaH samapadyata
shlokas.18:
tasyA vyapohane shakraH paraM yatnaM chakAra ha |
na chAshakattAM devendro brahmahatyAM vyapohitum
shlokas.19:
gRRihIta eva tu tayA devendro bharatarShabha |
pitAmahamupAgamya shirasA pratyapUjayat
shlokas.20:
j~nAtvA gRRihItaM shakraM tu dvijapravarahatyayA |
brahmA sa~nchintayAmAsa tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.21:
tAmuvAcha mahAbAho brahmahatyAM pitAmahaH |
svareNa madhureNAtha sAntvayanniva bhArata
shlokas.22:
muchyatAM tridashendro.ayaM matpriyaM kuru bhAmini |
brUhi kiM te karomyadya kAmaM kaM tvamihechChasi
shlokas.23:
brahmahatyovAcha||
trilokapUjite deve prIte trailokyakartari |
kRRitameveha manye.ahaM nivAsaM tu vidhatsva me
shlokas.24:
tvayA kRRiteyaM maryAdA lokasa.nrakShaNArthinA |
sthApanA vai sumahatI tvayA deva pravartitA
shlokas.25:
prIte tu tvayi dharmaj~na sarvalokeshvare prabho |
shakrAdapagamiShyAmi nivAsaM tu vidhatsva me
shlokas.26:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatheti tAM prAha tadA brahmahatyAM pitAmahaH |
upAyataH sa shakrasya brahmahatyAM vyapohata
shlokas.27:
tataH svayambhuvA dhyAtastatra vahnirmahAtmanA |
brahmANamupasa~Ngamya tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.28:
prApto.asmi bhagavandeva tvatsakAshamari.ndama |
yatkartavyaM mayA deva tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.29:
brahmovAcha||
bahudhA vibhajiShyAmi brahmahatyAmimAmaham |
shakrasyAdya vimokShArthaM chaturbhAgaM pratIchCha me
shlokas.30:
agniruvAcha||
mama mokShasya ko.anto vai brahmandhyAyasva vai prabho |
etadichChAmi vij~nAtuM tattvato lokapUjita
shlokas.31:
brahmovAcha||
yastvAM jvalantamAsAdya svayaM vai mAnavaH kvachit |
bIjauShadhirasairvahne na yakShyati tamovRRitaH
shlokas.32:
tameShA yAsyati kShipraM tatraiva cha nivatsyati |
brahmahatyA havyavAha vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.33:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityuktaH pratijagrAha tadvacho havyakavyabhuk |
pitAmahasya bhagavA.nstathA cha tadabhUtprabho
shlokas.34:
tato vRRikShauShadhitRRiNaM samAhUya pitAmahaH |
imamarthaM mahArAja vaktuM samupachakrame
shlokas.35:
tato vRRikShauShadhitRRiNaM tathaivoktaM yathAtatham |
vyathitaM vahnivadrAjanbrahmANamidamabravIt
shlokas.36:
asmAkaM brahmahatyAto ko.anto lokapitAmaha |
svabhAvanihatAnasmAnna punarhantumarhasi
shlokas.37:
vayamagniM tathA shItaM varShaM cha pavaneritam |
sahAmaH satataM deva tathA Chedanabhedanam
shlokas.38:
brahmahatyAmimAmadya bhavataH shAsanAdvayam |
grahIShyAmastrilokesha mokShaM chintayatAM bhavAn
shlokas.39:
brahmovAcha||
parvakAle tu samprApte yo vai Chedanabhedanam |
kariShyati naro mohAttameShAnugamiShyati
shlokas.40:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato vRRikShauShadhitRRiNamevamuktaM mahAtmanA |
brahmANamabhisampUjya jagAmAshu yathAgatam
shlokas.41:
AhUyApsaraso devastato lokapitAmahaH |
vAchA madhurayA prAha sAntvayanniva bhArata
shlokas.42:
iyamindrAdanuprAptA brahmahatyA varA~NganAH |
chaturthamasyA bhAgaM hi mayoktAH sampratIchChata
shlokas.43:
apsarasa UchuH||
grahaNe kRRitabuddhInAM devesha tava shAsanAt |
mokShaM samayato.asmAkaM chintayasva pitAmaha
shlokas.44:
brahmovAcha||
rajasvalAsu nArIShu yo vai maithunamAcharet |
tameShA yAsyati kShipraM vyetu vo mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.45:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatheti hRRiShTamanasa uktvAthApsarasAM gaNAH |
svAni sthAnAni samprApya remire bharatarShabha
shlokas.46:
tatastrilokakRRiddevaH punareva mahAtapAH |
apaH sa~nchintayAmAsa dhyAtAstAshchApyathAgaman
shlokas.47:
tAstu sarvAH samAgamya brahmANamamitaujasam |
idamUchurvacho rAjanpraNipatya pitAmaham
shlokas.48:
imAH sma deva samprAptAstvatsakAshamari.ndama |
shAsanAttava devesha samAj~nApaya no vibho
shlokas.49:
brahmovAcha||
iyaM vRRitrAdanuprAptA puruhUtaM mahAbhayA |
brahmahatyA chaturthA.nshamasyA yUyaM pratIchChata
shlokas.50:
Apa UchuH||
evaM bhavatu lokesha yathA vadasi naH prabho |
mokShaM samayato.asmAkaM sa~nchintayitumarhasi
shlokas.51:
tvaM hi devesha sarvasya jagataH paramo guruH |
ko.anyaH prasAdo hi bhavedyaH kRRichChrAnnaH samuddharet
shlokas.52:
brahmovAcha||
alpA iti matiM kRRitvA yo naro buddhimohitaH |
shleShmamUtrapurIShANi yuShmAsu pratimokShyati
shlokas.53:
tameShA yAsyati kShipraM tatraiva cha nivatsyati |
tathA vo bhavitA mokSha iti satyaM bravImi vaH
shlokas.54:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato vimuchya devendraM brahmahatyA yudhiShThira |
yathAnisRRiShTaM taM deshamagachChaddevashAsanAt
shlokas.55:
evaM shakreNa samprAptA brahmahatyA janAdhipa |
pitAmahamanuj~nApya so.ashvamedhamakalpayat
shlokas.56:
shrUyate hi mahArAja samprAptA vAsavena vai |
brahmahatyA tataH shuddhiM hayamedhena labdhavAn
shlokas.57:
samavApya shriyaM devo hatvArI.nshcha sahasrashaH |
praharShamatulaM lebhe vAsavaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.58:
vRRitrasya rudhirAchchaiva khukhuNDAH pArtha jaj~nire |
dvijAtibhirabhakShyAste dIkShitaishcha tapodhanaiH
shlokas.59:
sarvAvasthaM tvamapyeShAM dvijAtInAM priyaM kuru |
ime hi bhUtale devAH prathitAH kurunandana
shlokas.60:
evaM shakreNa kauravya buddhisaukShmyAnmahAsuraH |
upAyapUrvaM nihato vRRitro.athAmitatejasA
shlokas.61:
evaM tvamapi kauravya pRRithivyAmaparAjitaH |
bhaviShyasi yathA devaH shatakraturamitrahA
shlokas.62:
ye tu shakrakathAM divyAmimAM parvasu parvasu |
vipramadhye paThiShyanti na te prApsyanti kilbiSham
shlokas.63:
ityetadvRRitramAshritya shakrasyAtyadbhutaM mahat |
kathitaM karma te tAta kiM bhUyaH shrotumichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pitAmaha mahAprAj~na sarvashAstravishArada |
asti vRRitravadhAdeva vivakShA mama jAyate
shlokas.2:
jvareNa mohito vRRitraH kathitaste janAdhipa |
nihato vAsaveneha vajreNeti mamAnagha
shlokas.3:
kathameSha mahAprAj~na jvaraH prAdurabhUtkutaH |
jvarotpattiM nipuNataH shrotumichChAmyahaM prabho
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAja~njvarasyeha sambhavaM lokavishrutam |
vistaraM chAsya vakShyAmi yAdRRishaM chaiva bhArata
shlokas.5:
purA merormahArAja shRRi~NgaM trailokyavishrutam |
jyotiShkaM nAma sAvitraM sarvaratnavibhUShitam
aprameyamanAdhRRiShyaM sarvalokeShu bhArata
shlokas.6:
tatra devo giritaTe hemadhAtuvibhUShite |
parya~Nka iva vibhrAjannupaviShTo babhUva ha
shlokas.7:
shailarAjasutA chAsya nityaM pArshve sthitA babhau |
tathA devA mahAtmAno vasavashcha mahaujasaH
shlokas.8:
tathaiva cha mahAtmAnAvashvinau bhiShajAM varau |
tathA vaishravaNo rAjA guhyakairabhisa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.9:
yakShANAmadhipaH shrImAnkailAsanilayaH prabhuH |
a~NgiraHpramukhAshchaiva tathA devarShayo.apare
shlokas.10:
vishvAvasushcha gandharvastathA nAradaparvatau |
apsarogaNasa~NghAshcha samAjagmuranekashaH
shlokas.11:
vavau shivaH sukho vAyurnAnAgandhavahaH shuchiH |
sarvartukusumopetAH puShpavanto mahAdrumAH
shlokas.12:
tathA vidyAdharAshchaiva siddhAshchaiva tapodhanAH |
mahAdevaM pashupatiM paryupAsanta bhArata
shlokas.13:
bhUtAni cha mahArAja nAnArUpadharANyatha |
rAkShasAshcha mahAraudrAH pishAchAshcha mahAbalAH
shlokas.14:
bahurUpadharA hRRiShTA nAnApraharaNodyatAH |
devasyAnucharAstatra tasthire chAnalopamAH
shlokas.15:
nandI cha bhagavA.nstatra devasyAnumate sthitaH |
pragRRihya jvalitaM shUlaM dIpyamAnaM svatejasA
shlokas.16:
ga~NgA cha saritAM shreShThA sarvatIrthajalodbhavA |
paryupAsata taM devaM rUpiNI kurunandana
shlokas.17:
evaM sa bhagavA.nstatra pUjyamAnaH surarShibhiH |
devaishcha sumahAbhAgairmahAdevo vyatiShThata
shlokas.18:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya dakSho nAma prajApatiH |
pUrvoktena vidhAnena yakShyamANo.anvapadyata
shlokas.19:
tatastasya makhaM devAH sarve shakrapurogamAH |
gamanAya samAgamya buddhimApedire tadA
shlokas.20:
te vimAnairmahAtmAno jvalitairjvalanaprabhAH |
devasyAnumate.agachChanga~NgAdvAramiti shrutiH
shlokas.21:
prasthitA devatA dRRiShTvA shailarAjasutA tadA |
uvAcha vachanaM sAdhvI devaM pashupatiM patim
shlokas.22:
bhagavankva nu yAntyete devAH shakrapurogamAH |
brUhi tattvena tattvaj~na sa.nshayo me mahAnayam
shlokas.23:
maheshvara uvAcha||
dakSho nAma mahAbhAge prajAnAM patiruttamaH |
hayamedhena yajate tatra yAnti divaukasaH
shlokas.24:
umA uvAcha||
yaj~nametaM mahAbhAga kimarthaM nAbhigachChasi |
kena vA pratiShedhena gamanaM te na vidyate
shlokas.25:
maheshvara uvAcha||
suraireva mahAbhAge sarvametadanuShThitam |
yaj~neShu sarveShu mama na bhAga upakalpitaH
shlokas.26:
pUrvopAyopapannena mArgeNa varavarNini |
na me surAH prayachChanti bhAgaM yaj~nasya dharmataH
shlokas.27:
umA uvAcha||
bhagavansarvabhUteShu prabhavAbhyadhiko guNaiH |
ajeyashchApradhRRiShyashcha tejasA yashasA shriyA
shlokas.28:
anena te mahAbhAga pratiShedhena bhAgataH |
atIva duHkhamutpannaM vepathushcha mamAnagha
shlokas.29:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktvA tu sA devI devaM pashupatiM patim |
tUShNImbhUtAbhavadrAjandahyamAnena chetasA
shlokas.30:
atha devyA mataM j~nAtvA hRRidgataM yachchikIrShitam |
sa samAj~nApayAmAsa tiShTha tvamiti nandinam
shlokas.31:
tato yogabalaM kRRitvA sarvayogeshvareshvaraH |
taM yaj~naM sumahAtejA bhImairanucharaistadA
sahasA ghAtayAmAsa devadevaH pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.32:
kechinnAdAnamu~nchanta kechiddhAsA.nshcha chakrire |
rudhireNApare rAja.nstatrAgniM samavAkiran
shlokas.33:
kechidyUpAnsamutpATya babhramurvikRRitAnanAH |
Asyairanye chAgrasanta tathaiva parichArakAn
shlokas.34:
tataH sa yaj~no nRRipate vadhyamAnaH samantataH |
AsthAya mRRigarUpaM vai khamevAbhyapatattadA
shlokas.35:
taM tu yaj~naM tathArUpaM gachChantamupalabhya saH |
dhanurAdAya bANaM cha tadAnvasarata prabhuH
shlokas.36:
tatastasya sureshasya krodhAdamitatejasaH |
lalATAtprasRRito ghoraH svedabindurbabhUva ha
shlokas.37:
tasminpatitamAtre tu svedabindau tathA bhuvi |
prAdurbabhUva sumahAnagniH kAlAnalopamaH
shlokas.38:
tatra chAjAyata tadA puruShaH puruSharShabha |
hrasvo.atimAtraraktAkSho harishmashrurvibhIShaNaH
shlokas.39:
Urdhvakesho.atilomA~NgaH shyenolUkastathaiva cha |
karAlaH kRRiShNavarNashcha raktavAsAstathaiva cha
shlokas.40:
taM yaj~naM sa mahAsattvo.adahatkakShamivAnalaH |
devAshchApyadravansarve tato bhItA disho dasha
shlokas.41:
tena tasminvicharatA puruSheNa vishAM pate |
pRRithivI vyachaladrAjannatIva bharatarShabha
shlokas.42:
hAhAbhUte pravRRitte tu nAde lokabhaya~Nkare |
pitAmaho mahAdevaM darshayanpratyabhAShata
shlokas.43:
bhavato.api surAH sarve bhAgaM dAsyanti vai prabho |
kriyatAM pratisaMhAraH sarvadeveshvara tvayA
shlokas.44:
imA hi devatAH sarvA RRiShayashcha parantapa |
tava krodhAnmahAdeva na shAntimupalebhire
shlokas.45:
yashchaiSha puruSho jAtaH svedAtte vibudhottama |
jvaro nAmaiSha dharmaj~na lokeShu prachariShyati
shlokas.46:
ekIbhUtasya na hyasya dhAraNe tejasaH prabho |
samarthA sakalA pRRithvI bahudhA sRRijyatAmayam
shlokas.47:
ityukto brahmaNA devo bhAge chApi prakalpite |
bhagavantaM tathetyAha brahmANamamitaujasam
shlokas.48:
parAM cha prItimagamadutsmaya.nshcha pinAkadhRRik |
avApa cha tadA bhAgaM yathoktaM brahmaNA bhavaH
shlokas.49:
jvaraM cha sarvadharmaj~no bahudhA vyasRRijattadA |
shAntyarthaM sarvabhUtAnAM shRRiNu tachchApi putraka
shlokas.50:
shIrShAbhitApo nAgAnAM parvatAnAM shilAjatuH |
apAM tu nIlikAM vidyAnnirmokaM bhujageShu cha
shlokas.51:
khorakaH saurabheyANAmUSharaM pRRithivItale |
pashUnAmapi dharmaj~na dRRiShTipratyavarodhanam
shlokas.52:
randhrAgatamathAshvAnAM shikhodbhedashcha barhiNAm |
netrarogaH kokilAnAM jvaraH prokto mahAtmanA
shlokas.53:
abjAnAM pittabhedashcha sarveShAmiti naH shrutam |
shukAnAmapi sarveShAM hikkikA prochyate jvaraH
shlokas.54:
shArdUleShvatha dharmaj~na shramo jvara ihochyate |
mAnuSheShu tu dharmaj~na jvaro nAmaiSha vishrutaH
maraNe janmani tathA madhye chAvishate naram
shlokas.55:
etanmAheshvaraM tejo jvaro nAma sudAruNaH |
namasyashchaiva mAnyashcha sarvaprANibhirIshvaraH
shlokas.56:
anena hi samAviShTo vRRitro dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
vyajRRimbhata tataH shakrastasmai vajramavAsRRijat
shlokas.57:
pravishya vajro vRRitraM tu dArayAmAsa bhArata |
dAritashcha sa vajreNa mahAyogI mahAsuraH
jagAma paramaM sthAnaM viShNoramitatejasaH
shlokas.58:
viShNubhaktyA hi tenedaM jagadvyAptamabhUtpurA |
tasmAchcha nihato yuddhe viShNoH sthAnamavAptavAn
shlokas.59:
ityeSha vRRitramAshritya jvarasya mahato mayA |
vistaraH kathitaH putra kimanyatprabravImi te
shlokas.60:
imAM jvarotpattimadInamAnasaH; paThetsadA yaH susamAhito naraH |
vimuktarogaH sa sukhI mudA yuto; labheta kAmAnsa yathAmanIShitAn

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shokAdduHkhAchcha mRRityoshcha trasyanti prANinaH sadA |
ubhayaM me yathA na syAttanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atraivodAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradasya cha sa.nvAdaM sama~Ngasya cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
nArada uvAcha||
uraseva praNamase bAhubhyAM tarasIva cha |
samprahRRiShTamanA nityaM vishoka iva lakShyase
shlokas.4:
udvegaM neha te ki~nchitsusUkShmamapi lakShaye |
nityatRRipta iva svastho bAlavachcha vicheShTase
shlokas.5:
sama~Nga uvAcha||
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha sarvaM sattveShu mAnada |
teShAM tattvAni jAnAmi tato na vimanA hyaham
shlokas.6:
upakramAnahaM veda punareva phalodayAn |
loke phalAni chitrANi tato na vimanA hyaham
shlokas.7:
agAdhAshchApratiShThAshcha gatimantashcha nArada |
andhA jaDAshcha jIvanti pashyAsmAnapi jIvataH
shlokas.8:
vihitenaiva jIvanti arogA~NgA divaukasaH |
balavanto.abalAshchaiva tadvadasmAnsabhAjaya
shlokas.9:
sahasriNashcha jIvanti jIvanti shatinastathA |
shAkena chAnye jIvanti pashyAsmAnapi jIvataH
shlokas.10:
yadA na shochemahi kiM nu na syA;ddharmeNa vA nArada karmaNA vA |
kRRitAntavashyAni yadA sukhAni; duHkhAni vA yanna vidharShayanti
shlokas.11:
yasmai praj~nAM kathayante manuShyAH; praj~nAmUlo hIndriyANAM prasAdaH |
muhyanti shochanti yadendriyANi; praj~nAlAbho nAsti mUDhendriyasya
shlokas.12:
mUDhasya darpaH sa punarmoha eva; mUDhasya nAyaM na paro.asti lokaH |
na hyeva duHkhAni sadA bhavanti; sukhasya vA nityasho lAbha eva
shlokas.13:
bhAvAtmakaM samparivartamAnaM; na mAdRRishaH sa~njvaraM jAtu kuryAt |
iShTAnbhogAnnAnurudhyetsukhaM vA; na chintayedduHkhamabhyAgataM vA
shlokas.14:
samAhito na spRRihayetpareShAM; nAnAgataM nAbhinandeta lAbham |
na chApi hRRiShyedvipule.arthalAbhe; tathArthanAshe cha na vai viShIdet
shlokas.15:
na bAndhavA na cha vittaM na kaulI; na cha shrutaM na cha mantrA na vIryam |
duHkhAttrAtuM sarva evotsahante; paratra shIle na tu yAnti shAntim
shlokas.16:
nAsti buddhirayuktasya nAyogAdvidyate sukham |
dhRRitishcha duHkhatyAgashchApyubhayaM naH sukhodayam
shlokas.17:
priyaM hi harShajananaM harSha utsekavardhanaH |
utseko narakAyaiva tasmAttaM santyajAmyaham
shlokas.18:
etA~nshokabhayotsekAnmohanAnsukhaduHkhayoH |
pashyAmi sAkShivalloke dehasyAsya vicheShTanAt
shlokas.19:
arthakAmau parityajya vishoko vigatajvaraH |
tRRiShNAmohau tu santyajya charAmi pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.20:
na mRRityuto na chAdharmAnna lobhAnna kutashchana |
pItAmRRitasyevAtyantamiha chAmutra vA bhayam
shlokas.21:
etadbrahmanvijAnAmi mahatkRRitvA tapo.avyayam |
tena nArada samprApto na mAM shokaH prabAdhate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atattvaj~nasya shAstrANAM satataM sa.nshayAtmanaH |
akRRitavyavasAyasya shreyo brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
gurupUjA cha satataM vRRiddhAnAM paryupAsanam |
shravaNaM chaiva vidyAnAM kUTasthaM shreya uchyate
shlokas.3:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
gAlavasya cha sa.nvAdaM devarShernAradasya cha
shlokas.4:
vItamohaklamaM vipraM j~nAnatRRiptaM jitendriyam |
shreyaskAmaM jitAtmAnaM nAradaM gAlavo.abravIt
shlokas.5:
yaiH kaishchitsaMmato loke guNaistu puruSho nRRiShu |
bhavatyanapagAnsarvA.nstAnguNA.NllakShayAmyaham
shlokas.6:
bhavAneva.nvidho.asmAkaM sa.nshayaM Chettumarhati |
amUDhashchiramUDhAnAM lokatattvamajAnatAm
shlokas.7:
j~nAne hyevaM pravRRittiH syAtkAryAkArye vijAnataH |
yatkAryaM na vyavasyAmastadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.8:
bhagavannAshramAH sarve pRRithagAchAradarshinaH |
idaM shreya idaM shreya iti nAnApradhAvitAH
shlokas.9:
tA.nstu viprasthitAndRRiShTvA shAstraiH shAstrAbhinandinaH |
svashAstraiH parituShTA.nshcha shreyo nopalabhAmahe
shlokas.10:
shAstraM yadi bhavedekaM vyaktaM shreyo bhavettadA |
shAstraishcha bahubhirbhUyaH shreyo guhyaM praveshitam
shlokas.11:
etasmAtkAraNAchChreyaH kalilaM pratibhAti mAm |
bravItu bhagavA.nstanme upasanno.asmyadhIhi bhoH
shlokas.12:
nArada uvAcha||
AshramAstAta chatvAro yathAsa~NkalpitAH pRRithak |
tAnsarvAnanupashya tvaM samAshrityaiva gAlava
shlokas.13:
teShAM teShAM tathA hi tvamAshramANAM tatastataH |
nAnArUpaguNoddeshaM pashya viprasthitaM pRRithak
nayanti chaiva te samyagabhipretamasa.nshayam
shlokas.14:
RRiju pashya.nstathA samyagAshramANAM parAM gatim |
yattu niHshreyasaM samyaktachchaivAsa.nshayAtmakam
shlokas.15:
anugrahaM cha mitrANAmamitrANAM cha nigraham |
sa~NgrahaM cha trivargasya shreya AhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.16:
nivRRittiH karmaNaH pApAtsatataM puNyashIlatA |
sadbhishcha samudAchAraH shreya etadasa.nshayam
shlokas.17:
mArdavaM sarvabhUteShu vyavahAreShu chArjavam |
vAkchaiva madhurA proktA shreya etadasa.nshayam
shlokas.18:
devatAbhyaH pitRRibhyashcha sa.nvibhAgo.atithiShvapi |
asantyAgashcha bhRRityAnAM shreya etadasa.nshayam
shlokas.19:
satyasya vachanaM shreyaH satyaj~nAnaM tu duShkaram |
yadbhUtahitamatyantametatsatyaM bravImyaham
shlokas.20:
aha~NkArasya cha tyAgaH praNayasya cha nigrahaH |
santoShashchaikacharyA cha kUTasthaM shreya uchyate
shlokas.21:
dharmeNa vedAdhyayanaM vedA~NgAnAM tathaiva cha |
vidyArthAnAM cha jij~nAsA shreya etadasa.nshayam
shlokas.22:
shabdarUparasasparshAnsaha gandhena kevalAn |
nAtyarthamupaseveta shreyaso.arthI parantapa
shlokas.23:
nakta~ncharyA divAsvapnamAlasyaM paishunaM madam |
atiyogamayogaM cha shreyaso.arthI parityajet
shlokas.24:
karmotkarShaM na mArgeta pareShAM parinindayA |
svaguNaireva mArgeta viprakarShaM pRRithagjanAt
shlokas.25:
nirguNAstveva bhUyiShThamAtmasambhAvino narAH |
doShairanyAnguNavataH kShipantyAtmaguNakShayAt
shlokas.26:
anuchyamAnAshcha punaste manyante mahAjanAt |
guNavattaramAtmAnaM svena mAnena darpitAH
shlokas.27:
abruvankasyachinnindAmAtmapUjAmavarNayan |
vipashchidguNasampannaH prApnotyeva mahadyashaH
shlokas.28:
abruvanvAti surabhirgandhaH sumanasAM shuchiH |
tathaivAvyAharanbhAti vimalo bhAnurambare
shlokas.29:
evamAdIni chAnyAni parityaktAni medhayA |
jvalanti yashasA loke yAni na vyAharanti cha
shlokas.30:
na loke dIpyate mUrkhaH kevalAtmaprasha.nsayA |
api chApihitaH shvabhre kRRitavidyaH prakAshate
shlokas.31:
asannuchchairapi proktaH shabdaH samupashAmyati |
dIpyate tveva lokeShu shanairapi subhAShitam
shlokas.32:
mUDhAnAmavaliptAnAmasAraM bhAShitaM bahu |
darshayatyantarAtmAnaM divA rUpamivA.nshumAn
shlokas.33:
etasmAtkAraNAtpraj~nAM mRRigayante pRRithagvidhAm |
praj~nAlAbho hi bhUtAnAmuttamaH pratibhAti mAm
shlokas.34:
nApRRiShTaH kasyachidbrUyAnna chAnyAyena pRRichChataH |
j~nAnavAnapi medhAvI jaDavallokamAcharet
shlokas.35:
tato vAsaM parIkSheta dharmanityeShu sAdhuShu |
manuShyeShu vadAnyeShu svadharmanirateShu cha
shlokas.36:
chaturNAM yatra varNAnAM dharmavyatikaro bhavet |
na tatra vAsaM kurvIta shreyorthI vai katha~nchana
shlokas.37:
nirArambho.apyayamiha yathAlabdhopajIvanaH |
puNyaM puNyeShu vimalaM pApaM pApeShu chApnuyAt
shlokas.38:
apAmagnestathendoshcha sparshaM vedayate yathA |
tathA pashyAmahe sparshamubhayoH pApapuNyayoH
shlokas.39:
apashyanto.annaviShayaM bhu~njate vighasAshinaH |
bhu~njAnaM chAnnaviShayAnviShayaM viddhi karmaNAm
shlokas.40:
yatrAgamayamAnAnAmasatkAreNa pRRichChatAm |
prabrUyAdbrahmaNo dharmaM tyajettaM deshamAtmavAn
shlokas.41:
shiShyopAdhyAyikA vRRittiryatra syAtsusamAhitA |
yathAvachChAstrasampannA kastaM deshaM parityajet
shlokas.42:
AkAshasthA dhruvaM yatra doShaM brUyurvipashchitAm |
AtmapUjAbhikAmA vai ko vasettatra paNDitaH
shlokas.43:
yatra sa.nloDitA lubdhaiH prAyasho dharmasetavaH |
pradIptamiva shailAntaM kastaM deshaM na santyajet
shlokas.44:
yatra dharmamanAsha~NkAshchareyurvItamatsarAH |
charettatra vasechchaiva puNyashIleShu sAdhuShu
shlokas.45:
dharmamarthanimittaM tu chareyuryatra mAnavAH |
na tAnanuvasejjAtu te hi pApakRRito janAH
shlokas.46:
karmaNA yatra pApena vartante jIvitespavaH |
vyavadhAvettatastUrNaM sasarpAchCharaNAdiva
shlokas.47:
yena khaTvAM samArUDhaH karmaNAnushayI bhavet |
Aditastanna kartavyamichChatA bhavamAtmanaH
shlokas.48:
yatra rAjA cha rAj~nashcha puruShAH pratyanantarAH |
kuTumbinAmagrabhujastyajettadrAShTramAtmavAn
shlokas.49:
shrotriyAstvagrabhoktAro dharmanityAH sanAtanAH |
yAjanAdhyApane yuktA yatra tadrAShTramAvaset
shlokas.50:
svAhAsvadhAvaShaTkArA yatra samyaganuShThitAH |
ajasraM chaiva vartante vasettatrAvichArayan
shlokas.51:
ashuchInyatra pashyeta brAhmaNAnvRRittikarshitAn |
tyajettadrAShTramAsannamupasRRiShTamivAmiSham
shlokas.52:
prIyamANA narA yatra prayachCheyurayAchitAH |
svasthachitto vasettatra kRRitakRRitya ivAtmavAn
shlokas.53:
daNDo yatrAvinIteShu satkArashcha kRRitAtmasu |
charettatra vasechchaiva puNyashIleShu sAdhuShu
shlokas.54:
upasRRiShTeShvadAnteShu durAchAreShvasAdhuShu |
avinIteShu lubdheShu sumahaddaNDadhAraNam
shlokas.55:
yatra rAjA dharmanityo rAjyaM vai paryupAsitA |
apAsya kAmAnkAmesho vasettatrAvichArayan
shlokas.56:
tathAshIlA hi rAjAnaH sarvAnviShayavAsinaH |
shreyasA yojayantyAshu shreyasi pratyupasthite
shlokas.57:
pRRichChataste mayA tAta shreya etadudAhRRitam |
na hi shakyaM pradhAnena shreyaH sa~NkhyAtumAtmanaH
shlokas.58:
evaM pravartamAnasya vRRittiM praNihitAtmanaH |
tapasaiveha bahulaM shreyo vyaktaM bhaviShyati

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM nu muktaH pRRithivIM charedasmadvidho nRRipaH |
nityaM kaishcha guNairyuktaH sa~NgapAshAdvimuchyate
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi itihAsaM purAtanam |
ariShTaneminA proktaM sagarAyAnupRRichChate
shlokas.3:
sagara uvAcha||
kiM shreyaH paramaM brahmankRRitveha sukhamashnute |
kathaM na shochenna kShubhyedetadichChAmi veditum
shlokas.4:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamuktastadA tArkShyaH sarvashAstravishAradaH |
vibudhya sampadaM chAgryAM sadvAkyamidamabravIt
shlokas.5:
sukhaM mokShasukhaM loke na cha loko.avagachChati |
prasaktaH putrapashuShu dhanadhAnyasamAkulaH
shlokas.6:
saktabuddhirashAntAtmA na sa shakyashchikitsitum |
snehapAshasito mUDho na sa mokShAya kalpate
shlokas.7:
snehajAniha te pAshAnvakShyAmi shRRiNu tAnmama |
sakarNakena shirasA shakyAshChettuM vijAnatA
shlokas.8:
sambhAvya putrAnkAlena yauvanasthAnniveshya cha |
samarthA~njIvane j~nAtvA muktashchara yathAsukham
shlokas.9:
bhAryAM putravatIM vRRiddhAM lAlitAM putravatsalAm |
j~nAtvA prajahi kAle tvaM parArthamanudRRishya cha
shlokas.10:
sApatyo nirapatyo vA muktashchara yathAsukham |
indriyairindriyArthA.nstvamanubhUya yathAvidhi
shlokas.11:
kRRitakautUhalasteShu muktashchara yathAsukham |
upapattyopalabdheShu lAbheShu cha samo bhava
shlokas.12:
eSha tAvatsamAsena tava sa~NkIrtito mayA |
mokShArtho vistareNApi bhUyo vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.13:
muktA vItabhayA loke charanti sukhino narAH |
saktabhAvA vinashyanti narAstatra na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.14:
AhArasa~nchayAshchaiva tathA kITapipIlikAH |
asaktAH sukhino loke saktAshchaiva vinAshinaH
shlokas.15:
svajane na cha te chintA kartavyA mokShabuddhinA |
ime mayA vinAbhUtA bhaviShyanti kathaM tviti
shlokas.16:
svayamutpadyate jantuH svayameva vivardhate |
sukhaduHkhe tathA mRRityuM svayamevAdhigachChati
shlokas.17:
bhojanAchChAdane chaiva mAtrA pitrA cha sa~Ngraham |
svakRRitenAdhigachChanti loke nAstyakRRitaM purA
shlokas.18:
dhAtrA vihitabhakShyANi sarvabhUtAni medinIm |
loke viparidhAvanti rakShitAni svakarmabhiH
shlokas.19:
svayaM mRRitpiNDabhUtasya paratantrasya sarvadA |
ko hetuH svajanaM poShTuM rakShituM vAdRRiDhAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
svajanaM hi yadA mRRityurhantyeva tava pashyataH |
kRRite.api yatne mahati tatra boddhavyamAtmanA
shlokas.21:
jIvantamapi chaivainaM bharaNe rakShaNe tathA |
asamApte parityajya pashchAdapi mariShyasi
shlokas.22:
yadA mRRitashcha svajanaM na j~nAsyasi katha~nchana |
sukhitaM duHkhitaM vApi nanu boddhavyamAtmanA
shlokas.23:
mRRite vA tvayi jIve vA yadi bhokShyati vai janaH |
svakRRitaM nanu buddhvaivaM kartavyaM hitamAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
evaM vijAna.Nlloke.asminkaH kasyetyabhinishchitaH |
mokShe niveshaya mano bhUyashchApyupadhAraya
shlokas.25:
kShutpipAsAdayo bhAvA jitA yasyeha dehinaH |
krodho lobhastathA mohaH sattvavAnmukta eva saH
shlokas.26:
dyUte pAne tathA strIShu mRRigayAyAM cha yo naraH |
na pramAdyati saMmohAtsatataM mukta eva saH
shlokas.27:
divase divase nAma rAtrau rAtrau sadA sadA |
bhoktavyamiti yaH khinno doShabuddhiH sa uchyate
shlokas.28:
AtmabhAvaM tathA strIShu muktameva punaH punaH |
yaH pashyati sadA yukto yathAvanmukta eva saH
shlokas.29:
sambhavaM cha vinAshaM cha bhUtAnAM cheShTitaM tathA |
yastattvato vijAnAti loke.asminmukta eva saH
shlokas.30:
prasthaM vAhasahasreShu yAtrArthaM chaiva koTiShu |
prAsAde ma~nchakasthAnaM yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.31:
mRRityunAbhyAhataM lokaM vyAdhibhishchopapIDitam |
avRRittikarshitaM chaiva yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.32:
yaH pashyati sukhI tuShTo napashya.nshcha vihanyate |
yashchApyalpena santuShTo loke.asminmukta eva saH
shlokas.33:
agnIShomAvidaM sarvamiti yashchAnupashyati |
na cha sa.nspRRishyate bhAvairadbhutairmukta eva saH
shlokas.34:
parya~NkashayyA bhUmishcha samAne yasya dehinaH |
shAlayashcha kadannaM cha yasya syAnmukta eva saH
shlokas.35:
kShaumaM cha kushachIraM cha kausheyaM valkalAni cha |
AvikaM charma cha samaM yasya syAnmukta eva saH
shlokas.36:
pa~nchabhUtasamudbhUtaM lokaM yashchAnupashyati |
tathA cha vartate dRRiShTvA loke.asminmukta eva saH
shlokas.37:
sukhaduHkhe same yasya lAbhAlAbhau jayAjayau |
ichChAdveShau bhayodvegau sarvathA mukta eva saH
shlokas.38:
raktamUtrapurIShANAM doShANAM sa~nchayaM tathA |
sharIraM doShabahulaM dRRiShTvA chedaM vimuchyate
shlokas.39:
valIpalitasa.nyogaM kArshyaM vaivarNyameva cha |
kubjabhAvaM cha jarayA yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.40:
pu.nstvopaghAtaM kAlena darshanoparamaM tathA |
bAdhiryaM prANamandatvaM yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.41:
gatAnRRiShI.nstathA devAnasurA.nshcha tathA gatAn |
lokAdasmAtparaM lokaM yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.42:
prabhAvairanvitAstaistaiH pArthivendrAH sahasrashaH |
ye gatAH pRRithivIM tyaktvA iti j~nAtvA vimuchyate
shlokas.43:
arthA.nshcha durlabhA.Nlloke kleshA.nshcha sulabhA.nstathA |
duHkhaM chaiva kuTumbArthe yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.44:
apatyAnAM cha vaiguNyaM janaM viguNameva cha |
pashyanbhUyiShThasho loke ko mokShaM nAbhipUjayet
shlokas.45:
shAstrAllokAchcha yo buddhaH sarvaM pashyati mAnavaH |
asAramiva mAnuShyaM sarvathA mukta eva saH
shlokas.46:
etachChrutvA mama vacho bhavA.nshcharatu muktavat |
gArhasthye yadi te mokShe kRRitA buddhiraviklavA
shlokas.47:
tattasya vachanaM shrutvA samyaksa pRRithivIpatiH |
mokShajaishcha guNairyuktaH pAlayAmAsa cha prajAH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tiShThate me sadA tAta kautUhalamidaM hRRidi |
tadahaM shrotumichChAmi tvattaH kurupitAmaha
shlokas.2:
kathaM devarShirushanA sadA kAvyo mahAmatiH |
asurANAM priyakaraH surANAmapriye rataH
shlokas.3:
vardhayAmAsa tejashcha kimarthamamitaujasAm |
nityaM vairanibaddhAshcha dAnavAH surasattamaiH
shlokas.4:
kathaM chApyushanA prApa shukratvamamaradyutiH |
RRiddhiM cha sa kathaM prAptaH sarvametadbravIhi me
shlokas.5:
na yAti cha sa tejasvI madhyena nabhasaH katham |
etadichChAmi vij~nAtuM nikhilena pitAmaha
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannavahitaH sarvametadyathAtatham |
yathAmati yathA chaitachChrutapUrvaM mayAnagha
shlokas.7:
eSha bhArgavadAyAdo muniH satyo dRRiDhavrataH |
asurANAM priyakaro nimitte karuNAtmake
shlokas.8:
indro.atha dhanado rAjA yakSharakShodhipaH sa cha |
prabhaviShNushcha koshasya jagatashcha tathA prabhuH
shlokas.9:
tasyAtmAnamathAvishya yogasiddho mahAmuniH |
ruddhvA dhanapatiM devaM yogena hRRitavAnvasu
shlokas.10:
hRRite dhane tataH sharma na lebhe dhanadastathA |
ApannamanyuH sa.nvignaH so.abhyagAtsurasattamam
shlokas.11:
nivedayAmAsa tadA shivAyAmitatejase |
devashreShThAya rudrAya saumyAya bahurUpiNe
shlokas.12:
kubera uvAcha||
yogAtmakenoshanasA ruddhvA mama hRRitaM vasu |
yogenAtmagatiM kRRitvA niHsRRitashcha mahAtapAH
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tataH kruddho mahAyogI maheshvaraH |
sa.nraktanayano rAja~nshUlamAdAya tasthivAn
shlokas.14:
kvAsvau kvAsAviti prAha gRRihItvA paramAyudham |
ushanA dUratastasya babhau j~nAtvA chikIrShitam
shlokas.15:
sa mahAyogino buddhvA taM roShaM vai mahAtmanaH |
gatimAgamanaM vetti sthAnaM vetti tataH prabhuH
shlokas.16:
sa~nchintyogreNa tapasA mahAtmAnaM maheshvaram |
ushanA yogasiddhAtmA shUlAgre pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.17:
vij~nAtarUpaH sa tadA tapaHsiddhena dhanvinA |
j~nAtvA shUlaM cha deveshaH pANinA samanAmayat
shlokas.18:
AnatenAtha shUlena pANinAmitatejasA |
pinAkamiti chovAcha shUlamugrAyudhaH prabhuH
shlokas.19:
pANimadhyagataM dRRiShTvA bhArgavaM tamumApatiH |
AsyaM vivRRitya kakudI pANiM samprAkShipachChanaiH
shlokas.20:
sa tu praviShTa ushanA koShThaM mAheshvaraM prabhuH |
vyacharachchApi tatrAsau mahAtmA bhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kimarthaM vyacharadrAjannushanA tasya dhImataH |
jaThare devadevasya kiM chAkArShInmahAdyutiH
shlokas.22:
bhIShma uvAcha||
purA so.antarjalagataH sthANubhUto mahAvrataH |
varShANAmabhavadrAjanprayutAnyarbudAni cha
shlokas.23:
udatiShThattapastaptvA dushcharaM sa mahAhradAt |
tato devAtidevastaM brahmA samupasarpata
shlokas.24:
tapovRRiddhimapRRichChachcha kushalaM chainamavyayam |
tapaH suchIrNamiti cha provAcha vRRiShabhadhvajaH
shlokas.25:
tatsa.nyogena vRRiddhiM chApyapashyatsa tu sha~NkaraH |
mahAmatirachintyAtmA satyadharmarataH sadA
shlokas.26:
sa tenADhyo mahAyogI tapasA cha dhanena cha |
vyarAjata mahArAja triShu lokeShu vIryavAn
shlokas.27:
tataH pinAkI yogAtmA dhyAnayogaM samAvishat |
ushanA tu samudvigno nililye jaThare tataH
shlokas.28:
tuShTAva cha mahAyogI devaM tatrastha eva cha |
niHsAraM kA~NkShamANastu tejasA pratyahanyata
shlokas.29:
ushanA tu tadovAcha jaTharastho mahAmuniH |
prasAdaM me kuruShveti punaH punarari.ndama
shlokas.30:
tamuvAcha mahAdevo gachCha shishnena mokShaNam |
iti srotA.nsi sarvANi ruddhvA tridashapu~NgavaH
shlokas.31:
apashyamAnaH sa dvAraM sarvataHpihito muniH |
paryakrAmaddahyamAna itashchetashcha tejasA
shlokas.32:
sa viniShkramya shishnena shukratvamabhipedivAn |
kAryeNa tena nabhaso nAgachChata cha madhyataH
shlokas.33:
niShkrAntamatha taM dRRiShTvA jvalantamiva tejasA |
bhavo roShasamAviShTaH shUlodyatakaraH sthitaH
shlokas.34:
nyavArayata taM devI kruddhaM pashupatiM patim |
putratvamagamaddevyA vArite sha~Nkare cha saH
shlokas.35:
devyuvAcha||
hi.nsanIyastvayA naiSha mama putratvamAgataH |
na hi devodarAtkashchinniHsRRito nAshamarChati
shlokas.36:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH prIto.abhavaddevyAH prahasa.nshchedamabravIt |
gachChatveSha yathAkAmamiti rAjanpunaH punaH
shlokas.37:
tataH praNamya varadaM devaM devImumAM tathA |
ushanA prApa taddhImAngatimiShTAM mahAmuniH
shlokas.38:
etatte kathitaM tAta bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH |
charitaM bharatashreShTha yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ataH paraM mahAbAho yachChreyastadvadasva me |
na tRRipyAmyamRRitasyeva vachasaste pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
kiM karma puruShaH kRRitvA shubhaM puruShasattama |
shreyaH paramavApnoti pretya cheha cha tadvada
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShyAmi yathA pUrvaM mahAyashAH |
parAsharaM mahAtmAnaM paprachCha janako nRRipaH
shlokas.4:
kiM shreyaH sarvabhUtAnAmasmi.Nlloke paratra cha |
yadbhavetpratipattavyaM tadbhavAnprabravItu me
shlokas.5:
tataH sa tapasA yuktaH sarvadharmavidhAnavit |
nRRipAyAnugrahamanA munirvAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.6:
dharma eva kRRitaH shreyAniha loke paratra cha |
tasmAddhi paramaM nAsti yathA prAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.7:
pratipadya naro dharmaM svargaloke mahIyate |
dharmAtmakaH karmavidhirdehinAM nRRipasattama
tasminnAshramiNaH santaH svakarmANIha kurvate
shlokas.8:
chaturvidhA hi lokasya yAtrA tAta vidhIyate |
martyA yatrAvatiShThante sA cha kAmAtpravartate
shlokas.9:
sukRRitAsukRRitaM karma niShevya vividhaiH kramaiH |
dashArdhapravibhaktAnAM bhUtAnAM bahudhA gatiH
shlokas.10:
sauvarNaM rAjataM vApi yathA bhANDaM niShichyate |
tathA niShichyate jantuH pUrvakarmavashAnugaH
shlokas.11:
nAbIjAjjAyate ki~nchinnAkRRitvA sukhamedhate |
sukRRitI vindati sukhaM prApya dehakShayaM naraH
shlokas.12:
daivaM tAta na pashyAmi nAsti daivasya sAdhanam |
svabhAvato hi sa.nsiddhA devagandharvadAnavAH
shlokas.13:
pretya jAtikRRitaM karma na smaranti sadA janAH |
te vai tasya phalaprAptau karma chApi chaturvidham
shlokas.14:
lokayAtrAshrayashchaiva shabdo vedAshrayaH kRRitaH |
shAntyarthaM manasastAta naitadvRRiddhAnushAsanam
shlokas.15:
chakShuShA manasA vAchA karmaNA cha chaturvidham |
kurute yAdRRishaM karma tAdRRishaM pratipadyate
shlokas.16:
nirantaraM cha mishraM cha phalate karma pArthiva |
kalyANaM yadi vA pApaM na tu nAsho.asya vidyate
shlokas.17:
kadAchitsukRRitaM tAta kUTasthamiva tiShThati |
majjamAnasya sa.nsAre yAvadduHkhAdvimuchyate
shlokas.18:
tato duHkhakShayaM kRRitvA sukRRitaM karma sevate |
sukRRitakShayAdduShkRRitaM cha tadviddhi manujAdhipa
shlokas.19:
damaH kShamA dhRRitistejaH santoShaH satyavAditA |
hrIrahi.nsAvyasanitA dAkShyaM cheti sukhAvahAH
shlokas.20:
duShkRRite sukRRite vApi na janturayato bhavet |
nityaM manaHsamAdhAne prayateta vichakShaNaH
shlokas.21:
nAyaM parasya sukRRitaM duShkRRitaM vApi sevate |
karoti yAdRRishaM karma tAdRRishaM pratipadyate
shlokas.22:
sukhaduHkhe samAdhAya pumAnanyena gachChati |
anyenaiva janaH sarvaH sa~Ngato yashcha pArthiva
shlokas.23:
pareShAM yadasUyeta na tatkuryAtsvayaM naraH |
yo hyasUyustathAyuktaH so.avahAsaM niyachChati
shlokas.24:
bhIrU rAjanyo brAhmaNaH sarvabhakSho; vaishyo.anIhAvAnhInavarNo.alasashcha |
vidvA.nshchAshIlo vRRittahInaH kulInaH; satyAdbhraShTo brAhmaNaH strI cha duShTA
shlokas.25:
rAgI muktaH pachamAno.a.atmaheto;rmUrkho vaktA nRRipahInaM cha rAShTram |
ete sarve shochyatAM yAnti rAja;nyashchAyuktaH snehahInaH prajAsu

shlokas.1:
parAshara uvAcha||
manoratharathaM prApya indriyArthahayaM naraH |
rashmibhirj~nAnasambhUtairyo gachChati sa buddhimAn
shlokas.2:
sevAshritena manasA vRRittihInasya shasyate |
dvijAtihastAnnirvRRittA na tu tulyAtparasparam
shlokas.3:
AyurnasulabhaM labdhvA nAvakarShedvishAM pate |
utkarShArthaM prayatate naraH puNyena karmaNA
shlokas.4:
