varNebhyo.api paribhraShTaH sa vai saMmAnamarhati |
na tu yaH satkriyAM prApya rAjasaM karma sevate
shlokas.5:
varNotkarShamavApnoti naraH puNyena karmaNA |
durlabhaM tamalabdhA hi hanyAtpApena karmaNA
shlokas.6:
aj~nAnAddhi kRRitaM pApaM tapasaivAbhinirNudet |
pApaM hi karma phalati pApameva svayaM kRRitam
tasmAtpApaM na seveta karma duHkhaphalodayam
shlokas.7:
pApAnubandhaM yatkarma yadyapi syAnmahAphalam |
na tatseveta medhAvI shuchiH kusalilaM yathA
shlokas.8:
ki~NkaShTamanupashyAmi phalaM pApasya karmaNaH |
pratyApannasya hi sato nAtmA tAvadvirochate
shlokas.9:
pratyApattishcha yasyeha bAlishasya na jAyate |
tasyApi sumahA.nstApaH prasthitasyopajAyate
shlokas.10:
viraktaM shodhyate vastraM na tu kRRiShNopasaMhitam |
prayatnena manuShyendra pApamevaM nibodha me
shlokas.11:
svayaM kRRitvA tu yaH pApaM shubhamevAnutiShThati |
prAyashchittaM naraH kartumubhayaM so.ashnute pRRithak
shlokas.12:
aj~nAnAttu kRRitAM hi.nsAmahi.nsA vyapakarShati |
brAhmaNAH shAstranirdeshAdityAhurbrahmavAdinaH
shlokas.13:
tathA kAmakRRitaM chAsya vihi.nsaivApakarShati |
ityAhurdharmashAstraj~nA brAhmaNA vedapAragAH
shlokas.14:
ahaM tu tAvatpashyAmi karma yadvartate kRRitam |
guNayuktaM prakAshaM cha pApenAnupasaMhitam
shlokas.15:
yathA sUkShmANi karmANi phalantIha yathAtatham |
buddhiyuktAni tAnIha kRRitAni manasA saha
shlokas.16:
bhavatyalpaphalaM karma sevitaM nityamulbaNam |
abuddhipUrvaM dharmaj~na kRRitamugreNa karmaNA
shlokas.17:
kRRitAni yAni karmANi daivatairmunibhistathA |
nAcharettAni dharmAtmA shrutvA chApi na kutsayet
shlokas.18:
sa~nchintya manasA rAjanviditvA shaktimAtmanaH |
karoti yaH shubhaM karma sa vai bhadrANi pashyati
shlokas.19:
nave kapAle salilaM saMnyastaM hIyate yathA |
navetare tathAbhAvaM prApnoti sukhabhAvitam
shlokas.20:
satoye.anyattu yattoyaM tasminneva prasichyate |
vRRiddhe vRRiddhimavApnoti salile salilaM yathA
shlokas.21:
evaM karmANi yAnIha buddhiyuktAni bhUpate |
nasamAnIha hInAni tAni puNyatamAnyapi
shlokas.22:
rAj~nA jetavyAH sAyudhAshchonnatAshcha; samyakkartavyaM pAlanaM cha prajAnAm |
agnishcheyo bahubhishchApi yaj~nai;rante madhye vA vanamAshritya stheyam
shlokas.23:
damAnvitaH puruSho dharmashIlo; bhUtAni chAtmAnamivAnupashyet |
garIyasaH pUjayedAtmashaktyA; satyena shIlena sukhaM narendra

shlokas.1:
parAshara uvAcha||
kaH kasya chopakurute kashcha kasmai prayachChati |
prANI karotyayaM karma sarvamAtmArthamAtmanA
shlokas.2:
gauraveNa parityaktaM niHsnehaM parivarjayet |
sodaryaM bhrAtaramapi kimutAnyaM pRRithagjanam
shlokas.3:
vishiShTasya vishiShTAchcha tulyau dAnapratigrahau |
tayoH puNyataraM dAnaM taddvijasya prayachChataH
shlokas.4:
nyAyAgataM dhanaM varNairnyAyenaiva vivardhitam |
sa.nrakShyaM yatnamAsthAya dharmArthamiti nishchayaH
shlokas.5:
na dharmArthI nRRisha.nsena karmaNA dhanamarjayet |
shaktitaH sarvakAryANi kuryAnnarddhimanusmaret
shlokas.6:
apo hi prayataH shItAstApitA jvalanena vA |
shaktito.atithaye dattvA kShudhArtAyAshnute phalam
shlokas.7:
rantidevena lokeShTA siddhiH prAptA mahAtmanA |
phalapatrairatho mUlairmunInarchitavAnasau
shlokas.8:
taireva phalapatraishcha sa mATharamatoShayat |
tasmAllebhe paraM sthAnaM shaibyo.api pRRithivIpatiH
shlokas.9:
devatAtithibhRRityebhyaH pitRRibhyo.athAtmanastathA |
RRiNavA~njAyate martyastasmAdanRRiNatAM vrajet
shlokas.10:
svAdhyAyena maharShibhyo devebhyo yaj~nakarmaNA |
pitRRibhyaH shrAddhadAnena nRRiNAmabhyarchanena cha
shlokas.11:
vAchaH sheShAvahAryeNa pAlanenAtmano.api cha |
yathAvadbhRRityavargasya chikIrSheddharmamAditaH
shlokas.12:
prayatnena cha sa.nsiddhA dhanairapi vivarjitAH |
samyagghutvA hutavahaM munayaH siddhimAgatAH
shlokas.13:
vishvAmitrasya putratvamRRichIkatanayo.agamat |
RRigbhiH stutvA mahAbhAgo devAnvai yaj~nabhAginaH
shlokas.14:
gataH shukratvamushanA devadevaprasAdanAt |
devIM stutvA tu gagane modate tejasA vRRitaH
shlokas.15:
asito devalashchaiva tathA nAradaparvatau |
kakShIvA~njAmadagnyashcha rAmastANDyastathA.nshumAn
shlokas.16:
vasiShTho jamadagnishcha vishvAmitro.atrireva cha |
bharadvAjo harishmashruH kuNDadhAraH shrutashravAH
shlokas.17:
ete maharShayaH stutvA viShNumRRigbhiH samAhitAH |
lebhire tapasA siddhiM prasAdAttasya dhImataH
shlokas.18:
anarhAshchArhatAM prAptAH santaH stutvA tameva ha |
na tu vRRiddhimihAnvichChetkarma kRRitvA jugupsitam
shlokas.19:
ye.arthA dharmeNa te satyA ye.adharmeNa dhigastu tAn |
dharmaM vai shAshvataM loke na jahyAddhanakA~NkShayA
shlokas.20:
AhitAgnirhi dharmAtmA yaH sa puNyakRRiduttamaH |
vedA hi sarve rAjendra sthitAstriShvagniShu prabho
shlokas.21:
sa chApyagnyAhito vipraH kriyA yasya na hIyate |
shreyo hyanAhitAgnitvamagnihotraM na niShkriyam
shlokas.22:
agnirAtmA cha mAtA cha pitA janayitA tathA |
gurushcha narashArdUla paricharyA yathAtatham
shlokas.23:
mAnaM tyaktvA yo naro vRRiddhasevI; vidvAnklIbaH pashyati prItiyogAt |
dAkShyeNAhIno dharmayukto nadAnto; loke.asminvai pUjyate sadbhirAryaH

shlokas.1:
parAshara uvAcha||
vRRittiH sakAshAdvarNebhyastribhyo hInasya shobhanA |
prItyopanItA nirdiShTA dharmiShThAnkurute sadA
shlokas.2:
vRRittishchennAsti shUdrasya pitRRipaitAmahI dhruvA |
na vRRittiM parato mArgechChushrUShAM tu prayojayet
shlokas.3:
sadbhistu saha sa.nsargaH shobhate dharmadarshibhiH |
nityaM sarvAsvavasthAsu nAsadbhiriti me matiH
shlokas.4:
yathodayagirau dravyaM saMnikarSheNa dIpyate |
tathA satsaMnikarSheNa hInavarNo.api dIpyate
shlokas.5:
yAdRRishena hi varNena bhAvyate shuklamambaram |
tAdRRishaM kurute rUpametadevamavaihi me
shlokas.6:
tasmAdguNeShu rajyethA mA doSheShu kadAchana |
anityamiha martyAnAM jIvitaM hi chalAchalam
shlokas.7:
sukhe vA yadi vA duHkhe vartamAno vichakShaNaH |
yashchinoti shubhAnyeva sa bhadrANIha pashyati
shlokas.8:
dharmAdapetaM yatkarma yadyapi syAnmahAphalam |
na tatseveta medhAvI na taddhitamihochyate
shlokas.9:
yo hRRitvA gosahasrANi nRRipo dadyAdarakShitA |
sa shabdamAtraphalabhAgrAjA bhavati taskaraH
shlokas.10:
svayambhUrasRRijachchAgre dhAtAraM lokapUjitam |
dhAtAsRRijatputramekaM prajAnAM dhAraNe ratam
shlokas.11:
tamarchayitvA vaishyastu kuryAdatyarthamRRiddhimat |
rakShitavyaM tu rAjanyairupayojyaM dvijAtibhiH
shlokas.12:
ajihmairashaThakrodhairhavyakavyaprayoktRRibhiH |
shUdrairnirmArjanaM kAryamevaM dharmo na nashyati
shlokas.13:
apranaShTe tato dharme bhavanti sukhitAH prajAH |
sukhena tAsAM rAjendra modante divi devatAH
shlokas.14:
tasmAdyo rakShati nRRipaH sa dharmeNAbhipUjyate |
adhIte chApi yo vipro vaishyo yashchArjane rataH
shlokas.15:
yashcha shushrUShate shUdraH satataM niyatendriyaH |
ato.anyathA manuShyendra svadharmAtparihIyate
shlokas.16:
prANasantApanirdiShTAH kAkiNyo.api mahAphalAH |
nyAyenopArjitA dattAH kimutAnyAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.17:
satkRRitya tu dvijAtibhyo yo dadAti narAdhipa |
yAdRRishaM tAdRRishaM nityamashnAti phalamUrjitam
shlokas.18:
abhigamya dattaM tuShTyA yaddhanyamAhurabhiShTutam |
yAchitena tu yaddattaM tadAhurmadhyamaM budhAH
shlokas.19:
avaj~nayA dIyate yattathaivAshraddhayApi cha |
tadAhuradhamaM dAnaM munayaH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.20:
atikrame majjamAno vividhena naraH sadA |
tathA prayatnaM kurvIta yathA muchyeta sa.nshayAt
shlokas.21:
damena shobhate vipraH kShatriyo vijayena tu |
dhanena vaishyaH shUdrastu nityaM dAkShyeNa shobhate

shlokas.1:
parAshara uvAcha||
pratigrahAgatA vipre kShatriye shastranirjitAH |
vaishye nyAyArjitAshchaiva shUdre shushrUShayArjitAH
svalpApyarthAH prashasyante dharmasyArthe mahAphalAH
shlokas.2:
nityaM trayANAM varNAnAM shUdraH shushrUShuruchyate |
kShatradharmA vaishyadharmA nAvRRittiH patati dvijaH
shUdrakarmA yadA tu syAttadA patati vai dvijaH
shlokas.3:
vANijyaM pAshupAlyaM cha tathA shilpopajIvanam |
shUdrasyApi vidhIyante yadA vRRittirna jAyate
shlokas.4:
ra~NgAvataraNaM chaiva tathA rUpopajIvanam |
madyamA.nsopajIvyaM cha vikrayo lohacharmaNoH
shlokas.5:
apUrviNA na kartavyaM karma loke vigarhitam |
kRRitapUrviNastu tyajato mahAndharma iti shrutiH
shlokas.6:
sa.nsiddhaH puruSho loke yadAcharati pApakam |
madenAbhiplutamanAstachcha nagrAhyamuchyate
shlokas.7:
shrUyante hi purANe vai prajA dhigdaNDashAsanAH |
dAntA dharmapradhAnAshcha nyAyadharmAnuvartakAH
shlokas.8:
dharma eva sadA nR^INAmiha rAjanprashasyate |
dharmavRRiddhA guNAneva sevante hi narA bhuvi
shlokas.9:
taM dharmamasurAstAta nAmRRiShyanta janAdhipa |
vivardhamAnAH kramashastatra te.anvAvishanprajAH
shlokas.10:
teShAM darpaH samabhavatprajAnAM dharmanAshanaH |
darpAtmanAM tataH krodhaH punasteShAmajAyata
shlokas.11:
tataH krodhAbhibhUtAnAM vRRittaM lajjAsamanvitam |
hrIshchaivApyanashadrAja.nstato moho vyajAyata
shlokas.12:
tato mohaparItAste nApashyanta yathA purA |
parasparAvamardena vartayanti yathAsukham
shlokas.13:
tAnprApya tu sa dhigdaNDo nakAraNamato.abhavat |
tato.abhyagachChandevA.nshcha brAhmaNA.nshchAvamanya ha
shlokas.14:
etasminneva kAle tu devA devavaraM shivam |
agachCha~nsharaNaM vIraM bahurUpaM gaNAdhipam
shlokas.15:
tena sma te gaganagAH sapurAH pAtitAH kShitau |
tisro.apyekena bANena devApyAyitatejasA
shlokas.16:
teShAmadhipatistvAsIdbhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
devatAnAM bhayakaraH sa hataH shUlapANinA
shlokas.17:
tasminhate.atha svaM bhAvaM pratyapadyanta mAnavAH |
prAvartanta cha vedA vai shAstrANi cha yathA purA
shlokas.18:
tato.abhyaShi~nchanrAjyena devAnAM divi vAsavam |
saptarShayashchAnvayu~njannarANAM daNDadhAraNe
shlokas.19:
saptarShINAmathordhvaM cha vipRRithurnAma pArthivaH |
rAjAnaH kShatriyAshchaiva maNDaleShu pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.20:
mahAkuleShu ye jAtA vRRittAH pUrvatarAshcha ye |
teShAmathAsuro bhAvo hRRidayAnnApasarpati
shlokas.21:
tasmAttenaiva bhAvena sAnuSha~Ngena pArthivAH |
AsurANyeva karmANi nyaShevanbhImavikramAH
shlokas.22:
pratyatiShTha.nshcha teShveva tAnyeva sthApayanti cha |
bhajante tAni chAdyApi ye bAlishatamA narAH
shlokas.23:
tasmAdahaM bravImi tvAM rAjansa~nchintya shAstrataH |
sa.nsiddhAdhigamaM kuryAtkarma hi.nsAtmakaM tyajet
shlokas.24:
na sa~NkareNa draviNaM vichinvIta vichakShaNaH |
dharmArthaM nyAyamutsRRijya na tatkalyANamuchyate
shlokas.25:
sa tvameva.nvidho dAntaH kShatriyaH priyabAndhavaH |
prajA bhRRityA.nshcha putrA.nshcha svadharmeNAnupAlaya
shlokas.26:
iShTAniShTasamAyogo vairaM sauhArdameva cha |
atha jAtisahasrANi bahUni parivartate
shlokas.27:
tasmAdguNeShu rajyethA mA doSheShu kadAchana |
nirguNo yo hi durbuddhirAtmanaH so.ariruchyate
shlokas.28:
mAnuSheShu mahArAja dharmAdharmau pravartataH |
na tathAnyeShu bhUteShu manuShyarahiteShviha
shlokas.29:
dharmashIlo naro vidvAnIhako.anIhako.api vA |
AtmabhUtaH sadA loke charedbhUtAnyahi.nsayan
shlokas.30:
yadA vyapetahRRillekhaM mano bhavati tasya vai |
nAnRRitaM chaiva bhavati tadA kalyANamRRichChati

shlokas.1:
parAshara uvAcha||
eSha dharmavidhistAta gRRihasthasya prakIrtitaH |
tapovidhiM tu vakShyAmi tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.2:
prAyeNa hi gRRihasthasya mamatvaM nAma jAyate |
sa~NgAgataM narashreShTha bhAvaistAmasarAjasaiH
shlokas.3:
gRRihANyAshritya gAvashcha kShetrANi cha dhanAni cha |
dArAH putrAshcha bhRRityAshcha bhavantIha narasya vai
shlokas.4:
evaM tasya pravRRittasya nityamevAnupashyataH |
rAgadveShau vivardhete hyanityatvamapashyataH
shlokas.5:
rAgadveShAbhibhUtaM cha naraM dravyavashAnugam |
mohajAtA ratirnAma samupaiti narAdhipa
shlokas.6:
kRRitArtho bhogato bhUtvA sa vai ratiparAyaNaH |
lAbhaM grAmyasukhAdanyaM ratito nAnupashyati
shlokas.7:
tato lobhAbhibhUtAtmA sa~NgAdvardhayate janam |
puShTyarthaM chaiva tasyeha janasyArthaM chikIrShati
shlokas.8:
sa jAnannapi chAkAryamarthArthaM sevate naraH |
bAlasnehaparItAtmA tatkShayAchchAnutapyate
shlokas.9:
tato mAnena sampanno rakShannAtmaparAjayam |
karoti yena bhogI syAmiti tasmAdvinashyati
shlokas.10:
tapo hi buddhiyuktAnAM shAshvataM brahmadarshanam |
anvichChatAM shubhaM karma narANAM tyajatAM sukham
shlokas.11:
snehAyatananAshAchcha dhananAshAchcha pArthiva |
AdhivyAdhipratApAchcha nirvedamupagachChati
shlokas.12:
nirvedAdAtmasambodhaH sambodhAchChAstradarshanam |
shAstrArthadarshanAdrAja.nstapa evAnupashyati
shlokas.13:
durlabho hi manuShyendra naraH pratyavamarshavAn |
yo vai priyasukhe kShINe tapaH kartuM vyavasyati
shlokas.14:
tapaH sarvagataM tAta hInasyApi vidhIyate |
jitendriyasya dAntasya svargamArgapradeshakam
shlokas.15:
prajApatiH prajAH pUrvamasRRijattapasA vibhuH |
kvachitkvachidvrataparo vratAnyAsthAya pArthiva
shlokas.16:
AdityA vasavo rudrAstathaivAgnyashvimArutAH |
vishvedevAstathA sAdhyAH pitaro.atha marudgaNAH
shlokas.17:
yakSharAkShasagandharvAH siddhAshchAnye divaukasaH |
sa.nsiddhAstapasA tAta ye chAnye svargavAsinaH
shlokas.18:
ye chAdau brahmaNA sRRiShTA brAhmaNAstapasA purA |
te bhAvayantaH pRRithivIM vicharanti divaM tathA
shlokas.19:
martyaloke cha rAjAno ye chAnye gRRihamedhinaH |
mahAkuleShu dRRishyante tatsarvaM tapasaH phalam
shlokas.20:
kaushikAni cha vastrANi shubhAnyAbharaNAni cha |
vAhanAsanayAnAni sarvaM tattapasaH phalam
shlokas.21:
manonukUlAH pramadA rUpavatyaH sahasrashaH |
vAsaH prAsAdapRRiShThe cha tatsarvaM tapasaH phalam
shlokas.22:
shayanAni cha mukhyAni bhojyAni vividhAni cha |
abhipretAni sarvANi bhavanti kRRitakarmaNAm
shlokas.23:
nAprApyaM tapasA ki~nchittrailokye.asminparantapa |
upabhogaparityAgaH phalAnyakRRitakarmaNAm
shlokas.24:
sukhito duHkhito vApi naro lobhaM parityajet |
avekShya manasA shAstraM buddhyA cha nRRipasattama
shlokas.25:
asantoSho.asukhAyaiva lobhAdindriyavibhramaH |
tato.asya nashyati praj~nA vidyevAbhyAsavarjitA
shlokas.26:
naShTapraj~no yadA bhavati tadA nyAyaM na pashyati |
tasmAtsukhakShaye prApte pumAnugraM tapashcharet
shlokas.27:
yadiShTaM tatsukhaM prAhurdveShyaM duHkhamihochyate |
kRRitAkRRitasya tapasaH phalaM pashyasva yAdRRisham
shlokas.28:
nityaM bhadrANi pashyanti viShayA.nshchopabhu~njate |
prAkAshyaM chaiva gachChanti kRRitvA niShkalmaShaM tapaH
shlokas.29:
apriyANyavamAnA.nshcha duHkhaM bahuvidhAtmakam |
phalArthI satpathatyaktaH prApnoti viShayAtmakam
shlokas.30:
dharme tapasi dAne cha vichikitsAsya jAyate |
sa kRRitvA pApakAnyeva nirayaM pratipadyate
shlokas.31:
sukhe tu vartamAno vai duHkhe vApi narottama |
svavRRittAdyo na chalati shAstrachakShuH sa mAnavaH
shlokas.32:
iShuprapAtamAtraM hi sparshayoge ratiH smRRitA |
rasane darshane ghrANe shravaNe cha vishAM pate
shlokas.33:
tato.asya jAyate tIvrA vedanA tatkShayAtpunaH |
budhA yena prasha.nsanti mokShaM sukhamanuttamam
shlokas.34:
tataH phalArthaM charati bhavanti jyAyaso guNAH |
dharmavRRittyA cha satataM kAmArthAbhyAM na hIyate
shlokas.35:
aprayatnAgatAH sevyA gRRihasthairviShayAH sadA |
prayatnenopagamyashcha svadharma iti me matiH
shlokas.36:
mAninAM kulajAtAnAM nityaM shAstrArthachakShuShAm |
dharmakriyAviyuktAnAmashaktyA sa.nvRRitAtmanAm
shlokas.37:
kriyamANaM yadA karma nAshaM gachChati mAnuSham |
teShAM nAnyadRRite loke tapasaH karma vidyate
shlokas.38:
sarvAtmanA tu kurvIta gRRihasthaH karmanishchayam |
dAkShyeNa havyakavyArthaM svadharmaM vicharennRRipa
shlokas.39:
yathA nadInadAH sarve sAgare yAnti sa.nsthitim |
evamAshramiNaH sarve gRRihasthe yAnti sa.nsthitim

shlokas.1:
janaka uvAcha||
varNo visheShavarNAnAM maharShe kena jAyate |
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM tadbrUhi vadatAM vara
shlokas.2:
yadetajjAyate.apatyaM sa evAyamiti shrutiH |
kathaM brAhmaNato jAto visheShagrahaNaM gataH
shlokas.3:
parAshara uvAcha||
evametanmahArAja yena jAtaH sa eva saH |
tapasastvapakarSheNa jAtigrahaNatAM gataH
shlokas.4:
sukShetrAchcha subIjAchcha puNyo bhavati sambhavaH |
ato.anyatarato hInAdavaro nAma jAyate
shlokas.5:
vaktrAdbhujAbhyAmUrubhyAM padbhyAM chaivAtha jaj~nire |
sRRijataH prajApaterlokAniti dharmavido viduH
shlokas.6:
mukhajA brAhmaNAstAta bAhujAH kShatrabandhavaH |
UrujA dhanino rAjanpAdajAH parichArakAH
shlokas.7:
chaturNAmeva varNAnAmAgamaH puruSharShabha |
ato.anye tvatiriktA ye te vai sa~NkarajAH smRRitAH
shlokas.8:
kShatrajAtirathAmbaShThA ugrA vaidehakAstathA |
shvapAkAH pulkasAH stenA niShAdAH sUtamAgadhAH
shlokas.9:
AyogAH karaNA vrAtyAshchaNDAlAshcha narAdhipa |
ete chaturbhyo varNebhyo jAyante vai parasparam
shlokas.10:
janaka uvAcha||
brahmaNaikena jAtAnAM nAnAtvaM gotrataH katham |
bahUnIha hi loke vai gotrANi munisattama
shlokas.11:
yatra tatra kathaM jAtAH svayoniM munayo gatAH |
shUdrayonau samutpannA viyonau cha tathApare
shlokas.12:
parAshara uvAcha||
rAjannaitadbhavedgrAhyamapakRRiShTena janmanA |
mahAtmanAM samutpattistapasA bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.13:
utpAdya putrAnmunayo nRRipate yatra tatra ha |
svenaiva tapasA teShAmRRiShitvaM vidadhuH punaH
shlokas.14:
pitAmahashcha me pUrvamRRishyashRRi~Ngashcha kAshyapaH |
vaTastANDyaH kRRipashchaiva kakShIvAnkamaThAdayaH
shlokas.15:
yavakrItashcha nRRipate droNashcha vadatAM varaH |
Ayurmata~Ngo dattashcha drupado matsya eva cha
shlokas.16:
ete svAM prakRRitiM prAptA vaideha tapaso.a.ashrayAt |
pratiShThitA vedavido dame tapasi chaiva hi
shlokas.17:
mUlagotrANi chatvAri samutpannAni pArthiva |
a~NgirAH kashyapashchaiva vasiShTho bhRRigureva cha
shlokas.18:
karmato.anyAni gotrANi samutpannAni pArthiva |
nAmadheyAni tapasA tAni cha grahaNaM satAm
shlokas.19:
janaka uvAcha||
visheShadharmAnvarNAnAM prabrUhi bhagavanmama |
tathA sAmAnyadharmA.nshcha sarvatra kushalo hyasi
shlokas.20:
parAshara uvAcha||
pratigraho yAjanaM cha tathaivAdhyApanaM nRRipa |
visheShadharmo viprANAM rakShA kShatrasya shobhanA
shlokas.21:
kRRiShishcha pAshupAlyaM cha vANijyaM cha vishAmapi |
dvijAnAM paricharyA cha shUdrakarma narAdhipa
shlokas.22:
visheShadharmA nRRipate varNAnAM parikIrtitAH |
dharmAnsAdhAraNA.nstAta vistareNa shRRiNuShva me
shlokas.23:
AnRRisha.nsyamahi.nsA chApramAdaH sa.nvibhAgitA |
shrAddhakarmAtitheyaM cha satyamakrodha eva cha
shlokas.24:
sveShu dAreShu santoShaH shauchaM nityAnasUyatA |
Atmaj~nAnaM titikShA cha dharmAH sAdhAraNA nRRipa
shlokas.25:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAstrayo varNA dvijAtayaH |
atra teShAmadhIkAro dharmeShu dvipadAM vara
shlokas.26:
vikarmAvasthitA varNAH patanti nRRipate trayaH |
unnamanti yathAsantamAshrityeha svakarmasu
shlokas.27:
na chApi shUdraH patatIti nishchayo; na chApi sa.nskAramihArhatIti vA |
shrutipravRRittaM na cha dharmamApnute; na chAsya dharme pratiShedhana
kRRitam
shlokas.28:
vaidehakaM shUdramudAharanti; dvijA mahArAja shrutopapannAH |
ahaM hi pashyAmi narendra devaM; vishvasya viShNuM jagataH pradhAnam
shlokas.29:
satAM vRRittamanuShThAya nihInA ujjihIrShavaH |
mantravarjaM na duShyanti kurvANAH pauShTikIH kriyAH
shlokas.30:
yathA yathA hi sadvRRittamAlambantItare janAH |
tathA tathA sukhaM prApya pretya cheha cha sherate
shlokas.31:
janaka uvAcha||
kiM karma dUShayatyenamatha jAtirmahAmune |
sa.ndeho me samutpannastanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.32:
parAshara uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM mahArAja ubhayaM doShakArakam |
karma chaiva hi jAtishcha visheShaM tu nishAmaya
shlokas.33:
jAtyA cha karmaNA chaiva duShTaM karma niShevate |
jAtyA duShTashcha yaH pApaM na karoti sa pUruShaH
shlokas.34:
jAtyA pradhAnaM puruShaM kurvANaM karma dhikkRRitam |
karma taddUShayatyenaM tasmAtkarma nashobhanam
shlokas.35:
janaka uvAcha||
kAni karmANi dharmyANi loke.asmindvijasattama |
na hi.nsantIha bhUtAni kriyamANAni sarvadA
shlokas.36:
parAshara uvAcha||
shRRiNu me.atra mahArAja yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
yAni karmANyahi.nsrANi naraM trAyanti sarvadA
shlokas.37:
saMnyasyAgnInupAsInAH pashyanti vigatajvarAH |
naiHshreyasaM dharmapathaM samAruhya yathAkramam
shlokas.38:
prashritA vinayopetA damanityAH susa.nshitAH |
prayAnti sthAnamajaraM sarvakarmavivarjitAH
shlokas.39:
sarve varNA dharmakAryANi samya;kkRRitvA rAjansatyavAkyAni choktvA |
tyaktvAdharmaM dAruNaM jIvaloke; yAnti svargaM nAtra kAryo vichAraH

shlokas.1:
parAshara uvAcha||
pitA sakhAyo guravaH striyashcha; na nirguNA nAma bhavanti loke |
ananyabhaktAH priyavAdinashcha; hitAshcha vashyAshcha tathaiva rAjan
shlokas.2:
pitA paraM daivataM mAnavAnAM; mAturvishiShTaM pitaraM vadanti |
j~nAnasya lAbhaM paramaM vadanti; jitendriyArthAH paramApnuvanti
shlokas.3:
raNAjire yatra sharAgnisa.nstare; nRRipAtmajo ghAtamavApya dahyate |
prayAti lokAnamaraiH sudurlabhA;nniShevate svargaphalaM yathAsukham
shlokas.4:
shrAntaM bhItaM bhraShTashastraM rudantaM; parA~NmukhaM paribarhaishcha hInam |
anudyataM rogiNaM yAchamAnaM; na vai hi.nsyAdbAlavRRiddhau cha rAjan
shlokas.5:
paribarhaiH susampannamudyataM tulyatAM gatam |
atikrameta nRRipatiH sa~NgrAme kShatriyAtmajam
shlokas.6:
tulyAdiha vadhaH shreyAnvishiShTAchcheti nishchayaH |
nihInAtkAtarAchchaiva nRRipANAM garhito vadhaH
shlokas.7:
pApAtpApasamAchArAnnihInAchcha narAdhipa |
pApa eva vadhaH prokto narakAyeti nishchayaH
shlokas.8:
na kashchittrAti vai rAjandiShTAntavashamAgatam |
sAvasheShAyuShaM chApi kashchidevApakarShati
shlokas.9:
snigdhaishcha kriyamANAni karmANIha nivartayet |
hi.nsAtmakAni karmANi nAyurichChetparAyuShA
shlokas.10:
gRRihasthAnAM tu sarveShAM vinAshamabhikA~NkShatAm |
nidhanaM shobhanaM tAta pulineShu kriyAvatAm
shlokas.11:
AyuShi kShayamApanne pa~nchatvamupagachChati |
nAkAraNAttadbhavati kAraNairupapAditam
shlokas.12:
tathA sharIraM bhavati dehAdyenopapAditam |
adhvAnaM gatakashchAyaM prAptashchAyaM gRRihAdgRRiham
shlokas.13:
dvitIyaM kAraNaM tatra nAnyatki~nchana vidyate |
taddehaM dehinAM yuktaM mokShabhUteShu vartate
shlokas.14:
sirAsnAyvasthisa~NghAtaM bIbhatsAmedhyasa~Nkulam |
bhUtAnAmindriyANAM cha guNAnAM cha samAgamam
shlokas.15:
tvagantaM dehamityAhurvidvA.nso.adhyAtmachintakAH |
guNairapi parikShINaM sharIraM martyatAM gatam
shlokas.16:
sharIriNA parityaktaM nishcheShTaM gatachetanam |
bhUtaiH prakRRitimApannaistato bhUmau nimajjati
shlokas.17:
bhAvitaM karmayogena jAyate tatra tatra ha |
idaM sharIraM vaideha mriyate yatra tatra ha
tatsvabhAvo.aparo dRRiShTo visargaH karmaNastathA
shlokas.18:
na jAyate tu nRRipate ka~nchitkAlamayaM punaH |
paribhramati bhUtAtmA dyAmivAmbudharo mahAn
shlokas.19:
sa punarjAyate rAjanprApyehAyatanaM nRRipa |
manasaH paramo hyAtmA indriyebhyaH paraM manaH
shlokas.20:
dvividhAnAM cha bhUtAnAM ja~NgamAH paramA nRRipa |
ja~NgamAnAmapi tathA dvipadAH paramA matAH
dvipadAnAmapi tathA dvijA vai paramAH smRRitAH
shlokas.21:
dvijAnAmapi rAjendra praj~nAvantaH parA matAH |
prAj~nAnAmAtmasambuddhAH sambuddhAnAmamAninaH
shlokas.22:
jAtamanveti maraNaM nRRiNAmiti vinishchayaH |
antavanti hi karmANi sevante guNataH prajAH
shlokas.23:
Apanne tUttarAM kAShThAM sUrye yo nidhanaM vrajet |
nakShatre cha muhUrte cha puNye rAjansa puNyakRRit
shlokas.24:
ayojayitvA kleshena janaM plAvya cha duShkRRitam |
mRRityunAprAkRRiteneha karma kRRitvAtmashaktitaH
shlokas.25:
viShamudbandhanaM dAho dasyuhastAttathA vadhaH |
daMShTribhyashcha pashubhyashcha prAkRRito vadha uchyate
shlokas.26:
na chaibhiH puNyakarmANo yujyante nAbhisandhijaiH |
eva.nvidhaishcha bahubhiraparaiH prAkRRitairapi
shlokas.27:
UrdhvaM hitvA pratiShThante prANAH puNyakRRitAM nRRipa |
madhyato madhyapuNyAnAmadho duShkRRitakarmaNAm
shlokas.28:
ekaH shatrurna dvitIyo.asti shatru;raj~nAnatulyaH puruShasya rAjan |
yenAvRRitaH kurute samprayukto; ghorANi karmANi sudAruNAni
shlokas.29:
prabodhanArthaM shrutidharmayuktaM; vRRiddhAnupAsyaM cha bhaveta yasya |
prayatnasAdhyo hi sa rAjaputra; praj~nAshareNonmathitaH paraiti
shlokas.30:
adhItya vedA.nstapasA brahmachArI; yaj~nA~nshaktyA saMnisRRijyeha pa~ncha |
vanaM gachChetpuruSho dharmakAmaH; shreyashchitvA sthApayitvA svava.nsham
shlokas.31:
upabhogairapi tyaktaM nAtmAnamavasAdayet |
chaNDAlatve.api mAnuShyaM sarvathA tAta durlabham
shlokas.32:
iyaM hi yoniH prathamA yAM prApya jagatIpate |
AtmA vai shakyate trAtuM karmabhiH shubhalakShaNaiH
shlokas.33:
kathaM na vipraNashyema yonito.asyA iti prabho |
kurvanti dharmaM manujAH shrutiprAmANyadarshanAt
shlokas.34:
yo durlabhataraM prApya mAnuShyamiha vai naraH |
dharmAvamantA kAmAtmA bhavetsa khalu va~nchyate
shlokas.35:
yastu prItipurogeNa chakShuShA tAta pashyati |
dIpopamAni bhUtAni yAvadarchirna nashyati
shlokas.36:
sAntvenAnupradAnena priyavAdena chApyuta |
samaduHkhasukho bhUtvA sa paratra mahIyate
shlokas.37:
dAnaM tyAgaH shobhanA mUrtiradbhyo; bhUyaH plAvyaM tapasA vai sharIram |
sarasvatInaimiShapuShkareShu; ye chApyanye puNyadeshAH pRRithivyAm
shlokas.38:
gRRiheShu yeShAmasavaH patanti; teShAmatho nirharaNaM prashastam |
yAnena vai prApaNaM cha shmashAne; shauchena nUnaM vidhinA chaiva dAhaH
shlokas.39:
iShTiH puShTiryajanaM yAjanaM cha; dAnaM puNyAnAM karmaNAM cha prayogaH |
shaktyA pitryaM yachcha ki~nchitprashastaM; sarvANyAtmArthe mAnavo yaH karoti
shlokas.40:
dharmashAstrANi vedAshcha ShaDa~NgAni narAdhipa |
shreyaso.arthe vidhIyante narasyAkliShTakarmaNaH
shlokas.41:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evadvai sarvamAkhyAtaM muninA sumahAtmanA |
videharAjAya purA shreyaso.arthe narAdhipa

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
punareva tu paprachCha janako mithilAdhipaH |
parAsharaM mahAtmAnaM dharme paramanishchayam
shlokas.2:
kiM shreyaH kA gatirbrahmankiM kRRitaM na vinashyati |
kva gato na nivarteta tanme brUhi mahAmune
shlokas.3:
parAshara uvAcha||
asa~NgaH shreyaso mUlaM j~nAnaM j~nAnagatiH parA |
chIrNaM tapo na praNashyedvApaH kShetre na nashyati
shlokas.4:
ChittvAdharmamayaM pAshaM yadA dharme.abhirajyate |
dattvAbhayakRRitaM dAnaM tadA siddhimavApnuyAt
shlokas.5:
yo dadAti sahasrANi gavAmashvashatAni cha |
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyastaddAnamativartate
shlokas.6:
vasanviShayamadhye.api na vasatyeva buddhimAn |
sa.nvasatyeva durbuddhirasatsu viShayeShvapi
shlokas.7:
nAdharmaH shliShyate prAj~namApaH puShkaraparNavat |
aprAj~namadhikaM pApaM shliShyate jatu kAShThavat
shlokas.8:
nAdharmaH kAraNApekShI kartAramabhimu~nchati |
kartA khalu yathAkAlaM tatsarvamabhipadyate
na bhidyante kRRitAtmAna AtmapratyayadarshinaH
shlokas.9:
buddhikarmendriyANAM hi pramatto yo na budhyate |
shubhAshubheShu saktAtmA prApnoti sumahadbhayam
shlokas.10:
vItarAgo jitakrodhaH samyagbhavati yaH sadA |
viShaye vartamAno.api na sa pApena yujyate
shlokas.11:
maryAdAyAM dharmaseturnibaddho naiva sIdati |
puShTasrota ivAyattaH sphIto bhavati sa~nchayaH
shlokas.12:
yathA bhAnugataM tejo maNiH shuddhaH samAdhinA |
Adatte rAjashArdUla tathA yogaH pravartate
shlokas.13:
yathA tilAnAmiha puShpasa.nshrayA;tpRRithakpRRithagyAti guNo.atisaumyatAm |
tathA narANAM bhuvi bhAvitAtmanAM; yathAshrayaM sattvaguNaH pravartate
shlokas.14:
jahAti dArAnihate na sampadaH; sadashvayAnaM vividhAshcha yAH kriyAH |
triviShTape jAtamatiryadA nara;stadAsya buddhirviShayeShu bhidyate
shlokas.15:
prasaktabuddhirviShayeShu yo naro; yo budhyate hyAtmahitaM kadA cha na |
sa sarvabhAvAnugatena chetasA; nRRipAmiSheNeva jhaSho vikRRiShyate
shlokas.16:
sa~NghAtavAnmartyalokaH parasparamapAshritaH |
kadalIgarbhaniHsAro naurivApsu nimajjati
shlokas.17:
na dharmakAlaH puruShasya nishchito; na chApi mRRityuH puruShaM pratIkShate |
kriyA hi dharmasya sadaiva shobhanA; yadA naro mRRityumukhe.abhivartate
shlokas.18:
yathAndhaH svagRRihe yukto hyabhyAsAdeva gachChati |
tathA yuktena manasA prAj~no gachChati tAM gatim
shlokas.19:
maraNaM janmani proktaM janma vai maraNAshritam |
avidvAnmokShadharmeShu baddho bhramati chakravat
shlokas.20:
yathA mRRiNAlo.anugatamAshu mu~nchati kardamam |
tathAtmA puruShasyeha manasA parimuchyate
manaH praNayate.a.atmAnaM sa enamabhiyu~njati
shlokas.21:
parArthe vartamAnastu svakAryaM yo.abhimanyate |
indriyArtheShu saktaH sansvakAryAtparihIyate
shlokas.22:
adhastiryaggatiM chaiva svarge chaiva parAM gatim |
prApnoti svakRRitairAtmA prAj~nasyehetarasya cha
shlokas.23:
mRRinmaye bhAjane pakve yathA vai nyasyate dravaH |
tathA sharIraM tapasA taptaM viShayamashnute
shlokas.24:
viShayAnashnute yastu na sa bhokShyatyasa.nshayam |
yastu bhogA.nstyajedAtmA sa vai bhoktuM vyavasyati
shlokas.25:
nIhAreNa hi sa.nvItaH shishnodaraparAyaNaH |
jAtyandha iva panthAnamAvRRitAtmA na budhyate
shlokas.26:
vaNigyathA samudrAdvai yathArthaM labhate dhanam |
tathA martyArNave jantoH karmavij~nAnato gatiH
shlokas.27:
ahorAtramaye loke jarArUpeNa sa~ncharan |
mRRityurgrasati bhUtAni pavanaM pannago yathA
shlokas.28:
svayaM kRRitAni karmANi jAto jantuH prapadyate |
nAkRRitaM labhate kashchitki~nchidatra priyApriyam
shlokas.29:
shayAnaM yAntamAsInaM pravRRittaM viShayeShu cha |
shubhAshubhAni karmANi prapadyante naraM sadA
shlokas.30:
na hyanyattIramAsAdya punastartuM vyavasyati |
durlabho dRRishyate hyasya vinipAto mahArNave
shlokas.31:
yathA bhArAvasaktA hi naurmahAmbhasi tantunA |
tathA mano.abhiyogAdvai sharIraM pratikarShati
shlokas.32:
yathA samudramabhitaH sa.nsyUtAH sarito.aparAH |
tathAdyA prakRRitiryogAdabhisa.nsyUyate sadA
shlokas.33:
snehapAshairbahuvidhairAsaktamanaso narAH |
prakRRitisthA viShIdanti jale saikataveshmavat
shlokas.34:
sharIragRRihasa.nsthasya shauchatIrthasya dehinaH |
buddhimArgaprayAtasya sukhaM tviha paratra cha
shlokas.35:
vistarAH kleshasa.nyuktAH sa~NkShepAstu sukhAvahAH |
parArthaM vistarAH sarve tyAgamAtmahitaM viduH
shlokas.36:
sa~Nkalpajo mitravargo j~nAtayaH kAraNAtmakAH |
bhAryA dAsAshcha putrAshcha svamarthamanuyu~njate
shlokas.37:
na mAtA na pitA ki~nchitkasyachitpratipadyate |
dAnapathyodano jantuH svakarmaphalamashnute
shlokas.38:
mAtA putraH pitA bhrAtA bhAryA mitrajanastathA |
aShTApadapadasthAne tvakShamudreva nyasyate
shlokas.39:
sarvANi karmANi purA kRRitAni; shubhAshubhAnyAtmano yAnti jantoH |
upasthitaM karmaphalaM viditvA; buddhiM tathA chodayate.antarAtmA
shlokas.40:
vyavasAyaM samAshritya sahAyAnyo.adhigachChati |
na tasya kashchidArambhaH kadAchidavasIdati
shlokas.41:
advaidhamanasaM yuktaM shUraM dhIraM vipashchitam |
na shrIH santyajate nityamAdityamiva rashmayaH
shlokas.42:
AstikyavyavasAyAbhyAmupAyAdvismayAddhiyA |
yamArabhatyanindyAtmA na so.arthaH parisIdati
shlokas.44:
svarUpatAmAtmakRRitaM cha vistaraM; kulAnvayaM dravyasamRRiddhisa~nchayam |
naro hi sarvo labhate yathAkRRitaM; shubhAshubhenAtmakRRitena karmaNA
shlokas.45:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityukto janako rAjanyathAtathyaM manIShiNA |
shrutvA dharmavidAM shreShThaH parAM mudamavApa ha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
satyaM kShamAM damaM praj~nAM prasha.nsanti pitAmaha |
vidvA.nso manujA loke kathametanmataM tava
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShye.ahamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sAdhyAnAmiha sa.nvAdaM ha.nsasya cha yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
ha.nso bhUtvAtha sauvarNastvajo nityaH prajApatiH |
sa vai paryeti lokA.nstrInatha sAdhyAnupAgamat
shlokas.4:
sAdhyA UchuH||
shakune vayaM sma devA vai sAdhyAstvAmanuyujmahe |
pRRichChAmastvAM mokShadharmaM bhavA.nshcha kila mokShavit
shlokas.5:
shruto.asi naH paNDito dhIravAdI; sAdhushabdaH patate te patatrin |
kiM manyase shreShThatamaM dvija tvaM; kasminmanaste ramate mahAtman
shlokas.6:
tannaH kAryaM pakShivara prashAdhi; yatkAryANAM manyase shreShThamekam |
yatkRRitvA vai puruShaH sarvabandhai;rvimuchyate vihagendreha shIghram
shlokas.7:
ha.nsa uvAcha||
idaM kAryamamRRitAshAH shRRiNomi; tapo damaH satyamAtmAbhiguptiH |
granthInvimuchya hRRidayasya sarvA;npriyApriye svaM vashamAnayIta
shlokas.8:
nAruntudaH syAnna nRRisha.nsavAdI; na hInataH paramabhyAdadIta |
yayAsya vAchA para udvijeta; na tAM vadedrushatIM pApalokyAm
shlokas.9:
vAksAyakA vadanAnniShpatanti; yairAhataH shochati rAtryahAni |
parasya nAmarmasu te patanti; tAnpaNDito nAvasRRijetpareShu
shlokas.10:
parashchedenamativAdabANai;rbhRRishaM vidhyechChama eveha kAryaH |
sa.nroShyamANaH pratimRRiShyate yaH; sa Adatte sukRRitaM vai parasya
shlokas.11:
kShepAbhimAnAdabhiSha~NgavyalIkaM; nigRRihNAti jvalitaM yashcha manyum |
aduShTachetA mudito.anasUyuH; sa Adatte sukRRitaM vai pareShAm
shlokas.12:
AkrushyamAno na vadAmi kiM chi;tkShamAmyahaM tADyamAnashcha nityam |
shreShThaM hyetatkShamamapyAhurAryAH; satyaM tathaivArjavamAnRRisha.nsyam
shlokas.13:
vedasyopaniShatsatyaM satyasyopaniShaddamaH |
damasyopaniShanmokSha etatsarvAnushAsanam
shlokas.14:
vAcho vegaM manasaH krodhavegaM; vivitsAvegamudaropasthavegam |
etAnvegAnyo viShahatyudIrNAM;staM manye.ahaM brAhmaNaM vai muniM cha
shlokas.15:
akrodhanaH krudhyatAM vai vishiShTa;stathA titikShuratitikShorvishiShTaH |
amAnuShAnmAnuSho vai vishiShTa;stathAj~nAnAjj~nAnavAnvai pradhAnaH
shlokas.16:
AkrushyamAno nAkroshenmanyureva titikShataH |
AkroShTAraM nirdahati sukRRitaM chAsya vindati
shlokas.17:
yo nAtyuktaH prAha rUkShaM priyaM vA; yo vA hato na pratihanti dhairyAt |
pApaM cha yo nechChati tasya hantu;stasmai devAH spRRihayante sadaiva
shlokas.18:
pApIyasaH kShametaiva shreyasaH sadRRishasya cha |
vimAnito hato.a.akruShTa evaM siddhiM gamiShyati
shlokas.19:
sadAhamAryAnnibhRRito.apyupAse; na me vivitsA na cha me.asti roShaH |
na chApyahaM lipsamAnaH paraimi; na chaiva ki~nchidviShameNa yAmi
shlokas.20:
nAhaM shaptaH pratishapAmi kiM chi;ddamaM dvAraM hyamRRitasyeha vedmi |
guhyaM brahma tadidaM vo bravImi; na mAnuShAchChreShThataraM hi ki~nchit
shlokas.21:
vimuchyamAnaH pApebhyo dhanebhya iva chandramAH |
virajAH kAlamAkA~NkShandhIro dhairyeNa sidhyati
shlokas.22:
yaH sarveShAM bhavati hyarchanIya; utsechane stambha ivAbhijAtaH |
yasmai vAchaM suprashastAM vadanti; sa vai devAngachChati sa.nyatAtmA
shlokas.23:
na tathA vaktumichChanti kalyANAnpuruShe guNAn |
yathaiShAM vaktumichChanti nairguNyamanuyu~njakAH
shlokas.24:
yasya vA~NmanasI gupte samyakpraNihite sadA |
vedAstapashcha tyAgashcha sa idaM sarvamApnuyAt
shlokas.25:
AkroshanAvamAnAbhyAmabudhAdvardhate budhaH |
tasmAnna vardhayedanyaM na chAtmAnaM vihi.nsayet
shlokas.26:
amRRitasyeva santRRipyedavamAnasya vai dvijaH |
sukhaM hyavamataH shete yo.avamantA sa nashyati
shlokas.27:
yatkrodhano yajate yaddadAti; yadvA tapastapyati yajjuhoti |
vaivasvatastaddharate.asya sarvaM; moghaH shramo bhavati krodhanasya
shlokas.28:
chatvAri yasya dvArANi suguptAnyamarottamAH |
upasthamudaraM hastau vAkchaturthI sa dharmavit
shlokas.29:
satyaM damaM hyArjavamAnRRisha.nsyaM; dhRRitiM titikShAmabhisevamAnaH |
svAdhyAyanityo.aspRRihayanpareShA;mekAntashIlyUrdhvagatirbhavetsaH
shlokas.30:
sarvAnetAnanucharanvatsavachchaturaH stanAn |
na pAvanatamaM ki~nchitsatyAdadhyagamaM kvachit
shlokas.31:
AchakShe.ahaM manuShyebhyo devebhyaH pratisa~ncharan |
satyaM svargasya sopAnaM pArAvArasya nauriva
shlokas.32:
yAdRRishaiH saMnivasati yAdRRishA.nshchopasevate |
yAdRRigichChechcha bhavituM tAdRRigbhavati pUruShaH
shlokas.33:
yadi santaM sevate yadyasantaM; tapasvinaM yadi vA stenameva |
vAso yathA ra~NgavashaM prayAti; tathA sa teShAM vashamabhyupaiti
shlokas.34:
sadA devAH sAdhubhiH sa.nvadante; na mAnuShaM viShayaM yAnti draShTum |
nenduH samaH syAdasamo hi vAyu;ruchchAvachaM viShayaM yaH sa veda
shlokas.35:
aduShTaM vartamAne tu hRRidayAntarapUruShe |
tenaiva devAH prIyante satAM mArgasthitena vai
shlokas.36:
shishnodare ye.abhiratAH sadaiva; stenA narA vAkparuShAshcha nityam |
apetadoShAniti tAnviditvA; dUrAddevAH samparivarjayanti
shlokas.37:
na vai devA hInasattvena toShyAH; sarvAshinA duShkRRitakarmaNA vA |
satyavratA ye tu narAH kRRitaj~nA; dharme ratAstaiH saha sambhajante
shlokas.38:
avyAhRRitaM vyAhRRitAchChreya AhuH; satyaM vadedvyAhRRitaM taddvitIyam |
dharmaM vadedvyAhRRitaM tattRRitIyaM; priyaM vadedvyAhRRitaM tachchaturtham
shlokas.39:
sAdhyA UchuH||
kenAyamAvRRito lokaH kena vA na prakAshate |
kena tyajati mitrANi kena svargaM na gachChati
shlokas.40:
ha.nsa uvAcha||
aj~nAnenAvRRito loko mAtsaryAnna prakAshate |
lobhAttyajati mitrANi sa~NgAtsvargaM na gachChati
shlokas.41:
sAdhyA UchuH||
kaH svideko ramate brAhmaNAnAM; kaH svideko bahubhirjoShamAste |
kaH svideko balavAndurbalo.api; kaH svideShAM kalahaM nAnvavaiti
shlokas.42:
ha.nsa uvAcha||
prAj~na eko ramate brAhmaNAnAM; prAj~na eko bahubhirjoShamAste |
prAj~na eko balavAndurbalo.api; prAj~na eShAM kalahaM nAnvavaiti
shlokas.43:
sAdhyA UchuH||
kiM brAhmaNAnAM devatvaM kiM cha sAdhutvamuchyate |
asAdhutvaM cha kiM teShAM kimeShAM mAnuShaM matam
shlokas.44:
ha.nsa uvAcha||
svAdhyAya eShAM devatvaM vrataM sAdhutvamuchyate |
asAdhutvaM parIvAdo mRRityurmAnuShamuchyate
shlokas.45:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa.nvAda ityayaM shreShThaH sAdhyAnAM parikIrtitaH |
kShetraM vai karmaNAM yoniH sadbhAvaH satyamuchyate

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sA~Nkhye yoge cha me tAta visheShaM vaktumarhasi |
tava sarvaj~na sarvaM hi viditaM kurusattama
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sA~NkhyAH sA~NkhyaM prasha.nsanti yogA yogaM dvijAtayaH |
vadanti kAraNaiH shraiShThyaM svapakShodbhAvanAya vai
shlokas.3:
anIshvaraH kathaM muchyedityevaM shatrukarshana |
vadanti kAraNaiH shraiShThyaM yogAH samya~NmanIShiNaH
shlokas.4:
vadanti kAraNaM chedaM sA~NkhyAH samyagdvijAtayaH |
vij~nAyeha gatIH sarvA virakto viShayeShu yaH
shlokas.5:
UrdhvaM sa dehAtsuvyaktaM vimuchyediti nAnyathA |
etadAhurmahAprAj~nAH sA~NkhyaM vai mokShadarshanam
shlokas.6:
svapakShe kAraNaM grAhyaM samarthaM vachanaM hitam |
shiShTAnAM hi mataM grAhyaM tvadvidhaiH shiShTasaMmataiH
shlokas.7:
pratyakShahetavo yogAH sA~NkhyAH shAstravinishchayAH |
ubhe chaite mate tattve mama tAta yudhiShThira
shlokas.8:
ubhe chaite mate j~nAne nRRipate shiShTasaMmate |
anuShThite yathAshAstraM nayetAM paramAM gatim
shlokas.9:
tulyaM shauchaM tayoryuktaM dayA bhUteShu chAnagha |
vratAnAM dhAraNaM tulyaM darshanaM na samaM tayoH
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadi tulyaM vrataM shauchaM dayA chAtra pitAmaha |
tulyaM na darshanaM kasmAttanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.11:
bhIShma uvAcha||
rAgaM mohaM tathA snehaM kAmaM krodhaM cha kevalam |
yogAchChittvAdito doShAnpa~nchaitAnprApnuvanti tat
shlokas.12:
yathA chAnimiShAH sthUlA jAlaM ChittvA punarjalam |
prApnuvanti tathA yogAstatpadaM vItakalmaShAH
shlokas.13:
tathaiva vAgurAM ChittvA balavanto yathA mRRigAH |
prApnuyurvimalaM mArgaM vimuktAH sarvabandhanaiH
shlokas.14:
lobhajAni tathA rAjanbandhanAni balAnvitAH |
ChittvA yogAH paraM mArgaM gachChanti vimalAH shivam
shlokas.15:
abalAshcha mRRigA rAjanvAgurAsu tathApare |
vinashyanti na sa.ndehastadvadyogabalAdRRite
shlokas.16:
balahInAshcha kaunteya yathA jAlagatA jhaShAH |
antaM gachChanti rAjendra tathA yogAH sudurbalAH
shlokas.17:
yathA cha shakunAH sUkShmAH prApya jAlamari.ndama |
tatra saktA vipadyante muchyante cha balAnvitAH
shlokas.18:
karmajairbandhanairbaddhAstadvadyogAH parantapa |
abalA vai vinashyanti muchyante cha balAnvitAH
shlokas.19:
alpakashcha yathA rAjanvahniH shAmyati durbalaH |
AkrAnta indhanaiH sthUlaistadvadyogo.abalaH prabho
shlokas.20:
sa eva cha yadA rAjanvahnirjAtabalaH punaH |
samIraNayutaH kRRitsnAM dahetkShipraM mahImapi
shlokas.21:
tadvajjAtabalo yogI dIptatejA mahAbalaH |
antakAla ivAdityaH kRRitsnaM sa.nshoShayejjagat
shlokas.22:
durbalashcha yathA rAjansrotasA hriyate naraH |
balahInastathA yogo viShayairhriyate.avashaH
shlokas.23:
tadeva cha yathA sroto viShTambhayati vAraNaH |
tadvadyogabalaM labdhvA vyUhate viShayAnbahUn
shlokas.24:
vishanti chAvashAH pArtha yogA yogabalAnvitAH |
prajApatInRRiShIndevAnmahAbhUtAni cheshvarAH
shlokas.25:
na yamo nAntakaH kruddho na mRRityurbhImavikramaH |
Ishate nRRipate sarve yogasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.26:
AtmanAM cha sahasrANi bahUni bharatarShabha |
yogaH kuryAdbalaM prApya taishcha sarvairmahIM charet
shlokas.27:
prApnuyAdviShayA.nshchaiva punashchograM tapashcharet |
sa~NkShipechcha punaH pArtha sUryastejoguNAniva
shlokas.28:
balasthasya hi yogasya bandhaneshasya pArthiva |
vimokShaprabhaviShNutvamupapannamasa.nshayam
shlokas.29:
balAni yoge proktAni mayaitAni vishAM pate |
nidarshanArthaM sUkShmANi vakShyAmi cha punastava
shlokas.30:
Atmanashcha samAdhAne dhAraNAM prati chAbhibho |
nidarshanAni sUkShmANi shRRiNu me bharatarShabha
shlokas.31:
apramatto yathA dhanvI lakShyaM hanti samAhitaH |
yuktaH samyaktathA yogI mokShaM prApnotyasa.nshayam
shlokas.32:
snehapUrNe yathA pAtre mana AdhAya nishchalam |
puruSho yatta ArohetsopAnaM yuktamAnasaH
shlokas.33:
yuktvA tathAyamAtmAnaM yogaH pArthiva nishchalam |
karotyamalamAtmAnaM bhAskaropamadarshanam
shlokas.34:
yathA cha nAvaM kaunteya karNadhAraH samAhitaH |
mahArNavagatAM shIghraM nayetpArthiva pattanam
shlokas.35:
tadvadAtmasamAdhAnaM yuktvA yogena tattvavit |
durgamaM sthAnamApnoti hitvA dehamimaM nRRipa
shlokas.36:
sArathishcha yathA yuktvA sadashvAnsusamAhitaH |
deshamiShTaM nayatyAshu dhanvinaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.37:
tathaiva nRRipate yogI dhAraNAsu samAhitaH |
prApnotyAshu paraM sthAnaM lakShaM mukta ivAshugaH
shlokas.38:
AveshyAtmani chAtmAnaM yogI tiShThati yo.achalaH |
pApaM hanteva mInAnAM padamApnoti so.ajaram
shlokas.39:
nAbhyAM kaNThe cha shIrShe cha hRRidi vakShasi pArshvayoH |
darshane sparshane chApi ghrANe chAmitavikrama
shlokas.40:
sthAneShveteShu yo yogI mahAvratasamAhitaH |
AtmanA sUkShmamAtmAnaM yu~Nkte samyagvishAM pate
shlokas.41:
sa shIghramamalapraj~naH karma dagdhvA shubhAshubham |
uttamaM yogamAsthAya yadIchChati vimuchyate
shlokas.42:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AhArAnkIdRRishAnkRRitvA kAni jitvA cha bhArata |
yogI balamavApnoti tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.43:
bhIShma uvAcha||
kaNAnAM bhakShaNe yuktaH piNyAkasya cha bhakShaNe |
snehAnAM varjane yukto yogI balamavApnuyAt
shlokas.44:
bhu~njAno yAvakaM rUkShaM dIrghakAlamari.ndama |
ekArAmo vishuddhAtmA yogI balamavApnuyAt
shlokas.45:
pakShAnmAsAnRRitU.nshchitrAnsa~nchara.nshcha guhAstathA |
apaH pItvA payomishrA yogI balamavApnuyAt
shlokas.46:
akhaNDamapi vA mAsaM satataM manujeshvara |
upoShya samyakShuddhAtmA yogI balamavApnuyAt
shlokas.47:
kAmaM jitvA tathA krodhaM shItoShNe varShameva cha |
bhayaM nidrAM tathA shvAsaM pauruShaM viShayA.nstathA
shlokas.48:
aratiM durjayAM chaiva ghorAM tRRiShNAM cha pArthiva |
sparshAnsarvA.nstathA tandrIM durjayAM nRRipasattama
shlokas.49:
dIpayanti mahAtmAnaH sUkShmamAtmAnamAtmanA |
vItarAgA mahAprAj~nA dhyAnAdhyayanasampadA
shlokas.50:
durgastveSha mataH panthA brAhmaNAnAM vipashchitAm |
na kashchidvrajati hyasminkShemeNa bharatarShabha
shlokas.51:
yathA kashchidvanaM ghoraM bahusarpasarIsRRipam |
shvabhravattoyahInaM cha durgamaM bahukaNTakam
shlokas.52:
abhaktamaTavIprAyaM dAvadagdhamahIruham |
panthAnaM taskarAkIrNaM kShemeNAbhipatedyuvA
shlokas.53:
yogamArgaM tathAsAdya yaH kashchidbhajate dvijaH |
kShemeNoparamenmArgAdbahudoSho hi sa smRRitaH
shlokas.54:
sustheyaM kShuradhArAsu nishitAsu mahIpate |
dhAraNAsu tu yogasya duHstheyamakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.55:
vipannA dhAraNAstAta nayanti nashubhAM gatim |
netRRihInA yathA nAvaH puruShAnarNave nRRipa
shlokas.56:
yastu tiShThati kaunteya dhAraNAsu yathAvidhi |
maraNaM janma duHkhaM cha sukhaM cha sa vimu~nchati
shlokas.57:
nAnAshAstreShu niShpannaM yogeShvidamudAhRRitam |
paraM yogaM tu yatkRRitsnaM nishchitaM taddvijAtiShu
shlokas.58:
paraM hi tadbrahma mahanmahAtma;nbrahmANamIshaM varadaM cha viShNum |
bhavaM cha dharmaM cha ShaDAnanaM cha; ShaDbrahmaputrA.nshcha mahAnubhAvAn
shlokas.59:
tamashcha kaShTaM sumahadrajashcha; sattvaM cha shuddhaM prakRRitiM parAM cha |
siddhiM cha devIM varuNasya patnIM; tejashcha kRRitsnaM sumahachcha dhairyam
shlokas.60:
tArAdhipaM vai vimalaM satAraM; vishvA.nshcha devAnuragAnpitR^I.nshcha |
shailA.nshcha kRRitsnAnudadhI.nshcha ghorA;nnadIshcha sarvAH
savanAnghanA.nshcha
shlokas.61:
nAgAnnagAnyakShagaNAndishashcha; gandharvasa~NghAnpuruShAnstriyashcha |
parasparaM prApya mahAnmahAtmA; visheta yogI nachirAdvimuktaH
shlokas.62:
kathA cha yeyaM nRRipate prasaktA; deve mahAvIryamatau shubheyam |
yogAnsa sarvAnabhibhUya martyA;nnArAyaNAtmA kurute mahAtmA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
samyaktvayAyaM nRRipate varNitaH shiShTasaMmataH |
yogamArgo yathAnyAyaM shiShyAyeha hitaiShiNA
shlokas.2:
sA~Nkhye tvidAnIM kArtsnyena vidhiM prabrUhi pRRichChate |
triShu lokeShu yajj~nAnaM sarvaM tadviditaM hi te
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
shRRiNu me tvamidaM shuddhaM sA~NkhyAnAM viditAtmanAm |
vihitaM yatibhirbuddhaiH kapilAdibhirIshvaraiH
shlokas.4:
yasminna vibhramAH kechiddRRishyante manujarShabha |
guNAshcha yasminbahavo doShahAnishcha kevalA
shlokas.5:
j~nAnena parisa~NkhyAya sadoShAnviShayAnnRRipa |
mAnuShAndurjayAnkRRitsnAnpaishAchAnviShayA.nstathA
shlokas.6:
rAkShasAnviShayA~nj~nAtvA yakShANAM viShayA.nstathA |
viShayAnauragA~nj~nAtvA gAndharvaviShayA.nstathA
shlokas.7:
pitR^INAM viShayA~nj~nAtvA tiryakShu charatAM nRRipa |
suparNaviShayA~nj~nAtvA marutAM viShayA.nstathA
shlokas.8:
rAjarShiviShayA~nj~nAtvA brahmarShiviShayA.nstathA |
AsurAnviShayA~nj~nAtvA vaishvadevA.nstathaiva cha
shlokas.9:
devarShiviShayA~nj~nAtvA yogAnAmapi cheshvarAn |
viShayA.nshcha prajeshAnAM brahmaNo viShayA.nstathA
shlokas.10:
AyuShashcha paraM kAlaM loke vij~nAya tattvataH |
sukhasya cha paraM tattvaM vij~nAya vadatAM vara
shlokas.11:
prApte kAle cha yadduHkhaM patatAM viShayaiShiNAm |
tiryakcha patatAM duHkhaM patatAM narake cha yat
shlokas.12:
svargasya cha guNAnkRRitsnAndoShAnsarvA.nshcha bhArata |
vedavAde cha ye doShA guNA ye chApi vaidikAH
shlokas.13:
j~nAnayoge cha ye doShA guNA yoge cha ye nRRipa |
sA~Nkhyaj~nAne cha ye doShAstathaiva cha guNA nRRipa
shlokas.14:
sattvaM dashaguNaM j~nAtvA rajo navaguNaM tathA |
tamashchAShTaguNaM j~nAtvA buddhiM saptaguNAM tathA
shlokas.15:
ShaDguNaM cha nabho j~nAtvA manaH pa~nchaguNaM tathA |
buddhiM chaturguNAM j~nAtvA tamashcha triguNaM mahat
shlokas.16:
dviguNaM cha rajo j~nAtvA sattvamekaguNaM punaH |
mArgaM vij~nAya tattvena pralaye prekShaNaM tathA
shlokas.17:
j~nAnavij~nAnasampannAH kAraNairbhAvitAH shubhaiH |
prApnuvanti shubhaM mokShaM sUkShmA iha nabhaH param
shlokas.18:
rUpeNa dRRiShTiM sa.nyuktAM ghrANaM gandhaguNena cha |
shabde saktaM tathA shrotraM jihvAM rasaguNeShu cha
shlokas.19:
tanuM sparshe tathA saktAM vAyuM nabhasi chAshritam |
mohaM tamasi sa.nsaktaM lobhamartheShu sa.nshritam
shlokas.20:
viShNuM krAnte bale shakraM koShThe saktaM tathAnalam |
apsu devIM tathA saktAmapastejasi chAshritAH
shlokas.21:
tejo vAyau tu sa.nsaktaM vAyuM nabhasi chAshritam |
nabho mahati sa.nyuktaM mahadbuddhau cha sa.nshritam
shlokas.22:
buddhiM tamasi sa.nsaktAM tamo rajasi chAshritam |
rajaH sattve tathA saktaM sattvaM saktaM tathAtmani
shlokas.23:
saktamAtmAnamIshe cha deve nArAyaNe tathA |
devaM mokShe cha sa.nsaktaM mokShaM saktaM tu na kvachit
shlokas.24:
j~nAtvA sattvayutaM dehaM vRRitaM ShoDashabhirguNaiH |
svabhAvaM chetanAM chaiva j~nAtvA vai dehamAshrite
shlokas.25:
madhyasthamekamAtmAnaM pApaM yasminna vidyate |
dvitIyaM karma vij~nAya nRRipate viShayaiShiNAm
shlokas.26:
indriyANIndriyArthA.nshcha sarvAnAtmani sa.nshritAn |
prANApAnau samAnaM cha vyAnodAnau cha tattvataH
shlokas.27:
avAkchaivAnilaM j~nAtvA pravahaM chAnilaM punaH |
sapta vAtA.nstathA sheShAnsaptadhA vidhivatpunaH
shlokas.28:
prajApatInRRiShI.nshchaiva mArgA.nshcha subahUnvarAn |
saptarShI.nshcha bahU~nj~nAtvA rAjarShI.nshcha parantapa
shlokas.29:
surarShInmahatashchAnyAnmaharShInsUryasaMnibhAn |
aishvaryAchchyAvitA~nj~nAtvA kAlena mahatA nRRipa
shlokas.30:
mahatAM bhUtasa~NghAnAM shrutvA nAshaM cha pArthiva |
gatiM chApyashubhAM j~nAtvA nRRipate pApakarmaNAm
shlokas.31:
vaitaraNyAM cha yadduHkhaM patitAnAM yamakShaye |
yonIShu cha vichitrAsu sa.nsArAnashubhA.nstathA
shlokas.32:
jaThare chAshubhe vAsaM shoNitodakabhAjane |
shleShmamUtrapurIShe cha tIvragandhasamanvite
shlokas.33:
shukrashoNitasa~NghAte majjAsnAyuparigrahe |
sirAshatasamAkIrNe navadvAre pure.ashuchau
shlokas.34:
vij~nAyAhitamAtmAnaM yogA.nshcha vividhAnnRRipa |
tAmasAnAM cha jantUnAM ramaNIyAvRRitAtmanAm
shlokas.35:
sAttvikAnAM cha jantUnAM kutsitaM bharatarShabha |
garhitaM mahatAmarthe sA~NkhyAnAM viditAtmanAm
shlokas.36:
upaplavA.nstathA ghorA~nshashinastejasastathA |
tArANAM patanaM dRRiShTvA nakShatrANAM cha paryayam
shlokas.37:
dva.ndvAnAM viprayogaM cha vij~nAya kRRipaNaM nRRipa |
anyonyabhakShaNaM dRRiShTvA bhUtAnAmapi chAshubham
shlokas.38:
bAlye mohaM cha vij~nAya kShayaM dehasya chAshubham |
rAge mohe cha samprApte kvachitsattvaM samAshritam
shlokas.39:
sahasreShu naraH kashchinmokShabuddhiM samAshritaH |
durlabhatvaM cha mokShasya vij~nAya shrutipUrvakam
shlokas.40:
bahumAnamalabdheShu labdhe madhyasthatAM punaH |
viShayANAM cha daurAtmyaM vij~nAya nRRipate punaH
shlokas.41:
gatAsUnAM cha kaunteya dehAndRRiShTvA tathAshubhAn |
vAsaM kuleShu jantUnAM duHkhaM vij~nAya bhArata
shlokas.42:
brahmaghnAnAM gatiM j~nAtvA patitAnAM sudAruNAm |
surApAne cha saktAnAM brAhmaNAnAM durAtmanAm
gurudAraprasaktAnAM gatiM vij~nAya chAshubhAm
shlokas.43:
jananIShu cha vartante ye na samyagyudhiShThira |
sadevakeShu lokeShu ye na vartanti mAnavAH
shlokas.44:
tena j~nAnena vij~nAya gatiM chAshubhakarmaNAm |
tiryagyonigatAnAM cha vij~nAya gatayaH pRRithak
shlokas.45:
vedavAdA.nstathA chitrAnRRitUnAM paryayA.nstathA |
kShayaM sa.nvatsarANAM cha mAsAnAM prakShayaM tathA
shlokas.46:
pakShakShayaM tathA dRRiShTvA divasAnAM cha sa~NkShayam |
kShayaM vRRiddhiM cha chandrasya dRRiShTvA pratyakShatastathA
shlokas.47:
vRRiddhiM dRRiShTvA samudrANAM kShayaM teShAM tathA punaH |
kShayaM dhanAnAM cha tathA punarvRRiddhiM tathaiva cha
shlokas.48:
sa.nyogAnAM kShayaM dRRiShTvA yugAnAM cha visheShataH |
kShayaM cha dRRiShTvA shailAnAM kShayaM cha saritAM tathA
shlokas.49:
varNAnAM cha kShayaM dRRiShTvA kShayAntaM cha punaH punaH |
jarAmRRityuM tathA janma dRRiShTvA duHkhAni chaiva ha
shlokas.50:
dehadoShA.nstathA j~nAtvA teShAM duHkhaM cha tattvataH |
dehaviklavatAM chaiva samyagvij~nAya bhArata
shlokas.51:
AtmadoShA.nshcha vij~nAya sarvAnAtmani sa.nshritAn |
svadehAdutthitAngandhA.nstathA vij~nAya chAshubhAn
shlokas.52:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kAnsvagAtrodbhavAndoShAnpashyasyamitavikrama |
etanme sa.nshayaM kRRitsnaM vaktumarhasi tattvataH
shlokas.53:
bhIShma uvAcha||
pa~ncha doShAnprabho dehe pravadanti manIShiNaH |
mArgaj~nAH kApilAH sA~NkhyAH shRRiNu tAnarisUdana
shlokas.54:
kAmakrodhau bhayaM nidrA pa~nchamaH shvAsa uchyate |
ete doShAH sharIreShu dRRishyante sarvadehinAm
shlokas.55:
Chindanti kShamayA krodhaM kAmaM sa~NkalpavarjanAt |
sattvasa.nshIlanAnnidrAmapramAdAdbhayaM tathA
Chindanti pa~nchamaM shvAsaM laghvAhAratayA nRRipa
shlokas.56:
guNAnguNashatairj~nAtvA doShAndoShashatairapi |
hetUnhetushataishchitraishchitrAnvij~nAya tattvataH
shlokas.57:
apAM phenopamaM lokaM viShNormAyAshatairvRRitam |
chittabhittipratIkAshaM nalasAramanarthakam
shlokas.58:
tamaH shvabhranibhaM dRRiShTvA varShabudbudasaMnibham |
nAshaprAyaM sukhAddhInaM nAshottaramabhAvagam
rajastamasi saMmagnaM pa~Nke dvipamivAvasham
shlokas.59:
sA~NkhyA rAjanmahAprAj~nAstyaktvA dehaM prajAkRRitam |
j~nAnaj~neyena sA~Nkhyena vyApinA mahatA nRRipa
shlokas.60:
rAjasAnashubhAngandhA.nstAmasA.nshcha tathAvidhAn |
puNyA.nshcha sAttvikAngandhAnsparshajAndehasa.nshritAn
ChittvAshu j~nAnashastreNa tapodaNDena bhArata
shlokas.61:
tato duHkhodakaM ghoraM chintAshokamahAhradam |
vyAdhimRRityumahAgrAhaM mahAbhayamahoragam
shlokas.62:
tamaHkUrmaM rajomInaM praj~nayA santarantyuta |
snehapa~NkaM jarAdurgaM sparshadvIpamari.ndama
shlokas.63:
karmAgAdhaM satyatIraM sthitavratamidaM nRRipa |
hi.nsAshIghramahAvegaM nAnArasamahAkaram
shlokas.64:
nAnAprItimahAratnaM duHkhajvarasamIraNam |
shokatRRiShNAmahAvartaM tIkShNavyAdhimahAgajam
shlokas.65:
asthisa~NghAtasa~NghATaM shleShmaphenamari.ndama |
dAnamuktAkaraM bhImaM shoNitahradavidrumam
shlokas.66:
hasitotkruShTanirghoShaM nAnAj~nAnasudustaram |
rodanAshrumalakShAraM sa~NgatyAgaparAyaNam
shlokas.67:
punarAjanmalokaughaM putrabAndhavapattanam |
ahi.nsAsatyamaryAdaM prANatyAgamahormiNam
shlokas.68:
vedAntagamanadvIpaM sarvabhUtadayodadhim |
mokShaduShprApaviShayaM vaDavAmukhasAgaram
shlokas.69:
taranti munayaH siddhA j~nAnayogena bhArata |
tIrtvA cha dustaraM janma vishanti vimalaM nabhaH
shlokas.70:
tatastAnsukRRitInsA~NkhyAnsUryo vahati rashmibhiH |
padmatantuvadAvishya pravahanviShayAnnRRipa
shlokas.71:
tatra tAnpravaho vAyuH pratigRRihNAti bhArata |
vItarAgAnyatInsiddhAnvIryayuktA.nstapodhanAn
shlokas.72:
sUkShmaH shItaH sugandhI cha sukhasparshashcha bhArata |
saptAnAM marutAM shreShTho lokAngachChati yaH shubhAn
sa tAnvahati kaunteya nabhasaH paramAM gatim
shlokas.73:
nabho vahati lokesha rajasaH paramAM gatim |
rajo vahati rAjendra sattvasya paramAM gatim
shlokas.74:
sattvaM vahati shuddhAtmanparaM nArAyaNaM prabhum |
prabhurvahati shuddhAtmA paramAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.75:
paramAtmAnamAsAdya tadbhUtAyatanAmalAH |
amRRitatvAya kalpante na nivartanti chAbhibho
paramA sA gatiH pArtha nirdva.ndvAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.76:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sthAnamuttamamAsAdya bhagavantaM sthiravratAH |
AjanmamaraNaM vA te smarantyuta na vAnagha
shlokas.77:
yadatra tathyaM tanme tvaM yathAvadvaktumarhasi |
tvadRRite mAnavaM nAnyaM praShTumarhAmi kaurava
shlokas.78:
mokShadoSho mahAneSha prApya siddhiM gatAnRRiShIn |
yadi tatraiva vij~nAne vartante yatayaH pare
shlokas.79:
pravRRittilakShaNaM dharmaM pashyAmi paramaM nRRipa |
magnasya hi pare j~nAne kiM nu duHkhataraM bhavet
shlokas.80:
bhIShma uvAcha||
yathAnyAyaM tvayA tAta prashnaH pRRiShTaH susa~NkaTaH |
buddhAnAmapi saMmohaH prashne.asminbharatarShabha
atrApi tattvaM paramaM shRRiNu samya~Nmayeritam
shlokas.81:
buddhishcha paramA yatra kApilAnAM mahAtmanAm |
indriyANyapi budhyante svadehaM dehino nRRipa
kAraNAnyAtmanastAni sUkShmaH pashyati taistu saH
shlokas.82:
AtmanA viprahINAni kAShThakuDyasamAni tu |
vinashyanti na sa.ndehaH phenA iva mahArNave
shlokas.83:
indriyaiH saha suptasya dehinaH shatrutApana |
sUkShmashcharati sarvatra nabhasIva samIraNaH
shlokas.84:
sa pashyati yathAnyAyaM sparshAnspRRishati chAbhibho |
budhyamAno yathApUrvamakhileneha bhArata
shlokas.85:
indriyANIha sarvANi sve sve sthAne yathAvidhi |
anIshatvAtpralIyante sarpA hataviShA iva
shlokas.86:
indriyANAM tu sarveShAM svasthAneShveva sarvashaH |
Akramya gatayaH sUkShmAshcharatyAtmA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.87:
sattvasya cha guNAnkRRitsnAnrajasashcha guNAnpunaH |
guNA.nshcha tamasaH sarvAnguNAnbuddheshcha bhArata
shlokas.88:
guNA.nshcha manasastadvannabhasashcha guNA.nstathA |
guNAnvAyoshcha dharmAtma.nstejasashcha guNAnpunaH
shlokas.89:
apAM guNA.nstathA pArtha pArthivA.nshcha guNAnapi |
sarvAtmanA guNairvyApya kShetraj~naH sa yudhiShThira
shlokas.90:
AtmA cha yAti kShetraj~naM karmaNI cha shubhAshubhe |
shiShyA iva mahAtmAnamindriyANi cha taM vibho
shlokas.91:
prakRRitiM chApyatikramya gachChatyAtmAnamavyayam |
paraM nArAyaNAtmAnaM nirdva.ndvaM prakRRiteH param
shlokas.92:
vimuktaH puNyapApebhyaH praviShTastamanAmayam |
paramAtmAnamaguNaM na nivartati bhArata
shlokas.93:
shiShTaM tvatra manastAta indriyANi cha bhArata |
AgachChanti yathAkAlaM guroH sa.ndeshakAriNaH
shlokas.94:
shakyaM chAlpena kAlena shAntiM prAptuM guNArthinA |
evaM yuktena kaunteya yuktaj~nAnena mokShiNA
shlokas.95:
sA~NkhyA rAjanmahAprAj~nA gachChanti paramAM gatim |
j~nAnenAnena kaunteya tulyaM j~nAnaM na vidyate
shlokas.96:
atra te sa.nshayo mA bhUjj~nAnaM sA~NkhyaM paraM matam |
akSharaM dhruvamavyaktaM pUrvaM brahma sanAtanam
shlokas.97:
anAdimadhyanidhanaM nirdva.ndvaM kartRRi shAshvatam |
kUTasthaM chaiva nityaM cha yadvadanti shamAtmakAH
shlokas.98:
yataH sarvAH pravartante sargapralayavikriyAH |
yachcha sha.nsanti shAstreShu vadanti paramarShayaH
shlokas.99:
sarve viprAshcha devAshcha tathAgamavido janAH |
brahmaNyaM paramaM devamanantaM parato.achyutam
shlokas.100:
prArthayantashcha taM viprA vadanti guNabuddhayaH |
samyagyuktAstathA yogAH sA~NkhyAshchAmitadarshanAH
shlokas.101:
amUrtestasya kaunteya sA~NkhyaM mUrtiriti shrutiH |
abhij~nAnAni tasyAhurmataM hi bharatarShabha
shlokas.102:
dvividhAnIha bhUtAni pRRithivyAM pRRithivIpate |
ja~NgamAgamasa~nj~nAni ja~NgamaM tu vishiShyate
shlokas.103:
j~nAnaM mahadyaddhi mahatsu rAja;nvedeShu sA~NkhyeShu tathaiva yoge |
yachchApi dRRiShTaM vividhaM purANaM; sA~NkhyAgataM tannikhilaM narendra
shlokas.104:
yachchetihAseShu mahatsu dRRiShTaM; yachchArthashAstre nRRipa shiShTajuShTe |
j~nAnaM cha loke yadihAsti kiM chi;tsA~NkhyAgataM tachcha mahanmahAtman
shlokas.105:
shamashcha dRRiShTaH paramaM balaM cha; j~nAnaM cha sUkShmaM cha yathAvaduktam |
tapA.nsi sUkShmANi sukhAni chaiva; sA~Nkhye yathAvadvihitAni rAjan
shlokas.106:
viparyaye tasya hi pArtha devA;ngachChanti sA~NkhyAH satataM sukhena |
tA.nshchAnusa~nchArya tataH kRRitArthAH; patanti vipreShu yateShu bhUyaH
shlokas.107:
hitvA cha dehaM pravishanti mokShaM; divaukaso dyAmiva pArtha sA~NkhyAH |
tato.adhikaM te.abhiratA mahArhe; sA~Nkhye dvijAH pArthiva shiShTajuShTe
shlokas.108:
teShAM na tiryaggamanaM hi dRRiShTaM; nAvAggatiH pApakRRitAM nivAsaH |
na chAbudhAnAmapi te dvijAtayo; ye j~nAnametannRRipate.anuraktAH
shlokas.109:
sA~NkyaM vishAlaM paramaM purANaM; mahArNavaM vimalamudArakAntam |
kRRitsnaM cha sA~NkhyaM nRRipate mahAtmA; nArAyaNo dhArayate.aprameyam
shlokas.110:
etanmayoktaM naradeva tattvaM; nArAyaNo vishvamidaM purANam |
sa sargakAle cha karoti sargaM; saMhArakAle cha tadatti bhUyaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kiM tadakSharamityuktaM yasmAnnAvartate punaH |
kiM cha tatkSharamityuktaM yasmAdAvartate punaH
shlokas.2:
akSharakSharayorvyaktimichChAmyariniShUdana |
upalabdhuM mahAbAho tattvena kurunandana
shlokas.3:
tvaM hi j~nAnanidhirviprairuchyase vedapAragaiH |
RRiShibhishcha mahAbhAgairyatibhishcha mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.4:
sheShamalpaM dinAnAM te dakShiNAyanabhAskare |
AvRRitte bhagavatyarke gantAsi paramAM gatim
shlokas.5:
tvayi pratigate shreyaH kutaH shroShyAmahe vayam |
kuruva.nshapradIpastvaM j~nAnadravyeNa dIpyase
shlokas.6:
tadetachChrotumichChAmi tvattaH kurukulodvaha |
na tRRipyAmIha rAjendra shRRiNvannamRRitamIdRRisham
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShye.ahamitihAsaM purAtanam |
vasiShThasya cha sa.nvAdaM karAlajanakasya cha
shlokas.8:
vasiShThaM shreShThamAsInamRRiShINAM bhAskaradyutim |
paprachCha janako rAjA j~nAnaM naiHshreyasaM param
shlokas.9:
paramadhyAtmakushalamadhyAtmagatinishchayam |
maitrAvaruNimAsInamabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.10:
svakSharaM prashritaM vAkyaM madhuraM chApyanulbaNam |
paprachCharShivaraM rAjA karAlajanakaH purA
shlokas.11:
bhagava~nshrotumichChAmi paraM brahma sanAtanam |
yasmAnna punarAvRRittimApnuvanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.12:
yachcha tatkSharamityuktaM yatredaM kSharate jagat |
yachchAkSharamiti proktaM shivaM kShemyamanAmayam
shlokas.13:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
shrUyatAM pRRithivIpAla kSharatIdaM yathA jagat |
yanna kSharati pUrveNa yAvatkAlena chApyatha
shlokas.14:
yugaM dvAdashasAhasraM kalpaM viddhi chaturguNam |
dashakalpashatAvRRittaM tadaharbrAhmamuchyate
rAtrishchaitAvatI rAjanyasyAnte pratibudhyate
shlokas.15:
sRRijatyanantakarmANaM mahAntaM bhUtamagrajam |
mUrtimantamamUrtAtmA vishvaM shambhuH svayambhuvaH
aNimA laghimA prAptirIshAnaM jyotiravyayam
shlokas.16:
sarvataHpANipAdAntaM sarvatokShishiromukham |
sarvataHshrutimalloke sarvamAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.17:
hiraNyagarbho bhagavAneSha buddhiriti smRRitaH |
mahAniti cha yogeShu viri~ncha iti chApyuta
shlokas.18:
sA~Nkhye cha paThyate shAstre nAmabhirbahudhAtmakaH |
vichitrarUpo vishvAtmA ekAkShara iti smRRitaH
shlokas.19:
vRRitaM naikAtmakaM yena kRRitsnaM trailokyamAtmanA |
tathaiva bahurUpatvAdvishvarUpa iti smRRitaH
shlokas.20:
eSha vai vikriyApannaH sRRijatyAtmAnamAtmanA |
aha~NkAraM mahAtejAH prajApatimaha~NkRRitam
shlokas.21:
avyaktAdvyaktamutpannaM vidyAsargaM vadanti tam |
mahAntaM chApyaha~NkAramavidyAsargameva cha
shlokas.22:
avidhishcha vidhishchaiva samutpannau tathaikataH |
vidyAvidyeti vikhyAte shrutishAstrArthachintakaiH
shlokas.23:
bhUtasargamaha~NkArAttRRitIyaM viddhi pArthiva |
aha~NkAreShu bhUteShu chaturthaM viddhi vaikRRitam
shlokas.24:
vAyurjyotirathAkAshamApo.atha pRRithivI tathA |
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhastathaiva cha
shlokas.25:
evaM yugapadutpannaM dashavargamasa.nshayam |
pa~nchamaM viddhi rAjendra bhautikaM sargamarthavat
shlokas.26:
shrotraM tvakchakShuShI jihvA ghrANameva cha pa~nchamam |
vAkcha hastau cha pAdau cha pAyurmeDhraM tathaiva cha
shlokas.27:
buddhIndriyANi chaitAni tathA karmendriyANi cha |
sambhUtAnIha yugapanmanasA saha pArthiva
shlokas.28:
eShA tattvachaturvi.nshA sarvAkRRitiShu vartate |
yAM j~nAtvA nAbhishochanti brAhmaNAstattvadarshinaH
shlokas.29:
etaddehaM samAkhyAtaM trailokye sarvadehiShu |
veditavyaM narashreShTha sadevanaradAnave
shlokas.30:
sayakShabhUtagandharve sakiMnaramahorage |
sachAraNapishAche vai sadevarShinishAchare
shlokas.31:
sada.nshakITamashake sapUtikRRimimUShake |
shuni shvapAke vaiNeye sachaNDAle sapulkase
shlokas.32:
hastyashvakharashArdUle savRRikShe gavi chaiva ha |
yachcha mUrtimayaM ki~nchitsarvatraitannidarshanam
shlokas.33:
jale bhuvi tathAkAshe nAnyatreti vinishchayaH |
sthAnaM dehavatAmasti ityevamanushushruma
shlokas.34:
kRRitsnametAvatastAta kSharate vyaktasa~nj~nakam |
ahanyahani bhUtAtmA tataH kShara iti smRRitaH
shlokas.35:
etadakSharamityuktaM kSharatIdaM yathA jagat |
jaganmohAtmakaM prAhuravyaktaM vyaktasa~nj~nakam
shlokas.36:
mahA.nshchaivAgrajo nityametatkSharanidarshanam |
kathitaM te mahArAja yasmAnnAvartate punaH
shlokas.37:
pa~nchavi.nshatimo viShNurnistattvastattvasa~nj~nakaH |
tattvasa.nshrayaNAdetattattvamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.38:
yadamUrtyasRRijadvyaktaM tattanmUrtyadhitiShThati |
chaturvi.nshatimo vyakto hyamUrtaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH
shlokas.39:
sa eva hRRidi sarvAsu mUrtiShvAtiShThate.a.atmavAn |
chetaya.nshchetano nityaH sarvamUrtiramUrtimAn
shlokas.40:
sargapralayadharmiNyA asargapralayAtmakaH |
gochare vartate nityaM nirguNo guNasa~nj~nakaH
shlokas.41:
evameSha mahAnAtmA sargapralayakovidaH |
vikurvANaH prakRRitimAnabhimanyatyabuddhimAn
shlokas.42:
tamaHsattvarajoyuktastAsu tAsviha yoniShu |
lIyate.apratibuddhatvAdabuddhajanasevanAt
shlokas.43:
sahavAso nivAsAtmA nAnyo.ahamiti manyate |
yo.ahaM so.ahamiti hyuktvA guNAnanu nivartate
shlokas.44:
tamasA tAmasAnbhAvAnvividhAnpratipadyate |
rajasA rAjasA.nshchaiva sAttvikAnsattvasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.45:
shuklalohitakRRiShNAni rUpANyetAni trINi tu |
sarvANyetAni rUpANi jAnIhi prAkRRitAni vai
shlokas.46:
tAmasA nirayaM yAnti rAjasA mAnuShA.nstathA |
sAttvikA devalokAya gachChanti sukhabhAginaH
shlokas.47:
niShkaivalyena pApena tiryagyonimavApnuyAt |
puNyapApena mAnuShyaM puNyenaikena devatAH
shlokas.48:
evamavyaktaviShayaM kSharamAhurmanIShiNaH |
pa~nchavi.nshatimo yo.ayaM j~nAnAdeva pravartate

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
evamapratibuddhatvAdabuddhamanuvartate |
dehAddehasahasrANi tathA samabhipadyate
shlokas.2:
tiryagyonisahasreShu kadAchiddevatAsvapi |
upapadyati sa.nyogAdguNaiH saha guNakShayAt
shlokas.3:
mAnuShatvAddivaM yAti divo mAnuShyameva cha |
mAnuShyAnnirayasthAnamAnantyaM pratipadyate
shlokas.4:
koshakAro yathAtmAnaM kITaH samanurundhati |
sUtratantuguNairnityaM tathAyamaguNo guNaiH
shlokas.5:
dva.ndvameti cha nirdva.ndvastAsu tAsviha yoniShu |
shIrSharoge.akShiroge cha dantashUle galagrahe
shlokas.6:
jalodare.arshasAM roge jvaragaNDaviShUchike |
shvitre kuShThe.agnidAhe cha sidhmApasmArayorapi
shlokas.7:
yAni chAnyAni dva.ndvAni prAkRRitAni sharIriShu |
utpadyante vichitrANi tAnyeSho.apyabhimanyate
abhimanyatyabhImAnAttathaiva sukRRitAnyapi
shlokas.8:
ekavAsAshcha durvAsAH shAyI nityamadhastathA |
maNDUkashAyI cha tathA vIrAsanagatastathA
shlokas.9:
chIradhAraNamAkAshe shayanaM sthAnameva cha |
iShTakAprastare chaiva kaNTakaprastare tathA
shlokas.10:
bhasmaprastarashAyI cha bhUmishayyAnulepanaH |
vIrasthAnAmbupa~Nke cha shayanaM phalakeShu cha
shlokas.11:
vividhAsu cha shayyAsu phalagRRiddhyAnvito.aphalaH |
mu~njamekhalanagnatvaM kShaumakRRiShNAjinAni cha
shlokas.12:
shANIvAlaparIdhAno vyAghracharmaparichChadaH |
siMhacharmaparIdhAnaH paTTavAsAstathaiva cha
shlokas.13:
kITakAvasanashchaiva chIravAsAstathaiva cha |
vastrANi chAnyAni bahUnyabhimanyatyabuddhimAn
shlokas.14:
bhojanAni vichitrANi ratnAni vividhAni cha |
ekavastrAntarAshitvamekakAlikabhojanam
shlokas.15:
chaturthAShTamakAlashcha ShaShThakAlika eva cha |
ShaDrAtrabhojanashchaiva tathaivAShTAhabhojanaH
shlokas.16:
saptarAtradashAhAro dvAdashAhAra eva cha |
mAsopavAsI mUlAshI phalAhArastathaiva cha
shlokas.17:
vAyubhakSho.ambupiNyAkagomayAdana eva cha |
gomUtrabhojanashchaiva shAkapuShpAda eva cha
shlokas.18:
shaivAlabhojanashchaiva tathAchAmena vartayan |
vartaya~nshIrNaparNaishcha prakIrNaphalabhojanaH
shlokas.19:
vividhAni cha kRRichChrANi sevate sukhakA~NkShayA |
chAndrAyaNAni vidhivalli~NgAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.20:
chAturAshramyapanthAnamAshrayatyAshramAnapi |
upAsInashcha pAShaNDAnguhAH shailA.nstathaiva cha
shlokas.21:
viviktAshcha shilAChAyAstathA prasravaNAni cha |
vividhAni cha japyAni vividhAni vratAni cha
shlokas.22:
niyamAnsuvichitrA.nshcha vividhAni tapA.nsi cha |
yaj~nA.nshcha vividhAkArAnvidhI.nshcha vividhA.nstathA
shlokas.23:
vaNikpathaM dvijakShatraM vaishyashUdraM tathaiva cha |
dAnaM cha vividhAkAraM dInAndhakRRipaNeShvapi
shlokas.24:
abhimanyatyasambodhAttathaiva trividhAnguNAn |
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva dharmArthau kAma eva cha
prakRRityAtmAnamevAtmA evaM pravibhajatyuta
shlokas.25:
svadhAkAravaShaTkArau svAhAkAranamaskriyAH |
yAjanAdhyApanaM dAnaM tathaivAhuH pratigraham
yajanAdhyayane chaiva yachchAnyadapi ki~nchana
shlokas.26:
janmamRRityuvivAde cha tathA vishasane.api cha |
shubhAshubhamayaM sarvametadAhuH kriyApatham
shlokas.27:
prakRRitiH kurute devI mahApralayameva cha |
divasAnte guNAnetAnabhyetyaiko.avatiShThati
shlokas.28:
rashmijAlamivAdityastatkAlena niyachChati |
evameSho.asakRRitsarvaM krIDArthamabhimanyate
shlokas.29:
AtmarUpaguNAnetAnvividhAnhRRidayapriyAn |
evameva vikurvANaH sargapralayakarmaNI
shlokas.30:
kriyAkriyA pathe raktastriguNastriguNAtigaH |
kriyAkriyApathopetastathA taditi manyate
shlokas.31:
evaM dva.ndvAnyathaitAni vartante mama nityashaH |
mamaivaitAni jAyante bAdhante tAni mAmiti
shlokas.32:
nistartavyAnyathaitAni sarvANIti narAdhipa |
manyate.ayaM hyabuddhitvAttathaiva sukRRitAnyapi
shlokas.33:
bhoktavyAni mayaitAni devalokagatena vai |
ihaiva chainaM bhokShyAmi shubhAshubhaphalodayam
shlokas.34:
sukhameva cha kartavyaM sakRRitkRRitvA sukhaM mama |
yAvadantaM cha me saukhyaM jAtyAM jAtyAM bhaviShyati
shlokas.35:
bhaviShyati cha me duHkhaM kRRitenehApyanantakam |
mahadduHkhaM hi mAnuShyaM niraye chApi majjanam
shlokas.36:
nirayAchchApi mAnuShyaM kAlenaiShyAmyahaM punaH |
manuShyatvAchcha devatvaM devatvAtpauruShaM punaH
manuShyatvAchcha nirayaM paryAyeNopagachChati
shlokas.37:
ya evaM vetti vai nityaM nirAtmAtmaguNairvRRitaH |
tena devamanuShyeShu niraye chopapadyate
shlokas.38:
mamatvenAvRRito nityaM tatraiva parivartate |
sargakoTisahasrANi maraNAntAsu mUrtiShu
shlokas.39:
ya evaM kurute karma shubhAshubhaphalAtmakam |
sa eva phalamashnAti triShu lokeShu mUrtimAn
shlokas.40:
prakRRitiH kurute karma shubhAshubhaphalAtmakam |
prakRRitishcha tadashnAti triShu lokeShu kAmagA
shlokas.41:
tiryagyonau manuShyatve devaloke tathaiva cha |
trINi sthAnAni chaitAni jAnIyAtprAkRRitAni ha
shlokas.42:
ali~NgAM prakRRitiM tvAhurli~NgairanumimImahe |
tathaiva pauruShaM li~NgamanumAnAddhi pashyati
shlokas.43:
sa li~NgAntaramAsAdya prAkRRitaM li~NgamavraNam |
vraNadvArANyadhiShThAya karmANyAtmani manyate
shlokas.44:
shrotrAdIni tu sarvANi pa~ncha karmendriyANi cha |
vAgAdIni pravartante guNeShveva guNaiH saha
ahametAni vai kurvanmamaitAnIndriyANi cha
shlokas.45:
nirindriyo.abhimanyeta vraNavAnasmi nirvraNaH |
ali~Ngo li~NgamAtmAnamakAlaH kAlamAtmanaH
shlokas.46:
asattvaM sattvamAtmAnamatattvaM tattvamAtmanaH |
amRRityurmRRityumAtmAnamacharashcharamAtmanaH
shlokas.47:
akShetraH kShetramAtmAnamasargaH sargamAtmanaH |
atapAstapa AtmAnamagatirgatimAtmanaH
shlokas.48:
abhavo bhavamAtmAnamabhayo bhayamAtmanaH |
akSharaH kSharamAtmAnamabuddhistvabhimanyate

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
evamapratibuddhatvAdabuddhajanasevanAt |
sargakoTisahasrANi patanAntAni gachChati
shlokas.2:
dhAmnA dhAmasahasrANi maraNAntAni gachChati |
tiryagyonau manuShyatve devaloke tathaiva cha
shlokas.3:
chandramA iva koshAnAM punastatra sahasrashaH |
lIyate.apratibuddhatvAdevameSha hyabuddhimAn
shlokas.4:
kalAH pa~nchadashA yonistaddhAma iti paThyate |
nityametadvijAnIhi somaH ShoDashamI kalA
shlokas.5:
kalAyAM jAyate.ajasraM punaH punarabuddhimAn |
dhAma tasyopayu~njanti bhUya eva tu jAyate
shlokas.6:
ShoDashI tu kalA sUkShmA sa soma upadhAryatAm |
na tUpayujyate devairdevAnupayunakti sA
shlokas.7:
evaM tAM kShapayitvA hi jAyate nRRipasattama |
sA hyasya prakRRitirdRRiShTA tatkShayAnmokSha uchyate
shlokas.8:
tadevaM ShoDashakalaM dehamavyaktasa~nj~nakam |
mamAyamiti manvAnastatraiva parivartate
shlokas.9:
pa~nchavi.nshastathaivAtmA tasyaivA pratibodhanAt |
vimalasya vishuddhasya shuddhAnilaniShevaNAt
shlokas.10:
ashuddha eva shuddhAtmA tAdRRigbhavati pArthiva |
abuddhasevanAchchApi buddho.apyabudhatAM vrajet
shlokas.11:
tathaivApratibuddho.api j~neyo nRRipatisattama |
prakRRitestriguNAyAstu sevanAtprAkRRito bhavet
shlokas.12:
karAlajanaka uvAcha||
akSharakSharayoreSha dvayoH sambandha iShyate |
strIpu.nsorvApi bhagavansambandhastadvaduchyate
shlokas.13:
RRite na puruSheNeha strI garbhaM dhArayatyuta |
RRite striyaM na puruSho rUpaM nirvartayettathA
shlokas.14:
anyonyasyAbhisambandhAdanyonyaguNasa.nshrayAt |
rUpaM nirvartayatyetadevaM sarvAsu yoniShu
shlokas.15:
ratyarthamabhisa.nrodhAdanyonyaguNasa.nshrayAt |
RRitau nirvartate rUpaM tadvakShyAmi nidarshanam
shlokas.16:
ye guNAH puruShasyeha ye cha mAtRRiguNAstathA |
asthi snAyu cha majjA cha jAnImaH pitRRito dvija
shlokas.17:
tva~NmA.nsaM shoNitaM chaiva mAtRRijAnyapi shushruma |
evametaddvijashreShTha vedashAstreShu paThyate
shlokas.18:
pramANaM yachcha vedoktaM shAstroktaM yachcha paThyate |
vedashAstrapramANaM cha pramANaM tatsanAtanam
shlokas.19:
evamevAbhisambaddhau nityaM prakRRitipUruShau |
pashyAmi bhagava.nstasmAnmokShadharmo na vidyate
shlokas.20:
atha vAnantarakRRitaM ki~nchideva nidarshanam |
tanmamAchakShva tattvena pratyakSho hyasi sarvathA
shlokas.21:
mokShakAmA vayaM chApi kA~NkShAmo yadanAmayam |
adehamajaraM divyamatIndriyamanIshvaram
shlokas.22:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
yadetaduktaM bhavatA vedashAstranidarshanam |
evametadyathA chaitanna gRRihNAti tathA bhavAn
shlokas.23:
dhAryate hi tvayA grantha ubhayorvedashAstrayoH |
na tu granthasya tattvaj~no yathAvattvaM nareshvara
shlokas.24:
yo hi vede cha shAstre cha granthadhAraNatatparaH |
na cha granthArthatattvaj~nastasya taddhAraNaM vRRithA
shlokas.25:
bhAraM sa vahate tasya granthasyArthaM na vetti yaH |
yastu granthArthatattvaj~no nAsya granthAgamo vRRithA
shlokas.26:
granthasyArthaM cha pRRiShTaH sa.nstAdRRisho vaktumarhati |
yathA tattvAbhigamanAdarthaM tasya sa vindati
shlokas.27:
yastu sa.nsatsu kathayedgranthArthaM sthUlabuddhimAn |
sa kathaM mandavij~nAno granthaM vakShyati nirNayAt
shlokas.28:
nirNayaM chApi ChidrAtmA na taM vakShyati tattvataH |
sopahAsAtmatAmeti yasmAchchaivAtmavAnapi
shlokas.29:
tasmAttvaM shRRiNu rAjendra yathaitadanudRRishyate |
yAthAtathyena sA~NkhyeShu yogeShu cha mahAtmasu
shlokas.30:
yadeva yogAH pashyanti sA~Nkhyaistadanugamyate |
ekaM sA~NkhyaM cha yogaM cha yaH pashyati sa buddhimAn
shlokas.31:
tva~NmA.nsaM rudhiraM medaH pittaM majjAsthi snAyu cha |
etadaindriyakaM tAta yadbhavAnidamAha vai
shlokas.32:
dravyAddravyasya niShpattirindriyAdindriyaM tathA |
dehAddehamavApnoti bIjAdbIjaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.33:
nirindriyasyAbIjasya nirdravyasyAsya dehinaH |
kathaM guNA bhaviShyanti nirguNatvAnmahAtmanaH
shlokas.34:
guNA guNeShu jAyante tatraiva nivishanti cha |
evaM guNAH prakRRitito jAyante cha na santi cha
shlokas.35:
tva~NmA.nsaM rudhiraM medaH pittaM majjAsthi snAyu cha |
aShTau tAnyatha shukreNa jAnIhi prAkRRitAni vai
shlokas.36:
pumA.nshchaivApumA.nshchaiva traili~NgyaM prAkRRitaM smRRitam |
naiva pumAnpumA.nshchaiva sa li~NgItyabhidhIyate
shlokas.37:
ali~NgA prakRRitirli~Ngairupalabhyati sAtmajaiH |
yathA puShpaphalairnityamRRitavo mUrtayastathA
shlokas.38:
evamapyanumAnena hyali~Ngamupalabhyate |
pa~nchavi.nshatimastAta li~NgeShvaniyatAtmakaH
shlokas.39:
anAdinidhano.anantaH sarvadarshI nirAmayaH |
kevalaM tvabhimAnitvAdguNeShvaguNa uchyate
shlokas.40:
guNA guNavataH santi nirguNasya kuto guNAH |
tasmAdevaM vijAnanti ye janA guNadarshinaH
shlokas.41:
yadA tveSha guNAnsarvAnprAkRRitAnabhimanyate |
tadA sa guNavAneva parameNAnupashyati
shlokas.42:
yattadbuddheH paraM prAhuH sA~NkhyA yogAshcha sarvashaH |
budhyamAnaM mahAprAj~namabuddhaparivarjanAt
shlokas.43:
aprabuddhamathAvyaktaM saguNaM prAhurIshvaram |
nirguNaM cheshvaraM nityamadhiShThAtArameva cha
shlokas.44:
prakRRiteshcha guNAnAM cha pa~nchavi.nshatikaM budhAH |
sA~Nkhyayoge cha kushalA budhyante paramaiShiNaH
shlokas.45:
yadA prabuddhAstvavyaktamavasthAjanmabhIravaH |
budhyamAnaM prabudhyanti gamayanti samaM tadA
shlokas.46:
etannidarshanaM samyagasamyaganudarshanam |
budhyamAnAprabuddhAbhyAM pRRithakpRRithagari.ndama
shlokas.47:
paraspareNaitaduktaM kSharAkSharanidarshanam |
ekatvamakSharaM prAhurnAnAtvaM kSharamuchyate
shlokas.48:
pa~nchavi.nshatiniShTho.ayaM yadAsamyakpravartate |
ekatvaM darshanaM chAsya nAnAtvaM chApyadarshanam
shlokas.49:
tattvanistattvayoretatpRRithageva nidarshanam |
pa~nchavi.nshatisargaM tu tattvamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.50:
nistattvaM pa~nchavi.nshasya paramAhurnidarshanam |
vargasya vargamAchAraM tattvaM tattvAtsanAtanam

shlokas.1:
karAlajanaka uvAcha||
nAnAtvaikatvamityuktaM tvayaitadRRiShisattama |
pashyAmi chAbhisa.ndigdhametayorvai nidarshanam
shlokas.2:
tathAprabuddhabuddhAbhyAM budhyamAnasya chAnagha |
sthUlabuddhyA na pashyAmi tattvametanna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.3:
akSharakSharayoruktaM tvayA yadapi kAraNam |
tadapyasthirabuddhitvAtpranaShTamiva me.anagha
shlokas.4:
tadetachChrotumichChAmi nAnAtvaikatvadarshanam |
buddhamapratibuddhaM cha budhyamAnaM cha tattvataH
shlokas.5:
vidyAvidye cha bhagavannakSharaM kSharameva cha |
sA~NkhyaM yogaM cha kArtsnyena pRRithakchaivApRRithakcha ha
shlokas.6:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
hanta te sampravakShyAmi yadetadanupRRichChasi |
yogakRRityaM mahArAja pRRithageva shRRiNuShva me
shlokas.7:
yogakRRityaM tu yogAnAM dhyAnameva paraM balam |
tachchApi dvividhaM dhyAnamAhurvedavido janAH
shlokas.8:
ekAgratA cha manasaH prANAyAmastathaiva cha |
prANAyAmastu saguNo nirguNo manasastathA
shlokas.9:
mUtrotsarge purIShe cha bhojane cha narAdhipa |
trikAlaM nAbhiyu~njIta sheShaM yu~njIta tatparaH
shlokas.10:
indriyANIndriyArthebhyo nivartya manasA muniH |
dashadvAdashabhirvApi chaturvi.nshAtparaM tataH
shlokas.11:
taM chodanAbhirmatimAnAtmAnaM chodayedatha |
tiShThantamajaraM taM tu yattaduktaM manIShibhiH
shlokas.12:
taishchAtmA satataM j~neya ityevamanushushruma |
dravyaM hyahInamanaso nAnyatheti vinishchayaH
shlokas.13:
vimuktaH sarvasa~Ngebhyo laghvAhAro jitendriyaH |
pUrvarAtre pare chaiva dhArayeta mano.a.atmani
shlokas.14:
sthirIkRRityendriyagrAmaM manasA mithileshvara |
mano buddhyA sthiraM kRRitvA pAShANa iva nishchalaH
shlokas.15:
sthANuvachchApyakampaH syAdgirivachchApi nishchalaH |
budhA vidhividhAnaj~nAstadA yuktaM prachakShate
shlokas.16:
na shRRiNoti na chAghrAti na rasyati na pashyati |
na cha sparshaM vijAnAti na sa~Nkalpayate manaH
shlokas.17:
na chAbhimanyate ki~nchinna cha budhyati kAShThavat |
tadA prakRRitimApannaM yuktamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.18:
nivAte cha yathA dIpyandIpastadvatsa dRRishyate |
niri~NgashchAchalashchordhvaM na tiryaggatimApnuyAt
shlokas.19:
tadA tamanupashyeta yasmindRRiShTe tu kathyate |
hRRidayastho.antarAtmeti j~neyo j~nastAta madvidhaiH
shlokas.20:
vidhUma iva saptArchirAditya iva rashmimAn |
vaidyuto.agnirivAkAshe dRRishyate.a.atmA tathAtmani
shlokas.21:
yaM pashyanti mahAtmAno dhRRitimanto manIShiNaH |
brAhmaNA brahmayoniShThA hyayonimamRRitAtmakam
shlokas.22:
tadevAhuraNubhyo.aNu tanmahadbhyo mahattaram |
tadantaH sarvabhUteShu dhruvaM tiShThanna dRRishyate
shlokas.23:
buddhidravyeNa dRRishyeta manodIpena lokakRRit |
mahatastamasastAta pAre tiShThannatAmasaH
shlokas.24:
sa tamonuda ityuktastattvaj~nairvedapAragaiH |
vimalo vitamaskashcha nirli~Ngo.ali~Ngasa~nj~nitaH
shlokas.25:
yogametaddhi yogAnAM manye yogasya lakShaNam |
evaM pashyaM prapashyanti AtmAnamajaraM param
shlokas.26:
yogadarshanametAvaduktaM te tattvato mayA |
sA~Nkhyaj~nAnaM pravakShyAmi parisa~NkhyAnidarshanam
shlokas.27:
avyaktamAhuH prakRRitiM parAM prakRRitivAdinaH |
tasmAnmahatsamutpannaM dvitIyaM rAjasattama
shlokas.28:
aha~NkArastu mahatastRRitIyamiti naH shrutam |
pa~ncha bhUtAnyaha~NkArAdAhuH sA~NkhyAnudarshinaH
shlokas.29:
etAH prakRRitayastvaShTau vikArAshchApi ShoDasha |
pa~ncha chaiva visheShA vai tathA pa~nchendriyANi cha
shlokas.30:
etAvadeva tattvAnAM sA~NkhyamAhurmanIShiNaH |
sA~Nkhye vidhividhAnaj~nA nityaM sA~Nkhyapathe ratAH
shlokas.31:
yasmAdyadabhijAyeta tattatraiva pralIyate |
lIyante pratilomAni sRRijyante chAntarAtmanA
shlokas.32:
anulomena jAyante lIyante pratilomataH |
guNA guNeShu satataM sAgarasyormayo yathA
shlokas.33:
sargapralaya etAvAnprakRRiternRRipasattama |
ekatvaM pralaye chAsya bahutvaM cha yadAsRRijat
evameva cha rAjendra vij~neyaM j~neyachintakaiH
shlokas.34:
adhiShThAtAramavyaktamasyApyetannidarshanam |
ekatvaM cha bahutvaM cha prakRRiteranu tattvavAn
ekatvaM pralaye chAsya bahutvaM cha pravartanAt
shlokas.35:
bahudhAtmA prakurvIta prakRRitiM prasavAtmikAm |
tachcha kShetraM mahAnAtmA pa~nchavi.nsho.adhitiShThati
shlokas.36:
adhiShThAteti rAjendra prochyate yatisattamaiH |
adhiShThAnAdadhiShThAtA kShetrANAmiti naH shrutam
shlokas.37:
kShetraM jAnAti chAvyaktaM kShetraj~na iti chochyate |
avyaktike pure shete puruShashcheti kathyate
shlokas.38:
anyadeva cha kShetraM syAdanyaH kShetraj~na uchyate |
kShetramavyaktamityuktaM j~nAtA vai pa~nchavi.nshakaH
shlokas.39:
anyadeva cha j~nAnaM syAdanyajj~neyaM taduchyate |
j~nAnamavyaktamityuktaM j~neyo vai pa~nchavi.nshakaH
shlokas.40:
avyaktaM kShetramityuktaM tathA sattvaM tatheshvaram |
anIshvaramatattvaM cha tattvaM tatpa~nchavi.nshakam
shlokas.41:
sA~NkhyadarshanametAvatparisa~NkhyAnadarshanam |
sA~NkhyaM prakurute chaiva prakRRitiM cha prachakShate
shlokas.42:
tattvAni cha chaturvi.nshatparisa~NkhyAya tattvataH |
sA~NkhyAH saha prakRRityA tu nistattvaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH
shlokas.43:
pa~nchavi.nsho.aprabuddhAtmA budhyamAna iti smRRitaH |
yadA tu budhyate.a.atmAnaM tadA bhavati kevalaH
shlokas.44:
samyagdarshanametAvadbhAShitaM tava tattvataH |
evametadvijAnantaH sAmyatAM pratiyAntyuta
shlokas.45:
samya~NnidarshanaM nAma pratyakShaM prakRRitestathA |
guNatattvAnyathaitAni nirguNo.anyastathA bhavet
shlokas.46:
na tvevaM vartamAnAnAmAvRRittirvidyate punaH |
vidyate.akSharabhAvatvAdaparasparamavyayam
shlokas.47:
pashyerannekamatayo na samyakteShu darshanam |
te.avyaktaM pratipadyante punaH punarari.ndama
shlokas.48:
sarvametadvijAnanto na sarvasya prabodhanAt |
vyaktIbhUtA bhaviShyanti vyaktasya vashavartinaH
shlokas.49:
sarvamavyaktamityuktamasarvaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH |
ya enamabhijAnanti na bhayaM teShu vidyate

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
sA~NkhyadarshanametAvaduktaM te nRRipasattama |
vidyAvidye tvidAnIM me tvaM nibodhAnupUrvashaH
shlokas.2:
avidyAmAhuravyaktaM sargapralayadharmi vai |
sargapralayanirmuktaM vidyAM vai pa~nchavi.nshakam
shlokas.3:
parasparamavidyAM vai tannibodhAnupUrvashaH |
yathoktamRRiShibhistAta sA~NkhyasyAsya nidarshanam
shlokas.4:
karmendriyANAM sarveShAM vidyA buddhIndriyaM smRRitam |
buddhIndriyANAM cha tathA visheShA iti naH shrutam
shlokas.5:
visheShANAM manasteShAM vidyAmAhurmanIShiNaH |
manasaH pa~nchabhUtAni vidyA ityabhichakShate
shlokas.6:
aha~NkArastu bhUtAnAM pa~nchAnAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
aha~NkArasya cha tathA buddhirvidyA nareshvara
shlokas.7:
buddheH prakRRitiravyaktaM tattvAnAM parameshvaram |
vidyA j~neyA narashreShTha vidhishcha paramaH smRRitaH
shlokas.8:
avyaktasya paraM prAhurvidyAM vai pa~nchavi.nshakam |
sarvasya sarvamityuktaM j~neyaM j~nAnasya pArthiva
shlokas.9:
j~nAnamavyaktamityuktaM j~neyaM vai pa~nchavi.nshakam |
tathaiva j~nAnamavyaktaM vij~nAtA pa~nchavi.nshakaH
shlokas.10:
vidyAvidyArthatattvena mayoktaM te visheShataH |
akSharaM cha kSharaM chaiva yaduktaM tannibodha me
shlokas.11:
ubhAvetau kSharAvuktAvubhAvetau cha nakSharau |
kAraNaM tu pravakShyAmi yathA khyAtau tu tattvataH
shlokas.12:
anAdinidhanAvetAvubhAveveshvarau matau |
tattvasa~nj~nAvubhAvetau prochyete j~nAnachintakaiH
shlokas.13:
sargapralayadharmitvAdavyaktaM prAhurakSharam |
tadetadguNasargAya vikurvANaM punaH punaH
shlokas.14:
guNAnAM mahadAdInAmutpadyati parasparam |
adhiShThAnAtkShetramAhuretattatpa~nchavi.nshakam
shlokas.15:
yadA tu guNajAlaM tadavyaktAtmani sa~NkShipet |
tadA saha guNaistaistu pa~nchavi.nsho vilIyate
shlokas.16:
guNA guNeShu lIyante tadaikA prakRRitirbhavet |
kShetraj~no.api yadA tAta tatkShetre sampralIyate
shlokas.17:
tadAkSharatvaM prakRRitirgachChate guNasa~nj~nitA |
nirguNatvaM cha vaideha guNeShu prativartanAt
shlokas.18:
evameva cha kShetraj~naH kShetraj~nAnaparikShaye |
prakRRityA nirguNastveSha ityevamanushushruma
shlokas.19:
kSharo bhavatyeSha yadA tadA guNavatImatha |
prakRRitiM tvabhijAnAti nirguNatvaM tathAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
tadA vishuddho bhavati prakRRiteH parivarjanAt |
anyo.ahamanyeyamiti yadA budhyati buddhimAn
shlokas.21:
tadaiSho.anyatvatAmeti na cha mishratvamAvrajet |
prakRRityA chaiva rAjendra namishro.anyashcha dRRishyate
shlokas.22:
yadA tu guNajAlaM tatprAkRRitaM vijugupsate |
pashyate chAparaM pashyaM tadA pashyanna sa~njvaret
shlokas.23:
kiM mayA kRRitametAvadyo.ahaM kAlamimaM janam |
matsyo jAlaM hyavij~nAnAdanuvartitavA.nstathA
shlokas.24:
ahameva hi saMmohAdanyamanyaM janAjjanam |
matsyo yathodakaj~nAnAdanuvartitavAniha
shlokas.25:
matsyo.anyatvaM yathAj~nAnAdudakAnnAbhimanyate |
AtmAnaM tadvadaj~nAnAdanyatvaM chaiva vedmyaham
shlokas.26:
mamAstu dhigabuddhasya yo.ahaM magnamimaM punaH |
anuvartitavAnmohAdanyamanyaM janAjjanam
shlokas.27:
