ayamatra bhavedbandhuranena saha mokShaNam |
sAmyamekatvamAyAto yAdRRishastAdRRishastvaham
shlokas.28:
tulyatAmiha pashyAmi sadRRisho.ahamanena vai |
ayaM hi vimalo vyaktamahamIdRRishakastathA
shlokas.29:
yo.ahamaj~nAnasaMmohAdaj~nayA sampravRRittavAn |
sasa~NgayAhaM niHsa~NgaH sthitaH kAlamimaM tvaham
shlokas.30:
anayAhaM vashIbhUtaH kAlametaM na buddhavAn |
uchchamadhyamanIchAnAM tAmahaM kathamAvase
shlokas.31:
samAnayAnayA cheha sahavAsamahaM katham |
gachChAmyabuddhabhAvatvAdeShedAnIM sthiro bhave
shlokas.32:
sahavAsaM na yAsyAmi kAlametaddhi va~nchanAt |
va~nchito.asmyanayA yaddhi nirvikAro vikArayA
shlokas.33:
na chAyamaparAdho.asyA aparAdho hyayaM mama |
yo.ahamatrAbhavaM saktaH parA~NmukhamupasthitaH
shlokas.34:
tato.asmi bahurUpAsu sthito mUrtiShvamUrtimAn |
amUrtashchApi mUrtAtmA mamatvena pradharShitaH
shlokas.35:
prakRRiteranayatvena tAsu tAsviha yoniShu |
nirmamasya mamatvena kiM kRRitaM tAsu tAsu cha
yonIShu vartamAnena naShTasa~nj~nena chetasA
shlokas.36:
na mamAtrAnayA kAryamaha~NkArakRRitAtmayA |
AtmAnaM bahudhA kRRitvA yeyaM bhUyo yunakti mAm
idAnImeSha buddho.asmi nirmamo niraha~NkRRitaH
shlokas.37:
mamatvamanayA nityamaha~NkArakRRitAtmakam |
apetyAhamimAM hitvA sa.nshrayiShye nirAmayam
shlokas.38:
anena sAmyaM yAsyAmi nAnayAhamachetasA |
kShamaM mama sahAnena naikatvamanayA saha
evaM paramasambodhAtpa~nchavi.nsho.anubuddhavAn
shlokas.39:
akSharatvaM niyachCheta tyaktvA kSharamanAmayam |
avyaktaM vyaktadharmANaM saguNaM nirguNaM tathA
nirguNaM prathamaM dRRiShTvA tAdRRigbhavati maithila
shlokas.40:
akSharakSharayoretaduktaM tava nidarshanam |
mayeha j~nAnasampannaM yathAshrutinidarshanAt
shlokas.41:
niHsa.ndigdhaM cha sUkShmaM cha vibuddhaM vimalaM tathA |
pravakShyAmi tu te bhUyastannibodha yathAshrutam
shlokas.42:
sA~Nkhyayogau mayA proktau shAstradvayanidarshanAt |
yadeva shAstraM sA~NkhyoktaM yogadarshanameva tat
shlokas.43:
prabodhanakaraM j~nAnaM sA~NkhyAnAmavanIpate |
vispaShTaM prochyate tatra shiShyANAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.44:
bRRihachchaiva hi tachChAstramityAhuH kushalA janAH |
asmi.nshcha shAstre yogAnAM punardadhi punaH sharaH
shlokas.45:
pa~nchavi.nshAtparaM tattvaM na pashyati narAdhipa |
sA~NkhyAnAM tu paraM tatra yathAvadanuvarNitam
shlokas.46:
buddhamapratibuddhaM cha budhyamAnaM cha tattvataH |
budhyamAnaM cha buddhaM cha prAhuryoganidarshanam

shlokas.1:
vasiShTha uvAcha||
aprabuddhamathAvyaktamimaM guNavidhiM shRRiNu |
guNAndhArayate hyeShA sRRijatyAkShipate tathA
shlokas.2:
ajasraM tviha krIDArthaM vikurvantI narAdhipa |
AtmAnaM bahudhA kRRitvA tAnyeva cha vichakShate
shlokas.3:
etadevaM vikurvANAM budhyamAno na budhyate |
avyaktabodhanAchchaiva budhyamAnaM vadantyapi
shlokas.4:
na tveva budhyate.avyaktaM saguNaM vAtha nirguNam |
kadAchittveva khalvetadAhurapratibuddhakam
shlokas.5:
budhyate yadi vAvyaktametadvai pa~nchavi.nshakam |
budhyamAno bhavatyeSha sa~NgAtmaka iti shrutiH
shlokas.6:
anenApratibuddheti vadantyavyaktamachyutam |
avyaktabodhanAchchaiva budhyamAnaM vadantyuta
shlokas.7:
pa~nchavi.nshaM mahAtmAnaM na chAsAvapi budhyate |
ShaDvi.nshaM vimalaM buddhamaprameyaM sanAtanam
shlokas.8:
satataM pa~nchavi.nshaM cha chaturvi.nshaM cha budhyate |
dRRishyAdRRishye hyanugatamubhAveva mahAdyutI
shlokas.9:
avyaktaM na tu tadbrahma budhyate tAta kevalam |
kevalaM pa~nchavi.nshaM cha chaturvi.nshaM na pashyati
shlokas.10:
budhyamAno yadAtmAnamanyo.ahamiti manyate |
tadA prakRRitimAneSha bhavatyavyaktalochanaH
shlokas.11:
budhyate cha parAM buddhiM vishuddhAmamalAM yadA |
ShaDvi.nsho rAjashArdUla tadA buddhatvamAvrajet
shlokas.12:
tatastyajati so.avyaktaM sargapralayadharmiNam |
nirguNaH prakRRitiM veda guNayuktAmachetanAm
shlokas.13:
tataH kevaladharmAsau bhavatyavyaktadarshanAt |
kevalena samAgamya vimukto.a.atmAnamApnuyAt
shlokas.14:
etattattattvamityAhurnistattvamajarAmaram |
tattvasa.nshrayaNAdetattattvavanna cha mAnada
pa~nchavi.nshatitattvAni pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.15:
na chaiSha tattvavA.nstAta nistattvastveSha buddhimAn |
eSha mu~nchati tattvaM hi kShipraM buddhasya lakShaNam
shlokas.16:
ShaDvi.nsho.ahamiti prAj~no gRRihyamANo.ajarAmaraH |
kevalena balenaiva samatAM yAtyasa.nshayam
shlokas.17:
ShaDvi.nshena prabuddhena budhyamAno.apyabuddhimAn |
etannAnAtvamityuktaM sA~NkhyashrutinidarshanAt
shlokas.18:
chetanena sametasya pa~nchavi.nshatikasya cha |
ekatvaM vai bhavatyasya yadA buddhyA na budhyate
shlokas.19:
budhyamAno.aprabuddhena samatAM yAti maithila |
sa~NgadharmA bhavatyeSha niHsa~NgAtmA narAdhipa
shlokas.20:
niHsa~NgAtmAnamAsAdya ShaDvi.nshakamajaM viduH |
vibhustyajati chAvyaktaM yadA tvetadvibudhyate
chaturvi.nshamagAdhaM cha ShaDvi.nshasya prabodhanAt
shlokas.21:
eSha hyapratibuddhashcha budhyamAnashcha te.anagha |
prokto buddhashcha tattvena yathAshrutinidarshanAt
nAnAtvaikatvametAvaddraShTavyaM shAstradRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.22:
mashakodumbare yadvadanyatvaM tadvadetayoH |
matsyo.ambhasi yathA tadvadanyatvamupalabhyate
shlokas.23:
evamevAvagantavyaM nAnAtvaikatvametayoH |
etadvimokSha ityuktamavyaktaj~nAnasaMhitam
shlokas.24:
pa~nchavi.nshatikasyAsya yo.ayaM deheShu vartate |
eSha mokShayitavyeti prAhuravyaktagocharAt
shlokas.25:
so.ayamevaM vimuchyeta nAnyatheti vinishchayaH |
pareNa paradharmA cha bhavatyeSha sametya vai
shlokas.26:
vishuddhadharmA shuddhena buddhena cha sa buddhimAn |
vimuktadharmA muktena sametya puruSharShabha
shlokas.27:
niyogadharmiNA chaiva niyogAtmA bhavatyapi |
vimokShiNA vimokShashcha sametyeha tathA bhavet
shlokas.28:
shuchikarmA shuchishchaiva bhavatyamitadIptimAn |
vimalAtmA cha bhavati sametya vimalAtmanA
shlokas.29:
kevalAtmA tathA chaiva kevalena sametya vai |
svatantrashcha svatantreNa svatantratvamavApnute
shlokas.30:
etAvadetatkathitaM mayA te; tathyaM mahArAja yathArthatattvam |
amatsaratvaM pratigRRihya chArthaM; sanAtanaM brahma vishuddhamAdyam
shlokas.31:
na vedaniShThasya janasya rAja;npradeyametatparamaM tvayA bhavet |
vivitsamAnAya vibodhakArakaM; prabodhahetoH praNatasya shAsanam
shlokas.32:
na deyametachcha tathAnRRitAtmane; shaThAya klIbAya na jihmabuddhaye |
na paNDitaj~nAnaparopatApine; deyaM tvayedaM vinibodha yAdRRishe
shlokas.33:
shraddhAnvitAyAtha guNAnvitAya; parApavAdAdviratAya nityam |
vishuddhayogAya budhAya chaiva; kriyAvate.atha kShamiNe hitAya
shlokas.34:
viviktashIlAya vidhipriyAya; vivAdahInAya bahushrutAya |
vijAnate chaiva na chAhitakShame; dame cha shaktAya shame cha dehinAm
shlokas.35:
etairguNairhInatame na deya;metatparaM brahma vishuddhamAhuH |
na shreyasA yokShyati tAdRRishe kRRitaM; dharmapravaktAramapAtradAnAt
shlokas.36:
pRRithvImimAM yadyapi ratnapUrNAM; dadyAnnadeyaM tvidamavratAya |
jitendriyAyaitadasa.nshayaM te; bhavetpradeyaM paramaM narendra
shlokas.37:
karAla mA te bhayamastu kiM chi;detachChrutaM brahma paraM tvayAdya |
yathAvaduktaM paramaM pavitraM; niHshokamatyantamanAdimadhyam
shlokas.38:
agAdhajanmAmaraNaM cha rAja;nnirAmayaM vItabhayaM shivaM cha |
samIkShya mohaM tyaja chAdya sarvaM; j~nAnasya tattvArthamidaM viditvA
shlokas.39:
avAptametaddhi purA sanAtanA;ddhiraNyagarbhAdgadato narAdhipa |
prasAdya yatnena tamugratejasaM; sanAtanaM brahma yathAdya vai tvayA
shlokas.40:
pRRiShTastvayA chAsmi yathA narendra; tathA mayedaM tvayi choktamadya |
tathAvAptaM brahmaNo me narendra; mahajj~nAnaM mokShavidAM purANam
shlokas.41:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etaduktaM paraM brahma yasmAnnAvartate punaH |
pa~nchavi.nsho mahArAja paramarShinidarshanAt
shlokas.42:
punarAvRRittimApnoti paraM j~nAnamavApya cha |
nAvabudhyati tattvena budhyamAno.ajarAmaraH
shlokas.43:
etanniHshreyasakaraM j~nAnAnAM te paraM mayA |
kathitaM tattvatastAta shrutvA devarShito nRRipa
shlokas.44:
hiraNyagarbhAdRRiShiNA vasiShThena mahAtmanA |
vasiShThAdRRiShishArdUlAnnArado.avAptavAnidam
shlokas.45:
nAradAdviditaM mahyametadbrahma sanAtanam |
mA shuchaH kauravendra tvaM shrutvaitatparamaM padam
shlokas.46:
yena kSharAkShare vitte na bhayaM tasya vidyate |
vidyate tu bhayaM tasya yo naitadvetti pArthiva
shlokas.47:
avij~nAnAchcha mUDhAtmA punaH punarupadravan |
pretya jAtisahasrANi maraNAntAnyupAshnute
shlokas.48:
devalokaM tathA tirya~NmAnuShyamapi chAshnute |
yadi shudhyati kAlena tasmAdaj~nAnasAgarAt
shlokas.49:
aj~nAnasAgaro ghoro hyavyakto.agAdha uchyate |
ahanyahani majjanti yatra bhUtAni bhArata
shlokas.50:
yasmAdagAdhAdavyaktAduttIrNastvaM sanAtanAt |
tasmAttvaM virajAshchaiva vitamaskashcha pArthiva

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mRRigayAM vicharankashchidvijane janakAtmajaH |
vane dadarsha viprendramRRiShiM va.nshadharaM bhRRigoH
shlokas.2:
tamAsInamupAsInaH praNamya shirasA munim |
pashchAdanumatastena paprachCha vasumAnidam
shlokas.3:
bhagavankimidaM shreyaH pretya vApIha vA bhavet |
puruShasyAdhruve dehe kAmasya vashavartinaH
shlokas.4:
satkRRitya paripRRiShTaH sansumahAtmA mahAtapAH |
nijagAda tatastasmai shreyaskaramidaM vachaH
shlokas.5:
manaso.apratikUlAni pretya cheha cha vA~nChasi |
bhUtAnAM pratikUlebhyo nivartasva yatendriyaH
shlokas.6:
dharmaH satAM hitaH pu.nsAM dharmashchaivAshrayaH satAm |
dharmAllokAstrayastAta pravRRittAH sacharAcharAH
shlokas.7:
svAdukAmuka kAmAnAM vaitRRiShNyaM kiM na gachChasi |
madhu pashyasi durbuddhe prapAtaM nAnupashyasi
shlokas.8:
yathA j~nAne parichayaH kartavyastatphalArthinA |
tathA dharme parichayaH kartavyastatphalArthinA
shlokas.9:
asatA dharmakAmena vishuddhaM karma duShkaram |
satA tu dharmakAmena sukaraM karma duShkaram
shlokas.10:
vane grAmyasukhAchAro yathA grAmyastathaiva saH |
grAme vanasukhAchAro yathA vanacharastathA
shlokas.11:
manovAkkarmake dharme kuru shraddhAM samAhitaH |
nivRRittau vA pravRRittau vA sampradhArya guNAguNAn
shlokas.12:
nityaM cha bahu dAtavyaM sAdhubhyashchAnasUyatA |
prArthitaM vratashauchAbhyAM satkRRitaM deshakAlayoH
shlokas.13:
shubhena vidhinA labdhamarhAya pratipAdayet |
krodhamutsRRijya dattvA cha nAnutapyenna kIrtayet
shlokas.14:
anRRisha.nsaH shuchirdAntaH satyavAgArjave sthitaH |
yonikarmavishuddhashcha pAtraM syAdvedaviddvijaH
shlokas.15:
satkRRitA chaikapatnI cha jAtyA yoniriheShyate |
RRigyajuHsAmago vidvAnShaTkarmA pAtramuchyate
shlokas.16:
sa eva dharmaH so.adharmastaM taM pratinaraM bhavet |
pAtrakarmavisheSheNa deshakAlAvavekShya cha
shlokas.17:
lIlayAlpaM yathA gAtrAtpramRRijyAdrajasaH pumAn |
bahuyatnena mahatA pApanirharaNaM tathA
shlokas.18:
viriktasya yathA samyagghRRitaM bhavati bheShajam |
tathA nirhRRitadoShasya pretyadharmaH sukhAvahaH
shlokas.19:
mAnasaM sarvabhUteShu vartate vai shubhAshubhe |
ashubhebhyaH samAkShipya shubheShvevAvatArayet
shlokas.20:
sarvaM sarveNa sarvatra kriyamANaM cha pUjaya |
svadharme yatra rAgaste kAmaM dharmo vidhIyatAm
shlokas.21:
adhRRitAtmandhRRitau tiShTha durbuddhe buddhimAnbhava |
aprashAnta prashAmya tvamaprAj~na prAj~navachchara
shlokas.22:
tejasA shakyate prAptumupAyasahachAriNA |
iha cha pretya cha shreyastasya mUlaM dhRRitiH parA
shlokas.23:
rAjarShiradhRRitiH svargAtpatito hi mahAbhiShaH |
yayAtiH kShINapuNyashcha dhRRityA lokAnavAptavAn
shlokas.24:
tapasvinAM dharmavatAM viduShAM chopasevanAt |
prApsyase vipulAM buddhiM tathA shreyo.abhipatsyase
shlokas.25:
sa tu svabhAvasampannastachChrutvA munibhAShitam |
vinivartya manaH kAmAddharme buddhiM chakAra ha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dharmAdharmavimuktaM yadvimuktaM sarvasa.nshrayAt |
janmamRRityuvimuktaM cha vimuktaM puNyapApayoH
shlokas.2:
yachChivaM nityamabhayaM nityaM chAkSharamavyayam |
shuchi nityamanAyAsaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atra te vartayiShye.ahamitihAsaM purAtanam |
yAj~navalkyasya sa.nvAdaM janakasya cha bhArata
shlokas.4:
yAj~navalkyamRRiShishreShThaM daivarAtirmahAyashAH |
paprachCha janako rAjA prashnaM prashnavidAM varaH
shlokas.5:
katIndriyANi viprarShe kati prakRRitayaH smRRitAH |
kimavyaktaM paraM brahma tasmAchcha paratastu kim
shlokas.6:
prabhavaM chApyayaM chaiva kAlasa~NkhyAM tathaiva cha |
vaktumarhasi viprendra tvadanugrahakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.7:
aj~nAnAtparipRRichChAmi tvaM hi j~nAnamayo nidhiH |
tadahaM shrotumichChAmi sarvametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.8:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
shrUyatAmavanIpAla yadetadanupRRichChasi |
yogAnAM paramaM j~nAnaM sA~NkhyAnAM cha visheShataH
shlokas.9:
na tavAviditaM ki~nchinmAM tu jij~nAsate bhavAn |
pRRiShTena chApi vaktavyameSha dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.10:
aShTau prakRRitayaH proktA vikArAshchApi ShoDasha |
atha sapta tu vyaktAni prAhuradhyAtmachintakAH
shlokas.11:
avyaktaM cha mahA.nshchaiva tathAha~NkAra eva cha |
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam
shlokas.12:
etAH prakRRitayastvaShTau vikArAnapi me shRRiNu |
shrotraM tvakchaiva chakShushcha jihvA ghrANaM cha pa~nchamam
shlokas.13:
shabdasparshau cha rUpaM cha raso gandhastathaiva cha |
vAkcha hastau cha pAdau cha pAyurmeDhraM tathaiva cha
shlokas.14:
ete visheShA rAjendra mahAbhUteShu pa~nchasu |
buddhIndriyANyathaitAni savisheShANi maithila
shlokas.15:
manaH ShoDashakaM prAhuradhyAtmagatichintakAH |
tvaM chaivAnye cha vidvA.nsastattvabuddhivishAradAH
shlokas.16:
avyaktAchcha mahAnAtmA samutpadyati pArthiva |
prathamaM sargamityetadAhuH prAdhAnikaM budhAH
shlokas.17:
mahatashchApyaha~NkAra utpadyati narAdhipa |
dvitIyaM sargamityAhuretadbuddhyAtmakaM smRRitam
shlokas.18:
aha~NkArAchcha sambhUtaM mano bhUtaguNAtmakam |
tRRitIyaH sarga ityeSha Aha~NkArika uchyate
shlokas.19:
manasastu samudbhUtA mahAbhUtA narAdhipa |
chaturthaM sargamityetanmAnasaM parichakShate
shlokas.20:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhastathaiva cha |
pa~nchamaM sargamityAhurbhautikaM bhUtachintakAH
shlokas.21:
shrotraM tvakchaiva chakShushcha jihvA ghrANaM cha pa~nchamam |
sargaM tu ShaShThamityAhurbahuchintAtmakaM smRRitam
shlokas.22:
adhaH shrotrendriyagrAma utpadyati narAdhipa |
saptamaM sargamityAhuretadaindriyakaM smRRitam
shlokas.23:
UrdhvasrotastathA tiryagutpadyati narAdhipa |
aShTamaM sargamityAhuretadArjavakaM budhAH
shlokas.24:
tiryaksrotastvadhaHsrota utpadyati narAdhipa |
navamaM sargamityAhuretadArjavakaM budhAH
shlokas.25:
etAni nava sargANi tattvAni cha narAdhipa |
chaturvi.nshatiruktAni yathAshruti nidarshanAt
shlokas.26:
ata UrdhvaM mahArAja guNasyaitasya tattvataH |
mahAtmabhiranuproktAM kAlasa~NkhyAM nibodha me

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
avyaktasya narashreShTha kAlasa~NkhyAM nibodha me |
pa~ncha kalpasahasrANi dviguNAnyaharuchyate
shlokas.2:
rAtriretAvatI chAsya pratibuddho narAdhipa |
sRRijatyoShadhimevAgre jIvanaM sarvadehinAm
shlokas.3:
tato brahmANamasRRijaddhairaNyANDasamudbhavam |
sA mUrtiH sarvabhUtAnAmityevamanushushruma
shlokas.4:
sa.nvatsaramuShitvANDe niShkramya cha mahAmuniH |
sa.ndadhe.ardhaM mahIM kRRitsnAM divamardhaM prajApatiH
shlokas.5:
dyAvApRRithivyorityeSha rAjanvedeShu paThyate |
tayoH shakalayormadhyamAkAshamakarotprabhuH
shlokas.6:
etasyApi cha sa~NkhyAnaM vedavedA~NgapAragaiH |
dasha kalpasahasrANi pAdonAnyaharuchyate
rAtrimetAvatIM chAsya prAhuradhyAtmachintakAH
shlokas.7:
sRRijatyaha~NkAramRRiShirbhUtaM divyAtmakaM tathA |
chaturashchAparAnputrAndehAtpUrvaM mahAnRRiShiH
te vai pitRRibhyaH pitaraH shrUyante rAjasattama
shlokas.8:
devAH pitR^INAM cha sutA devairlokAH samAvRRitAH |
charAcharA narashreShTha ityevamanushushruma
shlokas.9:
parameShThI tvaha~NkAro.asRRijadbhUtAni pa~nchadhA |
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam
shlokas.10:
etasyApi nishAmAhustRRitIyamiha kurvataH |
pa~ncha kalpasahasrANi tAvadevAharuchyate
shlokas.11:
shabdaH sparshashcha rUpaM cha raso gandhashcha pa~nchamaH |
ete visheShA rAjendra mahAbhUteShu pa~nchasu
yairAviShTAni bhUtAni ahanyahani pArthiva
shlokas.12:
anyonyaM spRRihayantyete anyonyasya hite ratAH |
anyonyamabhimanyante anyonyaspardhinastathA
shlokas.13:
te vadhyamAnA anyonyaM guNairhAribhiravyayAH |
ihaiva parivartante tiryagyonipraveshinaH
shlokas.14:
trINi kalpasahasrANi eteShAmaharuchyate |
ratriretAvatI chaiva manasashcha narAdhipa
shlokas.15:
manashcharati rAjendra charitaM sarvamindriyaiH |
na chendriyANi pashyanti mana evAtra pashyati
shlokas.16:
chakShuH pashyati rUpANi manasA tu na chakShuShA |
manasi vyAkule chakShuH pashyannapi na pashyati
tathendriyANi sarvANi pashyantItyabhichakShate
shlokas.17:
manasyuparate rAjannindriyoparamo bhavet |
na chendriyavyuparame manasyuparamo bhavet
evaM manaHpradhAnAni indriyANi vibhAvayet
shlokas.18:
indriyANAM hi sarveShAmIshvaraM mana uchyate |
etadvishanti bhUtAni sarvANIha mahAyashAH

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
tattvAnAM sargasa~NkhyA cha kAlasa~NkhyA tathaiva cha |
mayA proktAnupUrvyeNa saMhAramapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.2:
yathA saMharate jantUnsasarja cha punaH punaH |
anAdinidhano brahmA nityashchAkShara eva cha
shlokas.3:
ahaHkShayamatho buddhvA nishi svapnamanAstathA |
chodayAmAsa bhagavAnavyakto.aha~NkRRitaM naram
shlokas.4:
tataH shatasahasrA.nshuravyaktenAbhichoditaH |
kRRitvA dvAdashadhAtmAnamAdityo jvaladagnivat
shlokas.5:
chaturvidhaM prajAjAlaM nirdahatyAshu tejasA |
jarAyvaNDasvedajAtamudbhijjaM cha narAdhipa
shlokas.6:
etadunmeShamAtreNa viniShTaM sthANuja~Ngamam |
kUrmapRRiShThasamA bhUmirbhavatyatha samantataH
shlokas.7:
jagaddagdhvAmitabalaH kevalaM jagatIM tataH |
ambhasA balinA kShipramApUryata samantataH
shlokas.8:
tataH kAlAgnimAsAdya tadambho yAti sa~NkShayam |
vinaShTe.ambhasi rAjendra jAjvalItyanalo mahAn
shlokas.9:
tamaprameyo.atibalaM jvalamAnaM vibhAvasum |
UShmANaM sarvabhUtAnAM saptArchiShamathA~njasA
shlokas.10:
bhakShayAmAsa balavAnvAyuraShTAtmako balI |
vicharannamitaprANastiryagUrdhvamadhastathA
shlokas.11:
tamapratibalaM bhImamAkAshaM grasate.a.atmanA |
AkAshamapyatinadanmano grasati chArikam
shlokas.12:
mano grasati sarvAtmA so.aha~NkAraH prajApatiH |
aha~NkAraM mahAnAtmA bhUtabhavyabhaviShyavit
shlokas.13:
tamapyanupamAtmAnaM vishvaM shambhuH prajApatiH |
aNimA laghimA prAptirIshAno jyotiravyayaH
shlokas.14:
sarvataHpANipAdAntaH sarvatokShishiromukhaH |
sarvataHshrutimA.Nlloke sarvamAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.15:
hRRidayaM sarvabhUtAnAM parvaNo.a~NguShThamAtrakaH |
anugrasatyanantaM hi mahAtmA vishvamIshvaraH
shlokas.16:
tataH samabhavatsarvamakShayAvyayamavraNam |
bhUtabhavyamanuShyANAM sraShTAramanaghaM tathA
shlokas.17:
eSho.apyayaste rAjendra yathAvatparibhAShitaH |
adhyAtmamadhibhUtaM cha adhidaivaM cha shrUyatAm

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
pAdAvadhyAtmamityAhurbrAhmaNAstattvadarshinaH |
gantavyamadhibhUtaM cha viShNustatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.2:
pAyuradhyAtmamityAhuryathAtattvArthadarshinaH |
visargamadhibhUtaM cha mitrastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.3:
upastho.adhyAtmamityAhuryathAyoganidarshanam |
adhibhUtaM tathAnando daivataM cha prajApatiH
shlokas.4:
hastAvadhyAtmamityAhuryathAsA~Nkhyanidarshanam |
kartavyamadhibhUtaM tu indrastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.5:
vAgadhyAtmamiti prAhuryathAshrutinidarshanam |
vaktavyamadhibhUtaM tu vahnistatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.6:
chakShuradhyAtmamityAhuryathAshrutinidarshanam |
rUpamatrAdhibhUtaM tu sUryastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.7:
shrotramadhyAtmamityAhuryathAshrutinidarshanam |
shabdastatrAdhibhUtaM tu dishastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.8:
jihvAmadhyAtmamityAhuryathAtattvanidarshanam |
rasa evAdhibhUtaM tu ApastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.9:
ghrANamadhyAtmamityAhuryathAshrutinidarshanam |
gandha evAdhibhUtaM tu pRRithivI chAdhidaivatam
shlokas.10:
tvagadhyAtmamiti prAhustattvabuddhivishAradAH |
sparsha evAdhibhUtaM tu pavanashchAdhidaivatam
shlokas.11:
mano.adhyAtmamiti prAhuryathAshrutinidarshanam |
mantavyamadhibhUtaM tu chandramAshchAdhidaivatam
shlokas.12:
aha~NkArikamadhyAtmamAhustattvanidarshanam |
abhimAno.adhibhUtaM tu bhavastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.13:
buddhiradhyAtmamityAhuryathAvedanidarshanam |
boddhavyamadhibhUtaM tu kShetraj~no.atrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.14:
eShA te vyaktato rAjanvibhUtiranuvarNitA |
Adau madhye tathA chAnte yathAtattvena tattvavit
shlokas.15:
prakRRitirguNAnvikurute svachChandenAtmakAmyayA |
krIDArthaM tu mahArAja shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
yathA dIpasahasrANi dIpAnmartyAH prakurvate |
prakRRitistathA vikurute puruShasya guNAnbahUn
shlokas.17:
sattvamAnanda udrekaH prItiH prAkAshyameva cha |
sukhaM shuddhitvamArogyaM santoShaH shraddadhAnatA
shlokas.18:
akArpaNyamasa.nrambhaH kShamA dhRRitirahi.nsatA |
samatA satyamAnRRiNyaM mArdavaM hrIrachApalam
shlokas.19:
shauchamArjavamAchAramalaulyaM hRRidyasambhramaH |
iShTAniShTaviyogAnAM kRRitAnAmavikatthanam
shlokas.20:
dAnena chAnugrahaNamaspRRihArthe parArthatA |
sarvabhUtadayA chaiva sattvasyaite guNAH smRRitAH
shlokas.21:
rajoguNAnAM sa~NghAto rUpamaishvaryavigrahe |
atyAshitvamakAruNyaM sukhaduHkhopasevanam
shlokas.22:
parApavAdeShu ratirvivAdAnAM cha sevanam |
aha~NkArastvasatkArashchintA vairopasevanam
shlokas.23:
paritApo.apaharaNaM hrInAsho.anArjavaM tathA |
bhedaH paruShatA chaiva kAmakrodhau madastathA
darpo dveSho.ativAdashcha ete proktA rajoguNAH
shlokas.24:
tAmasAnAM tu sa~NghAtaM pravakShyAmyupadhAryatAm |
moho.aprakAshastAmisramandhatAmisrasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.25:
maraNaM chAndhatAmisraM tAmisraM krodha uchyate |
tamaso lakShaNAnIha bhakShANAmabhirochanam
shlokas.26:
bhojanAnAmaparyAptistathA peyeShvatRRiptatA |
gandhavAso vihAreShu shayaneShvAsaneShu cha
shlokas.27:
divAsvapne vivAde cha pramAdeShu cha vai ratiH |
nRRityavAditragItAnAmaj~nAnAchChraddadhAnatA
dveSho dharmavisheShANAmete vai tAmasA guNAH

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
ete pradhAnasya guNAstrayaH puruShasattama |
kRRitsnasya chaiva jagatastiShThantyanapagAH sadA
shlokas.2:
shatadhA sahasradhA chaiva tathA shatasahasradhA |
koTishashcha karotyeSha pratyagAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.3:
sAttvikasyottamaM sthAnaM rAjasasyeha madhyamam |
tAmasasyAdhamaM sthAnaM prAhuradhyAtmachintakAH
shlokas.4:
kevaleneha puNyena gatimUrdhvAmavApnuyAt |
puNyapApena mAnuShyamadharmeNApyadhogatim
shlokas.5:
dva.ndvameShAM trayANAM tu saMnipAtaM cha tattvataH |
sattvasya rajasashchaiva tamasashcha shRRiNuShva me
shlokas.6:
sattvasya tu rajo dRRiShTaM rajasashcha tamastathA |
tamasashcha tathA sattvaM sattvasyAvyaktameva cha
shlokas.7:
avyaktasattvasa.nyukto devalokamavApnuyAt |
rajaHsattvasamAyukto manuShyeShUpapadyate
shlokas.8:
rajastamobhyAM sa.nyuktastiryagyoniShu jAyate |
rajastAmasasattvaishcha yukto mAnuShyamApnuyAt
shlokas.9:
puNyapApaviyuktAnAM sthAnamAhurmanIShiNAm |
shAsvataM chAvyayaM chaiva akSharaM chAbhayaM cha yat
shlokas.10:
j~nAninAM sambhavaM shreShThaM sthAnamavraNamachyutam |
atIndriyamabIjaM cha janmamRRityutamonudam
shlokas.11:
avyaktasthaM paraM yattatpRRiShTaste.ahaM narAdhipa |
sa eSha prakRRitiShTho hi tasthurityabhidhIyate
shlokas.12:
achetanashchaiSha mataH prakRRitisthashcha pArthiva |
etenAdhiShThitashchaiva sRRijate saMharatyapi
shlokas.13:
janaka uvAcha||
anAdinidhanAvetAvubhAveva mahAmune |
amUrtimantAvachalAvaprakampyau cha nirvraNau
shlokas.14:
agrAhyAvRRiShishArdUla kathameko hyachetanaH |
chetanAvA.nstathA chaikaH kShetraj~na iti bhAShitaH
shlokas.15:
tvaM hi viprendra kArtsnyena mokShadharmamupAsase |
sAkalyaM mokShadharmasya shrotumichChAmi tattvataH
shlokas.16:
astitvaM kevalatvaM cha vinAbhAvaM tathaiva cha |
tathaivotkramaNasthAnaM dehino.api viyujyataH
shlokas.17:
kAlena yaddhi prApnoti sthAnaM tadbrUhi me dvija |
sA~Nkhyaj~nAnaM cha tattvena pRRithagyogaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.18:
ariShTAni cha tattvena vaktumarhasi sattama |
viditaM sarvametatte pANAvAmalakaM yathA

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
na shakyo nirguNastAta guNIkartuM vishAM pate |
guNavA.nshchApyaguNavAnyathAtattvaM nibodha me
shlokas.2:
guNairhi guNavAneva nirguNashchAguNastathA |
prAhurevaM mahAtmAno munayastattvadarshinaH
shlokas.3:
guNasvabhAvastvavyakto guNAnevAbhivartate |
upayu~Nkte cha tAneva sa chaivAj~naH svabhAvataH
shlokas.4:
avyaktastu na jAnIte puruSho j~naH svabhAvataH |
na mattaH paramastIti nityamevAbhimanyate
shlokas.5:
anena kAraNenaitadavyaktaM syAdachetanam |
nityatvAdakSharatvAchcha kSharANAM tattvato.anyathA
shlokas.6:
yadAj~nAnena kurvIta guNasargaM punaH punaH |
yadAtmAnaM na jAnIte tadAvyaktamihochyate
shlokas.7:
kartRRitvAchchApi tattvAnAM tattvadharmI tathochyate |
kartRRitvAchchaiva yonInAM yonidharmA tathochyate
shlokas.8:
kartRRitvAtprakRRitInAM tu tathA prakRRitidharmitA |
kartRRitvAchchApi bIjAnAM bIjadharmI tathochyate
shlokas.9:
guNAnAM prasavatvAchcha tathA prasavadharmavAn |
kartRRitvAtpralayAnAM cha tathA pralayadharmitA
shlokas.10:
bIjatvAtprakRRititvAchcha pralayatvAttathaiva cha |
upekShakatvAdanyatvAdabhimAnAchcha kevalam
shlokas.11:
manyante yatayaH shuddhA adhyAtmavigatajvarAH |
anityaM nityamavyaktamevametaddhi shushruma
shlokas.12:
avyaktaikatvamityAhurnAnAtvaM puruShastathA |
sarvabhUtadayAvantaH kevalaM j~nAnamAsthitAH
shlokas.13:
anyaH sa puruSho.avyaktastvadhruvo dhruvasa~nj~nakaH |
yathA mu~nja iShIkAyAstathaivaitaddhi jAyate
shlokas.14:
anyaM cha mashakaM vidyAdanyachchodumbaraM tathA |
na chodumbarasa.nyogairmashakastatra lipyate
shlokas.15:
anya eva tathA matsyastathAnyadudakaM smRRitam |
na chodakasya sparshena matsyo lipyati sarvashaH
shlokas.16:
anyo hyagnirukhApyanyA nityamevamavaihi bhoH |
na chopalipyate so.agnirukhAsa.nsparshanena vai
shlokas.17:
puShkaraM tvanyadevAtra tathAnyadudakaM smRRitam |
na chodakasya sparshena lipyate tatra puShkaram
shlokas.18:
eteShAM saha sa.nvAsaM vivAsaM chaiva nityashaH |
yathA tathainaM pashyanti na nityaM prAkRRitA janAH
shlokas.19:
ye tvanyathaiva pashyanti na samyakteShu darshanam |
te vyaktaM nirayaM ghoraM pravishanti punaH punaH
shlokas.20:
sA~Nkhyadarshanametatte parisa~NkhyAtamuttamam |
evaM hi parisa~NkhyAya sA~NkhyAH kevalatAM gatAH
shlokas.21:
ye tvanye tattvakushalAsteShAmetannidarshanam |
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi yogAnAmapi darshanam

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
sA~Nkhyaj~nAnaM mayA proktaM yogaj~nAnaM nibodha me |
yathAshrutaM yathAdRRiShTaM tattvena nRRipasattama
shlokas.2:
nAsti sA~NkhyasamaM j~nAnaM nAsti yogasamaM balam |
tAvubhAvekacharyau tu ubhAvanidhanau smRRitau
shlokas.3:
pRRithakpRRithaktu pashyanti ye.alpabuddhiratA narAH |
vayaM tu rAjanpashyAma ekameva tu nishchayAt
shlokas.4:
yadeva yogAH pashyanti tatsA~Nkhyairapi dRRishyate |
ekaM sA~NkhyaM cha yogaM cha yaH pashyati sa tattvavit
shlokas.5:
rudrapradhAnAnaparAnviddhi yogAnparantapa |
tenaiva chAtha dehena vicharanti disho dasha
shlokas.6:
yAvaddhi pralayastAta sUkShmeNAShTaguNena vai |
yogena lokAnvicharansukhaM saMnyasya chAnagha
shlokas.7:
vedeShu chAShTaguNitaM yogamAhurmanIShiNaH |
sUkShmamaShTaguNaM prAhurnetaraM nRRipasattama
shlokas.8:
dviguNaM yogakRRityaM tu yogAnAM prAhuruttamam |
saguNaM nirguNaM chaiva yathAshAstranidarshanam
shlokas.9:
dhAraNA chaiva manasaH prANAyAmashcha pArthiva |
prANAyAmo hi saguNo nirguNaM dhAraNaM manaH
shlokas.10:
yatra dRRishyeta mu~nchanvai prANAnmaithilasattama |
vAtAdhikyaM bhavatyeva tasmAddhi na samAcharet
shlokas.11:
nishAyAH prathame yAme chodanA dvAdasha smRRitAH |
madhye suptvA pare yAme dvAdashaiva tu chodanAH
shlokas.12:
tadevamupashAntena dAntenaikAntashIlinA |
AtmArAmeNa buddhena yoktavyo.a.atmA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
pa~nchAnAmindriyANAM tu doShAnAkShipya pa~nchadhA |
shabdaM sparshaM tathA rUpaM rasaM gandhaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.14:
pratibhAmapavargaM cha pratisaMhRRitya maithila |
indriyagrAmamakhilaM manasyabhiniveshya ha
shlokas.15:
manastathaivAha~NkAre pratiShThApya narAdhipa |
aha~NkAraM tathA buddhau buddhiM cha prakRRitAvapi
shlokas.16:
evaM hi parisa~NkhyAya tato dhyAyeta kevalam |
virajaskamalaM nityamanantaM shuddhamavraNam
shlokas.17:
tasthuShaM puruShaM sattvamabhedyamajarAmaram |
shAshvataM chAvyayaM chaiva IshAnaM brahma chAvyayam
shlokas.18:
yuktasya tu mahArAja lakShaNAnyupadhArayet |
lakShaNaM tu prasAdasya yathA tRRiptaH sukhaM svapet
shlokas.19:
nivAte tu yathA dIpo jvaletsnehasamanvitaH |
nishchalordhvashikhastadvadyuktamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.20:
pAShANa iva meghotthairyathA bindubhirAhataH |
nAlaM chAlayituM shakyastathA yuktasya lakShaNam
shlokas.21:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShairvividhairgItavAditaiH |
kriyamANairna kampeta yuktasyaitannidarshanam
shlokas.22:
tailapAtraM yathA pUrNaM karAbhyAM gRRihya pUruShaH |
sopAnamAruhedbhItastarjyamAno.asipANibhiH
shlokas.23:
sa.nyatAtmA bhayAtteShAM na pAtrAdbindumutsRRijet |
tathaivottaramANasya ekAgramanasastathA
shlokas.24:
sthiratvAdindriyANAM tu nishchalatvAttathaiva cha |
evaM yuktasya tu munerlakShaNAnyupadhArayet
shlokas.25:
sa yuktaH pashyati brahma yattatparamamavyayam |
mahatastamaso madhye sthitaM jvalanasaMnibham
shlokas.26:
etena kevalaM yAti tyaktvA dehamasAkShikam |
kAlena mahatA rAja~nshrutireShA sanAtanI
shlokas.27:
etaddhi yogaM yogAnAM kimanyadyogalakShaNam |
vij~nAya taddhi manyante kRRitakRRityA manIShiNaH

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
tathaivotkramamANaM tu shRRiNuShvAvahito nRRipa |
padbhyAmutkramamANasya vaiShNavaM sthAnamuchyate
shlokas.2:
ja~NghAbhyAM tu vasUndevAnApnuyAditi naH shrutam |
jAnubhyAM cha mahAbhAgAndevAnsAdhyAnavApnuyAt
shlokas.3:
pAyunotkramamANastu maitraM sthAnamavApnuyAt |
pRRithivIM jaghanenAtha UrubhyAM tu prajApatim
shlokas.4:
pArshvAbhyAM maruto devAnnAsAbhyAmindumeva cha |
bAhubhyAmindramityAhururasA rudrameva cha
shlokas.5:
grIvAyAstamRRiShishreShThaM naramApnotyanuttamam |
vishvedevAnmukhenAtha dishaH shrotreNa chApnuyAt
shlokas.6:
ghrANena gandhavahanaM netrAbhyAM sUryameva cha |
bhrUbhyAM chaivAshvinau devau lalATena pitR^Inatha
shlokas.7:
brahmANamApnoti vibhuM mUrdhnA devAgrajaM tathA |
etAnyutkramaNasthAnAnyuktAni mithileshvara
shlokas.8:
ariShTAni tu vakShyAmi vihitAni manIShibhiH |
sa.nvatsaraviyogasya sambhaveyuH sharIriNaH
shlokas.9:
yo.arundhatIM na pashyeta dRRiShTapUrvAM kadAchana |
tathaiva dhruvamityAhuH pUrNenduM dIpameva cha
khaNDAbhAsaM dakShiNataste.api sa.nvatsarAyuShaH
shlokas.10:
parachakShuShi chAtmAnaM ye na pashyanti pArthiva |
AtmachChAyAkRRitIbhUtaM te.api sa.nvatsarAyuShaH
shlokas.11:
atidyutiratipraj~nA apraj~nA chAdyutistathA |
prakRRitervikriyApattiH ShaNmAsAnmRRityulakShaNam
shlokas.12:
daivatAnyavajAnAti brAhmaNaishcha virudhyate |
kRRiShNashyAvachChavichChAyaH ShaNmAsAnmRRityulakShaNam
shlokas.13:
shIrNanAbhi yathA chakraM ChidraM somaM prapashyati |
tathaiva cha sahasrA.nshuM saptarAtreNa mRRityubhAk
shlokas.14:
shavagandhamupAghrAti surabhiM prApya yo naraH |
devatAyatanasthastu ShaDrAtreNa sa mRRityubhAk
shlokas.15:
karNanAsAvanamanaM dantadRRiShTivirAgitA |
sa~nj~nAlopo nirUShmatvaM sadyomRRityunidarshanam
shlokas.16:
akasmAchcha sravedyasya vAmamakShi narAdhipa |
mUrdhatashchotpateddhUmaH sadyomRRityunidarshanam
shlokas.17:
etAvanti tvariShTAni viditvA mAnavo.a.atmavAn |
nishi chAhani chAtmAnaM yojayetparamAtmani
shlokas.18:
pratIkShamANastatkAlaM yatkAlaM prati tadbhavet |
athAsya neShTaM maraNaM sthAtumichChedimAM kriyAm
shlokas.19:
sarvagandhAnrasA.nshchaiva dhArayeta samAhitaH |
tathA hi mRRityuM jayati tatpareNAntarAtmanA
shlokas.20:
sasA~NkhyadhAraNaM chaiva viditvA manujarShabha |
jayechcha mRRityuM yogena tatpareNAntarAtmanA
shlokas.21:
gachChetprApyAkShayaM kRRitsnamajanma shivamavyayam |
shAshvataM sthAnamachalaM duShprApamakRRitAtmabhiH

shlokas.1:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
avyaktasthaM paraM yattatpRRiShTaste.ahaM narAdhipa |
paraM guhyamimaM prashnaM shRRiNuShvAvahito nRRipa
shlokas.2:
yathArSheNeha vidhinA charatAvamatena ha |
mayAdityAdavAptAni yajUMShi mithilAdhipa
shlokas.3:
mahatA tapasA devastapiShThaH sevito mayA |
prItena chAhaM vibhunA sUryeNoktastadAnagha
shlokas.4:
varaM vRRiNIShva viprarShe yadiShTaM te sudurlabham |
tatte dAsyAmi prItAtmA matprasAdo hi durlabhaH
shlokas.5:
tataH praNamya shirasA mayoktastapatAM varaH |
yajUMShi nopayuktAni kShipramichChAmi veditum
shlokas.6:
tato mAM bhagavAnAha vitariShyAmi te dvija |
sarasvatIha vAgbhUtA sharIraM te pravekShyati
shlokas.7:
tato mAmAha bhagavAnAsyaM svaM vivRRitaM kuru |
vivRRitaM cha tato me.a.asyaM praviShTA cha sarasvatI
shlokas.8:
tato vidahyamAno.ahaM praviShTo.ambhastadAnagha |
avij~nAnAdamarShAchcha bhAskarasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.9:
tato vidahyamAnaM mAmuvAcha bhagavAnraviH |
muhUrtaM sahyatAM dAhastataH shItIbhaviShyasi
shlokas.10:
shItIbhUtaM cha mAM dRRiShTvA bhagavAnAha bhAskaraH |
pratiShThAsyati te vedaH sottaraH sakhilo dvija
shlokas.11:
kRRitsnaM shatapathaM chaiva praNeShyasi dvijarShabha |
tasyAnte chApunarbhAve buddhistava bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
prApsyase cha yadiShTaM tatsA~NkhyayogepsitaM padam |
etAvaduktvA bhagavAnastamevAbhyavartata
shlokas.13:
tato.anuvyAhRRitaM shrutvA gate deve vibhAvasau |
gRRihamAgatya saMhRRiShTo.achintayaM vai sarasvatIm
shlokas.14:
tataH pravRRittAtishubhA svaravya~njanabhUShitA |
o~NkAramAditaH kRRitvA mama devI sarasvatI
shlokas.15:
tato.ahamarghyaM vidhivatsarasvatyai nyavedayam |
tapatAM cha variShThAya niShaNNastatparAyaNaH
shlokas.16:
tataH shatapathaM kRRitsnaM sarahasyaM sasa~Ngraham |
chakre saparisheShaM cha harSheNa parameNa ha
shlokas.17:
kRRitvA chAdhyayanaM teShAM shiShyANAM shatamuttamam |
vipriyArthaM sashiShyasya mAtulasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
tataH sashiShyeNa mayA sUryeNeva gabhastibhiH |
vyApto yaj~no mahArAja pitustava mahAtmanaH
shlokas.19:
miShato devalasyApi tato.ardhaM hRRitavAnaham |
svavedadakShiNAyAtha vimarde mAtulena ha
shlokas.20:
sumantunAtha pailena tathA jaimininA cha vai |
pitrA te munibhishchaiva tato.ahamanumAnitaH
shlokas.21:
dasha pa~ncha cha prAptAni yajUMShyarkAnmayAnagha |
tathaiva lomaharShAchcha purANamavadhAritam
shlokas.22:
bIjametatpuraskRRitya devIM chaiva sarasvatIm |
sUryasya chAnubhAvena pravRRitto.ahaM narAdhipa
shlokas.23:
kartuM shatapathaM vedamapUrvaM kAritaM cha me |
yathAbhilaShitaM mArgaM tathA tachchopapAditam
shlokas.24:
shiShyANAmakhilaM kRRitsnamanuj~nAtaM sasa~Ngraham |
sarve cha shiShyAH shuchayo gatAH paramaharShitAH
shlokas.25:
shAkhAH pa~nchadashemAstu vidyA bhAskaradarshitAH |
pratiShThApya yathAkAmaM vedyaM tadanuchintayam
shlokas.26:
kimatra brahmaNyamRRitaM kiM cha vedyamanuttamam |
chintaye tatra chAgatya gandharvo mAmapRRichChata
shlokas.27:
vishvAvasustato rAjanvedAntaj~nAnakovidaH |
chaturvi.nshatikAnprashnAnpRRiShTvA vedasya pArthiva
pa~nchavi.nshatimaM prashnaM paprachChAnvIkShikIM tathA
shlokas.28:
vishvAvishvaM tathAshvAshvaM mitraM varuNameva cha |
j~nAnaM j~neyaM tathAj~no j~naH kastapA atapAstathA
sUryAdaH sUrya iti cha vidyAvidye tathaiva cha
shlokas.29:
vedyAvedyaM tathA rAjannachalaM chalameva cha |
apUrvamakShayaM kShayyametatprashnamanuttamam
shlokas.30:
athoktashcha mayA rAjanrAjA gandharvasattamaH |
pRRiShTavAnanupUrveNa prashnamuttamamarthavat
shlokas.31:
muhUrtaM mRRiShyatAM tAvadyAvadenaM vichintaye |
bADhamityeva kRRitvA sa tUShNIM gandharva AsthitaH
shlokas.32:
tato.anvachintayamahaM bhUyo devIM sarasvatIm |
manasA sa cha me prashno dadhno ghRRitamivoddhRRitam
shlokas.33:
tatropaniShadaM chaiva parisheShaM cha pArthiva |
mathnAmi manasA tAta dRRiShTvA chAnvIkShikIM parAm
shlokas.34:
chaturthI rAjashArdUla vidyaiShA sAmparAyikI |
udIritA mayA tubhyaM pa~nchavi.nshe.adhi dhiShThitA
shlokas.35:
athoktastu mayA rAjanrAjA vishvAvasustadA |
shrUyatAM yadbhavAnasmAnprashnaM sampRRiShTavAniha
shlokas.36:
vishvAvishveti yadidaM gandharvendrAnupRRichChasi |
vishvAvyaktaM paraM vidyAdbhUtabhavyabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.37:
triguNaM guNakartRRitvAdavishvo niShkalastathA |
ashvastathaiva mithunamevamevAnudRRishyate
shlokas.38:
avyaktaM prakRRitiM prAhuH puruSheti cha nirguNam |
tathaiva mitraM puruShaM varuNaM prakRRitiM tathA
shlokas.39:
j~nAnaM tu prakRRitiM prAhurj~neyaM niShkalameva cha |
aj~nashcha j~nashcha puruShastasmAnniShkala uchyate
shlokas.40:
kastapA atapAH proktaH ko.asau puruSha uchyate |
tapAH prakRRitirityAhuratapA niShkalaH smRRitaH
shlokas.41:
tathaivAvedyamavyaktaM vedyaH puruSha uchyate |
chalAchalamiti proktaM tvayA tadapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.42:
chalAM tu prakRRitiM prAhuH kAraNaM kShepasargayoH |
akShepasargayoHkartA nishchalaH puruShaH smRRitaH
shlokas.43:
ajAvubhAvaprajau cha akShayau chApyubhAvapi |
ajau nityAvubhau prAhuradhyAtmagatinishchayAH
shlokas.44:
akShayatvAtprajanane ajamatrAhuravyayam |
akShayaM puruShaM prAhuH kShayo hyasya na vidyate
shlokas.45:
guNakShayatvAtprakRRitiH kartRRitvAdakShayaM budhAH |
eShA te.a.anvIkShikI vidyA chaturthI sAmparAyikI
shlokas.46:
vidyopetaM dhanaM kRRitvA karmaNA nityakarmaNi |
ekAntadarshanA vedAH sarve vishvAvaso smRRitAH
shlokas.47:
jAyante cha mriyante cha yasminnete yatashchyutAH |
vedArthaM ye na jAnanti vedyaM gandharvasattama
shlokas.48:
sA~NgopA~NgAnapi yadi pa~ncha vedAnadhIyate |
vedavedyaM na jAnIte vedabhAravaho hi saH
shlokas.49:
yo ghRRitArthI kharIkShIraM mathedgandharvasattama |
viShThAM tatrAnupashyeta na maNDaM nApi vA ghRRitam
shlokas.50:
tathA vedyamavedyaM cha vedavidyo na vindati |
sa kevalaM mUDhamatirj~nAnabhAravahaH smRRitaH
shlokas.51:
draShTavyau nityamevaitau tatpareNAntarAtmanA |
yathAsya janmanidhane na bhavetAM punaH punaH
shlokas.52:
ajasraM janmanidhanaM chintayitvA trayImimAm |
parityajya kShayamiha akShayaM dharmamAsthitaH
shlokas.53:
yadA tu pashyate.atyantamahanyahani kAshyapa |
tadA sa kevalIbhUtaH ShaDvi.nshamanupashyati
shlokas.54:
anyashcha shashvadavyaktastathAnyaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH |
tasya dvAvanupashyeta tamekamiti sAdhavaH
shlokas.55:
tenaitannAbhijAnanti pa~nchavi.nshakamachyutam |
janmamRRityubhayAdyogAH sA~NkhyAshcha paramaiShiNaH
shlokas.56:
vishvAvasuruvAcha||
pa~nchavi.nshaM yadetatte proktaM brAhmaNasattama |
tathA tanna tathA veti tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.57:
jaigIShavyasyAsitasya devalasya cha me shrutam |
parAsharasya viprarShervArShagaNyasya dhImataH
shlokas.58:
bhikShoH pa~nchashikhasyAtha kapilasya shukasya cha |
gautamasyArShTiSheNasya gargasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.59:
nAradasyAsureshchaiva pulastyasya cha dhImataH |
sanatkumArasya tataH shukrasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.60:
kashyapasya pitushchaiva pUrvameva mayA shrutam |
tadanantaraM cha rudrasya vishvarUpasya dhImataH
shlokas.61:
daivatebhyaH pitRRibhyashcha daityebhyashcha tatastataH |
prAptametanmayA kRRitsnaM vedyaM nityaM vadantyuta
shlokas.62:
tasmAttadvai bhavadbuddhyA shrotumichChAmi brAhmaNa |
bhavAnprabarhaH shAstrANAM pragalbhashchAtibuddhimAn
shlokas.63:
na tavAviditaM ki~nchidbhavA~nshrutinidhiH smRRitaH |
kathyate devaloke cha pitRRiloke cha brAhmaNa
shlokas.64:
brahmalokagatAshchaiva kathayanti maharShayaH |
patishcha tapatAM shashvadAdityastava bhAShate
shlokas.65:
sA~Nkhyaj~nAnaM tvayA brahmannavAptaM kRRitsnameva cha |
tathaiva yogaj~nAnaM cha yAj~navalkya visheShataH
shlokas.66:
niHsa.ndigdhaM prabuddhastvaM budhyamAnashcharAcharam |
shrotumichChAmi tajj~nAnaM ghRRitaM maNDamayaM yathA
shlokas.67:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
kRRitsnadhAriNameva tvAM manye gandharvasattama |
jij~nAsasi cha mAM rAja.nstannibodha yathAshrutam
shlokas.68:
abudhyamAnAM prakRRitiM budhyate pa~nchavi.nshakaH |
na tu budhyati gandharva prakRRitiH pa~nchavi.nshakam
shlokas.69:
anenApratibodhena pradhAnaM pravadanti tam |
sA~NkhyayogAshcha tattvaj~nA yathAshrutinidarshanAt
shlokas.70:
pashya.nstathaivApashya.nshcha pashyatyanyastathAnagha |
ShaDvi.nshaH pa~nchavi.nshaM cha chaturvi.nshaM cha pashyati
na tu pashyati pashya.nstu yashchainamanupashyati
shlokas.71:
pa~nchavi.nsho.abhimanyeta nAnyo.asti paramo mama |
na chaturvi.nshako.agrAhyo manujairj~nAnadarshibhiH
shlokas.72:
matsyevodakamanveti pravartati pravartanAt |
yathaiva budhyate matsyastathaiSho.apyanubudhyate
sasnehaH sahavAsAchcha sAbhimAnashcha nityashaH
shlokas.73:
sa nimajjati kAlasya yadaikatvaM na budhyate |
unmajjati hi kAlasya mamatvenAbhisa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.74:
yadA tu manyate.anyo.ahamanya eSha iti dvijaH |
tadA sa kevalIbhUtaH ShaDvi.nshamanupashyati
shlokas.75:
anyashcha rAjannavarastathAnyaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH |
tatsthatvAdanupashyanti eka eveti sAdhavaH
shlokas.76:
tenaitannAbhinandanti pa~nchavi.nshakamachyutam |
janmamRRityubhayAdbhItA yogAH sA~NkhyAshcha kAshyapa
ShaDvi.nshamanupashyanti shuchayastatparAyaNAH
shlokas.77:
yadA sa kevalIbhUtaH ShaDvi.nshamanupashyati |
tadA sa sarvavidvidvAnna punarjanma vindati
shlokas.78:
evamapratibuddhashcha budhyamAnashcha te.anagha |
buddhashchokto yathAtattvaM mayA shrutinidarshanAt
shlokas.79:
pashyApashyaM yo.anupashyetkShemaM tattvaM cha kAshyapa |
kevalAkevalaM chAdyaM pa~nchavi.nshAtparaM cha yat
shlokas.80:
vishvAvasuruvAcha||
tathyaM shubhaM chaitaduktaM tvayA bhoH; samyakkShemyaM devatAdyaM yathAvat |
svastyakShayaM bhavatashchAstu nityaM; buddhyA sadA buddhiyuktaM namaste
shlokas.81:
yAj~navalkya uvAcha||
evamuktvA samprayAto divaM sa; vibhrAjanvai shrImatA darshanena |
tuShTashcha tuShTyA parayAbhinandya; pradakShiNaM mama kRRitvA mahAtmA
shlokas.82:
brahmAdInAM khecharANAM kShitau cha; ye chAdhastAtsa.nvasante narendra |
tatraiva taddarshanaM darshayanvai; samyakkShemyaM ye pathaM sa.nshritA vai
shlokas.83:
sA~NkhyAH sarve sA~Nkhyadharme ratAshcha; tadvadyogA yogadharme ratAshcha |
ye chApyanye mokShakAmA manuShyA;steShAmetaddarshanaM j~nAnadRRiShTam
shlokas.84:
j~nAnAnmokSho jAyate pUruShANAM; nAstyaj~nAnAdevamAhurnarendra |
tasmAjj~nAnaM tattvato.anveShitavyaM; yenAtmAnaM mokShayejjanmamRRityoH
shlokas.85:
prApya j~nAnaM brAhmaNAtkShatriyAdvA; vaishyAchChUdrAdapi nIchAdabhIkShNam |
shraddhAtavyaM shraddadhAnena nityaM; na shraddhinaM janmamRRityU vishetAm
shlokas.86:
sarve varNA brAhmaNA brahmajAshcha; sarve nityaM vyAharante cha brahma |
tattvaM shAstraM brahmabuddhyA bravImi; sarvaM vishvaM brahma chaitatsamastam
shlokas.87:
brahmAsyato brAhmaNAH samprasUtA; bAhubhyAM vai kShatriyAH samprasUtAH |
nAbhyAM vaishyAH pAdatashchApi shUdrAH; sarve varNA nAnyathA veditavyAH
shlokas.88:
aj~nAnataH karmayoniM bhajante; tAM tAM rAja.nste yathA yAntyabhAvam |
tathA varNA j~nAnahInAH patante; ghorAdaj~nAnAtprAkRRitaM yonijAlam
shlokas.89:
tasmAjj~nAnaM sarvato mArgitavyaM; sarvatrasthaM chaitaduktaM mayA te |
tasthau brahmA tasthivA.nshchAparo ya;stasmai nityaM mokShamAhurdvijendrAH
shlokas.90:
yatte pRRiShTaM tanmayA chopadiShTaM; yAthAtathyaM tadvishoko bhavasva |
rAjangachChasvaitadarthasya pAraM; samyakproktaM svasti te.astvatra nityam
shlokas.91:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa evamanushAstastu yAj~navalkyena dhImatA |
prItimAnabhavadrAjA mithilAdhipatistadA
shlokas.92:
gate munivare tasminkRRite chApi pradakShiNe |
daivarAtirnarapatirAsInastatra mokShavit
shlokas.93:
gokoTiM sparshayAmAsa hiraNyasya tathaiva cha |
ratnA~njalimathaikaM cha brAhmaNebhyo dadau tadA
shlokas.94:
videharAjyaM cha tathA pratiShThApya sutasya vai |
yatidharmamupAsa.nshchApyavasanmithilAdhipaH
shlokas.95:
sA~Nkhyaj~nAnamadhIyAno yogashAstraM cha kRRitsnashaH |
dharmAdharmau cha rAjendra prAkRRitaM parigarhayan
shlokas.96:
anantamiti kRRitvA sa nityaM kevalameva cha |
dharmAdharmau puNyapApe satyAsatye tathaiva cha
shlokas.97:
janmamRRityU cha rAjendra prAkRRitaM tadachintayat |
brahmAvyaktasya karmedamiti nityaM narAdhipa
shlokas.98:
pashyanti yogAH sA~NkhyAshcha svashAstrakRRitalakShaNAH |
iShTAniShTaviyuktaM hi tasthau brahma parAtparam
nityaM tamAhurvidvA.nsaH shuchistasmAchChuchirbhava
shlokas.99:
dIyate yachcha labhate dattaM yachchAnumanyate |
dadAti cha narashreShTha pratigRRihNAti yachcha ha
dadAtyavyaktamevaitatpratigRRihNAti tachcha vai
shlokas.100:
AtmA hyevAtmano hyekaH ko.anyastvatto.adhiko bhavet |
evaM manyasva satatamanyathA mA vichintaya
shlokas.101:
yasyAvyaktaM na viditaM saguNaM nirguNaM punaH |
tena tIrthAni yaj~nAshcha sevitavyAvipashchitA
shlokas.102:
na svAdhyAyaistapobhirvA yaj~nairvA kurunandana |
labhate.avyaktasa.nsthAnaM j~nAtvAvyaktaM mahIpate
shlokas.103:
tathaiva mahataH sthAnamAha~NkArikameva cha |
aha~NkArAtparaM chApi sthAnAni samavApnuyAt
shlokas.104:
ye tvavyaktAtparaM nityaM jAnate shAstratatparAH |
janmamRRityuviyuktaM cha viyuktaM sadasachcha yat
shlokas.105:
etanmayAptaM janakAtpurastA;ttenApi chAptaM nRRipa yAj~navalkyAt |
j~nAnaM vishiShTaM na tathA hi yaj~nA; j~nAnena durgaM tarate na yaj~naiH
shlokas.106:
durgaM janma nidhanaM chApi rAja;nna bhUtikaM j~nAnavido vadanti |
yaj~naistapobhirniyamairvrataishcha; divaM samAsAdya patanti bhUmau
shlokas.107:
tasmAdupAsasva paraM mahachChuchi; shivaM vimokShaM vimalaM pavitram |
kShetraj~navitpArthiva j~nAnayaj~na;mupAsya vai tattvamRRiShirbhaviShyasi
shlokas.108:
upaniShadamupAkarottadA vai; janakanRRipasya purA hi yAj~navalkyaH |
yadupagaNitashAshvatAvyayaM ta;chChubhamamRRitatvamashokamRRichChatIti

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
aishvaryaM vA mahatprApya dhanaM vA bharatarShabha |
dIrghamAyuravApyAtha kathaM mRRityumatikramet
shlokas.2:
tapasA vA sumahatA karmaNA vA shrutena vA |
rasAyanaprayogairvA kairnopaiti jarAntakau
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bhikShoH pa~nchashikhasyeha sa.nvAdaM janakasya cha
shlokas.4:
vaideho janako rAjA maharShiM vedavittamam |
paryapRRichChatpa~nchashikhaM ChinnadharmArthasa.nshayam
shlokas.5:
kena vRRittena bhagavannatikrAmejjarAntakau |
tapasA vAtha buddhyA vA karmaNA vA shrutena vA
shlokas.6:
evamuktaH sa vaidehaM pratyuvAcha parokShavit |
nivRRittirnaitayorasti nAnivRRittiH katha~nchana
shlokas.7:
na hyahAni nivartante na mAsA na punaH kShapAH |
so.ayaM prapadyate.adhvAnaM chirAya dhruvamadhruvaH
shlokas.8:
sarvabhUtasamuchChedaH srotasevohyate sadA |
uhyamAnaM nimajjantamaplave kAlasAgare
jarAmRRityumahAgrAhe na kashchidabhipadyate
shlokas.9:
naivAsya bhavitA kashchinnAsau bhavati kasyachit |
pathi sa~NgatamevedaM dArairanyaishcha bandhubhiH
nAyamatyantasa.nvAso labdhapUrvo hi kenachit
shlokas.10:
kShipyante tena tenaiva niShTanantaH punaH punaH |
kAlena jAtA jAtA hi vAyunevAbhrasa~nchayAH
shlokas.11:
jarAmRRityU hi bhUtAnAM khAditArau vRRikAviva |
balinAM durbalAnAM cha hrasvAnAM mahatAmapi
shlokas.12:
evambhUteShu bhUteShu nityabhUtAdhruveShu cha |
kathaM hRRiShyeta jAteShu mRRiteShu cha kathaM jvaret
shlokas.13:
kuto.ahamAgataH ko.asmi kva gamiShyAmi kasya vA |
kasminsthitaH kva bhavitA kasmAtkimanushochasi
shlokas.14:
draShTA svargasya na hyasti tathaiva narakasya cha |
AgamA.nstvanatikramya dadyAchchaiva yajeta cha

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
aparityajya gArhasthyaM kururAjarShisattama |
kaH prApto vinayaM buddhyA mokShatattvaM vadasva me
shlokas.2:
saMnyasyate yathAtmAyaM saMnyastAtmA yathA cha yaH |
paraM mokShasya yachchApi tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.3:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
janakasya cha sa.nvAdaM sulabhAyAshcha bhArata
shlokas.4:
saMnyAsaphalikaH kashchidbabhUva nRRipatiH purA |
maithilo janako nAma dharmadhvaja iti shrutaH
shlokas.5:
sa vede mokShashAstre cha sve cha shAstre kRRitAgamaH |
indriyANi samAdhAya shashAsa vasudhAmimAm
shlokas.6:
tasya vedavidaH prAj~nAH shrutvA tAM sAdhuvRRittatAm |
lokeShu spRRihayantyanye puruShAH puruSheshvara
shlokas.7:
atha dharmayuge tasminyogadharmamanuShThitA |
mahImanuchachAraikA sulabhA nAma bhikShukI
shlokas.8:
tayA jagadidaM sarvamaTantyA mithileshvaraH |
tatra tatra shruto mokShe kathyamAnastridaNDibhiH
shlokas.9:
sA susUkShmAM kathAM shrutvA tathyaM neti sasa.nshayA |
darshane jAtasa~NkalpA janakasya babhUva ha
shlokas.10:
tataH sA viprahAyAtha pUrvarUpaM hi yogataH |
abibhradanavadyA~NgI rUpamanyadanuttamam
shlokas.11:
chakShurnimeShamAtreNa laghvastragatigAminI |
videhAnAM purIM subhrUrjagAma kamalekShaNA
shlokas.12:
sA prApya mithilAM ramyAM samRRiddhajanasa~NkulAm |
bhaikShacharyApadeshena dadarsha mithileshvaram
shlokas.13:
rAjA tasyAH paraM dRRiShTvA saukumAryaM vapustathA |
keyaM kasya kuto veti babhUvAgatavismayaH
shlokas.14:
tato.asyAH svAgataM kRRitvA vyAdishya cha varAsanam |
pUjitAM pAdashauchena varAnnenApyatarpayat
shlokas.15:
atha bhuktavatI prItA rAjAnaM mantribhirvRRitam |
sarvabhAShyavidAM madhye chodayAmAsa bhikShukI
shlokas.16:
sulabhA tvasya dharmeShu mukto neti sasa.nshayA |
sattvaM sattvena yogaj~nA pravivesha mahIpate
shlokas.17:
netrAbhyAM netrayorasya rashmInsa.nyojya rashmibhiH |
sA sma sa~nchodayiShyantaM yogabandhairbabandha ha
shlokas.18:
janako.apyutsmayanrAjA bhAvamasyA visheShayan |
pratijagrAha bhAvena bhAvamasyA nRRipottamaH
shlokas.19:
tadekasminnadhiShThAne sa.nvAdaH shrUyatAmayam |
ChatrAdiShu vimuktasya muktAyAshcha tridaNDake
shlokas.20:
bhagavatyAH kva charyeyaM kRRitA kva cha gamiShyasi |
kasya cha tvaM kuto veti paprachChainAM mahIpatiH
shlokas.21:
shrute vayasi jAtau cha sadbhAvo nAdhigamyate |
eShvartheShUttaraM tasmAtpravedyaM satsamAgame
shlokas.22:
ChatrAdiShu visheSheShu muktaM mAM viddhi sarvashaH |
sa tvAM saMmantumichChAmi mAnArhAsi matA hi me
shlokas.23:
yasmAchchaitanmayA prAptaM j~nAnaM vaisheShikaM purA |
yasya nAnyaH pravaktAsti mokShe tamapi me shRRiNu
shlokas.24:
pArAsharyasagotrasya vRRiddhasya sumahAtmanaH |
bhikShoH pa~nchashikhasyAhaM shiShyaH paramasaMmataH
shlokas.25:
sA~Nkhyaj~nAne tathA yoge mahIpAlavidhau tathA |
trividhe mokShadharme.asmingatAdhvA Chinnasa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
sa yathAshAstradRRiShTena mArgeNeha parivrajan |
vArShikA.nshchaturo mAsAnpurA mayi sukhoShitaH
shlokas.27:
tenAhaM sA~Nkhyamukhyena sudRRiShTArthena tattvataH |
shrAvitastrividhaM mokShaM na cha rAjyAdvichAlitaH
shlokas.28:
so.ahaM tAmakhilAM vRRittiM trividhAM mokShasaMhitAm |
muktarAgashcharAmyekaH pade paramake sthitaH
shlokas.29:
vairAgyaM punaretasya mokShasya paramo vidhiH |
j~nAnAdeva cha vairAgyaM jAyate yena muchyate
shlokas.30:
j~nAnena kurute yatnaM yatnena prApyate mahat |
mahaddva.ndvapramokShAya sA siddhiryA vayotigA
shlokas.31:
seyaM paramikA buddhiH prAptA nirdva.ndvatA mayA |
ihaiva gatamohena charatA muktasa~NginA
shlokas.32:
yathA kShetraM mRRidUbhUtamadbhirAplAvitaM tathA |
janayatya~NkuraM karma nRRiNAM tadvatpunarbhavam
shlokas.33:
yathA chottApitaM bIjaM kapAle yatra tatra vA |
prApyApya~NkurahetutvamabIjatvAnna jAyate
shlokas.34:
tadvadbhagavatA tena shikhAproktena bhikShuNA |
j~nAnaM kRRitamabIjaM me viShayeShu na jAyate
shlokas.35:
nAbhiShajjati kasmi.nshchinnAnarthe na parigrahe |
nAbhirajyati chaiteShu vyarthatvAdrAgadoShayoH
shlokas.36:
yashcha me dakShiNaM bAhuM chandanena samukShayet |
savyaM vAsyA cha yastakShetsamAvetAvubhau mama
shlokas.37:
sukhI so.ahamavAptArthaH samaloShTAshmakA~nchanaH |
muktasa~NgaH sthito rAjye vishiShTo.anyaistridaNDibhiH
shlokas.38:
mokShe hi trividhA niShThA dRRiShTA pUrvairmaharShibhiH |
j~nAnaM lokottaraM yachcha sarvatyAgashcha karmaNAm
shlokas.39:
j~nAnaniShThAM vadantyeke mokShashAstravido janAH |
karmaniShThAM tathaivAnye yatayaH sUkShmadarshinaH
shlokas.40:
prahAyobhayamapyetajj~nAnaM karma cha kevalam |
tRRitIyeyaM samAkhyAtA niShThA tena mahAtmanA
shlokas.41:
yame cha niyame chaiva dveShe kAme parigrahe |
mAne dambhe tathA snehe sadRRishAste kuTumbibhiH
shlokas.42:
tridaNDAdiShu yadyasti mokSho j~nAnena kenachit |
ChatrAdiShu kathaM na syAttulyahetau parigrahe
shlokas.43:
yena yena hi yasyArthaH kAraNeneha kasyachit |
tattadAlambate dravyaM sarvaH sve sve parigrahe
shlokas.44:
doShadarshI tu gArhasthye yo vrajatyAshramAntaram |
utsRRijanparigRRihNa.nshcha so.api sa~NgAnna muchyate
shlokas.45:
Adhipatye tathA tulye nigrahAnugrahAtmani |
rAjarShibhikShukAchAryA muchyante kena hetunA
shlokas.46:
atha satyAdhipatye.api j~nAnenaiveha kevalam |
muchyante kiM na muchyante pade paramake sthitAH
shlokas.47:
kAShAyadhAraNaM mauNDyaM triviShTabdhaH kamaNDaluH |
li~NgAnyatyarthametAni na mokShAyeti me matiH
shlokas.48:
yadi satyapi li~Nge.asmi~nj~nAnamevAtra kAraNam |
nirmokShAyeha duHkhasya li~NgamAtraM nirarthakam
shlokas.49:
atha vA duHkhashaithilyaM vIkShya li~Nge kRRitA matiH |
kiM tadevArthasAmAnyaM ChatrAdiShu na lakShyate
shlokas.50:
Aki~nchanye na mokSho.asti kai~nchanye nAsti bandhanam |
kai~nchanye chetare chaiva janturj~nAnena muchyate
shlokas.51:
tasmAddharmArthakAmeShu tathA rAjyaparigrahe |
bandhanAyataneShveShu viddhyabandhe pade sthitam
shlokas.52:
rAjyaishvaryamayaH pAshaH snehAyatanabandhanaH |
mokShAshmanishiteneha ChinnastyAgAsinA mayA
shlokas.53:
so.ahameva~Ngato mukto jAtAsthastvayi bhikShuki |
ayathArtho hi te varNo vakShyAmi shRRiNu tanmama
shlokas.54:
saukumAryaM tathA rUpaM vapuragryaM tathA vayaH |
tavaitAni samastAni niyamashcheti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.55:
yachchApyananurUpaM te li~NgasyAsya vicheShTitam |
mukto.ayaM syAnna vetyasmAddharShito matparigrahaH
shlokas.56:
na cha kAmasamAyukte mukte.apyasti tridaNDakam |
na rakShyate tvayA chedaM na muktasyAsti gopanA
shlokas.57:
matpakShasa.nshrayAchchAyaM shRRiNu yaste vyatikramaH |
AshrayantyAH svabhAvena mama pUrvaparigraham
shlokas.58:
praveshaste kRRitaH kena mama rAShTre pure tathA |
kasya vA saMnisargAttvaM praviShTA hRRidayaM mama
shlokas.59:
varNapravaramukhyAsi brAhmaNI kShatriyo hyaham |
nAvayorekayogo.asti mA kRRithA varNasa~Nkaram
shlokas.60:
vartase mokShadharmeShu gArhasthye tvahamAshrame |
ayaM chApi sukaShTaste dvitIyo.a.ashramasa~NkaraH
shlokas.61:
sagotrAM vAsagotrAM vA na veda tvAM na vettha mAm |
sagotramAvishantyAste tRRitIyo gotrasa~NkaraH
shlokas.62:
atha jIvati te bhartA proShito.apyatha vA kvachit |
agamyA parabhAryeti chaturtho dharmasa~NkaraH
shlokas.63:
sA tvametAnyakAryANi kAryApekShA vyavasyasi |
avij~nAnena vA yuktA mithyAj~nAnena vA punaH
shlokas.64:
atha vApi svatantrAsi svadoSheNeha kenachit |
yadi ki~nchichChrutaM te.asti sarvaM kRRitamanarthakam
shlokas.65:
idamanyattRRitIyaM te bhAvasparshavighAtakam |
duShTAyA lakShyate li~NgaM pravaktavyaM prakAshitam
shlokas.66:
na mayyevAbhisandhiste jayaiShiNyA jaye kRRitaH |
yeyaM matpariShatkRRitsnA jetumichChasi tAmapi
shlokas.67:
tathA hyevaM punashcha tvaM dRRiShTiM svAM pratimu~nchasi |
matpakShapratighAtAya svapakShodbhAvanAya cha
shlokas.68:
sA svenAmarShajena tvamRRiddhimohena mohitA |
bhUyaH sRRijasi yogAstraM viShAmRRitamivaikadhA
shlokas.69:
ichChatorhi dvayorlAbhaH strIpu.nsoramRRitopamaH |
alAbhashchApyaraktasya so.atra doSho viShopamaH
shlokas.70:
mA sprAkShIH sadhu jAnIShva svashAstramanupAlaya |
kRRiteyaM hi vijij~nAsA mukto neti tvayA mama
etatsarvaM pratichChannaM mayi nArhasi gUhitum
shlokas.71:
sA yadi tvaM svakAryeNa yadyanyasya mahIpateH |
tattvaM satrapratichChannA mayi nArhasi gUhitum
shlokas.72:
na rAjAnaM mRRiShA gachChenna dvijAtiM katha~nchana |
na striyaM strIguNopetAM hanyurhyete mRRiShAgatAH
shlokas.73:
rAj~nAM hi balamaishvaryaM brahma brahmavidAM balam |
rUpayauvanasaubhAgyaM strINAM balamanuttamam
shlokas.74:
ata etairbalairete balinaH svArthamichChatA |
ArjavenAbhigantavyA vinAshAya hyanArjavam
shlokas.75:
sA tvaM jAtiM shrutaM vRRittaM bhAvaM prakRRitimAtmanaH |
kRRityamAgamane chaiva vaktumarhasi tattvataH
shlokas.76:
ityetairasukhairvAkyairayuktairasama~njasaiH |
pratyAdiShTA narendreNa sulabhA na vyakampata
shlokas.77:
uktavAkye tu nRRipatau sulabhA chArudarshanA |
tatashchArutaraM vAkyaM prachakrAmAtha bhAShitum
shlokas.78:
navabhirnavabhishchaiva doShairvAgbuddhidUShaNaiH |
apetamupapannArthamaShTAdashaguNAnvitam
shlokas.79:
saukShmyaM sa~NkhyAkramau chobhau nirNayaH saprayojanaH |
pa~nchaitAnyarthajAtAni vAkyamityuchyate nRRipa
shlokas.80:
eShAmekaikasho.arthAnAM saukShmyAdInAM sulakShaNam |
shRRiNu sa.nsAryamANAnAM padArthaiH padavAkyataH
shlokas.81:
j~nAnaM j~neyeShu bhinneShu yathAbhedena vartate |
tatrAtishayinI buddhistatsaukShmyamiti vartate
shlokas.82:
doShANAM cha guNAnAM cha pramANaM pravibhAgashaH |
ka~nchidarthamabhipretya sA sa~NkhyetyupadhAryatAm
shlokas.83:
idaM pUrvamidaM pashchAdvaktavyaM yadvivakShitam |
kramayogaM tamapyAhurvAkyaM vAkyavido janAH
shlokas.84:
dharmArthakAmamokSheShu pratij~nAya visheShataH |
idaM taditi vAkyAnte prochyate sa vinirNayaH
shlokas.85:
ichChAdveShabhavairduHkhaiH prakarSho yatra jAyate |
tatra yA nRRipate vRRittistatprayojanamiShyate
shlokas.86:
tAnyetAni yathoktAni saukShmyAdIni janAdhipa |
ekArthasamavetAni vAkyaM mama nishAmaya
shlokas.87:
upetArthamabhinnArthaM nApavRRittaM na chAdhikam |
nAshlakShNaM na cha sa.ndigdhaM vakShyAmi paramaM tava
shlokas.88:
na gurvakSharasambaddhaM parA~NmukhamukhaM na cha |
nAnRRitaM na trivargeNa viruddhaM nApyasa.nskRRitam
shlokas.89:
na nyUnaM kaShTashabdaM vA vyutkramAbhihitaM na cha |
na sheShaM nAnukalpena niShkAraNamahetukam
shlokas.91:
vaktA shrotA cha vAkyaM cha yadA tvavikalaM nRRipa |
samameti vivakShAyAM tadA so.arthaH prakAshate
shlokas.92:
vaktavye tu yadA vaktA shrotAramavamanyate |
svArthamAha parArthaM vA tadA vAkyaM na rohati
shlokas.93:
atha yaH svArthamutsRRijya parArthaM prAha mAnavaH |
visha~NkA jAyate tasminvAkyaM tadapi doShavat
shlokas.94:
yastu vaktA dvayorarthamaviruddhaM prabhAShate |
shrotushchaivAtmanashchaiva sa vaktA netaro nRRipa
shlokas.95:
tadarthavadidaM vAkyamupetaM vAkyasampadA |
avikShiptamanA rAjannekAgraH shrotumarhasi
shlokas.96:
kAsi kasya kuto veti tvayAhamabhichoditA |
tatrottaramidaM vAkyaM rAjannekamanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.97:
yathA jatu cha kAShThaM cha pA.nsavashchodabindubhiH |
sushliShTAni tathA rAjanprANinAmiha sambhavaH
shlokas.98:
shabdaH sparsho raso rUpaM gandhaH pa~nchendriyANi cha |
pRRithagAtmA dashAtmAnaH sa.nshliShTA jatukAShThavat
shlokas.99:
na chaiShAM chodanA kAchidastItyeSha vinishchayaH |
ekaikasyeha vij~nAnaM nAstyAtmani tathA pare
shlokas.100:
na veda chakShushchakShuShTvaM shrotraM nAtmani vartate |
tathaiva vyabhichAreNa na vartante parasparam
sa.nshliShTA nAbhijAyante yathApa iha pA.nsavaH
shlokas.101:
bAhyAnanyAnapekShante guNA.nstAnapi me shRRiNu |
rUpaM chakShuH prakAshashcha darshane hetavastrayaH
yathaivAtra tathAnyeShu j~nAnaj~neyeShu hetavaH
shlokas.102:
j~nAnaj~neyAntare tasminmano nAmAparo guNaH |
vichArayati yenAyaM nishchaye sAdhvasAdhunI
shlokas.103:
dvAdashastvaparastatra buddhirnAma guNaH smRRitaH |
yena sa.nshayapUrveShu boddhavyeShu vyavasyati
shlokas.104:
atha dvAdashake tasminsattvaM nAmAparo guNaH |
mahAsattvo.alpasattvo vA janturyenAnumIyate
shlokas.105:
kShetraj~na iti chApyanyo guNastatra chaturdashaH |
mamAyamiti yenAyaM manyate na cha manyate
shlokas.106:
atha pa~nchadasho rAjanguNastatrAparaH smRRitaH |
pRRithakkalAsamUhasya sAmagryaM tadihochyate
shlokas.107:
guNastvevAparastatra sa~NghAta iti ShoDashaH |
AkRRitirvyaktirityetau guNau yasminsamAshritau
shlokas.108:
sukhaduHkhe jarAmRRityU lAbhAlAbhau priyApriye |
iti chaikonavi.nsho.ayaM dva.ndvayoga iti smRRitaH
shlokas.109:
Urdhvamekonavi.nshatyAH kAlo nAmAparo guNaH |
itImaM viddhi vi.nshatyA bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayam
shlokas.110:
vi.nshakashchaiSha sa~NghAto mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha cha |
sadasadbhAvayogau cha guNAvanyau prakAshakau
shlokas.111:
ityevaM vi.nshatishchaiva guNAH sapta cha ye smRRitAH |
vidhiH shukraM balaM cheti traya ete guNAH pare
shlokas.112:
ekavi.nshashcha dasha cha kalAH sa~NkhyAnataH smRRitAH |
samagrA yatra vartante tachCharIramiti smRRitam
shlokas.113:
avyaktaM prakRRitiM tvAsAM kalAnAM kashchidichChati |
vyaktaM chAsAM tathaivAnyaH sthUladarshI prapashyati
shlokas.114:
avyaktaM yadi vA vyaktaM dvayImatha chatuShTayIm |
prakRRitiM sarvabhUtAnAM pashyantyadhyAtmachintakAH
shlokas.115:
seyaM prakRRitiravyaktA kalAbhirvyaktatAM gatA |
ahaM cha tvaM cha rAjendra ye chApyanye sharIriNaH
shlokas.116:
bindunyAsAdayo.avasthAH shukrashoNitasambhavAH |
yAsAmeva nipAtena kalalaM nAma jAyate
shlokas.118:
sampUrNe navame mAse jantorjAtasya maithila |
jAyate nAmarUpatvaM strI pumAnveti li~NgataH
shlokas.119:
jAtamAtraM tu tadrUpaM dRRiShTvA tAmranakhA~Nguli |
kaumArarUpamApannaM rUpato nopalabhyate
shlokas.120:
kaumArAdyauvanaM chApi sthAviryaM chApi yauvanAt |
anena kramayogena pUrvaM pUrvaM na labhyate
shlokas.121:
kalAnAM pRRithagarthAnAM pratibhedaH kShaNe kShaNe |
vartate sarvabhUteShu saukShmyAttu na vibhAvyate
shlokas.122:
na chaiShAmapyayo rAja.NllakShyate prabhavo na cha |
avasthAyAmavasthAyAM dIpasyevArchiSho gatiH
shlokas.123:
tasyApyevamprabhAvasya sadashvasyeva dhAvataH |
ajasraM sarvalokasya kaH kuto vA na vA kutaH
shlokas.124:
kasyedaM kasya vA nedaM kuto vedaM na vA kutaH |
sambandhaH ko.asti bhUtAnAM svairapyavayavairiha
shlokas.125:
yathAdityAnmaNeshchaiva vIrudbhyashchaiva pAvakaH |
bhavatyevaM samudayAtkalAnAmapi jantavaH
shlokas.126:
AtmanyevAtmanAtmAnaM yathA tvamanupashyasi |
evamevAtmanAtmAnamanyasminkiM na pashyasi
yadyAtmani parasmi.nshcha samatAmadhyavasyasi
shlokas.127:
atha mAM kAsi kasyeti kimarthamanupRRichChasi |
idaM me syAdidaM neti dva.ndvairmuktasya maithila
kAsi kasya kuto veti vachane kiM prayojanam
shlokas.128:
ripau mitre.atha madhyasthe vijaye sandhivigrahe |
kRRitavAnyo mahIpAla kiM tasminmuktalakShaNam
shlokas.129:
trivarge saptadhA vyaktaM yo na vedeha karmasu |
sa~NgavAnyastrivarge cha kiM tasminmuktalakShaNam
shlokas.130:
priye chaivApriye chaiva durbale balavatyapi |
yasya nAsti samaM chakShuH kiM tasminmuktalakShaNam
shlokas.131:
tadamuktasya te mokShe yo.abhimAno bhavennRRipa |
suhRRidbhiH sa nivAryaste vichittasyeva bheShajaiH
shlokas.132:
tAni tAnyanusa.ndRRishya sa~NgasthAnAnyari.ndama |
AtmanAtmani sampashyetkiM tasminmuktalakShaNam
shlokas.133:
imAnyanyAni sUkShmANi mokShamAshritya kAnichit |
chatura~NgapravRRittAni sa~NgasthAnAni me shRRiNu
shlokas.134:
ya imAM pRRithivIM kRRitsnAmekachChatrAM prashAsti ha |
ekameva sa vai rAjA puramadhyAvasatyuta
shlokas.135:
tatpure chaikamevAsya gRRihaM yadadhitiShThati |
gRRihe shayanamapyekaM nishAyAM yatra lIyate
shlokas.136:
shayyArdhaM tasya chApyatra strIpUrvamadhitiShThati |
tadanena prasa~Ngena phalenaiveha yujyate
shlokas.137:
evamevopabhogeShu bhojanAchChAdaneShu cha |
guNeShu parimeyeShu nigrahAnugrahau prati
shlokas.138:
paratantraH sadA rAjA svalpe so.api prasajjate |
sandhivigrahayoge cha kuto rAj~naH svatantratA
shlokas.139:
strIShu krIDAvihAreShu nityamasyAsvatantratA |
mantre chAmAtyasamitau kuta eva svatantratA
shlokas.140:
yadA tvAj~nApayatyanyA.nstadAsyoktA svatantratA |
avashaH kAryate tatra tasmi.nstasminguNe sthitaH
shlokas.141:
svaptukAmo na labhate svaptuM kAryArthibhirjanaiH |
shayane chApyanuj~nAtaH supta utthApyate.avashaH
shlokas.142:
snAhyAlabha piba prAsha juhudhyagnInyajeti cha |
vadasva shRRiNu chApIti vivashaH kAryate paraiH
shlokas.143:
abhigamyAbhigamyainaM yAchante satataM narAH |
na chApyutsahate dAtuM vittarakShI mahAjanAt
shlokas.144:
dAne koshakShayo hyasya vairaM chApyaprayachChataH |
kShaNenAsyopavartante doShA vairAgyakArakAH
shlokas.146:
yadA chaite praduShyanti rAjanye kIrtitA mayA |
tadaivAsya bhayaM tebhyo jAyate pashya yAdRRisham
shlokas.147:
sarvaH sve sve gRRihe rAjA sarvaH sve sve gRRihe gRRihI |
nigrahAnugrahau kurva.nstulyo janaka rAjabhiH
shlokas.148:
putrA dArAstathaivAtmA kosho mitrANi sa~nchayaH |
paraiH sAdhAraNA hyete taistairevAsya hetubhiH
shlokas.149:
hato deshaH puraM dagdhaM pradhAnaH ku~njaro mRRitaH |
lokasAdhAraNeShveShu mithyAj~nAnena tapyate
shlokas.151:
dva.ndvaistaistairupahataH sarvataH parisha~NkitaH |
bahupratyarthikaM rAjyamupAste gaNayannishAH
shlokas.152:
tadalpasukhamatyarthaM bahuduHkhamasAravat |
ko rAjyamabhipadyeta prApya chopashamaM labhet
shlokas.153:
mamedamiti yachchedaM puraM rAShTraM cha manyase |
balaM koshamamAtyA.nshcha kasyaitAni na vA nRRipa
shlokas.154:
mitrAmAtyaM puraM rAShTraM daNDaH kosho mahIpatiH |
saptA~Ngashchakrasa~NghAto rAjyamityuchyate nRRipa
shlokas.155:
saptA~NgasyAsya rAjyasya tridaNDasyeva tiShThataH |
anyonyaguNayuktasya kaH kena guNato.adhikaH
shlokas.156:
teShu teShu hi kAleShu tattada~NgaM vishiShyate |
yena yatsidhyate kAryaM tatprAdhAnyAya kalpate
shlokas.157:
saptA~NgashchApi sa~NghAtastrayashchAnye nRRipottama |
sambhUya dashavargo.ayaM bhu~Nkte rAjyaM hi rAjavat
shlokas.158:
yashcha rAjA mahotsAhaH kShatradharmarato bhavet |
sa tuShyeddashabhAgena tatastvanyo dashAvaraiH
shlokas.159:
nAstyasAdhAraNo rAjA nAsti rAjyamarAjakam |
rAjye.asati kuto dharmo dharme.asati kutaH param
shlokas.160:
yo.apyatra paramo dharmaH pavitraM rAjarAjyayoH |
pRRithivI dakShiNA yasya so.ashvamedho na vidyate
shlokas.161:
sAhametAni karmANi rAjyaduHkhAni maithila |
samarthA shatasho vaktumatha vApi sahasrashaH
shlokas.162:
svadehe nAbhiSha~Ngo me kutaH paraparigrahe |
na mAmeva.nvidhAM muktAmIdRRishaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.163:
nanu nAma tvayA mokShaH kRRitsnaH pa~nchashikhAchChrutaH |
sopAyaH sopaniShadaH sopAsa~NgaH sanishchayaH
shlokas.164:
tasya te muktasa~Ngasya pAshAnAkramya tiShThataH |
ChatrAdiShu visheSheShu kathaM sa~NgaH punarnRRipa
shlokas.165:
shrutaM te na shrutaM manye mithyA vApi shrutaM shrutam |
atha vA shrutasa~NkAshaM shrutamanyachChrutaM tvayA
shlokas.166:
athApImAsu sa~nj~nAsu laukikIShu pratiShThasi |
abhiSha~NgAvarodhAbhyAM baddhastvaM prAkRRito mayA
shlokas.167:
sattvenAnupravesho hi yo.ayaM tvayi kRRito mayA |
kiM tavApakRRitaM tatra yadi mukto.asi sarvataH
shlokas.168:
niyamo hyeSha dharmeShu yatInAM shUnyavAsitA |
shUnyamAvAsayantyA cha mayA kiM kasya dUShitam
shlokas.169:
na pANibhyAM na bAhubhyAM pAdorubhyAM na chAnagha |
na gAtrAvayavairanyaiH spRRishAmi tvA narAdhipa
shlokas.170:
kule mahati jAtena hrImatA dIrghadarshinA |
naitatsadasi vaktavyaM sadvAsadvA mithaH kRRitam
shlokas.171:
brAhmaNA guravashcheme tathAmAtyA gurUttamAH |
tvaM chAtha gururapyeShAmevamanyonyagauravam
shlokas.172:
tadevamanusa.ndRRishya vAchyAvAchyaM parIkShatA |
strIpu.nsoH samavAyo.ayaM tvayA vAchyo na sa.nsadi
shlokas.173:
yathA puShkaraparNasthaM jalaM tatparNasa.nsthitam |
tiShThatyaspRRishatI tadvattvayi vatsyAmi maithila
shlokas.174:
yadi vApyaspRRishantyA me sparshaM jAnAsi ka~nchana |
j~nAnaM kRRitamabIjaM te kathaM teneha bhikShuNA
shlokas.175:
sa gArhasthyAchchyutashcha tvaM mokShaM nAvApya durvidam |
ubhayorantarAle cha vartase mokShavAtikaH
shlokas.176:
na hi muktasya muktena j~nasyaikatvapRRithaktvayoH |
bhAvAbhAvasamAyoge jAyate varNasa~NkaraH
shlokas.177:
varNAshramapRRithaktve cha dRRiShTArthasyApRRithaktvinaH |
nAnyadanyaditi j~nAtvA nAnyadanyatpravartate
shlokas.178:
pANau kuNDaM tathA kuNDe payaH payasi makShikAH |
AshritAshrayayogena pRRithaktvenAshrayA vayam
shlokas.179:
na tu kuNDe payobhAvaH payashchApi na makShikAH |
svayamevAshrayantyete bhAvA na tu parAshrayam
shlokas.180:
pRRithaktvAdAshramANAM cha varNAnyatve tathaiva cha |
parasparapRRithaktvAchcha kathaM te varNasa~NkaraH
shlokas.181:
nAsmi varNottamA jAtyA na vaishyA nAvarA tathA |
tava rAjansavarNAsmi shuddhayoniraviplutA
shlokas.182:
pradhAno nAma rAjarShirvyaktaM te shrotramAgataH |
kule tasya samutpannAM sulabhAM nAma viddhi mAm
shlokas.183:
droNashcha shatashRRi~Ngashcha vakradvArashcha parvataH |
mama satreShu pUrveShAM chitA maghavatA saha
shlokas.184:
sAhaM tasminkule jAtA bhartaryasati madvidhe |
vinItA mokShadharmeShu charAmyekA munivratam
shlokas.185:
nAsmi satrapratichChannA na parasvAbhimAninI |
na dharmasa~NkarakarI svadharme.asmi dhRRitavratA
shlokas.186:
nAsthirA svapratij~nAyAM nAsamIkShyapravAdinI |
nAsamIkShyAgatA chAhaM tvatsakAshaM janAdhipa
shlokas.187:
mokShe te bhAvitAM buddhiM shrutvAhaM kushalaiShiNI |
tava mokShasya chApyasya jij~nAsArthamihAgatA
shlokas.188:
na vargasthA bravImyetatsvapakShaparapakShayoH |
mukto na muchyate yashcha shAnto yashcha na shAmyati
shlokas.189:
yathA shUnye purAgAre bhikShurekAM nishAM vaset |
tathA hi tvachCharIre.asminnimAM vatsyAmi sharvarIm
shlokas.190:
sAhamAsanadAnena vAgAtithyena chArchitA |
suptA susharaNA prItA shvo gamiShyAmi maithila
shlokas.191:
ityetAni sa vAkyAni hetumantyarthavanti cha |
shrutvA nAdhijagau rAjA ki~nchidanyadataH param

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM nirvedamApannaH shuko vaiyAsakiH purA |
etadichChAmi kauravya shrotuM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
prAkRRitena suvRRittena charantamakutobhayam |
adhyApya kRRitsnaM svAdhyAyamanvashAdvai pitA sutam
shlokas.3:
dharmaM putra niShevasva sutIkShNau hi himAtapau |
kShutpipAse cha vAyuM cha jaya nityaM jitendriyaH
shlokas.4:
satyamArjavamakrodhamanasUyAM damaM tapaH |
ahi.nsAM chAnRRisha.nsyaM cha vidhivatparipAlaya
shlokas.5:
satye tiShTha rato dharme hitvA sarvamanArjavam |
devatAtithisheSheNa yAtrAM prANasya sa.nshraya
shlokas.6:
phenapAtropame dehe jIve shakunivatsthite |
anitye priyasa.nvAse kathaM svapiShi putraka
shlokas.7:
apramatteShu jAgratsu nityayukteShu shatruShu |
antaraM lipsamAneShu bAlastvaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.8:
gaNyamAneShu varSheShu kShIyamANe tathAyuShi |
jIvite shiShyamANe cha kimutthAya na dhAvasi
shlokas.9:
aihalaukikamIhante mA.nsashoNitavardhanam |
pAralaukikakAryeShu prasuptA bhRRishanAstikAH
shlokas.10:
dharmAya ye.abhyasUyanti buddhimohAnvitA narAH |
apathA gachChatAM teShAmanuyAtApi pIDyate
shlokas.11:
ye tu tuShTAH suniyatAH satyAgamaparAyaNAH |
dharmyaM panthAnamArUDhAstAnupAssva cha pRRichCha cha
shlokas.12:
upadhArya mataM teShAM vRRiddhAnAM dharmadarshinAm |
niyachCha parayA buddhyA chittamutpathagAmi vai
shlokas.13:
adyakAlikayA buddhyA dUre shva iti nirbhayAH |
sarvabhakShA na pashyanti karmabhUmiM vichetasaH
shlokas.14:
dharmaniHshreNimAsthAya ki~nchitki~nchitsamAruha |
koshakAravadAtmAnaM veShTayannAvabudhyase
shlokas.15:
nAstikaM bhinnamaryAdaM kUlapAtamivAsthiram |
vAmataH kuru visrabdho naraM veNumivoddhatam
shlokas.16:
kAmaM krodhaM cha mRRityuM cha pa~nchendriyajalAM nadIm |
nAvaM dhRRitimayIM kRRitvA janmadurgANi santara
shlokas.17:
mRRityunAbhyAhate loke jarayA paripIDite |
amoghAsu patantIShu dharmayAnena santara
shlokas.18:
tiShThantaM cha shayAnaM cha mRRityuranveShate yadA |
nirvRRitiM labhase kasmAdakasmAnmRRityunAshitaH
shlokas.19:
sa~nchinvAnakamevainaM kAmAnAmavitRRiptakam |
vRRikIvoraNamAsAdya mRRityurAdAya gachChati
shlokas.20:
kramashaH sa~nchitashikho dharmabuddhimayo mahAn |
andhakAre praveShTavye dIpo yatnena dhAryatAm
shlokas.21:
sampatandehajAlAni kadAchidiha mAnuShe |
brAhmaNyaM labhate jantustatputra paripAlaya
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNasya hi deho.ayaM na kAmArthAya jAyate |
iha kleshAya tapase pretya tvanupamaM sukham
shlokas.23:
brAhmaNyaM bahubhiravApyate tapobhi;stallabdhvA na paripaNena heDitavyam |
svAdhyAye tapasi dame cha nityayuktaH; kShemArthI kushalaparaH sadA yatasva
shlokas.24:
avyaktaprakRRitirayaM kalAsharIraH; sUkShmAtmA kShaNatruTisho nimeSharomA |
RRitvAsyaH samabalashuklakRRiShNanetro; mA.nsA~Ngo dravati vayohayo narANAm
shlokas.25:
taM dRRiShTvA prasRRitamajasramugravegaM; gachChantaM satatamihAvyapekShamANam |
chakShuste yadi na parapraNetRRineyaM; dharme te bhavatu manaH paraM nishamya
shlokas.26:
ye.amI tu prachalitadharmakAmavRRittAH; kroshantaH satatamaniShTasamprayogAH |
klishyante parigatavedanAsharIrA; bahvIbhiH subhRRishamadharmavAsanAbhiH
shlokas.27:
rAjA dharmaparaH sadA shubhagoptA; samIkShya sukRRitinAM dadhAti lokAn |
bahuvidhamapi charataH pradishati; sukhamanupagataM niravadyam
shlokas.28:
shvAno bhIShaNAyomukhAni vayA.nsi; vaDagRRidhrakulapakShiNAM cha sa~NghAH |
narAM kadane rudhirapA guruvachana;nudamuparataM vishasanti
shlokas.29:
maryAdA niyatAH svayambhuvA ya ihemAH; prabhinatti dashaguNA manonugatvAt |
nivasati bhRRishamasukhaM pitRRiviShaya;vipinamavagAhya sa pApaH
shlokas.30:
yo lubdhaH subhRRishaM priyAnRRitashcha manuShyaH; satatanikRRitiva~nchanAratiH syAt |
upanidhibhirasukhakRRitsa paramanirayago; bhRRishamasukhamanubhavati duShkRRitakarmA
shlokas.31:
uShNAM vaitaraNIM mahAnadI;mavagADho.asipatravanabhinnagAtraH |
parashuvanashayo nipatito; vasati cha mahAniraye bhRRishArtaH
shlokas.32:
mahApadAni katthase na chApyavekShase param |
chirasya mRRityukArikAmanAgatAM na budhyase
shlokas.33:
prayAsyatAM kimAsyate samutthitaM mahadbhayam |
atipramAthi dAruNaM sukhasya sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.34:
purA mRRitaH praNIyase yamasya mRRityushAsanAt |
tadantikAya dAruNaiH prayatnamArjave kuru
shlokas.35:
purA samUlabAndhavaM prabhurharatyaduHkhavit |
taveha jIvitaM yamo na chAsti tasya vArakaH
shlokas.36:
purA vivAti mAruto yamasya yaH puraHsaraH |
puraika eva nIyase kuruShva sAmparAyikam
shlokas.37:
purA sahikka eva te pravAti mAruto.antakaH |
purA cha vibhramanti te disho mahAbhayAgame
shlokas.38:
smRRitishcha saMnirudhyate purA taveha putraka |
samAkulasya gachChataH samAdhimuttamaM kuru
shlokas.39:
kRRitAkRRite shubhAshubhe pramAdakarmaviplute |
smaranpurA na tapyase nidhatsva kevalaM nidhim
shlokas.40:
purA jarA kalevaraM vijarjarIkaroti te |
balA~NgarUpahAriNI nidhatsva kevalaM nidhim
shlokas.41:
purA sharIramantako bhinatti rogasAyakaiH |
prasahya jIvitakShaye tapo mahatsamAchara
shlokas.42:
purA vRRikA bhaya~NkarA manuShyadehagocharAH |
abhidravanti sarvato yatasva puNyashIlane
shlokas.43:
purAndhakAramekako.anupashyasi tvarasva vai |
purA hiraNmayAnnagAnnirIkShase.adrimUrdhani
shlokas.44:
purA kusa~NgatAni te suhRRinmukhAshcha shatravaH |
vichAlayanti darshanAdghaTasva putra yatparam
shlokas.45:
dhanasya yasya rAjato bhayaM na chAsti chaurataH |
mRRitaM cha yanna mu~nchati samarjayasva taddhanam
shlokas.46:
na tatra sa.nvibhajyate svakarmabhiH parasparam |
yadeva yasya yautakaM tadeva tatra so.ashnute
shlokas.47:
paratra yena jIvyate tadeva putra dIyatAm |
dhanaM yadakShayaM dhruvaM samarjayasva tatsvayam
shlokas.48:
na yAvadeva pachyate mahAjanasya yAvakam |
apakva eva yAvake purA praNIyase tvara
shlokas.49:
na mAtRRipitRRibAndhavA na sa.nstutaH priyo janaH |
anuvrajanti sa~NkaTe vrajantamekapAtinam
shlokas.50:
yadeva karma kevalaM svayaM kRRitaM shubhAshubham |
tadeva tasya yautakaM bhavatyamutra gachChataH
shlokas.51:
hiraNyaratnasa~nchayAH shubhAshubhena sa~nchitAH |
na tasya dehasa~NkShaye bhavanti kAryasAdhakAH
shlokas.52:
paratragAmikasya te kRRitAkRRitasya karmaNaH |
na sAkShirAtmanA samo nRRiNAmihAsti kashchana
shlokas.53:
manuShyadehashUnyakaM bhavatyamutra gachChataH |
prapashya buddhichakShuShA pradRRishyate hi sarvataH
shlokas.54:
ihAgnisUryavAyavaH sharIramAshritAstrayaH |
ta eva tasya sAkShiNo bhavanti dharmadarshinaH
shlokas.55:
yathAnisheShu sarvataHspRRishatsu sarvadAriShu |
prakAshagUDhavRRittiShu svadharmameva pAlaya
shlokas.56:
anekapAripanthike virUparaudrarakShite |
svameva karma rakShyatAM svakarma tatra gachChati
shlokas.57:
na tatra sa.nvibhajyate svakarmaNA parasparam |
yathAkRRitaM svakarmajaM tadeva bhujyate phalam
shlokas.58:
yathApsarogaNAH phalaM sukhaM maharShibhiH saha |
tathApnuvanti karmato vimAnakAmagAminaH
shlokas.59:
yatheha yatkRRitaM shubhaM vipApmabhiH kRRitAtmabhiH |
tadApnuvanti mAnavAstathA vishuddhayonayaH
shlokas.60:
prajApateH salokatAM bRRihaspateH shatakratoH |
vrajanti te parAM gatiM gRRihasthadharmasetubhiH
shlokas.61:
sahasrasho.apyanekashaH pravaktumutsahAmahe |
abuddhimohanaM punaH prabhurvinA na yAvakam
shlokas.62:
gatA dviraShTavarShatA dhruvo.asi pa~nchavi.nshakaH |
kuruShva dharmasa~nchayaM vayo hi te.ativartate
shlokas.63:
purA karoti so.antakaH pramAdagomukhaM damam |
yathAgRRihItamutthitaM tvarasva dharmapAlane
shlokas.64:
yadA tvameva pRRiShThatastvamagrato gamiShyasi |
tathA gatiM gamiShyataH kimAtmanA pareNa vA
shlokas.65:
yadekapAtinAM satAM bhavatyamutra gachChatAm |
bhayeShu sAmparAyikaM nidhatsva taM mahAnidhim
shlokas.66:
sakUlamUlabAndhavaM prabhurharatyasa~NgavAn |
na santi yasya vArakAH kuruShva dharmasaMnidhim
shlokas.67:
idaM nidarshanaM mayA taveha putra saMmatam |
svadarshanAnumAnataH pravarNitaM kuruShva tat
shlokas.68:
dadhAti yaH svakarmaNA dhanAni yasya kasyachit |
abuddhimohajairguNaiH shataika eva yujyate
shlokas.69:
shrutaM samarthamastu te prakurvataH shubhAH kriyAH |
tadeva tatra darshanaM kRRitaj~namarthasaMhitam
shlokas.70:
nibandhanI rajjureShA yA grAme vasato ratiH |
ChittvainAM sukRRito yAnti nainAM Chindanti duShkRRitaH
shlokas.71:
kiM te dhanena kiM bandhubhiste; kiM te putraiH putraka yo mariShyasi |
AtmAnamanvichCha guhAM praviShTaM; pitAmahAste kva gatAshcha sarve
shlokas.72:
shvaHkAryamadya kurvIta pUrvAhNe chAparAhNikam |
ko hi tadveda kasyAdya mRRityusenA nivekShyate
shlokas.73:
anugamya shmashAnAntaM nivartantIha bAndhavAH |
agnau prakShipya puruShaM j~nAtayaH suhRRidastathA
shlokas.74:
nAstikAnniranukroshAnnarAnpApamatau sthitAn |
vAmataH kuru vishrabdhaM paraM prepsuratandritaH
shlokas.75:
evamabhyAhate loke kAlenopanipIDite |
sumahaddhairyamAlambya dharmaM sarvAtmanA kuru
shlokas.76:
athemaM darshanopAyaM samyagyo vetti mAnavaH |
samyaksa dharmaM kRRitveha paratra sukhamedhate
shlokas.77:
na dehabhede maraNaM vijAnatAM; na cha praNAshaH svanupAlite pathi |
dharmaM hi yo vardhayate sa paNDito; ya eva dharmAchchyavate sa muhyati
shlokas.78:
prayuktayoH karmapathi svakarmaNoH; phalaM prayoktA labhate yathAvidhi |
nihInakarmA nirayaM prapadyate; triviShTapaM gachChati dharmapAragaH
shlokas.79:
sopAnabhUtaM svargasya mAnuShyaM prApya durlabham |
tathAtmAnaM samAdadhyAdbhrashyeta na punaryathA
shlokas.80:
yasya notkrAmati matiH svargamArgAnusAriNI |
tamAhuH puNyakarmANamashochyaM mitrabAndhavaiH
shlokas.81:
yasya nopahatA buddhirnishchayeShvavalambate |
svarge kRRitAvakAshasya tasya nAsti mahadbhayam
shlokas.82:
tapovaneShu ye jAtAstatraiva nidhanaM gatAH |
teShAmalpataro dharmaH kAmabhogamajAnatAm
shlokas.83:
yastu bhogAnparityajya sharIreNa tapashcharet |
na tena ki~nchinna prAptaM tanme bahumataM phalam
shlokas.84:
mAtApitRRisahasrANi putradArashatAni cha |
anAgatAnyatItAni kasya te kasya vA vayam
shlokas.85:
na teShAM bhavatA kAryaM na kAryaM tava tairapi |
svakRRitaistAni yAtAni bhavA.nshchaiva gamiShyati
shlokas.86:
iha loke hi dhaninaH paro.api svajanAyate |
svajanastu daridrANAM jIvatAmeva nashyati
shlokas.87:
sa~nchinotyashubhaM karma kalatrApekShayA naraH |
tataH kleshamavApnoti paratreha tathaiva cha
shlokas.88:
pashya tvaM ChidrabhUtaM hi jIvalokaM svakarmaNA |
tatkuruShva tathA putra kRRitsnaM yatsamudAhRRitam
shlokas.89:
tadetatsampradRRishyaiva karmabhUmiM pravishya tAm |
shubhAnyAcharitavyAni paralokamabhIpsatA
shlokas.90:
mAsartusa~nj~nAparivartakena; sUryAgninA rAtridivendhanena |
svakarmaniShThAphalasAkShikeNa; bhUtAni kAlaH pachati prasahya
shlokas.91:
dhanena kiM yanna dadAti nAshnute; balena kiM yena ripUnna bAdhate |
shrutena kiM yena na dharmamAchare;tkimAtmanA yo na jitendriyo vashI
shlokas.92:
idaM dvaipAyanavacho hitamuktaM nishamya tu |
shuko gataH parityajya pitaraM mokShadeshikam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM vyAsasya dharmAtmA shuko jaj~ne mahAtapAH |
siddhiM cha paramAM prAptastanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.2:
kasyAM chotpAdayAmAsa shukaM vyAsastapodhanaH |
na hyasya jananIM vidma janma chAgryaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.3:
kathaM cha bAlasya sataH sUkShmaj~nAne gatA matiH |
yathA nAnyasya loke.asmindvitIyasyeha kasyachit
shlokas.4:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM vistareNa mahAdyute |
na hi me tRRiptirastIha shRRiNvato.amRRitamuttamam
shlokas.5:
mAhAtmyamAtmayogaM cha vij~nAnaM cha shukasya ha |
yathAvadAnupUrvyeNa tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
na hAyanairna palitairna vittena na bandhubhiH |
RRiShayashchakrire dharmaM yo.anUchAnaH sa no mahAn
shlokas.7:
tapomUlamidaM sarvaM yanmAM pRRichChasi pANDava |
tadindriyANi sa.nyamya tapo bhavati nAnyathA
shlokas.8:
indriyANAM prasa~Ngena doShamRRichChatyasa.nshayam |
saMniyamya tu tAnyeva siddhiM prApnoti mAnavaH
shlokas.9:
ashvamedhasahasrasya vAjapeyashatasya cha |
yogasya kalayA tAta na tulyaM vidyate phalam
shlokas.10:
atra te vartayiShyAmi janmayogaphalaM yathA |
shukasyAgryAM gatiM chaiva durvidAmakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.11:
merushRRi~Nge kila purA karNikAravanAyute |
vijahAra mahAdevo bhImairbhUtagaNairvRRitaH
shlokas.12:
shailarAjasutA chaiva devI tatrAbhavatpurA |
tatra divyaM tapastepe kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH prabhuH
shlokas.13:
yogenAtmAnamAvishya yogadharmaparAyaNaH |
dhArayansa tapastepe putrArthaM kurusattama
shlokas.14:
agnerbhUmerapAM vAyorantarikShasya chAbhibho |
vIryeNa saMmitaH putro mama bhUyAditi sma ha
shlokas.15:
sa~NkalpenAtha so.anena duShprApeNAkRRitAtmabhiH |
varayAmAsa deveshamAsthitastapa uttamam
shlokas.16:
atiShThanmArutAhAraH shataM kila samAH prabhuH |
ArAdhayanmahAdevaM bahurUpamumApatim
shlokas.17:
tatra brahmarShayashchaiva sarve devarShayastathA |
lokapAlAshcha lokeshaM sAdhyAshcha vasubhiH saha
shlokas.18:
AdityAshchaiva rudrAshcha divAkaranishAkarau |
maruto mArutashchaiva sAgarAH saritastathA
shlokas.19:
ashvinau devagandharvAstathA nAradaparvatau |
vishvAvasushcha gandharvaH siddhAshchApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.20:
tatra rudro mahAdevaH karNikAramayIM shubhAm |
dhArayANaH srajaM bhAti jyotsnAmiva nishAkaraH
shlokas.21:
tasmindivye vane ramye devadevarShisa~Nkule |
AsthitaH paramaM yogamRRiShiH putrArthamudyataH
shlokas.22:
na chAsya hIyate varNo na glAnirupajAyate |
trayANAmapi lokAnAM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.23:
jaTAshcha tejasA tasya vaishvAnarashikhopamAH |
prajvalantyaH sma dRRishyante yuktasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.24:
mArkaNDeyo hi bhagavAnetadAkhyAtavAnmama |
sa devacharitAnIha kathayAmAsa me sadA
shlokas.25:
tA etAdyApi kRRiShNasya tapasA tena dIpitAH |
agnivarNA jaTAstAta prakAshante mahAtmanaH
shlokas.26:
eva.nvidhena tapasA tasya bhaktyA cha bhArata |
maheshvaraH prasannAtmA chakAra manasA matim
shlokas.27:
uvAcha chainaM bhagavA.nstryambakaH prahasanniva |
eva.nvidhaste tanayo dvaipAyana bhaviShyati
shlokas.28:
yathA hyagniryathA vAyuryathA bhUmiryathA jalam |
yathA cha khaM tathA shuddho bhaviShyati suto mahAn
shlokas.29:
tadbhAvabhAvI tadbuddhistadAtmA tadapAshrayaH |
tejasAvRRitya lokA.nstrInyashaH prApsyati kevalam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa labdhvA paramaM devAdvaraM satyavatIsutaH |
araNIM tvatha sa~NgRRihya mamanthAgnichikIrShayA
shlokas.2:
atha rUpaM paraM rAjanbibhratIM svena tejasA |
ghRRitAchIM nAmApsarasamapashyadbhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.3:
RRiShirapsarasaM dRRiShTvA sahasA kAmamohitaH |
abhavadbhagavAnvyAso vane tasminyudhiShThira
shlokas.4:
sA cha kRRitvA tadA vyAsaM kAmasa.nvignamAnasam |
shukI bhUtvA mahArAja ghRRitAchI samupAgamat
shlokas.5:
