sa tAmapsarasaM dRRiShTvA rUpeNAnyena sa.nvRRitAm |
sharIrajenAnugataH sarvagAtrAtigena ha
shlokas.6:
sa tu dhairyeNa mahatA nigRRihNanhRRichChayaM muniH |
na shashAka niyantuM tadvyAsaH pravisRRitaM manaH
bhAvitvAchchaiva bhAvasya ghRRitAchyA vapuShA hRRitaH
shlokas.7:
yatnAnniyachChatastasya muneragnichikIrShayA |
araNyAmeva sahasA tasya shukramavApatat
shlokas.8:
so.avisha~Nkena manasA tathaiva dvijasattamaH |
araNIM mamantha brahmarShistasyAM jaj~ne shuko nRRipa
shlokas.9:
shukre nirmathyamAne tu shuko jaj~ne mahAtapAH |
paramarShirmahAyogI araNIgarbhasambhavaH
shlokas.10:
yathAdhvare samiddho.agnirbhAti havyamupAttavAn |
tathArUpaH shuko jaj~ne prajvalanniva tejasA
shlokas.11:
bibhratpitushcha kauravya rUpavarNamanuttamam |
babhau tadA bhAvitAtmA vidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.12:
taM ga~NgA saritAM shreShThA merupRRiShThe janeshvara |
svarUpiNI tadAbhyetya snApayAmAsa vAriNA
shlokas.13:
antarikShAchcha kauravya daNDaH kRRiShNAjinaM cha ha |
papAta bhuvi rAjendra shukasyArthe mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
jegIyante sma gandharvA nanRRitushchApsarogaNAH |
devadundubhayashchaiva prAvAdyanta mahAsvanAH
shlokas.15:
vishvAvasushcha gandharvastathA tumburunAradau |
hAhAhUhU cha gandharvau tuShTuvuH shukasambhavam
shlokas.16:
tatra shakrapurogAshcha lokapAlAH samAgatAH |
devA devarShayashchaiva tathA brahmarShayo.api cha
shlokas.17:
divyAni sarvapuShpANi pravavarShAtra mArutaH |
ja~NgamaM sthAvaraM chaiva prahRRiShTamabhavajjagat
shlokas.18:
taM mahAtmA svayaM prItyA devyA saha mahAdyutiH |
jAtamAtraM muneH putraM vidhinopAnayattadA
shlokas.19:
tasya deveshvaraH shakro divyamadbhutadarshanam |
dadau kamaNDaluM prItyA devavAsA.nsi chAbhibho
shlokas.20:
ha.nsAshcha shatapatrAshcha sArasAshcha sahasrashaH |
pradakShiNamavartanta shukAshchAShAshcha bhArata
shlokas.21:
AraNeyastathA divyaM prApya janma mahAdyutiH |
tatraivovAsa medhAvI vratachArI samAhitaH
shlokas.22:
utpannamAtraM taM vedAH sarahasyAH sasa~NgrahAH |
upatasthurmahArAja yathAsya pitaraM tathA
shlokas.23:
bRRihaspatiM tu vavre sa vedavedA~NgabhAShyavit |
upAdhyAyaM mahArAja dharmamevAnuchintayan
shlokas.24:
so.adhItya vedAnakhilAnsarahasyAnsasa~NgrahAn |
itihAsaM cha kArtsnyena rAjashAstrANi chAbhibho
shlokas.25:
gurave dakShiNAM dattvA samAvRRitto mahAmuniH |
ugraM tapaH samArebhe brahmachArI samAhitaH
shlokas.26:
devatAnAmRRiShINAM cha bAlye.api sa mahAtapAH |
saMmantraNIyo mAnyashcha j~nAnena tapasA tathA
shlokas.27:
na tvasya ramate buddhirAshrameShu narAdhipa |
triShu gArhasthyamUleShu mokShadharmAnudarshinaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa mokShamanuchintyaiva shukaH pitaramabhyagAt |
prAhAbhivAdya cha guruM shreyorthI vinayAnvitaH
shlokas.2:
mokShadharmeShu kushalo bhagavAnprabravItu me |
yathA me manasaH shAntiH paramA sambhavetprabho
shlokas.3:
shrutvA putrasya vachanaM paramarShiruvAcha tam |
adhIShva putra mokShaM vai dharmA.nshcha vividhAnapi
shlokas.4:
piturniyogAjjagrAha shuko brahmavidAM varaH |
yogashAstraM cha nikhilaM kApilaM chaiva bhArata
shlokas.5:
sa taM brAhmyA shriyA yuktaM brahmatulyaparAkramam |
mene putraM yadA vyAso mokShavidyAvishAradam
shlokas.6:
uvAcha gachCheti tadA janakaM mithileshvaram |
sa te vakShyati mokShArthaM nikhilena visheShataH
shlokas.7:
piturniyogAdagamanmaithilaM janakaM nRRipam |
praShTuM dharmasya niShThAM vai mokShasya cha parAyaNam
shlokas.8:
uktashcha mAnuSheNa tvaM pathA gachChetyavismitaH |
na prabhAveNa gantavyamantarikShachareNa vai
shlokas.9:
ArjaveNaiva gantavyaM na sukhAnveShiNA pathA |
nAnveShTavyA visheShAstu visheShA hi prasa~NginaH
shlokas.10:
aha~NkAro na kartavyo yAjye tasminnarAdhipe |
sthAtavyaM cha vashe tasya sa te Chetsyati sa.nshayam
shlokas.11:
sa dharmakushalo rAjA mokShashAstravishAradaH |
yAjyo mama sa yadbrUyAttatkAryamavisha~NkayA
shlokas.12:
evamuktaH sa dharmAtmA jagAma mithilAM muniH |
padbhyAM shakto.antarikSheNa krAntuM bhUmiM sasAgarAm
shlokas.13:
sa girI.nshchApyatikramya nadIstIrtvA sarA.nsi cha |
bahuvyAlamRRigAkIrNA vividhAshchATavIstathA
shlokas.14:
merorhareshcha dve varShe varShaM haimavataM tathA |
krameNaiva vyatikramya bhArataM varShamAsadat
shlokas.15:
sa deshAnvividhAnpashya.nshchInahUNaniShevitAn |
AryAvartamimaM deshamAjagAma mahAmuniH
shlokas.16:
piturvachanamAj~nAya tamevArthaM vichintayan |
adhvAnaM so.atichakrAma khe.acharaH khe charanniva
shlokas.17:
pattanAni cha ramyANi sphItAni nagarANi cha |
ratnAni cha vichitrANi shukaH pashyanna pashyati
shlokas.18:
udyAnAni cha ramyANi tathaivAyatanAni cha |
puNyAni chaiva tIrthAni so.atikramya tathAdhvanaH
shlokas.19:
so.achireNaiva kAlena videhAnAsasAda ha |
rakShitAndharmarAjena janakena mahAtmanA
shlokas.20:
tatra grAmAnbahUnpashyanbahvannarasabhojanAn |
pallIghoShAnsamRRiddhA.nshcha bahugokulasa~NkulAn
shlokas.21:
sphItA.nshcha shAliyavasairha.nsasArasasevitAn |
padminIbhishcha shatashaH shrImatIbhirala~NkRRitAn
shlokas.22:
sa videhAnatikramya samRRiddhajanasevitAn |
mithilopavanaM ramyamAsasAda maharddhimat
shlokas.23:
hastyashvarathasa~NkIrNaM naranArIsamAkulam |
pashyannapashyanniva tatsamatikrAmadachyutaH
shlokas.24:
manasA taM vahanbhAraM tamevArthaM vichintayan |
AtmArAmaH prasannAtmA mithilAmAsasAda ha
shlokas.25:
tasyA dvAraM samAsAdya dvArapAlairnivAritaH |
sthito dhyAnaparo mukto viditaH pravivesha ha
shlokas.26:
sa rAjamArgamAsAdya samRRiddhajanasa~Nkulam |
pArthivakShayamAsAdya niHsha~NkaH pravivesha ha
shlokas.27:
tatrApi dvArapAlAstamugravAcho nyaShedhayan |
tathaiva cha shukastatra nirmanyuH samatiShThata
shlokas.28:
na chAtapAdhvasantaptaH kShutpipAsAshramAnvitaH |
pratAmyati glAyati vA nApaiti cha tathAtapAt
shlokas.29:
teShAM tu dvArapAlAnAmekaH shokasamanvitaH |
madhya~NgatamivAdityaM dRRiShTvA shukamavasthitam
shlokas.30:
pUjayitvA yathAnyAyamabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
prAveshayattataH kakShyAM dvitIyAM rAjaveshmanaH
shlokas.31:
tatrAsInaH shukastAta mokShamevAnuchintayan |
ChAyAyAmAtape chaiva samadarshI mahAdyutiH
shlokas.32:
taM muhUrtAdivAgamya rAj~no mantrI kRRitA~njaliH |
prAveshayattataH kakShyAM tRRitIyAM rAjaveshmanaH
shlokas.33:
tatrAntaHpurasambaddhaM mahachchaitrarathopamam |
suvibhaktajalAkrIDaM ramyaM puShpitapAdapam
shlokas.34:
taddarshayitvA sa shukaM mantrI kAnanamuttamam |
arhamAsanamAdishya nishchakrAma tataH punaH
shlokas.35:
taM chAruveShAH sushroNyastaruNyaH priyadarshanAH |
sUkShmaraktAmbaradharAstaptakA~nchanabhUShaNAH
shlokas.36:
sa.nlApollApakushalA nRRittagItavishAradAH |
smitapUrvAbhibhAShiNyo rUpeNApsarasAM samAH
shlokas.37:
kAmopachArakushalA bhAvaj~nAH sarvakovidAH |
paraM pa~nchAshato nAryo vAramukhyAH samAdravan
shlokas.38:
pAdyAdIni pratigrAhya pUjayA parayArchya cha |
deshakAlopapannena sAdhvannenApyatarpayan
shlokas.39:
tasya bhuktavatastAta tadantaHpurakAnanam |
suramyaM darshayAmAsurekaikashyena bhArata
shlokas.40:
krIDantyashcha hasantyashcha gAyantyashchaiva tAH shukam |
udArasattvaM sattvaj~nAH sarvAH paryachara.nstadA
shlokas.41:
AraNeyastu shuddhAtmA trisa.ndehastrikarmakRRit |
vashyendriyo jitakrodho na hRRiShyati na kupyati
shlokas.42:
tasmai shayyAsanaM divyaM varArhaM ratnabhUShitam |
spardhyAstaraNasa.nstIrNaM dadustAH paramastriyaH
shlokas.43:
pAdashauchaM tu kRRitvaiva shukaH sandhyAmupAsya cha |
niShasAdAsane puNye tamevArthaM vichintayan
shlokas.44:
pUrvarAtre tu tatrAsau bhUtvA dhyAnaparAyaNaH |
madhyarAtre yathAnyAyaM nidrAmAhArayatprabhuH
shlokas.45:
tato muhUrtAdutthAya kRRitvA shauchamanantaram |
strIbhiH parivRRito dhImAndhyAnamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.46:
anena vidhinA kArShNistadahaHsheShamachyutaH |
tAM cha rAtriM nRRipakule vartayAmAsa bhArata

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa rAjA janako mantribhiH saha bhArata |
puraH purohitaM kRRitvA sarvANyantaHpurANi cha
shlokas.2:
AsanaM cha puraskRRitya ratnAni vividhAni cha |
shirasA chArghyamAdAya guruputraM samabhyagAt
shlokas.3:
sa tadAsanamAdAya bahuratnavibhUShitam |
spardhyAstaraNasa.nstIrNaM sarvatobhadramRRiddhimat
shlokas.4:
purodhasA sa~NgRRihItaM hastenAlabhya pArthivaH |
pradadau guruputrAya shukAya paramArchitam
shlokas.5:
tatropaviShTaM taM kArShNiM shAstrataH pratyapUjayat |
pAdyaM nivedya prathamamarghyaM gAM cha nyavedayat
sa cha tAM mantravatpUjAM pratyagRRihNAdyathAvidhi
shlokas.6:
pratigRRihya cha tAM pUjAM janakAddvijasattamaH |
gAM chaiva samanuj~nAya rAjAnamanumAnya cha
shlokas.7:
paryapRRichChanmahAtejA rAj~naH kushalamavyayam |
anAmayaM cha rAjendra shukaH sAnucharasya ha
shlokas.8:
anuj~nAtaH sa tenAtha niShasAda sahAnugaH |
udArasattvAbhijano bhUmau rAjA kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.9:
kushalaM chAvyayaM chaiva pRRiShTvA vaiyAsakiM nRRipaH |
kimAgamanamityeva paryapRRichChata pArthivaH
shlokas.10:
shuka uvAcha||
pitrAhamukto bhadraM te mokShadharmArthakovidaH |
videharAjo yAjyo me janako nAma vishrutaH
shlokas.11:
tatra gachChasva vai tUrNaM yadi te hRRidi sa.nshayaH |
pravRRittau vA nivRRittau vA sa te Chetsyati sa.nshayam
shlokas.12:
so.ahaM piturniyogAttvAmupapraShTumihAgataH |
tanme dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha yathAvadvaktumarhasi
shlokas.13:
kiM kAryaM brAhmaNeneha mokShArthashcha kimAtmakaH |
kathaM cha mokShaH kartavyo j~nAnena tapasApi vA
shlokas.14:
janaka uvAcha||
yatkAryaM brAhmaNeneha janmaprabhRRiti tachChRRiNu |
kRRitopanayanastAta bhavedvedaparAyaNaH
shlokas.15:
tapasA guruvRRittyA cha brahmacharyeNa chAbhibho |
devatAnAM pitR^INAM chApyanRRiNashchAnasUyakaH
shlokas.16:
vedAnadhItya niyato dakShiNAmapavarjya cha |
abhyanuj~nAmatha prApya samAvarteta vai dvijaH
shlokas.17:
samAvRRittastu gArhasthye sadAro niyato vaset |
anasUyuryathAnyAyamAhitAgnistathaiva cha
shlokas.18:
utpAdya putrapautraM tu vanyAshramapade vaset |
tAnevAgnInyathAshAstramarchayannatithipriyaH
shlokas.19:
sa vane.agnInyathAnyAyamAtmanyAropya dharmavit |
nirdva.ndvo vItarAgAtmA brahmAshramapade vaset
shlokas.20:
shuka uvAcha||
utpanne j~nAnavij~nAne pratyakShe hRRidi shAshvate |
kimavashyaM nivastavyamAshrameShu vaneShu cha
shlokas.21:
etadbhavantaM pRRichChAmi tadbhavAnvaktumarhati |
yathAvedArthatattvena brUhi me tvaM janAdhipa
shlokas.22:
janaka uvAcha||
na vinA j~nAnavij~nAnaM mokShasyAdhigamo bhavet |
na vinA gurusambandhaM j~nAnasyAdhigamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.23:
AchAryaH plAvitA tasya j~nAnaM plava ihochyate |
vij~nAya kRRitakRRityastu tIrNastadubhayaM tyajet
shlokas.24:
anuchChedAya lokAnAmanuchChedAya karmaNAm |
pUrvairAcharito dharmashchAturAshramyasa~NkathaH
shlokas.25:
anena kramayogena bahujAtiShu karmaNA |
kRRitvA shubhAshubhaM karma mokSho nAmeha labhyate
shlokas.26:
bhavitaiH kAraNaishchAyaM bahusa.nsArayoniShu |
AsAdayati shuddhAtmA mokShaM vai prathamAshrame
shlokas.27:
tamAsAdya tu muktasya dRRiShTArthasya vipashchitaH |
triShvAshrameShu ko nvartho bhavetparamabhIpsataH
shlokas.28:
rAjasA.nstAmasA.nshchaiva nityaM doShAnvivarjayet |
sAttvikaM mArgamAsthAya pashyedAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.29:
sarvabhUteShu chAtmAnaM sarvabhUtAni chAtmani |
sampashyannopalipyeta jale vAricharo yathA
shlokas.30:
pakShIva plavanAdUrdhvamamutrAnantyamashnute |
vihAya dehaM nirmukto nirdva.ndvaH prashamaM gataH
shlokas.31:
atra gAthAH purA gItAH shRRiNu rAj~nA yayAtinA |
dhAryante yA dvijaistAta mokShashAstravishAradaiH
shlokas.32:
jyotirAtmani nAnyatra rataM tatraiva chaiva tat |
svayaM cha shakyaM taddraShTuM susamAhitachetasA
shlokas.33:
na bibheti paro yasmAnna bibheti parAchcha yaH |
yashcha nechChati na dveShTi brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.34:
yadA bhAvaM na kurute sarvabhUteShu pApakam |
karmaNA manasA vAchA brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.35:
sa.nyojya tapasAtmAnamIrShyAmutsRRijya mohinIm |
tyaktvA kAmaM cha lobhaM cha tato brahmatvamashnute
shlokas.36:
yadA shravye cha dRRishye cha sarvabhUteShu chApyayam |
samo bhavati nirdva.ndvo brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.37:
yadA stutiM cha nindAM cha samatvenaiva pashyati |
kA~nchanaM chAyasaM chaiva sukhaduHkhe tathaiva cha
shlokas.38:
shItamuShNaM tathaivArthamanarthaM priyamapriyam |
jIvitaM maraNaM chaiva brahma sampadyate tadA
shlokas.39:
prasAryeha yathA~NgAni kUrmaH saMharate punaH |
tathendriyANi manasA sa.nyantavyAni bhikShuNA
shlokas.40:
tamaHparigataM veshma yathA dIpena dRRishyate |
tathA buddhipradIpena shakya AtmA nirIkShitum
shlokas.41:
etatsarvaM prapashyAmi tvayi buddhimatAM vara |
yachchAnyadapi vettavyaM tattvato veda tadbhavAn
shlokas.42:
brahmarShe viditashchAsi viShayAntamupAgataH |
gurostava prasAdena tava chaivopashikShayA
shlokas.43:
tasyaiva cha prasAdena prAdurbhUtaM mahAmune |
j~nAnaM divyaM mamApIdaM tenAsi vidito mama
shlokas.44:
adhikaM tava vij~nAnamadhikA cha gatistava |
adhikaM cha tavaishvaryaM tachcha tvaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.45:
bAlyAdvA sa.nshayAdvApi bhayAdvApyavimokShajAt |
utpanne chApi vij~nAne nAdhigachChati tAM gatim
shlokas.46:
vyavasAyena shuddhena madvidhaishChinnasa.nshayaH |
vimuchya hRRidayagranthInAsAdayati tAM gatim
shlokas.47:
bhavA.nshchotpannavij~nAnaH sthirabuddhiralolupaH |
vyavasAyAdRRite brahmannAsAdayati tatparam
shlokas.48:
nAsti te sukhaduHkheShu visheSho nAsti lolupA |
nautsukyaM nRRittagIteShu na rAga upajAyate
shlokas.49:
na bandhuShu nibandhaste na bhayeShvasti te bhayam |
pashyAmi tvAM mahAbhAga tulyaloShTAshmakA~nchanam
shlokas.50:
ahaM cha tvAnupashyAmi ye chApyanye manIShiNaH |
AsthitaM paramaM mArgamakShayaM tamanAmayam
shlokas.51:
yatphalaM brAhmaNasyeha mokShArthashcha yadAtmakaH |
tasminvai vartase vipra kimanyatparipRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM kRRitAtmA kRRitanishchayaH |
AtmanAtmAnamAsthAya dRRiShTvA chAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.2:
kRRitakAryaH sukhI shAntastUShNIM prAyAduda~NmukhaH |
shaishiraM girimuddishya sadharmA mAtarishvanaH
shlokas.3:
etasminneva kAle tu devarShirnAradastadA |
himavantamiyAddraShTuM siddhachAraNasevitam
shlokas.4:
tamapsarogaNAkIrNaM gItasvananinAditam |
kiMnarANAM samUhaishcha bhRRi~NgarAjaistathaiva cha
shlokas.5:
madgubhiH kha~njarITaishcha vichitrairjIvajIvakaiH |
chitravarNairmayUraishcha kekAshatavirAjitaiH
rAjaha.nsasamUhaishcha hRRiShTaiH parabhRRitaistathA
shlokas.6:
pakShirAjo garutmA.nshcha yaM nityamadhigachChati |
chatvAro lokapAlAshcha devAH sarShigaNAstathA
yatra nityaM samAyAnti lokasya hitakAmyayA
shlokas.7:
viShNunA yatra putrArthe tapastaptaM mahAtmanA |
yatraiva cha kumAreNa bAlye kShiptA divaukasaH
shlokas.8:
shaktirnyastA kShititale trailokyamavamanya vai |
yatrovAcha jagatskandaH kShipanvAkyamidaM tadA
shlokas.9:
yo.anyo.asti matto.abhyadhiko viprA yasyAdhikaM priyAH |
yo brahmaNyo dvitIyo.asti triShu lokeShu vIryavAn
shlokas.10:
so.abhyuddharatvimAM shaktimatha vA kampayatviti |
tachChrutvA vyathitA lokAH ka imAmuddharediti
shlokas.11:
atha devagaNaM sarvaM sambhrAntendriyamAnasam |
apashyadbhagavAnviShNuH kShiptaM sAsurarAkShasam
kiM nvatra sukRRitaM kAryaM bhavediti vichintayan
shlokas.12:
sa nAmRRiShyata taM kShepamavaikShata cha pAvakim |
sa prahasya vishuddhAtmA shaktiM prajvalitAM tadA
kampayAmAsa savyena pANinA puruShottamaH
shlokas.13:
shaktyAM tu kampamAnAyAM viShNunA balinA tadA |
medinI kampitA sarvA sashailavanakAnanA
shlokas.14:
shaktenApi samuddhartuM kampitA sA na tUddhRRitA |
rakShatA skandarAjasya dharShaNAM prabhaviShNunA
shlokas.15:
tAM kampayitvA bhagavAnprahrAdamidamabravIt |
pashya vIryaM kumArasya naitadanyaH kariShyati
shlokas.16:
so.amRRiShyamANastadvAkyaM samuddharaNanishchitaH |
jagrAha tAM tasya shaktiM na chainAmapyakampayat
shlokas.17:
nAdaM mahAntaM muktvA sa mUrChito girimUrdhani |
vihvalaH prApatadbhUmau hiraNyakashipoH sutaH
shlokas.18:
yatrottarAM dishaM gatvA shailarAjasya pArshvataH |
tapo.atapyata durdharShastAta nityaM vRRiShadhvajaH
shlokas.19:
pAvakena parikShipto dIpyatA tasya chAshramaH |
AdityabandhanaM nAma durdharShamakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.20:
na tatra shakyate gantuM yakSharAkShasadAnavaiH |
dashayojanavistAramagnijvAlAsamAvRRitam
shlokas.21:
bhagavAnpAvakastatra svayaM tiShThati vIryavAn |
sarvavighnAnprashamayanmahAdevasya dhImataH
shlokas.22:
divyaM varShasahasraM hi pAdenaikena tiShThataH |
devAnsantApaya.nstatra mahAdevo dhRRitavrataH
shlokas.23:
aindrIM tu dishamAsthAya shailarAjasya dhImataH |
vivikte parvatataTe pArAsharyo mahAtapAH
vedAnadhyApayAmAsa vyAsaH shiShyAnmahAtapAH
shlokas.24:
sumantuM cha mahAbhAgaM vaishampAyanameva cha |
jaiminiM cha mahAprAj~naM pailaM chApi tapasvinam
shlokas.25:
ebhiH shiShyaiH parivRRito vyAsa Aste mahAtapAH |
tatrAshramapadaM puNyaM dadarsha pituruttamam
AraNeyo vishuddhAtmA nabhasIva divAkaraH
shlokas.26:
atha vyAsaH parikShiptaM jvalantamiva pAvakam |
dadarsha sutamAyAntaM divAkarasamaprabham
shlokas.27:
asajjamAnaM vRRikSheShu shaileShu viShameShu cha |
yogayuktaM mahAtmAnaM yathA bANaM guNachyutam
shlokas.28:
so.abhigamya pituH pAdAvagRRihNAdaraNIsutaH |
yathopajoShaM taishchApi samAgachChanmahAmuniH
shlokas.29:
tato nivedayAmAsa pitre sarvamasheShataH |
shuko janakarAjena sa.nvAdaM prItamAnasaH
shlokas.30:
evamadhyApaya~nshiShyAnvyAsaH putraM cha vIryavAn |
uvAsa himavatpRRiShThe pArAsharyo mahAmuniH
shlokas.31:
tataH kadAchichChiShyAstaM parivAryAvatasthire |
vedAdhyayanasampannAH shAntAtmAno jitendriyAH
shlokas.32:
vedeShu niShThAM samprApya sA~NgeShvatitapasvinaH |
athochuste tadA vyAsaM shiShyAH prA~njalayo gurum
shlokas.33:
mahatA shreyasA yuktA yashasA cha sma vardhitAH |
ekaM tvidAnImichChAmo guruNAnugrahaM kRRitam
shlokas.34:
iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA brahmarShistAnuvAcha ha |
uchyatAmiti tadvatsA yadvaH kAryaM priyaM mayA
shlokas.35:
etadvAkyaM guroH shrutvA shiShyAste hRRiShTamAnasAH |
punaH prA~njalayo bhUtvA praNamya shirasA gurum
shlokas.36:
Uchuste sahitA rAjannidaM vachanamuttamam |
yadi prIta upAdhyAyo dhanyAH smo munisattama
shlokas.37:
kA~NkShAmastu vayaM sarve varaM dattaM maharShiNA |
ShaShThaH shiShyo na te khyAtiM gachChedatra prasIda naH
shlokas.38:
chatvAraste vayaM shiShyA guruputrashcha pa~nchamaH |
iha vedAH pratiShTheranneSha naH kA~NkShito varaH
shlokas.39:
shiShyANAM vachanaM shrutvA vyAso vedArthatattvavit |
parAsharAtmajo dhImAnparalokArthachintakaH
uvAcha shiShyAndharmAtmA dharmyaM naiHshreyasaM vachaH
shlokas.40:
brAhmaNAya sadA deyaM brahma shushrUShave bhavet |
brahmaloke nivAsaM yo dhruvaM samabhikA~NkShati
shlokas.41:
bhavanto bahulAH santu vedo vistAryatAmayam |
nAshiShye sampradAtavyo nAvrate nAkRRitAtmani
shlokas.42:
ete shiShyaguNAH sarve vij~nAtavyA yathArthataH |
nAparIkShitachAritre vidyA deyA katha~nchana
shlokas.43:
yathA hi kanakaM shuddhaM tApachChedanigharShaNaiH |
parIkSheta tathA shiShyAnIkShetkulaguNAdibhiH
shlokas.44:
na niyojyAshcha vaH shiShyA aniyoge mahAbhaye |
yathAmati yathApAThaM tathA vidyA phaliShyati
shlokas.45:
sarvastaratu durgANi sarvo bhadrANi pashyatu |
shrAvayechchaturo varNAnkRRitvA brAhmaNamagrataH
shlokas.46:
vedasyAdhyayanaM hIdaM tachcha kAryaM mahatsmRRitam |
stutyarthamiha devAnAM vedAH sRRiShTAH svayambhuvA
shlokas.47:
yo nirvadeta saMmohAdbrAhmaNaM vedapAragam |
so.apadhyAnAdbrAhmaNasya parAbhUyAdasa.nshayam
shlokas.48:
yashchAdharmeNa vibrUyAdyashchAdharmeNa pRRichChati |
tayoranyataraH praiti vidveShaM vAdhigachChati
shlokas.49:
etadvaH sarvamAkhyAtaM svAdhyAyasya vidhiM prati |
upakuryAchcha shiShyANAmetachcha hRRidi vo bhavet

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etachChrutvA gurorvAkyaM vyAsashiShyA mahaujasaH |
anyonyaM hRRiShTamanasaH pariShasvajire tadA
shlokas.2:
uktAH smo yadbhagavatA tadAtvAyatisaMhitam |
tanno manasi sa.nrUDhaM kariShyAmastathA cha tat
shlokas.3:
anyonyaM cha sabhAjyaivaM suprItamanasaH punaH |
vij~nApayanti sma guruM punarvAkyavishAradAH
shlokas.4:
shailAdasmAnmahIM gantuM kA~NkShitaM no mahAmune |
vedAnanekadhA kartuM yadi te ruchitaM vibho
shlokas.5:
shiShyANAM vachanaM shrutvA parAsharasutaH prabhuH |
pratyuvAcha tato vAkyaM dharmArthasahitaM hitam
shlokas.6:
kShitiM vA devalokaM vA gamyatAM yadi rochate |
apramAdashcha vaH kAryo brahma hi prachurachChalam
shlokas.7:
te.anuj~nAtAstataH sarve guruNA satyavAdinA |
jagmuH pradakShiNaM kRRitvA vyAsaM mUrdhnAbhivAdya cha
shlokas.8:
avatIrya mahIM te.atha chAturhotramakalpayan |
sa.nyAjayanto viprA.nshcha rAjanyA.nshcha vishastathA
shlokas.9:
pUjyamAnA dvijairnityaM modamAnA gRRihe ratAH |
yAjanAdhyApanaratAH shrImanto lokavishrutAH
shlokas.10:
avatIrNeShu shiShyeShu vyAsaH putrasahAyavAn |
tUShNIM dhyAnaparo dhImAnekAnte samupAvishat
shlokas.11:
taM dadarshAshramapade nAradaH sumahAtapAH |
athainamabravItkAle madhurAkSharayA girA
shlokas.12:
bho bho maharShe vAsiShTha brahmaghoSho na vartate |
eko dhyAnaparastUShNIM kimAsse chintayanniva
shlokas.13:
brahmaghoShairvirahitaH parvato.ayaM na shobhate |
rajasA tamasA chaiva somaH sopaplavo yathA
shlokas.14:
na bhrAjate yathApUrvaM niShAdAnAmivAlayaH |
devarShigaNajuShTo.api vedadhvaninirAkRRitaH
shlokas.15:
RRiShayashcha hi devAshcha gandharvAshcha mahaujasaH |
vimuktA brahmaghoSheNa na bhrAjante yathA purA
shlokas.16:
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
maharShe yattvayA proktaM vedavAdavichakShaNa
shlokas.17:
etanmanonukUlaM me bhavAnarhati bhAShitum |
sarvaj~naH sarvadarshI cha sarvatra cha kutUhalI
shlokas.18:
triShu lokeShu yadvRRittaM sarvaM tava mate sthitam |
tadAj~nApaya viprarShe brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.19:
yanmayA samanuShTheyaM brahmarShe tadudAhara |
viyuktasyeha shiShyairme nAtihRRiShTamidaM manaH
shlokas.20:
nArada uvAcha||
anAmnAyamalA vedA brAhmaNasyAvrataM malam |
malaM pRRithivyA vAhIkAH strINAM kautUhalaM malam
shlokas.21:
adhIyatAM bhavAnvedAnsArdhaM putreNa dhImatA |
vidhunvanbrahmaghoSheNa rakShobhayakRRitaM tamaH
shlokas.22:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA vyAsaH paramadharmavit |
tathetyuvAcha saMhRRiShTo vedAbhyAse dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.23:
shukena saha putreNa vedAbhyAsamathAkarot |
svareNochchaiH sa shaikSheNa lokAnApUrayanniva
shlokas.24:
tayorabhyasatorevaM nAnAdharmapravAdinoH |
vAto.atimAtraM pravavau samudrAnilavejitaH
shlokas.25:
tato.anadhyAya iti taM vyAsaH putramavArayat |
shuko vAritamAtrastu kautUhalasamanvitaH
shlokas.26:
apRRichChatpitaraM brahmankuto vAyurabhUdayam |
AkhyAtumarhati bhavAnvAyoH sarvaM vicheShTitam
shlokas.27:
shukasyaitadvachaH shrutvA vyAsaH paramavismitaH |
anadhyAyanimitte.asminnidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.28:
divyaM te chakShurutpannaM svasthaM te nirmalaM manaH |
tamasA rajasA chApi tyaktaH sattve vyavasthitaH
shlokas.29:
Adarshe svAmiva ChAyAM pashyasyAtmAnamAtmanA |
nyasyAtmani svayaM vedAnbuddhyA samanuchintaya
shlokas.30:
devayAnacharo viShNoH pitRRiyAnashcha tAmasaH |
dvAvetau pretya panthAnau divaM chAdhashcha gachChataH
shlokas.31:
pRRithivyAmantarikShe cha yatra sa.nvAnti vAyavaH |
saptaite vAyumArgA vai tAnnibodhAnupUrvashaH
shlokas.32:
tatra devagaNAH sAdhyAH samabhUvanmahAbalAH |
teShAmapyabhavatputraH samAno nAma durjayaH
shlokas.33:
udAnastasya putro.abhUdvyAnastasyAbhavatsutaH |
apAnashcha tato j~neyaH prANashchApi tataH param
shlokas.34:
anapatyo.abhavatprANo durdharShaH shatrutApanaH |
pRRithakkarmANi teShAM tu pravakShyAmi yathAtatham
shlokas.35:
prANinAM sarvato vAyushcheShTA vartayate pRRithak |
prANanAchchaiva bhUtAnAM prANa ityabhidhIyate
shlokas.36:
prerayatyabhrasa~NghAtAndhUmajA.nshchoShmajA.nshcha yaH |
prathamaH prathame mArge pravaho nAma so.anilaH
shlokas.37:
ambare snehamabhrebhyastaDidbhyashchottamadyutiH |
Avaho nAma sa.nvAti dvitIyaH shvasano nadan
shlokas.38:
udayaM jyotiShAM shashvatsomAdInAM karoti yaH |
antardeheShu chodAnaM yaM vadanti maharShayaH
shlokas.39:
yashchaturbhyaH samudrebhyo vAyurdhArayate jalam |
uddhRRityAdadate chApo jImUtebhyo.ambare.anilaH
shlokas.40:
yo.adbhiH sa.nyojya jImUtAnparjanyAya prayachChati |
udvaho nAma varShiShThastritIyaH sa sadAgatiH
shlokas.41:
samuhyamAnA bahudhA yena nIlAH pRRithagghanAH |
varShamokShakRRitArambhAste bhavanti ghanAghanAH
shlokas.42:
saMhatA yena chAviddhA bhavanti nadatAM nadAH |
rakShaNArthAya sambhUtA meghatvamupayAnti cha
shlokas.43:
yo.asau vahati devAnAM vimAnAni vihAyasA |
chaturthaH sa.nvaho nAma vAyuH sa girimardanaH
shlokas.44:
yena vegavatA rugNA rUkSheNArujatA rasAn |
vAyunA vihatA meghA na bhavanti balAhakAH
shlokas.45:
dAruNotpAtasa~nchAro nabhasaH stanayitnumAn |
pa~nchamaH sa mahAvego vivaho nAma mArutaH
shlokas.46:
yasminpAriplave divyA vahantyApo vihAyasA |
puNyaM chAkAshaga~NgAyAstoyaM viShTabhya tiShThati
shlokas.47:
dUrAtpratihato yasminnekarashmirdivAkaraH |
yonira.nshusahasrasya yena bhAti vasundharA
shlokas.48:
yasmAdApyAyate somo nidhirdivyo.amRRitasya cha |
ShaShThaH parivaho nAma sa vAyurjavatAM varaH
shlokas.49:
sarvaprANabhRRitAM prANAnyo.antakAle nirasyati |
yasya vartmAnuvartete mRRityuvaivasvatAvubhau
shlokas.50:
samyaganvIkShatAM buddhyA shAntayAdhyAtmanityayA |
dhyAnAbhyAsAbhirAmANAM yo.amRRitatvAya kalpate
shlokas.51:
yaM samAsAdya vegena dishAmantaM prapedire |
dakShasya dasha putrANAM sahasrANi prajApateH
shlokas.52:
yena sRRiShTaH parAbhUto yAtyeva na nivartate |
parAvaho nAma paro vAyuH sa duratikramaH
shlokas.53:
evamete.aditeH putrA mArutAH paramAdbhutAH |
anAramantaH sa.nvAnti sarvagAH sarvadhAriNaH
shlokas.54:
etattu mahadAshcharyaM yadayaM parvatottamaH |
kampitaH sahasA tena vAyunAbhipravAyatA
shlokas.55:
viShNorniHshvAsavAto.ayaM yadA vegasamIritaH |
sahasodIryate tAta jagatpravyathate tadA
shlokas.56:
tasmAdbrahmavido brahma nAdhIyante.ativAyati |
vAyorvAyubhayaM hyuktaM brahma tatpIDitaM bhavet
shlokas.57:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM parAsharasutaH prabhuH |
uktvA putramadhIShveti vyomaga~NgAmayAttadA

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
etasminnantare shUnye nAradaH samupAgamat |
shukaM svAdhyAyanirataM vedArthAnvaktumIpsitAn
shlokas.2:
devarShiM tu shuko dRRiShTvA nAradaM samupasthitam |
arghyapUrveNa vidhinA vedoktenAbhyapUjayat
shlokas.3:
nArado.athAbravItprIto brUhi brahmavidAM vara |
kena tvAM shreyasA tAta yojayAmIti hRRiShTavat
shlokas.4:
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA shukaH provAcha bhArata |
asmi.Nlloke hitaM yatsyAttena mAM yoktumarhasi
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
tattvaM jij~nAsatAM pUrvamRRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
sanatkumAro bhagavAnidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
nAsti vidyAsamaM chakShurnAsti vidyAsamaM tapaH |
nAsti rAgasamaM duHkhaM nAsti tyAgasamaM sukham
shlokas.7:
nivRRittiH karmaNaH pApAtsatataM puNyashIlatA |
sadvRRittiH samudAchAraH shreya etadanuttamam
shlokas.8:
mAnuShyamasukhaM prApya yaH sajjati sa muhyati |
nAlaM sa duHkhamokShAya sa~Ngo vai duHkhalakShaNam
shlokas.9:
saktasya buddhishchalati mohajAlavivardhinI |
mohajAlAvRRito duHkhamiha chAmutra chAshnute
shlokas.10:
sarvopAyena kAmasya krodhasya cha vinigrahaH |
kAryaH shreyorthinA tau hi shreyoghAtArthamudyatau
shlokas.11:
nityaM krodhAttapo rakShechChriyaM rakSheta matsarAt |
vidyAM mAnAvamAnAbhyAmAtmAnaM tu pramAdataH
shlokas.12:
AnRRisha.nsyaM paro dharmaH kShamA cha paramaM balam |
Atmaj~nAnaM paraM j~nAnaM na satyAdvidyate param
shlokas.13:
satyasya vachanaM shreyaH satyAdapi hitaM bhavet |
yadbhUtahitamatyantametatsatyaM mataM mama
shlokas.14:
sarvArambhaphalatyAgI nirAshIrniShparigrahaH |
yena sarvaM parityaktaM sa vidvAnsa cha paNDitaH
shlokas.15:
indriyairindriyArthebhyashcharatyAtmavashairiha |
asajjamAnaH shAntAtmA nirvikAraH samAhitaH
shlokas.16:
AtmabhUtairatadbhUtaH saha chaiva vinaiva cha |
sa vimuktaH paraM shreyo nachireNAdhigachChati
shlokas.17:
adarshanamasa.nsparshastathAsambhAShaNaM sadA |
yasya bhUtaiH saha mune sa shreyo vindate param
shlokas.18:
na hi.nsyAtsarvabhUtAni maitrAyaNagatashcharet |
nedaM janma samAsAdya vairaM kurvIta kenachit
shlokas.19:
Aki~nchanyaM susantoSho nirAshIShTvamachApalam |
etadAhuH paraM shreya Atmaj~nasya jitAtmanaH
shlokas.20:
parigrahaM parityajya bhava tAta jitendriyaH |
ashokaM sthAnamAtiShTha iha chAmutra chAbhayam
shlokas.21:
nirAmiShA na shochanti tyajehAmiShamAtmanaH |
parityajyAmiShaM saumya duHkhatApAdvimokShyase
shlokas.22:
taponityena dAntena muninA sa.nyatAtmanA |
ajitaM jetukAmena bhAvyaM sa~NgeShvasa~NginA
shlokas.23:
guNasa~NgeShvanAsakta ekacharyArataH sadA |
brAhmaNe nachirAdeva sukhamAyAtyanuttamam
shlokas.24:
dva.ndvArAmeShu bhUteShu ya eko ramate muniH |
viddhi praj~nAnatRRiptaM taM j~nAnatRRipto na shochati
shlokas.25:
shubhairlabhati devatvaM vyAmishrairjanma mAnuSham |
ashubhaishchApyadhojanma karmabhirlabhate.avashaH
shlokas.26:
tatra mRRityujarAduHkhaiH satataM samabhidrutaH |
sa.nsAre pachyate jantustatkathaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.27:
ahite hitasa~nj~nastvamadhruve dhruvasa~nj~nakaH |
anarthe chArthasa~nj~nastvaM kimarthaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.28:
sa.nveShTyamAnaM bahubhirmohatantubhirAtmajaiH |
koshakAravadAtmAnaM veShTayannAvabudhyase
shlokas.29:
alaM parigraheNeha doShavAnhi parigrahaH |
kRRimirhi koshakArastu badhyate svaparigrahAt
shlokas.30:
putradArakuTumbeShu saktAH sIdanti jantavaH |
saraHpa~NkArNave magnA jIrNA vanagajA iva
shlokas.31:
mahAjAlasamAkRRiShTAnsthale matsyAnivoddhRRitAn |
snehajAlasamAkRRiShTAnpashya jantUnsuduHkhitAn
shlokas.32:
kuTumbaM putradAraM cha sharIraM dravyasa~nchayAH |
pArakyamadhruvaM sarvaM kiM svaM sukRRitaduShkRRitam
shlokas.33:
yadA sarvaM parityajya gantavyamavashena te |
anarthe kiM prasaktastvaM svamarthaM nAnutiShThasi
shlokas.34:
avishrAntamanAlambamapAtheyamadaishikam |
tamaHkAntAramadhvAnaM kathameko gamiShyasi
shlokas.35:
na hi tvA prasthitaM kashchitpRRiShThato.anugamiShyati |
sukRRitaM duShkRRitaM cha tvA yAsyantamanuyAsyati
shlokas.36:
vidyA karma cha shauryaM cha j~nAnaM cha bahuvistaram |
arthArthamanusAryante siddhArthastu vimuchyate
shlokas.37:
nibandhanI rajjureShA yA grAme vasato ratiH |
ChittvainAM sukRRito yAnti nainAM Chindanti duShkRRitaH
shlokas.38:
rUpakUlAM manaHsrotAM sparshadvIpAM rasAvahAm |
gandhapa~NkAM shabdajalAM svargamArgadurAvahAm
shlokas.39:
kShamAritrAM satyamayIM dharmasthairyavaTAkarAm |
tyAgavAtAdhvagAM shIghrAM buddhinAvA nadIM taret
shlokas.40:
tyaja dharmamadharmaM cha ubhe satyAnRRite tyaja |
ubhe satyAnRRite tyaktvA yena tyajasi taM tyaja
shlokas.41:
tyaja dharmamasa~NkalpAdadharmaM chApyahi.nsayA |
ubhe satyAnRRite buddhyA buddhiM paramanishchayAt
shlokas.42:
asthisthUNaM snAyuyutaM mA.nsashoNitalepanam |
charmAvanaddhaM durgandhi pUrNaM mUtrapurIShayoH
shlokas.43:
jarAshokasamAviShTaM rogAyatanamAturam |
rajasvalamanityaM cha bhUtAvAsaM samutsRRija
shlokas.44:
idaM vishvaM jagatsarvamajagachchApi yadbhavet |
mahAbhUtAtmakaM sarvaM mahadyatparamANu yat
shlokas.45:
indriyANi cha pa~nchaiva tamaH sattvaM rajastathA |
ityeSha saptadashako rAshiravyaktasa~nj~nakaH
shlokas.46:
sarvairihendriyArthaishcha vyaktAvyaktairhi saMhitaH |
pa~nchavi.nshaka ityeSha vyaktAvyaktamayo guNaH
shlokas.47:
etaiH sarvaiH samAyuktaH pumAnityabhidhIyate |
trivargo.atra sukhaM duHkhaM jIvitaM maraNaM tathA
shlokas.48:
ya idaM veda tattvena sa veda prabhavApyayau |
pArAsharyeha boddhavyaM j~nAnAnAM yachcha ki~nchana
shlokas.49:
indriyairgRRihyate yadyattattadvyaktamiti sthitiH |
avyaktamiti vij~neyaM li~NgagrAhyamatIndriyam
shlokas.50:
indriyairniyatairdehI dhArAbhiriva tarpyate |
loke vitatamAtmAnaM lokaM chAtmani pashyati
shlokas.51:
parAvaradRRishaH shaktirj~nAnavelAM na pashyati |
pashyataH sarvabhUtAni sarvAvasthAsu sarvadA
shlokas.52:
brahmabhUtasya sa.nyogo nAshubhenopapadyate |
j~nAnena vividhAnkleshAnativRRittasya mohajAn
loke buddhiprakAshena lokamArgo na riShyate
shlokas.53:
anAdinidhanaM jantumAtmani sthitamavyayam |
akartAramamUrtaM cha bhagavAnAha tIrthavit
shlokas.54:
yo jantuH svakRRitaistaistaiH karmabhirnityaduHkhitaH |
sa duHkhapratighAtArthaM hanti jantUnanekadhA
shlokas.55:
tataH karma samAdatte punaranyannavaM bahu |
tapyate.atha punastena bhuktvApathyamivAturaH
shlokas.56:
ajasrameva mohArto duHkheShu sukhasa~nj~nitaH |
badhyate mathyate chaiva karmabhirmanthavatsadA
shlokas.57:
tato nivRRitto bandhAtsvAtkarmaNAmudayAdiha |
paribhramati sa.nsAraM chakravadbahuvedanaH
shlokas.58:
sa tvaM nivRRittabandhastu nivRRittashchApi karmataH |
sarvavitsarvajitsiddho bhava bhAvavivarjitaH
shlokas.59:
sa.nyamena navaM bandhaM nivartya tapaso balAt |
samprAptA bahavaH siddhimapyabAdhAM sukhodayAm

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
ashokaM shokanAshArthaM shAstraM shAntikaraM shivam |
nishamya labhate buddhiM tAM labdhvA sukhamedhate
shlokas.2:
shokasthAnasahasrANi bhayasthAnashatAni cha |
divase divase mUDhamAvishanti na paNDitam
shlokas.3:
tasmAdaniShTanAshArthamitihAsaM nibodha me |
tiShThate chedvashe buddhirlabhate shokanAshanam
shlokas.4:
aniShTasamprayogAchcha viprayogAtpriyasya cha |
manuShyA mAnasairduHkhairyujyante alpabuddhayaH
shlokas.5:
dravyeShu samatIteShu ye guNAstAnna chintayet |
tAnanAdriyamANasya snehabandhaH pramuchyate
shlokas.6:
doShadarshI bhavettatra yatra rAgaH pravartate |
aniShTavaddhitaM pashyettathA kShipraM virajyate
shlokas.7:
nArtho na dharmo na yasho yo.atItamanushochati |
apyabhAvena yujyeta tachchAsya na nivartate
shlokas.8:
guNairbhUtAni yujyante viyujyante tathaiva cha |
sarvANi naitadekasya shokasthAnaM hi vidyate
shlokas.9:
mRRitaM vA yadi vA naShTaM yo.atItamanushochati |
duHkhena labhate duHkhaM dvAvanarthau prapadyate
shlokas.10:
nAshru kurvanti ye buddhyA dRRiShTvA lokeShu santatim |
samyakprapashyataH sarvaM nAshrukarmopapadyate
shlokas.11:
duHkhopaghAte shArIre mAnase vApyupasthite |
yasminna shakyate kartuM yatnastannAnuchintayet
shlokas.12:
bhaiShajyametadduHkhasya yadetannAnuchintayet |
chintyamAnaM hi na vyeti bhUyashchApi pravardhate
shlokas.13:
praj~nayA mAnasaM duHkhaM hanyAchChArIramauShadhaiH |
etadvij~nAnasAmarthyaM na bAlaiH samatAmiyAt
shlokas.14:
anityaM yauvanaM rUpaM jIvitaM dravyasa~nchayaH |
ArogyaM priyasa.nvAso gRRidhyettatra na paNDitaH
shlokas.15:
na jAnapadikaM duHkhamekaH shochitumarhati |
ashochanpratikurvIta yadi pashyedupakramam
shlokas.16:
sukhAdbahutaraM duHkhaM jIvite nAtra sa.nshayaH |
snigdhatvaM chendriyArtheShu mohAnmaraNamapriyam
shlokas.17:
parityajati yo duHkhaM sukhaM vApyubhayaM naraH |
abhyeti brahma so.atyantaM na taM shochanti paNDitAH
shlokas.18:
duHkhamarthA hi tyajyante pAlane na cha te sukhAH |
duHkhena chAdhigamyante nAshameShAM na chintayet
shlokas.19:
anyAmanyAM dhanAvasthAM prApya vaisheShikIM narAH |
atRRiptA yAnti vidhva.nsaM santoShaM yAnti paNDitAH
shlokas.20:
sarve kShayAntA nichayAH patanAntAH samuchChrayAH |
sa.nyogA viprayogAntA maraNAntaM hi jIvitam
shlokas.21:
anto nAsti pipAsAyAstuShTistu paramaM sukham |
tasmAtsantoShameveha dhanaM pashyanti paNDitAH
shlokas.22:
nimeShamAtramapi hi vayo gachChanna tiShThati |
svasharIreShvanityeShu nityaM kimanuchintayet
shlokas.23:
bhUteShvabhAvaM sa~nchintya ye buddhvA tamasaH param |
na shochanti gatAdhvAnaH pashyantaH paramAM gatim
shlokas.24:
sa~nchinvAnakamevainaM kAmAnAmavitRRiptakam |
vyAghraH pashumivAsAdya mRRityurAdAya gachChati
shlokas.25:
athApyupAyaM sampashyedduHkhasya parimokShaNe |
ashochannArabhetaiva yuktashchAvyasanI bhavet
shlokas.26:
shabde sparshe cha rUpe cha gandheShu cha raseShu cha |
nopabhogAtparaM ki~nchiddhanino vAdhanasya vA
shlokas.27:
prAksamprayogAdbhUtAnAM nAsti duHkhamanAmayam |
viprayogAttu sarvasya na shochetprakRRitisthitaH
shlokas.28:
dhRRityA shishnodaraM rakShetpANipAdaM cha chakShuShA |
chakShuHshrotre cha manasA mano vAchaM cha vidyayA
shlokas.29:
praNayaM pratisaMhRRitya sa.nstuteShvitareShu cha |
vicharedasamunnaddhaH sa sukhI sa cha paNDitaH
shlokas.30:
adhyAtmaratirAsIno nirapekSho nirAmiShaH |
Atmanaiva sahAyena yashcharetsa sukhI bhavet

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
sukhaduHkhaviparyAso yadA samupapadyate |
nainaM praj~nA sunItaM vA trAyate nApi pauruSham
shlokas.2:
svabhAvAdyatnamAtiShThedyatnavAnnAvasIdati |
jarAmaraNarogebhyaH priyamAtmAnamuddharet
shlokas.3:
rujanti hi sharIrANi rogAH shArIramAnasAH |
sAyakA iva tIkShNAgrAH prayuktA dRRiDhadhanvibhiH
shlokas.4:
vyAdhitasya vivitsAbhistrasyato jIvitaiShiNaH |
avashasya vinAshAya sharIramapakRRiShyate
shlokas.5:
sravanti na nivartante srotA.nsi saritAmiva |
AyurAdAya martyAnAM rAtryahAni punaH punaH
shlokas.6:
vyatyayo hyayamatyantaM pakShayoH shuklakRRiShNayoH |
jAtaM martyaM jarayati nimeShaM nAvatiShThate
shlokas.7:
sukhaduHkhAni bhUtAnAmajaro jarayannasau |
Adityo hyastamabhyeti punaH punarudeti cha
shlokas.8:
adRRiShTapUrvAnAdAya bhAvAnaparisha~NkitAn |
iShTAniShTAnmanuShyANAmastaM gachChanti rAtrayaH
shlokas.9:
yo yamichChedyathAkAmaM kAmAnAM tattadApnuyAt |
yadi syAnna parAdhInaM puruShasya kriyAphalam
shlokas.10:
sa.nyatAshcha hi dakShAshcha matimantashcha mAnavAH |
dRRishyante niShphalAH santaH prahINAshcha svakarmabhiH
shlokas.11:
apare bAlishAH santo nirguNAH puruShAdhamAH |
AshIrbhirapyasa.nyuktA dRRishyante sarvakAminaH
shlokas.12:
bhUtAnAmaparaH kashchiddhi.nsAyAM satatotthitaH |
va~nchanAyAM cha lokasya sa sukheShveva jIryate
shlokas.13:
acheShTamAnamAsInaM shrIH ka~nchidupatiShThati |
kashchitkarmAnusRRityAnyo na prApyamadhigachChati
shlokas.14:
aparAdhaM samAchakShva puruShasya svabhAvataH |
shukramanyatra sambhUtaM punaranyatra gachChati
shlokas.15:
tasya yonau prasaktasya garbho bhavati vA na vA |
AmrapuShpopamA yasya nivRRittirupalabhyate
shlokas.16:
keShA~nchitputrakAmAnAmanusantAnamichChatAm |
siddhau prayatamAnAnAM naivANDamupajAyate
shlokas.17:
garbhAchchodvijamAnAnAM kruddhAdAshIviShAdiva |
AyuShmA~njAyate putraH kathaM pretaH pitaiva saH
shlokas.18:
devAniShTvA tapastaptvA kRRipaNaiH putragRRiddhibhiH |
dasha mAsAnparidhRRitA jAyante kulapA.nsanAH
shlokas.19:
apare dhanadhAnyAni bhogA.nshcha pitRRisa~nchitAn |
vipulAnabhijAyante labdhAstaireva ma~NgalaiH
shlokas.20:
anyonyaM samabhipretya maithunasya samAgame |
upadrava ivAviShTo yoniM garbhaH prapadyate
shlokas.21:
shIrNaM parasharIreNa nichChavIkaM sharIriNam |
prANinAM prANasa.nrodhe mA.nsashleShmavicheShTitam
shlokas.22:
nirdagdhaM paradehena paradehaM chalAchalam |
vinashyantaM vinAshAnte nAvi nAvamivAhitam
shlokas.23:
sa~NgatyA jaThare nyastaM retobindumachetanam |
kena yatnena jIvantaM garbhaM tvamiha pashyasi
shlokas.24:
annapAnAni jIryante yatra bhakShAshcha bhakShitAH |
tasminnevodare garbhaH kiM nAnnamiva jIryate
shlokas.25:
garbhamUtrapurIShANAM svabhAvaniyatA gatiH |
dhAraNe vA visarge vA na karturvidyate vashaH
shlokas.26:
sravanti hyudarAdgarbhA jAyamAnAstathApare |
Agamena sahAnyeShAM vinAsha upapadyate
shlokas.27:
etasmAdyonisambandhAdyo jIvanparimuchyate |
prajAM cha labhate kA~nchitpunardva.ndveShu majjati
shlokas.28:
shatasya sahajAtasya saptamIM dashamIM dashAm |
prApnuvanti tataH pa~ncha na bhavanti shatAyuShaH
shlokas.29:
nAbhyutthAne manuShyANAM yogAH syurnAtra sa.nshayaH |
vyAdhibhishcha vimathyante vyAlaiH kShudramRRigA iva
shlokas.30:
vyAdhibhirbhakShyamANAnAM tyajatAM vipulaM dhanam |
vedanAM nApakarShanti yatamAnAshchikitsakAH
shlokas.31:
te chApi nipuNA vaidyAH kushalAH sambhRRitauShadhAH |
vyAdhibhiH parikRRiShyante mRRigA vyAdhairivArditAH
shlokas.32:
te pibantaH kaShAyA.nshcha sarpIMShi vividhAni cha |
dRRishyante jarayA bhagnA nAgA nAgairivottamaiH
shlokas.33:
ke vA bhuvi chikitsante rogArtAnmRRigapakShiNaH |
shvApadAni daridrA.nshcha prAyo nArtA bhavanti te
shlokas.34:
ghorAnapi durAdharShAnnRRipatInugratejasaH |
Akramya roga Adatte pashUnpashupacho yathA
shlokas.35:
iti lokamanAkrandaM mohashokapariplutam |
srotasA sahasA kShiptaM hriyamANaM balIyasA
shlokas.36:
na dhanena na rAjyena nogreNa tapasA tathA |
svabhAvA vyativartante ye niyuktAH sharIriShu
shlokas.37:
na mriyeranna jIryeransarve syuH sarvakAmikAH |
nApriyaM pratipashyeyurutthAnasya phalaM prati
shlokas.38:
uparyupari lokasya sarvo bhavitumichChati |
yatate cha yathAshakti na cha tadvartate tathA
shlokas.39:
aishvaryamadamattA.nshcha mattAnmadyamadena cha |
apramattAH shaThAH krUrA vikrAntAH paryupAsate
shlokas.40:
kleshAH pratinivartante keShA~nchidasamIkShitAH |
svaM svaM cha punaranyeShAM na ki~nchidabhigamyate
shlokas.41:
mahachcha phalavaiShamyaM dRRishyate karmasandhiShu |
vahanti shibikAmanye yAntyanye shibikAgatAH
shlokas.42:
sarveShAmRRiddhikAmAnAmanye rathapuraHsarAH |
manujAshcha shatastrIkAH shatasho vidhavAH striyaH
shlokas.43:
dva.ndvArAmeShu bhUteShu gachChantyekaikasho narAH |
idamanyatparaM pashya mAtra mohaM kariShyasi
shlokas.44:
tyaja dharmamadharmaM cha ubhe satyAnRRite tyaja |
ubhe satyAnRRite tyaktvA yena tyajasi taM tyaja
shlokas.45:
etatte paramaM guhyamAkhyAtamRRiShisattama |
yena devAH parityajya martyalokaM divaM gatAH
shlokas.46:
bhIShma uvAcha||
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA shukaH paramabuddhimAn |
sa~nchintya manasA dhIro nishchayaM nAdhyagachChata
shlokas.47:
putradArairmahAnklesho vidyAmnAye mahA~nshramaH |
kiM nu syAchChAshvataM sthAnamalpakleshaM mahodayam
shlokas.48:
tato muhUrtaM sa~nchintya nishchitAM gatimAtmanaH |
parAvaraj~no dharmasya parAM naiHshreyasIM gatim
shlokas.49:
kathaM tvahamasa~NkliShTo gachCheyaM paramAM gatim |
nAvarteyaM yathA bhUyo yonisa.nsArasAgare
shlokas.50:
paraM bhAvaM hi kA~NkShAmi yatra nAvartate punaH |
sarvasa~NgAnparityajya nishchitAM manaso gatim
shlokas.51:
tatra yAsyAmi yatrAtmA shamaM me.adhigamiShyati |
akShayashchAvyayashchaiva yatra sthAsyAmi shAshvataH
shlokas.52:
na tu yogamRRite shakyA prAptuM sA paramA gatiH |
avabandho hi muktasya karmabhirnopapadyate
shlokas.53:
tasmAdyogaM samAsthAya tyaktvA gRRihakalevaram |
vAyubhUtaH pravekShyAmi tejorAshiM divAkaram
shlokas.54:
na hyeSha kShayamApnoti somaH suragaNairyathA |
kampitaH patate bhUmiM punashchaivAdhirohati
kShIyate hi sadA somaH punashchaivAbhipUryate
shlokas.55:
ravistu santApayati lokAnrashmibhirulbaNaiH |
sarvatasteja Adatte nityamakShayamaNDalaH
shlokas.56:
ato me rochate gantumAdityaM dIptatejasam |
atra vatsyAmi durdharSho niHsa~NgenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.57:
sUryasya sadane chAhaM nikShipyedaM kalevaram |
RRiShibhiH saha yAsyAmi sauraM tejo.atiduHsaham
shlokas.58:
ApRRichChAmi nagAnnAgAngirInurvIM disho divam |
devadAnavagandharvAnpishAchoragarAkShasAn
shlokas.59:
lokeShu sarvabhUtAni pravekShyAmi nasa.nshayaH |
pashyantu yogavIryaM me sarve devAH saharShibhiH
shlokas.60:
athAnuj~nApya tamRRiShiM nAradaM lokavishrutam |
tasmAdanuj~nAM samprApya jagAma pitaraM prati
shlokas.61:
so.abhivAdya mahAtmAnamRRiShiM dvaipAyanaM munim |
shukaH pradakShiNIkRRitya kRRiShNamApRRiShTavAnmuniH
shlokas.62:
shrutvA RRiShistadvachanaM shukasya; prIto mahAtmA punarAha chainam |
bho bhoH putra sthIyatAM tAvadadya; yAvachchakShuH prINayAmi tvadartham
shlokas.63:
nirapekShaH shuko bhUtvA niHsneho muktabandhanaH |
mokShamevAnusa~nchintya gamanAya mano dadhe
pitaraM samparityajya jagAma dvijasattamaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
giripRRiShThaM samAruhya suto vyAsasya bhArata |
same deshe vivikte cha niHshalAka upAvishat
shlokas.2:
dhArayAmAsa chAtmAnaM yathAshAstraM mahAmuniH |
pAdAtprabhRRitigAtreShu krameNa kramayogavit
shlokas.3:
tataH sa prA~Nmukho vidvAnAditye nachirodite |
pANipAdaM samAdhAya vinItavadupAvishat
shlokas.4:
na tatra pakShisa~NghAto na shabdo nApi darshanam |
yatra vaiyAsakirdhImAnyoktuM samupachakrame
shlokas.5:
sa dadarsha tadAtmAnaM sarvasa~NgaviniHsRRitam |
prajahAsa tato hAsaM shukaH samprekShya bhAskaram
shlokas.6:
sa punaryogamAsthAya mokShamArgopalabdhaye |
mahAyogIshvaro bhUtvA so.atyakrAmadvihAyasam
shlokas.7:
tataH pradakShiNaM kRRitvA devarShiM nAradaM tadA |
nivedayAmAsa tadA svaM yogaM paramarShaye
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTo mArgaH pravRRitto.asmi svasti te.astu tapodhana |
tvatprasAdAdgamiShyAmi gatimiShTAM mahAdyute
shlokas.9:
nAradenAbhyanuj~nAtastato dvaipAyanAtmajaH |
abhivAdya punaryogamAsthAyAkAshamAvishat
shlokas.10:
kailAsapRRiShThAdutpatya sa papAta divaM tadA |
antarikShacharaH shrImAnvyAsaputraH sunishchitaH
shlokas.11:
tamudyantaM dvijashreShThaM vainateyasamadyutim |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni manomArutaraMhasam
shlokas.12:
vyavasAyena lokA.nstrInsarvAnso.atha vichintayan |
Asthito divyamadhvAnaM pAvakArkasamaprabhaH
shlokas.13:
tamekamanasaM yAntamavyagramakutobhayam |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni ja~NgamAnItarANi cha
shlokas.14:
yathAshakti yathAnyAyaM pUjayAM chakrire tadA |
puShpavarShaishcha divyaistamavachakrurdivaukasaH
shlokas.15:
taM dRRiShTvA vismitAH sarve gandharvApsarasAM gaNAH |
RRiShayashchaiva sa.nsiddhAH paraM vismayamAgatAH
shlokas.16:
antarikShacharaH ko.ayaM tapasA siddhimAgataH |
adhaHkAyordhvavaktrashcha netraiH samabhivAhyate
shlokas.17:
tataH paramadhIrAtmA triShu lokeShu vishrutaH |
bhAskaraM samudIkShansa prA~Nmukho vAgyato.agamat
shabdenAkAshamakhilaM pUrayanniva sarvataH
shlokas.18:
tamApatantaM sahasA dRRiShTvA sarvApsarogaNAH |
sambhrAntamanaso rAjannAsanparamavismitAH
pa~nchachUDAprabhRRitayo bhRRishamutphullalochanAH
shlokas.19:
daivataM katamaM hyetaduttamAM gatimAsthitam |
sunishchitamihAyAti vimuktamiva niHspRRiham
shlokas.20:
tataH samatichakrAma malayaM nAma parvatam |
urvashI pUrvachittishcha yaM nityamupasevate
te sma brahmarShiputrasya vismayaM yayatuH param
shlokas.21:
aho buddhisamAdhAnaM vedAbhyAsarate dvije |
achireNaiva kAlena nabhashcharati chandravat
pitRRishushrUShayA siddhiM samprApto.ayamanuttamAm
shlokas.22:
pitRRibhakto dRRiDhatapAH pituH sudayitaH sutaH |
ananyamanasA tena kathaM pitrA vivarjitaH
shlokas.23:
urvashyA vachanaM shrutvA shukaH paramadharmavit |
udaikShata dishaH sarvA vachane gatamAnasaH
shlokas.24:
so.antarikShaM mahIM chaiva sashailavanakAnanAm |
AlokayAmAsa tadA sarA.nsi saritastathA
shlokas.25:
tato dvaipAyanasutaM bahumAnapuraHsaram |
kRRitA~njalipuTAH sarvA nirIkShante sma devatAH
shlokas.26:
abravIttAstadA vAkyaM shukaH paramadharmavit |
pitA yadyanugachChenmAM kroshamAnaH shuketi vai
shlokas.27:
tataH prativacho deyaM sarvaireva samAhitaiH |
etanme snehataH sarve vachanaM kartumarhatha
shlokas.28:
shukasya vachanaM shrutvA dishaH savanakAnanAH |
samudrAH saritaH shailAH pratyUchustaM samantataH
shlokas.29:
yathAj~nApayase vipra bADhamevaM bhaviShyati |
RRiShervyAharato vAkyaM prativakShyAmahe vayam

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
ityevamuktvA vachanaM brahmarShiH sumahAtapAH |
prAtiShThata shukaH siddhiM hitvA lokA.nshchaturvidhAn
shlokas.2:
tamo hyaShTavidhaM hitvA jahau pa~nchavidhaM rajaH |
tataH sattvaM jahau dhImA.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.3:
tatastasminpade nitye nirguNe li~Ngavarjite |
brahmaNi pratyatiShThatsa vidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.4:
ulkApAtA dishAM dAhA bhUmikampAstathaiva cha |
prAdurbhUtAH kShaNe tasmi.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.5:
drumAH shAkhAshcha mumuchuH shikharANi cha parvatAH |
nirghAtashabdaishcha girirhimavAndIryatIva ha
shlokas.6:
na babhAse sahasrA.nshurna jajvAla cha pAvakaH |
hradAshcha saritashchaiva chukShubhuH sAgarAstathA
shlokas.7:
vavarSha vAsavastoyaM rasavachcha sugandhi cha |
vavau samIraNashchApi divyagandhavahaH shuchiH
shlokas.8:
sa shRRi~Nge.apratime divye himavanmerusambhave |
sa.nshliShTe shvetapIte dve rukmarUpyamaye shubhe
shlokas.9:
shatayojanavistAre tiryagUrdhvaM cha bhArata |
udIchIM dishamAshritya ruchire sa.ndadarsha ha
shlokas.10:
so.avisha~Nkena manasA tathaivAbhyapatachChukaH |
tataH parvatashRRi~Nge dve sahasaiva dvidhAkRRite
adRRishyetAM mahArAja tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.11:
tataH parvatashRRi~NgAbhyAM sahasaiva viniHsRRitaH |
na cha pratijaghAnAsya sa gatiM parvatottamaH
shlokas.12:
tato mahAnabhUchChabdo divi sarvadivaukasAm |
gandharvANAmRRiShINAM cha ye cha shailanivAsinaH
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA shukamatikrAntaM parvataM cha dvidhAkRRitam |
sAdhu sAdhviti tatrAsInnAdaH sarvatra bhArata
shlokas.14:
sa pUjyamAno devaishcha gandharvairRRiShibhistathA |
yakSharAkShasasa~Nghaishcha vidyAdharagaNaistathA
shlokas.15:
divyaiH puShpaiH samAkIrNamantarikShaM samantataH |
AsItkila mahArAja shukAbhipatane tadA
shlokas.16:
tato mandAkinIM ramyAmupariShTAdabhivrajan |
shuko dadarsha dharmAtmA puShpitadrumakAnanAm
shlokas.17:
tasyAM krIDantyabhiratAH snAnti chaivApsarogaNAH |
shUnyAkAraM nirAkArAH shukaM dRRiShTvA vivAsasaH
shlokas.18:
taM prakramantamAj~nAya pitA snehasamanvitaH |
uttamAM gatimAsthAya pRRiShThato.anusasAra ha
shlokas.19:
shukastu mArutAdUrdhvaM gatiM kRRitvAntarikShagAm |
darshayitvA prabhAvaM svaM sarvabhUto.abhavattadA
shlokas.20:
mahAyogagatiM tvagryAM vyAsotthAya mahAtapAH |
nimeShAntaramAtreNa shukAbhipatanaM yayau
shlokas.21:
sa dadarsha dvidhA kRRitvA parvatAgraM shukaM gatam |
shasha.nsurRRiShayastasmai karma putrasya tattadA
shlokas.22:
tataH shuketi dIrgheNa shaikSheNAkranditastadA |
svayaM pitrA svareNochchaistrI.NllokAnanunAdya vai
shlokas.23:
shukaH sarvagato bhUtvA sarvAtmA sarvatomukhaH |
pratyabhAShata dharmAtmA bhoHshabdenAnunAdayan
shlokas.24:
tata ekAkSharaM nAdaM bho ityeva samIrayan |
pratyAharajjagatsarvamuchchaiH sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.25:
tataH prabhRRiti chAdyApi shabdAnuchchAritAnpRRithak |
girigahvarapRRiShTheShu vyAjahAra shukaM prati
shlokas.26:
antarhitaH prabhAvaM tu darshayitvA shukastadA |
guNAnsantyajya shabdAdInpadamadhyagamatparam
shlokas.27:
mahimAnaM tu taM dRRiShTvA putrasyAmitatejasaH |
niShasAda giriprasthe putramevAnuchintayan
shlokas.28:
tato mandAkinItIre krIDanto.apsarasAM gaNAH |
AsAdya tamRRiShiM sarvAH sambhrAntA gatachetasaH
shlokas.29:
jale nililyire kAshchitkAshchidgulmAnprapedire |
vasanAnyAdaduH kAshchiddRRiShTvA taM munisattamam
shlokas.30:
tAM muktatAM tu vij~nAya muniH putrasya vai tadA |
saktatAmAtmanashchaiva prIto.abhUdvrIDitashcha ha
shlokas.31:
taM devagandharvavRRito maharShigaNapUjitaH |
pinAkahasto bhagavAnabhyAgachChata sha~NkaraH
shlokas.32:
tamuvAcha mahAdevaH sAntvapUrvamidaM vachaH |
putrashokAbhisantaptaM kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM tadA
shlokas.33:
agnerbhUmerapAM vAyorantarikShasya chaiva ha |
vIryeNa sadRRishaH putrastvayA mattaH purA vRRitaH
shlokas.34:
sa tathAlakShaNo jAtastapasA tava sambhRRitaH |
mama chaiva prabhAvena brahmatejomayaH shuchiH
shlokas.35:
sa gatiM paramAM prApto duShprApAmajitendriyaiH |
daivatairapi viprarShe taM tvaM kimanushochasi
shlokas.36:
yAvatsthAsyanti girayo yAvatsthAsyanti sAgarAH |
tAvattavAkShayA kIrtiH saputrasya bhaviShyati
shlokas.37:
ChAyAM svaputrasadRRishIM sarvato.anapagAM sadA |
drakShyase tvaM cha loke.asminmatprasAdAnmahAmune
shlokas.38:
so.anunIto bhagavatA svayaM rudreNa bhArata |
ChAyAM pashyansamAvRRittaH sa muniH parayA mudA
shlokas.39:
iti janma gatishchaiva shukasya bharatarShabha |
vistareNa mayAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.40:
etadAchaShTa me rAjandevarShirnAradaH purA |
vyAsashchaiva mahAyogI sa~njalpeShu pade pade
shlokas.41:
itihAsamimaM puNyaM mokShadharmArthasaMhitam |
dhArayedyaH shamaparaH sa gachChetparamAM gatim

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
gRRihastho brahmachArI vA vAnaprastho.atha bhikShukaH |
ya ichChetsiddhimAsthAtuM devatAM kAM yajeta saH
shlokas.2:
kuto hyasya dhruvaH svargaH kuto niHshreyasaM param |
vidhinA kena juhuyAddaivaM pitryaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.3:
muktashcha kAM gatiM gachChenmokShashchaiva kimAtmakaH |
svargatashchaiva kiM kuryAdyena na chyavate divaH
shlokas.4:
devatAnAM cha ko devaH pitR^INAM cha tathA pitA |
tasmAtparataraM yachcha tanme brUhi pitAmaha
shlokas.5:
bhIShma uvAcha||
gUDhaM mAM prashnavitprashnaM pRRichChase tvamihAnagha |
na hyeSha tarkayA shakyo vaktuM varShashatairapi
shlokas.6:
RRite devaprasAdAdvA rAja~nj~nAnAgamena vA |
gahanaM hyetadAkhyAnaM vyAkhyAtavyaM tavArihan
shlokas.7:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradasya cha sa.nvAdamRRiShernArAyaNasya cha
shlokas.8:
nArAyaNo hi vishvAtmA chaturmUrtiH sanAtanaH |
dharmAtmajaH sambabhUva pitaivaM me.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.9:
kRRite yuge mahArAja purA svAyambhuve.antare |
naro nArAyaNashchaiva hariH kRRiShNastathaiva cha
shlokas.10:
tebhyo nArAyaNanarau tapastepaturavyayau |
badaryAshramamAsAdya shakaTe kanakAmaye
shlokas.11:
aShTachakraM hi tadyAnaM bhUtayuktaM manoramam |
tatrAdyau lokanAthau tau kRRishau dhamanisantatau
shlokas.12:
tapasA tejasA chaiva durnirIkShau surairapi |
yasya prasAdaM kurvAte sa devau draShTumarhati
shlokas.13:
nUnaM tayoranumate hRRidi hRRichChayachoditaH |
mahAmerorgireH shRRi~NgAtprachyuto gandhamAdanam
shlokas.14:
nAradaH sumahadbhUtaM lokAnsarvAnachIcharat |
taM deshamagamadrAjanbadaryAshramamAshugaH
shlokas.15:
tayorAhnikavelAyAM tasya kautUhalaM tvabhUt |
idaM tadAspadaM kRRitsnaM yasmi.NllokAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.16:
sadevAsuragandharvAH sarShikiMnaralelihAH |
ekA mUrtiriyaM pUrvaM jAtA bhUyashchaturvidhA
shlokas.17:
dharmasya kulasantAno mahAnebhirvivardhitaH |
aho hyanugRRihIto.adya dharma ebhiH surairiha
naranArAyaNAbhyAM cha kRRiShNena hariNA tathA
shlokas.18:
tatra kRRiShNo harishchaiva kasmi.nshchitkAraNAntare |
sthitau dharmottarau hyetau tathA tapasi dhiShThitau
shlokas.19:
etau hi paramaM dhAma kAnayorAhnikakriyA |
pitarau sarvabhUtAnAM daivataM cha yashasvinau
kAM devatAM nu yajataH pitR^InvA kAnmahAmatI
shlokas.20:
iti sa~nchintya manasA bhaktyA nArAyaNasya ha |
sahasA prAdurabhavatsamIpe devayostadA
shlokas.21:
kRRite daive cha pitrye cha tatastAbhyAM nirIkShitaH |
pUjitashchaiva vidhinA yathAproktena shAstrataH
shlokas.22:
taM dRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyamapUrvaM vidhivistaram |
upopaviShTaH suprIto nArado bhagavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.23:
nArAyaNaM saMnirIkShya prasannenAntarAtmanA |
namaskRRitvA mahAdevamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.24:
vedeShu sapurANeShu sA~NgopA~NgeShu gIyase |
tvamajaH shAshvato dhAtA mato.amRRitamanuttamam
pratiShThitaM bhUtabhavyaM tvayi sarvamidaM jagat
shlokas.25:
chatvAro hyAshramA deva sarve gArhasthyamUlakAH |
yajante tvAmaharaharnAnAmUrtisamAsthitam
shlokas.26:
pitA mAtA cha sarvasya jagataH shAshvato guruH |
kaM tvadya yajase devaM pitaraM kaM na vidmahe
shlokas.27:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
avAchyametadvaktavyamAtmaguhyaM sanAtanam |
tava bhaktimato brahmanvakShyAmi tu yathAtatham
shlokas.28:
yattatsUkShmamavij~neyamavyaktamachalaM dhruvam |
indriyairindriyArthaishcha sarvabhUtaishcha varjitam
shlokas.29:
sa hyantarAtmA bhUtAnAM kShetraj~nashcheti kathyate |
triguNavyatirikto.asau puruShashcheti kalpitaH
tasmAdavyaktamutpannaM triguNaM dvijasattama
shlokas.30:
avyaktA vyaktabhAvasthA yA sA prakRRitiravyayA |
tAM yonimAvayorviddhi yo.asau sadasadAtmakaH
AvAbhyAM pUjyate.asau hi daive pitrye cha kalpite
shlokas.31:
nAsti tasmAtparo.anyo hi pitA devo.atha vA dvijaH |
AtmA hi nau sa vij~neyastatastaM pUjayAvahe
shlokas.32:
tenaiShA prathitA brahmanmaryAdA lokabhAvinI |
daivaM pitryaM cha kartavyamiti tasyAnushAsanam
shlokas.33:
brahmA sthANurmanurdakSho bhRRigurdharmastapo damaH |
marIchira~NgirAtrishcha pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH
shlokas.34:
vasiShThaH parameShThI cha vivasvAnsoma eva cha |
kardamashchApi yaH proktaH krodho vikrIta eva cha
shlokas.35:
ekavi.nshatirutpannAste prajApatayaH smRRitAH |
tasya devasya maryAdAM pUjayanti sanAtanIm
shlokas.36:
daivaM pitryaM cha satataM tasya vij~nAya tattvataH |
AtmaprAptAni cha tato jAnanti dvijasattamAH
shlokas.37:
svargasthA api ye kechittaM namasyanti dehinaH |
te tatprasAdAdgachChanti tenAdiShTaphalAM gatim
shlokas.38:
ye hInAH saptadashabhirguNaiH karmabhireva cha |
kalAH pa~nchadasha tyaktvA te muktA iti nishchayaH
shlokas.39:
muktAnAM tu gatirbrahmankShetraj~na iti kalpitaH |
sa hi sarvagatashchaiva nirguNashchaiva kathyate
shlokas.40:
dRRishyate j~nAnayogena AvAM cha prasRRitau tataH |
evaM j~nAtvA tamAtmAnaM pUjayAvaH sanAtanam
shlokas.41:
taM vedAshchAshramAshchaiva nAnAtanusamAsthitAH |
bhaktyA sampUjayantyAdyaM gatiM chaiShAM dadAti saH
shlokas.42:
ye tu tadbhAvitA loke ekAntitvaM samAsthitAH |
etadabhyadhikaM teShAM yatte taM pravishantyuta
shlokas.43:
iti guhyasamuddeshastava nArada kIrtitaH |
bhaktyA premNA cha viprarShe asmadbhaktyA cha te shrutaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa evamukto dvipadAM variShTho; nArAyaNenottamapUruSheNa |
jagAda vAkyaM dvipadAM variShThaM; nArAyaNaM lokahitAdhivAsam
shlokas.2:
yadarthamAtmaprabhaveha janma; tavottamaM dharmagRRihe chaturdhA |
tatsAdhyatAM lokahitArthamadya; gachChAmi draShTuM prakRRitiM tavAdyAm
shlokas.3:
vedAH svadhItA mama lokanAtha; taptaM tapo nAnRRitamuktapUrvam |
pUjAM gurUNAM satataM karomi; parasya guhyaM na cha bhinnapUrvam
shlokas.4:
guptAni chatvAri yathAgamaM me; shatrau cha mitre cha samo.asmi nityam |
taM chAdidevaM satataM prapanna; ekAntabhAvena vRRiNomyajasram
ebhirvisheShaiH parishuddhasattvaH; kasmAnna pashyeyamanantamIsham
shlokas.5:
tatpArameShThyasya vacho nishamya; nArAyaNaH sAtvatadharmagoptA |
gachCheti taM nAradamuktavAnsa; sampUjayitvAtmavidhikriyAbhiH
shlokas.6:
tato visRRiShTaH parameShThiputraH; so.abhyarchayitvA tamRRiShiM purANam |
khamutpapAtottamavegayukta;stato.adhimerau sahasA nililye
shlokas.7:
tatrAvatasthe cha munirmuhUrta;mekAntamAsAdya gireH sa shRRi~Nge |
Alokayannuttarapashchimena; dadarsha chAtyadbhutarUpayuktam
shlokas.8:
kShIrodadheruttarato hi dvIpaH; shvetaH sa nAmnA prathito vishAlaH |
meroH sahasraiH sa hi yojanAnAM; dvAtri.nshatordhvaM kavibhirniruktaH
shlokas.9:
atIndriyAshchAnashanAshcha tatra; niShpandahInAH susugandhinashcha |
shvetAH pumA.nso gatasarvapApA;shchakShurmuShaH pApakRRitAM narANAm
shlokas.10:
vajrAsthikAyAH samamAnonmAnA; divyAnvayarUpAH shubhasAropetAH |
ChatrAkRRitishIrShA meghaughaninAdAH; satpuShkarachatuShkA rAjIvashatapAdAH
shlokas.11:
ShaShTyA dantairyuktAH shuklai;raShTAbhirdaMShTrAbhirye |
jihvAbhirye viShvagvaktraM; lelihyante sUryaprakhyam
shlokas.12:
bhaktyA devaM vishvotpannaM; yasmAtsarve lokAH sUtAH |
vedA dharmA munayaH shAntA; devAH sarve tasya visargAH
shlokas.13:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atIndriyA nirAhArA aniShpandAH sugandhinaH |
kathaM te puruShA jAtAH kA teShAM gatiruttamA
shlokas.14:
ye vimuktA bhavantIha narA bharatasattama |
teShAM lakShaNametaddhi yachChvetadvIpavAsinAm
shlokas.15:
tasmAnme sa.nshayaM Chindhi paraM kautUhalaM hi me |
tvaM hi sarvakathArAmastvAM chaivopAshritA vayam
shlokas.16:
bhIShma uvAcha||
vistIrNaiShA kathA rAja~nshrutA me pitRRisaMnidhau |
saiShA tava hi vaktavyA kathAsAro hi sa smRRitaH
shlokas.17:
rAjoparicharo nAma babhUvAdhipatirbhuvaH |
AkhaNDalasakhaH khyAto bhakto nArAyaNaM harim
shlokas.18:
dhArmiko nityabhaktashcha pitR^InnityamatandritaH |
sAmrAjyaM tena samprAptaM nArAyaNavarAtpurA
shlokas.19:
sAtvataM vidhimAsthAya prAksUryamukhaniHsRRitam |
pUjayAmAsa deveshaM tachCheSheNa pitAmahAn
shlokas.20:
pitRRisheSheNa viprA.nshcha sa.nvibhajyAshritA.nshcha saH |
sheShAnnabhuksatyaparaH sarvabhUteShvahi.nsakaH
sarvabhAvena bhaktaH sa devadevaM janArdanam
shlokas.21:
tasya nArAyaNe bhaktiM vahato.amitrakarshana |
ekashayyAsanaM shakro dattavAndevarATsvayam
shlokas.22:
AtmA rAjyaM dhanaM chaiva kalatraM vAhanAni cha |
etadbhagavate sarvamiti tatprekShitaM sadA
shlokas.23:
kAmyanaimittikAjasraM yaj~niyAH paramakriyAH |
sarvAH sAtvatamAsthAya vidhiM chakre samAhitaH
shlokas.24:
pa~ncharAtravido mukhyAstasya gehe mahAtmanaH |
prAyaNaM bhagavatproktaM bhu~njate chAgrabhojanam
shlokas.25:
tasya prashAsato rAjyaM dharmeNAmitraghAtinaH |
nAnRRitA vAksamabhavanmano duShTaM na chAbhavat
na cha kAyena kRRitavAnsa pApaM paramaNvapi
shlokas.26:
ye hi te munayaH khyAtAH sapta chitrashikhaNDinaH |
tairekamatibhirbhUtvA yatproktaM shAstramuttamam
shlokas.27:
marIchiratrya~Ngirasau pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
vasiShThashcha mahAtejA ete chitrashikhaNDinaH
shlokas.28:
sapta prakRRitayo hyetAstathA svAyambhuvo.aShTamaH |
etAbhirdhAryate lokastAbhyaH shAstraM viniHsRRitam
shlokas.29:
ekAgramanaso dAntA munayaH sa.nyame ratAH |
idaM shreya idaM brahma idaM hitamanuttamam
lokAnsa~nchintya manasA tataH shAstraM prachakrire
shlokas.30:
tatra dharmArthakAmA hi mokShaH pashchAchcha kIrtitaH |
maryAdA vividhAshchaiva divi bhUmau cha sa.nsthitAH
shlokas.31:
ArAdhya tapasA devaM hariM nArAyaNaM prabhum |
divyaM varShasahasraM vai sarve te RRiShibhiH saha
shlokas.32:
nArAyaNAnushAstA hi tadA devI sarasvatI |
vivesha tAnRRiShInsarvA.NllokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.33:
tataH pravartitA samyaktapovidbhirdvijAtibhiH |
shabde chArthe cha hetau cha eShA prathamasargajA
shlokas.34:
AdAveva hi tachChAstramo~NkArasvarabhUShitam |
RRiShibhirbhAvitaM tatra yatra kAruNiko hyasau
shlokas.35:
tataH prasanno bhagavAnanirdiShTasharIragaH |
RRiShInuvAcha tAnsarvAnadRRishyaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.36:
kRRitaM shatasahasraM hi shlokAnAmidamuttamam |
lokatantrasya kRRitsnasya yasmAddharmaH pravartate
shlokas.37:
pravRRittau cha nivRRittau cha yoniretadbhaviShyati |
RRigyajuHsAmabhirjuShTamatharvA~NgirasaistathA
shlokas.38:
tathA pramANaM hi mayA kRRito brahmA prasAdajaH |
rudrashcha krodhajo viprA yUyaM prakRRitayastathA
shlokas.39:
sUryAchandramasau vAyurbhUmirApo.agnireva cha |
sarve cha nakShatragaNA yachcha bhUtAbhishabditam
shlokas.40:
adhikAreShu vartante yathAsvaM brahmavAdinaH |
sarve pramANaM hi yathA tathaitachChAstramuttamam
shlokas.41:
bhaviShyati pramANaM vai etanmadanushAsanam |
asmAtpravakShyate dharmAnmanuH svAyambhuvaH svayam
shlokas.42:
ushanA bRRihaspatishchaiva yadotpannau bhaviShyataH |
tadA pravakShyataH shAstraM yuShmanmatibhiruddhRRitam
shlokas.43:
svAyambhuveShu dharmeShu shAstre choshanasA kRRite |
bRRihaspatimate chaiva lokeShu pravichArite
shlokas.44:
yuShmatkRRitamidaM shAstraM prajApAlo vasustataH |
bRRihaspatisakAshAdvai prApsyate dvijasattamAH
shlokas.45:
sa hi madbhAvito rAjA madbhaktashcha bhaviShyati |
tena shAstreNa lokeShu kriyAH sarvAH kariShyati
shlokas.46:
etaddhi sarvashAstrANAM shAstramuttamasa~nj~nitam |
etadarthyaM cha dharmyaM cha yashasyaM chaitaduttamam
shlokas.47:
asya pravartanAchchaiva prajAvanto bhaviShyatha |
sa cha rAjA shriyA yukto bhaviShyati mahAnvasuH
shlokas.48:
sa.nsthite tu nRRipe tasmi~nshAstrametatsanAtanam |
antardhAsyati tatsatyametadvaH kathitaM mayA
shlokas.49:
etAvaduktvA vachanamadRRishyaH puruShottamaH |
visRRijya tAnRRiShInsarvAnkAmapi prasthito disham
shlokas.50:
tataste lokapitaraH sarvalokArthachintakAH |
prAvartayanta tachChAstraM dharmayoniM sanAtanam
shlokas.51:
utpanne.a.a~Ngirase chaiva yuge prathamakalpite |
sA~NgopaniShadaM shAstraM sthApayitvA bRRihaspatau
shlokas.52:
jagmuryathepsitaM deshaM tapase kRRitanishchayAH |
dhAraNAtsarvalokAnAM sarvadharmapravartakAH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tato.atIte mahAkalpe utpanne.a~NgirasaH sute |
babhUvurnirvRRitA devA jAte devapurohite
shlokas.2:
bRRihadbrahma mahachcheti shabdAH paryAyavAchakAH |
ebhiH samanvito rAjanguNairvidvAnbRRihaspatiH
shlokas.3:
tasya shiShyo babhUvAgryo rAjoparicharo vasuH |
adhItavA.nstadA shAstraM samyakchitrashikhaNDijam
shlokas.4:
sa rAjA bhAvitaH pUrvaM daivena vidhinA vasuH |
pAlayAmAsa pRRithivIM divamAkhaNDalo yathA
shlokas.5:
tasya yaj~no mahAnAsIdashvamedho mahAtmanaH |
bRRihaspatirupAdhyAyastatra hotA babhUva ha
shlokas.6:
prajApatisutAshchAtra sadasyAstvabhava.nstrayaH |
ekatashcha dvitashchaiva tritashchaiva maharShayaH
shlokas.7:
dhanuShAkSho.atha raibhyashcha arvAvasuparAvasU |
RRiShirmedhAtithishchaiva tANDyashchaiva mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.8:
RRiShiH shaktirmahAbhAgastathA vedashirAshcha yaH |
kapilashcha RRiShishreShThaH shAlihotrapitAmahaH
shlokas.9:
AdyaH kaThastaittirishcha vaishampAyanapUrvajaH |
kaNvo.atha devahotrashcha ete ShoDasha kIrtitAH
sambhRRitAH sarvasambhArAstasminrAjanmahAkratau
shlokas.10:
na tatra pashughAto.abhUtsa rAjaivaM sthito.abhavat |
ahi.nsraH shuchirakShudro nirAshIH karmasa.nstutaH
AraNyakapadodgItA bhAgAstatropakalpitAH
shlokas.11:
prItastato.asya bhagavAndevadevaH purAtanaH |
sAkShAttaM darshayAmAsa so.adRRishyo.anyena kenachit
shlokas.12:
svayaM bhAgamupAghrAya puroDAshaM gRRihItavAn |
adRRishyena hRRito bhAgo devena harimedhasA
shlokas.13:
bRRihaspatistataH kruddhaH sruvamudyamya vegitaH |
AkAshaM ghnansruvaH pAtai roShAdashrUNyavartayat
shlokas.14:
uvAcha choparicharaM mayA bhAgo.ayamudyataH |
grAhyaH svayaM hi devena matpratyakShaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.15:
udyatA yaj~nabhAgA hi sAkShAtprAptAH surairiha |
kimarthamiha na prApto darshanaM sa harirvibhuH
shlokas.16:
tataH sa taM samuddhUtaM bhUmipAlo mahAnvasuH |
prasAdayAmAsa muniM sadasyAste cha sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
UchushchainamasambhrAntA na roShaM kartumarhasi |
naiSha dharmaH kRRitayuge yastvaM roShamachIkRRithAH
shlokas.18:
aroShaNo hyasau devo yasya bhAgo.ayamudyataH |
na sa shakyastvayA draShTumasmAbhirvA bRRihaspate
yasya prasAdaM kurute sa vai taM draShTumarhati
shlokas.19:
ekatadvitatritA UchuH||
vayaM hi brahmaNaH putrA mAnasAH parikIrtitAH |
gatA niHshreyasArthaM hi kadAchiddishamuttarAm
shlokas.20:
taptvA varShasahasrANi chatvAri tapa uttamam |
ekapAdasthitAH samyakkAShThabhUtAH samAhitAH
shlokas.21:
meroruttarabhAge tu kShIrodasyAnukUlataH |
sa desho yatra nastaptaM tapaH paramadAruNam
kathaM pashyemahi vayaM devaM nArAyaNaM tviti
shlokas.22:
tato vratasyAvabhRRithe vAguvAchAsharIriNI |
sutaptaM vastapo viprAH prasannenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.23:
yUyaM jij~nAsavo bhaktAH kathaM drakShyatha taM prabhum |
kShIrodadheruttarataH shvetadvIpo mahAprabhaH
shlokas.24:
tatra nArAyaNaparA mAnavAshchandravarchasaH |
ekAntabhAvopagatAste bhaktAH puruShottamam
shlokas.25:
te sahasrArchiShaM devaM pravishanti sanAtanam |
atIndriyA nirAhArA aniShpandAH sugandhinaH
shlokas.26:
ekAntinaste puruShAH shvetadvIpanivAsinaH |
gachChadhvaM tatra munayastatrAtmA me prakAshitaH
shlokas.27:
atha shrutvA vayaM sarve vAchaM tAmasharIriNIm |
yathAkhyAtena mArgeNa taM deshaM pratipedire
shlokas.28:
prApya shvetaM mahAdvIpaM tachchittAstaddidRRikShavaH |
tato no dRRiShTiviShayastadA pratihato.abhavat
shlokas.29:
na cha pashyAma puruShaM tattejohRRitadarshanAH |
tato naH prAdurabhavadvij~nAnaM devayogajam
shlokas.30:
na kilAtaptatapasA shakyate draShTuma~njasA |
tataH punarvarShashataM taptvA tAtkAlikaM mahat
shlokas.31:
vratAvasAne sushubhAnnarAndadRRishire vayam |
shvetA.nshchandrapratIkAshAnsarvalakShaNalakShitAn
shlokas.32:
nityA~njalikRRitAnbrahma japataH prAguda~NmukhAn |
mAnaso nAma sa japo japyate tairmahAtmabhiH
tenaikAgramanastvena prIto bhavati vai hariH
shlokas.33:
yA bhavenmunishArdUla bhAH sUryasya yugakShaye |
ekaikasya prabhA tAdRRiksAbhavanmAnavasya ha
shlokas.34:
tejonivAsaH sa dvIpa iti vai menire vayam |
na tatrAbhyadhikaH kashchitsarve te samatejasaH
shlokas.35:
atha sUryasahasrasya prabhAM yugapadutthitAm |
sahasA dRRiShTavantaH sma punareva bRRihaspate
shlokas.36:
sahitAshchAbhyadhAvanta tataste mAnavA drutam |
kRRitA~njalipuTA hRRiShTA nama ityeva vAdinaH
shlokas.37:
tato.abhivadatAM teShAmashrauShma vipulaM dhvanim |
baliH kilopahriyate tasya devasya tairnaraiH
shlokas.38:
vayaM tu tejasA tasya sahasA hRRitachetasaH |
na ki~nchidapi pashyAmo hRRitadRRiShTibalendriyAH
shlokas.39:
ekastu shabdo.avirataH shruto.asmAbhirudIritaH |
jitaM te puNDarIkAkSha namaste vishvabhAvana
shlokas.40:
namaste.astu hRRiShIkesha mahApuruShapUrvaja |
iti shabdaH shruto.asmAbhiH shikShAkSharasamIritaH
shlokas.41:
etasminnantare vAyuH sarvagandhavahaH shuchiH |
divyAnyuvAha puShpANi karmaNyAshchauShadhIstathA
shlokas.42:
tairiShTaH pa~nchakAlaj~nairharirekAntibhirnaraiH |
nUnaM tatrAgato devo yathA tairvAgudIritA
vayaM tvenaM na pashyAmo mohitAstasya mAyayA
shlokas.43:
mArute saMnivRRitte cha balau cha pratipAdite |
chintAvyAkulitAtmAno jAtAH smo.a~NgirasAM vara
shlokas.44:
mAnavAnAM sahasreShu teShu vai shuddhayoniShu |
asmAnna kashchinmanasA chakShuShA vApyapUjayat
shlokas.45:
te.api svasthA munigaNA ekabhAvamanuvratAH |
nAsmAsu dadhire bhAvaM brahmabhAvamanuShThitAH
shlokas.46:
tato.asmAnsuparishrAntA.nstapasA chApi karshitAn |
uvAcha khasthaM kimapi bhUtaM tatrAsharIrakam
shlokas.47:
dRRiShTA vaH puruShAH shvetAH sarvendriyavivarjitAH |
dRRiShTo bhavati devesha ebhirdRRiShTairdvijottamAH
shlokas.48:
gachChadhvaM munayaH sarve yathAgatamito.achirAt |
na sa shakyo abhaktena draShTuM devaH katha~nchana
shlokas.49:
kAmaM kAlena mahatA ekAntitvaM samAgataiH |
shakyo draShTuM sa bhagavAnprabhAmaNDaladurdRRishaH
shlokas.50:
mahatkAryaM tu kartavyaM yuShmAbhirdvijasattamAH |
itaH kRRitayuge.atIte viparyAsaM gate.api cha
shlokas.51:
vaivasvate.antare viprAH prApte tretAyuge tataH |
surANAM kAryasiddhyarthaM sahAyA vai bhaviShyatha
shlokas.52:
tatastadadbhutaM vAkyaM nishamyaivaM sma somapa |
tasya prasAdAtprAptAH smo deshamIpsitama~njasA
shlokas.53:
evaM sutapasA chaiva havyakavyaistathaiva cha |
devo.asmAbhirna dRRiShTaH sa kathaM tvaM draShTumarhasi
nArAyaNo mahadbhUtaM vishvasRRigghavyakavyabhuk
shlokas.54:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evamekatavAkyena dvitatritamatena cha |
anunItaH sadasyaishcha bRRihaspatirudAradhIH
samAnIya tato yaj~naM daivataM samapUjayat
shlokas.55:
samAptayaj~no rAjApi prajAH pAlitavAnvasuH |
brahmashApAddivo bhraShTaH pravivesha mahIM tataH
shlokas.56:
antarbhUmigatashchaiva satataM dharmavatsalaH |
nArAyaNaparo bhUtvA nArAyaNapadaM jagau
shlokas.57:
tasyaiva cha prasAdena punarevotthitastu saH |
mahItalAdgataH sthAnaM brahmaNaH samanantaram
parAM gatimanuprApta iti naiShThikama~njasA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yadA bhakto bhagavata AsIdrAjA mahAvasuH |
kimarthaM sa paribhraShTo vivesha vivaraM bhuvaH
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
RRiShINAM chaiva sa.nvAdaM tridashAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.3:
ajena yaShTavyamiti devAH prAhurdvijottamAn |
sa cha ChAgo hyajo j~neyo nAnyaH pashuriti sthitiH
shlokas.4:
RRiShaya UchuH||
bIjairyaj~neShu yaShTavyamiti vai vaidikI shrutiH |
ajasa~nj~nAni bIjAni ChAgaM na ghnantumarhatha
shlokas.5:
naiSha dharmaH satAM devA yatra vadhyeta vai pashuH |
idaM kRRitayugaM shreShThaM kathaM vadhyeta vai pashuH
shlokas.6:
bhIShma uvAcha||
teShAM sa.nvadatAmevamRRiShINAM vibudhaiH saha |
mArgAgato nRRipashreShThastaM deshaM prAptavAnvasuH
antarikShacharaH shrImAnsamagrabalavAhanaH
shlokas.7:
taM dRRiShTvA sahasAyAntaM vasuM te tvantarikShagam |
UchurdvijAtayo devAneSha Chetsyati sa.nshayam
shlokas.8:
yajvA dAnapatiH shreShThaH sarvabhUtahitapriyaH |
kathaM svidanyathA brUyAdvAkyameSha mahAnvasuH
shlokas.9:
evaM te sa.nvidaM kRRitvA vibudhA RRiShayastathA |
apRRichChansahasAbhyetya vasuM rAjAnamantikAt
shlokas.10:
bho rAjankena yaShTavyamajenAho svidauShadhaiH |
etannaH sa.nshayaM Chindhi pramANaM no bhavAnmataH
shlokas.11:
sa tAnkRRitA~njalirbhUtvA paripaprachCha vai vasuH |
kasya vaH ko mataH pakSho brUta satyaM samAgatAH
shlokas.12:
RRiShaya UchuH||
dhAnyairyaShTavyamityeSha pakSho.asmAkaM narAdhipa |
devAnAM tu pashuH pakSho mato rAjanvadasva naH
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
devAnAM tu mataM j~nAtvA vasunA pakShasa.nshrayAt |
ChAgenAjena yaShTavyamevamuktaM vachastadA
shlokas.14:
kupitAste tataH sarve munayaH sUryavarchasaH |
UchurvasuM vimAnasthaM devapakShArthavAdinam
shlokas.15:
surapakSho gRRihItaste yasmAttasmAddivaH pata |
adya prabhRRiti te rAjannAkAshe vihatA gatiH
asmachChApAbhighAtena mahIM bhittvA pravekShyasi
shlokas.16:
tatastasminmuhUrte.atha rAjoparicharastadA |
adho vai sambabhUvAshu bhUmervivarago nRRipaH
smRRitistvenaM na prajahau tadA nArAyaNAj~nayA
shlokas.17:
devAstu sahitAH sarve vasoH shApavimokShaNam |
chintayAmAsuravyagrAH sukRRitaM hi nRRipasya tat
shlokas.18:
anenAsmatkRRite rAj~nA shApaH prApto mahAtmanA |
asya pratipriyaM kAryaM sahitairno divaukasaH
shlokas.19:
iti buddhyA vyavasyAshu gatvA nishchayamIshvarAH |
UchustaM hRRiShTamanaso rAjoparicharaM tadA
shlokas.20:
brahmaNyadevaM tvaM bhaktaH surAsuraguruM harim |
kAmaM sa tava tuShTAtmA kuryAchChApavimokShaNam
shlokas.21:
mAnanA tu dvijAtInAM kartavyA vai mahAtmanAm |
avashyaM tapasA teShAM phalitavyaM nRRipottama
shlokas.22:
yatastvaM sahasA bhraShTa AkAshAnmedinItalam |
ekaM tvanugrahaM tubhyaM dadmo vai nRRipasattama
shlokas.23:
yAvattvaM shApadoSheNa kAlamAsiShyase.anagha |
bhUmervivarago bhUtvA tAvantaM kAlamApsyasi
yaj~neShu suhutAM viprairvasordhArAM mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.24:
prApsyase.asmadanudhyAnAnmA cha tvAM glAnirAspRRishet |
na kShutpipAse rAjendra bhUmeshChidre bhaviShyataH
shlokas.25:
vasordhArAnupItatvAttejasApyAyitena cha |
sa devo.asmadvarAtprIto brahmalokaM hi neShyati
shlokas.26:
evaM dattvA varaM rAj~ne sarve tatra divaukasaH |
gatAH svabhavanaM devA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH
shlokas.27:
chakre cha satataM pUjAM viShvaksenAya bhArata |
japyaM jagau cha satataM nArAyaNamukhodgatam
shlokas.28:
tatrApi pa~nchabhiryaj~naiH pa~nchakAlAnari.ndama |
ayajaddhariM surapatiM bhUmervivarago.api san
shlokas.29:
tato.asya tuShTo bhagavAnbhaktyA nArAyaNo hariH |
ananyabhaktasya satastatparasya jitAtmanaH
shlokas.30:
varado bhagavAnviShNuH samIpasthaM dvijottamam |
garutmantaM mahAvegamAbabhAShe smayanniva
shlokas.31:
dvijottama mahAbhAga gamyatAM vachanAnmama |
samrADrAjA vasurnAma dharmAtmA mAM samAshritaH
shlokas.32:
brAhmaNAnAM prakopena praviShTo vasudhAtalam |
mAnitAste tu viprendrAstvaM tu gachCha dvijottama
shlokas.33:
bhUmervivarasa~NguptaM garuDeha mamAj~nayA |
adhashcharaM nRRipashreShThaM khecharaM kuru mAchiram
shlokas.34:
garutmAnatha vikShipya pakShau mArutavegavAn |
vivesha vivaraM bhUmeryatrAste vAgyato vasuH
shlokas.35:
tata enaM samutkShipya sahasA vinatAsutaH |
utpapAta nabhastUrNaM tatra chainamamu~nchata
shlokas.36:
tasminmuhUrte sa~njaj~ne rAjoparicharaH punaH |
sasharIro gatashchaiva brahmalokaM nRRipottamaH
shlokas.37:
evaM tenApi kaunteya vAgdoShAddevatAj~nayA |
prAptA gatirayajvArhA dvijashApAnmahAtmanA
shlokas.38:
kevalaM puruShastena sevito harirIshvaraH |
tataH shIghraM jahau shApaM brahmalokamavApa cha
shlokas.39:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM te bhUtA mAnavA yathA |
nArado.api yathA shvetaM dvIpaM sa gatavAnRRiShiH
tatte sarvaM pravakShyAmi shRRiNuShvaikamanA nRRipa

pUjayAmAsa shirasA manasA taishcha pUjitaH |
didRRikShurjapyaparamaH sarvakRRichChradharaH sthitaH
shlokas.3:
bhUtvaikAgramanA vipra UrdhvabAhurmahAmuniH |
stotraM jagau sa vishvAya nirguNAya mahAtmane

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM stutaH sa bhagavAnguhyaistathyaishcha nAmabhiH |
taM muniM darshayAmAsa nAradaM vishvarUpadhRRik
shlokas.2:
ki~nchichchandravishuddhAtmA ki~nchichchandrAdvisheShavAn |
kRRishAnuvarNaH ki~nchichcha ki~nchiddhiShNyAkRRitiH prabhuH
shlokas.3:
shukapatravarNaH ki~nchichcha ki~nchitsphaTikasaprabhaH |
nIlA~njanachayaprakhyo jAtarUpaprabhaH kvachit
shlokas.4:
pravAlA~NkuravarNashcha shvetavarNaH kvachidbabhau |
kvachitsuvarNavarNAbho vaiDUryasadRRishaH kvachit
shlokas.5:
nIlavaiDUryasadRRisha indranIlanibhaH kvachit |
mayUragrIvavarNAbho muktAhAranibhaH kvachit
shlokas.6:
etAnvarNAnbahuvidhAnrUpe bibhratsanAtanaH |
sahasranayanaH shrImA~nshatashIrShaH sahasrapAt
shlokas.7:
sahasrodarabAhushcha avyakta iti cha kvachit |
o~NkAramudgiranvaktrAtsAvitrIM cha tadanvayAm
shlokas.8:
sheShebhyashchaiva vaktrebhyashchaturvedodgataM vasu |
AraNyakaM jagau devo harirnArAyaNo vashI
shlokas.9:
vedIM kamaNDaluM darbhAnmaNirUpAnathopalAn |
ajinaM daNDakAShThaM cha jvalitaM cha hutAshanam
dhArayAmAsa devesho hastairyaj~napatistadA
shlokas.10:
taM prasannaM prasannAtmA nArado dvijasattamaH |
vAgyataH prayato bhUtvA vavande parameshvaram
tamuvAcha nataM mUrdhnA devAnAmAdiravyayaH
shlokas.11:
ekatashcha dvitashchaiva tritashchaiva maharShayaH |
imaM deshamanuprAptA mama darshanalAlasAH
shlokas.12:
na cha mAM te dadRRishire na cha drakShyati kashchana |
RRite hyekAntikashreShThAttvaM chaivaikAntiko mataH
shlokas.13:
mamaitAstanavaH shreShThA jAtA dharmagRRihe dvija |
tAstvaM bhajasva satataM sAdhayasva yathAgatam
shlokas.14:
vRRiNIShva cha varaM vipra mattastvaM yamihechChasi |
prasanno.ahaM tavAdyeha vishvamUrtirihAvyayaH
shlokas.15:
nArada uvAcha||
adya me tapaso deva yamasya niyamasya cha |
sadyaH phalamavAptaM vai dRRiShTo yadbhagavAnmayA
shlokas.16:
vara eSha mamAtyantaM dRRiShTastvaM yatsanAtanaH |
bhagavAnvishvadRRiksiMhaH sarvamUrtirmahAprabhuH
shlokas.17:
bhIShma uvAcha||
evaM sa.ndarshayitvA tu nAradaM parameShThijam |
uvAcha vachanaM bhUyo gachCha nArada mAchiram
shlokas.18:
ime hyanindriyAhArA madbhaktAshchandravarchasaH |
ekAgrAshchintayeyurmAM naiShAM vighno bhavediti
shlokas.19:
siddhAshchaite mahAbhAgAH purA hyekAntino.abhavan |
tamorajovinirmuktA mAM pravekShyantyasa.nshayam
shlokas.20:
na dRRishyashchakShuShA yo.asau na spRRishyaH sparshanena cha |
na ghreyashchaiva gandhena rasena cha vivarjitaH
shlokas.21:
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva na guNAstaM bhajanti vai |
yashcha sarvagataH sAkShI lokasyAtmeti kathyate
shlokas.22:
bhUtagrAmasharIreShu nashyatsu na vinashyati |
ajo nityaH shAshvatashcha nirguNo niShkalastathA
shlokas.23:
dvirdvAdashebhyastattvebhyaH khyAto yaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH |
puruSho niShkriyashchaiva j~nAnadRRishyashcha kathyate
shlokas.24:
yaM pravishya bhavantIha muktA vai dvijasattama |
sa vAsudevo vij~neyaH paramAtmA sanAtanaH
shlokas.25:
pashya devasya mAhAtmyaM mahimAnaM cha nArada |
shubhAshubhaiH karmabhiryo na lipyati kadAchana
shlokas.26:
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva guNAnetAnprachakShate |
ete sarvasharIreShu tiShThanti vicharanti cha
shlokas.27:
etAnguNA.nstu kShetraj~no bhu~Nkte naibhiH sa bhujyate |
nirguNo guNabhukchaiva guNasraShTA guNAdhikaH
shlokas.28:
jagatpratiShThA devarShe pRRithivyapsu pralIyate |
jyotiShyApaH pralIyante jyotirvAyau pralIyate
shlokas.29:
khe vAyuH pralayaM yAti manasyAkAshameva cha |
mano hi paramaM bhUtaM tadavyakte pralIyate
shlokas.30:
avyaktaM puruShe brahmanniShkriye sampralIyate |
nAsti tasmAtparataraM puruShAdvai sanAtanAt
shlokas.31:
nityaM hi nAsti jagati bhUtaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
RRite tamekaM puruShaM vAsudevaM sanAtanam
sarvabhUtAtmabhUto hi vAsudevo mahAbalaH
shlokas.32:
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
te sametA mahAtmAnaH sharIramiti sa~nj~nitam
shlokas.33:
tadAvishati yo brahmannadRRishyo laghuvikramaH |
utpanna eva bhavati sharIraM cheShTayanprabhuH
shlokas.34:
na vinA dhAtusa~NghAtaM sharIraM bhavati kvachit |
na cha jIvaM vinA brahmandhAtavashcheShTayantyuta
shlokas.35:
sa jIvaH parisa~NkhyAtaH sheShaH sa~NkarShaNaH prabhuH |
tasmAtsanatkumAratvaM yo labheta svakarmaNA
shlokas.36:
yasmi.nshcha sarvabhUtAni pralayaM yAnti sa~NkShaye |
sa manaH sarvabhUtAnAM pradyumnaH paripaThyate
shlokas.37:
tasmAtprasUto yaH kartA kAryaM kAraNameva cha |
yasmAtsarvaM prabhavati jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam
so.aniruddhaH sa IshAno vyaktiH sA sarvakarmasu
shlokas.38:
yo vAsudevo bhagavAnkShetraj~no nirguNAtmakaH |
j~neyaH sa eva bhagavA~njIvaH sa~NkarShaNaH prabhuH
shlokas.39:
sa~NkarShaNAchcha pradyumno manobhUtaH sa uchyate |
pradyumnAdyo.aniruddhastu so.aha~NkAro maheshvaraH
shlokas.40:
mattaH sarvaM sambhavati jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
akSharaM cha kSharaM chaiva sachchAsachchaiva nArada
shlokas.41:
mAM pravishya bhavantIha muktA bhaktAstu ye mama |
ahaM hi puruSho j~neyo niShkriyaH pa~nchavi.nshakaH
shlokas.42:
nirguNo niShkalashchaiva nirdva.ndvo niShparigrahaH |
etattvayA na vij~neyaM rUpavAniti dRRishyate
ichChanmuhUrtAnnashyeyamIsho.ahaM jagato guruH
shlokas.43:
mAyA hyeShA mayA sRRiShTA yanmAM pashyasi nArada |
sarvabhUtaguNairyuktaM naivaM tvaM j~nAtumarhasi
mayaitatkathitaM samyaktava mUrtichatuShTayam
shlokas.44:
siddhA hyete mahAbhAgA narA hyekAntino.abhavan |
tamorajobhyAM nirmuktAH pravekShyanti cha mAM mune
shlokas.45:
ahaM kartA cha kAryaM cha kAraNaM chApi nArada |
ahaM hi jIvasa~nj~no vai mayi jIvaH samAhitaH
maivaM te buddhiratrAbhUddRRiShTo jIvo mayeti cha
shlokas.46:
ahaM sarvatrago brahmanbhUtagrAmAntarAtmakaH |
bhUtagrAmasharIreShu nashyatsu na nashAmyaham
shlokas.47:
hiraNyagarbho lokAdishchaturvaktro niruktagaH |
brahmA sanAtano devo mama bahvarthachintakaH
shlokas.48:
pashyaikAdasha me rudrAndakShiNaM pArshvamAsthitAn |
dvAdashaiva tathAdityAnvAmaM pArshvaM samAsthitAn
shlokas.49:
agratashchaiva me pashya vasUnaShTau surottamAn |
nAsatyaM chaiva dasraM cha bhiShajau pashya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.50:
sarvAnprajApatInpashya pashya sapta RRiShInapi |
vedAnyaj~nA.nshcha shatashaH pashyAmRRitamathauShadhIH
shlokas.51:
tapA.nsi niyamA.nshchaiva yamAnapi pRRithagvidhAn |
tathAShTaguNamaishvaryamekasthaM pashya mUrtimat
shlokas.52:
shriyaM lakShmIM cha kIrtiM cha pRRithivIM cha kakudminIm |
vedAnAM mAtaraM pashya matsthAM devIM sarasvatIm
shlokas.53:
dhruvaM cha jyotiShAM shreShThaM pashya nArada khecharam |
ambhodharAnsamudrA.nshcha sarA.nsi saritastathA
shlokas.54:
mUrtimantaH pitRRigaNA.nshchaturaH pashya sattama |
trI.nshchaivemAnguNAnpashya matsthAnmUrtivivarjitAn
shlokas.55:
devakAryAdapi mune pitRRikAryaM vishiShyate |
devAnAM cha pitR^INAM cha pitA hyeko.ahamAditaH
shlokas.56:
ahaM hayashiro bhUtvA samudre pashchimottare |
pibAmi suhutaM havyaM kavyaM cha shraddhayAnvitam
shlokas.57:
mayA sRRiShTaH purA brahmA madyaj~namayajatsvayam |
tatastasmai varAnprIto dadAvahamanuttamAn
shlokas.58:
matputratvaM cha kalpAdau lokAdhyakShatvameva cha |
aha~NkArakRRitaM chaiva nAma paryAyavAchakam
shlokas.59:
tvayA kRRitAM cha maryAdAM nAtikrAmyati kashchana |
tvaM chaiva varado brahmanvarepsUnAM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.60:
surAsuragaNAnAM cha RRiShINAM cha tapodhana |
pitR^INAM cha mahAbhAga satataM sa.nshitavrata
vividhAnAM cha bhUtAnAM tvamupAsyo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.61:
prAdurbhAvagatashchAhaM surakAryeShu nityadA |
anushAsyastvayA brahmanniyojyashcha suto yathA
shlokas.62:
etA.nshchAnyA.nshcha ruchirAnbrahmaNe.amitatejase |
ahaM dattvA varAnprIto nivRRittiparamo.abhavam
shlokas.63:
nirvANaM sarvadharmANAM nivRRittiH paramA smRRitA |
tasmAnnivRRittimApannashcharetsarvA~NganirvRRitaH
shlokas.64:
vidyAsahAyavantaM mAmAdityasthaM sanAtanam |
kapilaM prAhurAchAryAH sA~NkhyanishchitanishchayAH
shlokas.65:
hiraNyagarbho bhagavAneSha Chandasi suShTutaH |
so.ahaM yogagatirbrahmanyogashAstreShu shabditaH
shlokas.66:
eSho.ahaM vyaktimAgamya tiShThAmi divi shAshvataH |
tato yugasahasrAnte saMhariShye jagatpunaH
kRRitvAtmasthAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.67:
ekAkI vidyayA sArdhaM vihariShye dvijottama |
tato bhUyo jagatsarvaM kariShyAmIha vidyayA
shlokas.68:
asmanmUrtishchaturthI yA sAsRRijachCheShamavyayam |
sa hi sa~NkarShaNaH proktaH pradyumnaM so.apyajIjanat
shlokas.69:
