pradyumnAdaniruddho.ahaM sargo mama punaH punaH |
aniruddhAttathA brahmA tatrAdikamalodbhavaH
shlokas.70:
brahmaNaH sarvabhUtAni charANi sthAvarANi cha |
etAM sRRiShTiM vijAnIhi kalpAdiShu punaH punaH
shlokas.71:
yathA sUryasya gaganAdudayAstamayAviha |
naShTau punarbalAtkAla AnayatyamitadyutiH
tathA balAdahaM pRRithvIM sarvabhUtahitAya vai
shlokas.72:
sattvairAkrAntasarvA~NgAM naShTAM sAgaramekhalAm |
AnayiShyAmi svaM sthAnaM vArAhaM rUpamAsthitaH
shlokas.73:
hiraNyAkShaM haniShyAmi daiteyaM balagarvitam |
nArasiMhaM vapuH kRRitvA hiraNyakashipuM punaH
surakArye haniShyAmi yaj~naghnaM ditinandanam
shlokas.74:
virochanasya balavAnbaliH putro mahAsuraH |
bhaviShyati sa shakraM cha svarAjyAchchyAvayiShyati
shlokas.75:
trailokye.apahRRite tena vimukhe cha shachIpatau |
adityAM dvAdashaH putraH sambhaviShyAmi kashyapAt
shlokas.76:
tato rAjyaM pradAsyAmi shakrAyAmitatejase |
devatAH sthApayiShyAmi sveShu sthAneShu nArada
baliM chaiva kariShyAmi pAtAlatalavAsinam
shlokas.77:
tretAyuge bhaviShyAmi rAmo bhRRigukulodvahaH |
kShatraM chotsAdayiShyAmi samRRiddhabalavAhanam
shlokas.78:
sandhau tu samanuprApte tretAyAM dvAparasya cha |
rAmo dAsharathirbhUtvA bhaviShyAmi jagatpatiH
shlokas.79:
tritopaghAtAdvairUpyamekato.atha dvitastathA |
prApsyato vAnaratvaM hi prajApatisutAvRRiShI
shlokas.80:
tayorye tvanvaye jAtA bhaviShyanti vanaukasaH |
te sahAyA bhaviShyanti surakArye mama dvija
shlokas.81:
tato rakShaHpatiM ghoraM pulastyakulapA.nsanam |
haniShye rAvaNaM sa~Nkhye sagaNaM lokakaNTakam
shlokas.82:
dvAparasya kaleshchaiva sandhau paryavasAnike |
prAdurbhAvaH ka.nsahetormathurAyAM bhaviShyati
shlokas.83:
tatrAhaM dAnavAnhatvA subahUndevakaNTakAn |
kushasthalIM kariShyAmi nivAsaM dvArakAM purIm
shlokas.84:
vasAnastatra vai puryAmaditervipriya~Nkaram |
haniShye narakaM bhaumaM muraM pIThaM cha dAnavam
shlokas.85:
prAgjyotiShapuraM ramyaM nAnAdhanasamanvitam |
kushasthalIM nayiShyAmi hatvA vai dAnavottamAn
shlokas.86:
sha~NkaraM cha mahAsenaM bANapriyahitaiShiNam |
parAjeShyAmyathodyuktau devalokanamaskRRitau
shlokas.87:
tataH sutaM balerjitvA bANaM bAhusahasriNam |
vinAshayiShyAmi tataH sarvAnsaubhanivAsinaH
shlokas.88:
yaH kAlayavanaH khyAto gargatejobhisa.nvRRitaH |
bhaviShyati vadhastasya matta eva dvijottama
shlokas.89:
jarAsandhashcha balavAnsarvarAjavirodhakaH |
bhaviShyatyasuraH sphIto bhUmipAlo girivraje
mama buddhiparispandAdvadhastasya bhaviShyati
shlokas.90:
samAgateShu baliShu pRRithivyAM sarvarAjasu |
vAsaviH susahAyo vai mama hyeko bhaviShyati
shlokas.91:
evaM lokA vadiShyanti naranArAyaNAvRRiShI |
udyuktau dahataH kShatraM lokakAryArthamIshvarau
shlokas.92:
kRRitvA bhArAvataraNaM vasudhAyA yathepsitam |
sarvasAtvatamukhyAnAM dvArakAyAshcha sattama
kariShye pralayaM ghoramAtmaj~nAtivinAshanam
shlokas.93:
karmANyaparimeyAni chaturmUrtidharo hyaham |
kRRitvA lokAngamiShyAmi svAnahaM brahmasatkRRitAn
shlokas.94:
ha.nso hayashirAshchaiva prAdurbhAvA dvijottama |
yadA vedashrutirnaShTA mayA pratyAhRRitA tadA
savedAH sashrutIkAshcha kRRitAH pUrvaM kRRite yuge
shlokas.95:
atikrAntAH purANeShu shrutAste yadi vA kvachit |
atikrAntAshcha bahavaH prAdurbhAvA mamottamAH
lokakAryANi kRRitvA cha punaH svAM prakRRitiM gatAH
shlokas.96:
na hyetadbrahmaNA prAptamIdRRishaM mama darshanam |
yattvayA prAptamadyeha ekAntagatabuddhinA
shlokas.97:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM brahmanbhaktimato mayA |
purANaM cha bhaviShyaM cha sarahasyaM cha sattama
shlokas.98:
evaM sa bhagavAndevo vishvamUrtidharo.avyayaH |
etAvaduktvA vachanaM tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.99:
nArado.api mahAtejAH prApyAnugrahamIpsitam |
naranArAyaNau draShTuM prAdravadbadarAshramam
shlokas.100:
idaM mahopaniShadaM chaturvedasamanvitam |
sA~NkhyayogakRRitaM tena pa~ncharAtrAnushabditam
shlokas.101:
nArAyaNamukhodgItaM nArado.ashrAvayatpunaH |
brahmaNaH sadane tAta yathA dRRiShTaM yathA shrutam
shlokas.102:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
etadAshcharyabhUtaM hi mAhAtmyaM tasya dhImataH |
kiM brahmA na vijAnIte yataH shushrAva nAradAt
shlokas.103:
pitAmaho hi bhagavA.nstasmAddevAdanantaraH |
kathaM sa na vijAnIyAtprabhAvamamitaujasaH
shlokas.104:
bhIShma uvAcha||
mahAkalpasahasrANi mahAkalpashatAni cha |
samatItAni rAjendra sargAshcha pralayAshcha ha
shlokas.105:
sargasyAdau smRRito brahmA prajAsargakaraH prabhuH |
jAnAti devapravaraM bhUyashchAto.adhikaM nRRipa
paramAtmAnamIshAnamAtmanaH prabhavaM tathA
shlokas.106:
ye tvanye brahmasadane siddhasa~NghAH samAgatAH |
tebhyastachChrAvayAmAsa purANaM vedasaMmitam
shlokas.107:
teShAM sakAshAtsUryashcha shrutvA vai bhAvitAtmanAm |
AtmAnugAminAM brahma shrAvayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.108:
ShaTShaShTirhi sahasrANi RRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
sUryasya tapato lokAnnirmitA ye puraHsarAH
teShAmakathayatsUryaH sarveShAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.109:
sUryAnugAmibhistAta RRiShibhistairmahAtmabhiH |
merau samAgatA devAH shrAvitAshchedamuttamam
shlokas.110:
devAnAM tu sakAshAdvai tataH shrutvAsito dvijaH |
shrAvayAmAsa rAjendra pitR^INAM munisattamaH
shlokas.111:
mama chApi pitA tAta kathayAmAsa shantanuH |
tato mayaitachChrutvA cha kIrtitaM tava bhArata
shlokas.112:
surairvA munibhirvApi purANaM yairidaM shrutam |
sarve te paramAtmAnaM pUjayanti punaH punaH
shlokas.113:
idamAkhyAnamArSheyaM pAramparyAgataM nRRipa |
nAvAsudevabhaktAya tvayA deyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.114:
matto.anyAni cha te rAjannupAkhyAnashatAni vai |
yAni shrutAni dharmyANi teShAM sAro.ayamuddhRRitaH
shlokas.116:
yashchedaM paThate nityaM yashchedaM shRRiNuyAnnaraH |
ekAntabhAvopagata ekAnte susamAhitaH
shlokas.117:
prApya shvetaM mahAdvIpaM bhUtvA chandraprabho naraH |
sa sahasrArchiShaM devaM pravishennAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.118:
muchyedArtastathA rogAchChrutvemAmAditaH kathAm |
jij~nAsurlabhate kAmAnbhakto bhaktagatiM vrajet
shlokas.119:
tvayApi satataM rAjannabhyarchyaH puruShottamaH |
sa hi mAtA pitA chaiva kRRitsnasya jagato guruH
shlokas.120:
brahmaNyadevo bhagavAnprIyatAM te sanAtanaH |
yudhiShThira mahAbAho mahAbAhurjanArdanaH
shlokas.121:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvaitadAkhyAnavaraM dharmarADjanamejaya |
bhrAtarashchAsya te sarve nArAyaNaparAbhavan
shlokas.122:
jitaM bhagavatA tena puruSheNeti bhArata |
nityaM japyaparA bhUtvA sarasvatImudIrayan
shlokas.123:
yo hyasmAkaM guruH shreShThaH kRRiShNadvaipAyano muniH |
sa jagau paramaM japyaM nArAyaNamudIrayan
shlokas.124:
gatvAntarikShAtsatataM kShIrodamamRRitAshayam |
pUjayitvA cha deveshaM punarAyAtsvamAshramam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM sa bhagavAndevo yaj~neShvagraharaH prabhuH |
yaj~nadhArI cha satataM vedavedA~NgavittathA
shlokas.2:
nivRRittaM chAsthito dharmaM kShemI bhAgavatapriyaH |
pravRRittidharmAnvidadhe sa eva bhagavAnprabhuH
shlokas.3:
kathaM pravRRittidharmeShu bhAgArhA devatAH kRRitAH |
kathaM nivRRittidharmAshcha kRRitA vyAvRRittabuddhayaH
shlokas.4:
etaM naH sa.nshayaM vipra Chindhi guhyaM sanAtanam |
tvayA nArAyaNakathA shrutA vai dharmasaMhitA
shlokas.5:
ime sabrahmakA lokAH sasurAsuramAnavAH |
kriyAsvabhyudayoktAsu saktA dRRishyanti sarvashaH
mokShashchoktastvayA brahmannirvANaM paramaM sukham
shlokas.6:
ye cha muktA bhavantIha puNyapApavivarjitAH |
te sahasrArchiShaM devaM pravishantIti shushrumaH
shlokas.7:
aho hi duranuShTheyo mokShadharmaH sanAtanaH |
yaM hitvA devatAH sarvA havyakavyabhujo.abhavan
shlokas.8:
kiM nu brahmA cha rudrashcha shakrashcha balabhitprabhuH |
sUryastArAdhipo vAyuragnirvaruNa eva cha
AkAshaM jagatI chaiva ye cha sheShA divaukasaH
shlokas.9:
pralayaM na vijAnanti AtmanaH parinirmitam |
tataste nAsthitA mArgaM dhruvamakShayamavyayam
shlokas.10:
smRRitvA kAlaparImANaM pravRRittiM ye samAsthitAH |
doShaH kAlaparImANe mahAneSha kriyAvatAm
shlokas.11:
etanme sa.nshayaM vipra hRRidi shalyamivArpitam |
ChindhItihAsakathanAtparaM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.12:
kathaM bhAgaharAH proktA devatAH kratuShu dvija |
kimarthaM chAdhvare brahmannijyante tridivaukasaH
shlokas.13:
ye cha bhAgaM pragRRihNanti yaj~neShu dvijasattama |
te yajanto mahAyaj~naiH kasya bhAgaM dadanti vai
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
aho gUDhatamaH prashnastvayA pRRiShTo janeshvara |
nAtaptatapasA hyeSha nAvedaviduShA tathA
nApurANavidA chApi shakyo vyAhartuma~njasA
shlokas.15:
hanta te kathayiShyAmi yanme pRRiShTaH purA guruH |
kRRiShNadvaipAyano vyAso vedavyAso mahAnRRiShiH
shlokas.16:
sumanturjaiminishchaiva pailashcha sudRRiDhavrataH |
ahaM chaturthaH shiShyo vai pa~nchamashcha shukaH smRRitaH
shlokas.17:
etAnsamAgatAnsarvAnpa~ncha shiShyAndamAnvitAn |
shauchAchArasamAyuktA~njitakrodhA~njitendriyAn
shlokas.18:
vedAnadhyApayAmAsa mahAbhAratapa~nchamAn |
merau girivare ramye siddhachAraNasevite
shlokas.19:
teShAmabhyasyatAM vedAnkadAchitsa.nshayo.abhavat |
eSha vai yastvayA pRRiShTastena teShAM prakIrtitaH
tataH shruto mayA chApi tavAkhyeyo.adya bhArata
shlokas.20:
shiShyANAM vachanaM shrutvA sarvAj~nAnatamonudaH |
parAsharasutaH shrImAnvyAso vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.21:
mayA hi sumahattaptaM tapaH paramadAruNam |
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha jAnIyAmiti sattamAH
shlokas.22:
tasya me taptatapaso nigRRihItendriyasya cha |
nArAyaNaprasAdena kShIrodasyAnukUlataH
shlokas.23:
traikAlikamidaM j~nAnaM prAdurbhUtaM yathepsitam |
tachChRRiNudhvaM yathAj~nAnaM vakShye sa.nshayamuttamam
yathA vRRittaM hi kalpAdau dRRiShTaM me j~nAnachakShuShA
shlokas.24:
paramAtmeti yaM prAhuH sA~Nkhyayogavido janAH |
mahApuruShasa~nj~nAM sa labhate svena karmaNA
shlokas.25:
tasmAtprasUtamavyaktaM pradhAnaM tadvidurbudhAH |
avyaktAdvyaktamutpannaM lokasRRiShTyarthamIshvarAt
shlokas.26:
aniruddho hi lokeShu mahAnAtmeti kathyate |
yo.asau vyaktatvamApanno nirmame cha pitAmaham
so.aha~NkAra iti proktaH sarvatejomayo hi saH
shlokas.27:
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
aha~NkAraprasUtAni mahAbhUtAni bhArata
shlokas.28:
mahAbhUtAni sRRiShTvAtha tadguNAnnirmame punaH |
bhUtebhyashchaiva niShpannA mUrtimanto.aShTa tA~nshRRiNu
shlokas.29:
marIchira~NgirAshchAtriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
vasiShThashcha mahAtmA vai manuH svAyambhuvastathA
j~neyAH prakRRitayo.aShTau tA yAsu lokAH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.30:
vedAnvedA~Ngasa.nyuktAnyaj~nAnyaj~nA~Ngasa.nyutAn |
nirmame lokasiddhyarthaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH
aShTAbhyaH prakRRitibhyashcha jAtaM vishvamidaM jagat
shlokas.31:
rudro roShAtmako jAto dashAnyAnso.asRRijatsvayam |
ekAdashaite rudrAstu vikArAH puruShAH smRRitAH
shlokas.32:
te rudrAH prakRRitishchaiva sarve chaiva surarShayaH |
utpannA lokasiddhyarthaM brahmANaM samupasthitAH
shlokas.33:
vayaM hi sRRiShTA bhagava.nstvayA vai prabhaviShNunA |
yena yasminnadhIkAre vartitavyaM pitAmaha
shlokas.34:
yo.asau tvayA vinirdiShTo adhikAro.arthachintakaH |
paripAlyaH kathaM tena so.adhikAro.adhikAriNA
shlokas.35:
pradishasva balaM tasya yo.adhikArArthachintakaH |
evamukto mahAdevo devA.nstAnidamabravIt
shlokas.36:
sAdhvahaM j~nApito devA yuShmAbhirbhadramastu vaH |
mamApyeShA samutpannA chintA yA bhavatAM matA
shlokas.37:
lokatantrasya kRRitsnasya kathaM kAryaH parigrahaH |
kathaM balakShayo na syAdyuShmAkaM hyAtmanashcha me
shlokas.38:
itaH sarve.api gachChAmaH sharaNaM lokasAkShiNam |
mahApuruShamavyaktaM sa no vakShyati yaddhitam
shlokas.39:
tataste brahmaNA sArdhamRRiShayo vibudhAstathA |
kShIrodasyottaraM kUlaM jagmurlokahitArthinaH
shlokas.40:
te tapaH samupAtiShThanbrahmoktaM vedakalpitam |
sa mahAniyamo nAma tapashcharyA sudAruNA
shlokas.41:
UrdhvaM dRRiShTirbAhavashcha ekAgraM cha mano.abhavat |
ekapAdasthitAH samyakkAShThabhUtAH samAhitAH
shlokas.42:
divyaM varShasahasraM te tapastaptvA taduttamam |
shushruvurmadhurAM vANIM vedavedA~NgabhUShitAm
shlokas.43:
bho bhoH sabrahmakA devA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH |
svAgatenArchya vaH sarvA~nshrAvaye vAkyamuttamam
shlokas.44:
vij~nAtaM vo mayA kAryaM tachcha lokahitaM mahat |
pravRRittiyuktaM kartavyaM yuShmatprANopabRRiMhaNam
shlokas.45:
sutaptaM vastapo devA mamArAdhanakAmyayA |
bhokShyathAsya mahAsattvAstapasaH phalamuttamam
shlokas.46:
eSha brahmA lokaguruH sarvalokapitAmahaH |
yUyaM cha vibudhashreShThA mAM yajadhvaM samAhitAH
shlokas.47:
sarve bhAgAnkalpayadhvaM yaj~neShu mama nityashaH |
tathA shreyo vidhAsyAmi yathAdhIkAramIshvarAH
shlokas.48:
shrutvaitaddevadevasya vAkyaM hRRiShTatanUruhAH |
tataste vibudhAH sarve brahmA te cha maharShayaH
shlokas.49:
vedadRRiShTena vidhinA vaiShNavaM kratumAharan |
tasminsatre tadA brahmA svayaM bhAgamakalpayat
devA devarShayashchaiva sarve bhAgAnakalpayan
shlokas.50:
te kArtayugadharmANo bhAgAH paramasatkRRitAH |
prApurAdityavarNaM taM puruShaM tamasaH param
bRRihantaM sarvagaM devamIshAnaM varadaM prabhum
shlokas.51:
tato.atha varado devastAnsarvAnamarAnsthitAn |
asharIro babhAShedaM vAkyaM khastho maheshvaraH
shlokas.52:
yena yaH kalpito bhAgaH sa tathA samupAgataH |
prIto.ahaM pradishAmyadya phalamAvRRittilakShaNam
shlokas.53:
etadvo lakShaNaM devA matprasAdasamudbhavam |
yUyaM yaj~nairijyamAnAH samAptavaradakShiNaiH
yuge yuge bhaviShyadhvaM pravRRittiphalabhoginaH
shlokas.54:
yaj~nairye chApi yakShyanti sarvalokeShu vai surAH |
kalpayiShyanti vo bhAgA.nste narA vedakalpitAn
shlokas.55:
yo me yathA kalpitavAnbhAgamasminmahAkratau |
sa tathA yaj~nabhAgArho vedasUtre mayA kRRitaH
shlokas.56:
yUyaM lokAndhArayadhvaM yaj~nabhAgaphaloditAH |
sarvArthachintakA loke yathAdhIkAranirmitAH
shlokas.57:
yAH kriyAH prachariShyanti pravRRittiphalasatkRRitAH |
tAbhirApyAyitabalA lokAnvai dhArayiShyatha
shlokas.58:
yUyaM hi bhAvitA loke sarvayaj~neShu mAnavaiH |
mAM tato bhAvayiShyadhvameShA vo bhAvanA mama
shlokas.59:
ityarthaM nirmitA vedA yaj~nAshchauShadhibhiH saha |
ebhiH samyakprayuktairhi prIyante devatAH kShitau
shlokas.60:
nirmANametadyuShmAkaM pravRRittiguNakalpitam |
mayA kRRitaM surashreShThA yAvatkalpakShayAditi
chintayadhvaM lokahitaM yathAdhIkAramIshvarAH
shlokas.61:
marIchira~NgirAshchAtriH pulastyaH pulahaH kratuH |
vasiShTha iti saptaite mAnasA nirmitA hi vai
shlokas.62:
ete vedavido mukhyA vedAchAryAshcha kalpitAH |
pravRRittidharmiNashchaiva prAjApatyena kalpitAH
shlokas.63:
ayaM kriyAvatAM panthA vyaktIbhUtaH sanAtanaH |
aniruddha iti prokto lokasargakaraH prabhuH
shlokas.64:
sanaH sanatsujAtashcha sanakaH sasanandanaH |
sanatkumAraH kapilaH saptamashcha sanAtanaH
shlokas.65:
saptaite mAnasAH proktA RRiShayo brahmaNaH sutAH |
svayamAgatavij~nAnA nivRRittaM dharmamAsthitAH
shlokas.66:
ete yogavido mukhyAH sA~NkhyadharmavidastathA |
AchAryA mokShashAstre cha mokShadharmapravartakAH
shlokas.67:
yato.ahaM prasRRitaH pUrvamavyaktAttriguNo mahAn |
tasmAtparataro yo.asau kShetraj~na iti kalpitaH
so.ahaM kriyAvatAM panthAH punarAvRRittidurlabhaH
shlokas.68:
yo yathA nirmito janturyasminyasmi.nshcha karmaNi |
pravRRittau vA nivRRittau vA tatphalaM so.ashnute.avashaH
shlokas.69:
eSha lokagururbrahmA jagadAdikaraH prabhuH |
eSha mAtA pitA chaiva yuShmAkaM cha pitAmahaH
mayAnushiShTo bhavitA sarvabhUtavarapradaH
shlokas.70:
asya chaivAnujo rudro lalATAdyaH samutthitaH |
brahmAnushiShTo bhavitA sarvatrasavarapradaH
shlokas.71:
gachChadhvaM svAnadhIkArA.nshchintayadhvaM yathAvidhi |
pravartantAM kriyAH sarvAH sarvalokeShu mAchiram
shlokas.72:
pradRRishyantAM cha karmANi prANinAM gatayastathA |
parinirmitakAlAni AyUMShi cha surottamAH
shlokas.73:
idaM kRRitayugaM nAma kAlaH shreShThaH pravartate |
ahi.nsyA yaj~napashavo yuge.asminnaitadanyathA
chatuShpAtsakalo dharmo bhaviShyatyatra vai surAH
shlokas.74:
tatastretAyugaM nAma trayI yatra bhaviShyati |
prokShitA yatra pashavo vadhaM prApsyanti vai makhe
tatra pAdachaturtho vai dharmasya na bhaviShyati
shlokas.75:
tato vai dvAparaM nAma mishraH kAlo bhaviShyati |
dvipAdahIno dharmashcha yuge tasminbhaviShyati
shlokas.76:
tatastiShye.atha samprApte yuge kalipuraskRRite |
ekapAdasthito dharmo yatra tatra bhaviShyati
shlokas.77:
devA UchuH||
ekapAdasthite dharme yatrakvachanagAmini |
kathaM kartavyamasmAbhirbhagava.nstadvadasva naH
shlokas.78:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
yatra vedAshcha yaj~nAshcha tapaH satyaM damastathA |
ahi.nsAdharmasa.nyuktAH prachareyuH surottamAH
sa vai deshaH sevitavyo mA vo.adharmaH padA spRRishet
shlokas.79:
vyAsa uvAcha||
te.anushiShTA bhagavatA devAH sarShigaNAstathA |
namaskRRitvA bhagavate jagmurdeshAnyathepsitAn
shlokas.80:
gateShu tridivaukaHsu brahmaikaH paryavasthitaH |
didRRikShurbhagavantaM tamaniruddhatanau sthitam
shlokas.81:
taM devo darshayAmAsa kRRitvA hayashiro mahat |
sA~NgAnAvartayanvedAnkamaNDalugaNitradhRRik
shlokas.82:
tato.ashvashirasaM dRRiShTvA taM devamamitaujasam |
lokakartA prabhurbrahmA lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.83:
mUrdhnA praNamya varadaM tasthau prA~njaliragrataH |
sa pariShvajya devena vachanaM shrAvitastadA
shlokas.84:
lokakAryagatIH sarvAstvaM chintaya yathAvidhi |
dhAtA tvaM sarvabhUtAnAM tvaM prabhurjagato guruH
tvayyAveshitabhAro.ahaM dhRRitiM prApsyAmyathA~njasA
shlokas.85:
yadA cha surakAryaM te aviShahyaM bhaviShyati |
prAdurbhAvaM gamiShyAmi tadAtmaj~nAnadeshikaH
shlokas.86:
evamuktvA hayashirAstatraivAntaradhIyata |
tenAnushiShTo brahmApi svaM lokamachirAdgataH
shlokas.87:
evameSha mahAbhAgaH padmanAbhaH sanAtanaH |
yaj~neShvagraharaH prokto yaj~nadhArI cha nityadA
shlokas.88:
nivRRittiM chAsthito dharmaM gatimakShayadharmiNAm |
pravRRittidharmAnvidadhe kRRitvA lokasya chitratAm
shlokas.89:
sa AdiH sa madhyaH sa chAntaH prajAnAM; sa dhAtA sa dheyaH sa kartA sa kAryam |
yugAnte sa suptaH susa~NkShipya lokA;nyugAdau prabuddho jagaddhyutsasarja
shlokas.90:
tasmai namadhvaM devAya nirguNAya guNAtmane |
ajAya vishvarUpAya dhAmne sarvadivaukasAm
shlokas.91:
mahAbhUtAdhipataye rudrANAM pataye tathA |
Adityapataye chaiva vasUnAM pataye tathA
shlokas.92:
ashvibhyAM pataye chaiva marutAM pataye tathA |
vedayaj~nAdhipataye vedA~Ngapataye.api cha
shlokas.93:
samudravAsine nityaM haraye mu~njakeshine |
shAntaye sarvabhUtAnAM mokShadharmAnubhAShiNe
shlokas.94:
tapasAM tejasAM chaiva pataye yashaso.api cha |
vAchashcha pataye nityaM saritAM pataye tathA
shlokas.95:
kapardine varAhAya ekashRRi~NgAya dhImate |
vivasvate.ashvashirase chaturmUrtidhRRite sadA
shlokas.96:
guhyAya j~nAnadRRishyAya akSharAya kSharAya cha |
eSha devaH sa~ncharati sarvatragatiravyayaH
shlokas.97:
evametatpurA dRRiShTaM mayA vai j~nAnachakShuShA |
kathitaM tachcha vaH sarvaM mayA pRRiShTena tattvataH
shlokas.98:
kriyatAM madvachaH shiShyAH sevyatAM harirIshvaraH |
gIyatAM vedashabdaishcha pUjyatAM cha yathAvidhi
shlokas.99:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktAstu vayaM tena vedavyAsena dhImatA |
sarve shiShyAH sutashchAsya shukaH paramadharmavit
shlokas.100:
sa chAsmAkamupAdhyAyaH sahAsmAbhirvishAM pate |
chaturvedodgatAbhishcha RRigbhistamabhituShTuve
shlokas.101:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
evaM me.akathayadrAjanpurA dvaipAyano guruH
shlokas.102:
yashchedaM shRRiNuyAnnityaM yashchedaM parikIrtayet |
namo bhagavate kRRitvA samAhitamanA naraH
shlokas.103:
bhavatyarogo dyutimAnbalarUpasamanvitaH |
Aturo muchyate rogAdbaddho muchyeta bandhanAt
shlokas.104:
kAmakAmI labhetkAmaM dIrghamAyuravApnuyAt |
brAhmaNaH sarvavedI syAtkShatriyo vijayI bhavet
vaishyo vipulalAbhaH syAchChUdraH sukhamavApnuyAt
shlokas.105:
aputro labhate putraM kanyA chaivepsitaM patim |
lagnagarbhA vimuchyeta garbhiNI janayetsutam
vandhyA prasavamApnoti putrapautrasamRRiddhimat
shlokas.106:
kShemeNa gachChedadhvAnamidaM yaH paThate pathi |
yo yaM kAmaM kAmayate sa tamApnoti cha dhruvam
shlokas.107:
idaM maharShervachanaM vinishchitaM; mahAtmanaH puruShavarasya kIrtanam |
samAgamaM charShidivaukasAmimaM; nishamya bhaktAH susukhaM labhante

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
astauShIdyairimaM vyAsaH sashiShyo madhusUdanam |
nAmabhirvividhaireShAM niruktaM bhagavanmama
shlokas.2:
vaktumarhasi shushrUShoH prajApatipaterhareH |
shrutvA bhaveyaM yatpUtaH sharachchandra ivAmalaH
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathAchaShTa phalgunasya harirvibhuH |
prasannAtmAtmano nAmnAM niruktaM guNakarmajam
shlokas.4:
nAmabhiH kIrtitaistasya keshavasya mahAtmanaH |
pRRiShTavAnkeshavaM rAjanphalgunaH paravIrahA
shlokas.5:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhagavanbhUtabhavyesha sarvabhUtasRRigavyaya |
lokadhAma jagannAtha lokAnAmabhayaprada
shlokas.6:
yAni nAmAni te deva kIrtitAni maharShibhiH |
vedeShu sapurANeShu yAni guhyAni karmabhiH
shlokas.7:
teShAM niruktaM tvatto.ahaM shrotumichChAmi keshava |
na hyanyo vartayennAmnAM niruktaM tvAmRRite prabho
shlokas.8:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
RRigvede sayajurvede tathaivAtharvasAmasu |
purANe sopaniShade tathaiva jyotiShe.arjuna
shlokas.9:
sA~Nkhye cha yogashAstre cha Ayurvede tathaiva cha |
bahUni mama nAmAni kIrtitAni maharShibhiH
shlokas.10:
gauNAni tatra nAmAni karmajAni cha kAnichit |
niruktaM karmajAnAM cha shRRiNuShva prayato.anagha
kathyamAnaM mayA tAta tvaM hi me.ardhaM smRRitaH purA
shlokas.11:
namo.atiyashase tasmai dehinAM paramAtmane |
nArAyaNAya vishvAya nirguNAya guNAtmane
shlokas.12:
yasya prasAdajo brahmA rudrashcha krodhasambhavaH |
yo.asau yonirhi sarvasya sthAvarasya charasya cha
shlokas.13:
aShTAdashaguNaM yattatsattvaM sattvavatAM vara |
prakRRitiH sA parA mahyaM rodasI yogadhAriNI
RRitA satyAmarAjayyA lokAnAmAtmasa~nj~nitA
shlokas.14:
tasmAtsarvAH pravartante sargapralayavikriyAH |
tato yaj~nashcha yaShTA cha purANaH puruSho virAT
aniruddha iti prokto lokAnAM prabhavApyayaH
shlokas.15:
brAhme rAtrikShaye prApte tasya hyamitatejasaH |
prasAdAtprAdurabhavatpadmaM padmanibhekShaNa
tatra brahmA samabhavatsa tasyaiva prasAdajaH
shlokas.16:
ahnaH kShaye lalATAchcha suto devasya vai tathA |
krodhAviShTasya sa~njaj~ne rudraH saMhArakArakaH
shlokas.17:
etau dvau vibudhashreShThau prasAdakrodhajau smRRitau |
tadAdeshitapanthAnau sRRiShTisaMhArakArakau
nimittamAtraM tAvatra sarvaprANivarapradau
shlokas.18:
kapardI jaTilo muNDaH shmashAnagRRihasevakaH |
ugravratadharo rudro yogI tripuradAruNaH
shlokas.19:
dakShakratuharashchaiva bhaganetraharastathA |
nArAyaNAtmako j~neyaH pANDaveya yuge yuge
shlokas.20:
tasminhi pUjyamAne vai devadeve maheshvare |
sampUjito bhavetpArtha devo nArAyaNaH prabhuH
shlokas.21:
ahamAtmA hi lokAnAM vishvAnAM pANDunandana |
tasmAdAtmAnamevAgre rudraM sampUjayAmyaham
shlokas.22:
yadyahaM nArchayeyaM vai IshAnaM varadaM shivam |
AtmAnaM nArchayetkashchiditi me bhAvitaM manaH
mayA pramANaM hi kRRitaM lokaH samanuvartate
shlokas.23:
pramANAni hi pUjyAni tatastaM pUjayAmyaham |
yastaM vetti sa mAM vetti yo.anu taM sa hi mAmanu
shlokas.24:
rudro nArAyaNashchaiva sattvamekaM dvidhAkRRitam |
loke charati kaunteya vyaktisthaM sarvakarmasu
shlokas.25:
na hi me kenachiddeyo varaH pANDavanandana |
iti sa~nchintya manasA purANaM vishvamIshvaram
putrArthamArAdhitavAnAtmAnamahamAtmanA
shlokas.26:
na hi viShNuH praNamati kasmaichidvibudhAya tu |
RRita AtmAnameveti tato rudraM bhajAmyaham
shlokas.27:
sabrahmakAH sarudrAshcha sendrA devAH saharShibhiH |
archayanti surashreShThaM devaM nArAyaNaM harim
shlokas.28:
bhaviShyatAM vartatAM cha bhUtAnAM chaiva bhArata |
sarveShAmagraNIrviShNuH sevyaH pUjyashcha nityashaH
shlokas.29:
namasva havyadaM viShNuM tathA sharaNadaM nama |
varadaM namasva kaunteya havyakavyabhujaM nama
shlokas.30:
chaturvidhA mama janA bhaktA evaM hi te shrutam |
teShAmekAntinaH shreShThAste chaivAnanyadevatAH
ahameva gatisteShAM nirAshIHkarmakAriNAm
shlokas.31:
ye cha shiShTAstrayo bhaktAH phalakAmA hi te matAH |
sarve chyavanadharmANaH pratibuddhastu shreShThabhAk
shlokas.32:
brahmANaM shitikaNThaM cha yAshchAnyA devatAH smRRitAH |
prabuddhavaryAH sevante mAmevaiShyanti yatparam
bhaktaM prati visheShaste eSha pArthAnukIrtitaH
shlokas.33:
tvaM chaivAhaM cha kaunteya naranArAyaNau smRRitau |
bhArAvataraNArthaM hi praviShTau mAnuShIM tanum
shlokas.34:
jAnAmyadhyAtmayogA.nshcha yo.ahaM yasmAchcha bhArata |
nivRRittilakShaNo dharmastathAbhyudayiko.api cha
shlokas.35:
narANAmayanaM khyAtamahamekaH sanAtanaH |
Apo nArA iti proktA Apo vai narasUnavaH
ayanaM mama tatpUrvamato nArAyaNo hyaham
shlokas.36:
ChAdayAmi jagadvishvaM bhUtvA sUrya ivA.nshubhiH |
sarvabhUtAdhivAsashcha vAsudevastato hyaham
shlokas.37:
gatishcha sarvabhUtAnAM prajAnAM chApi bhArata |
vyAptA me rodasI pArtha kAntishchAbhyadhikA mama
shlokas.38:
adhibhUtAni chAnte.ahaM tadichCha.nshchAsmi bhArata |
kramaNAchchApyahaM pArtha viShNurityabhisa~nj~nitaH
shlokas.39:
damAtsiddhiM parIpsanto mAM janAH kAmayanti hi |
divaM chorvIM cha madhyaM cha tasmAddAmodaro hyaham
shlokas.40:
pRRishnirityuchyate chAnnaM vedA Apo.amRRitaM tathA |
mamaitAni sadA garbhe pRRishnigarbhastato hyaham
shlokas.41:
RRiShayaH prAhurevaM mAM tritakUpAbhipAtitam |
pRRishnigarbha tritaM pAhItyekatadvitapAtitam
shlokas.42:
tataH sa brahmaNaH putra Adyo RRiShivarastritaH |
uttatArodapAnAdvai pRRishnigarbhAnukIrtanAt
shlokas.43:
sUryasya tapato lokAnagneH somasya chApyuta |
a.nshavo ye prakAshante mama te keshasa~nj~nitAH
sarvaj~nAH keshavaM tasmAnmAmAhurdvijasattamAH
shlokas.44:
svapatnyAmAhito garbha utathyena mahAtmanA |
utathye.antarhite chaiva kadAchiddevamAyayA
bRRihaspatirathAvindattAM patnIM tasya bhArata
shlokas.45:
tato vai tamRRiShishreShThaM maithunopagataM tathA |
uvAcha garbhaH kaunteya pa~nchabhUtasamanvitaH
shlokas.46:
pUrvAgato.ahaM varada nArhasyambAM prabAdhitum |
etadbRRihaspatiH shrutvA chukrodha cha shashApa cha
shlokas.47:
maithunopagato yasmAttvayAhaM vinivAritaH |
tasmAdandho jAsyasi tvaM machChApAnnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.48:
sa shApAdRRiShimukhyasya dIrghaM tama upeyivAn |
sa hi dIrghatamA nAma nAmnA hyAsIdRRiShiH purA
shlokas.49:
vedAnavApya chaturaH sA~NgopA~NgAnsanAtanAn |
prayojayAmAsa tadA nAma guhyamidaM mama
shlokas.50:
AnupUrvyeNa vidhinA keshaveti punaH punaH |
sa chakShuShmAnsamabhavadgautamashchAbhavatpunaH
shlokas.51:
evaM hi varadaM nAma keshaveti mamArjuna |
devAnAmatha sarveShAmRRiShINAM cha mahAtmanAm
shlokas.52:
agniH somena sa.nyukta ekayoni mukhaM kRRitam |
agnIShomAtmakaM tasmAjjagatkRRitsnaM charAcharam
shlokas.53:
api hi purANe bhavati
ekayonyAtmakAvagnIShomau
devAshchAgnimukhA iti
ekayonitvAchcha parasparaM mahayanto lokAndhArayata iti

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
agnIShomau kathaM pUrvamekayonI pravartitau |
eSha me sa.nshayo jAtastaM Chindhi madhusUdana
shlokas.2:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
hanta te vartayiShyAmi purANaM pANDunandana |
AtmatejodbhavaM pArtha shRRiNuShvaikamanA mama
shlokas.3:
samprakShAlanakAle.atikrAnte chaturthe yugasahasrAnte
avyakte sarvabhUtapralaye sthAvaraja~Ngame
jyotirdharaNivAyurahite.andhe tamasi jalaikArNave loke
tama ityevAbhibhUte.asa~nj~nake.advitIye pratiShThite
naiva rAtryAM na divase na sati nAsati na vyakte nAvyakte vyavasthite
etasyAmavasthAyAM nArAyaNaguNAshrayAdakShayAdajarAdanindriyAdagrAhyAdasambhavAtsatyAdahi.nsrAllalAmAdvividhapravRRittivisheShAt
akShayAdajarAmarAdamUrtitaH sarvavyApinaH sarvakartuH
shAshvatAttamasaH puruShaH prAdurbhUto hariravyayaH
shlokas.4:
nidarshanamapi hyatra bhavati
nAsIdaho na rAtrirAsIt
na sadAsInnAsadAsIt
tama eva purastAdabhavadvishvarUpam
sA vishvasya jananItyevamasyArtho.anubhAShyate
shlokas.5:
tasyedAnIM tamaHsambhavasya puruShasya padmayonerbrahmaNaH prAdurbhAve sa puruShaH prajAH sisRRikShamANo netrAbhyAmagnIShomau sasarja
tato bhUtasarge pravRRitte prajAkramavashAdbrahmakShatramupAtiShThat
yaH somastadbrahma yadbrahma te brAhmaNAH
yo.agnistatkShatraM kShatrAdbrahma balavattaram
kasmAditi lokapratyakShaguNametattadyathA
brAhmaNebhyaH paraM bhUtaM notpannapUrvam
dIpyamAne.agnau juhotIti kRRitvA bravImi
bhUtasargaH kRRito brahmaNA bhUtAni cha pratiShThApya trailokyaM
dhAryata iti
shlokas.6:
mantravAdo.api hi bhavati
tvamagne yaj~nAnAM hotA vishveShAm
hito devebhirmAnuShe jane iti
nidarshanaM chAtra bhavati
vishveShAmagne yaj~nAnAM hoteti
hito devairmAnuShairjagata iti
agnirhi yaj~nAnAM hotA kartA
sa chAgnirbrahma
shlokas.7:
na hyRRite mantrAddhavanamasti
na vinA puruShaM tapaH sambhavati
havirmantrANAM sampUjA vidyate devamanuShyANAmanena tvaM hoteti niyuktaH
ye cha mAnuShA hotrAdhikArAste cha
brAhmaNasya hi yAjanaM vidhIyate na kShatravaishyayordvijAtyoH
tasmAdbrAhmaNA hyagnibhUtA yaj~nAnudvahanti
yaj~nA devA.nstarpayanti devAH pRRithivIM bhAvayanti
shlokas.8:
shatapathe hi brAhmaNaM bhavati
agnau samiddhe sa juhoti yo vidvAnbrAhmaNamukhe dAnAhutiM juhoti
evamapyagnibhUtA brAhmaNA vidvA.nso.agniM bhAvayanti
agnirviShNuH sarvabhUtAnyanupravishya prANAndhArayati
api chAtra sanatkumAragItAH shlokA bhavanti
shlokas.9:
vishvaM brahmAsRRijatpUrvaM sarvAdirniravaskaram |
brahmaghoShairdivaM tiShThantyamarA brahmayonayaH
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNAnAM matirvAkyaM karma shraddhA tapA.nsi cha |
dhArayanti mahIM dyAM cha shaityAdvAryamRRitaM yathA
shlokas.11:
nAsti satyAtparo dharmo nAsti mAtRRisamo guruH |
brAhmaNebhyaH paraM nAsti pretya cheha cha bhUtaye
shlokas.12:
naiShAmukShA vardhate nota vAhA; na gargaro mathyate sampradAne |
apadhvastA dasyubhUtA bhavanti; yeShAM rAShTre brAhmaNA vRRittihInAH
shlokas.13:
vedapurANetihAsaprAmANyAnnArAyaNamukhodgatAH sarvAtmAnaH sarvakartAraH sarvabhAvanAshcha brAhmaNAH
vAksamakAlaM hi tasya devasya varapradasya brAhmaNAH prathamaM prAdurbhUtA brAhmaNebhyashcha sheShA varNAH prAdurbhUtAH
itthaM cha surAsuravishiShTA brAhmaNA yadA mayA brahmabhUtena purA
svayamevotpAditAH surAsuramaharShayo bhUtavisheShAH sthApitA nigRRihItAshcha
shlokas.14:
ahalyAdharShaNanimittaM hi gautamAddharishmashrutAmindraH prAptaH
kaushikanimittaM chendro muShkaviyogaM meShavRRiShaNatvaM chAvApa
ashvinorgrahapratiShedhodyatavajrasya pura.ndarasya chyavanena stambhito bAhuH
kratuvadhaprAptamanyunA cha dakSheNa bhUyastapasA chAtmAnaM sa.nyojya netrAkRRitiranyA lalATe rudrasyotpAditA
shlokas.15:
tripuravadhArthaM dIkShAmabhyupagatasya rudrasyoshanasA shiraso jaTA utkRRitya prayuktAH
tataH prAdurbhUtA bhujagAH
tairasya bhujagaiH pIDyamAnaH kaNTho nIlatAmupanItaH
pUrve cha manvantare svAyambhuve nArAyaNahastabandhagrahaNAnnIlakaNThatvameva vA
shlokas.16:
amRRitotpAdane purashcharaNatAmupagatasyA~Ngiraso bRRihaspaterupaspRRishato na prasAdaM gatavatyaH kilApaH
atha bRRihaspatirapAM chukrodha
yasmAnmamopaspRRishataH kaluShIbhUtA na prasAdamupagatAstasmAdadyaprabhRRiti jhaShamakaramatsyakachChapajantusa~NkIrNAH kaluShIbhavateti
tadAprabhRRityApo yAdobhiH sa~NkIrNAH sa.nvRRittAH
shlokas.17:
vishvarUpo vai tvAShTraH purohito devAnAmAsItsvasrIyo.asurANAm
sa pratyakShaM devebhyo bhAgamadadatparokShamasurebhyaH
shlokas.18:
atha hiraNyakashipuM puraskRRitya vishvarUpamAtaraM svasAramasurA varamayAchanta
he svasarayaM te putrastvAShTro vishvarUpastrishirA devAnAM purohitaH pratyakShaM devebhyo bhAgamadadatparokShamasmAkam
tato devA vardhante vayaM kShIyAmaH
tadenaM tvaM vArayitumarhasi tathA yathAsmAnbhajediti
shlokas.19:
atha vishvarUpaM nandanavanamupagataM mAtovAcha
putra kiM parapakShavardhanastvaM mAtulapakShaM nAshayasi
nArhasyevaM kartumiti
sa vishvarUpo mAturvAkyamanatikramaNIyamiti matvA sampUjya hiraNyakashipumagAt
shlokas.20:
hairaNyagarbhAchcha vasiShThAddhiraNyakashipuH shApaM prAptavAn
yasmAttvayAnyo vRRito hotA tasmAdasamAptayaj~nastvamapUrvAtsattvajAtAdvadhaM prApsyasIti
tachChApadAnAddhiraNyakashipuH prAptavAnvadham
shlokas.21:
vishvarUpo mAtRRipakShavardhano.atyarthaM tapasyabhavat
tasya vratabha~NgArthamindro bahvIH shrImatyo.apsaraso niyuyoja
tAshcha dRRiShTvA manaH kShubhitaM tasyAbhavattAsu chApsaraHsu nachirAdeva sakto.abhavat
saktaM chainaM j~nAtvApsarasa UchurgachChAmahe vayaM yathAgatamiti
shlokas.22:
tAstvAShTra uvAcha
kva gamiShyatha AsyatAM tAvanmayA saha shreyo bhaviShyatIti
tAstamabruvan
vayaM devastriyo.apsarasa indraM varadaM purA prabhaviShNuM vRRiNImaha iti
shlokas.23:
atha tA vishvarUpo.abravIdadyaiva sendrA devA na bhaviShyantIti
tato mantrA~njajApa
tairmantraiH prAvardhata trishirAH
ekenAsyena sarvalokeShu dvijaiH kriyAvadbhiryaj~neShu suhutaM somaM papAvekenApa ekena sendrAndevAn
athendrastaM vivardhamAnaM somapAnApyAyitasarvagAtraM dRRiShTvA chintAmApede
shlokas.24:
devAshcha te sahendreNa brahmANamabhijagmurUchushcha
vishvarUpeNa sarvayaj~neShu suhutaH somaH pIyate
vayamabhAgAH sa.nvRRittAH
asurapakSho vardhate vayaM kShIyAmaH
tadarhasi no vidhAtuM shreyo yadanantaramiti
shlokas.25:
tAnbrahmovAcha RRiShirbhArgavastapastapyate dadhIchaH
sa yAchyatAM varaM yathA kalevaraM jahyAt
tasyAsthibhirvajraM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.26:
devAstatrAgachChanyatra dadhIcho bhagavAnRRiShistapastepe
sendrA devAstamabhigamyochurbhagava.nstapasaH kushalamavighnaM cheti
tAndadhIcha uvAcha svAgataM bhavadbhyaH kiM kriyatAm
yadvakShyatha tatkariShyAmIti
te tamabruva~nsharIraparityAgaM lokahitArthaM bhagavAnkartumarhatIti
atha dadhIchastathaivAvimanAH sukhaduHkhasamo mahAyogI AtmAnaM
samAdhAya sharIraparityAgaM chakAra
shlokas.27:
tasya paramAtmanyavasRRite tAnyasthIni dhAtA sa~NgRRihya vajramakarot
tena vajreNAbhedyenApradhRRiShyeNa brahmAsthisambhUtena viShNupraviShTenendro vishvarUpaM jaghAna
shirasAM chAsya Chedanamakarot
tasmAdanantaraM vishvarUpagAtramathanasambhavaM tvaShTrotpAditamevAriM vRRitramindro jaghAna
shlokas.28:
tasyAM dvaidhIbhUtAyAM brahmavadhyAyAM bhayAdindro devarAjyaM parityajya apsu sambhavAM shItalAM mAnasasarogatAM nalinIM prapede
tatra chaishvaryayogAdaNumAtro bhUtvA bisagranthiM pravivesha
shlokas.29:
atha brahmavadhyAbhayapranaShTe trailokyanAthe shachIpatau jagadanIshvaraM babhUva
devAnrajastamashchAvivesha
mantrA na prAvartanta maharShINAm
rakShA.nsi prAdurabhavan
brahma chotsAdanaM jagAma
anindrAshchAbalA lokAH supradhRRiShyA babhUvuH
shlokas.30:
atha devA RRiShayashchAyuShaH putraM nahuShaM nAma devarAjatve.abhiShiShichuH
nahuShaH pa~nchabhiH shatairjyotiShAM lalATe jvaladbhiH sarvatejoharaistriviShTapaM pAlayAM babhUva
atha lokAH prakRRitimApedire svasthAshcha babhUvuH
shlokas.31:
athovAcha nahuShaH
sarvaM mAM shakropabhuktamupasthitamRRite shachImiti
sa evamuktvA shachIsamIpamagamaduvAcha chainAm
subhage.ahamindro devAnAM bhajasva mAmiti
taM shachI pratyuvAcha
prakRRityA tvaM dharmavatsalaH somava.nshodbhavashcha
nArhasi parapatnIdharShaNaM kartumiti
shlokas.32:
tAmathovAcha nahuShaH
aindraM padamadhyAsyate mayA
ahamindrasya rAjyaratnaharo nAtrAdharmaH kashchittvamindrabhukteti
sA tamuvAcha
asti mama ki~nchidvratamaparyavasitam
tasyAvabhRRithe tvAmupagamiShyAmi kaishchidevAhobhiriti
sa shachyaivamabhihito nahuSho jagAma
shlokas.33:
atha shachI duHkhashokArtA bhartRRidarshanalAlasA nahuShabhayagRRihItA bRRihaspatimupAgachChat
sa cha tAmabhigatAM dRRiShTvaiva dhyAnaM pravishya bhartRRikAryatatparAM j~nAtvA bRRihaspatiruvAcha
anenaiva vratena tapasA chAnvitA devIM varadAmupashrutimAhvaya
sA tavendraM darshayiShyatIti
shlokas.34:
sAtha mahAniyamamAsthitA devIM varadAmupashrutiM mantrairAhvayat
sopashrutiH shachIsamIpamagAt
uvAcha chainAmiyamasmi tvayopahUtopasthitA
kiM te priyaM karavANIti
tAM mUrdhnA praNamyovAcha shachI bhagavatyarhasi me bhartAraM darshayituM tvaM satyA matA cheti
sainAM mAnasaM saro.anayat
tatrendraM bisagranthigatamadarshayat
shlokas.35:
tAmindraH patnIM kRRishAM glAnAM cha dRRiShTvA chintayAM babhUva
aho mama mahadduHkhamidamadyopagatam
naShTaM hi mAmiyamanviShyopAgamadduHkhArteti
tAmindra uvAcha kathaM vartayasIti
sA tamuvAcha
nahuSho mAmAhvayati
kAlashchAsya mayA kRRita iti
shlokas.36:
tAmindra uvAcha
gachCha
nahuShastvayA vAchyo.apUrveNa mAmRRiShiyuktena yAnena tvamadhirUDha udvahasva
indrasya hi mahAnti vAhanAni manasaH priyANyadhirUDhAni mayA
tvamanyenopayAtumarhasIti
saivamuktA hRRiShTA jagAma
indro.api bisagranthimevAvivesha bhUyaH
shlokas.37:
athendrANImabhyAgatAM dRRiShTvovAcha nahuShaH pUrNaH sa kAla iti
taM shachyabravIchChakreNa yathoktam
sa maharShiyuktaM vAhanamadhirUDhaH shachIsamIpamupAgachChat
shlokas.38:
atha maitrAvaruNiH kumbhayoniragastyo maharShInvikriyamANA.nstAnnahuSheNApashyat
padbhyAM cha tenAspRRishyata
tataH sa nahuShamabravIdakAryapravRRitta pApa patasva mahIm
sarpo bhava yAvadbhUmirgirayashcha tiShTheyustAvaditi
sa maharShivAkyasamakAlameva tasmAdyAnAdavApatat
shlokas.39:
athAnindraM punastrailokyamabhavat
tato devA RRiShayashcha bhagavantaM viShNuM sharaNamindrArthe.abhijagmuH
UchushchainaM bhagavannindraM brahmavadhyAbhibhUtaM trAtumarhasIti
tataH sa varadastAnabravIdashvamedhaM yaj~naM vaiShNavaM shakro.abhiyajatu
tataH svaM sthAnaM prApsyatIti
shlokas.41:
tato devA RRiShayashchendraM nApashyanyadA tadA shachImUchurgachCha subhage indramAnayasveti
sA punastatsaraH samabhyagachChat
indrashcha tasmAtsarasaH samutthAya bRRihaspatimabhijagAma
bRRihaspatishchAshvamedhaM mahAkratuM shakrAyAharat
tataH kRRiShNasAra~NgaM medhyamashvamutsRRijya vAhanaM tameva kRRitvA indraM marutpatiM bRRihaspatiH svasthAnaM prApayAmAsa
tataH sa devarADdevairRRiShibhiH stUyamAnastriviShTapastho niShkalmaSho babhUva
brahmavadhyAM chaturShu sthAneShu vanitAgnivanaspatigoShu vyabhajat
evamindro brahmatejaHprabhAvopabRRiMhitaH shatruvadhaM kRRitvA
svasthAnaM prApitaH
shlokas.42:
AkAshaga~NgAgatashcha purA bharadvAjo maharShirupAspRRisha.nstrInkramAnkramatA viShNunAbhyAsAditaH
sa bharadvAjena sasalilena pANinorasi tADitaH salakShaNoraskaH
sa.nvRRittaH
shlokas.43: bhRRiguNA maharShiNA shapto.agniH sarvabhakShatvamupanItaH
shlokas.44:
aditirvai devAnAmannamapachadetadbhuktvAsurAnhaniShyantIti
tatra budho vratacharyAsamAptAvAgachChat
aditiM chAvochadbhikShAM dehIti
tatra devaiH pUrvametatprAshyaM nAnyenetyaditirbhikShAM nAdAt
atha bhikShApratyAkhyAnaruShitena budhena brahmabhUtena vivasvato dvitIye janmanyaNDasa~nj~nitasyANDaM mAritamadityAH
sa mArtaNDo vivasvAnabhavachChrAddhadevaH
shlokas.45:
dakShasya vai duhitaraH ShaShTirAsan
tAbhyaH kashyapAya trayodasha prAdAddasha dharmAya dasha manave saptavi.nshatimindave
tAsu tulyAsu nakShatrAkhyAM gatAsu somo rohiNyAmabhyadhikAM prItimakarot
tatastAH sheShAH patnya IrShyAvatyaH pituH samIpaM gatvemamarthaM shasha.nsuH
bhagavannasmAsu tulyaprabhAvAsu somo rohiNImadhikaM bhajatIti
so.abravIdyakShmainamAvekShyatIti
shlokas.46:
dakShashApAtsomaM rAjAnaM yakShmAvivesha
sa yakShmaNAviShTo dakShamagamat
dakShashchainamabravInna samaM vartasa iti
tatrarShayaH somamabruvankShIyase yakShmaNA
pashchimasyAM dishi samudre hiraNyasarastIrtham
tatra gatvAtmAnamabhiShechayasveti
athAgachChatsomastatra hiraNyasarastIrtham
gatvA chAtmanaH snapanamakarot
snAtvA chAtmAnaM pApmano mokShayAmAsa
tatra chAvabhAsitastIrthe yadA somastadAprabhRRiti tIrthaM tatprabhAsamiti nAmnA khyAtaM babhUva
tachChApAdadyApi kShIyate somo.amAvAsyAntarasthaH
paurNamAsImAtre.adhiShThito meghalekhApratichChannaM vapurdarshayati
meghasadRRishaM varNamagamattadasya shashalakShma vimalamabhavat
shlokas.47:
sthUlashirA maharShirmeroH prAguttare digbhAge tapastepe
tasya tapastapyamAnasya sarvagandhavahaH shuchirvAyurvivAyamAnaH sharIramaspRRishat
sa tapasA tApitasharIraH kRRisho vAyunopavIjyamAno hRRidayaparitoShamagamat
tatra tasyAnilavyajanakRRitaparitoShasya sadyo vanaspatayaH
puShpashobhAM na darshitavanta iti sa etA~nshashApa na sarvakAlaM puShpavanto
bhaviShyatheti
shlokas.48:
nArAyaNo lokahitArthaM vaDavAmukho nAma maharShiH purAbhavat
tasya merau tapastapyataH samudra AhUto nAgataH
tenAmarShitenAtmagAtroShmaNA samudraH stimitajalaH kRRitaH
svedaprasyandanasadRRishashchAsya lavaNabhAvo janitaH
uktashchApeyo bhaviShyasi
etachcha te toyaM vaDavAmukhasa~nj~nitena pIyamAnaM madhuraM bhaviShyati
tadetadadyApi vaDavAmukhasa~nj~nitenAnuvartinA toyaM sAmudraM pIyate
shlokas.49:
himavato girerduhitaramumAM rudrashchakame
bhRRigurapi cha maharShirhimavantamAgamyAbravItkanyAmumAM me dehIti
tamabravIddhimavAnabhilaShito varo rudra iti
tamabravIdbhRRiguryasmAttvayAhaM kanyAvaraNakRRitabhAvaH pratyAkhyAtastasmAnna ratnAnAM bhavAnbhAjanaM bhaviShyatIti
adyaprabhRRityetadavasthitamRRiShivachanam
shlokas.50:
tadeva.nvidhaM mAhAtmyaM brAhmaNAnAm
kShatramapi shAshvatImavyayAM pRRithivIM patnImabhigamya bubhuje
tadetadbrahmAgnIShomIyam
tena jagaddhAryate

shlokas.1:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
sUryAchandramasau shashvatkeshairme a.nshusa~nj~nitaiH |
bodhaya.nstApaya.nshchaiva jagaduttiShThataH pRRithak
shlokas.2:
bodhanAttApanAchchaiva jagato harShaNaM bhavet |
agnIShomakRRitairebhiH karmabhiH pANDunandana
hRRiShIkesho.ahamIshAno varado lokabhAvanaH
shlokas.3:
iDopahUtayogena hare bhAgaM kratuShvaham |
varNashcha me harishreShThastasmAddharirahaM smRRitaH
shlokas.4:
dhAma sAro hi lokAnAmRRitaM chaiva vichAritam |
RRitadhAmA tato vipraiH satyashchAhaM prakIrtitaH
shlokas.5:
naShTAM cha dharaNIM pUrvamavindaM vai guhAgatAm |
govinda iti mAM devA vAgbhiH samabhituShTuvuH
shlokas.6:
shipiviShTeti chAkhyAyAM hInaromA cha yo bhavet |
tenAviShTaM hi yatki~nchichChipiviShTaM hi tatsmRRitam
shlokas.7:
yAsko mAmRRiShiravyagro naikayaj~neShu gItavAn |
shipiviShTa iti hyasmAdguhyanAmadharo hyaham
shlokas.8:
stutvA mAM shipiviShTeti yAsko RRiShirudAradhIH |
matprasAdAdadho naShTaM niruktamabhijagmivAn
shlokas.9:
na hi jAto na jAye.ahaM na janiShye kadAchana |
kShetraj~naH sarvabhUtAnAM tasmAdahamajaH smRRitaH
shlokas.10:
noktapUrvaM mayA kShudramashlIlaM vA kadAchana |
RRitA brahmasutA sA me satyA devI sarasvatI
shlokas.11:
sachchAsachchaiva kaunteya mayAveshitamAtmani |
pauShkare brahmasadane satyaM mAmRRiShayo viduH
shlokas.12:
sattvAnna chyutapUrvo.ahaM sattvaM vai viddhi matkRRitam |
janmanIhAbhavatsattvaM paurvikaM me dhana~njaya
shlokas.13:
nirAshIHkarmasa.nyuktaM sAtvataM mAM prakalpaya |
sAtvataj~nAnadRRiShTo.ahaM sAtvataH sAtvatAM patiH
shlokas.14:
kRRiShAmi medinIM pArtha bhUtvA kArShNAyaso mahAn |
kRRiShNo varNashcha me yasmAttasmAtkRRiShNo.ahamarjuna
shlokas.15:
mayA sa.nshleShitA bhUmiradbhirvyoma cha vAyunA |
vAyushcha tejasA sArdhaM vaikuNThatvaM tato mama
shlokas.16:
nirvANaM paramaM saukhyaM dharmo.asau para uchyate |
tasmAnna chyutapUrvo.ahamachyutastena karmaNA
shlokas.17:
pRRithivInabhasI chobhe vishrute vishvalaukike |
tayoH sandhAraNArthaM hi mAmadhokShajama~njasA
shlokas.18:
niruktaM vedaviduSho ye cha shabdArthachintakAH |
te mAM gAyanti prAgva.nshe adhokShaja iti sthitiH
shlokas.19:
shabda ekamataireSha vyAhRRitaH paramarShibhiH |
nAnyo hyadhokShajo loke RRite nArAyaNaM prabhum
shlokas.20:
ghRRitaM mamArchiSho loke jantUnAM prANadhAraNam |
ghRRitArchirahamavyagrairvedaj~naiH parikIrtitaH
shlokas.21:
trayo hi dhAtavaH khyAtAH karmajA iti cha smRRitAH |
pittaM shleShmA cha vAyushcha eSha sa~NghAta uchyate
shlokas.22:
etaishcha dhAryate janturetaiH kShINaishcha kShIyate |
AyurvedavidastasmAttridhAtuM mAM prachakShate
shlokas.23:
vRRiSho hi bhagavAndharmaH khyAto lokeShu bhArata |
naighaNTukapadAkhyAtaM viddhi mAM vRRiShamuttamam
shlokas.24:
kapirvarAhaH shreShThashcha dharmashcha vRRiSha uchyate |
tasmAdvRRiShAkapiM prAha kashyapo mAM prajApatiH
shlokas.25:
na chAdiM na madhyaM tathA naiva chAntaM; kadAchidvidante surAshchAsurAshcha |
anAdyo hyamadhyastathA chApyanantaH; pragIto.ahamIsho vibhurlokasAkShI
shlokas.26:
shuchIni shravaNIyAni shRRiNomIha dhana~njaya |
na cha pApAni gRRihNAmi tato.ahaM vai shuchishravAH
shlokas.27:
ekashRRi~NgaH purA bhUtvA varAho divyadarshanaH |
imAmuddhRRitavAnbhUmimekashRRi~Ngastato hyaham
shlokas.28:
tathaivAsaM trikakudo vArAhaM rUpamAsthitaH |
trikakuttena vikhyAtaH sharIrasya tu mApanAt
shlokas.29:
viri~ncha iti yaH proktaH kapilaj~nAnachintakaiH |
sa prajApatirevAhaM chetanAtsarvalokakRRit
shlokas.30:
vidyAsahAyavantaM mAmAdityasthaM sanAtanam |
kapilaM prAhurAchAryAH sA~NkhyA nishchitanishchayAH
shlokas.31:
hiraNyagarbho dyutimAneSha yashChandasi stutaH |
yogaiH sampUjyate nityaM sa evAhaM vibhuH smRRitaH
shlokas.32:
ekavi.nshatishAkhaM cha RRigvedaM mAM prachakShate |
sahasrashAkhaM yatsAma ye vai vedavido janAH
gAyantyAraNyake viprA madbhaktAste.api durlabhAH
shlokas.33:
ShaTpa~nchAshatamaShTau cha saptatri.nshatamityuta |
yasmi~nshAkhA yajurvede so.ahamAdhvaryave smRRitaH
shlokas.34:
pa~nchakalpamatharvANaM kRRityAbhiH paribRRiMhitam |
kalpayanti hi mAM viprA atharvANavidastathA
shlokas.35:
shAkhAbhedAshcha ye kechidyAshcha shAkhAsu gItayaH |
svaravarNasamuchchArAH sarvA.nstAnviddhi matkRRitAn
shlokas.36:
yattaddhayashiraH pArtha samudeti varapradam |
so.ahamevottare bhAge kramAkSharavibhAgavit
shlokas.37:
rAmAdeshitamArgeNa matprasAdAnmahAtmanA |
pA~nchAlena kramaH prAptastasmAdbhUtAtsanAtanAt
bAbhravyagotraH sa babhau prathamaH kramapAragaH
shlokas.38:
nArAyaNAdvaraM labdhvA prApya yogamanuttamam |
kramaM praNIya shikShAM cha praNayitvA sa gAlavaH
shlokas.39:
kaNDarIko.atha rAjA cha brahmadattaH pratApavAn |
jAtImaraNajaM duHkhaM smRRitvA smRRitvA punaH punaH
saptajAtiShu mukhyatvAdyogAnAM sampadaM gataH
shlokas.40:
purAhamAtmajaH pArtha prathitaH kAraNAntare |
dharmasya kurushArdUla tato.ahaM dharmajaH smRRitaH
shlokas.41:
naranArAyaNau pUrvaM tapastepaturavyayam |
dharmayAnaM samArUDhau parvate gandhamAdane
shlokas.42:
tatkAlasamayaM chaiva dakShayaj~no babhUva ha |
na chaivAkalpayadbhAgaM dakSho rudrasya bhArata
shlokas.43:
tato dadhIchivachanAddakShayaj~namapAharat |
sasarja shUlaM krodhena prajvalantaM muhurmuhuH
shlokas.44:
tachChUlaM bhasmasAtkRRitvA dakShayaj~naM savistaram |
AvayoH sahasAgachChadbadaryAshramamantikAt
vegena mahatA pArtha patannArAyaNorasi
shlokas.45:
tataH svatejasAviShTAH keshA nArAyaNasya ha |
babhUvurmu~njavarNAstu tato.ahaM mu~njakeshavAn
shlokas.46:
tachcha shUlaM vinirdhUtaM hu~NkAreNa mahAtmanA |
jagAma sha~NkarakaraM nArAyaNasamAhatam
shlokas.47:
atha rudra upAdhAvattAvRRiShI tapasAnvitau |
tata enaM samuddhUtaM kaNThe jagrAha pANinA
nArAyaNaH sa vishvAtmA tenAsya shitikaNThatA
shlokas.48:
atha rudravighAtArthamiShIkAM jagRRihe naraH |
mantraishcha sa.nyuyojAshu so.abhavatparashurmahAn
shlokas.49:
kShiptashcha sahasA rudre khaNDanaM prAptavA.nstadA |
tato.ahaM khaNDaparashuH smRRitaH parashukhaNDanAt
shlokas.50:
arjuna uvAcha||
asminyuddhe tu vArShNeya trailokyamathane tadA |
jayaM kaH prAptavA.nstatra sha.nsaitanme janArdana
shlokas.51:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
tayoH sa.nlagnayoryuddhe rudranArAyaNAtmanoH |
udvignAH sahasA kRRitsnA lokAH sarve.abhava.nstadA
shlokas.52:
nAgRRihNAtpAvakaH shubhraM makheShu suhutaM haviH |
vedA na pratibhAnti sma RRiShINAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.53:
devAnrajastamashchaiva samAvivishatustadA |
vasudhA sa~nchakampe.atha nabhashcha vipaphAla ha
shlokas.54:
niShprabhANi cha tejA.nsi brahmA chaivAsanAchchyutaH |
agAchChoShaM samudrashcha himavA.nshcha vyashIryata
shlokas.55:
tasminnevaM samutpanne nimitte pANDunandana |
brahmA vRRito devagaNairRRiShibhishcha mahAtmabhiH
AjagAmAshu taM deshaM yatra yuddhamavartata
shlokas.56:
sA~njalipragraho bhUtvA chaturvaktro niruktagaH |
uvAcha vachanaM rudraM lokAnAmastu vai shivam
nyasyAyudhAni vishvesha jagato hitakAmyayA
shlokas.57:
yadakSharamathAvyaktamIshaM lokasya bhAvanam |
kUTasthaM kartRRinirdva.ndvamakarteti cha yaM viduH
shlokas.58:
vyaktibhAvagatasyAsya ekA mUrtiriyaM shivA |
naro nArAyaNashchaiva jAtau dharmakulodvahau
shlokas.59:
tapasA mahatA yuktau devashreShThau mahAvratau |
ahaM prasAdajastasya kasmi.nshchitkAraNAntare
tvaM chaiva krodhajastAta pUrvasarge sanAtanaH
shlokas.60:
mayA cha sArdhaM varadaM vibudhaishcha maharShibhiH |
prasAdayAshu lokAnAM shAntirbhavatu mAchiram
shlokas.61:
brahmaNA tvevamuktastu rudraH krodhAgnimutsRRijan |
prasAdayAmAsa tato devaM nArAyaNaM prabhum
sharaNaM cha jagAmAdyaM vareNyaM varadaM harim
shlokas.62:
tato.atha varado devo jitakrodho jitendriyaH |
prItimAnabhavattatra rudreNa saha sa~NgataH
shlokas.63:
RRiShibhirbrahmaNA chaiva vibudhaishcha supUjitaH |
uvAcha devamIshAnamIshaH sa jagato hariH
shlokas.64:
yastvAM vetti sa mAM vetti yastvAmanu sa mAmanu |
nAvayorantaraM ki~nchinmA te bhUdbuddhiranyathA
shlokas.65:
adya prabhRRiti shrIvatsaH shUlA~Nko.ayaM bhavatvayam |
mama pANya~NkitashchApi shrIkaNThastvaM bhaviShyasi
shlokas.66:
evaM lakShaNamutpAdya parasparakRRitaM tadA |
sakhyaM chaivAtulaM kRRitvA rudreNa sahitAvRRiShI
tapastepaturavyagrau visRRijya tridivaukasaH
shlokas.67:
eSha te kathitaH pArtha nArAyaNajayo mRRidhe |
nAmAni chaiva guhyAni niruktAni cha bhArata
RRiShibhiH kathitAnIha yAni sa~NkIrtitAni te
shlokas.68:
evaM bahuvidhai rUpaishcharAmIha vasundharAm |
brahmalokaM cha kaunteya golokaM cha sanAtanam
mayA tvaM rakShito yuddhe mahAntaM prAptavA~njayam
shlokas.69:
yastu te so.agrato yAti yuddhe sampratyupasthite |
taM viddhi rudraM kaunteya devadevaM kapardinam
shlokas.70:
kAlaH sa eva kathitaH krodhajeti mayA tava |
nihatA.nstena vai pUrvaM hatavAnasi vai ripUn
shlokas.71:
aprameyaprabhAvaM taM devadevamumApatim |
namasva devaM prayato vishveshaM haramavyayam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
brahmansumahadAkhyAnaM bhavatA parikIrtitam |
yachChrutvA munayaH sarve vismayaM paramaM gatAH
shlokas.2:
idaM shatasahasrAddhi bhAratAkhyAnavistarAt |
Amathya matimanthena j~nAnodadhimanuttamam
shlokas.3:
navanItaM yathA dadhno malayAchchandanaM yathA |
AraNyakaM cha vedebhya oShadhibhyo.amRRitaM yathA
shlokas.4:
samuddhRRitamidaM brahmankathAmRRitamanuttamam |
taponidhe tvayoktaM hi nArAyaNakathAshrayam
shlokas.5:
sa hIsho bhagavAndevaH sarvabhUtAtmabhAvanaH |
aho nArAyaNaM tejo durdarshaM dvijasattama
shlokas.6:
yatrAvishanti kalpAnte sarve brahmAdayaH surAH |
RRiShayashcha sagandharvA yachcha ki~nchichcharAcharam
na tato.asti paraM manye pAvanaM divi cheha cha
shlokas.7:
sarvAshramAbhigamanaM sarvatIrthAvagAhanam |
na tathA phaladaM chApi nArAyaNakathA yathA
shlokas.8:
sarvathA pAvitAH smeha shrutvemAmAditaH kathAm |
harervishveshvarasyeha sarvapApapraNAshanIm
shlokas.9:
na chitraM kRRitavA.nstatra yadAryo me dhana~njayaH |
vAsudevasahAyo yaH prAptavA~njayamuttamam
shlokas.10:
na chAsya ki~nchidaprApyaM manye lokeShvapi triShu |
trailokyanAtho viShNuH sa yasyAsItsAhyakRRitsakhA
shlokas.11:
dhanyAshcha sarva evAsanbrahma.nste mama pUrvakAH |
hitAya shreyase chaiva yeShAmAsIjjanArdanaH
shlokas.12:
tapasApi na dRRishyo hi bhagavA.NllokapUjitaH |
yaM dRRiShTavantaste sAkShAchChrIvatsA~NkavibhUShaNam
shlokas.13:
tebhyo dhanyatarashchaiva nAradaH parameShThijaH |
na chAlpatejasamRRiShiM vedmi nAradamavyayam
shvetadvIpaM samAsAdya yena dRRiShTaH svayaM hariH
shlokas.14:
devaprasAdAnugataM vyaktaM tattasya darshanam |
yaddRRiShTavA.nstadA devamaniruddhatanau sthitam
shlokas.15:
badarImAshramaM yattu nAradaH prAdravatpunaH |
naranArAyaNau draShTuM kiM nu tatkAraNaM mune
shlokas.16:
shvetadvIpAnnivRRittashcha nAradaH parameShThijaH |
badarImAshramaM prApya samAgamya cha tAvRRiShI
shlokas.17:
kiyantaM kAlamavasatkAH kathAH pRRiShTavA.nshcha saH |
shvetadvIpAdupAvRRitte tasminvA sumahAtmani
shlokas.18:
kimabrUtAM mahAtmAnau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI |
tadetanme yathAtattvaM sarvamAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
namo bhagavate tasmai vyAsAyAmitatejase |
yasya prasAdAdvakShyAmi nArAyaNakathAmimAm
shlokas.20:
prApya shvetaM mahAdvIpaM dRRiShTvA cha harimavyayam |
nivRRitto nArado rAja.nstarasA merumAgamat
hRRidayenodvahanbhAraM yaduktaM paramAtmanA
shlokas.21:
pashchAdasyAbhavadrAjannAtmanaH sAdhvasaM mahat |
yadgatvA dUramadhvAnaM kShemI punarihAgataH
shlokas.22:
tato meroH prachakrAma parvataM gandhamAdanam |
nipapAta cha khAttUrNaM vishAlAM badarImanu
shlokas.23:
tataH sa dadRRishe devau purANAvRRiShisattamau |
tapashcharantau sumahadAtmaniShThau mahAvratau
shlokas.24:
tejasAbhyadhikau sUryAtsarvalokavirochanAt |
shrIvatsalakShaNau pUjyau jaTAmaNDaladhAriNau
shlokas.25:
jAlapAdabhujau tau tu pAdayoshchakralakShaNau |
vyUDhoraskau dIrghabhujau tathA muShkachatuShkiNau
shlokas.26:
ShaShTidantAvaShTadaMShTrau meghaughasadRRishasvanau |
svAsyau pRRithulalATau cha suhanU subhrunAsikau
shlokas.27:
AtapatreNa sadRRishe shirasI devayostayoH |
evaM lakShaNasampannau mahApuruShasa~nj~nitau
shlokas.28:
tau dRRiShTvA nArado hRRiShTastAbhyAM cha pratipUjitaH |
svAgatenAbhibhAShyAtha pRRiShTashchAnAmayaM tadA
shlokas.29:
babhUvAntargatamatirnirIkShya puruShottamau |
sadogatAstatra ye vai sarvabhUtanamaskRRitAH
shlokas.30:
shvetadvIpe mayA dRRiShTAstAdRRishAvRRiShisattamau |
iti sa~nchintya manasA kRRitvA chAbhipradakShiNam
upopavivishe tatra pIThe kushamaye shubhe
shlokas.31:
tatastau tapasAM vAsau yashasAM tejasAmapi |
RRiShI shamadamopetau kRRitvA pUrvAhNikaM vidhim
shlokas.32:
pashchAnnAradamavyagrau pAdyArghyAbhyAM prapUjya cha |
pIThayoshchopaviShTau tau kRRitAtithyAhnikau nRRipa
shlokas.33:
teShu tatropaviShTeShu sa desho.abhivyarAjata |
AjyAhutimahAjvAlairyaj~navATo.agnibhiryathA
shlokas.34:
atha nArAyaNastatra nAradaM vAkyamabravIt |
sukhopaviShTaM vishrAntaM kRRitAtithyaM sukhasthitam
shlokas.35:
apIdAnIM sa bhagavAnparamAtmA sanAtanaH |
shvetadvIpe tvayA dRRiShTa AvayoH prakRRitiH parA
shlokas.36:
nArada uvAcha||
dRRiShTo me puruShaH shrImAnvishvarUpadharo.avyayaH |
sarve hi lokAstatrasthAstathA devAH saharShibhiH
adyApi chainaM pashyAmi yuvAM pashyansanAtanau
shlokas.37:
yairlakShaNairupetaH sa hariravyaktarUpadhRRik |
tairlakShaNairupetau hi vyaktarUpadharau yuvAm
shlokas.38:
dRRiShTau mayA yuvAM tatra tasya devasya pArshvataH |
iha chaivAgato.asmyadya visRRiShTaH paramAtmanA
shlokas.39:
ko hi nAma bhavettasya tejasA yashasA shriyA |
sadRRishastriShu lokeShu RRite dharmAtmajau yuvAm
shlokas.40:
tena me kathitaM pUrvaM nAma kShetraj~nasa~nj~nitam |
prAdurbhAvAshcha kathitA bhaviShyanti hi ye yathA
shlokas.41:
tatra ye puruShAH shvetAH pa~nchendriyavivarjitAH |
pratibuddhAshcha te sarve bhaktAshcha puruShottamam
shlokas.42:
te.archayanti sadA devaM taiH sArdhaM ramate cha saH |
priyabhakto hi bhagavAnparamAtmA dvijapriyaH
shlokas.43:
ramate so.archyamAno hi sadA bhAgavatapriyaH |
vishvabhuksarvago devo bAndhavo bhaktavatsalaH
sa kartA kAraNaM chaiva kAryaM chAtibaladyutiH
shlokas.44:
tapasA yojya so.a.atmAnaM shvetadvIpAtparaM hi yat |
teja ityabhivikhyAtaM svayambhAsAvabhAsitam
shlokas.45:
shAntiH sA triShu lokeShu siddhAnAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
etayA shubhayA buddhyA naiShThikaM vratamAsthitaH
shlokas.46:
na tatra sUryastapati na somo.abhivirAjate |
na vAyurvAti deveshe tapashcharati dushcharam
shlokas.47:
vedImaShTatalotsedhAM bhUmAvAsthAya vishvabhuk |
ekapAdasthito deva UrdhvabAhuruda~NmukhaH
sA~NgAnAvartayanvedA.nstapastepe sudushcharam
shlokas.48:
yadbrahmA RRiShayashchaiva svayaM pashupatishcha yat |
sheShAshcha vibudhashreShThA daityadAnavarAkShasAH
shlokas.49:
nAgAH suparNA gandharvAH siddhA rAjarShayashcha ye |
havyaM kavyaM cha satataM vidhipUrvaM prayu~njate
kRRitsnaM tattasya devasya charaNAvupatiShThati
shlokas.50:
yAH kriyAH samprayuktAstu ekAntagatabuddhibhiH |
tAH sarvAH shirasA devaH pratigRRihNAti vai svayam
shlokas.51:
na tasyAnyaH priyataraH pratibuddhairmahAtmabhiH |
vidyate triShu lokeShu tato.asmyaikAntikaM gataH
iha chaivAgatastena visRRiShTaH paramAtmanA
shlokas.52:
evaM me bhagavAndevaH svayamAkhyAtavAnhariH |
AsiShye tatparo bhUtvA yuvAbhyAM saha nityashaH

shlokas.1:
naranArAyaNAvUchatuH||
dhanyo.asyanugRRihIto.asi yatte dRRiShTaH svayaM prabhuH |
na hi taM dRRiShTavAnkashchitpadmayonirapi svayam
shlokas.2:
avyaktayonirbhagavAndurdarshaH puruShottamaH |
nAradaitaddhi te satyaM vachanaM samudAhRRitam
shlokas.3:
nAsya bhaktaiH priyataro loke kashchana vidyate |
tataH svayaM darshitavAnsvamAtmAnaM dvijottama
shlokas.4:
tapo hi tapyatastasya yatsthAnaM paramAtmanaH |
na tatsamprApnute kashchidRRite hyAvAM dvijottama
shlokas.5:
yA hi sUryasahasrasya samastasya bhaveddyutiH |
sthAnasya sA bhavettasya svayaM tena virAjatA
shlokas.6:
tasmAduttiShThate vipra devAdvishvabhuvaH pateH |
kShamA kShamAvatAM shreShTha yayA bhUmistu yujyate
shlokas.7:
tasmAchchottiShThate devAtsarvabhUtahito rasaH |
Apo yena hi yujyante dravatvaM prApnuvanti cha
shlokas.8:
tasmAdeva samudbhUtaM tejo rUpaguNAtmakam |
yena sma yujyate sUryastato lokAnvirAjate
shlokas.9:
tasmAddevAtsamudbhUtaH sparshastu puruShottamAt |
yena sma yujyate vAyustato lokAnvivAtyasau
shlokas.10:
tasmAchchottiShThate shabdaH sarvalokeshvarAtprabhoH |
AkAshaM yujyate yena tatastiShThatyasa.nvRRitam
shlokas.11:
tasmAchchottiShThate devAtsarvabhUtagataM manaH |
chandramA yena sa.nyuktaH prakAshaguNadhAraNaH
shlokas.12:
ShaDbhUtotpAdakaM nAma tatsthAnaM vedasa~nj~nitam |
vidyAsahAyo yatrAste bhagavAnhavyakavyabhuk
shlokas.13:
ye hi niShkalmaShA loke puNyapApavivarjitAH |
teShAM vai kShemamadhvAnaM gachChatAM dvijasattama
sarvalokatamohantA Adityo dvAramuchyate
shlokas.14:
AdityadagdhasarvA~NgA adRRishyAH kenachitkvachit |
paramANubhUtA bhUtvA tu taM devaM pravishantyuta
shlokas.15:
tasmAdapi vinirmuktA aniruddhatanau sthitAH |
manobhUtAstato bhUyaH pradyumnaM pravishantyuta
shlokas.16:
pradyumnAchchApi nirmuktA jIvaM sa~NkarShaNaM tathA |
vishanti viprapravarAH sA~NkhyA bhAgavataiH saha
shlokas.17:
tatastraiguNyahInAste paramAtmAnama~njasA |
pravishanti dvijashreShTha kShetraj~naM nirguNAtmakam
sarvAvAsaM vAsudevaM kShetraj~naM viddhi tattvataH
shlokas.18:
samAhitamanaskAshcha niyatAH sa.nyatendriyAH |
ekAntabhAvopagatA vAsudevaM vishanti te
shlokas.19:
AvAmapi cha dharmasya gRRihe jAtau dvijottama |
ramyAM vishAlAmAshritya tapa ugraM samAsthitau
shlokas.20:
ye tu tasyaiva devasya prAdurbhAvAH surapriyAH |
bhaviShyanti trilokasthAsteShAM svastItyato dvija
shlokas.21:
vidhinA svena yuktAbhyAM yathApUrvaM dvijottama |
AsthitAbhyAM sarvakRRichChraM vrataM samyaktaduttamam
shlokas.22:
AvAbhyAmapi dRRiShTastvaM shvetadvIpe tapodhana |
samAgato bhagavatA sa~njalpaM kRRitavAnyathA
shlokas.23:
sarvaM hi nau sa.nviditaM trailokye sacharAchare |
yadbhaviShyati vRRittaM vA vartate vA shubhAshubham
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tayorvAkyaM tapasyugre.abhyavartata |
nAradaH prA~njalirbhUtvA nArAyaNaparAyaNaH
shlokas.25:
jajApa vidhivanmantrAnnArAyaNagatAnbahUn |
divyaM varShasahasraM hi naranArAyaNAshrame
shlokas.26:
avasatsa mahAtejA nArado bhagavAnRRiShiH |
tamevAbhyarchayandevaM naranArAyaNau cha tau

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kasyachittvatha kAlasya nAradaH parameShThijaH |
daivaM kRRitvA yathAnyAyaM pitryaM chakre tataH param
shlokas.2:
tatastaM vachanaM prAha jyeShTho dharmAtmajaH prabhuH |
ka ijyate dvijashreShTha daive pitrye cha kalpite
shlokas.3:
tvayA matimatAM shreShTha tanme sha.nsa yathAgamam |
kimetatkriyate karma phalaM chAsya kimiShyate
shlokas.4:
nArada uvAcha||
tvayaitatkathitaM pUrvaM daivaM kartavyamityapi |
daivataM cha paro yaj~naH paramAtmA sanAtanaH
shlokas.5:
tatastadbhAvito nityaM yaje vaikuNThamavyayam |
tasmAchcha prasRRitaH pUrvaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH
shlokas.6:
mama vai pitaraM prItaH parameShThyapyajIjanat |
ahaM sa~Nkalpajastasya putraH prathamakalpitaH
shlokas.7:
yajAmyahaM pitR^InsAdho nArAyaNavidhau kRRite |
evaM sa eva bhagavAnpitA mAtA pitAmahaH
ijyate pitRRiyaj~neShu mayA nityaM jagatpatiH
shlokas.8:
shrutishchApyaparA deva putrAnhi pitaro.ayajan |
vedashrutiH praNaShTA cha punaradhyApitA sutaiH
tataste mantradAH putrAH pitRRitvamupapedire
shlokas.9:
nUnaM puraitadviditaM yuvayorbhAvitAtmanoH |
putrAshcha pitarashchaiva parasparamapUjayan
shlokas.10:
trInpiNDAnnyasya vai pRRithvyAM pUrvaM dattvA kushAniti |
kathaM tu piNDasa~nj~nAM te pitaro lebhire purA
shlokas.11:
naranArAyaNAvUchatuH||
imAM hi dharaNIM pUrvaM naShTAM sAgaramekhalAm |
govinda ujjahArAshu vArAhaM rUpamAshritaH
shlokas.12:
sthApayitvA tu dharaNIM sve sthAne puruShottamaH |
jalakardamaliptA~Ngo lokakAryArthamudyataH
shlokas.13:
prApte chAhnikakAle sa madhya.ndinagate ravau |
daMShTrAvilagnAnmRRitpiNDAnvidhUya sahasA prabhuH
sthApayAmAsa vai pRRithvyAM kushAnAstIrya nArada
shlokas.14:
sa teShvAtmAnamuddishya pitryaM chakre yathAvidhi |
sa~NkalpayitvA trInpiNDAnsvenaiva vidhinA prabhuH
shlokas.15:
AtmagAtroShmasambhUtaiH snehagarbhaistilairapi |
prokShyApavargaM deveshaH prA~NmukhaH kRRitavAnsvayam
shlokas.16:
maryAdAsthApanArthaM cha tato vachanamuktavAn |
ahaM hi pitaraH sraShTumudyato lokakRRitsvayam
shlokas.17:
tasya chintayataH sadyaH pitRRikAryavidhiM param |
daMShTrAbhyAM pravinirdhUtA mamaite dakShiNAM disham
AshritA dharaNIM piNDAstasmAtpitara eva te
shlokas.18:
trayo mUrtivihInA vai piNDamUrtidharAstvime |
bhavantu pitaro loke mayA sRRiShTAH sanAtanAH
shlokas.19:
pitA pitAmahashchaiva tathaiva prapitAmahaH |
ahamevAtra vij~neyastriShu piNDeShu sa.nsthitaH
shlokas.20:
nAsti matto.adhikaH kashchitko vAbhyarchyo mayA svayam |
ko vA mama pitA loke ahameva pitAmahaH
shlokas.21:
pitAmahapitA chaiva ahamevAtra kAraNam |
ityevamuktvA vachanaM devadevo vRRiShAkapiH
shlokas.22:
varAhaparvate vipra dattvA piNDAnsavistarAn |
AtmAnaM pUjayitvaiva tatraivAdarshanaM gataH
shlokas.23:
etadarthaM shubhamate pitaraH piNDasa~nj~nitAH |
labhante satataM pUjAM vRRiShAkapivacho yathA
shlokas.24:
ye yajanti pitR^IndevAngurU.nshchaivAtithI.nstathA |
gAshchaiva dvijamukhyA.nshcha pRRithivIM mAtaraM tathA
karmaNA manasA vAchA viShNumeva yajanti te
shlokas.25:
antargataH sa bhagavAnsarvasattvasharIragaH |
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu IshvaraH sukhaduHkhayoH
mahAnmahAtmA sarvAtmA nArAyaNa iti shrutaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvaitannArado vAkyaM naranArAyaNeritam |
atyantabhaktimAndeve ekAntitvamupeyivAn
shlokas.2:
proShya varShasahasraM tu naranArAyaNAshrame |
shrutvA bhagavadAkhyAnaM dRRiShTvA cha harimavyayam
himavantaM jagAmAshu yatrAsya svaka AshramaH
shlokas.3:
tAvapi khyAtatapasau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI |
tasminnevAshrame ramye tepatustapa uttamam
shlokas.4:
tvamapyamitavikrAntaH pANDavAnAM kulodvahaH |
pAvitAtmAdya sa.nvRRittaH shrutvemAmAditaH kathAm
shlokas.5:
naiva tasya paro loko nAyaM pArthivasattama |
karmaNA manasA vAchA yo dviShyAdviShNumavyayam
shlokas.6:
majjanti pitarastasya narake shAshvatIH samAH |
yo dviShyAdvibudhashreShThaM devaM nArAyaNaM harim
shlokas.7:
kathaM nAma bhaveddveShya AtmA lokasya kasyachit |
AtmA hi puruShavyAghra j~neyo viShNuriti sthitiH
shlokas.8:
ya eSha gururasmAkamRRiShirgandhavatIsutaH |
tenaitatkathitaM tAta mAhAtmyaM paramAtmanaH
tasmAchChrutaM mayA chedaM kathitaM cha tavAnagha
shlokas.9:
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM vyAsaM viddhi nArAyaNaM prabhum |
ko hyanyaH puruShavyAghra mahAbhAratakRRidbhavet
dharmAnnAnAvidhA.nshchaiva ko brUyAttamRRite prabhum
shlokas.10:
vartatAM te mahAyaj~no yathA sa~NkalpitastvayA |
sa~NkalpitAshvamedhastvaM shrutadharmashcha tattvataH
shlokas.11:
etattu mahadAkhyAnaM shrutvA pArikShito nRRipaH |
tato yaj~nasamAptyarthaM kriyAH sarvAH samArabhat
shlokas.12:
nArAyaNIyamAkhyAnametatte kathitaM mayA |
nAradena purA rAjangurave me niveditam
RRiShINAM pANDavAnAM cha shRRiNvatoH kRRiShNabhIShmayoH
shlokas.13:
sa hi paramagururbhuvanapati;rdharaNidharaH shamaniyamanidhiH |
shrutivinayanidhirdvijaparamahita;stava bhavatu gatirhariramarahitaH
shlokas.14:
tapasAM nidhiH sumahatAM mahato; yashasashcha bhAjanamariShTakahA |
ekAntinAM sharaNado.abhayado; gatido.astu vaH sa makhabhAgaharaH
shlokas.15:
triguNAtigashchatuShpa~nchadharaH; pUrteShTayoshcha phalabhAgaharaH |
vidadhAti nityamajito.atibalo; gatimAtmagAM sukRRitinAmRRiShiNAm
shlokas.16:
taM lokasAkShiNamajaM puruShaM; ravivarNamIshvaragatiM bahushaH |
praNamadhvamekamatayo yatayaH; salilodbhavo.api tamRRiShiM praNataH
shlokas.17:
sa hi lokayoniramRRitasya padaM; sUkShmaM purANamachalaM paramam |
tatsA~NkhyayogibhirudAradhRRitaM; buddhyA yatAtmabhirviditaM satatam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
shrutaM bhagavatastasya mAhAtmyaM paramAtmanaH |
janma dharmagRRihe chaiva naranArAyaNAtmakam
mahAvarAhasRRiShTA cha piNDotpattiH purAtanI
shlokas.2:
pravRRittau cha nivRRittau cha yo yathA parikalpitaH |
sa tathA naH shruto brahmankathyamAnastvayAnagha
shlokas.3:
yachcha tatkathitaM pUrvaM tvayA hayashiro mahat |
havyakavyabhujo viShNorudakpUrve mahodadhau
tachcha dRRiShTaM bhagavatA brahmaNA parameShThinA
shlokas.4:
kiM tadutpAditaM pUrvaM hariNA lokadhAriNA |
rUpaM prabhAvamahatAmapUrvaM dhImatAM vara
shlokas.5:
dRRiShTvA hi vibudhashreShThamapUrvamamitaujasam |
tadashvashirasaM puNyaM brahmA kimakaronmune
shlokas.6:
etannaH sa.nshayaM brahmanpurANaj~nAnasambhavam |
kathayasvottamamate mahApuruShanirmitam
pAvitAH sma tvayA brahmanpuNyAM kathayatA kathAm
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kathayiShyAmi te sarvaM purANaM vedasaMmitam |
jagau yadbhagavAnvyAso rAj~no dharmasutasya vai
shlokas.8:
shrutvAshvashiraso mUrtiM devasya harimedhasaH |
utpannasa.nshayo rAjA tameva samachodayat
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yattaddarshitavAnbrahmA devaM hayashirodharam |
kimarthaM tatsamabhavadvapurdevopakalpitam
shlokas.10:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yatki~nchidiha loke vai dehabaddhaM vishAM pate |
sarvaM pa~nchabhirAviShTaM bhUtairIshvarabuddhijaiH
shlokas.11:
Ishvaro hi jagatsraShTA prabhurnArAyaNo virAT |
bhUtAntarAtmA varadaH saguNo nirguNo.api cha
bhUtapralayamavyaktaM shRRiNuShva nRRipasattama
shlokas.12:
dharaNyAmatha lInAyAmapsu chaikArNave purA |
jyotirbhUte jale chApi lIne jyotiShi chAnile
shlokas.13:
vAyau chAkAshasa.nlIne AkAshe cha manonuge |
vyakte manasi sa.nlIne vyakte chAvyaktatAM gate
shlokas.14:
avyakte puruShaM yAte pu.nsi sarvagate.api cha |
tama evAbhavatsarvaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.15:
tamaso brahma sambhUtaM tamomUlamRRitAtmakam |
tadvishvabhAvasa~nj~nAntaM pauruShIM tanumAsthitam
shlokas.16:
so.aniruddha iti proktastatpradhAnaM prachakShate |
tadavyaktamiti j~neyaM triguNaM nRRipasattama
shlokas.17:
vidyAsahAyavAndevo viShvakseno hariH prabhuH |
apsveva shayanaM chakre nidrAyogamupAgataH
jagatashchintayansRRiShTiM chitrAM bahuguNodbhavAm
shlokas.18:
tasya chintayataH sRRiShTiM mahAnAtmaguNaH smRRitaH |
aha~NkArastato jAto brahmA shubhachaturmukhaH
hiraNyagarbho bhagavAnsarvalokapitAmahaH
shlokas.19:
padme.aniruddhAtsambhUtastadA padmanibhekShaNaH |
sahasrapatre dyutimAnupaviShTaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.20:
dadRRishe.adbhutasa~NkAshe lokAnApomayAnprabhuH |
sattvasthaH parameShThI sa tato bhUtagaNAnsRRijat
shlokas.21:
pUrvameva cha padmasya patre sUryA.nshusaprabhe |
nArAyaNakRRitau bindU apAmAstAM guNottarau
shlokas.22:
tAvapashyatsa bhagavAnanAdinidhano.achyutaH |
ekastatrAbhavadbindurmadhvAbho ruchiraprabhaH
shlokas.23:
sa tAmaso madhurjAtastadA nArAyaNAj~nayA |
kaThinastvaparo binduH kaiTabho rAjasastu saH
shlokas.24:
tAvabhyadhAvatAM shreShThau tamorajaguNAnvitau |
balavantau gadAhastau padmanAlAnusAriNau
shlokas.25:
dadRRishAte.aravindasthaM brahmANamamitaprabham |
sRRijantaM prathamaM vedA.nshchaturashchAruvigrahAn
shlokas.26:
tato vigrahavantau tau vedAndRRiShTvAsurottamau |
sahasA jagRRihaturvedAnbrahmaNaH pashyatastadA
shlokas.27:
atha tau dAnavashreShThau vedAngRRihya sanAtanAn |
rasAM vivishatustUrNamudakpUrve mahodadhau
shlokas.28:
tato hRRiteShu vedeShu brahmA kashmalamAvishat |
tato vachanamIshAnaM prAha vedairvinAkRRitaH
shlokas.29:
vedA me paramaM chakShurvedA me paramaM balam |
vedA me paramaM dhAma vedA me brahma chottamam
shlokas.30:
mama vedA hRRitAH sarve dAnavAbhyAM balAditaH |
andhakArA hi me lokA jAtA vedairvinAkRRitAH
vedAnRRite hi kiM kuryAM lokAnvai sraShTumudyataH
shlokas.31:
aho bata mahadduHkhaM vedanAshanajaM mama |
prAptaM dunoti hRRidayaM tIvrashokAya randhayan
shlokas.32:
ko hi shokArNave magnaM mAmito.adya samuddharet |
vedA.nstAnAnayennaShTAnkasya chAhaM priyo bhave
shlokas.33:
ityevaM bhAShamANasya brahmaNo nRRipasattama |
hareH stotrArthamudbhUtA buddhirbuddhimatAM vara
tato jagau paraM japyaM sA~njalipragrahaH prabhuH
shlokas.34:
namaste brahmahRRidaya namaste mama pUrvaja |
lokAdya bhuvanashreShTha sA~Nkhyayoganidhe vibho
shlokas.35:
vyaktAvyaktakarAchintya kShemaM panthAnamAsthita |
vishvabhuksarvabhUtAnAmantarAtmannayonija
shlokas.36:
ahaM prasAdajastubhyaM lokadhAmne svayambhuve |
tvatto me mAnasaM janma prathamaM dvijapUjitam
shlokas.37:
chAkShuShaM vai dvitIyaM me janma chAsItpurAtanam |
tvatprasAdAchcha me janma tRRitIyaM vAchikaM mahat
shlokas.38:
tvattaH shravaNajaM chApi chaturthaM janma me vibho |
nAsikyaM chApi me janma tvattaH pa~nchamamuchyate
shlokas.39:
aNDajaM chApi me janma tvattaH ShaShThaM vinirmitam |
idaM cha saptamaM janma padmajaM me.amitaprabha
shlokas.40:
sarge sarge hyahaM putrastava triguNavarjitaH |
prathitaH puNDarIkAkSha pradhAnaguNakalpitaH
shlokas.41:
tvamIshvarasvabhAvashcha svayambhUH puruShottamaH |
tvayA vinirmito.ahaM vai vedachakShurvayotigaH
shlokas.42:
te me vedA hRRitAshchakShurandho jAto.asmi jAgRRihi |
dadasva chakShuShI mahyaM priyo.ahaM te priyo.asi me
shlokas.43:
evaM stutaH sa bhagavAnpuruShaH sarvatomukhaH |
jahau nidrAmatha tadA vedakAryArthamudyataH
aishvareNa prayogeNa dvitIyAM tanumAsthitaH
shlokas.44:
sunAsikena kAyena bhUtvA chandraprabhastadA |
kRRitvA hayashiraH shubhraM vedAnAmAlayaM prabhuH
shlokas.45:
tasya mUrdhA samabhavaddyauH sanakShatratArakA |
keshAshchAsyAbhavandIrghA ravera.nshusamaprabhAH
shlokas.46:
karNAvAkAshapAtAle lalATaM bhUtadhAriNI |
ga~NgA sarasvatI puNyA bhruvAvAstAM mahAnadI
shlokas.47:
chakShuShI somasUryau te nAsA sandhyA punaH smRRitA |
o~NkArastvatha sa.nskAro vidyujjihvA cha nirmitA
shlokas.48:
dantAshcha pitaro rAjansomapA iti vishrutAH |
goloko brahmalokashcha oShThAvAstAM mahAtmanaH
grIvA chAsyAbhavadrAjankAlarAtrirguNottarA
shlokas.49:
etaddhayashiraH kRRitvA nAnAmUrtibhirAvRRitam |
antardadhe sa vishvesho vivesha cha rasAM prabhuH
shlokas.50:
rasAM punaH praviShTashcha yogaM paramamAsthitaH |
shaikShaM svaraM samAsthAya omiti prAsRRijatsvaram
shlokas.51:
sa svaraH sAnunAdI cha sarvagaH snigdha eva cha |
babhUvAntarmahIbhUtaH sarvabhUtaguNoditaH
shlokas.52:
tatastAvasurau kRRitvA vedAnsamayabandhanAn |
rasAtale vinikShipya yataH shabdastato drutau
shlokas.53:
etasminnantare rAjandevo hayashirodharaH |
jagrAha vedAnakhilAnrasAtalagatAnhariH
prAdAchcha brahmaNe bhUyastataH svAM prakRRitiM gataH
shlokas.54:
sthApayitvA hayashira udakpUrve mahodadhau |
vedAnAmAlayashchApi babhUvAshvashirAstataH
shlokas.55:
atha ki~nchidapashyantau dAnavau madhukaiTabhau |
punarAjagmatustatra vegitau pashyatAM cha tau
yatra vedA vinikShiptAstatsthAnaM shUnyameva cha
shlokas.56:
tata uttamamAsthAya vegaM balavatAM varau |
punaruttasthatuH shIghraM rasAnAmAlayAttadA
dadRRishAte cha puruShaM tamevAdikaraM prabhum
shlokas.57:
shvetaM chandravishuddhAbhamaniruddhatanau sthitam |
bhUyo.apyamitavikrAntaM nidrAyogamupAgatam
shlokas.58:
AtmapramANarachite apAmupari kalpite |
shayane nAgabhogADhye jvAlAmAlAsamAvRRite
shlokas.59:
niShkalmaSheNa sattvena sampannaM ruchiraprabham |
taM dRRiShTvA dAnavendrau tau mahAhAsamamu~nchatAm
shlokas.60:
Uchatushcha samAviShTau rajasA tamasA cha tau |
ayaM sa puruShaH shvetaH shete nidrAmupAgataH
shlokas.61:
anena nUnaM vedAnAM kRRitamAharaNaM rasAt |
kasyaiSha ko nu khalveSha kiM cha svapiti bhogavAn
shlokas.62:
ityuchchAritavAkyau tau bodhayAmAsaturharim |
yuddhArthinau tu vij~nAya vibuddhaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.63:
nirIkShya chAsurendrau tau tato yuddhe mano dadhe |
atha yuddhaM samabhavattayornArAyaNasya cha
shlokas.64:
rajastamoviShTatanU tAvubhau madhukaiTabhau |
brahmaNopachitiM kurva~njaghAna madhusUdanaH
shlokas.65:
tatastayorvadhenAshu vedApaharaNena cha |
shokApanayanaM chakre brahmaNaH puruShottamaH
shlokas.66:
tataH parivRRito brahmA hatArirvedasatkRRitaH |
nirmame sa tadA lokAnkRRitsnAnsthAvaraja~NgamAn
shlokas.67:
dattvA pitAmahAyAgryAM buddhiM lokavisargikIm |
tatraivAntardadhe devo yata evAgato hariH
shlokas.68:
tau dAnavau harirhatvA kRRitvA hayashirastanum |
punaH pravRRittidharmArthaM tAmeva vidadhe tanum
shlokas.69:
evameSha mahAbhAgo babhUvAshvashirA hariH |
paurANametadAkhyAtaM rUpaM varadamaishvaram
shlokas.70:
yo hyetadbrAhmaNo nityaM shRRiNuyAddhArayeta vA |
na tasyAdhyayanaM nAshamupagachChetkadAchana
shlokas.71:
ArAdhya tapasogreNa devaM hayashirodharam |
pA~nchAlena kramaH prApto rAmeNa pathi deshite
shlokas.72:
etaddhayashiro rAjannAkhyAnaM tava kIrtitam |
purANaM vedasamitaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.73:
yAM yAmichChettanuM devaH kartuM kAryavidhau kvachit |
tAM tAM kuryAdvikurvANaH svayamAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.74:
eSha vedanidhiH shrImAneSha vai tapaso nidhiH |
eSha yogashcha sA~NkhyaM cha brahma chAgryaM harirvibhuH
shlokas.75:
nArAyaNaparA vedA yaj~nA nArAyaNAtmakAH |
tapo nArAyaNaparaM nArAyaNaparA gatiH
shlokas.76:
nArAyaNaparaM satyamRRitaM nArAyaNAtmakam |
nArAyaNaparo dharmaH punarAvRRittidurlabhaH
shlokas.77:
pravRRittilakShaNashchaiva dharmo nArAyaNAtmakaH |
nArAyaNAtmako gandho bhUmau shreShThatamaH smRRitaH
shlokas.78:
apAM chaiva guNo rAjanraso nArAyaNAtmakaH |
jyotiShAM cha guNo rUpaM smRRitaM nArAyaNAtmakam
shlokas.79:
nArAyaNAtmakashchApi sparsho vAyuguNaH smRRitaH |
nArAyaNAtmakashchApi shabda AkAshasambhavaH
shlokas.80:
manashchApi tato bhUtamavyaktaguNalakShaNam |
nArAyaNaparaH kAlo jyotiShAmayanaM cha yat
shlokas.81:
nArAyaNaparA kIrtiH shrIshcha lakShmIshcha devatAH |
nArAyaNaparaM sA~NkhyaM yogo nArAyaNAtmakaH
shlokas.82:
kAraNaM puruSho yeShAM pradhAnaM chApi kAraNam |
svabhAvashchaiva karmANi daivaM yeShAM cha kAraNam
shlokas.83:
pa~nchakAraNasa~NkhyAto niShThA sarvatra vai hariH |
tattvaM jij~nAsamAnAnAM hetubhiH sarvatomukhaiH
shlokas.84:
tattvameko mahAyogI harirnArAyaNaH prabhuH |
sabrahmakAnAM lokAnAmRRiShINAM cha mahAtmanAm
shlokas.85:
sA~NkhyAnAM yoginAM chApi yatInAmAtmavedinAm |
manIShitaM vijAnAti keshavo na tu tasya te
shlokas.86:
ye kechitsarvalokeShu daivaM pitryaM cha kurvate |
dAnAni cha prayachChanti tapyanti cha tapo mahat
shlokas.87:
sarveShAmAshrayo viShNuraishvaraM vidhimAsthitaH |
sarvabhUtakRRitAvAso vAsudeveti chochyate
shlokas.88:
ayaM hi nityaH paramo maharShi;rmahAvibhUtirguNavAnnirguNAkhyaH |
guNaishcha sa.nyogamupaiti shIghraM; kAlo yathartAvRRitusamprayuktaH
shlokas.89:
naivAsya vindanti gatiM mahAtmano; na chAgatiM kashchidihAnupasyati |
j~nAnAtmakAH sa.nyamino maharShayaH; pashyanti nityaM puruShaM guNAdhikam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
aho hyekAntinaH sarvAnprINAti bhagavAnhariH |
vidhiprayuktAM pUjAM cha gRRihNAti bhagavAnsvayam
shlokas.2:
ye tu dagdhendhanA loke puNyapApavivarjitAH |
teShAM tvayAbhinirdiShTA pAramparyAgatA gatiH
shlokas.3:
chaturthyAM chaiva te gatyAM gachChanti puruShottamam |
ekAntinastu puruShA gachChanti paramaM padam
shlokas.4:
nUnamekAntadharmo.ayaM shreShTho nArAyaNapriyaH |
agatvA gatayastisro yadgachChantyavyayaM harim
shlokas.5:
sahopaniShadAnvedAnye viprAH samyagAsthitAH |
paThanti vidhimAsthAya ye chApi yatidharmiNaH
shlokas.6:
tebhyo vishiShTAM jAnAmi gatimekAntinAM nRRiNAm |
kenaiSha dharmaH kathito devena RRiShiNApi vA
shlokas.7:
ekAntinAM cha kA charyA kadA chotpAditA vibho |
etanme sa.nshayaM Chindhi paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.8:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
samupoDheShvanIkeShu kurupANDavayormRRidhe |
arjune vimanaske cha gItA bhagavatA svayam
shlokas.9:
Agatishcha gatishchaiva pUrvaM te kathitA mayA |
gahano hyeSha dharmo vai durvij~neyo.akRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.10:
saMmitaH sAmavedena puraivAdiyuge kRRitaH |
dhAryate svayamIshena rAjannArAyaNena ha
shlokas.11:
etamarthaM mahArAja pRRiShTaH pArthena nAradaH |
RRiShimadhye mahAbhAgaH shRRiNvatoH kRRiShNabhIShmayoH
shlokas.12:
guruNA cha mamApyeSha kathito nRRipasattama |
yathA tu kathitastatra nAradena tathA shRRiNu
shlokas.13:
yadAsInmAnasaM janma nArAyaNamukhodgatam |
brahmaNaH pRRithivIpAla tadA nArAyaNaH svayam
tena dharmeNa kRRitavAndaivaM pitryaM cha bhArata
shlokas.14:
phenapA RRiShayashchaiva taM dharmaM pratipedire |
vaikhAnasAH phenapebhyo dharmametaM prapedire
vaikhAnasebhyaH somastu tataH so.antardadhe punaH
shlokas.15:
yadAsIchchAkShuShaM janma dvitIyaM brahmaNo nRRipa |
tadA pitAmahAtsomAdetaM dharmamajAnata
nArAyaNAtmakaM rAjanrudrAya pradadau cha saH
shlokas.16:
tato yogasthito rudraH purA kRRitayuge nRRipa |
vAlakhilyAnRRiShInsarvAndharmametamapAThayat
antardadhe tato bhUyastasya devasya mAyayA
shlokas.17:
tRRitIyaM brahmaNo janma yadAsIdvAchikaM mahat |
tatraiSha dharmaH sambhUtaH svayaM nArAyaNAnnRRipa
shlokas.18:
suparNo nAma tamRRiShiH prAptavAnpuruShottamAt |
tapasA vai sutaptena damena niyamena cha
shlokas.19:
triH parikrAntavAnetatsuparNo dharmamuttamam |
yasmAttasmAdvrataM hyetattrisauparNamihochyate
shlokas.20:
RRigvedapAThapaThitaM vratametaddhi dushcharam |
suparNAchchApyadhigato dharma eSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.21:
vAyunA dvipadAM shreShTha prathito jagadAyuShA |
vAyoH sakAshAtprAptashcha RRiShibhirvighasAshibhiH
shlokas.22:
tebhyo mahodadhishchainaM prAptavAndharmamuttamam |
tataH so.antardadhe bhUyo nArAyaNasamAhitaH
shlokas.23:
yadA bhUyaH shravaNajA sRRiShTirAsInmahAtmanaH |
brahmaNaH puruShavyAghra tatra kIrtayataH shRRiNu
shlokas.24:
jagatsraShTumanA devo harirnArAyaNaH svayam |
chintayAmAsa puruShaM jagatsargakaraM prabhuH
shlokas.25:
atha chintayatastasya karNAbhyAM puruShaH sRRitaH |
prajAsargakaro brahmA tamuvAcha jagatpatiH
shlokas.26:
sRRija prajAH putra sarvA mukhataH pAdatastathA |
shreyastava vidhAsyAmi balaM tejashcha suvrata
shlokas.27:
dharmaM cha matto gRRihNIShva sAtvataM nAma nAmataH |
tena sarvaM kRRitayugaM sthApayasva yathAvidhi
shlokas.28:
tato brahmA namashchakre devAya harimedhase |
dharmaM chAgryaM sa jagrAha sarahasyaM sasa~Ngraham
AraNyakena sahitaM nArAyaNamukhodgatam
shlokas.29:
upadishya tato dharmaM brahmaNe.amitatejase |
taM kArtayugadharmANaM nirAshIHkarmasa~nj~nitam
jagAma tamasaH pAraM yatrAvyaktaM vyavasthitam
shlokas.30:
tato.atha varado devo brahmalokapitAmahaH |
asRRijatsa tadA lokAnkRRitsnAnsthAvaraja~NgamAn
shlokas.31:
tataH prAvartata tadA Adau kRRitayugaM shubham |
tato hi sAtvato dharmo vyApya lokAnavasthitaH
shlokas.32:
tenaivAdyena dharmeNa brahmA lokavisargakRRit |
pUjayAmAsa deveshaM hariM nArAyaNaM prabhum
shlokas.33:
dharmapratiShThAhetoshcha manuM svArochiShaM tataH |
adhyApayAmAsa tadA lokAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.34:
tataH svArochiShaH putraM svayaM sha~NkhapadaM nRRipa |
adhyApayatpurAvyagraH sarvalokapatirvibhuH
shlokas.35:
tataH sha~NkhapadashchApi putramAtmajamaurasam |
dishApAlaM sudharmANamadhyApayata bhArata
tataH so.antardadhe bhUyaH prApte tretAyuge punaH
shlokas.36:
nAsikyajanmani purA brahmaNaH pArthivottama |
dharmametaM svayaM devo harirnArAyaNaH prabhuH
ujjagArAravindAkSho brahmaNaH pashyatastadA
shlokas.37:
sanatkumAro bhagavA.nstataH prAdhItavAnnRRipa |
sanatkumArAdapi cha vIraNo vai prajApatiH
kRRitAdau kurushArdUla dharmametamadhItavAn
shlokas.38:
vIraNashchApyadhItyainaM rauchyAya manave dadau |
rauchyaH putrAya shuddhAya suvratAya sumedhase
shlokas.39:
kukShinAmne.atha pradadau dishAM pAlAya dharmiNe |
tataH so.antardadhe bhUyo nArAyaNamukhodgataH
shlokas.40:
aNDaje janmani punarbrahmaNe hariyonaye |
eSha dharmaH samudbhUto nArAyaNamukhAtpunaH
shlokas.41:
gRRihIto brahmaNA rAjanprayuktashcha yathAvidhi |
adhyApitAshcha munayo nAmnA barhiShado nRRipa
shlokas.42:
barhiShadbhyashcha sa~NkrAntaH sAmavedAntagaM dvijam |
jyeShThaM nAmnAbhivikhyAtaM jyeShThasAmavrato hariH
shlokas.43:
jyeShThAchchApyanusa~NkrAnto rAjAnamavikampanam |
antardadhe tato rAjanneSha dharmaH prabhorhareH
shlokas.44:
yadidaM saptamaM janma padmajaM brahmaNo nRRipa |
tatraiSha dharmaH kathitaH svayaM nArAyaNena hi
shlokas.45:
pitAmahAya shuddhAya yugAdau lokadhAriNe |
pitAmahashcha dakShAya dharmametaM purA dadau
shlokas.46:
tato jyeShThe tu dauhitre prAdAddakSho nRRipottama |
Aditye saviturjyeShThe vivasvA~njagRRihe tataH
shlokas.47:
tretAyugAdau cha punarvivasvAnmanave dadau |
manushcha lokabhUtyarthaM sutAyekShvAkave dadau
shlokas.48:
ikShvAkuNA cha kathito vyApya lokAnavasthitaH |
gamiShyati kShayAnte cha punarnArAyaNaM nRRipa
shlokas.49:
vratinAM chApi yo dharmaH sa te pUrvaM nRRipottama |
kathito harigItAsu samAsavidhikalpitaH
shlokas.50:
nAradena tu samprAptaH sarahasyaH sasa~NgrahaH |
eSha dharmo jagannAthAtsAkShAnnArAyaNAnnRRipa
shlokas.51:
evameSha mahAndharma Adyo rAjansanAtanaH |
durvij~neyo duShkarashcha sAtvatairdhAryate sadA
shlokas.52:
dharmaj~nAnena chaitena suprayuktena karmaNA |
ahi.nsAdharmayuktena prIyate harirIshvaraH
shlokas.53:
ekavyUhavibhAgo vA kvachiddvivyUhasa~nj~nitaH |
trivyUhashchApi sa~NkhyAtashchaturvyUhashcha dRRishyate
shlokas.54:
harireva hi kShetraj~no nirmamo niShkalastathA |
jIvashcha sarvabhUteShu pa~nchabhUtaguNAtigaH
shlokas.55:
manashcha prathitaM rAjanpa~nchendriyasamIraNam |
eSha lokanidhirdhImAneSha lokavisargakRRit
shlokas.56:
akartA chaiva kartA cha kAryaM kAraNameva cha |
yathechChati tathA rAjankrIDate puruSho.avyayaH
shlokas.57:
eSha ekAntidharmaste kIrtito nRRipasattama |
mayA guruprasAdena durvij~neyo.akRRitAtmabhiH
ekAntino hi puruShA durlabhA bahavo nRRipa
shlokas.58:
yadyekAntibhirAkIrNaM jagatsyAtkurunandana |
ahi.nsakairAtmavidbhiH sarvabhUtahite rataiH
bhavetkRRitayugaprAptirAshIHkarmavivarjitaiH
shlokas.59:
evaM sa bhagavAnvyAso gururmama vishAM pate |
kathayAmAsa dharmaj~no dharmarAj~ne dvijottamaH
shlokas.60:
RRiShINAM saMnidhau rAja~nshRRiNvatoH kRRiShNabhIShmayoH |
tasyApyakathayatpUrvaM nAradaH sumahAtapAH
shlokas.61:
devaM paramakaM brahma shvetaM chandrAbhamachyutam |
yatra chaikAntino yAnti nArAyaNaparAyaNAH
shlokas.62:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM bahuvidhaM dharmaM pratibuddhairniShevitam |
na kurvanti kathaM viprA anye nAnAvrate sthitAH
shlokas.63:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tisraH prakRRitayo rAjandehabandheShu nirmitAH |
sAttvikI rAjasI chaiva tAmasI cheti bhArata
shlokas.64:
dehabandheShu puruShaH shreShThaH kurukulodvaha |
sAttvikaH puruShavyAghra bhavenmokShArthanishchitaH
shlokas.65:
atrApi sa vijAnAti puruShaM brahmavartinam |
nArAyaNaparo mokShastato vai sAttvikaH smRRitaH
shlokas.66:
manIShitaM cha prApnoti chintayanpuruShottamam |
ekAntabhaktiH satataM nArAyaNaparAyaNaH
shlokas.67:
manIShiNo hi ye kechidyatayo mokShakA~NkShiNaH |
teShAM vai ChinnatRRiShNAnAM yogakShemavaho hariH
shlokas.68:
jAyamAnaM hi puruShaM yaM pashyenmadhusUdanaH |
sAttvikastu sa vij~neyo bhavenmokShe cha nishchitaH
shlokas.69:
sA~Nkhyayogena tulyo hi dharma ekAntasevitaH |
