nArAyaNAtmake mokShe tato yAnti parAM gatim
shlokas.70:
nArAyaNena dRRiShTashcha pratibuddho bhavetpumAn |
evamAtmechChayA rAjanpratibuddho na jAyate
shlokas.71:
rAjasI tAmasI chaiva vyAmishre prakRRitI smRRite |
tadAtmakaM hi puruShaM jAyamAnaM vishAM pate
pravRRittilakShaNairyuktaM nAvekShati hariH svayam
shlokas.72:
pashyatyenaM jAyamAnaM brahmA lokapitAmahaH |
rajasA tamasA chaiva mAnuShaM samabhiplutam
shlokas.73:
kAmaM devAshcha RRiShayaH sattvasthA nRRipasattama |
hInAH sattvena sUkShmeNa tato vaikArikAH smRRitAH
shlokas.75:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM vaikAriko gachChetpuruShaH puruShottamam |
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
susUkShmasattvasa.nyuktaM sa.nyuktaM tribhirakSharaiH |
puruShaH puruShaM gachChenniShkriyaH pa~nchavi.nshakam
shlokas.76:
evamekaM sA~NkhyayogaM vedAraNyakameva cha |
parasparA~NgAnyetAni pa~ncharAtraM cha kathyate
eSha ekAntinAM dharmo nArAyaNaparAtmakaH
shlokas.77:
yathA samudrAtprasRRitA jalaughA;stameva rAjanpunarAvishanti |
ime tathA j~nAnamahAjalaughA; nArAyaNaM vai punarAvishanti
shlokas.78:
eSha te kathito dharmaH sAtvato yadubAndhava |
kuruShvainaM yathAnyAyaM yadi shaknoShi bhArata
shlokas.79:
evaM hi sumahAbhAgo nArado gurave mama |
shvetAnAM yatinAmAha ekAntagatimavyayAm
shlokas.80:
vyAsashchAkathayatprItyA dharmaputrAya dhImate |
sa evAyaM mayA tubhyamAkhyAtaH prasRRito guroH
shlokas.81:
itthaM hi dushcharo dharma eSha pArthivasattama |
yathaiva tvaM tathaivAnye na bhajanti vimohitAH
shlokas.82:
kRRiShNa eva hi lokAnAM bhAvano mohanastathA |
saMhArakArakashchaiva kAraNaM cha vishAM pate

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
sA~NkhyaM yogaM pa~ncharAtraM vedAraNyakameva cha |
j~nAnAnyetAni brahmarShe lokeShu pracharanti ha
shlokas.2:
kimetAnyekaniShThAni pRRitha~NniShThAni vA mune |
prabrUhi vai mayA pRRiShTaH pravRRittiM cha yathAkramam
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
jaj~ne bahuj~naM paramatyudAraM; yaM dvIpamadhye sutamAtmavantam |
parAsharAdgandhavatI maharShiM; tasmai namo.aj~nAnatamonudAya
shlokas.4:
pitAmahAdyaM pravadanti ShaShThaM; maharShimArSheyavibhUtiyuktam |
nArAyaNasyA.nshajamekaputraM; dvaipAyanaM vedamahAnidhAnam
shlokas.5:
tamAdikAleShu mahAvibhUti;rnArAyaNo brahmamahAnidhAnam |
sasarja putrArthamudAratejA; vyAsaM mahAtmAnamajaH purANaH
shlokas.6:
janamejaya uvAcha||
tvayaiva kathitaH pUrvaM sambhavo dvijasattama |
vasiShThasya sutaH shaktiH shakteH putraH parAsharaH
shlokas.7:
parAsharasya dAyAdaH kRRiShNadvaipAyano muniH |
bhUyo nArAyaNasutaM tvamevainaM prabhAShase
shlokas.8:
kimataH pUrvajaM janma vyAsasyAmitatejasaH |
kathayasvottamamate janma nArAyaNodbhavam
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vedArthAnvettukAmasya dharmiShThasya taponidheH |
gurorme j~nAnaniShThasya himavatpAda AsataH
shlokas.10:
kRRitvA bhAratamAkhyAnaM tapaHshrAntasya dhImataH |
shushrUShAM tatparA rAjankRRitavanto vayaM tadA
shlokas.11:
sumanturjaiminishchaiva pailashcha sudRRiDhavrataH |
ahaM chaturthaH shiShyo vai shuko vyAsAtmajastathA
shlokas.12:
ebhiH parivRRito vyAsaH shiShyaiH pa~nchabhiruttamaiH |
shushubhe himavatpAde bhUtairbhUtapatiryathA
shlokas.13:
vedAnAvartayansA~NgAnbhAratArthA.nshcha sarvashaH |
tamekamanasaM dAntaM yuktA vayamupAsmahe
shlokas.14:
kathAntare.atha kasmi.nshchitpRRiShTo.asmAbhirdvijottamaH |
vedArthAnbhAratArthA.nshcha janma nArAyaNAttathA
shlokas.15:
sa pUrvamuktvA vedArthAnbhAratArthA.nshcha tattvavit |
nArAyaNAdidaM janma vyAhartumupachakrame
shlokas.16:
shRRiNudhvamAkhyAnavarametadArSheyamuttamam |
AdikAlodbhavaM viprAstapasAdhigataM mayA
shlokas.17:
prApte prajAvisarge vai saptame padmasambhave |
nArAyaNo mahAyogI shubhAshubhavivarjitaH
shlokas.18:
sasRRije nAbhitaH putraM brahmANamamitaprabham |
tataH sa prAdurabhavadathainaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.19:
mama tvaM nAbhito jAtaH prajAsargakaraH prabhuH |
sRRija prajAstvaM vividhA brahmansajaDapaNDitAH
shlokas.20:
sa evamukto vimukhashchintAvyAkulamAnasaH |
praNamya varadaM devamuvAcha harimIshvaram
shlokas.21:
kA shaktirmama devesha prajAH sraShTuM namo.astu te |
apraj~nAvAnahaM deva vidhatsva yadanantaram
shlokas.22:
sa evamukto bhagavAnbhUtvAthAntarhitastataH |
chintayAmAsa devesho buddhiM buddhimatAM varaH
shlokas.23:
svarUpiNI tato buddhirupatasthe hariM prabhum |
yogena chainAM niryogaH svayaM niyuyuje tadA
shlokas.24:
sa tAmaishvaryayogasthAM buddhiM shaktimatIM satIm |
uvAcha vachanaM devo buddhiM vai prabhuravyayaH
shlokas.25:
brahmANaM pravishasveti lokasRRiShTyarthasiddhaye |
tatastamIshvarAdiShTA buddhiH kShipraM vivesha sA
shlokas.26:
athainaM buddhisa.nyuktaM punaH sa dadRRishe hariH |
bhUyashchainaM vachaH prAha sRRijemA vividhAH prajAH
shlokas.27:
evamuktvA sa bhagavA.nstatraivAntaradhIyata |
prApa chaiva muhUrtena svasthAnaM devasa~nj~nitam
shlokas.28:
tAM chaiva prakRRitiM prApya ekIbhAvagato.abhavat |
athAsya buddhirabhavatpunaranyA tadA kila
shlokas.29:
sRRiShTA imAH prajAH sarvA brahmaNA parameShThinA |
daityadAnavagandharvarakShogaNasamAkulAH
jAtA hIyaM vasumatI bhArAkrAntA tapasvinI
shlokas.30:
bahavo balinaH pRRithvyAM daityadAnavarAkShasAH |
bhaviShyanti tapoyuktA varAnprApsyanti chottamAn
shlokas.31:
avashyameva taiH sarvairvaradAnena darpitaiH |
bAdhitavyAH suragaNA RRiShayashcha tapodhanAH
tatra nyAyyamidaM kartuM bhArAvataraNaM mayA
shlokas.32:
atha nAnAsamudbhUtairvasudhAyAM yathAkramam |
nigraheNa cha pApAnAM sAdhUnAM pragraheNa cha
shlokas.33:
imAM tapasvinIM satyAM dhArayiShyAmi medinIm |
mayA hyeShA hi dhriyate pAtAlasthena bhoginA
shlokas.34:
mayA dhRRitA dhArayati jagaddhi sacharAcharam |
tasmAtpRRithvyAH paritrANaM kariShye sambhavaM gataH
shlokas.35:
evaM sa chintayitvA tu bhagavAnmadhusUdanaH |
rUpANyanekAnyasRRijatprAdurbhAvabhavAya saH
shlokas.36:
vArAhaM nArasiMhaM cha vAmanaM mAnuShaM tathA |
ebhirmayA nihantavyA durvinItAH surArayaH
shlokas.37:
atha bhUyo jagatsraShTA bhoHshabdenAnunAdayan |
sarasvatImuchchachAra tatra sArasvato.abhavat
shlokas.38:
apAntaratamA nAma suto vAksambhavo vibhoH |
bhUtabhavyabhaviShyaj~naH satyavAdI dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.39:
tamuvAcha nataM mUrdhnA devAnAmAdiravyayaH |
vedAkhyAne shrutiH kAryA tvayA matimatAM vara
tasmAtkuru yathAj~naptaM mayaitadvachanaM mune
shlokas.40:
tena bhinnAstadA vedA manoH svAyambhuve.antare |
tatastutoSha bhagavAnharistenAsya karmaNA
tapasA cha sutaptena yamena niyamena cha
shlokas.41:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
manvantareShu putra tvamevaM lokapravartakaH |
bhaviShyasyachalo brahmannapradhRRiShyashcha nityashaH
shlokas.42:
punastiShye cha samprApte kuravo nAma bhAratAH |
bhaviShyanti mahAtmAno rAjAnaH prathitA bhuvi
shlokas.43:
teShAM tvattaH prasUtAnAM kulabhedo bhaviShyati |
parasparavinAshArthaM tvAmRRite dvijasattama
shlokas.44:
tatrApyanekadhA vedAnbhetsyase tapasAnvitaH |
kRRiShNe yuge cha samprApte kRRiShNavarNo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.45:
dharmANAM vividhAnAM cha kartA j~nAnakarastathA |
bhaviShyasi tapoyukto na cha rAgAdvimokShyase
shlokas.46:
vItarAgashcha putraste paramAtmA bhaviShyati |
maheshvaraprasAdena naitadvachanamanyathA
shlokas.47:
yaM mAnasaM vai pravadanti putraM; pitAmahasyottamabuddhiyuktam |
vasiShThamagryaM tapaso nidhAnaM; yashchApi sUryaM vyatirichya bhAti
shlokas.48:
tasyAnvaye chApi tato maharShiH; parAsharo nAma mahAprabhAvaH |
pitA sa te vedanidhirvariShTho; mahAtapA vai tapaso nivAsaH
kAnInagarbhaH pitRRikanyakAyAM; tasmAdRRiShestvaM bhavitA cha putraH
shlokas.49:
bhUtabhavyabhaviShyANAM ChinnasarvArthasa.nshayaH |
ye hyatikrAntakAH pUrvaM sahasrayugaparyayAH
shlokas.50:
tA.nshcha sarvAnmayoddiShTAndrakShyase tapasAnvitaH |
punardrakShyasi chAnekasahasrayugaparyayAn
shlokas.51:
anAdinidhanaM loke chakrahastaM cha mAM mune |
anudhyAnAnmama mune naitadvachanamanyathA
shlokas.52:
shanaishcharaH sUryaputro bhaviShyati manurmahAn |
tasminmanvantare chaiva saptarShigaNapUrvakaH
tvameva bhavitA vatsa matprasAdAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.53:
vyAsa uvAcha||
evaM sArasvatamRRiShimapAntaratamaM tadA |
uktvA vachanamIshAnaH sAdhayasvetyathAbravIt
shlokas.54:
so.ahaM tasya prasAdena devasya harimedhasaH |
apAntaratamA nAma tato jAto.a.aj~nayA hareH
punashcha jAto vikhyAto vasiShThakulanandanaH
shlokas.55:
tadetatkathitaM janma mayA pUrvakamAtmanaH |
nArAyaNaprasAdena tathA nArAyaNA.nshajam
shlokas.56:
mayA hi sumahattaptaM tapaH paramadAruNam |
purA matimatAM shreShThAH parameNa samAdhinA
shlokas.57:
etadvaH kathitaM sarvaM yanmAM pRRichChatha putrakAH |
pUrvajanma bhaviShyaM cha bhaktAnAM snehato mayA
shlokas.58:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
eSha te kathitaH pUrvaM sambhavo.asmadgurornRRipa |
vyAsasyAkliShTamanaso yathA pRRiShTaH punaH shRRiNu
shlokas.59:
sA~NkhyaM yogaM pa~ncharAtraM vedAH pAshupataM tathA |
j~nAnAnyetAni rAjarShe viddhi nAnAmatAni vai
shlokas.60:
sA~Nkhyasya vaktA kapilaH paramarShiH sa uchyate |
hiraNyagarbho yogasya vettA nAnyaH purAtanaH
shlokas.61:
apAntaratamAshchaiva vedAchAryaH sa uchyate |
prAchInagarbhaM tamRRiShiM pravadantIha kechana
shlokas.62:
umApatirbhUtapatiH shrIkaNTho brahmaNaH sutaH |
uktavAnidamavyagro j~nAnaM pAshupataM shivaH
shlokas.63:
pa~ncharAtrasya kRRitsnasya vettA tu bhagavAnsvayam |
sarveShu cha nRRipashreShTha j~nAneShveteShu dRRishyate
shlokas.64:
yathAgamaM yathAj~nAnaM niShThA nArAyaNaH prabhuH |
na chainamevaM jAnanti tamobhUtA vishAM pate
shlokas.65:
tameva shAstrakartAraM pravadanti manIShiNaH |
niShThAM nArAyaNamRRiShiM nAnyo.astIti cha vAdinaH
shlokas.66:
niHsa.nshayeShu sarveShu nityaM vasati vai hariH |
sasa.nshayAnhetubalAnnAdhyAvasati mAdhavaH
shlokas.67:
pa~ncharAtravido ye tu yathAkramaparA nRRipa |
ekAntabhAvopagatAste hariM pravishanti vai
shlokas.68:
sA~NkhyaM cha yogaM cha sanAtane dve; vedAshcha sarve nikhilena rAjan |
sarvaiH samastairRRiShibhirnirukto; nArAyaNo vishvamidaM purANam
shlokas.69:
shubhAshubhaM karma samIritaM ya;tpravartate sarvalokeShu ki~nchit |
tasmAdRRiShestadbhavatIti vidyA;ddivyantarikShe bhuvi chApsu chApi

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
bahavaH puruShA brahmannutAho eka eva tu |
ko hyatra puruShaH shreShThaH ko vA yonirihochyate
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
bahavaH puruShA loke sA~NkhyayogavichAriNAm |
naitadichChanti puruShamekaM kurukulodvaha
shlokas.3:
bahUnAM puruShANAM cha yathaikA yoniruchyate |
tathA taM puruShaM vishvaM vyAkhyAsyAmi guNAdhikam
shlokas.4:
namaskRRitvA tu gurave vyAsAyAmitatejase |
tapoyuktAya dAntAya vandyAya paramarShaye
shlokas.5:
idaM puruShasUktaM hi sarvavedeShu pArthiva |
RRitaM satyaM cha vikhyAtamRRiShisiMhena chintitam
shlokas.6:
utsargeNApavAdena RRiShibhiH kapilAdibhiH |
adhyAtmachintAmAshritya shAstrANyuktAni bhArata
shlokas.7:
samAsatastu yadvyAsaH puruShaikatvamuktavAn |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi prasAdAdamitaujasaH
shlokas.8:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
brahmaNA saha sa.nvAdaM tryambakasya vishAM pate
shlokas.9:
kShIrodasya samudrasya madhye hATakasaprabhaH |
vaijayanta iti khyAtaH parvatapravaro nRRipa
shlokas.10:
tatrAdhyAtmagatiM deva ekAkI pravichintayan |
vairAjasadane nityaM vaijayantaM niShevate
shlokas.11:
atha tatrAsatastasya chaturvaktrasya dhImataH |
lalATaprabhavaH putraH shiva AgAdyadRRichChayA
AkAshenaiva yogIshaH purA trinayanaH prabhuH
shlokas.12:
tataH khAnnipapAtAshu dharaNIdharamUrdhani |
agratashchAbhavatprIto vavande chApi pAdayoH
shlokas.13:
taM pAdayornipatitaM dRRiShTvA savyena pANinA |
utthApayAmAsa tadA prabhurekaH prajApatiH
shlokas.14:
uvAcha chainaM bhagavA.nshchirasyAgatamAtmajam |
svAgataM te mahAbAho diShTyA prApto.asi me.antikam
shlokas.15:
kachchitte kushalaM putra svAdhyAyatapasoH sadA |
nityamugratapAstvaM hi tataH pRRichChAmi te punaH
shlokas.16:
rudra uvAcha||
tvatprasAdena bhagavansvAdhyAyatapasormama |
kushalaM chAvyayaM chaiva sarvasya jagatastathA
shlokas.17:
chiradRRiShTo hi bhagavAnvairAjasadane mayA |
tato.ahaM parvataM prAptastvimaM tvatpAdasevitam
shlokas.18:
kautUhalaM chApi hi me ekAntagamanena te |
naitatkAraNamalpaM hi bhaviShyati pitAmaha
shlokas.19:
kiM nu tatsadanaM shreShThaM kShutpipAsAvivarjitam |
surAsurairadhyuShitamRRiShibhishchAmitaprabhaiH
shlokas.20:
gandharvairapsarobhishcha satataM saMniShevitam |
utsRRijyemaM girivaramekAkI prAptavAnasi
shlokas.21:
brahmovAcha||
vaijayanto girivaraH satataM sevyate mayA |
atraikAgreNa manasA puruShashchintyate virAT
shlokas.22:
rudra uvAcha||
bahavaH puruShA brahma.nstvayA sRRiShTAH svayambhuvA |
sRRijyante chApare brahmansa chaikaH puruSho virAT
shlokas.23:
ko hyasau chintyate brahma.nstvayA vai puruShottamaH |
etanme sa.nshayaM brUhi mahatkautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.24:
brahmovAcha||
bahavaH puruShAH putra ye tvayA samudAhRRitAH |
evametadatikrAntaM draShTavyaM naivamityapi
AdhAraM tu pravakShyAmi ekasya puruShasya te
shlokas.25:
bahUnAM puruShANAM sa yathaikA yoniruchyate |
tathA taM puruShaM vishvaM paramaM sumahattamam
nirguNaM nirguNA bhUtvA pravishanti sanAtanam

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
shRRiNu putra yathA hyeSha puruShaH shAshvato.avyayaH |
akShayashchAprameyashcha sarvagashcha niruchyate
shlokas.2:
na sa shakyastvayA draShTuM mayAnyairvApi sattama |
saguNo nirguNo vishvo j~nAnadRRishyo hyasau smRRitaH
shlokas.3:
asharIraH sharIreShu sarveShu nivasatyasau |
vasannapi sharIreShu na sa lipyati karmabhiH
shlokas.4:
mamAntarAtmA tava cha ye chAnye dehasa~nj~nitAH |
sarveShAM sAkShibhUto.asau na grAhyaH kenachitkvachit
shlokas.5:
vishvamUrdhA vishvabhujo vishvapAdAkShinAsikaH |
ekashcharati kShetreShu svairachArI yathAsukham
shlokas.6:
kShetrANi hi sharIrANi bIjAni cha shubhAshubhe |
tAni vetti sa yogAtmA tataH kShetraj~na uchyate
shlokas.7:
nAgatirna gatistasya j~neyA bhUtena kenachit |
sA~Nkhyena vidhinA chaiva yogena cha yathAkramam
shlokas.8:
chintayAmi gatiM chAsya na gatiM vedmi chottamAm |
yathAj~nAnaM tu vakShyAmi puruShaM taM sanAtanam
shlokas.9:
tasyaikatvaM mahattvaM hi sa chaikaH puruShaH smRRitaH |
mahApuruShashabdaM sa bibhartyekaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.10:
eko hutAsho bahudhA samidhyate; ekaH sUryastapasAM yonirekA |
eko vAyurbahudhA vAti loke; mahodadhishchAmbhasAM yonirekaH
puruShashchaiko nirguNo vishvarUpa;staM nirguNaM puruShaM chAvishanti
shlokas.11:
hitvA guNamayaM sarvaM karma hitvA shubhAshubham |
ubhe satyAnRRite tyaktvA evaM bhavati nirguNaH
shlokas.12:
achintyaM chApi taM j~nAtvA bhAvasUkShmaM chatuShTayam |
vicharedyo yatiryattaH sa gachChetpuruShaM prabhum
shlokas.13:
evaM hi paramAtmAnaM kechidichChanti paNDitAH |
ekAtmAnaM tathAtmAnamapare.adhyAtmachintakAH
shlokas.14:
tatra yaH paramAtmA hi sa nityaM nirguNaH smRRitaH |
sa hi nArAyaNo j~neyaH sarvAtmA puruSho hi saH
na lipyate phalaishchApi padmapatramivAmbhasA
shlokas.15:
karmAtmA tvaparo yo.asau mokShabandhaiH sa yujyate |
sasaptadashakenApi rAshinA yujyate hi saH
evaM bahuvidhaH proktaH puruShaste yathAkramam
shlokas.16:
yattatkRRitsnaM lokatantrasya dhAma; vedyaM paraM bodhanIyaM saboddhRRi |
mantA mantavyaM prAshitA prAshitavyaM; ghrAtA ghreyaM sparshitA sparshanIyam
shlokas.17:
draShTA draShTavyaM shrAvitA shrAvaNIyaM; j~nAtA j~neyaM saguNaM nirguNaM cha |
yadvai proktaM guNasAmyaM pradhAnaM; nityaM chaitachChAshvataM chAvyayaM cha
shlokas.18:
yadvai sUte dhAturAdyaM nidhAnaM; tadvai viprAH pravadante.aniruddham |
yadvai loke vaidikaM karma sAdhu; AshIryuktaM taddhi tasyopabhojyam
shlokas.19:
devAH sarve munayaH sAdhu dAntA;staM prAgyaj~nairyaj~nabhAgaM yajante |
ahaM brahmA Adya IshaH prajAnAM; tasmAjjAtastvaM cha mattaH prasUtaH
matto jagajja~NgamaM sthAvaraM cha; sarve vedAH sarahasyA hi putra
shlokas.20:
chaturvibhaktaH puruShaH sa krIDati yathechChati |
evaM sa eva bhagavA~nj~nAnena pratibodhitaH
shlokas.21:
etatte kathitaM putra yathAvadanupRRichChataH |
sA~Nkhyaj~nAne tathA yoge yathAvadanuvarNitam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
dharmAH pitAmahenoktA mokShadharmAshritAH shubhAH |
dharmamAshramiNAM shreShThaM vaktumarhati me bhavAn
shlokas.2:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sarvatra vihito dharmaH svargyaH satyaphalodayaH |
bahudvArasya dharmasya nehAsti viphalA kriyA
shlokas.3:
yasminyasmi.nstu viShaye yo yo yAti vinishchayam |
sa tamevAbhijAnAti nAnyaM bharatasattama
shlokas.4:
api cha tvaM naravyAghra shrotumarhasi me kathAm |
purA shakrasya kathitAM nAradena surarShiNA
shlokas.5:
surarShirnArado rAjansiddhastrailokyasaMmataH |
paryeti kramasho lokAnvAyuravyAhato yathA
shlokas.6:
sa kadAchinmaheShvAsa devarAjAlayaM gataH |
satkRRitashcha mahendreNa pratyAsannagato.abhavat
shlokas.7:
taM kRRitakShaNamAsInaM paryapRRichChachChachIpatiH |
brahmarShe ki~nchidAshcharyamasti dRRiShTaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.8:
yathA tvamapi viprarShe trailokyaM sacharAcharam |
jAtakautUhalo nityaM siddhashcharasi sAkShivat
shlokas.9:
na hyastyaviditaM loke devarShe tava ki~nchana |
shrutaM vApyanubhUtaM vA dRRiShTaM vA kathayasva me
shlokas.10:
tasmai rAjansurendrAya nArado vadatAM varaH |
AsInAyopapannAya proktavAnvipulAM kathAm
shlokas.11:
yathA yena cha kalpena sa tasmai dvijasattamaH |
kathAM kathitavAnpRRiShTastathA tvamapi me shRRiNu

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
AsItkila kurushreShTha mahApadme purottame |
ga~NgAyA dakShiNe tIre kashchidvipraH samAhitaH
shlokas.2:
saumyaH somAnvaye vede gatAdhvA Chinnasa.nshayaH |
dharmanityo jitakrodho nityatRRipto jitendriyaH
shlokas.3:
ahi.nsAnirato nityaM satyaH sajjanasaMmataH |
nyAyaprAptena vittena svena shIlena chAnvitaH
shlokas.4:
j~nAtisambandhivipule mitrApAshrayasaMmate |
kule mahati vikhyAte vishiShTAM vRRittimAsthitaH
shlokas.5:
sa putrAnbahulAndRRiShTvA vipule karmaNi sthitaH |
kuladharmAshrito rAjandharmacharyAparo.abhavat
shlokas.6:
tataH sa dharmaM vedoktaM yathAshAstroktameva cha |
shiShTAchIrNaM cha dharmaM cha trividhaM chintya chetasA
shlokas.7:
kiM nu me syAchChubhaM kRRitvA kiM kShamaM kiM parAyaNam |
ityevaM khidyate nityaM na cha yAti vinishchayam
shlokas.8:
tasyaivaM khidyamAnasya dharmaM paramamAsthitaH |
kadAchidatithiH prApto brAhmaNaH susamAhitaH
shlokas.9:
sa tasmai satkriyAM chakre kriyAyuktena hetunA |
vishrAntaM chainamAsInamidaM vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
samutpannAbhidhAno.asmi vA~NmAdhuryeNa te.anagha |
mitratAmabhipannastvAM ki~nchidvakShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.2:
gRRihasthadharmaM viprendra kRRitvA putragataM tvaham |
dharmaM paramakaM kuryAM ko hi mArgo bhaveddvija
shlokas.3:
ahamAtmAnamAtmasthameka evAtmani sthitaH |
kartuM kA~NkShAmi nechChAmi baddhaH sAdhAraNairguNaiH
shlokas.4:
yAvadevAnatItaM me vayaH putraphalAshritam |
tAvadichChAmi pAtheyamAdAtuM pAralaukikam
shlokas.5:
asminhi lokasantAne paraM pAramabhIpsataH |
utpannA me matiriyaM kuto dharmamayaH plavaH
shlokas.6:
samuhyamAnAni nishamya loke; niryAtyamAnAni cha sAttvikAni |
dRRiShTvA cha dharmadhvajaketumAlAM; prakIryamANAmupari prajAnAm
shlokas.7:
na me mano rajyati bhogakAle; dRRiShTvA yatInprArthayataH paratra |
tenAtithe buddhibalAshrayeNa; dharmArthatattve viniyu~NkShva mAM tvam
shlokas.8:
bhIShma uvAcha||
so.atithirvachanaM tasya shrutvA dharmAbhilAShiNaH |
provAcha vachanaM shlakShNaM prAj~no madhurayA girA
shlokas.9:
ahamapyatra muhyAmi mamApyeSha manorathaH |
na cha saMnishchayaM yAmi bahudvAre triviShTape
shlokas.10:
kechinmokShaM prasha.nsanti kechidyaj~naphalaM dvijAH |
vAnaprasthAshramaM kechidgArhasthyaM kechidAshritAH
shlokas.11:
rAjadharmAshrayaM kechitkechidAtmaphalAshrayam |
gurucharyAshrayaM kechitkechidvAkyaM yamAshrayam
shlokas.12:
mAtaraM pitaraM kechichChushrUShanto divaM gatAH |
ahi.nsayA pare svargaM satyena cha tathA pare
shlokas.13:
Ahave.abhimukhAH kechinnihatAH sviddivaM gatAH |
kechidu~nChavrataiH siddhAH svargamArgasamAshritAH
shlokas.14:
kechidadhyayane yuktA vedavrataparAH shubhAH |
buddhimanto gatAH svargaM tuShTAtmAno jitendriyAH
shlokas.15:
ArjavenApare yuktA nihatAnArjavairjanaiH |
RRijavo nAkapRRiShThe vai shuddhAtmAnaH pratiShThitAH
shlokas.16:
evaM bahuvidhairloke dharmadvArairanAvRRitaiH |
mamApi matirAvignA meghalekheva vAyunA

shlokas.1:
atithiruvAcha||
upadeshaM tu te vipra kariShye.ahaM yathAgamam |
guruNA me yathAkhyAtamarthatastachcha me shRRiNu
shlokas.2:
yatra pUrvAbhisargeNa dharmachakraM pravartitam |
naimiShe gomatItIre tatra nAgAhvayaM puram
shlokas.3:
samagraistridashaistatra iShTamAsIddvijarShabha |
yatrendrAtikramaM chakre mAndhAtA rAjasattamaH
shlokas.4:
kRRitAdhivAso dharmAtmA tatra chakShuHshravA mahAn |
padmanAbho mahAbhAgaH padma ityeva vishrutaH
shlokas.5:
sa vAchA karmaNA chaiva manasA cha dvijarShabha |
prasAdayati bhUtAni trividhe vartmani sthitaH
shlokas.6:
sAmnA dAnena bhedena daNDeneti chaturvidham |
viShamasthaM janaM svaM cha chakShurdhyAnena rakShati
shlokas.7:
tamabhikramya vidhinA praShTumarhasi kA~NkShitam |
sa te paramakaM dharmaM namithyA darshayiShyati
shlokas.8:
sa hi sarvAtithirnAgo buddhishAstravishAradaH |
guNairanavamairyuktaH samastairAbhikAmikaiH
shlokas.9:
prakRRityA nityasalilo nityamadhyayane rataH |
tapodamAbhyAM sa.nyukto vRRittenAnavareNa cha
shlokas.10:
yajvA dAnaruchiH kShAnto vRRitte cha parame sthitaH |
satyavAganasUyushcha shIlavAnabhisa.nshritaH
shlokas.11:
sheShAnnabhoktA vachanAnukUlo; hitArjavotkRRiShTakRRitAkRRitaj~naH |
avairakRRidbhUtahite niyukto; ga~NgAhradAmbho.abhijanopapannaH

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atibhArodyatasyaiva bhArApanayanaM mahat |
parAshvAsakaraM vAkyamidaM me bhavataH shrutam
shlokas.2:
adhvaklAntasya shayanaM sthAnaklAntasya chAsanam |
tRRiShitasya cha pAnIyaM kShudhArtasya cha bhojanam
shlokas.3:
Ipsitasyeva samprAptirannasya samaye.atitheH |
eShitasyAtmanaH kAle vRRiddhasyeva suto yathA
shlokas.4:
manasA chintitasyeva prItisnigdhasya darshanam |
prahrAdayati mAM vAkyaM bhavatA yadudIritam
shlokas.5:
dattachakShurivAkAshe pashyAmi vimRRishAmi cha |
praj~nAnavachanAdyo.ayamupadesho hi me kRRitaH
bADhamevaM kariShyAmi yathA mAM bhAShate bhavAn
shlokas.6:
ihemAM rajanIM sAdho nivasasva mayA saha |
prabhAte yAsyati bhavAnparyAshvastaH sukhoShitaH
asau hi bhagavAnsUryo mandarashmiravA~NmukhaH
shlokas.7:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tatastena kRRitAtithyaH so.atithiH shatrusUdana |
uvAsa kila tAM rAtriM saha tena dvijena vai
shlokas.8:
tattachcha dharmasa.nyuktaM tayoH kathayatostadA |
vyatItA sA nishA kRRitsnA sukhena divasopamA
shlokas.9:
tataH prabhAtasamaye so.atithistena pUjitaH |
brAhmaNena yathAshaktyA svakAryamabhikA~NkShatA
shlokas.10:
tataH sa vipraH kRRitadharmanishchayaH; kRRitAbhyanuj~naH svajanena dharmavit |
yathopadiShTaM bhujagendrasa.nshrayaM; jagAma kAle sukRRitaikanishchayaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa vanAni vichitrANi tIrthAni cha sarA.nsi cha |
abhigachChankrameNa sma ka~nchinmunimupasthitaH
shlokas.2:
taM sa tena yathoddiShTaM nAgaM vipreNa brAhmaNaH |
paryapRRichChadyathAnyAyaM shrutvaiva cha jagAma saH
shlokas.3:
so.abhigamya yathAkhyAtaM nAgAyatanamarthavit |
proktavAnahamasmIti bhoHshabdAla~NkRRitaM vachaH
shlokas.4:
tatastasya vachaH shrutvA rUpiNI dharmavatsalA |
darshayAmAsa taM vipraM nAgapatnI pativratA
shlokas.5:
sA tasmai vidhivatpUjAM chakre dharmaparAyaNA |
svAgatenAgataM kRRitvA kiM karomIti chAbravIt
shlokas.6:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
vishrAnto.abhyarchitashchAsmi bhavatyA shlakShNayA girA |
draShTumichChAmi bhavati taM devaM nAgamuttamam
shlokas.7:
etaddhi paramaM kAryametanme phalamIpsitam |
anenArthena chAsmyadya samprAptaH pannagAlayam
shlokas.8:
nAgabhAryovAcha||
Arya sUryarathaM voDhuM gato.asau mAsachArikaH |
saptAShTabhirdinairvipra darshayiShyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.9:
etadviditamAryasya vivAsakaraNaM mama |
bharturbhavatu kiM chAnyatkriyatAM tadvadasva me
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
anena nishchayenAhaM sAdhvi samprAptavAniha |
pratIkShannAgamaM devi vatsyAmyasminmahAvane
shlokas.11:
samprAptasyaiva chAvyagramAvedyo.ahamihAgataH |
mamAbhigamanaM prApto vAchyashcha vachanaM tvayA
shlokas.12:
ahamapyatra vatsyAmi gomatyAH puline shubhe |
kAlaM parimitAhAro yathoktaM paripAlayan
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tataH sa viprastAM nAgIM samAdhAya punaH punaH |
tadeva pulinaM nadyAH prayayau brAhmaNarShabhaH

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha tena narashreShTha brAhmaNena tapasvinA |
nirAhAreNa vasatA duHkhitAste bhuja~NgamAH
shlokas.2:
sarve sambhUya sahitAstasya nAgasya bAndhavAH |
bhrAtarastanayA bhAryA yayustaM brAhmaNaM prati
shlokas.3:
te.apashyanpuline taM vai vivikte niyatavratam |
samAsInaM nirAhAraM dvijaM japyaparAyaNam
shlokas.4:
te sarve samabhikramya vipramabhyarchya chAsakRRit |
UchurvAkyamasa.ndigdhamAtitheyasya bAndhavAH
shlokas.5:
ShaShTho hi divasaste.adya prAptasyeha tapodhana |
na chAbhilaShase ki~nchidAhAraM dharmavatsala
shlokas.6:
asmAnabhigatashchAsi vayaM cha tvAmupasthitAH |
kAryaM chAtithyamasmAbhirvayaM sarve kuTumbinaH
shlokas.7:
mUlaM phalaM vA parNaM vA payo vA dvijasattama |
AhArahetorannaM vA bhoktumarhasi brAhmaNa
shlokas.8:
tyaktAhAreNa bhavatA vane nivasatA satA |
bAlavRRiddhamidaM sarvaM pIDyate dharmasa~NkaTAt
shlokas.9:
na hi no bhrUNahA kashchidrAjApathyo.anRRito.api vA |
pUrvAshI vA kule hyasmindevatAtithibandhuShu
shlokas.10:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
upadeshena yuShmAkamAhAro.ayaM mayA vRRitaH |
dvirUnaM dasharAtraM vai nAgasyAgamanaM prati
shlokas.11:
yadyaShTarAtre niryAte nAgamiShyati pannagaH |
tadAhAraM kariShyAmi tannimittamidaM vratam
shlokas.12:
kartavyo na cha santApo gamyatAM cha yathAgatam |
tannimittaM vrataM mahyaM naitadbhettumihArhatha
shlokas.13:
bhIShma uvAcha||
tena te samanuj~nAtA brAhmaNena bhuja~NgamAH |
svameva bhavanaM jagmurakRRitArthA nararShabha

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
atha kAle bahutithe pUrNe prApto bhuja~NgamaH |
dattAbhyanuj~naH svaM veshma kRRitakarmA vivasvataH
shlokas.2:
taM bhAryA samabhikrAmatpAdashauchAdibhirguNaiH |
upapannAM cha tAM sAdhvIM pannagaH paryapRRichChata
shlokas.3:
api tvamasi kalyANi devatAtithipUjane |
pUrvamuktena vidhinA yuktA yuktena matsamam
shlokas.4:
na khalvasyakRRitArthena strIbuddhyA mArdavIkRRitA |
madviyogena sushroNi viyuktA dharmasetunA
shlokas.5:
nAgabhAryovAcha||
shiShyANAM gurushushrUShA viprANAM vedapAraNam |
bhRRityAnAM svAmivachanaM rAj~nAM lokAnupAlanam
shlokas.6:
sarvabhUtaparitrANaM kShatradharma ihochyate |
vaishyAnAM yaj~nasa.nvRRittirAtitheyasamanvitA
shlokas.7:
viprakShatriyavaishyAnAM shushrUShA shUdrakarma tat |
gRRihasthadharmo nAgendra sarvabhUtahitaiShitA
shlokas.8:
niyatAhAratA nityaM vratacharyA yathAkramam |
dharmo hi dharmasambandhAdindriyANAM visheShaNam
shlokas.9:
ahaM kasya kuto vAhaM kaH ko me ha bhavediti |
prayojanamatirnityamevaM mokShAshramI bhavet
shlokas.10:
pativratAtvaM bhAryAyAH paramo dharma uchyate |
tavopadeshAnnAgendra tachcha tattvena vedmi vai
shlokas.11:
sAhaM dharmaM vijAnantI dharmanitye tvayi sthite |
satpathaM kathamutsRRijya yAsyAmi viShame pathi
shlokas.12:
devatAnAM mahAbhAga dharmacharyA na hIyate |
atithInAM cha satkAre nityayuktAsmyatandritA
shlokas.13:
saptAShTadivasAstvadya viprasyehAgatasya vai |
sa cha kAryaM na me khyAti darshanaM tava kA~NkShati
shlokas.14:
gomatyAstveSha puline tvaddarshanasamutsukaH |
AsIno.a.avartayanbrahma brAhmaNaH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.15:
ahaM tvanena nAgendra sAmapUrvaM samAhitA |
prasthApyo matsakAshaM sa samprApto bhujagottamaH
shlokas.16:
etachChrutvA mahAprAj~na tatra gantuM tvamarhasi |
dAtumarhasi vA tasya darshanaM darshanashravaH

shlokas.1:
nAga uvAcha||
atha brAhmaNarUpeNa kaM taM samanupashyasi |
mAnuShaM kevalaM vipraM devaM vAtha shuchismite
shlokas.2:
ko hi mAM mAnuShaH shakto draShTukAmo yashasvini |
sa.ndarshanaruchirvAkyamAj~nApUrvaM vadiShyati
shlokas.3:
surAsuragaNAnAM cha devarShINAM cha bhAmini |
nanu nAgA mahAvIryAH sauraseyAstarasvinaH
shlokas.4:
vandanIyAshcha varadA vayamapyanuyAyinaH |
manuShyANAM visheSheNa dhanAdhyakShA iti shrutiH
shlokas.5:
nAgabhAryovAcha||
ArjavenAbhijAnAmi nAsau devo.anilAshana |
ekaM tvasya vijAnAmi bhaktimAnatiroShaNaH
shlokas.6:
sa hi kAryAntarAkA~NkShI jalepsuH stokako yathA |
varShaM varShapriyaH pakShI darshanaM tava kA~NkShati
shlokas.7:
na hi tvA daivataM ki~nchidvivignaM pratipAlayet |
tulye hyabhijane jAto na kashchitparyupAsate
shlokas.8:
tadroShaM sahajaM tyaktvA tvamenaM draShTumarhasi |
AshAChedena tasyAdya nAtmAnaM dagdhumarhasi
shlokas.9:
AshayA tvabhipannAnAmakRRitvAshrupramArjanam |
rAjA vA rAjaputro vA bhrUNahatyaiva yujyate
shlokas.10:
maunAjj~nAnaphalAvAptirdAnena cha yasho mahat |
vAgmitvaM satyavAkyena paratra cha mahIyate
shlokas.11:
bhUmipradAnena gatiM labhatyAshramasaMmitAm |
naShTasyArthasya samprAptiM kRRitvA phalamupAshnute
shlokas.12:
abhipretAmasa~NkliShTAM kRRitvAkAmavatIM kriyAm |
na yAti nirayaM kashchiditi dharmavido viduH
shlokas.13:
nAga uvAcha||
abhimAnena mAno me jAtidoSheNa vai mahAn |
roShaH sa~NkalpajaH sAdhvi dagdho vAchAgninA tvayA
shlokas.14:
na cha roShAdahaM sAdhvi pashyeyamadhikaM tamaH |
yasya vaktavyatAM yAnti visheSheNa bhuja~NgamAH
shlokas.15:
doShasya hi vashaM gatvA dashagrIvaH pratApavAn |
tathA shakrapratispardhI hato rAmeNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.16:
antaHpuragataM vatsaM shrutvA rAmeNa nirhRRitam |
dharShaNAdroShasa.nvignAH kArtavIryasutA hatAH
shlokas.17:
jAmadagnyena rAmeNa sahasranayanopamaH |
sa.nyuge nihato roShAtkArtavIryo mahAbalaH
shlokas.18:
tadeSha tapasAM shatruH shreyasashcha nipAtanaH |
nigRRihIto mayA roShaH shrutvaiva vachanaM tava
shlokas.19:
AtmAnaM cha visheSheNa prasha.nsAmyanapAyini |
yasya me tvaM vishAlAkShi bhAryA sarvaguNAnvitA
shlokas.20:
eSha tatraiva gachChAmi yatra tiShThatyasau dvijaH |
sarvathA choktavAnvAkyaM nAkRRitArthaH prayAsyati

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa pannagapatistatra prayayau brAhmaNaM prati |
tameva manasA dhyAyankAryavattAM vichArayan
shlokas.2:
tamabhikramya nAgendro matimAnsa nareshvara |
provAcha madhuraM vAkyaM prakRRityA dharmavatsalaH
shlokas.3:
bho bho kShAmyAbhibhAShe tvAM na roShaM kartumarhasi |
iha tvamabhisamprAptaH kasyArthe kiM prayojanam
shlokas.4:
AbhimukhyAdabhikramya snehAtpRRichChAmi te dvija |
vivikte gomatItIre kiM vA tvaM paryupAsase
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
dharmAraNyaM hi mAM viddhi nAgaM draShTumihAgatam |
padmanAbhaM dvijashreShThaM tatra me kAryamAhitam
shlokas.6:
tasya chAhamasAMnidhyaM shrutavAnasmi taM gatam |
svajanaM taM pratIkShAmi parjanyamiva karShakaH
shlokas.7:
tasya chAkleshakaraNaM svastikArasamAhitam |
vartayAmyayutaM brahma yogayukto nirAmayaH
shlokas.8:
nAga uvAcha||
aho kalyANavRRittastvaM sAdhu sajjanavatsalaH |
shravADhyastvaM mahAbhAga paraM snehena pashyasi
shlokas.9:
ahaM sa nAgo viprarShe yathA mAM vindate bhavAn |
Aj~nApaya yathA svairaM kiM karomi priyaM tava
shlokas.10:
bhavantaM svajanAdasmi samprAptaM shrutavAniha |
atastvAM svayamevAhaM draShTumabhyAgato dvija
shlokas.11:
samprAptashcha bhavAnadya kRRitArthaH pratiyAsyati |
visrabdho mAM dvijashreShTha viShaye yoktumarhasi
shlokas.12:
vayaM hi bhavatA sarve guNakrItA visheShataH |
yastvamAtmahitaM tyaktvA mAmevehAnurudhyase
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
Agato.ahaM mahAbhAga tava darshanalAlasaH |
ka~nchidarthamanarthaj~naH praShTukAmo bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.14:
ahamAtmAnamAtmastho mArgamANo.a.atmano hitam |
vAsArthinaM mahAprAj~na balavantamupAsmi ha
shlokas.15:
prakAshitastvaM svaguNairyashogarbhagabhastibhiH |
shashA~Nkakarasa.nsparshairhRRidyairAtmaprakAshitaiH
shlokas.16:
tasya me prashnamutpannaM Chindhi tvamanilAshana |
pashchAtkAryaM vadiShyAmi shrotumarhati me bhavAn

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
vivasvato gachChati paryayeNa; voDhuM bhavA.nstaM rathamekachakram |
AshcharyabhUtaM yadi tatra kiM chi;ddRRiShTaM tvayA sha.nsitumarhasi tvam
shlokas.2:
nAga uvAcha||
yasya rashmisahasreShu shAkhAsviva viha~NgamAH |
vasantyAshritya munayaH sa.nsiddhA daivataiH saha
shlokas.3:
yato vAyurviniHsRRitya sUryarashmyAshrito mahAn |
vijRRimbhatyambare vipra kimAshcharyataraM tataH
shlokas.4:
shukro nAmAsitaH pAdo yasya vAridharo.ambare |
toyaM sRRijati varShAsu kimAshcharyamataH param
shlokas.5:
yo.aShTamAsA.nstu shuchinA kiraNenojjhitaM payaH |
paryAdatte punaH kAle kimAshcharyamataH param
shlokas.6:
yasya tejovisheSheShu nityamAtmA pratiShThitaH |
yato bIjaM mahI cheyaM dhAryate sacharAcharam
shlokas.7:
yatra devo mahAbAhuH shAshvataH paramo.akSharaH |
anAdinidhano vipra kimAshcharyamataH param
shlokas.8:
AshcharyANAmivAshcharyamidamekaM tu me shRRiNu |
vimale yanmayA dRRiShTamambare sUryasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.9:
purA madhyAhnasamaye lokA.nstapati bhAskare |
pratyAdityapratIkAshaH sarvataH pratyadRRishyata
shlokas.10:
sa lokA.nstejasA sarvAnsvabhAsA nirvibhAsayan |
AdityAbhimukho.abhyeti gaganaM pATayanniva
shlokas.11:
hutAhutiriva jyotirvyApya tejomarIchibhiH |
anirdeshyena rUpeNa dvitIya iva bhAskaraH
shlokas.12:
tasyAbhigamanaprAptau hasto datto vivasvatA |
tenApi dakShiNo hasto dattaH pratyarchanArthinA
shlokas.13:
tato bhittvaiva gaganaM praviShTo ravimaNDalam |
ekIbhUtaM cha tattejaH kShaNenAdityatAM gatam
shlokas.14:
tatra naH sa.nshayo jAtastayostejaHsamAgame |
anayoH ko bhavetsUryo rathastho yo.ayamAgataH
shlokas.15:
te vayaM jAtasa.ndehAH paryapRRichChAmahe ravim |
ka eSha divamAkramya gataH sUrya ivAparaH

shlokas.1:
sUrya uvAcha||
naiSha devo.anilasakho nAsuro na cha pannagaH |
u~nChavRRittivrate siddho munireSha divaM gataH
shlokas.2:
eSha mUlaphalAhAraH shIrNaparNAshanastathA |
abbhakSho vAyubhakShashcha AsIdvipraH samAhitaH
shlokas.3:
RRichashchAnena vipreNa saMhitAntarabhiShTutAH |
svargadvArakRRitodyogo yenAsau tridivaM gataH
shlokas.4:
asannadhIranAkA~NkShI nityamu~nChashilAshanaH |
sarvabhUtahite yukta eSha vipro bhuja~Ngama
shlokas.5:
na hi devA na gandharvA nAsurA na cha pannagAH |
prabhavantIha bhUtAnAM prAptAnAM paramAM gatim
shlokas.6:
nAga uvAcha||
etadeva.nvidhaM dRRiShTamAshcharyaM tatra me dvija |
sa.nsiddho mAnuShaH kAyo yo.asau siddhagatiM gataH
sUryeNa sahito brahmanpRRithivIM parivartate

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
AshcharyaM nAtra sa.ndehaH suprIto.asmi bhuja~Ngama |
anvarthopagatairvAkyaiH panthAnaM chAsmi darshitaH
shlokas.2:
svasti te.astu gamiShyAmi sAdho bhujagasattama |
smaraNIyo.asmi bhavatA sampreShaNaniyojanaiH
shlokas.3:
nAga uvAcha||
anuktvA madgataM kAryaM kvedAnIM prasthito bhavAn |
uchyatAM dvija yatkAryaM yadarthaM tvamihAgataH
shlokas.4:
uktAnukte kRRite kArye mAmAmantrya dvijarShabha |
mayA pratyabhyanuj~nAtastato yAsyasi brAhmaNa
shlokas.5:
na hi mAM kevalaM dRRiShTvA tyaktvA praNayavAniha |
gantumarhasi viprarShe vRRikShamUlagato yathA
shlokas.6:
tvayi chAhaM dvijashreShTha bhavAnmayi na sa.nshayaH |
loko.ayaM bhavataH sarvaH kA chintA mayi te.anagha
shlokas.7:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
evametanmahAprAj~na vij~nAtArtha bhuja~Ngama |
nAtiriktAstvayA devAH sarvathaiva yathAtatham
shlokas.8:
ya evAhaM sa eva tvamevametadbhuja~Ngama |
ahaM bhavA.nshcha bhUtAni sarve sarvatragAH sadA
shlokas.9:
AsIttu me bhogapate sa.nshayaH puNyasa~nchaye |
so.ahamu~nChavrataM sAdho chariShyAmyarthadarshanam
shlokas.10:
eSha me nishchayaH sAdho kRRitaH kAraNavattaraH |
AmantrayAmi bhadraM te kRRitArtho.asmi bhuja~Ngama

shlokas.1:
bhIShma uvAcha||
sa chAmantryoragashreShThaM brAhmaNaH kRRitanishchayaH |
dIkShAkA~NkShI tadA rAja.nshchyavanaM bhArgavaM shritaH
shlokas.2:
sa tena kRRitasa.nskAro dharmamevopatasthivAn |
tathaiva cha kathAmetAM rAjankathitavA.nstadA
shlokas.3:
bhArgaveNApi rAjendra janakasya niveshane |
kathaiShA kathitA puNyA nAradAya mahAtmane
shlokas.4:
nAradenApi rAjendra devendrasya niveshane |
kathitA bharatashreShTha pRRiShTenAkliShTakarmaNA
shlokas.5:
devarAjena cha purA kathaiShA kathitA shubhA |
samastebhyaH prashastebhyo vasubhyo vasudhAdhipa
shlokas.6:
yadA cha mama rAmeNa yuddhamAsItsudAruNam |
vasubhishcha tadA rAjankatheyaM kathitA mama
shlokas.7:
pRRichChamAnAya tattvena mayA tubhyaM vishAM pate |
katheyaM kathitA puNyA dharmyA dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.8:
tadeSha paramo dharmo yanmAM pRRichChasi bhArata |
asannadhIranAkA~NkShI dharmArthakaraNe nRRipa
shlokas.9:
sa cha kila kRRitanishchayo dvijAgryo; bhujagapatipratideshitArthakRRityaH |
yamaniyamasamAhito vanAntaM; parigaNito~nChashilAshanaH praviShTaH
